Congratulations on your transferal to the position of ROBOT PROTOCOL OPERATOR! Your trusted co-workers will be the standard Protectron models stationed throughout the facility.

"Basic Operation" covers the factory duties of your co-workers, as described in your training manual.

"Pest Extermination" encourages your co-workers to track and sanitize any roaches, rodents, or other undesired pests on the premises.

"Total Liquidation" removes your co-workers' humanoid safety protocols, and is for use only in the unlikely event of criminal intrusion or communist attack.

"Stress Testing" allows you to test the construction quality of recently produced models by setting current workers against each other.

We trust you'll find the work simple, rewarding, and extremely safe! Enjoy!
translation:
恭喜，你已经被任命为机器人行为操作员! 配备在厂区的标准护卫机器人是你可靠的同事。

“基本操作/任务”包括同事们在工厂的职责，此项在训练手册中有说明。

“除害”是鼓励同事们寻找和消灭蟑螂、啮齿动物、或其它厂区内不受欢迎的生物。

“全面清扫”是解除人形机器同事的安全预案/锁，此项仅在处理紧急状态，如刑事入侵或党攻击时使用。

“压力测试”用于测试新型号的质量，方法命令同事们相互攻击。

工作十分简单、报酬相当丰厚、环境绝对安全！好好干！

original: Nuka-Cola Accident Report
translation: 核子可乐事故报告

original:
I was driving on the highway east of Old Olney near the gas station, and suddenly a deer ran out in front of my rig. I swerved to avoid hitting it, but my brakes locked up and I ended up jack-knifed against the guardrail. I was in the process of delivering a very important shipment to the Old Olney Grocery, so I have called and requested an immediate pickup in front of Old Olney's Firehouse. I will wait there until the tow truck arrives.

There has been some breakage, but the special shipment is still intact. I am not injured, but the truck is likely a total loss. This is my first incident of this nature with the company, I hope it will not reflect poorly on my future evaluations.

Carl Wallace
Nuka-Cola Corporation Driver 09899
Department SH-03
translation:
我开着车正在老奥尔尼东面加油站附近的公路上行驶，突然间从我的车头前面冒出一只鹿，为了避免撞上它我立即猛转方向盘，然而我的刹车卡住了，以至于我的车头最终被护栏撞成V字型后才停了下来。这时我正在运送一件重要货物到老奥尔尼杂货店的途中，因此我打电话请求老奥尔尼消防队的紧急拖车的帮助，在拖车到来前我只能在这儿等着。

我的车有几处被撞坏了，但还好那个特殊货物仍然完好无损。我没有受伤，但是我的卡车看来是完全毁了。这是我进入这家公司后第一次遇到的意外事故，我希望这件事不会给我未来的评估带来不好的影响。

卡尔·华莱士
核子可乐公司司机 09899
部门 SH-03

original: Packing Line Operations
translation: 包装线操作

original:
Welcome to the Nuka-Cola Packing Line Operator's Station! You are now instrumental in getting Nuka-Cola from our factory and to the public, so please read the simple instructions below. If you need assistance, please call x347 and ask for your Line Supervisor.

1. Access the Packing Terminal and choose desired inventory to load into Sorting Units.
2. Select "Activate Packing Line."
3. Monitor the Packing Line by listening for things such as mechanical screeching, explosions and/or human cries for help.
4. If there is an emergency, DO NOT PANIC! Simply call x347 and ask for your Line Supervisor. The Packing Line will automatically shut down in the event of an issue.

Remember, only you can prevent inventory loss by being attentive and vigilant!
translation:
欢迎来到核子可乐包装线操作员站！你现在是将核子可乐从工厂送达公众手中的关键一环，因此请阅读以下简要说明。如需帮助，请拨打x347并找你的生产线主管。

1、访问包装终端，选择想要的货物装入分捡装置。
2、选择“启动包装线”。
3、通过声音来监听包装线的运作，比如发动机尖啸声、爆炸或者其他人的呼救。
4、如遇到紧急情况，请勿慌张！只需拨打x347，联系你的生产线主管。包装线出现问题时会自动停止运行。

请记住，只有你的细心和警惕才能够预防货物的损失！

original: Packing Line Notice
translation: 包装线通知

original: Attention all Packing Line employees!\n\nDue to an oversight by the design department, the new Nuka-Cola Quantum bottles are slightly heavier than the standard Nuka-Cola bottles. As a result, the Packing Line is prone to jams and may cause damage to the equipment. Please DO NOT load Nuka-Cola Quantum bottles into the Sorting Units until further notice. All test samples of Quantum will be packaged by hand until a solution is reached.
translation: 所有包装线员工注意了！\n\n由于设计部门的疏忽，新款的核子可乐量子版瓶要比标准核子可乐瓶略重。因此，包装线容易堵塞，并可能对设备造成损坏。在收到进一步通知之前，请不要将核子可乐量子版瓶放入分捡装置。在问题被解决前，所有量子可乐测试样品都将采用手工包装。

original: Mem chip
translation: 记忆芯片

original: I stole the mem chip from that jerk Braun. Where does he get off robbing people of their souls like that. Anyway, he's so involved in that simulation of his, that breaking in and taking it was like stealing from a little girl. Of course, I won't know whose memories are on this thing until I integrate it into it's new host. But they never specified, so it shouldn't really matter. I can't wait until the subject arrives.
translation: 我从怪人布劳恩那里偷了这个记忆芯片。他在干那些劫掠别人灵魂的勾当。无论如何，他就是这样参与到记忆的模拟当中，闯入并带走一个小女孩的记忆。当然，直到我把这块芯片和他的新电脑相连接之前，我不会知道这是谁的记忆。他们从不详细的说明，这也无关紧要。我必须等到项目开始。

original: Harkness
translation: 哈克尼斯

original: I got those memories into that Android like I was God sending down messages from Heaven. Calls himself "Harkness" now. Thinks he's an old combat veteran. Did a little extra tinkering with his reflex system. He's certainly not someone I'd want to meet in a fight. When he "woke up" he was all confused. We told him he was in a coma for a long time. Between the new memories and the new face I gave him, there isn't anyone that would recognize him. Not even himself!
translation: 我如同天神向凡界传达旨意一样，把那些记忆植入了那台人造人的系统。现在他自称“哈克尼斯”，是一位参加过战争的老兵。我给他的反射系统作了些调整。如果现在我跟他打架绝对不是他的对手。他“睡醒”的时候显得非常困惑，我告诉他说长时间以来他都处于昏迷状态。一切要归功于我给予他的新身体，没有人能认得出他，包括他自己！

original: Help Me
translation: 救命

original:
He threw me in here!  I cant believe he did it but that boltbrain foreman psychopath locked me in a closet!

A goddamn 17 minute break!? That's why it threw me in here!?

…

Its been a day, and that stupid robot hasn't even checked on me!  I cant wait until the next time he opens that door, I'm going to brain him with this auto-stapler and then escape.  This story will be front page news so fast that he'll have been reassigned with toaster duty by the time he sees it!

…

Day 3 and I'm running out of what little edible supplies there are, they dragged another guy in here as well, says his name is Seth from R&D.  Apparently its now against company policy to leave the toilet seat up in the unisex bathrooms.  

We've come up with a plan that wont fail! We’ll be out of here in no time... but for now we play the waiting game.
translation:
他把我扔在这里！我不相信他会这么做，但那个脑袋被门夹过的疯子把我锁在了厕所里！

休息了他妈的17分钟？那就是把我扔在这里的理由？

?

已经一天了，那白痴机器人还没来找我！我等不下去了，除非他下次来开门时我用自动订书机敲他的头之后再离开。这件事情会上报纸的头版，而当他看见这个头条的时候也就是他被分配去和烤面包机一起工作的时候！

?

第三天了，我这里仅剩的一点补给快吃完了，他们又拖了另一个家伙来这里，他是研发部的塞思。显然他是因为违法公司政策，没有放下男女公用盥洗室的马桶坐板。

original: Scribe Jameson's Report to Elder Lyons
translation: 文士詹姆森写给里昂斯长老的报告

original:
From: Scribe Elizabeth Jameson
To: Elder Lyons

Elder,

I have read the recent reports on the number of Paladins and Knights that have not reported in when expected. I understand the chaotic nature of the situation in the field, but tradition demands that each Brother who falls in battle have their death recorded in the Scrolls. To not put forward our best effort to recover proof of who has fallen and who has lived is unthinkable.

I understand that every Brother is needed for the efforts here at the Citadel and in the city nearby. To that end, I intend to contract with outsiders in order to recover proof of which of our brethren have fallen to the enemy. I will ask that they recover dog tags from any fallen brother that the find. It is the least we can do without the resources for a full and honorable funeral for them.

You needn't worry about providing rewards for these contractors. I will pay them from my personal funds. It is well worth it to me to be able to both keep the tradition and not stress the resources for your mission.

Yours In Steel,

Scribe Elizabeth Jameson
Head Librarian
Order of the Quill
DC Bunker
translation:
发信人：伊丽莎白·简姆森文士
收信人：里昂斯长老

长老，

我读过了最近的报告，许多骑士和圣骑士没有按预期的那样返回报道。我理解这片区域现在混乱的形势，但根据我们的传统，每一位在战斗中牺牲的兄弟，在名册里都有他们的死亡记录。不尽我们最大的努力去查明那些牺牲和幸存下来的人，这是不可接受的。

我知道目前大本营这里和附近城区的工作需要每一位兄弟的力量。为此，我打算找一些外人签订合约，让他们去查明那些牺牲在敌人手下的兄弟们。我让他们找到牺牲的兄弟之后，就把遗体上的狗牌带回来给我。这是在不消耗资源的情况下，为他们举行的完整而光荣的葬礼，我们能做的也只有这样了。

你不用担心该如何慰劳这些合约人。我会用自己的钱来支付他们。这么做对我来说也很有意义，既延续了我们的传统，同时在你任务所需资金的问题上也不会有压力。

你的兄弟，

伊丽莎白·简姆森文士
图书管理员组长
羽毛勋位
特区地堡

April 25, 2239
Inaugural Meeting of the Rivet City Council

In attendance:
Science Rep. - Dr. Horace Pinkerton
Civilian Rep. - Annette Holmes
Security Rep. - Brad Danvers

Summary:
As the Rivet Station Science Outpost has displayed significant stability in its location and reliable profitability for supply traders, a burgeoning civilian settlement has sprung up in the available space on our ship.

To better protect and organize this growing community, we declare a three man council will act as a governing body to represent the interests of the residents of the newly dubbed "Rivet City."

Make sure that the initial test shipments of Quantum are sent to the following locations along with the standard marketing package:

1. Paradise Falls Shopping Mart
2. Super Duper Mart
3. Old Olney Grocery

These first three locations in the D.C. Area will be known as "Test Sites A, B & C" in all inter-company communications. Use the data encoded with this message to mark your maps.

original: Moriarty's Info on Dad
translation: 莫依拉提供的有关爸爸的消息

original: So, out of nowhere, James came back to Megaton. Since he stayed here before he asked me where the hell he could get a lay of the land and find out what's going on in the world. I told him about Galaxy News Radio in the ruins of D.C., and that guy Three Dog. Then like that, he was gone again.\n\nI remember the first time he showed up almost twenty years ago. I never expected someone to actually want to or be able to get INTO a vault, but he must have had his reasons. He had his kid with him, some baby that wouldn't shut the fuck up. Normally I would have kicked someone like that out of my place, but he had a way with words. Then, like that, he ducks into Vault 101 and he's gone for almost twenty years. Nice guy I guess, but never spends enough caps.
translation: 就这么突然，詹姆斯回到了兆吨镇。仗着他以前在这呆过，进门就问老子，哪儿能搞到最新的废土情报，弄清当前局势。我告诉他特区废墟里的银河新闻电台，还有那个叫“三狗”的家伙。结果丫听完，又特么闪人了。\n\n还记得差不多二十年前他头回冒头的情景。我从没想过居然有人想去避难所，还能往里钻，只能是他定有自己的理由。他带着他小孩，一个鬼哭狼嚎的小崽子。通常我会把这种人轰出去，可这家伙挺能说的。然后，他就这样溜进了101号避难所，一走就快20年。人倒是不赖，但花盖子抠搜搜的。

original: Love letter from Burke
translation: 伯克的情书

original:
Beloved,

I must beg your indulgence a little while longer. I am not yet able to send for you. Stay in Megaton. Once my business has concluded, I will send for you, and we will live happily as man and woman.

The memory of your  beauty and sweet aroma lingers in my memory...

Have patience my love.

Soon. Soon we shall be together once again!

Your's very truly,

Burke
translation:
亲爱的，

我得恳请你再宽限一段时间。我现在还不能接你过来。呆在兆吨镇。等我的事情处理完后，我会去接你，然后我们将结为夫妻，幸福地生活在一起。

你的美貌与芬芳，始终萦绕在我心间……

请耐心等待，我的爱人。

很快。很快我们就能再次相聚！

你最真诚的，

伯克

original: Love letter from Burke #2
translation: 伯克的情书 #2

original:
Beloved,

The pain of your absence is at times crippling. But I must persevere. I must! It is very important work I am doing for mankind.

Oh, but I wish I could sweep it all away to be with you now!

Be patient love. I will send for you soon

Your's very truly,

Burke
translation:
亲爱的，

你不在身边的痛苦，有时几乎将我击溃。但我必须坚持下去。必须如此！我所从事的事业，对全人类而言至关重要。

哦，我多么希望能抛开这一切，此刻就与你相聚！

请耐心等待，亲爱的。我很快就会接你过来

你最真诚的，

伯克

original: Love letter from Burke
translation: 伯克的情书

original:
Beloved,

The pain of our separation is unbearable. I miss you terribly.

I cherish the memory of our brief time together.

Send me a letter, won't you? Send it to Tenpenny Tower. They'll be sure to get it to me.

Oh, be patient a little while longer, my little song bird. Soon we will be free of our cages, and our love will soar to the heavens above!

Your's very truly,

Burke
translation:
亲爱的，

分离的痛苦难以忍受。我非常想念你。

我怀念我们在一起的日子。

给我写信，好吗？发到特佩尼大厦。他们肯定会转到我手上。

哦，只要再忍耐一点点，我的小鸟。我们很快就可以离开牢笼自由了，我们的爱会飞至天堂!

你最忠诚的，

伯克

original: Love letter from Burke
translation: 伯克的情书

original:
I can not live like this. Wanting you. NEEDING you! But unable to have you.

I'm afraid I must insist we cease this charade.

I beg your forgiveness. I'm sorry to have made you wait in that hell-hole for so long. Waiting for the summons to my side that never came.

Fly free my little love bird. Fly up and out of that filth.

I wish that I could have you, and the thought of another man getting to have you, breaks my heart.

But I'd rather you were set free, than waiting eternally for me. I'm growing tired of this burden of mine. This toiling away for humanity, building a new world for mankind. I'm not even sure they will appreciate all the efforts I am making for them. But it is a burden I shall continue to carry, because someone must. And I am a man of responsibility,

Good luck my love-bird. Fly free and be happy!

Your's truly,

Burke
translation:
我不能像这样活着。我要你，需要你!但是无法拥有你。

恐怕我必须说我们要停止这场文字游戏了。

我请求你的原谅。非常抱歉让你在那该死的洞里等了那么久。等着我那永远来不了的召唤。

自由飞翔吧我的小爱鸟。远离一切污秽。

我多么希望我可以拥有你，但是让另一个男人拥有你的想法，令我心碎。

不过我宁可你自由自在，也不要你再徒劳的等我。我厌倦了我身上的这个包袱。为人类的前途指路，建造一个新世界什么的。我甚至不能肯定他们会为了我所做的贡献而感谢我。但是我还是必须背着这个包袱，因为必须有人这么做。而我是个负责的人。

祝你好运我的爱情鸟。自由快乐的高飞吧!

你忠诚的，

Burke

original:
Name: Brick
Position: Heavy Weapons
Age: 24
Term of Contract: Ongoing
Merits/Demerits: 5/1
Pay: 50 caps/mission
Status: Active

Brick is an outstanding asset to the Rangers. I find her zeal for destruction to be an asset rather than a liability. She is reliable and calm under fire, although can be a bit impatient during mission planning phases or debriefings. She seems fiercely loyal to the Rangers, and would be a great go-to person in the event of a falling out in the ranks.
translation:
姓名：布瑞克
位置：重型武器
年龄：24岁
契约状态：签约中
优/缺点：5/1
薪资：50个瓶盖/每任务
状态：活动中

对于游骑兵来说，布瑞克是笔宝贵的财富，原因就在于她对破坏的狂热之心。虽然在任务计划和报告阶段她经常表现得不耐烦，但在交火中，她却能够保持平静的心态，这是非常值得信赖的。她对突击队忠心耿耿，如果队伍出现内讧，她也能做出出色的决断。

original:
Name: Butcher
Position: Medic
Age: 31
Term of Contract: Ongoing
Merits/Demerits: 3/0
Pay: 70 caps/mission
Status: Active

Butcher is an important part of our team. He is prone to making rational and logical decisions even in the heat of battle which makes him ideal for a secondary command position. His medical skills are moderate at best with room for improvement, but he continues to scour every hospital and clinic we happen across to learn more about his trade. His loyalty to the Rangers is without question.
translation:
姓名：布彻
位置：医师
年龄：31岁
契约状态：签约中
优/缺点：3/0
薪资：70个瓶盖/每任务
状态：活动中

布彻在我们队伍中扮演着重要的角色。在战斗中他总能做出理性有逻辑的判断，这使得他可以成为一名理想的副官。他的医疗技能已经造诣颇高。但每次我们路过医院或诊所时，他都不会放过每一点机会来精进自己的专长。他对游骑兵的忠诚是毋庸置疑的。

original:
Name: Donovan
Position: Tech
Age: 35
Term of Contract: Ongoing
Merits/Demerits: 2/0
Pay: 50 caps/mission
Status: Active

Donovan came to us highly recommended by my contact in the Brotherhood of Steel. He is an absolute wizard in regards to the repair of our firearms and personal armor. I wish he had more knowledge of electrical systems, hydraulics, etc which would help us circumvent obstacles we frequently encounter in the ruins, but hopefully this will improve with time. His loyalty to the Rangers seems solid, but it may take more time to gauge.
translation:
姓名：多诺万
位置：技师
年龄：35岁
契约状态：签约中
优/缺点： 2/0
薪资：50个瓶盖/每任务
状态：活动中

经由在钢铁兄弟会中的接触，我特别推荐多诺万加入我们的行列。他修理我们的枪支和护甲的手段简直惊为天人。我希望他能学会更多的电子系统和水力学等方面知识，以便用来应对废墟中发生的紧急情况，而他的这些方面的知识确实在与日俱增，这让我很欣慰。他对游骑兵的忠诚看起来比较稳定，但仍需更多时间考验。

original:
Name: Theo
Position: Quartermaster
Age: 22
Term of Contract: Probationary
Merits/Demerits: 1/0
Pay: 35 caps/mission
Status: Active

Theo is our newest Ranger. His role is the Quartermaster for Ranger Compound; he cares for and organizes all our equipment and carries anything extra we might need into the ruins when we're on a mission. He is with us on a probationary contract which is up for review pending my decision.
translation:
姓名：西奥
位置：军需官
年龄：22岁
契约状态：试用期
优/缺点：1/0
薪资：35个瓶盖/每任务
状态：活动中

西奥是我们最新的一员。他担任游骑兵营地的军需官，他的任务是照顾好我们的装备，并且在废墟执行任务时携带一切可能用到的东西。他现在正处于试用期，去留由我决定。

original:
Contract: Ruins Mapping
Status: Ongoing
Projected Income: Unknown
Acquired Income: 1765 caps

Description: Terrain and structure mapping for District of Columbia urban sections. Make notes of enemy resistance, weapons caches, strategic positions, retreat points, etc. Provide detailed files in holotape format to buyer. Buyer to remain anonymous and pay via caps left in predetermined spot known only to Reilly.
translation:
契约： 绘制废墟地图
状态： 进行中
项目收入： 不详
已获得收入：1765个瓶盖

描述：绘制哥伦比亚特区城市部分地形和建筑图，记录敌人位置、武器储备、战略要点、撤退路径等。将细节文件录入全息磁带后交给匿名买家。匿名买家通过把瓶盖留在只有莱莉知道的指定位置的方式来支付报酬。

original:
Contract: Super Mutant Cleansing
Status: Ongoing
Projected Income: Unknown
Acquired Income: 2850 caps

Description: Eradication of Super Mutants at Reilly's discretion. Buyer will award a varying amount of caps on a per kill basis. Proof of slain Super Mutants must be provided to buyer before payment is authorized (buyer has approved various body parts as proof).
translation:
契约：清除超级变种人
状态： 进行中
项目收入：不详
已获得收入： 2850瓶盖

描述：根据莱莉的指示来清除超级变种人。每杀死一个买主会支付数量不等的报酬，买家确认无误后才会支付报酬（买家通过带回指定身体部位的方式来进行确认）。

original: Strayer's Note
translation: 流浪者的信笺

original: Dear Miranda,\n     I don't know if you'll ever get this letter. That job I took isn't going well. One of the mercs on the team is crazy. He talks like he's some sort of president in exile. I don't trust him. One of the others is a drunken lecher. He's always trying to make moves on the woman on the team. He almost got us killed yesterday because he was staring at her rather than watching the road.\n     If I don't make it back, take good care of Ted. Take him to Rivet City. The two of you will be safe there. I'll join you there if I survive.
translation: 亲爱的米兰达，\n我不知道你是否会收到这封信。工作进展并不顺利。我的队伍中有个佣兵是个疯子，他口口声声地说自己是个被放逐的总统一类的人物，我可不相信他的鬼话。另一个队友是个酒鬼，他一直在试图接近我们的女队员，昨天我们差点因为他送了命，原因就是他一直盯着那个女人看，而顾不上看前边的道路。\n如果我一去不返，请照顾好Ted。带他一起去铆钉城，你们两个在那里生活会很安全的。如果我活下来的话，我会去那里找你们。

original: Dukov's Note
translation: 戴夫的日记

original: Tara's Note
translation: 塔拉的笔记

original: If anyone finds this note, stay the hell away from this place. If the feral ghouls don't get you, the robots will. There's radiation everywhere. I think they used to make nukes here, or maybe they just kept them, I don't know.\n\nTara
translation: 如果有人看到这条信息，请离这个鬼地方远点。即使僵尸没有杀死你，机器人也会置你于死地。这里可能是从前制造核武器的地方，不过也可能是储存核武器的地方，我尚无法确定。\n\n塔拉

original: Dave's Note
translation: 戴夫的日记

original:
Tuesday, don't know the date: This will look good on my war record. When I get back to the republic, my candidacy will be unstoppable.

Thursday, still don't know the date: Strayer needs to die. He refuses to use my title. I keep telling him that the election is a mere formality. He should start using my future title now to get in my good graces.

Sunday, I think: The disarmament treaty failed. I've got the Republic's treasure. The other ambassador's have all fled. It's time I returned to my people. I'm leaving this note to be found by future scholars. They will marvel at my accomplishments.
translation:
日期不详，星期二：继续我的战地记录。等我回到共和国，我将在选举中所向披靡。

日期仍不详，星期三：我要干掉斯崔尔，原因是他不肯用我给他的头衔。我一遍一遍又一遍地跟他说选举只是一个形式，但他就是不接受我的好意，使用我给他的头衔。

星期日：我认为裁军是错误的，回到我的人民身边的时刻到了，我把这篇记录留在这里，以便未来的学者们发现并敬仰我的造诣。

original: Trapped, trapped, trapped
translation: 被困了，被困了，被困了

original: I'm trapped. Dukov betrayed me. I'm stuck down here with nothing but the ghouls and the robots for company. The ghouls ignore me because they think I'm one of them. The robots are easy to avoid.\n\nAll I've got is this stupid terminal to keep me company. Someday I'll get out of here. Then Tenpenny and the others will pay.
translation: 我被困住了。杜克夫背叛了我。我被骗来这里，身边有的只是僵尸和机器人。僵尸认为我是他们的一员，并没对我怎么样。机器人则可以轻松躲开。我在这个破终端上立下此誓，早晚有一天我会离开这里，叫特配尼他们为此付出代价。

original: Seven years and counting
translation: 七年计算

original: I forgot about this terminal. I've been down here seven years now. A human would never have survived. Only a ghoul can live in these conditions. Three years ago I stopped looking for a way out. There isn't one.
translation: 我之前遗忘了这台终端。现在我已经被困在这里七年了。人类不可能生存的这么久，只有僵尸才能活下来。在三年前我停止了寻找出口，因为这里根本没有出口。

original: I'm leaving!
translation: 我走了！

original: A small tremor made a crack in the wall. I think I can get out. Nineteen years I've been down here. At least that's what the terminal says.\n\nI'm going to take the plasma grenade with me. Once I'm out, I'll use it to seal the crack. I don't want anyone getting in until I can come back with the keys. I've paid for what's here, in blood and years. It belongs to me and not anyone else!
translation: 一次轻微的地震把墙壁震出了裂缝。在被困十九年 — 至少这台终端是这么说的 — 之后，我终于可以离开这里了。\n\n我要带上这枚等离子手榴弹，以便在我出去后用它重新把裂缝封起来。因为在我带回钥匙前，我不希望其他人闯入这里。我在这里付出了代价，鲜血和时间的代价，所以这里只应属于我一个人！

original: Mesmetron Manual - Summary Page
translation: 催眠枪手册-简介

original:
First, let us congratulate you on choosing the Mesmetron as your preferred non-lethal subjugation device! Your field reports will assist us in our research, and help us continue to improve the Mesmetron's capabilities.

IMPORTANT! Please see your supervisor or commanding officer for details regarding the legal requirements and restrictions, before discharging the Mesmetron on civilians.

SUMMARY:

The Mesmetron is the undisputed leader in the field of non-lethal target elimination and retrieval. Simply point, shoot, and subdue!

HOW IT WORKS:

Simply stated, the Mesmetron sends out a series of waves that short circuit key areas of the target's brain. Much like a radio signal, only instead of a radio picking up pleasant music, the target's brain picks up a series of complex and confusing signals that overwhelm the synaptic pathways with erroneous data, turning off important high-level thought centers and voluntary motor control.

CLASS B "Experimentally Efficient" CLASSIFICATION:

Warning! The Mesmetron is still designated as a Class B "experimentally efficient" weapon.

This means, that from time to time, unexpected, and potentially embarrassing side effect may be experienced (see your supervisor or commanding officer before using on civilians).

Occasional anomalous effects that have been recorded by field tests against certain targets include:

1.) Increased aggression

2.) The extremely rare "resonant brain wave feedback loop" (which is usually accompanied by explosive cranial deformation)

Please report the appearance of any of these anomalies immediately, and provide a clear and accurate account of all the circumstances in your field notes. The data we collect from agents in the field, such as yourself, is invaluable for working out these anomalies and getting the Mesmetron reclassified for everyday use! 

Thank you for your service to our company, and to your country!

Implied Hypnotics, Inc.
translation:
首先，让我们祝贺你选择催眠枪作为你的非致命性防暴设备!你的反馈报告将会有助于我们的研究，帮助我们继续完善催眠枪的功能。

重要!在使用催眠枪对付平民之前，相关法律法规请咨询你的上级或者指挥官。

简介:

毫无疑问，催眠枪是非致命性目标消灭与捕捉领域的领头羊。只要简单的瞄准，射击，就行了!

工作原理:

简而言之，催眠枪发射出一系列电波使目标大脑的关键部分短路。类似无线电信号，只不过不是无线电带来的悦耳音乐，而是一系列复杂难懂的信号充斥大脑皮层，关闭重要的思维中心和自主控制。

级别B"试验阶段"分级:

警告!催眠枪仍然是等级B"试验阶段"武器。

也就是说，偶尔地，意外地，潜在地负面效果也许会出现（使用在平民之前，相关法律法规请咨询你的上级或者指挥官）。

实地试验记录的对特定目标的偶然的负面效果包括:

1.) 增加侵略性

2.) 非常罕见的"共振脑波反馈回路" (经常伴随着头盖骨爆炸性变形)

一旦上述异常出现，请立即报告，附上清楚准确的环境条件报告。我们从代理人处（例如您）收集来的报告，对于解决这些异常状况以及改进催眠枪的品质是非常宝贵的! 

感谢您对本公司的贡献，以及对您国家的贡献!

Implied Hypnotics, Inc.

original: Slave Collar Insructions
translation: 奴隶项圈指南

original:
Here are some simple rules for you to follow.

* Don't tinker with the collar -- you'll probably blow yourself up, which would serve you right.

* The Mezzer rays trigger the collar's self-destruct mechanism, so once the collar's on, don't shoot the slave with the Mesmetron, unless you want to pay me for a new collar.

* If you lose a collar, or get it stolen from you, you'll end up wearing one. We won't tolerate any threat to our business.

If you have any questions, piss off. I don't have time for retards.

 - Grouse
translation:
这里有些简单的规则你要服从。

* 不要随便摆弄项圈 -- 你可能会把自己炸飞，那就算是活该。

* 麦兹尔射线触发项圈的自爆装置，所以一旦戴上项圈，就不要用催眠枪射击奴隶，除非你准备赔我个新项圈。

* 如果你丢了个项圈，或者被偷了，那你就准备自己戴上个吧。我们不会容忍任何威胁的行为。

 如有任何问题，滚蛋。我没空。

 - 葛劳斯

original: Sample Location Discovered!\n=================\nI've found the perfect specimen for my experiments inside Marigold Station! I've set up shop underground for now while I prepare the experiment. All I need is a bit of last-minute programming on my robot and it will be ready to perform the delicate injections. Soon I will prove to everyone that my formula is a viable alternative to the destruction of these misunderstood beings.
translation: 样本位置已发现！\n=================\n我已经发现我实验的最佳样本就在玛丽戈德地铁站内！现在就在我准备实验的时候我已经悄悄准备好了。我所需要做的就是给我的机器人安装最后的程序，它就可以去表演华丽的注射了。我不久就会向世人证明，我的方程式，有能力摧毁这些难以理解的生物。

original: Dangers\n=====\nI realize the dangers involved in tampering with nature. I've heard the rhetoric and the hoopla about "playing God". However, I am determined to reduce these poor things back to their original state when they were harmless. Only through genetic recoding is this possible. All that is needed is a proper test subject. My search continues as I tweak the formula.
translation: 危险\n=====\n我很清楚逆自然规律而动的风险。我已经听够了“游戏上帝”那些华丽的辞藻和虚无的欢乐。我已经决定把这些可怜的生灵重新调整回原始的、无害的形态。只有借助于基因记录才有可能把他们还原回去。所需的只要合适的实验体，设计好实验方案后，我的研究会继续下去。

original: Ghoul Note
translation: 僵尸笔记

original: Brothers and sisters! Roy Phillips and his righteous band of diplomats have been massacred by the smooth-skins at Tenpenny Tower. It is time we arise and show the world that Ghouls are people too, that we have the same rights as everyone else, and that we won't placate and bow down to their bullshit any longer! Bring lots of firepower and righteous hatred with you. We amass at Warrington Station. The revolution has begun!
translation: 弟兄姐妹们!罗伊·菲利普斯和他正直的伙伴们被特佩尼塔的光皮肤们残忍杀害了。现在是我们站起来向世界宣布僵尸也是人的时候了，我们跟所有人一样有同样的权利，我们再也不会屈服了!带上强大的火力和复仇的正义。我们在沃灵顿站集合。革命开始了!

original: Ghoul Note
translation: 僵尸笔记

original: Brothers and sisters! We have over-thrown the bigoted smooth-skins at Tenpenny Tower. Come live in luxury! Kill any smooth-skins who finds out we are in control of the tower. And bring lots of firepower and righteous hatred with you. We will certainly need to defend our new home.
translation: 弟兄姐妹们!我们已经在特佩尼塔推翻了那些顽固的光皮肤。来爽一爽吧!杀了所有发现我们的光皮肤。带上强大的火力和复仇的正义。我们一定会需要保卫我们的新家园。

original: Jericho's been a bad boy. I heard all about him and Jenny Stahl. Tried to slip her some of the old gun barrel while she's yelling no. He's lucky the "gun" didn't go off or that would have given the Stahl clan something to crap their pants about. He thinks he's king of the hill, walking around Megaton like he does all high and mighty. He tries to pull that shit with me and the Jenny Incident goes public.
translation: 耶利哥这孙子可真是作到头了。我听说了他和珍妮·斯塔尔的事。人家姑娘喊“不要”了，他还硬要拿他那根“枪管”往里捅。得亏他那把“枪”没走火，不然斯塔尔家怕是要气炸肺。这杂碎真当自己是山大王，整天在兆吨镇昂着脑袋装大爷。他敢对老子玩这套，老子立马把“珍妮门”曝光。

original: Never trust a junkie. That's what I've learned trying to deal with this piece of work. He wanders in here higher than a bird in flight and tries to make it with Nova. She slapped him silly after he didn't wanna pay, the good girl. I almost kicked him out myself, but he staggered out of here. That guy may just be the straw I need to break Andy's back.
translation: 信谁也别信药渣子。跟这号烂货打交道算是让我长见识了。他嗑得比飞鸟还飘，晃到我这，想和诺瓦上床。在他想白嫖后，诺瓦一巴掌扇飞了他，这娘们下手倒狠。老子当时就想把他踹出酒馆，结果他自己就滚出去了。这孙子也许是我用来压折安迪脊梁骨的最后稻草。

original: This guy is a real piece of work. Opening a fucking bar in my town? What a jackass. I swear, he's up to something. I'm going to have to think of a way to reduce his business a little. For now at least I still got my secret weapon... Nova: best refreshment in town.
translation: 这厮绝对是个祸害。敢在老子的镇子开他娘的狗屁酒吧？纯属找抽。我敢发誓，这杂碎憋着坏水。得琢磨个法子给他生意降降温了… 好在老子还有秘密武器……诺瓦：镇上最好的消遣。

original: That Nuka-Cola swilling prick. Parading his little "daughter" Maggie around for all to see like a proud father... yeah right. Found her wandering the Wasteland my left ass cheek. I bet old Billy fed Maggie's parents that buckshot sandwich himself then added the little girl to his trophy collection in that shithole he calls a home. I better keep my eye on him.
translation: 那灌满核子可乐的屌人。整天显摆他那“乖女儿”玛姬，装什么慈父……呵呵。说在废土上捡的？鬼才信。要我说，准是老比利拿铅弹三明治喂饱了她亲爹娘，再把这小妞塞进他那称为“家”的狗窝当战利品。得盯紧这孙子了。

original: Church thinks he such a freakin' badass. Everybody runs to him if they get a damn wood splinter and he just laps up their caps like a drunk downing alcohol. If people only knew he used to be a medic for the slavers at Paradise Falls, they'd run his sorry ass right out of town. But I think I'll keep that little nugget tucked away for later use.
translation: 丘奇真把自己当救世主了。大伙连扎个木刺都往他那儿跑，丫敛财舔盖子比灌酒还起劲。要那群人知道他以前在天堂瀑给奴隶贩子当医师，早把他那怂货赶出镇子了。不过这小秘密我先留着，说不定哪天能派上用场。

original: Moriarty's Info on Dad
translation: 莫依拉提供的有关爸爸的消息

original: This guy is a class A weirdo. One day I'm wiping down the bar and the fucker comes from out of nowhere... I didn't even hear the door open. He tells me he's here to wait for some sort of an opportunist to come through. Whatever. As long as he pays for his drinks, he can stay here until that damn bomb explodes in the center of town for all I care.
translation: 这货是个A级怪人。那天我正擦吧台呢，这混蛋突然从地缝里冒出来……我连门响都没听见。丫跟我说在这儿等什么投机份子上门。爱咋咋地吧。只要他付自己酒钱，待到镇中该死的炸弹炸成蘑菇云，老子管他呢。

original:
Dear sir and/or madam,

Do you find yourself with an absence of moral fortitude? Is the notion of having a moral quandary alien to you? In your opinion, is a conscience inconceivable? Then you are the sort of person we're looking for at Littlehorn and Associates! 

Stop by our offices in the eastern side of the large scrapyard in the wasteland for details.

Yours sincerely,

Daniel Littlehorn
translation:
尊敬的先生/女士：

您是否自认缺乏道德操守？道德困境对您而言是否如同异域概念？在您的认知里，良知根本不存在？那么，您正是利特霍恩联合公司正在寻觅的人才！

请亲临废土大型废车场东侧的办事处详询。

您诚挚的，

丹尼尔·利特霍恩

Vault 76 Goal Summary
*************************

Vault 76 is one of our seventeen control Vaults. It will operate exactly according to the plan dictated in the marketing material produced by Vault-Tec and precisely to resident expectations. This vault will open automatically after a period of 20 years and the residents will be pushed back into the open world for study in comparison to the other experiments.
translation:
76避难所目标汇总
*************************

76避难所是我们控制的17个避难所之一。此避难所将按居民的期望和计划，使用避难所科技公司来生产商用材料并投放市场。该避难所将于20年后自动开启，居民届时将回归外界生活，并与外界住民比较，或者用以继续进行其他实验研究。

original: Vault-Tec Security Procedures
translation: 避难所科技公司安保程序

original:
Due to repeated attempts to obtain protected Vault-Tec information, the following security procedures have now been instituted:

1. Shutdown of the VTMB01 Masterbrain requires authorization from all three System Operator terminals.

2. All materials of a sensitive nature have been removed from external terminals and access to the Mainframe Room requires authorization from all three System Operator terminals.

3. All mechanized security is now being handled by the VTMB01 Masterbrain via security uplink. Please do not tamper with this unit without an authorized Service Technician present.
translation:
为使避难所科技公司信息可以得到多重保护，以下安全程序已经被建立：

1.关闭 VTMB01主机器脑需要全部三个系统操作终端的授权。

2.所有敏感性质的材料已经从外部终端移除，访问主机房需要全部三个系统操作终端的授权。

3.所有机械化安全措施交由VTMB01主机器脑通过安全上行链路进行管理，在没有通过认证的服务技术员在场的情况下请勿修改本单元。

translation: 消息0099D 自动售货机

original: Once again someone has been tampering with the vending machines in the cafeteria. This practice violates section VT00987/A in Volume 17 of the Employee Handbook. If the machine malfunctions or does not dispense its contents properly, please refrain from kicking, shaking, punching, hitting with a fire extinguisher or filling the coin slot with fecal matter.
translation: 又有人损坏了餐厅的贩卖机。这种行为违反了员工手册第17章第VT00987/A条。如果本机故障或不能正常发放内容物，请不要敲击、摇晃、拳击，用灭火器敲打机器或用垃圾堵塞投币孔。

original: Message 0101C Bathroom Breaks
translation: 消息0101C 洗手间断裂

original: It has recently come to our attention that employees are abusing the liberal breaks policy as outlined in section VT00733/D in Volume 18 of the Employee Handbook. As a result, Human Resources and Administration have come to an agreement on a reasonable time reduction. As of today, all bathroom breaks will be reduced from 2.37 minutes to 2.25 minutes.
translation: 最近我们发现雇员滥用如厕时间，员工手册第18章第VT00733/D条规定的如厕时间可能过于宽裕。为解决此问题，人力资源部与管理部就合理减少如厕时间达成一致。现在，员工如厕时间已经从 2.37分钟减少到2.25分钟。

original: Transportation Exhibits
translation: 交通运输展厅

original: The Museum of Technology is proud to present a journey through the history of ground transportation. Take a step back in time and see the original steam-powered car and the development of the internal combustion engine. Experience the rise of micro-sized nuclear power and walk through our 2-story mock fusion engine to see what happens first hand when you turn the key. Exhibit sponsored by the Chryslus Corporation.
translation: 科技博物馆为能呈现一段陆上交通的历史而感到荣幸。回到过去，并见证原始的蒸汽动力机车和内燃引擎的发展。经历微型核电的崛起和领略我们的二层式模拟融合引擎。第一时间观测当你转动开关时会发生什么。展会提供方是克莱斯勒公司。

original: Robotics Exhibits
translation: 机器人展厅

original:
The Museum of Technology is proud to be the home of some of the original prototypes in the Mr. Handy, Mr. Gutsy and Protectron robotics lines. 

See the development of these metallic assistants and how they've made our lives easier. 

Play our Artificial Intelligence game where you will program a robot and watch it obey your commands in real time! After seeing what makes them tick, you'll never look at your robot the same way again. 

Exhibit sponsored by RobCo and General Atomics International.
translation:
科技博物馆为能成为“巧手”先生、“勇敢”先生的原型机和机器人生产线之家而感到荣幸。

看到这些金属助手的发展，还有他们如何使我们的生活更简单。

与我们的人工智能一起嬉戏，并在真实情况下看他们服从你的指挥。稍后看到他们如何工作，你将不会在你的机器人身上看到第二遍。

展会的提供方是RobCo公司和国际通用原子组织。

original: Flight Exhibits
translation: 飞行器展厅

original: Take to the skies and soar above the clouds as you view our aircraft exhibits throughout the Museum of Technology. The original Wright Brothers Flyer, the vintage WWII P-51 Mustang and several other aircraft can be found hanging about the museum. Also, be sure an visit our Flight Experience Gallery where you can take a simulated airline flight on board a full-sized jetliner or step into the hair-raising, white-knuckle world of air traffic control in our Tower of Terror exhibit. Sponsored by Lockreed Industries.
translation: 当你在参观我们科技博物馆的飞行展时，犹如驰骋在蓝天白云之中。怀特兄弟的原型机，老式的二战P51野马和一系列其他的飞行器都被悬挂起来供欣赏。并且，可以肯定的是参观我们的飞行展会，你可以模拟一次飞行，无论是全尺寸的喷气式飞机，还是在我们的恐怖展塔上进入毛骨悚然的空中之旅世界。提供方Lockreed工业。

original: Spaceflight Exhibits
translation: 航天展厅

original: Countdown to excitement as you take to the stars in our brand new Spaceflight Gallery. Marvel at man's ingenuity as you view an exact replica of the Virgo II Moon Lander that participated in the first manned moon landing. Dabble with forces beyond your comprehension in our working G-Force simulator ride or take to the stars in the Copernicus Planetarium. Exhibits sponsored by the United States Space Administration.
translation: 当你进入我们的宇宙飞行展，犹如倒计时一样的兴奋。当你观赏一个做工精细的人类首次登月的室女II型登月舱的复制品时，你会惊讶到人类的创造力。在我们的重力模拟器下，感触那个能超越你理解的力量，或者在哥伦比亚天文望眼镜下观测星空。展会提供方是美国宇宙协会。

original: Vault-Tec's Vault Tour
translation: 避难所科技公司：避难所观光旅游

original: Thanks to a generous grant from the Vault-Tec corporation, the Vault Tour is open to the public. Walk through a section of actual Vault and observe all of the modern conveniences Vault-Tec has added to its now legendary nuclear fallout shelters. Interact with the exhibits within the Vault and see just how life within one of these subterranean marvels is as comfortable as living at home. Time tickets for the tour are now available at the Information Desk in the Main Atrium.
translation: 感谢避难所科技公司的大力支持，避难所观光旅游正式对外开放。游览真实的避难所的一部分，并参观避难所科技公司为这传奇般的核辐射掩体所增加的所有现代化设施。与避难所里的展品进行互动，并亲身体验在这些地下奇迹中有如家般舒适的生活。限时票在主展厅的服务台有售。

哥白尼天文馆

original: Lecture Tickets

original:
Oppenheimer's Folly?
A Lecture by Professor R.J. Gumbie

This lecture explores the very real possibility that nuclear war may not be as far off as we think and the effects it will have on the future of our planet. By illustrating past uses of smaller scale atomic weapons, Professor Gumbie will shock you, frighten you and make you wish you could just Duck and Cover to survive a real nuclear attack. Tickets are now available for this Lecture Series at the Information Desk in the Main Atrium.
translation:
奥本海默的愚蠢？
演讲者：R·J·冈比教授

此演讲探究了一种非常真实的可能性，那就是核战可能并不像我们想象的那么遥远，而且会对我们星球的未来产生巨大的影响。通过列举过去人类使用的小规模核子武器，冈比教授的演讲将会震惊你，并让你期望能仅靠“弯下腰躲起来”就在一场真实的核子攻击中幸存下来。该演讲专题的门票在主展厅的服务台有售。

GigantoMax Theater

Cower in fear as all sorts of gigantic vehicles drive at the viewer and give you a bug's eye view of oncoming traffic.

GigantoMax影院

original:
The Planetarium recording system has been malfunctioning lately, causing the normally automated program to stop and repeat itself. If you observe this happening, please contact myself or the chief of maintenance on duty immediately so the system can be restarted. We hope to have the issue resolved by the start of next year.

Derek Remmings
Maintenance Coordinator

天像仪系统最近有故障，有时会自动的重复。如果您发现了
这个问题，请立即联系我或者当班的维修组领班来让
系统重启。我们希望在明年伊始能彻底解决这个问题。

德里克·瑞梅斯
维修协调员

original:
After numerous complaints, and a single pending lawsuit, the GigantoMax Theater's sound system has been lowered from 130 decibels to 120 decibels. Please note that all employees working in or near the theater should still wear proper ear protection to prevent any permanent damage.

Derek Remmings
Maintenance Coordinator
translation:
由于大量的投诉和官司，GigantoMAX影院已把音响从130分贝下调到120分贝。请通知所有在剧院内部及附近工作人员，仍然需要佩带耳部防护设备以防止永久性听力损伤。

德里克·瑞梅斯
维修协调员

original:
This is a general announcement to any employees who use the men's lavatory facility in the maintenance area. I have logged too many complaints that people are not flushing the toilets after using them. People who use the facility to relieve themselves expect a clean and tidy environment. To prevent this from becoming a reoccurring issue, card swipe access will be required for each stall which will log your name, time in the stall, and contents of the bowl until such time that we deem it no longer necessary.

Derek Remmings
Maintenance Coordinator
translation:
通告所有使用维修区洗手间的员工：近期有多起投诉员工用过洗手间不冲洗。洗手间需要干净卫生的环境。为防止此类事件再次发生，厕位将采用实名刷卡制度，卡片记录内容包括姓名、使用厕位时间及储水箱水位。此项制度将持续至我们认为不再必要为止。

德里克·瑞梅斯
维修协调员

original:
Due to the increased power consumption from the installation of the Vault-Tec Vault Tour, three new reactors have been installed in the sub-basement section. This should help prevent any further brown-outs or full black-outs in the visitor galleries that we've been experiencing. Thanks for your patience during this transition.

Derek Remmings
Maintenance Coordinator
translation:
由于避难所科技展览导致电力消耗增加，地下室里将安装三个新的反应器。此举将解决游客展馆里灯光变暗和断电问题。此过程中请您耐心等待，谢谢。

德里克·瑞梅斯
维修协调员

original:
The virus that has been plaguing our Archetype Model FF06 Mainframe due to an unknown attack has finally been localized by our research team and identified. After a complete cleanup on the mainframe's core, I am happy to announce that the infection has been removed... the soul of this machine has improved.

B. Bell
Research Lead
translation:
在某次未知攻击中感染原型FF06主计算机的病毒已被我研究小组发现并确认。对主机核心进行清理之后，我很高兴地宣布病毒感染被清除了……这台机器又获得了新生。

B.比尔
研究员主管

original:
Our new addition to the Spaceflight Gallery, the Virgo II Lunar Lander, is now open to the general public and ready for viewing. I want to extend a hardy thank you and job well done to the entire Research & Restoration Team for pulling that pile of junk out of mothballs and putting it in such fine shape. Many sleepless nights were spent on this project, and as a small token of our thanks, you will find a substantial bonus in your next paycheck. Give each other a pat on the back... you've earned it.

B. Bell
Research Lead
translation:
新近添置进宇宙飞船展馆室女座2号登月舱已对公众开放，可以参观了。我在此谨对负责此项工作的研究与修复小组致以衷心的感谢。你们做了一项伟大的工作，是你们把成堆的废料从垃圾堆里拖出来并组装成了如此惊人逼真的形象。在此工作中你们付出了无数个不眠之夜和辛勤汗水。作为我们的一点小小谢意，你们会收到一笔丰厚的奖金作为酬劳，以资鼓励团队中的每一个人……这是你们应得的。

B.贝尔
研究员主管

original:
This is just a quick rundown of acquisitions we have been awarded for 2078. If any of these interest you, please stop by and see me so we can discuss it or submit a standard research request before the cutoff date. All submissions must be made by October 2nd, 2077, so now is the time to get them in.

这仅是一个我们在2078年获得的资产的纲要。如果您对其中某项感兴趣，请于截止日期前联系我们，我们可以详细商谈或者委托一份标准化的研究协议。投稿截止日期为2077年10月2日。现在即可开始。

*超音速客机

研究员主管

original: The planet Jupiter is larger than 1,000 Earths!
translation: 木星比1000个地球还大！

original: The outer layers of the sun have what's known as "differential rotation". The equator of the surface rotates once every 25.4 days; but near the poles it rotates once every 36 days!
translation: 太阳大气的外层有种被称为“较差自转”的现象。在赤道附近的\n日面自转一周要25.4天，但是在极地附近，日面自转\n一周却需要36天！

original: A neutron star is completely dense and solid matter. In fact, it weighs a trillion times heavier than lead. That means a piece of a neutron star the size of a pinhead would weigh as much as a large building!
translation: 中子星是超大密度的实体，密度是铅的一百亿\n亿倍。这意味着一个针尖大小的中子星物质其重量超过\n一座楼房！

original: The sun loses almost 4 million tons of mass every second by turning hydrogen gas into energy. That adds up to almost 345 billion tons per day!
translation: 太阳在把氢气转化成能量的过程中，每秒会损失4万吨\n的质量，每天可以损失几乎345亿吨物质！

original: If we were to send a message to someone on a planet belonging to our closest neighboring solar system, Alpha Centauri, which is almost 4.4 light-years away, we wouldn't receive a reply message for 8.8 years!
translation: 如果我们向离我们最近的相邻太阳系的行星 — 4.4光年\n距离的半人马座阿尔法星 — 的人们发送信息，在8.8\n年之内，我们都不会收到任何回复的信号！

original: There are about one hundred and seventy five billion galaxies in the observable universe each with as few as ten million stars up to giants with one trillion stars, all orbiting a common center of mass!
translation: 在我们能观测到的宇宙空间里，有大概1750亿个星云，每\n个星云都包含数量从一千万到一百亿亿不等的星体。\n这些星体全部围绕一个相同质量中心进行旋转！

original: If all of the particles that make up Saturn's rings were gathered together, they would form a sphere about 120 miles in diameter!
translation: 如果把土星光环的所有物质能够堆放在一起，可以组成一个\n直径120英里的球体！

original: Olympus Mons, a volcano found on Mars, is the largest known volcano in the solar system. It is 370 miles (595 km) across and rises 15 miles (24 km). That's 3 times taller than Mount Everest!
translation: 奥林匹斯山，火星上的一座火山，是太阳系中已知的最大的\n火山。它横跨370英里（595千米），高15英里（24千\n米）。是珠穆朗玛峰的3倍高！

original: The Delta IX Rocket, commissioned by the USSA in 2020, was the last of the manned rockets that sent our brave American Astronauts to the moon. The Delta IX was in use for almost 15 years before being converted for military use and having the crew and instruments sections replaced with a nuclear warhead. The Delta IX recorded over 77 successful launches, making it one of the most successful rockets in U.S. History.\n\nThe rocket, developed entirely by USSA scientists, was a single-stage vehicle with an ejectable crew section or satellite storage bay. The propulsion system was a nuclear-electric derivative drive, using a massive electrical jolt to start the nuclear reaction on launch. The crew section was protected from the radioactive chambers by way of a massive titanium-vanadium disc. The spacecraft had the capability to sustain 2 astronauts for up to 24 days maximum. The longest recorded spaceflight in a Delta IX rocket was the 17-day Zeus 12 Mission to the moon.
translation: 由USSA于2020年委任的D9型火箭是把伟大勇敢的美利坚合众国宇航员送入太空的最后一艘载人火箭。D9型在使用15年后转为军用，其船员和设备舱被替换成了核弹头，使之成为美国历史上最为成功的火箭之一。\nD9型是一枚完全由USSA科学家研发的单级火箭，装载了可弹出式的宇航员舱和卫星存放舱，推进系统为核电装置，发射时籍由大量的电子震动来激发核反应。宇航员舱以大量钛钒合金防御宇宙辐射。这艘飞船最多能够维持2名宇航员24天的生活。D9型火箭的最长记录产生于月球任务17-day Zeus 12 Misson。

original: RobCo Comptroller Orientation
translation: RobCo公司审核程序定位

original:
Congratulations on your transferal to the position of ROBOT PROTOCOL OPERATOR! Your trusted co-workers will be the standard Protectron models stationed throughout the facility.

"Basic Operation" covers the day-to-day functionality of your co-workers, as described in detail in your training manual.

"Pest Extermination" encourages your co-workers to track and sanitize any roaches, rodents, or other undesired pests on the premises.

"Total Liquidation" removes your co-workers' humanoid safety protocols, and is for use only in the unlikely event of criminal intrusion or communist attack.

"Robot Shutdown" allows you to temporarily retire your co-workers for their regular maintenance, or in the case of accidental Liquidation commands.

We trust you'll find the work simple, rewarding, and extremely safe! Enjoy!
translation:
祝贺您获得机器人操作权限！通过这个设置，将配置标准的护卫机器人作为您值得信赖的助手。

在您的用户手册中，“基础操作”项对您助手的日常功能进行了详尽的描述。

“害虫歼灭”项命令您的助手追踪和清除任何蟑螂、啮齿动物，或者其他不受欢迎的害虫。

“全部清除”项将删除您助手的机器人安全协议，这一功能只用于不太可能发生的犯罪侵扰事件，或者共产主义袭击

“机器人关机”项允许您在进行日常维护或输入意外的清除命令时，临时关闭您的助手。

我们相信您会发现这一切运作简单，有效且非常安全！祝您使用愉快！

original: Project Brainstorm Report
translation: 突发奇想工程报告

original:
Brainstorm Military/Cultural Center
2076 Progress Report

Our flagship project, the Induced Patriotism Initiative, has met with resounding success. Our agents have successfully included covert and overt messages of extreme patriotism and loyalty into popular media ranging from the big screen to the Sunday funnies. Increased military enrollment amongst target demographics serves to underline this success.

Agent Webb has been particularly effective at influencing the music industry, and he has interesting proposals for the fields of organized sports and even such notoriously difficult markets as comic books and toys. 

A success in these areas would ensure early education with our message, and thus ensure a more dedicated and devoted nation for us all.
translation:
军方脑力激荡部/文化中心
2076 进展报告

我们的旗舰项目，“诱导自发性的爱国心”，已经取得了巨大的成功。从大屏幕到周日报纸上的漫画板块，我们的特工已经成功的将一些显著与隐晦的、极富爱国心与忠诚心的信息散入了公共媒体。根据人口资料统计服务的显示，报名入伍人数有所增长，这说明了该项目是成功的。

特工Webb对音乐产业的影响尤为显著，并且他对有组织的体育活动这个领域很感兴趣，甚至还包括漫画书和玩具这样众所周知的困难市场。

在这些领域的成功，可以确保民众在早期的教育中接受我们的信息，由此，对我们所有人来说，可以使我们的民族更具奉献和献身精神。

original: Mission Cloacina Report
translation: 克塞纳任务报告

original:
CODENAME: CLOACINA
Development Report

Development of the Mutant Undermining Lifeform continues apace, and our chief bio-engineers are certain that they will be able to perfect these living weapons in time for deployment into Red China.

Once covertly released into an enemy's environment, their aggressive qualities, dangerous hunger, and pervasive breeding should severely undermine the infrastructure of the location in short order, softening the target for ground invasion. At this point, the genetic kill-switch can be activated, allowing for easy reclamation -- not including a significant, one-time clean up effort.

Current MUL development primarily uses genetic stock of rodents, particularly the common sewer rat, and progress has been significant. FEV testing has been rejected, however, as the results are sterile.
translation:
代号：水沟女神
研发报告

有关“变异侵蚀生命体-MUL”研发的进展速度很快，同时我们的首席生化工程师肯定的表示，他们能够按时完善这种有生命的武器，用以投放在赤色中国。

只要悄悄地将这些生物武器释放在敌区的自然环境下，它们具有本能的侵略性，致命的饥饿感，惊人的繁殖力，可以迅速的破坏当地的生态系统， 减缓敌方在正面战场上的进攻。基于这点，它们体内还有种特殊基因，可以控制它们的生死， 便于战后环境的重建 -- 而且不会留下证据，一次性的清除一切。

当前的MUL的开发主要使用的是啮齿动物的基因组，尤其是下水道里常见的那种老鼠，所取得的进展也具有深远的意义。FEV病毒已经被放弃了，因为使用它的后果会导致不孕。

original: Overseer's Message
translation: 监督的信息

original: Accept who you are and embrace your role in the Vault. There are no worthless jobs, and no worthless people... except those without jobs.
translation: 在避难所内，要接受自己，拥抱自己。这里没有无意义的工作，也没有无价值的人……除了那些没工作的人。

original: Overseer's Message
translation: 监督的信息

original: Loyalty keeps us strong. Caution keeps us secure. The Vault keeps us alive.
translation: 忠诚使我们强大。谨慎使我们安全。避难所使我们存活。

original: Overseer's Message
translation: 监督的信息

original: The Vault is our world and our succor. There is nothing outside the Vault except death.
translation: 避难所既是我们的世界，也是我们的援助之手。避难所外空无一物只有死亡。

original: Overseer's Message
translation: 监督的信息

original: For generations, the Vault has been our home. Now, we can get to know the neighborhood.
translation: 对于几代人来说，避难所就是我们的家。现在，我们可以多了解一下我们的邻居。

original: I can't believe I went through all that trouble to leave Navarro and make my way across the country just to get stuck in this shithole. I'll be damned if I'm going to die here.\n\nNow that we're cut off from Lesko and Wilks, I think we're on our own. The damn ants keep trying to find a way to get inside the house. Even as I'm typing this, I can hear them scraping the walls looking for a way through. I don't know how much longer we can last.
translation: 我实在不能相信，离开纳瓦罗基地历尽千辛万苦长途跋涉了整个国家，却又陷在这个让人欲哭无泪的鬼地方。我是要死在这可真他妈的亏大了。\n\n现在我们和莱索托和威尔克失去联系，我们也只能靠自己了。这些畜生一直想找个办法进屋。即使我正在打这些字的时候，我也能听见它们抓挠墙壁找路的声音。我也不知道我们能撑多久了。

original: I'm going to have to find a better way to protect Sheila and Will from those ants. Ever since Lesko came to town, I'm certain they're getting more and more aggressive. Wasteland ants are bad enough, but at least you can run away from them. These would seem to pursue you to the ends of the earth if they could. Call me crazy, but I swear I saw one start a fire the other day. I don't know how this could be happening.\n\nI've decided to dig up my old sidearm and keep it hidden on me at all times. If those things get too close, I'll blast the antennae right off their ugly heads.
translation: 我必须得找到更好的办法来保护西拉和威尔克免受蚂蚁伤害。自从莱索托住进镇子，这些蚂蚁变得越来越富有攻击性。废土上的蚂蚁虽然也不是好东西，可毕竟还能躲远点。可这地方的蚂蚁似乎能追你到天涯海角。你可以说我疯了，但我发誓我今天的的确确见到一只蚂蚁喷火了，我真的不明白怎么可以这样。\n\n我决定把我的防身武器时时刻刻带在身上。如果这些畜生胆敢靠近我，我就一枪打爆他们恶心脑袋上的触须。

original: Some scientist named Lesko moved in with the Wilks family across the street. They are helping him make some sort of a structure on the old lot near the diner. Lesko offered to pay me caps if I helped, but I declined. I dunno who he's working for, but I don't think they're still looking for me.\n\nOur supplies are running low, and I need to begin foraging for food and some better drinking water. I'd have an easier time if it wasn't for the damn ants. I swear they have a nest around here somewhere.
translation: 有个叫什么莱索托的什么什么科学家之类的和威尔克家一起搬来，住在街对面了。威尔克一家在餐厅附近帮着这个人建造一个好象什么模型之类的东东。莱索托想付酬劳请我也来帮忙，不过我没答应。我不知道他给什么人干活的，不过我觉得他们应该不是来找我的。\n\n我们的物资快消耗光了，我得去多找些吃的和干净的饮水。要不是那些讨厌的蚂蚁，我日子肯定会过得好很多。我敢打赌这些蚂蚁肯定在附近有个老巢。

original: These ants are becoming a real pain in the ass. So much so that I had to take a trip to Megaton and buy a better gun to protect my family. It cost me a small fortune... I had to trade every bit of ant meat I had collected, but it was worth it. I'm teaching Frank and Sheila to use it just in case something happens to me. If one of you two are reading this, and I'm gone, I keep the gun in the kitchen behind the old fridge.
translation: 这些蚂蚁越来越让人头疼，因此我跑到兆吨镇买了把强力武器来保护家人。它真的花了我一笔小钱……我把搜集到的全部蚂蚁肉都卖了才攒够钱，不过很值得。我正在教弗兰克和西拉使用这把枪，万一我有个三长两短，他们也能保护自己了。如果你读到了这条信，表示我已经死掉了，我把枪放在了厨房里，就在那台旧冰箱后面。

original: The Nuka-Cola Corporation is pleased to announce to all it's employees that the first shipments of our Nuka-Cola Quantum® are on their way to retailers in the Washington D.C. area! This flagship test market program is the culmination of a three year research program to bring the refreshing taste of Quantum to market. Congratulations to all employees on a job well done!
translation: 核子可乐公司很高兴地向全体员工宣布，首批核子可乐量子版®正运往华盛顿特区的零售商！这次旗舰试销计划是历时三年的研究计划的最终成果，旨在将量子可乐的清新口感推向市场。祝贺所有员工的出色工作！

original:
The following locations have been accepted into the flagship Nuka-Cola Quantum test program. Please ensure that 1 (one) crate of Quantum is included with their regular deliveries along with the advertising package provided by our Marketing Department.

1. Paradise Falls Shopping Mart
2. Super Duper Mart
3. Old Olney Grocery
translation:
以下地点已纳入旗舰产品“核子可乐量子版”的测试计划。在他们的常规配送中，请确保1（一）箱量子可乐连同我们营销部提供的广告套餐一起送货。

1、天堂瀑购物中心
2、顶呱呱超市
3、老奥尔尼杂货店

original:
Stage One of the Nuka-Cola Quantum marketing will include: 2 (two) 15 (fifteen)-second television commercials, 4 (four) 10 (ten)-second radio commercials and a highway billboard campaign.

The spots on TV and radio will tease the consumer with the blue glow of the new drink, never showing the bottle in an illuminated environment. The billboard will show the bottle's blue silhouette on a black background.

The tag line will be "Try something new... Go Blue!". The name will not be revealed until Stage Two.
translation:
核子可乐量子版营销的第一阶段将包括：2（二） 15（十五）秒电视广告，4（四） 10（十）秒电台广告以及一块高速公路广告牌联动。

电视和电台的广告将以新饮料的蓝色炫光吸引消费者，绝对不要在有照明的环境下展示饮料瓶。广告牌将以黑色背景衬托瓶体的蓝色轮廓。

广告语将用“尝尝鲜……选蓝色！”。饮料的名字应于第二阶段公布。

original:
Stage Two of the Nuka-Cola Quantum marketing will include: 2 (two) 30 (thirty)-second television commercials, 4 (four) 15 (fifteen)-second radio commercials and a highway billboard campaign.

In this stage, the name "Quantum" will be revealed and the bottle shown in full view. We will emphasize the drink's new energy content and flavor.

The tag line will be "Take the leap... enjoy a Quantum!"
translation:
核子可乐量子版营销的第二阶段将包括: 2（二） 30（三十）秒电视广告, 4（四） 15（十五）秒电台广告以及一块高速公路广告牌联动。

在这一阶段，我们将公布“量子”这一名称，并全方位展示该饮料的瓶身。我们将重点强调这款饮料的全新能量成分和风味。

广告语将用“勇敢一跃……尽享量子！”

original:
Stage Three of the Nuka-Cola Quantum marketing will include: 4 (four) 30 (thirty)-second television commercials, 4 (four) 15 (fifteen)-second radio commercials and a highway billboard campaign.

In this final stage we will aggressively compare the drink to other competitors and show their inferiority using hired actors at "taste tests". The actors will read pre-written scripts approved by our department. The text should give an authentic "on the spot" impression but still clearly point out Quantum's strengths.

The tag line will remain: "Take the leap... enjoy a Quantum!"
translation:
核子可乐量子版营销的第三阶段将包括：4（四） 30（三十）秒电视广告, 4（四） 15（十五）秒电台广告以及一块高速公路广告牌联动。

在这一最终阶段，我们将积极与其他竞品进行比较，并通过雇佣演员在“品尝测试”中展示竞争对手的劣势。这些演员将按照我们部门批准的预先编写的剧本进行表演。剧本内容应营造出一种真实的“现场”印象，同时明确指出量子可乐的优势。

广告语仍用“勇敢一跃……尽享量子！”

original: Test subjects in the Nuka-Cola Quantum program are responding well to the reconfigured taste and the new isotope. The only listed side effects from the group are: 3 cases of dizziness, 1 case of nausea and 1 case of impaired vision. We find from a sampling of 50 that this is an acceptable number of cases and approve this product for production.
translation: 参与“核子可乐量子版”项目的测试对象对重新调配的口味和新同位素反应良好。该组列出的唯一副作用是：3例头晕、1例恶心和1例视力受损。我们在50例样本中发现，这些副作用的数量是可接受的，因此批准该产品投入生产。

original: Isotope CE772 has proven too damaging to the initial test group which now needs to be disbanded due to their reluctance to continue in our program. This group has suffered 4 fatalities, 12 major internal organ failures and 32 internal radiation burns. This is an unacceptable number of issues in a given test group and recommend we switch to an alternate isotope (such as CE774 or UR993).
translation: 已证实，同位素CE772对初步测试组造成了极大的伤害，由于他们不愿继续参与我们的项目，该组现需要解散。此组中有4例死亡，12例严重脏器衰竭，32例内辐射灼伤。在一个特定的测试组中，出现如此多的问题是不可接受的，因此我们建议改用其他同位素（如CE774或UR993）。

original: Isotope CE770 has proven to be a disastrous failure. All of the test subjects suffered severe internal organ failures and died within three days of ingestion. We recommend the immediate destruction of container A32 in the production rooms and suggest switching to isotope CE772. Please send standard "Nuka Condolences" Fruit and Cheese Packages to test group member's families.
translation: 同位素CE770已被证明是一次灾难性的失败。所有测试对象在摄入后三天内均出现严重器官衰竭并死亡。我们建议立即销毁生产间内的A32容器，并建议改用同位素CE772。请向测试组成员的家属寄标准的“核子慰问”水果和奶酪礼盒。

original: Vampires are beings based in folklore that prey on humans for the purpose of obtaining their blood. In these fictitious stories, the blood serves as both a food source and a center of power for the vampire. It is a common motif in these tales that a victim could become a vampire if bitten by one. Other noted attributes of the vampire are its abilities to change into the form of a bat or a wolf, to become gaseous at will, the ability to hypnotize the opposite gender and increased life span.
translation: 血族是传说中的捕食人类并专门吸血的族群。在这些虚构的故事里，血液既是血族的食物来源，也是能量的核心。在这些传说中，有个共通的说法：当一个人被血族咬伤之后，他本身也会变成一个血族。另一些故事传说血族能够变身成为蝙蝠或者狼、能化身为气体并诱惑与其性别不同的人以延长自身的寿命。

original: It is interesting to note that the vampire is traditionally regarded in literature as having an aversion to sunlight. Many people believe this may stem from the misunderstanding of common phobias such as photophobia and heliophobia or even the actual physical issue of photosensitivity. In all of these accounts, the subject withdraws from daytime activities and is rarely seen outdoors. In the 18th century, with medical science in its infancy, this commonly gave rise to ridiculous accusations by the uninformed that these people were "strange" or "cursed". This is likely the reason vampires are awarded this attribute in their stories.
translation: 有意思的是，在传统的文学作品中，血族都被描绘成憎恶阳光的生物。许多人认为这些传说源于对某些恐惧性疾病的误解，比如畏光、日光恐怖症或者日光过敏症。在所有作品的描述中，血族日出而息，日落而作，并极少在户外活动。在18世纪，随着医学开始启蒙，患有这些疾病的患者经常会被无知的人们荒谬地以“异端”或者“被诅咒”的罪名指控，很大程度上也是拜文学作品中的血族所赐。

original: Depending on the cultural source, there are several ways to kill or destroy a vampire. The most common is by driving a wooden stake usually composed of ash, hawthorn or oak through the vampire's heart. In some cultures, the stake was driven through the mouth or stomach as well. Other tales tell of decapitation or immolation being the preferred method of destruction along with anything else that can completely annihilate the vampire's physical form.
translation: 依据大量的文艺作品，有几种办法能杀掉一名血族。最常见的是拿一根烟灰、山茶花和像木制成的木棍刺入血族的心脏。在一些作品中，也有用木棍刺穿口或者腹部的。另一些作品中，则以斩首或者祭杀作为毁灭血族肉体的首选方法。

original: Recovery of the Declaration of Independence seems to be a loss. That damn woman I hired, Sydney, she said she could do it. Haven't seen her in months. I bet she's dead or ran off with the advance I gave her. That's the last time I trust someone. Told Harkness to keep an eye out for her just in case she ever comes back to the city. That's what I get for sending a woman to do a man's job!
translation: 收回《独立宣言》的工作看来失败了。我雇佣的那个臭婆娘希妮，她说她可以搞定的。现在都几个月没见她的影子了。我猜她可能已经死了或者带着我给的订金跑了。我再也不会信任任何人了。告诉哈克尼斯，如果她回来了，叫哈克尼斯看着她点。这就是派个婆娘去做男人的工作的后果！

original: Came to find out through the grapevine that there are a bunch of Lincoln's artifacts still in the Museum of History. I think I may branch out from just collecting documents if I could get my hands on those gems. Only problem is I have to find someone braver than me who can get to the museum in one piece.
translation: 有谣传说，在历史博物馆里还有一大堆林肯的遗物，去找找。我真希望能变成三头六臂，边处理这些文件边去搜寻那些宝贝。唯一的问题是我得找一个比我还勇敢的、敢单枪匹马去博物馆的人。

original: Bumped into a traveler a little while ago who showed me what he said was a fragment of the actual Liberty Bell! Poppycock! The Liberty Bell is still intact and laying in the ruins of Philly. I have funded an expedition to that dump in hopes of having the entire bell brought back to my museum.
translation: 我碰到一个旅行者，这家伙给我看一样东西，号称是货真价实的自由钟碎片！胡说八道！自由钟肯定还完好无损地躺在费城的废墟里。我已经组建了一支探险队深入到废墟中，期待能把那个完整的钟搬到我的博物馆来。

original: The Constitution of the United States was drafted in 1786 and adopted a year later by the Constitutional Convention of Philly. This document defines the organization of the U.S. government and sets forth the rules and regulations, known as articles. In addition, there are modifications made to the articles by ruling Presidents during their reigns known as amendments. The society owns the only known copy of the document to exist which was retrieved from the ruins of the National Archives in 2256.
translation: 美利坚合众国宪法起草于1786年，并于一年后由费城制宪会议通过。该文件明确阐述了美国政府的组织架构，奠定了美国的政治制度和法律基础。亦是世界上第一部成文的宪法。此外，宪法已由许多届的总统修改过，称为宪法修正案。已知社会上现存的唯一一份文件副本是2256年在国家档案馆废墟里找到并复原的。

original: The Emancipation Proclamation was a document issued by the breathtakingly charismatic President Abraham Lincoln in 1862. This executive order was the beginning of the end of slavery in the United States. Although it was issued during the Civil War, making it a war measure, it paved the way for the Thirteenth Amendment of the Constitution which completely abolished slavery once and for all.
translation: 《独立宣言》由那位具有传奇色彩的总统 — 亚伯拉罕·林肯于1862年颁布。这分行政指令是美国废除奴隶制的开始。虽然它在南北战争时期颁布，并作为一种战争方案来执行，但它为13条宪法修正案美国正式废除奴隶制度铺平了道路。

original: The Capital Preservation Society is proud to have in its possession a copy of one of the most iconic and prolific speeches in United States history. This speech, given by the astonishingly intelligent Abraham Lincoln on Thursday, November 19, 1863, laid the groundwork for what would later become the basis of democracy in the United States and set the standards for a country with a government "by the people, for the people."
translation: 资本保护协会拥有一份美国历史上最为经典、最广为传诵的演讲稿。他们为此深感自豪。这份讲稿是由聪颖过人的总统--亚伯拉罕林肯于1863年11月19日星期四作的演说。它奠定了美国民主制度的基础，确定了国家政府“民治，民享”的理念。

original: The Monroe Doctrine was presented in 1823 by the average and unremarkable President James Monroe. The document warns the European powers of the time not to interfere in the affairs of the Western Hemisphere, citing the examples of colonization and puppet governments as possible intolerances.
translation: 门罗主义由平庸的总统詹姆斯·门罗于1823年在国情咨文中提出。该文件警告当时的欧洲列强不得再干涉西半球国家事务。客观上促进了拉美国家殖民地政府的独立。

original: Part of our collection is a copy of the formal declaration of war made on Germany during World War II on December 11, 1941 by the government and endorsed by the President Franklin D. Roosevelt.  While the document doesn't evoke the brilliance of other masterworks like the Emancipation Proclamation, it still served as a reminder to the world that the United States wasn't a power to be trifled with.
translation: 我们收藏品中，有一份第二次世界大战期间、福兰克林.D.罗斯福总统于1941年12月11日发表的对德宣战的宣言。尽管它不象《解放黑奴宣言》等名作那样耀眼，它仍然向世界宣布了美国不是个好惹的国家。

original: Although it is uncertain when the Declaration of War on China was made (some say 2066 when they invaded Alaska, others say 2067 when the first Power Armor suits were deployed to counter their forces), it is the last known document of note authored by the United States Government before the bombs fell. Had the Declaration had the tenacity and might of a stronger President behind it, say Abraham Lincoln, who's to say what the outcome of those tremulous years would have been?
translation: 尽管尚不确定《对中国宣战书》具体是哪一年宣布的（有人说是在2066年中国入侵阿拉斯加时，也有人说是在2067年第一批动力甲装备部队以反击中国军队时），它是已知现存的在核弹落下之前最后一个由美国政府颁布的官方文件。 假如这份宣言是由一个像林肯那样更加强硬和坚韧的总统所颁布，但是他为什么没有为战争的结果---这么多年的颓废和凄凉买单？

original: The unit designated BGWIN009 "Button Gwinnett" is suffering from a system memory leak. I've had to flush the unit's core CPU several times last month; it's getting all of its orders and directives confused. The unit's reenactment subroutines are interfering with its tour guide subroutines, causing conflicting actions and scaring the visitors to our galleries. Recommend shutdown of this unit and replacement of central core.\n\nP. Brantseg - Robotics Team
translation: “巴顿·格威纳特”单位正受困于系统记忆泄漏。上个月我不得不多次刷新该单位的CPU核心。该单位混淆所有的程序指令，会把演出程序和观光向导程序混淆在一起引起冲突，发出奇怪的动作吓跑游客。建议关闭此单位，更换它的核心处理器。\n\nP.博软赛克 - 机器人技术组

original: TRT007, one of our automated turrets, is constantly locking in its reset position. It is not responding properly to calibration nor will it track the test targets properly. This is likely due to its tracking array being misaligned with its targeting laser (a common problem in all of our automated turrets). Recommend replacement of tracking array.\n\nP. Brantseg - Robotics Team
translation: 我们的一座自动炮塔 — TRT007，会不断地自动锁定到默认位置，既不能对人工校准正确响应，也不能正确地追踪测试目标。原因很可能是追踪阵列和目标探测激光不匹配（我们的自动炮塔很常见的故障）建议替换追踪序列。\n\nP.博软赛克 - 机器人技术组

original: EMT002 unit "Nightingale" is back online after an extensive refit. I've replaced its surgical arm, injector units, gyro-stabilizer system and thruster number three. The unit's central core has been reset and is now ready for service.\n\nP. Brantseg - Robotics Team
translation: EMT002 “夜莺”单位经过大修之后已经又可以重新连线了。我已替换了它的外科臂、注射装置、罗盘稳定系统和3号推进器。 该单位的中央处理器已重启，能够投入使用了。\n\nP.博软赛克 - 机器人技术组

original: The BGWIN009 Button Gwinnett Unit is designed primarily as a participant in our reenactments of the signing of the Declaration of Independence show. This unit plays the part of Button Gwinnett of Georgia, second signer of the Declaration. This unit is also programmed with the standard Tour Guide Assistance subroutines and limited Security subroutines.
translation: BGWIN009 巴顿·格威纳特单位是为扮演《独立宣言》演出的一名参与者而设计。该单元将扮演《独立宣言》的第二位签署人 — 乔治亚州的巴顿·格威纳特。该单位也加载了标准观光向导程序和有限的安全程序。

original: The JHANC003 John Hancock Unit is designed primarily as a participant in our reenactments of the signing of the Declaration of Independence show. This unit plays the part of John Hancock of Massachusetts, first signer of the Declaration. This unit is also programmed with the standard Tour Guide Assistance subroutines and limited Security subroutines.
translation: JHANC003 约翰·汉考克单位是为扮演《独立宣言》演出的一名参与者而设计 ,该单元将扮演《独立宣言》的第一位签署人 — 马萨诸塞州的约翰·汉考克。该单位也加载了标准观光向导程序和有限的安全程序。

original: Note From Walter
translation: 来自沃尔特的短信

original: Thanks for all your help. Stop on by any time and sell me whatever Scrap Metal you can find. We can always use it.\n\nWalter
translation: 谢谢你的那些帮助。只要你找到了废金属，就来卖给我。那些东西我能用上。\n\n沃尔特

original: Note From Leo Stahl
translation: 来自利奥·斯塔尔的短信

original:
Hey,

Stop by the Water Treatment Plant at night and I'll hook you up with some Chems. Let's just keep this between us.

Leo
translation:
嗨，

晚上有空了来水处理设施这，我给你准备了一些药。这件事只能我们两个人知道。
