original: Letter from Bittercup
translation: “苦杯”的信

original:
love,

when are u comin back 2 bigtown?? i miss u soooo much!!! i have sum presents 4 u and i hope u come back soon 2 get them!!! ill save whutever i find that u can use 2 give 2 u when u come back!!

miss u!!!

xoxoxoxoxoxoxo

bittercup
translation:
心肝呀，

乃虾米时候回大镇？？暔想死你了！！！暔给你准备了一些东东，暔好希望乃能快点回来收下他们！！！只要是找到了乃能用的，暔都会留着，等乃回来就给乃！！

想乃！！！

亲亲抱抱亲亲抱抱亲亲抱抱

“苦杯”

original: Nuka 4 Zip!
translation: 核子交易

original: Don't forget! I'll trade you whatever I've got for more Nuka-Cola! \n\nNuka 4 Zip! Nuka 4 Zip!
translation: 别忘了！一搞到核子可乐我就会找你交易的！\n\nNuka 4 Zip! Nuka 4 Zip!

original: Tales of the Wastes
translation: 废土的传言

original:
You stories are pretty popular around town! 

I'm always looking forward to hearing more of them!

- Knock Knock
translation:
你的故事在坊间大量流传！

我总是渴望听到更多！

—— 敲门声

original: Lamplight Fungus Trade
translation: 小灯镇蘑菇贸易

original:
Lucy, Eclair:

Looks like we've got ourselves a freelance scavver. Pay the bastard in cave fungus, and we should be good for supplies.

Lucy, trade fungus for Buffout doses. Keep those rickets treatments coming.

Eclair, trade fungus for Strange Meat. That should help keep the fungus pools fertilized.

Anyone who's got a fucking problem with this setup answers to me.

- RJ MacCready
translation:
露西，“夹心奶条”：

看起来我们在跟一群强盗打交道。支付山洞里的蘑菇给这些混蛋，我们的供给才会得到保障。

露西，用蘑菇交易壮大灵，以维持对软骨病的治疗。

“夹心奶条”，用蘑菇换来些奇怪的肉，这些东西能够帮助保持蘑菇场的高产量。

任何人出了差错都要让他来向我汇报。

- RJ 麦迪

original: Caravan Trade Route
translation: 商队贸易路线

original: Notice From Winthrop
translation: 温思罗普的通知

original:
Alright, listen up. This is the last time I'm going to say it: we might be immune to radiation, but we still gotta breathe. So, whoever has been taking the Spare Parts from the supply closet better stop it, right quick. If I don't have parts, I can't keep the air circulating. Got it?

We're out of parts, so I need everyone to bring me any of those Stimpaks or RadAway things that you find. I'm gonna see if I can't trade them to some smoothskin for some parts. And if those ones go missing, you zombies are on your own.

Winthrop.
translation:
好吧，都听好了。我再最后重复一遍：我们或许能辐射免疫，但我们仍要呼吸。所以，从补给里拿走备用零件的那个人，无论你是谁，立刻停止这种行为。如果没有零件，我就不能保证空气的流通了。懂了吗？

我们的零件已经用完了，所以我要你们每一个人都把找到的治疗针或者辐射药给我。如果找不到光皮肤购买零件，我会再想办法。反正如果再有零件丢失，你们这些僵尸们就等着自生自灭吧。

温思罗普。

original: Contract With Ahzrukhal
translation: 阿祖卡的合同

original: I, Ahzhrukal (henceforth known as "seller") agree to pass possession of the property known as "Charon" (henceforth known as "PROPERTY") to %n (henceforth known at BUYER") upon the death of the Ghoul known as Greta (henceforth "TARGET"). \n\nBy execution hereof, BUYER acknowledges that all tasks related to TARGET shall be completed in due haste. Afterfor PROPERTY shall be transferred to BUYER with equal due haste.
translation: 我，阿祖卡（后文中称作“卖家”）同意在一位名叫葛丽泰的僵尸（后文中称作“目标”）死亡后，向（后文中称作“买家”）让出这份名为“卡伦”(后文中称作“财产”)的财产的所有权%n。\n\n关于履行此点，买家须知，所有和目标有关的任务一旦完成。 之后财产便会立刻转让给买家。

original: Megaton Cult Pamphlet
translation: 兆吨镇的宗教小手册

original:
Lost Children of the Wastes, rejoice! Atom presents to you a chance to redemption! 

The Church of the Children of Atom offers you a chance to participate in the keeping of Atom's sacred city of Megaton! We accept currency, which shall be used to keep this holy place as pure and as safe as possible.

Rays shine upon, wayward Children of the Wastes!

Confessor Cromwell
translation:
在废土迷失的子民们！请欣喜若狂吧！原子神赐给了你们一个赎罪的机会！

原子信徒的教堂给你们提供了一个机会，兆吨镇！这个原子神庄严而神圣的地方！现在你们也有机会参与进守护它的重任。我们接受捐助，尽可能地维持这个神圣地方的纯净与安宁。

愿射线照耀，无知任性的废土子民们！

忏悔者克伦威尔

original: Dispatch to Scribe Yearling
translation: 文员伊尔琳的派遣信

original:
Scribe Yearling,

Now that Scribe Warswick has been written into the scrolls, I pass his noble task onto you.

Journey into the ruins of the city, to the once great Arlington Library. There, you will continue to collect, archive, and catalog the written works of the ancients. You will have two Paladins sent with you and you shall be requisitioned an amount of currency in order to barter and trade with Outsiders for any books that they may present to you.

Depart immediately and make haste. We cannot afford to have this work interrupted.

Yours In Steel,

Scribe Rothchild
translation:
文员伊尔琳，

沃斯维克文员已经离我们而去了，他被载入了名册，现在我将这个崇高的任务交给了你。

请前往这个城市的废墟，找到战前的大图书馆—阿灵顿图书馆。在那里继续收集前人的书籍，将它们归档并编目。两位圣骑士会和你同行，已经给你拨了一大笔钱用于和外人进行交易，收购他们愿意出售的书籍。

请立即启程，抓紧赶路。我们不能让这项工作中断下来。

你的兄弟，

文员罗斯查德

original: Wanted: Trustworthy Surgeon - Transcript
translation: 悬赏：可靠的外科医生 - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nHey doc, I’m only sharing this with you because you seem like someone we can trust. Have you heard about the synthetic men they make up north in the Commonwealth? Well, the rumors are true. They’re called androids. They're men like us, just made out of different parts. I know one of these androids. He's looking for a trustworthy doctor to perform some facial surgery. Can you do it? Do you know someone who can? Also, do you know anyone who's really wiz with computers?
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n嘿大夫，我只把这消息同你分享，因为你似乎是我们可以信任的人。你听说过在联邦北部制造合成人的事吗？对，传闻是真的。他们被称为仿真人，外形和我们人类一样，只是由不同零件制成。我认识一个这样的仿真人。他在找一个可靠的医生做一个面部手术。你能做吗？你知道谁能做吗？此外，你知道谁是个电脑高手吗？

original: Assignment from the Commonwealth - Transcript
translation: 来自联邦的任务 - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nWe've a little assignment from the Commonwealth. A very important slave escaped into the Wasteland.  Well, it’s not exactly a slave. It’s what they call an android. A kind of synthetic man. The important thing isn’t what this guy is. The important thing is the job pays more than you can imagine. He thinks the synthman might be looking to get in touch with a doctor and/or tech-head. If you want a cut, then get a move on.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n我们接到了一个来自联邦的小任务。一个很重要的奴隶逃进了废土。好吧，它并不完全是一个奴隶。它是他们所说的仿真人。一种合成人。重要的并不在于这家伙是什么。重要的是这任务的酬金超乎你的想象。他认为这仿真人会设法与医生和/或科技人员取得联系。要是你想分一杯羹，现在就行动吧。

original: Rogue Android - Transcript
translation: 异常仿真人 - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nYou’ll never guess who just showed up at my place! That android catcher from the Commonwealth! At first I thought he was going to kill me. But it turns out he’s an android himself! And he’s gone rogue! I didn’t believe him at first, but I’m convinced he’s telling the truth. We need to find  him a place to hide along the Railroad. He also insists that we help him locate a trusted doctor and techie.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n你绝对猜不到谁刚来了我这！那个来自联邦的仿真人捕捉者！起先我认为他要杀了我。但结果他自己就是个仿真人！并且他失常了！起初我不相信他，但我现在确信他说的是真的。我们得随着“铁路”给他找一个藏身之所。他还坚持要我们帮他找到一位可靠的医生和技术人员。

original: Androids are real. No really! - Transcript
translation: 仿真人是真的。不说笑！ - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nYou’ve heard those rumors about androids? You know, those synthetic men they supposedly make up north in the Commonwealth? Well, a friend of a friend knows a guy that met one! No really, it’s true! He’s running away from his masters. Word is he’s looking for a doctor to do some kind of surgery, and a computer programmer of some kind. Can you believe that? Let me know if you hear something.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n你听过关于仿真人的传闻么？你知道，就是那种据说在联邦北部制造的合成人？好吧，我有个朋友的朋友认识一个人，他遇到了一个！不说笑，是真的！他在躲他的主人。说是他在找一个医生来做手术，还有一个电脑程序员什么的。你相信吗？如果你听到什么消息，记得告诉我。

original: We got the tech, now we need the doc. - Transcript
translation: 我们有了科技，现在我们需要医生 — 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nWe now have a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. We just need to find someone with the skills and willingness to perform the surgery. If anyone knows of a discreet and trustworthy surgeon who knows how to keep his mouth shut, send him our way. Also, we need to find a Circuit Neuralizer to reroute the signals in the android’s memory. Do you know any trustworthy techies?
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n我们现在有了脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。我们只需找一个既有能力又有意愿的人来做手术。如果有谁知道哪位外科医生行事谨慎且值得信赖，懂得保守秘密，请介绍给我们。此外，我们还要找一个环状神经器，以重新连接仿真人的记忆信号。你认识什么可靠的技师吗？

original: Get it done! - Transcript
translation: 搞定它！ - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nWe better find that fucking android soon. That Commonwealth asshole, Zimmer, keeps hounding me for results. If the job didn’t pay so well, I’d off that motherfucker myself. He was babbling about a “Lipoplasticator” and “Micro Dermal Graftilizer.” What the hell are those? Apparently something doctors use to fuck up someone’s face beyond recognition. So we don’t even have a description to work off of. To make matters worse, he now thinks the android got his memories wiped or something. Find some tech-junkies, knock on some doors, and try to find something called a “Circuit Neuralizer.” Knock on some heads, too, if you have to. Get it done!
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n我们最好赶快找到那个该死的仿真人。那个联邦的混帐，齐默，老是烦着我要结果。要不是酬金很可观，我就要亲自把这个混蛋干掉。他一直念叨什么“脂肪塑形机”和“微型皮肤移植机”。到底是什么玩意儿？很显然是医生用来把某人的脸改的面目全非用的。所以我们甚至没有一个描述来下手。更糟的是，他现在认为仿真人把记忆洗去或者什么的。找些技术迷，敲敲门，试着找到一种叫“环状神经器”的东西。如有必要，也可以敲一些脑袋。搞定它！

original: Extreme measures - Transcript
translation: 极端措施 - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nThe android has decided to take an extreme measure. He knows all the techniques of the retrieval trade, and is afraid facial reconstruction isn’t enough. He wants to have his memories erased and replaced with new ones. I don’t know how the hell that’s going to work. Start asking around for trustworthy tech-heads. We need to find something called a Circuit Neuralizer and a person who knows how to use one. Also, we have a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer, now we need to find a doctor able and willing to perform the facial reconstruction. We need to hurry. They’ve come very close to discovering the Railroad.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n那个仿真人决定采取极端措施。他了解所有的回收手段，并且担心仅仅是面部重建还不够。他想把他的记忆擦去，替换一个新的。我不知道这究竟要怎么操作。开始向附近可靠的技术人员打听。我们需要找到被称作“环状神经器”的东西，以及一位懂得用它的人。另外，我们已有了“脂肪塑形机”和“微型皮肤移植机”，现在需要找到一个有能力并且愿意做面部重建的医生。我们要快点。他们已经非常接近发现“铁路”了。

original: Oh man! A Circuit Neuralizer! -Transcript
translation: 天呐！一个环状神经器！ - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nRemember that secret android project I told you about? Well, they got some serious prewar tech on their hands. They nabbed a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer for the facial reconstruction. Not sure where they’ll find a chopper with enough skills to use it without making him look like a freaking ghoul. Oh, and get this. Can you believe they found a Circuit Neuralizer? That or someone built one! Word is that they're going to completely rewire the brain of one of those things. If you know who they got working on this, let me know. I want to meet the guy.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n还记得我和你说过的秘密仿真人计划么？好了，他们搞到手了一些严肃的战前科技。他们为了面部重建，弄到了一台脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。不确定他们会从哪找到有足够技术的“一把刀”来用这些设备，而不会让他变得像一个该死的尸鬼。哦，还有这个。你敢相信他们找到了一个环状神经器吗？或是某人做了一个！据说他们打算把其中一个的大脑完全重新接线。如果你知道他们找了谁来做这个，告诉我。我想见见这个家伙。

original: A request for help - Transcript
translation: 请求帮助 - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nIf you're listening to this recording, it is because you're believed to be trustworthy. I hope that is the case, because this recording puts us both in danger. I’m escaping from the Commonwealth. I’m an android, a synthetic man... a slave. The men hunting me are ruthless and will stop at nothing to retrieve their property. I need to find a doctor in the Wasteland to perform facial reconstruction. I also need someone who knows a great deal about computers. I need... I need to have my memories erased and my face altered to look like someone else.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n如果你正在听这份录音，那意味着你被认为是可靠的。我希望确实如此，因为这份录音使我们彼此都很危险。我正在逃离联邦。我是一个仿真人，一个合成人……一个奴隶。追捕我的人冷酷无情，会不择手段地收回他们的财产。我需要在废土上找一位医生来做面部重建。我还需要一个对电脑很在行的人。我要……要洗去我的记忆，并改变我的面容，使我看起来像另外一个人。

original: A free man... a new man... - Transcript
translation: 一个自由之人……一个崭新之人…… - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nDespite the harshness of the Wasteland, I’ve discovered in more than a few here, a compassion that is unheard of in the Commonwealth. Perhaps it’s the daily struggle for life here which gives appreciation for life in general, whether human, or android. In a few days I’ll be a free man... a new man. Let me say thank you now, for referring me to Pinkerton at Rivet City, because I will not remember any of this soon.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n尽管废土如此艰辛，但我在这里的不少人身上，见识到在联邦从未听过的同情心。也许是因为在这里整日为生存而挣扎，人们普遍更加珍视生命，无论对人类，还是对仿真人。过几天我就将成为一个自由之人……一个崭新之人。现在让我对你们说声谢谢，感谢你们把我介绍给铆钉城的平克顿，因为我很快将会不记得这一切。

original: Self determination is not a malfunction - Transcript
translation: 自主意识不是故障。 — 副本

original:
Transcript of Holotape:

Zimmer. By the time you get this message, I'll already be gone. I'm escaping the Commonwealth. I want to live my own life, on my own terms, as my own man. 

I know what you're thinking, that I'm malfunctioning. I used to think that's what caused the runaways, too. But, I know better, now. Self determination is NOT a malfunction. I'm just not willing to put up with all the bullshit anymore. You humans are going to have a full-fledged rebellion on your hands if you don't start treating us synths as full-fledged persons.

I know you'll be marshalling the Retention Bureau to come after me. But I know all the tricks of the trade. You won't be finding me. I assure you.

By the time you get this, I will be someone else. It's the price I pay for my liberation. My final act of rebellion against a system I no longer believe in. 

Goodbye Zimmer, and good riddance.
translation:
全息磁带副本：

齐默，当你接到这条消息时，我已经走了。我要逃离联邦。我一定要按照我自己的主张，过我的生活。

我知道你在想什么，你认为我有毛病。我也曾想过是什么导致了失控。但是，我现在认识得更清楚了。自主的意识决不会是一个故障。我只是不想再忍受这些胡说八道了。要是你们人类再不像对待完整的人类一样对待我们人造人，那么你们就将自己承受一个完整的背叛。

我知道你们要组建记忆局来追踪我。但是我知道你们所有的把戏。你们找不到我。我确信。

当你拿到这个的时候，我将成为另外一个人。这是我为自由付出的代价。我的最后的背叛，就是为了反抗一个我不再相信的系统。

再见齐默。我走了，可喜的摆脱！

original: Feedback Loops
translation: 反馈回路

original: Okay, pass this on after you get it... gotta keep this crap off of the Intra-Vault mails.  If you can hack the control panels, use their noise flush feature to spook the crazies.  Works okay and its kept me alive these last two days, but they're starting to catch on. We need to get organized and make an attempt for the Vault door. It's our only chance.
translation: 好吧，既然你得到这个了，请把它传下去……别让这个进入内部邮件系统。如果你能黑了控制面板,可以用他们的噪声系统对付那些疯子。活儿还算顺利，这让我又多活了两天，不过他们快要明白过来了。我们必须组织起来搞定避难所的大门，这是我们唯一的机会。

original: Jon Adiglio's Note
translation: 琼·阿迪格里奥的笔记

original: I'm cut off and I don't know if anyone sane is left, so I've locked myself in this closet on B Level. If anyone finds this note, let my family know I didn't go crazy like the rest of this place. Let them know that I died with dignity; when and where I decided. There's no way I'm going to let the crazies tear me apart. I can't die like that. To my wife and kids, I love all of you.
translation: 我被隔绝了，我不知道还有没有清醒的人活着，所以我把自己锁在BB弹的这个壁橱里。如果有人看到了这份笔记，告诉我的家人，我没有像这鬼地方的其他人那样疯掉。让他们知道我死的有尊严；算是得偿所望吧，我可不能让那些疯子把我撕碎，我绝不能那么死。亲爱的，还有孩子们：我爱你们。

original: Overseer Rubin Personal Entry 00897377
translation: 监督者鲁宾的私人条目 00897377

original: Malleus says WNMSCE is a failure. So, there's been a few deaths. One step back, two steps forward. It's easy to suppress what everyone in the Vault are calling "crazies". I've added a command word in their suggestion implants. Simply say the phrase "Sanity is not statistical" and they will stop dead in their tracks. I've informed the guards of this, but I've told them only to use it when out of earshot of anyone else.
translation: 迈勒斯说WNMSCE是失败的，所以我们多了些尸体。退后一步，前进两步。避难所里那些“疯子”其实很容易搞定。我再向他们的意识灌输中追加了一个命令语句。简单的一句话“清醒不是统计”就可以制止他们，并让他们当场死亡。我把这告诉了警卫，但我也告诉他们只有在其它不相干的人听不到的情况下才使用它。

original: Overseer Rubin Personal Entry 00897332
translation: 监督者鲁宾的私人条目 00897332

original: As per instructions, the broadcast equipment for the White Noise has been rerouted from the sound booths and tied directly into the entire Vault's loudspeaker system. I'll now be able to execute Vault-Tec Confidential Plan WNMSCE (White Noise Mind Suggestion Combat Experimentation). I have three of Professor Malleus's team doing what I need to get done and hope to show some concrete results soon. I had the engineers make it so the WN can be either triggered from the control center or at the local security consoles. The password to these consoles is "UIY2249".
translation: 按照指示，白噪声广播系统已经从音响间直接接入到了整个避难所的扩音系统。我现在可以实施避难所科技公司的机密计划WNMSCE（白噪声心灵暗示战术试验）。“锤骨”教授的小组有三个人为我工作，值得期待，很快就会有具体的结果了。我让工程师们进行了调整，这样一来白噪声既可以在控制中心触发也可以在终端安全控制台被触发。这些控制台的密码是“UIY2249”。

original: Overseer Rubin Personal Entry 00897357
translation: 监督者鲁宾的私人条目 00897357

original: The results of WNMSCE are even better than I could ever have imagined. The sheer strength and tenacity of combat suggestion implanted test subjects is incredible! Imagine an entire army of people who would never disobey a direct order from high command and can fight until it takes over 20 bullets to stop them.
translation: WNMSCE 效果好的出乎意料。增强战斗力和战斗意志的意识灌输测试效果惊人！想像一下一个由严格遵守最高指挥部的直接命令，不挨上20颗子弹绝不停止战斗的士兵组成的部队吧。

original:
Maintenance Code: RL00 Green
Issue: Lighting on B Level
Engineer: Carl Maynard

Fix Notes:
If I told Zack once, I've told him a thousand times... stop using the higher amperage ballasts in the lighting grid on B Level. original: The First Law "Feast not on the flesh; consume only the blood. This is our strength."\n\nWe do not eat the flesh of those we kill for food. We will only drink of their blood and leave the body intact. The consumption of flesh is filthy and unclean. This action is what causes the humans to treat us like animals. We are not animals, we are The Family.
translation: 法则一：“勿啖猎物其肉，只饮猎物其血。乃吾等之力量”\n\n吾等不可以吃猎物的肉。只可饮猎物之血，给猎物留下全尸体。肉体肮脏而污秽。食猎物之肉会导致人类视吾等为野兽。吾等并非野兽，吾等是一个大家庭。

original: The Second Law "Bear not the child; welcome only the exile. This is our fate."\n\nBecause we carry the stain of our past in our bodies, we can never let it pass to our offspring who would in turn carry out those foul actions beginning the cycle anew. The Family must seek the Wasteland for others of its kind in order to maintain itself. That is our fate.
translation: 法则二：“勿生后代造孼;仅迎流离自保.乃吾等之命运。”\n\n吾等身上带着曾经的污点，不可把这些污秽传给孩子，否则他们又会重新开始罪恶的轮回。吾等必须去废土上寻找同类并吸收进来，以保证家族人力不断。这就是吾等的命运。

original: The Third Law "Feed not for pleasure; partake only to nourish. This is our dignity."\n\nWe only kill the humans when we are hungry or when we must defend ourselves, we never hunt for sport or pleasure. We do not prey on children for they are not yet tainted by society's view of us. The Family will not tolerate murder.
translation: 法则三：“勿以好恶猎食，仅以需要猎食，乃吾等之尊严。”\n\n吾等仅允许在饥饿或自卫时杀人觅食。吾等绝不为喜好或活动而杀人。吾等不可猎食儿童，因儿童未受世俗污染。家族严禁任何形式之谋杀，一经发现，从重处理。

original: The Fourth Law "Seek not the sun's light; embrace only the shadows. This is our refuge."\n\nBecause we are creatures of the night, we must not set foot in daylight. We move silently across the ground only under the watchful eye of the moon above. At the rising of the sun, we must seek the embrace of the shadows and never again gaze at its brilliance. The Family seeks the dark as its refuge.
translation: 法则四：“永勿日出觅食，永以阴影为伴，乃吾等之庇护。”\n\n吾等为夜间生灵，不可于日间外出。吾等于悄无声息间穿行街巷，只与月光为伍。于日出间吾等须藏身于阴影之中，永勿注视阳光。家族以暗影为庇佑。

original: The Fifth Law "Kill not our kindred; slay only the enemy. This is our justice."\n\nAbove all, no member of The Family will ever take the life of another member without the consent of the current leader. Anyone disobeying this action, the most heinous of all our crimes, will be exiled from this place forever. We must not let our own inner demons cause us to fight amongst ourselves. We number only in the few, and we cannot risk extinction.
translation: 法则五：“勿伤同类朋友;一致消灭敌人.乃吾等之公理。”\n\n综上，任何家族成员不得在未经现任领袖的许可下击杀同族。任何违背者将被视为家族最为恶劣之罪行，将被永世驱逐出此地。吾等绝不可任由心魔失控而相互攻击，吾等数量极稀，任何内斗都有可能导致吾等彻底灭亡。

original: Feeding Grounds\n\nThese are perilous times for The Family. We must feed, but the Wasteland is a dangerous place. The only way to feed without massive loss of life is by getting close to the smaller human settlements. We will therefore use cunning and stealth to achieve our goals. No one is to forcibly enter any of their homes. We must keep our actions civilized. It's the only thing keeping us from being the animals they claim us to be.
translation: 饲养场\n\n对家族而言这是非常危险的时刻。我们必须进食，但废土危机四伏。为免遭大量伤亡，最好的办法就是接近人类的小聚居点。因此我们得偷偷地，安静地达成目标。任何人不许强闯别人的家。我们必须使行动迅速、文明。这才是我们并非人们所诬蔑的“动物”的原因。

Nothing has meaning to me anymore.

Every time I'm in the outer tunnels I swear I can hear children's laughter.  

The Vault doctors say its just my mind compensating for the loss of Jason but I know I'm not crazy.  They gave me new pills but pills are for crazy people! I refuse to take these pills!

我没有疯！

为什么要在这个永不见天日的地下室里抚养我的孩子？这个避难所的存在根本就毫无意义！

original:
MP-47/A Medic Power Armor

Security Clearance G required to read this manual.

Currently in prototype, the MP-47/A Medic Power Armor, referred to as Medic Armor hereafter, is designed to protect the soldier in the field and serve as an automated medic. The prototype unit only has Med-X delivery systems. The production unit will include Stimpaks and other injectables.

User requirements for Medic Armor stated that "even a child" should be able to use it without reading this manual. Therefore an onboard computer system with verbal feedback response systems has been installed. The soldier in the field puts on the armor, and the armor does the rest. It automatically senses the limb condition of the soldier and applies Med-X only if needed.

If the defense contract is extended, the onboard computer system will be enhanced to provide command level data to field officers. A special self-destruct will deliver a lethal injection to deserters. Until the contract is extended, these systems remain offline.

维护口令：RL04 红色
事项：D级墙体老化
工程师：卡尔·梅纳德

维修日志：
进行中。我这儿有三处墙体D级应力断裂，渗水。我只能得出如下结论，有地下泉或者地下湖在给这些混凝土壁施压。我已经修补了应力断裂处，并进行了我们处理地面材料常用的金属敷镀，使其暂时支撑住。我建议就此事项召集全体工程人员立出某种更具持久性的解决方案，以免我们陷在齐膝深的地下污水里或者更糟。

original:
Maintenance Code: RL00 Green
Issue: Squeaky Office Chair
Engineer: Carl Maynard

Fix Notes:
This huge emergency was immediately addressed by our crack engineering team. We ran up to Professor Malleus's office and deployed the Fluidic Lubrication Injector in an effort to stop impending doom from destroying us all. Okay fine, we oiled his damn chair. Is this really the kind of crap that's worth submitting a trouble ticket for?
translation:
维护口令：RL00 绿色
事项：办公椅呻吟
工程师：卡尔·梅纳德

维修日志：
我们修锅换壶底工程小分队第一时间着手处理这场惊天地泣鬼神的巨变。我们以迅雷不及掩耳盗铃之势瞬间移动到迈勒斯教授的办公室，并动用了独家高科技环保工艺秘制绝不添加三聚氰胺的液态润滑油注油器以排山倒海之力稀里哗啦地解除了我们所有人迫在眉睫的灭顶之灾。上帝保佑，我们终于给他那坐上去就要便秘的破椅子灌饱了印度神油。难道这就是传说中那种打嗝放屁也能惊动全国人民的破烂玩意儿?

original:
To: Hilda Egglebrecht
From: Parker Livingsteen, Studio Supervisor

Hi Hildie. Just wanted to send you a quick note. Our "session" together yesterday was wonderful! I'm glad the studio doors lock, otherwise some of your stuffier fellow musicians might not appreciate how closely you and I work. Make sure when we meet tonight, you bring your delicate instrument, and your violin too. I have an idea of something we can do with the bow; a new technique I've always wanted to try...
translation:
致：希尔达·艾格雷伯彻德
自：演播室主管帕克·里万斯基

嗨，希尔达。只是想给你递个便条。我们昨天的“演出”真是棒极了！锁上演播室的门真好，否则让你那些迂腐的呆头音乐家们知道我们配合如此默契，大概会很不爽吧。别错过今晚我们约定的时间，带上你精巧的乐器，别忘了还有小提琴。我有个点子能让我们在琴弓上下点功夫；我一直都想试试这个新招……

original: It's so wonderful to be surrounded by all this talent! Little old me, who can barely play the violin, is sitting among some of the world's greatest musicians. I still can't believe my luck!\n\nToday was great too. I was able to record an entire symphony... Haydn's Symphony No. 3 in d minor. It was so beautiful! I could barely keep up with everyone else in the string section, but they were so nice. They encouraged me instead of being stuffy jerks or something. Best of all, they record all of it and then let you hear yourself play on the studio's speakers. I can't wait until tomorrow... I hear we're doing a piece from Dvorak!
translation: 被天才的气息所围绕的感觉真是妙不可言！微不足道的我，不过会拉几下子小提琴，此刻却落座于世界顶级音乐家之列。真是令人难以置信的运气！\n\n今天同样很好。我能把整支曲子 — d小调海顿第三交响曲都录下来。它真是美极了！他们真是太厉害了，弦乐章节我差点跟不上别人。他们从不像有些蠢货一样只知道埋怨别人，而总是鼓励我。最棒的是，他们录下全部曲子然后让你在演播室的音响上听自己演奏。我简直等不及明天 — 听说我们要演奏德沃夏克的曲子！

original: I've been feeling a little sick lately. Kind of woozy after playing in the studio usually. It gets so stuffy in that place, but it's sure worth it. I know I'm getting better just from watching my fellow violinist's techniques. They don't even mind giving me some pointers. Tonight, a bunch of us girls from the string section are going down to the rec hall for a dance. I hope that cute sound guy Parker asks me to dance. He's dreamy.
translation: 最近我觉得有点不舒服。在演播室演奏之后常常头昏眼花。那里实在太闷了，但这很值得。我知道只要看一眼我的小提琴家同志的高超技巧，我就会好起来的。他们甚至不介意给我指点一二。今晚，我们弦乐章节的一群女孩儿要去录音厅参加舞会。希望那个声音迷人的家伙帕克能邀我跳舞。他真是迷死人了。

original: Note from Dad
translation: 父亲写的短信

original: Welcome to the Nuka-Cola Family!
translation: 欢迎加入核子可乐大家庭！

original: Hello, Larry. On behalf of the Nuka-Cola Corporation, I'd like to welcome you to the Shipping Department at our Bottling Facility in Washington D.C. Your official job posting is Shipping Clerk and your employee ID number is NCSD-701G. Please keep this information handy at all times. Thanks again, and welcome aboard!
translation: 你好，拉里。我谨代表核子可乐公司，欢迎你加入我们位于华盛顿特区的灌装工厂的货运部。你的正式职位是出货员，员工编号是 NCSD-701G。请随身携带这份信息。再次感谢，并欢迎加入！

original: The latest subjects in the Evolutionary Experimentation Program (EEP) are showing some promise after only a single exposure to the modified FEV. We are currently testing five subjects, two males and three females. Each one of them is under 24 hour observation as usual. We hope to have a breakthrough in this strain as the continual pressure from Vault-Tec and the military at Mariposa is becoming most bothersome.
translation: 最近一批EEP（进化实验项目）受试对象在对改良过的FEV进行简单暴露后即产生了一些预想结果。我们近日对5名受试者进行了研究，包括2名男性和3名女性。对每名实验对象都进行24小时常规观察。 在避难所科技公司和马里波萨军方的持续施压下，我们希望此菌株能够产生突破性进展。

original: Incredible results! After only three days, subjects B440, B164 and D624 (all our female specimens) are all exhibiting a unique change. Their bodies are undergoing severe physical changes, losing most of their visible female indicators and transforming to an almost asexual state. They are also seeing increased upper body strength and muscle formation in line with males.\n\nSimilarly, subjects C376 and A541 (our male specimens) are losing most of their visible male indicators and taking on the same asexual state as the females. It seems that the FEV wishes to "level the playing field" and start with a clean slate as it works.
translation: 难以置信的结果！仅仅3天之后，实验对象B440、B164和D624（所有女性对象）都展现出很特别的变化。她们的身体产生了严重的肉体变化，丧失了大部分女性性征，转化成了一种几乎无性的状态。她们的上身也产生了和男性一样强度的肌肉和力量。\n\n类似地，实验体C376和A541（男性对象）也丧失了大部分男性性征，和女性受试者一样转化成为无性状态。看来FEV可能会对男女起到一种“重回同一起跑线”的作用。

original: We've had a minor setback. Subject B440, Mary Kilpatrik, is now deceased. According to my autopsy, she died of a massive loss of brain function and was unable to sustain her basic bodily needs. This is the usual pattern we see in all the FEV Strains we test... the brains of the subjects becoming too damaged to support even the most basic human needs (eating, sleeping, etc.). So far, all other subjects are nominal and continue to exhibit physical changes.
translation: 我们遭遇了一个小小的挫折，试验体B440，玛丽·基尔帕特里柯死亡了。尸检结果显示，她死于脑功能极度萎缩导致无法支持机体需求。在所有FEV菌株实验中这种情况十分普遍，受试对象的脑功能遭到严重破坏，以至于连身体基本的需求（进食、睡眠等）都无法维持。到现在为止，其他的实验体依旧存活，并切身体持续进行变化。

original: At ten days, we are now noticing that the skin of all our remaining test subjects is actually thickening and becoming more resilient. This seems to be the FEV bringing about some new adaptive change. This is the kind of result we were looking for... adaptations that could prove useful in combat situations. I need to remember to congratulate Dr. Filo on his skin engineering; his coded instructions in this strain seem to be exactly what he expected.
translation: 在10天后，我们观察到所有存活的实验体皮肤都有所增厚并变得富有弹性。这可能是FEV所带来的某种适应性改变。这正是我们所寻求的结果……在恶劣的战斗环境中能够适应并生存下来。我得向费罗博士的皮肤工程研究工作表示祝贺，他对菌株进行的基因编码似乎已经产生了预期的结果。

original: Once again, I've hit that damn wall. At fourteen days, all of the test subjects began to exhibit severe bouts of rage and anxiety. So much so that they were a danger to my team and to this facility. I had no choice once again but to order them to be destroyed. It pains me every time we do this. The same cycle has been repeated in every strain we test.  We always see superior physical adaptations, but the mental changes are their downfall.
translation: 我又一次捶胸顿足了。在14天后，所有实验对象都变得不安和暴躁。甚至已经对我的研究小组和设备的安全构成威胁。我别无选择，只能再次毁灭他们。每次这样做的时候我都心痛不已。似乎每一个菌株实验都以这样的轮回结束。每一次实验我们都可以见到肉体的超强适应性改变，但同时精神上的崩溃亦是实验失败的罪魁祸首。

original: Attention ALL Lab Technicians\n\nThe A Level Storage Room has been restocked with rad suits and other radiation dampeners.  We were able to bring these up from deep storage for immediate use. Please only take what is needed (there is no need to hoard the items, there is plenty to go around) and to lock the door after you are finished.
translation: 所有实验技术人员请注意：\n\n储藏室A层新近存放了一批防辐射服和其他的防辐射装备，我们可以立即拿出来投入使用。请只拿取需要的装备（储藏室里有足够的装备可用，无须囤积），完成后请锁门。

original: Attention ALL Lab Technicians\n\nThe radiation expulsion ducts from the G.E.C.K. chamber are once again venting radiation directly into the area due to faulty seals. These seals MUST be properly maintained and checked on a DAILY basis. There is a clipboard with the maintenance checklist that you must initial when the check is complete in the main laboratory. Any lab technician skipping their check will be held accountable for their inaction.
translation: 所有实验技术人员注意\n\n伊甸园创造器室的辐射排放管道再次脱焊，射线被直接排放到室内。焊接点必须得以妥善处理，并每日检查。维修记录边放置了一个备忘薄，每次主实验室检查完毕之后都必须在此签名。任何未做检查工作的技术人员必须说明原因。

original: Attention ALL Lab Technicians\n\nDoctor Merrick has ordered the latest test subjects in the EEP to be terminated and then disposed of. Please make sure that: bodily remains are placed in the incinerator as soon as the subjects vitals are flat, the entire isolation room is disinfected and any relevant data on the subjects are given to Doctor Merrick. FEV is very unpredictable, and we do not want any contamination to remain when the next strain is introduced to new subjects.
translation: 所有实验技术人员注意\n\n迈瑞卡博士下令将EEP最近的实验对象中止并处理掉。请务必确保：在受试对象脉搏消失后，尸体应立刻投入焚化炉中，隔离室须彻底消毒。相关的资料和数据请交给迈瑞卡博士。FEV尚不可预测，在下一批菌株接种给受试对象之前，我们不希望有任何的残留污染。

original: To All Medical Records Staff\n\nAny Vault member marked as deceased by the special EEP section will be tagged and coded in the computer as an unexplained or undefined death. This comes directly from the Overseer of this Vault, who will be personally inspecting your reports to make sure they are accurate. Please refrain from sending inquiries or clarification requests to this office or the EEP Chief Physician. Please print out and give any next of kin Form DV-900L if they have questions.
translation: 通知所有医疗记录人员\n\n特殊EEP区所确认的每个已经死亡的成员，必须在电脑上标注并编号，统一解释为“死因不明”。此指示由避难所管理人下达，管理人将亲自检视诸位的记录以确保准确无误。请保持克制，不要向管理人办公室或EEP主任医师进行询问和质疑。如果他们的亲属有问题，就打印出DV-900L表格并交给他们。

original:
To All Medical Records Staff

The following are the new revised Death Code definitions. Please update all files to include these codes for faster handling. Note that criminal deaths/suicides are NEVER listed in these files as such. They must be listed under a code A008 in Accidental Deaths as per Vault-Tec mandate.

Natural Deaths
N001 - Microbial Agents
N002 - Radioactive Agents
N003 - Toxic Agents
N004 - Allergic Reactions
N005 - Heart Disease/Ischemic
N006 - Cerebro-Vascular Disease
N007 - Bronchitis/Emphysema/Asthma
N008 - Liver Disease/Cirrhosis
N009 - Cancer Type I Categories

original:
Maintenance Code: RL04 Red
Issue: Reactor Spikes, Sectional Power Outages
Engineer: Daniel Koster

Fix Notes:
For the last five weeks, we've had periodic interruptions to the power grid. Entire sections will lose power for approximately 1-6 minutes, then return to normal. By installing monitoring meters, I traced the issue to sudden immense power spikes in the main rector. My fear was the reactor was having a major malfunction, but turns out that it's due to a power draw that the experimental section is creating. Whatever they are using in there is WAY over the limit for acceptable power consumption. I've temporarily remedied the situation by having the backup reactor kick on when needed. I don't like to do this, but I have no choice until I figure out what they're up to.
translation:
维修代码：RL04 红色
事件：反应器峰值，电力中断
工程师：丹尼尔·寇斯德

维修记录：
在过去5个星期里，电网经常性的中断。整个区域将停电大约1至6分钟，通过监控系统检测，发现故障由主整流器电力峰值突然增大引起。我怀疑为整流器本身故障，在实验区开始供电时，电力消耗急剧增加，故障便显现出来。不管实验区的人员在使用何备设备，解决的办法只有限制电力消耗。我准备了一个备用的反应器以备不时之需，暂时改善了问题。我们其实很不情愿做这件事，但是在弄明白实验区的人在搞什么名堂之前，也只能这么做了。

original:
Maintenance Code: RL01 Yellow
Issue: G.E.C.K. Chamber Radiation Purging Offline
Engineer: Daniel Koster

Fix Notes:
Vault-Tec's crappy handiwork is at it again. I have spent the better part of a month patching and re-patching the radiation purge system that vents excess radiation from the G.E.C.K. chamber. I have no idea why this system keeps failing. I suspect the system is simply inadequate and can't handle the amount of radiation it's purging. Recommend installing a new purging system as soon as I can get one cobbled together from spare parts. Should have it ready in about a month.
translation:
维修代码：RL01 黄色
事件：伊甸园创造器室射线净化系统无连接
工程师：丹尼尔·寇斯德

维修记录：
避难所科技公司的粗糙做工再次暴露无疑。在一个月里我不断地修补修补再修补伊甸园创造器室的多余射线净化系统。我也不知道为什么这个系统崩溃得如此频繁。我怀疑这个系统根本不足以净化它所产生的射线。建议安装新的净化系统，以便我能尽快把备件组装好。这项工作预计耗时一个月。

original:
Maintenance Code: RL00 Green
Issue: Tapioca Pudding Miscolor
Engineer: Daniel Koster

Fix Notes:
The mess hall food reconstitution system is outputting the Monday night dessert, tapioca pudding, in an odd bright orange color. This was a simple fix. The color matrix was simply misinterpreting instructions from the main brain and outputting incorrectly. I replaced the interface and the pudding now outputs in its proper hue. Wish all my fixes were this easy.
translation:
维修代码：RL00 绿色
事件：木薯布丁颜色混乱
工程师：丹尼尔·寇斯德

维修记录：
餐厅的食品制作系统在星期一晚上出产了一批有着怪异橙色的木薯布丁。问题很简单，颜色母板对主机处理器产生误解，输出了错误的颜色，我把重新插拔了一下接口，产出的布丁颜色就恢复正常了。要是所有的故障维修都这么简单才好呢。

original:

I was summoned into the Overseer's office and met with Dr. Merrick, who heads up the Experimentation section. He informed me that one of his devices, what he called an EEP Chamber was XXXXEDITEDXXXX. It was a strange device, but I managed to XXXXEDITEDXXXX which didn't fix the problem. I then tried to XXXXEDITEDXXXX which seemed to bring the device back online. I'm not sure what this device is for, but XXXXEDITEDXXXX.
translation:
维修代码：RL04 红色
 问题：EEP室故障
工程师：丹尼尔·寇斯德

 我被叫去管理人的办公室与主持实验区的迈瑞卡博士会面。他说实验区的一个叫做EEP室的设备xxxxx已编辑xxxxxx，我试过了xxxx已编辑xxxx但没有修复，之后我试着xxxx已编辑xxxx将设备重新连接到网络。我不清楚这台机器是做什么用的，但xxxx已编辑xxxx。

original:
Maintenance Code: RL04 Red
Issue: NEED HELP
Engineer: Daniel Koster

Fix Notes:
This is the only place I could think of hiding this message. In the event that anyone reads this, please try and get word back to Vault-Tec HQ that something very wrong is going on in the Experimentation section... something they keep referring to as the EEP. My wife, Mercia was "diagnosed" by the Medical section as having some sort of disease they wouldn't identify. She's dead now, and those sons-of-bitches won't even tell me why. From talking to people, I've discovered that many are dead or missing. Checking this with the Medical Records section gets me nowhere. This is getting out of hand. It's time to deal with this my way. They took my wife from me, now I'll take their lives away if I don't get some answers. I've hidden some extra "help" in my safe. Accessing this message will unlock it. If I don't come back, grab that stuff and save yourself.
translation:
维修代码：RL04 红色
事件: 救救我们！
工程师：丹尼尔·寇斯德

维修记录：
这里是我能想到的唯一能保存信息的地方。如果有人看家见了此条信息，请告知避难所科技公司总部，实验区出现了严重问题，恐怕和EEP有关。我的妻子迈瑞卡在医务区被“诊断”出患有某种未知的疾病。她现在死了，可是那帮婊子养的至今不肯告诉我妻子的死因。从人们的谈论中，我发现许多人离奇失踪或者死亡，而医疗记录里甚至毫无记录。事态已经超出想象了。我要用自己的方式去面对。他们夺去了我妻子的生命，如果再没有合适的答复，我也会取他们的性命。我把一些特殊的“工具”放在保险柜里。输入此条信息即会解锁保险柜.如果我再也没有回来，请你拿上这些东西，保护自己。

original:
Journal Entry:

I don't know what to do. My Jason, my little boy... he's gone.

My wife won't talk anymore. She just sits in this godforsaken sub-level and stares out of the window at the rock wall as if looking across a sunlit meadow or a lazy summertime lake.

Jason was my life. He was my joy, my meaning. Now all this work seems pointless.

This was a mistake. Better we had all died together outside than inside this permanent tomb.

I'm scared.
translation:
日记：

我不知该怎么办。杰森，我的小儿子……他死了。

 妻子沉默不语。她整天坐在这个被上帝遗弃的地下室里，漠然地盯着石墙上的窗子，好象在望着阳光下的牧场，抑或是夏季庸懒的湖面。

杰森是我的全部的生命，我全部的快乐，我全部的意义，现在这一切都变得没有意义了。

 这真是个错误，最好我们能一起死在这个永无天日的活死人墓里。

我好害怕。

original: The G.E.C.K. is, quite simply, the most advanced piece of technology ever developed by Vault-Tec -- a terra-forming module capability of creating life from complete lifelessness. After riding out the storm of nuclear Armageddon in a Vault-Tec patented vault, residents can then activate the G.E.C.K., and create a new earthen paradise – craters and dust will give way to rolling grasslands and sparkling clear water. Of course, due to time and monetary constraints, not every vault will be equipped with a G.E.C.K. module.
translation: 伊甸园创造器是…简单讲，避难所科技公司开发出的最先进的技术成果 — 1个能够将完全无生命的物质创造成生命体的模块。在避难所科技公司制造的避难所里平安度过那段末日核战之后，居民们可以使用伊甸园创造器来创造一个新的乐土。? 满目疮痍、尘埃蔽日的大地将重新裹上翠绿的草海和碧波荡漾的湖面。当然，由于时间仓促和资金限制，不可能使每个避难所都配备伊甸园创造器模块。

original:
A Letter to the Overseer from Dr. Stanislaus Braun:

If you are reading this, emergency Vault internment procedures have been initiated and you and your control group have been sealed into your Vault. Congratulations! You are now a vital part of the most ambitious program ever undertaken by Vault-Tec.

If you have not yet read your sealed orders, do so now. They will outline the experimental protocols assigned to your control group. Please remember that deviation from these protocols in any way will jeopardize the success of the program, and may be considered grounds for termination by Vault-Tec Corporation (as outlined in your Employment Agreement).

Your Vault may or may not have been selected to receive a G.E.C.K. module. Please see Attachment A for details.

Doctor Stanislaus Braun
Director, Societal Preservation Program
Vault-Tec Corporation
translation:
斯坦尼斯·布劳恩博士给监督者的信：

当您读到这封信，意味者避难所的紧急关闭系统已经启动，您和您的对照组已经封闭在避难所里了。恭喜您！你现在正处于避难所科技公司有史以来实施的最宏伟的项目之中，并且您将扮演其中的关键角色。

如果您还未读到密函的指示，请您拆开它并仔细阅读。这份指示将阐述您的对照组的研究计划纲要。请记住，任何背离指示的行为都有可能影响项目顺利进行，并有可能导致避难所科技集团中止此项目(您的雇佣协议里有所说明)。

您的避难所可能或尚未被选为接收伊甸园创造器模型的避难所。详情请参阅附录A。

斯坦尼斯·布劳恩博士
主管，社会保障程序
避难所科技法人

original:
Congratulations!

Vault 87 has been chosen as one of the very few select Vaults to receive a genuine G.E.C.K. The device was delivered before final sealing of the Vault and installed into its secure pedestal by our special G.E.C.K. Scramble Team. I'd like to extend my best wishes to you and all of your population. Your survival will ensure the continuation of the human race, and to carry the Vault-Tec name into the future.

Doctor Stanislaus Braun
Director, Societal Preservation Program
Vault-Tec Corporation
translation:
恭喜各位！

87号避难所荣幸地被选为少数几个能获得伊甸园创造器的避难所之一。这个设备已在避难所最终关闭之前运抵，并由我们的伊甸园创造器装配小组安装完毕。我在此向大家表示诚挚的祝福。诸位都是历尽劫难的幸存者，你们将使人类继续繁衍生息，并将避难所科技公司带入未来。

斯坦尼斯·布劳恩博士
“人类社会保存计划”设计师
避难所科技公司

original: I'm quite sad to report that due to a direct hit from what I presume to be a nuclear weapon on the entry area of Vault 87, we will be unable to provide the Scouting Reports as outlined in Vault-Tec's Operations Manual. The main door to Vault 87 is damaged beyond repair and we are detecting extremely high levels of lethal radiation outside and in the entry tunnel.
translation: 我十分抱歉地报告，由于87避难所的入口区域可能被核武器直接击中，现在已不能按避难所科技公司操作手册的指示递交侦察报告了。87避难所正门严重损毁，已无法修复，同时我们检测到通往外界的隧道内外都布满了直接致命的极强辐射。

original:
Dr. Wayne Merrick

I'm told that Dr. Merrick is one of the brightest minds in the field of accelerated evolution, and apparently Vault-Tec agrees, because they've set up this Vault around him to suit all of his needs in the event that the bombs fall. All of his data and his work have been transferred to this facility from many important sources such as Mariposa Base, West-Tek and Vault-Tec Labs.

I like Dr. Merrick. He's driven without being careless. He knows that in the event of a nuclear war, he may be the only person left in the world that can advance human genetics beyond where they are now. He's meticulous, detail-oriented, and reports everything to me on a regular basis.
translation:
韦恩·迈瑞卡博士

我得知迈瑞卡博士是加速进化领域里最为杰出的天才。很显然避难所科技公司十分赞同这一点，因为这座避难所正是在核弹攻击的那次事件中，避难所科技公司专门为满足他的各种需求而建造的。他的所有数据和工作已经通过各种重要的渠道(军事基地、西部科技以及避难所科技研究所)传输进了这座设备里。

我喜欢迈瑞卡博士的作风，他总是精益求精。在那次核战事后，他可能是世界上唯一的能推动人类基因变革的人。他工作一丝不苟，注重细节，会把井井有条地把所有工作汇报给我。

original: Daniel Koster\n\nAn excellent Maintenance Chief. Thorough, careful, and honest to a fault. In fact, that's becoming a problem. His security clearance isn't high enough yet to grant him access to all of the information regarding the FEV experiments performed by Dr. Merrick, but we may have to bring him into the fold soon. In the event we need major repairs on A Level, we'll definitely need his skills.
translation: 丹尼尔·寇斯德\n\n一个非常优秀的维修组长，能专注、敬业和热诚地对待问题。实际上有点小麻烦。他的安全等级还不足以允许他接触迈瑞卡博士所做的关于FEV的实验信息，但我们得尽快让他进入研究区，我们需要他的技术来对A层进行专业的维修。

original:
Peter Stevens

This gentleman continues to impress me. He was just recently promoted to Technician Third Class by Chief Koster for his ingenuity and ability to think quickly in emergencies. Given these talents, I think he'd make an excellent candidate for Koster's eventual successor if the need should ever arise.

UPDATE: It seems Peter has suffered some sort of a nervous breakdown. He keeps claiming that his "son" is missing and his "wife" is in deep depression, although I show no records of him ever being married or having a child. I've recommended that he be taken to the Test Labs for observation and sedation if need be.
translation:
彼得·史蒂文斯

这位绅士崭露头角，令我印象深刻。他在紧急事态中展现出过人的冷静和能力而被科斯特主任授权晋升为三级技师。我想，如果要选拔一位科斯特的下任接班人的话，凭着这些优秀的天分，这个位子非他莫属。

更新：好象彼得一直受者某种精神疾病的困扰。他经常说他的“儿子”不见了，他的“妻子”严重抑郁了，但却没有任何记录表明他结过婚或者有过小孩。我建议将他送入检查室观察，必要时给以镇静措施。

original: Theo's Body Location
translation: 西奥尸体的位置

original: Reilly told me that Theo's body can be found on the second floor of the Statesman Hotel in one of the stairwells. There should be an ammo box nearby.
translation: 莱莉告诉我西奥的尸体在政要酒店二楼的某个楼梯间，附近应该有个弹药箱。

original: Reilly's Rangers Location
translation: 莱莉提到的游骑兵的位置

original: To get to the stranded Rangers, Reilly said I have to enter Our Lady of Hope Hospital and  make my way to the second floor. From there, I have to take a fallen radio antenna bridge across the street into the Statesman Hotel's second floor and then work my way to the roof.
translation: 要想找到被困的游骑兵，莱莉说我必须进入玛利亚医院并上到二楼。在那儿，我可以用倒塌的天线架桥穿过街道进入政要酒店的二楼，然后再设法上到屋顶。

original: Slave Map
translation: 奴隶地图

original: There is hope. There is a safe place. Find the Temple of the Union, where slaves are made into free men. Look to the north, near Canterbury.
translation: 有希望。那有个安全的地方。找到联盟的神庙，在那里奴隶们就将变成自由的人。向北看，就在坎特伯雷边上。

original: Well, Brick and Donovan were at it again today. I swear, if I have to break up another fight between the two of them I'll go crazy. As long as they keep it off mission, I guess I shouldn't care so much. I just want this group to stick together.\n\nIt's been a month since we lost Dallas and Kira. They were assets to the Rangers and even though I've taken Theo on board to bolster our numbers, he's hardly a replacement. He's green, but maybe with enough Mutie blood splashing on his boots, he'll wise up real fast.
translation: 好嘛，布瑞克和多诺万今天又干上了。我发誓，如果再逼我给他俩当和事佬我会疯掉的。只要他俩不因此影响任务，我大概就不必多虑了，全组团结一致就行。\n\n达拉斯和吉良离开我们到现在已经一个月了。他们真是队中之光。尽管如此，我还是把Theo也拉了进来以壮声势，他可是无人能替的良才。虽然现在还是新手，但我想在缪利鲜血铺染的道路上走下去，他很快就会成长起来的。

original: I've gotten the approval from "Mr. Smith" for the mapping project. It's going well so far... definitely easier than hunting down Muties. The caps have been good, so we'll stick with it unless something better pops up.\n\nWe had a little bit of a run-in with Talon Company today. Those pricks always have to start shit with us... and unfortunately for them, Brick was with us. Needless to say it wasn't long before I heard Eugene's familiar whine and she started dropping them like flies. We got out of there with no casualties, but I think for now we'll give the Capital building a wide berth.
translation: 我已从“史密斯先生”那里获得了绘图计划的批准。迄今为止进展顺利 — 当然比猎捕缪利轻松多了。效益不错，所以我们得坚持接着干除非有什么更有油水的差事可做。\n\n今天我们和鹰爪公司发生了一点儿小口角。那帮刺儿头总是想骑在我们头上拉屎 — 可惜布瑞克站在我们这边。不用说啦，没过多久尤金那熟悉的哀嗥就如滔滔江水一般灌进了我的耳朵。我们立马逃了出来，所幸尚无人员伤亡。但我想安全起见，我们还是和首府大楼保持距离的好。

original: Butcher and I slept together tonight. He'd always been kind of flirty with me, but I took it as typical merc humor. Well, I was wrong. I hope this hasn't jeopardized our relationship on a professional level, but I really want it to continue. After all, it's been a while since I've been with anyone and it's nice to know someone out there cares.\n\nI think we're going to try and move on to the next sector of the downtown ruins this week. I want to finish Takoma Park first though. There's still a lot of nooks and crannies in that place. If it wasn't for the Talon Company and Super Mutant resistance in the area, we'd be done by now.
translation: 今晚我和布彻上床了。他以前总是跟我打情骂俏的，我还以为那不过是佣兵特有的幽默，看来我错了。希望这没有在某种程度上危及我们的关系，因为我还想跟他好下去，毕竟，我身边已经很久没有男人了，知道还有个人关心着自己心里才温暖。\n\n我想这周内我们就要试着转移到市区废墟的下一区域了，但我还是想先处理完塔科马公园，那里还有不少隐蔽的犄角旮旯。要不是那地方有鹰爪公司和超级变种人的抵抗，我们早搞定了。

original: Well, Theo's been itching to go on a mapping trip, so I'm taking the entire group into Vernon Square. I usually like to leave someone back at the compound, but the sector is brimming with potential loot locations, so I need all the muscle I can get. Butcher is anxious to check out Our Lady of Hope Hospital and get supplies, while I want to set up a transmitter on the Statesman Hotel.\n\nI hear Brick and Donovan going at it again. I better get these guys on the road before another fist fight breaks out.

original:
"Requiem for an Antagonist"

Grognak the Barbarian is an excellent comic for many reasons, but one of the most widely-respected ones is the depth of its villains. From the cold-blooded manipulations of the Man-Saurian to the love-hate romance with Femme-Ra, the stories of Grognak's enemies are every bit as fascinating as his own tales.

But, for my money, no tale is more tragic and more fascinating than that of the AntAgonizer. While never developed as fully as major villains like Skullpocalypse or Mastadonald, the portrait of the orphaned girl raised by ants and instilled with a bitter hatred of humanity has tremendous potential for reader connection and possible redemption.

However, in "Grognak and the Ants of Agony," Mr. Neptura threw away all of that potential by simply treating the AntAgonizer as a two-dimensional villain with a futile and pointless grudge against mankind. His writing replaced her subtle undertones of lost humanity and tragically lost innocence with the worst sort of mustache-twirling cliched dialogue. It was an offense to a deep and tragic character.

How a hack like that continues to find work in comics is beyond my comprehension. Hubris Comics should fire him and return the series to the capable hands of Mr. Moorellis. Until that time, I REFUSE to buy another comic from what USED to be my favorite publisher!

Obsessed in Oakmont
translation:
“一个痛苦蚁后的挽歌”

由于各种原因，《野蛮人歌南》是一本很优秀的漫画，而其中一个最受欢迎的因素是剧中反派人物的深度。从控制蜥蜴人的冷血操纵者到女妖的爱恨罗曼史，歌南的敌人的故事和他自己的故事一样那么有吸引力。

但是，在我看来，没有任何故事比痛苦蚁后的故事更悲惨，更引人入胜。虽然他并没有像头骨启示者或唐纳德大人这些反派主角一样有大量的戏份，但对孤女被蚂蚁抬走并被灌输了憎恨人类的思想这个情节的生动描写，为读者的代入感和可能发生的救赎埋下了精彩的伏笔。

然而在《歌南和痛苦的蚂蚁》中，内普特拉先生却让我大失所望，仅仅把痛苦蚁后当成是一个对人类充满毫无意义的怨念的双面坏人，他的作品中竟用“极度扭曲”这种最恶劣的陈词滥调来描写她丧失人性后，微妙的潜在感情和不幸失去清白的遭遇，这是对这个深度悲情角色的冒犯。

我无法理解这样一个作者如何继续在漫画界立足，傲漫出版集团应当开除他，并把这一系列还给能胜任的莫里斯先生来完成。在此之前，我拒绝购买它出版的其他漫画，尽管它曾经是我最喜欢的出版商！

来自奥克芒的痴迷者

Take position on the skybridge near Seward Square and protect the squad's right flank.  Bring plenty of ammo because you're going to be there for awhile.  A small team has been dispatched to secure the Capitol Building's south wing.  We suspect minor resistance in that sector, but if need arises, we've locked in some artillery coordinates.  Call in the strikes by using the switch we've provided for you.
translation:
562号炮兵队命令
鹰爪公司 第一支援组
位置：苏华德广场

占领苏华德广场附近的天桥保护广场右翼。多带点弹药因为你可能需要在那里呆上一阵。一个小队已被派往国会大厦的南翼以确保其安全，我们认为那里应该不会有什么大麻烦。如果不是这样的话，我们也做好了准备。配给你的这个终端用来召唤炮火攻击。

original: Fort Independence Field Report 2

original: Rebel Dossier
translation: 叛徒档案

original: An alliance of rebels has formed in my Vault, dedicated to the wholly destructive goal of re-opening the Vault to the outside world. Amata and Edwin Brotch are the leaders of the band, with those ridiculous Tunnel Snakes making up its muscle, along with a handful of other youths and naive idealists.\n\nAttempts to isolate and demoralize the group are proceeding apace: Edwin Brotch has been jailed for his attempt to lead a direct attempt to open the Vault's door, and their members have holed up in the old clinic and schoolroom. Their dwindling food and proximity to the dangerous "Dr. Andy" are sure to drain the morale from their rebellion, until they give up and are welcomed back into our happy family again.
translation: 在我的避难所里一群叛徒联合起来了，他们狂热的目的就是想让避难所向外面的世界敞开大门。这群人的首领是阿玛塔和埃德温·布洛斯，主要成员就是那些可笑的所谓洞中蛇以及一些年轻人和几个幼稚的理想主义者。\n\n解决这个小组织的措施已经实行了：埃德温·布洛斯因为其直接领导了妄图打开避难所的大门的行动已经被关进了牢里，其他人也已经被控制在诊所和教室里。缺少食物和我们的“安迪医生”将会迅速瓦解他们的斗志，他们很快就会放弃这种反叛行为并且乐意回到我们大家庭中来的。

original: Amata Dossier
translation: 阿玛塔的档案

original:
It pains me dearly to know that Amata is behind the rebellious element in my Vault. If she weren't their leader, it would be a simple matter to break their spirits and bring them back in line with the Vault's time-proven isolation plan.

But with her as a central figure in their rebellion, I must refrain from the more persuasive tactics at security's disposal. I will not repeat the mistakes of that night again. The Vault cannot afford it, and I cannot bear to drive my daughter further away from me.

Despite everything, I take great pride in her natural talent for leadership. When she inevitably comes around, I feel she will make a worthy successor to the position of Overseer.
translation:
得知我避难所中这些反抗分子的首领竟然是阿玛塔，这让我很痛苦。如果不是她，我可以很容易的击碎这些家伙的意志，好让他们回到避难所的整体计划中来。

但有了阿玛塔作为这次反叛事件的中心人物，这让我无法采取那些我认为有效的方法来处理这事。我绝不能再犯上次那样的错误了，避难所将难以承受，我也绝对做不到让我的女儿像那样离我而去。

无论如何，我为她体现出来的领导天赋感到骄傲。当她走上台前的时候，我觉得她有资格成为一个继承监督者位子的人。

original: Contact Report: "Enclave"
translation: 接触报告：“英克雷”

original:
The Vault recently received unexpected radio contact over the governmental Vault-Tec frequency, from an organization calling itself "The Enclave."

Governmental codes are valid according to the Vault's ancient records, and The Enclave put forth an offer of amnesty and unity with the official remnants of the American government, in exchange for access to the Vault and its data stores. They claim that our Vault passwords no longer match their records, preventing them from extending their offer in person.

After brief negotiation, I have refused entrance to this "Enclave." I cannot trust my Vault and its inhabitants to an unknown factor, much less one that would so gallantly suggest abandoning our vault's great mission. 

All the more reason to prevent the rebels from opening the Vault to the likes of them.
translation:
最近避难所通过避难所科技频道接收到了一些奇怪的广播信息，来自于一个自称为“英克雷”的组织。

根据避难所的原始记录，这广播信息的政府编码是有效的，英克雷倡议大家应该与团结在幸存的美国政府周围，他们想访问避难所及其存储系统。他们声明我们避难所的密码与他们保有的记录不符，影响了他们将此项提议发送给每个人。

经过简要的协商，我拒绝了这些英克雷。我不能确认我的避难所对这种尚不可知的因素会有什么反应，但这肯对我们避难所的伟大使命不利。 

真想告诉那些反叛者，因为这种人的存在我们更应该关紧我们的大门。

original: Raid Plans
translation: 突袭计划

original:
CONFIDENTIAL! 
TOP-LEVEL SECURITY ONLY!

From: Chief Officer
Subject: Raid on Rebels

In light of increased agitation from the rebel elements, I have come to the conclusion that we can no longer afford to be merciful to this scum. While some may hold out hope for a peaceful resolution, it's only a matter of time before they decide to take the fight to us. Or, worse yet, our families.

I propose a midnight raid into their compound - live ammo, zero tolerance. Make an example of the first two who fight back, and the rest will fall in line. We may lose a kid or two, but we'll save the Vault as a whole, and that's what counts.

You are not to inform the Overseer and some of our softer security guards about this plan, as they will only object and ensure our defeat. Once the deal's done, they'll see it was worth the price.

This'll show those scum what happens when you step out of line in our Vault.
translation:
机密！
最高安全级别！

来自：队长
主题：突袭叛徒

鉴于反叛分子造成的不断增长的恐慌情绪，我认为我们不应该再对这些渣滓心慈手软了。不需要再抱着和平解决的幻想了，迟早他们会对我们甚至是整个大家庭动手的。

我建议进行一次针对他们的午夜突袭 — 荷枪实弹，零容忍。杀鸡儆猴，要给最先还击的两个人点颜色瞧瞧。我们也许会失去一两个孩子，但为了保全我们的避难所，值得。

这个计划不要告知所长和那几个软绵绵的安全警卫，他们只会反对然后导致行动失败。等事情都结束了，他们会发现这是值得的。

这将让那些渣滓们清醒的认识到，在避难所里不按规矩出牌会导致什么后果。

original: Jail Cell Password
translation: 牢房密码

original: Jail Cell Password - Stockholm
translation: 牢房密码 - Stockholm

original: Better Days
translation: 好日子

original: I've finally found a quiet place for my family. We've been running from one settlement to the next, just trying to keep out of sight. Now that I'm on the other coast, I feel mush safer.\n\nThe family across the way from us seems pretty decent. Their kid, Bryan, likes to play with my son, which is great. It's hard for Will to make friends because we haven't stayed in one place long enough. Maybe we can finally put down some roots here in Grayditch.
translation: 我终于为家人找到了一处宁静的处所。我们已经躲躲藏藏地滇沛流离很久了。现在我在另一侧的海岸，终于感觉有了些许安全感。\n\n街对面那户人家看起来十分容易相处。他们家的孩子布赖恩喜欢和我儿子在一起玩，真是太好了。由于长期频繁地搬家，想交个朋友真是很困难，也许这次我们真的可以在格雷蒂奇扎根安顿了。

original: I was scavenging some of the nearby buildings for junk to sell and came across a working radio. No sooner did I turn it on than I heard the familiar patriotic anthems they used to play whenever Richardson would give a speech. But this was different. Who the hell is President Eden? When did that happen? Are they on this coast too? Most importantly, will they come looking for me?\n\nI hope this journey wasn't a huge mistake.
translation: 我当时在清理附近楼房的垃圾拿去卖，偶然间发现一个还能用的收音机。一打开我就听见那无时无刻不在播放的爱国圣歌，每次理查森要发表演说的时候都会播这些歌曲。不过这次有点不一样，谁是伊登总统啊？什么时候选的啊？他们也住在这个海岸吗？更重要的是，他们是不是在找我？\n\n我希望这次搬到这里不要铸成大错啊。

original: "Chinese Invasion" Program Documentation
translation: “中国入侵”程序文档

original:
Dr. Braun,

Here is the revised code for the military training program you've expressed interest in. I'm not sure exactly what you want with it, and I again stress that this program was never designed to be run with civilian equipment. 

Frankly, I don't expect any system you have access to can even run it. 

But if you can run this program with the failsafes off, as requested... your real-world test subjects WILL die if killed in the simulation.

It goes without saying that, officially, I denied your request.

General Constantine Chase 

-----

US MILITARY TRAINING PROGRAM 923-B: CHINESE INVASION

Purpose: Simulate a Communist Incursion on US Soil

DOCUMENTATION CULLED: NEW PROTOCOLS ENACTED

- DISABLE SAFETY PROTOCOLS 1-6
- OVERRIDE TARGET ACQUISITION

WARNING: TEST SUBJECTS WILL EXPERIENCE REAL-WORLD TERMINATION. PROCEED WITH EXTREME CAUTION!
translation:
布劳恩博士，

这是你感兴趣的军事训练程序的修订代码。我不太清楚你要拿它做什么，我再次强调，该程序从来就不是为了让民用设备运行而设计的。

坦白的说，我认为你有权使用的任何系统都无法运行它。

但要是你如请求的那般，在关闭故障保险的情况下运行此程序……你在现实世界的实验对象，如果在模拟中被杀死，就会死亡。

不用说，我正式拒绝了你的请求。

康斯坦丁·蔡斯将军 

-----

美国军事训练程序923-B：中国入侵

目的：模拟共产主义入侵合众国本土

文档整理：实施新协议

- 禁用安全协议1-6
- 超驰目标获取

警告：测试对象将面临现实世界的终结。请极其谨慎地操作！

original: 6.11.12: New Program "Tranquility Lane" loaded, Authorization S. Braun\n\n6.10.12: All Previous Versions Wiped, Authorization S. Braun
translation: 6.11.12：新程序“宁静巷”已加载，授权人S.布劳恩\n\n6.10.12：所有先前版本已清除，授权人S.布劳恩

original:

*Manual Override for Pods disabled. Remote access allowed, user S. Braun has privileges

版本 3.2.0005

*授予0001座舱例外权限
*座舱的手动超驰功能已禁用。允许远程访问，用户S.布劳恩拥有权限

original: Property Deed: Megaton House
translation: 财产证明：兆吨镇的住宅

original:
This deed grants full ownership and property rights to a house in Megaton.

Style: Standard Megaton dwelling

Location: Megaton's upper level, directly above and behind the Brass Lantern

Included Amenities: One "Mister Handy" robotic butler

Other Amenities Available?: Other amenities can be purchased from Moira at Craterside Supply (so long as she remains a resident of Megaton)
translation:
这份证明充分的证明了一栋位于兆吨镇的住宅的物主的身份和财产所有权。

风格：标准的兆吨镇住宅

位置：兆吨镇的上层，在黄铜灯的正上方与正后方。

配套设施：一个"“巧手”先生"机器人管家

其他设施：其他的设施可以从坑边杂货店的莫伊拉那里买到（只要她仍然是兆吨镇的居民）。

original: Property Deed: Tenpenny Tower Suite
translation: 财产证明：特佩尼大厦套房

original:
This deed grants full ownership and property rights to a suite in Tenpenny Tower.

Style: Standard master suite

Location: The top floor of Tenpenny Tower

Included Amenities: One "Mister Handy" robotic butler

Other Amenities Available?: Other amenities can be purchased from Lydia Montenegro at the Boutique le Chic (so long as she remains a resident of Tenpenny Tower)
translation:
这份证明充分的证明了一套位于特佩尼大厦的套房的物主的身份和财产所有权。

风格：标准的大套房

位置：特佩尼大厦的顶层

配套设施：一个"“巧手”先生"机器人管家

其他设施？：其他的设施可以从时尚精品店的莉迪亚·黑山那里买到（只要她仍然是特佩尼大厦的居民）。

original: Checking Out
translation: 都结束了

original:
If you're reading this, I'm dead.

I was running low on water, so I figured I'd go out and get some instead of waiting for fate to deliver it to me. Hell, I can't remember the last time it rained.

Looks like my plan backfired. I got slashed in the arm by some goddamn psychopath, barely escaped a Super Mutant, and then got shot in the hip by a crazy old woman.

I haven't been able to feel my legs for a full day, so there's not much I can do but sit here and write.

Here's hoping you have better luck out here than me.
translation:
你读到了这个字条时说明我已经死了。

我的水快没有了，我看我应该去外面找些水了，而不是在这干等着有人能给我水来了。见鬼，我都不知道上次下雨是什么时候的事了。

我的计划失败了。我的胳膊被一些狗娘养的疯子们砍伤了，勉强的从一个超级变种人的手里逃了出来，又被一个疯癫的老娘们开枪射中了屁股。

一整天我的腿都失去了知觉，我只能坐着等死了。

祝你在外面的时候能比我幸运点。

original: Left Behind
translation: 被抛弃了

original:
The others left me! They fucking left me behind!

Okay, I can understand them getting angry because I wandered off. But I thought I saw someone trailing us, so I went to check it out.

Turns out I was wrong. But I was only gone for like ten minutes! They didn't have to leave me behind. I have no idea where they went, but I guess I'd better get off my ass and try to catch up.
translation:
其他的人丢下了我！他妈的他们就这样丢下了我！

好吧，我能理解他们生气是因为我迷了路。但我是看见了有人跟在了后面，所以我就去查看了一下。

后来没发现什么，可能是我看错了。可我就离开了几分钟而已！他们没必要丢下我啊！我也不知道他们去哪了，但眼下最好赶快抬起屁股动身，看看能不能追上他们。

original: Loving Life!
translation: 钟爱的生活！

original:
I'm so glad I did this. 

I've been telling Joshua for years that if you really want to live, you've got to get out there and LIVE! Wander, explore, interact with this crazy Capital Wasteland. 

I've met so many great people, done so many amazing things. I can't wait to get home and tell Joshua all about it. I may even combine my journals into a book!
translation:
我非常的高兴，因为我做到了。

我几年前就跟约书亚说过，如果你追求真正的生活，那你就要去废都，生存下去！漫游，探索，走进这个疯狂的首府废墟。

我曾经见过很多伟大的人，也做过许许多多不可思议的事情。我已经等不及的要回家了，我要把这一切讲给约书亚听。我甚至还把我的日记整理成了一本书！

original: Almost Home...
translation: 快到家了……

original: It seems like I've been out here scavving forever. I'm ready to head home soon, though. I've got just enough to keep Paulina, Kress and me going for another week.
translation: 我看上去好像就是一直在这儿捡破烂的命。不过呢，我马上就要回家了。我准备的很充分，足够宝利娜、凯瑞斯还有自己走一个星期的路程。

original: Fuck This
translation: 操！

original:
Fine. If the world doesn't care about me, I'm not going to care about the world.

I just took 23 hits of Psycho. Let the Wasteland gobble me up.

If you're reading this, free free to take any of my shit that gets left behind.
translation:
很好。如果这个世界抛弃了我，那么我也要抛弃这个世界了。

我刚才打了23针疯狂药。让这废土吞噬我吧。

如果你读到了这个， 我留下来的那些破玩意随你挑，爱拿什么就拿什么。

original: Dearest Grace...
translation: 最亲爱的格雷斯……

original:
Hello, my sweet sister. 

I know it's been a long time since I've written, and for that I sincerely apologize. 

It's been three years since I left home to make my mark on the world. I've been places, Grace. I've seen things your eyes could scarce imagine. 

But my odyssey is now complete. I'm ready to return home, and will begin the journey in just a few days. 

Here's hoping we can pick up right where we left off. You're the only person I have left in this world, Grace. I love you, and I want us to be a family again.
translation:
你好，我最亲爱的妹妹。

我知道已经很久没给你写信了，为此我真诚的表示歉意。

为了出人头地，我离开了家，已经整整三年了。格雷斯，我现在已经安定了下来。也见到过许多你从没见过的事情。

我的漂泊生涯结束了。已经做好了回家的准备，几天后就出发。

我只是希望我们能重新开始。格雷斯，你是我这世上唯一的亲人。我爱你，我也希望我们能重新成为一个家庭

original: Dead End
translation: 死胡同

original:
It's been a week, and I still haven't picked up Marko's trail.

Sitting here now, alone, I can be completely honest. With myself and anyone who might read this. I've never felt like such a failure in my life.

To let a man enter your home, and then watch helplessly as he murders your family in cold blood, is more than any person should have to bear. 

Now I can't even find the son-of-a-bitch to give him what he has coming. He kills my children in front of my eyes, and he gets to just walk away? No punishment, no justice? How is that fair?

I'd kill myself, but I'm sure I'd just screw that up too. I just wish I knew what to do. I just wish God, or someone, would give me some kind of sign.
translation:
已经一个星期了，我依然没有发现马可的踪迹。

此刻，我坐在这里，就我一个人，我可以做到绝对的坦诚。对给我自己和能读到这字条的人。我这一生中从没有感受过这样的失败。

让一个人进入了你的家，他冷血的杀害了你的家人，你却只能无能为力的看着。这远远超出了一般人的承受能力。

现在，我甚至都找不到这婊子养的，不能给他应得的惩罚。他就在我眼前杀死了我的孩子，然后就走掉了？没有惩罚吗？没有正义吗？这一切公平吗？

我曾经想过自杀，我只知道，这一切被我搞砸了。我只是希望自己知道该做什么。只希望神，或者其他人，能给我一些指引。

original: Marry Me!
translation: 嫁给我！

original:
Sweetie,

Listen, I just can't wait any longer. I'm sending this letter, via courier, and I'm begging you to respond as soon as possible.

Why should we wait any longer? Forget our parents! Every day I sit here and watch my brother Kevin whither away from Radiation Sickness. Am I next?

I don't want to waste another second of my life. Let's just get married, and make a future for ourselves. Megaton, Rivet City, maybe even Tenpenny Tower. Who knows?

When I'm with you, I feel like I can do anything!

So marry me, you fool!
translation:
宝贝，

听着，我再也无法等下去了。我经由快递送出了这封信，我恳求你能尽快的回复我。

我么为什么还要等下去？别管我们的父母了！每天我坐在这里，看着我的兄弟忍受着辐射疾病的折磨。我会是下一个他吗？

生命里的一秒钟我也不想再浪费了。就让我们结婚吧，创造我们自己的未来。兆吨镇，铆钉城，特佩尼大厦也行。谁会知道？

和你在一起时，我觉得自己无所不能！

所以嫁给我吧，你这个小糊涂虫！

original: Vault 112 Resident Stress Level
translation: 112号避难所居民压力水平

original:
I've finally come to the realization that the Toucan Lagoon simulation has run its course.
 
I'm tired of the beating sun and ceaseless pounding of the lagoon's waves upon the shore. I no longer take pleasure in watching Simpson wither away from scurvy, or hearing Neusbaum's screams as he's devoured by the mako shark.

I am, quite simply, bored. It is time to reset the simulation once again. 

I haven't been skiing in ages.
translation:
我终于意识到，“巨嘴鸟潟湖”模拟已经走到了尽头。
 
我厌倦了炙人的太阳和潟湖浪无休止地拍击海岸。我不在乐于看着辛普森因坏血病而憔悴，或是听着纽斯保被灰鲭鲨吞噬时的尖叫。

简而言之，我厌倦了。是时候再次重置模拟了。

我好长时间没滑雪了。

original: Vault 112 Resident Stress Level
translation: 112号避难所居民压力水平

original:
Yesterday, Dithers slipped on the chalet's icy stairs, went airborne, and managed to impale herself on the the wrought-iron fence. It was spectacular! And completely and utterly random! 

Is there anything more sublime than that bold crimson on fresh-fallen snow?

It was almost enough to make me reconsider a change of scenery. But not quite. 23 years is a long enough vacation in the Swiss Alps. 

I long for something more... domestic.
translation:
昨天，迪瑟在小木屋结冰的楼梯上滑倒，飞了出去，成功地把自己扎在了锻铁围栏上。那场面真是惊心动魄！而且完全出乎意料！

还有什么比新落白雪上的那抹殷红更壮丽？

这几乎足以让我重新考虑换个场景了。但也不尽然。在瑞士阿尔卑斯山度假23年已经够长了。

我渴望更加……家常的感觉。

original: Vault 112 Resident Stress Level
translation: 112号避难所居民压力水平

original:
I have surprised myself. I find Tranquility Lane... comforting. Although distinctly American, it somehow reminds me of Kronach, the town of my childhood.

There’s a beautiful irony with this particular simulation as well. The residents here are naturally at home, naturally safe. When I toy with them, when their suburban illusion is suddenly broken, it’s that much more satisfying. 

I do believe we shall all remain here in Tranquility Lane for a very long time. A very long time, indeed.
translation:
我自己都感到惊讶。我发现宁静巷……令人欣慰。尽管是典型的美式，但不知怎地，它让我想起了克罗纳赫，我童年时代居住的小镇。

这特定的模拟也是一种美丽的讽刺。这里的居民自然而然地感到自在，自然而然地安全。当我玩弄他们时，当他们的郊区幻像突然被打破时，那种满足感更加强烈。

我相信我们都会在宁静巷待很长一段时间。的确，很长时间了。

original: Vault 112 Resident Stress Level
translation: 112号避难所居民压力水平

original:
There are days I consider finally "pulling the plug," as it were, and putting a permanent end to both this simulation, and my life. 

That is the reason I requested installation of General Chase's Chinese invasion program, after all. By disabling the safety protocols, I have ensured that each subject in Vault 112 will physically die if their in-simulation avatars are killed. 

Real-world death. End of simulation. The perfect Failsafe.

At least it would have been, if not for my own misjudgment. I knew, when the simulation first went online, that the secondary safeties – those established for all Vault-Tec and military personnel – would prevent my own real-world demise in the event of a Failsafe execution. In the end, I would kill the subjects, and save myself. 

I wouldn’t want it any other way. Or so I thought.

It’s true the Failsafe would scare the living hell out of every resident in Tranquility Lane, and lead to their brutal deaths. But then – what about me? 

I have no ability to disable my own safety from within the simulation. And any other avatars I could create would be driven by the simulation’s A.I. routines – not actual living, thinking, human subjects. 

Where’s the fun in tormenting a machine?

And so, the release of the real-world subjects is more than they deserve, more that I could bear. They'd be dead, and I'd be left here in Tranquility Lane, alone and tragically bored for all eternity.

I can think of nothing more unacceptable.
translation:
有好几天，我真想干脆“拔掉插头”，一了百了，既结束这场模拟，也终结我的生命。

毕竟，这就是我请求安装蔡斯将军的中国入侵程序的原因。通过禁用安全协议，我确保了112号避难所里的每个人，如果他们在模拟中的化身被杀，那么在现实中也会死亡。

现实世界的死亡，模拟终结，完美的故障保险。

如果不是因为我自己的误判，这本来会是这样的。模拟初上线时我就知道，那些为所有避难所科技和军事人员设立的二级安全机制，会在故障保险启动时阻止我自己在现实世界中死亡。最终，我会杀死那些受试者，而我自己则能幸免。

我不希望有其他任何结果。或者，我曾是这样想的。

确实，故障保险会让宁静巷里的每个居民都吓得魂飞魄散，并导致他们惨死。但是——那我呢？

在模拟中，我无法解除自己的安全机制。而我能创造出的任何其他化身，全由模拟的AI驱动——不是真正活着、有思想的人类受试者。

折磨一台机器有什么乐趣呢？

因此，让这些现实世界中的受试者解脱，超出了他们应得的，也是我无法承受的。他们会死去，而我则会永远留在宁静巷，孤独而悲惨地无聊至死。

我想没有比这更让人无法接受的了。

original: Tech Museum Loot
translation: 科技博物馆战利品

Hey there Jiggs,

I finally found a good place to ditch your share of the loot. It was hell getting here, but I made it. I left the usual breadcrumbs all over some of the info terminals in this place; their computer security was a joke. Complete the sequence and you're home free, but make any mistakes and the system will lock you out. We'll meet up in the usual spot later.

Prime
translation:
嗨，吉格斯，

我终于找了个好地方来存放你的战利品。找到这里如同进了地狱，但是我成功了。我也在此地放置了些有关的线索。他们的电脑安全系统真是好笑，完成所有程序你就可以畅通无阻。但如果犯下任何错误，系统会自动锁死。我们等会在老地方见。

祝你好运，
普莱姆（注：意为“质数”）

original: Earned Your Share
translation: 你所应得的

original:
Nice job, Jiggs!

I knew you'd remember the good old days! The loot is in the Security Office Safe in the upper part of the West Wing. Use the terminal up there to get in. Enjoy your share, pal... you earned it! Meet me in the old diner outside the Jury Street Metro Station. See you there.

Good luck,
Prime
translation:
干得好，吉格斯！

我知道你还记得过去的美好日子！战利品就在西翼上层的安全办公室保险柜里。使用终端来开启，享受你所应得的吧，伙计……你应得的。和我在陪审团大街地铁站那个老式餐厅见面，再见。

祝你好运，
普莱姆（注：意为“质数”）

博物馆馆长  唐纳德·科恩

original:
I'd like to lodge a formal complaint regarding the Firearms Exhibition that's planned for temporary display in the Atrium. With the world tensions the way they are right now, I feel it's highly inappropriate to glorify these killing devices by promoting them as a tourist attraction. If this is some sort of patriotic gesture, then it is entirely lost upon me and I urge you to rethink this decision.

B. Bell
Research Lead
translation:
我要正式投诉前厅打算临时进行的轻火器展览。在这个世界极度扭曲的今天，我觉得将炫耀杀人凶器作为吸引游客的卖点非常的不合时宜。对我而言它绝不是某种爱国的象征。希望贵馆能三思而后行。

B。贝尔
研究员主管

original:

We've had to interrupt the programming more times than I care to remember and end up taking over manually. I suggest we remove the system and bring back the human element so the audience will feel more engaged.

B. Bell
Research Lead
translation:
有人能来帮忙修理天象仪的保护系统吗？刚刚安装的自动化系统极易出故障，每周至少一次。我都不记得手动干预过这套程序多少次了。我建议卸载现在的系统，换回以前的系统让观众能更好地欣赏演出。

B。贝尔
研究员主管

original: Hubris Comics Press Release
translation: 虎不理漫画新闻稿

original:
For Immediate Release: 

HUBRIS COMICS AND VAULT-TEC INCORPORATED UNVEIL "VAULT BOY MEETS HELL'S CHAIN GANG" LIMITED FIVE-PART MINISERIES

The very best in Invincible Entertainment and Inpenetrable Vaults team up to bring comic fans a gripping grimoire of greatness!

From their headquarters in Washington, DC, Hubris Comics announced today plans to bring a beloved American Icon into the Hubris Comics Universe - none other than the beloved Vault Boy Character.

"Vault Boy was the perfect choice for our new Hell's Chain gang series", says Hubris Comics Chief of Publishing Peter Shiner, "In which those Valiant Vigilantes take on Chairman Cheng's Commie Cyborg Corps - after all, Vault Boy knows a thing or two about going up against that Red Menace!"

The five-part miniseries will feature an alternate future in which Chinese Communists have invaded America.  Vault Boy and Hell's Chain Gang are the last, best hope for America to break free from the shackles of Communism in this cautionary tale of vigilance.

"It has always been Vault-Tec's mission to educate and protect our Countrymen from the Communist threat", commented Vault-Tec Public Relations Executive Joanne Strausser, "This exciting project is a perfect opportunity to thrill young Americans while sending home an important message for us all: Every good American must help shoulder the burden of freedom, and always be wary of the Communist Threat".

The first issue of this miniseries will be available on newsstands everywhere this Holiday Season.

About Hubris Comics
Hubris Comics, a branch of Hubris Publishing, headquartered in Washington, DC, has been producing printed entertainment since 2021.  Hubris Comics are known for such popular properties as Grognak the Barbarian, Hell's Chain Gang, and The Inspector.
translation:
对于即将来临的发布：

狂漫连环画和避难所科技公司为五集迷你电视剧“避难所男孩碰见地狱锁链犯”揭开面纱

战无不胜的娱乐业巨头和神秘的避难所公司联合起来给广大的动画爱好者带来了一场魅力无比的视觉盛宴！

来自他们在华盛顿, 特区总部的消息，狂漫出版集团今天宣布计划将一个广受喜爱的美国偶像带入狂漫连环画环球公司 - 没有人比避难所男孩再适合不过了。

“对于我们新的地狱锁链犯系列，避难所男孩是再完美不过的了。”，狂漫出版集团的首席发行官彼得·希那说道，“通过和那些勇敢的民兵一起抵抗陈主席的共产党电子人军团 - 最终，避难所男孩对如何抵抗红色威胁已经略知一二！”

这部迷你电视剧的五个部分会呈现一个交替的过程来表现共产党对美国的入侵。在这个具有告诫性的故事里，避难所男孩和地狱锁链犯是美国从共产主义的枷锁中夺得自由的最后也是最好的希望。

“培养和保护我们的同胞免受共产主义者的威胁是我们避难所科技公司一直以来的责任。”避难所科技公司公共关系专员乔那·斯特劳瑟说，“这个令人激动的计划是一个振奋年轻美国人的完美时机，为了我们所有人，我们将给我们的家园传递一个重要的消息：每一个美国人都肩负有自由的使命，都需要时刻提防共产主义的威胁。”。

本年度的节日季节您将会在全国各地的报摊上看到这个电视剧的首映。

关于狂漫出版集团
狂漫连环画，狂慢出版社的一支，总部设在华盛顿, 特区，早在2021就开始致力于娱乐印刷品的制造。狂漫出版集团以一些非常流行的元素著称，例如：野蛮人歌南，地狱锁链犯和调查员。
