original: I'm just here to make sure nothing goes wrong. With you or her.
translation: 我在这只是确认没有出差错，你或她。

original: This place is a whole lot quieter, now. Thanks, I guess.
translation: 现在这地方安静多了，大概要谢谢你。

original: I got nothing to say to you.
translation: 我和你无话可说。

original: Could you come back in an hour or two? Even geniuses need their sleep.
translation: 你能不能过一两个小时再回来？天才也是需要睡觉的。

original: Well, whaddya know? It worked! I mean, I was pretty sure it would, obviously.
translation: 好啦，你知道什么？它工作了！我的意思是，我早就肯定它行，很明显。

original: Here, take a few radiation Chems with you. I'm sure you'll run into more in the future.
translation: 来，带些抗辐射药品。我肯定你以后会需要更多。

original: Well, you're alive... That's the good news. But there was a little side effect. A teeny, tiny, um, mutation. But it seems to be benign, at least.
translation: 你还活着……真是好消息。但有些副作用。小小的、极小的、呃……突变。但至少，看上去是良性的。

original: Here, take a few radiation Chems, as my little way of saying, "I'm sorry I twisted your DNA like a kitten with a ball of yarn."
translation: 来，带些抗辐射药品。这是说表示“很抱歉我把你的DNA像小猫玩毛线球一样弄糟了”的方法。

original: No mess, no problem! Well, a bit of a mess. But no problem, regardless!
translation: 没混乱，没问题！啊，有点混乱，但没问题，别在意！

original: Here. You know, for next time you get hurt, and I'm not around.
translation: 来，你知道。下次你受伤我可就不在你身边了。

original: Okay, I even stitched a little smiley-face in you, to keep up your spirits. It's kind of hard to see from your side, though.
translation: 好了，我甚至在你身上缝了个小笑脸，来提起你的精神。虽然从你的角度很难看到。

original: Here, take this environment suit of mine. It will help with medical tasks, and it should help prevent the effects of exposure, too.
translation: 来，拿着我的野外套装。它会在医学任务里帮上忙，而且还能防止核泄漏的影响。

original: Hey, I hear you're that stray from the Vault! I haven't seen one of you for years!
translation: 嗨，我听说你从避难所逃出来！我好多年没见过你这样的了！

original: Good to meet you! I'm Moira Brown. I run Craterside Supply, but what I really do is mostly tinkering and research.
translation: 很高兴见到你！我是莫伊拉·布朗，经营坑边杂货店，但我真正从事的是熔补和研究。

original: Say, I'm working on a book about the Wasteland -- it'd be great to have the foreword by a vault dweller. Help me out, would you?
translation: 看，我在写一本废土的书 — 能有一个避难所居民的序言不是很棒吗？帮帮我行吗？

original: Hey! Is that you?
translation: 嗨！是你吗？

original: Oh, my head's still ringing from that explosion... What happened?
translation: 哦，爆炸以后我的头一直嗡嗡响……发生了什么？

original: Hey, new in town? Good to meet you! I'm Moira Brown. I take care of supplies and repairs here, but what I really do is mostly tinkering and research.
translation: 嗨，刚来镇里的？很高兴认识你！我是莫伊拉·布朗，负责这的供给和修理，但我真正从事的是熔补和研究。

original: Actually, right now I'm working on a book to help the world. And I could use a bit of help. I can pay you, and it'll be fun!
translation: 事实上，我在写本拯救世界的书。我需要些帮助，我可以给你点报酬，而工作会很有趣！

original: So, how's the scavving been? Got the food and medicine from that Super-Duper Mart?
translation: “扫货”得怎么样？在顶好超市里找到食物和药品了没？

original: About collecting the stuff from Super-Duper Mart...
translation: 关于从顶好超市收集物品的事……

original: Oh? Feeling a bit under the weather? Or a bit over the Geiger-counter?
translation: 哦？感觉身体有点不舒服？或是盖氏计量器的数字有点超标？

original: About the radiation...
translation: 关于辐射……

original: How are those hot little potatoes?
translation: 那些滚烫的小土豆怎么样啊？

original: Because, you know, they're on the ground, like potatoes. And hot, because they, um, explode.
translation: 因为你知道，它们在地面上，像土豆，而且还发热，因为它们…嗯…会爆炸。

original: Anyway, what's up?
translation: 无论如何，发生了什么？

original: About Minefield...
translation: 关于雷区……

original: How are those hot little potatoes? Or whatever. You know what I mean.
translation: 那些滚烫的小土豆怎么样了？别管怎么称呼啦，你知道我说的是什么。

original: About Minefield...
translation: 关于雷区……

original: Oh, I can't wait to hear how the repellent's working!
translation: 哦，我等不及要看看驱鼠剂的效果了！

original: About the Mole Rats...
translation: 关于地鼠……

original: So, are they intelligent? Do they have a leader? Some sort of king? Or priests? Or some sort of scaly community center?
translation: 那，它们有智力吗？有领袖吗？有国王吗？有牧师吗？或是有某种低等社会核心吗？

original: About the Mirelurks...
translation: 关于泥沼蟹……

original: Well, how do you feel?
translation: 好啦，你感觉怎么样？

original: About this serious injury...
translation: 关于这次严重的伤害……

original: Any luck finding out how Rivet City got started?
translation: 了解到铆钉城是怎么建立的了吗？

original: About Rivet City's history...
translation: 关于铆钉城的历史……

original: Fiddle with any interesting technology, lately?
translation: 最近有没试试那些有趣的科技？

original: About those robots...
translation: 关于那些机器人……

original: Is it there? Are there books? Can I go borrow some?
translation: 在那里吗？还书吗？我能借几本不？

original: About the library...
translation: 关于图书馆……

original: Oh, hey! Kinda busy here, but I guess I can talk for a bit. What's up?
translation: 哦，嗨！现在有点忙，不过我想还能聊会，什么事？

original: Huh. Did you know the human body can survive without the stomach or spleen? Oh, what's up?
translation: 呃。你知道人类即使没了脾胃照样能生存吗？哦，什么事？

original: You know, I think I've found a new way to prepare Radroach meat. Still tastes like old feet, though. Anyway, what's up with you?
translation: 你知道，我想我知道了做辐射蟑螂肉的新方法，虽然尝起来还像臭脚丫。不管了，你有什么事？

original: Oh, hey! Watch your step, I think one of my test subjects got loose. But don't worry, it's probably harmless.
translation: 哦，嗨！留神脚下，我好像丢了一个试验对象。但别担心，它应该没危险。

original: Hey, don't mind the smell. I was just testing a few chemicals, but it's perfectly safe to breathe. Really!
translation: 嗨，别在意臭味。我在试验一些新的化学药品，但这气体很安全。真的！

original: What's up? Anything interesting out there in the wild Wasteland?
translation: 怎么了？在废土荒野有什么有趣的事吗？

original: How's it going out there in the Wastes?
translation: 废土现在怎么样了？

original: I guess it's my turn to thank you.
translation: 我想轮到我谢谢你了。

original: Anyway, the area's secure, so you're free to talk to Three Dog if you need to.
translation: 总之，这区域是安全的。需要的话，你可以随意和三狗谈。

original: By the way, because you helped us I'm going to let you wear that Power Armor. But don't you ever forget where it came from.
translation: 顺便提一下，因为你救了我们，我准备让你穿上动力装甲，但是别忘了它是从哪里来的。

original: I guess it's my turn to thank you.
translation: 我想轮到我谢谢你了。

original: Anyway, the area's secure, so you're free to talk to Three Dog if you need to.
translation: 总之，这区域是安全的。需要的话，你可以随意和三狗谈。

original: Look, I don't know who you are but you don't belong here.
translation: 听着，我不知道你是谁，但是你不属于这。

original: The Super Mutants have overrun our brothers at the Galaxy News Radio building, and we're headed there to back them up.
translation: 超级变种人正在冲击我们在银河新闻电台大楼里的兄弟，我们去增援。

original: You can tag along if you want. But keep your head down and try not to do anything... stupid.
translation: 愿意的话，你就跟着吧。但把头低下，别做任何……蠢事。

original: You can follow us as far as GNR. But keep your head down if you don't want it to get blown off.
translation: 你能跟我们一起去银河新闻电台。但如果你不想脑袋开花的话，就把头低下。

original: No offense, but I'm a little busy saving your ass right now.
translation: 不想冒犯你，但我现在正忙着救你。

original: Go away.
translation: 走吧。

original: Welcome, friend. My brothers may be gruff but they will lay down their lives for you.
translation: 欢迎，朋友。我的兄弟们或许有些粗鲁，但他们会为你抛弃生命的。

original: You don't need to worry. We're the best outfit in the whole Brotherhood of Steel. Just watch what we do to these Uglies.
translation: 你不需要担心，我们是钢铁兄弟会的最佳组合。看着我们怎么对付那些丑八怪。

original: Colin Moriarty, at your service! Welcome to Moriarty's! My saloon, my home, my slice of heaven in this backwoods little burg.
translation: 科林·莫里亚蒂，为你服务！欢迎来到莫里亚蒂的酒吧！我的酒吧、我的家，我在这边远镇子的一片天堂。

original: If you've got the caps, I've got your pleasure. Please, sit down, make yourself comfortable. Your troubles are a thing of the past.
translation: 如果你有瓶盖，那我会让你满意。请坐下，随意点。你的麻烦已经留在门外了。

original: Colin Moriarty. Always pleased to see a new face. But I'm afraid you've had the misfortune to catch me, well... out of me element.
translation: 科林·莫里亚蒂。一直都乐意见到新面孔。但……在这撞见我，对你恐怕并不是什么好事。

original: I'm the owner and proprietor of Moriarty's, you see. The saloon?
translation: 我是莫里亚蒂的酒吧的拥有者和经营者。你知道那个酒吧吗？

original: But, please! See for yourself! Come by for a drink or twelve. You and I, oh, we're going to be fast friends. Fast friends!
translation: 但是，拜托！自己看看！路过就来喝一杯，或者一打。你和我，哦，我们会成好朋友的，好朋友！

original: What is it I can do for you?
translation: 我能为你做点什么？

original: Ahhh... my new friend. What can I get you? Some sorrows are best buried, and I'm a man that can provide all sorts of tools to bury them.
translation: 啊……我的新朋友。需要来点什么？有些苦楚最好埋葬，而我最不缺让人“埋东西”的法子。

original: And back he comes. So... are you just thirsty, or are you ready to pay me fee? Dear dad's not going to find himself.
translation: 你回来啦。那么……你是渴了还是愿意给钱了？亲爱的爸爸可不会自己找到自己。

original: And back she comes. So, are you just thirsty, or are you ready to pay me fee? Dear dad's not going to find himself.
translation: 你回来啦。那么……你是渴了还是愿意给钱了？亲爱的爸爸可不会自己找到自己。

original: What's it to be? A few caps to find out where your father went? Or are you going to have a go of it on your own?
translation: 想干嘛？花几个瓶盖来打听你父亲的去处？还是你准备自己去找？

original: The Wasteland can be such an unforgiving place....
translation: 废土可是一片无情的地方……

original: No luck finding dear old dad? Can't say it surprises me. Wasteland's a big place. Maybe you need a drink.
translation: 找不到你亲爱的爸爸？我一点都不惊讶。废土可是很大的地方，或许你要杯喝的。

original: You're still standing here, and I can't think why. You know where your father went. Seems to me you ought to be out searching the Wastes.
translation: 你还站在这，我不知道还有什么理由。你知道你爸爸去哪了，我想你该到废土去找他。

original: I uh... don't feel so good.
translation: 我，呃……感觉不太好。

original: Am I drunk? I think I'm drunk... Do I seem drunk to you?
translation: 我醉了？我想我醉了……你看我醉了吗？

original: Whoa!!! Is it me, or is the world spinning?
translation: 哇！！！是我，还是这世界在转？

original: Who are you again?
translation: 再说一遍你是谁？

original: I don't want to be a slave! I was just confused before! Take it off!
translation: 我不想成为奴隶！我之前只是一时糊涂！把它拿掉！

original: Please! You got to let me go!
translation: 求求你！你得放我走！

original: I'm begging you! Let me go!
translation: 我求求你！让我走吧！

original: You enjoy being a "recruiter" for Paradise Falls, eh? Here's another collar and some caps.
translation: 看来你很乐意成为堕落天堂的“招募员”，对吧？这是另一个项圈和一些瓶盖。

original: The slaves keep rolling in. Keep this up and you're going to be rich! Here's your caps and another collar.
translation: 把奴隶源源不绝地带来。继续努力，你会变得富有！这是你的瓶盖和另一个项圈。

original: Tallied the last slave you sent us. You're pretty good at the slaving thing. Keep it up! Here's another collar and pile of caps.
translation: 算上了你交给我们的最后一个奴隶。你很擅长奴役嘛。继续努力！这是另一个项圈和一堆瓶盖。

original: Keep it up. We all make a ton of caps on every slave you send to us. Here's your cut and another collar.
translation: 继续努力！你交给我们的每个奴隶都让我们赚到大量瓶盖。这是你那份和另一个项圈。

original: You idiot! Your slave's dead. You ruined perfectly good merchandise. I monitor the collars, you know. You need to be more careful!
translation: 你这白痴！你的奴隶死了。你毁了那么好的货物。你知道我监控着这些项圈。你必须更小心！

original: Do you want another collar and try again? You'll have to buy it. I'm not going to subsidize your screwups.
translation: 你想要另一个项圈再试一次？你必须花钱来买。你搞砸了我可不负责。

original: Idiot. You don't make money on dead slaves. You want to buy another collar and try again?
translation: 白痴。你从死掉的奴隶身上可赚不到钱。你要买另一个项圈再试一次吗？

original: Hold it right there.
translation: 站那儿别动。

original: State your business in Rivet City.
translation: 陈述你进入铆钉城的事由。

original: Please be seated in the nearest available Tranquility Lounger. Thank you for your cooperation.
translation: 请就座于附近空置的宁静巷催眠舱上。谢谢你的合作。

original: Please take a seat in the Tranquility Lounger.
translation: 请找个宁静巷催眠舱就座。

original: Welcome to Vault 112, Resident! According to sensors, you have arrived 202.3 years behind schedule.
translation: 欢迎来到112号避难所，居民！根据传感器，你比预计到达时间晚到了202.3年。

original: Please re-dress in your Vault-Tec issued Vault suit before proceeding. If you have misplaced your suit, I am authorized to distribute a new one.
translation: 行动前请重新穿戴你的基于避难所科技的避难所服装，如果你找不到你的服装，我有权给你再发套新的。

original: Once dressed, please proceed down the stairs to the main floor so that you may enter your assigned Tranquility Lounger.
translation: 穿戴完毕后，请由台阶下至主楼层，以便你进入分配给你的宁静巷催眠舱。

original: Please dress in your Vault 112 suit. Remove all other articles of clothing to prevent damage to the equipment.
translation: 请穿上你的112号避难所服装。脱掉所有其他服饰物品以免阻碍与损坏设备。

original: Thank you for your cooperation.
translation: 谢谢您的合作。

original: Please dress in your Vault 112 suit. Remove all other articles of clothing to prevent damage to the equipment.
translation: 请穿上你的112号避难所服装。脱掉所有其他服饰物品以免阻碍与损坏设备。

original: Thank you for your cooperation.
translation: 谢谢您的合作。

original: I've already told you everything I know. I don't understand why you're still here.
translation: 我已经告诉了你我所知的一切。我不知道为什么你还在这。

original: Look, this is a restricted area. I'm tired of telling you people...
translation: 听着，这是限制区。我厌倦了告诉你们这些人……

original: I... It's you. My heavens, you look so much like him...
translation: 我……是你。我的天，你看起来真像他……

original: You're James' son, aren't you? What are you doing here?
translation: 你是詹姆斯的孩子，对吧？你在这干嘛？

original: Look, this is a restricted area. I'm tired of telling you people...
translation: 听着，这是限制区。我厌倦了告诉你们这些人……

original: I... It's you. My heavens, you look so much like him...
translation: 我……是你。我的天，你看起来真像他……

original: You're James' daughter, aren't you? What are you doing here?
translation: 你是詹姆斯的女儿，对吧？你在这干嘛？

original: President Rosie? What's happening around here anyway?
translation: 萝丝总统？这附近到底发生什么事了？

original: Rosie? As President? You've got to be kidding me...
translation: 萝丝？做总统？你在开玩笑吧……

original: Well, now. President Bob. How do you like that? Boy, things are gonna change around here. First step: get rid of all this "Dave" shit.
translation: 好吧。鲍勃总统。你觉得那怎么样？孩子，这的一切都会改变的，第一步就是除去所有与“戴夫”相关的狗屎。

original: The Kingdom of Bob! Or maybe Bobtopia! I'll have to give it some thought.
translation: 鲍勃王国！要么就是鲍托邦！我会考虑下的。

original: But I guess you want something, don't you? Tell you what... Dave kept some old junk in that safe of his... I mean MY office. The code is 1138.
translation: 但是你需要什么，不是吗？告诉你吧……戴夫在他那保险箱放了些旧垃圾……我是说在“我的”办公室。密码1138。

original: Take whatever you want out of there. Consider it a gift from your kind and loving President Bob.
translation: 那的东西你尽管拿。就当是感谢你的对鲍勃总统的友善和热爱的回礼。

original: Maybe we need a flag? One with my picture on it. That could be pretty cool.
translation: 或许我们需要一面旗？上面有我的照片。那样可能很酷。

original: Maybe we need a flag? One with my picture on it. That could be pretty cool.
translation: 或许我们需要一面旗？上面有我的照片。那样可能很酷。

original: First things first, we're gonna have to open up the Museum of Bob.
translation: 当务之急，我们首先必须开放鲍勃博物馆。

original: I've got nothing to say to you, stranger.
translation: 我对你没什么好说的，陌生人。

original: C'mon. Make it fast. I got chores.
translation: 来吧。快点。我还有很多事。

original: Yes? What is it? C'mon, I don't have all day.
translation: 嗯，什么？得了吧，我没有多少闲功夫。

original: This is the new Republic of Dave! Go away!
translation: 这是新戴夫共和国！滚！

original: By the order of the new Republic of Dave, I order you to go away! This is your last warning!
translation: 受新戴夫共和国之命，我命令你滚！这是最后的警告！

original: I warned you!
translation: 我警告过你！

original: I guess you're wondering where I'm going. I'm off to annex Old Olney and forge the New Republic of Dave! Don't try to stop me!
translation: 你是在想我要去哪里吧。我要去吞并老奥尔尼，并成立新戴夫共和国！别想阻止我！

original: Ah, you're back. So, have you brought a gift for the President? Which is it? The rifle or the money?
translation: 啊，你回来了。你有带礼物给总统吗？是哪种？步枪还是钱？

original: We have nothing more to talk about. Leave my republic within 24 hours or you will be executed for treason.
translation: 我们没什么其他可以谈的了。限你24小时内离开我的共和国，否则以叛国罪处决你。

original: Breach! How did you make it in here without an escort? Only a master spy could be so skilled! Are you a spy?
translation: 疏漏！没有护卫你怎么进来的？只有精英间谍才有这样的技能！你是间谍吗？

original: You are, aren't you? Come on now, confess! Have you been sent to spy on the Republic of Dave?
translation: 你是，对吧？得啦，承认吧！你是不是被派来监视戴夫共和国的？

original: I am Dave, President of the Republic of Dave. You will address me as "Mister President" or I will have you executed.
translation: 我是戴夫，戴夫共和国的总统。你要称呼我总统先生，否则我将处决你。

original: Now, are you applying for citizenship, asylum, or just vacationing in the Republic of Dave?
translation: 那你来戴夫共和国是要申请成为公民、寻求庇护还是观光旅行？

original: Hmmm. You look familiar. No matter. We never hold prior meetings against tourists.
translation: 唔。你看着眼熟。没关系。我们招待游客从不忌前嫌。

original: Now, are you applying for citizenship, asylum, or just vacationing in the Republic of Dave?
translation: 那你来戴夫共和国是要申请成为公民、寻求庇护还是观光旅行？

original: Yeah? What do you want?
translation: 是的，你想要什么？

original: Oh, look at this, the spy has returned to gather intelligence. You'll get nothing from me, spy. What do you want?
translation: 哦，看哪，间谍回来收集情报了。你从我这得不到任何东西，间谍。你想要什么？

original: Out with it, Ambassador. This Republic isn't going to run itself.
translation: 别胡闹了，大使。这共和国是不会自己运作的。

original: Yes? What can President Dave do for you?
translation: 嗯？戴夫总统可以为你做些什么？

original: Stop right there, mister!  Whatcha think you're doing in the Republic of Dave?
translation: 站住，先生！你知道你都在戴夫共和国做了什么吗？

original: Stop right there, lady!  Whatcha think you're doing in the Republic of Dave?
translation: 站住，小姐！你知道你都在戴夫共和国做了什么吗？

original: Whatcha want, Stranger?
translation: 你要什么，陌生人？

original: Come on! I have to take you to Daddy!
translation: 来吧！我还要带你去见爸爸！

original: Dave says you're okay? Fine.
translation: 戴夫说你没问题？好吧。

original: It's kind of late to be entering the Republic.
translation: 现在进入共和国太晚了点。

original: Can't you come back later?
translation: 你不能晚点过来吗？

original: Come on! I have to take you to Daddy!
translation: 来吧！我还要带你去见爸爸！

original: Hey, you. Stop! What do you want from the Republic of Dave?
translation: 嗨，你，停下！你想从戴夫共和国得到什么？

original: What do you want from us?
translation: 你想要从我们这得到什么？

original: Come on! I have to take you to Daddy!
translation: 来吧！我还要带你去见爸爸！

original: Hey, who are you?  What do you want from the Republic of Dave?
translation: 嗨，你是谁？你想从戴夫共和国得到什么？

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: Did Dave say it was okay for you to be here?
translation: 戴夫说过你可以在这吗？

original: Well now... who could have ever thought? Me! President! Things are really going to be different around here.
translation: 现在……谁会想得到？我！总统！真的是变天了啊。

original: Listen, I can't thank you enough. You convinced that that I could do this, and you were right. I want you to have something.
translation: 听着，我对你无比感激。你让我确信自己有这能力，我因此才能成功。我想你能得到些什么。

original: Dave kept some big weapon or something locked up in the safe in his office. The code is 1138.
translation: 戴夫办公室的保险箱里存放着某种大型武器之类的东西。密码1138。

original: It's yours if you want it. We don't need it anymore.
translation: 你想要你就拿去吧。我们不再有用了。

original: I just can't thank you enough!
translation: 不胜感激！

original: Things are going to be different around here!
translation: 真的是变天了啊！

original: Bob as president? I don't know how I feel about that...
translation: 鲍勃当总统？我不知道自己会有什么感觉……

original: President Bob. Well, that's a change. I don't know if it's a change for the better though...
translation: 鲍勃总统。好吧，是个转变。我不知道这是不是朝好方向转变……

original: I heard that Dave allowed you to stay. Well, welcome stranger. Just be mindful of the children.
translation: 听说戴夫允许你留下？那，欢迎你陌生人。留神孩子。

original: Who are you?  Is it okay for you to be here?
translation: 你是谁？你可以在这出现吗？

original: What do you want now?
translation: 你现在想要什么？

original: Come on! I have to take you to Daddy!
translation: 来吧！我还要带你去见爸爸！

original: So Dave gave you the okay, huh?  Well, welcome then.
translation: 那么戴夫已经同意了，欢迎啊。

original: I run the Museum of Dave, where the children of the Republic can learn about their heritage.
translation: 我经营戴夫博物馆，共和国的孩子在这可以学到传统。

original: I have nothing more to say to you. You are the most un-Dave-like person I've ever met!
translation: 我和你没其他说的了。你是我见过的最不像戴夫的人了。

original: Something you need?
translation: 需要点什么？

original: Dave doesn't like us talking to strangers.
translation: 戴夫不喜欢我们和陌生人谈话。

original: President Daddy says that people from outside the Republic are bad.
translation: 总统爸爸说共和国之外的人都是坏人。

original: Are you really from the Wasteland? Wooooow!
translation: 你真的是从废土来的吗？哇！

original: This ain't a tourist trap. You civilians get topside immediately!
translation: 这不是黑店。你们平民必须立刻去楼顶！

original: We need to get this resolved, and fast. We're too exposed like this. We need to keep moving.
translation: 我们必须尽快解决。像现在这样太暴露了。我们必须继续走。

original: What the hell are we standing around for? If Garza can't make it, then we need to go without him. This is crazy!
translation: 见鬼，我们还坐在这干嘛？如果加尔萨搞不定，我们就不能和他一起走了。这真是疯了！

original: All right, you should be just outside the pipe that's been giving us trouble.
translation: 好，你应该待在不断给我们找麻烦的管道外面。

original: Now don't worry, this isn't dangerous at all.
translation: 别担心。这一点都不危险。

original: Just get inside and use the manual controls to drain the pipe. That'll break up the debris enough for the filters to function properly.
translation: 进去后使用手动控制疏通管道。那应该可以冲掉碎片，使过滤器能正常工作了。

original: Get to the museum level and use the intercom there. I'll talk you through cycling the airlock on the intake pipe.
translation: 到博物馆层使用那的对讲机。我会告诉你怎么打开输入管道的气密门。

original: There are a few minor repairs still to be made up here in the control room. Why don't you come back here and give me a hand?
translation: 控制室那还有些小故障需要修理。为什么你不回来帮我一把？

original: Actually, wait. There's one other thing I need you to do. Janice says there's a blockage in one of the intake pipes.
translation: 事实上，等等。我还有另一件事需要你去做。贾尼斯说有个输入管道被堵塞了。

original: It's on your way back; head back up to the museum level and give me a call on the intercom when you get there.
translation: 它在你回来的路上，到博物馆层，用那的对讲机联系我。

original: Well, you've done it. It'll just be a few minutes until we can access the mainframe. Use the intercom so I can tell you where to go next.
translation: 好，你做到了。过几分钟我们就能进入主机了。使用对讲机，让我能告诉你接下来该去哪。

original: There are a few minor repairs still to be made up here in the control room. Why don't you come back here and give me a hand?
translation: 控制室那还有些小故障需要修理。为什么你不回来帮我一把？

original: Actually, wait. There's one other thing I need you to do. Janice says there's a blockage in one of the intake pipes.
translation: 事实上，等等。我还有另一件事需要你去做。贾尼斯说有个输入管道被堵塞了。

original: It's on your way back; head back up to the museum level and give me a call on the intercom when you get there.
translation: 它在你回来的路上，到博物馆层，用那的对讲机联系我。

original: With the fuses in place, you should be able to access the mainframe. No need to come back to the control room; just head right there.
translation: 接通保险丝后，你才能进入主机。不需要回控制室，直接去那边。

original: Great work on the pumps. Hurry back and I'll give you the fuses you'll need.
translation: 水泵那干得好。赶快回来，我给你需要的保险丝。

original: How are you holding up? Need directions?
translation: 你进展得怎么样？需要指示吗？

original: Everything all right?
translation: 一切都还好吗？

original: You're doing great out there. Keep it up.
translation: 你干得好。继续努力。

original: I better not ever find out that you or your father had something to do with this. If I even think you sold us out...
translation: 我宁可不知道你和你父亲和这有关系。如果我觉得你出卖了我们……

original: This isn't what I had in mind when I came back here.
translation: 当我回来这，发现和我想的不同。

original: Thank God someone else made it out. What the hell is going on? Who are those guys? Did I hear gunshots?
translation: 感谢上帝有人做到了。该死，发生了什么？那些家伙是谁？我听到的是枪声吗？

original: We'll make it out of here, right? I don't want to die down here.
translation: 我们能出去，对吧？我不想死在这。

original: After all that, you just kill the man? What is wrong with you?
translation: 经历了这么多，你却杀了那人？你怎么搞的？

original: You monster! How could you do that to him!
translation: 你这怪物！你怎么能那样对他！

original: I am sorry. I cannot continue. I need to rest for a while.
translation: 很抱歉我无法继续。我需要休息一会。

original: My heart... All this stress... I was not expecting any of this. I need to rest.
translation: 我的心脏……压力太大了……我无法继续。我需要休息。

original: Now is not a good time to be talking.
translation: 现在不是聊天的时候。

original: I can't leave Garza here in this condition. We're not going anywhere until he's been helped.
translation: 这种情况下，我不能把加尔萨留在这。在他被救前，我们哪都不能去。

original: We can't go any further. We need to stop.
translation: 我们无法走得更远。我们需要停下。

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: Don't wander off. We're going to need you.
translation: 别走开，我们需要你。

original: We have to make it to the tunnel. Follow me, and stay quiet!
translation: 我们必须去隧道。跟着我，保持安静！

original: Didn't your dad tell you about the blockage? I thought you'd be off taking care of that now.
translation: 你爸爸告诉你堵塞的事没？我想你现在得去解决。

original: You really should go fix that blockage before something bad happens.
translation: 你得在发生事故前把堵塞解决。

original: Just be careful what you touch in here, okay? The equipment's old enough as it is.
translation: 小心别碰这的任何东西，好吗？这设备很旧了。

original: So you're going to make sure it's safe for us in there? That's really brave of you.
translation: 你要去看看那里是否安全？你真勇敢。

original: This is kind of exciting, isn't it? I've always heard Doctor Li talk about Project Purity, but I never thought I'd be going there.
translation: 真让人兴奋，对吧？我经常听李博士说净水工程，但是没想到我也加入了。

original: Well, at least now we're not completely doomed. Thanks for taking care of those beasts.
translation: 至少现在我们还没彻底完蛋。谢谢你干掉了那些野兽。

original: I'm sure it's not safe in there, but how safe is it for us to be standing around out here?
translation: 我确信那不安全，但我们站在这又有多安全呢？

original: I don't know if I like this. I understand it's important to Doctor Li, but isn't going to Project Purity dangerous?
translation: 我不知道自己是否喜欢这样。我知道这对李博士很重要，但去净水工程难道不危险吗？

original: I thank you for risking your life to make sure we are safe.
translation: 感谢你冒死保护我们。

original: Now we must worry about mutants as well? Perhaps we should have stayed at Rivet City.
translation: 现在我们也得担心变种人了？或许我们应该待在铆钉城。

original: I am unsure how useful I will be at this Purity Project, but I am happy to do whatever I can to help Doctor Li.
translation: 我不确定自己能给净水工程带来什么帮助，但是我很乐于协助李博士任何事。

original: Oh, great.
translation: 哦，真棒。

original: Listen, I know who you are, okay? Far as I'm concerned, you've got no business being here. So just stay out of my way.
translation: 听着，我知道你是谁，懂吗？据我所知，你在这没做任何买卖。所以，别挡我的路。

original: Yeah, what do you want?
translation: 是的，你想要什么？

original: Hey, here's an idea. Why don't you go worry about whatever it is you're supposed to be doing, and leave me alone.
translation: 嗨，给你个建议。你为什么不去操心自己该做什么，离我远点。

original: Hey there. I hear we have you to thank for getting us up and running again!
translation: 嗨。我听说我们得感谢你使我们能恢复运作！

original: Hey there, little lady. What's going on?
translation: 嗨，女孩，怎么了？

original: Hey there, bud. What's going on?
translation: 嗨，伙计。怎么了？

original: James... he's gone...
translation: 詹姆斯……他死了……

original: We have to get out of here. They'll be coming for us next. We've got to evacuate now!
translation: 我们必须离开这。他们接下来就要来找我们了，我们得立刻跑！

original: What is he doing in there?
translation: 他在那干嘛？

original: I've been hearing good things about you.
translation: 我听过你的不少事迹。

original: Is it true? Did you really disarm the bomb in Megaton?
translation: 真的吗？你真的解除了兆吨镇的核弹？

original: I think we need to talk.
translation: 我想我们得谈谈。

original: I've been... hearing things. Things that have happened out there.
translation: 我……听说了一些事。外面发生的一些事。

original: Megaton destroyed... You... You didn't have anything to do with that, did you?
translation: 兆吨镇被毁了，你……不是你干的，对吧？

original: I know there's a lot going on right now. This is all very sudden.
translation: 我知道现在那发生了很多事。这一切都非常突然。

original: I just want you to know that I'm here if you want to talk. You seem troubled, like there's a cloud hanging over you.
translation: 我只是想你知道，如果你想要聊聊，我就在这。你看起来很困扰，像是置身迷雾中。

original: I know there's a lot going on right now. This is all very sudden.
translation: 我知道现在那发生了很多事。这一切都非常突然。

original: I just wanted to say... I wanted to say that I'm proud of you. You're a good person, and it shows.
translation: 我只是想说……我只是想说我为你骄傲。很明显你是个好人。

original: It's essential that you get to the pipes as soon as you can. We can't allow the pressure to build up, or it could be a disaster.
translation: 你必须尽快前往管道。我们不能让压力继续提升，那可能酿成大祸。

original: I'll be here for you when you get back.
translation: 我会在这等你回来。

original: Please, hurry. Once the blockage is cleared up, we'll be in good shape.
translation: 请赶快。一旦堵塞被清除，我们的情况就会变得良好。

original: I'll be here for you when you get back.
translation: 我会在这等你回来。

original: You didn't have to come all the way back here, you know. You could've just gone right to the mainframe.
translation: 要知道，你没必要回这。你可以直接去主机那。

original: Replace those fuses. Otherwise we'll never get the doors open, and there's no chance of getting the mainframe running.
translation: 换掉那些保险丝。否则我们永远也打不开门，也没机会让主机运作。

original: So the pumps are working, and some of the doors are opened. We're making progress.
translation: 水泵工作了，一些门也打开了。我们进展不错。

original: Problem is that the water shorted out a few key fuse boxes. Here, take these fuses and replace the ones that have burnt out.
translation: 问题在于水让一些关键的保险丝盒短路了。给，拿这些保险丝去把烧掉的换掉。

original: Once you get the Flood Control Pumps activated, that'll clear out some of the water and make it easier for us to see what else has gone wrong.
translation: 一旦你将排水泵启动，一部分水会被排出，我们能更容易知道还有什么出了问题。

original: Let's get to the control room and assess the situation. We can talk more there.
translation: 我们去控制室分析目前情况，我们到那再谈。

original: Are you all right? Is it safe in there?
translation: 你还好吧？那里面安全吗？

original: We can't accomplish anything until we can get inside, but none of us are particularly capable fighters.
translation: 除非我们进到里面，不然我们什么都做不了，但是我们中没有能胜任战士工作的。

original: I hate to ask you to put yourself in harm's way, but you seem to have learned to handle yourself.
translation: 我讨厌将你推入危险的境地，但看上去你懂得怎么处理。

original: I need you to go in and make sure it's safe for Doctor Li and her crew.
translation: 我需要你进去确保李博士和她手下工作人员的安全。

original: I still need your help. I can't do this without you, you know.
translation: 我还需要你帮助。你知道，没你我做不到。

original: Here we are. Where it all began. You remember your mother's favorite passage?
translation: 我们到了。一切开始的地方，你记得你妈妈最喜欢的那段吗？

original: Revelation 21:6. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life, freely.
translation: 启示录21：6。我是阿尔法，我是欧米伽，我是初，我是终。我要将生命泉的水，白白赐给那口渴的人喝。

original: Don't you see? This is what it all means. The water, the purifier. THIS is the water of life. Your mother's dream.
translation: 你看见了吗？这就是它的含义。这水，这净化器。这就是生命之水。你母亲的梦想。

original: No point in wasting time. Let's get to work. There's much to be done.
translation: 别浪费时间了。我们开始工作，还有很多事要做。

original: I'm not trying to put you off, but we need to get to Project Purity. Anything else can wait until later.
translation: 我不想让你失望，但我们要前往净水工程，其他事都得等等。

original: We need to get back to Project Purity. The computer there is our best chance to locate a G.E.C.K.
translation: 我们得回到“净水工程”，那里的电脑是我们找到G.E.C.K.所在的最佳选择

original: Give me a few moments to speak with Madison. Then we can decide on a course of action. Have patience.
translation: 让我和麦迪逊谈谈。然后我们决定行动过程。耐心点。

original: Yeah? You need something?
translation: 嗯？你需要些什么？

original: You found him! I can't believe it!
translation: 我找到他了！难以置信。

original: You have my thanks. We would be lost without James.
translation: 我要表示我的谢意。没有詹姆斯我们肯定会迷路。

original: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

original: My goodness... You must be James' daughter. You look so much like him.
translation: 我的天……你一定是詹姆斯的女儿。你看起来很像他。

original: I'm surprised to see you here. He gave me the impression that you were... somewhere else, and that we wouldn't be seeing you again.
translation: 见到你在这我很惊讶。他给我的印象是：你在……某处，我们无法再次见到你。

original: If you're here to talk to him, I'm afraid he's come and gone. The last I knew, he was headed back to the lab.
translation: 如果你来着是想和他谈谈，我恐怕他已经走了。据我所知，他回实验室了。

original: My goodness... You must be James' son. You look so much like him.
translation: 我的天……你一定是詹姆斯的儿子。你看起来很像他。

original: I'm surprised to see you here. He gave me the impression that you were... somewhere else, and that we wouldn't be seeing you again.
translation: 见到你在这我很惊讶。他给我的印象是：你在……某处，我们无法再次见到你。

original: If you're here to talk to him, I'm afraid he's come and gone. The last I knew, he was headed back to the lab.
translation: 如果你来着是想和他谈谈，我恐怕他已经走了。据我所知，他回实验室了。

original: Good to see you again, honey.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，亲爱的。

original: Good to see you again, son.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，孩子。

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: I need to reach Madison as soon as possible. Now I can make her see that Project Purity is worth finishing.
translation: 我要尽快见到麦迪逊。现在我能让她了解净水工程是否值得完成。

original: Well, hi there! Welcome to Andale! I'm Willy Wilson, though folks just call me Bill. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 你好！欢迎来到安戴尔！我是薇柳·威尔逊，不过人们都叫我比尔。有什么可以帮助你的吗？

original: Well, hello again! How can the Wilson clan help you today?
translation: 你好！今天威尔逊能为你做点什么？

original: Hooeee, smell that air! Ain't nothing like it, is there?
translation: 呵，你闻闻！从没有闻过这气味，对吧？

original: And what can I do for you on this fine day?
translation: 天气不错，能为你做点什么？

original: By God, it's another fine day in Andale!
translation: 今天安戴尔又是一个好天气！

original: Hey there, stranger. I've got something that I want to talk to you about.
translation: 嗨，陌生人。我有些事想和你说。

original: I couldn't help but notice that you were poking around in Bill's shed.
translation: 我不得不注意你又在比尔的地盘游荡了。

original: So, did you find what you were looking for in there?
translation: 你在那找到你要找的东西了吗？

original: Hey there, stranger. I've got something that I want to talk to you about.
translation: 嗨，陌生人。我有些事想和你说。

original: I couldn't help but notice that you're poking around in my basement.
translation: 我不得不注意你又在我的地下室游荡了。

original: So, be honest now, You wouldn't know anything about that would you?
translation: 所以，说实话，那事你什么都不知道，对吧？

original: Hello there, fellah! Good to meet you! Name's Smith, Jack Smith. Welcome to Andale, the best little town in Virginia!
translation: 你好，伙计！很高兴见到你！我叫史密斯，杰克·史密斯。欢迎来到安戴尔，弗吉尼亚最好的镇子。

original: Hello there, young lady! Good to meet you! Name's Smith, Jack Smith. Welcome to Andale, the best little town in Virginia!
translation: 你好，女士！很高兴见到你！我叫史密斯，杰克·史密斯。欢迎来到安戴尔，弗吉尼亚最好的镇子。

original: Hello there, stranger! Good to meet you! Name's Jack Smith. I hear you've already met my wife. Sweet lady, isn't she?
translation: 你好，陌生人！很高兴见到你！我叫史密斯，杰克·史密斯。听说你已经见过我妻子了。温柔可人的淑女，对吧？

original: But anyway, welcome to Andale, the best little town in Virginia!
translation: 总之，欢迎来到安戴尔，弗吉尼亚最好的镇子！

original: Hey there, good to see you again!
translation: 嗨，很高兴再次见到你！

original: Afternoon, friend!
translation: 下午好，朋友！

original: Look at this weather, can you believe it?
translation: 看看这天气，你能相信吗？

original: It's so weird... our parents went on a trip and aren't coming back. Do you think they're dead or something?
translation: 太奇怪了……我父母去旅行但还没回来。你觉得他们会不会死了还是怎么了？

original: Wouldn't Mr. Harris tell us if they were?
translation: 难道海瑞斯先生不愿意告诉我们他们的状况吗？？

original: Mr Harris is nice to us, but he doesn't read the stories the same way that my daddy did.
translation: 海瑞斯先生对我们很好，但他讲故事的方式和我爸爸不同。

original: We're eating all sorts of different food now. Before, we always just ate my mom's meat pies.
translation: 现在我们什么都吃。以前，我们一直都只吃我妈妈做的肉派。

original: Hi! Welcome to Andale! I'm Jenny! You should probably talk to my dad, he likes to welcome all the new visitors!
translation: 你好！欢迎来到安戴尔！我是珍妮！你或许应该和我爸爸谈谈，他很喜欢迎接新来访者！

original: Hi, again! How're you doing?
translation: 嘿，又见面了！你还好吗？

original: I'm not really sure what happened. Mr. Harris said that our parents went away, and they won't be back.
translation: 我不太确定发生了什么。海瑞斯先生说我父母已经离开了，而且不再回来了。

original: He says that he'll tell me more about it when I'm older but... I miss my mom and dad...
translation: 他说等我大些了再告诉我详细的事不过……我想念我爸和我妈……

original: Mr. Harris is a lot like my dad. I never knew that he could be so nice.
translation: 海瑞斯先生就像我爸爸。我从来没想过他会对我这么好。

original: You're new here, aren't you? Wow! I never get a chance to talk to the new people! Dad always takes care of them before I get a chance.
translation: 你是新来的，对吧？哇！我从没机会和新来的人讲话！爸爸总是在我有机会之前就全关照好他们了。

original: Hello again! Have you been out having adventures?
translation: 你好，又见面了！你刚出去探险了吗？

original: I wish I was like you, instead of stuck here in boring ol' Andale.
translation: 我希望我能像你一样，而不是困在这百无聊赖的安戴尔。

original: Oh man, I'm so jealous, you get to go out and do stuff outside of town and you probably don't even have a bedtime.
translation: 哦，哥们，我太妒忌了，你将会到镇外做事，甚至连睡觉的时间都没有。

original: Well, hello! Welcome to Andale! Winner of the best town in the USA contest!
translation: 你好！欢迎来到安戴尔！美利坚合众国最佳城镇竞赛冠军镇！

original: Oh. It's you again. Well, I don't want to be rude, so what do you want?
translation: 哦，又是你。哦，我还是礼貌些，你需要什么？

original: Oh. Hello. Do you need something, or are you here to tell me about your incredibly nice underground vault again?
translation: 哦。你好。你需要什么，还是你要再告诉我一次你那难以置信的地下避难所？

original: Hmph. Well, I'm not as rude as you, so I'll politely ask you what you need.
translation: 哼。好吧，我没你那么无礼，所以我会礼貌地问你需要什么。

original: Hello again! Stick around for a while, I'm thinking about making some meat cookies later! Isn't that exciting!
translation: 你好！先等一会，我正在考虑做些夹肉饼干！令人兴奋吧！

original: I'm so happy to see you! What do you need?
translation: 见到你太高兴了！你需要什么？

original: I'm a little busy right now, but never too busy for a friend! What did you want to talk about?
translation: 我现在有点忙，不过对朋友的话我就有时间！你想说点什么？

original: Why, hello there. I'd heard there was someone new coming. How can our little family help you?
translation: 噢，你好。我已经听说有个新来的。我们的小家可以帮你什么吗？

original: Hello again! You know, I actually missed you! And I barely know who you are!
translation: 再次见面，你好！你知道么，我还蛮想念你的！而我根本不知道你是谁！

original: It's so good to see you again. Honestly, I get a little bored around here... don't tell Bill!
translation: 再见到你很高兴。坦白说，我感觉在这有点无聊……不要告诉比尔！

original: Busy busy busy, a wife's work is never done!
translation: 忙忙忙，主妇的事永远做不完！

original: I saw what happened out there, stranger. Those people may have been my family but... it had to be done.
translation: 我看到那发生了什么，陌生人。那些人或许是我的家人，不过……非这样做不可。

original: I was like them for so many years... it's... I can't even talk about it.
translation: 这么多年来，我像他们一样……这……我甚至不能说出口。

original: The only thing that I can do is try to raise these kids and make Andale into a decent place.
translation: 我能做的只有尽力抚养这些孩子，把安戴尔打理得有条有理。

original: This is such an ugly place... so many bad memories. But we're trying.
translation: 这实在是个糟糕的地方……这么多不好的回忆。但是我们在努力。

original: I'm not sure why you'd come back here, but I'm glad to see you.
translation: 我不清楚为什么你回来这，但很高兴见到你。

original: Little by little, each day, I'm trying to clean up the mess my family left.
translation: 一点一点，日复一日，我在努力处理我的家人留下的麻烦。

original: Wha- how? How did you get in here? What are you doing in this town? Get out! Get out while you can!
translation: 哇 — 你怎样进来这的？你在镇里干嘛？滚出去！有多远滚多远！

original: Get out of here! Run!
translation: 滚开！滚！

original: They're crazy! Crazy I tell you!
translation: 他们疯了！我跟你说吧，疯了！

original: Get out of town while you still can!
translation: 趁现在还能走，赶快滚出镇子！

original: What is it? Can't you see that I'm watching the guards?
translation: 你要什么？快点说，你挡住我视线了。

original: What do you want? Make it quick, you're blocking my view!
translation: 哦……嗨！你想要什么，年轻的小伙？

original: Oh... hey! What do you need, young fellow?
translation: 哦……嗨！你想要什么，年轻的女士？

original: Oh... hey! What do you need, young lady?
translation: 什么……呃？我？你和我讲话吗？啊？你需要什么？

original: What... huh? Me? You're talking to me? Yes? What do you need?
translation: 嗨，想看点好玩的东西吗？我只想喝点酒，然后我会给你看的。

original: Hey, want to see something funny? All I need is some booze, and I'll show you!
translation: 嗨……嗨！你想听歌吗？舞蹈？给我些酒喝，就可以！

original: Hey... hey! You wanna hear a song? See a dance? Just gimme some booze, I'll make it happen!
translation: 噢，看看谁来了。新人啊，刚从废土来！

original: Why, look at what we have here. Some fresh meat, right out of the Wastes!
translation: 你特想和那些人一起进围栏，对吧？还是我打晕你，亲自把你拖进去？

original: You just wanna go ahead and jump into the pen with the others, or should I beat you senseless and drag you there myself?
translation: 噢，看看你！可爱的小淘气。

original: Aww, look at you! You're such a cute lil' varmint.
translation: 你最好不要这样看我，否则我会狠狠修理你的。

original: You'd best stop lookin' at me like that before I spit you up and chew you out.
translation: 我想念尤勒基……

original: I miss Eulogy...
translation: 我要说的，尤勒基先生都已经替我说了。

original: Anything that I have to say, Mr. Eulogy can say for me.
translation: 尤勒基先生不喜欢我未经他的允许就和他人随便交谈。

original: Mr. Eulogy don't like me talking to the johnnies without his permission.
translation: 你想要什么，呆子？

original: What do you want, square?
translation: 告诉你真相，我很高兴那蠢货死了。

original: To tell you the truth, I'm glad that fool is dead.
translation: 尤勒基负责这生意。

original: Eulogy handles the business.
translation: 什么？见到什么喜欢的了吗？

original: What? Do you see something you like?
translation: 听着，这可不是私人恩怨，但是如果需要什么，尽管和那带帽子的傻蛋说。

original: Look, nothing personal, but if you need something, talk to the clown in the hat.
translation: 再盯着我看，我就揍你。

original: Keep staring and I'll start charging.
translation: 看你一塌糊涂的，我希望你带了很多钱来。

original: You're a mess. I hope you brought a lot of money with you.
translation: 你是想把血都撒在我身上，还是想付钱给我来修好你？

original: Are you just going to bleed on me, or are you going to pay me to fix you?
translation: 我喜欢看到跛足废物。对我来说你就像一堆移动的瓶盖。

original: I love the sight of a limping Waster. You just look like a walking pile of caps to me.
translation: 看你跛成什么样了。你给“快刀”阿姨带瓶盖来了吗？

original: Well now, look at you limping in here like that. Did you bring some caps for Auntie Cutter?
translation: 你似乎过了几天好日子。几个瓶盖就可以把你修好。

original: You look like you've seen better days. A few caps'll fix that up for you.
translation: 我们经历了几次战斗，不是吗？那就是为何他们付给我这么多钱……

original: Been in a few fights, have we? Well, that's why they pay me the big bucks...
translation: 没什么能比带有超多瓶盖，并负了伤的奴隶贩子更能吸引我的。但愿你也是那种类型的。

original: Ain't nothing that I love more than an injured Slaver with more caps than sense. Hopefully, you fall into that category.
translation: 我觉得你还可以，是来这买补给的吗？

original: You look alright to me. Are you here for some supplies?
translation: 你好，亲爱的。今天尤勒基能帮你什么吗？

original: Hello there, my dear. What can Eulogy do for you today?
translation: 如果要什么东西只管告诉我，我会尽量给你弄到。

original: Just let me know if you need anything, and I'll do whatever I can to procure it.
translation: 如果你是来谈生意的，我洗耳恭听。

original: If it's business you're here to discuss, I'm all ears.
translation: 我能为你效劳吗？堕落天堂随时愿意做生意。

original: What can I do for you? Paradise Falls is always open for business.
translation: 有什么可以帮你的吗？

original: Something I can help you with?
translation: <叹气>我肯定只要是你说的都非常重要。所以让我们听听。

original: <sighs>I'm sure that whatever you have to say is absolutely vital. So let's hear it.
translation: 你-要-什-么？

original: What. Do. You. Want?
translation: 你要干嘛 ?

original: Look. I told you. My name's Forty. I'm not inclined to change it, so unless you've got something good to say, you'd best make it fast.
translation: 佐敦。

original: Jotun.
translation: 什么？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: This place is terrible! Please! You've got to help us!
translation: 这地方太糟了！帮帮我们！

original: You need guns, I got guns. You need armor? Got that too. So long as you got the caps for 'em.
translation: 你需要枪支，我这有。你要装甲吗？我也有。只要你有足够的瓶盖。

original: Guns, guns, and more guns. What do you need?
translation: 枪，枪，还是枪。你需要什么？

original: What? I guard the gate. That's all. What the fuck do you want from me?
translation: 什么？我看守大门。就这样。你他妈的想要我干嘛？

original: Hey. Talk fast, they hate it when I talk to customers.
translation: 嗨。讲快点。他们不喜欢我和顾客聊天。

original: Haha! Hello! I am Ymir!
translation: 哈哈！你好！我是伊米尔！

original: Haha! Good to see you again, little man! Have you come to drink with me?
translation: 哈哈！很高兴再见到你，小伙子！你是来找我喝酒的？

original: Haha! Good to see you again, little girl! Have you come to drink with me?
translation: 哈哈！很高兴再见到你，小女孩！你是来找我喝酒的？

original: Hey sorry, man. Let me get out of your way!
translation: 嗨，不好意思，哥们。我给你让路！

original: Whoa there. Easy, killer. I'm movin', I'm movin'!
translation: 哇。别紧张，杀手。我走了，我走了！

original: Heard about you. You're some pretty slick shit.
translation: 听说过你。你这狗屎。

original: Respect.
translation: 问候下。

original: You look like a damn fool in that Vault Suit.
translation: 你穿避难所套装太傻了。

original: Nice! Did you get that monkey suit from the Brotherhood?
translation: 不错！你是从兄弟会那搞到这猴子套装的？

original: Sorry, bro. Got nothin' to say to you.
translation: 不好意思，哥们。和你没什么好说的。

original: Sorry, chica. Got nothin' to say to you.
translation: 不好意思，小妞。和你没什么好说的。

original: Keep walkin'.
translation: 继续走。

original: I can't believe that Grouse let you in here.
translation: 不敢相信是那葛劳斯放你进来的。

original: Don't think I won't throw your ass in the pens with the rest of the meat.
translation: 别以为我不会把你和那帮菜鸟一起送进围栏。

original: You don't exactly look like you belong here.
translation: 你看上去不像是这里的。

original: Okay, seriously. Leave me alone.
translation: 好了，真的。不要管我。

original: *sniff* Smells like meat. Move on.
translation: *嗅* 像肉的味道。继续。

original: Hey, I've been wanting to talk to you. Leo told me what you said to him. You know, about his problem.
translation: 嗨，我一直想和你说话。利奥告诉我你和他谈过，你知道，他的问题。

original: I just wanted to say thank you. I know I can be rough, but my little brother means the world to me and you may have saved his life.
translation: 我只是想说谢谢。我知道我可能比较失礼，但是我的弟弟对我来说就是整个世界，而你救了他的命。

original: If there's anything that I can ever help you with, just let me know.
translation: 如果还有什么事是我可以帮你的，请尽管告诉我。

original: Hey there, Leo's been doing a lot better. I think we have you to thank for that. How can I help you?
translation: 嗨，利奥现在做得好多了。我想我们该谢谢你。我能帮你什么忙吗？

original: Leo's tickets have stopped coming up short ever since he gave up the chems. Me and my wallet both thank you. What can we do for you?
translation: 自从利奥戒了毒，他不再缺钱。我和我的钱包都很谢谢你。我们能为你做什么？

original: Can't a man eat in peace? Go talk to Jenny or Leo if you need something.
translation: 不能让人安静吃饭吗？如果你需要什么去和珍妮或利奥说。

original: Look, I need to balance these books. If you'd like to order some food, please talk to Jenny or Leo.
translation: 听着，我需要对账。如果你要点吃的，去和珍妮或利奥说。

original: Yep. Still balancing the books. Is there something exciting about watching me? Look: Go talk to Jenny or Leo.
translation: 对。还在对账。你除了盯着我之外就没其他事可做了吗？听着：去和珍妮或利奥谈。

original: You again. Is there something exciting about watching me? Look: Go talk to Jenny or Leo.
translation: 又是你。你除了盯着我之外就没其他事可做了吗？听着：去和珍妮或利奥谈。

original: Hmm? Oh. I'm afraid I'm quite busy right now. If it's food you're after, talk to Jenny or Leo. Otherwise, I can't help you.
translation: 嗯？哦。我恐怕我现在很忙。如果你要些吃的，去和珍妮或利奥谈。否则我没什么可帮你的。

original: You again? Go Bother Jenny or Leo, will you?
translation: 又是你？去找珍妮或利奥好吗？

original: Hooo weee! Look at you! Now I haven't seen one of those Vault jumpsuits in, wow, a LONG time.  Pretty damn good condition, too!
translation: 哇~~！看看你！我多久不见这样的避难所工作服了。而且状况还真他妈不错！

original: Name's Billy Creel. You call me Billy, all right? I know Megaton looks more like a boneyard than a town, but it ain't all bad.
translation: 我是比利·克里，你叫我比利，好吗？我知道兆吨镇看起来更像是一个废车场而不是一个城镇，但是也不是都很糟。

original: Take me and Maggie, for instance. We make do just fine. I trade the stuff I scavenge, and she helps keep me on the straight and narrow. He he he.
translation: 拿我和玛姬举例。我们做得很好。我交易那些从废物中提取的东西，而她帮我保持循规蹈矩。呵呵呵。

original: Well hot damn! Someone new! Always a pleasure!
translation: 真是该死！新来的！太让人高兴了！

original: Name's Billy Creel. You call me Billy, all right? I know Megaton looks more like a boneyard than a town, but it ain't all bad.
translation: 我是比利·克里，你叫我比利，好吗？我知道兆吨镇看起来更像是一个废车场而不是一个城镇，但是也不是都很糟。

original: Take me and Maggie, for instance. We make do just fine. I trade the stuff I scavenge, and she helps keep me on the straight and narrow. He he he.
translation: 拿我和玛姬举例。我们做得很好。我交易那些从废物中提取的东西，而她帮我保持循规蹈矩。呵呵呵。

original: Look, bud. It'd be best if you just drift on by and leave us alone.
translation: 听着，伙计。你最好把自己挪开，让我们自己待着。

original: Hey, man. What's going on?
translation: 嗨，伙计。发生了什么事？

original: Well now, if it ain't our local terror. You behave yourself this time, you hear?
translation: 哎哟，这不是我们的地头蛇嘛。这次你最好收敛点，听见了吗？

original: I don't care what you do to these yokels, you just keep your brand of trouble far away from me.
translation: 我不管你怎么对待这些乡巴佬，你只要带着你那队麻烦离我远点。

original: Colin Moriarty, at your service! Welcome to Moriarty's! My saloon, my home, my little slice of heaven in this godforsaken little town!
translation: 科林·莫里亚蒂，为你服务！欢迎来到莫里亚蒂的酒吧！我的酒吧，我的家，我在这荒芜镇子上的一片天堂。

original: If you've got the caps, I've got your pleasure. Please, sit down, make yourself comfortable -- your troubles are a thing of the past.
translation: 如果你有瓶盖，我能帮你找点乐子。请，坐下，请随意 — 你的麻烦已经是过去的事情了。

original: Colin Moriarty. Always pleased to see a new face around here. I'm afraid you've had the misfortune to catch me, well... out of my element.
translation: 科林·莫里亚蒂总是乐意见到新面孔。但在这撞见我，对你恐怕并不是什么好事。

original: I'm the owner and proprietor of Moriarty's, you see. My saloon, my home, my little slice of heaven in this godforsaken little town!
translation: 我是莫里亚蒂的酒吧的拥有者和经营者。你看，我的酒吧，我的家，我在这荒芜镇子上的一片天堂。

original: But, I already know your face from that little stunt you pulled the other day. But no worries, all are welcome here.
translation: 但前几天你耍的小花招使我认识了你的脸。不过别担心，所有人在这都受欢迎。

original: Colin Moriarty. Always pleased to see a new face around here. I'm afraid you've had the misfortune to catch me, well... out of my element.
translation: 科林·莫里亚蒂总是乐意见到新面孔。但在我这撞见我，对你恐怕并不是什么好事。

original: I'm the owner and proprietor of Moriarty's, you see. My saloon, my home, my little slice of heaven in this godforsaken little town!
translation: 我是莫里亚蒂的酒吧的拥有者和经营者。你看，我的酒吧，我的家，我在这荒芜镇子上的一片天堂。

original: But, please! Please! See for yourself! Come by for a drink or three. You and I... you and I are going to get along just fine.
translation: 但是，请！请！你自己看！来一两杯喝的。你和我……你和我会和睦相处的。

original: Hello, hello. What is it I can do for you?
translation: 你好，你好。我能为你做什么？

original: Ahhh... my new friend. What can I get you? Some sorrows are best buried, and I'm a man that can provide all sorts of tools to bury them.
translation: 啊……我的新朋友。需要来点什么？有些苦楚最好埋葬，而我最不缺让人“埋东西”的法子。

original: And back he comes. So... are you just thirsty, or are you ready to pay my fee? Dear dad's not going to find himself.
translation: 他回来过这。那么……你只是渴望呢，还是打算付钱？亲爱的爸爸可不会自己出现哦。

original: And back she comes. So, are you just thirsty, or are you ready to pay my fee? Dear dad's not going to find himself.
translation: 他回来过这。那么……你只是渴望呢，还是打算付钱？亲爱的爸爸可不会自己出现哦。

original: What's it to be? A few caps to find out where your father went? Or are you going to have a go of it on your own?
translation: 想干嘛？想用些瓶盖来打听你父亲的去处？还是你准备自己去找？

original: The Wasteland can be such an unforgiving place....
translation: 废土可是一片无情的地方……

original: No luck finding dear old dad? Can't say it surprises me. Wasteland's a big place. Maybe you need a drink.
translation: 找不到你亲爱的爸爸？我一点都不惊讶。废土可是很大的地方，或许你要杯喝的。

original: You're still standing here, and I can't think why. You know where your father went. Seems to me you ought to be out searching the Wastes.
translation: 你还站在这，我不知道还有什么理由。你知道你爸爸去哪了，我想你该到废土去找他。

original: If it isn't my favorite vault baby! What can I do for you?
translation: 这不是我最喜欢的避难所宝宝吗！我能为你做些什么？

original: And look who it is! What can this humble barkeep do for you?
translation: 看这是谁！我这卑微的酒吧老板能为你做些什么？

original: Who have we here? Could it be? A new addition to our humble little community? Dear child, welcome! Welcome to Megaton!
translation: 看谁来了？不可能？我们这卑微群体的新成员？亲爱的孩子，欢迎！欢迎来到兆吨镇！

original: I am Confessor Cromwell, prophet of Atom and father of the undying Glow. Please child, come to the Church any time. Any time at all!
translation: 我是忏悔者克伦威尔，原子的先知，不朽光辉的忏悔者。来，孩子，随时来教堂。什么时候都可以！

original: I apologize, but I cannot talk now. Perhaps you'd like to take a seat and enjoy the sermon?
translation: 抱歉，我现在不能聊天。或许你可以找个位置听我布道。

original: Yes? Oh, I apologize. I was just... contemplating why Atom, in his wisdom, chose to take my dear Maya to his glow before her time.
translation: 什么？哦，对不起。我只是……思考为什么原子用他的智慧选择提早将我亲爱的玛雅带入他的光辉中。

original: These are questions that none of us can answer in this life. Now, how may I help you?
translation: 这些是我们无法在有生之年回答的问题。现在，我能帮你什么忙？

original: It is so good to see you again, dear child! Remember, the Church of the Children of Atom is always here for you. Salvation IS attainable!
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，亲爱的孩子！记住，原子信徒教堂永远欢迎你。救赎总可得到！

original: Have yourself a nice visit, partner.
translation: 好好参观吧，伙计。

original: Howdy, pard-ner. My name is Deputy Steel. How may I assist you?
translation: 你好，伙计！我的名字是斯蒂尔副警长。我能帮你什么忙？

original: Howdy ma'am, my name is Deputy Steel. How may I assist you?
translation: 你好，女士，我的名字是斯蒂尔副警长。我能帮你什么忙？

original: Initiating conversation system... Well hello, pilgrim.
translation: 初始化谈话系统……嗯，你好，信徒。

original: I'm Doc Church and I run this clinic. Now, before you go askin' me for help, you'd better know the rules. Rule one: don't bother me.
translation: 我是丘奇医生，我经营这诊所。现在，在你要求我帮助之前，你最好知道规矩。规矩一，别打扰我。

original: If you do bother me, you better be damn near dead. I'm busy enough takin' care of people I actually like.
translation: 如果你打扰了我，你最好处在该死的濒死状态。照顾那些我真正喜欢的人已经够忙的了。

original: Follow my rule, I'll keep you patched up, I'll keep getting' paid, and we'll get along just fine.
translation: 照我的规矩，我会帮你治疗，我会收钱，我们合作愉快。

original: Boy, you're glowin' like a goddamn reactor core. You need help?
translation: 孩子，你身上发光像个该死的反应堆核心。需要帮助？

original: Girl, you're glowin' like a goddamn reactor core. You need help?
translation: 女孩，你身上发的光像个该死的反应堆核心。需要帮助？

original: Looks like you went and got yourself irradiated. Too bad for you, I'm off duty. Stop by the clinic in the morning.
translation: 看来你受辐射污染了。太糟了，我下班了。明天早上再来吧。

original: What the hell are you standin' there bleedin' on my floor for? If you need help, then ask for it, dammit!
translation: 你他妈干嘛站在我的地板上流血？如果你要帮助就说，见鬼！

original: You came in here on your own power, so you must not be busted up too bad.
translation: 你靠自己的力量走进来，那你受伤一定不太严重。

original: You'd best have cancer because from the looks of you, you're breaking rule number one right now.
translation: 看看你那德行，你最好是得了癌，因为你现在破坏了第一条规矩。

original: For Christ's sake, you don't look sick and you sure as hell don't look dead, so why are you bothering me?
translation: 看在上帝份上，你看上去既没病、更没死。那你为何来打扰我？

original: The Doctor is off duty. Go away.
translation: 医生下班了，走开。

original: Don't shoot! Please! Just tell me what you want!
translation: 别开枪！求你！你说你要什么吧！

original: Hey smoothskin, do you need something? A drink, maybe? Anything? Anything at all?
translation: 嘿，光皮肤，你要点什么吗？来杯喝的，怎样？随便什么都行？什么都行？

original: <sigh>What'll it be?
translation: <叹气>来点什么？

original: Oh, it's you. Would you like to slap me around before you drink? I'm told that it's a lot of fun.
translation: 哦，是你。你能不能在喝之前扇我一耳光？我听说那很好玩。

original: Oh good. If it isn't my favorite smoothskin.
translation: 哦，好。这不是我最爱的光皮肤吗？

original: Hey, pal. What do you need?
translation: 嗨，伙计。你要什么？

original: Good to see you again! Need a drink?
translation: 很高兴再次见到你！来杯喝的？

original: Oh, man... I'm glad to see you. Moriarty's been especially nasty lately and I need a friendly face.
translation: 哦，哥们……很高兴见到你。莫里亚蒂近来特别讨厌，我需要友善的面孔。

original: Dad used to say... oh, never mind...
translation: 爸爸常说……哦，算了……

original: Dad usually doesn't like when I talk to strangers.
translation: 爸爸一般不喜欢我和陌生人说话。

original: Be careful, mister. My dad is right over there. Try anything, and I'll yell for him.
translation: 小心，先生。我爸爸就在那。你敢对我怎样我就叫他。

original: Be careful, lady. My dad is right over there. Try anything, and I'll yell for him.
translation: 小心，小姐。我爸爸就在那。你敢对我怎样我就叫他。

original: Now I KNOW I've never seen you in Megaton before. Let me guess -- just passing through, right?
translation: 我知道我从未在兆吨镇见过你。让我猜猜 — 你只是路过，对吧？

original: We get people tryin' to settle down here all the time. Anyway, if you're hungry, you came to the right place. What can I get you?
translation: 一直有人想在这定居。总之，你要是饿了，就算来对地方了。你要点什么？

original: Now I KNOW I've never seen you in Megaton before. Let me guess -- just passing through, right?
translation: 我知道我从未在兆吨镇见过你。让我猜猜 — 你只是路过，对吧？

original: We get people tryin' to settle down here all the time, but you don't look like the type. Anyway...
translation: 一直有人想在这定居，但你看起来不像那种类型。算了……

original: Hey. What can I get you?
translation: 嗨，来点什么？

original: So what'll it be today? We've got some noodles. And the Brahmin steak is pretty good, too.
translation: 今天怎么样啊？我们有些面条。双头牛肉排也相当不错。

original: So what's it going to be?
translation: 想来点什么？

original: Sorry man, I'm off the clock. Noodle time is over.
translation: 对不起，伙计。我下班了。面条时间过了。

original: Sorry girl, I'm off the clock. Noodle time is over.
translation: 对不起，女孩。我下班了。面条时间过了。

original: Oh, hey. Look, I'm not working right now.
translation: 哦，嗨。听着，我现在不工作。

original: The noodle stand is closed right now. If you need something, talk to Leo.
translation: 面条摊现在关了。如果你要什么，和利奥说。

original: Oh, look. Another one of your pampered vault assholes. Look here, vault asshole -- I don't like you. Stay clear of me and we'll have no trouble.
translation: 哦，看。又是个暴饮暴食的避难所混蛋。听好，避难所混蛋 — 我不喜欢你。离我远点，我们就不会有麻烦。

original: Oh, look. Another one of you Wasteland assholes. Look here, asshole -- I don't like you. Stay clear of me and we'll have no trouble.
translation: 哦，看。又是个废土混蛋。听好，混蛋 — 我不喜欢你。离我远点，我们就不会有麻烦。

original: Long time, no see. You takin' care of yourself out there?
translation: 好久不见。最近怎么样？

original: Been a while. You need something?
translation: 好久不见。你要什么？

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Yeah? You want something?
translation: 嗯？你要点什么？

original: This'd better be good. I'm in no mood for your shit.
translation: 最好是好事。我没心情和你闲聊。

original: Say what's on your mind then get out of my face.
translation: 说出你的想法然后立刻消失。

original: How may I assist you?
translation: 有什么我可以帮你的吗？

original: Hi there! I'm Moira, it's a pleasure to meet you! I run Craterside Supply.
translation: 你好！我是莫伊拉，很高兴见到你！我经营坑边杂货店。

original: If there's anything you need, anything at all, I probably got it layin' around in here somewhere. Don't be afraid to ask!
translation: 如果还有什么需要，任何需要，我都可能有存货。别担心，尽管问。

original: Hey, you! What do you need?
translation: 嗨，你！你需要什么？

original: Have you seen a radiphlange anywhere around here? I could really use one... ah, nevermind. What can I get you?
translation: 你在这附近见过电台投射器吗？我真的要用一个……啊，别介意。你要什么？ ?

original: Good to see you! Did you bring me any junk?
translation: 很高兴见到你！你给我带了什么破烂？！

original: Well goddamn. You're new, right? I've got to admit, the outfit's a little weird, but that's okay, that's okay. Name's Leo Stahl. It's a pleasure!
translation: 该死，你是新来的，是吗？我得承认，这套装有点怪异，但是没关系，没关系。我是利奥·斯塔尔。很荣幸！

original: Well goddamn. You're new, right?  Name's Leo Stahl. It's a pleasure! It's a pleasure! Yeah!
translation: 该死，你是新来的，是吗？我是利奥·斯塔尔。很高兴！真的很高兴！耶！

original: <sighs>It's you. I was hoping that you'd have moved on. What do you want?
translation: <叹气>是你。我还指望你走了。你要什么？

original: Goddammit. Can't you leave me alone? What do you want?
translation: 该死。就不能别烦我？你要什么？

original: Look, if you're going to tell on me, do it. Otherwise, tell me what you want and then get out of here.
translation: 听着，如果你要告发我，就去告。否则，告诉我你要什么，然后滚。

original: Hey hey! Nice to see you! Everything okay? You doing all right? You need something? Come on, talk to me!
translation: 嗨，嗨！很高兴见到你！都好吧？干得不错吧？你需要东西？来吧，和我谈谈！

original: Alright! Good to see you again? What's new? Feel like having a drink? C'mon, let's talk!
translation: 好吧！再次见到你？有什么新消息吗？感觉想要喝一杯？来吧，我们谈谈！

original: Hey there, buddy! Good to see you!
translation: 嗨，伙计！很高兴见到你！

original: Heya! How's it going?
translation: 你好！你好吗？

original: You pull another stunt like you did, and you're finished in this town. Do you understand?
translation: 再干那种事，你在这镇子就玩完了。你懂吗？

original: Now what do you want?
translation: 现在你要什么？

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: Hey there.
translation: 嘿你好。

original: Good to see you're staying out of trouble.
translation: 很高兴见到你没惹麻烦。

original: Got my eye on you. Don't do anything stupid.
translation: 我盯着你呢。别做蠢事。

original: Staying out of trouble, I hope? Don't want to have to waste good bullets on your sorry hide.
translation: 别惹麻烦，好吗？不想非得浪费好子弹在你这可怜的皮囊上。

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: Hi, I'm Maggie. I live with Billy. Billy Creel. Do you know him? He's not my dad or anything, but he takes care of me now. Anyway, I should go. Bye.
translation: 嘿，我是玛姬。我和比利一起住。比利·克里。你知道他吗？他不是我爸爸或什么人，但是他现在照顾我。总之，我该走了，再见。

original: Hi, I'm Maggie. I live with Billy. Billy Creel. Well... I used to. He died. Now... <sob> ... I need to go...
translation: 嘿，我是玛姬。我和比利一起住。比利·克里……我曾经。他死了。现在……<呜咽>……我该走了……

original: I probably shouldn't be talking to you. Billy always said that I get too friendly with people I don't know. I miss him...
translation: 我或许不该和你说。比利经常说我对不认识的人太好。我想念他……

original: I probably shouldn't be talking to you. Billy says I get too friendly with people I don't know. He says it's dangerous.
translation: 我或许不该和你说。比利经常说我对不认识的人太好。他说这很危险。

original: Hi there! How are you?
translation: 你好！怎么样？

original: Well hey there, stranger! I'm Manya. The old coot wandering around here is my husband, Nathan.
translation: 嗨，陌生人！我是曼雅。那个到处转的老笨蛋是我丈夫，内森。

original: If there's anything we can help you with, ask me. Don't ask Nathan, he'll just blabber at you about the damned Enclave all day.
translation: 如果有什么我们可以帮你的，请告诉我。别问内森，他会跟你唠叨该死的英克雷一整天。

original: Oh... hello, stranger. I'm sorry. I was just thinking about Nathan, my husband. He passed not too long ago.
translation: 哦……你好，陌生人。我很抱歉。我在想内森，我的丈夫。他不久前去世了。

original: I guess I'm not really over it. I'm not sure if I ever will be. Look, you have a good day, I need to go.
translation: 我想我还无法忘怀。我不肯定我将来是否能忘怀。看，你过得很好，我该走了。

original: I'm sorry. I was just thinking about Nathan. It's been so quiet around here since he passed...
translation: 对不起。我刚刚在想内森。自他走后，真是安静啊……

original: What do you need, honey?
translation: 你需要什么，亲爱的？

original: If you see Nathan, tell that man to get his ass back home.
translation: 如果你见到内森，告诉他滚回家来。

original: You seen Nathan anywhere around here?
translation: 你见到内森在附近什么地方吗？

original: Hello, sweet child. Hello. I don't believe we've met. I'm Mother Maya, prophet of the Atom and embracer of the universal Light.
translation: 好，亲爱的孩子。你好。我不相信我们见过。我是玛雅修女，原子的先知，宇宙光辉的信奉者。

original: Remember, sweet child, that as children of Atom, the fabric of the universe itself is ours to weave. So welcome to Megaton, and peace be with you.
translation: 记住，亲爱的孩子，作为原子的孩子，世界由我们自己建设。欢迎来到兆吨镇，愿和平与你同行。

original: Sweet child, now is not the time for talk. But you should join us now in our hour of prayer. Simply close thine eyes and bask in Atom's glow.
translation: 甜心，现在不是闲聊的时候。你该过来加入我们的祷告。闭上双眼，享受原子光辉的普照。

original: Well hello again, sweet child. Is all well with you? Remember, stay in the Glow and let all things take their course.
translation: 哦，再次见面你好，甜心，一切可好？记着，你要留在光辉中，一切顺其自然吧。

original: We meet again, sweet child. I hope you're finding our town agreeable? In darkness, in doubt, go ye to the bomb. Find Atom, and find truth.
translation: 我们又见面了，甜心。希望你能喜欢我们的镇子。在黑夜中，有疑问时，去核弹那。找到原子，找到真理。

original: Oh my, it divides my heart to see you again, sweet child. And what may Mother Maya do for you today?
translation: 噢，再次见面很高兴，甜心。玛雅修女今天能为你做点什么？

original: Huh? Oh... I'm sorry. I was thinking about Manya. Things ain't been the same since she passed...
translation: 呃？哦……不好意思。我刚在想玛雅的事。自从她去世后什么都变了……

original: Ha! Look at this! New blood! Tell me boy, you ever hear of the Enclave? The last remnant of the good ol' USA, they are!
translation: 哈！看！新人！小子，告诉我，你有没听过英克雷？昔日伟大美国残存的部分，就是他们！

original: Now, I don't know you from Adam, but I got you pegged for a patriot and any patriot worth his salt is gonna toss his gun in for the Enclave.
translation: 现在，我没听亚当说过你，但是我曾让你坚定作为爱国者的志向，所有称得上的爱国志士都会为英克雷贡献自己的力量。

original: Any day now, they're gonna roll up here and then this nightmare'll be over for good! But listen to me ramble -- I'm Nathan. What can I do for you?
translation: 他们随时都会到达这，然后噩梦永远地结束了！但听我道来 — 我是内森。可以为你做些什么吗？

original: Ha! Look at this! New blood! Tell me girl, you ever hear of the Enclave? The last remnant of the good ol' USA, they are!
translation: 哈！看！新人！女孩，告诉我，你有没听过英克雷？昔日伟大美国残存的部分，就是他们！

original: Now, I don't know you from Adam, but I got you pegged for a patriot and any patriot worth her salt is gonna toss her gun in for the Enclave.
translation: 现在，我没从原子那听说你，但是我曾让你坚定作为爱国者的志向，所有称得上的爱国志士都会为英克雷贡献自己的力量。

original: Any day now, they're gonna roll up here and then this nightmare'll be over for good! But listen to me ramble -- I'm Nathan. What can I do for you?
translation: 他们随时都会到达这，然后噩梦永远地结束了！但听我道来 — 我是内森。可以为你做些什么吗？

original: Where's that wife of mine got to anyway...
translation: 我妻子哪去了……

original: Have you seen my wife anywhere around here?
translation: 你有在附近见到我妻子吗？

original: Greetings, citizen!
translation: 你好，公民！

original: Be all you can be. Support the Enclave.
translation: 做所有你能做的。支持英克雷。

original: Well, hello there, Miss Dangerous. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好，危险的小姐。我能为你做些什么？

original: Well, hello there Mister Dangerous. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好，危险的先生，我能为你做些什么？

original: Hi there. I'm Nova. New to Megaton, huh? Do yourself a favor and keep walking. Some of us stay for a few days... and then it's five years later...
translation: 你好，我是诺瓦。刚来兆吨镇，呃？为你自己好，继续赶路吧。我们当中一些人只想待几天……然后过去了五年……

original: Hey, baby. What do you need?
translation: 嗨，宝贝。你有什么需要吗？

original: What is it, hon?
translation: 什么事，亲爱的？

original: Listen, I'm working right now. So make it quick, okay?
translation: 听着，我现在正在干活。因此动作快点，好吗？

original: The more time I spend talking to you, the less I'm spending watching for Raiders.
translation: 我和你聊得越久，能盯住歹徒的时间就越少。

original: How the hell did you get up here anyway?
translation: 你到底是怎么上来这的？

original: <grumbles> ... huh? Yeah? What is it?
translation: <抱怨> ……呃？嗯？什么事？

original: Yeah? What is it?
translation: 嗯？什么事？

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: I'm just here to guard the goods. That's all.
translation: 我只是来看守货物而已。

original: I'm here to watch over this stuff. Only touch what you've paid for, and we'll have no problem.
translation: 我在这看守。只碰你付过钱的东西，那我们就会相安无事。

original: I've got my eye on you.
translation: 我盯着你呢。

original: This place is so much better than Moriarty's. That place is just filled with scum.
translation: 这比莫里亚蒂那好多了。那都是人渣。

original: Pull up a chair if you want.
translation: 如果需要就拉张椅子过来。

original: Hey there, stranger. Talk to Leo if you need something.
translation: 嗨，陌生人。如果有什么需要就和利奥说。

original: Always good to see a new face.
translation: 很高兴见到新面孔。

original: Leo's a nice guy, a bit twitchy, but nice.
translation: 利奥是个好人，他有点急躁，但是个好人。

original: Don't mind Andy, he's just a busy guy.
translation: 不用介意安迪，他只是有些忙。

original: Hello, Child. Have you come to bask in Atom's glow?
translation: 你好，孩子。你是来享受原子的光辉普照吗？

original: Speak to the Confessor or the Mother if you wish to know more.
translation: 如果想了解更多就去和忏悔者或修女去谈。

original: Close your eyes, and feel Atom's glow...
translation: 闭上眼，感受原子的光辉……

original: The Confessor is truly the chosen of Atom.
translation: 忏悔者事实上是被原子选中的人。

original: Even those who are not dedicated Children of Atom may bask in his glow.
translation: 即使那些没有献身于原子的孩子们也可以受到他光辉照耀。

original: It's been so peaceful in here since Moriarty got killed.
translation: 自从莫里亚蒂被杀后这一直都很安定。

original: Talk to Gob if you need something.
translation: 如果你需要什么就和盖博说。

original: Can't I just drink in peace?
translation: 我只想安静地喝酒，可以吗？

original: I'm in the mood to drink, not to talk.
translation: 我只想喝酒，不想谈任何事。

original: Leave me alone.
translation: 离我远点。

original: It's not that kind of bar, stranger.
translation: 这不是那种酒吧，陌生人。

original: You looking to trade, stranger? Check out Craterside Supply.
translation: 看来你想做点交易吧，陌生人？去坑边杂货店看看吧。

original: If you need to buy something, Moira up in Craterside Supply can help you. Watch out though, she's... different.
translation: 如果你要买些什么，在坑边杂货店的莫伊拉可以帮到你。但是小心，她有点……特别。

original: Whatever you want, I don't have it.
translation: 不管你要什么，我都没有。

original: Leave me alone! Someone might see us!
translation: 不要理我！有人会看到我们一起的！

original: Don't let the people around here fool you with their hippie crap. They've got water they won't share with anyone. Nice, huh?
translation: 别被这人的嬉皮笑脸愚弄了。他们有水，不过他们不会拿出来和你分享。好人，呃？

original: What? Why are you being so friendly? Go away!
translation: 什么？你为什么如此友善？走开！

original: ...can't even afford some damn squirrel stew...
translation: ……就连该死的炖松鼠也吃不起……

original: Look, I don't want to be rude, but I don't trust strangers.
translation: 听着，我不想如此粗鲁，可我就是不相信陌生人。

original: [grumbles]... should've stayed in Rivet City... traveled through the Wasteland for this place...
translation: [抱怨]……本该待在铆钉城的……为了这地方我们穿越了废土……

original: I hope they let me buy a house here some day.
translation: 希望哪天他们让我在这买套房子。

original: *whistles*... dammit! You made me mess up the song!
translation: *口哨*…… 该死！你害我把歌唱乱了！

original: Where did you come from? ...not like it matters.
translation: 你从哪来的？……看上去这也没什么关系……

original: I don't want any trouble.
translation: 我不想找麻烦。

original: What? No! Go away!
translation: 什么？不行！走开！

original: Take it up with someone else.
translation: 你和其他人去处理吧。

original: I came to this place looking for water, but they're only selling to residents.
translation: 我到这来找水的，但他们只卖给当地居民。

original: [coughs] ... sorry... not now.
translation: [咳嗽] ……对不起……现在不行。

original: Sorry, I'm a little busy right now. Maybe we can talk later, okay?
translation: 对不起，现在有点忙。我们回头再聊，好吗？

original: The people here get really paranoid when they see outsiders chatting to each other. Keep that in mind.
translation: 这的人看到外来人互相交谈会变得非常偏执。好好记住。

original: Sorry, can't talk now.
translation: 对不起，现在不能谈话。

original: We've got nothing to say to each other.
translation: 我们之间没什么好说的。

original: Well, now... If it isn't the little villain from the vault. We've been looking for you. Someone's put quite a price on your head.
translation: 嗯……这不是避难所的小恶棍嘛。我们正在找你。有人花大价钱买你的脑袋。

original: What? You think you can walk around the Wasteland doing the evil that you do and there isn't going to be someone who takes notice?
translation: 什么？你觉得你能在废土到处游荡，干了什么而不被别人注意？

original: And now it's time for you to die.
translation: 现在就是你的死期。

original: Well, now... If it isn't the little saint from the vault. We've been looking for you. Someone's put quite a price on your head.
translation: 嗯……这不是避难所的小圣人嘛。我们正在找你，有人花大价钱买你的脑袋。

original: What? You think you can walk around the Wasteland doing the things that you do and there isn't going to be someone who takes notice?
translation: 什么？你觉得你能在废土到处游荡，干了什么而不被别人注意？

original: Such a shame. I hear that you could have been something useful. Ah well. Time to die.
translation: 遗憾。我听说你还有点用。好吧，你该去死了。

original: Surprise!
translation: 吓一跳！

original: Finally. Got you in my sights.
translation: 终于。你在我眼前了。

original: You won't get away this time.
translation: 这次你逃不走了。

original: And now it's time for you to die.
translation: 现在就是你的死期。

original: Go away, bleeder!
translation: 滚开，诈骗犯！

original: Nothing to see here, outsider.
translation: 这没什么好看的，外来人。

original: We've got this area locked down.
translation: 这区域已经被我们封锁了。

original: Keep moving, Wastelander.
translation: 不要停下来，游民。

original: Move along, outsider.
translation: 一边去，外来人。

original: I thought I told you to get the hell out of here!?! Tenpenny doesn't want your goddamn caps, and I don't want the goddamn headache.
translation: 见鬼，我想我已经告诉你离开这了吧？！特佩尼可不想要你该死的瓶盖，我也不想该死的头疼。

original: For the last time... Get your rotting, ugly, goddamn Ghoul ass off Mister Tenpenny's private property!
translation: 这是最后一次……你这肮脏、丑陋、该死的僵尸从特佩尼先生的私有财产挪开！

original: You again? I thought I told you to get lost?
translation: 又是你？我想我告诉过你快滚吧？

original: Give me a second. Keep your panties on!
translation: 给我点时间。我先穿上裤子！

original: Just a moment!
translation: 只要一会！

original: I guess you'd better be on your way... Sorry for the uhh, for the interruption.
translation: 我想你最好出发。呃……抱歉打扰了你。

original: They're not who they say they are... Get out while you can, before they get you too!
translation: 他们不像他们说的那样……趁他们没抓住你，赶快抽身！

original: If you're supposed to be meeting the President, then go do it. Get away from me.
translation: 如果你要见总统，那就去吧。离我远点。

original: High-level functions offline. Self-destruct sequence initiated. Civilian is advised to secure FEV sample and exit the facility immediately.
translation: 高阶功能离线。自毁程序启动。请平民收好FEV样品，并立即离开设施。

original: High-level functions offline. Self-destruct sequence initiated. Civilian is advised to exit the facility immediately.
translation: 高阶功能离线。自毁程序启动。请平民立即离开设施。

original: So, you're back. We had feared both you and the G.E.C.K. were lost. Were you successful?
translation: 你回来了。我们还以为你和伊甸园创造器都完蛋了。你成功了吗？

original: Hold it right there!
translation: 立刻站住。 !

original: You're supposed to be in that holding cell. You're not going anywhere!
translation: 你应该在传讯室里。你不能去任何地方！

original: There's a full complement of guards in the next room. As soon as I get them, you're going back to your cell. In a body bag, if necessary.
translation: 隔壁房间有一整队守卫。我一喊他们，你就只有回你的房间了。如果必要的话，用装尸袋拖回去。

original: I think you'd better leave now.
translation: 我想你现在最好离开。

original: You... What are you doing here?
translation: 你……你在这干嘛？

original: You... You're not supposed to be in here. What are you doing here?
translation: 你……你不该在这。你在这干嘛？

original: Ah, face to face at last. It's high time we met.
translation: 啊，终于面对面了。我们早该见见了。

original: I am quite pleased you were able to make it. The trip was not what I had intended, but serves as an adequate test of your abilities.
translation: 我很高兴你能做到。这段旅程并不是我安排的，不过对你的能力是一次考验。

original: You have the vial, and the task set before you. Shouldn't you be on your way now?
translation: 你拿到了试剂瓶和具体任务。是不是该启程了？

original: Yes? You still haven't taken the vial yet. As I've said, I'll only allow you to leave once you have it.
translation: 啊？你还没拿试剂瓶。我说过，只有你拿了它，才能离开。

original: Why do you insist on making things difficult?
translation: 你为什么坚持要把事情复杂化？

original: Maybe I should start shooting. How much blood you think you can afford to lose before you tell me what I want to know?
translation: 或许我该开始射击。你考虑过在你告诉我我想知道的东西前，有多少血能流吗？

original: So, you're awake.
translation: 你醒了。

original: Let's keep this nice and simple. You're going to tell me the code for that Purifier, and you're going to tell me now.
translation: 我们文明点。告诉我净化器的密码，立刻告诉我。

original: Tenpenny Tower is a wonderful place to live, isn't it?
translation: 特佩尼大厦是个居住的好地方，对吧？

original: We are safe from the Wasteland in here.
translation: 我们从废土到这来变得安全了。

original: I would surely have perished if it wasn't for Roy Phillips and his tower.
translation: 如果不是罗伊·菲利普斯和他的大厦，我肯定早就死了。

original: I would surely have perished if it wasn't for Mister Tenpenny and his tower.
translation: 如果不是特佩尼先生和他的大厦，我肯定早就死了。

original: So, Crowley is dead, eh?
translation: 考利死了，呃？

original: Here's your pay. Now, don't spend it all in one place, unless that place is Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 这是你的酬劳。现在，别在一个地方花光它，除非那地方是特佩尼大厦。

original: Fancy that! A visitor. I seldom get visitors. Which is a tiresome shame because I'm usually relentlessly bored out of my right mind!
translation: 有趣！一个来访者。我很少接待来访者。那很烦人，我经常被无情地打乱正常思维。

original: All these confounded people fluster about like I'm made of eggshells and about to fall to pieces at any moment. I'm surprised they even let you in.
translation: 所有这些糊涂蛋都很惊恐，好像我是蛋壳做的，随时都会掉在地上摔成碎片。我很惊讶他们居然让你进来。

original: So what do you think of my fine tower here? It's quite the jewel of the Wasteland isn't it? I daresay I'm quite proud of it myself.
translation: 你觉得我可爱的大厦怎么样？它真是废土上的一粒宝石，对吧？我为此感到自豪。

original: Heigh ho!
translation: 嗨！

original: This better be important.
translation: 这最好很重要。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: You got something to say?
translation: 你有话要说？

original: Welcome to New Urban Apparel. I carry the finest in pre-war clothes. Hurry up, lets get you out of those old rags and into something fabulous!
translation: 欢迎来到新都市服装店。我有最好的战前衣服。快点，把这些破抹布脱了换上漂亮的新衣服！ !

original: Those clothes are atrocious. You should stop by my shop, New Urban Apparel, and freshen up that look. Upgrade to fabulous!
translation: 那些衣服很没品位。在我的店里，新都市服装店，你就不用再穿了。换个样子。变得动人吧！

original: I'm always glad to see a customer, especially if they are dressed so hideously. Seriously, we have to get you a new wardrobe.
translation: 我一直都很高兴见到客人，特别是如果他们穿的很糟糕。说真的，我们必须给你换身新行头。

original: Ah, ready for a fresh look? Good.
translation: 啊，准备换个样子？好。

original: How can you be helped today?
translation: 我能怎么帮你？

original: You must be here to update that old look of yours. Let me help. I have just the thing!
translation: 你来这肯定是想改变你的旧形象。让我帮你。我正好有你要的！

original: Hurry up, lets get you out of those old rags and into something fabulous!
translation: 快，让我们把你这身旧抹布换掉，换身动人的！ !

original: I take it this is a social call, and not business?
translation: 我把这当成是招呼朋友，而不是生意？

original: This is the Tenpenny Wellness Clinic, and I am Doctor Banfield. I keep the residents healthy.
translation: 这是特佩尼大厦健康诊所，我是班菲尔德医生，我让居民们保持健康。

original: I'm off duty. Come back when...ah, what the hell. Let's just get it over with. I'm Doctor Banfield, what do you need?
translation: 我下班了。等……啊，见鬼。让我们搞定它。我是班菲尔德医生。你需要什么？

original: You look hurt. It's a good thing you've come in.
translation: 看来你受伤了。你来对地方了。

original: Welcome back to the Wellness Clinic.
translation: 欢迎回到健康诊所。

original: I really hope you aren't hurt. The Clinic is closed and I'd really hate to have to open it up at this hour.
translation: 我真希望你没有受伤。诊所关门了，我真讨厌必须在这时候开门。

original: I remember you. To what do I owe the pleasure?
translation: 我记得你。什么风把你吹来的？

original: Yes? Can I help you?
translation: 什么事？需要我帮忙吗？

original: Get into any adventures recently?
translation: 最近有什么新冒险？

original: You remind me of myself... back when I was a young adventurer.
translation: 你让我回忆起自己……还是年轻冒险家的时候。

original: Good to see you again, Comrade.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，同志。

original: Welcome to Boutique le Chic. I am Lydia Montenegro, proprietor. Here you'll find only the best, with a price tag you can boast about to your friends!
translation: 欢迎光临时尚精品店。我是店主莉迪亚·黑山。在这，你只能找到最好的，就连价钱也能在你朋友面前炫耀！

original: I am Lydia Montenegro. I'm sure you've heard of me and my shop, Boutique le Chic? No? Obviously you don't travel in the right circles.
translation: 我是莉迪亚·黑山。我肯定你听说过我和我的店，时尚精品店？没有？显然你没踏进正确的圈子。

original: I can't talk now, visit me at the Boutique during business hours.
translation: 我现在没空聊天。在上班时间到时尚精品店里找我。

original: I see my Boutique has proved to be an irresistible lure. Welcome back.
translation: 我想我的时尚精品店变得无法让人抗拒。欢迎回来。

original: Back for the best?
translation: 回来找最好的？

original: Shopping at le Chic proves you have great taste!
translation: 在时尚精品店购物证明你有最好的品位！

original: This better not be a waste of my time.
translation: 最好这不是在浪费我的时间。

original: New here? Pick any table, except that one in the corner. That's Mr. Tenpenny's table. Nobody sits there. Except him, of course.
translation: 头回来吧？请随意选个座，除开角落那张桌。那是特佩尼先生的专座。除了他，无人使用。

original: Welcome to Cafe Beau Monde! Gourmet meals and service with a smile!
translation: 欢迎光临尚界咖啡馆！品味精致料理，感受微笑服务！

original: Welcome to Cafe Beau Monde! Gourmet meals and service with a smile!
translation: 欢迎光临尚界咖啡馆！品味精致料理，感受微笑服务！

original: Have a seat. I'll get to you in a minute.
translation: 请坐。我很快就来为你服务。

original: You're new around here. I'm Margaret Primrose. I run the Cafe Beau Monde. Stop by sometime.
translation: 你生面孔呢。我是玛格丽特·普利洛斯，尚界咖啡馆的店主。有空来坐坐。

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: I know you. You're that guy. You know, the one that...whatever.
translation: 我知道你。你是那家伙。你知道，就是那……随便是谁吧。

original: I know you. You're that girl. You know, the one that...whatever.
translation: 我知道你，你是那女孩，你知道，就是那……随便是谁吧。

original: You may speak to me. And please, don't be tedious.
translation: 你可以和我说话，但请别太罗嗦。

original: Yes? You wish to speak to me? Whatever for?
translation: 什么？你想和我说话？说什么？

original: I don't suppose there is someone else for you to talk to?
