translation: 我猜没有其他人和你说话？

original: Are all young people ill-bred these days?
translation: 为什么现在的年轻人都没有教养？

original: Welcome to the Federalist Lounge. I'm Shakes. Wet your whistle?
translation: 欢迎来到联邦党人休息室。我是沙克斯。想润润喉咙吗？

original: Happy Holidays! Care for drink?
translation: 假日快乐！来杯喝的？

original: A very special welcome to you, sir!
translation: 非常欢迎你，先生！

original: A very special welcome to you, ma'am!
translation: 非常欢迎你，女士！

original: Care to wet your whistle?
translation: 想润润喉咙吗？

original: Hey there! Is there something I can do for you?
translation: 嗨！有什么事我能帮你吗？

original: Make it quick, missy.
translation: 快点，小姐。

original: Keep it short. I'm rather busy avoiding my husband.
translation: 简短些。我现在忙着躲避我丈夫。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Ah yes. Mister Burke is expecting you. He is waiting for you on the balcony.
translation: 啊，是。伯克先生正期盼与你见面。他在阳台等你。

original: Mister Tenpenny isn't taking callers.
translation: 特佩尼先生正在会客。

original: I'm on duty. Can't talk. Direct your security concerns to Chief Gustavo directly.
translation: 我在工作。别说话。你的安全问题直接去找古斯塔沃长官。

original: I'm not here for your entertainment.
translation: 我不是在这陪你玩的。

original: You ever make it to Little Lamplight, you come say hi. Okay mungo?
translation: 要去小灯镇周围的话，来问个好。好吗，毛人？

original: You should come to Little Lamplight sometime, mungo. You're okay after all.
translation: 你应该找时间去下小灯镇，毛人。毕竟你没问题。

original: If you ever go to Little Lamplight, I'll tell Mayor that you're okay, and he'll let you in, okay Mungo?
translation: 如果你要去小灯镇，我会告诉镇长你没问题的，他会让你进去，好吗，毛人？

original: I'm sorry, voice signature not recognized.
translation: 我很抱歉，声音信号验证失败。

original: No! I'm not talking to you anymore! You're a jerk and I hate you!
translation: 不！我不会再和你说话了！你这蠢货，我讨厌你！

original: I hope you found me a place to live.
translation: 你希望你帮我找个住的地方。

original: It was so weird! All of a sudden the ants went nuts and started fighting each other.
translation: 太不可思议了！突然间，蚂蚁们发狂并开始厮打起来。

original: It was like they were totally crazy! It was really scary, but kinda cool at the same time, ya know what I mean?
translation: 就好像它们完全疯了！真的很吓人，不过同时也很酷，你懂我意思吧？

original: It was so weird! All of a sudden the ants went nuts and started fighting each other.
translation: 太不可思议了！突然间，蚂蚁们发狂并开始厮打起来。

original: It was like they were totally crazy! It was really scary, but kinda cool at the same time, ya know what I mean?
translation: 就好像它们完全疯了！真的很吓人，不过同时也很酷，你懂我意思吧？

original: Wow, you've been gone a while. I was kinda worried.
translation: 哇，你有段时间没来了，我还有点担心。

original: Come on! Tell me already!
translation: 来吧！告诉我！

original: Did you change your mind or something?
translation: 你改变了主意还是怎么？

original: Those monsters... th-they're gonna' get me.
translation: 那些怪物……它-它们要来抓我。

original: What is it, mister?
translation: 这是什么，先生？

original: What is it, lady?
translation: 这是什么，小姐？

original: Yes, what did you need?
translation: 是的，你需要什么？

original: I've detected some changes within the Queen's Hatchery with my equipment. What's transpired?
translation: 我用设备侦测到蚁后孵化场有变化。发生了什么？

original: We'll speak when we reach the terminal. Nothing must stand in the way of progress!
translation: 等我们到了终端再说。进展不能听下来！

original: I trust your task is progressing well.
translation: 我相信你的任务进展良好。

original: Well, don't just stand there. You're distracting me. I must calculate the most efficient way to get to my equipment.
translation: 好了，别站在那，你在分散我注意力。我必须算出拿到我的设备的最佳方案。

original: I'm finding your interruptions trying. The slightest mistake because of your distractions and my experiments will be ruined!
translation: 我觉得你在干扰我。因为你的干扰而产生的最微小错误也会毁掉我的实验！

original: You startled me!
translation: 你让我震惊！

original: You really mustn't creep up on people like that.
translation: 你不该这样悄无声息地留进来。

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: There's no time to discuss it. Someone needs to activate the purifier now... Please!
translation: 没时间讨论了。有人需要现在就启动净化器……拜托！

original: Well, that takes care of that.
translation: 搞定了。

original: By now the Pride should be mopping up whatever opposition is left outside.
translation: 现在，“里昂斯的骄傲”要进行扫尾工作了，无论外面是否有阻碍。

original: Let's get this room secured.
translation: 让我们把这房间保护好。

original: It's time for fighting, not for talking.
translation: 现在是战斗时间，别废话了。

original: If you're going to put the code in, hurry up and do it. Otherwise this place explodes, and everyone in the Wasteland is in danger.
translation: 如果你要输入密码，那就快点。否则这地方爆炸了，在废土的每个人都会有危险。

original: You have to give me that code. If you won't turn this thing on, you have to at least let me do it.
translation: 你必须给我那密码。如果你不打开这东西，至少你得让我打开它。

original: Look, there's nothing more to be said. Cycle the airlock so I can get this over with.
translation: 听着，没什么好再说的。打开气密门，让我来结束这一切。

original: Get out of here as soon as you can. Get back to the Citadel where it's safe.
translation: 尽快离开这。回去五角大本营，那比较安全。

original: Well, so much for celebrating.
translation: 庆典结束了。

original: One of us is going to have to go in there and turn the damned thing on. And whoever does it isn't coming back out.
translation: 我们其中一人必须进去打开那该死的东西。无论是谁，必定有去无回。

original: Not exactly how I imagined going out, you know?
translation: 其实我可不是这么想的，你懂吗？

original: So, what should we do? Draw straws?
translation: 那，我们应该怎么办？抽签？

original: You're just going to let him leave like that?
translation: 你打算让他就像那样离开？

original: I can't believe you, of all people, would show mercy on him.
translation: 我不信在所有人中偏偏是你会宽恕他。

original: The real kicker is that the boys outside will probably cut him down as soon as he opens the door.
translation: 真正的问题是，他一打开门，或许就会被外面的小子们砍倒。

original: Now let's get this place locked down.
translation: 现在让我们把这地方封锁。

original: I guess I shouldn't be surprised that you'd let him just walk away. It's amazing the world hasn't beaten that out of you.
translation: 我倒不意外你放走他。但这世界没能打垮你真是个奇迹。

original: You'd just better hope it doesn't come back to bite you.
translation: 你最好希望它不会回来咬你。

original: Now let's get this place locked down.
translation: 现在让我们把这地方封锁。

original: You're just going to let him leave like that?
translation: 你打算让他就像那样离开？

original: I'll go along with it, but I don't like it.
translation: 我同意，但我不喜欢。

original: Let's get this room secured, and we'll call in the team.
translation: 让我们把这房间保护好，然后呼叫团队。

original: Let's make sure this area is locked down before we do anything else.
translation: 让我们先封锁这里，再采取行动。

original: You've already won. Allow me to leave with some dignity.
translation: 你已经赢了。允许我走时有些许尊严。

original: You again.
translation: 又是你。

original: I can't say I'm surprised. You and your ilk seem hell-bent on destroying everything our government has worked to achieve.
translation: 我不会感到惊讶，你和你的同伙看来要拼命摧毁我们政府建立起的一切。

original: There's nothing to stop me from killing you this time. Let's end this.
translation: 这次没人能阻止我杀死你了。让一切结束吧。

original: Let's get inside. Be careful -- they're probably pretty well dug-in. They've got to know we're coming by now.
translation: 我们进去吧。小心 — 他们或许已经埋伏好了。他们肯定知道我们现在进来了。

original: Stay sharp, and stick close to me until we're in the Control Room.
translation: 保持最好的状态，在我们进入控制室前紧跟着我。

original: Head for the control room, and keep your head down.
translation: 向控制室前进，低下头。

original: Look, if we make it to the purifier we can chat then. Now's not exactly a good time.
translation: 听着，等我们到净化器那后再聊吧。现在并不是合适的时候。

original: Are you ready now? We can't afford to keep standing around like this.
translation: 现在你准备好了吗？我们不能总在这里站着。

original: Before we get started, I wanted to let you know that my father and I have been talking.
translation: 在我们开始前，我想让你知道我父亲和我曾谈论过。

original: The Pride and I have decided that after all you've survived, you've done enough to be an honorary member of Lyon's Pride.
translation: “里昂斯的骄傲”和我一致决定，你经历过这么多，有资格成为“里昂斯的骄傲”的荣誉成员。

original: So congratulations. Membership comes with some privileges, including our Power Armor. You want the full suit, or the Recon armor?
translation: 恭喜你。成员有些特权，包括我们的动力装甲。你要全套动力装甲，还是一套侦察装甲？

original: Please, I have much work to do. Talk to Sarah about your role in the assault.
translation: 拜托，我还有很多工作要做。去和萨拉说你在攻击中起的作用。

original: You're reporting to Sarah from here on out. Don't let her down.
translation: 从现在起你向萨拉报告，别让她失望。

original: I'm sure you'll understand that there's far too much to be done right now. I've no time for chatting.
translation: 我肯定你会理解我现在有很多事要做。我没时间聊天。

original: This is surprising. Another of my kind, who does not follow the mindless killing way.
translation: 真让人吃惊。又一个和我一样不用无脑的杀戮方法来处理问题的家伙。

original: You haven't shot at me yet. That's different.
translation: 你还没向我开枪。那不一样。

original: Are you afraid of me? I understand. All of my brothers you've met have been savage killers.
translation: 你害怕我吗？我明白。你见到的所有我的兄弟都成了野蛮的杀手。

original: I try to think I am different from them, but maybe I'm only fooling myself. Maybe there is no escaping my inborn nature.
translation: 我试着想我和他们不一样，但或许这只能欺骗我自己。或许我逃避不了天性。

original: You are friends with another of my brothers? I am astounded! I thought I was the only one who wanted more from life.
translation: 你是我其他兄弟的朋友吗？我真吃惊！我还以为我是唯一一个想在生命里得到更多的人。

original: Ah, my little friend. Our paths cross once again. I have wandered far since we last spoke.
translation: 啊，我的小朋友。我们又走到一起了。自从上次谈话之后我迷惘了好久。

original: I didn't mean to come this way, actually, but some bleeders... ah, excuse me, some humans have been chasing me.
translation: 我不想走这条路，事实上，但是一些容易流血的家伙……啊，请原谅，一些人类一直在追杀我。

original: I am glad to see you, little one. I hope your life has been happy since we last spoke.
translation: 我很高兴见到你，小家伙。我希望自从上次谈话后你的人生变得快乐了。

original: Hello, little brother. Good to see you again.
translation: 你好，小兄弟。很高兴再次见到你。

original: Hello, little sister. Good to see you again.
translation: 你好，小妹妹。很高兴再次见到你。

original: I'm so glad you came back to see me.
translation: 我很高兴你回来看我。

original: I always enjoy our little chats. How can I help you?
translation: 我一直很喜欢和你交谈。我能帮你什么？

original: Have you heard? A man named Hannibal Hamlin is gathering all the escaped slaves at a safe place called the Temple of the Union!
translation: 你听说了吗？一个叫汉尼拔·哈姆林的人把逃跑的奴隶都聚集到一个叫团结圣殿的安全地方。

original: Finally, people are standing up against the Slavers! We're on our way to join Hannibal's cause!
translation: 最终，人们起来对抗奴隶贩子了！我们正要去加入汉尼拔的事业！

original: Thanks again for your help. For Freedom!
translation: 再次对你的帮助表示感谢。为了自由！

original: We have a dangerous journey ahead of us. What did you need?
translation: 在我们面前是一个危险的旅程。你要什么？

original: Thanks, friend. That was a narrow shave and no mistake. Probably would have eaten us or whatever those damned things do to people.
translation: 谢谢，朋友。那几乎是九死一生。或许我们会被吃或者被做些该死的事。

original: Listen, we got some water we can spare. Go ahead, you earned it.
translation: 听着，我们有一些备用的水。拿去，这是你应得的。

original: Whew. Thanks for the help. I thought I was a goner.
translation: 哟。谢谢帮助。我以为我死定了。

original: You probably saved my life. Here, take this. You look like you may need it more than I will.
translation: 或许你救了我的命。来，拿着。你看起来比我更需要这。

original: Where'd he come from? If you hadn't come along, that ugly brute probably would've eaten me, or dragged me off to wherever.
translation: 他从哪来的？如果不是你来了，这丑陋的畜生已经把我吃了或者把我拖到哪去了。

original: Here, take this. It's the least I can do.
translation: 来，拿着这。这是我唯一能做的。

original: Thanks, stranger. That thing would probably have killed me if it wasn't for you.
translation: 谢谢你，陌生人。如果不是你，这东西或许已经杀了我。

original: I wish I had more, but I want you to have this. And I won't take no for an answer.
translation: 我就这么点了，你都拿去吧。千万别拒绝。

original: You don't usually see those damned Super Mutants out so far from D.C. Good thing there was only one of them.
translation: 你在离特区那么远的地方不会经常见到那些该死的超级变种人。所幸只是一个。

original: Another human with a death wish... Welcome to the Mall, tourist.
translation: 又来个找死的……欢迎来到商业街，旅行者。

original: What's up, tourist?
translation: 怎么了，旅行者？

original: Atten-shun! Civilian on deck!
translation: 注 — 意！甲板上的平民！

original: We need to have us a little talk. You keep your gun in your holster when you're in my town.
translation: 我们应该谈谈。在我的镇子上，你得把枪放到枪套里。

original: Otherwise, we're going to have a problem. And Charon solves my problems for me. Understand?
translation: 否则，我们会有麻烦。卡戎是负责解决我的麻烦的。明白？

original: Now... how can I help you?
translation: 那……我能怎么帮你？

original: Well now, lookee here. We got us a smoothskin that I ain't ever seen before. I'm Ahzrukhal, and this... this is the Ninth Circle.
translation: 现在嘛，听着。我们这有个我从未见过的光皮肤。我是阿祖卡，这…是第九层。

original: Folks got problems, and I got liquor to sell to 'em... well, liquor and a few other pick me ups. You need anything, you just let me know.
translation: 人难免烦心，而我卖酒消愁……酒和其它提神饮料。如果你有需要，就告诉我。

original: Ghoul, human... I don't care. The caps all spend the same.
translation: 僵尸，人类……我不在乎。瓶盖都一个花法。

original: Back for more, eh? What can I get for you?
translation: 还要再来点吗，嗯？你要我拿什么？

original: Don't you look absolutely... miserable. Pull up a stool and lay down a few caps, tell Uncle Akzrukhal all about it...
translation: 你看上去真……不幸。搬张椅子，扔几个瓶盖，把这些全告诉阿祖卡叔叔。

original: What? Oh... I'm sorry... I was just thinking about my poor Gob. Did you need something?
translation: 什么？哦……对不起……我正在想我那可怜的盖博。你需要什么吗？

original: Poor Gob. I know it's not your problem, but... I'm sorry. Do you need something?
translation: 可怜的盖博。我知道这不是你的问题，但是……对不起。你需要什么吗？

original: First Gob goes to see the world, and now Greta is dead... everyone I love leaves me, it seems.
translation: 先是盖博出去见世面，现在葛丽泰死了……好像我所爱之人都离开了我。

original: Yeah, what is it- Oh! Oh my! Someone new! I'm so sorry, you must think me terribly rude! Welcome! Welcome to Carol's Place! I'm Carol.
translation: 嗯，那什么 — 哦！天啊！新来的！对不起，你一定觉得我很无礼！欢迎！欢迎到卡洛尔的地盘！我是卡洛尔。

original: It's not much, I know, but it's mine! So, if you need anything, just let me know. Greta will get you any food you want, and I handle the rooms.
translation: 地方不大，我知道，但这是我的！那么，如果你需要什么东西，只要告诉我。想吃什么只管找葛丽泰，而我出租房间。

original: It's so good to have someone new here, even if it is an ugly ol' smoothskin! I'm kidding! I'm just kiddin! Don't make that face! You'll love it here.
translation: 在这能见到新人真好，即使是丑陋的光皮肤！我开玩笑！开玩笑的！别拉长着脸！你会喜欢这的。

original: Yeah, what is it- Oh! Oh my! Someone new! I'm so sorry, you must think me terribly rude! Welcome! Welcome to Carol's Place! I'm Carol.
translation: 嗯，又要干 — 哦！天啊！新来的！对不起，你一定觉得我很无礼！欢迎！欢迎到卡洛尔的地盘！我是卡洛尔。

original: It's not much, I know, but it's mine! So, if you need anything, just let me know. Greta will get you any food you want, and I handle the rooms.
translation: 地方不大，我知道，但这是我的！那么，如果你需要什么东西，只要告诉我。想吃什么只管找葛丽泰，而我出租房间。

original: It's so good to have someone new here, especially a pretty young smoothskin like yourself! I hope you like it here!
translation: 在这能见到新人真好，特别是像你这样漂亮的光皮肤！希望你会喜欢这！

original: Oh, I just love to see your pretty face smiling at me. What do you need, honey?
translation: 哦，我喜欢你漂亮的脸庞冲我笑。你需要什么，甜心？

original: Oh, I was just telling Greta "that pretty young smoothskin hasn't been around in a while", and here you are!
translation: 哦，我才和葛丽泰说“那年轻漂亮的光皮肤已经很久不来这了”，然后你就来了！

original: Oh, hello again! Do you need anything, darling?
translation: 哦，又见面了，你好！你需要什么吗，亲爱的？

original: Well, hello. It's always good to see a customer. What do you need?
translation: 你好。见到客人总是很开心的。你需要什么？

original: See, I knew you'd be back.
translation: 看，我知道你会回来的。

original: Oh, hello again! Do you need anything?
translation: 又见面了，你好！有什么需要吗？

original: Scanning... target non-hostile.
translation: 扫描……目标无敌意。

original: Scanning... Target is armed. Code Yellow.
translation: 扫描……目标持有武器。黄色警报。

original: Unit running Patrol Scheme Delta-Seven.
translation: 单位执行巡逻方案D-7。

original: Unit running Patrol Scheme Alpha-Four.
translation: 单位执行巡逻方案A-4。

original: Talk to Ahzrukhal.
translation: 去和阿祖卡谈。

original: No. Go talk to Ahzurkhal.
translation: 不。去和阿祖卡谈。

original: Goddammit! Why did you tell Carol that Gob was dead? You couldn't have kept that to yourself?
translation: 该死！你为什么要和卡洛尔说盖博死了？你就不能保守这秘密吗？

original: You know, not everyone needs to hear the truth about everything. She was perfectly fine thinking that he'd found happiness out there.
translation: 你要知道，不是每个人都需要了解所有事的真相。她真的以为他会在外面找到幸福的。

original: Just... order something and get away from me.
translation: 就……买些东西，然后从我面前走开。

original: Sorry. I'm on a break. I'll be back in a bit if you need some food.
translation: 对不起。我在休息。你如果需要食物我立刻回来。

original: Oh look. It's everyone's favorite bearer of bad news.
translation: 哦，快看。大家最爱的坏消息专员。

original: Oh, hey. It's you. Did you bring some good news for us?
translation: 哦，嗨。是你啊。你带什么好消息给我们了吗？

original: Hey. I say you over there talking to Carol. She's friendly, isn't she? But don't you get any ideas about her. Got it? Good.
translation: 嗨。我说你去那和卡洛尔谈了。她很友好，对吧？但是你不要打她任何主意。明白了？很好。

original: Now, do you want something to eat?
translation: 现在你需要什么吃的吗？

original: Mornin', hon. What'll it be?
translation: 早，亲爱的。怎么样？

original: If you want something to eat, you should order it quick, hon. The stew just stopped moving.
translation: 如果你要什么吃的，就快点，亲爱的。炖菜快没了。

original: You need somethin', hon?
translation: 你需要什么，亲爱的？

original: Why the hell did you wake me up?
translation: 见鬼，你干嘛叫醒我？

original: Oh, you again.
translation: 哦，又是你。

original: ... ... huh? ... Ah! Jesus Christ! Don't... don't sneak up on me like that, the last fella... the last fella to do that damn near lost my arm.
translation: ……呃？……啊！耶稣基督！别……别这样偷偷接近我，最后一次这么做的伙计……最后一次这么做的伙计该死的差点废了我的胳膊。

original: You're new here, yeah... you must be, since you're actually talking to... talking to me... I'm Patchwork... or just "Patches" if... if you like that.
translation: 你是新来这的，对……你肯定是，因为你现在正在和……和我说话……我是“拼盘”……或者就“补丁”，如果……如果你喜欢那样叫。

original: I'm...  shit.... I forget.
translation: 我……狗屎……我忘了。

original: Oh! Hey! It's you! ... have we met?
translation: 哦！嗨！是你啊！……我们见过面吗？

original: ... ... uh oh... <burp>... just gimme a second here... <burp>.. okay, swallowed it before it... before it got out. What do you need?
translation: ……呃哦……<打嗝>……给我点时间……<打嗝>……好了，在它……跑出来之前吞了它。你需要什么？

original: I... I think I'm less drunk than... I was... Nope. Nope. There it is.
translation: 我……我想我没醉……我……不，不。找到了。

original: Oh, why hello there. Pleasure to meet you! I'm Quinn.
translation: 哦，你好。很高兴见到你！我是奎因。

original: Sorry sorry! So busy!
translation: 对不起对不起！太忙了！

original: Just couldn't stay away from us, could you?
translation: 尽量离我们远点，好吗？

original: Oh, hello, my boy! You've come back for more stories from ol' Quinn, have you?
translation: 哦，你好，小子！你来是想从老奎因这听更多故事的，对吧？

original: Oh, hello, my girl! You've come back for more stories from ol' Quinn, have you?
translation: 哦，你好，女孩！你来是想从老奎因这听更多故事的，对吧？

original: Oh... OH! Hey! Look at that! A human! With hair! Hey... you think we can do something about that?
translation: 哦……哦！嗨！看那！一个人类！长着头发！嗨……你觉得我们可以做点什么吗？

original: I just sharpened the knives! Have a seat and we'll give you a new look!
translation: 我刚磨完刀！请坐，我们会让你看起来焕然一新！

original: Good to see you again! You ready for some more of the ol' snip-snip?
translation: 很高兴再见到你！准备剪两刀吗？

original: Hey! You here for a cut? Maybe a buzz? Mohawk? C'mon! Something!
translation: 嗨！你是来剪发的吗？寸头？莫霍克？来吧！随便什么发型！

original: Oh... a human... well, hello. Welcome to Underworld Outfitters! It's... it's been so long since I had a customer!
translation: 哦……一个人类……哦，你好。欢迎来到地下城旅行用品！已经……已经过了这么久终于有了个客人！

original: You're back! Uhm... wow! You're really back! What do you need?
translation: 你回来了！嗯……哇！你真的回来了！你需要什么？

original: You came back! Do you need something?
translation: 你回来了！你需要什么吗？

original: I've got just the thing for you, do you want to see it? Please say yes...
translation: 我正好有你想要的，你想看看吗？请说是……

original: Oh, well would you look at that? We got us a smoothskin visitor! Hoooeeee, we ain't seen one of your type in a long time.
translation: 哦，你能看看那吗？我们有个光皮肤来访者！嗨，我们很久没见过你这型的了。

original: What? You come to try to steal from me again? Just get out of my face.
translation: 什么？你又来我这偷东西了？给我滚开。

original: Didn't you hear me? Leave us alone.
translation: 你没听到吗？离我们远点。

original: Well, hello again. You need something, smoothskin?
translation: 再次见面，你好。你需要什么吗，光皮肤？

original: How's Underworld been treatin' you so far, smoothskin?
translation: 你觉得地下城怎么样，光皮肤？

original: Well look who's back. What can I do you for, smoothskin?
translation: 看看谁回来了。我能为你做点什么，光皮肤？

original: Well look who's back. What can I do you for, smoothskin?
translation: 看看谁回来了。我能为你做点什么，光皮肤？

original: Holy shit! What happened?
translation: 他妈的！发生什么了？

original: What the fuck happened?
translation: 发生他妈什么事了？

original: It's so weird here without Azhrukhal.
translation: 阿祖卡不在这太蹊跷了。

original: I still can't believe that Charon shot Ahzrukhal. I never saw that one coming.
translation: 我还是不敢相信卡戎向阿祖卡开枪了。我从未想到会发生这样的事。

original: You know, Ahzrukhal was a bastard, but I kind of miss him...
translation: 你要知道，阿祖卡是个杂种，但我有点想念他……

original: Did you see that? Charon just shot Ahzrukhal!
translation: 看到了吗？卡戎刚向阿祖卡开枪！

original: There are a lot more of us down here than there are of you, smoothskin. You just behave yourself.
translation: 在这下面，我们的人比你们多多了，光皮肤。放老实点。

original: I hope you don't mind the smell, I know how sensitive you humans can be.
translation: 希望你别介意这气味。我知道你们人类有多敏感。

original: That's humans for you, always so goddamn friendly.
translation: 你还真是人类，总是该死的很友好。

original: We don't get a lot of your kind down here.
translation: 我们这像你这种人不多。

original: What makes you think that we've got something to say to one another?
translation: 是什么让你认为我们之间有什么要互相交流的？

original: So, Mechanist! You've come to throw yourself on the mercy of the Ant Queen?
translation: 机械侠！你跑来请求蚁后的宽大处理？

original: Very well! We shall grant you the kindest of our gifts for any human. A swift death!
translation: 很好！我们该给你在我们给所有人类中最好的礼物。让你死痛快点！

original: At last, I've come to destroy the Mechanist's precious Forge. And no minion of his will stop me!
translation: 终于，我要去摧毁机械侠珍贵的锻炉间。他的奴才们别想阻止我！

original: Now, face death from the AntAgonizer!
translation: 现在，面对来自痛苦蚁后的死亡吧。

original: Please, just leave me alone. I want to leave all of this behind me.
translation: 拜托，离我远点。我想把这一切都忘了。

original: Who dares interrupt the AntAgonizer? Begone!
translation: 谁敢打扰痛苦蚁后？滚！

original: I have no time to waste with you. Far more important matters await the attention of the AntAgonizer!
translation: 我没时间和你废话。痛苦蚁后还有很多重要的事要关心。

original: At last, you've pried the shell off of that meaty little Mechanist. Give it to me!
translation: 终于，你把那小机械侠的壳给剥了。把它给我！

original: My spies tell me that meddling Mechanist has been removed from the picture. I only wish I had that tin-man's shell to gloat over!
translation: 我的线人告诉我，那管闲事的机械侠已经被除去了。我只希望得到那铁皮人的壳。

original: Bring me the suit of the Mechanist, and then we can talk.
translation: 把机械侠的套装给我，然后我们就能谈谈了。

original: Excellent. Now, peel that tin-man's suit from his corpse and bring it to me. I wish to examine it more closely.
translation: 太棒了。现在，从那铁皮人的尸体上剥下他的套装给我。我希望近距离地研究它。

original: Bring me the suit of the Mechanist, and then we can talk.
translation: 把机械侠的套装给我，然后我们就能谈谈了。

original: You don't have the Mechanist's suit. Don't waste my time until you've brought me that prize!
translation: 你没有机械侠的套装。在你拿到前别浪费我的时间！

original: So, at last you've penetrated the court of the AntAgonizer, Queen of All Ants!
translation: 呵，终于，你已经渗透到痛苦蚁后的庭院了，所有蚂蚁的皇后！

original: Were you sent by that meddling Mechanist? He'll learn that no one can stand before my royal regiment of fighting ants!
translation: 你是那管闲事的机械侠派来的？他会明白，没人能挡住我的皇家兵蚁团！

original: Explain yourself! Why shouldn't I have my pretties kill you where you stand?
translation: 自己解释！为什么我不该将你优雅地就地解决？

original: You again! What is it, now?
translation: 又是你！什么事？

original: Make this fast. I have royal matters to ponder.
translation: 快点。我还有王室要事要去考虑。

original: Hahaha! Bow, peasant! Bow before the Ant Queen!
translation: 哈哈哈！鞠躬，乡巴佬！在蚁后面前鞠躬！

original: Aha! Vile AntAgonizer! You've got a lot of moxie, invading my private sanctum! Pretty courageous, for a spineless insect!
translation: 啊哈！卑劣的痛苦蚁后！敢闯进我的私人密室，你胆子不小啊！对于一只胆小的昆虫来说，你很有种！

original: But this is as far as you go. Now it's time to put down the foot of justice and crush your nefarious plans once and for all!
translation: 但是到此为止了。现在是坚决踏上正义之足、并一举碾碎你邪恶计划的时候了！

original: Vile minion of the AntAgonizer, you and your creepy mistress will face the unbending wrath of the Mechanist!
translation: 卑劣的痛苦蚁后的奴才，你们和你们只会爬行的女主人将要面对不屈的机械侠的愤怒。

original: Now, face death from the Mechanist!
translation: 现在，面对来自机械侠的死亡吧！

original: Really. Thanks for all your help, but I've got things I have to attend to.
translation: 真的。感谢你的帮助，但是我还有事不得不去做。

original: I'm sorry. Just leave me alone. I've got a lot to think about.
translation: 对不起。让我一个人待会。我有很多事要想。

original: Can't talk now, citizen! I must be leaving. Be safe!
translation: 现在没空闲聊，平民！我必须得走了。小心！

original: Well done! You have defeated the vile AntAgonizer, and you've brought back her suit so that we may destroy the last taint of her villainy!
translation: 好极了！你打败了卑劣的痛苦蚁后，而且你拿回了她的套装，我们能毁掉她罪恶的最后一个污点。

original: Hand it to me, and I'll make sure that no one else can ever bear the mantle of the foul AntAgonizer!
translation: 把它给我，我保证再也没有人会再次受到这肮脏的痛苦蚁后的阴影笼罩。

original: You had best hand over the AntAgonizer suit. It's too dangerous to let it fall into the wrong hands.
translation: 你最好把痛苦蚁后的套装给我。让它落入别有用心之人手中就太危险了。

original: Excellent work, Mechano-Lad! Now that the vile AntAgonizer is defeated, all that remains is to destroy the shell of her evil.
translation: 干得漂亮，机械小子！现在卑劣的痛苦蚁后被打败了，剩下的就是毁了她邪恶的壳。

original: Bring me the foul AntAgonizer's armor, and we can do what must be done.
translation: 给我带来污秽的痛苦蚁后的盔甲，然后我们做我们必须做的。

original: Excellent work, Mechano-Lass! Now that the vile AntAgonizer is defeated, all that remains is to destroy the shell of her evil.
translation: 干得漂亮，机械小子！现在卑劣的痛苦蚁后被打败了，剩下的就是毁了她邪恶的壳。

original: Bring me the foul AntAgonizer's armor, and we can do what must be done.
translation: 给我带来污秽的痛苦蚁后的盔甲，然后我们做我们必须做的。

original: My super-spybots tell me that the AntAgonizer has been defeated. I trust I have you to thank for this?
translation: 我的超级间谍机器人告诉我说痛苦蚁后被打败了。看来我得为此感谢你吧？

original: Congratulations, but I really must make sure her suit is destroyed, lest it fall into even more evil hands.
translation: 恭喜你，但我必须先把她的套装毁了，以免它落入罪恶之手。

original: Bring me the foul AntAgonizer's armor, and we can talk further. Until then, leave me be.
translation: 把那肮脏的痛苦蚁后盔甲给我，然后我们能谈更多，不过在此之前我还有事。

original: I must neutralize the AntAgonizer's suit. When you've removed it from her vile corpse, bring it to me.
translation: 我必须毁了痛苦蚁后的套装。你把它从她卑劣的尸体上脱下就交给我。

original: What are you doing in here? How did you get past my defenses? Did the AntAgonizer send you?
translation: 你在这干嘛？你是怎么通过我的防御的？是痛苦蚁后派你来的？

original: Speak now citizen or I'll be forced to detain you until I can ascertain your true motives!
translation: 说话，平民，否则在我能探知你的真实意图之前，不得不拘留你！

original: Make it fast, citizen. I can't talk long - evil is afoot!
translation: 快点，平民。我没时间再多说 — 邪恶就在眼前！

original: I trust everything is acceptable, citizen?
translation: 我相信一切都可以接受吧，公民？

original: Can't talk now. They're fighting! This is awesome!
translation: 现在没空说。他们在打架！太棒了！

original: I don't wanna talk to you. You killed my Uncle Roe.
translation: 我不想和你说话。你杀了我的罗伊大叔。

original: Go away! I hate you!
translation: 滚！我恨你！

original: Oh man! Did you see it! Did you see it? The AntAgonizer was all like, "Fear me!" But the Mechanist was all, "Stop, evil-doer!"
translation: 哦，哥们！你看到了没！你看到了吗？痛苦蚁后都像在喊“怕我吧！”，但是机械侠好像都在喊“住手，恶棍！”。

original: Are you all right? You aren't hurt, are you? I'd like to apologize for the rude welcome. Those two have been a bit of a, um, problem lately.
translation: 你还好吧？没受伤吧？我想对我粗鲁的欢迎道歉。那两个家伙最近一直有点……呃……问题。

original: Name's Roe. Uncle Roe, to most. Welcome to Canterbury Commons... for what that's worth.
translation: 我叫罗伊，罗伊大叔。欢迎来到坎特伯雷社区……你来到这会很有帮助。

original: Whew! You wouldn't believe how much trouble those two have caused in this town. We've been looking for someone to get rid of them for a long time.
translation: 哟！你不会相信那两个家伙在这镇上惹了多少麻烦。长久以来，我们一直期待有人出现除掉他们。

original: But you just walked in and cleaned up the town, easy as you please! We're in your debt, that's for sure.
translation: 但你就这么走进去，然后解决了镇子的麻烦，就像玩似的！我们欠你的，真的。

original: I'm mayor of Canterbury Commons, think of me as your own Uncle Roe. And take this, as our thanks for cleaning up the town.
translation: 我是坎特伯雷社区的镇长，把我当成你自己的罗伊大叔。然后拿着这，当作你解决镇子麻烦的酬谢。

original: Whew! You wouldn't believe how much trouble those two have caused in this town. We've been looking for someone to get rid of them for a long time.
translation: 哟！你不会相信那两个家伙在这镇上惹了多少麻烦。长久以来，我们一直期待有人出现除掉他们。

original: But you just walked in, downed one, and drove off the other, easy as you please! That'll be the last we see of them, you can be sure of that!
translation: 但你就这么进去，干掉一个，赶走另一个，跟玩似的！这是我们最后一次见到他们，肯定。

original: I'm mayor of Canterbury Commons, think of me as your own Uncle Roe. And take this, as our thanks for cleaning up the town.
translation: 我是坎特伯雷社区的镇长，把我当成你自己的罗伊大叔。然后拿着这，当作你解决镇子麻烦的酬谢。

original: Change your mind yet? You willing to help us deal with the AntAgonizer and Mechanist?
translation: 改主意了吗？你愿意帮我们解决痛苦蚁后和机械侠？

original: So, it looks like you decided to do things their way. How come?
translation: 这么看，你似乎决定按他们的方式行事了。为什么呢？

original: Well, well, well! Look who it is Bob! It's our new friend!
translation: 好，好，好！鲍勃看这是谁！我们的新朋友！

original: Hey! My second best friend in the whole wide world!
translation: 嘿！我全世界第二要好的朋友！

original: Hiya.
translation: 嗨。

original: I'm very happy to see you again, savior of Oasis.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，绿洲的救世主。

original: What is it, Outsider?
translation: 怎么了，外来者？

original: Ah, it's nice to have the pleasure of your company again.
translation: 啊，很高兴能再次和你作伴。

original: What is it you need, Outsider?
translation: 外来者，你需要什么？

original: Well, well... if it isn't our old friend! Good to see you!
translation: 看，看……这不是我们的老朋友嘛！很高兴见到你！

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: Welcome back, my good friend!
translation: 欢迎回来，我的好朋友！

original: Yes, Outsider?
translation: 什么事，外来者？

original: Goodness, it's wonderful to speak to you again!
translation: 天啊，真高兴能再次和你说话！

original: What is it now, Outsider?
translation: 又怎么了，外来者？

original: Yes, my friend? What can I do for you now?
translation: 怎么了，我的朋友？有什么可以帮到你的吗？

original: What is it, Outsider?
translation: 怎么了，外来者？

original: So, it looks like you decided to do things their way. How come?
translation: 这么看，你似乎决定按他们的方式行事了。为什么呢？

original: See Herbert? Now that's a nice person for you. Why can't you be more like that!
translation: 看到赫伯特了？现在他对你不错。为什么你不表现好一点！

original: Look, Herbert, he's back. I told you!
translation: 看，赫伯特，他回来了。我跟你说过！

original: Look, Herbert, she's back. I told you!
translation: 看，赫伯特，她回来了。我跟你说过！

original: Glad to see you're finally awake. I can't believe they made you do that stupid ceremony.
translation: 很高兴看到你终于醒了。我不敢相信他们居然要你参加那个愚蠢的仪式。

original: They listen when I talk, but they don't hear... know what I mean?
translation: 我说话，他们听，但根本没听进去……懂我意思吗？

original: Birch's word is the law. You must leave Oasis at once.
translation: 布瑞奇的话就是法律。你必须立刻离开绿洲。

original: You big dummy! Now we gotta wait for another Outsider!
translation: 你这大蠢货！现在我们得等另一个外来人了！

original: I'm afraid you're no longer welcome in His home. Please begone.
translation: 我恐怕他的家不再欢迎你。请离开。

original: Was it too much to ask to expect some civility from you? Bah. Get out of my sight.
translation: 要你更礼貌些就那么难吗？算了，从我的视线中消失吧。

original: I'm afraid you're no longer welcome here. If you come back, we have orders to shoot.
translation: 恐怕这里不再欢迎你。如果你回来，我们会按命令向你开枪。

original: By insulting the Tree Father, you've insulted us all. You are no longer a guest here. I'd advise you to leave immediately.
translation: 你侮辱“树之父”就是侮辱了我们所有人。你不再是这的客人。我劝你立刻离开。

original: I thought I was quite clear. Leave or we will be forced to take action!
translation: 我想我讲的很清楚了。滚，否则我们就要采取行动了。

original: How could this happen to us? Where did we go wrong?
translation: 这怎么会发生在我们身上？我们做错了什么？

original: It's over... all over.
translation: 结束了……都结束了。

original: This can't be! It just can't! How could He leave us?
translation: 不可能！绝不可能！他怎么会离开我们？

original: Our god lives no more.
translation: 我们的神死了。

original: I can't believe He's gone. He meant everything to me.
translation: 我不敢相信他走了。对我来说他就是一切。

original: He's dead... the Great One is dead!
translation: 他死了……圣贤死了！

original: I've just seen Tree Father and Leaf Mother Laurel enter the Grove. This worries me.
translation: 我看到“树之父”和“叶之母”萝瑞尔进了小树林。这让我很忧虑。

original: Our leaders speak with the Great One. I hope nothing's wrong.
translation: 我们的领袖和圣贤谈了。我希望没出什么事。

original: Tree Father and Leaf Mother are conferring with the Great One. Something important must be happening.
translation: “树之父”和“叶之母”正在与圣贤交谈。肯定有什么重要的事将要发生。

original: Something here is different. I can feel it.
translation: 这有变化。我能感觉的到。

original: I feel a change in the air, I wonder what it could be?
translation: 我觉得气氛变了，我想知道会有什么事发生。

original: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Bloomseer Poplar, soothsayer and healer of Oasis.
translation: 允许我自我介绍一下。我是“花先知”波普勒。绿洲的占卜师和治疗师。

original: It brings me great honor to welcome you.
translation: 很荣幸欢迎你。

original: You have more questions for me perhaps?
translation: 或许你有更多的问题要问我？

original: Go away, you big meanie!
translation: 走开，你这大坏蛋！

original: So you're the Outsider huh? You seem nice to me!
translation: 那你就是那个“外来者”喽？在我看来，你人不错嘛！

original: Hiya!
translation: 你好！

original: Branchtender Cypress at your service. Welcome to our little home.
translation: “护枝人”赛普拉斯为您效劳。欢迎来到我们这个小小的家园。

original: Ah, Outsider. So nice to see you again.
translation: 啊，外来人。很高兴再次见到你。

original: It's very nice to meet you, Outsider. I'm Branchtender Linden.
translation: 很高兴见到你，外来者。我是“护枝人”林登。

original: Good to speak to you again.
translation: 很高兴能再和你说话。

original: Yes, what can I do for you on this beautiful day?
translation: 是的，在这美好的一天有什么是我可以为你做的？

original: Have you changed your mind, Outsider? Do you want to speak with Tree Father Birch?
translation: 外来者，你改主意了吗？你要和“树之父”伯奇谈谈吗？

original: How could you do this to us? How could you take him away from us?
translation: 你怎么能这样对我们？你怎么能把他从我们这夺走？

original: Any chance the Wasteland had for recovery someday is now gone.
translation: 能让废土有朝一日恢复生机的唯一机会就这么消失了。

original: Please, I wish to be alone right now.
translation: 拜托，我现在想一个人待会。

original: You've done a great deed this day, my friend.
translation: 你今天干了件了不起的事，我的朋友。

original: The gifts the Great One has bestowed upon us will now take mere decades to breach the confines of Oasis instead of centuries.
translation: 圣贤给予我们的礼物，如今只要数十年就能突破绿洲的界限，而不再是几个世纪了。

original: The choice you made disturbs me, Outsider. Why you chose to side with my husband when it's quite clear Oasis could have benefited all eludes me.
translation: 你的选择扰乱了我，外来人。为什么你站在我丈夫那边，事实很清楚，绿洲没有我，任何事也都会好起来。

original: No matter. What's done is done, and I'll still do the best that I can to find a way to spread his influence throughout the Wasteland.
translation: 没关系。做了就做了。我还是会尽我所能去找到办法让他的影响广布废土。

original: You have questions for me, Outsider?
translation: 你有问题问我？外来人？

original: I love Birch, but sometimes I think he doesn't see the big picture.
translation: 我爱伯奇，但有时我觉得他看不到大局。

original: The spreading of His influence is not a curse, it's a great miracle... a benefit meant for the entire Wasteland!
translation: 祂影响的扩散并非祸根，而是一个伟大的奇迹……是惠及整个废土的好事！

original: The Great One is dead. Slain by your hand. Don't worry, I hold no grudge towards you.
translation: 圣贤死了。被你杀了。别担心，我对你并无怨恨。

original: You'll have to forgive my people at a time like this, Outsider. They aren't used to being so lost.
translation: 在这种时候，你得原谅我的人，外来者。他们不习惯如此迷茫无助。

original: And for once, I don't have the words to help them.
translation: 而这次，我没有话可以宽慰他们。

original: The choice you made disturbs me, Outsider. Why you chose to side with my wife when it's quite clear Oasis would be in peril eludes me.
translation: 你做出的选择打扰了我，外来人。你为什么选择我妻子那边。事实很清楚，绿洲没有我会有危险。

original: No matter. What's done is done, and I'll still do the best that I can keeping Him safe from those that seek to harm Him.
translation: 没关系。发生了就发生了吧，我会尽我所能保证那些试图危害他的东西不会伤害到他。

original: You've done a great deed this day, my friend. You've ensured the safety of the Great One and the inhabitants of Oasis.
translation: 你今天干了件了不起的事，我的朋友。你确保了圣贤和绿洲居民的安全。

original: Yes, Outsider? What is it?
translation: 是的，外来人？什么事？

original: I know why you're here and despite what my wife thinks, I know you'll do what's best for Oasis.
translation: 我知道你来这儿的目的，而且尽管我妻子有不同想法，但我知道你会为绿洲做出最有利的选择。

original: After all, He chose you and He would never want to put us in harm's way.
translation: 毕竟，祂选择了你，而祂永远不会让我们身处险境。

original: What's wrong? Why are you leaving?
translation: 怎么了？为什么你要走？

original: As soon as the rest of the Treeminders are in place, we'll begin.
translation: 等其他护树人都到齐了，我们就开始。

original: What is it you wish to talk about, my friend?
translation: 你想聊些什么呢，我的朋友？

original: You have no idea how overjoyed I am to see you! Normally Outsiders are forbidden inside Oasis, but He has made an exception.
translation: 你不知道，见到你我有多高兴！通常外来者是禁止进入绿洲的，但祂为你破了例。

original: We will speak once we've arrived in the Pavilion. Not to worry, all will be explained.
translation: 到了亭中我们就能谈谈。别担心，我会解释一切。

original: I'm so glad you're here. It's been a while since anyone's visited us, and He's been waiting for someone like yourself to arrive.
translation: 你能来我太高兴了。已经有段时间没人来访了，而祂一直在等像你这样的人到来。

original: If you wouldn't mind following me, I'll bring you right to Him.
translation: 如果你不介意跟我走，我这就带你去见祂。

original: Outsider! You have arrived! Please, come closer... I have something of the utmost urgency to speak to you about!
translation: 外来者！你终于到了！请走近点……我有极为紧急的事要跟你说！

original: Do hurry, He doesn't like to be kept waiting!
translation: 请快些，祂可不喜欢等人！

original: It's not wise to keep the Great One waiting.
translation: 让圣贤等待可不是明智之举。

original: Now is the time for an audience with Him. We can talk later.
translation: 现在是去谒见祂的时候了。我们稍后再谈。

original: We aren't permitted to speak until the Ceremony has completed.
translation: 在仪式结束之前，我们不能说话。

original: We'll speak after you meet the Great One.
translation: 等你见了圣贤之后我们再谈。

original: Prepare yourself to meet Him, Outsider. It will change your life.
translation: 准备好见他，外来人。这会改变你的人生。

original: The Ceremony of Purification has begun. Rejoice!
translation: 净化仪式已经开始了。欣喜啊！

original: No more words. The Ceremony begins.
translation: 别说了。仪式开始了。

original: Take your place, Outsider. The Ceremony is about to begin.
translation: 找个地方，外来人。仪式立刻开始。

original: Rejoice, the Great One wishes to see you!
translation: 欣喜吧，圣贤想见你！

original: You are welcome amongst us, Outsider.
translation: 外来者，我们欢迎你的到来。

original: Revel, Outsider, for he has chosen you!
translation: 欢呼吧，外来人，他选中了你！

original: Like the Great One Himself, we welcome you with outstretched arms.
translation: 像圣贤本身一样，我们伸开双臂欢迎你。

original: Welcome to Oasis, Outsider. We hope you'll find peace among us.
translation: 欢迎来到绿洲，外来人，愿你在我们中过得愉快。

original: We're very pleased to see you, Outsider. Welcome!
translation: 我们很高兴见到你，外来人。欢迎！

original: Welcome, Outsider!
translation: 欢迎，外来者！

original: Stand aside, comrade, while we deal with these Imperialist dogs.
translation: 同志，站开，我们正在全力消灭帝国主义走狗。

original: The Henderson estate is in tip-top shape, young master. Have a wonderful day!
translation: 亨德森的庄园保存完好，年轻的主人。过得愉快！

original: The Henderson estate is in tip-top shape, young miss. Have a wonderful day!
translation: 亨德森的庄园保存完好，年轻的女主人。过得愉快！

original: <bark!>
translation: <吠叫！>

original: How could Roger accuse me of something like that? What is wrong with him?
translation: 罗杰怎么能那样指责我？他到底怎么了？

original: Why would Roger do such a thing? It doesn't make sense...
translation: 为什么罗杰要这么做？这没道理……

original: How did it come to this? I just don't understand...
translation: 怎么会这样？我搞不懂……

original: Daddy..... why.... [crying]
translation: 爸爸……为什么……[呜]

original: Mommy..... why.... [crying]
translation: 妈妈……为什么……[呜]

original: [crying]
Do you realize what you’ve done? You’ve triggered the Failsafe! Ruined everything! The subjects will die, and I’ll be stuck here in this hell! Alone!
translation: 你意识到你干了什么吗？你触发了故障保险！毁了这的一切！实验对象会死！我会被孤独地困在这地狱里！

original: You've ruined everything! EVERYTHING!
translation: 你毁了一切！一切！

original: I exist to serve.
translation: 我存在就是为了服务。

original: I've given you permission to leave. I suggest you take the opportunity before I change my mind.
translation: 我已经准许你离开了。我建议你趁我还没改变主意前把握好机会。

original: I'm even being so gracious as to allow your father to exit as well. His presence here failed to amuse me some time ago.
translation: 我甚至还大发慈悲，允许你父亲也一起离开。早前他的出现可没让我开心。

original: Most enjoyable. Most enjoyable indeed. I haven't felt this exhilarated in years.
translation: 痛快。太痛快了。我已经很多年没这种感觉了。

original: A commendable start, but you still have work to do.
translation: 一个值得称道的开始，但你还有活要干。

original: Quite a clever interpretation of the rules. I'll have to reset the system to restore Martha, but it's well worth the effort.
translation: 对规则的巧妙理解。我得重置系统来恢复玛莎，但这是值得的。

original: You have taken a far greater interest in these little games than your father did. He found the whole thing beneath him.
translation: 你对这些小游戏的兴趣比你爸大得多。他对这不屑一顾。

original: Listen, you can't hurt people here, okay?
translation: 听着，你不能伤害这的人，知道了吗？

original: At least, not unless I say it's okay. It's against the rules! I can fix it, but you better not do it again.
translation: 反正除非我说好，否则不行。它违反了规则！我能修复，但是你最好别再这么做。

original: Stop hurting people without me telling you to. You're ruining all the fun!
translation: 我不说的话，你就不许伤人。你破坏了所有的乐趣！

original: I'll fix it again, but you're making me sad.
translation: 我会修复，但你让我很失望。

original: As amusing as it may be, you cannot simply wander around killing the residents of Tranquility Lane.
translation: 或许有趣，但你不能到处游荡并杀死宁静巷的居民。

original: I shall have to reset portions of the system to correct this.
translation: 我需要重设系统部分来纠正。

original: I can return the people of Tranquility Lane to life, but anything else you have meddled with will stay as it was. Do keep that in mind.
translation: 我会复活宁静巷的人，但是破坏的其它东西都要保持原样。记住。

original: I believe we've discussed this already. I appreciate the fervor with which you approach things, but indiscriminate killing impedes our fun.
translation: 我相信我们已经讨论过。我欣赏你处理事件的热忱，但无节制的杀戮破坏了我们的乐趣。

original: I shall again reset portions of the system to undo your mistakes.
translation: 我需要重设系统部分来弥补你犯的错误。

original: What are you doing? I didn't tell you to kill him!
translation: 你在干嘛！我没叫你杀了他。

original: If I wanted you to kill him, I'd have told you to do that. Gosh, you're slow.
translation: 如果我想要你杀了他，我会告诉你那样做。哎呀，你真笨。

original: Lucky for you, you get another chance.
translation: 你真幸运，你还有另一个机会。

original: You shouldn't be here, little one.
translation: 你不该在这，小家伙。

original: Betty... You need to talk to Betty. She's waiting for you.
translation: 贝蒂……你得和贝蒂谈谈。她在等你。

original: You... You don't belong here. You're not supposed to be here!
translation: 你……你不属于这。你不该在这！

original: It's not real, none of it! It needs to end... The suffering must end!
translation: 这不是真的，全不是！该结束它……这种折磨该结束了！

original: Remember what I told you. The Failsafe. You've got to find it!
translation: 记住我告诉你的。故障保险，你得去找到它！

original: This has to end.
translation: 该结束了。

original: What... What the hell is this?
translation: 什么……见鬼，这是什么？

original: You're doing quite well. Really, this is all terribly amusing. Keep at it...
translation: 你干得很好。真的，这很有趣。继续……

original: You're certainly looking the part. Don't waste time chatting... There's mayhem to be caused!
translation: 你一定得盯着那部分。别浪费时间聊天……还要去惹乱子呢！

original: Don't you have a few things you should be collecting? Get the knife and the mask from the dog house.
translation: 你不是有几件东西要去取吗？去狗屋把刀和面具带上。

original: Appliances certainly can be dangerous, can't they?
translation: 厨具当然可能会危险，不是吗？

original: You are most resourceful, and you certainly do get results. You have exceeded my expectations.
translation: 你很有办法，而且能取得成果。你超出了我的预期。

original: And now, we come to the last task that I have for you. Succeed, and you shall be granted whatever you wish.
translation: 现在，我们来到了给你的最后一个任务。成功了，你想要什么都可以得到满足。

original: A roller skate, on the stairs? Oh my, that is simply inspired.
translation: 在楼梯上的一只轮滑靴？哦，那很有灵感。

original: You are most resourceful, and you certainly do get results. You have exceeded my expectations.
translation: 你很有办法，而且能取得成果。你超出了我的预期。

original: And now, we come to the last task that I have for you. Succeed, and you shall be granted whatever you wish.
translation: 现在，我们来到了给你的最后一个任务。成功了，你想要什么都可以得到满足。

original: Poor Mabel, killed by her own robot. I suspect she never saw that coming.
translation: 可怜的梅布尔，被她的机器人杀了。我怀疑她从未想到会这样。

original: You are most resourceful, and you certainly do get results. You have exceeded my expectations.
translation: 你很有办法，而且能取得成果。你超出了我的预期。

original: And now, we come to the last task that I have for you. Succeed, and you shall be granted whatever you wish.
translation: 现在，我们来到了给你的最后一个任务。成功了，你想要什么都可以得到满足。

original: Well done, well done!
translation: 干得好，干得好！

original: You certainly do get results. You have exceeded my expectations.
translation: 你一定能达成结果。你超出了我的预期。

original: And now, we come to the last task that I have for you. Succeed, and you shall be granted whatever you wish.
translation: 现在，我们来到了给你的最后一个任务。成功了，你想要什么都可以得到满足。

original: I expected more creative results from you. Mabel awaits you for another try.
translation: 我期望你更富创造性的结果，梅布尔等待你的另一次尝试。

original: I appreciate that you're trying, but so far I am unimpressed with the results. Give it another go.
translation: 我欣赏你付出的努力，但我对目前的结果毫无兴趣。再来一次吧。

original: Not quite what I had in mind. But you get a chance to try again. Go to it!
translation: 不如我想的那样。但是你有机会再试一次。去吧！

original: See to it that Mabel meets an untimely, and hopefully gruesome, demise.
translation: 确保梅布尔迎来一场不合时宜的死亡，最好惨烈些。

original: I've told you what I want from you. I want to see some creativity. And I want to see Mabel dead.
translation: 我告诉过你我想你怎么做，我要看到创造性。我想看到梅布尔死。

original: Are you through pouting?
translation: 你生完气了吗？

original: You have turned out to be quite resourceful, it seems. I am slightly impressed.
translation: 看起来你变得机智了。我有点被打动了。

original: I enjoy your company far more than your father's. He responded quite negatively to my requests.
translation: 比起你父亲，我更喜欢和你在一起。他曾拒绝我的邀请。

original: So you have achieved your goal. I was hoping for something a bit more dramatic, but persuasion appears to be your strong suit.
translation: 你达到了目的。我曾希望更有戏剧性，但看来说服别人是你的强项。

original: And at least you are cooperative, unlike your father. I was most disappointed when he refused to participate, yet still expected something from me.
translation: 至少你很合作，不像你父亲。当他拒绝时我非常失望，却还指望我帮他。

original: I'm curious to see how you deal with the Rockwells.
translation: 我很好奇你会怎么对付罗克韦尔夫妇。

original: Don't you have something you should be doing now?
translation: 现在你是否无事可做？

original: Are we willing to be reasonable now? I ask so very little of you.
translation: 现在我们是否能公平些？我对你的要求很少。

original: Ha ha! Did you see him crying! What a big baby!
translation: 哈哈！看他都哭了！真是个大孩子！

original: You have won the game, and so you get a prize. You may ask of me a single question, and I shall answer you.
translation: 你赢得了比赛，奖金是你的了。你可以问我一个问题，我会回答你。

original: You did it, even though you said you wouldn't. You're tricky!
translation: 你做到了，虽然你说你做不到。你这狡猾的家伙！

original: Murdering Timmy's parent? Very inventive. I approve.
translation: 杀了提米的父母？很有创造性，我同意。

original: And with that, you win a prize. You may ask a single question of me, and receive an honest answer.
translation: 你赢得了奖励。你可以问我一个问题，而我会诚实地回答你。

original: You did it! I knew you could!
translation: 你做到了！我知道你能行！

original: And a particularly brutal way to deal with it, at that. Very effective.
translation: 用了特别残酷的方法。非常有效。

original: And with that, you win a prize. You may ask a single question of me, and receive an honest answer.
translation: 你赢得了奖励。你可以问我一个问题，而我会诚实地回答你。

original: You sure showed him, didn't you?
translation: 你肯定给他看了，对吧？

original: I suppose it wasn't the most cerebral way to deal with the situation, but it was definitely effective. Consider the game won.
translation: 我想这并不是最聪明的方法，但它确实有效。我认为你赢得了这游戏。

original: And with that, you win a prize. Your prize is one question, which I will answer to the best of my ability.
translation: 你赢得了奖励。你可以问我一个问题，而我会尽可能回答你。

original: And you said you didn't want to play...
translation: 你说你不想玩……

original: I was hoping for more than fisticuffs, but entertainment has been difficult to come by lately. Consider the game won.
translation: 我原指望不光是打斗的，但最近找点乐子真的很难。我认为你赢得这游戏。

original: And with that, you win a prize. Your prize is one question, which I will answer to the best of my ability.
translation: 你赢得了奖励。你可以问我一个问题，而我会尽可能回答你。

original: Decided you want to play after all, huh?
translation: 最后你还是决定要玩，呃？

original: I had a feeling you'd come around. Your approach was somewhat uninspired, but it'll do.
translation: 我一直觉得你会来。尽管你的方法有些欠缺灵感，但还行。

original: Since you won the game, you get a prize. You may ask one question, which I will answer as honestly as possible.
translation: 你赢得了游戏，得到了奖励。你可以问我一个问题，而我会尽可能诚实回答你。

original: I thought you didn't want to play. But you went and did it anyway. Good for you! Wasn't it fun?
translation: 我以为你不想玩，但你还是来玩了。干得好，好玩吗？

original: A clever approach. I'm not sure I would have considered it. Very encouraging.
translation: 聪明的办法。我都不一定想得出。值得奖励。

original: Your reward for winning the game is to ask a single question. I will answer honestly and frankly.
translation: 你赢得游戏的奖励是可以提一个问题，我会诚实且坦率地回答你。

original: Yay, you did it! Good job!
translation: 耶，你做到了！干得好！

original: A clever approach. I'm not sure I would have considered it. Very encouraging.
translation: 聪明的办法。我都不一定想得出。值得奖励。

original: Your reward for winning the game is to ask a single question. I will answer honestly and frankly.
translation: 你赢得游戏的奖励是可以提一个问题，我会诚实且坦率地回答你。

original: Yay! I knew you could do it!
translation: 耶！我就知道你能做到！

original: Perhaps not the most inventive approach, but persuasion can be quite powerful. Well done.
translation: 或许不是最有创造性的方法，但说服十分有力。干得好！

original: And for winning the game, you get a prize. You get to ask one question, and receive an honest answer.
translation: 赢了游戏，你得到了奖励。你可以问一个问题，并得到一个诚实的回答。

original: Timmy's back, so you can try again. Don't take too long, or the game won't be fun anymore.
translation: 提米回来了，你能再试一次。别拖太久，不然比赛就不好玩了。

original: You're mean! I hate you!
translation: 你真卑鄙！我讨厌你！

original: Hi there. I'm Timmy. Want to play?
translation: 你好。我是提米。想玩吗？

original: Hi. Want to play?
translation: 嗨，想玩吗？

original: You're supposed to be making Timmy cry. You can do it, I know you can!
translation: 你该把提米弄哭。你能做到，我知道你行！

original: When you win the game, maybe we can talk some more.
translation: 等你赢了游戏，我们再聊吧。

original: You don't want to play my game, so I don't want to talk to you.
translation: 你不想玩我的游戏，那我也不想和你说话。

original: You don't want to play with me. So I don't want to talk to you, and you're never going to find your daddy. Boo hoo hoo.
translation: 你不想和我玩，那我也不想和你说话，你永远也别想找到你爸爸。呜呜呜。

original: Oh, someone new to play with! What good luck I have lately!
translation: 哦，有新人一起玩了。我近来真幸运！

original: I was just starting to get bored. Oh, we're going to have so much fun!
translation: 我正觉得无聊呢。哦，我们会很开心的！

original: Can we play now? I've been waiting. I've been ever so patient.
translation: 我们现在能玩了吗？我一直在等。我从没这么耐心。

original: You probably oughta go talk to Betty, kiddo. Don't want to keep her waiting!
translation: 你为什么不和贝蒂聊聊，兄弟。别让她等着！

original: She's out there on the playground, probably looking for you. Run along now.
translation: 她在外面的运动场，或许正在找你。快去吧。

original: Have you talked to Betty? I think she's waiting for you.
translation: 你和贝蒂聊了吗？我想她正在等你。

original: You really shouldn't keep her waiting. She'll probably be on the playground. Run along now.
translation: 你真不该让她等着。她或许在运动场，快去吧。

original: Oh, hello there.
translation: 哦，你好。

original: I think you should go speak with Betty. She's waiting for you... On the playground, I think. Best to hurry up.
translation: 我想你应该去和贝蒂聊聊，我想她……在运动场等你，最好快点。

original: Hiya, kid.
translation: 你好，孩子。

original: You might want to go talk to Betty before you wander around too much. She's waiting for you.
translation: 在你到处游荡前，不如先和贝蒂聊聊吧。她在等你。

original: Hello there. Good to see you.
translation: 你好，很高兴见到你。

original: I think Betty is waiting for you on the playground. You'll want to go talk to her.
translation: 我想贝蒂在运动场等你，你去和她聊聊吧。

original: Hello there, dear. Beautiful weather we're having, wouldn't you say?
translation: 你好，亲爱的。天气真不错，是吧？

original: I think Betty is waiting for you at the playground. You really should go pay her a visit.
translation: 我想贝蒂在运动场等你，你真该去见见她。

original: Hey there, sport! Beautiful day, isn't it?
translation: 嗨，小家伙！真是个好天气，对吧？

original: Say, you should go talk to Betty. She's waiting for you over on the playground. Have fun, sport!
translation: 话说，你该去和贝蒂聊聊。她在运动场等你。玩得开心点，小家伙！

original: What can I do for you, sport?
translation: 老兄，有什么我能帮到你的？

original: Hiya, kiddo! What's the good word?
translation: 你好，兄弟！近来好吗？

original: Hey there, sport. How's it going?
translation: 嗨，老兄，还好吧？

original: Hey there, little lady. How's it going?
translation: 嗨，小女孩。最近还好吗？

original: Hello, sweetie. How are you?
translation: 你好，甜心。你好吗？

original: Well hi there!
translation: 你好！

original: Good day to you!
translation: 日安！

original: You've saved me. I was afraid I'd be trapped in there forever.
translation: 你救了我。我还担心我会永远困在那。

original: It's so good to see you, but... What are you DOING here?
translation: 见到你真是太好了，但……你在这干嘛？

original: Son... You've saved me. I was afraid I'd be trapped in there forever.
translation: 孩子……你救了我。我还怕我会被永远困在那。

original: It's so good to see you, but... What are you DOING here?
translation: 见到你真是太好了，但……你在这干嘛？

original: Who is this? You're not authorized to use this intercom!
translation: 是谁？你无权使用这台对讲机。

original: The time for talk is over. Now, you must act. Go to the purifier. Make your father proud!
translation: 谈话时间结束。现在，你必须行动。去找净化器。让你父亲为你自豪！

original: It's time to show the Enclave who they're dealing with. Now let's move out!
translation: 该让英克雷知道他们在和谁作对了。现在，我们行动！

original: For Elder Lyons!
translation: 为了里昂斯长老！

original: Good luck!
translation: 好运。 !

original: Project Purity is as good as ours!
translation: 净水工程已经是我们的了！

original: You! You're back! We... We all thought... you know.
translation: 你！你回来了！我们……我们都以为……你知道。

original: Look, Elder Lyons and the others are assembled in the lab. There's talk of assaulting the purifier. You'd better get down there right away.
translation: 听着，里昂斯长老和其他人在实验室集合。讨论攻击净化器的事。你最好赶快去那。

original: Glad to see you're still in one piece. You're just in time for the action. Best get to the lab and talk with Elder Lyons.
translation: 很高兴见到你完好无损。你正好赶上这次行动。最好去实验室和里昂斯长老谈。

original: You're back! Listen, something's happening. You need to get to the lab and talk to Elder Lyons right away!
translation: 你回来了！听着，有事发生。你需要立刻去实验室和里昂斯长老谈！

original: It's good to see you back. But you'd better get to the lab right away, and report to Elder Lyons.
translation: 很高兴见到你回来。但是你最好立刻赶去实验室，向里昂斯长老报到。

original: Great to see you, but have you spoken to Elder Lyons? He's here in the lab level, near the robot.
translation: 很高兴见到你，但是你和里昂斯长老谈过了吗？他在实验室层，靠近机器人的地方。

original: You need to report to Elder Lyons A.S.A.P. He's over by the robot.
translation: 你需要尽快和里昂斯长老报告。他在机器人那里。

original: Zzzzzz...
translation: Zzzzzz……

original: I'm sorry, but I really don't have time to talk right now. Perhaps Scribe Jameson could help you?
translation: 我很抱歉，但我真的没空聊天。或许詹姆森文士能帮你？

original: The Enclave seems to have developed advanced plasma-based weaponry. I need to analyze our Power Armor...
translation: 看来英克雷已经研发了进阶等离子武器。我需要分析我们的动力装甲……

original: What I wouldn't do to get my hands on one of those Enclave vertibirds...
translation: 我怎么都想逮到一架英克雷飞鸟……

original: All this time spent acquiring technology, and we look like cavemen next to the Enclave. That is not acceptable.
translation: 耗费了这么多时间来研发技术，但和英克雷比起来，我们看起来就像穴居人。这不能接受。

original: Super Mutants, Enclave -- they all bleed the same. No worries.
translation: 超级变种人，英克雷 — 他们一样会流血。别担心。

original: Welcome to the Citadel. Just remember -- you're a guest in our home. I expect you to behave yourself.
translation: 欢迎来到五角大本营。请记住 — 你是我们的客人。我希望你遵守规矩。

original: Welcome to the Citadel, friend of Steel.
translation: 欢迎来到五角大本营，钢铁兄弟会的朋友。

original: You ever seen a Super Mutant's head explode? Hell of a mess.
translation: 你见过一个超级变种人的脑袋爆炸吗？那真是恶心得一塌糊涂。

original: I hear those Enclave soldiers are equipped with Plasma weapons. Lucky bastards.
translation: 我听说那些英克雷士兵装备了等离子武器。幸运的杂种。

original: I will serve the Citadel and Elder Lyons until my dying breath. Is there any better life?
translation: 我会为五角大本营和里昂斯长老效忠至死。还有比这更好的人生吗？

original: Long live Elder Lyons!
translation: 里昂斯长老万岁！

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: Hail to you, son of James.
translation: 你好啊，詹姆斯的儿子。

original: Hail to you, daughter of James.
translation: 你好啊，詹姆斯的女儿。

original: Ah, it's good to see you again.
translation: 啊，很高兴再次见到你。

original: What the -- goddammit! Didn't anyone ever teach you not to creep up on people during a live fire exercise?
translation: 这 — 见鬼！没人教你不要在实战练习时吓唬别人吗？

original: What are you thinking? [Sighs] Anyway, I am Knight Captain Dusk, in service of Steel. If you require anything, simply ask.
translation: 你在想什么？[叹气]总之，我是骑士队长霞妹，为兄弟会服务。如果你需要什么，问就是了。

original: Hail to you, stranger. I am Knight Captain Dusk, in service of Steel. If you require anything, simply ask.
translation: 你好啊，陌生人。我是骑士队长霞妹，为兄弟会服务。如果你需要什么，问就是了。

original: I'm sorry, what part of "I'm done with you" didn't you understand? Leave me alone, Waster.
translation: 我很抱歉，你不懂“我和你无话可说”这话中的哪个部分？离我远点，废物。

original: Did I stutter? Get out of my face.
translation: 我说得不清楚吗？在我面前消失。

original: What? Can you not see that I'm concentrating here? You're gonna get your head blown off if you aren't careful. What do you want anyway?
translation: 什么？你没看到我正在这集中精力吗？如果你不小心的话就会脑袋开花。你到底要什么？

original: Do you really think it's wise to interrupt a sniper with a loaded rifle in her hand in the middle of a live fire drill?
translation: 你真的觉得打扰一个手持上膛步枪进行实战演习的狙击手明智吗？

original: What's so important anyway?
translation: 到底什么事那么重要？

original: Dammit! What's wrong with you? This is a firing range, not a nursery -- it's dangerous here. What do you want?
translation: 见鬼！你有毛病吗？这是实弹演习区，不是托儿所 — 这很危险。你要什么？

original: You holdin' it together, stranger? I see you're still in one piece. That's a good start, eh?
translation: 你还撑得住吗，陌生人？我看你目前还是整块的。是个好的开始，呃？

original: Still alive, I see. You're doing better than most Wasters that end up in the city.
translation: 还活着，我看到了。你比大多数死在城里的废物强。

original: Each day we make it to the end's a good one, eh? What do you need?
translation: 每天结束的时候都不错，呃？你需要什么？

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Speak.
translation: 说。

original: Quartermaster Durga here, stranger. I have to say, I'm not sure what you're doing in my armory.
translation: 军需官杜尔加在此，陌生人。我必须说，我不确定你在我的军工厂里干嘛。

original: We run a tight ship and unless Elder Lyons says so, we don't trade with outsiders.
translation: 我们管理严格，除非里昂斯长老吩咐，否则我们不会和外来人交易。

original: Quartermaster out.
translation: 军需官完毕。

original: Look, I told you. The Brotherhood doesn't trade with outsiders. If you want permission, you'll need to speak with Elder Lyons.
translation: 听着，我告诉过你。兄弟会不会和外来人交易。如果你想得到许可，你得去和里昂斯长老谈。

original: You again? Was I not clear the first time? I'm under order not to trade with outsiders for supplies. These orders come directly from Elder Lyons.
translation: 又是你？难道我上次没说清楚？我有命令不能和外来人交易补给。这命令是里昂斯长老直接下达的。

original: If you've got a problem with that, talk to him. Quartermaster out.
translation: 如果你有疑问，就去问他。军需官完毕。

original: I received word from Elder Lyons. He says that you have permission to trade with us. Good for you.
translation: 我收到了里昂斯长老的命令。他说你有和我们交易的许可。你走运了。

original: Yeah? What do you need?
translation: 嗯？你需要什么？

original: Quartermaster here. What do you need?
translation: 军需官在此。你需要什么？

original: Glad to see you and that egghead Li made it here in one piece. I heard what happened at that purifier. Hell of thing.
translation: 很高兴见到你和书呆子李安全到了这。我听说净化器那的事。真是见鬼。

original: 'can I do for you, kid?
translation: 我能为你做什么，孩子？

original: Good to see you in one piece, partner. What can I do for you?
translation: 很高兴你完整无缺，搭档。我能为你做什么？

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: Initiate! You got a lot of nerve interrupt... Oh, my apologies, stranger. I thought you were one of these worthless Initiates.
translation: 新兵！你得鼓起勇气……哦，对不起。陌生人。我还以为你是那些没用的新兵。

original: I swear, these kids'd be lost without me here to powder their asses.
translation: 我保证，要是没有我照料的话，这些孩子早就完蛋了。

original: I swear, these kids couldn't hit a barn door. Talk to me, say something to get my mind of these sorry ass recruits.
translation: 我发誓，这些孩子拿枪自我了断都会射偏。和我说点别的，让我的思绪离开这些可怜的小屁新兵。

original: These kids couldn't hit the ass end of a Behemoth at five paces. You should get in there and show 'em a thing or two, eh? That'd be a laugh.
translation: 这些孩子离开五步就打不到超级变种巨人的屁股。你得过去给他们表演下，呃？那一定很好玩。

original: Oh, good. Something to distract me. I swear, if I have to watch these kids miss targets for one more minute...
translation: 哦，好。说点转移我注意力的事。我发誓，如果我再多看一分钟这些孩子打脱靶的话……

original: Hail. Name's Greg -- Greg Bear. Most of the guys just call me Kodiak.
translation: 你好。我叫格雷格 — 格雷·贝尔。大多数人都叫我科迪亚克。

original: Heard about that mess over at the purifier. Don't you worry -- you're safe here.
translation: 听说了在净化器那的混乱。但你不必担心 — 在这你很安全。

original: Hail, friend.
translation: 你好，朋友。

original: I bend my knee to the might of Steel.
translation: 我臣服于兄弟会的力量。

original: How can I help, friend?
translation: 朋友，需要什么？

original: Hrm? Yes, hello. I've heard about you. We don't get many strangers here in the Citadel, especially those who walk about unescorted.
translation: 嗯？啊，你好。我听说过你。我们五角大本营没什么陌生人，特别是那些没护卫到处走的人。

original: I am Scribe Bowditch. If you require something, simply ask.
translation: 我是文员鲍蒂奇。如果你要什么，就请说。

original: How may a serve you, friend of Steel?
translation: 我能怎么帮你，兄弟会的朋友。

original: Hail, outsider. I am Scribe Jameson.
translation: 你好，外来人。我是文士詹姆森。

original: Word of your ordeal has spread. I am truly sorry for the loss of your father. But if I can help you in any way, please let me know.
translation: 你的严酷考验已经传开。我对你父亲的去世表示遗憾。但如果我能帮你什么，请告诉我。

original: "Knowledge is the beginning of wisdom, not the end of it." One of my favorite quotes. Its author has been lost to us.
translation: “知识是智慧的开始，而不是结束。”这是我最喜欢的引述。其作者已经无从考证。

original: How can I help you, outsider?
translation: 有什么可以帮助你的，外来者？

original: I came across something interesting: "The possession of knowledge does not kill the sense of wonder and mystery. There is always more mystery."
translation: 我碰到了些有趣的东西：“拥有知识不会削弱诧异感和神秘感。总会有更多神秘的东西。”

original: Quite true, don't you think?
translation: 很对，你不觉得吗？

original: "If we value the pursuit of knowledge, we must be free to follow wherever that search may lead us."
translation: “如果我们珍惜对知识的追寻，那我们必须任由研究引领我们前进。”

original: I found that in an ancient book. The words of wisdom of one of the greatest men of the former civilzation.
translation: 我在一本古书里面发现这个的。出自以前文明的一位伟人的智慧语言。

original: The Elder sent word of your arrival.  I am Scribe Peabody. Welcome, et. cetera...
translation: 长老说过你要来。我是文士博迪。欢迎，诸如此类……

original: Now, I'm really very busy. Is there something you needed?
translation: 现在我真的很忙。有什么你需要的吗？

original: What do you want, outsider?
translation: 你想要什么，外来者？

original: Yes? Can I help you? I'm very busy.
translation: 什么？需要我帮忙吗？我很忙。

original: Yes, what is it?
translation: 是吗？什么事？

original: How can I help you? Be quick about it.
translation: 有什么我能帮你？请快说。

original: H... hail to you, stranger. I am Squire Maxson, loyal servant of steel. It is... an honor to make your acquaintance.
translation: 啊，你好，外来人。我是扈从麦克森，兄弟会的忠实仆人。应该说……很高兴与你相识。

original: H... hail to you.
translation: 你……你好。

original: Greet... greetings to you.
translation: 欢……欢迎你。

original: We've said all that we have to say to one another.
translation: 该说的我们已经说过了。

original: I will not have James disgraced by anyone, including his ungrateful child.
translation: 我不会让詹姆森受任何人的侮辱，包括他那不领情的孩子。

original: Now get out of my sight.
translation: 现在从我的眼前消失。

original: Hail to you. By the traction of hospitality and on the word of Elder Lyons, I welcome you to the Citadel.
translation: 你好。由于盛情的吸引和里昂斯长老的话，我欢迎你来到五角大本营。

original: I am Star Paladin Cross, Keeper of the ARM, and Seneschal to Elder Lyons.
translation: 我是星骑士 克罗丝，装甲管理员，里昂斯长老手下的总管。

original: And, I am honored to say, I was acquainted with your father. Now, what may I do to help you?
translation: 还有，我很荣幸的说，我和你父亲是老相识。现在，我能帮你什么？

original: Good evening. What do you require of me?
translation: 晚上好。你需要什么？

original: I salute you, warrior. You walk among us, but apart from us. How may I aid you?
translation: 向你致敬，勇士。我们理想相同，却不得不分道而行。我能怎么帮你？

original: What? Huh? I'm sorry... I'm just an Initiate.
translation: 什么？呃？我很抱歉……我是新兵。

original: Uhm... I don't think that Paladin Gunny would be very happy if he saw me talking to an outsider.
translation: 嗯……我不觉得圣骑士甘尼看见我和外来人说话会很高兴。

original: Go away! You're going to get me chewed out!
translation: 走开！你是想让我臭骂你吗！

original: Please state the nature of the medical emergency.
translation: 请陈述紧急医疗的类型。

original: Stand down, civilian.
translation: 退下，平民。

original: Please address any questions to Paladin Bael.
translation: 有问题请向圣骑士贝尔提。

original: You're making me edgy. Back off.
translation: 你让我很烦躁。让开。

original: If there's an issue, you should speak to my superior, Paladin Bael.
translation: 如果有什么问题，请和我的上级圣骑士贝尔说。

original: Name's Paladin Bael. What do you need, civilian?
translation: 我是圣骑士贝尔。你需要什么，平民？

original: You again.
translation: 又是你。

original: State your business, and be quick about it.
translation: 有何贵干，长话短说。

original: What do you need, civilian?
translation: 你要什么，平民？

original: What aid can I offer you, outsider?
translation: 我能提供你什么帮助，外来人？

original: Great job kid! Meet me around front.
translation: 干得好，孩子！到前面和我碰头。

original: Herbert Dashwood. Damn glad to meet you! Call me Daring. Everyone else does.
translation: 赫伯特·达什伍德。真高兴见到你！叫我“大胆”吧。大家都这么叫。

original: Don't suppose you'll let me finish this drink before killing me? Hmm?
translation: 看来你不打算我喝完这杯就要下手了，对吧？

original: It's hard to drink with all that screaming.
translation: 到处都是尖叫声，真难喝得下去。

original: Okay fine! Quit pestering me. I know I'm going to bloody die, and I want to do it with a bloody, Bloody Mary in my hand. Is that alright with you?
translation: 好吧！别烦我了。我知道我要浑身是血地死掉，我想要拿着血腥玛丽死去。你看行吗？

original: I'm busy drinking.
translation: 我正忙着喝酒。

original: Die zombie!
translation: 该死的丧尸！

original: Goddamn it! This is no time to talk!
translation: 该死！没时间聊天！

original: Great job kid!
translation: 干得好，孩子！

original: Here, take this mask. It'll keep you safe from the Ferals. Just don't get too close to them, or they'll sniff you out. Don't forget to PUT IT ON!
translation: 来，拿着这面具。这会保护你避免受到凶悍僵尸的攻击。只要别靠他们太近，就发现不了你。别忘了戴上它！

original: Come on kid. There's killing and maiming going on. We can talk later.
translation: 得了，孩子。没看见正在杀人么，血肉四溅的。我们回头再聊。

original: Help!
translation: 救命！

original: Are you daft?! Don't stand there. Do something!
translation: 你傻啦？！别站在那，做些什么！

original: Please! Don't hurt me!
translation: 求求你！别伤害我！

original: Oh my God! They're killing everyone!
translation: 哦，我的天啊！他们在屠杀所有的人！

original: Help! Don't kill me!
translation: 救命！别杀我！

original: Help!
translation: 救命啊！

original: Why are you doing this?
translation: 你为什么要这么做？

original: Don't just stand their child! Take up the fight!
translation: 别光站在角落里，孩子！快来战斗！

original: Aiiiyeeeeah! Get away from me!
translation: 啊~~~！离我远点！

original: Find a place to hide, comrade!
translation: 找个地方躲起来，同志！

original: Don't hurt me! Please!
translation: 不要伤害我！求求你！

original: We're all going to die!
translation: 我们都死定了！

original: No!!! Don't!
Help us! Please!
translation: 救救我们！求求你！

original: Don't hurt me!
translation: 别伤害我！

original: Help us!
translation: 救救我们！

original: What's the status on those Tenpenny bigots?
translation: 那些特佩尼偏执狂现在怎样？

original: Well kid, what've you accomplished?
translation: 孩子，你完成了什么？

original: What's the word at Tenpenny, kid?
translation: 特佩尼那有什么消息，孩子？

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: What are you looking at?
translation: 你在看什么？

original: I'm really not in the mood, so leave me alone.
translation: 我现在心情不好，所以离我远点。

original: You take care of those Ghouls yet?
translation: 你把那些僵尸干掉了？

original: The Ghouls trying to get in are all dead.
translation: 试图进入的僵尸已经都死了。

original: You having trouble with those Ghouls?
translation: 有麻烦？

original: The Ghouls trying to get in are all dead.
translation: 试图进入的僵尸已经都死了。

original: Hmph. Didn't think you had it in you. Guess you proved me wrong. Good job. Knowing those Ghouls are gone takes a load off my mind. Thanks.
translation: 哼。没想到你还真有两下子，我想你已证明我错了。好样的。知道那些僵尸离开了，我也放心了。谢谢。

original: You'll be wanting the reward now, won't you. I suppose you've earned it.
translation: 你现在就想要报酬，对吧？我觉得这是你应得的。

original: There's your caps. Contract fulfilled, debt paid. This don't mean we're buddies, alright? Now get going.
translation: 这是你的瓶盖。约定完成，欠债付清。这并不意味着我们是同伴了，懂吗？现在走吧。

original: The Ghouls trying to get in are all dead.
translation: 试图进入的僵尸已经都死了。

original: Your constant need to chatter is pressing on my optic nerve.
translation: 我受不了你没完没了的唠叨了。

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: You have a curious look about you. I presume you have something interesting to tell me?
translation: 你的样子真奇怪。我想你有什么趣事要告诉我？

original: Well, well. What have we here? Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Susan Lancaster. Perhaps we can become better acquainted, in the near future?
translation: 这个这个。看看谁来了？我先自我介绍下。我是苏珊·兰卡斯特。或许将来我们之间能有更深入的了解。

original: Hmm. What have we here? A lost little girl? Do you have permission to be in here? If not, you should leave before it gets ugly.
translation: 嗯。看看谁来了？迷路的小女孩？你有进入这的许可吗？如果没有，你最好在事情闹大前离开。

original: Edgar Wellington the second, at your service. Please excuse my demeanor. My wife recently passed away.
translation: 埃德加·威灵顿二世，为你服务。请原谅我的失礼。我的妻子刚刚去世了。

original: Hold on there... who let YOU in here?
translation: 站住……谁让你进来的？

original: Edgar Wellington the second. Have you met my wife Millicent?
translation: 埃德加·威灵顿二世。你见过我妻子米莉森特吧？

original: Hold on... who let YOU in here?
translation: 站住……谁让你进来的？

original: Edgar Wellington the second, at your service.
translation: 埃德加·威灵顿二世，为你服务。

original: Hold on... who let YOU in here?
translation: 站住……谁让你进来的？

original: I am Comrade Cheng, beloved leader of the people, shining servant of the community! How can I help you?
translation: 我是程主席，人民爱戴的领袖，公社光荣的仆人！我能帮你做些什么？

original: I'm Michael Hawthorne. Who are you? And more importantly, should I care?
translation: 我是迈克尔·霍桑。你是谁？更重要的是，我需要知道吗？

original: I loved that stupid man... now that he's gone... I'm lost.
translation: 我爱那蠢男人……现在，他走了……我也失去了自我。

original: I can't talk now.
translation: 我现在不能聊天。

original: Introductions are in order. I am Mrs. Edgar Wellington. You may refer to me as Madam or My Lady Wellington.
translation: 我先自我介绍下，我是埃德加·威灵顿夫人。你也可以尊称我为威灵顿夫人或女士。

original: My name is Tiffany Cheng. My miserable excuse for a husband, is "comrade" Irving Cheng, and you can tell him I said so.
translation: 我的名字是提凡尼·程。我可怜无趣的丈夫，是艾尔文·程“同志”，你可以告诉他我这样说。

original: Lemme guess... you said something dumb and now Birch wants you outta Oasis. Wonderful.
translation: 让我猜猜看……你说了些什么蠢话，所以布尔奇先生要你离开绿洲。很好。

original: You better get a move on before they really get mad and hunt you down.
translation: 在他们真的发疯并把你揍倒在地之前，你还是快点走吧。

original: Oh great. Now you got yourself kicked out of here.
translation: 很好。现在你自己滚出这吧。

original: Looks like I'll have to find someone else to help me. You better get outta here... these guys will get pretty cross if you stick around.
translation: 看上去我得另找他人来帮我了。你最好快点离开这……要是你再逗留，这些家伙就要发怒了。

original: I can't believe you'd kill those innocent people like that. And I thought I was a monster!
translation: 我真不敢相信你会如此残忍的杀害这些无辜的人。我还以为自己是个怪物！

original: If I could move, I would show you a thing or two, but Bob has me stuck here.
translation: 如果我能走，我倒是有一两样东西想给你看，但鲍勃把我困在这了。

original: Those people you killed were some of the most peaceful people in the Wasteland!
translation: 那些被你残害的人是这片废土上最热爱和平的人！

original: How could you do that to them?
translation: 你怎么下得了手？

original: Leave me alone! Me and Bob have better things to do than speak to a murderer!
translation: 走开！我和鲍勃才不要和杀人凶手说话！

original: Now go away and never come back!
translation: 滚开，再也不要回来！

original: How dare you come into Oasis and shoot up the place!
translation: 你竟敢在绿洲里大开杀戒！

original: Even Bob is mad at you, and he never gets mad except when I don't stop calling him Herbert!
translation: 就连鲍勃都对你愤怒了，而他除了我不停叫他赫伯特之外从来没发过怒！

original: I'm only gonna ask you this one time. Give me the Naughty Nightwear!
translation: 我只会开这么一次口。给我淘气睡衣！

original: Yeah, yeah. Just keep on walkin'.
translation: 嗯，嗯。继续走。

original: So, what did ya bring me?
translation: 你给我带了什么？

original: So what's the deal. You gonna get me some Sugar Bombs or what?
translation: 什么交易。你要给我一些糖麦弹还是什么？ ?

original: You're n..not here to try and steal my secrets are you?
translation: 你……你不会在想偷走我的秘密吧，对吧？

original: Get away from me, smoothskin.
translation: 离我远点，光皮肤。

original: You lookin' for a problem?
translation: 你在找麻烦？

original: The hell you looking at, smoothskin?
translation: 见鬼，你在看什么，光皮肤？

original: I like these guys, they let me play with their pucks.
translation: 我喜欢这些人，他们让我玩他们的冰球。

original: Hey, I may be just a Winger now, but I'll make Centre soon.
translation: 嗨，我或许现在只是个边锋。不过我不久就能成为中场。

original: Sorry, we've got practice. Maybe we'll cross sticks again one day.
translation: 抱歉，我们要训练。或许有朝一日我们会有机会切磋球技。

original: Hold it right there! What are you doing here?
translation: 站住！你在这干嘛？

original: What the hell do you want? I hope you've decided to be more civil.
translation: 见鬼，你想要什么？我希望你能更守规矩。

original: No, I'm sorry. I tried to be nice to you and you decided to make fun of me. Well, this old lady doesn't put up with those shenanigans.
translation: 不，我很抱歉。我试着对你好，而你却打算取笑我。好吧，我不能容忍那些恶作剧。

original: Oh my goodness gracious! Seems like you've been gone forever. Please tell me you have good news.
translation: 哦，我仁慈的主！我以为你永远回不来了。请告诉我你带来的好消息吧。

original: No luck yet finding the Soil Stradivarius, eh?
translation: 还没发现索耶尔的斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴，嗯？

original: Let me know if there's anything I can do to help!
translation: 如果需要我帮助尽管开口！

original: Oh my, it's you. I-I wasn't expecting visitors all the way out here.
translation: 哦，是你啊。我……我可没想到在这会有远道而来的来访者。

original: My name's Agatha. What brings you to my home?
translation: 我叫阿加莎，是什么风把你吹到我家来了？

original: My my my. You certainly do look a little bit worn out from your travels.
translation: 喔喔喔，看上去你的旅途很艰辛啊。

original: Oh, just look at my terrible manners! I'm Agatha. It's so nice to meet you.
translation: 哦，看我多没礼貌！我是阿加莎，很高兴见到你。

original: Now, what brings you all the way out here?
translation: 是什么风把你吹到我这来了？

original: Have you decided to find me a violin?
translation: 你决定帮我找小提琴了吗？

original: You do actually know how to plant mines, right?
translation: 你真的知道怎么埋设地雷，对吧？

original: The robots are over in the junkyard, in case you're wondering.
translation: 你想打听的话，机器人在废物堆积场那。

original: Are you going to show us how to fix the robots?
translation: 你准备让我们见识下怎样修理机器人？

original: So are you going to ever show us how to be sneaky so we can hide from the Super Mutants?
translation: 你是准备给我们演示怎么隐匿，让我们能躲开超级变种人吗？

original: I'm getting bored. I thought you were going to teach us something.
translation: 我开始无聊了。我还以为你会教我们些什么。

original: Go on, I'm watching. Show us what to do.
translation: 继续，我在看着。告诉我们做什么。

original: I'm confused. What am I supposed to be doing? Can you show me?
translation: 我糊涂了。我该做什么？你能给我演示下吗？

original: We're all watching you waiting to learn something. Well. Get on with it already!
translation: 我们都在看着你，等你教东西。来吧，准备好就开始吧。

original: Go on. I'm paying attention. Show us what to do.
translation: 来吧。我正在看着。告诉我们做什么。

original: Well, hotshot. Are you going to teach us something, or just stand there looking stupid?
translation: 自命不凡的家伙。你准备教我们些什么，还是像蠢货一样站着。

original: Oooh. I can't wait. Show us what to do!
translation: 哦，我等不下去了。教我们怎么做！

original: I'm watching. Go on. Teach us what to do.
translation: 我在看着，来吧，教我们怎么做。

original: I'm glad to be safely back home!
translation: 我很高兴能安全回家！

original: Quick! Unlock the door!
translation: 快！开门！

original: You've got to get this door unlocked!
translation: 你得把门打开！

original: You're rescuing me? Let's get the hell out of here!
translation: 你来救我的吗？让我们离开这。

original: You're rescuing Shorty and me?! Thanks! I thought we were goners for sure.
translation: 你来救我和“矮子”的吗？！谢谢！我以为我们死定了。

original: I think the others are dead... or worse.
translation: 我想其他人都死了……或许更糟。

original: You're rescuing me?! Thanks! I thought we were goners for sure.
translation: 你来救我的？！谢谢！我以为我们死定了。

original: I think the others are dead... or worse.
translation: 我想其他人都死了……或许更糟。

original: You're rescuing me?! Thanks! I thought we were goners for sure.
translation: 你来救我的？！谢谢！我以为我们死定了。

original: I think the others are dead... or worse.
translation: 我想其他人都死了……或许更糟。

original: We can talk back at Big Town. Let's get out of here!
translation: 我们回了大镇再说。我们快离开这！

original: I'll feel better once we're safe.
translation: 等安全了，我会觉得好些。

original: Thank God! Who are you? Never mind, I don't care right now. Let's go get Red and get out of here!
translation: 谢天谢地！你是谁？别在意，现在我不关心这。我们离开这去找瑞德！

original: Come on, you've got to untie me!
translation: 来吧，给我解开绳子！

original: Thanks! Who are you? Never mind, I don't care right now. Let's go get Red and get out of here!
translation: 谢天谢地！你是谁？别在意，现在我不关心这。我们离开这去找瑞德！

original: You lead. I'll follow. Let's go! Move it!
translation: 你带路，我跟着。我们走！快点！

original: No more talking! Let's get out of here!
translation: 别说了！我们离开这！

original: What's the hold up?
translation: 还在等什么？

original: Who are you? And why do I have the feeling that you have some bad news?
translation: 你是谁？我怎么感觉你有坏消息？

original: They're dead. Aren't they?
translation: 他们死了，对吧？

original: Hey! Who are you?
translation: 嗨！你是谁？

original: Thanks for helping us. I just hope we can survive another attack. Probably won't.
translation: 谢谢你帮助我们。我只是希望我们能在下次进攻中活下来。可能不会。

original: Where's Red?
translation: 瑞德在哪？

original: So what, you here to make fun of me or something?
translation: 你是来取笑我的还是有事？

original: I can't believe you sold me to Slavers! Why would you do that to me?
translation: 我不敢相信你把我卖给奴隶贩子！你为什么要这么对我？

original: Well, you can... you can just GO TO HELL. That's right. I said it and I mean it. I never wanna talk to you again. Like ever!
translation: 好，你可以……可以下地狱去了。对。我说了，我就这意思。我永远不会和你说话了。永远！

original: What's the matter with you? Leave me alone!
translation: 你有病吗？离我远点！

original: Get away from me! I never wanna see you again!
translation: 离我远点！我永远不要再见到你。

original: I got a lot of stuff to get together. Can't wait to get to Paradise Falls!
translation: 我有好多东西要准备。等不及要到堕落天堂了！

original: I got a lot of stuff to get together. Can't wait to get to Rivet City!
translation: 我有好多东西要准备。等不及要到铆钉城了！

original: I got a lot of stuff to get together. Can't wait to get to Little Lamplight!
translation: 我有好多东西要准备。等不及要到小灯镇了！

original: Checking up on me or something?
translation: 来看看我，还是有什么事？

original: Your arrival is most unexpected, but not entirely unwelcome.
translation: 你的到来是最意想不到的，但也不是完全不受欢迎的。

original: My friend! I see I've found you at last!
translation: 我的朋友！我知道我总会找到你！

original: I knew you had survived, and I had hoped to assist in your rescue to repay my debt to you.
translation: 我知道你活下来了，而且我曾希望去支援你的援助行动来作为对你的回报。

original: You're a real hero the way you handled the Ghouls.
translation: 处理僵尸的方式显示了你是个真正的英雄。

original: I was worried about those Ghouls. Now I can get back to worrying about important things, like what color to dye my hair. Thanks for everything!
translation: 我曾担心那些僵尸。现在，我可以想其他重要的事了，就像今天染什么颜色的头发之类。谢谢你！
