original: You're amazing. The way you handled those Ghouls. Good show!
translation: 你太棒了。处理那些僵尸的方式。漂亮！

original: Guess we can try living with the Ghouls.
translation: 我想我们能试着和僵尸一起生活。

original: I hope those Ghouls try to get along with us civilized people.
translation: 我希望那些僵尸不要打扰我们这些文明人。

original: Hello, hello!
translation: 你好，你好！

original: I'm mighty appreciative of your straightening things out. Perhaps next time I go on safari I'll take you along.
translation: 我非常感激你把事情妥善处理了。或许下次旅行我会把你带上。

original: Is there something you require?
translation: 有什么你需要的东西吗？

original: Good job taking care of our little problem. Now if you'll excuse me...
translation: 帮我们处理了小问题，干得漂亮。现在，如果你不介意的话……

original: Thank you for dealing with those Ghouls. You're a real hero.
translation: 谢谢你帮我们处理了那些僵尸。你是个真正的英雄。

original: Thanks for helping those Ghouls. They really aren't so bad.
translation: 谢谢你帮助了那些僵尸。他们真的不坏。

original: Good to see you!
translation: 很高兴见到你！

original: Hey... you're the one that got rid of those Ghouls. Or was that someone else...? No, it WAS you!
translation: 嗨……你是那赶走僵尸的人。还是其他人做的……？不，就是你！

original: Hey... you're the one with the Ghoul friends... well I guess they're our friends now, too.
translation: 嗨……你是那个僵尸的朋友……我想现在他们也是我们的朋友了。

original: Hey... I know you! Cheers!
translation: 嗨……我知道你！干杯！

original: Good job removing our little pest problem!
translation: 干得好，帮我们清理了害虫！

original: Hello friend!
translation: 你好，朋友！

original: I have nothing to say to you. Except this: Watch your back!
translation: 我没话和你说，除了这句：小心！

original: Hrmph.
translation: 哼。

original: I loved that stupid man... now that he's gone... I'm lost.
translation: 我爱那蠢男人……现在，他走了……我也失去了自我。

original: You did it! You got rid of those vile creatures! Good show!
translation: 你做到了！你赶走了那些卑劣的生物！干掉漂亮！

original: Yes, dear?
translation: 嗯，亲爱的？

original: You'll get yours soon enough.
translation: 很快你会得到你应得的。

original: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！

original: Hello friend. Thanks for handling those Ghouls.
translation: 你好，朋友。谢谢你处理了那些僵尸。

original: Hello friend. Ghoul physiology is fascinating!
translation: 你好，朋友。僵尸的生理机能真令人着迷！

original: Hello friend!
translation: 你好，朋友！

original: Those Ghouls wont be bothering us anymore, will they?
translation: 那些僵尸不会再打扰我们了，对吧？

original: Hello!
translation: 你好！

original: Come to pour salt into the wound? Well, I won't stand for it!
translation: 想在伤口撒盐？我可受不了！

original: Zombie-lover!
translation: 丧尸迷！！

original: Things have been perfectly fabulous since you exterminated that filthy vermin!
translation: 自从你清除了那些丑恶的害虫，事情变得难以置信的完美！

original: Fabulous!
translation: 难以置信！

original: You think I want to talk to you?
translation: 你觉得我想和你说话？

original: You've ruined my life!
translation: 你毁了我的生活！

original: Comrade! Hero of the people! Hello!
translation: 同志！人民的英雄！你好！

original: Hey comrade! Those Ghoul's seem like a real community, hey? Adversity must have made them strong.
translation: 嗨，同志！那些僵尸看起来是个真正的公社，对吧？曾经的不幸一定让他们变得很强。

original: Greetings hero-comrade!
translation: 幸会，英雄同志！

original: You're all my husband talks about now. Do you have any idea how annoying that is?
translation: 我丈夫现在天天谈论你。你知道那有多烦人吗？

original: I miss my husband. He would have really liked you I think.
translation: 我想我丈夫。我想他肯定会很喜欢你。

original: Hello!
translation: 你好！

original: Hey! I'm sure glad to have you around. That Gustavo's a real loser compared to you!
translation: 嗨！有你在真的让我很高兴。那古斯塔沃和你比完全就是废物！

original: Hey there!
translation: 嗨！

original: Take a real good look, because you won't be getting any of this!
translation: 好好看一看，因为你不会得到任何东西。

original: Hah! I'm doing just fine, no thanks to you!
translation: 哈！我也能做得同样好，不用谢你！

original: What do YOU want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: You're a lot tougher than you look, kid.
translation: 你比你的外表更坚强，孩子。

original: Glad to see you were able to convince these people to open their minds a little. Those Ghouls will liven things up around here for a long time!
translation: 很高兴看到你能说服这些人稍微开放点他们的思想。那些僵尸会让这里很长时间都有生气的！

original: Hello fellow adventurer!
translation: 你好，冒险家伙伴！

original: Haha! Look at this mess. We'll have it cleaned up soon. Then it will be a Ghoul haven.
translation: 哈哈！看看这烂摊子。我们会很快处理掉。此后这里会成为僵尸的天堂。

original: Ha ha! Hey there bud. Thanks again for helping us get in here!
translation: 哈哈！嗨，伙计。再次感谢你把我们带到这！

original: Hey there bud!
translation: 嗨，伙计！

original: Well, it'll take a little elbow grease but then this place will be a true home!
translation: 这会费些体力，但之后这会变成一个真正的家！

original: Oh, hello there! Can't thank you enough!
translation: 哦，你好！怎么感激你都不够！

original: Hi again!
translation: 你好！

original: Bastards. Could have done it the easy way and just let us live here with them. Oh well. Guess we better get started with the clean up.
translation: 杂种。可以让事情更简单的，让我们和他们一起生活。哦，算了。我想我们最好开始把这弄干净。

original: Hey kid. I was wrong about you. Good job!
translation: 嗨，孩子。我错怪你了。干得好！

original: Hey kid, how's it going?
translation: 嗨，孩子。怎么样？

original: Must admit, you did good soldier. I'm glad to have you around.
translation: 必须承认，你是个好士兵。我很高兴有你在。

original: Don't know how you did it. I'd never allow those zombies room and board. But as long as Tenpenny keeps paying me I'll stay.
translation: 不知道你是怎么做到的，我是永远不会允许给那些丧尸提供食宿。但只要特佩尼继续付我钱，我会留下。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Good job handling those zombies!
translation: 干得漂亮，处理了那些丧尸！

original: What's up? Kill any more zombies lately?
translation: 什么事？最近杀丧尸了吗？

original: Hey soldier!
translation: 嗨，士兵！

original: There you go! I hope you like it.
translation: 给你！我希望你喜欢它。

original: Oh good, you came back to visit!
translation: 噢，好。有空回来看看！

original: Yay! You're back!
translation: 耶！你回来了！

original: Hiya! Whatcha doing back here?
translation: 你好！你回这来干嘛？

original: Sorry... need to be alone for a while.
translation: 抱歉……需要单独待会。

original: Get away from me! They'll find me next!
translation: 离我远点！他们会发现我的！

original: Hey there, hot stuff.
translation: 嗨，大红人。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: I have no time to waste with you. Far more important matters await the attention of the AntAgonizer!
translation: 我没时间和你废话。痛苦蚁后还有很多重要的事要关心。

original: Really. Thanks for all your help, but I've got things I have to attend to.
translation: 真的。感谢你的帮助，但是我还有事不得不去做。

original: I'm getting out of here!
translation: 我要离开这儿！

original: I'm getting out of here!
translation: 我要离开这儿！

original: I'm getting out of here!
translation: 我要离开这儿！

original: Hey. We grabbed this on our last mission. Thought you might like it.
translation: 嗨。上次任务我们拿了这。我想你可能喜欢它。

original: A badass like you, you deserve a cut of everything around here. Take it. It's yours.
translation: 你个混蛋，这里所有的东西都该有你一份。拿着，这是你的了。

original: Check this out. Me and a couple of the boys thought you could use a cut of the loot we picked up.
translation: 看看这。我和几个兄弟认为你该得到一些我们战利品的分成。

original: ...okay. You got all that? I think you know enough now to at least move around in Power Armor without killing yourself. That’s something, right?
translation: ……好，你都了解了？我看你已经清楚怎样穿着动力装甲才不会送命了。那不赖，对吧？

original: God help us all.
translation: 上帝保佑我们所有人。

original: Okay, there you go. The computer is on again. Dunno what good it'll do you.
translation: 好，成功了。电脑再次启动了。不知道它对你有什么用。

original: I'll get that computer turned on for you.
translation: 我会为你打开电脑。

original: You have my condolences. Your father was a good man.
translation: 请接受我的哀悼，你父亲是个好人。

original: Please, not now.
translation: 拜托，现在不是时候。

original: Follow me. I'll show you what I can about Vault 87.
translation: 跟着我，我会让你看看我在87号避难所里能做什么。

original: This map shows the locations of all known Vaults in the local area. Vault 87 has been highlighted for you, there.
translation: 这地图显示了所有当地已知的避难所。87号避难所做了高亮，在那里。

original: Entrance to Vault 87 will be particularly difficult for you, I'm afraid.
translation: 我恐怕对你来说，进入87号避难所非常困难。

original: Did you have any success with that old terminal?
translation: 你修好那旧终端了吗？

original: Ah, you're back. You need something else now?
translation: 啊，你回来了，你现在还有什么需要？

original: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
translation: 是吗？我还能帮你些什么？

original: I'm afraid I have other duties to attend to right now. If you find the computer to be helpful, there may be more I can offer.
translation: 恐怕现在我要去做其他的事了。如果你认为电脑有用，我还能提供更多。

original: May I start by saying that I am sorry for your loss. I was acquainted with your father, many years ago.
translation: 对你的遭遇我非常难过，让我先说声抱歉。很多年前我就熟悉你的父亲了。

original: The world has lost one of its few remaining visionaries.
translation: 世界又失去了一位为数不多的梦想者。

original: I... I need to rest. Lie down, or something. This is just too much.
translation: 我……我要休息了。躺下或者怎么，太累了。

original: Rothchild should help you. But don't forget that he's Brotherhood. I've never trusted them. Be careful what you tell them.
translation: 罗斯查德会帮助你。但是别忘了他是兄弟会的。我从不相信他们。和他们说话要小心。

original: I need to collect my wits, and figure out what to do next. Excuse me.
translation: 我需要镇定下来，来想想接下来该干嘛。失陪。

original: Can't you see I'm trying to have a conversation?
translation: 你没看到我正在谈话？

original: There must be something they can do.
translation: 他们肯定能做些什么。

original: Come with me. We need to talk to the leaders at once; they have to know what's happened out there.
translation: 跟我来。我们需要立刻和领袖们谈谈，他们一定知道外面发生了什么。

original: There must be something they can do.
translation: 他们肯定能做些什么。

original: I need to speak with Scribe Rothchild and Elder Lyons. They must be told what is going on.
translation: 我要和文士罗斯查德、以及里昂斯长老谈谈。他们肯定得知发生了什么。

original: What are you looking at? You'd think you'd never seen a Ghoul up close before.
translation: 你在看什么？你是不是觉得从来没这么近看到一个僵尸。

original: What the hell did you wake me up for, smoothskin? What are you staring at? You think you'd never seen a Ghoul up close before.
translation: 见鬼，你叫醒我干嘛，光皮肤？你在看什么呢？你觉得你从来没这么近看过一个僵尸吗？

original: What now? You're starting to piss me off. Are you one of them Ghoul haters?
translation: 什么事？你开始惹怒我了。你是一个僵尸仇视者吗？

original: Back again, eh? Changed your mind? I still need to know if you have any problems with killing.
translation: 又回来了，呃？改主意了？我还是需要知道你杀人是否有困难。

original: I thought you weren't interested in what I had to say?
translation: 我以为你对我说的没有兴趣。

original: Do you have those keys yet?
translation: 你拿到那些钥匙了吗？

original: Are they all dead yet? Did you bring me any proof?
translation: 他们都死了？你给我带回了什么证据？

original: Is Tenpenny dead? God, I hope so.
translation: 特佩尼死了？天啊，正如我愿。

original: Don't you have something to do?
translation: 你就没有要做的事？

original: How did you get past the guard? What do you want?
translation: 你怎么通过守卫的？你要什么？

original: I haven't heard anything about Mister Crowley recently. So what could you possibly want?
translation: 我目前还没有听到考利先生的任何消息。你又想知道些什么？

original: Dude, you got your key. What do you want now?
translation: 伙计，你得到钥匙了。你现在还要什么？

original: Do you need more than that gift?
translation: 除了那礼物，你还要些什么？

original: Here's the key. He never even noticed.
translation: 这是钥匙。他不会注意到的。

original: You've got your god damn key. Isn't that enough?
translation: 你拿到你那该死的钥匙了。还不够？

original: Good work! That's one less Radroach to deal with.
translation: 干得好！又少了一只辐射蟑螂要操心了。

original: Let's get a picture together. Capture the moment.
translation: 让我们一起照张相。记住这瞬间。

original: Having trouble with that Radroach?
translation: 搞不定那只辐射蟑螂？

original: Something wrong? That Radroach is still over there.
translation: 有什么问题？那只辐射蟑螂还活着。

original: Well, what do you think? You can come down here and shoot any time you want.
translation: 好，你觉得怎么样？你随时能下来进行射击。

original: Don't worry, you'll get the hang of it. Here are some more BBs.
translation: 别担心，你会掌握怎么使用它的。这还有些BB弹。

original: If you're having trouble, try crouching to steady your aim.
translation: 如果有麻烦，试着弯腰瞄准你的目标。

original: Go ahead. Try out your new gun on those targets over there.
translation: 去吧。试试你的新枪，靶子在那。

original: Come on. We'll show you the place.
translation: 来吧，我带你参观下这。

original: Are you ready for your surprise?
translation: 准备好接受惊喜了吗？

original: Hey, that was Jonas on the intercom. He and I have been cooking up a little surprise present.
translation: 嗨，对讲机那边是乔纳斯。他和我筹划了一份令你惊喜的小礼物。

original: Jonas is waiting for you downstairs on the Reactor Level. Go ahead, I don't think anyone will mind if you slip out for a few minutes.
translation: 乔纳斯在楼下的反应堆层等你。去吧，我想没人会介意你离开几分钟。

original: Just be patient. You don't want to ruin the surprise, do you? Go ahead, Jonas is waiting!
translation: 耐心点。你不想破坏这惊喜，对吧？去吧，乔纳斯在等你！

original: Are you all right? Is Butch giving you a hard time again?
translation: 你还好吧？布奇是不是又让你难堪了？

original: Having a good time? It wasn't easy keeping this a secret! Now go on, I'm sure everyone else would like a chance to talk to the birthday boy.
translation: 开心吗？要我保守这秘密可真辛苦！现在去吧，我相信每个人都想有机会和小寿星聊聊。

original: Having a good time? It wasn't easy keeping this a secret! Now go on, I'm sure everyone else would like a chance to talk to the birthday girl.
translation: 开心吗？要我保守这秘密可真辛苦！现在去吧，我相信每个人都想有机会和小寿星聊聊。

original: Hey there, pal. Having fun?
translation: 嗨，伙计，开心吗？

original: Hi, honey. Having fun?
translation: 嘿，亲爱的，开心吗？

original: I can't believe you're 10 already. Your mother would have been proud of you, son. Now go on and enjoy your party!
translation: 难以置信你已经10岁了。你妈妈一定会为你自豪的，孩子。现在去享受你的生日聚会吧！

original: I can't believe you're 10 already. Your mother would have been proud of you, honey. Now go on and enjoy your party!
translation: 难以置信你已经10岁了。你妈妈一定会为你自豪的，亲爱的。现在去享受你的生日聚会吧！

original: Listen, once you finish being a good host, I have something I want to show you.
translation: 听着，等你尽完你的地主之谊，我有些东西想给你看。

original: I hope you appreciate the effort Amata put into this party. She really seems to like you, for some reason.
translation: 我希望你会赞赏阿玛塔为这聚会投入的精力。出于某种原因，她看上去真的很喜欢你。

original: Another youth well on his way to becoming a productive vault citizen!
translation: 又一个年轻人即将成为能参与生产的避难所居民了！

original: Another youth well on her way to becoming a productive vault citizen!
translation: 又一个年轻人即将成为能参与生产的避难所居民了！

original: Are you having a nice party? Ten years old, my my my. Seems like only yesterday that your daddy came...
translation: 聚会开心吗？10岁了，喔喔喔。好像还是昨天啊，你爸爸来……

original: Goodness, listen to me ramble! You're waiting for your present, aren't you?
translation: 天啊，看我唠叨的！你在等你的礼物，对吧？

original: Go ahead, you can eat the sweetroll now. It's your birthday!
translation: 去吧，你现在可以吃甜面包卷了。这是你的生日！

original: You've grown up into such a fine young man. Your father must be very proud of you.
translation: 你已经长成一个这样帅气的小伙了。你爸爸一定为你感到非常骄傲。

original: You've grown up into such a fine young lady. Your father must be very proud of you.
translation: 你已经长成一个这样漂亮的女孩了。你爸爸一定为你感到非常骄傲。

original: I don't have any more presents for you, if that's what you're wondering.
translation: 如果你还有什么想知道的，那就是我没其他礼物给你了。

original: Go on now, I'm sure you've had quite enough old lady chitchat for one birthday!
translation: 现在，去吧，我肯定你已经在生日这天听够了老女人的唠叨！

original: Happy birthday, dearie! My goodness, I hope I didn't miss the party!
translation: 生日快乐，亲爱的！我的天，我希望没有迟到！

original: I hope you're having a good party! Did you read your poem yet? You know how to find it in your Pip-Boy, don't you?
translation: 我希望你会喜欢这聚会！你读了送给你的诗了吗？你知道怎么在你的哔哔小子里找到它，对吧？

original: I hope Butch didn't hurt you. Do you want to tell me what that was all about?
translation: 我希望布奇没伤到你。你能告诉我到底发生了什么事吗？

original: Happy birthday, sonny!
translation: 生日快乐，小伙子！

original: Happy birthday, missy!
translation: 生日快乐，小女孩！

original: Sounds like everybody's having a good time in there.
translation: 听起来大家在那都过得很愉快。

original: How do you like that Pip-Boy, son? Fit all right and everything?
translation: 喜欢哔哔小子吗，孩子？戴着合适吧？

original: How do you like that there Pip-Boy, miss? Fit all right and everything?
translation: 喜欢哔哔小子吗，女孩？戴着合适吧？

original: You let me know if that Pip-Boy ever gives you any trouble.
translation: 如果哔哔小子出了什么问题就告诉我。

original: I am mortified about the cake mishap. Simply mortified.
translation: 那蛋糕的事情让人生气。真气人。

original: Allow me to wish you happy birthday. I would offer you a piece of cake, but...
translation: 允许我祝你生日快乐。我想给你块蛋糕，但是……

original: Happy birthday! If you'll excuse me I'll have this cake sliced up for you in a jiffy.
translation: 生日快乐！如果你不介意，我立刻为你切开蛋糕。

original: I'm hungry and that stupid robot destroyed the cake.
translation: 我饿了，而那蠢货机器人却毁了蛋糕。

original: Give me that sweetroll you got from Old Lady Palmer.
translation: 把帕尔默大妈给你的甜面包卷给我。

original: Mmm, that sweetroll was really good. You can tell Old Lady Palmer thanks for me. Ha ha ha!
translation: 嗯，甜面包卷真不错。你见到帕尔默大妈时，说我谢谢她，哈哈哈！

original: So you're a tattletale, too. Just wait. Gomez isn't always going to be around to save your butt.
translation: 你也是个告密者。等着吧，戈麦斯不会总在身边保护你。

original: You're going to be really sorry you messed with me, punk.
translation: 招惹我你会后悔的，废物。

original: Nice party, butt-head. Now get lost before I have to make you cry.
translation: 不错的聚会，大头蛋。现在，在我没让哭你之前赶快消失。

original: Didn't I tell you to stop bothering us? Shove off, dork.
translation: 我没告诉你别再打扰我们吗？滚开，呆子。

original: My mom made me come to your stupid party, but don't expect me to hang out with you. Get lost, loser.
translation: 我妈妈非要我来你这愚蠢的聚会，但是别指望我会和你混在一起。消失吧，废物。

original: Why don't you go play dolls or something with your little friend Amata. No girls allowed.
translation: 怎么不和你的小朋友阿玛塔去玩洋娃娃什么的。女孩靠边。

original: Hey, I think your girlfriend Amata is looking for you. K-I-S-S-I-N-G. Ha ha ha.
translation: 嗨，我想你的女朋友阿玛塔在找你，亲-亲，哈哈哈！

original: This party's pretty good, I guess. For a little kid. Balloons. Party hats...
translation: 我想，这聚会很不错。对于小孩子来说，气球，聚会帽……

original: Not as cool as my party though. Remember how my dad got Andy to do magic tricks? And we all played Hunt the Mutant in the Atrium?
translation: 尽管不如我的聚会那么酷。记的我爸爸让安迪来做的魔术表演吗？我们所有人在前厅玩猎杀变种人？

original: Oh, right... you weren't invited to my party. Too bad, man. It was really fun.
translation: 哦，对……你没有被邀请来我聚会。太糟了，伙计。那真的很有趣。

original: Why are you still hanging around?
translation: 你为什么还在这？

original: Hey, uh, thanks for inviting me. Really cool party and everything.
translation: 嗨，呃，谢谢你邀请我。真是个不错的聚会。

original: I know that, uh, Butch and I give you a hard time, but you don't take that seriously, right?
translation: 我知道，呃，布奇和我找了你麻烦，但是，你不会记仇的，对吧？

original: Anyway, uh, happy birthday and everything. I better get back to, you know...
translation: 总之，呃，生日快乐。我最好回去了，你知道……

original: Get lost, butt-breath.
translation: 滚开，臭虫。

original: What's Butch's problem anyway? I can't believe he tried to start a fight at your own birthday party. What a jerk.
translation: 布奇怎么搞的？我真不敢相信他想要在你的生日聚会上和你打架。真是个蠢货。

original: Butch is such an idiot. Just ignore him.
translation: 布奇真是个白痴。别理他。

original: What happened with Butch? He looked awfully pleased with himself, which usually means something bad happened to somebody.
translation: 布奇怎么了？他看起来洋洋得意，通常这意味着有人遭殃了。

original: What'd Butch want? I thought you were in trouble there for a second.
translation: 布奇到底想干嘛？我想你刚才有点麻烦。

original: Happy birthday! We really surprised you, didn't we?
translation: 生日快乐！我们让你感到惊喜了，不是吗？

original: Ha ha. Your dad was afraid you were onto us. But I told him not to worry. You're so easy to fool.
translation: 哈哈，你爸爸担心你会看穿我们。但我告诉他别担心，你很容易糊弄。

original: Having fun, I hope?
translation: 开心吗？我希望。

original: Happy birthday!
translation: 生日快乐！

original: Go on, mingle!
translation: 继续！

original: Isn't this great?
translation: 这是不很棒？

original: Oh, hey, it's Jonas. Happy birthday! Sorry I couldn't be at your party. Listen, would you put your dad on?
translation: 哦，嗨，我是乔纳斯。生日快乐！抱歉我不能参加你的聚会。听着，你能让你爸爸听电话吗？

original: Can you put your dad on, please?
translation: 请让你爸爸听电话好吗？

original: What are you doing down here, young man? I thought kids weren't allowed down on the Reactor Level.
translation: 你下来这干嘛，年轻人？我想孩子不准下到反应堆层吧。

original: What are you doing down here, young lady? I thought kids weren't allowed down on the Reactor Level.
translation: 你下来这干嘛，小女孩？我想孩子不准下到反应堆层吧。

original: Your dad is waiting to give you your present. Or should we just keep it?
translation: 你爸爸正等着给你礼物，还是让我们留着它？

original: Happy birthday, buddy. I hope you have fun with it.
translation: 生日快乐，伙计。我希望你收到它会开心。

original: Happy birthday, darlin'. I hope you have fun with it.
translation: 生日快乐，亲爱的。我希望你收到它会开心。

original: Go on, shoot something for me!
translation: 去吧，找个目标打一枪。

original: Stand next to your dad and I'll get a nice picture of you and your new BB gun.
translation: 站在你爸爸旁边，我给你和你的新BB枪拍张照片。

original: Well, hello there. You look like you could use a rest.
translation: 嗯，你好。你看起来需要休息一下。

original: Oh, just look at my terrible manners! I'm Agatha. It's so nice to meet you.
translation: 哦，看我多没礼貌！我是阿加莎，很高兴见到你。

original: Mmmm-hmmm. What's that you're carrying? Is it something else to taunt me with?
translation: 唔。你拿着什么？还有什么要奚落我的？

original: I told you to get the hell out and I meant it!
translation: 见鬼，我告诉过你滚，快滚！

original: Sit down a spell and relax.
translation: 坐下歇歇，轻松一下。

original: You're a sight for these old eyes.
translation: 你让这些老顽固开了眼界。

original: Well, well. Look who the cat dragged in.
translation: 好，好。看哪个大人物来了。

original: You came to visit! You'll never guess what I found out in the Wastes, when I was supposed to be patrolling.
translation: 你来看看！你肯定想不到我在废土巡逻的时候发现了什么。

original: Here. This is for you.
translation: 给。这是给你的。

original: Oh, hi there! I'm Bittercup.
translation: 哦，你好！我是“苦杯”。

original: Oh, hey... I was just trying to think of a word that rhymes with "gloom"... hrm...
translation: 哦，嗨……我刚在想有什么词和“阴暗”押韵……嗯……

original: Yep. Still not dead. Unfortunately...
translation: 对。还没死，很不幸……

original: God, life is such a hassle, you know?
translation: 天啊，活着真麻烦，你懂吗？

original: Hey. Don't get any bright ideas about trying anything. We may not look it, but every one of us is a trained killer.
translation: 嗨，别想出什么鬼主意。可能我们看着不像，不过我们每个人都是受过训的杀手。

original: Oh, who am I kidding? Look, we're in trouble here. If you want to help, great. If not, just please don't kill anyone while you're here.
translation: 哦，我在和谁开玩笑？听着，我们在这有麻烦。如果你想帮忙，最好。如果不想，就请你待在这时不要杀任何人。

original: I heard how you helped out Timebomb. I'm not sure why you did it, but thanks.  I only hope that he lives long enough to appreciate your help.
translation: 我听说过你怎么帮助“定时炸弹”逃走。我不知道你为什么这么做，不过谢谢你。我只希望他能活到能感谢你的那天。

original: Now, did you need something?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: Yeah? What is it?
translation: 嗯？什么事？

original: What do you need, stranger?
translation: 你有什么需要，陌生人？

original: I'm on patrol here, what do you want?
translation: 我在这巡逻，你要干嘛？

original: The more time I spend talking to you, the less time I'm watching for raids.
translation: 我和你说得越久，观察歹徒行动的时间就越少。

original: Wha-? Jesus. I'm on the lookout here, don't sneak up on me like that. What do you want?
translation: 什么？天的。我现在在这放哨，不要这样偷偷接近我。你想要什么？

original: A visitor? Who'd want to visit this hell hole? I bet you're here to rape and pillage us. Aren't you? Aren't you?!
translation: 一个来访者？谁想来访这么个烂地方？我想你是来奸淫掳掠的吧，对吧？对吧？

original: Not that it matters. We're all Super Mutant snacks anyway.
translation: 这也没什么大不了的。反正我们都是超级变种人的点心了。

original: Unless you're here to help us, fuck off.
translation: 除非你是来帮我们的，要不就滚开。

original: You got a problem?
translation: 你有问题吗？

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Hrm? What? Oh... I'm sorry. My patient just passed away. He... he was my friend. I'm just... I'm a little out of it.
translation: 嗯？什么？噢……对不起。我的病人刚过世了。他……他是我朋友。我只是……心情有点失控。

original: I'll be alright though. What did you need?
translation: 不过我会没事的。你需要什么？

original: You remember my patient, Timebomb? He died. As far as I can tell, his injuries were just too much. I did my best, but... it wasn't enough.
translation: 你记得我的病人吗，“定时炸弹”？他死了。在我看来，是他的伤势太严重了。我已经尽力了，但是……还是救不了他。

original: I'll be alright though. What did you need?
translation: 不过我会没事的。你需要什么？

original: So, it turns out, Timebomb died. So I guess you were right. Still, he was my friend, and I had to try...
translation: 因此，结果“定时炸弹”死了。我认为你是正确的。不过，他曾是我朋友，我必须尝试……

original: I'll be alright though. What did you need?
translation: 不过我会没事的。你需要什么？

original: Wow. I can't believe that you were able to help Timebomb. And here I was sure that you were ready to just let him die. I guess I had you wrong.
translation: 哇。我不敢相信你能帮助“定时炸弹”。我本以为你一定会看着他死。看来我错看你了。

original: He still can't fight, but if we survive for a bit longer, he should be back into it soon enough.
translation: 他还不能战斗，但是如果我们能再坚持一段时间，他应该能很快恢复战斗力。

original: Look, you're a better doc than me, that's pretty obvious. But if you need healing, I'll do it for you no charge.
translation: 听着，很明显你的医术比我高超。但是如果你需要治疗，我可以免费提供。

original: Wow. I can't believe that you were able to help Timebomb. I thought he was done for.
translation: 哦。我不敢相信你竟能帮助“定时炸弹”。我还以为他已经完蛋了。

original: He still can't fight, but if we survive for a bit longer, he should be back into it soon enough.
translation: 他还不能战斗，但是如果我们能再坚持一段时间，他应该能很快恢复战斗力。

original: Look, you're a better doc than me, that's pretty obvious. But if you need healing, I'll do it for you no charge.
translation: 听着，很明显你的医术比我高超。但是如果你需要治疗，我可以免费提供。

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: What's up? Are you hurt?
translation: 怎么了？受伤了吗？

original: Woa, looks like you've seen some action. Do you need help?
translation: 哇，看起来你见过些大场面。你要帮助吗？

original: Are you hurt? You don't look hurt. What do you need?
translation: 受伤了吗？你看着不像。你需要什么？

original: Hey, pal. What's up?
translation: 嗨，伙计。你好吗？

original: Things are looking good here, bud.
translation: 这一切顺利，朋友。

original: Your fly's open! Haha, made ya look!
translation: 你的裤门开了！哈哈，看看你。

original: Heya! Whaddaya need?
translation: 哟！需要什么？

original: Damn... what... what happened?
translation: 该死……发生……发生什么事了？

original: Hey. Thanks again, man. I wouldn't be here if it wasn't for you.
translation: 嗨，再次感谢你，哥们。要没你我就完了。

original: Anything for you, man. What do you need?
translation: 随时为你效劳，哥们。你需要什么？

original: Hey, it's good to see you. Is there something I can do for you? Anything?
translation: 嗨，很高兴见到你。有什么可以帮到你的？

original: Welcome to Big Town. Not that there's much of a town left. Those Super Mutants keep kidnapping people.
translation: 欢迎来到大镇。可能剩下的已不能称之为是个镇子了。那些超级变种人一直在绑架这的人。

original: Hi there. Um, can I help you?
translation: 你好。嗯，我能帮你吗？

original: You need something?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: They're out there. I can feel it. Uh, what? You? I gave you the welcoming speech.
translation: 他们就在附近。我可以感觉的到。呃，什么？你？要我表示欢迎吗。

original: Watch the Wastes. Keep track of movement. Uh, what? Did you need something?
translation: 看着废土。跟上节奏。什么？你需要什么吗？

original: Greetings, fellow survivor! Another fine day in the Wastes, isn't it?
translation: 幸会，一起捡了条命的家伙！又一个废土上的好日子，对吧？

original: Greetings, fellow survivor! The great work of rebuilding humanity must go forward!
translation: 幸会，一起捡了条命的家伙！人性的重建工作必须向前推进！

original: Another Wasteland survivor, huh? Sorry, but I don't got enough to share. Get your own copy of the book and do your own hunting!
translation: 又一个废土幸存者，呃？抱歉，但是我没什么可以分享。拿着你自己的书本复件，然后自己去狩猎！

original: Glad to see a friendly face out here.
translation: 很高兴在这见到一张友善的面孔。

original: I swear, that damn book nearly ended me.
translation: 我发誓，这该死的书差点把我害死。

original: Whew! I thought I was a goner. You saved my life. Here, take this. It's the least I can do.
translation: 哟！我还以为我死定了呢。你救了我的命。来，拿着这。这是我唯一能做到的。

original: I'm afraid you're just bringing in too many slaves for us to keep up. Now Eulogy is pissed at us for not being as good as you.
translation: 我恐怕你抓了太多奴隶，让我们难以企及。因为我们没有你出色，现在尤勒基正对我们大发雷霆。

original: First rule of competition: you can't lose if your competitor is dead. So long, fucker.
translation: 比赛的第一个规矩：如果你的对手死了你就不会输。就这样，混蛋。

original: The hell do you want? We're busy.
translation: 见鬼，你想要什么？我们很忙。

original: Can I interest you in an extremely rare refreshment?
translation: 有兴趣来点极其罕见的提神饮品吗？

original: Look, I have business to get back to, so if you don't mind...
translation: 听着，我还有生意要回去做，所以，如果你不介意的话……

original: Quit gawking, smoothskin! We're headed over to Tenpenny Tower. We Ghouls own that place now. You smoothskins aren't allowed to live there anymore.
translation: 别傻看着，光皮肤！我们要去特佩尼大厦了。我们僵尸现在拥有那地方了，而你们这些光皮肤再也不被允许住在那了。

original: Quit gawking smoothskin! We’re on our way to Tenpenny Tower. You know anything about the tower?
translation: 别傻看着，光皮肤！我们要去特佩尼大厦。你知道那大厦吗？

original: We're done being oppressed by you smoothskins.
translation: 我们受够了你们这些光皮肤的压迫。

original: I was on my way to Megaton to do some trading when I heard somebody blew the place right off the map. Jesus.
translation: 当我听说兆吨镇在这地图上被炸飞的时候，我正准备去兆吨镇去做买卖。基督耶稣。

original: Don't even think about it. That Enclave tech is mine, fair and square.
translation: 想都别想。英克雷的科技是我的，公平公正。

original: Help yourself. I don't think messing with the Enclave is a good idea.
translation: 请自便。我不觉得招惹英克雷是个好主意。

original: I don't know about you, but those Enclave Eyebots give me the creeps.
translation: 我不了解你，但是英克雷的那些飞眼让我毛骨悚然。

original: You see these all over nowadays. I wonder what it means.
translation: 你看，现在这些东西到处都是。我想我知道这意味着什么。

original: That'll make for some nice, juicy steaks. If you like ant, that is.
translation: 那会做成美味多汁的肉排。我意思，如果你喜欢蚂蚁的话。

original: There's nothing better than fresh dog, don't you think? We'll be happy to set you up with something if you're hungry.
translation: 没什么东西能比新鲜狗肉更好吃了？如果你饿了，我们会很高兴给你弄点东西吃。

original: A bit gamey for my taste, but there's some folks that like a nice bit of Mole Rat. If you like it fresh, I'm selling...
translation: 就我的口味来说有点重，但是有些人喜欢地鼠美味的肉。如果你喜欢新鲜的，我会卖些……

original: Nasty brute, but tasty once you get the fur off.
translation: 肮脏的畜生，但只要你把皮剥了就会很好吃。

original: Hello, stranger. I'm Tinker Joe, premier supplier of robotic parts and service throughout the DC Wasteland.
translation: 你好，陌生人。我是廷克·乔，首都废土的机器人零件和服务的主要供应商。

original: Remember me? Tinker Joe, at your service. Robots for sale, robots serviced while you wait. Interested?
translation: 记得我吗？廷克·乔，为你服务。机器人销售，也有机器人服务。感兴趣吗？

original: Yes? Did you need something else?
translation: 嗯？你还有什么需要的？

original: I am not for sale. I am only a demonstration model. Tinker Joe will be glad to handle any of your robotic needs. Have a nice day.
translation: 我是非卖品，我只是个样机。廷克·乔会很高兴帮你解决机器人的需求问题。祝你愉快。

original: Damned shame about those slaves. Would've fetched us a nice pile of caps at Paradise Falls.
translation: 那些奴隶真可惜。会在堕落天堂给我们换来一大堆瓶盖。

original: Hey, we're looking for some slaves that ran off. Seen 'em? They can't have gone far.
translation: 嗨，我们在寻找一些逃跑的奴隶。见过他们吗？他们不会逃得太远。

original: We got away from the Slavers who were taking us to Paradise Falls, but they said our collars were explosive. Blow our heads off if we ran.
translation: 我们从那些想把我们带到堕落天堂的奴隶贩子手中逃了出来，但是他们说我们的项圈是炸弹。如果我们逃跑，就会炸飞我们的脑袋。

original: Do you think you can get this thing off of me before it's too late?
translation: 你觉得你能在爆炸前把这东西从我身上摘下来吗？

original: Thanks for not attacking us. Most people don't tolerate Ghouls.
translation: 谢谢你没有攻击我们。大多数人无法忍受僵尸。

original: Please, help me! You've got to get this collar off of me!
translation: 求求你，救救我！你得帮我把这项圈摘了！

original: Please... won't you help me?
translation: 求求你……能不能帮帮我？

original: Come on. Help me get this collar off. Please.
translation: 来吧，帮我把这项圈摘了，求求你。

original: Thank God you saved me!
translation: 谢谢！不管你是谁，谢谢！他们正商量要干掉我……

original: I'm heading to the Temple of the Union. They take care of escaped slaves.
translation: 我正准备去团结圣殿。那有人照顾逃跑的奴隶。

original: Maybe you could tell any other slaves you meet about it.
translation: 或许你能把这消息告诉其他你碰到的奴隶。

original: You saved me from those bastards. I won't forget it.
translation: 谢谢你，我的朋友，我们是不会忘记的。

original: Hey... hey, man. You need something? A little fix, maybe? Some Jet? I got Jet. Psycho too. Take a look!
translation: 嗨……嗨，哥们。你要什么？或许一些修理？一些杰特？我有杰特。还有疯狂药。来看看！

original: What do you need? I can get you a fix. Anything you want. Cheap, too! Check it out!
translation: 你要什么？我能提供一些修理。你想要的东西。便宜！来看看！

original: Hey man, relax. We can do business.
translation: 嗨，伙计，放松点。我们可以做个交易。

original: There rest of these guys around here might not want anything to do with you, but I got no problem with you... well, not with your caps at least.
translation: 其余那些家伙或许不愿和你打交道，但我可不介意……至少不介意和你的钱打交道。

original: Shh. Not too loud. I don't really want people to know that we're doin' business.
translation: 嘘。轻点。我可不想让别人知道我们在做交易。

original: There rest of these guys around here might not want anything to do with you, but I got no problem with you... well, not with your caps at least.
translation: 其余那些家伙或许不愿和你打交道，但我可不介意……至少不介意和你的钱打交道。

original: Hey, good to see you again. What do you need?
translation: 嗨，很高兴见到你！需要些什么？

original: I'm not in the mood for you, asshole.
translation: 没心情搭理你，你这混蛋！

original: Yeah, I remember you. What's up?
translation: 嗯，我记得你。什么事？

original: Whoa, whoa. Slow down there. This area's off limits to everyone but the Family. Where the hell do you think you're going?
translation: 哇，哇，等等。这区域除了家族成员，禁止其他人进入。你该死的想去哪儿？

original: Yeah? What do you want this time?
translation: 嗯？现在你要干嘛？

original: I thought I knew everyone in the Family, but I don't recognize you. You must be one of Vance's new initiates.
translation: 我想我认识家族的每个人，但我不认识你。你一定是万斯召的新人。

original: My name's Justin, I'm pretty new here myself.
translation: 我叫贾斯汀，是新来的。

original: Hello.
translation: 你好。

original: Well, well. I haven't had a customer in a while. Last one I had was a bit chewy... know what I mean?
translation: 好，好。我有一阵没顾客了。前一个客人挺难嚼的……明白我意思吧？

original: You gonna gawk all day or are you gonna buy something?
translation: 你是想整天傻看还是想买些东西？

original: I don't think I've met you yet. The name's Alan. What did you want?
translation: 我觉得我不认识你。我叫艾伦，你想要点什么？

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: Well, well. I'm surprised you don't know me. I'm Brianna. I... take care of the men around here. Well, unmarried ones anyway.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我很惊讶你居然不知道我。我是碧安娜。我……我照顾这的男人。呃，未婚的，总的来说。

original: Hey there.
translation: 嘿你好。

original: I don't think we've been properly introduced. I'm Holly... Vance's wife.
translation: 还没自我介绍呢。我是霍莉……万斯的妻子。

original: Whatcha need?
translation: 你要什么？

original: Always a pleasure. What can I do for you?
translation: 很荣幸。我能为你做些什么？

original: I trust your talk with young Ian went well.
translation: 我相信你和年轻的伊恩谈的很愉快。

original: I am quite interested in learning the results of your discussion. Did he come to a decision?
translation: 我对你们讨论的结果很感兴趣。他做出决定了吗？

original: I hear that you decided to speak to Ian regardless of my warnings.
translation: 我听说你无视我的警告，决定要和伊恩谈谈。

original: Be that as it may, I am still interested in what you conversed about. Did he come to a decision?
translation: 无论如何，我仍旧对你们谈话的内容感兴趣。他做出决定了吗？

original: Welcome to our home.
translation: 欢迎到我们的家。

original: My people call me Vance. I lead this group of weary travelers and outcasts who need a home.
translation: 我的人管我叫万斯。我带领着一群疲倦者旅行和放逐者，他们需要个家。

original: And to what do I owe the pleasure of your visit?
translation: 什么风把你吹来了？

original: You wish to speak to me again?
translation: 你想再和我谈谈？

original: Hey there, sweetie!
translation: 嗨，甜心！

original: Hello? Is this the mailman? Oh I do hope my fall catalog has arrived!
translation: 你好？是邮差吗？哦，我希望我的秋季目录到了！

original: You must be exhausted from all that walking in this horrible heat. Oh, and hungry too! Sit, please!
translation: 大热天走这么远一定累坏了吧。哦，也一定饿坏了！请坐！

original: Brailee Ewers is the name. Don't mind my husband Kenneth. He woke up on the wrong side of the bed this morning!
translation: 我是布莱利·尤尔斯。别在意我的丈夫肯尼斯。他从今早起床起就吃错药了！

original: Whatcha' need darling?
translation: 你要什么，亲爱的？

original: I'm sorry, but my husband told me to say that nobody's here.
translation: 我很抱歉，但我丈夫告诉我说这没人。

original: We aren't talking any more. Get out!
translation: 我们无话可说。出去！

original: What are you doing in here?
translation: 你在这里干什么？

original: What the hell are you doing in here?! Get the fuck out!
translation: 见鬼，你在这干嘛？！快他妈的滚出去！

original: Look, I want to be left alone. Can't you tell?
translation: 听着，我想单独待会。你听不见吗？

original: Yes? Who is it?
translation: 嗯？是谁？

original: It's nice to see a friendly new face around here. It's been a long time.
translation: 很高兴见到你。这已经很久没陌生人出现了。

original: The name's Karen Schenzy.
translation: 我是卡伦·森奇。

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Go away! You're not getting in here!
translation: 走开！不许你进来！

original: I thought I told you I didn't want to talk to you any more! I'm not going home and that's it!
translation: 我想我告诉过你别再和我说话！我不要回家，就这样！

original: I wanted to thank you one last time for what you've done for me.
translation: 再次感谢你为我所做的。

original: My brain feels like less of a mess now... I think I may be seeing clearly for the first time in years.
translation: 我现在感觉脑子不再那么混乱……我想这是我几年来第一次看清楚。

original: Don't worry about me... I've been through a lot, but I think I'm gonna be okay.
translation: 别担心我……虽然我经历了很多，但是我想我会好起来的。

original: Thanks again for helping me clear my thoughts.
translation: 再次感谢你让我恢复理智。

original: I thought I heard guns... what's going on? Who are you?
translation: 我想我听到了枪声……怎么回事？你是谁？

original: Huh? What do you want?
translation: 呃？你要什么？

original: Yeah? What is it this time?
translation: 嗯？这次要什么？

original: I thought I heard guns... what's going on? Who are you? You better tell me right now or I'll call for Vance!
translation: 我想我听到枪声……怎么回事？你是谁？你最好现在就告诉我，不然我会叫万斯！

original: Well, holy shit! You're back!
translation: 他妈的！你回来了！

original: What the hell happened out there?
translation: 见鬼，外面发生了什么事？

original: There he is... the hero of the day!
translation: 他在那……今天的英雄！

original: There she is... the heroine of the day!
translation: 她在那……今天的女英雄！

original: How's the search going? Any sign of Ian?
translation: 搜索有进展吗？有伊恩的行踪吗？

original: What did they tell you? Everyone ok?
translation: 他们和你说了什么？大家都好吗？

original: Don't you have some houses to be checking?
translation: 你还不快去检查下那些房子？

original: Hang on, you're not one of them. I nearly blasted you in two!
translation: 等下，你不是他们那伙的。我差点把你打成两半！

original: Get over here before they spot you.
translation: 在他们发现你前快点过来。

original: Now, what the hell are you doin' all the way out here?
translation: 见鬼，你大老远来这里干嘛？

original: You again, huh? What is it now?
translation: 又是你，呃？现在怎么了？

original: Please tell me you have some good news... I could use it.
translation: 请告诉我你有些好消息……对我有用的。

original: Any word about my brother? I'm worried sick!
translation: 有我弟弟的消息吗？我担心得快疯了！

original: I really appreciate you doing this for me. I'm feeling better already!
translation: 很感谢你为我所做的。我感觉好多了。

original: Did you need something else?
translation: 你还需要什么吗？

original: I don't recognize you. New in town or something?
translation: 我不认识你。新来的还是什么？

original: You still up for that job I was talking about?
translation: 你对我说过的那工作有兴趣吗？

original: What... who? You mean... are you for real? I'm safe?
translation: 什么……谁？你的意思……你说真的？我安全了？

original: I... I need to get out of here! Here, take these supplies. It's all I have, but they'll only slow me down.
translation: 我……我要离开这！来，拿着这些补给。我只有这些，而它们只会拖累我。

original: Thank you! Whoever you are, thank you! The... things they talked about doing to me...
translation: 谢谢！不管你是谁，谢谢！他们正商量要干掉我……

original: Look, I don't have anything to offer you except these supplies. I don't know why they didn't take it.
translation: 你看，除了这些补给，我没什么能给你的了。我不知道他们为什么不拿走。

original: I'm... I'm alive! I can't believe it! I'm alive!
translation: 我……我还活着！我不敢相信！我还活着！

original: Here, I managed to hide this stuff before they tied me up. You take it, it's the best I can do to thank you...
translation: 给，在他们捆住我之前，我设法把这藏了起来。你拿着，这是我能给你的最好谢礼了……

original: My... thank you! Thank you so much! I thought I was dead for sure!
translation: 天……谢谢！太谢谢你了！我以为我死定了！

original: Here, I managed to hide these supplies before they tied me up. You take them, it's the best I can do to thank you...
translation: 给，在他们捆住我之前，我设法把这藏了起来。你拿着，这是我能给你的最好谢礼了……

original: Oh my God! I thought I was dead! You saved me!
translation: 我的天！我以为我要死了！你救了我！

original: They dropped this stuff... Why don't you take it? It's all I have.
translation: 他们漏过了这……你为什么不拿走呢？我只有这些。

original: There's a bomb strapped to me! You've got to disarm it, quick!
translation: 有个炸弹绑在我身上！你得把它解除了，快！

original: Help me! I'm wired with explosives!
translation: 帮帮我！我身上被捆了个炸弹！

original: Help! This bomb is about to go off!
translation: 救命！这炸弹就要炸了！

original: Thanks! You saved my life!
translation: 谢谢！你救了我的命！

original: Alright. Let's go.
translation: 好吧。我们走。

original: Talk to-
translation: 交谈-

original: Salutations, Commander! Sergeant RL-3, Gutsy-class robotic soldier, reporting for duty!
translation: 敬礼，指挥官！RL-3中士，“勇敢”级机器人士兵，前来报到！

original: You will come to regret your actions.
translation: 你会为你的行为后悔的。

original: You should be proud of your accomplishment.
translation: 你该为自己的成就自豪。

original: I hope you're here to turn yourself in, young man. You're already in enough trouble as it is. Don't make it worse for yourself.
translation: 我希望你不要自添麻烦，年轻人。你已经有够多麻烦了，别让自己变得更糟。

original: I hope you're here to turn yourself in, young lady. You're already in enough trouble as it is. Don't make it worse for yourself.
translation: 我希望你不要自添麻烦，年轻人。你已经有够多麻烦了，别让自己变得更糟。

original: I have nothing else to say to you.
translation: 我没什么和你好说的。

original: Please, just go. I already said everything I had to say.
translation: 拜托走吧，我告诉你所有事了。

original: I'm waiting to make sure you leave. Now get going.
translation: 我等着你走呢，快走。

original: Leave me alone. I have to... take care of my father...
translation: 走开，我必须……照顾我父亲……

original: Go on! Before security comes. Be careful out there!
translation: 在警卫没来前快走！出门要小心！

original: I'm just waiting for you to leave so I can close the door and go back to pretending my life is perfect.
translation: 我在等你离开，这样我才能关上门，回去假装自己的人生是完美的。

original: There's nothing else for you here. You're an outsider now. You know, the people who are supposed to stay on the other side of this door.
translation: 这没你想要的了，你是外来人了。你知道，就是那种该待在这扇门外的人。

original: Please, you need to go before someone comes. Be careful out there.
translation: 拜托，在有人来之前你必须走，出门要小心。

original: I thought you didn't need my help. The door's open. Go through it.
translation: 我想你不需要我的帮助。门开着，走出去吧。

original: You told me to get out of your way, so I'm going. Goodbye.
translation: 你叫我别挡路，那我让就开，再见。

original: Don't bother trying to apologize. Just get out of here before it's too late!
translation: 别费心来道歉，赶快离开这！

original: You've got to get out of here. Someone's sure to come see what's going on. Take care!
translation: 你得离开这，肯定有人会过来看发生了什么。保重！

original: Good. You're leaving. I guess you were trying to help me. But you... You didn't have to kill him!
translation: 好，你还是走吧。我想你原来打算保护我的，但你也不必杀了他啊！

original: I didn't think I would make it... My father, he... Officer Mack... I didn't tell them anything, I swear...
translation: 我不认为那是我做的……我父亲……他……麦克警员……我什么事都没告诉他们，我发誓。

original: When the warning sirens came on, they all ran out. I guess that was you. I see you got the door open. That's good.
translation: 当警报汽笛响起来，他们都跑了出去。我想那是你。我看见你打开了门。太好了。

original: Were you going to leave without even saying goodbye?
translation: 你难道不说声再见就走吗？

original: You did it! You opened the door! My God, I almost didn't believe it was possible.
translation: 你做到了！你打开了门！我的天啊，我简直不敢相信你做到了。

original: My God, what have you done? You killed him! Why would you kill my father?
translation: 我的天啊，你都做了些什么？你杀了他！你为什么要杀我父亲？

original: Get away from me! I can't talk to you right now.
translation: 离我远点！我现在不能和你说话。

original: Oh my God. I had no idea my father would... I had no choice. Officer Mack, he...
translation: 哦，我的天啊。我不知道我的父亲会……我没得选择，麦克警员，他……

original: Here. Take it. I don't want it any more. I don't know what I'd do if still had the gun and my father came looking for me.
translation: 来，拿着。我不需要它了。我可不想我父亲来找我时，我手里还拿着枪。

original: Thank God you came along when you did. I don't know what I might have done...
translation: 感谢上帝你赶来，我不知道自己会怎样做……

original: Here. Take the gun. I don't want to find out what I'd do if I still had the gun when my father comes looking for me.
translation: 来，拿着枪。我可不想我父亲来找我时，我手里还拿着枪。

original: You'd better get out of here. I'll try to meet you at the vault door. If I don't make it... good luck.
translation: 你最好离开这。我会设法在避难所大门和你碰头，如果我不行的话……祝你好运。

original: Thank you! I told you my father wasn't himself. I don't know what he might have done if you hadn't come along.
translation: 谢谢！我告诉过你我父亲已经变了。如果你没来，我不知道他会干嘛。

original: You'd better get out of here. I'll try to meet you at the vault door. If I don't make it... good luck.
translation: 你最好离开这。我会设法在避难所大门和你碰头，如果我不行的话……祝你好运。

original: You need to go. I'll try to meet you by the vault door. Be careful.
translation: 你最好离开这，我会设法在避难所大门和你碰头。小心。

original: You need to get moving. And be careful -- the security men are everywhere.
translation: 你得快走。小心 — 到处都是警卫。

original: Come on, you've got to wake up!
translation: 快，快醒醒！

original: Well, look who's come crawling back. What do you want?
translation: 好，看谁回来了。你想要干嘛？

original: Back again? Did you forget something?
translation: 又回来了？你是不是有健忘症？

original: What are you waiting for? You said you'd help her!
translation: 你在等什么？你说你会帮她！

original: You coming too? Hey, I could sure use some help. Come on!
translation: 你也来了？嗨，我还真缺帮手，来吧！

original: It's no use! I've got to get away from these damned roaches!
translation: 没用！我得从这些该死的蟑螂堆里离开。

original: Did you change your mind? Are you going to help my mom after all?
translation: 你改主意了？你能帮我妈妈吗？

original: We did it! My mom's gonna be okay! You're the best friend I've ever had, man!
translation: 我们做到了！我妈妈安全了！你是我这辈子最好的朋友，伙计！

original: Hey, I know it isn't much, but I want you to have my Tunnel Snakes jacket. Go ahead, take it.
translation: 嗨，我知道这不算什么，但拿上我的穴蛇帮夹克吧，给。

original: You're the best, man. The best. Everything's gonna be okay now, thanks to you!
translation: 你最棒了，伙计。最棒的，都好了，谢谢你！

original: She's dead! She's dead and you could have helped and you didn't. Get away from me!
translation: 她死了！她死了！你能帮她可你没有，离我远点！

original: Just go away and leave me alone.
translation: 走开，让我自己待会。

original: You gotta help me! My mom's trapped in there with the Radroaches!
translation: 你得帮帮我！我妈妈被那些辐射蟑螂困住了！

original: You're lucky it was me who found you. The others won't be so forgiving.
translation: 你很幸运，是我找到了你。其他人可不会那么慈悲。

original: I don't know what you're up to and I don't want to know. Just clear out of here and I'll pretend I never saw you.
translation: 我不知道你想干嘛，我也不想知道。走开吧，我会假装没见过你。

original: Come on, kid, get out of here before you get us both killed!
translation: 快啊，孩子，离开这，趁你现在还没把我们俩都害死！

original: Just keep your hands where I can see them.
translation: 把双手放在我能看见的地方。

original: Where did those ... things... come from? Ugh. I need another drink.
translation: 这些东西……从……哪来的？呃，我还得喝一杯。

original: Come on, sit down and have a drink with me.
translation: 来吧，坐下来和我喝一杯。

original: God! I could really use a drink right now!
translation: 天啊！现在真的得好好喝一杯！

original: Me and Andy were in a tight spot there, ain't no mistake. Good thing he loves toasting roaches so much.
translation: 我和安迪严密监视着那，不能有错误。他热爱烤蟑螂。

original: I'm not sure how I could help.
translation: 我不确定我能帮上什么。

original: Those nasty roaches have gotten my circuits in such a frazzle!
translation: 那些恶心的蟑螂把我的电路搞得一团糟！

original: We're getting out of here. Now's our chance!
translation: 我们得离开这，现在是我们的机会！

original: Tom wouldn't listen to me. You know how he gets.
translation: 汤姆不会听我的，你知道他的为人。

original: Think you can take charge of the gang by getting rid of me?
translation: 你以为除掉我就能接管帮派？

original: Hey, man. Can I come with you again? This place sucks.
translation: 嗨，伙计。我能再次跟随你吗？这地方真糟。

original: About time you got back. I got a full clip and an empty flask. Time we fixed that, huh?
translation: 你也该回来了。我有一个满仓弹夹和一个空瓶子。我们开始修理，呃？

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: What's the story, my fellow Tunnel Snake?
translation: 什么事，我的穴蛇帮伙计？

original: You got something to say to the Butch-man?
translation: 你有话要对布奇大人说？

original: Physical violence on your part invalidates our contract.
translation: 要是你对我使用暴力的话，我们的合约就失效了。

original: You return. Shall I join you once again?
translation: 你回来了。我能再次加入你吗？

original: You return. Shall I join you once again?
translation: 你回来了。我能再次加入你吗？

original: I don't like the look of this place.
translation: 我不喜欢这地方的样子。

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: Yes? What is it?
translation: 是吗？什么事？

original: Oh, it's been too long since I got to play rough.
translation: 哦，我已经好久没有动真格的了。

original: Oh! You came back! Do you want me to back you up, lover?
translation: 哦！你回来了！爱人，要我作你的后盾吗？

original: Can we go yet?
translation: 我们能走了吗？

original: Can I do something for you? Or... to you?
translation: 能为你做什么吗？或者……与你？

original: Yes, lover?
translation: 是的，爱人？

original: Bottlecap for your thoughts.
translation: 你想要的瓶盖。

original: <growl!>
translation: <咆哮！>

original: <pant> <pant>
translation: <喘气><喘气>

original: <pant> <pant>
translation: <喘气><喘气>

original: <bark>
<bark!>
translation: <吠叫！>

original: <bark>
<bark> <bark!>
Oh, fuck no. I don't take that shit from anyone. You're dead!
translation: 哦，他妈的不。谁他妈也别想对我这样。你死定了！

original: What the fuck, man? I've been standing here forever!
translation: 他妈的什么事，伙计？我一直都站在这！

original: Yeah? What is it?
translation: 嗯？什么事？

original: What're we standing around here for when there's plenty of action around?
translation: 周围都是战斗，我们傻站在这干嘛？

original: Yeah, kid? What do you need?
translation: 嗯，孩子？你要什么？

original: Yeah, I know what you're thinkin'. Boo hoo. Megaton blew up.
translation: 嗯，我知道你在想什么。哼哼，兆吨镇爆炸了。

original: These fuckers deserved what they got.
translation: 这是那些混账应得的。

original: Now, can we get out of here? Or should I just keep waiting next to this stinking hole?
translation: 现在，我们能出去了吗？或者我是不是该在这臭洞边上等？

original: Can we get out of here? Or should I just keep waiting next to this stinking hole?
translation: 我们能出去了吗？或者我是不是该这臭洞边上等？

original: Yeah? What the fuck do you want now?
translation: 嗯？你他妈的现在要什么？

original: It saddens me that it has come to this. Farewell, my friend.
translation: 事情变成这样让我很悲哀。回见，我的朋友。

original: I had hoped you'd return. What now?
translation: 我曾经希望你会回来。现在呢？

original: You have something to say?
translation: 你有话要说？

original: What have you got on your mind?
translation: 你在想些什么？

original: Something troubling you, my friend?
translation: 你有麻烦，我的朋友？

original: Something troubling you, my friend?
translation: 你有麻烦，我的朋友？

original: If you're going to get yourself killed out here, you mind doing it further away from our bunker?
translation: 如果你想出去送命，可否离我们的地堡远点再死？

original: I don't want your corpse stinking up our little patch of heaven.
translation: 我可不想你的尸体把我们的一小块天堂熏臭了。

original: Shut up. Kinda busy.
translation: 闭嘴。有点忙。

original: Back to stare in awe at the Outcasts? Don't you have something better to do, kid?
translation: 回去敬畏地凝视放逐者？你没更好的事可做吗，孩子？

original: Defender Rococo Rockfowl, at your service.
translation: 守卫者洛可可·罗克浮，为你效劳。

original: Might want to watch your head around here, miss.
translation: 在这得管好自己，小姐。

original: Defender Rococo Rockfowl, at your service.
translation: 守卫者洛可可·罗克浮，为你效劳。

original: Gotta be careful out here, mister.
translation: 在这得小心，先生。

original: Hey. Make it quick, huh?
translation: 嗨。快点，呃？

original: I'm Protector Henry Casdin, leader of the Outcasts. This had better be good.
translation: 我是守护者亨利·卡斯丁，放逐者的首领。最好解释下你来找我的原因。

original: Normally, I wouldn't be wasting my time talking to a local, but Morgan tells me you can make yourself useful.
translation: 通常，我不会浪费时间去和当地居民谈话，但摩根告诉我你有点用处。

original: So, interested in collecting technology for us?
translation: 有兴趣为我们搜集科技吗？

original: Changed your mind about the job, yet?
translation: 对工作改变主意了吗？

original: Well, look who it is. What have you got for us, today?
translation: 看这是谁。今天你给我们带来了什么？

original: If it isn't our local scavenger-for-hire. What've you found for us, today?
translation: 这不是我们雇佣的拾荒人吗。今天你给我们带来了什么？

original: Always good to see you. What have you brought for us?
translation: 总是很高兴看到你。你给我们带来了什么？

original: Ah, good to see you back. What've you got for us today?
translation: 喔，看到你回来真好。今天你给我们带来了什么？

original: Hold on! You're a new face, and around here, new faces tend to get shot.
translation: 站住！你的面孔在这很生。生面孔很可能会吃子弹。

original: You'd better explain yourself, before I have to ask again, with lead.
translation: 在我用子弹问你前，你最好自己解释一下。

original: I suggest you get going now, before I start shooting.
translation: 在我开枪前，你现在赶快给我滚。

original: You had your warning.
translation: 我警告过你。

original: My name's Clover. I hear you're the new man in my life.
translation: 我叫可萝尔。我听说你是我人生中的新男人。

original: You're looking for a bodyguard, and I'm looking for a body. Sounds like we're going to have some fun times, lover.
translation: 你在找保镖，而我在找肉体。看来我们会有些开心的日子，亲爱的。

original: My name's Clover. I hear you're the new woman in my life.
translation: 我叫可萝尔。我听说你是我人生中的新女人。

original: You're looking for a bodyguard, and I'm looking for a body. Sounds like we're going to have some fun times, lover.
translation: 你在找保镖，而我在找肉体。看来我们会有些开心的日子，亲爱的。

original: A3-21... awaiting initialization protocol parameters...
translation: A3-21……等待初始化协议参数……

original: Look, no offense, but I've got some heavy things to think about. Just go tell Zimmer I'm waiting for him.
translation: 听着，无意冒犯，但是我想到一些重要的事。去告诉齐默我等着他。

original: Look. I appreciate you're helping with Zimmer, but I really just want to put this all behind me. So I'm going to pretend none of that happened.
translation: 听着，我感谢你帮助了齐默，但是我真的不想知道。所以我会假装什么都没发生。

original: Now, is there something I can help you with citizen?
translation: 现在，有什么事要我帮忙，公民？

original: You've been rather busy lately. Asking questions. "Investigating." So, is that it? You're some kind of investigator? A detective for hire?
translation: 你最近相当忙呀。不停地问问题，搞“调查”。出什么事了？你是调查员？受雇的侦探？

original: Or do you have some kind of personal grudge against an innocent android who simply wants to be left alone? Please, tell me. I'd really like to know.
translation: 还是你和一个只想清静的无辜仿真人，有什么私人恩怨？请告诉我，我真的很想知道。

original: Was there something else?
translation: 还有什么事？

original: You did a good thing, delivering that component to Zimmer. Telling him the android was dead. For that, I'm going entrust you with some information.
translation: 你做了好事，把零件给了齐默。告诉他人造人已经死了。为此，我会将一些信息委托给你。

original: The android's transformation was done by a man named Pinkerton, here in Rivet City. He's hidden down in the broken fore section of the ship.
translation: 人造人的改造是铆钉城一个叫做平克顿的人完成的。他藏在断裂的船头。

original: You'll need to swim to reach him, but if you're inclined, Pinkerton can perform a facial reconstruction on you as well.
translation: 你得游过去找到他，但是如果你被他看中，平克顿也会对你进行面部改造。

original: It won't disguise your identity, but you'll be able to experience life in a new skin, and truly understand... that we're all human on the inside.
translation: 那不会改变你的本质，但是你能用新面孔来体验生活，而且请理解……在我们内心，我们都是人类。

original: We'd best not be seen speaking with each other further. If you want a new face, see Pinkerton, down in the flooded fore section  of the carrier.
translation: 我们最好不要被人看见互相交流。如果你要张新面孔，去见平克顿，在航母被淹掉的船体前部。

original: The android's transformation was done by a man named Pinkerton, here in Rivet City. He's hidden down in the broken fore section of the ship.
translation: 人造人的改造是铆钉城一个叫做平克顿的人完成的。他藏在断裂的船头。

original: You'll need to swim to reach him, but if you're inclined, Pinkerton can perform a facial reconstruction on you as well.
translation: 你得游过去找到他，但是如果你被他看中，平克顿也会对你进行面部改造。

original: It won't disguise your identity, but you'll be able to experience life in a new skin, and truly understand... that we're all human on the inside.
translation: 那不会改变你的本质，但是你能用新面孔来体验生活，而且请理解……在我们内心，我们都是人类。

original: Our dealings are done. I must ready myself for the journey back to the Commonwealth. Now if you don't mind...
translation: 我们的交易完成。我必须为回到联邦的旅程做准备。现在，如果你不介意的话……

original: Wow! What luck!
translation: 哇！真幸运！

original: I'm Sticky. Forget these little kids. I'll take you to Big Town where the mungos -- err, I mean, where the grownups live. I'm headed there now.
translation: 我是斯蒂奇。忘了这些小孩。我会带你去大镇，那些毛人 — 呃，我的意思是那些大人住的地方。我现在就带你去。

original: Hey mungo. This is an A B conversation so C your way out.
translation: 嗨，毛人，这是A和B的谈话，所以C请自便。

original: Are you sure you know where you're going? I mean... you look kinda like you might be lost?
translation: 你确定你知道自己要去哪吗？我的意思是……你看上去好像迷路了？

original: Are we there yet?
translation: 我们到了吗？

original: I can't wait to get to Big Town!
translation: 我迫不及待地要去大镇！

original: You want to go to Big Town? Of course you do!
translation: 你想去大镇？你当然想！

original: Yeah! I made it to Big Town! Big Town! Hurray! Now I just need to find Red.
translation: 耶！我到大镇了！大镇！万岁！现在我需要找到瑞德。

original: Can't talk now. We've heard Slavers are attacking.
translation: 现在不能聊天。听说奴隶贩子正在攻击我们。

original: Go away! Hannibal is waiting for you.
translation: 走开！汉尼拔在等你。

original: What are we going to do? Those Slavers have captured the Memorial.
translation: 我们现在要去干嘛？那些奴隶贩子占领了纪念馆。

original: My feet are sore. It's a long way to the Lincoln Memorial
translation: 我的脚很痛。到林肯纪念馆的路真长。

original: Hannibal says you're on our side. My name is Alejandra.
translation: 汉尼拔说你是站在我们这边的。我叫亚历山德拉。

original: What? Oh! I didn't see you there. I get that way sometimes when I'm thinking.
translation: 什么？哦！我没看见你在那。当我思考的时候我有时会过于专注。

original: Excuse me, sir. I can't talk now. Slavers could any moment.
translation: 对不起，先生。我现在不能聊天。奴隶贩子随时会打进来。

original: Excuse me, ma'am. I can't talk now. Slavers could any moment.
translation: 对不起，女士。我现在不能聊天。奴隶贩子随时会打进来。

original: I don't talk to strangers. You need to go talk to Hannibal.
translation: 我不和陌生人说话。你去和汉尼拔谈吧。

original: Please, sir. Help us get rid of all those Slavers in the Memorial.
translation: 求求你，先生。帮我们把那些占领纪念馆的奴隶贩子赶走吧。

original: Please, ma'am. Help us get rid of all those Slavers in the Memorial.
translation: 求求你，女士。帮我们把那些占领纪念馆的奴隶贩子赶走吧。

original: I hope our brahmin survives this trip.
translation: 我希望我们的双头牛能在这次旅程中活下来。

original: My name is Bill. Bill Seward, if you please, sir.
translation: 我叫比尔。比尔·苏华德，为你效劳，先生。

original: My name is Bill. Bill Seward, if you please, ma'am.
translation: 我叫比尔。比尔·苏华德，为你效劳，女士。

original: Yes, sir. What can I do for you sir?
translation: 是的，先生，能为你做点什么，先生？

original: Yes, ma'am. What can I do for you ma'am?
translation: 是的，女士。能为你做点什么，女士？

original: Not now. We can talk after the Slaver attack.
translation: 现在不行。等奴隶贩子攻击结束后我们再谈。

original: Don't you be stopping here, mister. You got to talk to Hannibal first.
translation: 别说了，先生。你先去和汉尼拔谈谈。

original: Don't you be stopping here, lady. You got to talk to Hannibal first.
translation: 别说了，小姐。你先去和汉尼拔谈谈。

original: We've got to get those Slavers cleared out of the Memorial.
translation: 我们必须把纪念堂里的奴隶贩子都消灭了。

original: I'm sure Hannibal is cooking up a plan.
translation: 我确信汉尼拔正在酝酿一个计划。

original: This is a glorious day. We will rebuild Lincoln's Memorial. I hope I can reattach his head.
translation: 真是荣耀的一天。我们将重建林肯纪念堂。我希望我能把他的头再接上。

original: I'm sure Hannibal is cooking up a plan.
translation: 我确信汉尼拔正在酝酿一个计划。

original: You're new. I'm Caleb. If you're going to be staying a while, I could use some help.
translation: 你是新来的吧。我是卡勒布。如果你愿意留下，我倒是缺帮手。

original: You have a picture! And such a large one, too.
translation: 你有张照片！好大的一张。

original: I'll have no problems restoring the Memorial with this. Thank you!
translation: 对我来说，用这来修复纪念堂一点问题都没有。谢谢！

original: Make it quick. I've got a lot of work to do.
translation: 快点。我还有很多工作要做。

original: Those Slavers are all dead. We must stay vigilant. There may be more of them.
translation: 那些奴隶贩子都死了。我们必须保持警惕。可能还会来更多的。

original: We got wind that the Slavers are going to attack. We could really use your help in the fight.
translation: 我们得到风声，奴隶贩子准备攻击。我们在这场战斗中确实需要你的帮助。

original: Ah, a visitor. Welcome to the Temple of the Union.
translation: 啊，一位来访者。欢迎来到团结圣殿。

original: I'm not going to ask you who you are. For the moment, I don't care.
translation: 我不会问你是谁。现在我不关心这。

original: We are all escaped slaves. I need your solemn promise not to betray us to Paradise Falls or the Slavers.
translation: 我们都是逃跑的奴隶。我要你发誓绝不把我们出卖给堕落天堂或奴隶贩子。

original: Until I get that, you cannot leave here. So, do I have your word?
translation: 在此之前，你哪都不能去。那么，你愿意发誓吗？

original: Are you ready to pledge your allegiance?
translation: 你准备好遵守诺言了吗？

original: Everything is done? I can hardly believe it. We are finally going to realize the dream!
translation: 搞定了？真不敢相信。我们终于实现了梦想！

original: We'll start out within the hour. We'll meet you at the site.
translation: 我们立刻出发。我们会在遗址等你。

original: I hear you found a great picture for Caleb. Once the Memorial site is safe, we can move there.
translation: 我听说你帮卡勒布找到张很棒的照片。只要纪念堂遗址安全了，我们就能到那去了。

original: So the Super Mutants are dead? This is wonderful news!
translation: 超级变种人死了？真是个好消息！

original: Now all you have to do is get Caleb his picture and we can begin our journey.
translation: 现在你要做的就是帮卡勒布拿到他的照片，然后我们就能开始我们的旅程。

original: Slavers! They're holed up in the Memorial.
translation: 奴隶贩子！他们占领了纪念堂。

original: In a moment we will charge them. We will have liberty or we will have death! Join with us to defeat evil!
translation: 我们立刻要向他们进攻。我们不是自由就是死亡！加入我们，战胜邪恶！

original: Those Slavers are still in control of the Memorial.
translation: 那些奴隶贩子还控制着纪念堂。

original: Is it time for us to attack yet?
translation: 是我们开始进攻的时候了吗？

original: We made it! The Memorial is really ours! I cannot thank you enough.
translation: 我们成功了！纪念堂是我们的了！我真不知道该怎么感谢你。

original: Here, take this. It's a token of our thanks.
translation: 来，拿着这。这代表我们的谢意。

original: Thanks to you, we are able to make this journey.
translation: 谢谢你，因为你我们才完成了这旅程。

original: We will rebuild the great Memorial to Lincoln and give hope to slaves everywhere!
translation: 我们要重建这伟大的林肯纪念堂，也给各地的奴隶带去希望！

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: You have been good to your word. You are welcome at the Temple of the Union anytime.
translation: 你言而有信。欢迎你随时来到团结圣殿。

original: Take these schematics as a token of our gratitude.
translation: 拿着这些设计图，这是我们给你的谢礼。

original: Ah! It is our newest brother! What can I do for you?
translation: 啊！是我们的新兄弟！我能为你做些什么？

original: Ah! It is our newest sister! What can I do for you?
translation: 啊！是我们的新姐妹！我能为你做些什么？

original: I'm Leroy Walker, and you're probably wondering about what we're doing here.
translation: 我是乐瑞·沃克，你大概很好奇我们在这干嘛。

original: Yeah, I killed them all after telling you not to.
translation: 嗯，在叫你别动手之后，我把他们都杀了。

original: I just couldn't trust anyone else to do it. I needed to see them dead with my own eyes.
translation: 我只是不能信任其他人去做。我要亲眼看他们死掉。

original: Anyway, the problem has been taken care of. I can go back to Paradise Falls now.
translation: 总之，问题解决了。我现在能回堕落天堂了。

original: I'll make sure they know you're our kind of people. You'll be welcome there any time.
translation: 我会让他们知道你是我们一伙的。那随时欢迎你。

original: You just couldn't wait for us, could you? Well, at least they're all dead. Guess I'll go back to Paradise Falls.
translation: 你只是不能等我们，对吧？至少他们都死了。我想我该回堕落天堂了。

original: We are just about to wipe out this Temple of the Union. You can join us or not. It makes no difference to me.
translation: 我们正要扫荡团结圣殿。你可以加入我们，也可以不加入。对我来说没什么两样。

original: We're preparing for a slave attack. Just stay out of the way.
translation: 我们准备向奴隶发动进攻。别挡路。

original: So did you find any Lincoln artifacts in the Museum?
translation: 你在博物馆里找到了什么林肯遗物吗？

original: Is there something else?
translation: 还有什么事吗？

original: Not now. Slavers are out there somewhere, preparing to attack.
translation: 现在不行。奴隶贩子正在某处准备发动攻击。

original: Now, beat it! Hannibal is waiting for you.
translation: 现在，快去！汉尼拔在等你。

original: What's your business stranger?
translation: 你有什么事，陌生人？

original: You again. Don't dawdle. Get in here.
translation: 又是你。别浪费时间。快进来。

original: You ain't supposed to be looking at me, to say nothing of talking to me.
translation: 你不该找我，更别说和我谈话了。

original: Now, beat it! Hannibal is waiting for you.
translation: 现在，快去！汉尼拔在等你。

original: Goddamn Slavers have the Memorial.
translation: 该死的奴隶贩子占领了纪念堂。

original: As soon as Hannibal gives the word, we're going to charge in there and take it from them.
translation: 只要汉尼拔一声令下，我们就去进攻那，把它从他们手里夺回来。

original: Stay sharp. The Wasteland is dangerous.
translation: 保持警惕。废土很危险。

original: You don't look like much, stranger. Bet you run from Radroaches.
translation: 你看上去不是很像，陌生人。我打赌你看见蟑螂都会跑。

original: I'm Simone Cameron. Don't fuck with me. Hannibal says I can't shoot you, but I ain't trusting you with a gun to my back.
translation: 我是西蒙妮·卡梅隆。别和我对着干。汉尼拔告诉我不能对你开枪，但你在我身后拿着枪令我不舒服。

original: Are you trying to piss me off?
translation: 你想把我惹火？

original: That's close enough. What the hell are you doing wandering around here?
translation: 真够悬的。见鬼，你在这游荡做什么？

original: Keep moving. Mister Walker is waiting.
translation: 快走。沃克先生在等你。

original: Oh. You again.
translation: 哦，又是你。

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: I heard you're going to help us get those runaways.
translation: 我听说你准备帮我们抓住那些逃跑的家伙。

original: Make it quick. I'm busy.
translation: 快点，我很忙。

original: Well, if it isn't "my hero," the guy who sprang me from the Vault! I think I owe this man a drink!
translation: 哟，这不是帮我逃出避难所的“英雄”嘛！我想我欠这男人一杯酒！

original: Well, if it isn't my best gal, the one who sprung me from the Vault! I think I owe this lovely lady a drink!
translation: 哟，这不是帮我逃出避难所的“女神”嘛！我想我欠这可爱的女士一杯酒！

original: How's it hanging?
translation: 最近怎样？

original: Hey, what's the word?
translation: 嗨，想说什么？

original: Stay away from me! This is all your fault!
translation: 离我远点！这都是你的错！

original: Wow, who would have thought I'd run into you out here? It's a small world... but not as small as the Vault, I guess!
translation: 哇，谁能想到我会在这撞上你？这世界太小了……但是我猜再小也没避难所小！

original: I really do have to get back to the vault. Good to see you again, though.
translation: 我真的必须回避难所了。虽然我很高兴又能见到你。

original: What have you done? The Vault is done for!
translation: 你干了什么？避难所已经废了！

original: What are we going to do now? You've ruined everything!
translation: 我们现在怎么办？你把一切都毁了！

original: This is all your fault! You've ruined the Vault! You'll pay!
translation: 全是你的错！你把避难所都毁了！你会付出代价的！

original: You did me a great favor with those keys. How do you like my new armor? Those keys led me right to it.
translation: 很感激你帮我拿到了钥匙，喜欢我的新装甲吗？那些钥匙让我得到了它。

original: You stole what was rightfully mine! Get lost.
translation: 你偷的是我的东西！快滚！

original: You did me a great favor with those keys. I know just how to use them.
translation: 很感激你帮我拿到了钥匙。我知道怎么用它们。

original: Thanks for not croaking me, dude.
translation: 谢谢你没对我发牢骚，伙计。

original: Hey! It's my favorite wanker! I so fucking glad I talked you out of putting a bullet in my brain. Hah ha!
translation: 嗨！是我最喜欢的卑鄙家伙！我他妈的真高兴，打消了你要把子弹打进我脑袋的想法，哈哈！

original: Hey! It's my favorite bitch assassin! Hah ha! I so fucking glad I talked you out of putting a bullet in my brain!
translation: 嗨！是我最喜欢的婊子刺客！哈哈！我他妈的真高兴，打消了你要把子弹打进我脑袋的想法！

original: I presume you are still honoring our previous arrangement? I enjoy being alive, at least for the moment.
translation: 我猜你还在为我们先前的安排而自豪？我很高兴还活着，至少现在是。

original: I'm guessing that you've come about the notice. You know, I've heard about you.
translation: 我猜你是为传闻来的。你知道，我听说过你。

original: You're not bad people, from what I understand. And the Regulators can always use good folks.
translation: 据我所知，你不是个坏人。赏金猎人总是欢迎好人。

original: So, what do you say? You read the notice, and you're here, so I'm guessing that you want to ride with us. Am I right?
translation: 你怎么说？你读了通知，就来了这里。我觉得你是想和我们一起行动，对吧？

original: You live the life of a Regulator. You're an example to all.
translation: 当上赏金猎人，你就是所有人的榜样了。

original: Word reaches across the Wastes of your deeds. I am honored to have you among us.
translation: 你的行为传遍废土，有你加入让我觉得很荣耀。

original: It's always good to see one of our number here. Have you brought tales and trophies of justice?
translation: 真高兴在这见到我们的一员，你带来了正义的传说和战利品吗？

original: The Regulators welcome you back.
translation: 赏金猎人欢迎你回来。

original: The unrighteous will be punished.
translation: 邪恶将被净化。

original: We bring law to a lawless land.
translation: 我们把法律带到了无法无天的土地。

original: We are justice. We are the law.
translation: 我们就是正义，我们就是法律。

original: Sonora is our leader. Speak with her.
translation: 索诺拉是我们的领袖。去和她谈谈。

original: Stay true to yourself and to the law. This is the rule of the Regulator.
translation: 保持诚实，遵守法律。这是赏金猎人的宗旨。

original: Surely you have someplace better to be than hanging around my classroom?
translation: 你去别处肯定好过在我的教室里游荡。

original: They say the G.O.A.T. never lies... According to this, you're slated to be the next vault chaplain. God help us all.
translation: 据说G.O.A.T.从不出错……根据结果，你将成为下任避难所牧师。上帝保佑。

original: Well, according to this, you're in line to be trained as a Laundry Cannon Operator. First time for everything, indeed.
translation: 根据结果，你接下来要受训成为一名洗衣机操作员。凡事总有第一次。

original: It's nice to know I can still be surprised. Pedicurist! I might have guessed manicurist or even masseuse, but apparently you're a foot person.
translation: 很高兴我还能感到惊喜。修脚师！我原以为你会是美甲师或按摩师，但看起来你是个脚踏实地的人。

original: It says here you're perfectly suited for a career as a Waste Management Specialist. A specialist, mind you, not just a dabbler. Congratulations!
translation: 结果显示你很适合成为一名废弃物处理专家。专家，看到没，可不是业余的。恭喜你！

original: Huh. "Vault Loyalty Inspector"... I thought that had been phased out decades ago. Well, sounds like a job right up your alley, hmm?
translation: 呃。“避难所忠诚度调查员”……我还以为这职业几十年前就被淘汰了。好吧，听起来是个很适合你的职业，对吧？

original: Interesting. "Clinical Test Subject"... sounds like something you should excel at. I guess you and your dad will be working together.
translation: 有意思。“临床实验对象”……听起来你会干的很出色的。我想你会和你爸爸一起工作。

original: Looks like the diner's going to get a new Fry Cook. I'll just say this once: hold the mustard, extra pickles. Ha ha ha.
translation: 看来我们的餐厅要有一个新厨师了。我只说一次：去芥末，多腌汁。哈哈哈。

original: Thank goodness. We're finally getting a new Jukebox Technician. That thing hasn't worked right since old Joe Palmer passed.
translation: 感谢上帝。我们终于有了个新的点唱机技师。那东西自从老乔·帕尔默死后就无法正常工作。

original: Well, well. Pip-Boy Programmer, eh? Stanley will finally have someone to talk shop with.
translation: 好，好，哔哔小子程序员，对吧？斯坦利总算有说话对象了。

original: Huh. I wonder who will be brave enough to be your first customer as the vault's new Tattoo Artist? I promise it won't be me.
translation: 呃。我很怀疑谁够胆成为你这避难所的新纹身艺师的首个顾客。我保证那不会是我。

original: Apparently you're management material. You're going to be trained as a Shift Supervisor.
translation: 显然你是个搞管理的材料，你会被训练成轮班主管。

original: Could I be talking to the next Overseer? Stranger things have happened.
translation: 难道我在和下任监督者谈话吗？一堆怪事。

original: Wow. Wow. Says here you're going to be the vault's Marriage Counselor.
translation: 哇。哇。结果显示你会成为避难所的婚姻顾问。

original: Almost makes me want to get married, just to be able to avail myself of your services.
translation: 我真想赶快结婚，这样才能享受到你的服务。

original: I always thought you'd have a career in professional sports. You're the new vault Little League coach! Congratulations.
translation: 我一直认为你会从事职业运动。你是避难所的新任小联盟教练！恭喜你。

original: Looks like you'll be putting your ... physical talents to good use as the vault's new Masseuse.
translation: 看上去你要将你的……身体本钱充分用于避难所的新按摩师这职业。

original: All set, eh? You shouldn't have had any trouble with this little formality.
translation: 都准备好了，对吧？你不会被这小程序难到的。

original: You managed to answer all the questions, I see. That's a good start. Maybe a bit more than I expected given your grades.
translation: 我看看，你回答完了所有问题。这是个好的开始。或许会得到比我期望给的更高分数。

original: Well, you made it. All set for the G.O.A.T.? Trust me, it really isn't that bad. Just something everybody has to go through.
translation: 好，你来了。准备好参加G.O.A.T.了吗？相信我，它没那么糟。有些事每个人都得经历。

original: Do you mind? I know to you it's just meaningless jabber, but I'm actually trying to teach here.
translation: 你怎么搞得？我知道对你来说这只是毫无意义的唠叨，但是我还得继续上课。

original: Feel free to stick around if you want, but I don't want you disrupting the test.
translation: 如果你愿意可以随意逗留，但我不希望你干扰到这测试。

original: As soon as everyone takes their seats we can get started.
translation: 所有人都坐好后我们就开始。

original: No more excuses from you children! Go in and sit down.
translation: 孩子，别找借口！进去坐下。

original: Buzz off, nosebleed.
translation: 走开，鼻涕虫。

original: You're all right, kid. See you around.
translation: 你没问题，孩子。回见。

original: We'll talk to your little friend... later. Ha ha ha.
translation: 我们迟点会和你的小朋友……谈谈。哈哈哈。

original: This isn't over, punk.
translation: 这没完，废物。

original: I look like I want to chit-chat, nosebleed? What, you want another beating?
translation: 鼻涕虫，我看上去是想要和你闲聊吗？什么，你还想找揍？

original: Hey, look. It's smart mouth. Afraid I ain't got time for your fancy words right now. So beat it.
translation: 嗨，看。真是能说会道。恐怕我现在没空听你的花言巧语。躲开。

original: Look, I'm not looking to rumble with you. How about we just stay out of each other's business, like usual.
translation: 听着，我不想和你吵架。我们像往常那样井水不犯河水怎么样。

original: Yeah? What do you want?
translation: 是的，你想要什么？

original: Don't mess with the Tunnel Snakes.
translation: 别惹穴蛇帮。

original: What is it, feeb?
translation: 那是什么？蠢货。

original: Look, square, I already told you: we got nothin' to say to each other.
translation: 听着，死脑筋，我已经告诉你：我们之间无话可说。

original: Leave me alone, you little spaz.
translation: 离我远点，你这笨蛋。

original: Tunnel Snakes rule!
translation: 穴蛇帮主宰一切！

original: What? What do you want, nerd?
translation: 什么？你要干嘛？蠢货。

original: Oh look, it's Doc's kid. Great. What you do want, nerdboy?
translation: 哦 看，是医生的孩子。好极了。蠢货，你要干嘛？

original: Oh look, it's Doc's kid. Great. What you do want, nerdgirl?
translation: 哦 看，是医生的孩子。好极了。蠢货，你要干嘛？

original: You again! What'd I tell you about talking to me, huh? I don't want to catch a case of the nerd from you!
translation: 又是你！呃，要我来告诉你该怎么和我说话？我可不想和你这蠢货扯上关系！

original: Hey, hey, hey, sport! It's been a while since you stopped in here to see us! It's the big G.O.A.T. day today, right?
translation: 嗨，嗨，嗨，来消遣下！你在这看我们有一阵！今天是G.O.A.T.的大日子，对吧？

original: Good luck with the G.O.A.T., buddy!
translation: 祝你G.O.A.T.顺利，伙计！

original: Good luck with the G.O.A.T., cutie!
translation: 祝你G.O.A.T.顺利，美人！

original: Shh. I'm trying to concentrate.
translation: 嘘。我正集中注意力。

original: I heard what you said. Why would you do that? Just leave me alone!
translation: 我听到你说的了。为什么你要那样做？离我远点！

original: Thanks for your help, jerk. It's good to know I can count on you when I'm in trouble.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助，蠢货。当我有麻烦时，能依靠你真好。

original: Thank God that's over. Come on, let's go get some lunch.
translation: 感谢上帝，终于结束了。来吧，我们去吃点午餐。

original: Thanks for getting rid of them. Assholes.
translation: 谢谢你帮我摆脱他们。那帮混蛋。

original: I don't know why they won't leave me alone. Just because my father is the Overseer, I guess. Idiots.
translation: 我不知道他们为什么不离我远点。我想只是因为我爸爸是监督者。那帮白痴。

original: Stupid Tunnel Snakes! Immature assholes, if you ask me.
translation: 愚蠢的穴蛇帮！如果你问我的话，他们就是帮没长大的混蛋。

original: Why won't they leave me alone? It's not my fault my father's the Overseer. I don't care about their stupid gang!
translation: 我不知道他们为什么不离我远点。我爸爸是监督者又不是我的错。我可不关心他们的愚蠢帮会！

original: Can you talk to them? Maybe Butch will listen to you. Please?
translation: 你能和他们谈谈吗？或许布奇会听你的。拜托？

original: Go on, now. You've got a G.O.A.T. to take.
translation: 现在走吧。你还有G.O.A.T.要完成。

original: Come on, pal. You're fine, and you know it.
translation: 加油，伙计。你要知道，你很棒。

original: You're a perfectly healthy 16-year-old boy.
translation: 你是个完全健康的16岁男孩。

original: So, you need to get to class and take your G.O.A.T. exam. No excuses.
translation: 因此，你必须去教室参加G.O.A.T.。没有任何借口。

original: Come on, honey. You're fine, and you know it.
translation: 加油，亲爱的。你要知道，你很棒。

original: You're a perfectly healthy 16-year-old girl.
translation: 你是个完全健康的16岁女孩。

original: So, you need to get to class and take your G.O.A.T. exam. No excuses.
translation: 因此，你必须去教室参加G.O.A.T.。没有任何借口。

original: <coughs>You'd better stay away... I don't want you to catch what I've got.
translation: <咳嗽>你最好走开……我不想传染到你。

original: I'm a little worried <coughs> I hope Jonas can take a look at me soon.
translation: 我有点担心<咳嗽>我希望乔纳斯能快点看看我。

original: Hey, what did you put for #10?
translation: 嗨，第10题你选了什么？

original: Stop bothering me, I've just got to figure out this last one!
translation: 别打扰我，我得搞明白最后一题！

original: I can't figure out #5. First I think I should listen to my grandmother. But then, isn't killing someone wrong?
translation: 我做不出第5题。一开始我觉得应该听我祖母的。但随后想到杀人不是错的吗？

original: I'm thinking of going with "Overseer" for the last one. What did you put?
translation: 最后一题我觉得应该是“监督者”。你选了什么？

original: Hey, why don't you have to take the test?
translation: 嗨，你为什么不去做自己的测试？

original: You nervous? I'm not.
translation: 你紧张了？我可没有。

original: Shh!
translation: 嘘！

original: We're not friends. We're never going to be friends. Got it?
translation: 我们不是朋友。我们绝对不会成为朋友。明白了吗？

original: Right now, I don't pay any attention to you. You really want to keep it that way, okay?
translation: 现在，我不想为你浪费注意力了。你真的得让路了，好吧？

original: I hope you weren't just talking to me.
translation: 我希望你不是在和我说话。

original: Mr. Brotch is a big fat liar!
translation: 布洛彻先生是个撒谎的大胖子！

original: Do you mind? I'm trying to pay attention.
translation: 不介意吧？我得集中注意力了。

original: Oh. Hi. Why are you talking to me?
translation: 哦。嘿。你为什么和我说话？

original: You never should have left, kid. Now, we'll make sure nobody ever leaves again!
translation: 你本不该离开，孩子。现在我们要确信没人会再次离开！

original: I'm sorry, but you have to leave. Goodbye.
translation: 对不起，但是你必须离开。再见。

original: Our business is finished. Please leave immediately.
translation: 我们的交易结束了。请立刻离开。

original: It's a shame you've got to go. But you'll do okay out there, I'm sure.
translation: 实在很遗憾，可你必须走。但你在外面会很好的，我保证。

original: It's a shame you've got to go. But you'll do okay out there, I'm sure.
translation: 实在很遗憾，可你必须走。但你在外面会很好的，我保证。

original: Goodbye. We'll miss you.
translation: 再见。我们会想你的。

original: Good riddance. Get out.
translation: 感谢上帝，你要走了。快出去。

original: Stay back!
translation: 退后！

original: Stay out of this!
translation: 别过来！

original: Well, I see you've returned.
translation: 好吧，我看到你回来了。

original: Done with the dust and ruins of the Wasteland, are you? Given up looking for daddy? Thought you could just slink back in, like a teen missing curfew?
translation: 受够了废土的尘埃和混乱是吗？放弃找你爸爸了？我想你本可以像个晚回家的孩子般偷偷溜进来。

original: Well, that's too bad. You have no future in this Vault. You're tainted.
translation: 太糟了。你在避难所没有未来。你有前科了。

original: You just couldn't let us live in peace, could you? You couldn't have a home, so you decided to destroy ours.
translation: 你就不能让我们活在和平里吗？你不能有一个家，所以你决定毁了我们的。

original: But I'll see to it that you die first!
translation: 但是我会先让你死的！

original: You just couldn't let us live in peace, could you? You couldn't have a home, so you've decided to destroy ours.
translation: 你就不能让我们活在和平里吗？你不能有一个家，所以你决定毁了我们的。

original: Stop right there! I don't know how you got in here, but... Hold on...
translation: 站住！我不知道你是怎么进来的，但是……站住……

original: Wait a minute! It's you! I hardly recognized you with all the dust and grime from out there.
translation: 等等！是你！我都认不出你了，你浑身都是外面的尘土和污秽。

original: Guess that explains how you got that door open. You've got more experience with it than most everyone down here combined.
translation: 我猜这能解释你是怎么把门打开的。你在这方面比这下面大部分人加起来都有经验。

original: I guess you can see how bad things are down here. Sorry, where were we going?
translation: 我想你能看到这下面发生了多糟的事。对不起，我们这是要去哪？

original: Make it quick.
translation: 快一点儿。

original: I heard you were leaving us. That's not really true, is it?
translation: 我听说你抛弃了我们。那不是真的，对吧？

original: I really shouldn't be seen talking with you, you know. What do you want?
translation: 你知道，我真的不能被看到在和你说话。你想干嘛？

original: I've gotta say, it's a shame to see you go. I still remember when you turned ten. Who could have guessed how you'd grow up?
translation: 我得说，很遗憾得看你走。我还记得你十岁那年。谁能猜到你是怎么长大的？

original: Hey, if it ain't a fellow Tunnel Snake, slumming it down here with the old crew?
translation: 嗨，如果他不是穴蛇帮一伙的，就用老规矩在这把他干掉？

original: I thought you'd be out there tearing up the Wasteland and raising Hell!
translation: 我以为你在外面把废土搅得一塌糊涂呢。
