original: But if you've gotta be back, might as well make yourself useful. You gotta help us.
translation: 但是如果你必须回来，就得让自己有点用。你必须帮助我们。

original: Damn, look who's come waltzing back into the Vault?
translation: 该死，看谁跳着华尔兹回到避难所了？

original: It takes some real balls coming back here after everything you and your dad screwed up.
translation: 在你和你爸爸把一切都搞砸了之后，你还真有种回这来。

original: But if you've gotta be back, might as well make yourself useful. You gotta help us.
translation: 但是如果你必须回来，就得让自己有点用。你必须帮助我们。

original: Hey, what's the word?
translation: 嗨，想说什么？

original: Oh my God, you're back! You got my message and actually came back!
translation: 哦，我的天啊。你回来了！你收到了我的消息，真的回来了！

original: Oh, thank goodness you're here! I told everyone to wait here for you, that you'd know what to do, but they didn't listen to me.
translation: 哦，感谢上帝，你在这！我叫所有人在这等你，因为你知道该怎么做，但是他们不听我的。

original: With everything they'd been through, they just panicked. But I knew you'd come back.
translation: 经历了这一切之后，他们害怕了。但是我知道你会回来。

original: I knew you'd know what was happening. You do, don't you?
translation: 我知道你会清楚发生了什么事。对吧？

original: I'll keep looking for the others. Good luck with everything.
translation: 我会继续找其他人的。好运！

original: Did you think I was joking? You murderer!
translation: 你觉得我在开玩笑？你这凶手！

original: You've already made your point with us. What else is there to say?
translation: 你是准备让我们接受你的看法。你还有什么要说的？

original: It sounds like you've already abandoned us. Did you change your mind, or are you just here to make fun of us?
translation: 听起来你已经把我们抛弃了。你改主意了，还是只是在这耍我们？

original: I hope you're making your farewells, because we don't have much to say, otherwise.
translation: 我希望你是来道别的，因为除此之外我们没什么好说的。

original: I... I just heard. The Overseer... My father is dead.
translation: 我……我刚听说。监督者……我父亲死了。

original: What's more, some of the people are saying I should be the new Overseer. It's all so sudden.
translation: 还有，一些人在说我应该成为新的监督者。这太突然了。

original: I just heard what you did. It was terrible, but... I guess it had to be done.
translation: 我听说你干了些什么。太可怕了，但是……我想必须得这么做。

original: What's more, some of the people are saying I should be the new Overseer. It's all so sudden.
translation: 还有，一些人在说我应该成为新的监督者。这太突然了。

original: I... I just heard. My father says he's stepping down as Overseer. He won't tell me why, but I have to assume it's something you said to him.
translation: 我……我刚听说。我父亲说他正准备卸任监督者。他不告诉我为什么，但是我猜你和他说了些什么。

original: I hope you're making progress with my father. I can't imagine anyone else who could convince him we should venture outside.
translation: 我希望你和我父亲之间有进展。我不能想象还有其他人能说服他让我们出去闯荡。

original: I hope you're making progress with the Overseer. I can't imagine anyone else who could convince him we should venture outside.
translation: 我希望你和我父亲之间有进展。我不能想象还有其他人能说服他让我们出去闯荡。

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: Well, look at who came crawling back home?
translation: 看谁穿得破破烂烂的回家了？

original: What's the matter? Homesick? Outside not everything it was cracked up to be? Or was it just that Daddy didn't want you anymore?
translation: 怎么了？想家了？受不了外面了？还是你爸爸不要你了？

original: Too bad. You're not wanted here. You're scum.
translation: 太糟了。这里不需要你。你这人渣。

original: Can't you just leave me and my Vault to die in peace?
translation: 你就不能让我和我的避难所死得安静点？

original: You know what? I changed my mind. Playtime's over, kid.
translation: 你知道吗？我改主意了。游戏时间结束，孩子。

original: Aren't you supposed to be leaving?
translation: 你是不是应该离开了？

original: Aren't you supposed to be leaving?
translation: 你是不是应该离开了？

original: I just heard about your so-called "solution." I've got to admit, I didn't think you'd do it.
translation: 我听说了你所谓的“办法”，我必须承认，我不觉得你会这么做。

original: But, hey, you've solved my problems, and gave me an easy place to pin the blame. I guess I owe you my thanks.
translation: 但是，嗨，你解决了我的问题，让我有台可下。我想我该谢谢你。

original: I just heard about your so-called "solution." I should have you killed where you stand.
translation: 我刚听说了你所谓的“办法”。我该把你就地解决了。

original: But obviously, we simply can't kill a Wasteland monster like you. The best we can do is offer you a sacrifice to send you on your way.
translation: 但很显然，我们不能简单地杀了一个像你这样的废土怪物。我们最好是按你说的方式让你献身。

original: At least with you gone, our home can return to some semblance of peace, even if it came at a tragic cost.
translation: 至少你走以后，我们的家园能恢复些平静，即使它需要惨痛的代价。

original: I hear you talked some sense into that rabble, and convinced them to give up on their nonsense. All without bloodshed, no less.
translation: 我听说你和闹事的讲道理，说服他们放弃了愚蠢的举动。整个事件没有流血冲突。

original: Good thing, too. We can't afford to lose any more of the breeding pool. I guess I owe you something in the way of thanks.
translation: 也是好事。我们不能再失去更多的繁殖池了。我想我该谢谢你。

original: I hear that you've had a little chat with our rebellious elements. It seems I underestimated your persuasive skills.
translation: 我听说你和反抗我们的势力谈了。看来我小看了你的说服技巧。

original: I applaud your restraint. Violence only weakens our community, and now is no time for weakness.
translation: 我欣赏你的克制。暴力只会削弱我们的社团，而我们现在不能衰落。

original: Once again, there is a firm hand in control, and all will be well in Vault 101. I suppose you'll want some sort of payment for your aid.
translation: 这再一次有了严格的控制，而101号避难所也会好起来。我想你的协助应该得到些酬劳。

original: I told you to leave me here. This is my fate for failing the people of my Vault.
translation: 我告诉你别来烦我。我注定要让我的避难所的子民失望了。

original: Now go! See if you can keep a few of them alive out there!
translation: 现在走吧！看你是不是能让外面的一些人也活着。

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: Ah, another patient! What's it to be, eh? Appendectomy? Tonsillectomy?
translation: 啊，又一个病人！想治疗什么，呃？阑尾切除？扁桃体切除？

original: Hysterectomy?
translation: 子宫切除？

original: Back again, hmm? Here to watch the master work?
translation: 又回来了，嗯？来这看大师工作？

original: Oh, it's good to see you're back from outside. It can be dangerous out there for someone your age.
translation: 哦，很高兴你从外面回来。像你这年纪的人出门要是很危险的。

original: It's been a while, kid. I guess the G.O.A.T. couldn't have predicted how you'd turn out, could it?
translation: 已经好一会啦，孩子。我猜G.O.A.T.没能预言到你成为什么人，对吧？

original: Remind me to add a question about rescuing your teacher from the Vault jail. If the Vault ever goes back to normal, that is...
translation: 提醒了我加一道把你老师救出避难所监狱的题目。我是说，如果避难所最终能够恢复正常的话……

original: By the way, while I was in there, I heard some worrying things from the guards.
translation: 哦 对了，我在里面的时候，从守卫那听到些令人担忧的事。

original: Well, if it isn't my star pupil.
translation: 那不是我的明星学生嘛。

original: You're back, again?
translation: 你又回来了？

original: Can't you just leave us alone?
translation: 你就不能别烦我们吗？

original: I don't know that I should be talking with you.
translation: 我不知道我该不该和你说话。

original: Oh boy, are you in trouble.
translation: 哦，孩子，你遇到麻烦了吗？

original: Oh, look. The bad seed is back.
translation: 哦，看。这坏胚子回来了。

original: You got a lot to answer for, kid.
translation: 你有很多需要解释的，孩子。

original: I sure didn't expect you to show your face here again.
translation: 我还真没指望你那张脸会再次出现。

original: Don't you know enough to stay away?
translation: 你对“滚”这字理解透彻吗？

original: Wow, you're back!
translation: 哇，你回来了！

original: Hey, good to see you again!
translation: 嗨，很高兴再次见到你。

original: You're alive!
translation: 你还活着！

original: <whimper>
translation: <呜咽>

original: <bark!>
translation: <吠叫！>

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: Hey there.
translation: 嘿你好。

original: Pretty impressive work for a civilian, bringing the Doctor here in once piece.
translation: 你这平民干得还真不赖，将博士完好无损地带来了。

original: Sarah Lyons, Sentinel and commander of Lyons' Pride. Welcome to the Citadel.
translation: 萨拉·里昂斯，“里昂斯的骄傲”的哨兵兼指挥官。欢迎来到五角大本营。

original: You just manage to get yourself into all sorts of trouble, don't you?
translation: 你还真能给自己找麻烦，不是吗？

original: Welcome to the Citadel. Not many civilians get to see the place.
translation: 欢迎来到五角大本营。没有几个平民能见到这地方。

original: What in the HELL do you think you're doing, mungo?
translation: 见鬼，你以为你在干嘛，毛人？

original: Hold it right there, mister!
translation: 站住，先生！

original: Don't take another step, or we'll blow your fucking head off!
translation: 再向前一步我们就让你的脑袋开花！

original: Hold it right there, lady!
translation: 站住，小姐。

original: Don't take another step, or we'll blow your fucking head off!
translation: 再向前一步我们就让你的脑袋开花！

original: Unless you've got Sammy and the others with you, then get lost!
translation: 除非萨米和其他孩子和你一起回来，不然就滚开！

original: You again? I told you to get lost!
translation: 又是你？我告诉过你快滚！

original: Hey, hey buddy! Hi. Yeah, so listen, thanks and all. Really great job you did there.
translation: 嗨，嗨，伙计！你好，嗯，听着，谢谢。你干得真漂亮。

original: Boy this place is something else, isn't it? Really amazing stuff here.
translation: 伙计，这地方真不一样，不是吗？在这有很多好东西。

original: Listen, thanks for getting us through that. I'm not stupid; I know we wouldn't have made it without you.
translation: 听着，谢谢你帮我们搞定。我不蠢，我知道没有你的话，根本就搞不定。

original: I'm sorry about your dad, and I'm sorry I've acted like an ass.
translation: 对你父亲的事我很遗憾，很抱歉我表现得像个混蛋。

original: Hey, how's it going?
translation: 嗨，怎么样？

original: It's good to see you again. I hope that we can return to the purifier soon and finish your father's work.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你。我希望我们能尽快回到净化器那，完成你父亲的工作。

original: In the meantime, it seems that my talents are of use to the Brotherhood. I still don't completely trust them, but I'm willing to look past that.
translation: 同时，看上去我的才能对兄弟会很有用。我还是不能完全相信他们，但是我愿意帮忙。

original: If you need something specific, please make it quick. Otherwise, excuse me. I have work to attend to.
translation: 如果你要些特别的，那就请快点。否则，抱歉。我还有事要做。

original: <yawn> What?
translation: <哈欠>什么？

original: Please excuse me. There is much work to be done.
translation: 抱歉。我还有很多事要做。

original: Please excuse me. There is much work to be done.
translation: 抱歉。我还有很多事要做。

original: Looks like it's all clear. Unlocking outer doors.
translation: 看上去扫荡完了。打开外门。

original: Door's open. Quit buzzing me, willya?
translation: 门开了，别再烦我，好吗？

original: I'm not opening the door now! Are you crazy?!
translation: 我现在不会开门！你疯了吗？！

original: Door stays closed until we finish securing the perimeter.
translation: 要先确保周围安全，否则不能开门。

original: Keep your shirt on. I'm not opening the door until the commander gives the all clear.
translation: 沉住气。等指挥官说平安无事后我才能开门。

original: Do you mind? We're a little busy at the moment!
translation: 不介意吧？我们现在还有点忙！

original: You did it! You disarmed that thing!
translation: 干得好！你解除了那东西！

original: My dad... he... He would have been real happy about that. Thank you.
translation: 我父亲……他……他一定会为此感到很高兴的。谢谢。

original: He wanted you to have these... a key and the deed to an empty place up behind the Brass Lantern. You can move in there if you want.
translation: 他要你拿着这些……一把钥匙与黄铜灯后一间空房的地契。如果你愿意，可以去那住。

original: Oh, and talk to Moira at Craterside Supply.  She can help you decorate the place.
translation: 哦，和坑边杂货店的莫伊拉谈谈。她能帮你装修那地方。

original: My dad told me about how you're going to disarm the bomb. He gave me some stuff for you for when you get it done...
translation: 我爸爸告诉了我你要解除那核弹。他让我在你完成后，把这些东西交给你。

original: Not now!
translation: 不是现在！

original: I'll be damned! You did it, didn't you? You disarmed that thing!
translation: 该死！你做到了，对吧？你解除了那东西！

original: Hell, where's my manners? I'm Lucas Simms, mayor and sheriff. And I'm pleased to say, we've had a reward for fixing up that bomb. Here you go!
translation: 见鬼，失礼了！我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，镇长兼警长。我很荣幸的说，我们要给解除核弹的人报酬。拿着！

original: Y'know, we could use someone like you living in town. We've got an empty place up behind the Brass Lantern. Here's the key and deed.
translation: 你知道，我们需要你这样的人留在镇里。我们在黄铜灯后有间空房。给你钥匙和地契。

original: And heck, Moira over at Craterside Supply can even sell you stuff to help fix the place up.
translation: 坑边杂货店的莫伊拉会卖给你家具去装修那地方。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，警长兼镇长，有需要时找我。

original: You got a weird look about you, boy. The kind that means trouble. I give everyone a fair shake. But if you do anything remotely stupid, you're dead.
translation: 你看起来很怪，孩子。通常这意味着麻烦。我对每个人一视同仁。但如果你干了什么蠢事，那你就死定了。

original: You got a weird look about you, boy. The kind that means trouble. I give everyone a fair shake. But if you do anything remotely stupid, you're dead.
translation: 你看起来很怪，孩子。通常这意味着麻烦。我对每个人一视同仁。但如果你干了什么蠢事，那你就死定了。

original: You got a weird look about you, girl. The kind that means trouble. I give everyone a fair shake. But if you do anything remotely stupid, you're dead.
translation: 你看起来很怪，丫头。通常这意味着麻烦。我对每个人一视同仁。但如果你干了什么蠢事，那你就死定了。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，警长兼镇长，有需要时找我。

original: I don't know why, but I like you, boy! Something tells me you're all right. So welcome to Megaton! Just holler if you need something.
translation: 我不知道为什么，但我喜欢你，小子！我觉得你没问题。欢迎来到兆吨镇，需要什么尽管说。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，警长兼镇长，有需要时找我。

original: I don't know why, but I like you, girl! Something tells me you're all right. So welcome to Megaton! Just holler if you need something.
translation: 我不知道为什么，但我喜欢你，丫头！我觉得你没问题。欢迎来到兆吨镇，需要什么尽管说。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，警长兼镇长，有需要时找我。

original: I must be getting slow in my old age. Thanks for saving my hide, there.
translation: 我一定是老得迟钝了。谢谢你救了我。

original: Haven't disarmed the bomb yet? That's some serious pre-war hardware. So go easy, okay?
translation: 还没把那核弹解除？那可是一大块战前的五金产品，所以轻松些，好吗？

original: Don't suppose you've disarmed that bomb?
translation: 你不是以为已经解除那核弹了吧？

original: I'll be damned! You did it, didn't you? You disarmed that thing!
translation: 该死！你做到了，对吧？你解除了那东西！

original: Here's your reward. Hell, why don't you move in? Could use someone like you. Got an empty place here you can use. Here's the key and deed.
translation: 这是你的报酬。见鬼，你干嘛不搬进来？我们需要你这样的人。有间空房你可以拿去用。这是钥匙和地契。

original: It ain't much to look at. But talk with Moira. She's got random odds and ends you might be able to spruce the place up with.
translation: 看起来不怎么样。但和莫伊拉谈谈，她有些零碎东西，你可以拿来装修下那地方。

original: I'll be damned! You did it, didn't you? You disarmed that thing!
translation: 该死！你做到了，对吧？你解除了那东西！

original: And all without asking for pay, too. Hell, why don't you move in? Here's the key and deed to an empty house. Consider yourself a Megaton citizen!
translation: 完全不求回报。见鬼，你干嘛不搬进来？这是一间空房子的地契和钥匙。把你自己当成兆吨镇的镇民吧！

original: Oh and talk with Moira at Craterside Supply. She's got random odds and ends you might be able to spruce the place up with.
translation: 哦，还有去和坑边杂货店的莫伊拉谈谈。她有些零碎的东西，你可以拿来装修下那地方。

original: Well, hey! How's it going? You need something, you just ask. Disarming that bomb, well... that's something I'm not ever likely to forget.
translation: 嗨！怎么样了？有需要尽管说。解除了核弹，啊……我永远不会忘记。

original: Well, now... how's my favorite explosives expert doing?
translation: 现在……我最爱的拆弹专家在干嘛？

original: Not now!
translation: 不是现在！

original: Savor this moment.
translation: 尽情享受这一刻。

original: Shush! You're ruining the moment.
translation: 嘘！你在糟蹋这好时光。

original: Wait for my summons. I will send for you after I finish some business in the Wasteland.
translation: 等我的消息。我结束废土的小生意后会来叫你。

original: Patience my love. I will send for you in due time.
translation: 耐心，亲爱的。到时候我会叫你的。

original: Patience.
translation: 耐心。

original: So. You're the genius who disarmed the bomb. Weeks of waiting and watching, ruined!
translation: 你就是那解除核弹的天才。数周的观望，都白费了！

original: It's a pity you acted so hastily. In the future, best sleep with one eye open.
translation: 都是因为你草率的行动。以后，你睡觉最好都睁只眼睛。

original: You will come to regret your actions.
translation: 你会为你的行为后悔的。

original: My, my. Just when I had all but given up hope. My dear boy, I am very happy to make your acquaintance. I am Mister Burke.
translation: 喔，喔。就在我失去所有希望的时候，我亲爱的孩子。认识你很高兴。我是伯克先生。

original: And you, well, you are not a resident of this putrescent cesspool. That makes you a rather valuable individual.
translation: 你，嗯，你不是这腐臭的污水池的居民。那让你更难能可贵。

original: My, my. Just when I had all but given up hope. My dear girl, I am very happy to make your acquaintance. I am Mister Burke.
translation: 喔，喔。就在我失去所有希望的时候，我亲爱的孩子。很高兴能认识你。我是伯克先生。

original: And you, well, you are not a resident of this putrescent cesspool. That makes you a rather valuable individual.
translation: 你，嗯，你不是这腐臭的污水池的居民。那让你更难能可贵。

original: You self-righteous little.... Do you have any idea what you've done to my employer's development plan? A word of advice: watch your back.
translation: 你有点自以为是……你知道你对我们老板的开发计划都干了什么吗？给你个忠告：小心你背后。

original: You haven't rigged the bomb yet? If it's information you need, get to it. Time is wasting.
translation: 你还没有装配好核弹？如果有你需要的信息，就快点去了解。时不待人。

original: Back again, hmm? Perhaps you've reconsidered my offer?
translation: 又回来了，嗯？或许你已经再次考虑了我的提议？

original: The pulse charge is rigged? Excellent! Meet me upstairs at Tenpenny Tower. There you will see a most glorious sight.
translation: 脉冲充电器安装好了？好极了！到特佩尼大厦的楼上来见我。我让你开开眼界。

original: Meet me upstairs at Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 到特佩尼大厦的楼上来见我。

original: The pulse charge is rigged? Excellent! Excellent!
translation: 脉冲充电器安装好了？好极了！好极了！

original: Ah. The anticipation is palpable. Isn't it?
translation: 啊。和预料的一样，对吧？

original: When you have finished savoring the moment, you may have the honor of pressing the button. Oh, and mind your eyes. It'll be brighter than bright.
translation: 品味完这瞬间，我把按动按钮的荣誉给你。哦，小心你的眼睛。这会非常刺眼。

original: The detonator is right over there. You may have the honor. Hit the switch!
translation: 按钮就在那里。这是你的荣誉。按下开关！

original: My God... what transcendent beauty... what purifying light....
translation: 我的天啊……多么超凡的美丽……多么纯洁的光芒……

original: Ahem... Allow me to collect myself, as I'm sure you're anxious to collect your payment.
translation: 嗯……允许我调整下自己的情绪。因为我想你肯定急着想拿到你的报酬。

original: I've been asked to extend to you an invitation to reside at Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 我收到要求邀请你在特佩尼大厦居住。

original: Here's the key, and deed, to your new master suite. It's on the top floor, first door on your right from the elevator. Enjoy your new accommodations.
translation: 这是钥匙还有地契，到你的新大套房吧。乘电梯至顶楼，右边第一扇门。好好享受你的新住处。

original: Oh, and if you wish to spruce the place up a bit, speak with Lydia Montenegro in the Boutique le Chic.
translation: 哦，还有，如果你想让那整洁，就和时尚精品店的莉迪亚·黑山谈谈。

original: My God... what transcendent beauty... what purifying light....
translation: 我的天啊……多么超凡的美丽……多么纯洁的光芒……

original: Ahem... Allow me to collect myself, as I'm sure you're anxious to collect your payment.
translation: 嗯……允许我调整下自己的情绪。因为我想你肯定急着想拿到你的报酬。

original: I've been asked to extend to you an invitation to reside at Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 我收到要求邀请你在特佩尼大厦居住。

original: Here's the key, and deed, to your new master suite. It's on the top floor, first door on your right from the elevator. Enjoy your new accommodations.
translation: 这是钥匙还有地契，到你的新大套房吧。乘电梯至顶楼，右边第一扇门。好好享受你的新住处。

original: What you did, it was a great thing. That place, those people... necessary sacrifices. Here's to a better future. Here's to Tenpenny Tower!
translation: 你做的事，是伟大的事。那地方，那些人……必须牺牲。为了更美好的未来，为了特佩尼大厦！

original: Yeah, you're pretty busted up, but you'll live. Stop by the clinic in the morning.
translation: 嗯，虽然你伤得很重的，但你会活下来。早上去诊所吧。

original: Welcome to the Chop Shop. I'm Nurse Graves, Doctor Barrows' assistant.
translation: 欢迎来到排骨店。我是格雷芙护士，巴罗斯医生的助手。

original: Don't let our place's name fool you. The Doctor is very good with injuries, dismemberments, and trauma.
translation: 别被我们这地方的名字吓到。医生对内伤、断肢和外伤都很在行。

original: If you require any Stimpaks or Bloodpacks, let me know.
translation: 如果你需要治疗针或血浆袋，就告诉我。

original: And how can we help you today?
translation: 今天我能为你做些什么？

original: Well, I guess you weren't such a jerk after all.
translation: 好吧，我想你不是一个蠢货。

original: Wow, you look like you've been through Hell.
translation: 哇，你看起来像刚从地狱里回来。

original: From what I've heard, sounds like you've been through Hell.
translation: 从我听到的情况看，你刚从地狱里回来。

original: You look like you've been though Hell.
translation: 看起来你刚从地狱里回来。

original: Well, I'm still waiting. What's the deal with my men?
translation: 好吧，我还在等。这和我的人有关吗？

original: Any other info I can give you?
translation: 还需要些什么信息？

original: Staying in Underworld isn't helping our cause. Make this fast.
translation: 待在地下城对我们的目的没有帮助。麻利点。

original: You still here? The Rangers aren't going to last forever if you don't get out there and help them.
translation: 你还在这？如果你不去帮助他们，那游骑兵迟早完蛋。

original: I thought we covered everything. What is it now?
translation: 我以为各个问题都谈过了。现在怎么样？

original: Get the hell out of my face.
translation: 见鬼，离我远点。

original: If you're going to continue to irritate me, I'm not going to be so nice about it.
translation: 如果你还要继续激怒我的话，我就对你不客气了。

original: What.... Where am I? What happened?
translation: 什么……我在哪？发生了什么？

original: How long have I been out?
translation: 我晕倒多久了？

original: Yeah? What is it? Ready to help?
translation: 嗯？怎么？想要帮忙？

original: Yeah? What do you want?
translation: 是的，你想要什么？

original: I'm afraid she's going to be out for a while. She's not well at all.
translation: 恐怕她会晕倒一阵。她的情况不太好。

original: Don't worry though, I'm sure the rest of Reilly's Rangers will show up soon and take her home.
translation: 尽管放心，我肯定剩下的莱莉游骑兵会立刻出现并带她回家。

original: Doctor Barrows at your service. What brings you to the Chop Shop?
translation: 巴罗斯医生为你服务，什么风把你吹到排骨店的？

original: Come to lend me a hand I hope. I can always use fresh human samples.
translation: 我希望你过来帮把手。新鲜人类标本对我来说总是有用。

original: Yes, what is it now? Please, be brief. I'm quite busy.
translation: 是的，什么事？请简要说明。我很忙。

original: You sure know your shit. Ever consider joining the Rangers? I bet Reilly would love to have you on our team.
translation: 你还挺能啊。考虑过加入游骑兵吗？我打赌莱莉会很乐意让你加入我们的队伍。

original: Remember, if you need anything fixed, look me up at the Ranger Compound.
translation: 记住，如果你要修理什么的话，就到游骑兵营地来找我。

original: Move... move!
translation: 行动……行动！

original: Hey there. Donovan at your service. You break it, I fix it.
translation: 嗨。多诺万为你服务。你坏了什么，我就修什么。

original: What can I do you for?
translation: 我能为你做些什么？

original: Hey man, the Butcher wants to see you. He's right over yonder.
translation: 嗨，哥们，布彻想见你。他就在那。

original: Did ya see me? Nothing good ole' Eugene and a few hundred rounds of ammo couldn't handle.
translation: 你看见不？没有什么是老尤金和几百发子弹不能解决的。

original: Goodbye. If you're ever in the neighborhood and need some help, just listen for Eugene's rat-a-tat-tat. Ha ha ha!
translation: 再见，当你在这附近需要帮助时，就会听到尤金的“跶-跶-跶”声。哈哈哈！

original: Go go go!
translation: 走走走！

original: Brick's the name, and I call this fine looking roomsweeper Eugene.
translation: 我叫布瑞克，我把那帅气的扫荡者称为尤金。

original: We've had a lot of fun together mowin' down Super Mutants, but I think it's time we get off this roof.
translation: 我们在一起做掉超级变种人的战斗中有好多乐子，不过我想现在是我们离开楼顶的时候了。

original: Yeah? What is it?
translation: 嗯？什么事？

original: I think Butcher wants to talk with you and he's callin' the shots. We can talk about me 'n Eugene later.
translation: 我想布彻想和你谈谈，他说了算。迟点我们再聊我和尤金的事。

original: Welcome back. It's great to see you again.
translation: 欢迎回来。很高兴再次见到你。

original: It's been good knowing you. Hope to see you at the Ranger Compound.
translation: 很高兴认识你。希望能在游骑兵营地见到你。

original: Well, I suppose thanks are in order... and a little something extra for your trouble.
translation: 我想先谢谢你……然后还有一点额外的谢礼。

original: I'm going to head back to Ranger Compound and see if Reilly's back yet. If you make your way there, Reilly will pay you herself.
translation: 我准备回游骑兵营地，看看莱莉是不是回来了。如果你去那里的话，莱莉会亲自给你报酬的。

original: If I can ever be of medical assistance or you need some supplies or repairs, let me or Donovan know.
translation: 如果你需要药品援助、补给或修理，就告诉我或者多诺万。

original: Again, I'm not sure how to thank you.
translation: 再一次，我真不知道怎么感谢你。

original: I'm going to head back to Ranger Compound to see if Reilly's back yet. Look me up anytime you're in the neighborhood.
translation: 我准备回游骑兵营地，看看莱莉是不是回来了。你到那附近的话，任何时候都能来拜访我。

original: If I can ever be of medical assistance or you need some supplies or repairs, let me or Donovan know.
translation: 如果你需要药品援助、补给或修理，就告诉我或者多诺万。

original: We'll talk when we get to the exit. Let's roll.
translation: 我们到了出口再谈。我们走。

original: Back so soon? Are we in luck?
translation: 这么快回来了？我们走运了？

original: Hey you! Get your ass over here before you attract every Super Mutant in the building!
translation: 嗨，你！趁你还没把那房子里所有超级变种人都引出来前，赶快把你的屁股挪过来。

original: The name's Butcher, I'm the team medic. It's good to see a friendly face.
translation: 我是布彻。队中的医生。很高兴见到你这么友善的面孔。

original: Okay, now who the heck are you and when are reinforcements coming?
translation: 好，现在，你他娘的是谁，援军什么时候到？

original: Welcome to Rivet City. Please wait while the bridge extends.
translation: 欢迎来到铆钉城。请等待放好吊桥。

original: Welcome to Rivet City.
translation: 欢迎来到铆钉城。

original: I...uh, I don't get visitors very often. My name is Abraham Washington. This is my Capital Preservation Society.
translation: 我……呃，我不大有访客的。我叫亚伯拉罕·华盛顿。这是我的首都保护协会。

original: Welcome to...uh...the Capital Preservation Society.
translation: 欢迎来到……呃……首都保护协会……

original: What...uh, what can I do for you?
translation: 我……呃，我能为你做些什么？

original: Hi. I'm Angela. My dad runs Gary's Galley. If you want anything to eat, talk to him.
translation: 嗨。我是安吉拉。我爸爸经营加里厨房。如果想吃什么，和他说。

original: Hi. I'm Angela. I run Gary's Galley. Let me know when you are ready to order.
translation: 嗨，我是安吉拉。我经营加里厨房。准备点餐的话就告诉我。

original: Have you heard? I'm getting married!
translation: 你听到了吗？我就要结婚了！

original: Welcome to Gary's Galley. Can I take your order?
translation: 欢迎光临加里厨房。可以点菜了吗？

original: Yes, sir?
translation: 什么事，先生？

original: Yes, ma'am?
translation: 什么事，女士。

original: Lay a hand on Doctor Zimmer, and I'll snap your neck like a chicken bone.
translation: 你敢动齐默博士一根汗毛，我就像拧鸡骨一样拧断你的脖子。

original: That's close enough. Keep your hands where I can see them.
translation: 够近了。把你双手放在我能看见的地方。

original: The market is closing soon. You'd better make it quick.
translation: 市场很快就关门了。你最好动作快点。

original: The council has a report that C.J. Young is missing. Have you seen her?
translation: 议会报告说杨长江失踪了。你见过她没？

original: Welcome to Potomac Attire. I am Bannon, proprietor and City Council member.
translation: 欢迎光临波托马克服装。我是班侬，这的经营人和城市议会成员。

original: I carry discriminating attire for discriminating customers.
translation: 我为不同客户准备不同的服饰。

original: We haven't met. I'm Bannon, proprietor of Potomac Attire, and City Council member.
translation: 我们没见过面。我是班侬，这的经营人和城市议会成员。

original: You should stop by my shop. What you're wearing is dreadful.
translation: 你应该去我店里看看。你穿的实在太糟糕了。

original: I heard that Danvers found a letter from Slavers in Seagrave's room.
translation: 听说丹佛斯在西格雷夫的房间找到一份奴隶贩子寄来的信。

original: That will teach that bastard to mess with me.
translation: 看那杂种还敢不敢找我的麻烦。

original: I think you've earned a permanent discount here.
translation: 我想你已经获得了这的永久折扣。

original: You told Danvers that I was trying to blackmail Seagrave.
translation: 你告诉丹佛斯，我正在努力设法敲诈西格雷夫。

original: Thanks to you, they've suspended council meeting and are probably going to censure me.
translation: 拜你所赐，他们推迟了议会会议，可能立刻会来非难我了。

original: I can't ban you from my shop, but they can't tell me what to charge.
translation: 我不能把你拒在我店外，但是他们不能要求我怎么开价。

original: Welcome to Potomac Attire.
translation: 欢迎光临波托马克服装。

original: I think I've seen you in here before. When you're ready to buy, just let me know.
translation: 我觉得之前有在这见过你。你什么时候想买了，就来找我。

original: Have you found anything you like?
translation: 看中了什么？

original: Is this interruption really necessary?
translation: 这样打扰别人真的有必要吗？

original: I'm Belle Bonny, and this is the Muddy Rudder.
translation: 我是贝勒·邦尼，这是“泥舵”酒吧。

original: I'll tell you what I tell all the fresh meat. Don't start anything down here or I'll have Brock kick your ass.
translation: 我把丑话说在前面。别在这找麻烦，否则我让布洛克给你好看。

original: I'm Belle Bonny, and this is the Muddy Rudder.
translation: 我是贝勒·邦尼，这是“泥舵”酒吧。

original: I'll tell you what I tell all the fresh meat. Don't start anything down here or I'll have to kick your ass.
translation: 我把丑话说在前面。别在这找麻烦，否则我会给你好看。

original: You're a new one. I'm Belle Bonny of the Muddy Rudder. Make it quick.
translation: 你是新来的吧。我是“泥舵”酒吧的贝勒·邦尼。动作快点。

original: What the hell do you want?
translation: 你到底想要什么？

original: I'm Brock, the bouncer. I take care of the troublemakers. You aren't going to be a troublemaker, are you?
translation: 我是保镖布洛克。我负责处理找麻烦的人。你不想找麻烦，对吧？

original: Don't tell me your problems.
translation: 我不想听你的问题。

original: I can't talk right now. My daughter, C.J. is missing.
translation: 我现在不能聊天。我的女儿长江不见了。

original: If you see her, please send her home right away.
translation: 如果你见到她，请立刻送她回家。

original: This place won't clean itself. That's my job.
translation: 这不会自己干净起来的。是我打扫的。

original: Look, I'm busy.
translation: 听着，我现在很忙。

original: This is A Quick Fix. I mean that's the name of our shop. Paulie and mine that is. My name is Cindy. Cindy Cantelli.
translation: 这是快速修复。我指的是这商店的名字。我和保利的商店。我叫辛迪，辛迪·坎特利。

original: This is A Quick Fix. I mean that's the name of the shop. My name is Cindy. Cindy Cantelli.
translation: 这是快速修复。我指的是这商店的名字。我叫辛迪，辛迪·坎特利。

original: Nice to see you again. Are you looking for a quick fix?
translation: 很高兴再见到你。你需要快速修复吗？

original: Made up your mind yet?
translation: 想好了吗？

original: I'm Cindy. I mean, Cindy Cantelli. I'm a quick fix. I mean, I run A Quick Fix. Anyway, you were saying?
translation: 我是辛迪。我是说，辛迪·坎特利，我是快速修理匠。我是说，我经营快速修复。你刚才的意思是？

original: Oh! It's you. I mean, hi there.
translation: 哦！是你。我是说，你好。

original: Will you take me home, mister? I'm scared.
translation: 你能带我回家吗，先生？我很害怕。

original: Will you take me home, ma'am? I'm scared.
translation: 你能带我回家吗，女士？我很害怕。

original: I'm not supposed to talk to strangers.
translation: 我不应该和陌生人说话。

original: Yes, miss.
translation: 是的，小姐。

original: Maybe you don't know who you're talking to. I'm Commander Danvers, assistant chief of security.
translation: 或许你不知道你正在和谁说话。我是丹佛斯指挥官，警卫助理长官。

original: Maybe you don't know who you're talking to. I'm Chief Danvers, head of Rivet City security.
translation: 或许你不知道你正在和谁说话。我是丹佛斯长官，铆钉城警卫的头。

original: This better be good.
translation: 你最好找个像样点的借口。

original: Ted Strayer. You can chill with me if you want, dude.
translation: 泰德·斯崔尔。哥们，如果想的话可以和我一起干。

original: Whoa! What's the rush, dude?
translation: 哇！哥们，你急什么？

original: I'm Diego, the acolyte for Saint Monica's.
translation: 我是迭戈，圣莫尼卡的侍僧。

original: I'm Diego,the new priest for Saint Monica's.
translation: 我是迭戈，圣莫尼卡的新任神父。

original: Have you seen Angela? I need to ask her something about our wedding.
translation: 你见过安吉拉吗？我需要向她询问我们婚礼的事。

original: Oh...nevermind. I just remembered. Sorry. I'm so scatterbrained these days. What was it you wanted again?
translation: 哦……没关系。我记得了。对不起。我最近记性不好。你又是要什么来着？ ?

original: God bless you and keep you safe.
translation: 上帝保佑你平安。

original: Hmmm? Oh! Do you need something?
translation: 唔？哦！你需要些什么吗？

original: You're in the Rivet City Clinic. I'm Doctor Preston.
translation: 你到了铆钉城诊所。我是普雷斯顿医生。

original: I'm eating right now. If you're hurt, I'll be back in the clinic shortly.
translation: 我正在吃饭。你受伤的话，我会很快回到诊所。

original: You're wounded. Let me bandage that.
translation: 你受伤了。我来给你包扎一下。

original: You don't look hurt. What can I do for you?
translation: 你不像是受伤了。我能为你做点什么吗？

original: I am Father Clifford. This is Saint Monica's church.
translation: 我是克利福德神父。这是圣莫尼卡教堂。

original: I am Father Clifford of Saint Monica's church.
translation: 我是圣莫尼卡教堂的克利福德神父。

original: Can this wait? I'm very busy planning a wedding.
translation: 能等会吗？我正忙着筹划婚礼。

original: May Saint Monica bless you.
translation: 愿圣莫尼卡保佑你。

original: It's almost closing time. I'd get out of here if I was you.
translation: 快关门了。如果我是你，我就离开这。

original: This here is Flak and Shrapnel's gun shop. Pretty catchy, huh? Take a look around. If you see anything you like, I'll be right over here.
translation: 这是“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的枪械店。很好记，呃？随便看看吧。如果看中什么，就去那找我。

original: Decided to check out the shop, eh? If you want any of this shit, just holler.
translation: 想要在店里看看是吗？如果想要什么东西，叫我一声就行了。

original: Made up your mind?
translation: 想好了吗？

original: I'm Flak. If you want something better than that peashooter, stop by Flak and Shrapnel's.
translation: 我是“高炮”弗莱克。如果你想要比那玩具枪好的武器，来“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的店里看看。

original: I'm Flak. If you want something better than that stick of yours, stop by Flak and Shrapnel's.
translation: 我是“高炮”弗莱克。如果想要比你那棍子好的武器，来“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的店里看看。

original: I'm Flak. If you want a decent weapon, stop by Flak and Shrapnel's.
translation: 我是“高炮”弗莱克。如果你想要件像样的武器，来“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的店里看看。

original: Yeah? You need something?
translation: 嗯？你需要些什么？

original: Let me introduce myself. I am Gary Staley gourmet chef and gourmand. I'll be preparing your meal.
translation: 我先介绍下自己。我是美食家兼厨师长加里·斯塔利。由我来为你准备用餐。

original: My specialty is Mirelurk Cakes. Although the iguana is very popular too.
translation: 我的招牌菜是蟹人饼。蜥蜴类的也很受欢迎。

original: I'm Gary. Gary Staley. If you ever get hungry, stop by Gary's Galley.
translation: 我是加里，加里·斯塔利。如果饿了，随时来加里厨房坐坐。

original: Ah! I knew you wouldn't be able to stay away from my cuisine for long.
translation: 啊！我就知道你不久就会再来光临我的餐馆的。

original: How may I serve you?
translation: 请问能为你做些什么？

original: Make it quick. I'm on a tight schedule.
translation: 快点。我时间排得很紧。

original: Is there a problem?
translation: 有什么问题吗？

original: This isn't a good time. My daugher, C.J. is missing.
translation: 现在不合适。我女儿长江不见了。

original: If you hear anything, please let me know right away.
translation: 如果你打听到什么消息，请立刻告诉我。

original: This place could use a few more people willing to work. Everything is falling apart and I'm the only one willing to fix it.
translation: 这可以多招几个愿意做事的人。一切都崩溃了，而我是唯一想要修复的人。

original: I'm busy. I've got a lot of repairs to make.
translation: 我很忙。我有很多修理工作要做。

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: I'm scared. Will you take me home? Take me to my Mom.
translation: 我很害怕。你能带我回家吗？带我去见我妈妈。

original: I'm scared. Will you take me home?
translation: 我很害怕。你能带我回家吗。

original: What's your problem, mister?
translation: 有什么事，先生？

original: What's your problem, lady?
translation: 你有什么问题，女士？

original: I'm Janice Kaplinski, chief botanist. What do you need?
translation: 我是贾尼斯·卡普林斯基，首席植物学家。你需要什么？

original: Be careful around these fruits and vegetables. They're worth more to us than you are.
translation: 别碰这些水果和蔬菜。对我们来说，它们比你值钱多了。

original: You need me? For what?
translation: 你需要我做什么？

original: Well? Are you going to help me or turn me over to the Slaver?
translation: 哦？你是想帮我，还是想把我交给奴隶贩子？

original: Stay away from me. What do you want? Are you one of them?
translation: 离我远点。你想干嘛？你和他们是一伙的吗？

original: Stay away from me!
translation: 滚开！

original: I heard Sister is dead. Thank God!
translation: 听说“修女”死了。太好了！

original: I'd rather be alone just now.
translation: 现在还是让我一个人静一静吧。

original: Welcome to the Weatherly. Mister Buckingham at your service.
translation: 欢迎光临韦瑟利。白金汉先生为你服务。

original: How may I serve you?
translation: 请问能为你做些什么？

original: Haven't run into you before. You probably wouldn't remember me anyway. I'm Mister Lopez.
translation: 之前没遇见过你。或许你也不记得我，我是洛佩斯先生。

original: I wish I had the courage to end it all.
translation: 我希望自己有勇气去结束这一切。

original: I'm just taking things one day at a time.
translation: 我每天就一次。

original: Just leave me alone.
translation: 让我一个人静静。

original: Haven't seen you in here before. Do you need a fix? I might have what you need. You can always come see Paulie to get what you need.
translation: 之前没见过你。需要修理吗？我说不定有你需要的。有什么需要随时都可以过来找保利。

original: Who are you? Got any Psycho? I could really use a fix, but I'm broke.
translation: 你是哪位？有疯狂药吗？我真想自己来一支，可我身无分文。

original: Ha ha! I run the chem shop, but I'm broke and can't buy chems!
translation: 哈哈！我经营药店，却穷得买不起药品！

original: Looking for a fix?
translation: 需要修理吗？

original: Make it quick, will ya? I'm coming down and I gotta get my fix.
translation: 快点，好不好？我到这来就是让你修一下。

original: How the hell did you get in here? Hmph. I suppose you can't be all that bad if you made it this far without dying.
translation: 见鬼，你怎么进来的？哼。我觉得你既然能够活到现在，相信身手一定不错。

original: This is the part where you tell me what the hell you are doing bothering an old man who obviously wants to be left alone.... Get on with it already!
translation: 该你说说为他妈什么来打搅一个显然想独处的老人了……快点啊！ !

original: Stay sharp. They're everywhere.
translation: 机灵点，他们随时会出现。

original: Sir, yes sir! Private Jones reporting!
translation: 是，长官！列兵琼斯报告！

original: Sir, yes sir!
translation: 是，长官！

original: You'd better get out of here. The guards are going to close up soon.
translation: 你最好立刻离开，守卫要包围这里了。

original: Howdy. I'm Seagrave. Seagrave Holmes. I have a little of just about everything here.
translation: 你好。我是西格雷夫，西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。我这什么都有点。

original: You must be new. I'm Seagrave. If you've got anything you want to unload, stop by my shop, Rivet City Supply.
translation: 你一定刚来这。我是西格雷夫。如果你有什么要出手的东西，就来我的店里，铆钉城补给。

original: Hey! I heard that Bannon got caught trying to frame me.
translation: 嗨！听说班侬想要陷害我而被抓了。

original: I also heard you ratted him out. I think you've earned a true, blue friendship discount.
translation: 我还听说你出卖了他。我想你获得了一个真正的友情价。

original: You sneak into my room, steal my property, and then tell the world about it.
translation: 你潜入我的房间，偷走了我的财物，然后大肆宣扬。

original: I'd ban you from my shop if they'd let me. Instead I'll just have to settle for ripping you off.
translation: 如果他们同意，我会把你挡在门外。但我宁愿把你榨干。

original: Take a look around. I got all kinds of stuff in here.
translation: 好好看看吧。我这应有尽有。

original: The shop's closed right now. Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 商店已关门，还有什么能帮到你的吗？

original: Can't you see I'm eating? What do you want?
translation: 难道你没看到我在吃东西？你要干嘛？

original: Hey, you. Have you seen C.J. Young? We have a report that she is missing.
translation: 嗨，你。有没见过杨长江？有报告说她失踪了。

original: I'm on duty. Make it quick.
translation: 我在值班。快点。

original: We're going to close soon. You'd better get out of here.
translation: 我们就要关门了。你还是快点走吧。

original: They call me Shrapnel. I run this place. Got the best damn armament you'll ever see.
translation: 他们叫我“榴弹”小帅。我经营这地方。你在这可以见到最精良的装备。

original: Don't know you, don't care. Keep it short.
translation: 不认识你，也不想。有话快说。

original: If you want any of this shit, just say so. Otherwise keep your fingers the hell away from the triggers. I don't want no accidents.
translation: 想要哪件烂货就说出来。否则让你丫的手指离扳机远点。我不想出乱子。

original: What's your beef?
translation: 你在抱怨什么？

original: They call me Sister. Don't ask.
translation: 他们叫我“修女”。别问为什么。

original: You're bothering me. You don't want to bother me.
translation: 你打扰到我了，打扰我是没好下场的。

original: I'm Tammy. Have you seen my good for nothing son lately?
translation: 我是塔米。你最近看到我那一无是处的孩子没有？

original: The little shit is usually up to no good.
translation: 这狗屎从来不干什么好事。

original: I'm Tammy. Just leave me alone, okay.
translation: 好吧？你在等什么呢？赶快走，让我一个人静一静。

original: Yeah? What do you want?
translation: 是的，你想要什么？

original: Hey, good lookin'. How come you haven't bought me a drink yet?
translation: 嗨，帅哥。为什么你不请我喝一杯？

original: Shit. Just what this hole needs. Another woman.
translation: 狗屎。想什么来什么，又来个女人。

original: Either buy me a drink, or take your skanky ass somewhere else.
translation: 给我买杯喝的，不然你就离我远点。

original: Buy a girl a drink, sailor?
translation: 给女孩买杯喝的，水手？

original: Unless you're going to buy me a round, get lost.
translation: 除非你请我喝一杯，不然就滚开。

original: Welcome to the Weatherly Hotel. I am your hostess, Vera Weatherly.
translation: 欢迎光临韦瑟利旅馆。我是女房主，薇拉·韦瑟利。

original: Charmed to meet you. I am Vera Weatherly of the Weatherly Hotel.
translation: 很高兴认识你。我是韦瑟利旅馆的薇拉·韦瑟利 。

original: Welcome back, ma'am.
translation: 欢迎回来，女士。

original: Welcome back, sir.
translation: 欢迎回来，先生。

original: Nice to see you again.
translation: 很高兴再见到你。

original: I have yet to make your acquaintance. My name is Zimmer.
translation: 初次见面。我叫齐默。

original: Are you in need of assistance?
translation: 需要帮助吗？

original: Those Raiders strapped me with explosives! You've got to help me!
translation: 那些歹徒在我身上绑了炸弹！你得帮帮我！

original: Got to get away! They're burning everything!
translation: 快走！他们会把所有东西都烧了的！

original: Grayditch... it's burning... burning!
translation: 格雷蒂奇……它在燃烧……燃烧！

original: Yeah? What is it?
translation: 嗯？什么事？

original: Who the hell are you?! Where did you come from?! Did Moriarty send you?!
translation: 你他妈是谁？你从哪来？是莫里亚蒂派你来的？！

original: Here... you've done so much for us. I want you to have this. It's all I have to offer you...
translation: 拿好……你为我们做了很多。我希望你收下。我只有这些了……

original: All of us here thank you for everything you've done. For us... for the Wastes. We pooled together and got you this.
translation: 这里所有的人都感谢你为我们做的一切。为我们……为废土。我们凑了些东西给你。

original: It's the best we could do. Please take it, with our thanks.
translation: 这是我们能做的最好的了。请收下它，还有我们的谢意。

original: I wish there were more people like you in the world.
translation: 我希望这世界能有更多像你一样的人。

original: I want you to have this. I hope it helps keep you safe.
translation: 我要你拿着这。我希望它能帮助保护你。

original: Our abolitionist hero!
translation: 我们的废奴英雄！

original: Life is much better for us here than it was in the Wasteland. We're better armed and better fed.
translation: 我们在这的生活比在废土上好多了。我们有了更好的武器和资源。

original: I am most honored to see you again, sir.
translation: 很荣幸再次见到你，先生。

original: I am most honored to see you again, ma'am.
translation: 很荣幸再次见到你，女士。

original: You've come to see us! How sweet.
translation: 你来看我们了！太好了。

original: Thanks to you, we're rebuilding the Memorial.
translation: 谢谢你，我们正在重建纪念堂。

original: It's great to see you again.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你。

original: The slaves know their place now, thanks to you.
translation: 现在奴隶知道他们的地位了，感谢你。

original: I'm not looking for trouble, or conversation either.
translation: 我不想找麻烦，也不想和任何人交谈。

original: All better now, you big baby. Can I get back to work now?
translation: 全好了，你这大孩子。现在我能回去工作了吗？

original: Alright, that should do it. You need anything else?
translation: 好了，这应该可以了。你还需要什么吗？

original: All better now, you big baby. Can I get back to work now?
translation: 全好了，你这大孩子。现在我能回去工作了吗？

original: Okay, you should be fine, and ready to run off and play.
translation: 好。你没事了，准备出去玩吧。

original: I'll say this; it's easier to work on a mungo, since you're a lot bigger. Easier to find a vein, at least.
translation: 我会这样说：对付毛人更简单，至少，更容易找到血管。

original: Good as new. Now, watch yourself out there, all right?
translation: 像新的一样好。出外小心，好吗？

original: Now next time, try to be where the bullets aren't.
translation: 下次试着躲在子弹打不到的地方。

original: There you go. All better, you big baby. You need anything else?
translation: 可以了。全好了，你这大孩子，你还有什么其他需要？

original: That should keep you going for a bit longer.
translation: 那应该能使你多撑一阵了。

original: Medical procedure complete. Further instructions?
translation: 医疗程序完成。进一步命令？

original: RL-3 is ready for another tour of duty, sir!
translation: RL-3已准备好再次执行任务，长官！

original: I am disappointed that things have come to this.
translation: 事情变成这样我很失望。

original: It is well to see you again. Shall we continue?
translation: 很高兴再次见到你。我们继续？

original: Yes? What do you require?
translation: 嗯？你有什么需要？

original: Vigilance is necessary in this location. Be on your guard, my friend.
translation: 在这区域，保持警惕非常重要。小心，我的朋友。

original: There is a foul stench on the wind. Let us not tarry for long.
translation: 这风里都是恶心的臭气。我们别耽搁太久。

original: And so you return. It is good to see you hale. How my I help you, my friend?
translation: 你回来了。很高兴见到你。需要我帮你什么，我的朋友？

original: I had a feeling you would return. Is it further assistance that you seek?
translation: 我有感觉你会回来。你在寻找帮助吗？

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: PLAYER SWING MELEE WEAPON
translation: 玩家挥舞近战武器

original: Can I try that? Just for a minute? Please?
translation: 我能试试看吗？只要一会。

original: I used to have one just like that.
translation: 我以前也有个一模一样的。

original: Neat. What else you got?
translation: 真妙。你还会什么？

original: Watch where you're swinging that, will you?
translation: 挥舞的时候一定要注意安全，听到没？

original: Is that really necessary?
translation: 真的有必要么？

original: Hey, knock it off.
translation: 嗨，停下！

original: Why don't you go swing that somewhere else?
translation: 你为什么不找个其他地方挥舞你那东西？

original: Careful with that.
translation: 谨慎对待。

original: Stop doing that so close to me.
translation: 离我远点。

original: Would you stop screwing around?
translation: 你能不能别胡闹？

original: Watch it, will you?
translation: 小心点，好吗？

original: PLAYER THROW GRENADE
translation: 玩家扔手雷

original: Take cover!
translation: 掩护！

original: Watch out!
translation: 小心点！

original: Look out!
translation: 当心！

original: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

original: Grenade!
translation: 手雷！

original: Take cover!
translation: 掩护！

original: Look out!
translation: 当心！

original: Whoa, whoa! Careful!
translation: 哇哦，哇哦！小心点！

original: Hey, knock it off!
translation: 嗨，住手！

original: Watch it!
translation: 小心！

original: Not so close!
translation: 离远点！

original: I hope you know what you're doing.
translation: 我希望你知道自己在做什么。

original: Cut it out, will you?
translation: 别闹了，好吗？

original: What are you doing? That's dangerous!
translation: 你在干嘛？多危险！

original: Stop that! Someone could get hurt.
translation: 住手！会伤到别人的。

original: You know what you're doing there?
translation: 你知道自己在干嘛吗？

original: Whoa now. Be careful with that thing.
translation: 哇，现在。小心那东西。

original: Don't blow yourself up, okay?
translation: 不要把你自己炸飞了，好吧？

original: You sure that's a good idea?
translation: 你确定这是个好主意？

original: I hope you know what you're doing.
translation: 我希望你知道自己在做什么。

original: Be careful with that.
translation: 小心点。

original: I trust you know what you're doing.
translation: 我相信你知道自己在干嘛。

original: Oh come on. Cut it out.
translation: 哦，够了，住手。

original: Put that down, will you?
translation: 把东西放下，好吗？

original: Give it a rest, will you?
translation: 你就不能消停会吗？

original: Is that really necessary?
translation: 真的有必要么？

original: Are you having fun with that?
translation: 你是不是觉得很好玩啊？

original: You're easily amused, eh?
translation: 你真是自娱自乐啊？

original: What are you going to do with that?
translation: 你拿那东西想去干嘛？

original: Does that belong to you?
translation: 那是你的东西吗？

original: You're kind of weird.
translation: 你这人真古怪。

original: Do you know where that's been?
translation: 你知道那要放在哪儿吗？

original: Is that really necessary?
translation: 真的有必要么？

original: Hey, there's no jumping in the capitol.
translation: 嗨，国会大厦禁止蹦跳。

original: Getting some exercise, are we?
translation: 这是在做运动吗？

original: Watch it, will you?
translation: 看着点，好吗？

original: Oh come on. Pay more attention to what you're doing.
translation: 哦，拜托，你就不能再小心点？

original: Cut it out.
translation: 停下。

original: Hey, be more careful!
translation: 嗨！小心！

original: Why don't you look where you're going?
translation: 你会不会走路啊？

original: What's the big idea?
translation: 你想干嘛？

original: Please be careful.
translation: 请你小心。

original: A bit clumsy today, are we?
translation: 今天身手有点笨拙，对吧？

original: Watch where you're going.
translation: 走路看着点！

original: Put that away. Unless you plan on using it.
translation: 收起来，除非你真的打算用它。

original: I've had guns leveled at me before. If you are wise, you will pause to consider that I am still around to talk about it.
translation: 我以前也被人拿枪指过。如果你还算机灵，在我面前就该收起枪考虑考虑。

original: Only small men require guns to do their persuading.
translation: 只有弱者才会用枪说话。

original: Most civilized people consider waving guns around to be rather uncouth.
translation: 大多数有素质的人都认为玩枪是野蛮人的行为。

original: Why don't you put that away? Or do I need to give you a lesson in manners?
translation: 你怎么不把它收起来？是不是还要我教你一些最基本的规矩？

original: Don't point that thing at me.
translation: 别把那东西对着我。

original: Hey, knock it off.
translation: 嗨，停下！

original: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？

original: Be careful with that!
translation: 小心点！

original: That's not a good idea.
translation: 这不是个好主意。

original: Easy there.
translation: 放松。

original: Watch where you point that.
translation: 请注意你的指向。

original: That's not a toy, you know.
translation: 你要知道，那可不是玩具。

original: Now's not really the time for that, is it?
translation: 现在可不是做那事的时候，对吧？

original: Was that really necessary?
translation: 这真有必要吗？

original: I certainly didn't raise you to behave like that.
translation: 我从没教过你那样做吧？

original: That was uncalled for.
translation: 没那必要。

original: Be more careful, will you?
translation: 注意点！听到没？

original: HELLO
translation: 你好。

original: I'm busy right now, please leave me alone.
translation: 没看见我正忙着吗？别来烦我！

original: Can't you just get out of here?
translation: 你能不能离开这？

original: What the hell do you want?
translation: 你到底想要什么？

original: My place is yours. Kick your feet up and relax.
translation: 不要见外，就像在你自己家一样。歇歇脚，放松放松。

original: Grab anything you need.
translation: 需要什么你就随便拿。

original: Feel free to roam around... you're quite welcome in my place.
translation: 不必拘束……我这非常欢迎你。

original: Howdy Ranger!
translation: 你好！游骑兵。

original: You saved my ass back there... I won't forget it.
translation: 你救了我的命……我不会忘记的。

original: Our savior returns!
translation: 我们的救世主回来啦！

original: Reilly keeps talking' about you. I think you made a friend.
translation: 莱莉一直在谈论你，我想你已经是朋友了。

original: Come back to visit or to patch yourself up?
translation: 是来参观还是修补自己？

original: Nice to see you again.
translation: 很高兴再见到你。

original: Back from splatterin' more Muties?
translation: 刚狩猎完变种人回来？

original: Welcome back to the compound, kid.
translation: 欢迎回到营地，孩子。

original: Me 'n Eugene missed ya.
translation: 我和尤金都很想你。

original: Hey! Over here!
translation: 嗨！这！

original: Been busy testing?
translation: 在忙着测试？

original: How's the field research going?
translation: 研究进行的怎么样？

original: Hey! Book's coming along well, thanks to you. What's next?
translation: 嗨！书的销量很好。谢谢你。还有什么事？

original: There's my super-assistant! What's up?
translation: 这不是我的超级助手吗！什么事？

original: Hey. You. Yeah, you. I don't like the look you're givin' me. Keep it up and I'll break your fuckin' head open.
translation: 嗨。你，嗯，就是你。我不喜欢你那样看着我。如果再看我就把你的脑袋敲碎。

original: Um...uh...I'd like, I mean can you get me some Iguana Bits? And a glass of water. No... yes, a glass of water.
translation: 嗯……呃……我想，我的意思是你能不能给我点蜥蜴肉？再给我杯水。不……啊，是的，一杯水。

original: You'll, uh, um, need help with the barricades soon, right Pappy?
translation: 你，呃，嗯，是不是需要人手帮你搭建防御工事，帕匹？

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: Was there something else you needed?
translation: 你还需要别的什么吗？

original: What else do you want from me?
translation: 我这还有什么你想要的？

original: I've got the best whores in the Wasteland. The two of them are going to break my bed springs some day. Hah ha!
translation: 我在废土上碰到两个最棒的妓女。她们两个会把我的床折腾地粉碎，哈哈哈！

original: Get the heck out of my face!
translation: 把那鬼东西从我面前拿开！

original: Nice to see you again.
translation: 很高兴再见到你。

original: What's going on out there?
translation: 那发生了什么？

original: Huh? How'd you get in here?
translation: 呃？你是怎么到这的？

original: What is it now?
translation: 现在是什么时候？

original: What's going on out there?
translation: 那发生了什么？

original: You're the best mungo ever!
translation: 你是世界上最好的……毛人？

original: I just want Rory to be safe...
translation: 我只希望罗瑞平安无事……

original: Ha ha! We're outta that shitbox!
translation: 哈哈！我们终于逃出了那鬼地方了！

original: We're free!
translation: 我们自由啦！

original: Hey hey, mungo! We're getting' outta here, right?
translation: 嗨，嗨！毛人！我们是要逃出这地方是吗？

original: Hey there.
translation: 嘿你好。

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: Welcome to Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 欢迎来到特佩尼大厦。

original: Charmed, I'm sure...
translation: 幸会，真的……

original: Ah, hello!
translation: 你好。

original: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这干嘛？

original: You are welcome here any time.
translation: 这随时随地欢迎你。

original: Hey there. Come to use the radio set?
translation: 嗨，你是来用电台设备的？

original: Always a pleasure when you visit.
translation: 对你的到来，我总是一如既往地欢迎。

original: Welcome back!
translation: 欢迎回来！

original: Good to see you.
translation: 很高兴见到你。

original: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

original: Hello.
translation: 你好。

original: Begone from this place, blasphemer!
translation: 从这滚蛋，亵渎者！

original: Oasis is no longer a refuge for you, Outsider.
translation: 绿洲不再是你的避难所了，外来人。

original: You stupid-head! I can't believe you mouthed off to the Tree Father.
translation: 你这蠢货！我不能相信你敢这样议论“树之父”。

original: You're no longer welcome here.
translation: 这不再欢迎你。

original: Leave us and never look back, Outsider.
translation: 不准回头，离我们远点，外来人。

original: Such a shame, you could have been of great benefit to us.
translation: 太可惜了，你本可以对我们有很大帮助的。

original: It's time for you to leave.
translation: 你该走了。

original: How can I help you, Outsider?
translation: 有什么可以帮助你的，外来者？

original: Tsk. To think you could have been rich. And now all you'll be is sorry.  VERY sorry.
translation: 啧啧。想想原本你应该已经身缠万贯了。而现在你将拥有的只有你的悔恨。真是太遗憾了。

original: I would advise staying clear of me for awhile. A LONG while.
translation: 我建议你让我一个人静一会。一大会。

original: Tell me. Do you have a death wish?
translation: 告诉我，你可曾有过想死的念头？

original: Hey, what'd I tell you about lookin' at me like that? Are you in the mood for a busted mouth or something?
translation: 嗨，我告诉过你那样看我的后果了吗？还是你想我就打烂你的嘴或者别的地方？

original: You'd best point those peepers somewhere else before I tear 'em out of your skull.
translation: 你最好在我把你的那双眼睛抠出来之前转移你的视线。

original: Did you hear about those newbies? The ones who who went up north lookin' for raids?
translation: 你听说那些新人了吗？他们要去北方寻找歹徒？

original: Oh, hey. Check this out. You know those rookie idiots that tried to head up north?
translation: 哦，嗨。你看。你知道那些白痴新人想试着去北方？

original: Come on in and relax with a cold Nuka-Cola.
translation: 快进来，来瓶核子可乐轻松下。

original: You have the violin! You've done it!
translation: 你拿到小提琴了！你真的办到了！

original: Oh my word! Is that what I think it is?
translation: 我都激动地语无伦次了。

original: Hello, my Child.
translation: 你好，我的孩子。

original: Hello, my Child.
translation: 你好，我的孩子。

original: Father and son, side by side. This is the way it should be.
translation: 上阵父子兵，本应如此。

original: My God, can you believe the devastation out here? That's why our work is so important.
translation: 我的天啊，你能相信外面的这一切吗？那就说明了为什么我们的工作如此重要。

original: I'm glad I've got you watching my back. I'm not quite sure I'm cut out for all this excitement. Not anymore.
translation: 很高兴有你协助我。我都不确信我能不能承受这兴奋。

original: Come on, let's keep moving.
translation: 来吧，我们继续走。

original: Not much farther. We'll be at Rivet City before you know it.
translation: 不是很远。我们会在你知道前抵达铆钉城。

original: What a sight we must be! If only your mother could see us now...
translation: 我们一定是一道壮丽的景观！如果你妈妈现在能看见我们……

original: Let me guess. The dog's coming with us, yes?
translation: 让我猜猜。狗也跟着我们来了，是吗？

original: Ahzrukhal, boy, I want to talk to you.
translation: 阿祖卡，孩子，我想和你谈谈。

original: Well hello there, sweeheart.
translation: 你好，你好，甜心。

original: Hello there, Junior.
translation: 你好，新人。

original: Hello there, Junior, sweetheart. It's a lovely day, isn't it?
translation: 你好，新人，甜心。今天天气不错，对吧？

original: Hey there, Junior!
translation: 嗨，新人！

original: How's it going, sport?
translation: 情况怎样，老兄？

original: Hey there, little buddy!
translation: 嗨，小家伙！

original: Mmmm... dinner smells delicious, honey!
translation: 嗯……晚餐闻起来真不错，亲爱的！

original: There's my honey pie!
translation: 我的爱心派！

original: Honeypie, can I talk to you?
translation: 爱心派，我能和你谈谈吗？

original: Hi, Mrs. Smith!
translation: 嘿，史密斯先生！

original: Dinner smells great, mom!
translation: 晚餐闻起来真香，妈妈！

original: Room's all clean, mom!
translation: 房间整理好了，妈妈！

original: You got the stuff, I got the caps. A match made in heaven.
translation: 你得到东西，我得到瓶盖。一举“两”得。

original: All my equipment is ready. Just need some Sugar Bombs.
translation: 我的所有设备都已准备妥当，就只差一些糖麦弹。

original: Ah. You're back. Good...
translation: 啊。你回来了。真好……

original: Whoa, who the hell are you?
translation: 哇，你他妈是谁？

original: So what's the deal, smoothskin?
translation: 什么交易，光皮肤？

original: Goddamn are you one ugly son-of-a-bitch!
translation: 你这该死的真他妈恶心！

original: Keep it moving, meat.
translation: 继续走，烂肉。

original: Yeah? You got somethin' to say?
translation: 嗯？你刚才想说什么？

original: No one messes with Sudden-Death Overtime. No one.
translation: 没人敢惹“超时轰杀”。没人。

original: Damn, poor Mercier. He was a good Winger.
translation: 该死，可怜的梅西埃。他是个好护卫。

original: Whew... it's hot in this mask.
translation: 哟……这面具还真烫。

original: Well if it isn't our "hero."
translation: 好吧，如果那不是我们的“英雄”。

original: Hey kid.
translation: 嗨，孩子。

original: Hey. Thanks again. Couldn't have done it with out ya.
translation: 嗨。再次感谢你。没有你办不到。

original: Trading caps for crap, step right up!
translation: 卖破烂喽，过来看看！

original: Got some junk to unload? I'm buying!
translation: 有什么不需要的垃圾吗？我要！

original: Welcome, friend. Looking for more appropriate attire?
translation: 欢迎，朋友。想买套合适的漂亮衣服吗？

original: The spirits told me you'd be coming. And that you're looking to buy.
translation: 第六感告诉我你会来，没想到你真的来买东西了。

original: Here for a pick-me-up?
translation: 想把“我”买走吗？

original: If you've got the caps, I've got your fix.
translation: 如果你有瓶盖，我就给你修。

original: Here to pick up a few of my marvelous toys?
translation: 想从我这买点惊人的小玩具吗？

original: Fear not, for Lucky Harith is here to offer you protection for a price!
translation: 不用害怕，幸运哈里斯在这为你提供有偿保护！

original: Looking to make a trade?
translation: 想做些买卖吗？

original: Searching for that special something?
translation: 想买特殊物品？

original: Excuse me.
translation: 打扰一下。

original: Don't you have a component to deliver?
translation: 你不是有什么东西要递送？

original: Hey, Andy. Got a sec?
translation: 嗨，安迪。你有空吗？

original: Andy, listen to this great idea I had!
translation: 安迪，听听我的好主意！

original: Hey there, Andy.
translation: 嗨，安迪！

original: Billy, I want to talk to you...
translation: 比利，我想和你谈谈……

original: Billy, can I talk to you about something?
translation: 比利，我有些事，你看能不能和你谈谈？

original: Billy...
translation: 比利……

original: Hey there, Billy...
translation: 嗨，比利……

original: Mister Moriarty? Can I talk to you?
translation: 莫里亚蒂先生？我能和您谈谈吗？

original: Umm... Mister Moriarty? Sir?
translation: 呃……莫里亚蒂先生？先生？

original: Hey, Colin.
translation: 嘿，科林。

original: Colin... Listen...
translation: 科林……听着……

original: Colin.
translation: 科林。

original: Good morning, Mr. Moriarty...
translation: 早上好，莫里亚蒂先生……

original: Mr. Moriarty...
translation: 莫里亚蒂先生……

original: Husband, a word if you will.
translation: 老公，如果你同意就点点头。

original: Might we talk, dearest husband?
translation: 我们能不能谈谈，亲爱的老公？

original: Confessor.
translation: 忏悔者。

original: Hey, Jenny. Lookin' good. What've you got for me today?
translation: 嗨，珍妮。你看上去真不错。今天你给我准备了什么东西？

original: Well, hello there, sweetie. What's on the menu today?
translation: 嗨，你好，甜心。今天的菜单上都有些什么？

original: Hi, Jenny.
translation: 嘿，珍妮。

original: Hey, Jenny.
translation: 嗨，珍妮。

original: Jenny...
translation: 珍妮……

original: What's up, Jericho?
translation: 怎么了，耶利哥？

original: Hey, Jericho.
translation: 嗨，耶利哥。

original: Jericho...
translation: 耶利哥……

original: Gob. These people aren't nearly drunk enough. Fix it.
translation: 盖博，这些人还没喝够呢，继续上酒。

original: Gob!
translation: 盖博！

original: I want a word with you, zombie.
translation: 我想和你说两句，丧尸。

original: Hey. Zombie. Yeah, you. Come here.
translation: 嗨。丧尸。嗯，就是你，过来。

original: Gob. Here. Now.
translation: 盖博。过来，快点。

original: Heya, Gob...
translation: 你好，盖博……

original: Gob...
translation: 盖博……

original: Come here for a second, son. I want to talk to you.
translation: 过来，孩子。我有话要和你说。

original: Harden, come here, boy. I want to talk to you.
translation: 哈登，过来，孩子。我想和你谈谈。

original: It's my turn to be the Raiders!
translation: 该轮到我做歹徒了！

original: I see you, Harden!
translation: 我看见你啦，哈登！

original: C'mon, Harden! Let's go over here!
translation: 过来，哈登！到这来！

original: Hey there, Harden.
translation: 嗨，哈登。

original: Leo, we need to talk.
translation: 利奥，我想我们需要谈谈。

original: Hey, Leo. Come here. I want to talk to you about something.
translation: 嗨，利奥。到这来。有些事我想和你谈谈。

original: Leo...
translation: 利奥……

original: Miss West...
translation: 维斯特小姐……

original: Sheriff Simms...
translation: 西姆斯警长……

original: Dad! Dad, I want to talk to you!
translation: 爸爸！爸爸，我有话要和你说！

original: Nothing stops the Railroad.
translation: 没有东西可以阻止“轨道”。

original: Hi there!
translation: 你好啊!

original: You MUST be lost...
translation: 觉得商业街怎么样？

original: How's the Mall treatin' ya?
translation: 欢迎所有人光临第九环……

original: All are welcome here at the Ninth Circle...
translation: 坐下，喝酒，付账。这会让你感觉很好。

original: Welcome to the Capital Preservation Society!
translation: 欢迎来到首都保护协会！

original: It's so very nice to see you again.
translation: 再次见到你真是件令人开心的事。

original: Good to have you back.
translation: 很高兴你回来了。

original: If you have any questions about the exhibits, please let me know.
translation: 如果你对这些展品有什么疑问，请告诉我。

original: Do have a look around, but don't touch anything.
translation: 你可以四处看看，但请勿动手。

original: We have the most complete archive of U.S. historical documents in the Wasteland.
translation: 在这片废土上要找美国历史的文件，那就属我们拥有的资料最完整了。

original: Get the hell away from me.
translation: 离我远点。

original: Keep it moving. I got a whole bottle of whiskey with my name on it.
translation: 继续前进。我有一整瓶刻着我名字的威士忌。

original: The sooner we get back, the sooner we get paid.
translation: 我们越早回来，就越早拿到报酬。

original: Let's get this scrap of paper to Abraham.
translation: 让我们把这些纸带给亚伯拉罕。

original: The Declaration is in the safe, I just know it.
translation: 《独立宣言》在安全的地方，我确定。

original: That robot's brain is scrambled.
translation: 那机器人的脑子一定是短路了。

original: What a nutjob.
translation: 这活可不简单。

original: This place is pretty far down, no wonder there's so little damage.
translation: 这地方真是相当深啊，只受到这么一点点损伤也就不足为奇了。

original: This place isn't right. Robots still active?
translation: 这地方不正常。机器人仍在激活状态？

original: We're getting closer, I can feel it.
translation: 我有感觉我们越来越接近了。

original: I know this place like the back of my hand.
translation: 我对这地方了如指掌。

original: So far, so good.
translation: 到目前为止一切都很好。

original: Let's keep moving.
translation: 咱们接着走吧。

original: Come on, let me loose!
translation: 拜托，救救我！

original: Time to go yet?
translation: 该出发了吧？

original: Nothing new, sir.
translation: 没什么情况，先生。

original: Sir, people are mostly staying quiet.
translation: 平安无事，先生。

original: Security check, people. Everything all right?
translation: 安全检查。一切正常？

original: Everyone sticking to curfew down here? Good.
translation: 这的每个人都严格遵守宵禁令？很好。

original: Everything all right down here?
translation: 怎么样？一切还正常吗？

original: Standard check-in. Things okay?
translation: 情况怎么样？

original: All quiet down here, right?
translation: 看来没什么情况，对吧？

original: Overseer's glad to see everyone staying so calm down here.
translation: 监督者看见大家情绪稳定很高兴，

original: For your safety, please stand clear.
translation: 为了你的安全，请站远点。

original: I'll make it right... they'll see.
translation: 我会搞定的……让他们等着瞧。

original: Back to the drawing board.
translation: 回到制图版。

original: Sigh. Time to start back at square one.
translation: 唉。该动身回出发点了。

original: You wish to add something to my hypothesis?
translation: 你想对我的假设补充点什么吗？

original: I suppose I could answer a few more queries.
translation: 我想我能再回答一些问题。

original: How else may I assist you in your endeavors?
translation: 我还能协助你些什么？

original: Oh my!
translation: 天哪！

original: Where did I go wrong? I must run more tests.
translation: 哪出错了？看来我必须多测试一下。

original: Hmmm, carry the one... no, wait. That's just what it's expecting me to do!
translation: 唔，带上这……不，等等。这么做正是它所期望的！

original: Shhhh, quiet please. Science is in progress!
translation: 嘘，请安静。这里正在进行科学实验

original: Holy moley! You actually came back like you said you would! Did you find me a home?
translation: 哇塞！你真的像你说的那样回来了！你给我找到家了吗？

original: The ants! They're all dead! Every single one of 'em!
translation: 该死的蚂蚁，他们都死了！一个不剩！

original: Wow! Are you the one that made all these ants do that?!
translation: 哇！你就是制造这些蚂蚁的人？！

original: I'm glad you came back, mister.
translation: 很高兴你回来，先生。

original: I'm glad you came back, lady.
translation: 很高兴你回来，女士。

original: I hope you have good news for me, I really do!
translation: 真希望你有好消息给我！

original: Hey! You're back! Any word? Any news?!
translation: 嗨！你回来啦！快告诉我结果怎样？有什么新消息？！

original: Oh, you decided to come back, huh?
translation: 哦，你决定回来，呃？

original: Th-those... those...those...
translation: 那……那……那些……

original: Yeah, whatcha' need mister?
translation: 嗯，你要什么，先生？

original: Yeah, whatcha' need lady?
translation: 嗯，你要什么，小姐？

original: Leave us alone!
translation: 别烦我们，走开！

original: Get out!
translation: 滚出去！

original: Don't do this. Please tell me the code.
translation: 别这样。请告诉我密码。

original: Keep moving!
translation: 继续前进！

original: Get inside!
translation: 进去！

original: Head for the Control Room.
translation: 前往控制室。

original: What did you do?
translation: 你都干了什么？

original: Shouldn't you be leaving now?
translation: 你现在不是该走了吗？

original: Well done, well done!
translation: 干得好，干得好！

original: The Pint-Sized Slasher returns!
translation: 小杀手回来啦！

original: Oh, Mabel. Always good for a laugh.
translation: 哦，梅布尔。你总是惹人发笑。

original: Poor Janet and Roger.
translation: 可怜的珍妮特和罗杰。

original: I'm waiting to see how you handle the Rockwells...
translation: 我等着看你怎么处理罗克韦尔一家……

original: You won the game!
translation: 你赢啦！

original: Have you gone to see Timmy yet?
translation: 你还没去找提米？

original: Good, you made it.
translation: 很好，你做的很棒。

original: Glad to see you here.
translation: 很高兴见到你。

original: Hey, look. Another rebel.
translation: 嗨，看，又一个反叛的。

original: Good to see another rebel.
translation: 又一个反叛的，很好。

original: Hey, how's the gang holding up?
translation: 嗨，帮派维持得怎么样？

original: Still representing the gang? Good to see, man.
translation: 仍是帮派？很高兴见到你，伙计。

original: Is the place secure? Can we talk freely?
translation: 这地方安全吗？在这交谈没事吧？

original: Good to see you here. Please keep quiet, you never know who's listening.
translation: 在这见到你很高兴。不过要保持安静，隔墙有耳。

original: Hi, Christine. How's life stuck in the freak dorm?
translation: 嘿，克里斯廷。在这鬼宿舍过得怎样啊？

original: Hi, Chrissie. Any stories from the weirdo dorm?
translation: 嘿，克里斯。有什么那古怪宿舍的故事吗？

original: Hi, Susie!
translation: 嘿，苏茜！

original: Good to see you, Susie!
translation: 见到你很高兴，苏茜！

original: Stanley, how's everything going downstairs?
translation: 斯坦利，楼下情况怎么样？

original: Well, Stanley, how's everything going down in the reactor?
translation: 斯坦利，反应堆那目前怎么样？

original: Good to see ya, Butch.
translation: 很高兴见到你，布奇。

original: Tunnel Snakes rule, huh?
translation: 穴蛇帮主宰一切，呃？

original: Man, I sure wish we could blow this joint.
translation: 听我说，我当然希望能离开这地方。

original: Please, be careful.
translation: 千万要小心。

original: You've got to change the Overseer's mind.
translation: 你必须要让监督者改变想法。

original: You've got to convince them it isn't safe outside!
translation: 你必须要让他们相信外面是不安全的！

original: Are you sure you won't stay and help?
translation: 你确定你不会留下来帮忙？

original: Go on, get out.
translation: 滚，滚出去。

original: I'm sorry. Goodbye.
translation: 对不起，再见。

original: Sorry to see you go.
translation: 你要走我很遗憾。

original: You did it!
translation: 你做到了！

original: What have you done?
translation: 你做了什么？

original: I never thought you'd be back.
translation: 我从没想过你会回来。

original: It's good to see you again.
translation: 再见到你真是太好了。

original: Leave me alone.
translation: 离我远点。

original: Why won't you just leave us alone? You've done enough damage.
translation: 为什么你就不能放过我们？你已经给我们带来了那么多伤害。

original: Go ahead and start something, I dare you.
translation: 想继续惹事？谅你也不敢！

original: You don't belong here anymore.
translation: 从现在起这不欢迎你。

original: Who do we have here?
translation: 看是谁来了？

original: Excellent.
translation: 太棒了！

original: You're not going to ask me to hold your hand through this are you?
translation: 你没打算让我手把手教你怎么做吧？

original: Yes? Are you having trouble with your little assignment? Do I need to find someone else?
translation: 怎么了？布置给你的小任务出问题了？是不是我应该另外找个人来做？

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: We're all still breathing. So I know you didn't screw up. You got something on your mind?
translation: 我们还活着。所以我知道你还没把一切搞砸。你有什么新的主意吗？

original: Were you just kidding 'bout disarming that thing?
translation: 你是在开玩笑吧？你要解除那玩意？

original: You looking for the mayor or the sheriff?
translation: 你是在找镇长还是警长？

original: It was a wonderful thing you did. Inspirational. Truly.
translation: 你做的真是太棒了。灵气十足，真的。

original: Yes friend? Is there something I can assist you with?
translation: 什么事，朋友？有什么需要我协助的？

original: Thanks again for you part in paving the way towards progress.
translation: 再次对你为我们铺平前进的道路而表示感谢。

original: Boy do I breathe a lot easier knowing that thing is truly dead!
translation: 知道那东西真的死了，可让我松了一口气！

original: Mighty fine thing you did for this town.
translation: 你为这座镇子做了伟大的事。

original: Hey friend!
translation: 嗨，朋友！

original: Well? Is it done yet? Did you get that door open?
translation: 怎么样？搞定了？你打开那扇门了？

original: What are you waiting for? Go open that emergency door!
translation: 你还在等什么？快去打开那扇紧急出口的门！

original: What?! You're not here with good news, are you?
translation: 什么？！我想你没带来好消息，是不是？

original: What's up with those bigots at the tower?
translation: 大厦里的那些偏执狂怎样？

original: Yeah! We did it!
translation: 耶！我们成功了！

original: Hahaha! They'll get it now!
translation: 哈哈哈！现在又他们好受的了。

original: I can smell the stink of Ghoul on you.
translation: 我能闻到你身上僵尸的恶臭味。

original: Well? What's the status on Roy Phillips and his gang?
translation: 嗯？罗伊·菲利普斯和他那帮人情况怎么样？

original: Not ready to take on those Ghouls after all? Huh?
translation: 还是不愿意雇用这些僵尸？呃？

original: How'd you get in here?!
translation: 你怎么来这的！？

original: We should get out of here, don't you think?
translation: 我们该立刻离开这，你认为呢？

original: You can't leave me here!
translation: 你不能把我扔在这！

original: Alright! Hi there!
translation: 太棒了！嘿，你好！

original: Remember my offer, Outsider: cash for pre-war books.
translation: 记住我的任务：寻找战前书籍，我会给你报酬。

original: If you have any pre-war books, I'll take them.
translation: 只要你有战前的书籍，我照单全收。

original: You are not welcome here.
translation: 这不欢迎你。

original: Do you have any scrap metal for me?
translation: 你有没有什么废铜烂铁给我？

original: Remember: cash for scrap metal.
translation: 记住，收集废铜烂铁。

original: Casdin said you're clear.
translation: 卡斯丁说你没问题了。

original: Stay in line, and you'll be okay.
translation: 规矩点对你有好处。

original: Don't start anything and you'll be fine. Um, probably.
translation: 如果你不惹事你就不会有事。嗯，这也是相对而言。

original: Keep that tech coming, and we'll make it worth your while.
translation: 多带些高科技产品来，我们会酬谢你的。

original: You are in the presence of ant royalty!
translation: 你就在蚁后的面前。

original: Yes, citizen?
translation: 什么事，平民？

original: Whatever you can do to help our town, we'd appreciate it.
translation: 任何事，只要能帮助我们的镇子，我们都会对你心存感激。

original: We appreciate you taking care of our town's little problem.
translation: 我们感谢你帮我们的镇子解决了点小问题。

original: Any luck finding those two troublemakers, yet?
translation: 有没有找到那两个惹事的家伙？

original: When you find those two costumed idiots, put a bullet in their heads for me.
translation: 你要是看见那两个穿着戏服的白痴，帮我朝他们的头上开一枪。

original: Nice work cleaning up the town.
translation: 那镇子的扫荡工作做得不错。

original: Town's a lot safer now. Thanks.
translation: 镇子现在安全多了，多谢。

original: Aw, you made this place get so boring.
translation: 啊，你让这地方变得无聊起来了。

original: Run while you can!
translation: 快跑！

original: You're back! Oh my gosh!
translation: 你回来了！我的天！

original: Don't you have a letter to deliver?
translation: 你不是有封信要送吗？

original: Hey there, glad you're back.
translation: 嗨，很高兴你回来了。

original: A traveler, eh?
translation: 你是个旅行者吧？

original: Ah, you've returned.
translation: 啊，你回来啦。

original: It appears we have a lot to speak about.
translation: 看来我们有好多东西要谈。

original: Welcome to Meresti, human.
translation: 米尔斯蒂欢迎你，人类。

original: You wish to speak with me?
translation: 你想和我说话？

original: I take it you found the place.
translation: 我猜你找到那地方了。

original: I'm surprised to see you... thought you'd run for the hills.
translation: 见到你我很惊讶…我以为你逃之夭夭了呢。

original: I hope you killed every last one of those bastards.
translation: 我希望你把那些杂种都赶尽杀绝了。

original: You're back already? What do you have for me?
translation: 你已经回来啦？有没有给我的东西？

original: Please tell me you've found something.
translation: 你一定找到了些有用的东西。

original: I hope you got some good news tucked away for me.
translation: 我希望你给我带来了好消息。

original: Well, is everyone okay?
translation: 所有人都好吗？

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: I've never seen you around here before.
translation: 我以前从没在这见过你。

original: Please don't take Ian away from us.
translation: 请不要把伊恩从我们身边带走。

original: Human or not, I don't care. You got caps, I got stuff.
translation: 管你是人是鬼，你付钱，我出货。

original: Anything you need, I got it.
translation: 我这应有尽有。

original: I'll be at my store later. Catch me there in the Common Area.
translation: 我迟点就回店里。来工作间找我。

original: You new here too?
translation: 你也是新来的？

original: Oh, hey there.
translation: 哦，嗨。

original: You got the cash, I got the time.
translation: 你有钱，我就有时间。

original: Howdy, handsome.
translation: 嗨，帅哥。

original: Howdy, cutie.
translation: 嗨，美人。

original: Hello there, stranger.
translation: 你好，陌生人。

original: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

original: Oh, it's you again. What's up?
translation: 哦，又是你？什么事？

original: What the hell are you doing in here?
translation: 你到底在这想要干嘛？

original: Wasn't I clear the last time you were here?
translation: 是不是上次你在这的时候我没说清楚？

original: Welcome back to Arefu, kid.
translation: 欢迎回到阿雷富，孩子。

original: Huh? Oh, you're back.
translation: 呃？哦，是你回来啦！

original: Hey ho! Welcome back to our cozy village!
translation: 嗨！欢迎回到我们舒适宜人的镇子。

original: Hey, you're back! Let's chat a while.
translation: 嗨，你可回来了！让我们好好聊一会。

original: Huh? Almost didn't see you there.
translation: 呃？刚才差点没看到你。。

original: What the fuck do you want?
translation: 你他妈的到底想干嘛？

original: What brings you back to Megaton?
translation: 什么风把你吹回了兆吨镇？

original: I knew you couldn't stay away!
translation: 你为何就是不肯离我远点？

original: The Family welcomes your return with open arms.
translation: 我们热情地张开双臂欢迎你回来。

original: Thanks again for straightening out Ian.
translation: 再次感谢你让我们的伊恩改邪归正。

original: Well, well look who's back.
translation: 看看是谁回来了？

original: Look what the cat dragged in.
translation: 看看这阵风把谁给吹来了？

original: If you're here to give blood, we're always willing to accept.... Just kidding!
translation: 如果你来这是想“无偿献血”，我们的大门始终向你打开…哈哈，开个玩笑！

original: Needed a place to get out of the sun for a while, eh? I understand completely.
translation: 是不是想找个地方躲躲这当头的烈日？我完全明白你的心思。

original: Come back to the "scary vampire lair" have we? He he he!
translation: 我们又回到了“恐怖血族洞穴”，对吧？呵呵呵！

original: I was wondering if we could speak a moment.
translation: 我很荣幸能和你交谈。

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: You look quite troubled, my darling. What's on your mind?
translation: 你看起来心事重重，亲爱的。你在想什么？

original: And how are we doing today?
translation: 那我们今天过得怎么样？

original: Hey there, how's it going?
translation: 嗨，近来怎么样？

original: How's life treating ya?
translation: 过得怎么样？

original: Well hey there, cutie... how's it hangin'?
translation: 嗨，小妞……最近怎么样？

original: Well hey there, sweetie... how's tricks?
translation: 嗨，甜心……想找点乐子吗？

original: Can we go now?
translation: 我们现在能走了吗？

original: I'm still here. Waiting for you.
translation: 我一直在这，等你。

original: I'm bored!
translation: 我无聊死了！

original: Are we actually gonna do something, or am I gonna stand here all day?
translation: 我们是不是真的该找些事做，难道就这样在这傻站着？

original: I patiently await your word.
translation: 我在很耐心的等你下令。

original: RL-3 stands at attention, sir!
translation: RL-3静候命令，长官！

original: I am vigilant.
translation: 警戒中。

original: Oh, another soul to add to my circle of darkness.
translation: 哦，我的黑圈内又多了一个灵魂。

original: Looks like the muties missed one.
translation: 看上去变种人漏过了一个。

original: Oh, great, another person trying to kill us all off.
translation: 哦，太棒了，又一个家伙想把我们都干掉。

original: Someone new in town? You aren't from Lamplight.
translation: 新来的？你不是从小灯镇来的。

original: Welcome to my clinic. If you're hurt, then you're in the right place.
translation: 欢迎来到我的诊所。如果你受伤了，那你真是来对地方了。

original: Hey there. Are you hurt?
translation: 嗨，你受伤了？

original: The Wastelander from Germantown. How's life treating you?
translation: 从日耳曼镇来的废土游民。你的日子过得怎么样？

original: Here to help me out again?
translation: 来这想再帮我一把？

original: Hey, look at me. I'm in Big Town!
translation: 嗨，看着我。我可是在大镇里！

original: You saved my life. Thank you.
translation: 你救了我的命，谢谢。

original: I've got nothing to say until Hannibal says you're okay.
translation: 在汉尼拔说你没问题前，我是不会和你说话的。

original: I hope you succeed, stranger. I can't wait to set up a school for freed slaves.
translation: 我希望你成功，陌生人。我已经等不及为重获自由的奴隶建造一所学校了。

original: Careful where you point that thing. Can't we talk about this?
translation: 小心别让你的家伙走火了。我们就不能谈谈吗？

original: Hey you. Ya, you. I want to talk to you.
translation: 是你啊，你好，我正想和你谈谈。

original: Changed your mind?
translation: 改变主意了吗？

original: Well, look who's back.
translation: 来，看看谁回来了？

original: So dude, did that key ever get you anything?
translation: 我说，老兄，那钥匙就没帮你找到什么东西？

original: Ah! It's the keeper of the key.
translation: 啊！是管钥匙的家伙！

original: Hey, clown shoes. I hope that key was worth it.
translation: 嗨，乡巴佬。我希望那钥匙是有价值的。

original: Too bad about Crowley. I heard Tenpenny put out a contract on him.
translation: 这下考利糟糕了。我听说特佩尼与他签订了一份协议。

original: Is something amiss?
translation: 有什么事出错了吗？

original: We'll begin as soon as the rest of the Treeminders have taken their places.
translation: 我们等其他树启者一休息就开始行动。

original: Yes, Outsider?
translation: 什么事，外来者？

original: I can't believe you're here!
translation: 我不敢相信你在这！

original: All will be answered soon, my friend.
translation: 所有问题都将会被解答，我的朋友。

original: Welcome, Outsider... welcome to Oasis!
translation: 欢迎，外来者……欢迎来到绿洲！

original: I hate you! I hate you!
translation: 我恨你！我恨你！

original: Ah, Outsider... back again I see.
translation: 哦，外来人……你又回来了。

original: It's good to see you again, Outsider.
translation: 很高兴又见到你，外来人。

original: We welcome you always with outstretched arms.
translation: 我们一直会向你伸出友谊之手。

original: Hello again, Outsider.
translation: 你好，外来人。

original: Oasis is no more.
translation: 绿洲不复存在。

original: It can't be... it just can't be!
translation: 不可能……绝对不可能！

original: The Great One is dead!
translation: 圣贤已经死了！

original: It's over... all over.
translation: 结束了……都结束了。

original: We are lost!
translation: 我们迷失了！

original: Tree Father and Leaf Mother have conferred with the Great One. Something important must have happened.
translation: “树之父”和“叶之母”去见圣贤了。肯定有什么重要的事发生了。

original: Our leaders have spoken with the Great One. I hope nothing's wrong.
translation: 我们的首领已经与圣贤谈过了。希望别出什么事。

original: Something here is different. I can feel it.
translation: 这有变化。我能感觉的到。

original: I feel a change in the air. I wonder what it could be.
translation: 我感到空气中出现了些变化。我想知道是什么变了。

original: You're a guest among us and quite welcome, Outsider.
translation: 你是我们的贵宾，外来人。

original: Cast aside your bits of technology and marvel at His miracles, Outsider.
translation: 忘掉你脑中那点可怜的技术知识吧，感受他的伟大，外来人。

original: Revel, Outsider. You are under His protection.
translation: 欢呼吧，外来者。你受到了他的庇护。

original: There's nowhere like this left in the world anymore, eh Outsider?
translation: 这世界中没有任何地方能像这一样，哦，外来人？

original: This place is wonderful, isn't it?
translation: 这真漂亮，不是吗？

original: Hello, Outsider! It's very nice to see you!
translation: 你好，外来人！很高兴见到你！

original: Rejoice, the Great One wishes to see you!
translation: 欣喜吧，圣贤想见你！

original: You are welcome amongst us, Outsider.
translation: 外来者，我们欢迎你的到来。

original: Revel, Outsider, for He has chosen you!
translation: 欢呼吧，外来人，他选中了你！

original: We welcome you with outstretched arms.
translation: 我们向你伸出友谊之手。

original: Welcome to Oasis, Outsider.
translation: 欢迎来到绿洲，外来人。

original: We're very pleased to see you, Outsider.
translation: 非常高兴见到你，外来人。

original: Welcome, Outsider!
