original: <hocks something up>
translation: <典当物品>

original: <coughs>
translation: <咳嗽>

original: <coughs>
translation: <咳嗽>

original: <coughs> ...terrible air down here...
translation: <咳嗽> ……这的空气真糟糕……

original: <wheezing cough>
translation: <咳嗽气喘>

original: <clears throat>
translation: <清嗓>

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: You got something to say?
translation: 你有话要说？

original: Enjoying your stay?
translation: 过的愉快吗？

original: Phew... you smell that?
translation: 该死……你闻到了吗？

original: Don't let the smell get to you.
translation: 快捂住你的鼻子。

original: This is our town. You'd best be careful.
translation: 这是我们的小城镇。你最好小心。

original: ...think you own the place...
translation: ……你以为这是你的地盘……

original: We don't get a lot of your kind down here.
translation: 我们这像你这种人不多。

original: Watch your step.
translation: 注意脚下。

original: Just try not to kill anyone while you're here.
translation: 当你在这的时候请不要杀人。

original: Don't mess with us, we won't mess with you.
translation: 不要打扰我们，我们也不会打扰你。

original: Boy, you and I need to talk.
translation: 孩子，让我们谈谈。

original: Ahzrukhal, boy, I need to talk to you.
translation: 阿祖卡，孩子，我有话要和你说。

original: Oh, oh! Mr Ahzrukhal, I want to ask you something.
translation: 哦，哦！阿祖卡先生，我有些事要问你。

original: Oh, hey... Mr. <coughs> .... Mr. Ahzrukhal... hi.
translation: 哦，嗨……阿……<咳嗽>阿祖卡先生……嗨。

original: Hey, Mr. Ahzrukhal...
translation: 嗨，阿祖卡先生……

original: Mr. Ahzrukhal...
translation: 阿祖卡先生……

original: Excuse me, Mr. Ahzrukhal...
translation: 打扰了，阿祖卡先生……

original: Mr. Ahzrukhal.
translation: 阿祖卡先生。

original: Hello, Ahzrukhal.
translation: 你好，阿祖卡。

original: Ahzrukhal...
translation: 阿祖卡……

original: Carol, why don't you get some rest? You look so tired.
translation: 卡洛尔，你为什么不休息？你看上去很疲惫。

original: Why don't you go get some sleep, Carol. I can manage things up here for a while.
translation: 你为什么不去睡会，卡洛尔。这有我能帮你照看。

original: Hey, are you okay? You're not looking so good.
translation: 嗨，你还好吗？你脸色看上去很不好。

original: Carol, honey, I'm worried about you. Are you alright?
translation: 卡洛尔，亲爱的，我很担心你。你没事吧？

original: Hey, Carol. You okay? You don't look so good.
translation: 嗨，卡洛尔。你没事吧？你看上去不舒服。

original: Hi, Carol.
translation: 嘿，卡洛尔。

original: Hello, Carol. It's been pretty quiet around here lately.
translation: 你好，卡洛尔。最近这清静了很多。

original: Hi, Carol. You know, things seem a little quiet around here.
translation: 嘿，卡洛尔。我说这的一切好像平静了。

original: Carol...
translation: 卡洛尔……

original: Dammit... it was attached a second ago... Hey! Robot! You seen any, you know, toes around here?
translation: 该死……刚才还在的……嗨！机器人！你有没有看见……就是……这儿附近有脚趾？

original: Hey, robot, have you seen any toes laying around here?
translation: 嗨，机器人，你有没有看见放在这的脚趾？

original: All clear, Cerberus?
translation: 一切正常么，地狱犬？

original: Have you seen anything unusual, Cerberus?
translation: 你有没有发现什么异常，地狱犬？

original: Cerberus, run your diagnostic program. Code 662-847-B.
translation: 地狱犬，运行一下你的诊断程序。密码662-847-B。

original: Cerberus, you're still making that god awful noise. Go ahead and run that diagnostic program. Code 662-847-B.
translation: 地狱犬，你怎么还在发出那种令人讨厌的噪音。快运行你的诊断程序。密码662-847-B。

original: Why, hello there, Cerberus.
translation: 噢，你好，地狱犬。

original: Cerberus! How are you? Programming holding up?
translation: 地狱犬！你好吗？程序运行得怎么样？

original: Charon. Charon! Look at me when I'm talking to you!
translation: 卡戎。卡戎！当我和你说话的时候看着我！

original: Charon. Charon! Look at me when I'm talking to you!
translation: 卡戎。卡戎！当我和你说话的时候看着我！

original: Charon... come here. I want to talk to you about something...
translation: 卡戎……过来。有些事我想和你谈谈……

original: Charon. Come here. Now.
translation: 卡戎。过来，快点。

original: Hey, Charon...
translation: 嗨，卡戎……

original: I was wondering something...
translation: 我在想一些事……

original: Hey... uh... Charon, is it? I was...
translation: 嗨……呃……你叫卡戎，对吧？我是……

original: Good to see you, Doctor Barrows.
translation: 很高兴见到你，巴罗斯医生。

original: Hey there, Doc.
translation: 嗨，医生。

original: Doc Barrows! Good to see you!
translation: 巴罗斯医生！见到你真高兴！

original: If it isn't ol' Doc Barrows. Hey there, Doc!
translation: 是巴罗斯医生。嗨，医生！

original: Doctor Barrows...
translation: 巴罗斯医生……

original: Greta, bring me some of that slop that you call food.
translation: 葛丽泰，给我来点被你称作食物的那种东西。

original: Greta, bring me something. Preferably something dead this time. And not glowing.
translation: 葛丽泰，给我拿点东西吃。唉，现在是万物死亡而不是生长的时候。

original: Hey, Greta, can I get a drink?
translation: 嗨，葛丽泰，我能不能来一杯？

original: I'm thirsty, Greta.
translation: 我渴死了，葛丽泰。

original: Greta, I have a thirst.
translation: 葛丽泰，我口干舌燥。

original: Greta, you got a second? I wanted a drink.
translation: 葛丽泰，你有空吗？我想来点喝的。

original: Hey Greta, can I get a drink?
translation: 嗨，葛丽泰，能不能给我杯喝的？

original: I need a drink, Greta.
translation: 来杯喝的，葛丽泰。

original: Greta, I'm still sober. Fix it, please.
translation: 葛丽泰，我还没喝多。拜托再给我来点。

original: Brains... I mean "food". I'm hungry, Greta.
translation: 动动脑子……我的意思是“食物”。我好饿，葛丽泰。

original: Well, I'm not dead yet, so I might as well eat something.
translation: 好吧，我还没死呢，我想我还是要吃东西的。

original: I want some food.
translation: 我想要点吃的。

original: Greta, can I get some food over here?
translation: 葛丽泰，能不能给我点食物？

original: Greta, can you get me something to eat?
translation: 葛丽泰，你能不能给我拿点吃的？

original: I'm starving, Greta. Help me out here.
translation: 我饥肠辘辘，葛丽泰。你得救救我。

original: Nng. Hungry.
translation: 呃。好饿。

original: Heya, Greta.
translation: 嗨，葛丽泰。

original: Morning, Greta.
translation: 早上好，葛丽泰。

original: Nice night, huh, Greta?
translation: 美丽的夜晚，呃，葛丽泰？

original: Greta...
translation: 葛丽泰……

original: Hello, Mister Crowley.
translation: 你好，考利先生。

original: Mister Crowley, hello!
translation: 考利先生，你好！

original: Good to see you, Mister Crowley!
translation: 很高兴见到你，考利先生！

original: Hello, Mister Crowley! Nice day, isn't it?
translation: 你好，考利先生！天气不错，不是吗？

original: Mister Crowley...
translation: 考利先生……

original: Patches. Patches! Hey, buddy, stay with me here for a second. We need to talk.
translation: “拼盘”。“拼盘”！嗨，老兄，陪我一会，我们得谈谈。

original: Hey, Patches. Patchwork, man. Pay attention, I need to talk to you.
translation: 嗨，“拼盘”。“拼盘”，伙计。听着，我们得谈谈。

original: Everything alright there, Patches? You don't look so good.
translation: 一切都还好么，“拼盘”？你看上去不太好的样子。

original: Heya, Patches. You alright, buddy? You're not lookin' so good.
translation: 你好，“拼盘”。你还好吧，老兄？你看上去不太妙啊。

original: Hey, Patchwork. How're you holding together?
translation: 嗨，“拼盘”。你怎么样了？

original: Patchwork, buddy, how are you holding up?
translation: “拼盘”，伙计，感觉怎样啊？

original: Hey, Patchwork... whoa there, be careful. Are you okay?
translation: 嗨，“拼盘”……哇，小心。你没事吧？

original: Hello, Patchwork.
translation: 你好，“拼盘”。

original: Patchwork...
Quinn, no one told me you were back!
translation: 奎因，没人告诉我你回来了！

original: Hey, Quinn.
translation: 嗨，奎因。

original: Quinn...
translation: 奎因……

original: Hey there, Tulip.
translation: 嗨，“郁金香”。

original: Hi, Tulip!
translation: 嘿，“郁金香”！

original: Tulip...
translation: “郁金香”……

original: Hey, Winthrop. How's it going?
translation: 嗨，温思罗普，近来怎么样？

original: Hey, I wanted to tell you, Patchwork got drunk last week and left his booze in the air filter...
translation: 嗨，我想告诉你，“拼盘”昨天喝多了，把他的酒落在空气过滤器里了……

original: Winthrop, I was wondering if you could take a look at the generator down in the common area...
translation: 温思罗普，我想你是不是能去查看下工作间的发电机……

original: Heya, Winthrop. You got a second?
translation: 呀，温思罗普。你有空吗？

original: Winthrop...
translation: 温思罗普……

original: How's everything? Enjoying your drinks?
translation: 一切顺利？喝得还满意吗？

original: Yes, yes, how is everyone doing? Everything alright? Do you need anything else?
translation: 是的，是的，所有人都好吗？一切都好？你还有什么其他需要？

original: Hey, hon. Do you need anything?
translation: 嗨，亲爱的。你需要什么吗？

original: Do you need anything else?
translation: 你还有什么其他需要？

original: Hello, Citizen!
translation: 你好，平民！

original: Greetings!
translation: 幸会！

original: This place is going to shit, have you noticed?
translation: 这地方就快变成一堆狗屎，你发现了没？

original: You know, Winthrop does his best -- he's a great mechanic, but he just can't keep up. This place is falling apart!
translation: 你知道，温思罗普尽力了 — 他是一流的机械师，他都坚持不下去了。这地方就快土崩瓦解了！

original: Winthrop needs some help. I mean, it's not like he has any time to train anyone to fix this shit around here.
translation: 温思罗普需要帮助。我是指，他好像没有时间去教一个人去修理这堆狗屎。

original: Every day, there's something new: the generators go down, the water has funk in it, the air filters die...
translation: 每一天都会有新麻烦：发电机坏了，水里散发出恶臭，空气过滤器罢工……

original: The air is off in the common house again. It stinks of sweaty death down there. I swear, every day it's something new.
translation: 工作间的空气又不流通了。臭气熏天。我保证，每天都会出现新麻烦。

original: Carol's changed at lot lately. Have you noticed? She's more... quiet.
translation: 卡洛尔最近变了很多。你注意到了吗？变得……安静了。

original: Carol just seems so sad these days...
translation: 卡洛尔这几天看上去很不对劲……

original: Carol used to love this place, now it's like she hardly even cares. Have you noticed that?
translation: 卡洛尔过去很喜欢这地方，现在看上去她对这漠不关心了。你注意到了吗？

original: Did you hear that?
translation: 你听到了吗？

original: That sound just won't stop. Do you hear that?
translation: 那声音一直没停下来，你听见没？

original: Hey, did I tell you about... wait... do you hear that?
translation: 嗨，我有没有和你说过…等等…你听，什么声音？

original: Do you smell something strange?
translation: 你有没有闻到怪味道？

original: I keep smelling this strange smell... it's like... onions. You remember onions? Yeah. It's like that. Do you smell it?
translation: 那怪味道一直都有……就像是……洋葱。你记得洋葱吗？对，就是那味道。你闻到了吗？

original: What the hell is that smell? I mean, it's not bad, it's just... I don't know... do you smell that?
translation: 那到底是什么味道？我说，其实味道还不赖，就是有点……我说不清楚……你没闻到？

original: Have you tried the new whisky he's stocking? It's... it's something special...
translation: 你有没有尝过他储藏的新威士忌？味道……味道很特别……

original: This drink is foul. And that's a Ghoul calling something foul.
translation: 这酒真难喝。就是僵尸称之为难喝的那种味道。

original: Oh man... this is nasty, but it does the job.
translation: 哦，哥们……是有点令人不爽，但这就是工作。

original: This vodka really sucks.
translation: 这伏特加真的很棒。

original: Have you tried this? It isn't good, but it's strong.
translation: 你有没有试过？味道一般，但是真的很醺。

original: Christ, the beer in this place tastes like piss...
translation: 天啊，这的啤酒就像尿……

original: You know, the cider isn't half bad... for malted rat piss.
translation: 我说，这苹果酒还算不错……和老鼠尿比起来。

original: This stuff tastes like Centaur piss.
translation: 这东西的味道像多脚兽的尿。

original: ...buncha goddamn worthless walking corpses...
translation: ……该死，一群毫无价值的行尸走肉……

original: Jesus Christ... 123 years... what's the fucking point?
translation: 我的天……123年……有什么意义？

original: Some days, I just wish that someone would come through here and put a bullet in all of our heads...
translation: 有些时候，我希望有个人来到这，朝我们每个人头上开一枪……

original: Nothing but pain and misery...
translation: 除了痛苦和苦难之外什么都没有……

original: There's got to be something more than this...
translation: 应该不会就这样而已……

original: Yeah, I'm just a drunk zombie... what good am I?
translation: 嗯，我只是一个喝得烂醉的丧尸……我还能怎样？

original: The best I can hope for is that the liquor kills me before some mutated beast turns me into a snack.
translation: 我最大的愿望就是，在那些突变野兽把我当甜点给吃了之前被烈酒醉死。

original: If there were a God, I'd pray for death.
translation: 如果真的有上帝，我会祈求一死。

original: All I ask is to go quietly. And soon.
translation: 我的要求就是快与静！

original: Hey, you.
translation: 嗨，你。

original: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

original: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

original: Hello.
translation: 你好。

original: Hey. How's it going?
translation: 嗨，进展得怎么样？

original: How's it going?
translation: 进展如何？

original: Hey, you. What's new?
translation: 嗨，你，有什么新消息？

original: Hey, man. What's happening?
translation: 嗨，哥们。怎么了？

original: Long time, no see. What's going on with you?
translation: 好久不见。你过得怎么样？

original: Hey, what's up?
translation: 嘿，怎么了？

original: It's been a while, what've you been up to?
translation: 那么久，你去哪了？

original: What's happening?
translation: 发生什么事了？

original: What's going on?
translation: 发生了什么？

original: What's the word?
translation: 说呀？

original: What've you heard?
translation: 你听说了什么？

original: Oh my goodness... you've been fighting.
translation: 我的天……你跟人打架了。

original: Ugh, you look like you need a rest.
translation: 看上去你真的该好好休息一下。

original: I hope Vault Tec had some answers for you.
translation: 我希望避难所科技能够帮上你。

original: Hmmm... I don't see a case yet. No luck, huh?
translation: 唔……我还不知道怎么办。不太走运，呃？

original: If there's anything else you need to know, you go right ahead and ask.
translation: 如果你还有什么不清楚就尽管开口问。

original: Oh my! I wasn't expecting any visitors.
translation: 哦！没想到我这还能见到来访者。

original: I assure you, there's nothing valuable here.
translation: 相信我，这没什么值钱的东西。

original: Well, don't just stand there, say something.
translation: 嗯，别光站着，聊点什么。

original: Maybe we could chat if you have the time.
translation: 如果你有时间，我们不妨聊聊天。

original: Kimba, um, I heard you helped bandage me up when I was on the table. Uh, thank you.
translation: 金巴，嗯，听说我躺在台子上不省人事的时候是你帮我包扎绷带。呃，谢谢。

original: I was thinking of hitting patrol again soon, Flash.
translation: 我计划迟点再去巡逻一遍，福莱斯。

original: Hey Sticky, um, uh, what do you think of Big Town?
translation: 嗨，斯蒂奇，嗯，呃，你觉得大镇怎么样？

original: I wonder if someone should work on the barricades again.
translation: 我不知道是不是该找个人加固防御工事。

original: Hey, Red, can I stop by the clinic later? You know, just in case?
translation: 嗨，瑞德，等下我能不能去下诊所？你知道的，以防万一。

original: Timebomb, I heard you got hurt. Wow... What does it feel like?
translation: “定时炸弹”，我听说你受伤了。喔哦……那是什么样的感受？

original: Hey, Flash. Patrolling sounds like a lot of fun. Maybe I could come out with you.
translation: 嗨，福莱斯。巡逻听起来挺有意思，能不能带上我？

original: Do you have any idea of what I can do in town, Shorty?
translation: 我想做些事，你有什么建议吗，“矮子”？

original: Hey there, Pappy. I was out trying to gather food. Did you know there's not much food out here in the Wastes?
translation: 嗨，帕匹。我刚出去想找点食物。你知不知道这片废土很难找到吃的？

original: Hey there, Kimba. Is there anything I can do around town?
translation: 嗨，金巴。镇里有什么需要我做的？

original: Hey, Red. Is there anything I can do around town to help out?
translation: 嗨，瑞德。有什么我能帮的上忙的？

original: Sticky, it's about time you learned that I'm in charge here.
translation: 斯蒂奇，是时候该让你知道了，我，是这的领袖。

original: I think I should be mayor of this town, Kimba...
translation: 我想我应该做这镇的镇长，金巴……

original: Can I help you, Sheriff?
translation: 有什么能帮你的，警长？

original: Can I help you?
translation: 需要帮忙吗？

original: I don't like the looks of the barricades, Pappy. Why don't you redo them?
translation: 我不太喜欢这防御工事，帕匹。你为什么不重新搭建？

original: Timebomb, since you insist on staying alive, why don't you make yourself useful and help me reset the barricades.
translation: “定时炸弹”，既然你坚持活着，为什么你就不能让自己变得有点用处呢？至少能帮帮我搭建防御工事啊？

original: You don't go far out enough on your patrol, Flash. A real patrol would cover a solid half-mile radius.
translation: 你的巡逻范围还不够大，福莱斯。最起码覆盖半径半英里的区域才称得上是真正的巡逻。

original: I'm telling you, Red, just let me run everything. I'll get those barricades twice as high!
translation: 给我听好，瑞德，你应该让我来管理一切。我会把这些防御工事加高两倍！

original: Bittercup, make sure you're paying attention out on patrol. There are dangerous people out there.
translation: “苦杯”，你应该更认真地巡逻，到处都是危险的家伙。

original: Hey, Flash. How are you feeling? Any calluses from stroking that new gun of yours?
translation: 嗨，福莱斯。感觉怎么样？摸你的新枪有没有让手出老茧？

original: How are you feeling, Timebomb? Are those stitches holding together?
translation: 你感觉怎么样，“定时炸弹”？那些缝线伤口愈合了吗？

original: There's my Sticky! How are you doing?
translation: 亲爱的斯蒂奇！你过得怎么样？

original: Hey, Pappy. How's that wound on your arm?
translation: 嗨，帕匹。你胳膊上的伤口怎么样了？

original: Shorty, I want to gather everyone together soon about setting up the barricades higher. I'd really appreciate your, uh,  expertise.
translation: “矮子”,我想要尽快聚集所有人来加高防御工事。我真感谢你的帮助，哦，专家。

original: Kimba, could you help me out with Pappy? It's just... He's been so glum lately.
translation: 金巴，你能帮我照顾一下帕匹吗？只是……他最近很忧郁。

original: Hey Kimba, thanks for offering to help me in the clinic.
translation: 嗨，金巴。感谢你为我的诊所提供帮助。

original: How are you feeling, Timebomb?
translation: 你感觉怎么样，“定时炸弹”？

original: Hey there, Sticky.
translation: 嗨，斯蒂奇。

original: How are the patrols going, Flash? Are we still safe?
translation: 巡逻进行得怎么样了，福莱斯？看看我们是否依旧安全？

original: God, I miss Lamplight. Those were the days...
translation: 天啊，我想念小灯镇。在那的那些日子……

original: I wonder how the Lamplighters are doing...
translation: 我想知道现在小灯镇怎么样了……

original: Hey, Red. Do you need any help washing bandages later?
translation: 嗨，瑞德。你迟点需要人帮你洗绷带吗？

original: Hey Shorty. How's our favorite little guy doing?
translation: 嗨，“矮子”。我们至爱的小家伙过得怎么样？

original: How are you doing, Pappy?
translation: 你过得怎么样，帕匹？

original: Hey, Sticky. Keep your stickiness away from me and my new gun. This is a Sticky-free zone!
translation: 嗨，斯蒂奇。让你的口水离我和我的新枪远点。谢绝斯蒂奇靠近！

original: Timebomb! How're you doing? I thought you were dead for sure!
translation: “定时炸弹”！你怎么样？我以为你死定了！

original: Hey Shorty, you should come with me on patrol. The Raiders will never see you coming.
translation: 嗨，“矮子”。你应该和我一起巡逻。歹徒根本看不到你。

original: Hey Red, can I stop by the clinic later? I feel a bit sick.
translation: 嗨，瑞德，迟点我能去诊所看看吗？我感觉有点难受。

original: Wow, you should have seen me on patrol, Kimba, I was all "bang-bang-bang." I must have killed a hundred Raiders!
translation: 哇，你真该来看我巡逻，金巴，我刚才一直在“嘣-嘣-嘣”。我肯定已经杀了100个歹徒了！

original: Have you seen my new gun, Pappy? It's awesome! Bad-Ass.
translation: 你看到我的新枪了吗，帕匹？它棒极了！贱人。

original: Did you see anything on patrol, Bittercup?
translation: 你在巡逻中看到什么东西了吗，“苦杯”？

original: Red, have you got a sec? It’s about this wound on my arm.
translation: 瑞德，你有时间吗？看看我胳膊上的伤口。

original: We're all going to die here. There's no way we can survive out here in this mess.
translation: 我们都会死在这。我们没法从这堆垃圾中活着出来。

original: Hey there, Kimba.
translation: 嗨，金巴。

original: What do you think of the barricades, Shorty?
translation: 你觉得防御工事怎么样，“矮子”？

original: Hey, Timebomb. You look like you're going to fall over dead.
translation: 嗨，“定时炸弹”。你看上去像要立刻倒地而死似的。

original: Never thought you'd make it, Sticky. Out of everyone who died trying to get here from Lamplight, we get you.
translation: 没人觉得你会成功，斯蒂奇。有很多人试着从小灯镇来这儿却死了，但是你成功了。

original: Anything out there, Flash? The Super Mutants and Raiders are coming back soon, aren't they?
translation: 外边有动静吗，福莱斯？超级变种人和歹徒不久就会回来，对吧？

original: What are you supposed to actually do if you ever find something on patrol, huh? Scare them off with that rusty pistol of yours?
translation: 如果你真的在巡逻中看到某些东西，那你还能怎么做，呃？用你那锈烂的小手枪吓跑他们？

original: At least we made it another day, right?
translation: 至少我们又过了一天，对不对？

original: I haven't slept in weeks.
translation: 我好几周没有合眼了。

original: Those assholes in Lamplight said that this place was great.
translation: 那些来自小灯镇的混蛋说这地方很棒。

original: I hate it here.
translation: 我恨这。

original: This place gets worse all the time.
translation: 这地方一向不怎么样。

original: Remember to keep an eye on the north.
translation: 记着盯住北面。

original: S'up, Pronto?
translation: 怎么了，普郎托？

original: How's it goin', Pronto?
translation: 情况怎么样，普郎托？

original: Don't think I haven't seen what's been goin' on around here, Bleak. You're makin' it dangerous for us all.
translation: 别以为我没看见这发生的事，布里克。你的所作所为让我们都身处险境。

original: I see what you're doin' around here, girl, and I got somethin' to say to you about it.
translation: 我看见你在这的所作所为了，女孩。对此我有话要和你谈谈。

original: Hey, Bleak... you remember... you remember that thing that you asked me about? The secret thing?
translation: 嗨，布里克…你记得…你还记得你曾问我要过的那东西吗？那秘密的东西？

original: Hey... Hey, Bleak... check this out... I did that thing you asked.
translation: 嗨……嗨，布里克……看这……我搞到你要的东西了。

original: Hey, Bleak.
translation: 嗨，布里克。

original: Bleak...
translation: 布里克……

original: Breadbox, listen. I need your help.
translation: 布来德博克斯，听着。我需要你的帮助。

original: Listen up, old man. I'm going to need your help with something...
translation: 听着，老头。有件事需要你帮我……

original: Hey, man... Breadbox... where'd you get such a funny name?
translation: 嗨，哥们…布来德博克斯…谁给你起的这滑稽的名字？

original: I... I was wonderin'... where'd you get your... get your name, Breadbox?
translation: 我…我很想知道…你到底是从哪…得到这名字的，布来德博克斯？

original: Hey, Breadbox. What's up?
translation: 嗨，布来德博克斯。怎么了？

original: Breadbox...
translation: 布来德博克斯……

original: Bronson, boy. You need to get off of that drink.
translation: 布朗森，孩子。看来你不能再喝了。

original: Look at you, Bronson, you're a mess. You need to stop all this drinkin'.
translation: 看看你自己，布朗森，你都醉得一塌糊涂了，不能再喝了。

original: Hey, Bronson, listen up. Hey! Pay attention! I need your help!
translation: 嗨，布朗森，听好了。嗨！注意！我需要你的帮助！

original: Bronson... Bronson! Dammit, listen to me. And keep quiet!
translation: 布朗森…布朗森！该死，安静点，听我说！

original: Bronson...
translation: 布朗森……

original: Drunk fool...
translation: 喝醉的白痴……

original: Come here, Carolina, I have something that I'm wondering about.
translation: 过来，卡罗来纳，我有些事想不明白。

original: Red, I wanna ask you something.
translation: 瑞德，我想问你些事。

original: Hello, Miss Carolina.
translation: 卡罗来纳小姐，你好。

original: Hey, Miss Carolina.
translation: 嗨，卡罗来纳小姐。

original: Carolina...
translation: 卡罗来纳……

original: Red...
translation: 瑞德……

original: Crimson, did you hear what those fools were saying out in the yard?
translation: 奎默森，你听到外面院子里的那群傻瓜在说什么吗？

original: I can't believe that Mr. Eulogy let's those fools out in the yard talk like that! Did you hear what they said?
translation: 我真不敢相信尤勒基先生会让这群白痴在院子里那样叽叽喳喳！你听见他们说什么了吗？

original: Clover, stay nearby. Let's not cause a scene.
translation: 可萝尔，靠近点。我们不要太引人注目。

original: Clover, we've had this discussion. You stay with me at all times.
translation: 可萝尔，我们已经讨论过了，你就一直跟着我了。

original: Hey, Clover.
translation: 嗨，可萝尔。

original: Miss Clover...
translation: 可萝尔小姐……

original: Crimson, did you see that new guy walking around here?
translation: 奎默森，你有没有看见经过这的那新来的家伙？

original: Did you get a chance to check out the new guy, Crimson?
translation: 你有没有时间去看看新来的家伙，奎默森？

original: Crimson, did you see that new girl walking around here?
translation: 奎默森，你有没有看见经过这的那新来的女孩？

original: Did you get a chance to check out the new girl, Crimson?
translation: 你有没有时间去看看新来的女孩，奎默森？

original: Crimson... Crimson! Do not cause me to lose my cool.
translation: 奎默森……奎默森！别让我发火。

original: Crimson, let's stay down to earth, shall we? No more daydreaming.
translation: 奎默森，让我们脚踏实地点，好吗？不要再白日做梦了。

original: Miss Crimson...
translation: 奎默森小姐……

original: Hey, Crimson.
translation: 嗨，奎默森。

original: So Cutter, what's the good word? Happy to see me? Miss me?
translation: “快刀”，有没有什么好话对我说？见到我高兴吗？想我吗？

original: Heya Cutter... you got anything for me today? Flowers, love letters?
translation: 嗨，“快刀”……今天你带什么给我了？一束花，还是情书？

original: Cutter.
translation: “快刀”。

original: Hey, Cutter.
translation: 嗨，“快刀”。

original: Mr. Eulogy... uhm... can I talk to you for a second? If, if you're not busy, I mean.
translation: 尤勒基先生…嗯……我能不能占用你点时间？如果，我的意思是，如果你不是很忙的话。

original: If you're not busy, Mr Eulogy... I... I wanted to talk to you for a second.
translation: 如果你不是很忙，尤勒基先生……我…我想和你谈谈。

original: I've got something to say to you, Mr. Eulogy.
translation: 我有些事要对你说，尤勒基先生。

original: Listen, Mr. Eulogy. We have to talk.
translation: 听着，尤勒基先生。我们得谈谈。

original: Respect, man.
translation: 向你致敬，伙计。

original: Excuse me... sir...
translation: 对不起……先生……

original: Eulogy! My man!
translation: 尤勒基！我的朋友！

original: What's up, Eulogy?
translation: 什么事，尤勒基？

original: Eulogy...
translation: 尤勒基……

original: Forty, what do I pay you for? Have you seen this out here?
translation: 弗替，我是为了什么付你工钱？你有看着这儿吗？

original: Goddammit, Forty, I don't pay you to sleep on the job. Look around here. Tell me what you see.
translation: 该死，弗替，我付你工钱不是叫你睡觉的。四处看看，告诉我你看到什么！

original: Dude, Forty. Did you hear?
translation: 老兄，弗替。你听见了吗？

original: Hey, Forty.
translation: 嗨，弗替。

original: You seen anything good today?
translation: 你今天看见什么好事没？

original: Hey, man. Anything goin' on out here today?
translation: 嗨，哥们。今天发生了什么事没？

original: Grouse.
translation: 葛劳斯。

original: Hey, big boy. How you holdin' up today?
translation: 嗨，大孩子。今天你过得怎么样？

original: Well look who's still standing. You're looking a lot better! And here I thought that wasn't possible...
translation: 让我们看看谁还站着。你们看上去更好了！我还以为那是不可能的呢……

original: Look at you, my boy! Fit as ever! You're as big as a tank! I always tell them, I say "My Jotun, he could lift a house!"
translation: 看看你自己，我的孩子！依旧壮实！你就像个坦克！我一直和他们说，我说 “我的佐敦，他能举起一间房子！”

original: Haha! My boy! He is so big! Look at him! He could carry four slaves under his arms! He doesn't even need a gun to take them!
translation: 哈哈！我的孩子！他可真大！看看他！他的手臂下面都能夹住四个奴隶！干掉他们他根本就不需要用枪！

original: Where'd you get a name like Jotun, anyway?
translation: 你到底是怎么得到佐敦这个名字的？

original: Hey, Jotun. How's your old man?
translation: 嗨，佐敦。你的老头怎么样？

original: Hey, Jotun.
translation: 嗨，佐敦。

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: One wrong move, and you're going in the meat pen.
translation: 要是你干错一件事，就把你剁成肉酱。

original: Watch your step, square.
translation: 小心行事，老古板。

original: Keep walkin'.
translation: 继续走。

original: You don't look like you belong here.
translation: 你看上去不像这的人。

original: Goddamn tin can.
translation: 该死的锈罐头。

original: Looks like one of those Brotherhood assholes...
translation: 看上去像是兄弟会的混蛋……

original: Nice outfit. You raid a vault or something?
translation: 不错的外套。你洗劫了避难所还是别的什么？

original: Fucking Vault brats...
translation: 他妈的避难所捣蛋鬼……

original: Ug. Get away from me.
translation: 咳。离我远点。

original: Miss Jeanette...
translation: 珍妮特小姐……

original: The man with the hardware. How are things, Pronto?
translation: 那拿着硬件的男人。怎么回事，普郎托？

original: There's the man that keeps us knee deep in lead. How you doing?
translation: 那就是那让我们举步维艰的家伙，你打算怎么做？

original: Pronto...
translation: 普郎托……

original: Jesus fucking Christ, it's dull out here.
translation: 他妈的基督耶稣，这真没劲。

original: For fuck's sake, I'm bored. There ain't nothin' happening today.
translation: 他妈的，我无聊死了。今天什么事都没发生。

original: Richter.
translation: 里克特。

original: That boy of yours sure was drunk off his ass the other night, huh?
translation: 那晚你的男孩肯定喝得烂醉，呃？

original: Oh, man. Jotun was fucking hammered the other night. I thought he was gonna kill himself!
translation: 哦，哥们。佐敦前几天晚上深受打击了。我想他会不会为此而自杀！

original: Hey, Ymir. Do you want a drink?
translation: 嗨，伊米尔。你要不要来一杯？

original: Drink with me, Ymir?
translation: 和我一起喝一杯吧，伊米尔？

original: Hey... uhm... Ymir. How's it going?
translation: 嗨……嗯……伊米尔。你最近怎么样？

original: Hail, Ymir.
translation: 你好，伊米尔。

original: Ymir...
translation: 伊米尔……

original: <grunts>
translation: <嘟囔>

original: Out of my way.
translation: 滚开。

original: Hey, you're back. You get anything good?
translation: 嗨，你回来了，有什么好消息？

original: You caught anything lately?
translation: 最近你有什么新消息？

original: How'd that roundup go?
translation: 那帮畜生怎么样了？

original: How's the meat?
translation: 肉怎么样？

original: Hey, how'd it go with that blonde thing you brought in here?
translation: 嗨，会怎么处置你在这抓的金发小妞？

original: You went out with Ymir last week, didn't you? Catch anything good?
translation: 你上周和伊米尔出去了，对吧？抓到什么好东西？

original: Catch any good meat lately?
translation: 最近有没有抓到好东西？

original: Things are quiet around here. We haven't had any good roundups in a while.
translation: 最近这很平静，我们有段日子没活动了。

original: S'up, fool?
translation: 什么事，傻瓜？

original: S'up.
translation: 什么事？

original: What's goin' on?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

original: Hey, Maggie! How you doin', darlin'?
translation: 嗨，玛姬！你怎么样，亲爱的？

original: Hey! Sweetie-pie!
translation: 嗨！甜心！

original: C'mon, Maggie! Let's go over here!
translation: 来吧，玛姬！到这来。

original: I see you!
translation: 我看见你了！

original: It's my turn!
translation: 轮到我啦！

original: Hey there, little Maggie.
translation: 嗨，小玛姬。

original: Manya! Manya!
translation: 曼雅！曼雅！

original: Darling!
translation: 亲爱的！

original: Hello there, Manya.
translation: 你好，曼雅。

original: Hello, Manya.
translation: 你好，曼雅。

original: Hello, Miss Brown.
translation: 嗨，布朗小姐。

original: Hi, Moira.
translation: 嘿，莫伊拉。

original: Hey there, Moira.
translation: 嗨，莫伊拉。

original: Ah, my dearest wife...
translation: 啊，我最爱的老婆……

original: Hello, Mother Maya.
translation: 你好，玛雅修女。

original: Nathan, dear...
translation: 内森，亲爱的……

original: Nathan.
translation: 内森。

original: Nova, love. A word...
translation: 诺瓦，亲爱的。过来聊聊……

original: A moment, Nova. NOW.
translation: 就一会儿，诺瓦。现在。

original: Nova?
translation: 诺瓦？

original: Lookin' good, Nova.
translation: 看起来不错，诺瓦。

original: Nova, can you come here for a second?
translation: 诺瓦，你能不能过来一下？

original: Hey, Nova. I want to talk to you.
translation: 嗨，诺瓦。我要和你谈谈。

original: Hello, Nova.
translation: 你好，诺瓦。

original: Nova...
translation: 诺瓦……

original: How are you doing, Walter?
translation: 最近怎么样，沃尔特？

original: Hello, Walter.
translation: 你好，沃尔特。

original: Hey, c'mere. I want to talk to you.
translation: 嗨，过来。来，我们谈谈。

original: Hey, you. I need to ask you something.
translation: 嗨，你。有些事我想问问你。

original: Hello.
translation: 你好。

original: S'up?
translation: 什么事？

original: Hey, how's it going?
translation: 嗨，怎么样？

original: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

original: How are you?
translation: 你好吗？

original: Hey there.
translation: 嘿你好。

original: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

original: You heard anything?
translation: 有什么不对劲吗？

original: What's goin' on over here?
translation: 这发生了什么？

original: Que pasa?
translation: 怎么回事？

original: What's happenin'?
translation: 发生了什么？

original: What's goin' on?
translation: 怎么了？

original: S'up?
translation: 什么事？

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: What's new?
translation: 有什么新鲜事吗？

original: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

original: Yo.
translation: 哟。

original: I can't believe we're stuck out here babysitting a radio station.
translation: 我真不敢相信我们大老远地跑来就是照料这电台。

original: Man, this sucks. I wanna be where the action is!
translation: 伙计，这太糟了。我想去个热闹的地方！

original: Status report?
translation: 有什么情况？

original: Did you see the hit I scored on that Super Mutant the other day? One round, and his head exploded like an overripe Mutfruit.
translation: 你看见我那天是怎样对付那超级变种人的吗？就一梭子弹，他的头就像熟透的水果一样炸开了。

original: Keep your eyes open, Brother.
translation: 保持警惕，兄弟。

original: Make sure you keep that weapon clean, Brother.
translation: 确保你的武器工作正常，兄弟。

original: Let's see the Super Mutants try and take this place now.
translation: 让我们看看超级变种人现在敢不敢来抢这地盘。

original: Nice digs, huh?
translation: 好地方，呃？

original: Did you see the size of that Behemoth?
translation: 你知道那超级变种巨人有多大吗？

original: Welcome to the GNR garrison.
translation: 欢迎来到银河新闻台敢死队。

original: That was a hell of a fight... nice work.
translation: 那可是一场恶战……干的太棒了。

original: If you're looking for Three Dog, he's upstairs.
translation: 如果你在找三狗，他就在楼上。

original: That should give the boys at Lost Hills something to think about.
translation: 那会让这些在孤立残丘的孩子好好考虑些东西。

original: Good old Mutant cleansing. There's nothing else like it.
translation: 老式的变种人清洁剂。没有东西比得上它。

original: Damn, we lost Reddin.
translation: 该死，我们和瑞丁走散了。

original: Galaxy News owes us big for this one.
translation: 银河新闻这下可欠了我们个大人情。

original: Let's see the Outcasts do THAT.
translation: 让我们看看放逐者是怎么做那事的。

original: Oh man, that thing was enormous.
translation: 我说伙计，那东西还真够大的。

original: Not bad, kid. Not bad at all.
translation: 不错，孩子。真的不错。

original: A pleasure hunting with you.
translation: 和你一起打猎很荣幸。

original: Power to the people, eh kid?
translation: 人民的权利，懂吗，孩子？

original: Smooth moves, kid. Smooth moves.
translation: 脚步放轻，孩子。放轻。

original: Looks like the Good Fight has gained a new ally.
translation: 看上去，这场大战有新的盟友了。

original: You got questions, I'm your answer man.
translation: 如果你有疑问，我就是你的解答者。

original: I'm sensing that you have more to say. Well, go on.
translation: 我感觉你还有话要说，快说吧。

original: Got more on your mind, huh?
translation: 又想到要说什么了，呃？

original: Wow kid, you look like you've got ten pounds of worry stuffed into a five pound box. Why don't you take a load off and tell me about it.
translation: 哇，孩子。你看上去有太多的烦恼得不到发泄。为什么你不能卸下包袱和我倾诉一番呢？

original: Bend my ear... I won't bite.
translation: 尽管数落我吧……我不会咬你。

original: Got something on your mind? Spill it.
translation: 有什么话就直说。

original: You look like you've got ten pounds of worry stuffed into a five pound box.
translation: 你看上去像是积压了很多烦恼的样子。

original: I'll be right with you.
translation: 我立刻就来。

original: The Mirelurks have been quiet lately.
translation: 最近蟹人好像安分很多。

original: Hello, Miss Vera.
translation: 你好，薇拉小姐。

original: We're running low on river water, dad.
translation: 我们的储备的河水快用完了，爸爸。

original: Scribe Bowditch. I'd like to hear your report on those latest armor modifications.
translation: 文士鲍蒂奇。我想听听你装甲改进方面的最新报告。

original: Hail, Scribe Bowditch. All is well with your work?
translation: 你好，文士鲍蒂奇。你的工作顺利吗？

original: Scribe Bowditch, I trust you are well. I'm here for your progress report on the modified Recon Armor.
translation: 文士鲍蒂奇，我相信你能行。我是为了你那改良型侦查装甲的进度报告而来的。

original: Hail to you, Scribe Bowditch.
translation: 向你问好，文士鲍蒂奇。

original: Hail, Scribe Bowditch.
translation: 你好，文士鲍蒂奇。

original: Scribe Peabody. How does the day find you?
translation: 文士博迪。日子过得怎么样？

original: Hello, Scribe Peabody. I trust that things are well with you?
translation: 你好，文士博迪。我想你一切还都顺利吧？

original: Hail, Scribe Peabody. I trust that your research goes well.
translation: 你好，文士博迪。我相信你的研究一定有进展。

original: Hail, Scribe Peabody.
translation: 你好，文士博迪。

original: Hail to you, Scribe Peabody.
translation: 向你问好，文士博迪。

original: Rothchild, a word please.
translation: 罗斯查德，借一步说话。

original: If you have a moment, Scribe Rothchild...
translation: 如果你有时间，文员罗斯查德……

original: Scribe Rothchild, sir.
translation: 文士罗斯查德，先生。

original: Hail, Scribe Rothchild.
translation: 你好，文士罗斯查德。

original: Hail to you, Scribe Rothchild.
translation: 向你问好，文士罗斯查德。

original: Sir Scribe.
translation: 文士先生。

original: Sentinel Lyons, ma'am!
translation: 莎拉·里昂斯，女士！

original: Watch it, Squire.
translation: 小心，侍从。

original: Don't you have somewhere to be, Squire?
translation: 侍从，你没有地方可去了？

original: Step lively, Squire.
translation: 加把劲，侍从。

original: Hail, Star Paladin, sir.
translation: 你好，骑士之星，长官。

original: Star Paladin Cross, sir!
translation: 星骑士 克罗丝，长官！

original: I saw that you completed your tests. What results are you seeing?
translation: 我看见你完成你的测试了。你期待得几分？

original: Scribe Rothchild wants a report on your tests. Have your results posted?
translation: 文员罗斯查德想要你的测试报告。你的结果出来了吗？

original: Switches are showing green. Ambulatory systems look good.
translation: 开关显示绿色。流动系统看上去正常。

original: The weapons systems are showing red on startup. We'll have to spend the rest of the day scrubbing the system before we can try again.
translation: 武器系统启动显示为红色。在我们再次尝试之前，我们必须把剩余的时间都花在清理系统上。

original: There's been a shutdown in the port shoulder systems -- looks like the gyros are locked up again. It'll take a few hours to clean it out.
translation: 舱门轴臂系统关闭了 — 看上去像是仪器又被锁住了。看来需要几个小时来清除故障。

original: There's a problem in the cooling system. I'm not sure what it is, but I'll take a look.
translation: 冷却系统有问题。但我不确定是什么问题，我过去看看。

original: I made a little bit of progress with Prime's locomotion capacitor, but now his IFF system is, um... unpredictable.
translation: 我在质数普莱姆的运动电容方面略有建树，但是他的敌我识别系统，嗯……不可预知啊。

original: I have those results you asked for. I sent them over to your station.
translation: 你要的结果我有了。我已经发送到你的驻地了。

original: Scribe Rothchild wanted those AMS tests done right away, so I went ahead and handled it for you.
translation: 文士罗斯查德要求立刻做阿尔法磁谱仪测试，所以我先走一步帮你处理。

original: Welcome.
translation: 欢迎。

original: The Brotherhood is at your service.
translation: 兄弟会为你服务。

original: You honor us with your presence here.
translation: 你能出席是我们莫大的荣幸。

original: Need something, friend?
translation: 需要些什么，朋友？

original: So what's the latest report?
translation: 最近的报告怎么样？

original: What was the result of the latest scan?
translation: 最近的那次扫描得到什么结果？

original: What's the situation?
translation: 情况怎么样？

original: Well? What's your tactical appraisal of our situation?
translation: 嗯？你对于我们的目前形势从战术上估量的结果是什么？

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: I'll train these marshmallows if it kills me...
translation: 要训练这些菜鸟，这简直要了我的命……

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Presence detected. This unit has activated.
translation: 发现物件。该单位已被激活。

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Outsiders in the Citadel. Such a pleasure...
translation: 五角大本营里的外来人。幸会……

original: H... Hello
translation: 你……你好

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Shit, that was a close one.
translation: 该死，好险！

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Tickets please.
translation: 请出示票。

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: What do you need, sir?
translation: 你需要什么，先生？

original: Hello, sir.
translation: 你好，先生。

original: Sir.
translation: 长官。

original: Squire.
translation: 侍从。

original: Sir Knight.
translation: 骑士先生。

original: Paladin.
translation: 圣骑士。

original: Sentinel. What can I do for you?
translation: 莎拉。我能为你做些什么？

original: Hello, Elder.
translation: 你好，长老。

original: Dad, can I buy that dress from Bannon? I want to wear it at my wedding. I want to look special for Diego.
translation: 爸爸，我能把班侬那的那条裙子买下来吗？我想在婚礼上穿。我想给迭戈一个惊喜。

original: Dad, do you think you'll ever meet someone? I mean like mom? You shouldn't just spend all day cooking you know.
translation: 爸爸，你就没想过再找一个吗？我的意思是像妈妈那样的？你不该整天就把心思泡在烹饪上。

original: I'm so excited about getting married. You got my invitation, didn't you? You've got to come.
translation: 步入婚姻殿堂让我兴奋极了，你收到我的喜帖了，对吧？你可一定要来啊。

original: Hello, Mrs. Cantelli. Do you have anything that would make a guy be like crazy in love? You know, make him really horny?
translation: 你好，坎特利夫人。你有什么东西能使一个男孩为爱疯狂？就是让他兽性大发。

original: Are you nervous about getting married?
translation: 要结婚了，紧张吗？

original: I have something special for you, but I can only give it to you in private.
translation: 我有个特别的东西要给你，但只能私下里给你。

original: Diego, do you think I'm sexy? I mean, if you weren't a priest and everything, would you be turned on by me?
translation: 迭戈，你觉得我性感吗？我是说，撇除你的神职身份，我会不会令你感到兴奋？

original: Hello, Mr. Holmes. Do you have anything new today?
translation: 你好，福尔摩斯先生。今天你有什么新闻？

original: Hello, Mr. Shrapnel. My dad wants some more 10mm rounds. Do you have any?
translation: 你好，“榴弹”小帅先生。我父亲想再要点10MM子弹。你这有吗？

original: Hello, Mr. Bannon. Can I look at that blue dress again? The one with the really deep cleavage?
translation: 你好，班侬先生。我能再看看那件蓝裙子吗？就是那件低胸的。

original: The prayer was touching, Father.
translation: 祷告令人感动，神父。

original: I know you could do a much better sermon. I could hardly stay awake.
translation: 我想你应该让你的布道更吸引人点。我都昏昏欲睡了。

original: Try not to drink too much tonight, sir. It affects your judgment.
translation: 今晚可别喝多了，先生。那会影响你的判断力。

original: This area looks safe, Mister Zimmer.
translation: 这区域看上去还算安全，齐默先生。

original: I'll have some water.
translation: 我要喝点水。

original: Brock.
translation: 混蛋。

original: Sister.
translation: 你好。

original: You've had too much to drink, Trinnie.
translation: 你不能再喝了，特里尼。

original: Miss Vera, could I trouble you for some vegetables? Whatever you have is fine.
translation: 薇拉小姐，能不能给我点蔬菜？随便给我点就好。

original: Mister Buckingham, I'd like some vegetables. Whatever you have available.
translation: 白金汉先生，我想买点蔬菜。随便来点就行。

original: Hmmm. No. I don't think you're him.
translation: 唔。不。我想你不是他。

original: I'll have two Mirelurk Cakes, carrots and wine, if you have it, beer if you don't.
translation: 我要两个蟹人饼，胡萝卜和红酒，如果没有红酒，那就来啤酒。

original: Angela, why do you insist on wearing such rags? I could sell you a most beautiful dress. Diego, would be positively starstruck.
translation: 安吉拉，你干吗非要穿这破衣服？我这能买到最漂亮的裙子。迭戈肯定会对你大吃一惊的。

original: Angela, why do you insist on wearing such rags? I could sell you a most beautiful dress.
translation: 安吉拉，你干嘛非要穿这破衣服？我这能买到最漂亮的裙子。

original: You come in here a lot, but you never buy anything.
translation: 你来得倒是勤快，可从来没见你买过。

original: Must you always sit next to me in church?
translation: 你为什么在教堂里总是坐在我旁边？

original: Before you start in on me, Vera, there's not much new here.
translation: 在你和我开始之前，薇拉，我想提醒你，没多少新鲜的东西可以试。

original: Can we make this quick? I have a wedding to get ready for.
translation: 我们能不能快一点？我还有个婚礼要准备呢。

original: Welcome to Potomac Attire.
translation: 欢迎光临波托马克服装。

original: Hmmph.
translation: 嗯。

original: When that little shit gets here, watch him. If he starts anything, kick his ass.
translation: 要是那个小混蛋在这出现，看住他。要是他敢惹事，就踢烂他的屁股。

original: You've had too much, Trinnie. Go sleep it off in the back.
translation: 你喝的太多了，崔妮。快回去睡觉。

original: Every week you come down here preaching this crap. Why don't you just stay in your god damned church?
translation: 每个礼拜你都大老远跑来传你的狗屁教。为什么你就该死的不能老老实实在你的教堂里待着？

original: What'll you have? And don't say water.
translation: 你要什么？别告诉我是杯水。

original: What'll you have?
translation: 你要什么？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Armitage.
translation: 阿米蒂奇。

original: You've got some nice stuff in here, Bannon. Too bad it's so expensive.
translation: 你的东西都不错，班侬。就是价格太贵了。

original: You need to raise your prices, Belle. You're practically giving this stuff away.
translation: 你要提高你的售价，贝勒。你几乎是在做慈善事业。

original: Belle told me to throw you out of here if you stir up too much trouble, Father.
translation: 贝勒说如果你引起太多麻烦就要我把你从这扔出去，神父。

original: Flak, I'm running low on ammo. What do you have in stock?
translation: “高炮”弗莱克，我的弹药快用完了。你还有存货吗？

original: Let's not have a repeat of the other day, Flak.
translation: 不要像前几天那样了，“高炮”弗莱克。

original: Size doesn't scare me, Sister. Don't start anything that I'll have to finish.
translation: 别以为我怕你。不要干傻事，不要逼我出手。

original: Hey, Shrapnel. How's the gun business?
translation: 嗨，“榴弹”小帅。军火生意怎么样？

original: Tammy, why don't you take the night off and spend it with James? If there's a repeat of the other night, Belle is going to kick you out.
translation: 塔米，为什么今晚你不休息休息，去陪陪詹姆斯？如果又和那天晚上一样，贝勒一定会把你踢出去。

original: Tammy, why don't you go home? If there's a repeat of the other night, Belle is going to kick you out.
translation: 塔米，你为什么不回家？如果又和那天晚上一样，贝勒一定会把你踢出去。

original: Don't you think you've had enough, Trinnie?
translation: 你还没喝够吗，崔妮？

original: This is the Muddy Rudder. Cause any trouble, and you'll have to deal with me.
translation: 这是“泥舵”酒吧。如果你惹了什么麻烦，就必须给我个交代。

original: Care for a drink?
translation: 来一杯？

original: Hey, I'm not looking for trouble.
translation: 嗨，我可不是来找麻烦的。

original: Don't forget to pick up your room, C.J.
translation: 不要忘记收拾你的房间，长江。

original: Finish your food, C.J. There are starving people in the Wasteland you know.
translation: 不许剩饭，长江。在这废土上挨饿的人满地都是。

original: Stop fidgeting, C.J.
translation: 不要坐立不安的样子，长江。

original: Congratulations! I'm so happy for Angela and Diego. Have they set a date yet?
translation: 恭喜恭喜！祝福安吉拉，迭戈。日子定了吗？

original: Are the Mirelurk Cakes fresh?
translation: 这泥沼蟹饼新鲜吗？

original: Henry, I'm not sure I like C.J. playing with that Hargrave boy. His mother is just dreadful, even if she is on the upper deck.
translation: 亨利，我想我不喜欢长江和那个哈格雷夫小孩一起玩。他妈妈很讨厌，尽管她住在上层。

original: God has truly blessed our family, Henry.
translation: 上帝真的在保佑我们，亨利。

original: Wonderful sermon, Father. It really made me think.
translation: 你的布道太精彩了，神父。让我感触颇深。

original: Someday you'll be the one preaching the sermons, Diego.
translation: 有一天你也会成为一个神父的，迭戈。

original: How was work today, Henry? Is Doctor Li almost finished?
translation: 今天干得怎么样，亨利？李博士这是不是快完成了？

original: Isn't it exciting? A wedding. We haven't had a wedding in Rivet City in years.
translation: 是不是很兴奋？一场婚礼。铆钉城好多年没有举行婚礼了。

original: Oh! Hello. Are you lost?
translation: 哦！你好，你是不是迷路了？

original: Hey, Vera. Still dodging old Seagrave? He's got eyes for you.
translation: 嗨，薇拉。还在躲避老西格雷夫？他已经盯上你了。

original: Shrapnel, I thought you shot your own food?
translation: “榴弹”小帅，我想你是不是已经猎到你的食物了？

original: Hi, Flak. I hear the Iguana on a Stick is good today.
translation: 嘿，“高炮”弗莱克。我听说今天的蜥蜴肉串很不错。

original: Your little girl is getting married! How exciting! You must be so proud.
translation: 你的女儿结婚了？！多么令人激动！你一定很骄傲。

original: Gary, could I have some ant meat and a Nuka-Cola?
translation: 加里，能不能给我来点蚂蚁肉和核子可乐？

original: Come to spend some of your hard earned caps, Henry? I'm afraid I'm all out of moral superiority.
translation: 是不是来用你辛苦挣来的钱消费，亨利？你这样做我恐怕会于心不忍。

original: Christie. I noticed you never clean up the hangar deck. Just the upper deck. What, we aren't good enough for you?
translation: 克里斯蒂。我注意到你从来不打扫机库甲板。你只打扫上层甲板。怎么，难道是我们对你还不够好？

original: Hello, C.J.
translation: 你好，长江。

original: Go home, or get high, or whatever it is you do when I'm not around.
translation: 要么回家，要么开玩，或者等我不在的时候随便你干嘛。

original: I heard you're getting married! Are you excited? Is Diego nervous?
translation: 我听说你要结婚了！你兴奋吗？迭戈是不是很紧张？

original: Angela, what brings you into A Quick Fix?
translation: 安吉拉，什么风把你吹到了快速修复来？

original: Father Clifford is making more sense than usual.
translation: 克利福德神父比平时讲的更有道理。

original: Hi, Bannon! Mind if I sit with you?
translation: 嘿，班侬！不介意我和你坐在一起吧？

original: See anything you like, Mei?
translation: 有没有你喜欢的，美？

original: You know, we helped fix up those love birds up. I'm so glad it worked out.
translation: 你知道，我们专门解决小两口间的事。很高兴我们做到了。

original: Welcome to A Quick Fix.
translation: 欢迎来到快速修复。

original: Have you seen my husband, Paulie?
translation: 你有没有看见我老公，保利？

original: Did you need something?
translation: 你是不是需要些什么？

original: Hey, Dad, can you tell me a story? Tell me one about when people could drink the river.
translation: 嗨，爸爸。能不能给我讲个故事？就和我讲讲人们可以喝河水的那时候的事。

original: Dad, can I be excused to go play with James?
translation: 爸爸，我能不能去和詹姆斯玩会？

original: Dad, I'm bored.
translation: 爸爸。我很无聊。

original: Mom, can I have a snack?
translation: 妈妈，我能不能吃块点心？

original: Mom, why don't we like the people that live on the hangar deck?
translation: 妈妈，为什么我们不喜欢那些住在机库甲板的人呢？

original: Mom, is James' mom going to go to hell?
translation: 妈咪，詹姆斯的妈妈是不是要下地狱了？

original: What do you want to do, James?
translation: 你想干嘛，詹姆斯？

original: Excuse me.
translation: 打扰一下。

original: Mr. Staley, could I have a Nuka-Cola please?
translation: 斯塔利先生，能不能给我来瓶核子可乐？

original: Hello, mister.
translation: 你好，先生。

original: Hello, ma'am.
translation: 你好，夫人。

original: Chief Harkness, we should go over those reports.
translation: 哈克尼斯长官，我们应该再看看那些报告。

original: Report, officer.
translation: 报告，长官。

original: Hello, Seagrave. You shouldn't waste your time with Vera. You can do better than her.
translation: 你好，西格雷夫。你不该在薇拉身上浪费时间。你能够做得比她好。

original: Hello, Diego. I'd be careful with that jailbait if I were you.
translation: 你好，迭戈。如果我是你我就会小心那小妞。

original: Hello, Garza. Everything okay down in Doctor Li's lab?
translation: 你好，加尔萨。李博士的实验室里一切正常吗？

original: You better be minding yourself, Sister. One more screw up and I'm tossing your ass overboard.
translation: 你最好给我规矩点，姐妹。再把事搞糟我就把你的屁股扔到水里去。

original: Hello, Father Clifford.
translation: 你好，克利福德神父。

original: Hello, Flak. I've got a couple of pistols that need repair. I'll bring them by tomorrow.
translation: 你好，“高炮”弗莱克。我有几把枪需要修理。我明天拿过来。

original: Guns and liquor don't mix, Shrapnel. Leave the ordnance at home when you're in the Muddy Rudder.
translation: 枪和酒可别放在一起，“榴弹”小帅。在“泥舵”酒吧你得把军火放在家里。

original: Hello Miss Weatherly. Still letting that bucket of bolts do all your work for you?
translation: 韦瑟利小姐，你好。还在让那些纨绔子弟为你做事？

original: How am I supposed to manage security at a wedding? It's impossible I tell you.
translation: 我是怎么安排婚礼的安保工作？想让我告诉你，没门。

original: If you see anything suspicious, be sure to tell a security officer.
translation: 如果你发现任何可疑情况，请立刻向警卫长官反映。

original: Hey, Security guy. This place is awesome. Don't mind me. I'm just admiring the scenery.
translation: 嗨，警卫。这地方真棒。别介意，我只是在夸赞这场面罢了。

original: So what's your story? Me, I'm just experiencing my freedom. You know, wandering the Wasteland, doing whatever I please.
translation: 那么你有什么原因呢？我，只是寻求我的自由。你知道，在废土中游荡，做我想做的事。

original: Dude, what's the word? You tripping or something? You seem really bummed out.
translation: 老兄，到底出什么事了？你看上去很沮丧。

original: Dude, I believe in better life through chems, but you're taking it way too far. You gotta cut back some.
translation: 老兄，我相信嗑药感觉很好，但你也嗑的太多了。你得缓缓。

original: Hey, squirt.
translation: 嗨，喷射器。

original: Chief Harkness! Dude, what's up?
translation: 哈克尼斯长官！老兄，怎么回事？

original: Hey, missy.
translation: 嗨，小姐。

original: Brock! The bouncer man! Dude, I would love your job. Free booze, drunk women, and you get to crack some skulls too.
translation: 布洛克！那大家伙！老兄，我喜欢你的工作。免费的酒，醉醺醺的小妞，你还能敲碎别人的脑袋。

original: Stay chill, dude.
translation: 放松，老兄。

original: Chief Harkness. It's always comforting to see you on your rounds.
translation: 哈克尼斯长官。看到你在巡视总是令人安心。

original: Have you decided on the message for your next sermon?
translation: 你决定你下次布道的主旨了吗？

original: Father, doesn't it bother you to preach to an empty church everyday but Sunday?
translation: 神父，除了周日之外，其余六天你对着空空的教堂布道不觉得烦恼吗？

original: I'm sure God hears your prayers, Mister Lopez.
translation: 我相信上帝听见了你的祈祷，洛佩斯小姐。

original: Doctor Preston, may I visit with your patients? I promise to be brief and quiet.
translation: 普雷斯顿，我能不能和你的病人谈谈？我保证会简短并轻声。

original: Angela, people are starting to talk. I can't be seen with you like this any more. From now on only visit me in the church.
translation: 安吉拉，人们开始议论了。我不能再这样和你见面了。从现在起，我们只能在教堂见面。

original: Angela, I'm not sure you should spend so much time around me. I am to be married to God soon.
translation: 安吉拉，我想你还是不要在我身上浪费时间了。我就快结婚了。

original: What looks good on the menu today, Mister Buckingham?
translation: 今天的菜单上有什么特色，白金汉先生？

original: This may be the happiest day of my life!
translation: 这是我有生以来最快乐的一天！

original: God bless you.
translation: 上帝保佑你。

original: Don't go too far away. I'm going to need you to move some equipment shortly.
translation: 别跑太远。等下我还要叫你帮我搬点设备。

original: Henry, do you have those readings ready for me yet?
translation: 亨利，我要看的那些东西帮我准备好了没？

original: Let me guess. I'm perfectly healthy. I keep telling you I'm fine.
translation: 让我猜猜。我一定非常健康。我一直和你说我身体很好。

original: Anna, don't just stand there, bring me that equipment.
translation: 安娜，别光站着啊，把那设备拿给我。

original: Janice, have you overbalanced the chemical mix?
translation: 贾尼斯，你是不是打翻了那些化学药剂？

original: Don't get in the way. We're very busy.
translation: 好狗不挡路。没见我们正忙着吗？

original: Father Clifford, I'll let you pray with my patients, but only for a short time. They need their rest.
translation: 克利福德神父，我允许你带着我的病人祈祷。但注意时间，他们需要休息。

original: Diego, I assume you are here to visit my patients.
translation: 迭戈，我猜你是来看我的病人的。

original: Li, you shouldn't see this weekly checkup as a bad thing. All of Rivet City needs you to be as healthy as possible.
translation: 李，你不应该把每周的例行检查想的那么糟。铆钉城的所有人都需要你越健康越好。

original: Mister Buckingham, could I get a bite to eat?
translation: 白金汉先生，我能不能吃点东西？

original: If those two lovebirds aren't careful, I'll be helping Angela deliver a baby before the year is out.
translation: 如果这两口子不小心，我想过了今年我就要帮安吉拉接生孩子了。

original: You're hurt. Fortunately, this is a medical clinic. Why don't you let me take a look at that.
translation: 你受伤了。幸运的是，这就是诊所。为什么你不让我瞧瞧呢？

original: This is a medical clinic. Please don't disturb any of my patients.
translation: 这是诊所。请不要打扰我的病人。

original: You don't look too good. Come by the clinic and I'll patch you up.
translation: 你看上去不太好。来诊所我帮你诊断一下。

original: Diego, you have been fornicating with that strumpet, Angela Staley. Don't try to deny it. I have a witness.
translation: 迭戈，你一直在和那妓女私通吧，那叫安吉拉·斯塔利的。不要狡辩。我可是有证据的。

original: Make sure the chapel is prepared for Sunday services.
translation: 请确认小教堂已经为周日的事准备就绪了。

original: Don't forget to prepare the sacrament.
translation: 不要忘记准备圣礼。

original: Saint Monica bless you, Vera. You have truly found peace through the Lord.
translation: 圣莫尼卡保佑你，薇拉。通过上帝你已经找到安宁了。

original: Saint Monica bless you, Christie. How is your family?
translation: 圣莫尼卡保佑你，克里斯蒂。你家人都好吗？

original: Saint Monica bless you, C.J. Have you spoken to James about coming to church? I'd really like to see him here.
translation: 圣莫尼卡保佑你，长江。你有没有和詹姆斯说过来教堂的事？我真想在这见见他。

original: Saint Monica bless you, Henry. The work you are doing with Doctor Li is blessed by God as well.
translation: 圣莫尼卡保佑你，亨利。你和李博士的善举同样受到上帝的祝福。

original: I'm so glad you and Diego decided to get married. So many couples decide to live in sin these days.
translation: 我很高兴你和迭戈准备结婚了。现在有太多男女决定姘居。

original: Saint Monica bless you, Angela. I hope your father is well. You really should try to get him to come with you to church.
translation: 圣莫尼卡保佑你，安吉拉。我希望你的父亲身体健康。你真应该叫他一起来教堂。

original: Saint Monica bless you, Mei. Remember, you faith will be your armor.
translation: 圣莫尼卡保佑你，美。记住，你的信仰就是你的装甲。

original: Your patients appreciate my visits, even if you don't, Doctor Preston. The Holy Spirit can be a balm to the soul.
translation: 你的病人感激我的造访，尽管你不喜欢，普雷斯顿。圣灵是灵魂的慰籍。

original: Diego, we must pray with any of Doctor Preston's patients. Help them to heal through Saint Monica.
translation: 迭戈，我们应该和普雷斯顿的所有病人一起祈祷，通过圣莫尼卡的力量让他们痊愈。

original: Suicide is a sin, Mister Lopez. Why kill yourself when there is so much to live for?
translation: 自杀是一种罪过，洛佩斯先生。生命有如此的的意义，你为何要选择自杀呢？

original: Have faith in Saint Monica, Mei. She will protect you from those that seek to hurt you.
translation: 虔诚的膜拜圣莫尼卡吧，美。她会保护你远离那些伤害你的事物。

original: My son, you are drifting through life. God can provide you a purpose, just as He did for Saint Monica.
translation: 我的孩子，你在虚度光阴。上帝会为你指明方向，就像他为圣莫尼卡做的那样。

original: Forsake the evils of alcohol, Flak. They tempt you with oblivion when you should be glorifying God.
translation: 不要再去触碰那邪恶的酒精了，“高炮”弗莱克。在你应该称颂上帝的时候，他们只会将你引向毁灭。

original: I'll just have some fruit today, Buckingham.
translation: 我今天只要一些水果，白金汉。

original: Put down that drink and raise your voice to the Lord!
translation: 放下手中的杯子，像上帝忏悔吧！

original: Trinnie, can't you see what whiskey has done to your life? You've sold your body to men and your soul to the Devil.
translation: 崔妮，你难道看不见威士忌让你的生活变得一团糟吗？你已经出卖了你的肉体，出卖了你的灵魂。

original: Belle, you are an unwitting servant of the devil. You serve his demon brew down here.
translation: 贝勒，你无意中已经成为魔鬼的仆人。你在侍奉在这酿造出来的他的恶魔们。

original: Deep down you are a good man, Brock. Come away from this den of iniquity. Come into the light of the Lord!
translation: 在内心深处你仍是个好人，布洛克。离开这邪魔的巢穴吧，去上帝的光辉照耀的地方！

original: This is not a safe place for your soul. Do not be tempted by the sins of vile liquor in this den of iniquity!
translation: 你的灵魂在这受到威胁。不要被这邪恶巢穴中的充满罪恶的液体引诱！

original: It's a glorious day for a wedding!
translation: 今天是大喜的好日子！

original: Saint Monica bless you.
translation: 圣莫尼卡保佑你。

original: How's our ammo inventory? It was getting low yesterday.
translation: 我们的弹药行囊怎么了？昨天感觉轻了好多。

original: Hey, Brock. Looking for more 10mm ammo?
translation: 嗨，布洛克。还想要点10MM弹药？

original: Business or pleasure, Vera?
translation: 你是来谈生意还是来消遣的，薇拉？

original: Hello Vera. I think I heard a Mirelurk off the starboard side. Think I'll get in some target practice.
translation: 你好，薇拉。我想我听说在右舷那边有个泥沼蟹。我想我该去拿它练练手。

original: The deck is quiet tonight.
translation: 今晚甲板上真安静。

original: Gary, two Mirelurk Cakes. And make it quick.
translation: 加里，来两份泥沼蟹饼。快点啊。

original: Welcome to Flak and Shrapnel's. Best god damn weapons anywhere.
translation: 欢迎来到“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅。这该死的到处都是上好的武器。

original: What are you looking at?
translation: 你在看什么？

original: You've grown up so fast, Angela. I remember when you first learned to walk, and now you're getting married!
translation: 你都长那么大了，安吉拉。我还记得你第一次学走路的样子，你看现在你都结婚了。

original: I heard that you've been hanging around that Diego boy. Be careful, Angela. You know boys only want one thing, even priests.
translation: 我听说你一直在和迭戈那男孩纠结不清。你要小心，安吉拉。你知道男孩子脑子里只想要一件事，即使是神父也不例外。

original: Make sure to clean all the empty tables.
translation: 请确定每张空台都收拾干净了。

original: Taking a break, Vera?
translation: 歇会，薇拉？

original: My little girl is all grown up. After today, she'll be married to Diego.
translation: 我的小女孩都长大成人了。从今以后，她就是迭戈的人了。

original: Have a seat anywhere. Someone will be with you in a minute.
translation: 随便坐，立刻会有人来招待你。

original: I...nevermind.
translation: 我……没事。

original: Are the Mirelurk Cakes fresh?
translation: 这泥沼蟹饼新鲜吗？

original: I moved the new plant beds under the sun lamps.
translation: 我把日光灯下的床移了一下。

original: Doctor Li, the new shipment has been stowed away.
translation: 李博士，新的货物被偷运了。

original: I have some spare time. Do you need anything?
translation: 我现在闲着。你需要点什么？

original: Hello Diego. Has Father Clifford decided to ordain you as a full priest yet?
translation: 你好，迭戈。克利福德神父还没有决定任命你为神父？

original: Commander Danvers. Doctor Li has asked that the latest shipment be locked up this time.
translation: 丹佛斯指挥官。李博士要求将最近的这批货物封锁起来。

original: If you could move out of the way, it would make things easier for all of us.
translation: 如果你能搬到偏远的地方会对我们大家都有好处。

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: Anything to report?
translation: 有什么情况要汇报吗？

original: Armitage.
translation: 阿米蒂奇。

original: Janice, I have something for you.
translation: 贾尼斯，我有东西给你。

original: Janice, a moment please.
translation: 贾尼斯，打扰你一会。

original: Is everything all right?
translation: 一切都还好吗？

original: Hello, honey.
translation: 你好，亲爱的。

original: Hello, son.
translation: 你好，孩子。

original: Oh, great.
translation: 哦，真棒。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Hey there!
translation: 嗨！

original: How's it going?
translation: 进展如何？

original: Hiya.
translation: 嗨。

original: Any problems in the Muddy Rudder that I should know about?
translation: “泥舵”酒吧有什么该让我知道的事吗？

original: C.J., don't do everything James tells you. He's a bad example.
translation: 长江，永远不要按詹姆斯教你的做。他是个坏蛋。

original: Commander Danvers, anything to report?
translation: 丹佛斯指挥官，什么情况？

original: Ted, if you're still looking for work, Christie Young can always use help cleaning the Hangar Decks.
translation: 泰德，如果你还在找工作，克里斯蒂·杨一直在找人帮忙清扫机库甲板。

original: Hey, Flak. How's business?
translation: 嗨，“高炮”弗莱克。生意怎么样？

original: James, you stay out of trouble.
translation: 詹姆斯，别惹麻烦。

original: Hello, Mei. I'm still keeping an eye on him. You're safe.
translation: 你好，美。我盯着他呢。你很安全。

original: Hello, Mei. You seem much more relaxed now that he's gone.
translation: 你好，美。他走之后你看上去轻松了不少。

original: Paulie, you need to lay off the chems.
translation: 保利，你必须停止嗑药。

original: Seagrave, got anything new in that flea market of yours?
translation: 西格雷夫，你的跳蚤市场有没有什么新东西？

original: Tammy, take it easy on the booze. You've got a son to raise.
translation: 塔米，在酒上你得悠着点花钱了，你还有个孩子要养呢。

original: Trinnie, don't make a fool of yourself tonight like you did last week.
translation: 崔妮，今晚你可别像上周那样自欺欺人了。

original: Vera, you look lovely as always.
translation: 薇拉，你看上去总是那么讨人喜爱。

original: Mister Zimmer. Have you found what you're looking for?
translation: 齐默先生。你找到你要找的东西了没有？

original: Let me or a security officer know if you see anything out of the ordinary.
translation: 如果你看见任何不正常的现象，就告诉我或者告诉警卫长官。

original: Shall we go for a walk on the flight deck tonight, dear?
translation: 亲爱的，今晚我们一起去飞行甲板上散步好吗？

original: How's your food, dear?
translation: 你的食物怎么样，亲爱的？

original: Attendance is good today.
translation: 今天人来得很齐嘛。

original: A thoughtful message, Father.
translation: 真是个发人深省的主题，神父。

original: He was on fire today, Diego. I could barely keep my eyes open.
translation: 他今天情绪激昂，迭戈。我几乎睁不开眼。

original: C.J, have you done your chores?
translation: 长江，你做完家务了吗？

original: I fixed the transformer, again. You should have power for a while.
translation: 我又把变压器修好了。等会就有电了。

original: Garza, you stacked those crates on the cables again. They need to be moved or you'll short out the system.
translation: 加尔萨，你又把这些箱子堆在电缆上面了。你得把它们挪走，不然系统会被你弄短路的。

original: Janice, are those sunlamps I fixed the other day holding up?
translation: 贾尼斯，那天我修好的日光灯工作正常吗？

original: I do the repairs around here. So if you see something that needs fixing, let me know.
translation: 我负责修理这的东西。所以，如果你看见什么东西坏了，请告诉我。

original: No problems to report, I assume.
translation: 我猜没有什么情况吧？

original: Mom, can I go to C.J.'s?
translation: 妈妈，我能去长江家吗？

original: Hey C.J., let's play killer. You pretend to be my Mom, and I'll pretend to be a serial killer.
translation: 嗨，长江，让我扮演杀手吧。你就扮我妈妈，我就是一个连环杀手。

original: Mom, do I have to eat this?
translation: 妈妈，我真的一定要吃这吗？

original: You're nothin' but a talking refrigerator.
translation: 你简直就是个会说话的冰箱。

original: Outta my way, tin can.
translation: 别挡路，你这罐头。

original: Don't mind me, mister.
translation: 不要在意我，先生。

original: Don't mind me, lady.
translation: 不要介意我，先生。

original: Doctor Li, the new solutions will be ready in a few hours.
translation: 李博士，新的解决方案几小时后就会准备好。

original: The waste water in the hydroponic gardens isn't draining properly. Could you look at it?
translation: 那水培花园里的废水排放好像不正常。你能不能过去看看？

original: Garza, when you get a chance, remove the empty water tanks in the gardens and put in the fresh ones.
translation: 加尔萨，如果你有空，请你把花园里的空水箱弄走，换个新的上去。

original: The work that Doctor Li is doing is just amazing. I might even be able to produce broccoli in the hydroponic gardens next year.
translation: 李博士正在做的那工作太神奇了。或许明年我就能在那水培花园里种花椰菜了。

original: I'd like a potato and some carrots. Oh, and put some of this herb in hot water. If I'm lucky, it will make tea.
translation: 我想来点马铃薯和胡萝卜。噢，再把这些草本植物放一点到热水里。如果我走运，它们说不定可以用来泡茶。

original: Don't touch the vegetables. They're fragile.
translation: 不要碰那些蔬菜，它们可经不起折腾。

original: Some people are in such a hurry.
translation: 一些人看上去行色匆匆。

original: Ted, could you please not put your stuff on my bed or all over the floor?
translation: 泰德，你能不能不要把你的东西堆的我满床满地都是？

original: Mister Lopez, would you like to talk? They say talking helps with problems.
translation: 洛佩斯先生，能和你谈谈吗？他们说交谈可以帮助解决问题。

original: A lovely sermon, Father.
translation: 非常好的布道，神父。

original: Diego, try and get Father Clifford to put some energy in his sermons. Some of us were trying not to fall asleep.
translation: 迭戈，你和克利福德神父说说看，叫他的布道带些激情，我们有些人都要睡着了。

original: Don't mind me.
translation: 别在意我。

original: Miss Mei, may I get you some water?
translation: 美小姐，要不要我给你上杯水？

original: Doctor Preston, the usual?
translation: 普雷斯顿，老样子？

original: Is everything satisfactory, Mister Washington?
translation: 一切还令人满意么，华盛顿先生？

original: Miss Janice, do you need a refill?
translation: 贾尼斯小姐，要续杯吗？

original: Are you ready to order, Mister Diego?
translation: 你想好要点些什么了吗，迭戈先生？

original: Are you ready to order, Mister Father Clifford?
translation: 你想好要来点什么了吗，克利福德神父？

original: Are you ready to order, Mister Sister?
translation: 你想好要来点什么了吗？

original: Something different today, Mister Armitage?
translation: 你今天要来点不一样的么，阿米蒂奇先生？

original: Are you ready to order, Mister Zimmer?
translation: 你要来点什么，齐默先生？

original: Do you have any instructions, Miss Vera?
translation: 你有什么指示，薇拉小姐？

original: I am at your service.
translation: 我随时为您效劳。

original: Mei, you've been kind to me. I'll miss you when I'm gone.
translation: 美，你一直对我那么好，我走了以后会想你的。

original: Ted, you're wasting your life. Do something with it. How about I teach you to read?
translation: 泰德，你在虚度年华。你要做点有意义的事。不如我教你阅读吧？

original: Ted, you're wasting your life. Do something with it. If you don't, you'll turn out just like me.
translation: 泰德，你在虚度年华。你要做点有意义的事。不然你就会变得和我一样没出息。

original: Shrapnel, do you sell ammo individually? Could I buy just one bullet?
translation: “榴弹”小帅，你的弹药可以“零售”吗？我能不能只买一颗子弹？

original: Father, I have these feelings of worthlessness. I just want to end it all.
translation: 神父，我有种觉得自己毫无价值的感觉。我真想结束这一切。

original: Diego, I am a troubled man. My life has no meaning. There is no point in going on.
translation: 迭戈，我是个麻烦的家伙。我的人生毫无价值，没有继续活着的意义。

original: Gary, is there anything new on the menu?
translation: 加里，菜单上有没有什么新东西？

original: Leave me alone. This is none of your business.
translation: 不要管我，这不关你的事。

original: Don't mind me. I'm just taking up space here.
translation: 不要在意我，我不过是找个地方待着。

original: Hey, Commander. Just walking the deck here. Yep, just walking the deck.
translation: 嗨，指挥官。我不过是在甲板上走走，对，走走而已。

original: You're tired, Cindy. I'll close up tonight. You go home and go to bed.
translation: 你很疲惫，辛迪。今天晚上我们不营业了，你回家好好睡一觉。

original: Ted, Teddy! I got some great Psycho. It's totally wow. You oughta come down to my shop and buy some. We could shoot it together.
translation: 泰德，泰德！我弄到一点上等的疯狂药。真是棒极了。你真该来我店里买一点，我们可以一起注射。

original: It's the colors, man. The colors are amazing. You really gotta try Psycho.
translation: 我看见好多颜色，伙计。五彩缤纷的颜色。你真该试试疯狂药。

original: Hey, haven't I seen you somewhere before?
translation: 嗨，我以前是不是在哪见过你？

original: Man, I'm so hungry. When I come down, I really get a need to feed.
translation: 伙计，我快饿死了。我真的要找点东西填饱肚子。

original: Gary, my man! I'm so hungry I could eat a whole Brahmin. How about lettin' me put this one on my tab?
translation: 加里，我的朋友！我饿得都能吃下一头双头牛了。那么我就点上这么一份儿吧，怎么样？

original: Angela, how would you like to trade some Brahmin steak for Mentats? It'll make you beautiful.
translation: 安吉拉，你愿不愿意拿双头牛肉排换一些曼他特？它会让你美丽动人的。

original: This is A Quick Fix. We sell all kinds of chems.
translation: 这是快速修复。我们这出售所有种类的药品。

original: Wanna do some Buffout? Maybe a little Psycho?
translation: 想来点壮大灵？或者来点疯狂药？

original: This area is off limits to civilians.
translation: 这区域禁止平民进入。

original: Hello, Vera. I just got in a new hot plate. I can sell it to you at a discount.
translation: 你好，薇拉。我刚买了一块新的加热板。我可以打折卖给你。

original: Vera, I know I'm not a sophisticated man, but I am a man, and I can take care of you.
translation: 薇拉，我知道我不是一个有教养的人，但我至少是个男人，我能够照顾你。

original: I'll have some mutfruit and noodles.
translation: 我想来点水果和面条。

original: Can I get a Nuka-Cola?
translation: 能不能给我来瓶核子可乐？

original: Any news with Doctor Li's project?
translation: 李博士的工程有没有什么新消息？

original: Hey, Cindy. How's that secure storage unit I made you working out?
translation: 嗨，辛迪。我帮你做的那保险柜用的怎么样？

original: There's the blushing bride to be! Congratulations Angela. You and Diego will make a good couple.
translation: 欢迎我们的新娘！祝贺你，安吉拉。你和迭戈会成为美好的伴侣。

original: Hello, Miss Angela. What brings you into my shop today?
translation: 你好，安吉拉小姐。今天来我的小店有何贵干？

original: Hello, Bannon. Anything interesting happen in the last council meeting?
translation: 你好，班侬。最近的那次议会会议上有没有发生什么有趣的事？

original: Hello, Henry. I just got in some new torc wrench and some electrical test equipment. You should take a look at them when you're done eating.
translation: 你好，亨利。我新进了一批扳手和电子测试设备。你吃完饭之后不妨来我店里看看。

original: Cindy, don't forget to bring by anything interesting you might find while cleaning the deck. It might be worth some caps to you.
translation: 辛迪，当你清扫甲板的时候，别忘记任何你觉得有趣的东西。或许它们能换点钱花。

original: C.J.! You're getting bigger and prettier every day.
translation: 长江！你一天比一天长大，一天比一天漂亮。

original: Hey, Flak. I'd avoid the Iguana today. It gave me the runs yesterday.
translation: 嗨，“高炮”弗莱克。我今天得避开那蜥蜴。昨天它追了我好久。

original: Diego is a lucky boy. Angela agreed to marry him.
translation: 迭戈真幸运，安吉拉同意嫁给他了。

original: Welcome to Rivet City Supply. I've got a little bit of everything here.
translation: 欢迎来到铆钉城补给点。我们这应有尽有。

original: Nice day, huh?
translation: 愉快的一天，呃？

original: I can't get that god damned laser pistol working. Think I should ask Seagrave to look at it?
translation: 我搞不定那该死的激光手枪。是不是该叫西格雷夫帮我看看？

original: Vera. Don't see you in here often. Looking for something in particular?
translation: 薇拉。你可是稀客啊。是不是想要点特别的东西？

original: Hey Brock, when are you going to trade in that piece of shit sidearm? I've got some sweet new ones here.
translation: 嗨，布洛克，你准备什么时候去把那该死的侧臂给卖掉？我已经弄了个新的了。

original: How's the whiskey, Belle?
translation: 威士忌怎么样，贝勒？

original: Hey, girlie. This ain't a god damn dress shop. There's nothing in here you oughta be buyin'.
translation: 嗨，女孩。这可不是什么该死的服装店，不会有你想要的东西。

original: Gary, gimme some Brahmin steaks. And don't burn them this time.
translation: 加里，给我来点双头牛肉排。现在先别烤。

original: If you want a gun, you've come to the right place.
translation: 如果你想买把枪，你可算来对地方了。

original: Are you looking at me?
translation: 你是在看我吗？

original: I need another whiskey, Belle.
translation: 再给我来杯威士忌，贝勒。

original: You're not so tough.
translation: 你还不够厉害。

original: Let me buy you a drink. You and Flak have a nice shop. Have you known him long? Was he born in Rivet City?
translation: 让我请你喝一杯。你和“高炮”弗莱克有一家不错的店。你认识他很久了？他是在铆钉城出生的？

original: You'd be worth some caps in the right circles. Too bad.
translation: 你本应值点钱的，真是太糟糕了。

original: Hey, you rusty tin can. Get me some food. Meat, any kind. And don't call me Mister Sister.
translation: 嗨，你这生锈的罐头。给我拿点吃的来。来点肉，随便什么肉。还有，不要叫我“修女”先生。

original: You can shove your sermon up your ass, Father. We're busy drinking down here.
translation: 带上把你的狗屁布道给我滚，神父。没看见我们正忙着喝酒吗？

original: You don't look so tough.
translation: 你看上去不够厉害。

original: Don't slouch. Chew your food. And don't give me that look or I'll slap it right off your face!
translation: 别无精打采的样子。吃你的饭！你再那样看我，我就直接扇你两耳光！

original: Stop that! Don't make me smack you. I oughta lock you in your goddamn room, you little brat. And stay away from that C.J. bitch from now on.
translation: 停下！别逼我扇你。我真应该把你锁在你该死的房间里，你这捣蛋鬼。从现在起不准你再和长江那婊子待在一起。

original: Gary, you know what I like. Make it rare. Oh, and get James something too. Not too expensive though. He's been naughty.
translation: 加里，你知道我喜欢什么，对，稀有的东西。哦，给詹姆斯也来点什么。不要太贵的，他不听话。

original: Did I ever tell you about my husband? Got me pregnant with that brat James. Then he ran off. Asshole.
translation: 我没和你说起过我丈夫吗？他让我怀上了詹姆斯那臭小子的孩子。然后他一跑了之，混蛋东西。

original: Hey, you. Don't trust those Hangar Deck people. They're all jealous of us cause we live in the Upper Deck.
translation: 嗨，你。不要相信机库甲板的人。他们都嫉妒我们这些住在上层甲板的人。

original: I'm drunk. Don't try to take advantage of me. No, really. You wouldn't like me when I'm sober.
translation: 我喝多了，但不要想占我便宜。真的，我喝醉的样子你不会喜欢的。

original: You're a drunk and a slut. I'm just a drunk. So there.
translation: 你是个喝醉的荡妇，而我只是喝醉，这就是我们的区别。

original: I'm outta caps. Can you put my next drink on my tab? Please Belle? I really need a drink after dealing with my brat all day.
translation: 我去拿钱。你能不能再给我来一杯？求你了，贝勒，在搞定我那捣蛋鬼后我真的很需要来一杯。

original: Have you seen my good-for-nothing son, James?
translation: 你有没有看见我那一无是处的孩子，詹姆斯？

original: Belle, gimme another drink.
translation: 贝勒，再给我来一杯。

original: Brock, how come you never put the moves on me?
translation: 布洛克，为什么你从来都不挑逗我？

original: I've got the headache from hell. Do you have anything that will help?
translation: 我的头疼死了，你有什么东西能帮我吗？

original: Flak, honey, buy me a drink. I'm short on caps, and I really need one.
translation: “高炮”弗莱克，亲爱的，请我喝一杯吧。我手头一时没钱，可我真的想喝一杯。

original: Shrapnel! You're my favorite man. Buy me a drink lover?
translation: “榴弹”小帅！你是我最喜欢的朋友了，请我喝一杯吧？

original: Hey, Sister. How about that drink you owe me?
translation: 嗨，修女。我记得你好像欠我一杯酒吧？

original: Father Clifford, I've been a bad girl.
translation: 克利福德神父，我变成个坏女孩了。

original: Hey stranger. Wanna buy a girl a drink?
translation: 嗨，陌生人，不想请女孩喝一杯吗？

original: Can you spare enough for drink? I could really use one.
translation: 你能不能多留些酒？我真想来一杯。

original: What are you looking at?
translation: 你在看什么？

original: So you finally got Diego to ask you to marry him. Well, I couldn't be happier for the both of you.
translation: 你最终还是让迭戈娶你了。说真的，我真是为你们感到高兴。

original: Angela, you are growing up so fast! Your father must be proud.
translation: 安吉拉，你都长那么大啦！你父亲一定很为你骄傲。

original: Are you getting enough to eat, Mister Armitage?
translation: 够吃吗，阿米蒂奇先生？

original: When are you going to get some new dresses, Bannon? I'm tired of these worn out styles.
translation: 你什么时候去进一点新衣服，班侬？我已经厌烦这种过时货了。

original: Hello Cindy. Is Paulie off getting high again? You really should kick him out.
translation: 你好，辛迪。保利又开始嗑药了？你真应该一脚把他踢出去。

original: Hello Cindy. I know we haven't been the best of friends, but I am sorry he's dead. I know he meant something to you.
translation: 你好，辛迪。我知道我们不是最好的朋友，但对他的死我感到很遗憾。我知道他对你很重要。

original: Commander Danvers. Walking the night patrol?
translation: 丹佛斯指挥官。在夜间巡视呐？

original: Eat what you want, Diego. I never charge you or Father Clifford for you meals.
translation: 敞开肚子吃，迭戈。你和克利福德神父来吃饭不用付帐。

original: Father Clifford's sermon was very inspirational.
translation: 克利福德神父的布道灵气十足。

original: Your sermon was very inspirational, Father Clifford.
translation: 你的布道很有灵气，克利福德神父。

original: I'm so happy for Angela. She and Diego will be so happy together.
translation: 我真为安吉拉高兴。她和迭戈一定会很幸福。

original: Hello Gary. How's Angela doing? I saw her with Diego the other day.
translation: 你好，加里。安吉拉怎么样？我那天看见她和迭戈在一起。

original: Someone said the Mirelurks are out tonight.
translation: 有人说泥沼蟹今晚出来了。

original: Hello Flak. How's business?
translation: 嗨，“高炮”弗莱克，生意怎么样？

original: Here for some target practice, Flak?
translation: 来这练习射击吗，“高炮”弗莱克？

original: It's good to see you eat, Janice. How are the hydroponic gardens?
translation: 看见你吃东西了我很开心，贾尼斯。水培花园怎么样了？

original: Hello Seagrave.
translation: 你好，西格雷夫。

original: Lovely night for a walk on the deck. Thank you for keeping me company.
translation: 这样的夜晚真适合在甲板上散步。谢谢你陪着我。

original: Mister Shrapnel. I need some 10mm ammo. Two clips should do.
translation: “榴弹”小帅先生。我想买些10MM子弹，两夹就够了。

original: Is your room comfortable, Mis...uh...Sister?
translation: 房间住得还舒适么，先……呃……修女？

original: Is everything to your satisfaction, Mister Zimmer?
translation: 一切还令你满意么，齐默先生？

original: Well, my metal friend. How are we doing today?
translation: 我的铁哥们，今天我们做什么？

original: Have you heard? Angela and Diego are getting married.
translation: 你听说了吗？安吉拉和迭戈要结婚啦。

original: Welcome to the Weatherly Hotel.
translation: 欢迎来到韦瑟利旅馆。

original: Nice to see you.
translation: 很高兴见到你。

original: Madam, do you know of anyone in Rivet City that seems unusual? Very unemotional or too formal?
translation: 夫人，你有没有注意到铆钉城里有什么人看上去不太正常？非常冷酷或者过于严肃？

original: A glass of wine, please.
translation: 一杯红酒，谢谢。

original: We're not having any luck, Armitage. We may have to change strategies.
translation: 我们好像不太走运，阿米蒂奇。或许我们应该改变策略。

original: Miss Janice, maybe we could exchange science notes sometime. My work in biological systems might be of interest to you.
translation: 贾尼斯小姐，或许什么时候我们应该交换我们的科学研究笔记。我在生物学系统的研究或许能引起你的兴趣。

original: Excuse me, sir. Have you noticed anyone acting peculiarly in Rivet City?
translation: 请原谅，先生。你有没有注意到铆钉城里有什么人行为很特别？

original: Do you have any salt?
translation: 你有没有盐？

original: Did I order already? If I didn't, I'd like Iguana Bits with vegetables.
translation: 我点餐了吗？如果没有，我想来点蔬菜拌蜥蜴肉粒。

original: Vera, may I have some Brahmin steak, carrots, and a glass of water, please?
translation: 薇拉，能不能给我来点肉排，还有胡萝卜，外加一杯水？

original: Hello officer. You haven't seen anyone acting oddly lately, have you?
translation: 你好，长官。你有没看见行为古怪的人？

original: Wastelander.
translation: 废土游民。

original: This place is closing soon. Do your business and get out.
translation: 这地方就快关了，没事就快滚。

original: They're all eating breakfast at Gary's. They'll still sell to you though. Just ask 'em.
translation: 他们都在加里那吃早餐。他们也会卖给你，你开口就是了。

original: They're all eating dinner at Gary's. They'll still sell to you though. Just ask 'em.
translation: 他们都在加里那吃晚餐。他们也会卖给你，你开口就是了。

original: Go get some chow. Your shift's over.
translation: 去吃点东西吧。你到已经到下班时间了。

original: Shift's over. Go get some rest.
translation: 下班了，你可以去休息了。

original: Everything looks okay here.
translation: 一切正常。

original: Any trouble in this area?
translation: 这区域有什么问题吗？

original: I'm looking for troublemakers. Have you seen any?
translation: 我在找制造麻烦的家伙。你看见没？

original: Out of the way you rust bucket.
translation: 闪开点，你这生锈的铁桶。

original: It was so noisy last night. I could hardly sleep.
translation: 昨晚太吵了，我都被吵得睡不着。

original: One of the new immigrants died of radiation poisoning last week.
translation: 上周有个新移民死于辐射中毒。

original: I heard that the City Council is debating putting railings on the flight deck.
translation: 我听说城议会在讨论在甲板上装置栏杆。

original: Did you hear about the fight in the Muddy Rudder last night?
translation: 你听说了吗？昨晚在“泥舵”酒吧发生战斗了。

original: Doctor Li and her staff left to get Project Purity running.
translation: 李博士和他的职员都去进行净水工程了。

original: I heard that a bunch of former slaves from Paradise Falls set up a free town in the Lincoln Memorial.
translation: 我听说从堕落天堂来的一帮逃脱的奴隶的家伙在林肯纪念堂建立了一座自由城。

original: Did you hear that the Enclave attacked Project Purity? They've taken over the Memorial.
translation: 你有没有听说英克雷攻击了净水工程？他们已经占领了纪念堂。

original: Hey, have you noticed that Enclave radio is off the air?
translation: 嗨，你有没有注意到英克雷电台停播了？

original: Did you hear what happened to Ted Strayer?
translation: 你知不知道泰德·斯崔尔出什么事了？

original: You know Tenpenny Tower, right? Well, Allistair Tenpenny was killed.
translation: 你知道特佩尼大厦，是吗？好吧，奥利斯特·特佩尼被杀了。

original: There was some sort of battle in the city yesterday. The gate guard said the gunfire went on for over an hour.
translation: 昨天那发生了冲突。门卫说枪声持续了有一个小时。

original: They found Harkness dead. It looks like he put up a fight though.
translation: 他们发现哈克尼斯死了。看上去他曾在战斗中奋勇抵抗。

original: Chief Harkness has vanished. Nobody knows what happened to him.
translation: 哈克尼斯长官失踪了。没人知道他出了什么事。

original: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

original: Sir.
translation: 长官。

original: Ma'am.
translation: 女士。

original: Attention! Officer on deck.
translation: 注意！长官来了。

original: Authorized Civilian. Proceed.
translation: 授权平民，获准通行。

original: Why would you do that?
translation: 你为什么要这么做？

original: Why don't you go hang out with your new friends?
translation: 你为何不和你的新朋友出去逛逛？

original: Thank God that's over.
translation: 感谢上帝终于结束了。

original: Get these idiots away from me!
translation: 把这些白痴从我身边赶走！

original: Go ahead and take a seat so we can start.
translation: 找个座位，我们开始。

original: You did fine. You should celebrate with your friends.
translation: 你做得很好，你可以和你的朋友们好好庆祝一番。

original: All finished?
translation: 都完了？

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: You need something?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: 'can I do for you, Sheriff?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的，警长？

original: 'can I do for you, daddy-o?
translation: 我能为你做些什么，爸爸？

original: 'can I do for you, dolly?
translation: 有何吩咐，娃娃？

original: Helluva day, isn't it?
translation: 艰难的一天，你说呢？

original: What's shakin'?
translation: 混得怎么样？

original: You got a lot of nerve wearing that badge in here.
translation: 你胆子可真够大的，敢在这带着那徽章。

original: You got somethin' to say?
translation: 有话要说？

original: Well, look who's starin' at me.
translation: 好吧，看看是谁在盯着我看。

original: Start talkin' or start walkin'. Your choice.
translation: 聊聊还是闪人，随便你。

original: (whistling a tune)
translation: (哼着小曲)

original: (whistling a tune)
translation: (哼着小曲)

original: (whistling a tune)
translation: (哼着小曲)

original: Light shine upon you, Sheriff.
translation: 春光满面啊，警长。

original: May Atom's Light shine.
translation: 愿核子光辉永远闪耀！

original: Light shine on your path.
translation: 核子光辉照亮你的道路。

original: Yes, my brother?
translation: 什么事，兄弟？

original: Yes, my sister?
translation: 什么事，姐妹？

original: You don't got nearly enough holes in you to be botherin' me.
translation: 你身上的洞还不够多，还不至于让我操心。

original: You sick? Injured?
translation: 你病了？受伤了？

original: Less'n you're on death's door, I'm busy.
translation: 除非你快挂了才能来找我。我忙着呢。

original: <hacking cough> What?
translation: <干咳> 什么？

original: Welcome back, stranger.
translation: 欢迎回来，陌生人。

original: Good to see you again, stranger.
translation: 很高兴又见到你，陌生人。

original: Welcome to Moriarty's.
translation: 欢迎来到莫里亚蒂的酒吧。

original: You... uh... want a drink?
translation: 你……呃……要不要来一杯？

original: You might wear his badge, but you're not my dad.
translation: 你带着他的徽章，但你不是我父亲。

original: Dad says not to talk to strangers.
translation: 爸爸说不要和陌生人说话。

original: I'm not supposed to talk to strangers.
translation: 我不应该和陌生人说话。

original: <coughs> Is there... <coughs> ...something you need?
translation: <咳嗽> 你需要……<咳嗽> ……些什么？

original: Stop starin'. We only sell drinks here.
translation: 别瞪着眼睛。我们这只卖喝的。

original: Can I interest you in a drink?
translation: 为什么不来上一杯呢？

original: C'mon in to the Brass Lantern, best food in town!
translation: 来，来，来，黄铜灯可是镇上最好的食品店！
