original: That badge don't impress me, kid.
translation: 那徽章并没让我记忆深刻，孩子。

original: You makin' a move? Huh?
translation: 你要干嘛？呃？

original: Point your eyes somewhere else.
translation: 看什么看啊！

original: Either start talkin' or get the fuck out of my face.
translation: 有屁快放，不然从我面前就滚开！

original: You got somethin' to say to me, kid?
translation: 有什么要说的，小孩？

original: Junk is my business.
translation: 我专门经营废品。

original: Welcome to Craterside Supply!

translation: 你要是需要我们，你知道在哪能找到我们。

translation: 祝你早日找到你的父亲。

translation: 祝你好运。在你打开避难所大门后我会设法去见你。

translation: 我要闪了。

original: Watch yourself out there, the Wasteland is no place to be messing around.
translation: 在外你得照顾自己，废土可不是个游乐场。

original: Safe travels.

original: Come back soon.

translation: 感谢你能陪我这老太婆。

translation: 可别把我们炸飞了。

original: Hurry up. Those bigots got big comeuppance waiting for them. I mean to give it to them soon. Now get!
translation: 快点。那些偏执狂只能得到报应。我的意思是尽快给他们。立刻！

original: I will. We've become pretty close and he's beginning to talk to me, so I think it's a good sign.
translation: 我会的。我们变得非常亲近，而且他开始和我说话了，所以我认为这是一个好兆头。

original: You can be such an asshole sometimes.
translation: 有时你真像一个混蛋。

original: See ya later!

original: Okay, I'm sorry Vancie. I'll be a good girl.
translation: 嗯，对不起，万斯。我会听话的。

original: You are the biggest jerk ever! Humph!
translation: 你就是一个大蠢货！

original: Bye bye!

original: It's the least I can do, Vance. You give so much and rarely receive. I'm glad I'm here to help.
translation: 这是我仅能做的，万斯。你付出很多而得到很少。我很高兴能在这帮忙。

original: You have a lot to learn about dealing with people.
translation: 你有很多为人处事的东西要学。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: You've made my day. I promise to never let you down!
translation: 你让我过上好日子。我保证不会让你失望！

original: Screw you! Jerk!
translation: 去你的！蠢货！

original: Well, see you around I guess.
translation: 嗯，回头见。

original: All right, all right. Don't get your nuts in a twist.
translation: 好吧，好吧。别犯傻。

original: Whatever. You'll come see me again when you need something.
translation: 不管怎样。当你有需要的时候就回来找我。

original: Sure thing, man!
translation: 当然，哥们！

original: Let's go.
translation: 走吧。

original: Take care, son. Now, get out of here. And good luck.
translation: 保重，儿子。快走吧。祝你好运。

original: Bye, Dad.
translation: 再见，爸爸。

original: Take care, sweetie. Now, get out of here. And good luck.
translation: 保重，甜心。快走吧。祝你好运。

original: Bye, Dad.
translation: 再见，爸爸。

original: Yep, do what you gotta do.
translation: 嗯，做你该做的。

original: Thanks for the disk. Maybe we'll cross sticks again some day.
translation: 谢谢你的磁盘。或许我们以后会再见面。

original: You know what you need to do.
translation: 你知道你需要做什么。

original: Of course you do.
translation: 当然。

original: Till next time, sightseer.
translation: 下次见，游客。

original: Come back anytime.
translation: 随时回来。

original: Next time I see the Family, there's gonna be hell to pay.
translation: 下次我看到家族，会让他们好好付出代价。

original: Take care of yourself.
translation: 照顾好自己。

original: Okay. See ya later, pal!
translation: 好吧。回头见，朋友！

original: Sorry, I'll be going now.
translation: 对不起，我现在就要走了。

original: That's right. And don't come back!
translation: 没错。别回来！

original: Sorry, I'll be going now.
translation: 对不起，我现在就要走了。

original: Come on, let's hurry up and get to Big Town!
translation: 来吧，让我们快点到大镇！

original: Enough chit-chat.
translation: 聊够了。

original: Why won't you just take me to Big Town?
translation: 不如你不把我带到大镇吧？

original: See ya, mister!
translation: 再见，先生！

original: See ya, lady!
translation: 再见，女士！

original: Now, was it five parts per milliliter or was it six? Hmmm...
translation: 它是每毫升五个还是六个？唔……

original: You have lots of work to do!
translation: 你有很多事要去做！

original: Mabel's waiting for you.
translation: 梅布尔正在等你。

original: I look forward to seeing how you deal with this.
translation: 我来看看你是怎么解决这事的。

original: Tell Timmy I said hi!
translation: 告诉提米，我向他问好！

original: Run along now.
translation: 快走开吧。

original: Betty... It's him. I know. He knows I know.
translation: 贝蒂……是他。我知道。他知道我知道。

original: It's the only thing that can save us.
translation: 那是唯一能救我们的方法。

original: You can do it. I know you can.
translation: 你能做到。我知道你能。

original: Just a chance to sleep. That's all I ask.
translation: 让我去睡吧。那是我唯一的要求。

original: Farewell, my friend. I suspect we may meet again.
translation: 回见，我的朋友。我想我们还会再见面的。

original: I won't be long.
translation: 我就好。

original: This place... so familiar.
translation: 这地方……如此熟悉。

original: The G.E.C.K. lies ahead. Follow me.
translation: 伊甸园创造器就在前面。跟着我。

original: Come, let's continue.
translation: 加油，让我们继续。

original: Take care, now.
translation: 小心点，现在。

original: You stay safe.
translation: 保证自己安全。

original: Later.
translation: 回见。

original: Hurry!
translation: 快点！

original: Watch your back. And don't trust that Roy Phillips for a second.
translation: 小心你的背后。时刻提防罗伊·菲利普斯。

original: It's dark in those tunnels. Shoot first, and ask questions later.
translation: 那些地道很黑。先开枪，再提问。

original: And I shall follow.
translation: 我会跟上你的。

original: Let's go.
translation: 走吧。

original: Very well.
translation: 那好吧。

original: Whatever you say, honey.
translation: 不管你说什么，亲爱的。

original: Let's go.

translation: 不管你说什么，亲爱的。

original: Let's go.

original: <bark!>

original: <bark!>

translation: 我得走了，狗肉。

original: Get out of here!
translation: 滚出去！

original: Just watch yourself. I've got an itchy trigger finger.
translation: 你自己小心。我可有个不听话的食指。

original: Adios.
translation: 再会。

original: Please, do what you can to find my brother.
translation: 求你了，尽你所能找到我的兄弟。

original: Good luck in the Museum. Bring me back something and I'll let you get a closer look at the Memorial.
translation: 在博物馆里好运。给我带回点东西的话，我会让你仔细看看纪念堂。

original: I'd better get going.
translation: 我要闪了。

original: Sure. Silas will tell them you're allowed up there.
translation: 当然。西拉斯会告诉他们你可以上来了。

original: So... Can I take a peek at the Memorial now?
translation: 那么……我能现在看看纪念碑吗？

original: Hey, thanks again for doing this for me, it means a lot.
translation: 嗨，再次感谢你为我们做的这些，对我们很重要。

original: Remember, my offer still stands.
translation: 记住，我的提议仍然有效。

original: All right, goodbye.
translation: 好的，再见。

original: Come back to us anytime. The Family considers you a friend.
translation: 随时可以回来。家族把你当成朋友。

original: You are free to roam the common area of our home as our guest.
translation: 你可以作为我们的客人，在我们的公共区域自由行动。

original: Yeah... goodbye.
translation: 嗯……再见。

original: Sure. Go. Just like everyone else.
translation: 当然。去吧。跟其他人一样。

original: I understand. Goodbye.
translation: 我明白。再见。

original: Guess I'll see you around.
translation: 那我们回头见吧。

original: Bye, sweetie!
translation: 再见，甜心！

original: It was good talking to you.
translation: 很高兴和你聊。

original: Just remember I got my eyes on you. We all do.
translation: 别忘了我会一直盯着你。我们都会。

original: Say it ain't so!

translation: 快点回来，我说不定有很多东西要给你看呢。

original: Bye bye!
translation: 再见！

original: Don't be a stranger, it's nice to have company.
translation: 别见外，很高兴你能来访。

original: I'm certain our paths will cross again.
translation: 我肯定很快我们又会不期而遇的。

original: Sigh. Alone again...
translation: 唉。又开始独自一人了……

original: Just get the hell away from me.
translation: 见鬼，离我远点。

original: Oh! Okay. Well, anytime you find yourself back in Megaton, be sure and look me up.
translation: 哦！嗯，好吧，如果你回到兆吨镇，就来找我吧。

original: Sounds good. Come back and visit me sometime.
translation: 听起来不错。随时回来找我。

original: Goodbye. It's always nice to speak to you.
translation: 再见。很高兴和你聊天。

original: What are you staring at me for then?
translation: 你刚才盯着我干嘛？

original: Bye bye now!
translation: 再见！

original: Sure thing, don't let me keep you.
translation: 没错，别让我耽误你。

original: All right, see you later.
translation: 嗯，回头见。

original: I'm sure we'll meet again.
translation: 我觉得我们还会再见面的。

original: Of course, of course! Don't let me keep you!
translation: 当然，当然！别让我耽误你了！

original: Goodbye Outsider, and good luck.
translation: 再见，外来者，祝你好运。

original: Have no fear, Outsider. I know you'll make a wise decision.
translation: 别害怕，外来人。我知道你会做一个明智的决定。

original: Speak to me when you are ready to be purified, but don't keep the Great One waiting.
translation: 当你准备被净化时和我说，但是别让圣贤久等。

original: This way, Outsider. Come along now.
translation: 这边，外来人。继续走。

original: Goodbye, Outsider.
translation: 再见，外来人。

original: I trust we'll speak again, Outsider.
translation: 我相信我们还会再交谈的，外来者。

original: May the Great One bless you.
translation: 愿圣贤保佑你。

original: May the sap of His wisdom sustain you.
translation: 愿祂智慧的汁液滋养你。

original: May your spirit rest in His branches.
translation: 愿你的灵魂在祂的枝间安息。

original: Farewell, Outsider.
translation: 再会，外来者。

original: May you remain under the canopy of His protection.
translation: 愿你始终处在祂的庇护之下。

original: Sure thing.
translation: 当然的。

original: That's a damned shame.
translation: 真他妈可耻。

original: About time. I got better things to do.
translation: 早该如此。我还有其它的事呢。

original: Good. I was tired of this conversation.
translation: 很好。我已经厌烦了这次谈话。

original: Yeah, let's get to the action.
translation: 嗯，让我们行动吧。

original: Let's go.
translation: 走吧。

original: And I shall follow.
translation: 我会跟上你的。

original: Let's go.
translation: 走吧。

original: It is my hope that we will speak again soon.
translation: 我希望我们能再次谈话。

original: Lead on!
translation: 带路！

original: Let's go.
translation: 走吧。

original: Lead the way.
translation: 带路。

original: Let's go.
translation: 走吧。

original: Stay strong, my friend.
translation: 坚强点，我的朋友。

original: Keep your skills sharp and your eyes peeled, alright?
translation: 让你的技术变得熟练，眼睛保持敏锐，行吗？

original: Until we meet again, keep yourself alive out there!
translation: 在我们再次见面之前，你都要活着！

original: Good luck out there. And maybe next time, you'll find something interesting for me, huh?
translation: 祝你好运。或许下次，你会给我带来有意思的东西，呃？

original: See you out on the road, huh?
translation: 路上小心，呃？

original: Stay safe on the path you travel.
translation: 旅途小心。

original: Walk well, friend.
translation: 走好，朋友。

original: See you next time you need that special little something.
translation: 等你下次需要些特殊的小东西时再见吧。

original: Cheers, pal. Watch yourself out there.
translation: 干杯，朋友。出外小心。

original: We're not waiting here for long.
translation: 我们不会在这久等的。

original: Wait here. I'll be right back.
translation: 在这等着。我很快就回来。

original: If you're not back soon, we're outta here!
translation: 如果你不尽快回来，我们就闪了！

original: Wait here until I get back.
translation: 在这等着直到我回来。

original: I'm not sure I like that idea. If you're not back soon, I'm leaving.
translation: 我好像不太喜欢这主意。如果你不赶快回来，我就离开。

original: Wait here. I'll be right back.
translation: 在这等着。我很快就回来。

original: I'm not waiting here for long.
translation: 我不会在这久等的。

original: Wait here until I get back.
translation: 在这等着直到我回来。

original: Good, good. I'll know when you've completed your task. At that point, we can begin rebuilding this shattered world. Good luck.
translation: 很好，很好。当你完成任务的时候我会知道。那时，我们就能开始重建这破碎的世界了。祝你好运。

original: I'll be heading out now.
translation: 现在我要出去了。

original: Yes, please do.
translation: 好的，请。

original: I'll go pick up that vial now.
translation: 我去找那个试剂瓶。

original: Find human time.
translation: 寻人时刻。

original: I leave now.
translation: 我现在走了。

original: I hate this place.
translation: 我恨这地方。

original: Bored, bored, bored.
translation: 无聊，无聊，无聊。

original: Must go find human.
translation: 必须找到人类。

original: Need more meat. I go now.
translation: 需要更多的肉。我现在去了。

original: I'm leaving now.
translation: 我现在就走。

original: Patrol not fun.
translation: 没意思的巡逻。

original: Hungry I go find food.
translation: 饿了，我要找食物。

original: Back to work!
translation: 回去工作！

original: Yessir, Mr. Moriarty. More drunk customers, coming up!
translation: 遵命，莫里亚蒂先生。好多喝醉的顾客，来吧！

original: Go!
translation: 出发！

original: Jesus give me strength...
translation: 耶稣啊，给我点耐心吧……

original: Okay, son. Okay.
translation: 好，孩子。好。

original: I know, I know, sweetheart. Now you run along, okay? Billy's got some thinkin' to do.
translation: 我知道，我知道，甜心。那你就去吧，好不？比利有些事要思考。

original: Hey, would you look at the time! Sorry sweetheart, I've got, um... somethin' to do...
translation: 嗨，你看看时间！抱歉，甜心，我需要，哦……去做一些事……

original: It's why you love me, Nova dear.
translation: 所以你才爱我不是吗，亲爱的诺瓦。

original: Awww... No one loves you more, sweet lass. And don't you ever think any differently. Now quit yammering and get back to doing what you do, hmmm?
translation: 哎……没人比我更疼你了，傻姑娘。你可千万别胡思乱想。快别唠叨了，回去干活吧，嗯？

original: Well then. Until next time.
translation: 好吧。下次见。

original: He he. You know, dad, for a sheriff, you're kind of a goofball.
translation: 呵呵。你知道，爸爸，作为一个警长，你是一个笨蛋。

original: Heh, yeah, well... If that's what you need to tell yourself, go for it. He he he he.
translation: 嗨，嗯，好吧……如果你想亲自和他谈，那就去吧。呵呵呵呵。

original: Yeah, we'll see. I'd just watch your fucking step around here, pal. There's a lot of ways to have an accident. Now... you have yourself a good day.
translation: 嗯，我们走着瞧。我觉得你在这应该小心，朋友。有很多种可能会发生意外。现在……祝你过上愉快的一天吧。

original: Good answer. Now, fuck off.
translation: 答得好。现在滚吧。

original: I'm watching you, outsider. You try anything, and I'll be there.
translation: 我看着你呢，外来人。你做什么，我都知道。

original: Ha! I'm just fuckin' with you! Ha ha ha! I got you good! Now go... before you make me mad.
translation: 哈！我和你开他妈玩笑呢！哈哈哈！中计了吧！快走吧……省得把我逼疯。

original: You got it, buddy.
translation: 你说中了，伙计。

original: You're the best, Billy!
translation: 你是最好的，比利！

original: Thank you, Billy. I just... thanks.
translation: 谢谢，比利。我只是……谢谢。

original: You're quite welcome, Nathan dear.
translation: 你很受欢迎，亲爱的内森。

original: You're welcome, you testy old fool. I swear, Nathan, one of these days you're going to give yourself a heart attack, just like Doc Church said....
translation: 欢迎，你这暴躁的老混蛋。我发誓，内森，总有一天你会突发心脏病，就像丘奇医生说的那样……

original: Yeah, Yeah...
translation: 行，行……

original: Okay, okay, I know, I know...
translation: 好的，好的，我知道，我知道……

original: Well... damn it. I ain't about to go out lookin' for one myself! Ah well... you have a good one, Moira.
translation: 嗯……该死。我可不想自己去找！啊，哦……你厉害，莫伊拉。

original: Ah, damn. Oh well. Thanks, Moira.
translation: 啊，该死。噢，好吧。谢谢，莫伊拉。

original: God, you can be such an asshole sometimes, Colin. Don't worry, the "princess" will serve her king. Happy now?
translation: 天啊，你有时真像一个混蛋，科林。放心，“公主”会伺候她的国王的。满意了吧？

original: I hear you, all right? Loud and clear. I'll make daddy proud.
translation: 我听明白了，行吧？清清楚楚。我会让“老爹”脸上有光的。

original: I'll talk to you later, hon.
translation: 回头再聊，亲爱的。

original: Okay, Gobbie. Bye.
translation: 嗯，盖博。再见。

original: Please don't make it any harder than it has to be, Jericho.
translation: 别把简单的复杂化，耶利哥。

original: I'll tell you what, I'll give you an extra ten minutes next time. On me. Just don't let Colin know...
translation: 我告诉你，下次多给你十分钟。我请客。但是别让科林知道……

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: Roger that.
translation: 收到。

original: All right.
translation: 好的。

original: Oh, anytime.
translation: 哦，随时。

original: Come back later. I mean, don't come back later. See if I care.
translation: 回头见。我的意思，回头别见。我不在乎。

original: Later, spooky girl.
translation: 回见，小妞。

original: Watch out for Muties and Raiders.
translation: 小心变种人和歹徒。

original: I'll let you and gun have some alone time...
translation: 我还是让你和枪独处吧……

original: Give me liberty, or give me death!
translation: 给我自由，要不给我死亡！

original: I only regret that I have but one life to lose for my country!
translation: 我只是惋惜，我只有一条命献给我的国家！

original: There never was a good war or a bad peace.
translation: 从未有过善良的战争或糟糕的和平。

original: I've not yet begun to fight!
translation: 我还没开始战斗！

original: I'm right behind you.
translation: 我跟着你。

original: Let's get going.
translation: 我们走。

original: Rivet City here we come!
translation: 铆钉城，我们来了！

original: Let's get going.
translation: 我们走。

original: Keep your eyes on the mission, and off my ass please.
translation: 你给我盯紧任务，而不是我的屁股。

original: Let's get going.
translation: 我们走。

original: I'm ready. Lead on.
translation: 我准备好了。带路吧。

original: Let's get going.
translation: 我们走。

original: Just watch yourself, 'cause I'm not dragging your corpse back to Rivet City.
translation: 你自己小心。因为我不会把你的尸体拖回铆钉城。

original: Let's get going.
translation: 我们走。

original: I am getting so drunk when we get paid for this.
translation: 等他们了报酬，我要喝个烂醉。

original: Let's get going.
translation: 我们走。

original: Stay focused and we may just get through this.
translation: 集中注意力，我们就有可能成功。

original: Let's get going.
translation: 我们走。

original: Come on, less gawking and more walking.
translation: 来吧，别待在那，继续走。

original: Let's get going.
translation: 我们走。

original: I got your back.
translation: 我来断后。

original: Let's get going.
translation: 我们走。

original: No Ranger will leave here alive!
translation: 没有一个游骑兵能活着离开这！

original: The roof will run red with their blood!
translation: 楼顶会被他们的血洗成红色！

original: Attack come soon. Wait 'til then.
translation: 攻击就要来了。等到那时。

original: I'll crush the Rangers with my bare hands!
translation: 我会用空手击溃那些游骑兵！

original: Soon it will be our time.
translation: 很快该我们上场了。

original: Ha ha ha ha ha.
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈。

original: Keep eye open for more.
translation: 时刻提防。

original: Sure enough.
translation: 那当然。

original: Yep, no problem.
translation: 是的，没问题。

original: Kick ass.
translation: 混蛋。

original: No sweat.
translation: 没什么。

original: Watch your ass, kid.
translation: 小心你的屁股，孩子。

original: Don't worry. Me 'n Eugene's got your back.
translation: 别担心。我和尤金护着你的后面。

original: Watch yourself... I don't wanna lose another man.
translation: 你自己小心……我不想再失去另一个兄弟了。

original: Stay frosty.
translation: 冷静。

original: Let's get a move on.
translation: 我们赶快走吧。

original: Get that fission battery then double time it back here!
translation: 拿到把那核裂变电池，然后跑回来！

original: Watch yourself, those ruins are bad ass.
translation: 照顾好自己，那些废墟对人有害。

original: Take it easy... I don't want to lose you too.
translation: 放松……我也不想失去你。

original: Careful out there.
translation: 在外面小心点。

original: The Citadel is our only chance now. We have to make it there.
translation: 五角大本营是我们现在唯一的机会。我们必须去那。

original: I am sorry to be causing problems.
translation: 我很抱歉引起了麻烦。

original: I am sorry to be causing problems.
translation: 我很抱歉引起了麻烦。

original: We must keep moving.
translation: 我们必须继续前进。

original: I really don't want to die down here.
translation: 我真的不想死在这。

original: Be careful.
translation: 当心！

original: Then leave. We'll do just fine without you.
translation: 那就滚开。我们没有你一样能做好。

original: I don't have time to deal with this.
translation: 我没时间处理。

original: Well, then, get going! I'm busy plotting!
translation: 好吧，那走吧！我在忙着想办法！

original: At last, I can be done with your distracting prattle.
translation: 我也终于忍受完了你的胡说八道。

original: Stay wary, citizen. And keep your laser handy!
translation: 小心，公民。拿稳你手里的激光枪！

original: Stay safe, brave citizen.
translation: 注意安全，勇敢的公民。

original: Good luck with those two troublemakers.
translation: 祝那两个麻烦制造者好运。

original: Say hi to the Mechanist for me!
translation: 代我向机械侠问好！

original: You never any fun.
translation: 你一点都没意思。

original: Ah, nevermind! Talk with you is... stupid.
translation: 啊，算了！和你说话真是……太蠢了。

original: Ah, I'm done talkin' to you anyway.
translation: 啊，我对你无话可说了。

original: Bah! I'm gonna go back to doin'... what I was doin'...
translation: 呸！我要回去做……我本该做的事……

original: Forget it! You too dumb to talk to.
translation: 算了吧！我不要和你这样的笨蛋说话了。

original: Watch yourself out there.
translation: 在外面注意自己。

original: Good hunting out there.
translation: 打猎愉快。

original: Stay sharp.
translation: 保持警惕。

original: Sure, fine. Get going.
translation: 当然，很好。行动。

original: Okay, I'm leaving.
translation: 好的，我走了。

original: Get a move on.
translation: 赶快。

original: I'll be leaving, now.
translation: 我现在就走。

original: Then get moving.
translation: 那快点。

original: I'll just be on my way, then.
translation: 我待会就走。

original: You're welcome back anytime. The Brotherhood never forgets its allies.
translation: 随时欢迎你回来。兄弟会绝不会忘了它的盟友。

original: Just stay out of our way and everything will be fine.
translation: 别给我们添乱，那样一切都会好。

original: Drop back in anytime, pal. We could use the company!
translation: 随时可以回来，朋友。我们一直是伙伴！

original: Okay. Just make sure not to interfere with our operations.
translation: 好的。只要保证不干扰我们的行动。

original: Be careful out there.
translation: 在外面要小心。

original: Suit yourself.
translation: 听你的。

original: Anytime you need a place to crash, duck in here. Be glad to provide.
translation: 无论何时你想找地方睡觉，就来这。我们很高兴为你服务。

original: Right on, right on. Keep your radio tuned to GNR for the real gospel.
translation: 好极了，好极了。想听真福音就把你的电台调到银河新闻台。

original: This is pointless.
translation: 这没有任何意义。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: I hope next time I see you, the Declaration will be in hand.
translation: 我希望下次见到你，那时我已经拿到那宣言了。

original: Remember, treat the document with care. It's a fragile piece of our history.
translation: 记住，要小心对待文件。那是我们历史的一片脆弱的记录。

original: Be careful, the Archives are infested with who knows what.
translation: 小心，档案馆充满了未知。

original: Remember, donations are always welcome.
translation: 记住，随时欢迎捐赠。

original: Remember, bring me back anything interesting you find.
translation: 记住，给我带回你找到的任何有趣的东西。

original: Very well, be careful out there.
translation: 很好，出门小心。

original: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

original: Bye, Timmy.
translation: 再见，提米。

original: Keep your head low.
translation: 保持低调。

original: Right. I'm out of here.
translation: 好的，我走了。

original: You watch out for 'guai! They're all over!
translation: 你要小心妖怪！它们到处都是！

original: We'll see y'all real soon!
translation: 我们不久就能看到你们了！

original: Y'all come back now, y'hea'?
translation: 你们都会回来的，对吧？

original: Yes! They're all dead! And I have the keys. The keys to the...are you still here? Get lost. I have a trip to plan.
translation: 嗯！他们都死了！我得到了钥匙。这钥匙是开……你在听吗？滚。我还要安排旅行。

original: Finally, I have the keys. Your job is done and you've been paid, so move along. I have a trip to plan.
translation: 最后，我得到了钥匙。你的活已经干完并且得到了报酬，走吧。我还要安排旅行。

original: Well, they may not all be dead, but I have the keys. I should have hired a better mercenary. Run along. I have a trip to plan.
translation: 好吧，他们或许没都死，但我还是得到钥匙了。我应该雇个更好的佣兵。走开。我还要安排旅行。

original: I hate you!
translation: 我恨你！

original: See you, fatty.
translation: 再见，胖子。

original: You, too. Thanks again for your help.
translation: 还有你。再次感谢你的帮助。

original: Take care, Amata.
translation: 保重，阿玛塔。

original: You've got to help me.
translation: 你一定要帮我。

original: Bye, Amata.
translation: 再见，阿玛塔。

original: Much later! Tunnel Snakes rule!
translation: 太迟了！穴蛇帮主宰一切！

original: Later, Paul.
translation: 回见，保罗。

original: Get out of here, kid.
translation: 从这滚出去，小子。

original: Bye, Wally.
translation: 再见，瓦利。

original: Regulate.
translation: 调节。

original: Do not let this world taint you.
translation: 不要让这世界腐蚀你。

original: Stay righteous.
translation: 维持你的正义心肠。

original: Hard work pays off!
translation: 有劳必有得！

original: Do good work out there, we're counting on you!
translation: 加油干，我们可是指望你了！

original: Come back anytime!
translation: 随时回来！

original: All right. We better get back to it. Be careful.
translation: 好吧。我们最好接着干。小心。

original: Yeah. Give me a shout if you see anything.
translation: 对。如果看到什么就喊我一声。

original: I guess it's back to roach patrol.
translation: 我猜它回到灭蟑队去了。

original: I am holding still. It's your old, palsied hands that are shaking.
translation: 不是我在动，是你老得中风的手在颤抖。

original: Don't blame me for your incompetence. Why, I remember George used to have the lightest touch. Those were the days...
translation: 别因为你的无能而怪责我。噢，我记得乔治当时多么的轻柔。那时候啊……

original: I don't believe you. I expect we'll be here for hours.
translation: 我不相信你。我猜我们在这都几个小时了。

original: Ouch! Do you have any idea what you're doing back there?
translation: 噢！你知道自己刚才在那里做什么吗？

original: That is not the servo-motor switch. To the left... left, I said!
translation: 这不是伺服电机开关。在左边……左边，我说！

original: I think you just made it worse. Should I do this myself?
translation: 我觉得你让它变得更糟了。要我亲自来吗？

original: I think I'd rather just stay broken than submit to any further indignity.
translation: 我觉得我什么都不做，也比受到更多的侮辱强。

original: Good luck. I need to take a look at poor Andy over here. His old gears just aren't up to this kind of excitement.
translation: 祝你好运。我需要看看可怜的安迪。他的旧装备经不起这种折腾。

original: I've got to get going.
translation: 我必须要走了。

original: You take care of yourself now.
translation: 你现在要照顾好自己了。

original: I need to get going.
translation: 我得走了。

original: Oh... okay. Thank you, Stevie. It's so dark...
translation: 哦……好的，谢谢，史蒂夫。太黑了……

original: I have big plans for Hannibal when I get my hands on him.
translation: 当我抓到汉尼拔，我准备了许多花样。

original: I should go.
translation: 我该走了。

original: Don't let me stop you.
translation: 别让我阻止你。

original: Don't be a stranger.
translation: 别疏远了。

original: I should go.
translation: 我该走了。

original: Take care of yourself.
translation: 照顾好自己。

original: Thanks. Bye.
translation: 谢谢。再见。

original: Yes, ma'am.
translation: 是的，女士。

original: Well, I've heard enough.
translation: 嗯，我已经听够了。

original: Yes, sir.
translation: 是的，长官。

original: Well, I've heard enough.
translation: 嗯，我已经听够了。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: May the spirit of the great Lincoln protect you.
translation: 伟大的林肯之灵会保佑你。

original: Thank you, Hannibal. I'd better get going.
translation: 谢谢你，汉尼拔。我还是走吧。

original: <grunt> Right.
translation: <嘟囔>对。

original: I should get going.
translation: 我应该走了。

original: Nothing but gray rocks. Just a lot of gray rocks...
translation: 除了灰岩什么也没有。就是有很多灰岩……

original: Yeah. Get me a thousand rounds of 5.56. You're a useless puke, Bill. Get away from me.
translation: 嗯。给我1000发5.56子弹。你这没用的垃圾，比尔。离我远点。

original: I don't know, Caleb. Ammo is tight. I shouldn't use it up like that.
translation: 我不知道，卡勒布。弹药很紧张。我不该那样挥霍。

original: Hmph. I suppose that little shit isn't totally useless. I'll grab it before I turn in tonight.
translation: 哼。我想这小狗屎不是完全没用的。我会在晚上睡觉前抓到它的。

original: I've been reading about Abraham Lincoln. He was a very great man, Bill. A very great man.
translation: 我已经拜读了林肯的事迹，他是个非常伟大的人，比尔。一个非常伟大的人。

original: I don't think that would be a good idea, Caleb. How about we talk about it tomorrow morning? Maybe during your lesson.
translation: 我不认为那是个好主意，卡勒布。我们明天早上再讨论，怎么样？或者在你上课的时候。

original: Just the ones I already gave him. There might be some in the museum though.
translation: 就是给他的那些。不过，或许博物馆里还有些。

original: I hate guns. Besides, the pen is mightier than the sword. Or the assault rifle.
translation: 我恨枪。而且，笔比剑更有力量。当然还包括突击步枪。

original: Bless you, ma'am.
translation: 祝福你，女士。

original: Bless you, sir.
translation: 祝福你，先生。

original: It's good of you to say so, miss Alejandra.
translation: 你说的真不错，亚历山德拉小姐。

original: Terribly sorry, sir. It's what we got the most of. I can try frying it instead of boiling it if you like.
translation: 非常抱歉，先生。通常我们都是这样做的。当然如果你喜欢，我可以油炸而不是水煮。

original: Yes, sir. Right away, sir.
translation: 是的，先生。立刻。

original: Yes, ma'am. Begging your pardon, ma'am.
translation: 是的，女士。请原谅。

original: I've got work to do.
translation: 我还有事要去做。

original: I should let you get back to work. Goodbye.
translation: 我应该让你回去工作。再见。

original: When I get time. Maybe once or twice a week. I'll try to do better.
translation: 当我有时间的时候。或许每周一到两次。我会试着做得更好。

original: I need more steel rods. At least as long as your arm. I'll take as many of them as you can find, and don't mind the rust.
translation: 我需要更多的钢棍。至少跟你胳膊一样长。我会买下所有你找到的钢棍，生锈的也行。

original: Sure thing, Hannibal.
translation: 当然，汉尼拔。

original: Thank you, Simone. I just wish the words were going as well.
translation: 谢谢，西蒙妮。我只希望消息已经传出去了。

original: Good luck against those Super Mutants.
translation: 祝你对付超级变种人时好运。

original: Well, I should get started. Goodbye.
translation: 嗯，我应该动身了。再见。

original: I hope we can make it to the Memorial by sundown.
translation: 我希望我们日落时能到纪念堂。

original: So long.
translation: 再见。

original: I don't think so. Don't worry. We're well armed, and soon we'll have a new home, safe from them.
translation: 我不这样认为。别担心。我们武装到了牙齿，而且我们就要有新家了，不用害怕他们的威胁了。

original: Simone and I will go hunting soon. Probably tomorrow.
translation: 西蒙妮和我很快要去狩猎。说不定是明天。

original: Don't worry, Caleb. Alejandra will find a reference for you. Once we are in our new home, maybe we'll find something there.
translation: 别担心，卡勒布……亚历山德拉会为你找一份证明的。一旦我们到了新家，或许我们会在那找到些东西。

original: Next time don't waste the ammo. Wait for it to get closer.
translation: 下次别浪费弹药。等它靠近了再开火。

original: Remember that the Department of Tourist Rights only guarantees your safety for 24 hours. After that time, you will be executed.
translation: 记住旅游者权益部门只能保护你二十四小时。之后，就要靠你自己了。

original: Goodbye, Mister President.
translation: 再见，总统先生。

original: Very well. Goodbye, Ambassador.
translation: 很好。再见，大使。

original: I'm going to go tour the Republic.
translation: 我要去共和国旅行了。

original: You are safe here so long as you obey me, refugee.
translation: 只有服从我，你在能在这得到安全，难民。

original: I'm going to go tour the Republic.
translation: 我要去共和国旅行了。

original: All spies say that.
translation: 间谍都是那一套。

original: I think I'll just be going.
translation: 我想我要走了。

original: Ah well... two steps back, one forward as they say!
translation: 好吧……后退两步，向前一步，如他们所说！

original: Now, let's see. Where did I go wrong...
translation: 现在，让我想想。我哪做错了……

original: Let's see... genetic sequence A28. Yes, this will be the one...
translation: 让我想想……遗传序列A28。是的，就是这……

original: Finally, a chance to recant my mistake! How marvelous!
translation: 终于，有了改正错误的机会！太好了！

original: Much to do... so much to do...
translation: 好多事要做……那么多事要做……

original: Be ever vigilant... those from the genus Solenopsis are not to be trifled with.
translation: 时刻警惕……那些火蚂蚁可不是好玩的。

original: I have important calculations to attend to. Good day.
translation: 我有个重要的计算需要处理，再见。

original: This work is quite delicate... please leave me to it.
translation: 这工作要做得十分细致……请让我安心工作。

original: I would ask if you'd keep the interruptions to a minimum.
translation: 请你把干扰降到最低。

original: {Shooting Noise} I wish I was tough like you!
translation: {开枪声}我希望我像你一样结实！

original: I wish you could stay here with me in Grayditch.
translation: 我希望你能和我留在格雷蒂奇这。

original: You're pretty swell for a grownup!
translation: 对于一个大人来说你还不错！

original: Stomp those stupid Ants!
translation: 踩死那些蠢蚂蚁！

original: Kill those ants dead!
translation: 杀死那些蚂蚁！

original: Now I can never go home!
translation: 现在我永远不能回家了！

original: If you look around enough in Grayditch you might find some useful stuff people left behind.
translation: 如果你在格雷蒂奇仔细搜索，就会发现一些别人留下的有用东西。

original: Please be careful, I don't want you to die either.
translation: 小心，我不想你也死了。

original: Sigh. I just wish things would go back to how they used to be.
translation: 唉。我只希望回到像过去那样。

original: Be careful or those things might getcha.
translation: 小心，那些东西会抓到你的。

original: Goodbye. Take care of yourself.
translation: 再见。你自己保重。

original: Goodbye, Rosie.
translation: 再见，萝丝。

original: Stay away from Dave. He's mine.
translation: 离戴夫远点。他是我的。

original: See you, Jessica.
translation: 再见，杰西卡。

original: You're safe as long as Dave says so.
translation: 戴夫说你安全，你便是安全的。

original: See you, Jessica.
translation: 再见，杰西卡。

original: Come back and visit the museum anytime!
translation: 随时欢迎回博物馆。

original: I'll leave you to the kids.
translation: 我还是让你和孩子们在一起吧。

original: Just don't bother me. I've got stuff to do for Dave.
translation: 别烦我。我正在为戴夫做事。

original: Later, Bob.
translation: 回见，鲍勃。

original: I have to go practice my Dave impression, anyway.
translation: 无论如何，我都得让戴夫对我有所印象。

original: Talk to you later, kid.

original: Feel free to lay your troubles at my doorstep. Just bring some caps with you when you do.

original: Drink until she's pretty! Ha Ha Ha Ha! Sorry... Ghoul joke. I guess you wouldn't get it.

original: You come back real soon now!
translation: 尽快回来噢！

original: You're not bad... for a human.
translation: 作为一个人类……你还不坏。

original: Don't let these people get to you.
translation: 别让那些人抓到你。

translation: 关闭对话系统。

original: Come back soon! ...please.
translation: 迟点见！……一定噢。

original: Let me know if you need something.
translation: 缺什么就告诉我。

original: Please! I must have that violin!

original: I'm getting so excited I could scream!

original: Watch yourself out there!

original: Be careful, I don't want to be responsible for getting you killed.

translation: 旅途愉快。

original: Rays shower you, child.
translation: 愿阳光照耀你，孩子。

original: Try to be careful.
translation: 多加小心。

original: Yeah. Bye.
translation: 嗯，再见。

original: Try not to hurt yourself.
translation: 别让自己受伤。

original: See you soon!
translation: 再见！

original: Goodbye, Gob.
translation: 再见，盖博。

original: Come back soon.
translation: 迟点见。

original: Goodbye, Gob.
translation: 再见，盖博。

original: Don't hit me!
translation: 别打我！

original: Goodbye, Gob.
translation: 再见，盖博。

original: Sorry!
translation: 对不起！

original: Good luck finding your dad.
translation: 祝你找到你的父亲。

original: Come back if you need something.
translation: 如果你需要什么就回来吧。

original: Have a good one, stranger.
translation: 再见，陌生人。

original: Remember us if you need something!
translation: 如果有需要的话可以找我们！

original: Are we finished now? Good.
translation: 我们结束了吗？很好。

original: Yeah, whatever.
translation: 好，随便。

original: Whatever you say, kid.
translation: 不管你说什么，孩子。

original: See ya!
translation: 回见！

original: Come back soon!
translation: 迟点见！

original: Remember: I'll buy whatever you're selling!
translation: 记住：你卖什么我都收！

original: Talk to you later, buddy.
translation: 回头再聊，老兄。

original: Anytime.
translation: 随时。

original: See you soon!
translation: 再见！

original: Have a good one.
translation: 祝你过得愉快。

original: Carry on.
translation: 继续。

original: Mind your manners, now.
translation: 注意礼貌。

original: See y'all later.
translation: 回头见。

original: Bye, mister!
translation: 再见，先生！

original: Bye, lady!
translation: 再见，女士！

original: Come back if you need something, honey.
translation: 如果你需要的话就回来，亲爱的。

original: It's been nice.
translation: 不错。

original: Send Nathan home if you see him.
translation: 如果你看到内森，喊他回家。

original: Walk in the Glow.
translation: 旅途愉快。

original: Atom's light be with you, sweet child.
translation: 原子的光辉与你同在，可爱的孩子。

original: Farewell, sweet child.
translation: 回见，可爱的孩子。

original: Take care.
translation: 保重。

original: God bless The Enclave.
translation: 上帝保佑英克雷。

original: Take care of yourself, hon.
translation: 你自己保重，亲爱的。

original: Gotcha.
translation: 知道了。

original: Well, back to work.
translation: 好吧，回去工作。

original: Yeah.
translation: 嗯。

original: Later.
translation: 回见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I'll expect to see you in class, Freddie. No excuses. Run along now, son.
translation: 我等你来上课哦，弗雷迪。别找借口。现在走开，孩子。

original: Whatever you say, Mr. Brotch.
translation: 随便吧，布洛彻先生。

original: Idle Chatter
translation: 闲聊

original: Don't get me wrong, I love to cause trouble, but you go too far.
translation: 别误会，我确实喜欢惹麻烦，但是你太夸张了。

original: So boring...
translation: 真无聊……

original: No green stuff here...
translation: 这没有绿玩意……

original: Getting hungry...
translation: 好饿……

original: Wish a buckethead would show up... I'd rip his legs clean off...
translation: 希望一个水桶脑袋能出现……我要连根扯下他的腿……

original: <bored grunt>
translation: <无聊嘟囔>

original: You've changed. I mean, bad is one thing. Evil is another.
translation: 你已经变了。我的意思，坏是一回事。邪恶是另一回事。

original: Did you really have to kill all of those people back there? They didn't seem so bad.
translation: 你真的要回去杀光那里的所有人？他们看起来并不坏。

original: I always knew that you were a teacher's pet.
translation: 我一直知道你是老师的最爱。

original: This do-gooder crap is for the birds.
translation: 这些不切实际的大道理只能骗骗小孩。

original: Man, you're just a little goody two-shoes, aren't you?
translation: 哥们，你真是个伪君子，不是吗？

original: I need some shades or something...
translation: 我需要找个太阳镜之类的……

original: It's so bright out here.
translation: 外面可真亮。

original: Let's get inside. I hate it out here.
translation: 让我们进去。我讨厌在外面。

original: Man. That creeps me out. That thing up there. You know, the sky.
translation: 哥们。那真叫我心颤。上面那，你知道，天空。

original: You're not gonna leave me here, are you?
translation: 你不会把我扔在这的，对吧？

original: Let's head to that place in Rivet City for a drink.
translation: 我们去铆钉城喝点。

original: Being sober really sucks.
translation: 清醒真无聊。

original: Can we rest or something?
translation: 我们能休息一下吗？

original: <coughs> How do people breathe out here?
translation: <咳嗽>人在这外面要怎么呼吸？

original: Man, I'm all itchy.
translation: 哥们，我浑身都痒。

original: What if someone's following us?
translation: 有人跟着我们怎么办？

original: Do you even know where you're going?
translation: 你知道你要去哪吗？

original: Are you going the right way?
translation: 你走的路对吗？

original: This place gives me the creeps.
translation: 这地方真诡异。

original: Whew. Man, it stinks.
translation: 哟。哥们，真臭。

original: I heard that there were dragons out here. You ever see one?
translation: 我听说外面有龙。你见过没？

original: You wanna get out of here?
translation: 你想从这出去？

original: What was that noise?
translation: 那是什么声音？

original: Hey! Did you hear that?
translation: 嗨！你听到了吗？

original: Bo-ring.
translation: 无 — 聊。

original: Man, it stinks. The vault never smelled like this.
translation: 哥们，真臭。避难所从没臭成这样。

original: Be careful.
translation: 当心！

original: This place is not safe.
translation: 这地方不安全。

original: There may be danger here.
translation: 这里或许有危险。

original: <grumbles>
translation: <抱怨>

original: <grumbles>
translation: <抱怨>

original: Be cautious.
translation: 小心。

original: Aww, aren't you cute?
translation: 啊，你真可爱。

original: Can I have a better gun?
translation: 能给我把更好的枪吗？

original: <yawns>
translation: <哈欠>

original: I wonder what Eulogy is doing...
translation: 不知道尤勒基在干嘛……

original: This place sucks.
translation: 这地方糟透了。

original: I'm bored.
translation: 我很无聊。

original: There's not a lot of cash in bein' good, you know.
translation: 做好人来钱慢，你要知道。

original: I didn't sign on with you so that we could be playing Santa Claus out here.
translation: 我可没和你签约出去扮演圣诞老人。

original: What's goin' on here, kid? I thought you were some sort of badass.
translation: 怎么了，孩子？我还以为你是个喜欢来事的人。

original: Goddamn cigarettes are getting' harder to find.
translation: 该死的香烟，真他妈难找。

original: What... what's happening?
translation: 什么……发生什么了？

original: Why's everything all blurry?
translation: 为什么所有东西都模糊不清？

original: Whoa... what's going on?
translation: 哇……怎么了？

original: Man... am I out of smokes again?
translation: 不是吧……我又没烟抽了吗？

original: I could use a smoke.
translation: 我想抽支烟。

original: Hang on... just need to catch my breath...
translation: 等等……让我喘口气……

original: Goddamn collar on this armor is too tight...
translation: 妈的，装甲的领子太紧了……

original: <coughs>
translation: <咳嗽>

original: <coughs>
translation: <咳嗽>

original: <coughs> ...is that blood?
translation: <咳嗽>……那是血吗？

original: <coughs> Dammit...
translation: <咳嗽>妈的……

original: I forgot how fucked up everything was out here.
translation: 我都忘了外面的情况有多糟糕。

original: Man, I'm glad to finally be away from Megaton.
translation: 哥们，我很高兴终于能离开兆吨镇了。

original: It's good to be out here again. Damn good.
translation: 很高兴我又出来了。真他妈的爽。

original: Hey! I found a... dammit. Never mind. It wasn't anything.
translation: 嗨！我发现一个……该死的。别在意。什么都没有。

original: C'mon. Let's get moving.
translation: 快点。让我们走吧。

original: What the...? Did I step in something?
translation: 怎么……？我刚才踩到什么东西？

original: Thought I heard something...
translation: 我好像听到了什么...

original: I think I've been here before.
translation: 我觉得我以前来过这。

original: Too much open space out here. I don't like it.
translation: 这的开阔地太多了。我不喜欢。

original: Up there. That's a good fuckin' spot for a sniper. Keep an eye out.
translation: 上去。那对于一个狙击手来说真是他妈的好位置。保持警惕。

original: I hope this place stays standin' long enough for us to leave.
translation: 我希望这地方能一直让我们待到离开。

original: This floor don't look stable.
translation: 这地板看起来不怎么稳。

original: Man, it stinks in here.
translation: 哦，真臭。

original: It saddens me to see you behaving in this manner, my friend.
translation: 看到你这样做我感到很难过，我的朋友。

original: The path of right action is the way of truth. Perhaps you need a reminder of this.
translation: 正确的抉择才是真理之路。或许你需要这提醒。

original: You have strayed from your path, my friend.
translation: 你已经误入歧途了，我的朋友。

original: There is reason to be cautious here.
translation: 在这里应该小心点。

original: Be aware of our surroundings.
translation: 注意我们周围。

original: Though we may seem safe for the moment, it is fleeting.
translation: 我们现在安全了，但这只是暂时的。

original: There is safety in mindfulness.
translation: 小心就能安全。

original: Be aware of the present moment.
translation: 现在要小心。

original: We should be mindful.
translation: 我们应该多加小心。

original: In all things, the calm heart must prevail.
translation: 真理是，清醒的头脑必将带来胜利。

original: I'm here, at your back.
translation: 我在这，你的背后。

original: Careful...
translation: 小心……

original: Our steps must be measured.
translation: 我们的步伐必须放缓。

original: The air smells... dangerous.
translation: 空气中弥漫着……危险。

original: There are times that I feel the primal part of me pulling me away.
translation: 很多次我都感到，是我的本能在驱使我前进。

original: We must walk softly.
translation: 我们必须轻声走。

original: It's amazing that people trust you enough not to attack me.
translation: 令人诧异的是人们足够信任你而不攻击我。

original: I'm concerned about this area.
translation: 这地方让我很紧张。

original: Sir, searching for targets.
translation: 正在搜寻目标，长官。

original: Scanning, sir...
translation: 扫描中，长官……

original: Sir, I am on the lookout.
translation: 长官，我正密切留意。

original: Your actions have become disturbing to me.
translation: 你的行动干扰到我了。

original: This is a dangerous game that you play.
translation: 你玩的游戏很危险。

original: We all stray from our path from time to time. I trust that you will return to yours. Soon.
translation: 我们任何人都可能误入歧途。我相信你不久就能找回自己的路。

original: Make no mistake. Your father would be proud of what you've done.
translation: 洁白无暇。你父亲会为你所做的感到骄傲。

original: Your father would be proud of you.
translation: 你的父亲会以你为荣。

original: You are a credit to your father.
translation: 你的父亲会为你感到光荣。

original: You're on point. I shall back you up.
translation: 你到位了。我会支援你。

original: Watch for signs of trouble.
translation: 警惕危险的信号。

original: Helping the people of the Wasteland is of the utmost to the Lyons Doctrine.
translation: 帮助废土的人们是“里昂斯的骄傲”信条的基石。

original: I've been here before...
translation: 我以前来过这……

original: I remember this area.
translation: 我记得这地方。

original: There may be hostiles in the area.
translation: 这地方弥漫着敌意。

original: Caution is advised.
translation: 谨慎是明智的。

original: Is this relevant to the mission?
translation: 这跟任务有关吗？

original: Vigilance is advised.
translation: 警惕是明智的。

original: Be vigilant.
translation: 警惕点。

original: Huh?
translation: 哈？

original: Rusty old pipe! A fresh coat of paint is just what you need!
translation: 陈旧的锈水管！重新喷漆正是你所需要的！

original: That should just about do it.
translation: 该做了。

original: Let's go people. The Overseer's patience is... limited.
translation: 我们走吧。监督者的耐心是……有限的。

original: There are no dishes in this house. Please go out and purchase more.
translation: 这屋里没有盘子。请出去多买点吧。

original: Laundry is dirty and unfolded. Please purchase a washing machine and ironing board.
translation: 洗衣是个又脏又乱的活。请购买一个洗衣机和一个熨衣板。

original: Floors need sweeping. Please purchase broom and vacuum cleaner accessories.
translation: 地板需要清洁。请购买扫帚和真空吸尘器。

original: Damn, machine. Stop floating there and get moving!
translation: 该死，机器人。不要飘在那，走开！

original: This robot is broken, all right. Damned if I know what to do about it...
translation: 机器人坏了，好吧。该死，要是我知道怎么修它……

original: Maybe it's a servo error? Nah, that doesn't make any sense...
translation: 是系统出错了？呐，没道理啊……

original: You don't want to be the first class in history to fail the G.O.A.T., do you?
translation: 你可不想成为历史上第一个G.O.A.T.不及格的人吧？

original: Take your seats so we can get started.
translation: 坐好后我们就能开始了。

original: Come on, people. Find your seats.
translation: 来吧，孩子们。找个座位坐下。

original: Let's not keep the Overseer waiting.
translation: 不要让监督者等久了。

original: Come on, Freddie! Finish up already.
translation: 算了吧，弗雷迪！考试结束了。

original: If I ever get my hands on that kid, so help me...
translation: 如果我抓到那孩子，那就过来帮我……

original: Anyone could have told him the roaches would swarm if we shut the lights off...
translation: 难道没有人告诉他，如果我们把灯打灭，蟑螂就会成群出来……

original: Damn roaches... where do they keep coming from?
translation: 该死的蟑螂……它们都是从哪来的？

original: Please no more roaches.
translation: 蟑螂别再来了。

original: I can't believe it. Jonas...
translation: 我不敢相信。乔纳斯……

original: Lights'll be back on in a few more minutes. Few more minutes.
translation: 再过几分钟灯就会亮了。再过几分钟。

original: What the hell has gotten into the Overseer?
translation: 监督者到底哪根筋不对劲？

original: You won't see the Overseer out on roach patrol.
translation: 监督者可不会出现在这蟑螂大队里。

original: I can't believe the Doc went out there. Rather shoot myself in the head.
translation: 打死我也不相信医生会跑到外面去了。

original: Damn that troublemaking doctor.
translation: 该死的捣乱医生。

original: It's all the Doc's fault. He never should have opened the door.
translation: 这全是医生的错。他根本不应该打开那门。

original: I knew we should've never let him in. Said so at the time.
translation: 我觉得我们就不应该让他进来。那时候就该这么说。

original: Oh my God. Oh my God.
translation: 哦，天啊。我的天啊。

original: They're everywhere...
translation: 它们到处都是……

original: Please, no more. No more no more no more.
translation: 不要来了，不要不要不要。

original: Got to get a grip on yourself, Gloria. Get a grip.
translation: 控制住你自己，格劳利。控制住。

original: Freddie, do you understand what "pencils down" means?
translation: 弗雷迪，你明白“把笔放下”是什么意思吗？

original: Freddie, it's multiple choice. You can't really still be thinking about it.
translation: 弗雷迪，这是选择题。你不会就是不会。

original: I don't have all day, Freddie. The Overseer's waiting for these.
translation: 我没时间跟你耗，弗雷迪。监督者正在等着考试结果。

original: Help! Bomb!
translation: 救命啊！炸弹！

original: Help me!
translation: 救命！

original: My God, it's about to go off!
translation: 我的天啊，要爆炸啦！

original: What's the word? Heard anything interesting?
translation: 最近大家都在聊什么？有什么有意思的事吗？

original: Mabel sure does make some wonderful pies. She's a great cook.
translation: 梅布尔做了些不错的派。她是个非常棒的厨师。

original: Oh, I was just looking at the new RobCo catalog. Some impressive things they're doing these days.
translation: 哦，我刚刚在看最新的RobCo购物目录。他们造的东西还真不错。

original: I was thinking of having a cookout soon, since the weather has been so wonderful.
translation: 我觉得什么时候应该来一次野餐，免得浪费了这么好的天气。

original: Sure is a beautiful day today.
translation: 祝您今天愉快。

original: Nothing like the smell of apple pie, is there? I can't get enough of it.
translation: 没有什么能比得上苹果派的味道，是吗？我总是吃不够。

original: Attack
translation: 攻击

original: I forgot how much fun it was to shoot Ferals!
translation: 我都忘了开枪射击凶悍僵尸是多么有趣！

original: Ghouls! On me!
translation: 僵尸！看这！

original: They're everywhere!
translation: 他们到处都是！

original: Die zombie! Die!
translation: 该死的丧尸！去死！

original: You got to shoot them in the head!
translation: 你应该射他们的头！

original: How the hell did they get in here?
translation: 这些该死的家伙是从哪来的？

original: Goddamn zombies everywhere!
translation: 到处都是该死的丧尸！

original: Someone flank that one!
translation: 快解决那个！

original: Keep firing!
translation: 继续开火！

original: Aggh!
Hunh!
Yaaaah!
Son, get your head down!
translation: 低头，孩子！

original: Honey, get your head down!
translation: 亲爱的，让开！

original: Get away from my daughter!
translation: 离我女儿远点！

original: Get away from my son!
translation: 离我儿子远点！

original: You see? This is why I took you to that Vault in the first place...
translation: 你明白了？这就是我为什么先带你去避难所……

original: This is lunacy!
translation: 太蠢了！

original: You think I'm going to let YOU stop me? After all I've been through?
translation: 你觉得我会让你阻止我吗？尤其是在我经历了这么多事之后？

original: I'll kill you before I let anyone harm my child!
translation: 我会在你伤到我孩子之前杀了你！

original: First that crazy simulation, now this. Has the entire world taken leave of its senses?
translation: 先是那疯狂的模拟，现在又是这。整个世界都发了疯吗？

original: Traveling the Wasteland, shooting guns! By God, I'm getting too old for this sort of thing!
translation: 在废土上，旅旅行开开枪！的确，对于这些事来说我太老了！

original: Damnit, just leave us alone!
translation: 该死，离我们远点！

original: Just like shooting that old BB Gun! You remember?
translation: 就像使用旧BB枪那样！你记得吗？

original: Ahhhhh!
translation: 啊啊啊！

original: Enough! Enough of this!
translation: 够了！这够了！

original: Run!
translation: 跑！

original: Die, American dogs!
translation: 死吧，美国狗！

original: You and your country will burn!
translation: 你和你的国家将会陷入火海！

original: Lay down and die!
translation: 去死吧！

original: We've got to stop them!
translation: 我们要阻止他们！

original: You'll have to kill me this time, mutie bastards!
translation: 这次你想杀了我，变种人杂种！

original: Come on, guys! We can do this!
translation: 加油，伙计们！我们能做到的！

original: Oh shit, oh shit, oh shit.
translation: 哦，狗屎，哦，狗屎，哦，狗屎。

original: If I'm going to die, I'm taking one of you with me!
translation: 如果我要死了，我会拉上你们做垫背！

original: This is surprisingly satisfying.
translation: 真出奇的令人意外。

original: I think I'm getting the hang of this.
translation: 我觉得我开始熟悉它的用法了。

original: I can't stop them all by myself!
translation: 凭我自己无法阻止他们！

original: I swear, I'll kill you!
translation: 我发誓，我要杀了你！

original: Yeaggh!
Had enough?
translation: 受够了吗？

original: Foul thing!
translation: 蠢货！

original: I'll turn you into fertilizer!
translation: 我要把你变成肥料！

original: How dare you!
translation: 你敢！

original: You're mine, Outsider!
translation: 你是我的，外来者！

original: Foolish is he who seeks to deceive!
translation: 他想掩人耳目，真是愚蠢！

original: Die, betrayer!
translation: 去死，叛徒！

original: His wrath upon you!
translation: 他的愤怒将降罚于你！

original: May He smite you!
translation: 他会惩罚你的！

original: Do I have to do everything myself?
translation: 我只好自己去干所有的事了？

original: Charon! Kill this asshole! Now!
translation: 卡戎！杀了这混蛋！快！

original: Charon! Get over here and help me!
translation: 卡戎！快过来，帮帮我！

original: Get! Out!
translation: 出去！

original: This is our town!

original: Warning. Use of lethal force is authorized.

translation: 市场要关闭了。你该走了。

original: Hey! Didn't I just tell you to get out? I've got to lock up.
translation: 嗨！我没叫过你快走吗？我要锁门了。

original: I'd get out of here if I was you.

original: Hey... you don't belong here.
translation: 嗨……这不是你来的地方。

original: Turn around and head back the way you came.
translation: 转过身去，哪来的回哪去。

original: Take my advice. Leave. Fast.
translation: 听我的建议。离开。尽快。

original: You got two options. Leave and live or stay and die. Your choice.
translation: 你有两个选择。活着离开，留下等死。选择权在你。

original: This is a restricted area.
translation: 这里是不对外开放区域.

original: Leave now. Use of deadly force has been authorized.
translation: 快点离开。已授权使用致命武力。

original: You are trespassing. Leave immediately.
translation: 你正在非法入侵。尽快离开。

original: This area is off limits.
translation: 这区域禁入。

original: Leave quickly before I sound the alarm.
translation: 快点离开，否则我要鸣警了。

original: This is only a warning. Leave or prepare to face the consequences.
translation: 这只是个警告。离开，否则后果自负。

original: Hey! You! Get the hell out of here!
translation: 嗨！你！见鬼，给我滚出去！

original: You should probably leave, you know.
translation: 你或许应该离开。

original: You shouldn't be here. Leave now before I forcibly remove you.
translation: 你不应该来这。快些离开，否则我将以武力驱逐你。

original: You're not allowed to be here.
translation: 你不准来这。

original: Get out of here. You're not allowed.
translation: 离开这。你不准进入。

original: Leave before I call security.
translation: 离开，要不我叫警卫了。

original: Unauthorized access! Exit the armory immediately!
translation: 非法进入！即刻离开军械库！

original: Unauthorized access detected! Activating weapons!
translation: 探测到非法进入！激活武器！

original: I've got full authority to gun you down if you don't comply. Back off.
translation: 如果你不顺从的话，我有权将你击毙。快退下。

original: Warning. You are in violation of a security zone. Use of lethal force is imminent.
translation: 警告。你已侵犯安全区域。致命武力即将实施。

original: Warning. You have entered a security zone. Lethal force may be used without further warning.
translation: 警告。你进入了受保护的区域。再往前走，不经警告，就会对你使用致命武器。

original: Warning. Leave the security zone immediately or you may be fired upon without further warning.
translation: 警告。马上离开受保护的区域，否则你将在不经警告的情况下受到攻击.

original: I don't mean to be rude, but you're not allowed here. You'd better leave before I'm forced to take preventive measures.
translation: 我无意冒犯，但你不能进来。在我不得不采取预防措施之前，你最好离开。

original: You're still within the restricted area. I really do advise you to leave immediately.
translation: 你仍处在受限区域内. 我很郑重议你马上离开.

original: Perhaps you didn't hear me the first time. This is a restricted area. Please leave immediately.
translation: 或许你没听清我刚才说什么. 这是首先区域.请立刻离开.

original: I'm sorry, but you're not allowed here. I hope you won't turn this into an unpleasant situation.
translation: 很抱歉。但是你没有被允许来这里. 我不希望你让这转化成不愉快的结局.

original: I'm sorry. You've entered a restricted area. I may have to use deadly force if you don't leave immediately.
translation: 很抱歉。你已经进入了受限区域.如果你不马上离开的话,我将不得不使用致命武器.

original: Excuse me, sir, but this is a restricted area. Please leave immediately so we can remain friends.
translation: 对不起，先生，但这里是受限区域。如果你能立刻离开,我们将仍是朋友.

original: Excuse me, ma'am, but this is a restricted area. Please leave immediately so we can remain friends.
translation: 对不起，女士，但这里是受限区域。如果你能立刻离开,我们将仍是朋友.

original: Trespasser, be advised that deadly force will be used against you without further warning.
translation: 入侵者，现在告诉你，在不经警告的情况下,我们随时都会对你使用致命武器.

original: Leave the restricted area immediately. No further warning is required.
translation: 立刻离开受限区域。不会再一次警告你了.

original: This is a restricted area. You will be sanctioned with deadly force if you do not leave immediately.
translation: 这是受限区域。如果你不马上离开,你将受到致命武器的攻击.

original: You are now trespassing. Be advised that deadly force may be used against you.
translation: 你现在是非法侵入。请注意，可能会对你使用致命武力。

original: Warning. You are trespassing. You must leave immediately.
translation: 警告。你未经许可进入私人土地. 你必须立刻离开.

original: This is a restricted area.
translation: 这里是不对外开放区域.

original: You had better remove yourself from this area before I am forced to declare you an enemy of the U.S. of A.
translation: 在我宣布你成为美军的敌人之前,你最好从这里消失.

original: This area is under the protection of the U.S. army. Remove yourself or be prepared to defend yourself.
translation: 这个区域受到美军的保护. 从这里消失或者准备迎接攻击

original: You're not allowed in here. Don't give me an excuse to use my weapon on you.
translation: 你没有被允许来这里. 不要给我一个攻击你的理由.

original: Do not push your luck any further.
translation: 不要试图碰碰运气.

original: I'll advise you again to leave immediately or I cannot be responsible for the consequences.
translation: 我再次建议你马上离开否则我将不会为后果负责.

original: You are taking your life into your own hands.
translation: 你是在拿生命冒险。

original: This is stupid! We shouldn't be in here, and you know it!
translation: 太蠢了！我们不该来这，你早该知道！

translation: 你最好离开这里。

translation: 我叫你离开。你最好听劝。

original: You don't belong here.
translation: 你不属于这里。

translation: 如果你知道什么对你有好处，你最好离开这里。

translation: 入侵警报！入侵警报！正在联系避难所科技警卫！

original: Bad idea.

original: To arms! Brothers! To arms!
translation: 拿起武器！兄弟们！拿起武器！

original: Combat alert! Alarm! Alarm!
translation: 战斗警报！警报！警报！

original: To your guns, Brothers!
translation: 拿起你们的枪，兄弟们！

original: Defend the Citadel!
translation: 保卫五角大本营！

original: Hostile in the Bailey!

original: We've got a hostile in the Lab!
translation: 在实验室内发现敌人！

translation: 在A环与敌人接触！请求增援！

original: Hostile contact in B Ring!

original: Roaches!

original: Dammit, more roaches!

original: There he is!
translation: 看，是他！

original: There she is!
translation: 看，是她！

original: Got you now.
translation: 抓住你了。

original: I knew you'd turn up sooner or later.
translation: 我就知道你早晚会出现。

original: Stop in the name of the Overseer!
translation: 以监督者的名义，站住！

original: Hold it right there!
translation: 立刻站住。 !

translation: 目标已锁定！

original: Tango spotted... open fire!
translation: 发现目标……开火！

original: Enemy reacquired! Code red!
translation: 已重新探测到敌人！红色警报！

original: I have positive ID on target.
translation: 已经确认目标。

original: Target locked! Go weapons hot!
translation: 目标锁定！启动武器！

original: Enemy located!
translation: 捕获敌人位置！

original: I got ya now!
translation: 我抓住你了！

original: Now the fun begins!
translation: 娱乐才刚开始呢！

original: I knew you couldn't hide forever!
translation: 我知道你可躲不了一世！

original: It's ass-stompin' time!
translation: 要你命的时间到了！

original: Game's over, pal!
translation: 游戏结束了，小子！

original: Game's over, lady!
translation: 游戏结束了，丫头！

original: Ha! Your ass is MINE!
translation: 哈！你是我的了！

original: Contact confirmed! Backup requested!
translation: 确认接触！请求增援！

original: Got one here! Engaging!
translation: 这有一个！开始攻击！

original: This is gonna be fun!
translation: 这会很有趣的！

original: Time to tear you apart!
translation: 把你碾成肉泥！

original: You're dead, meatsack!
translation: 你死去吧，肉球！

original: I'm gonna tear you up!
translation: 我要把你撕裂！

original: C'mon, boys! Fresh meat!
translation: 快点，伙计们！新鲜的肉！

original: Enemy contact!
translation: 与敌接触！

original: Opening fire on hostile target!
translation: 向敌对目标开火！

original: We've got company!
translation: 我们有同伴！

original: Hostile detected. Commencing neutralization.
translation: 发现敌人. 启动和谐处理机制.

original: Weapons free.
translation: 自由开火.

original: Alert. Hostile detected. Lethal force authorized for all units.
translation: 警报. 发现敌人. 已授权针对任何单位使用致命武器.

original: Allow me to introduce myself.
translation: 请允许我做自我介绍.

original: I'm afraid I'm quite good at killing things. You may want to run now.
translation: 恐怕我很擅长杀人，你现在可能想跑了。

original: There you are! Were you trying to hide from me?
translation: 原来你在这儿呀! 你在尝试躲避我吗？

original: Hostile target identified.
translation: 敌对目标已被确认.

original: Hold it right there.
translation: 站那儿别动。

original: Commencing attack on hostile target.
translation: 开始攻击敌对目标.

original: Didn't you hear me coming? Now I have to fight you. Bloody fantastic.
translation: 你没听到我来了吗？现在我得跟你打了，血腥味十足。

original: Here we go again.
translation: 又来了。

original: Oh good. I found you.
translation: 哦太好了。我找到你了。

original: You must be bloody stupid if you can't hide from me.
translation: 如果你不能避开我,那就说明你是个大傻逼。

original: You're gonna learn how Uncle Sam deals with commie maggots!
translation: 让你知道我们美国人是怎么干死你们这些共产主义蛆虫的!

original: You are about to be introduced to the U.S. army!
translation: 你将要被介绍给美军!

original: Kill that son of a bitch!
translation: 杀了这些狗杂种!

original: You just made my day! Opening fire!
translation: 你只是我的垫脚石! 开火!

original: Looks like this is my lucky day.
translation: 看起来今天是我的幸运日.

original: Since you don't seem willing to do the world a favor and kill yourself, I guess I'm going to have to do it for you.
translation: 既然你不愿意以自杀作为献给世界的礼物, 我想我不得不帮你这么做.

original: Look what we have here.
translation: 看看这是谁。

original: Found you!
translation: 找到你了！

original: Thought I heard something.
translation: 我好像听到了什么。

original: Hey!
translation: 嘿！

original: Somebody protect the booze!
translation: 来人，保护好酒！

original: A-ha! You've manifested yourself!
translation: 啊哈！你出来了！

original: Aha! There you are! That was fun. Pity you'll be dead soon so we can't play again.
translation: 啊哈！你在这！那很有趣。但可惜你就快死了，再没人和我一起玩了。

original: Not very clever are you?
translation: 你还不算太机灵，不是吗？

original: And here I was so enjoying our little cat and mouse game. It's a shame I have to kill you now.
translation: 我真喜欢这猫捉耗子的游戏。多可惜啊，我现在不得不解决掉你。

original: Tsk tsk. I had thought you were more clever than that. Oh well.
translation: 啧啧。我曾认为你远比这机灵的。喔，算了。

original: So are you going to let me kill you now, or are you going to run away again?
translation: 你是等着现在被我杀掉，抑或要再次撒腿就跑？

original: There you are. Now, let's finish this nonsense.
translation: 你在这里啊。我们结束这无聊的把戏吧。

original: Ha ha! There you are!
translation: 哈哈！你在这！

original: Found you!
translation: 找到你了！

original: Now try and hide from this!
translation: 现在躲这试试！

original: Game's over!
translation: 游戏结束！

original: No more games... time to die!
translation: 不玩了……去死吧！

original: I smelled your fear, human!
translation: 我嗅到了你的恐惧，人类！
