original: It's like I said, kid. Your dad was here for a bit, but didn't stay long. Said he was going to the Galaxy News Radio station. Southeast, in D.C.
translation: 就像我说的，孩子。你父亲来过这，但没待多久。他说他要去银河新闻电台，在东南方向，特区内。

original: What was it you said about my father, again?
translation: 你能再说一遍我父亲怎么了吗？

original: My God... It's you. The little baby boy, all grown up. Persistent little bastard, ain't ya? Then and now, it would seem. It's been a long time, kid.
translation: 我的天啊……是你。小男孩彻底长大了，都成了小帅哥了。估计以后会越来越帅。时间过得真快，孩子。

original: Oh, your daddy passed through here, all right. Here and gone. Got what he came for, and then left. I'm assuming you'll do the same, correct?
translation: 哦，你父亲来过这，是的。来了又走了。得到了他想要的随后就离开了。我猜你跟他一样，对吧？

original: My God... It's you. The little baby girl, all grown up. Persistent little flower, ain't ya? Then and now, it would seem. It's been a long time, kid.
translation: 我的天啊……是你。小女孩彻底长大了，都成了小美女了。估计以后会越来越美。时间过得真快，孩子。

original: Oh, your daddy passed through here, all right. Here and gone. Got what he came for, and then left. I'm assuming you'll do the same, correct?
translation: 哦，你父亲来过这，是的。来了又走了，得到了他想要的随后就离开了。我猜你跟他一样，对吧？

original: You took care of our little lost lamb, eh? I knew I could count on you.
translation: 你照顾了我们迷途的小羊羔，是吧？我就知道我能指望上你的。

original: How about you just hand over 100 caps and we'll call it even.
translation: 你给我100个瓶盖，我们就算扯平怎么样？

original: I did your stupid favor. Now can you tell me where my father is?
translation: 我帮你搞定了这蠢差事。现在你能告诉我我的父亲在哪了吗？

original: You got memory problems, kid? You ain't getting somethin' for nothin'. So pony up the 300 caps, and THEN we'll talk.
translation: 你脑子有问题吗，孩子？别指望不劳而获，拿300个瓶盖出来，给钱后我们再谈别的。

original: Can you tell me where my father is now?
translation: 现在你能告诉我我的父亲在哪了吗？

original: Even if I knew, I wouldn't tell you.
translation: 就算我知道，我也不会告诉你。

original: Oh, yeah! I do remember a guy like that.
translation: 哦，耶！我确实记得这样一个人。

original: Honestly, I usually keep my head down. I tend to get smacked around if I look customers in the eyes. But talk to Moriarty, he'll know more.
translation: 坦白说，平时我都是低着头的，如果盯着顾客看我会被揍的。去找莫里亚蒂谈吧，他知道得更多。

original: I can't talk about that anymore. Moriarty will beat me again if I do.
translation: 我不能跟你多说，否则莫里亚蒂又会打我了。

original: Yeah, I remember that man. I saw him talking to Moriarty. It's hard to forget handsome men like that.
translation: 嗯，我知道那男人。我看见他跟莫里亚蒂谈话来着。像他那样一个美男子很难让人忘记。

original: Not in here, I haven't.
translation: 我没见过。

original: Sorry, man. I haven't seen any cats like that roll through here.
translation: 抱歉，伙计。我没见过你说的人来过这。

original: Many of the transient visitors end up at one of Megaton's seedier establishments.
translation: 很多匆匆的旅行者都最后选择在兆吨镇的某个破房子里定居了。

original: I suggest you speak to Colin Moriarty and continue your search there.
translation: 你要想继续找寻，我建议去科林·莫里亚蒂那。

original: Boy... are you botherin' me? 'Cause I think we talked about what happens when you bother me.
translation: 小子……你在故意烦我吗？我觉得该说的，在你开始烦我时都说了。

original: I'm looking for my father...
translation: 我在寻找我的父亲……

original: Girl... are you botherin' me? 'Cause I think we talked about what happens when you bother me.
translation: 女孩……你在故意烦我吗？我觉得该说的，在你开始烦我时都说了。

original: I'm looking for my father...
translation: 我在寻找我的父亲……

original: Oh man, you're looking for your dad? That is so sweet! Did he run out on you when you were a kid or something?
translation: 哦，伙计，你在找你父亲？听起来真亲切！他在你还是个孩子的时候就抛下你走了吗？

original: Our parents died when we were kids. My brother Leo, he's the oldest, he raised my brother Andy and me. It was hard on him, but we turned out okay.
translation: 我们的父母在我们还小的时候就死了。我的哥哥利奥，他是家里最大的了，抚养安迪和我长大。对他来说这很不容易，但我们还是活下来了。

original: But God, you don't want to hear about that. I'm sorry, but I haven't seen your dad. He didn't eat at the Brass Lantern. I'd remember if he did.
translation: 可是，天啊，你不会希望听到这些的。我很抱歉，我没见过你父亲。他没在黄铜灯里吃过饭，否则我会知道有那么个人的。

original: Are you fucking kidding me? Get out of my face.
translation: 你他妈的在消遣我吗？滚出我的视线。

original: I usually avoid most of the Wasteland types that come through here, but there was one guy.
translation: 一般我不愿意跟那些从废土来这的人打交道，但有一个人例外。

original: Unlike most of the wannabe heroes that come in, he looked like he could actually read a book without giving himself a headache.
translation: 跟那些梦想成为英雄的人不同，他看上去能静下心来读一本书而不会感到头疼。

original: He spent a bunch of time at Moriarty's before moving on. I'd try talking to Colin.
translation: 他离开之前在莫里亚蒂那待了好一阵子，去找科林谈谈看吧。

original: I'm glad we understand each other. Now, have you seen my dad?
translation: 我很高兴我们能相互理解。现在，你见过我的父亲吗？

original: I usually avoid most of the Wasteland types that come through here, but there was one guy.
translation: 一般我不愿意跟那些从废土来这的人打交道，但有一个人例外。

original: Unlike most of the wannabe heroes that come in, he looked like he could actually read a book without giving himself a headache.
translation: 跟那些梦想成为英雄的人不同，他看上去能静下心来读一本书而不会感到头疼。

original: He spent a bunch of time at Moriarty's before moving on. I'd try talking to Colin.
translation: 他离开之前在莫里亚蒂那待了好一阵子，去找科林谈谈看吧。

original: Your father? I don't know, I don't know. Doesn't ring a bell, sorry.
translation: 你父亲？我不知道，不知道，什么也想不起来，抱歉了。

original: Well, come to think of it, I do remember a stranger coming through here. Had a look in his eye. You know the kind a man gets when he's got a purpose.
translation: 细想一下的话，我确实记得有个外来人来过。我注意到他的眼神。你知道当人怀有某种目的的时候眼神是特别的。

original: Spent some time up in the saloon. Might want to check with Moriarty. Just watch yourself. That man's trouble.
translation: 在酒吧待了一会，或许你可以去问问莫里亚蒂，但你自己要当心，那家伙可不好惹。

original: Now that I'm helping you, maybe you can help me. I'm looking for my dad...
translation: 既然我帮了你，或许你也可以帮我。我在寻找我的父亲……

original: Nope, sorry. I got enough fires to put out in this place that I don't have time to keep tabs on every visitor. I'd ask around town.
translation: 没有，抱歉。我要处理的麻烦事够多了，没空花心思在每一个旅行者身上。你去镇里打听打听。

original: Could be the guy I saw at Moriarty's Saloon not too long ago. I'd ask there.
translation: 可能是不久之前我在莫里亚蒂的酒吧里见到的那个人。你去那问问。

original: I could use some directions around town.
translation: 你能给我指些路吗？

original: You know, you're right -- I guess I do look like a sign post. [sighs] Where do you want to go?
translation: 好吧，你是对的 — 我想我就像个路标。[叹气]你想去哪？

original: In each our own way, we are all lost. Where would you like to be, sweet child?
translation: 在选择前进之路时，我们都是无助的。你的抉择在何方？我的孩子。

original: In each our own way, we are all lost. Where would you like to be, brother?
translation: 在选择前进之路时，我们都是无助的。你的抉择在何方？兄弟。

original: In each our own way, we are all lost. Where would you like to be, sister?
translation: 在选择前进之路时，我们都是无助的。你的抉择在何方？姐妹。

original: Sure thing, partner. What do you need to find?
translation: 没问题，伙计。你想找什么？

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <沉默不语>

original: The quiet type, huh? Fine. Might help keep you out of trouble. I hope you're not a weirdo. Got enough of those already.
translation: 沉默寡言的性格，呃？好的。或许能给你少惹不必要麻烦。希望你不是个古怪的人 — 近来我遇到的怪人太多了。

original: Pffft. Nice hat, Calamity Jane.
translation: 呸，好一顶帽子，瘟神。

original: So that's the way it's gonna be, huh? That's fine. That's fine...
translation: 你就这副德行，呃？好吧，好吧……

original: Just so long as we understand each other. This here is my town. These are my people. You so much as breathe wrong, and I'm gonna fuckin' end ya.
translation: 只要我们能互相明白就好。这是我的镇子，他们是我的镇民。你要是敢惹麻烦，我就他妈的干掉你。

original: Nice town you got here, sheriff. It's a pleasure to meet you.
translation: 你们的镇子看上去不错，警长。很高兴见到你。

original: Friendly AND well-mannered? I think we're gonna get along just fine. You treat my people nice, and you're welcome to stay as long as you'd like.
translation: 友善又有教养？我想我们会相处得不错。你对我的镇民很和善，你在这里想待多久都可以。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Oh, no problem. I'm not busy at all. Yep. Plenty of time to talk to strangers.
translation: 哦，没问题。我真是一点也不忙啊。恩。真有很多时间来和一个陌生人谈谈。

original: What else do you require, sweet child?
translation: 你还想知道什么，甜心？

original: Sure thing. What's on your mind?
translation: 没问题，你想知道什么？

original: What do you wish to discuss?
translation: 你想聊点什么？

original: Is there a weapons dealer around here?
translation: 这附近有武器供应商吗？

original: Go see Moira at Craterside Supply. She sells some weapons. Makes some too, from what I hear. Her place is down by the crater.
translation: 去坑边补给点找莫伊拉。她有些武器卖，我还听说她也自己制作一些。她的店就在下面的弹坑边。

original: It saddens me to think how quickly we resort to violence.
translation: 每次想起我们总是很快诉诸暴力来解决问题的时候，我都感到很悲哀。

original: You'll probably want to see Moira at Craterside Supply. She sells some weapons. Makes some too, from what I hear. Her place is down by the crater.
translation: 你或许应该去坑边杂货店找莫伊拉。她有些武器卖，我还听说她也自己制作一些。她的店就在下面的弹坑边。

original: It saddens me to think how quickly we resort to violence.
translation: 每次想起我们总是很快诉诸暴力来解决问题的时候，我都感到很悲哀。

original: Sure thing, Andy. What do you need?
translation: 没问题，安迪。你需要什么？

original: I'm a little busy right now, Andy. What is it?
translation: 我现在有点忙，安迪。什么事？

original: Yeah, Billy?
translation: 嗯，比利？

original: Yes, Billy?
translation: 嗯，比利？

original: Mister Moriarty, sir! What can I do for you?
translation: 尊敬的莫里亚蒂先生！有什么我能为你效力的？

original: Yessir, Mister Moriarty? What is it?
translation: 是，莫里亚蒂先生，你有什么吩咐？

original: Yeah, Colin?
translation: 嗯，科林？

original: Oh Christ, what now...
translation: 哦，天啊，又怎么了……

original: Yes, darling.
translation: 怎么了，亲爱的。

original: Yes, husband?
translation: 怎么了，老公？

original: What did you say to me? WHAT did you say to me? Did I give you permission to speak, you disgusting corpse?
translation: 你刚对我说什么？你他妈说什么？我允许你开口了吗，你这恶心的腐尸？

original: Well I'll be! I could have sworn I heard this corpse speak! But that's impossible. Dead men don't talk, do they? They LISTEN. They OBEY.
translation: 活见鬼了！我发誓刚才听见这具腐尸说话了！但这不可能啊。死人不会说话，对吧？他们只该听着，只会服从。

original: Oh, hey Jericho, baby! What's going on?
translation: 哦，嗨，亲爱的耶利哥！最近怎么样？

original: Jericho, baby! What's happening?
translation: 亲爱的耶利哥！近来好吗？

original: Hey Gob, what's up?
translation: 嗨，盖博，最近怎么样？

original: Hiya, Gobbie! Whatcha need?
translation: 呀，盖博！来点什么？

original: What's up, son?
translation: 怎么了，孩子？

original: What's on your mind, boy?
translation: 你在想什么，男孩？

original: Yes, Mr. Jericho? What can I do for you?
translation: 是的，耶利哥先生，有什么我能为你效劳的？

original: Sure thing, Mr. Jericho. What do you need?
translation: 没问题，耶利哥先生，你需要点什么？

original: Yeah, honey. What do you need?
translation: 嗯，亲爱的，你想要什么？

original: What is it, baby?
translation: 什么事，宝贝？

original: Food, Jericho. It's all I had for you yesterday. It's all I have for you today.  It's all I'll ever have for you.
translation: 食物，耶利哥。这是我昨天能为你准备的，这也是我今天能为你准备的，这同样会是我以后能为你准备的。

original: Jericho, you're disgusting. Are you going to order something or not?
translation: 耶利哥，你很烦啊，你到底要不要点菜？

original: What? Me? Why?
translation: 什么？我？为什么？

original: I'll help you if I can, what do you need?
translation: 我会尽力帮你的，你想要什么？

original: Sure... Jericho, is it? What do you want to talk about?
translation: 当然……耶利哥，对吧？你想聊点什么？

original: Yeah, sure. No problem. Anything I can do to help, you just let me know!
translation: 嗯，当然。没问题。如果有我能帮上忙的，只管对我说！

original: Yeah, Leo... what do you need?
translation: 嗯，利奥……你想要什么？

original: What is it, Leo?
translation: 怎么了，利奥？

original: Yeah, dad?
translation: 什么事，爸爸？

original: Whatcha need, dad?
translation: 有什么吩咐，爸爸？

original: For you, sweetheart, anything. What do you need?
translation: 甜心，为了你我愿意做任何事。你需要什么？

original: Anything for you, honey?
translation: 能为你效劳吗，甜心？

original: Oh, for the... What?
translation: 哦，怎么了？

original: Yes, good wife?
translation: 怎么了，好老婆？

original: Yes, my darling?
translation: 怎么了，我亲爱的？

original: Yes, Nathan?
translation: 怎么了，内森？

original: Yes, dear?
translation: 嗯，亲爱的？

original: Oh, heya Nathan. Sorry, I got lost in my work. What do you need?
translation: 哦，嗨呀，内森。抱歉我光忙自己的了。你需要什么？

original: Sure, Nathan, what's up?
translation: 没问题，内森，怎么了？

original: What is it NOW, Nova, dear...
translation: 现在又怎么了，亲爱的诺瓦……

original: Does the pampered princess seek an audience with her king?
translation: 这位娇生惯养的公主是想觐见她的国王吗？

original: Nova! Uhm... hi! What do you need?
translation: 诺瓦！嗯……嗨！你要点什么？

original: Nova! What can I do for you? Just name it!
translation: 诺瓦！有什么我能为你效劳的？只管说！

original: I was thinkin' Andy -- you know what would be great? If we went lookin' for a new refrigerator for the bar.
translation: 我在想，安迪 — 你知道吗？如果我们能给酒吧添个新冰箱就太好了。

original: We should get us a hooker. We could pull in a lot of money around here... maybe a nice blonde.
translation: 我们该去找个妓女。在这我们可以赚很多钱，最好是个金发娇娃。

original: You said we could have that talk sometime. You know. About boys. I'm ready! I'm ready now! There's some stuff I need to know. Like, really bad.
translation: 你说过我们可以找个时间谈谈，嗯，那群孩子。我准备好了，我现在已经准备好了！我需要了解一些事，急切地想知道。

original: It's about Harden. I think I want to... kiss him. But I don't know if I should. Well, I think I should, but I don't really know HOW. What should...
translation: 是关于哈登的。我想要……吻他。但我不知是否应该这么做。嗯，我想我应该，但不知该怎么做。该怎么……

original: I... I think we're running low on Nuka-Cola, sir. I... I just thought you'd want to know...
translation: 我……我觉得核子可乐快不够了，先生。我……我只是觉得您该知道……

original: Colin... Mister Moriarty, sir... I just wanted to... to say... well... you're looking quite dapper today, sir...
translation: 科林……莫里亚蒂先生……我只是想……想说……嗯……您今天看起来真精神，先生……

original: I'm tired. I think I'm going to knock off early. I know you won't mind.
translation: 我累了，想早点收工。我知道你不会介意的。

original: It's the tips, Colin. Your customers are actually getting cheaper, if that's even possible. Is a girl supposed to just lie down and take that?
translation: 是小费问题，科林。你的客人竟然还能更抠，如果这种事可能的话。难道姑娘家就该躺平认了？

original: I've been having those visions again. Not while I sleep, dear husband, but waking dreams. I see Atom, finally free! His glory revealed at last!
translation: 我再次憧憬这样的场面。不是在睡梦中，亲爱的老公，而是清醒地看到。我看到原子最终被解放了！他的光辉最终迸发！

original: He came to me again last night, husband. The great Atom! He visited me in my dreams, bid me to spread His gospel. I was infused with His energy!
translation: 他昨天晚上又来看我了，老公。伟大的原子！他在我的梦中造访，让我为他传福音。我体内现在充斥着他的活力！

original: These floors are filthy, you useless fucking zombie! Next time you sweep, put your back into it.
translation: 这的地板太脏了，你这没用的死丧尸！下次清扫的时候要卖力。

original: Christ almighty, Gob, if I told you once I told you a thousand times. Do something about that... oozing. You're scaring off my customers!
translation: 万能的主啊，盖博，我已经跟你说过一千遍了，管管你那流脓的地方，你把我的顾客都吓跑了！

original: I've got blood in my alcohol stream. I blame you. Fix it.
translation: 我发现我体内的酒精循环系统里居然有血液。都怪你，赶快搞定。

original: I can't help but notice that I'm sobering up. What are we gonna do about that?
translation: 我不禁发现我的酒就快醒了。我们该怎么办？

original: My drink is empty. Fix it.
translation: 我的瓶子空了，搞定它。

original: Don't forget to mop up really good today. You know how Colin gets when the bar is messy. I'd hate for him to, you know... Get angry again.
translation: 记住今天要把地拖得很干净。你知道如果科林看到他的酒吧不干净会有什么反应。我可不愿看到他，嗯……又发火。

original: I just wanted to let you know I reserved some special time for you. You know, as a thank you for all you done for me.
translation: 我只是想告诉你我为你特别预留了点时间。嗯，作为对你所做一切的感谢。

original: I wanted to tell you, I saw the patch job you did on that leaky section of roof. That was... That was really responsible of you, son. Thank you.
translation: 我得告诉你，我知道你帮忙把楼顶漏水的地方补上了。你真的……真的很热心，孩子。谢谢。

original: So, ummm... I noticed Deputy Steel looking a bit shinier than usual. You polished him up, didn't you boy? He he he. Good work, son. Good work.
translation: 嗯……我注意到斯蒂尔副警长看上去比平常更有光泽。是你把他擦亮了，对吗，孩子？呵呵呵，干得好，孩子，干得好。

original: C'mon, Jenny, why you gotta be like that? I'm just trying to be nice to you.
translation: 拜托，珍妮，为什么你要那样子？我只是想对你好一点。

original: Dammit, Jenny. Why do you have to embarrass me like that, out here in front of all these people?
translation: 可恶，珍妮，为什么你要在这么多人面前如此羞辱我？

original: I noticed some irregularities in the logs here. Are you tracking the drinks that you're selling like I told you?
translation: 我注意到这的记录里有些不对。你按我说的去核实你卖掉的酒了吗？

original: You came up short again. Now, I don't know what's going on, but it needs to stop.
translation: 你又没达到要求。现在，我不知道发生了什么，但不能再这样了。

original: You said we could take that trip. Up north, you know? To see one of the old towns? Come on, dad, you promised....
translation: 你说过我们可以走那条路，往北，你懂吗？去找那些古老的镇子，拜托，爸爸，你答应过的……

original: We still haven't built that model, you know. The Corvega? You told me we could do it this weekend....
translation: 我们还没完成那模型。科维加？你告诉过我，我们可以这周末再去的……

original: Well, I was thinkin', Sweetie Pie... Sometime soon, we should take a trip. Just you and me. Maybe visit Rivet City or somethin'. Would you like that?
translation: 嗯，我刚才在想，甜心……过段时间，我们应该去旅行，只有你和我两个人。比如去铆钉城或别的什么地方，你喜欢吗？

original: You know, I got to thinkin'. You and I should do some scavengin' sometime soon. See, we find us an old bike, and get Moira to help us fix her up!
translation: 你瞧，我刚才在想，你和我不久之后或许可以一起去哪探索。看，我们有架旧自行车，可以让莫伊拉帮我们修好它！

original: What did you do with my ratchet? I've looked everywhere! Where did you put it?
translation: 你拿了我的棘轮吗？我都找遍了！你把它放哪去了？

original: I... I never did find that gun. The one I was working on, remember? You put it somewhere didn't you? You cleaned up, and you lost my damn gun!
translation: 我……我根本没找到过那把枪。我修过的那把，记得吗？你把它丢到哪去了对吧？你清理过，然后就把我那把该死的枪弄丢了！

original: I was wonderin' if anyone's sold you a Fesson-Moch .45 cal. I need the trigger assembly for this rifle I'm workin' on.
translation: 我想问是不是有人卖了你一支芬森-摩奇.45手枪，我需要那上面的扳机零件来做好这支来福枪。

original: Did you ever get ahold of those shell casings that we talked about? The special alloy ones?
translation: 你这有我们说过的那种弹壳吗？那种特殊合金做的？

original: I've been concerned about church attendance lately, Mother. The town's inability to fully accept Atom's promise is... most discouraging.
translation: 教母，我一直在为教堂的出席率发愁。最让人沮丧的是镇子无法完全接受原子的福音。

original: Have you thought more on that matter we discussed? It's a bold plan, Mother. But I fear the townsfolk may not be ready for such an intervention.
translation: 你进一步考虑我们谈过的那件事了吗？那可是的大胆的计划，教母。但我害怕镇上的人还没有为这种改变做好准备。

original: Nathan, you promised me you'd talk to Moira about getting those flower seeds. Please, don't forget. Again.
translation: 内森，你答应过我会去跟莫伊拉商量拿些花种的。别又忘了。

original: The computer's doing that... that THING again. You know, with the flickering. You said you'd fix it...
translation: 这台电脑又……那样了。你看，闪屏。你说过你把它修好了……

original: Have you been Jetting again? For Christ's sake, lass, you're half the earner when you're on that junk. NO... MORE... CHEMS. Got it?
translation: 你又嗑杰特了？看在上帝的份上，姑娘，沾上那玩意儿你的业绩都砍半了。别……再……吸……了。听到没有？

original: Nova... You're a beautiful girl. Everyone knows that. But Jesus, put a smile on! If you can't be happy, at least look the part.
translation: 诺瓦……你是个漂亮姑娘，大伙都知道的。但天啊，笑一笑！就算开心不起来，至少装装样子。

original: I set that special wine aside for you. The one you said makes you really... uninhibited.
translation: 我把那种特别的酒放在你边上了，就是你说的那种使你……天不怕地不怕的。

original: You look beautiful today, Nova. Just like always.
translation: 你今天看上去真漂亮，诺瓦。一如往常。

original: I was thinkin', maybe you and me, we could go out sometime.
translation: 我在想，或许你和我，可以找个时间一起出去。

original: Now, I know you've turned me down before, but I'm gonna ask again -- what would you think about goin' out sometime?
translation: 现在，我知道你之前拒绝过我，但我还想再问一次 — 你愿意找个时间和我一起出去吗？

original: Look, don't give me any of your shit. Now, tell me something, and if you're lyin' I'll know. Are you workin' with the Raiders? You a scout?
translation: 好，别对我摆脸色。现在告诉我，最好别撒谎。你跟那些歹徒是一伙的吗？你是个探子？

original: I heard something about you, boy. I heard that you was a scout for the Raiders, here to recoin.. recon... err... check out our defenses. That true?
translation: 我听说过你的事，小子，我听说你是那些歹徒派来的探子，到这来刺……刺……嗯，刺探我们的防卫情况，没错吧？

original: I heard something about you, girl. I heard that you was a scout for the Raiders, here to recoin.. recon... err... check out our defenses. That true?
translation: 我听说过你的事，女孩。我听说你是那些歹徒派来的探子，到这来刺……刺……嗯，刺探我们的防卫情况，没错吧？

original: Never mind.
translation: 算了吧。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Yeah. Good idea. Not gonna happen.
translation: 嗯，好主意。没事的。

original: And where do you propose that we pick one of those up? We'd have to pay the caravan scavengers, and who knows what they'd bring back.
translation: 你觉得我们去哪能找个商队保镖来？我们要付钱拾荒人，但谁知道他们会有什么贡献。

original: Whoa! Whoa now, honeybun! Let's ah... Let's slow down a little, okay? You got a lot of time left before that stuff is important. All right?
translation: 哇，哇，现在，宝贝！让我们……嗯，让我们等等，好吗？事态现在还没那么严重。好吗？

original: Oh! Well... Well, now, you know Maggie sweetheart that boys and girls, umm... Aw hell, girl, can't you talk to Moira about this stuff?
translation: 哦，好……好，现在，你知道女孩小伙都管玛姬叫甜心，唔……见鬼，女孩，你干嘛不去向莫伊拉打听这些呢？

original: Shut yer gob, Gob! Ain't that why I named you that to begin with? Cause you talk too goddamn much? Now get your rotting ass back to work!
translation: 闭上你的臭嘴(gob)，盖博(Gob)！这名字不就是为这起的吗？因为你他娘废话连篇？现在滚回去工作！

original: Jesus Christ, what did I just tell you? Get back to yer job while you still have one!
translation: 耶稣基督啊，我刚说什么来着？趁你还有份工作，赶紧滚去干活！

original: I remember a time when you screwed more and complained less, Nova dear. Ah, but for the good old days.
translation: 亲爱的诺瓦，我可记得你过去接客更勤快、抱怨更少的时候呢。唉，过去的好时光啊。

original: *Sigh* Nova, lass. What happened to you, girl? Where's the fire? The enthusiasm? You've got such talent! You used to enjoy your work...
translation: *叹气* 诺娃，姑娘啊。你这是怎么了？你的冲劲呢？热情呢？你明明很有天赋！你曾经多享受工作……

original: *Sigh* Our heavenly Father put you on this earth to test me, is that it? 'Dear Lord, save me from the whinings of thine whore who doth complaineth!'
translation: *叹气* 天父把你降生到这世上就是为了考验我吧？‘主啊，请拯救我免受这抱怨的娼妇之扰吧！’

original: Please, sir! I'm sorry! I... I'm just stupid, you know that! A stupid, rotting corpse, right? I'll take care of it, I swear!
translation: 求你了，先生！我很抱歉！我……你知道我只是个蠢货！一具又蠢又烂的活尸，对吧？我发誓，我会把这件事做好的！

original: Mister Moriarty! Sir! I... I'm sorry! You're right, of course... It won't be a problem! I promise you!
translation: 莫里亚蒂先生！大人！我……我很抱歉！你是对的，当然了……这不会成问题的！我可以向你承诺！

original: Sure thing! ... you miserable drunken asshole ...
translation: 没问题！……你这烂醉如泥的混蛋……

original: One more drink, coming up!  ... shitbird ...
translation: 再来一杯，快点！……傻鸟……

original: You're always so nice to me, you know that, Nova? I don't know what I'd do without you, I swear.
translation: 你一直都对我很好，你知道吗，诺瓦？我发誓，我真的不知道没有你的话，我会怎么样。

original: Aww, Nova. I can always count on you to look out for me, huh? You're, well... You're just about the sweetest person I've ever met.
translation: 啊，诺瓦。我总是可以指望你照顾我，呃？你，嗯……你真是我遇到的最好的人。

original: I just... You know. Wanted to help out.
translation: 我只是……呃，想帮忙。

original: I like helping you out, dad. I'm not a kid anymore, you know. Okay, I am a kid. But I can do anything you need me to do. I can handle it.
translation: 我想帮助你，父亲。我已经不再是孩子了。好吧，我是个孩子，但我能完成你需要我做的任何工作，我能做好。

original: I'm not going to discuss it, Jericho. You know good and goddamn well why I'm like this and don't you dare play dumb with me.
translation: 我无意讨论下去，耶利哥。你该死的很清楚我为什么会这样，最好别对我装傻。

original: Don't play stupid with me, Jericho. You know what my problem is.
translation: 别对我装傻，耶利哥。你清楚我的问题是什么。

original: Is it really that big of a deal if your little papers don't add up? Why are you always hassling me about this?
translation: 你那些细微的努力没起到作用是大事吗？干嘛老拿这来烦我？

original: So we end up a few caps short at the end of the night. Who cares? It's not going to break us. Get off my back, man.
translation: 看来今晚我们最终还是没把钱给凑足。没关系，不会妨碍我们什么的。别对我罗嗦，伙计。

original: *Sigh.* You're right, Harden. You're right. No more broken promises. Let me just... get my affairs settled, and I'll free up some time. Okay?
translation: *叹气*你是对的，哈登，你是对的。不再做随口承诺，让我先……把我的事处理完。然后我会抽出时间来，好吗？

original: Oh man. I did say that, didn't I? Okay. Yeah, yeah we can do that. I've got some stuff to take care of, but after that, it's you and me! Okay, pal?
translation: 哦，伙计，我说过的，不是吗？好吧，嗯，我们能做到。我还有些事需要处理，不过在那之后，我们不见不散。怎么样，伙计？

original: Oh, yes! Please, please, please! Can we Billy? We could have so much fun. More fun than we could in Megaton, that's for sure!
translation: 哦，是的！拜托，拜托，拜托！好不好，比利？我们会很开心的，绝对比我们在兆吨镇开心的多！

original: You mean it? Oh Billy, thank you! Thank you so much! I can't wait!
translation: 当真？哦，比利，谢谢！非常感谢你！我都等不及了！

original: *Tsk* You boys and your toys. I know better than to touch your things, dear. If it's lost, YOU lost it.
translation: *啧啧*你们这些小男孩和你们的玩具。我知道不该碰你们的东西，亲爱的。如果丢了，那是你自己弄丢了。

original: Calm down, dear. Deeeeepppp breath. I didn't touch your... thingie. It's right where you left it, I'm sure. If I see it, you'll be the first to know.
translation: 镇定，亲爱的。深~~~呼吸，我可没动过你们的……东西。我确信就在上次你放的地方，如果看见了我会立刻告诉你。

original: Hrm. Let me think... you know, I don't think so. But I'll let you know if anyone sells me one.
translation: 嗯，我想想……我不知道。但如果有人卖这样的东西给我，我会告诉你的。

original: I'm sorry, Nathan. No. I have to tell you -- those are hard to come by. I wouldn't get your hopes up.
translation: 我很抱歉，内森。我不得不告诉你 — 想得到那些东西可不容易。我可不想你太过乐观。

original: Glorious, Maya! Simply glorious. I sense that His coming is upon us... any day now...
translation: 太华丽了，玛雅！太好了！我能感觉到他正降临于此……随时可能……

original: Breathtaking, my love. Soon, Atom's glory will be upon us. Very soon.
translation: 真是激动人心，我的爱人。很快，原子的光辉就会照耀我们，很快。

original: We should stay our course, dearest husband. Atom's power penetrates us all, does it not? Soon, every soul of Megaton will revel in His glory!
translation: 我们应该坚持下去，亲爱的老公。原子的力量会渗透我们所有人，对吧？很快，兆吨镇的每个灵魂都会陶醉于他的光辉之下。

original: Do not despair, dearest husband. Soon, all of Megaton will bask in Atom's glow.
translation: 别灰心，亲爱的老公。很快，兆吨镇的一切都会沐浴在原子的光辉下。

original: Always with the nagging.... I'll do what I do when I do it, woman.
translation: 别老是唠叨……我知道什么时候该干嘛。

original: Fine, fine, fine. I'll do whatever you want. Just please, for God's sake, stop with the nagging...
translation: 好，好，好，我会听你吩咐。只是，看在上帝的份上，别再唠叨了……

original: I... I'm sorry, Colin. I've been tired lately, you know? I ain't been myself. Don't worry, I'll pull it together. I promise.
translation: 我……我很抱歉，科林。最近太累了，你懂吗？我有点不在状态。别担心，会振作起来的，我保证。

original: *Sigh* All right, Colin, all right. Just lay off, already. Please?
translation: *叹气* 好好好，科林，知道了。别唠叨了。求你了？

original: Oh, you're so sweet, Gob.
translation: 哦，你真好，盖博。

original: Awwww... Thank you hon. You're so thoughtful.
translation: 啊……谢谢，亲爱的。你可真体贴。

original: Jericho, baby. We've talked about this. Colin' don't want me seein' customers outside of work. He thinks our business is best kept professional.
translation: 耶利哥，这一点我们已经谈过了，科林可不愿意我在工作之外见客户，他认为我们最好只在工作上来往。

original: You're sweet, Jericho. You really are, but Colin says that things between us is best kept on a professional level. If it were up to me...
translation: 你真好，耶利哥，真的。但科林说我们还是只在工作上来往为好。要是我说了算的话……

original: Who told you that?
translation: 谁告诉你的？

original: Me? A Raider? Are you joking? I'm not a Raider! I've never even met a Raider before!
translation: 你说我？歹徒？你开玩笑吧？我不是歹徒！我甚至都没见过歹徒！

original: I'm not a Raider! I swear! Who told you that? They're lying!
translation: 我发誓，我不是歹徒！谁告诉你的？他们撒谎！

original: Me? Working with Raiders? Hell no! I just want to get a place here in Megaton, and I'll kill any Raider who shows up here to prove it!
translation: 我？为歹徒工作？瞎说！我只是要在兆吨镇找个住处，我愿意干掉闯入这的歹徒来证明！

original: And you're supposed to be the smart one?
translation: 你不该是个聪明人吗？

original: Hey, I am smart. Jerk.
translation: 嗨，我是很聪明。蠢货！

original: Don't you have the password?
translation: 你有密码吗？

original: Nope. Nobody ever wrote it down, and then one day somebody forgot. You know how it goes.
translation: 没有，没人写下来过，某天有人就忘记了。你知道的。

original: I'm sorry... Who's Maggie?
translation: 抱歉……谁是玛姬？

original: Oh! Sorry, I guess I got ahead of myself, huh? Maggie's nine, sweetest little girl you'd ever care to meet. We take care of each other.
translation: 哦！抱歉，我只顾自言自语了，呃？玛姬只有九岁，一个你肯定想见见的可爱小女孩，她和我相依为命。

original: I ain't never had a daughter, but if I did, I'd want her to be Maggie. I took her in when her parents got killed by Raiders. That was two years ago.
translation: 我没有过女儿，但如果有的话，我希望就是玛姬。在她父母被歹徒杀害以后我收养了她，那是两年前的事了。

original: It was a pretty bad scene. Small settlement up north. I'd stopped in to trade some salvage, and the whole place had been wiped out.
translation: 当时可是一片惨象。北面有一块小型定居点，我曾到那去倒卖废品，却发现那已被屠戮一空。

original: I found Maggie hiding under a bed, in the same room where her parents had been butchered. We've been together ever since.
translation: 我发现玛姬藏在床底下，就在她父母被屠杀的那间房子里。从那以后，我们一直生活在一起。

original: I have to go now.
translation: 我现在要走了。

original: Please, do what you can to find my brother.
translation: 求你了，尽你所能找到我的兄弟。

original: Hey, thanks again for doing this for me, it means a lot.
translation: 嗨，再次感谢你为我们做的这些，对我们很重要。

original: Remember, my offer still stands.
translation: 记住，我的提议仍然有效。

original: All right, goodbye.
translation: 好的，再见。

original: Tell me about the Family.
translation: 和我说说家族。

original: I think they live somewhere east or northeast of here. Problem is, they always travel in the dark so I can't see exactly where they go.
translation: 我想他们住在东面或东北面某个地方。问题是，他们总是夜里活动，所以我不知道他们到底在哪。

original: There's all kinds of places they could be hiding like Hamilton's Hideaway, the old Moonbeam Cinema or Northwest Seneca Metro Station.
translation: 他们可能藏身在各种地方，比如汉密尔顿的隐居点，破旧的“一缕月光”露天影院，或者塞内卡西北站。

original: Where do you think I can find the Family?
translation: 你认为我在哪能找到家族？

original: All they do is terrorize us. They taunt us to open our doors, throw bottles at our houses and scream at us.
translation: 他们除了恐吓我们之外不干别的。他们威胁我们开门，往我们的房子里扔玻璃瓶，还向我们尖叫。

original: If I knew King had my back, I'd step outside and show them just how I feel about their visits... especially after this last attack.
translation: 如果有金的保护，我会站出来告诉他们我怎么看他们的造访，尤其是在他们上次来骚扰之后。

original: What do you think about the Family?
translation: 你认为家族怎么样？

original: They're lowlife scum who decided to use Arefu as their own personal amusement park. Oh, they're a fun bunch.
translation: 他们是一群想把断桥镇变成他们自己的乐园的低等人渣。哦，可笑之辈。

original: I'd take a shot at them if I could but judging from what they did to the Brahmin, I wouldn't live long to tell about it.
translation: 就凭他们对双头牛的所作所为，我真想毙了他们。我可能活不到那个时候了。

original: What do you think about the Family?
translation: 你认为家族怎么样？

original: The Family has become our moniker because that is exactly what we are... related by blood.
translation: 家族成为了我们的绰号，正因为我们是为了……该死的血液而活。

original: Even if all of us look different on the outside, we all had the same vice infesting our insides.
translation: 即便我们外表并不相同，但同样的邪恶在我们体内滋长。

original: But now, through my teachings, these subjugated people have come together and formed a bond stronger than mere friendship.
translation: 但现在，在我的教导之下，这些顺民被一种比友谊更强的纽带维系在一起。

original: We are a badass gang and we don't take shit from nobody.
translation: 我们本来就是臭流氓，不受任何人拘束。

original: We also don't like nosy assholes who creep around asking too many stupid questions.
translation: 我们同样不喜欢在这游荡，只会问些蠢问题的混蛋。

original: We're the last people you want to mess with... that's for damn sure.
translation: 我们这帮人可不是好惹的……你该死的最好明白。

original: It's a great way to get back at those assholes out there who think we're losers.
translation: 能把狗眼看人低的混蛋全干掉是再好不过的了。

original: If it wasn't for Vance, I'd still be getting the crap beat out of me by those guards in Rivet City.
translation: 如果不是因为万斯，我现在还被铆钉城那些警卫打得屁滚尿流呢。

original: My husband started this group not long ago. He was trying to save them from a life of hardship and ridicule.
translation: 不久之前我的丈夫组建了这帮派。他试图把这些人从充满艰辛和屈辱的生活中拯救出来。

original: They come from all over the Wasteland now to find us and become part of the Family.
translation: 他们从废土的各地来到这找我们，要求加入家族。

original: How about just the coolest gang this side of the U.S.?
translation: 美国东岸最酷的帮派如何？

original: As long as we listen to Vance's rules and listen to his stuff, he lets us do pretty much whatever we want.
translation: 只要我们服从万斯订下的规则听他的话，他就允许我们自由行动。

original: Well, anyone that Vance takes in because of their special problems can be part of the Family.
translation: 嗯，万斯带来的人都是因为他们有着能成为家族一员的特别之处。

original: Can you tell me more about what's been going on around here?
translation: 你能再告诉我些这里发生的事情吗？

original: There used to be more families living here. Most of them have dismantled their shacks and moved on to greener pastures.
translation: 以前有更多的人住在这，但大多数拆掉了屋子搬到更富饶的地方去了。

original: Those that are still living here are keeping themselves indoors thanks to the Family.
translation: 剩下的人因为家族的骚扰，都躲在屋里。

original: We're scared shitless. Evan King's got everyone so worked up about the Family, no one wants to set foot outside.
translation: 我们都被吓坏了。埃万·金试图组织大家一起对抗家族，但没人愿意出头。

original: That asshole runs the show, but does he really do anything about our problem? No.
translation: 那混蛋在主持局势，但他真的给我们帮上忙了吗？没有。

original: Everyone is keeping themselves safe from the Family. If I was you, I'd do the same.
translation: 每个人都试图远离家族以保平安。如果我是你，也会这样做的。

original: You want to know more, talk to Evan King.
translation: 你想知道更多的话，去跟埃万·金打听吧。

original: Oh my, I don't know. Mrs. West is probably whipping up a batch of her famous cookies and all the kids are playing in the yards.
translation: 哦，我不知道。维斯特夫人可能在烘烤她引以为傲的饼干，而所有的孩子都在院子里玩。

original: It's so nice outside, the grass looks lovely this time of year.
translation: 外面天气真好，每年这时候的草地总是很漂亮。

original: None of your business.
translation: 不关你事。

original: Hmph. Well, that's the attitude I've come to know from most of the people around this town. Folks like to keep to themselves.
translation: 哼，好吧，这就是我所知的镇上大多数人的态度，这些人不喜欢和别人打交道。

original: I don't want your life story, I just want a little bit of a favor. Think you're up to it?
translation: 我对你的经历没兴趣，只是想找人帮个忙。你能回想起来吗？

original: I'm just passing through.
translation: 我只是路过。

original: Nobody just passes through here. There's nothing to get to by way of this shithole. You've found yourself at a dead-end.
translation: 没人会路过这。这条路没法路过，你只会发觉你走了条死路。

original: The only bastards that still pass through are the Family. They're some lowlife gangers who've been giving us a hell of a lot of trouble lately.
translation: 只有那群家族恶棍才从这过，那群最近给我们惹了好多麻烦的下贱流氓。

original: They're the reason for my itchy trigger finger.
translation: 他们就是我手痒想开枪的原因。

original: I'm looking for Ian West. Have you seen him?
translation: 我正在找伊恩·维斯特，你见过他吗？

original: I haven't seen any of the Wests since we were told to head indoors.
translation: 我自从被告知待在屋里后，就再没见过任何维斯特家的人。

original: Nope. Everyone stays inside, except Evan King of course.
translation: 没有，所有人都待在屋里，当然除了埃万·金。

original: If I recall he and the boys are probably at the lake fishing. Those rapscallions! There's no telling what monkeyshines they'll get into next!
translation: 如果没记错他和那群人应该在湖边打鱼。那群流氓！谁知道他们下一步会做出什么来！

original: I had always assumed if a human happened upon our home, it would be for the purpose of our extermination.
translation: 我一直以为如果有人类接近我们的家，就是来屠杀我们的。

original: It appears my fears were ill-placed. It is a pleasant surprise to meet someone as amenable as yourself.
translation: 看来我的担心是错误的。能碰见像你这样通情达理的人真是让人惊奇。

original: Very well. I will allow you to speak to Ian. Perhaps you can help him come to grips with his greatest enemy. Himself.
translation: 很好，我会让你去找伊恩谈。或许你能帮他对付他最大的敌人。他自己。

original: Now that I have a better understanding of the Family, may I speak to Ian?
translation: 现在我对家族有了了解，我可以和伊恩谈谈吗？

original: I believe I was very clear when I said you are not welcome to see him.
translation: 我想我说的很清楚了，我们不欢迎你去见他。

original: Please allow me to speak to Ian.
translation: 请让我和伊恩谈谈。

original: Ah yes, my newest charge. What would you want with him?
translation: 啊，是的，那个新来的孩子。你找他做什么？

original: I've been searching for a young man named Ian West.
translation: 我在找一个叫伊恩·维斯特的年轻人。

original: I'm afraid Vance has him in isolation and there is no way I'm going to override Vance's orders.
translation: 恐怕万斯正让他独处，我可不会违抗他的命令。

original: He's a good kid. I think Vance will set him along the correct path soon... like he did for all of us.
translation: 他是个好孩子，我想万斯会引导他走上正路的……就像他引导我们那样。

original: Like I said, he's in isolation. It's his time to meditate and reflect.
translation: 我说过，他在独处，这是他专门用来冥想和反省的时间。

original: Anything else you can tell me about Ian West?
translation: 你可以和我说说关于伊恩·维斯特的其他事吗？

original: Vance has him in meditation right now. No one's supposed to be in there.
translation: 万斯正让他冥想，不许任何人进去。

original: Poor kid... he looks like he could use another friend.
translation: 可怜的孩子……看上去他需要一个朋友。

original: Nope. Like I told ya, Vance has him in meditation right now. No one's supposed to be in there.
translation: 不行，我告诉过你了，万斯正让他冥想，不许任何人进去。

original: Anything else you can tell me about Ian West?
translation: 你可以和我说说关于伊恩·维斯特的其他事吗？

original: I don't have any authority here. I'm pretty new myself.
translation: 我在这没有任何权力，我只是个新人。

original: Justin's been trying to talk to Ian; make him feel better. Maybe you should speak to him.
translation: 贾斯汀正试着跟伊恩谈话使他好过一些。或许你应该去找他。

original: Do I look like a fucking babysitter? I don't know where he is. Even if I did, I wouldn't tell you anyway.
translation: 我他妈的像个保姆吗？我不知道他在哪，就算知道，也绝不会告诉你。

original: Ian, Ian, Ian! Is that all you've got to say? Sheesh.
translation: 伊恩，伊恩，伊恩！你就只会说这些吗？天啊。

original: Anything else you can tell me about Ian West?
translation: 你可以和我说说关于伊恩·维斯特的其他事吗？

original: Ian? What do you want from him?
translation: 伊恩？你找他干嘛？

original: No, just that Vance said he isn't to be disturbed while he's in meditation.
translation: 不，只是万斯说过他在冥想的时候不能被打扰。

original: Anything else you can tell me about Ian West?
translation: 你可以和我说说关于伊恩·维斯特的其他事吗？

original: What kind of trouble?
translation: 什么样的麻烦？

original: Well at first they'd do typical gang bullshit. You know, break stuff and make lots of noise, but they always kept their distance.
translation: 开始他们只做些小混混的勾当。你知道，打烂东西，发出噪声，但是一直离的很远。

original: But this last time, they went too far. They killed all of our Brahmin! I mean, that's our lifeblood out here you know!
translation: 但这最近的一次，他们做得太过分了。他们把我们的双头牛都杀了！我意思是，你也知道它们是我们的生计来源！

original: What's the word around town?
translation: 镇上有什么传闻？

original: Moriarty pisses in his still -- crazy bastard thinks it's hilarious. Besides, you'll get your throat cut in that pit. You're much better off here.
translation: 莫里亚蒂往他的酒里撒尿 — 这疯子认为这很搞笑。除此之外，你还可能在他的酒窖里被干掉，所以你最好离开这。

original: Hey, maybe I'll put that on the sign out front: "The Brass Lantern: Cleaner, safer, and less likely to have piss in the drinks".
translation: 嗨，或许我应该在这前面竖块牌子：“黄铜灯：更清洁，更安全，酒里面的尿更少”。

original: People've been sayin' that there's somethin' wrong with the water purifier. But Ol' Walter's been keepin' that thing runnin' for decades.
translation: 人们都说净化器出了什么问题，但老沃尔特已经让那东西连续运转几十年了。

original: I'm not worried. No reason it'd pick now to go down for good... would it?
translation: 我不担心，那东西没理由会在这时候出问题……对吧？

original: I own a saloon, kid. Rumors are part and parcel. So I'll give you this one for free...
translation: 我开着酒馆呢，孩子。闲话就跟常客似的。所以这条免费送你……

original: Not sure if you've met her, but Lucy West, that pretty young thing? She's afraid. Of what, of who, I couldn't say. But you can feel the fear on her.
translation: 不知道你见过她没，露西·维斯特，那个小美女？她很害怕。怕什么，怕谁，我说不上。但你能感觉到她的害怕劲儿。

original: News? My friend, I take effort not to be involved in such worldly business. Earthly pursuits distract from Atom.
translation: 传闻？我的朋友，我尽量不去跟这种世俗的东西扯上关系。这些世俗的追求让我对原子教分心。

original: Of course... now that you mentioned it, I've noticed that Moira has hired a mercenary to protect her goods -- the man never sleeps. So they say.
translation: 当然了……既然你这么问了，我有点注意到莫伊拉雇了个佣兵帮忙看着她的货物 — 据说那人从不睡觉。

original: What's the news?
translation: 有什么消息吗？

original: I already told you about the Stahl boy's drug problem. You said you wanted to help.
translation: 我已经告诉过你斯塔尔那孩子嗑药的事了，你说过你会帮忙的。

original: That's about all the confidences I'm going to break for you, stranger.
translation: 这就是所有我能对你敞开的心里话了，陌生人。

original: What do you know about the people here?
translation: 你了解这的人吗？

original: A doctor doesn't talk about his patients. At least not to strangers, he doesn't.
translation: 医生不跟别人谈论他的病人，至少不跟陌生人谈，没得商量。

original: What do you know about the people here?
translation: 你了解这的人吗？

original: I ain't heard much. Truth be told, I don't really ever leave the Lantern. Too much work, too few hours in the day, y'know?
translation: 我没听到多少。老实讲，我没什么机会离开黄铜灯，工作太多而时间太少，懂吗？

original: Remember what I told you, kid: Moriarty keeps his money locked up right next to his bed.
translation: 记住我告诉你的，孩子：莫里亚蒂把钱锁在他床头右侧的柜子里。

original: A little drinkin' money might loosen my lips a bit. Give it a try. See what happens.
translation: 如果你能给我钱买杯酒的话，或许能松开我的嘴。试试吧，看看你能得到什么。

original: Hey, I'm not much of a mudslinger. I don't like to spread stuff around, you know what I mean? Everybody has their secrets. Let's keep them that way.
translation: 嗨，我可不是背后说人坏话的那种人。我没兴趣散布什么留言，懂我的意思吗？每个人都有秘密，所以我们最好别声张。

original: I'm sorry, I just haven't been paying any attention at all since Nathan died.
translation: 我很抱歉，内森的死让我无法回过神来。

original: There's only one thing that concerns me in this town these days: what my damn fool husband is doing.
translation: 这几天镇子里唯一让我心烦的事就是：我那该死的白痴老公在干嘛。

original: He wanders around here all day and all night, preaching about the Enclave and tryin' to get parts for his guns.
translation: 他白天晚上都在这附近转来转去，一边向人讲述英克雷的故事，一边收集他那把枪的零件。

original: I'm not sure who's the bigger fool, him or me. After all, I married him.
translation: 我不知道他和我哪个更傻，毕竟，我嫁给了他。

original: I'm not one to gossip, but I do know a few things. For instance, did you hear that Lucas wants someone to disarm our bomb?
translation: 我不是爱说闲话的人，但我确实知道些什么。比如，你听说卢卡斯在找人拆除那核弹吗？

original: Imagine the blasphemy! I can't believe it! I mean, I don't believe it. He would never do that to us.
translation: 那是种侮辱！我无法相信！嗯，我根本不相信！他绝不会对我们做这种事的。

original: Sure, you got the purifier working right again, but if it runs out of water to pump then we're still screwed.
translation: 当然，你让过滤器重新开始工作了，但如果水泵把水抽干了，我们还是会头疼。

original: Well, people've been sayin' that the water purifier's about to go. Honestly, I'll tell you what I tell them.
translation: 嗯，人们都在说净化器就要能运作了。坦白说，我会对你说和对他们一样的话。

original: I've been keeping that wreck going for thirty-five years and this is the first time I've ever had a problem I couldn't fix.
translation: 我已经负责维护这东西有35年了，但这还是头一次我不知道该怎么修。

original: I couldn't tell you, really. I'd talk to Manya if you care that much. She's lived in Megaton longer than anyone.
translation: 我真的没法告诉你。如果你那么在意应该去找曼雅，她在兆吨镇里住得比任何人都久。

original: It used to be that you could ask Manya just about anything. Now that she's gone, I don't know what to tell you...
translation: 以前你可以去问曼雅任何事，现在她死了，我不知道我还能告诉你什么……

original: Let's cut to the chase. How much for you to tell me where my father is?
translation: 让我们开门见山，多少才能让你告诉我父亲去了哪？

original: You catch on quick, kid. That's the way of it out here, for sure. You want something, you take it. Or you pay in cold, hard caps. Say... 100.
translation: 你领悟得很快，孩子，无疑这就是这儿的规矩。你想要什么东西的话，要么直接拿走，要么乖乖地付冰冷实在的瓶盖。比如……100个。

original: Seems a fair price to facilitate a family reunion. Don't you think?
translation: 能让一个家庭重新团聚，这价位很合理了，不是吗？

original: Tell me where he is, Moriarty, or I'll beat it out of you!
translation: 告诉我他去哪了，莫里亚蒂。否则我打到你说。

original: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Oh, kid... ah... I'll let that one go, chalk it up to youthful arrogance.
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！哦，孩子……啊……我就饶了你这次，算是原谅年轻人的傲慢吧。

original: Listen carefully. I don't know what Sheriff Simms told you, but this is my town. Simms, he's a facade. An illusion of order I allow to exist.
translation: 仔细听着，我不知道西姆斯警长跟你说了什么，但这是我统治的镇子。西姆斯，他只是个傀儡，一个我允许存在的傀儡。

original: I was slinging drinks and killing Raiders here in Megaton when the good sheriff was just an idiot kid with cowboy fantasies.
translation: 当那大警长还是个沉迷装扮成牛仔的小屁孩的时候，我就在兆吨镇里买醉和杀歹徒了。

original: Raise a hand to me, and you'll never leave this town alive. Now, as for your dad... 100 caps, and I sing.
translation: 要你敢对我动手的话，我会让你直着进来，横着出去。至于你父亲的事……100个瓶盖，我就说。

original: Look, I just want to find my Dad. Do you know where he is?
translation: 我只是想找到我父亲，你知道他去了哪吗？

original: You seem like a nice kid, so I'm going to be straight with you.
translation: 你看上去是个好孩子，所以我坦白和你说。

original: Your dad was here, and now he's not, and yes I know where he went. But what you're asking me for is information, and information is a commodity.
translation: 你的父亲曾在这，现在他离开了。没错，我当然知道他去哪了。但你是在向我索要消息，而消息是一种商品。

original: Let's say... 100 caps, and daddy's location is yours. Very reasonable.
translation: 这么说吧……100个瓶盖，你就会知道你父亲的去向了，很划算。

original: You're lying. The Vault's been sealed for 200 years!
translation: 你撒谎，避难所已经关闭了200多年。

original: Ha ha ha ha ha! God in Heaven, would you listen to yourself? Do you honestly believe that's true? The lies they've put into that head of yours....
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈！天上的主啊，你在自圆其说吗？你真的相信那是真的吗？真的相信他们的胡扯……

original: Your father brought you to the Vault right after you were born. To keep you safe, you see. I remember it well -- you stayed in my saloon, after all.
translation: 在你出生后不久，你父亲就带你去了避难所。这是为了你的安全，我记得很清楚 — 你毕竟在我的酒吧里待过。

original: That's right. Your father, his Brotherhood of Steel friend, and you, the suckling babe with nary a tit to suckle. Sorry about your mum. Truly.
translation: 是的，你父亲，和他在钢铁兄弟会的朋友，还有你这乳臭未干的小子。至于你的母亲，真的很抱歉。

original: But, no matter. That big round door has opened now, hasn't it? Daddy's gone, and you need to know why. Could be I know where, and why....
translation: 但无论如何，那扇大圆门已经打开了，对吧？父亲出走了，而你想知道为什么，而我则是那个知道他去了哪以及为什么去的人……

original: Tell me what you know! Tell me everything!
translation: 你知道什么都告诉我！所有！

original: Ah, temper, temper. And your father was so reserved. Take after our mum, do we? God rest her soul.
translation: 冷静，想想你父亲多稳重。缅怀下你母亲吧。愿主令她的灵魂安息。

original: But all least you've got balls. Yeah, I know your dad, met him when you were just a baby, when you two passed through here on your way to the Vault.
translation: 但至少你还有种。嗯，我认识你父亲，在你还是一个婴儿的时候就见过他。那时候你们在去避难所的路上，正好经过这里。

original: You look shocked. You didn't think you were born in that hole, did you? Good Christ, boy. Know the truth, and it will set you free.
translation: 你看上去挺惊讶的。你不会认为自己是在那洞里出生的，对吗？上帝保佑，明白真相会让你解脱的。

original: Ah, temper, temper. And your father was so reserved. Take after our mum, do we? God rest her soul.
translation: 冷静，想想你父亲多稳重。缅怀下你母亲吧。愿主令她的灵魂安息。

original: But all least you've got spunk. Yeah, I know your dad, met him when you were just a baby, when you two passed through here on your way to the Vault.
translation: 但至少你还有种。嗯，我认识你父亲，在你还是一个婴儿的时候就见过他。那时候你们在去避难所的路上，正好经过这里。

original: You look shocked. You didn't think you were born in that hole, did you? Ah, Lord.... Know the truth, and it will set you free.
translation: 你看上去挺惊讶的。你不会认为自己是在那洞里出生的，对吗？上帝保佑，明白真相会让你解脱的。

original: Huh? My father and I were born in Vault 101...
translation: 呃？我父亲和我都出生在101号避难所里……

original: Is that what your father told you? That you were born in that hole? That HE was born there as well?
translation: 你父亲那么跟你说的？说你是在那洞里出生的？而且他也是的？

original: Oh, the lies we tell to those we love.
translation: 哦，我们总是对所爱的人撒谎。

original: Your father brought you to the Vault right after you were born. To keep you safe, you see. I remember it well -- you stayed in my saloon, after all.
translation: 在你出生后不久，你父亲就带你去了避难所。这是为了你的安全，我记得很清楚 — 你毕竟在我的酒吧里待过。

original: That's right. Your father, his Brotherhood of Steel friend, and you, the suckling babe with nary a tit to suckle. Sorry about your mom. Truly.
translation: 是的，你父亲，和他在钢铁兄弟会的朋友，还有你这乳臭未干的小子。至于你的母亲，真的很抱歉。

original: But, life goes on. Daddy lied. Life's full of little disappointments. And now... you're all grown up, and wondering where he's gone to....
translation: 但，日子总要过下去。你父亲骗了你，正如生命里总是有这样那样的失望一样。现在……你长大了，想去找你的父亲……

original: I was kidding! Dad talked about you all time. Now really, where is he? <Lie.>
translation: 我刚才开玩笑呢！爸爸总是说起你。到底他去了哪？<撒谎>

original: Did he? Well, our time together was brief, but... that is the way of it out here. When a bond is forged, little else matters, hmm?
translation: 真的吗？好吧，我们在一起的时间不长，但……这儿有这儿的习俗。当兄弟关系确定下来后，其他什么就不重要了，是吧？

original: Well, he did come through here, but he left. I'm truly sorry. But maybe you can catch up to him?
translation: 嗯，他确实到这来过，但他已经走了。我真的很抱歉，但你或许可以追上他？

original: He headed southeast, into the city. Said he needed information from those loonies at the station. You know, Galaxy News Radio, what there is of it.
translation: 他往东南方走了，到市区里去了。他说他要找电台里那疯子问点事。你知道的，就是银河新闻电台。

original: I met a man named Burke. He said he'd pay me to rig the bomb to explode.
translation: 我遇到了一个叫伯克的男人。他说愿意付我钱让我去引爆那核弹。

original: He said what?! Oh, I never did like the look of him...
translation: 他说什么？哦，我从没对他那样的人有过好感……

original: I told you: Stop playing games with me. Now, run along before I decide to throw you in a cell for disturbing the peace.
translation: 我告诉过你了：别和我耍花招。现在，在我把你以危害和平的罪名抓起来之前滚开。

original: Actually, Burke really does want to blow up Megaton.
translation: 事实上，伯克确实想要炸掉兆吨镇。

original: What's on the menu?
translation: 菜单上都有什么？

original: Sorry, hon. The noodle stand is closed. If you want something, ask Leo in the restaurant.
translation: 抱歉，亲爱的。面馆关门了。要是你想吃点什么，去饭馆问问利奥吧。

original: Here, take a look.
translation: 给，看看吧。

original: Hey, I won't say it's all fresh, but it'll keep you going.
translation: 嗨，虽然不全是新鲜的，但还是咽得下去的。

original: Have a look, most of it's edible -- some of it even tastes good!
translation: 来看看，大多都是可以吃的 — 有的甚至还很好吃！

original: Okay, Andy. I'll try.
translation: 好的，安迪，我会试试。

original: You really need to relax, Andy.
translation: 你真的需要放松一下，安迪。

original: People don't change, Jericho. Now order something and leave me alone.
translation: 人是不会变的，耶利哥。赶快点吃的，别老是烦我。

original: No, Jericho. Just no. Now leave me alone.
translation: 不，耶利哥，就是没门。现在让我清净会。

original: Sorry, hon. I'm a lifer here. Just go drink your drink.
translation: 抱歉，亲爱的。我只是个终身受困于此的人，喝你的酒去。

original: Then you best unhear it. I know all about you, old man. I'd be careful before I went around town spreading rumors about Raiders. You dig?
translation: 那你最好什么也没听见。我知道你的一切，老头。在我往镇子上散布歹徒的传闻前最好小心，你懂了吗？

original: You can tell me that when you're the one paying the bills, Leo.
translation: 利奥，你买单的时候可以告诉我。

original: Yeah, well I'm the one accountable for this place -- not you.
translation: 嗯，我是这地方的负责人 — 不是你。

original: Aw... you're no fun anymore, Andy.
translation: 嗷……你的玩笑开大了，安迪。

original: You know, it's not all about money, Andy.
translation: 你知道，这不全是钱的事，安迪。

original: *Sigh* All right, Billy. But you can't avoid the subject forever, you know...
translation: *叹气*好吧，比利，但你不能永远逃避，嗯……

original: Geez, Billy, you're so timid with this stuff. I won't be a kid forever, you know.
translation: 天啊，比利，你不能一直这么胆怯。你知道我不会一直是个孩子。

original: Yes sir, Mister Moriarty!
translation: 是的，莫里亚蒂先生！

original: Oh! Um... Y... Yes, sir!
translation: 哦！呃……好……好的，先生！

original: You're all heart, you know that, Colin?
translation: 你可真贴心呢，知道吗，科林？

original: Thanks a lot, Colin. I can always count on you for sympathy and respect.
translation: 多谢了，科林。我总能指望你的同情与尊重呢。

original: All right, all right! Stop your pathetic sniveling and just do what you're fucking told.
translation: 好了，好了！别哭得那么惨了，你他妈的该干嘛就干嘛。

original: Gob? If I hear one more excuse come out of that rotting mouth, I'm going to sew it shut. Okay? There's a good zombie.
translation: 盖博？如果我再听到你那烂嘴里吐出借口，就会把你的嘴缝起来，听到了吗？当个好丧尸就行。

original: Now don't you go getting all mushy on me! We just... We got to look out for each other, right?
translation: 别总来我这撒娇！我们得……我们得互相照料，对不对？

original: Hey, if we ain't going to look out for each other, what's the point? You think Colin gives a shit about us, Gob? Come on, sweetie, wake up.
translation: 嗨，如果我们不互相照顾的话，还能怎样？你难道觉得科林会把我们当回事，盖博？拜托，甜心，醒醒。

original: I know, Harden. I know. You make me proud every day, son. What can I say, you're just like your dad! He he he he he.
translation: 哈登，我知道。你每天都令我骄傲，我只能说，你真像你父亲，呵呵呵呵呵。

original: Hey, you think it's easy, seeing my little boy turn into a man? Ha ha ha ha! Don't grow up too quick on me, you hear!
translation: 嗨，看着我的小男孩长大成人，你以为很好受？哈哈哈哈！听着，别给我长得太快！

original: Jenny, baby. That was a long time ago. I've left all that behind me now.
translation: 珍妮，宝贝，那是很久以前的事了。现在我已经把它们都抛到脑后了。

original: Look, Jenny, that was years ago. I'm a different man now.
translation: 听着，珍妮，那是很多年以前的事了。我现在彻底变了。

original: If these books don't add up, I don't know how much money we have, then how are we supposed to stay in business? Would you just be more careful?
translation: 如果这些书不行，我不知道我们有多少钱，我们还怎么做生意？你做事仔细点好不好？

original: It's important, Leo! I have to keep our head above water here. Please, just try to be more careful.
translation: 这很重要，利奥！我不能让我们欠债，拜托，尽量小心。

original: Okay, dad. But I'm going to hold you to it, this time.
translation: 好的，爸爸。不过这次我会和你坚持下去。

original: You're kidding, right? You mean it this time? For real? Great! Great, dad, I can't wait! Thanks!
translation: 你开玩笑，对吧？你这次是认真的？真的？好极了！爸爸，我等不及了！谢谢！

original: Ha ha! I just love seeing you happy, sweetheart.
translation: 哈哈！甜心，真高兴看到你开心。

original: Well all right then! It's settled! I'll set my affairs in order, as they say, and we'll sit down and plan this thing out.
translation: 嗯，那好吧！就这么定了，就像他们说的我会梳理一下我的事务，然后我们坐下来订个计划出来。

original: Aggh! Damnit! But I've looked everywhere! *Sigh* All right. Thanks, I guess.
translation: 啊！该死！但我都找遍了！*叹气*好吧，谢谢，唉。

original: Well... damn. Thanks for nothing.
translation: 好吧……该死，多谢费心。

original: I hear things. I know a few people. What of it?
translation: 我听说过一些事，也知道一些人。怎么了？

original: Thank you, Nathan dear.
translation: 谢谢，亲爱的内森。

original: Don't you take that tone with me, mister! Now quit with the cranky old man act and help your poor wife out. Heavens...
translation: 别用那种口气对我说话，先生！现在抛开你的大男子主义去帮你可怜的老婆吧。天啊……

original: Oh, Nova. I've always trusted you to do the right thing, haven't I? If I didn't... you'd be dead.
translation: 诺瓦啊。我一直信任你会懂事，对吧？否则……你早就没命了。

original: Fine. But if we have this conversation again, I'll be forced to turn off the charm.
translation: 行了。但要是我们再为这事谈话，我可要关掉“温柔模式”了。

original: Nah... it's okay, Nova. I get it. No one wants anything to do with a crusty old Wasteland rat like me less'n they're getting' paid. I understand.
translation: 啊……没关系，诺瓦。我知道了，除非我愿意掏钱，否则不会有人愿意和我这喜怒无常的糟老头子扯上关系。我明白的。

original: But you think... I don't know... that you might get out of here some day? I got plenty of money, I could take care of you...
translation: 但你觉得……我不知道……或许有一天你会离开这？我有足够的钱可以照顾你……

original: Aw, Nova. I'd do anything for you. Well... I don't want to keep you. You're always so busy and...
translation: 哦，诺瓦。我愿意为你做任何事，嗯……我不会一直打扰你的，你一向很忙而且……

original: Anything for you, Nova. Anytime.
translation: 诺瓦，愿意效劳，随时都行。

original: No thanks. I'll find out on my own.
translation: 不，谢谢，我自己会处理的。

original: So you've said. And yet you came back once... Somehow I think we'll be having this conversation again. I look forward to it.
translation: 虽然你这么说，你终有一天会回到这里的……我总觉得我们还会聊起这话题的。我倒是挺期待的。

original: Will you? Well, good luck with that. So far as I know, I'm the only one your Dad told where he was going.
translation: 你会吗？好吧，祝你好运，据我所知，你父亲只把他的行程告诉了我一个人。

original: So, when you change your mind, come see me. I'm usually at the saloon. 100 caps... Daddy wouldn't think twice if it were you out there....
translation: 那好，如果你改变主意了，就来找我。我通常都在酒吧里。100个瓶盖……如果失踪的是你，你父亲可不会为这犹豫的。

original: All right, Moriarty. Here's 100 caps. Now where's my father?
translation: 好的，莫里亚蒂，这是100个瓶盖。现在告诉我我父亲去哪了？

original: Excellent! Your dad raised a smart kid. Really no substitute for the love of a father, now is there?
translation: 很好！你父亲有个很聪明的孩子。父爱的确是无价的，不是吗？

original: Speaking of dear old dad, he went southeast, into D.C. to the Galaxy News Radio station. Good luck now.
translation: 你亲爱的爸爸，他往东南方到特区去了，目的地是银河新闻电台，祝你好运。

original: I don't have 100 caps.
translation: 我没有100个瓶盖。

original: All right, kid. Let me help you out, you know... for old time's sake.
translation: 好了，孩子。让我帮帮你吧，嗯……看在和你爸的老交情的份上。

original: If you don't have the caps to pay for the information, then maybe you could do a little favor for me.
translation: 如果你没有足够的钱用来交换信息，那么或许你可以帮我点小忙。

original: I want to buy a drink.
translation: 我想来杯喝的。

original: No problem at all. I'll take care of you until that lazy zombie wakes up to do his job.
translation: 完全没问题。在那懒散的丧尸起床工作之前让我为你服务吧。

original: Tell it to Gob, he'll get you whatever you need.
translation: 跟盖博说去，他会给你弄想要的。

original: Then you need to talk to Gob. Don't worry, he doesn't drip into the drinks... much.
translation: 你需要去找盖博，别担心，他不会喝醉的……至少不会太醉。

original: Sounds like you're pretty screwed. You're on your own.
translation: 听起来你喝醉了。你还是靠自己吧。

original: Fine. That's what I've come to expect from strangers. Always thinking of themselves.
translation: 嗯，好，我就知道陌生人都会这样的，只顾自己。

original: Why don't you just get out of Arefu? I've got a road to watch.
translation: 你干嘛不滚出阿雷富？我还要盯着来路呢。

original: Playing games with me, huh? Fine. I got better things to do.
translation: 逗我玩，呃？够了，我有更重要的事做。

original: Nope. You're still on your own.
translation: 不。你还是要靠自己。

original: I'd be glad to help. What do you need?
translation: 我很愿意帮忙，你需要我做什么？

original: I don't want to take my eyes off the ramp here. There's no telling when the Family will return.
translation: 我得盯着这石桥，不能干别的，谁知道家族什么时候会杀回来。

original: Can you do me a favor and check on the other people's houses here? You know, make sure they're doing okay.
translation: 你能不能帮我个忙？去走访一下其他人，确认下是否他们都没事。

original: Speak with Davis West, Karen Schenzy and Ken Ewers.
translation: 去大卫·维斯特，卡伦·森奇和肯·尤尔斯家里问问情况吧。

original: Who did you think I was?
translation: 你以为我是谁？

original: I thought you were one of the Family. They're some lowlife gangers who've been giving us a hell of a lot of trouble lately.
translation: 我以为你是家族的一员，最近那群下贱的流氓总是给我们惹很多麻烦。

original: They're the reason for my itchy trigger finger.
translation: 他们就是我手痒想开枪的原因。

original: Why is this place called Gary's Galley?
translation: 为什么这家店叫做加里厨房？

original: It's named after my dad. He's dead. I used to help him run it, but now it's just me.
translation: 这是以我父亲的名字命名的。他已经过世了，我曾经帮他一起经营，但现在只有我撑着了。

original: It's named after my dad. He's a great cook.
translation: 这是以我父亲的名字命名的。他可是个伟大的厨师。

original: You're too chicken to run away.
translation: 你胆子太小，所以你不敢离家出走。

original: Shut up, butt wipe.
translation: 闭嘴，擦屁虫。

original: Stop saying that, butt face.
translation: 别说了，屁脸。

original: Oh, yeah? I'll show you! I'll show all of you. My mother will be sorry.
translation: 哦，嗯？我会让你瞧瞧！让你们都瞧瞧。我母亲会后悔的。

original: Welcome to Tenpenny Tower! Don't do anything stupid.
translation: 欢迎来到特佩尼大厦！记住千万不要做蠢事。

original: You can tell Tenpenny he can kiss my ass! We got plenty of bottlecaps! Let me in, goddamnit!
translation: 你可以让特佩尼来给我舔屁股！我们有的是钱！让我进去， 该死！

original: How many times do we have to go through this? You're not getting in!
translation: 我们要重复多少遍才行？不准你进入！

original: I can stand here all day yelling at you through this damn speaker if I have to!
translation: 如果有必要的话，我会在这通过这该死的扩音器骂你一整天！

original: I've already told you Tenpenny won't allow zombies to live here!
translation: 我告诉过你了，丧尸不允许住在特佩尼这！

original: Who the hell are you calling a zombie?
translation: 见鬼。你叫谁丧尸？

original: You're definitely not human, that's for damn sure. For the last time: NO ZOMBIES ALLOWED!
translation: 你显然不是人类，不用该死的废话。最后再说一次：不准丧尸进入！

original: Can't tell the difference between me and a feral? Fine. I'll show you the goddamn difference! Just you wait! You'll get yours. All of you!
translation: 你难道看不出来我跟该死的凶悍僵尸的不同吗？好吧，我会让你们明白的！你等着，你们所有人都会有报应的！

original: Just let me in already!
translation: 赶快让我进去！

original: Nope. Now get the hell out of here.
translation: 不行，现在快滚。

original: Tenpenny is expecting me. I'm a new tenant. <Lie.>
translation: 特佩尼正等着我呢，我是新来的租户。<撒谎>

original: Nice try kid! I know everyone who lives here, even the new ones. It's my job, and I take my job very seriously.
translation: 想法不错，孩子！不过我认识所有住在这的人，包括新来的。这是我的工作，而且我工作起来很认真。

original: It's also my job to deal with anyone I consider a threat to Mister Tenpenny or his property. Feel free to stand there all day. I don't care.
translation: 干掉可能威胁特佩尼先生和他的财产的人同样是我的工作，愿意的话你就整天站在那吧。我无所谓。

original: I have a lucrative offer for Tenpenny. Let me in, or you'll come to regret it.
translation: 我有个很赚钱的生意想找特佩尼。让我进去，否则你会后悔的。

original: Just a minute. Let's not be hasty. If Tenpenny is interested in what you have to say, I suppose you should get your chance.
translation: 等一下，别着急。如果特佩尼对你说的有兴趣，我想你会有机会入内的。

original: Though, he normally conducts all his business through Mister Burke. If Tenpenny doesn't want to talk to you, then you best leave him alone.
translation: 他一般都通过伯克先生接生意。如果特佩尼不想理你，你最好掉头就走。

original: If you bother Mister Tenpenny or any of his residents, I will be very glad to forcibly show you out. Do we understand each other? Good.
translation: 如果你给特佩尼先生或其他住户惹麻烦，我会很乐意地把你踢出去的。明白了吗？

original: I'm here to see Tenpenny.
translation: 我是来见特佩尼的。

original: Hahaha! That's rich. What would a man like Tenpenny want to do with a Waste-rat like you?
translation: 哈哈哈！真有意思，你知道特佩尼先生会怎么对待你这样的野老鼠吗？

original: Open the damn gate! I'm done being interrogated by you!
translation: 打开这该死的门！我已经被你问得够多了！

original: You're really not in a position to be threatening me. I'm safe on the other side of this wall, and you are out there, exposed and unsafe.
translation: 你没本钱可威胁我。我在墙里，很安全，而你在外，暴露在危险中。

original: You have a lot to learn, kid. I think I'll let the Wasteland teach it to you. Try not to die out there!
translation: 你还有很多要学的，孩子。我看还是让废土教教你吧。尽量别死在路上！

original: Come on, let me in. Just for a little while. I won't cause any trouble.
translation: 拜托，让我进去，只要一会就好，我不会惹麻烦的。

original: You're not getting in. Stop trying. It's not working. I'm done talking to you.
translation: 你不能进来，不用再试了，没用的。我要说的就这些。

original: Good luck out there!
translation: 祝你逢凶化吉！

original: That's where you're mistaken. Does 100 caps sound about right?
translation: 这就是你的不对了。100个瓶盖怎么样？

original: You're poor, and stupid. Count your damn purse before you go offering people gifts.
translation: 你这下贱的蠢货，在给别人送礼之前先该死的数数钱。

original: Tell you what. You manage to scrape together 100 caps, and I'll let you in to look around a little.
translation: 告诉你，想办法去搞100个瓶盖来，我可以允许你在这看看。

original: Perhaps you'll fit in around here better than I thought. Alright. I'll take your money. But don't press your luck. I got my eye on you.
translation: 或许你比我想的更适合这里。好吧，我收下你的钱，但别想乘机占便宜，我会盯着你的。

original: Don't bother Tenpenny or the other residents. If you so much as sneeze in the wrong direction... I'll gut you!
translation: 别打扰特佩尼或其他的居民。哪怕你只是向错误的地方打了个喷嚏，我都会干掉你。

original: I just want to look around a little. Come on. I won't hurt anybody.
translation: 我只是在想这看看，拜托，我不会伤害任何人的。

original: This ain't a theme park, kid. And even if it was, you wouldn't be able to afford the admission. Now bugger off!
translation: 这不是游乐场，孩子。即便是，你也付不起门票。快走吧，要饭的！

original: You going to let me in or not?
translation: 你到底让不让我进去？

original: Listen. Like I've told those Ghouls a thousand times, I can't just let in every drifter that lands at the gate.
translation: 听着，就像我跟那群僵尸重复过无数遍那样，任何到这来的流浪者都不得入内。

original: You got a reason to be here, or what?
translation: 你来这是有什么原因的吧？

original: I kill Ghouls and rent-a-cops with attitudes who ask too many questions.
translation: 我只杀尸鬼和那些有问不完的问题的。

original: Oh ho! Looks like we got a live one here! I think we better leave this one outside. Good bye, kid. Try not to get eaten by anything out there.
translation: 霍霍！看上去我们逮了个活的！我们还是把他留在外面吧。再见了，孩子，希望你别被什么东西吃掉。

original: I've killed so many Ghouls, I've stopped counting.
translation: 我杀了太多的尸鬼，数都数不过来。

original: Is that so? Then I'm sure you can handle yourself out there in the Wasteland just fine. Are you done wasting my time?
translation: 真的吗？那你肯定能在废土里照顾好自己。你耽误够我们的时间了吗？

original: I can help take care of that little Ghoul problem for you.
translation: 我可以帮你们解决那些尸鬼的小问题。

original: Is that so? And why should I believe that? You ever kill a Ghoul before?
translation: 真的吗？我们凭什么相信你？你以前杀过僵尸吗？

original: I don't think you're talking to the person you think you are.
translation: 我不认为你在跟你以为的那人说话。

original: Oh? Thought you were that damn Ghoul. Well then. Back to business as usual. Ahem...
translation: 哦？我以为你是那该死的僵尸呢。那好，公事公办，唔……

original: You are trespassing on Allistair Tenpenny's private property. Renters and official business only.
translation: 你正在非法入侵奥利斯特·特佩尼的私人产业。只有租户和做大生意的人才能入内。

original: Do you kiss your mother with that mouth?
translation: 你就用这张臭嘴亲你妈吗？

original: What? Oh. Sorry 'bout that. I thought you were one of those damned Ghouls looking for a handout.
translation: 什么？哦，抱歉，我以为你是那些该死的等待救济的僵尸。

original: You are currently trespassing on Allistair Tenpenny's private property. You have some reason to be here?
translation: 你正在非法入侵奥利斯特·特佩尼的私人产业。你来这有什么事吗？

original: Is that how you treat all your guests?
translation: 这就是你对待客人的方式？

original: What? No, just those damn Ghouls. Sorry, thought you were one of them.
translation: 什么？不，只是那些该死的僵尸。抱歉，我以为你也是僵尸。

original: Ghoul or not, I must inform you that you are trespassing on Allistair Tenpenny's private property. Renters and official business only.
translation: 不管是不是僵尸，我必须通知你现在正在非法入侵奥利斯特·特佩尼的私人产业。只有租户和做大生意的人才能入内。

original: I don't care who you think you are. You're not getting in down there.
translation: 我才不管你觉得自己是谁，反正你不能进来。

original: I've got the only key, and I ain't lending it to you. I lost it once and had to make a new one. Tenpenny practically bit my head off. So forget it.
translation: 唯一的钥匙在我手里，我不会给你的。有一次我丢了一把去配新的，结果特佩尼差点把我的脑袋拧下来了。所以别白费劲了。

original: Look, I'm not an idiot. I won't break anything.
translation: 哈，我不是个白痴。我不会透露任何事。

original: That's awfully brash of you! You think you got what it takes?
translation: 你可真够无礼的！你以为这样能行？

original: The trick to "exploring" is to make sure no one knows you've done it. My neighbors, for instance, have no idea that I know so much about them!
translation: “探索”的技巧在于确保没人知道事情是你干的。举个例子吧，我的那些邻居从来都不知道我有多了解他们。

original: I'll make you a deal kid. You can borrow my key, IF you can find it without letting me see you take it. Good luck!
translation: 我们来做个交易，孩子。如果你能在我没发现的情况下拿走钥匙，那就借给你。好运！

original: You want Gustavo to catch you with that? Better let me hold onto it, old man.
translation: 你想要古斯塔沃抓住你吗？最好不要让我说出来，老头。

original: I've got the only key, and I ain't lending it to you. I lost it once and had to make a new one. Tenpenny practically bit my head off. So forget it.
translation: 唯一的钥匙在我手里，我不会给你的。有一次我丢了一把去配新的，结果特佩尼差点把我的脑袋拧下来了。所以别白费劲了。

original: If I promise not to touch anything, will you let me in?
translation: 如果我保证不碰任何东西，你会让我进去吗？

original: Well, it does get a trifle bit boring around here, and to spice things up I like to do a little... exploring.
translation: 好吧，这确实有点无聊，为了增加点趣味，让我来点小小的……探索吧。

original: Oh, I always put everything back! Well, almost everything. I occasionally keep a memento... like Gustavo's key to the generator room.
translation: 哦，我总是会把东西都放回原处！嗯，几乎都放回原处。有时候我也会保留些纪念品……比如说古斯塔沃的发电室钥匙。

original: Have you noticed how he turns a delightful shade of purple when he's angry?
translation: 你注意到他生气的时候脸就会变成可爱的紫色吗？

original: Well, kid. There're two keys floating around. Which one do you think you can nab without getting caught? Good luck!
translation: 好了，孩子。总共有两把钥匙，你觉得你能神不知鬼不觉地偷到哪一把？祝你好运！

original: Are you suggesting what I think you're suggesting?
translation: 你暗示的意思和我心里想的一样吗？

original: What?!
translation: 什么？！

original: That area is strictly off limits. Can't have people fooling around with the terminal down there. They could shut off power and open the escape door.
translation: 那地方禁止入内。不能让人在那里瞎逛，他们可能会切断电源，并且打开紧急出口的。

original: What can you tell me about the basement?
translation: 你能和我说说地下室的事吗？

original: That area is off limits to residents and visitors. Only Gustavo and authorized technicians are allowed down there.
translation: 那地方禁止住户和游客入内。只有古斯塔沃和获得授权的技工可以进去。

original: That emergency access door is currently keeping out Ghouls and other vermin. So you can see why people aren't allowed to picnic down there.
translation: 紧急出口现在被用来隔绝僵尸和其他混蛋。所以，你应该可以理解那地方为什么要禁止入内。

original: I've heard this place has a basement. How do I get to it?
translation: 我听说这有个地下室。我怎么才能找到它？

original: You mean the generator room? What the hell do you need to know about that for? That area is strictly off limits.
translation: 你说发电机室？你他妈的问这干嘛？那禁止入内。

original: What can you tell me about the basement of Tenpenny Tower?
translation: 你能跟我说说特配尼大厦地下室的事吗？

original: You stay away from the generator room!
translation: 离发电机室远点！

original: What can you tell me about the basement of Tenpenny Tower?
translation: 你能跟我说说特佩尼大厦地下室的事吗？

original: I hear there're some tunnels underground for use in emergencies. Ask Gustavo, he's in charge of all those kinds of things.
translation: 我听说有个逃生用的地下隧道。去问古斯塔沃吧，他负责这些事。

original: Do you know anything about the basement?
translation: 你知道地下室的事吗？

original: There's those access tunnels that lead underground - those are sealed by a door... Then there is someplace down there where they keep the generators.
translation: 那里有一些隧道通向地底-通向那些管道的门是锁着的……那里还有一些地方放着发电机。

original: Occasionally something goes wrong down there and we lose power. Then Burke goes out and finds a technician. We haven't had any blackouts in a while.
translation: 有时候出了问题导致我们断电，伯克就会出去找技工回来处理。我们已经很久没遇上断电了。

original: If you want to get into the gen room, you'll need to talk to Gustavo. Though I doubt he'll take you on a tour, or let you wander around down there.
translation: 如果你想去发电机室，你得去找古斯塔沃。不过我觉得他不会给你当导游，也不会让你到那去游荡。

original: Hey doc, what do you know about the basement area?
translation: 嗨，你了解地下室的情况吗？

original: Why would I ever go to the basement? Talk to Gustavo about such nonsense.
translation: 我为什么要去地下室？和古斯塔沃说这些废话去。

original: You ever been to the basement?
translation: 你去过地下室吗？

original: Aha! So you've been exploring the tower! Well done! Let's just say that Gustavo's not the only one with a key for the generator room!
translation: 啊哈！看来你翻遍了整座大厦！干得好！我们就说应该不止古斯塔沃一个人有发电机室的钥匙。

original: Do you know anything about the basement and emergency tunnels?
translation: 你知道地下室和逃生隧道吗？

original: Bah! I thought you were more interesting than that. Fine. But you better not get caught with that!
translation: 算了吧！我觉得你都比那有趣。好吧，但你最好不要被抓住了！

original: I don't want to play games... Can I please just borrow the key?
translation: 我不想玩游戏……我能只借钥匙吗？

original: Only that they keep generators down there... and some kind of emergency escape tunnels.
translation: 他们把发电机装置在下面……还有一些用来紧急疏散的隧道。

original: Oh, you know who you should talk to? Comrade Dashwood. He knows this place like the back of his hand.
translation: 哦，你知道你在跟谁说话吗？达什伍德同志，他对这了如指掌。

original: Do you know anything about the basement level, comrade?
translation: 同志，你知道地下室的事吗？

original: What are you talking about? You mean the basement of Tenpenny Tower? What a random question. Why should I know anything about a basement?
translation: 你在说什么？你说特佩尼大厦的地下室？好无聊的问题。为什么我要知道地下室的事呢？

original: Why don't you run off and find Gustavo. I'm sure he could help you find whatever it is you're looking for.
translation: 你为什么不去找古斯塔沃。不管你在找什么东西，我肯定他都能帮上你。

original: What can you tell me about the basement?
translation: 你能和我说说地下室的事吗？

original: I haven't. But every so often Gustavo takes someone down there to work on the generators when we lose power. That hasn't happened in awhile, though.
translation: 没有，但偶尔断电的时候，古斯塔沃会带些人下去修理发电机。不过，已经好一阵子没有断过电了。

original: You ever go down to the basement?
translation: 你去过地下室吗？

original: Tunnels in the basement? No can't say that I do.
translation: 地下室里的隧道？我完全不知道。

original: Hold it! I do remember something about a bunch of escape tunnels in case of disaster or something. Or something about generators for power...
translation: 等一下！我确实想起来那有几条疏散用的隧道，是在发生意外事故时用的。那可能还有一些发电机……

original: You should talk to that old guy... you know, the famous one with the radio show about him... You know, What's-His-Name!
translation: 你应该去找那老家伙……嗯，那著名的……上过电台的家伙……呃，他叫什么名字来着！

original: Daring! Daring Dashwood! That's him. He's explored this whole place from top to bottom. Ask him about those tunnels. He'd know.
translation: 亲爱的！亲爱的达什伍德！就是他。他从上到下把这都摸索遍了。去问他那些隧道的事。他肯定知道。

original: I don't suppose you know anything about the basement? And some tunnels?
translation: 我猜你不知道有关地下室的情况吧，或者逃生隧道的事？

original: What do you take me for? Some greasy engineer? All I know is that's where they make the electricity.
translation: 你以为我是干什么的？满身油污的工程师吗？我只知道那是个发电的地方。

original: Why don't you go bother Gustavo? I'm sure he can handle whatever it is you need in the basement.
translation: 你为什么不去烦古斯塔沃？我相信他能帮你搞清楚那地下室里的一切。

original: Do you know much about what's in the basement?
translation: 你知道地下室里有什么东西吗？

original: Yeah, supposedly there's some kind of emergency access to the Metro tunnels.
translation: 嗯，据说那有通往地铁隧道的紧急入口。

original: It'd have to be a pretty big emergency to get me down there. That's for sure. There's all kinds of gross things that live in those tunnels.
translation: 除非有很紧急的情况，不然我不会下到那，毫无疑问。隧道里住的全都是那些恶心的东西。

original: Talk to Chief Gustavo if you want to know more. I think he's the only one that has a key.
translation: 如果你想知道更多，就去找古斯塔沃长官。估计他是唯一拿着钥匙的人。

original: You ever been to the basement? I hear there's an escape tunnel...
translation: 你去过地下室吗？我听说有一个逃生隧道……

original: Maybe try talking to Mister Tenpenny or Chief Gustavo. They're probably the ones who would know.
translation: 或许可以去找特佩尼先生或者古斯塔沃长官。如果有人知道，估计就是他们俩了。

original: Do you know how I can get into the basement?
translation: 你知道我怎么才能进地下室吗？

original: I told you Gob, it ain't the radio. The Enclave station comes in fine. It's Galaxy News. Their signal's been shit lately.
translation: 我告诉过你了，盖博，不是收音机的原因。英克雷电台还收得好好的。是银河新闻的原因，他们的信号太烂了。

original: Aw, forget it. I guess we're stuck with this Enclave crap.
translation: 噢，算了吧。我想我们没法拜托英克雷这破玩意了。

original: Aggh! Come on, you piece of junk! Every day, it's the same damn thing...
translation: 啊！拜托，你这垃圾！每天都是这种该死的事……

original: Come on!
translation: 来吧！

original: Stupid radio!
translation: 愚蠢的收音机！

original: Wait... is that...? Dammit!
translation: 等一下……那是……？该死的！

original: Work! Come on. Work!
translation: 工作！拜托，快工作！

original: Why... won't... you... work?
translation: 你……为什么……不……工作？

original: Goddamn radio!
translation: 该死的收音机！

original: Son of a bitch!
translation: 混蛋！

original: You should be in a sanitarium, or a prison! You're out of your damned mind! You just stay away from me, you hear me?
translation: 你应该被关到精神病院或者监狱去！你他妈的疯了！你离我远点，听见了吗？

original: What are you talking about? I haven't done anything...
translation: 你在说什么啊？我什么都没做……

original: I'm scaring YOU? After you beat that poor woman to death? You've really lost it, Janet. You're crazy!
translation: 我吓到了你？在你把那可怜的女人打死之后？你真是疯了，珍妮特。你疯了！

original: Roger, stop it. You're scaring me!
translation: 罗杰，别这样。你吓到我了！

original: How could you? How could you do that to her? Have you lost your mind?
translation: 你怎么可以？你怎么可以对她这么做？你疯了吗？

original: What on earth are you talking about, Roger?
translation: 罗杰，你到底在说什么？

original: My God... Janet, what have you done?
translation: 我的天啊……珍妮特，你都做了什么？

original: What do you know about Vault 87?
translation: 对于87号避难所，你都知道些什么？

original: That's behind the Back Door! The Back Door is my job, and I do it really well!
translation: 就在后门外。守卫后门也是我的工作，我也一直做得很好！

original: See what happens is, Mayor says he wants the door open. Then I help him because I'm good at it. It takes two of us to do it.
translation: 是这样的，镇长说他想把这扇门打开，我就帮他打开。我对这可很在行。这需要我们两个人来完成。

original: But only Mayor can say it's okay. You gotta talk to him, and then I'll help him.
translation: 但只有镇长才能批准。你得去找他谈，然后我才会帮他。

original: Not much, really. Mayor has us steer clear of the door to Murder Pass, just in case. If you go near it, you can hear them howling.
translation: 知道的不多。镇长让我们远离通往杀戮通道的门。如果你走近那，还能听见他们的嚎叫。

original: Can't hear much around the other door, though. I guess maybe there aren't as many back there. Doesn't matter much, though.
translation: 但是，在另一扇门附近听不到什么。我猜这是因为那边没有多少。不过这不重要了。

original: Yeah, I know that place. Yep, sure do. Monsters back there. Big, scary monsters. Lots of them. Tons, even.
translation: 嗯，我当然知道哪个地方。后面是些怪物，很大，很吓人的怪物。很多，甚至上千。

original: Are you going there? Are you? Are you gonna shoot 'em dead? I bet you are. That'll be so cool. Unless they eat your face. They do that, you know.
translation: 你要到那去？你确定？你要去干掉他们？你肯定是。那就太酷了，除非他们把你脸啃掉。嗯，他们会那样做的。

original: That's where the monsters come from. We don't go back there. It's called Murder Pass for a reason, you know?
translation: 怪物们就是从那来的。我们不到那后面去。那儿叫做杀戮通道是有原因的，你懂吗？

original: If you go that way, you're probably gonna get hurt. I can patch you up as long as it's not real bad.
translation: 你如果走那条路很可能会受伤的。只要不是特别严重，我倒是可以帮你包扎。

original: I don't know what that is, mister.
translation: 先生，我不知道那是什么。

original: Very well. We'll sort this all out.
translation: 很好。我们会解决这事的。

original: Yes. She knows what we need. Vault-Tec computer, something to locate equipment. Please help her.
translation: 是的，她知道我们需要什么，避难所科技电脑，用来定位设备。请协助她。

original: Yes. He knows what we need. Vault-Tec computer, something to locate equipment. Please help him.
translation: 是的，他知道我们需要什么，避难所科技电脑，用来定位设备。请协助他。

original: All right, Madison. It'll be okay. Now, this is James' daughter, I presume? I can see the resemblance.
translation: 好的，麦迪逊，会没事的。我想，这是詹姆斯的孩子，是吗？跟他很像。

original: All right, Madison. It'll be okay. Now, this is James' son, I presume? I can see the resemblance.
translation: 好的，麦迪逊，会没事的。我想，这是詹姆斯的孩子，是吗？跟他很像。

original: No, I don't think... I don't know. I just don't know what's happening anymore.
translation: 不，我想他们不知道……我不知道。我已经不知道在发生什么了。

original: Is that so? Does the Enclave know this?
translation: 是吗？英克雷知道这些吗？

original: That's not true. James... He found what's been missing. We know how to get it running.
translation: 不是这样。詹姆斯……他找到缺失的部分了。我们已经知道如何让它运作了。

original: Now now, calm down. You know as well as I do that the purifier doesn't work. It's useless to them. Perhaps it's time to walk away.
translation: 好，好，冷静一下。你我都知道那净化器不能用，对他们也一样没用。或许是时候放手了。

original: Then do something now! They've taken over the purifier. Lyons, they cannot be permitted to have control over it. It's not right!
translation: 那就现在做点什么！他们占领了净化器。里昂斯，不能让净化器落到他们手里！

original: Then it's as we feared. Madison, I'm sorry this happened. I wish we could have done something...
translation: 就像我们担心的那样，麦迪逊。我很抱歉发生了这样的事，我真希望我们当时能做点什么……

original: The Enclave. They've attacked Project Purity. James is dead... there may be more. I don't know. You have to do something!
translation: 是英克雷，他们袭击了净水工程。詹姆斯死了……可能还死了更多人，我不知道。你得做点什么！

original: Yes, I'd heard reports of an incident there. What details can you give us?
translation: 是的，我听到那边事件的报告了。你能具体给我们说说吗？

original: Don't talk down to me, Lyons. I had nowhere else to turn. You must help us. Project Purity has been overrun.
translation: 别居高临下地对我说话，里昂斯。我已经无处可去，你必须帮助我们。净水工程被占领了。

original: Madison, I'm surprised to see you here. What can I do for you?
translation: 麦迪逊，没想到会在这见到你。我能为你做什么吗？

original: Do you suspect your family is in danger?
translation: 你怀疑你家人有危险？

original: No... not really. Maybe my letters just aren't arriving. Whatever you can do to get it there would sure be appreciated.
translation: 不……并不是。没准只是我的信没寄到。你要是能帮我送过去，我会非常感激的。

original: Where is Arefu?
translation: 断桥镇在哪？

original: Arefu is northwest of Megaton on an old overpass over the Potomac. If you follow what's left of the river, you can't miss it.
translation: 断桥镇在兆吨镇西北方，在一座废弃的跨越波托马克河的高架公路上。你沿着河边那些废墟走，一定能找到的。

original: A job usually means I get paid.
translation: 工作通常伴随报酬。

original: Actually, I don't have any caps with me. I used everything I had buying a shack in this town.
translation: 事实上，我身边现在没有任何瓶盖。我把所有的钱都用来买这镇子上的一间小屋了。

original: But if you'd be nice enough to help me, I bet my father would pay you something for all the trip. What do you say?
translation: 但如果你肯好心帮助我的话，我父亲一定为你做的一切回报你的，你觉得怎样？

original: Nope, sorry.
translation: 不行，抱歉。

original: Alright. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意了，就回来找我。

original: Sure, why not.
translation: 当然，为什么不？

original: Great! I'd like you to deliver this message to my family in the Arefu Settlement. I haven't heard from them in months and I'm worried.
translation: 好极了！我需要你帮我给在断桥镇定居点的家人送个信。我已经有几个月没跟他们联系了，很担心他们。
