original: As soon as you get there, talk to Davis West. He'll be glad to pay you for the trip.
translation: 你一到那边就去找大卫·维斯特，他会很乐意付你报酬。

original: Today we hear the story of Saint Monica.
translation: 今天我们要讲圣莫尼卡的故事。

original: She was born in Great Lanta on the shores of the Ocean.
translation: 她在海边的大兰达出生。

original: Her parents were both Ghouls. Yes, that’s right, I said Ghouls.
translation: 她的双亲都是僵尸，是的，我说的是僵尸。

original: That she was conceived at all was a miracle. That she was born unafflicted was an even greater miracle.
translation: 她的父母能怀上她实在是个奇迹，而她被顺利生下来是个更大的奇迹。

original: God tested Saint Monica. She did not lead an easy life.
translation: 上帝锤炼着圣莫尼卡，她的一生充满坎坷。

original: Sold into slavery by Raiders, she was forced to sell her body.
translation: 被歹徒卖身为奴后，她被迫出卖自己的肉体。

original: They took her only son, Ehren, from her and sold him.
translation: 他们从她身边抓走了她唯一的儿子，艾仁，并把他卖掉了。

original: She prayed every night to God for his safety. She did not pray for herself, although her burden was great.
translation: 她每晚都向上帝祈祷她儿子能够平安。尽管她肩上的担子够重了，但她从不为自己祈祷。

original: Each night she would preach the word of God to the Slavers.
translation: 每天晚上她都要向上帝祈祷惩罚那些奴隶贩子。

original: After sixteen years, God provided a miracle.
translation: 16年之后，上帝恩赐了一个奇迹。

original: One of the Slavers repented his wicked ways and helped her to escape.
translation: 其中一个奴隶贩良心发现，帮她逃了出来。

original: Four years she looked for Ehren. Four years she wandered the Wasteland.
translation: 她花了四年去找艾仁。四年间，她在废土上到处流浪。

original: God looked over her in those years.
translation: 那些年来，上帝一直眷顾着她。

original: When she found her son, she found he was a wicked man.
translation: 当她最终找到她儿子时，却发现他已经变成了一个恶棍。

original: Ehren had overthrown his masters and taken their place. He was an owner of men.
translation: 艾仁推翻了他的主人并占据了他们的地盘，他拥有其他的人。

original: Ehren took his mother to be his slave, even knowing who she was, for Ehren blamed her for his painful early life.
translation: 即便知道她的身份，艾仁还是把他的母亲抓住当奴隶，因为艾仁认为自己童年的不幸是她的错。

original: Each day Ehren would think of a new and wicked trial to put her through.
translation: 每天艾仁都想尽办法折磨着她。

original: She would only smile at him and say, "I forgive you."
translation: 而她只是微笑着对他说，“我原谅你。”

original: Each morning she would be miraculously healed as if nothing had happened.
translation: 每天早上，她都会奇迹般地痊愈，就像什么也没发生过一样。

original: When Ehren truly realized her love and God's love was boundless, he flung himself at her feet and begged for Saint Monica’s forgiveness.
translation: 当艾仁最终意识到她的爱，还有上帝的爱是多么宽广的时候，他扑到她脚下，请求圣莫尼卡宽恕自己。

original: Ehren released all of his slaves, and they rejoiced.
translation: 艾仁释放了所有奴隶，大家欣喜若狂。

original: He repented all his wicked ways.
translation: 他为自己过去的恶行忏悔。

original: Who among us is without sin? Who among us can claim to be innocent?
translation: 咱们谁没有罪？谁敢说自己是无辜的？

original: Come, brothers and sisters, let us pray to God and Saint Monica for deliverance from our sins, as Ehren was delivered from his.
translation: 来吧，兄弟姐妹们，让我们祈祷上帝和圣莫尼卡宽恕我们的罪恶，就像艾仁救赎了他自己一样。

original: Amen. Let us pray.
translation: 阿门，让我们祈祷吧。

original: Let's discuss this bomb.
translation: 我们谈谈那核弹。

original: What about it?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Don't let me keep you.
translation: 别让我耽误你。

original: It's time for me to go.
translation: 我该走了。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: All right. What's on your mind?
translation: 好吧。你在想什么？

original: I've disarmed the bomb, Burke. That thing will never explode now.
translation: 我已经把那核弹解除了，伯克，那东西以后再也不会爆炸了。

original: You did WHAT? Are you out of your goddamned mind? Do you have any idea how long we've pained to put this plan into motion?
translation: 你做了什么？你该死的疯了吗？你不知道我们为了实施这计划付出了多大代价吗？

original: Weeks of preparation, destroyed. No words of mine can express my utter contempt for you.
translation: 经过数周的准备后，却被毁掉了。我已经无法形容对你厌恶的程度了。

original: You have made a very poor error in judgment, my friend. One day... one day it WILL come back to haunt you.
translation: 你做了一个错误的判断，我的朋友。有朝一日，你会得到报应的。

original: Messing with that bomb seems pretty technical. What if I can't do it?
translation: 摆弄那核弹可是个技术活，我要是办不到呢？

original: Lack the aptitude, you mean? You're not re-wiring the thing, just attaching the Pulse Charge to the detonator.
translation: 你说你没有经验吗？这没有关系，不需要你去接线，只要把这核融合脉冲电池接到雷管上就好。

original: If you get stumped, talk to Leo Stahl. He might have something to help you concentrate. He's got a bit of a reputation.
translation: 如果你被难到了，就去找利奥·斯塔尔。他或许能帮你集中精力，这方面他还是小有名气的。

original: I thought you knew what you were doing. If it's just nerves, maybe some chems will help. But if you can't handle it, don't go fiddling with it!
translation: 我想你知道你的情况，如果你只是紧张，吃点药就好了。但如果你没这本事，就别乱动那东西。

original: I'm not sure I can disarm the bomb.
translation: 我不确定我能解除那核弹。

original: We're talking a lot of innocent lives here, Burke. Can I warn them?
translation: 这关系到这众多无辜的生命，伯克。我能警告他们吗？

original: Absolutely not! The place, the people, they're one and the same! Sacrifices for a nobler future.
translation: 当然不能！这地方，这儿的人，他们是一个整体并且都是一样的，它们为了一个更荣耀的未来奉献着。

original: I assure you, they are worth ten times as much in death, as they are in life.
translation: 我向你保证，像他们那样的人，早就该死几十次了。

original: You're out of your mind, Burke. There's no way I'm helping you.
translation: 你疯了，伯克。我才不会帮你。

original: Now that is a disappointment. Well, if you change your mind, the offer still stands. Good day.
translation: 真令人失望。好吧，如果你改变主意了，随时欢迎你回来找我。再见。

original: I'm beginning to lose my patience with you. But the offer still stands should you come to your senses.
translation: 我正对你失去耐心。不过什么时候你想通了，随时可以回来找我。

original: I'm not going to do it.
translation: 我不会做的。

original: All right, Mister Burke. I'll do it. Megaton will burn.
translation: 好的，伯克先生，我会干。兆吨镇会化成灰的。

original: Excellent! I had a feeling about you. Here's the Fusion Pulse Charge. It needs to be installed inside the bomb.
translation: 很好！我没看错你。这是核聚变脉冲炸药，必须安在那核弹上。

original: When it's done, meet me at Tenpenny Tower. It's southwest of here, well out of harm's way. You can't miss it. Questions?
translation: 搞定后来特佩尼大厦见我。它在这的西南方，一个很安全的地方，你不会找不到的。还有问题吗？

original: Megaton is under my protection. You're going to leave... now.
translation: 我会保护兆吨镇的。你得离开这……立刻。

original: Oh. I see. I didn't realize Megaton had any guardian beyond its intrepid sheriff. Very well, then. I'll take my leave, as you suggested.
translation: 哦，我知道了。我从没想到兆吨镇除了那位勇敢的警长以外还有其他守卫。那好，我会按你说的很快离开。

original: Throw in an extra 500 caps, and you've got yourself a deal.
translation: 多给500个瓶盖，我们就成交。

original: Well played!  An extra 500 caps, in addition to the base fee, when Megaton lies in ruins. Here's the Fusion Pulse Charge. Place it in the bomb.
translation: 干得好！当兆吨镇成为废墟以后我会再付你额外的500个瓶盖。这是核聚变脉冲炸药，去安到那核弹上。

original: When it's done, meet me at Tenpenny Tower. It's southwest of here, well out of harm's way. You can't miss it. Any questions?
translation: 搞定后来特佩尼大厦见我。它在这的西南方，一个很安全的地方，你不会找不到的。还有问题吗？

original: You're a sick man, Burke. This conversation's over.
translation: 你真是疯了，伯克。我们的对话到此为止。

original: It seems I have misjudged you. Very well. I'll simply find someone with more entrepreneurial spirit. Good day.
translation: 看来我高估你了。好吧，我会去找其他更有冒险精神的人，再见。

original: Wait... You're going to destroy the town?
translation: 等一下……你要毁掉这镇子？

original: No, no, I'm merely a recruiter. YOU get to have the real fun.
translation: 不，不，我只是个猎头而已。是“你”来完成这有趣的工作。

original: The undetonated atomic bomb for which this town is named is still very much alive. All it needs is a little motivation.
translation: 用来命名这镇子的那还没被引爆的核弹仍能被引爆，只需要动一点手脚。

original: I have in my possession a Fusion Pulse Charge. Once rigged to the bomb, it will be detonated, by you, at a secure location. Easy money, my friend.
translation: 我这有一个核融合脉冲电池。只要安在那核弹上，它就可以被引爆。这件事由你来做，而你不用冒任何风险。这钱好赚得很啊，我的朋友。

original: Go on. I'm listening.
translation: 继续，我在听。

original: The undetonated atomic bomb for which this town is named is still very much alive. All it needs is a little motivation.
translation: 用来命名这镇子的那还没被引爆的核弹仍能被引爆，只需要动一点手脚。

original: I have in my possession a Fusion Pulse Charge constructed for a singular purpose -- the detonation of that bomb.
translation: 我这有一个核融合脉冲电池。这东西的用途只有一个——引爆那核弹。

original: You'll rig it to the bomb. Then you'll get paid. Handsomely. What do you say?
translation: 你把它安到那核弹上，然后就有报酬，非常丰厚。听起来怎么样？

original: If you've got a point, make it.
translation: 如果你听懂了，就走人吧。

original: As you wish. I'm looking to employ an individual with no ties to Megaton, no interest in its future.
translation: 如你所说，我有意雇一个跟兆吨镇没有任何牵连的人，一个对兆吨镇的未来漠不关心的人。

original: Megaton is obsolete. The last vestige of a cobbled, desperate past. It needs to... go away. And you are going to see that it does.
translation: 兆吨镇已经过时了，作为那拙劣而疯狂的世界的最后残存。它应该……消失，而你将要目睹这一切的发生。

original: It does?
translation: 会吗？

original: Don't you see? You're a free agent! You've no ties here, no interest in this settlement's affairs. Megaton means nothing to you!
translation: 你没发现吗？你是个局外人！你跟这没有瓜葛，也无意插手这定居点的事。兆吨镇对你来说什么无关紧要！

original: I represent certain... interests who view this town, this "Megaton," as a blight on a burgeoning urban landscape.
translation: 我代表了某些……利益群体，他们把“兆吨镇”看成迅速发展的市区中的一个顽疾。

original: If this settlement were to... go away. Why, who would really care? Certainly not you, or I...
translation: 就算这定居点……消失了。噢，会有人把这当回事吗？显然不是你也不是我……

original: Mister Burke, is it? Please, continue. I find myself... enthralled.
translation: 伯克先生，是吗？请继续，我觉得我非常……感兴趣。

original: Finally, someone with a modicum of civility and common sense.
translation: 总算有人有那么一点礼貌和基本的常识了。

original: I represent certain... interests. And those interests view this town, this "Megaton," as a blight on a burgeoning urban landscape.
translation: 我代表了某些……利益群体，他们把“兆吨镇”看成迅速发展的市区中的一个顽疾。

original: You have no connections here. No interest in this cesspool's affairs, or fate. You could assist us in erasing this little accident off the map.
translation: 你跟这没有牵连，也无意插手这种狗屁事。你可以帮我们把这小麻烦从地图上抹去。

original: Why don't you fight back?
translation: 为什么你们不反击？

original: Yeah sure. I'll just go and take all of them out by myself. What are you, crazy?
translation: 哦，当然了，我会一个人把他们全搞定的。你怎么了，疯了吗？

original: As soon as they roll into town, I lock my doors just like everyone else. We could really use some assistance here.
translation: 每次他们跑到这来，我就跟其他人一样迅速地把门锁起来。我们真的需要一些帮助。

original: Tell me about Allistair Tenpenny.
translation: 和我说说奥利斯特·特佩尼。

original: He owns this building. We get our caps from him, and don't you forget it.
translation: 他是这幢楼的主人。我们从他那领工资，这一点你可要记好了。

original: A very well dressed gentleman, when he bothers to get dressed. He hardly ever leaves his penthouse suite.
translation: 他特意着装的时候，是一个很得体的绅士。但他很少离开自己的套间。

original: He stays in his penthouse suite most of the time. So long as we pay the rent, he lets us live here.
translation: 大多数时候他都在自己的套间里待着。只要我们按时付房租，他就允许我们住下去。

original: He's the landlord, although you hardly ever see him. I had to treat him once for bed sores, if you know what I mean.
translation: 他是这的房东，尽管你很难见到他。我曾经帮他治疗褥疮，你知道吧。

original: Wait...don't tell him I said that.
translation: 等一下……别告诉他那是我说的。

original: Every day it's the same thing. The man has no imagination with his meals.
translation: 每天都是老一套，这人在吃食上没半点新花样。

original: But it's his building, so everyday I make that damned "Iguana Bits sandwich, no salt, with a peeled pear on the side. Send it up to the penthouse."
translation: 但整栋楼都是他的，所以每天我还是得照做——见鬼的“鬣蜥肉丁三明治，免盐，配削皮梨。送至顶楼套房。”

original: He is the right lord and master of Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 他是特佩尼大厦合法的房东和主人。

original: Or at least that's what my files say.
translation: 至少我的文件里是这么说的。

original: It's impolite for a gentleman to talk about himself. But I'd hope this magnificent tower would speak volumes.
translation: 让一位绅士聊自己是很无礼的，但我希望这座华丽的大厦楼能说明问题。

original: Tell me about yourself, Mr. Tenpenny.
translation: 向我介绍一下你自己，特佩尼先生。

original: What can you tell me about Tenpenny Tower?
translation: 你能和我说说特佩尼大厦吗？

original: It's named after Allistair Tenpenny, who runs this building. Got a bunch of rich guys that pay him to live in it.
translation: 这是以这幢楼的所有人奥利斯特·特佩尼来命名的。找了一群富人住在这给他付房租。

original: We're here to make sure that people like you don't mess up his deal.
translation: 我们在这的任务是确保像你这样的人不会妨碍他的交易。

original: I'm not a tour guide.
translation: 我不是导游。

original: Some might say Tenpenny Tower is my crowning achievement. But no! No no! My dear boy, it is just the beginning!
translation: 有些人可能说特佩尼大厦是我最高的成就。但事实不是这样的！我亲爱的孩子，这只是个开始！

original: Quite a tower you have here, Mr. Tenpenny.
translation: 你的大厦真是漂亮，特佩尼先生。

original: Some might say that Tenpenny Tower is my crowning achievement. But no! No no! My dear girl, it is just the beginning!
translation: 有些人可能说特佩尼大厦是我最高的成就。但事实不是这样的！我亲爱的孩子，这只是个开始！

original: Quite a tower you have here, Mr. Tenpenny.
translation: 你的大厦真是漂亮，特佩尼先生。

original: I'd like to do business with you.
translation: 我想跟你做笔生意。

original: I only carry the finest garments.
translation: 我只有最好的衣服。

original: My Boutique has many unique items for the discerning customer.
translation: 我的精品店有很多独特的货物，是专门为有眼光的顾客准备。

original: What are you in the mood for?
translation: 你想要来点什么？

original: Can I get something to eat?
translation: 能给我来点吃的吗？

original: Enjoy the holiday discount, compliments of Mister Tenpenny!
translation: 请享受节日折扣，这是特佩尼先生的恩赐！

original: I'm thirsty.
translation: 我渴了。

original: And what will our most distinguished guest be having today?
translation: 我们今天最尊贵的客人想来点什么？

original: I'm thirsty.
translation: 我渴了。

original: I have an excellent selection of thirst quenchers.
translation: 我有上选的解渴饮料。

original: I'm thirsty.
translation: 我渴了。

original: I have some first aid supplies I can sell.
translation: 我有些急救用品可以出售。

original: I guess we could do a little trading. Here's what I got.
translation: 我想我们可以做点交易。这是我的货。

original: You got an armament supply? Want to do some trade?
translation: 你这有武器装备？想做交易吗？

original: Here's what I got.
translation: 这是我的货。

original: You got an armament supply? Want to do some trade?
translation: 你这有武器装备？想做交易吗？

original: Unfortunately you can't force a man's attentions.
translation: 你不能让一个男人喜欢你真是不幸。

original: Especially if he is a priest with a thick skull.
translation: 特别当这个男人还是一个头脑迟钝的牧师的时候。

original: Well, I'm not giving up. I just know we're made for each other.
translation: 唉，但我不会放弃的。我相信我们是天生一对。

original: I have some ant queen pheromones that might do the trick.
translation: 我这有些蚁后激素，可以用来玩个小把戏。

original: Really? Oh, thank you! I just know I can seduce Diego with this.
translation: 真的吗？哦，谢谢！我才知道这东西可以引诱迭戈上钩。

original: Then he'll have to marry me. We'll be so happy!
translation: 这样一来他就会娶我了。我们会很快乐的！

original: Yeah, right. I don't think I could get him drunk enough to do that.
translation: 嗯，我可不认为我能把他灌醉到能够受我诱惑。

original: I wish I had some ant pheromones. Trinnie says they would make any man lose control.
translation: 我希望可以搞到些蚁后激素。崔妮说它们能让所有男人失去理智。

original: You're a woman. Just seduce him.
translation: 你可是女人，色诱他就行了。

original: Okay, I believe you. I was just curious about it.
translation: 好，我相信你。我刚才不过是好奇罢了。

original: I forgive you. More importantly, God forgives you.
translation: 我原谅你了。更重要的是，上帝原谅你了。

original: If you don't stop seeing her, I'll tell Father Clifford about it.
translation: 你要是继续找她幽会，我会向克利福德神父告发你。

original: I swear to you, our relationship is chaste. I am only her friend.
translation: 我向你发誓，我们的关系是纯洁的。我只是她的朋友。

original: However, I must confess, I have not done all I could. I am sorely tempted.
translation: 可是我必须承认，我并不能彻底控制自己。我真的被她迷住了。

original: You have given me new resolve. I will tell Angela we cannot see each other again. Even as friends.
translation: 你让我下定了决心，我会告诉安吉拉我们再也不会见面了，即便是作为朋友也不行。

original: I saw them myself, on the light deck. Under the stars... <Lie.>
translation: 我亲眼见到了，在甲板上，在星空下……<撒谎>

original: Ah! Diego! What have you done!
translation: 啊！迭戈！你都干了什么！

original: He has forced my hand. I cannot let him be a priest now.
translation: 他这是在逼我。我不能让他做牧师了。

original: This may be the end of the faith if I cannot find another acolyte.
translation: 如果我无法找到另一名助手，我的信仰或许就要到头了。

original: It's just a rumor. I'd ask Diego about it first.
translation: 这不过是传闻。我建议先去问问迭戈本人。

original: Of course, you're right. It's not like you saw it with your own eyes. I'm sure it's just gossip.
translation: 当然，你是对的。眼见为实。我相信这只是流言。

original: Sorry I overreacted. So many of my hopes for the church lie in Diego that it would be devastating to have him leave.
translation: 抱歉我有点神经质了，我把教堂的许多希望都寄托在迭戈身上，如果要把他赶走，那真是太糟糕了。

original: Suicide is a sin. Kill yourself, and your soul won't go to Heaven.
translation: 自杀是一种罪。杀死你自己的话，你的灵魂就无法升入天国。

original: That's what Father Clifford says. I'm not sure I believe that. I'll think about it.
translation: 克利福德神父是那样说的，但我对他说的不大相信。再说吧。

original: What about Ted? He needs guidance. A father figure.
translation: 那泰德呢？他需要指引。一个父亲的角色。

original: Ted Strayer? I suppose I could talk to him. He is kind of a lost boy.
translation: 泰德·斯崔尔？我想我能试着跟他谈谈，他是个迷失了自我的孩子。

original: Thank you, stranger.
translation: 谢谢，陌生人。

original: Couldn't save your family, can't kill yourself... You're fucking pathetic.
translation: 不能救家人，又不能自杀……你他妈的可真惨啊。

original: You're right. I've failed everyone. Even my family.
translation: 你是对的。我辜负了所有人，甚至包括我的家人。

original: Real courage is living. Only cowards commit suicide.
translation: 活下去才是真正的勇敢。只有懦夫才自杀。

original: You may be right, but I have nothing to live for.
translation: 或许你是对的，但我活着没有任何目标。

original: If that's what you really want, I'll help you.
translation: 如果你想那样的话，我会帮你解脱。

original: Thank you. A quick shove should do it.
translation: 谢谢。痛快来一刀就够了。

original: This letter is all Ian has left of his old life. Allow me to give it to him.
translation: 这封信是过去的伊恩唯一的遗物，请让我把它交给他。

original: Your words impress me, human. Perhaps I misjudged you when we first met.
translation: 你的话打动了我，人类。或许初次见面时我误会了你。

original: If you wish to speak to Ian, you are free to do so. Here is the code to the area in which he is meditating.
translation: 如果你想见伊恩，请自便。这是进入他房间的密码。

original: I find this all very hard to believe.
translation: 这一切都让我难以相信。

original: The hunger that drives us must be kept in check. It is one of the most difficult things to teach.
translation: 我们必须控制自己不被欲望驱使。这是最难被教导的事之一。

original: Ian lost control because no one was around to guide him. His own family was alien to him.
translation: 因为没有人在身边指引他，伊恩无法控制自己。他觉得自己的家人都是异类。

original: He had a moment of weakness, and it was fatal.
translation: 他有一阵子很虚弱，那对他是致命的。

original: Ian shouldn't be here. He has family that misses him.
translation: 伊恩不应该在这。他的家人很想他。

original: WE are his family. If he were to leave, how can you be certain he would not feel the same way about us?
translation: “我们”是他的家人。如果你想带走他，你怎么保证他不会同样想念我们？

original: Ian is at a critical moment in his life right now. After all that occurred in Arefu, he is scared and confused.
translation: 伊恩现在正处在人生的关键时刻，毕竟在断桥镇发生的一切让他恐惧和困惑。

original: It would be ill advised for me to allow you to speak to him while he decides what he wants to do.
translation: 在他决定自己怎么做之前，我不会武断地让你去找他谈话。

original: You do this by teaching them that they're mythical beings?
translation: 你通过教导他们认为自己是某种神话生物？

original: Now you disappoint me. You need to open your mind and think for a moment before you pass judgment.
translation: 现在我对你失望了。在你做出判断之前，你需要放开你的思维，好好考虑一会。

original: I have reined in their cravings and taught them to eat not of the flesh, but to drink of the blood.
translation: 我已经减缓了他们的恶欲，并教导他们不要吃人肉，而只是喝血。

original: Most importantly, they have a Family. A place where their quirks are tolerated and understood.
translation: 最重要的是，他们有一个家族，一个宽容和理解他们的怪癖的地方。

original: I still say you're cannibals.
translation: 我仍然会说你们是食人族。

original: It saddens me to think that your failure to understand us could be my fault. If that is the case, allow me to enlighten you.
translation: 我很伤心，竟然可能是因为我的过错而让你无法理解我们。如果是这样的话，那就让我来开导一下你吧。

original: We call ourselves vampires; a brotherhood that honorably stretches back thousands of years.
translation: 我们管自己叫血族：一个延续了上千年,充满荣耀的氏族。

original: If I said vampires, and you said I was right, we'd both be crazy.
translation: 如果我刚才说血族，而你表示肯定的话，我们肯定都是疯子。

original: Do you think I believe I can turn into a bat and fly away? Of course not. Do I cast my image in a mirror? Absolutely.
translation: 你认为我会相信自己能变成一只蝙蝠飞走吗？当然不能。我会在镜子里照出自己吗？绝对会的。

original: Now ask me if I believe these individuals from every corner of the Wasteland need me to give them a sense of purpose and identity.
translation: 现在你可以问我是否相信这些从废土中各个角落来的人，都需要我来教导他们人生的目的和自身的价值。

original: I have shown these people the ways of the vampire. I've provided them shelter, organization and a sense of belonging.
translation: 我引导他们走上血族之路，为他们提供庇护、家园以及归属感。

original: Please, help me understand your Laws.
translation: 拜托，帮助我理解你们的法则。

original: Indeed? Tell me what you've learned from the Laws. What do you think we are?
translation: 真的？告诉我你从我们的生存法则里学到了什么？你觉得我们是什么？

original: I think I finally understand what you people are.
translation: 我想我终于理解你们是什么样的人了。

original: We are the remnants of society, cast aside like the picked bones of a hunter's feast.
translation: 我们是社会的残渣，就像一群猎人宴会后吃剩的骨头一样。

original: Men of science would call us cannibals, eaters of human flesh. Society labels us as monsters, demons and the unclean.
translation: 精通科学的人会叫我们作食人生番，吃人的畜生。我们被人类社会看作怪物、恶魔、不洁之人。

original: I've brought my flock here to shelter under the sun-baked sand of the Wasteland to keep them safe and teach them my ways.
translation: 我把我的门众们带到这位于废土被暴晒的黄沙底下的庇护所，保证他们的安全，并教给他们我的生存之道。

original: I don't understand what you people are.
translation: 我不明白你们到底是什么样的人。

original: No, I can see it in your eyes. You do not yet possess that spark of realization. Continue speaking to my people.
translation: 不，我可以从你的眼里看出来。你的眼睛里还没有闪出领悟的火花。继续去和我的子民交谈吧。

original: So, are you ready to explain to me just what you people are?
translation: 准备跟我说说你们是什么样的人吗？

original: Each of us is required to speak one of the Laws when we hold our ceremonies. I say the First Law.
translation: 每当举行典礼的时候，我们当中的每个人都要讲述一条法则。我来说第一条。

original: "Feast not on the flesh; consume only the blood. This is our strength."
translation: “不可享用肉体；只能饮用血液。血液能赐予我们的力量。”

original: When we all gather in the common area, Vance gives his speeches and then we each have like a Law to say.
translation: 当我们聚集到公共区域后，万斯会做个演讲，然后我们每个人都要讲述一条法则。

original: Mine is "Bear not the child; welcome only the exile. This is our fate." Kinda cool, huh?
translation: 我的是“不可生育小孩；只欢迎被流放者。这是我们的命运。”很酷吧，嗯？

original: Oh wait... Vance told me I was supposed to say something special when asked that... from his teachings.
translation: 哦，等一下……万斯说过当被问到时我该说点什么……从他的教义那学到的东西。

original: Oh, right! The Third Law is "Feed not for pleasure; partake only to nourish. This is our dignity." Whew... almost forgot it again.
translation: 哦，对了！法则的第三条是“进食不是为了享乐，而是为了滋长。这是我们的尊严。”哟……差点又忘了。

original: When Vance stands on that balcony and starts mouthing off like some kind of preacher, it makes me wanna puke.
translation: 每次万斯站在那讲台上像个神父那样布道时，我就想吐。

original: But if I wanna keep this place stocked I gotta have his permission, so I learned his Fifth Law.
translation: 但如果我想在这待下去，还必须得到他的许可，所以我只好学习了法则的第五条。

original: "Kill not our kindred; slay only the enemy. This is our justice." Pretty silly if you ask me.
translation: “不可杀害同胞；只可屠戮敌人。这是我们的正义。”如果你问我，我会说这想法很傻。

original: Well, usually everyone has a rule or something they have to yell out at our gang meetings.
translation: 其实，每次我们集会的时候，每个人都要高声朗诵一条戒律。

original: Since I guard the door all the time, I don't have to do that. I mean, they're good laws and all, but it feels stupid yelling that stuff out loud.
translation: 因为我总是负责看门，所以我不用那么做。我觉得这些戒律都很棒，只是大声喊出来显得有点蠢。

original: Well, Vance makes each of us remember a rule, and when we all gather in the common area, we have to say it out loud. Kinda weird.
translation: 嗯，万斯让我们每个人都背诵一条戒律，然后还得在公共区域集会时大声说出来。有点怪。

original: So, my Law is the fourth one. "Seek not the sun's light; embrace only the shadows. This is our refuge."
translation: 我要背的法则是第四条。“不要追逐阳光；而要拥抱黑暗。这是我们的庇护。”

original: I don't have time for chit-chat. Tell me where Ian is. Now!
translation: 我可没时间废话。告诉我伊恩在哪，立刻！

original: Sigh. Short temper. So typical of a human.
translation: 唉，急性子，人类都是这样。

original: One more outburst like that, and I think I am going to have you removed from our home... permanently.
translation: 你要是再像那样大喊大叫，我就要把你从我们的家园赶出去……永远。

original: Is there no end to your hostility? Your kind have never accepted us. So be it.
translation: 你永远都这样保持敌意吗？你们这些人永远不会接纳我们的。那就就这样吧。

original: All you rely on is violence to further your means. If that is what you seek, I will be happy to provide it!
translation: 你们总是用暴力来把自己的想法强加给别人。如果这是你想要的，我很乐意奉陪！

original: Enough talk, psycho. Tell me where Ian is or so help me...
translation: 说够了，疯子。告诉我伊恩在哪里……

original: You people murdered his parents!
translation: 你们这些人谋杀了他的双亲！

original: Murder is a very strong word, my friend. Do you consider it murder when a hunter stalks his prey in order to put food on the table?
translation: 谋杀说的可太重了，我的朋友。你难道觉得猎人为了获取餐桌上的食物，而尾随他的猎物是谋杀吗？

original: The Family must do what it can to survive, and Ian provided us the way.
translation: 家族必须为了生存而行动，而伊恩为我们提供了一种方式。

original: Ian is at a critical moment in his life right now. After all that occurred in Arefu, he is scared and confused.
translation: 伊恩现在正处在人生的关键时刻，毕竟在断桥镇发生的一切让他恐惧和困惑。

original: This may sound odd, but is there a trainyard outside Arefu?
translation: 这问题可能很怪，但断桥镇外围有车站月台吗？

original: Well, yeah actually. Meresti Trainyard almost due east of here.
translation: 嗯，事实上是的。米尔斯蒂编组站差不多就在东边。

original: The Wests had bite marks on their necks. Mean anything to you?
translation: 维斯特一家人的脖子上都有被咬过的痕迹，你知道为什么吗？

original: What!? The Family must be a pack of cannibals!
translation: 什么！？那家族一定都是一群食人者！

original: Oh, this is all I needed right now. What am I going to do? They'll keep coming back until all of us are dead if they think we're food.
translation: 哦，我现在知道这些就够了。我下一步该干嘛？如果他们觉得我们是食物的话，在我们死光之前他们会不断来骚扰的。

original: I discovered that the Wests had bite marks on their necks made by a human!
translation: 我发现维斯特一家人的脖子上的咬痕是人类造成的！

original: Bite marks on their necks? That's the strangest thing I've ever heard. The Family must have attack dogs with them or something.
translation: 在他们的脖子上咬出痕迹？这可是我听过的最奇怪的事。家族一定带着猛犬或别的什么吧？

original: Oh, this is all I needed right now. What am I going to do? They'll keep coming back until all of us are dead!
translation: 哦，我现在知道这些就够了。我下一步该干嘛？如果他们觉得我们是食物的话，在我们死光之前他们会不断来骚扰的。

original: Did you know the Wests are dead?
translation: 你知道维斯特一家都死了吗？

original: Thanks kid. You're all right.
translation: 谢谢，孩子。你是个好人。

original: Don't worry, Evan. I'll figure out what happened to the Wests.
translation: 别担心，埃文。我会搞清楚维斯特一家发生了什么事。

original: The Family must have gotten to them in the last attack! Sons of bitches!
translation: 他们肯定在上一次攻击中被家族袭击了！那群杂种！

original: Damn it! If only we had more men, we could stand up to them. I'm sick of them terrorizing this town.
translation: 该死！要是我们有更多人就能对抗他们了。我已经无法忍受他们这样威胁这镇子了。

original: Wait a minute... when you searched the West's place, did you find their son Ian's body?
translation: 等一下……你在搜索维斯特家的时候，找到他们的儿子伊恩的尸体了吗？

original: Wait a minute... when you searched the West's place, did you find their son Ian's body?
translation: 等一下……你在搜索维斯特家的时候，找到他们的儿子伊恩的尸体了吗？

original: Everyone else seems fine.
translation: 其他人看来还好。

original: The Family must have gotten to them in the last attack! Sons of bitches!
translation: 他们肯定在上一次攻击中被家族袭击了！那群杂种！

original: Damn it! If only we had more men, we could stand up to them. I'm sick of them terrorizing this town.
translation: 该死！要是我们有更多人就能对抗他们了。我已经无法忍受他们这样威胁这镇子了。

original: Check the rest of the town. Make sure I'm not the only one left.
translation: 检查一下镇子的其他地方吧，看看我是不是唯一幸存下来的。

original: What?! Oh my God!
translation: 什么？！我的天啊！

original: King has to do something about this now! Tell him to get off his ass and hunt those bastards down!
translation: 金现在得做点什么了！告诉他行动起来，该去干掉那群杂种了！

original: Son of a bitch! I knew the Family were going to cross the line. It was only a matter of time.
translation: 混蛋！我就知道家族那帮人迟早会玩过火的，只是时间问题罢了。

original: Maybe it's time I cut my losses and ran, but it just isn't fair. I made my home here, why should I have to leave?
translation: 或许我该趁早逃走了，但这不公平。我在这有了自己的家，为什么一定要离开？

original: Dead tired I bet from the square dance in the barn last night! What a time we had!
translation: 昨晚在牲口棚里跳卡德利尔舞跳得累死了！简直太爽了！

original: No. I'm done with you.
translation: 不，我们之间完了。

original: Acknowledged. Hitting the rack!
translation: 收到。打击后脖颈子！

original: Yes.
translation: 是的。

original: Acknowledged.
translation: 收到。

original: Initiate triage protocol.
translation: 启动治疗类选法程式。

original: Medical procedures initiated. Administering treat... ERROR ERROR!
translation: 医疗程序启动。实施治疗……错误 错误！

original: Medical procedures initiated. Administering treat... ERROR ERROR!
translation: 医疗程序启动。实施治疗……错误 错误！

original: Medical procedures initiated. Administering treatment. Please stand still.
translation: 医疗程序启动。实施治疗。请别动！

original: If Lucy is still alive I bet she misses you.
translation: 如果露西还活着，我打赌她一定会想你的。

original: She does? If she cared so much, why did she leave when she did?
translation: 她会吗？如果她真这么在意，为什么还要独自离开？

original: My parents would have never understood... they would have called me a freak and kicked me out.
translation: 我的父母永远都不会明白的……他们宁可把我看作怪物赶出来。

original: No, I'm sorry. Vance and the Family are the only ones that could possibly understand what I'm going through.
translation: 不，很抱歉。万斯和家族的成员是唯一可能理解我的感受地人。

original: I'm sorry, Ian, but your parents are dead.
translation: 很抱歉，伊恩，但你的父母都死了。

original: You think I don't know that? You think I don't know what I did?!
translation: 你以为我不知道？你以为我不知道我做了什么？

original: RadioGoodbye
translation: 告别广播

original: Roof access to the Statesman Hotel is only through the adjoining hospital. Please hurry! Butcher out.
translation: 只有经由旁边的医院才能通往政要酒店楼顶。请快一点！完毕。

original: We will continually broadcast as often as we can, but I'm afraid we don't have much time left. Butcher out.
translation: 我们会尽可能频繁地反复广播，但我担心我们抵抗不了多久了。完毕。

original: Keep your eyes open... we've left booby traps and mines to help slow the Mutants down.
translation: 眼睛放亮点……我们装置了用来拖延那些变种人的陷阱和地雷。

original: Oh, shit... here they come again...
translation: 哦，狗屎……他们又来了……

original: Message repeats.
translation: 重复讯息。

original: Until next time, this is President Eden, signing off.
translation: 下次再见，我是亨利·伊登总统，播报完毕。

original: Until we meet again, this is President Eden, signing off.
translation: 下次再见，我是亨利·伊登总统，播报完毕。

original: Until next time, this is John Henry Eden, signing off.
translation: 下次再见，我是亨利·伊登总统，播报完毕。

original: Until we meet again, this is John Henry Eden, signing off.
translation: 下次再见，我是亨利·伊登总统，播报完毕。

original: Until next time, this is your President, John Henry Eden, signing off.
translation: 下次再见，我是亨利·伊登总统，播报完毕。

original: Until we meet again, this is your President, John Henry Eden, signing off.
translation: 下次再见，我是亨利·伊登总统，播报完毕。

original: So you know how to find one?
translation: 那你知道该怎么找？

original: Possibly. I'm afraid I won't be able to assist you directly; the news Doctor Li has brought will require me to be elsewhere.
translation: 可能吧。我担心我不能直接帮上你，鉴于李博士带来的消息，我得到别处去。

original: I can, however, give you access to an old pre-war computer from Vault-Tec. It may have the information you need.
translation: 不过，我可以给你使用避难所科技制造的战前电脑的许可，那可能会有你需要的信息。

original: You'll find the terminal in the archives in the A ring.
translation: 你能在A环的档案室里找到那台终端。

original: I'm not going with you.
translation: 我不打算跟你们一起走。

original: Are you sure? I'm sure we could use your help.
translation: 你确定吗？我相信我们能用到你的帮助。

original: If you change your mind, you can always meet up with us along the way. If nothing else, come see me once we're set up.
translation: 要是你改变主意了，随时可以在路上与我们会合。就算不为别的，等我们安顿好了，也来看看我吧。

original: Won't that be dangerous?
translation: 那不会很危险吗？

original: Probably. But we have to try, don't we? It's too important to the people of the Wasteland to let fear stop us now.
translation: 或许吧，但我们总得试试，对吧？这对废土的人们太重要了，我们不能因为害怕而退缩。

original: We need to get moving right away. Are you coming with us?
translation: 我们必须立刻动身。你和我们一起来吗？

original: You have to go now? Can't this wait?
translation: 你们现在就要走？不能等会吗？

original: After twenty long years, I finally have a chance to make things right, to finish what I started so long ago.
translation: 经过漫长的二十年，我终于有机会让这重回正轨，完成我多年前启动的工程。

original: I owe this to Madison. I owe it to your mother. No, I can't wait another moment. Are you coming with us?
translation: 这是我欠麦迪逊的，也是我欠你母亲的。不，我一刻也不能耽搁了。你和我们一起去吗？

original: All right. Let's get going.
translation: 好了，我们走吧。

original: That's my boy!
translation: 这才是我的好小伙！

original: It'll be good to work side-by-side with you, son.
translation: 能跟你并肩工作真好，儿子。

original: That's my girl!
translation: 这才是我的好姑娘！

original: It'll be good to work side-by-side with you, honey.
translation: 能跟你并肩工作真好，宝贝。

original: What do we need to do right now?
translation: 我现在该干嘛？

original: You just need to power up the mainframe, and we can see what there is to see.
translation: 你只须要恢复主机的电力供应就行，然后才能知道我们还能做点什么。

original: What should I be doing now?
translation: 我现在该干嘛？

original: You need to replace the fuses that shorted out in the flooding. Once they're in, the automatic doors will work and we can reach the mainframe.
translation: 你需要把因为溢水短路烧掉的保险丝换掉。然后，自动门才会打开让我们去到主机那。

original: What should I be doing now?
translation: 我现在该干嘛？

original: Right. The flooding shorted out some of the fuse boxes downstairs, including one that controls some of the automatic doors.
translation: 对，溢水导致有些保险丝盒短路被烧掉了，包括控制某些自动门的。

original: Here, take these fuses. The box is back down in the sub-basement, near the eastern end of the level.
translation: 把这些保险丝拿去。保险丝盒在地下室的深处，接近那一层东头。

original: Once the fuses are replaced, you'll be able to get to the mainframe.
translation: 换上这些保险丝之后你就能够进到主控制室里了。

original: You said something about fuses?
translation: 你说保险丝怎么了？

original: The flood control pumps, remember? Without those working, we can't restore power to the mainframe.
translation: 那些排水泵，记得吗？如果它们不工作，我们是无法进到主控制室里恢复电力的。

original: I can use the intercom system to talk you through reaching them.
translation: 你到了那里，我就会用对讲机联络你。

original: What should I be doing now?
translation: 我现在该干嘛？

original: The Project was abandoned shortly after you were born. Things have deteriorated here since then, and there's been some flooding.
translation: 这工程在你出生后不久就被废弃了。迄今为止很多设备都破旧了，而且有些地方还有溢水。

original: I'll need you to get to the Flood Control Pumps and activate them so we can clear out the water and reach the mainframe.
translation: 我需要你帮忙到排水泵去启动它，我们才能把水排干进到主控制室里去。

original: What's our goal here?
translation: 我们来这的目的是什么？

original: Eventually, I think we can get the whole facility up and running. But we'll need a G.E.C.K. for that.
translation: 最终，我想我们可以让整个装置工作起来，但为此我们需要一套伊甸园创造器。

original: So we need to find a G.E.C.K. I'm hoping the Project's computer will have information on where we can locate one.
translation: 所以我们需要找到一套伊甸园创造器。希望电脑系统能提供给我们哪可能会有伊甸园创造器相关信息。

original: No way. I'm not doing this.
translation: 没门。这种事我才不干。

original: All right, all right. I won't push. But please reconsider.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我不会强迫你，但拜托再考虑下。

original: I said I'm not doing this, and I meant it.
translation: 我说我不会做，那我就是不会做。

original: Honey, I know things are moving a bit quickly, and I'm sure you have some conflicting feelings about helping me after what's happened.
translation: 亲爱的，我知道很多都改变了，也明白那些事发生以后，你可能不再愿意协助我了。

original: If you need to take a moment, that's fine. I'll be waiting for you.
translation: 如果你需要一点时间，没问题。我会等着你。

original: Son, I know things are moving a bit quickly, and I'm sure you have some conflicting feelings about helping me after what's happened.
translation: 儿子，我知道很多都改变了，也明白那些事发生以后，你可能不再愿意协助我了。

original: If you need to take a moment, that's fine. I'll be waiting for you.
translation: 如果你需要一点时间，没问题。我会等着你。

original: Okay. Where do I need to go?
translation: 好吧。我现在该到哪去？

original: The automatic doors sealed when the flooding occurred, so you'll have to use the access tunnels to reach the pumps.
translation: 水溢出后自动门会封起来，所以你得走通行隧道到水泵那。

original: Why me? Can't someone else do it?
translation: 为什么是我？找不到其他人做吗？

original: In a word? No. Everyone else has specific tasks to complete as the power comes back online.
translation: 简单地说，没有其他人手了。当电力恢复以后，其他所有的人都有预定的任务要完成。

original: Don't worry. I'll guide you along the way as best I can using the intercom system. You'll do fine.
translation: 别担心，我会用对讲机指导你。你一定能做到的。

original: I don't know, maybe.
translation: 我想我不知道。

original: Well fine! Go away then!
translation: 很好，那就快滚！

original: Here, maybe this will shut you up. <Give a Nuka-Cola Quantum.>
translation: 拿去，这应该能让你闭上嘴。<给予一瓶核子可乐量子版>

original: Oh my gosh! Oh my gosh! A real Quantum! Yummie yum yum!
translation: 哦，上帝！哦，上帝！一瓶真正的量子版核子可乐！耶耶耶！

original: Okay, I guess I can talk to you some more. Just be nicer next time!
translation: 好了，我想我可以跟你多说一些，不过下次对我好点！

original: Now, do you want to take the tour?
translation: 现在你愿意谈谈你的经历吗？

original: Yeah. I'm sorry, Sierra. Here's a Nuka-Cola Quantum for you!
translation: 嗯，真抱歉，塞拉。我帮你找到了一瓶核子可乐量子版！

original: Oh my gosh! Oh my gosh! A real Quantum! Yummie yum yum!
translation: 哦，上帝！哦，上帝！一瓶真正的量子版核子可乐！耶耶耶！

original: Okay, I guess I can talk to you some more. Just be nicer next time!
translation: 好了，我想我可以跟你多说一些，不过下次对我好点！

original: Now, do you want to take the tour?
translation: 现在你愿意谈谈你的经历吗？

original: No way! I'm not scouring the Wasteland for some stupid soft drink!
translation: 没门儿！我才不会为了些愚蠢的软饮料而在废土上瞎逛呢！

original: Hey! It isn't just some stupid soft drink!
translation: 嘿！这可不是什么愚蠢的软饮料！

original: It's only the most delicious thing man has ever conceived!
translation: 这可是人类能想象的最可口的东西！

original: If you don't want to help me find some Quantum then fine... someone else will come along one day who will!
translation: 如果你不想帮我找量子可乐，那就算了……帮忙的人总有一天会出现的！

original: Glowing pee? That sounds like dangerous stuff!
translation: 发光的尿？听起来像是危险品啊！

original: Oh no! Not at all!
translation: 哦不！完全不是那样！

original: Nuka-Cola Quantum was made under the supervision of the Food and Drug Association. They would NEVER let harmful products end up in stores!
translation: 核子可乐量子版是在食品药品监督管理局的监管下生产的。他们从不允许有害产品摆上货架！

original: Let me think about this, Sierra.
translation: 让我想想，塞拉。

original: Okay. But I bet you'll be back!
translation: 好吧，但我打赌你一定会回来的！

original: I think I've had just about enough of this.
translation: 我想我已经受够了。

original: You can never have enough of the refreshing taste of Nuka-Cola! He he he!
translation: 你绝不可能对这种全新口味的核子可乐感到厌倦的！呵呵呵！

original: Oh, don't be such a grump. You can go if you want to, but you're missing out...
translation: 哦，别发火。你想走随时可以走，但你会错过……

original: I think I'd rather be smacked in the head with a blunt instrument.
translation: 我觉得我宁可被人用钝器敲脑袋。

original: What an odd way to make music, I'll have to try it sometime!
translation: 好奇怪的音乐演奏方式，找时间我也来试试！

original: Well if you don't want to take the tour, what are you doing here?
translation: 好吧，如果你不想参观，那到这来干嘛？

original: Look, lady. I just want to get out of this nuthouse...
translation: 听着，女士。我只想离开这疯人院……

original: Oh, I think you came to the wrong place. I think there's someone in California that collects nuts. Or was it Nevada? Hmmm...
translation: 哦，我想你来错地方了。我想加利福尼亚州有人在收疯子。还是内华达州？唔……

original: Yeah, I guess you're right. It isn't that bad.
translation: 嗯，我想你是对的。这没那么糟。

original: See, I knew you were smart the moment you walked in here!
translation: 你瞧，在你进来的时候我就看出来你很聪明。

original: So, enough with the small talk. Are you ready for the tour?
translation: 好了，闲谈到此为止。你准备好开始观光了吗？

original: I'm sorry, Garza. I wish there was more we could do.
translation: 我很抱歉，加尔萨，我们没能帮上更多忙。

original: I insist. You have greater problems to worry about. I will be all right. Now please, go.
translation: 听我的。有更重要的事等着你们呢。我会没事的。快走吧，拜托。

original: We can't just leave you here. It isn't right.
translation: 我们不能这么把你扔在这。这是不对的。

original: You know what to do, Doctor Li. You must go on without me.
translation: 李博士，你知道该怎么做。你们必须丢下我赶快离开。

original: Garza, I'm sorry. I don't know what to do.
translation: 加尔萨，真抱歉。我不知道我该怎么办。

original: Vault101DadHolotape
translation: 101避难所里父亲的录音

original: Well, here we are. Nestled all safe and snug inside Vault 101. It's so cold down here. Colder still with Catherine gone...
translation: 那么，我们到了。栖身在安全又干净的101号避难所内。在这下面可真是冷，一想起凯瑟琳已经不在了就更冷……

original: Oh, Catherine.... I so wish you were here with me. How the hell am I supposed to do this by myself? Live down in this hole. Take care of our child...
translation: 哦，凯瑟琳……我真希望你能在这陪着我。我一个人要怎样才能应付啊？住在地洞里面，照看我们的孩子……

original: But this is our life now, so I guess I'd better get used to it. The Overseer who runs the place is an overbearing bully, but I've dealt with worse.
translation: 但这就是我们现在的生活，所以我还是得赶快适应。负责的监督者是个专横傲慢的人，不过我以前遇到过更差劲的。

original: The prisoner from Vault 101 is to be shot on sight. I repeat, shot on sight. This is an order!
translation: 如果发现来自101号避难所的犯人，格杀勿论。重复一遍，格杀勿论。这是命令！

original: Attention! This is Colonel Autumn! You are hereby ordered to ignore the President's previous directive.
translation: 注意！现在说话的是奥托姆上校！我命令你们忽略总统的上一条指示。

original: The code is "Priority Override, Authorization code 420-03-20-9"
I...  Oh. Oh my...
translation: 我……哦。哦，我的…天…

original: Root level access granted. Override O-923. Authorization J-512. Self-destruct sequence initialized.
translation: 系统管理授权获准。撤销-923。授权码J-512。自毁序列初始化。

original: Civilian is requested to secure FEV vial and vacate the facility at once.
translation: 那人被要求拿取FEV病毒试剂瓶并立刻撤离本设施。

original: You're right. I was just kidding.
translation: 你是对的。我刚才是在开玩笑。

original: Even I appreciate a good joke, but I'm afraid that was in rather poor taste.
translation: 尽管我会很欣赏有趣的笑话，但恐怕刚才的那笑话实在很冷。

original: Guess what? I know your self-destruct code.
translation: 你知道吗？我可有你的自毁密码。

original: Oh come now, bluffing's not really your style, is it?
translation: 哦，算了吧，你可不怎么擅长吹牛，不是吗？

original: And there's certainly no need to threaten me.
translation: 威胁我完全没有意义。

original: MQ09AutumnHolotape
translation: 奥特姆的录音

original: I'm not entirely sure Eden can be trusted. And I think he knows I don't trust him.
translation: 我还不能完全确定是否该信赖伊登，而且我想他知道我是不信赖他的。

original: But I don't think he knows I have the emergency destruct sequence for his console.
translation: 但我不认为他知道，我已经有了针对他的控制台的紧急自毁序列。

original: "Priority Override, Authorization code 420-03-20-9" and... boom. It'd have to be a last resort, of course, but at least the option is there.
translation: “优先撤销，密码420-03-20-9”然后……嘣嘣。尽管这是我最后一张牌，但至少我有了一张选择的底牌。

original: What's in this vial of yours?
translation: 你的试剂瓶里装的是什么？

original: Ah, the Forced Evolutionary Virus. Such a long and sordid history. The FEV in this vial is a far cry from what it was originally created to be.
translation: 啊，那是强效突变病毒。一段长久而肮脏的历史。这试剂瓶里的FEV病毒已经跟它本来的性质相去甚远了。

original: Yet little of that matters now. What does matter is that the virus contained in that vial will cause the eradication of all mutations.
translation: 不过这一点不重要。重要的是这试剂瓶里的病毒能够根除所有的突变体。

original: That's all I wanted to know.
translation: 这就是我想知道的。

original: Is there anything else?
translation: 还需要其他什么吗？

original: This explains why I've only heard your voice until now.
translation: 原来这就是我到现在为止只能听到你的声音的原因。

original: Very astute! Many people are content with a reassuring voice of authority, and never question the lack of public appearances.
translation: 真聪明！很多人只须要听到可靠的、威严的声音就满足了，他们从不质疑为什么我不在公众面前出现。

original: You, however, are not "many people." You are unique, and that is why I have asked you here. I think there are some things we should discuss.
translation: 但你，不在这“很多人”之列。你很特别，这也是我把你叫到这来的原因。我想我们可以谈点什么。

original: You're a computer! I should have guessed as much!
translation: 你是台电脑！我早该猜到的！

original: How very open-minded of you. Kudos for embracing the reality of the situation, rather than railing against it.
translation: 你很豁达开明。我们应该积极面对现实，而不是逃避它。

original: Let's get to brass tacks, shall we? There are some things I'd like to talk to you about.
translation: 让我们单刀直入，怎么样？有些事我想跟你谈谈。

original: So, you grew up here too?
translation: 你也是这长大的？

original: Sure did. Can't say that I'm proud of it, though. It was all just normal. It's what we all did. I didn't ever think much about it.
translation: 当然是了，尽管不觉得有什么骄傲的，但过去一切都很自然，既然现在我们做下了这样的事，那我就不怎么去想了。

original: I married Gladys, just like every boy in Andale married the girl closest to his age. We had Linda and she grew up to marry Jack.
translation: 我娶了葛莱蒂丝，就像安戴尔所有的男孩都娶跟他年龄最相近的那女孩一样。我们有了个女儿叫琳达，她长大后嫁给了开膛手“杰克”。

original: It wasn't until Gladys died that I thought about what went on around here. So many people over the years... hundreds... thousands, maybe?
translation: 直到葛莱蒂丝死后我才发觉这附近发生了些什么。这些年来有多少人遭难……几百……或许几千？

original: But what could I do? I'm just an old man. But you ended it. Bless you.
translation: 我能怎么办？我只是个老人，但你结束了这一切。愿主祝福你。

original: What's going to happen to the kids?
translation: 孩子们该怎么办？

original: They'll stay here with me and I'll raise them myself. It's a shame that they have to grow up without their parents.
translation: 他们会在这陪着我，我也会抚养他们长大的。真惭愧啊，父母不能陪伴在他们成长的日子里。

original: But, to tell you the truth, it's a lot better than growing up with their parents, everything considered.
translation: 但实不相瞒，不管怎么看，都比让他们的父母养大他们好多了。

original: Better an orphan than a cannibal, I guess?
translation: 成为孤儿总比成食人族好，不是吗？

original: Now what will you do?
translation: 现在你准备怎么办？

original: We'll do our best, is what we'll do. Me an the kids here in Andale... what's left of it, anyway.
translation: 我们会尽力，我们会的。不管怎样，我和安戴尔的孩子们……还有这剩下来的一切。

original: It'll be hard goin', but we'll do the best we can.
translation: 以后的日子将会很艰难，但我们会尽力的。

original: I just hope that one day, these kids'll grow up to go some good for this place, after all the evil that's been done here.
translation: 我只希望有一天，孩子们长大了，能为这做些好事，毕竟这曾经是充满罪恶的地方。

original: Do you like living in Andale?
translation: 你喜欢住在安戴尔吗？

original: It's okay, I guess. There aren't a lot of kids around here and no one who comes to visit stays around long.
translation: 还好吧，我想。就是周围没什么小孩子，访客也待不久。

original: Dad says it could be worse; that there are starving kids in other places. But still, I wish I had more kids to play with.
translation: 爸爸说这已经算好了：别处总有小孩饿死。但我还是希望能有更多小孩和我一起玩。

original: Are you joking? It's fantastic here! The best town in the USA! Has been for... why it's been so many years running that I've lost count!
translation: 你开玩笑吧？这可太棒了！全美国最好的镇子！已经有……年头长得我都数不过来了！

original: What's going on around Andale?
translation: 近来安戴尔附近发生什么了吗？

original: My dad says that it's going to rain soon, do you think it will?
translation: 我爸爸说就快下雨了，你看呢？

original: I dunno. Nothing, I guess. Old Man Harris won't come out of his house again.
translation: 我不知道，什么都不知道。海瑞斯老爹再也不从他屋里出来了。

original: What do you think of the other people in Andale?
translation: 你觉得安戴尔的其他人怎么样？

original: Hey, did you know that I'm going to marry Junior Smith when I'm old enough? I know, he doesn't like girls now, but mommy says that he'll come around.
translation: 嗨，你知道我长大以后要嫁给小史密斯吗？嗯，他现在对女孩子没什么兴趣，不过妈妈说以后他会变的。

original: He's okay, I guess. I don't think he really likes me. Well... not likes me, likes me.
translation: 他还好吧，我想。不过我不觉得他有多喜欢我。嗯……不像我喜欢他那么多。

original: What do you think of Junior Smith?
translation: 你觉得小史密斯怎么样？

original: Command protocol delta-five-three. Disengage security program.
translation: 指令协议delta-5-3。解除安全程序。

original: Command accepted. Security program disengaged.
translation: 指令收到。安全程序已解除。

original: Yes, fellow employee? What can I do for you on this wonderful day?
translation: 怎么了，同事？在这美好的日子里我能帮你什么？

original: Very well. Give me a few moments to bring the system online.
translation: 好吧，我这就登陆系统。

original: Then you will immediately hand over all materials related to this project, and aid us in making it operational at once.
translation: 那你必须立刻把跟这工程有关的资料交出来，协助我们接手这个工程。

original: Yes, Colonel. I'll do whatever you want; there's no need for more violence.
translation: 我明白了，上校，我会照办的，不过请对我客气点。

original: I suggest you comply immediately, sir, in order to prevent any more incidents. Are we clear?
translation: 先生，如果不想再有任何伤亡的话，我劝你还是老实点，清楚了吗？

original: Colonel, I assure you that this facility will not function. We have never been able to successfully replicate test results...
translation: 上校，我可以向你保证，这个设施已经完蛋了。我们从没有成功利用过那些实验成果……

original: Sir, this is the last time I am going to repeat myself. Stand down at once, and turn over control of this facility.
translation: 先生，我不想再啰嗦了。不要拖延时间了，立刻交出设备控制权。

original: Colonel... Is it Colonel? I'm sorry, but the facility is not operational. It never has been. I'm afraid you're wasting your time here.
translation: 上校…是上校吧？真的没骗你，设备已经完蛋了，它甚至都没有真正运行过。你完全是在浪费时间。

original: Furthermore, you are to assist Enclave scientists in assuming control of the administration and operation of this facility at once.
translation: 另外，你立刻着手协助英克雷的科学家获取设施所有的控制权。

original: I'm sorry, but that's....
translation: 我很抱歉，但这是……...

original: Then I repeat, sir, that you are hereby instructed to immediately hand over all materials related to the purifier.
translation: 别废话了，我命令你立刻交出所有跟净化器有关的材料。

original: Yes, I'm responsible for this project.
translation: 是的，我是这工程的负责人。

original: Am I to assume, sir, that you are in charge?
translation: 我想确定一下，你真是这里的负责人吗？

original: That's quite impossible. This is a private project; the Enclave has no authority here. I'm going to have to ask you to leave at once.
translation: 那不可能。这是一个私人工程，英克雷无权这样做。我请你们立刻离开。

original: The person in charge is to step forward immediately, and turn over all materials related to this project.
translation: 请真正的工程负责人立刻出来，把工程的所有相关资料全部交给我们。

original: By the authority of the President, this facility is now under United States government control.
translation: 根据总统的命令，美国政府即刻接管这里。

original: Lead the way. Let's not waste any time.
translation: 就这么样吧，我们别在这耽误时间了。

original: There's an old tunnel that will lead us out of here, to someplace safe. We used it as an evacuation route once before, but that was a long time ago.
translation: 有条废弃的隧道可以带我们去一个安全的地方。我们以前用来做过一次紧急疏散，但已经是很久以前了。

original: I hope everyone remembers how to get there. There isn't time to round everyone up. Come on, follow me. And hurry!
translation: 希望每个人都还记得怎么去那里，但没时间集合所有的人了，来吧，跟上我。快点！

original: How do we get out of here?
translation: 我们怎么离开这？

original: We used an old, abandoned tunnel as an escape route once before, many years ago. Everyone should know how to find it.
translation: 很多年前我们曾经用过一条被废弃的老隧道来紧急疏散。大家应该都知道怎么找到它。

original: We need to get there right now. Let's go.
translation: 我们必须立刻离开这，快走。

original: I'm not leaving my father in there!
translation: 我不能把我父亲留在这！

original: There's nothing anyone can do for him now. The radiation levels in there are lethal. You'd die the same way he did.
translation: 现在没人能救他了。这里的辐射是致命的，你会跟他一样没命的。

original: We need to get out of here, now!
translation: 我们必须离开这，立刻！

original: You don't need to be such an asshole...
translation: 你没必要成为一个混蛋……

original: God forbid I should be upset that twice now my work has been screwed over by your father.
translation: 但愿我没有因为你父亲两次把我的工作搞得一团糟而崩溃。

original: And, to make things worse, this time he brings his snot-nosed kid along for the ride.
translation: 更倒霉的是，这次他还带上了他妄尊自大的孩子一起来。

original: He's just trying to do the right thing.
translation: 他只是想做正确的事。

original: Sure, sure. No matter that he disappears for almost twenty years, leaving us all hanging. It's not like we have lives or anything.
translation: 当然，当然，就算他丢下我们消失了20来年也无所谓，就和我们完全不存在一样。

original: Anything I should know about this place?
translation: 这有什么我需要注意的吗？

original: Doctor Li has been waiting to come back here for twenty years, okay? Twenty. That's a long time.
translation: 李博士在这等他回来等了20年，知道吗？20年是好长一段时间。

original: This is important. We can't afford to screw it up.
translation: 这很重要，我们决不能把事搞糟。

original: The Brotherhood of Steel was overwhelmed by mutants here. Be careful they do not overwhelm you; I am sure some still lurk within the tunnels.
translation: 钢铁兄弟会完全被变种人压制了，当心不要让他们打死你。我确信他们还有些潜伏在隧道里。

original: Besides the fact that you shouldn't be here?
translation: 你就不能老实的待在这里吗？

original: Don't touch anything you're not told to. There's enough to do around here without having to clean up after you.
translation: 没被允许之前别动任何东西。这里除了你之外的麻烦已经够多的了。

original: I'd steer clear of the water if I were you. It's seeping in from the Tidal Basin, which means it's radioactive.
translation: 如果我是你就会避开水域的，这些水从潮汐湖渗进来，因此是带辐射的。

original: If that's not bad enough, if there are any loose wires as the power comes back on... you might get a bit of a jolt. Know what I mean?
translation: 如果没那么糟糕的话，如果有电线可以让电力恢复……或许你就能做点什么。你懂了吗？

original: Do you think Project Purity will ever work again?
translation: 你觉得净水工程可能重新运作吗？

original: I sure hope so, or it's just going to crush Doctor Li completely. Especially after your father came back and all.
translation: 我当然希望这样，否则李博士会完全崩溃的，特别是现在你父亲回来了。

original: I have faith in your father. With the knowledge he's gained, we stand a better chance than we ever have.
translation: 我相信你父亲。他现在的知识更为广博，我们更有希望了。

original: If Doctor Li says it will work, then it will be so.
translation: 如果李博士说它会运作，就一定会的。

original: The hell do you care? You showed up here what, five minutes ago, and now you're strutting around like you own the place?
translation: 该死的你要干嘛？五分钟前才来过这，现在又过来游荡？就好像这是你的家似的。

original: You shouldn't even be here. Why don't you go do whatever it is you're supposed to be doing and leave me alone.
translation: 你根本就不该来这。为什么你不去做你该做的，让我好好静静呢？

original: Not if you keep asking me stupid questions.
translation: 如果你继续问我这些蠢问题的话，那请你一边去。

original: I don't see why not. Between Doctor Li and your dad, we've got the best minds on the job. They can do just about anything.
translation: 我不觉得没有什么不可能。李博士还有你父亲，我们有最聪明的头脑来做这项工程。他们能做成任何事。

original: Yeah, I think we'll be up and running in no time.
translation: 嗯，我想我们得加把劲，剩下的时间不多了。

original: What's your story?
translation: 说说你的故事好吗？

original: I've been with Doctor Li for about ten years now. She needed an assistant, and I needed something to do.
translation: 我已经与李博士共事了十年了。她那时需要个助手，而我需要找些事做。

original: It was either this or wind up dead in a ditch someplace, y'know?
translation: 你知道吗？要不是这样，我想我早就死在哪条不知名的水沟里了。

original: I have worked for Doctor Li for many years. She has been good to me, helped me through some difficult times.
translation: 我为李博士工作了很多年。她一直对我很好，好几次在困难的时候帮助了我。

original: I had little purpose in my life before she helped me. So now I help her in return. I am no scientist, but I am good with machines.
translation: 在接受她的帮助之前，我的人生漫无目的。所以现在是我回报她的时候。我不是个科学家，但我擅长机械。

original: Unlike some people around here, I stuck with Doctor Li through it all. I was the last one to leave when we finally gave up.
translation: 不像这的其他人那样，我一直支持着李博士。当我们最终放弃的时候，我是最后一个离开的。

original: Now your daddy shows up out of the blue, and suddenly I have to drop everything to come back and help pick up the pieces.
translation: 现在你父亲出人意料地回来了，同样我必须放下手头的一切，重新帮着收拾残局。

original: Who, me? Oh, nothing special. I grew up in Rivet City, and was always interested in what the scientists were doing there.
translation: 谁？我？哦，没什么特别的。我在铆钉城长大，一直就对科学家们做的事有兴趣。

original: Doctor Li took me under her wing, and taught me everything I know. Dan and I were out in the field when we got the call to come back.
translation: 李博士收留了我，教会了我所有事。她把我们带回来时，我和丹正流浪荒野。

original: You're right. What do you need me to do?
translation: 你是对的，需要我做什么？

original: We need to stick together, but we need to move quickly. We'll follow behind you, all right? Let's get moving.
translation: 我们得一起走，但得快点。我们会跟在你后面的，好吧？我们动身吧。

original: You're not in charge here.
translation: 你说的不算。

original: I'm responsible for these people, and with James gone, I'm responsible for Project Purity.
translation: 我要为这的人负责，而且詹姆斯不在了，我还要为净水工程负责。

original: You're not getting into the Citadel without me, so I suggest you start listening to what I have to say.
translation: 没有我你进不去五角大本营，所以从现在起你还是得听我的。

original: What do you mean, "If we can make it"?
translation: 你说“如果我们能的话”是什么意思？

original: We're underground. No one's been down here for a long time. Odds are we're not alone. Understand me?
translation: 我们在地底下，这很久没人来过了。很可能有什么怪物，明白了吗？

original: We don't have time to waste. We need to get moving.
translation: 我们没时间浪费了，得快点上路。

original: Wait here. I'll scout ahead.
translation: 等在这，我去前面看看。

original: Are you sure? I don't want to stay in one place for too long.
translation: 你确定吗？我可不想在一个地方待太久。

original: Let's get moving. Follow me.
translation: 我们走吧，跟上我。

original: We'll be right behind you. Be careful.
translation: 我们就跟在你后面，当心。

original: You have a plan?
translation: 你有什么计划吗？

original: We need to keep everyone together, and we need to get through this tunnel as quickly as possible.
translation: 我们得召集所有人一起，尽快穿越这条隧道才行。

original: We're not safe until we reach the other side. You should stay close, and we'll follow behind you.
translation: 在我们走到另一头之前都是处在危险之中的。你别走远了，我们跟在你后面。

original: What's up ahead? You seem nervous.
translation: 发生了什么事？你看上去很紧张。

original: I don't know what's ahead. That's the problem.
translation: 问题是我不知道前方有什么在等着我们。

original: No one has used these tunnels in years. But we can't stay put; the Enclave will find us eventually. We have to get moving.
translation: 这些年来从没有人用过这条隧道，但我们不能停在一个地方，英克雷的人总会找到我们的。我们得往前走。

original: Excuse me?
translation: 什么？

original: You heard me. We need you right now. You're the only one here with any amount of combat experience.
translation: 听着。现在我们需要你，你是这唯一有战斗经验的人。

original: We've got the Enclave behind us and who-knows-what ahead of us. If we're going to make it through here, we need your help.
translation: 后面有英克雷的追兵，前面又不知有什么危险。我们需要你帮助我们安全通过这。

original: Where to now?
translation: 现在去哪？

original: This tunnel leads to the Citadel, the Brotherhood of Steel's fortress. We should be safe there, if we can make it.
translation: 这条隧道通向五角大本营，钢铁兄弟会的要塞。到那我们就安全了，当然是如果我们能的话。

original: Lyons! I know you're in there! I know you can hear me! You open this goddamn door right now!
translation: 里昂斯！我知道你在这！我知道你能听见我！现在就把这该死的门打开！

original: I'm sorry, ma'am. No unauthorized civilians allowed inside the Citadel. You'll have to leave now.
translation: 我很抱歉，夫人。未授权的平民不得进入五角大本营。你必须立刻离开。

original: I am Doctor Madison Li. I have people with me in need of shelter. You must allow us access at once.
translation: 我是李博士。我和我的人须要庇护，请立刻让我们进去。

original: I believe I can handle things from here.
translation: 我想我能处理这的事。

original: Can we talk about, you know... mom?
translation: 我们能谈谈，你知道的……妈妈…

original: Your mother, she... she was beautiful. But... beyond the beauty you've seen. There's just so much those old photos can never show.
translation: 你母亲，她……她很漂亮。但……除了你见到的那些照片以外，还有很多已经找不到了。

original: And she was passionate. About life, about love. But most of all, most of all she was passionate about you.
translation: 同时她也充满了热情，对生命，对爱情。但最重要的是，她对你所倾注的感情。

original: When she became pregnant, it was the happiest I had ever seen her. Ahhhh.... she had great things in mind for you....
translation: 当她怀孕的时候，是我见过的她最开心的时刻。啊……她把很大的梦想寄托在你身上……

original: And so! Time for you to stop stalling and get to class! Please, honey, please take these achievement tests seriously.
translation: 所以！时间到了，你该去教室了！拜托，亲爱的，认真对待这测试。

original: The last thing I need is you mother's ghost haunting me because her only child became a garbage burner.
translation: 我最不愿意看到是，她唯一的孩子成了个废物，而你母亲的灵魂因为这来埋怨我。

original: Your mother, she... she was beautiful. But... beyond the beauty you've seen. There's just so much those old photos can never show.
translation: 你母亲，她……她很漂亮。但……除了你见到的那些照片以外，还有很多已经找不到了。

original: And she was passionate. About life, about love. But most of all, most of all she was passionate about you.
translation: 同时她也充满了热情，对生命，对爱情。但最重要的是，她对你倾注的感情。

original: When she became pregnant, it was the happiest I had ever seen her. Ahhhh.... she had great things in mind for you....
translation: 当她怀孕的时候，是我见过的她最开心的时刻。啊……她把很大的梦想寄托在你身上……

original: And so! Time for you to stop stalling and get to class! Please, son, please take these achievement tests seriously.
translation: 所以！时间到了，你该去教室了！拜托，儿子，认真对待这测试。

original: The last thing I need is your mother's ghost haunting me because her only child became a garbage burner.
translation: 我最不愿意看到是，她唯一的孩子成了个废物，以致你母亲的灵魂为此来埋怨我。

original: Is it true, Dad? Was everyone born in the Vault?
translation: 爸爸，真的吗？每个人都是在避难所里出生的？

original: That's what the Overseer says, isn't it?
translation: 监督者是这么说的，对吧？

original: He's not about to let anyone else in, so I guess that's how it'll have to be.
translation: 他不让任何人进来，所以我猜就是这样的。

original: You're here now, and it's a hell of a lot better than being up there. All your mother and I ever wanted was for you to be safe, and you're safe here.
translation: 你现在在这，虽然这地方不怎么样，但还是比外面好多了。你母亲和我只是想让你安全罢了，而且你现在在这里很安全。

original: Do we have to die in the Vault? Can't we ever leave?
translation: 我们必须死在避难所里吗？我们不能出去吗？

original: That's not the way it works. And it won't do to go around asking questions like that. Especially not around the Overseer.
translation: 这可不是你该想的，同样不要到处去问这样的问题，特别是不要去问监督者。

original: I want to tell you something now. It's important, so listen closely: this place, this Vault... it's not perfect, I know. But it is your home.
translation: 我要告诉你一些重要的事情，所以听仔细了：这地方，这避难所，并不完美，我知道，但这是你的家。

original: You're safe here. Stay on the Overseer's good side, and you always will be. You understand? You need to appreciate all you have.
translation: 你在这很安全，听监督者的话，你会一直很安全的，明白了吗？你应当感激你得到的一切。

original: Because what's up there, on the outside, that's not the life I want for you, and it's not what your mother wanted for you, either.
translation: 因为我不想让你过外面的世界的那种生活，你母亲也同样不想。

original: Anything I need to know about the G.O.A.T.?
translation: 关于G.O.A.T.，我需要知道什么吗？

original: The Generalized Occupational Aptitude Test. G.O.A.T.! Everyone here in the Vault takes it when they're sixteen.
translation: G.O.A.T.的全称是广泛性职业能力测试！避难所里的每个人在16岁时都要参加。

original: Helps to figure out what sort of job you'll have here in Vault 101 when you get a bit older. So, pay attention and try not to fall asleep.
translation: 这项测验会判断当你长大后适合从事什么样的工作，所以记着要集中精力，别在测验时睡着了。

original: You know what the Overseer says: "We're born in the Vault. We die in the Vault."
translation: 你应该还记得监督者说过：“我们生于避难所，我们死于避难所。”

original: "Each is tested to determine their abilities, that they may work for the betterment of all Vault residents." Sound familiar?
translation: “这项测验检查每个人的各项能力，从而令他们充分发挥自己的才能，来改善避难所居民的生活。”听着很熟悉吧？

original: But, I'm sick. Really. <Lie.>
translation: 但我病了，真的。<撒谎>

original: No, you're not. Really.
translation: 不，你没有。别撒谎。

original: When I started studying medicine, one of the first things I learned was how to spot a kid playing sick to get out of taking a test.
translation: 当我开始学医的时候，我学到的第一件事就是怎样辨别一个为了逃避测试而装病的孩子。

original: You'll do fine. It's not so bad. Everyone has to take it when they're sixteen. I had to, you have to, and so does everyone else.
translation: 你能做好的，没那么糟。每个人到了16岁都要接受测试。我需要，你需要，每个人都需要。

original: And most everyone makes it through without a scratch.
translation: 而且所有人都安然无恙地完成了。

original: If you say so, Dad.
translation: 如果你这么说的话，爸爸。

original: Hey, it's not my call. Those are the rules.
translation: 嗨，这可不是我要你做的。这是规定。

original: You're sixteen now, so this year you take the G.O.A.T.
translation: 你已经16岁了，所以今年你要参加G.O.A.T.。

original: Come on. It's not so bad. Everyone has to take it. You'll do just fine.
translation: 来吧，没那么糟。每个人都要参加，你会做得很好的。

original: Fine. Let's go.
translation: 好吧。我们走。

original: Whatever you say, Butch. You're the boss! Tunnel Snakes rule!
translation: 听你的吩咐，布奇。你是老大。穴蛇帮主宰一切！

original: C'mon, Tunnel Snakes. This little bitch isn't worth our time.
translation: 好啦，穴蛇帮。这小杂种不值得我们浪费时间。

original: I'm not finished with you, either, twerp.
translation: 这事我也跟你没完，蠢材。

original: This ain't over, daddy's girl.
translation: 后会有期，乖乖女。

original: Fine. Let's go. I was done here, anyway.
translation: 好了，我们走吧。怎么说我也完事了。

original: Are you sure? Butch? Um... okay. Whatever you say, Wally. Tunnel Snakes rule!
translation: 你确定吗，布奇？呃……好吧，听你的吩咐，瓦利。穴蛇帮主宰一切！

original: Don't know who put you in charge. I say we're done. Let's go, Paul.
translation: 我不知道谁派你来的。我说我们完事了。走吧，保利。

original: Done? We're not done! I say when we're done.
translation: 好了吗？我们完事了！我说我们完事了。

original: We're done here.
translation: 我们到此为止。

original: I've heard you do anything he tells you. And I mean anything.
translation: 我听说他说什么你就干什么，不管什么事。

original: What? What kind of shit is that? No one talks that way about Wally Mack!
translation: 什么？这是什么话？没人敢这么跟瓦利·麦克说话！

original: He's not the boss of me! Nobody's the boss of me! I'm out of here.
translation: 他不是我的老大！没人是我的老大！我要离开这。

original: If you say so.
translation: 如果你这样说的话。

original: I do say so. Buzz off.
translation: 我确实这么说了。就这些。

original: Oh, I get it! Butch is the leader. You're just... a follower.
translation: 哦，我知道了！布奇是头，你只是个……跟班。

original: I don't follow anyone. Wally Mack is his own man. And the Tunnel Snakes is where I belong.
translation: 我不是任何人的跟班。瓦利·麦克是个大丈夫，我只属于穴蛇帮。

original: Why? You think Butch is in charge? Is that what people are saying? Because it's a load of shit, if that's what they're saying.
translation: 为什么？你们让布奇说了算？你们是都这么说吗？如果他们那样说的话，就因为他是狗屎。

original: Why do you listen to Butch?
translation: 为什么你们要听布奇的？

original: Because he's my pal. My brother. All us Tunnel Snakes are brothers. Birth to earth. Womb to tomb.
translation: 因为他是我的伙计，我的兄弟。穴蛇帮都是兄弟，一起出生入死。

original: Mostly because Tunnel Snakes rule!
translation: 因为穴蛇帮主宰一切！

original: None of your business. Because Butch said so. And what Butch says, goes.
translation: 没你的事，布奇说了，你少管闲事，滚。

original: Tunnel Snakes rule!
translation: 穴蛇帮主宰一切！

original: Yeah. I got that. Why are you picking on Amata?
translation: 嗯，我明白了。你为什么要烦阿玛塔？

original: Stay out of this. It's Tunnel Snake business.
translation: 离远点。这是穴蛇帮的事。

original: Me and Butch, we're just having some fun with this chick.
translation: 我和布奇只是在找这小鸡的乐子。

original: You have a problem with Amata?
translation: 你对阿玛塔有意见？

original: Look, Amata, this is none of my business. I don't want to get involved...
translation: 阿玛塔，这没我什么事。我可不想把自己卷进去……

original: Don't want to get involved? Thanks a lot.
translation: 不想卷进去？非常感谢。

original: Fine. Go. I don't need your help, anyway.
translation: 好，你走吧。我才不需要你帮忙。

original: You have to fight your own battles. I can't help you with everything...
translation: 你得为自己而战。我不能帮你的忙……

original: Fight my own battles? Sure. Three against one is fair. What's gotten into you?
translation: 为我自己而战？没问题，三对一很公平。你在想什么？

original: I thought we were friends. Turns out you're just as big a jerk as these idiots.
translation: 我还以为我们是朋友呢。看来你是和那群白痴一样的大蠢货。

original: I'll see if I can talk some sense into them.
translation: 我看我能不能劝劝他们。

original: Thanks. You've always been a good friend. Try talking to Butch. They'll all do whatever he says.
translation: 谢谢。你一直是个好朋友。去跟布奇谈谈吧，他们对他言听计从。

original: If you keep messing with her, the Overseer is going to come down on your gang.
translation: 如果你们再骚扰她，监督者可不会放过你们。

original: Maybe you're right. We can deal with her later.
translation: 或许你是对的。我们可以以后收拾她。

original: Maybe I can help. She's very sensitive about her weight...
translation: 或许我能帮点忙。她很在意自己的体重……

original: Her weight, huh? I can see why.
translation: 她的体重，呃？我知道为什么了。

original: You're okay, pipsqueak. Now, run along before you get hurt.
translation: 你干的不错，小不点。现在在你挨揍之前滚开。

original: Leave her alone, or you'll answer to me.
translation: 别缠着她，否则我对你不客气。

original: Whoa, take it easy. No need to go all psycho on me again. We were just joking with her.
translation: 哇，别生气。不用替我喊医生，我们只是跟她开玩笑。

original: And who are you? Her boyfriend? Ha!
translation: 你又是谁？她的男朋友？哈~！

original: Keep talking like that, boy, and we'll send you back to your daddy with a few broken bones for him to fix.
translation: 你要是再这么讲话，小子，我们会很乐意打断你几根骨头再让你爸帮你接上的。

original: And who are you? Her girlfriend? Ha! Should have known.
translation: 你又是谁？她的女朋友？哈！真该早点知道。

original: Keep talking like that, girl, and we'll send you back to your daddy with a few broken bones for him to fix.
translation: 你要是再这么讲话，女孩，我们会很愿意打断你几根骨头让再你爸帮你接上的。

original: Hey, it's none of my business.
translation: 嗨，这不关我事。

original: You've got that right. Just keep moving, and maybe we won't come looking for you next.
translation: 算你识相，快滚吧。或许我们下次会放过你。

original: Leave Tunnel Snake business to the Tunnel Snakes.
translation: 别在穴蛇帮头上动土。

original: Looks like you're having fun.
translation: 看上去你挺开心的。

original: Damn right. And you'll stay out of our way, if you know what's good for you.
translation: 该死的真对。如果你识相的话，就别多管闲事！

original: No one messes with the Tunnel Snakes. Especially not this stuck up little daddy's girl.
translation: 没人敢惹穴蛇帮，特别是这位识明智的乖乖女。

original: What's going on here?
translation: 这出什么事了？

original: None of your business, kid. Get outta here before you get hurt.
translation: 没你的事，小子。在你挨揍之前快滚。

original: If you mess with the Tunnel Snakes, you're asking for it. Got me?
translation: 要是敢惹穴蛇帮，你就是自找苦吃。明白了吗？

original: I'm not fat!
translation: 我一点也不胖！

original: But, I'm not fat!
translation: 但是，我一点也不胖！

original: Stop it! Stop it!
translation: 住手！住手！

original: Leave me alone!
translation: 离我远点！

original: Stay away from me!
translation: 滚开！

original: Back off, Butch!
translation: 退开，布奇！

original: Shut up, Butch!
translation: 闭嘴，布奇！

original: Go away, you stupid Tunnel Snakes!
translation: 滚，你们这帮愚蠢的穴蛇帮！

original: I'm not scared of you, Wally Mack!
translation: 我才不怕你，瓦利·麦克！

original: Leave me alone, Wally!
translation: 别烦我，瓦利！

original: Help!
translation: 救命啊！

original: Get away from me!
translation: 离我远点！

original: Amata's not fat, she's just 5 feet too short.
translation: 阿玛塔一点也不胖，就是稍微矮了点。

original: We're gonna run out of rations if Amata keeps eating.
translation: 要是阿玛塔继续这么吃下去，很快就要把我们的食物全吃光了。

original: Gonna go cry to your daddy, fatass?
translation: 要去你爸那哭诉了，胖妞？

original: You put on a couple of pounds, Amata?
translation: 阿玛塔，你最近又重了十几磅吗？

original: What's the matter. Daddy's girl gonna cry?
translation: 怎么了。乖乖女要哭了？

original: I can show you a real tunnel snake, Amata.
translation: 阿玛塔，我会让你见识一下什么才是真正的穴蛇帮。

original: You think you're special because your daddy is the Overseer?
translation: 你觉得爸爸是监督者就高人一等了？

original: Hey, fatso, I got something you can put in your mouth!
translation: 嗨，胖子，我这有些你能塞到嘴里去的东西！

original: Watch out! Wide load coming through!
translation: 小心！路不够宽！

original: Hey, lardass!
translation: 嗨，肥驴！

original: She thinks she's better than us!
translation: 她认为自己比我们强！

original: Tell her, Butch!
translation: 布奇，跟她说说！

original: She's nothing, Butch!
translation: 布奇，她什么也不是！

original: Amata's got more chins than a Chinese phone book!
translation: 阿玛塔胖得都有好几个下巴了！

original: Amata's so fat, her clothes have stretch marks!
translation: 阿玛塔好胖啊，你看她的衣服都被撑开了。

original: Amata's so fat, she broke her leg and gravy poured out!
translation: 阿玛塔好胖啊，她腿磕破了，流出来的都是油。

original: Careful. Amata might eat us!
translation: 小心哦，阿玛塔可能会吃了我们！

original: Been spending some extra time in the diner, Amata?
translation: 每天你都要花额外的时间吃晚餐吗，阿玛塔？

original: Let's go into the storeroom, Amata. I'll show you a good time....
translation: 阿玛塔我们去储藏室吧，我会让你很爽的……

original: Daddy's girl! Daddy's girl!
translation: 乖乖女！乖乖女！

original: Show it to her, Butch!
translation: 布奇，给她看看！

original: Okay. I'll be back soon.
translation: 好的，我很快就回来。

original: That's the spirit!
translation: 就是这股劲！

original: Tunnel Snakes? You guys are some kind of gang, is that it?
translation: 穴蛇帮？你们只是帮小混混，对吧？

original: Only the baddest gang in Vault 101. Like you don't know. We rule this Vault, and what we say goes.
translation: 我们可是101号避难所里最专业的混混。好像你还不知道，避难所是我们的地盘，我们说了算。

original: You'll stay out of our way, if you know what's good for you.
translation: 如果你识相的话，你最好别管闲事。

original: That's us. And we rule!
translation: 就是我们，我们说了算！

original: No one messes with the Tunnel Snakes. Or they have to answer to Butch. And Wally. You don't want to be on their bad sides. Trust me.
translation: 没人敢惹穴蛇帮，不然他们就得跟布奇和瓦利报道了。相信我，你可不会想跟他们对着干。

original: What's all this about the Tunnel Snakes?
translation: 穴蛇帮是什么东西？

original: What? You mouthing off, spaz? Everyone knows the Tunnel Snakes!
translation: 什么？你闭嘴，白痴？没人不知道穴蛇帮！

original: We rule this Vault, and we don't take shit from nobody. Not you, not her, and not her daddy, the Overseer.
translation: 避难所里我们说了算，没人敢惹我们，包括你，她，还有她爸爸，也就是监督者。

original: Should I have heard of the Tunnel Snakes?
translation: 你觉得我该听说过穴蛇帮吗？

original: A bunch of idiots, if you ask me. They think they're so tough, with their "gang."
translation: 他们就是一群白痴，我没别的评价。他们以为组个帮派就很厉害。

original: All they ever do is hang around and cause trouble. They've got it in for me because my father is the Overseer. Like that's my fault!
translation: 他们就知道在这惹是生非。因为我父亲是监督者，就来找我的麻烦，好像这是我的错一样。

original: Butch and his friends bothering you again?
translation: 布奇和他那帮狐朋狗友又来烦你了？

original: Can't think of anything. Butch says this little bitch is blabbing to her daddy about us Tunnel Snakes. We can't have that.
translation: 记不起来了吗？布奇说这小婊子去她爸爸那告发我们，我们可咽不下这口气。

original: Because we're the Tunnel Snakes. And we rule!
translation: 因为我们是穴蛇帮。我们说了算！

original: Don't you have something better to do?
translation: 你就没比这更好的事去做？

original: Why don't you mind your own business? Last I checked, you weren't a Tunnel Snake.
translation: 你最好该干嘛就干嘛。我知道，你不是个穴蛇帮。

original: Run along, kid. Before Butch and I decide you're a problem.
translation: 在布奇和我准备找你麻烦之前，快点滚开。

original: Why don't you leave her alone?
translation: 你们为什么不离她远点？

original: Never mind. Let's just get back to work.
translation: 没事，我们回去工作。

original: All right.
translation: 好的。

original: I think I understand. I'm glad we talked.
translation: 我想我明白了。真高兴我们能谈谈。

original: So am I, my love. While this isn't what I had in mind, it's good to have you with me.
translation: 我也是，我的宝贝。尽管我以前没打算这样，但有你在我身边真好。

original: So am I, son. While this isn't what I had in mind, it's good to have you with me.
translation: 我也是，儿子。尽管我以前没打算这样，但有你在我身边真好。

original: Just forget it. Let's get this over with.
translation: 忘了吧。过去的就让它过去吧。

original: I hope that you can understand why I've done the things that I've done. The last thing I want is to lose my daughter.
translation: 我希望你明白我为什么要这么做，我最不想看到的就是失去我的女儿。

original: I hope that you can understand why I've done the things that I've done. The last thing I want is to lose my son.
translation: 我希望你明白我为什么要这么做，我最不想看到的就是失去我的儿子。

original: Helping people? What about helping your own son?
translation: 帮助别人？还是先帮帮你的儿子吧？

original: I can understand that you're angry. You have a right to be.
translation: 我知道你为什么生气，当然你也确实有权利生气。

original: Perhaps the choice I made wasn't the right one. At the time, I thought I was doing what was best for you.
translation: 或许当时我做了个错误的选择。当时，我以为为你做的一切都是最好的。

original: Helpling people? What about helping your own daughter?
translation: 帮助别人？还是先帮帮你的女儿吧？

original: I can understand that you're angry. You have a right to be.
translation: 我知道你为什么生气，当然你也确实有权利生气。

original: Perhaps the choice I made wasn't the right one. At the time, I thought I was doing what was best for you.
translation: 或许当时我做了个错误的选择。当时，我以为为你做的一切都是最好的。

original: Is this about mom? Are you trying so hard because of what happened to her?
translation: 是因为我妈妈？你这么努力完全是因为我妈妈的缘故吗？

original: Oh, my child. If only you could have known how much it meant to her. She believed in the work we were doing, and was so determined to see it through.
translation: 哦，我的孩子，你要知道这对她意味着什么。她一直都支持着我们的工作，从来都没有动摇过。

original: She gave up so much for the project. We all did, and I don't want that to have been for nothing.
translation: 她为这项工程付出的太多了。我们也都一样，所以我不想让所有人的努力付之东流。

original: Oh, my son. If only you could have known how much it meant to her. She believed in the work we were doing, and was so determined to see it through.
translation: 哦，我的儿子，你要知道这对她意味着什么。她一直都支持着我们的工作，从来都没有动摇过。

original: She gave up so much for the project. We all did, and I don't want that to have been for nothing.
translation: 她为这项工程付出的太多了。我们也都一样，所以我不想让所有人的努力付之东流。

original: Can't we just go back to the Vault, back to the way things were?
translation: 我们就不能回避难所，过回我们以前的生活吗？

original: Somehow I don't think the Overseer would agree to that.
translation: 我不知道，我不觉得监督者会那么大度。

original: What's done is done. But if we succeed, if we can make Project Purity a reality, we can create a new life for ourselves out here.
translation: 过去的就让它过去吧。但如果我们成功了，如果我们能让净水工程运作，就会为我们所有人开创一个世纪新纪元的。

original: Why would you put yourself at risk like this? You have some sort of death wish?
translation: 你为什么要冒这个险？你想找死吗？

original: What? No. No, of course not!
translation: 什么？不，不，当然不是！

original: I just... This is important work. Clean water can change the lives of so many people. It's worth the risk to help them.
translation: 只是……这是件重要的工作，净化的水能改变很多人的生活。这值得我冒险。

original: Just what are you trying to do here?
translation: 你打算在这干嘛？

original: There's so much history here. So much time and energy spent on this place, because it could help so many people.
translation: 这片大地上承载了如此多的历史，它值得你付出时间和经历去帮助众生。

original: And now, after all these years, there's a chance to finish it. To see it through to the end, and help all the people of the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 多年后的今天，你终有机会去完成你的使命。完成你的宿愿吧，帮助首都废土人民去阻止这场灾难。

original: How could you leave me like that? What the hell were you thinking?
translation: 你怎么能就这样离开我？你现在究竟在想什么？

original: I wanted you to be safe. I didn't want this for you -- a life out here in this godforsaken warzone.
translation: 我想你平安，我不想你的一生在废土战场里度过。

original: I couldn't tell you what I was doing because I didn't want you following me.
translation: 我不能告诉你我在做什么，因为我不想你步我后尘。

original: A plan which clearly was not as successful as I imagined it would be.
translation: 很显然，计划远不如我想象的那么成功。

original: Can we just talk for a minute?
translation: 我们能谈谈吗？

original: Of course, honey. What's on your mind?
translation: 当然，亲爱的。你在想什么？

original: Of course, son. What's on your mind?
translation: 当然，孩子。你在想什么？

original: What's on your mind?
translation: 你在想什么？

original: I wanted to talk to you about some things.
translation: 有些事我想和你谈谈。

original: I'll need some details before I can decide.
translation: 在我做决定之前, 我还要先知道些细节。

original: Hey, you're pretty smart for a Wastelander!
translation: 嗨，作为一个废土游民，你算聪明了！

original: I need you to deliver a message to my family. They live in a small settlement northwest of here. If you bring it, I'm sure my dad will pay you.
translation: 我想你能帮我送封信到我家里，就在西北部的一个小型定居点。倘若你能帮我捎信，我敢保证我爸爸会付你一笔小费的。

original: I'll tell you more if you agree. Please, I could really use your help.
translation: 如果你同意的话。我还可以透露给你更多信息，求求你，我确实需要你的帮助。

original: So you just disappear without saying a word?
translation: 所以你就这样一言不发地离开？

original: I had thought that after my escape, the Overseer would seal the vault. You'd have no choice to stay behind.
translation: 我从这逃离后，想必监督者已经把避难所关闭了。你们无法离开，只能待在里面。

original: I suppose I underestimated how resourceful you are.
translation: 我想我低估了你的智商。

original: You could have told me you were leaving.
translation: 你离开的时候本该告诉我一声的。

original: Oh, be honest. Can you really say you wouldn't have tried to come with me if you knew?
translation: 哦，说实在的，你真的不是因为想跟我一起离开才故意这么说的？

original: I told you, I wanted a different life for you. I had hoped the Overseer would seal the Vault, making it impossible for you to leave.
translation: 我曾对你说过，我要给你一个崭新的生活，我曾希望监督者能关闭避难所，这样你就没法离开那里了。

original: It might mean you spent the rest of your life hating me, but... your well-being was worth that chance.
translation: 也许你会因此恨我一辈子，但……如果你能更幸福，我宁愿你恨我。

original: You really think you can do this? Make this thing work?
translation: 你确定你真的可以操作这些东西吗？

original: I wouldn't be here if I didn't. With what I've learned from Doctor Braun, I know it can work.
translation: 如果我不会，就不会站在这。我从布劳恩博士那学习了怎么操作。

original: That's why it's so important we find a G.E.C.K. as soon as possible. It's the key to Project Purity.
