translation: 它之所以那么重要，是因为这是净水工程的关键，我们要尽快找到关键的伊甸园创造器。

original: Why would you throw away the life we had?
translation: 为什么你要让我们冒着生命的危险来做这件事？

original: You have to understand, the Vault wasn't for me. It was for you. To make sure my daughter grew up someplace safe, away from all this.
translation: 你要知道我和你一起来避难所并不是为了我自己，而是为了你，我是要确保我的女儿生活在一个安全的地方，而不是凶险无比的废土世界。

original: I didn't want you to leave. I wanted you to stay there, to grow up and live your life in safety.
translation: 我不想让你离开这，我要你留下来，在安全的环境下生活。

original: You have to understand, the Vault wasn't for me. It was for you. To make sure my son grew up someplace safe, away from all this.
translation: 你要知道我和你一起来避难所并不是为了我自己，而是为了你，我是要确保我的儿子生活在一个安全的地方，而不是凶险无比的废土世界。

original: I didn't want you to leave. I wanted you to stay there, to grow up and live your life in safety.
translation: 我不想让你离开这，我要你留下来，在安全的环境下生活。

original: You know what? Fuck you, Dad.
translation: 知道我想说什么吗？你去死吧，爸爸。

original: I'm sorry you feel that way.
translation: 你那样想，我真的很遗憾。

original: How could abandoning me be the right choice?
translation: 你怎么就不能按我帮你规划好的去做呢？

original: For almost twenty years now, I've done everything I can to see that you have a good life.
translation: 快20年了，为了能让你生活得好些，我花费了全部心血。

original: The Vault wasn't perfect, to be sure, but it was the safest place in the Wasteland. That's why I took you there in the first place.
translation: 这避难所确实还不够完善，但它却是这片废土里最安全的地方，这就是我为什么一开始带你来这地方的原因。

original: I didn't see it as abandoning you. I saw it as moving on, knowing you were safe.
translation: 带你到避难所，不是想遗弃你，而是为了让你能健康成长。

original: I know it's painful, but let's talk about what happened in Arefu.
translation: 我知道这很痛苦，但我们还是先谈谈断桥镇发生的事吧。

original: It actually kinda makes me feel better to talk about it. Go ahead.
translation: 谈论它其实让我感觉好一点。继续。

original: What can I do to help?
translation: 我能帮忙做什么？

original: I don't have sufficient medical supplies with me, or else this wouldn't be a problem. If you have any Stimpaks, I would ask that you hand them over.
translation: 我身上带的药品不多，不过这也不是什么大问题。要是你有治疗针，把它们统统都交出来。

original: We don't have time for this shit. Let's go!
translation: 我们可不想在这件事上浪费时间，我们走！

original: I said I will NOT leave him. Now look around for any sort of medical supplies. There must be something we can put to use.
translation: 我说过我绝不会离开他，现在我们到处寻找某些药品。迟早会有它们的用武之地。

original: Let's go. This is no time to sit down.
translation: 我们走，我们可没有时间在这逗留。

original: I'm afraid I can't do that.
translation: 恐怕我办不到。

original: Doctor Li can tell you. It's my heart.
translation: 李博士会告诉你，我的心脏出了问题。

original: Garza is in need of medical attention immediately. He has a heart condition. I will not leave him behind.
translation: 加尔萨需要立刻进行医疗。他心脏不太好，我不能丢下他不管。

original: Stop here? Are you crazy?
translation: 留在这？你疯了？

original: What's the matter? Are you all right?
translation: 发生什么事了，你没事吧？

original: I... my heart. It's weak, and I have no medicine with me.
translation: 我……我的心脏跳动很微弱，可我身上没带药品。

original: Doctor Li, she can explain.
translation: 李博士，她可以解释一下。

original: Garza has a heart condition. He needs medicine, or he may not make it. I'm not moving until he gets the medicine he needs.
translation: 加尔萨心脏情况不妙，他需要药品，不吃药是无法好转的，我要等他拿到所需药品后才能离开。

original: Why would we stop now?
translation: 为什么我们要停下？

original: Doctor Li. My heart... I must rest.
translation: 李博士，我的心脏……我必须得歇会。

original: Do I look like someone that you want to blow off?
translation: 我像是那种你想甩掉的人吗？

original: Okay, tough guy. Say what's on your mind.
translation: 好吧，难缠的家伙，告诉我你有什么想法？

original: Well now, looks like she's got some spice. Say what's on your mind.
translation: 她好像找到些有趣的东西，你怎么看？

original: I'm sorry to interrupt, Andy. I just had a few questions.
translation: 安迪，抱歉打扰了，我只是还有一些疑问。

original: [sighs] I suppose. Just make it quick.
translation: <叹气> 我想是的，下手快点就是了。

original: I'm sorry to interrupt, Andy. I just had a few questions.
translation: 安迪，抱歉打扰了，我只是还有一些疑问。

original: Wait here a minute.
translation: 在这等一下。

original: Oh no you don't. You have the Declaration on you now. I'm going to stick to you like glue until we reach Abraham Washington.
translation: 你还不能走，你现在手上有宣言，在我们见到亚伯拉罕·华盛顿前，我会像胶水一样一直粘着你。

original: Sure thing, but don't get too far ahead of me.
translation: 当然行，但你不能走得太靠前。

original: You got it. Just don't stray too far.
translation: 当然可以，但你别跑太远。

original: Yep. Don't go too far.
translation: 对。别走远。

original: Whoa, whoa. Slow down. Let me think a minute.
translation: 哇，哇。等等。让我考虑下。

original: Slow huh? Okay. Hurry though, I don't want to wait here for more of those things to crack open my skull.
translation: 让我慢点？好吧。不过还是快点，我可不想在这待太久，让那些家伙把我脑袋开花。

original: What's our next move?
translation: 我们下一步该怎么做？

original: Let's head for Rivet City. It's a bit of a hike, but I want to get back there so I can start spending my caps!
translation: 我们还是先前往铆钉城吧，尽管有点远，但我可以到那尽情地挥霍我的瓶盖！

original: Don't worry, I know exactly where it is... we should make it in one piece.
translation: 别担心，我对路很熟，我们会安然无恙地到达那的。

original: Let's head for Rivet City. It's a bit of a hike, but I want to get back there so I can start spending my caps!
translation: 我们还是先前往铆钉城吧，尽管有点远，但我可以到那尽情地挥霍我的瓶盖！

original: Let's get the hell out of here. Time to get paid, then get drunk!
translation: 我们他妈离开这吧，先去领赏，然后去喝个一醉方休！

original: There should be an elevator to the upper level somewhere around here.
translation: 这附近应该有个电梯可以抵达上层。

original: What else, let's get the document!
translation: 还有，我们要拿到文件！

original: Look, if you think you can reason with him, go right ahead. My advice? Blow its damn head off. It's obviously malfunctioning.
translation: 听着，如果你觉得和他有道理可讲的话，那请继续。我的建议？打爆他该死的头，显然出了故障。

original: Either way, I'll let you decide. Anything that gets us closer to the prize is fine by me.
translation: 不管怎样，我会让你来决定，对我而言，只要能拿到报酬就行。

original: What do you make of this "Button Gwinnett" robot?
translation: 对于这个“巴顿·格温耐特”机器人，你怎么看？

original: Inside the Archives Strongroom should be the Declaration. I have no idea what's inside. That's the only part of the plans I never found.
translation: 这档案库机要室里存放的应该是宣言，我不知道里面是什么，这是我唯一没找到的。

original: If you can find and disable the turret generator, most of the turrets in the East Wing should go offline.
translation: 如果你能找到并关闭炮台发电机，那么在东翼的大部分炮台将会离线。

original: If you're any good at hacking or lockpicking, we can get through the maintenance doors or utility gates.
translation: 如果你擅长入侵电脑或开锁，我们就能打开维修仓或工作间的大门。

original: There should be shortcuts like it all over the East Wing.
translation: 这一定有通往东翼的捷径。

original: They kept the Declaration in the Archives Strongroom that's at the end of the East wing here. We'll have to make our way to it.
translation: 他们把宣言放在档案库机要室，也就是东翼的末端，我们要自己找到那。

original: It looks like we're in the Sub-Basement hub. I think the door we want is the one to the East. Never been this far in, only saw it on blueprints.
translation: 看来我们是在下层地下室中心。我想这的门应该是通往东翼。从没到达这么深入的地方，只在设计图上看过这。

original: There's a cargo lift right here in the Rotunda. It should take us directly down to the lower levels.
translation: 在圆形大厅里有一架货梯。它直接通向最底层。

original: I was hacking the system right before we were attacked. The code should be "We the People."
translation: 我们受到攻击前，我正在试图进入他们的电脑系统。密码应该是“我们人民。”

original: Nope, not interested.
translation: 不，没兴趣。

original: Fine by me. I've waited this long to get the Declaration, I can wait 'til someone smarter comes along.
translation: 我可是无所谓。为了得到宣言，我已经等待了很久。再等到更精明的人出现也无妨。

original: Don't try and follow me, not that you could.
translation: 别想跟踪我，再说你也跟不上。

original: Sure, let's team up.
translation: 可以，那我们合作。

original: Smart move.
translation: 聪明的举动。

original: Okay, the Declaration is secured in the Archives Strongroom underground.
translation: 好的，宣言存放在地下的档案库机要室里。

original: There's a concealed cargo lift right here in the center of the rotunda. I've spent a few days hacking the lock with my remote terminal.
translation: 在这圆形大厅的中央有内藏式货梯，我耗费了几天时间才用远程终端打开了那锁。

original: When you're ready, punch in the password and let's get going.
translation: 当你准备好的时候，输入密码，我们就出发。

original: What are you proposing?
translation: 你有什么打算？

original: Simple. We pool our resources, grab the Declaration then make for Rivet City and split the reward.
translation: 简单，我们共享资源，夺取宣言，然后去铆钉城分报酬。

original: I've studied the plans to this place, so without me you're going to go in circles. What do you say?
translation: 我已经勘察研究过这地方的线路，没有我，你只能原地打转兜圈子，你觉得呢？

original: I don't work with strangers.
translation: 我不与陌生人合作。

original: Okay cowboy, go ahead and blunder through the place. You'll never make it to the Declaration let alone back to Rivet City for the reward.
translation: 好吧，牛仔，你只管一路跌爬滚打，从这出去。你永远不会得到宣言，更别指望还能带它回铆钉城拿报酬。

original: You have no idea what type of resistance your up against. If I were you, I'd take every extra gun I could.
translation: 你对自己所要面对的险阻一无所知。如果我是你，我会尽可能的多带些枪。

original: I've studied the plans to this place, so without me you're going to go in circles. What do you say?
translation: 我已经勘察研究过这地方的线路，没有我，你只能原地打转兜圈子，你觉得呢？

original: What do you mean "fellow relic hunter"?
translation: 你说的“古董猎人”是什么意思？

original: Come on... you and I both know this is where the Declaration of Independence is stashed... no need to be coy about it.
translation: 拜托……你和我都很清楚这就存放《独立宣言》的地点，没必要对此含糊其辞。

original: Good old Abraham Washington sent you on the same suicide mission he sent me on.
translation: 老亚伯拉罕·华盛顿让我们来干同一个自杀任务。

original: Only problem is, you're not going to get it without my help.
translation: 唯一的问题是，没有我的帮助你不可能如愿。

original: Yep. I sure am.
translation: 对。我当然可以。

original: Ho ho. Do I detect a hint of wit? Rare to run into that in the Capital Wastes.
translation: 呵呵。很是明智嘛！很少在首都废土碰到那个吧。

original: Sorry, I'm being a complete asshole. I'm Sydney. It's good to meet a fellow relic hunter.
translation: 抱歉，我真是个混蛋。我是希妮，很高兴遇到一个古董猎人同行。

original: Thanks, you're not so bad yourself.
translation: 谢谢，你也不赖。

original: Well, with what I do for a living, you need to be.
translation: 很好，我依靠这谋生，必须如此。

original: Sorry, I'm being a complete asshole. I'm Sydney. It's good to meet a fellow relic hunter.
translation: 抱歉，我真是个混蛋。我是希妮，很高兴遇到一个古董猎人同行。

original: Can we stop beating around the bush, please? What's the reward?
translation: 我们别拐弯抹角了？有什么好处？

original: Sorry, my mind tends to wander. I would see to it you receive a worthwhile trade.
translation: 抱歉，我思绪太发散了。我会保证你得到相称的报酬。

original: I have in my possession the only known schematic for the creation of something called the Railway Rifle.
translation: 我这有一张可以用来参考制造射钉枪的设计图，它可是仅有的一张。

original: Bring me the Declaration, and it's yours.
translation: 给我带来宣言，它就是你的。

original: Can the speech, Abe. I need to get paid.
translation: 别废话，亚伯拉罕。我想要报酬。

original: Heroes of the United States will receive rewards befitting their rank, I can assure you. Your prize will be no different.
translation: 美国的英雄都可以得到和他们身份相符的报酬，我可以向你保证，你也会得到相同的待遇。

original: I have in my possession the only known schematic for the creation of something called the Railway Rifle.
translation: 我这有一张可以用来参考制造射钉枪的设计图，它可是仅有的一张。

original: Bring me the Declaration, and it's yours.
translation: 给我带来宣言，它就是你的。

original: I suppose that's good enough for me.
translation: 我想对我而言足够了。

original: Marvelous! Then you've decided?
translation: 真了不起！那你已经决定了？

original: Um... no. I've still got more important things to do.
translation: 嗯……不，我还有很多重要的事要去做。

original: What could be more important than completing my collection? Without that document, what is the U.S.A. now? Nothing!
translation: 有什么比完成我的收藏更重要呢？没那份文件，美国是什么？什么也不是！

original: Oh well. Please come back when you change your mind. I know you will.
translation: 好吧，当你改变主意时就回来找我吧。我想你会的。

original: Not now. Maybe another time.
translation: 现在不，下次吧。

original: A famous man once said that patience and perseverance have a magical effect before which difficulties disappear and obstacles vanish.
translation: 一位名人曾说过：耐心和坚持总能奇迹般地消灭困难，扫除障碍。

original: I've waited this long, I suppose I can wait until someone else comes along to accept my offer.
translation: 我等了那么久，总能等到其他人来接受我的提议。

original: I'd love to be a part of history, and bring you the Declaration.
translation: 我很乐意被载入史册，并为你带来宣言。

original: Excellent! You won't regret it, I promise you! Imagine, you are taking part in another chapter of American History. I envy you.
translation: 太棒了！你不会后悔的，我保证！试想想，你将成为美国历史新篇章的一份子。我真羡慕你。

original: You can find the Declaration of Independence in the ruins of the National Archives.
translation: 你可以在国家档案馆的废墟里找到《独立宣言》。

original: What does the Declaration of Independence look like?
translation: 《独立宣言》长什么样？

original: A piece of what was called parchment... sort of a thick paper. Has faded hand-written writing all over it.
translation: 是一张所谓的羊皮纸……很厚的那种。上面到处都是已经褪了色的手迹。

original: It's no more than two and a half feet tall and two feet wide. If you find it, you should be able to roll it up carefully.
translation: 它的长度不超过二尺半，宽度不超过二尺。如果你发现了它，要把它小心地卷好。

original: Yes, I was proud to participate in the signing of the Declaration of Independence along with fifty five of my fellow freedom fighters.
translation: 是的，我非常荣幸能和其他55名自由战士们参与《独立宣言》的签署。

original: It was an honor to have my signature among those of Benjamin Franklin, Thomas Jefferson and John Adams.
translation: 我的签名能和本杰明·富兰克林、托马斯·杰斐逊. 还有约翰·亚当斯在一起，让我感到非常荣幸。

original: Except maybe for Hancock, that show off.
translation: 或许约翰·汉考克那个爱炫耀的家伙除外。

original: Did you sign the Declaration of Independence?
translation: 你签署了《独立宣言》？

original: Can you show me how to get to the National Archives on my map?
translation: 你能给我在地图上指下怎么到国家档案馆？

original: In the D.C. Ruins you'll find the National Archives. Or what's left of it anyway.
translation: 在特区废墟你会找到国家档案馆，或它的遗址。

original: The building should contain the document in a protective glass case. Be careful, the place is swarming with Super Mutants.
translation: 那楼里应该有一个玻璃保险箱，文件就在里面。小心，这地方到处都是超级变种人。

original: Here, let me pinpoint its location for you.
translation: 来，我给你做上标记。

original: Skip the history lesson, professor.
translation: 教授，跳过历史课吧。

original: A man of few words. Very well.
translation: 沉默寡言的男人，非常好。

original: Get the Declaration of Independence to me intact and I'll pay you well for your time. What do you say?
translation: 原封不动地把《独立宣言》交给我，我会给你报酬，怎么样？

original: A woman of few words. Very well.
translation: 沉默寡言的女人，非常好。

original: Get the Declaration of Independence to me intact and I'll pay you well for your time. What do you say?
translation: 原封不动地把《独立宣言》交给我，我会给你报酬，怎么样？

original: Let me take a leap of faith here... you want me to find it for you.
translation: 我大胆猜测一下……你想让我帮着找到它。

original: Indeed I do. Without the Declaration, the rest of these relics are almost meaningless. I must have it!
translation: 正是如此。没有《独立宣言》，其他的那些文物也毫无意义可言，我必须得到它！

original: Acquire the document for me, and you'll be awarded most handsomely. What do you think?
translation: 为我找回宣言，你将会获得极其丰厚的报酬。你觉得怎么样？

original: Maybe later. I've got better things to do right now.
translation: 迟点再说，现在我还有更有意义的事要去做。

original: Shame. Very well, you're free to look around but with your level of patience I suspect you'll become bored rather quickly.
translation: 真遗憾。很好，你可以四处看看，但以你的耐性，我想你很快就会感到乏味。

original: Who cares...
translation: 谁在乎……

original: Your rude tone leads me to believe you aren't interested in a little proposal I have for you.
translation: 你粗鲁的口气足以让我相信，你对我的提议丝毫不感兴趣。

original: Now, will you hear me out? If not, we don't have much more to talk about.
translation: 你能先听我说完吗？如果不行的话，我们就没什么好说的了。

original: All right, I'll bite. Which document is missing?
translation: 好的。我问问，你失去了什么文件？

original: In 1776, the Second Judgmental Congress got together and adopted a document drafted by none other than Thomas Jefferson himself.
translation: 1776年，第二届大陆会议召开，并采纳了托马斯·杰斐逊本人起草的文件。

original: It was the day the United States of America earned its name and secured its place in history.
translation: 在历史上，这一天是美利坚合众国宣告成立的日子！

original: This magnificent achievement took form in the Declaration of Independence.
translation: 最大的成就在于《独立宣言》！

original: It's an interesting collection of garbage.
translation: 有趣的垃圾收藏！

original: One man's garbage is another's treasure trove. Don't underestimate these documents. They may not look like much, but their value is immeasurable.
translation: 一个人眼中的垃圾可能是另一个人的宝藏。不要小看这些文件，虽然看起来不起眼，但它们却是无价之宝。

original: Or would be anyway, if only I possessed one more item.
translation: 不管怎么说，要是再多一件就好了。

original: Yes, it's an interesting collection indeed.
translation: 嗯，确实是相当有趣的收藏。

original: Ah, a fellow scholar I see!
translation: 啊，一位学者同僚！

original: Each of the documents in this room tells a small but important story about the history of the United States of America.
translation: 这房间里的每一本文献都讲述了美国历史中很细微但却重要的一部分。

original: Unfortunately, the greatest prize of all is missing from the collection.
translation: 不幸的是，最有价值的一件并不在这收藏里。

original: What's it like living at Tenpenny Tower?
translation: 住在特佩尼大厦感觉如何？

original: Well, I feel a lot safer now that those Ghouls have stopped bothering us. That's for sure.
translation: 嗯，那些僵尸已经停止骚扰我们了。这确实使我感到很安全。

original: Our new neighbors aren't so bad after all. And they have big appetites, so that's good for the cafe!
translation: 我们的新邻居也不是很坏，他们只是胃口很大，这对餐厅而言也算是件好事！

original: It's clean and safe -- since those Ghouls left -- and Tenpenny knows how to stock the lounge with the good stuff. Stop by. Share a drink!
translation: 这地方既干净又舒适 — 自从那些僵尸不再来骚扰。特佩尼总有办法把休息室摆满好酒。来喝一杯！

original: It's swell. Those new neighbors of ours like to drink almost as much as I do… and boy, do they have some real good stories!
translation: 真不错。我们的新邻居和我一样爱喝酒，他们还有好多故事讲！

original: It's fine now that those Ghouls are taken care of. I've been treating less cases related to frazzled nerves and upset stomachs.
translation: 这些僵尸终于被妥善处理了，这很好。从今以后我不用接待那么多神经衰弱和反胃的病人了。

original: People are happy and healthy for the most part. And those Ghouls make great case studies! Did I mention I'm working on an important dissertation...
translation: 最重要的是人们健康幸福。而且那些僵尸也是很好的研究对象！呃，我和你说过我正在写一篇很重要的论文么……

original: It's great. Now that we have a real comrade around here to handle things. I'm appointing a special Security Subcommittee and I want you to chair it!
translation: 太好了，现在我们有位真正能干活的同志来处理事情，我要成立一个特别安全小组委员会，由你管事！

original: Things are going well, I'd say. We've all learned a thing or two about what makes a real community. Don't you think, comrade?
translation: 现在一切都不错，我们都认识到了什么才是一个真正的公社所应具备的。你说呢，同志？

original: It's a lot better now with those Ghouls out of the picture!
translation: 僵尸都被除掉，我觉得好多了！

original: I guess I don't mind those Ghouls as much as I thought I would.
translation: 我想我并不像之前想象中那样介意这些僵尸。

original: Business is still good!
translation: 一切顺利！

original: Those Ghouls are disgusting, so I just spend all my time up here.
translation: 那些僵尸令人作呕，我只好在这消磨时间。

original: Now everyone's calmed down and back to their old selves. Not that I cared much for them to begin with, but they've stopped all the Ghoul foolishness.
translation: 现在所有人都冷静下来，回去做他们的老本行了。倒不是我想要密切关注他们，只是他们的确不再表现出对僵尸的无知。

original: They really are quite ignorant here. But where else could I retire and fit all my trophies?
translation: 他们还真是愚昧无知，但我还能去哪？哪又能安放我所有的战利品呢？

original: I'm surprised by my fellow tenants. I used to think they were all closed minded idiots. Turns out they aren't so bad after all.
translation: 我对那些住户感到吃惊，我曾经认为他们是顽固的白痴。不过事实上，他们还不算太糟糕。

original: Beats the Wasteland and dirty tunnels, that's for damn sure!
translation: 不用再住在废土和肮脏的隧道里了，这确实是真的！

original: It's wonderful. Roy was right. This is the way to live!
translation: 太棒了！罗伊是对的，这才叫生活！

original: It's weird actually. I used to vacation here before the bombs dropped. Used to be a resort for the wealthy and powerful.
translation: 其实感觉有点奇怪。核弹落下前我曾到这度过假。这曾是有财有势者的休养圣地。

original: I never thought I'd be the one fighting to get in here. Guess way back it used to be a plantation. Ironic isn't it?
translation: 我从没想过有一天要一路厮杀才能到这来。我猜再往前这曾是一片种植园。很讽刺，对吧？

original: Can you help me find something else?
translation: 你能帮我找点别的东西吗？

original: Certainly.
translation: 行。

original: I'm actually just looking for some food.
translation: 事实上我是在找吃的。

original: Well, in that case I recommend the Brass Lantern. It's directly across from the Church. You can't miss it.
translation: 嗯，既然那样我就推荐黄铜灯，就在教堂对面，你不会错过的。

original: I... uh... only drink for medicinal reasons.
translation: 我……嗯……只是把酒当药用的。

original: Even still, I cannot aid you on this path with a clear conscience.
translation: 既便如此，我的良心也告诉我不能在这条路上帮助你。

original: Tell me about the Church of Atom.
translation: 和我说说原子教堂。

original: Yes? What would you like to know?
translation: 嗯？你想知道什么？

original: I've been looking for you.
translation: 我在找你。

original: I guess I shouldn't be surprised. I'm sure Evan King is pretty pissed right about now.
translation: 我想我不应该感到惊讶，我敢说埃万·金现在肯定很恼火。

original: I bet he has the entire town out looking for me. He's worse than my parents.
translation: 我打赌他已经让整个镇子的人都在找我了，他比我的父母还可恶。

original: So what are you doing in the Metro tunnels?
translation: 你在地铁隧道里干嘛？

original: Biding our time, making plans, getting ready. Tenpenny and his pack of elitist wannabes can't keep us out of that tower forever.
translation: 等待时机，制定计划，做好准备。特佩尼和他的那群崇拜者别想把我们永远挡在大厦的外面。

original: We got rights. And we'll take them if they aren't given to us.
translation: 我们有应得的权利。如果他们不给，我们就夺回来。

original: Biding our time, making plans, getting ready. Tenpenny and his pack of elitist wannabes can't keep us out of that tower forever.
translation: 等待时机，制定计划，做好准备。特佩尼和他的那群崇拜者别想把我们永远挡在大厦的外面。

original: We got rights. And we'll take them if they aren't given to us.
translation: 我们有应得的权利。如果他们不给，我们就夺回来。

original: What about it?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Let's talk about Tenpenny.
translation: 让我们谈谈特配尼。

original: What about it?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Let's talk about Tenpenny.
translation: 让我们谈谈特配尼。

original: Roy is coming up with a plan to get us into that tower. Tenpenny's. Says it's only a matter of time.
translation: 罗伊正在拟定一个让我们进入特佩尼大厦的计划，他说住进去只是时间问题。

original: He's strong like that. He never gives up. The kind of guy who makes things happen, Roy is. That's why the others follow him.
translation: 他很坚强，从不放弃。策划者，这就是罗伊。这也是为什么其他人都追随他。

original: Me, I just like the way he looks at me. Makes me feel pretty again. I'd go anywhere with him.
translation: 我，我喜欢他看我的样子，这让我觉得自己又漂亮了，我会追随着他到天涯海角。

original: I've been stomping around with Roy and his gang of misfits. Roy's a no nonsense, take no prisoners kinda guy.
translation: 我一直和罗伊还有他那帮痞子一起厮混，罗伊是那种说一不二的人。

original: He heard about this Tenpenny asshole, and now he's trying to get us in that tower. He's hatching some kind of plan to kill all those bigot bastards.
translation: 他听说过那混蛋特佩尼，现在他试着要带我们潜入那幢大厦。他在拟定一个计划，要干掉塔里那群种族分子。

original: Believe it or not, I used to vacation there.
translation: 信不信由你，我曾经在那度过假。

original: Ah... Nevermind.
translation: 啊……别介意。

original: Right. I thought so. I'm warning you. I don't take shit from no one.
translation: 没错。我也这么认为，我可警告你，少来这套。

original: You eat people's brains, right? So what's it like being a zombie?
translation: 你专吃人脑，对吗？做个丧尸感觉如何？

original: You got balls. Real big ones. I'll assume you're kidding 'cause no one shit talks me and lives.
translation: 有种，你真有种。我只当你是开玩笑，因为还没哪个混蛋能这样和我讲话后还有命的。

original: We Ghouls are just like the rest of you: Shit out of luck and doing our best to make it.
translation: 我们僵尸和你们一样：运气像狗屎，还在拼命挣扎。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Uh-huh. Didn't think so.
translation: 啊哈，不觉得。

original: You're the prejudiced asshole, not me. So you're ugly. Big deal.
translation: 带有偏见的混蛋不是我，而是你。还是个丑八怪。真的太强了。

original: Maybe I misjudged. Pardons. So yeah, people treat us like shit. But it just makes us stronger.
translation: 或许我判断错误了，请你原谅。就是啊，人们对我们就像对待狗屎一样，但这也让我们更强大。

original: Otherwise we ain't no different than anyone else that had the misfortune to live past infancy.
translation: 否则我们就和其他人没有区别了，活在过去遭遇的不幸里。

original: No, really. I mean it. I don't care if you're a Ghoul or not.
translation: 不，真的。我不在乎你是不是一个尸鬼。

original: Uh-huh? Fine, whatever. Being a Ghoul ain't anything worse than any other thing somebody's got to deal with.
translation: 呃？好的，随便。做僵尸和其他人要面对的难题一样。

original: Like your stupidity, for example. You can't help it. You were born stupid, or dropped on your head as a kid.
translation: 举个例子吧：你这愚德行。那是没办法的事。不是你天生就笨，就是小时候碰坏头。

original: Either way it ain't nothing you can change. So you deal with it.
translation: 不论如何，你都无法改变现状。因此你只有面对。

original: I didn't mean to offend. I'm not prejudiced.
translation: 我没有冒犯的意思，我没有偏见。

original: Sure, whatever you say. You pretentious two-faced asshole.
translation: 当然，随便你说什么，你这自负、伪善的混蛋。

original: So tell me, what's it like being a Ghoul?
translation: 和我说说，做个尸鬼有什么感觉？

original: You better choose your next words really carefully, cause you're startin' to piss me off...
translation: 你说下一句话前必须仔细想清楚，因为你已经惹到我了……

original: Oh... well... it's not so bad, I guess. Once you get used to it... but, it's not like before.
translation: 哦……这个……也没什么不妥，我看。一旦你习惯了……当然这还是和之前不同。

original: I used to be pretty, you know! Everyone used to come around all the time!
translation: 你知道，我曾经很美，每个人都一直围绕在我身旁！

original: People stop wanting to be around you, though... when it starts to happen... when you start to change, I mean...
translation: 人们不再围绕在你身边，尽管……当这开始发生的时候，当你开始变化时，我的意思是……

original: I wasn't always like this. I was a goddamn scientist. We were doing great things. Amazing things.
translation: 我以前不这样的。我曾是一个他妈的科学家，我们研究大事情，惊天动地的事。

original: Sure sacrifices were required. Some people got hurt. But we were making real progress. But then those goddamn bombs dropped.
translation: 当然牺牲是必然的，一些人受伤了，但是正当我们取得突破时，那些该死的核弹就下来了。

original: Karma's a real bitch. You'd be wise to remember that.
translation: 命运是个婊子，这点可别忘了。

original: Not much to say? That's good. It'll keep you out of trouble. Be warned: don't cause me or mine no problems, or I'll end you.
translation: 没什么可说了？好吧。我不会让你有麻烦的，但记住：别给我和我的人惹麻烦，否则我会干掉你。

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <一言不发。>

original: Oh, all right then. Kinda shy aren't you? I don't mind that. It's nice to have someone to talk to who listens, you know...
translation: 哦，那好吧。你是不是有点害羞？我不介意。你知道，有人听我说话，我很开心……

original: Am I babbling again? I tend to do that when I'm nervous...
translation: 我是不是又胡说了？我一紧张就会这样。

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <一言不发。>

original: Apathy is the death of the soul. It's better to be angry as hell! It keeps things interesting anyway.
translation: 漠然是灵魂的坟墓。还不如大发雷霆！那样至少还有趣些。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Listen good. I'll say this only once. I can respect a man's privacy. But I don't put up with bullshit.
translation: 好好的给我听着，我只说一遍。我能尊重别人的隐私，但我不能容忍胡言乱语。

original: Keep to yourself and we'll be fine. Cause any trouble for me or mine, and I'll end you. We understand each other?
translation: 别惹其他人，咱们就没事。因为任何给我和我的人惹任何麻烦的话，我就干掉你。明白了吗？

original: Mind your fucking business, that's who.
translation: 我是谁关你屁事。

original: Oh...  my... I guess... I was just trying to be nice. Am I babbling again? I tend to do that when I'm nervous.
translation: 噢，我……我想……我只是想有点礼貌啊。我是不是又胡说了？我一紧张就会这样。

original: Oh - you don't make me nervous. I mean, Roy says not to show weakness...
translation: 哦 — 你不会让我感到紧张，我是说，罗伊说不要轻易暴露自己的弱点……

original: Have you met Roy? He's killed lots of people before.  I'm his gal. He protects me. So better not try anything.
translation: 你见过罗伊吧？他以前干掉了很多人。我是他女人，他照顾我，最好别胡来。

original: I'm trouble. That's all you need to know.
translation: 你只用知道我是个麻烦就行了。

original: It's your own funeral then. Just remember that when you die, you die alone. Then you just rot until some jackal comes and snacks on you.
translation: 那就是你的葬礼了。记住，你死的时候，会是孤伶伶的。你的尸体慢慢腐烂，直到变成豺狼的点心。

original: I can handle myself.
translation: 我应付的来。

original: Harmless? Well, you're lucky I don't stick you and take your shit. Watch yourself, we don't take kindly to strangers, 'specially sweet-talking ones.
translation: 没危险？得了吧，我没抢你的垃圾已经算你走运了。你自己小心，我们不会对陌生人示好，尤其是那些油腔滑调的家伙。

original: You got nothing to worry about. I'm harmless.
translation: 你不用担心我，我没有恶意。

original: I wouldn't want to see anyone get hurt. You must be pretty tough to get past all the ferals. They tend to leave us alone, but someone like you...
translation: 我不愿意看到任何人受伤。你能一路穿越荒野，肯定很强悍。他们都不想理我们，但你这样的……

original: Am I babbling again? Roy tells me I shouldn't do that.
translation: 我不是又在胡说了？罗伊告诉我不该那样。

original: Nice to meet you, Bessie. Don't worry about me, I'll be fine.
translation: 很高兴见到你，贝茜。不用担心我，我很好。

original: Just passing through? That's no way to live your life. You need a purpose. A goal.
translation: 过路的？那样你可活不了。你需要一个计划、一个目标。

original: It's the only thing that keeps you from realizing how meaningless this shit-filled existence really is.
translation: 这是唯一让你不会意识到自己的存在是多么空洞、悲哀的东西。

original: Just passing through.
translation: 我只是路过的。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

original: What the hell is wrong with you people?
translation: 你们到底他妈的怎么回事？

original: It's a shame that you so easily mock us without even knowing our doctrine.
translation: 你并不了解我们的教义就轻易地嘲笑我们，真遗憾。

original: Even knowing the truth, you continue to mock us. How very, very sad.
translation: 尽管知道事实真相，你仍在嘲讽着我们，多么、多么令人沮丧啊。

original: Why do you worship the bomb?
translation: 你为什么崇拜核弹？

original: Those who were called to Atom during the Great Division were very fortunate. They were permitted to aid in the process of Atom's creation.
translation: 在大分裂时，被原子召集的那些人是幸运的。他们被允许在原子的创造中提供帮助。

original: We seek the same, both in symbol and in fact and the "bomb", as you call it, represents Atom's capacity for creation.
translation: 无论在象征意义还是现实层面上，我们追寻的是同一个目标。而这枚你们所谓的“核弹”，代表了原子的创造能力。

original: We kneel before it and ask that Atom call us to aid him. We pray that out of our meager bodies, he will create new life.
translation: 我们跪倒在它面前，恳求原子接受我们的帮助。我们祈祷他能从我们羸弱的身躯中创造出崭新的生命。

original: What do you believe?
translation: 你相信什么？

original: The Church of the Children of Atom is based on the idea that each single atomic mass in all of creation contains within it an entire universe.
translation: 原子信徒教堂创立在每一个原子中都包含一个完整宇宙的思想上的。

original: When that atomic mass is split, a single universe divides and becomes two -- thus signifying the single greatest act of Atom's creation.
translation: 当原子质量分裂时，一个宇宙分裂为两个 — 昭示着原子一次伟大的创造行为。

original: Occasionally, a divine event occurs and trillions upon trillions of new universes are created. The last such event took place here, 200 years ago.
translation: 有的时候，一次分裂会产生亿万个新的宇宙。最近的一次此类事件于200年前发生于此地。

original: Where most of the lost children of Atom see that event as simple war and devastation, we see creation and unification in Atom's Glow.
translation: 在我们大多数原子失散的孩子看到的只是单纯的战争和毁灭的背景下，我们看到的是原子光辉中的创造和团结。

original: I found him. He's with the Family.
translation: 我找到他的时候，他正和家族在一起。

original: What? Those gangers? I knew if he got mixed up with the wrong crowd this could happen! Why didn't I do anything to stop him?
translation: 什么？这些帮匪？我就知道他跟那些家伙在一起会发生这种事！我为什么没有去阻止他？

original: I... I don't know what to say. I... can't believe this is happening to me. My entire family... gone. I...
translation: 我……我不知道该怎么说，我……不敢相信这些会发生在我身上，我的整个家庭……都毁了。我……

original: Please, just go. Don't say anything, don't look back. Just go.
translation: 你走吧，别再说了，别回头，走！

original: I haven't found him. <Lie.>
translation: 我找不到他。<撒谎>

original: I... I don't know what to say. I... can't believe this is happening to me. My entire family... gone. I...
translation: 我……我不知道该怎么说，我……不敢相信这些会发生在我身上，我的整个家庭……都毁了。我……

original: Please, just go. Don't say anything, don't look back. Just go.
translation: 你走吧，别再说了，别回头，走！

original: I found him. He's safe.
translation: 我找到他了，他很安全。

original: Thank goodness! You have no idea how worried I was... I haven't even slept well since you left.
translation: 谢天谢地！你不知道我有多担心，自从你离开后我就没睡过好觉。

original: Thanks for bringing me the news, you've really cheered me up!
translation: 感谢你为我带来消息，这真叫人高兴！

original: I give up. Fine, stay here and cry.
translation: 我放弃了，你待在这哭吧。

original: Hmph. Just like Vance said. Humans will never understand us; just sit on their high horse and ridicule us.
translation: 哼，正如万斯所说的，人类从来都不了解我们，只会持盛气凌人地奚落我们。

original: Well fine. You can judge us any way you see fit, but one thing's certain... I'm not leaving.
translation: 好吧，你想怎么说都无所谓，但有一点确信的是，我不会走。

original: Now get the hell out of my room.
translation: 现在滚出我的房间。

original: Look, Ian. I know loss, too. I know it hurts. But staying here isn't the answer.
translation: 你看，伊恩。我也懂得失去的痛苦。但是，待在这不能解决问题。

original: There's something inside me... something completely messed up!
translation: 在我体内有某种东西……某种彻底紊乱的东西！

original: I'm a mutant; a freak! The only person I was ever able to talk to was my sister Lucy, and she's gone.
translation: 我是一个突变体，一个怪胎！以前唯一能和我说话的就是我姐姐露西，但是她已经不在了。

original: No one gives a shit about me except Vance and the Family. Can't you understand that?
translation: 除了万斯和家族，根本没人理我，难道你就不能理解吗？

original: There's something inside me... something completely messed up!
translation: 在我体内有某种东西……某种彻底紊乱的东西！

original: I'm a mutant, a fucking freak! The only person I was ever able to talk to was my sister Lucy, and she's gone.
translation: 我是一个突变体，一个怪胎！以前唯一能和我说话的就是我姐姐露西，但是她已经不在了。

original: No one gives a shit about me except Vance and the Family. Can't you understand that?
translation: 除了万斯和家族，根本没人理我，难道你就不能理解吗？

original: You're a bitch to find.
translation: 你真他妈的难找。

original: Well, maybe that's because I don't want to be found.
translation: 嗯，或许是因为我不想被找到。

original: Why the heck are you looking for me anyway?
translation: 你到底他妈的为什么要找我？

original: Money? I'm a slave? Where's this Paradise Falls? This collar will explode won't it? I've heard about these things.
translation: 瓶盖？我是一个奴隶？堕落天堂在哪？那项圈会爆炸，对吧？我已经知道这些事了。

original: You're a slave now. Get going to Paradise Falls. Sorry. I needed the money.
translation: 你现在是奴隶了。到堕落天堂去。抱歉。我需要这些钱。

original: Oh that sounds bad. I need my head. Where's Paradise Falls?
translation: 噢，这听起来很糟。我需要我的脑袋。堕落天堂在哪？

original: I'm afraid your head will explode if you don't get to Paradise Falls. Sorry.
translation: 恐怕你不去堕落天堂的话项圈就会爆炸。抱歉。

original: Huh? Paradise Falls? Where's that?
translation: 呃？堕落天堂在哪？

original: Go to Paradise Falls before that collar explodes. Sorry!
translation: 在项圈爆炸之前到堕落天堂去。抱歉！

original: Nothing personal? But I'm a person! ... I'm going, I'm going... don't hurt me!
translation: 不是针对个人？但我是一个人……我走，我走……别伤害我！

original: You're a slave now. Nothing personal. Get to Paradise Falls if you want to live.
translation: 你现在是奴隶了。这可不是个人恩怨。想活下去的话就去堕落天堂。

original: My pockets? I'm not sure. Here take a look...
translation: 我的口袋里？我不知道。我看看……

original: You hiding anything in your pockets?
translation: 你在口袋里藏了什么东西吗？

original: My stuff? Okay.
translation: 我的东西？好吧。

original: Give me all your stuff!
translation: 把你的东西都给我！

original: Huh? Sure, take a look.
translation: 呃？当然，来看看。

original: You'd better not be holding out on me! Show me what you're carrying.
translation: 你最好别在我面前装硬汉！给我看看你都带了些什么。

original: Okay, okay. Here.
translation: 好的，好的。给。

original: Turn your pockets out, before I get... nasty.
translation: 把你的口袋掏空，在我变得……残忍之前。

original: I'm a slave now?!?! Don't kill me please! I'm going!
translation: 我现在是一个奴隶了！？！请别杀死我！我这就走！

original: Start running to Paradise Falls or your head'll explode! That collar is a bomb.
translation: 立刻跑到堕落天堂去，不然你的头就会炸掉！这项圈是个炸弹。

original: A slave? I don't remember being a slave... Which way is that again?
translation: 一个奴隶？我怎么不记得自己变奴隶了……再说一遍去哪？

original: You're a slave now! Better get to Paradise Falls before your head explodes!
translation: 你现在是奴隶了！你最好在脑袋被炸掉之前到堕落天堂去！

original: Oh... that sounds painful... Okay, which way is Paradise Falls again?
translation: 噢……这听起来不太好……好吧，堕落天堂在哪，再说一遍？

original: You get moving to Paradise Falls, or that fucking collar will explode!
translation: 你现在去堕落天堂，不然那项圈就会炸掉！

original: The Slavers? I'm a slave? How did this happen?!
translation: 奴隶贩子？我是一个奴隶？怎么会这样呢？！

original: Give my regards to the Slavers in Paradise Falls. Move, or your head goes boom!
translation: 给堕落天堂的奴隶贩子带去我的问候。快，不然你的头就会炸掉！

original: What? Oh. Okay.
translation: 什么？哦。好吧。

original: You're just a little dazed. Walk it off. You'll be okay soon.
translation: 你只是有点迷糊了。到处走走。你马上就会好起来的。

original: I... I don't know... Where am I?
translation: 我不知道……我这是在哪？！

original: You're staring into space. You feeling okay? Wake up!
translation: 你在看着空气发呆。你还好吗？醒醒！

original: Who are you again?
translation: 再说一遍你是谁？

original: Let's hope there's no permanent brain damage. Run along now!
translation: 我希望这不会造成永久性的脑损伤。快跑吧！

original: Huh? Maybe... Yeah...
translation: 呃？或许……是的……

original: Have you been drinking? You'd better go get some rest.
translation: 你喝醉了吗？你最好去睡一会。

original: Huh? A slave collar? What are you talking about?
translation: 呃？奴隶项圈？你在说什么？

original: Damn. I wish I had a slave collar. I could totally make you a slave right now.
translation: 该死。我手上有个项圈就好了。我能立马把你变成奴隶。

original: Oh... alright... this thing's heavy!
translation: 哦……没关系……这东西可真沉！

original: Here. Put on this collar -- I mean, necklace. I think it'll look good on you.
translation: 这个。戴上这个项圈 -- 我是说项链。它和你挺合衬的。

original: Sure... what's this thing for anyway?
translation: 当然……这是怎么回事？

original: I'm going to put this collar on you. Just hold real still for a minute.
translation: 我要给你戴上这个项圈。别乱动。

original: Okay... Hey, this thing feels weird. Can I take it off now?
translation: 好吧……嗨，这东西让我觉得很不舒适，我能现在就拿掉它吗？

original: This is too easy. Here, put this collar on.
translation: 这太简单了。来，带上这个项圈。

original: Whoa! What is it? It's heavy! Oh... What friends are you talking about? Do I know them?
translation: 哇！这是什么？真沉！噢……你们说的那朋友是谁？我们认识吗？

original: I have some friends who want to meet you. Here, put this collar on.
translation: 我有几个朋友想见你。来，带上这个项圈。

original: Yeah... Good idea. Okay. Here you go.  I'm pretty tired all of a sudden. I can't even think straight.
translation: 是……好主意。好吧，就照你那么做吧。猝然间我感觉思维混乱，已经不能正常思考了。

original: You look exhausted. Let me carry your stuff for a while.
translation: 你看起来累极了。让我帮你拿东西吧。

original: Huh? ...I do? I don't think so, but go ahead and take a look if you want.
translation: 呃？……我是吗？我可不这么认为，但如果你这么想的话，就过来。

original: I think you've got something that belongs to me. I need it back.
translation: 我觉得你手上有我的东西。我要拿回来。

original: Magic trick? Like... like you'll make something disappear? Sure, I'd like to see you do that.
translation: 魔术欺诈？比如……比如你可以把东西变走？当然，我倒是很想看看你是如何做到的。

original: I want to show you a magic trick. You mind if I borrow some of your stuff?
translation: 我想给你变个魔术。你不介意给我几样东西吧。

original: A thief? Yeah... I'm feeling a little out of it... Maybe you better hold onto this stuff, you know, to keep it safe or whatever.
translation: 小偷？没错……我有点察觉到……或许你应该更好地看守这，无时无刻的保证它的安全, 你必须清楚！

original: There's a thief about, and you seem distracted.  I'll hold onto your gear.
translation: 这有个小偷，你看起来精神不太好。我来帮你保管物品吧。

original: I'm sorry, but it's for the good of everyone. Now let's go.
translation: 我很抱歉，但这是为了大家好，我们立刻出发。

original: I can't believe James raised a daughter like you. You disgust me.
translation: 我不敢相信詹姆斯会教出你这样的女儿，你真让我觉得恶心。

original: I can't believe James raised a son like you. You disgust me.
translation: 我不敢相信詹姆斯会教出你这样的儿子，你真让我觉得恶心。

original: No reason to hang around now, is there? Move it.
translation: 现在可没时间游荡，不是吗？行动。

original: You're inhuman! I won't forget this.
translation: 你真是个禽兽！我不会忘记的。

original: You're only going to slow us down. Maybe you should stay behind.
translation: 你只会拖我们的后腿。或许你应该留下。

original: Yes, you are right. There is no reason to put everyone at risk on my account. Go on without me.
translation: 是的，你是对的。没有理由因为我一个人而让所有人都陷入危机中，你们走吧，别管我。

original: I've changed my mind.
translation: 我改变主意了。

original: Very well.
translation: 那好吧。

translation: <捐赠100个瓶盖>

translation: 谢谢你。

translation: 原子与你同在。

original: Bless you, child.
translation: 保佑你，孩子。

translation: 你能聊表心意，我非常高兴，孩子，只是你没有足够的瓶盖。

translation: 既然卢卡斯和科林死了，那么在没有其他人来接替他们的位置前，这儿谁说了都不算。

translation: 卢卡斯·西姆斯曾是这唯一让这里有了秩序的人。在他死后，我想莫里亚蒂在这里会更加为所欲为吧。

original: Moriarty thought he was. Not so much anymore, I guess. I'm surprised that Simms never took care of Moriarty himself.
translation: 莫里亚蒂认为这里他说了算。不过，我觉得。我很诧异为什么西姆斯从没有把莫里亚蒂亲自处理掉。

original: Well, Moriarty thinks he is, but Lucas Simms is the law around here and everyone knows it.

translation: 虽然没有你以前用的避难所物品好，但对你来说也足够了。

translation: 我受伤了。医生，我需要帮助。

translation: 你看上去不错，但你还可以更好。这需要50个瓶盖。

translation: 你的要害都正常，但是我可以帮你把伤口缝得更好，只收你50个瓶盖，这听起来很棒吧？

translation: 你自己看看！再正常不过了！别在这浪费我的时间来讨论你的疑心病，还有真正的患者在等着我。

translation: 哦，别那么干。面对现实吧，你这大小孩。

translation: 我的上帝啊，这可得耗费我不少时间……价值100个瓶盖的工作。

translation: 你还能活着走到这，真令我很吃惊。我会帮你痊愈的，不过你得给我100个瓶盖，你说呢？

translation: 你什么该死的毛病也没有，除非你伤了心了。有伤在身再来找我，这样我才可以赚你钱。

translation: 嗨，如果你需要帮助，我会很乐意收取你的费用，但你确完全健康。他妈的，混蛋。别浪费我的时间。

translation: 让我看看，一些治疗针和几下缝合，你就可以痊愈了，仅需50个瓶盖。

translation: 好吧，缝几个伤口再绑上绷带，你就全好了。就收50个瓶盖吧，听起来不错吧？

translation: 断了些骨头，两处割伤……花费75个瓶盖，我能帮你治愈。

original: Sure, I'll help you. If you have the caps. Looks to me like you're pretty banged up, though. Let's say... 75 caps and I'll fix you good as new.
translation: 当然，我会帮助你，只要你有瓶盖。你看起来伤得还挺重的。就付……75个瓶盖吧，我就能把你治得像什么事也没发生过一样。

original: You know, when I saw you limping in here, I knew that I smelled money. That'll be 100 caps. Or you can just bleed to death. Your choice.
translation: 你要知道，当你跛着脚进来的时候，我就知道生意上门了。那需要100个瓶盖，否则，你就只能失血过多而死，你自己选择吧。

original: Well, hello, meal ticket. 100 caps. Or I can just wait for you to die and take it.
translation: 你好啊，送钱来的。100个瓶盖。否则我就等你死，然后再来拿走你的钱。

original: Don't think because I'm a Ghoul, I'm stupid. You're fine.
translation: 别因为我是尸鬼就觉得我笨，你聪明。

original: Is this a trick question? I don't even see a scratch on you.
translation: 你在开玩笑吧，你是一点伤都没有啊！

translation: 这么点小伤的话，我50盖就能搞定了。

translation: 我都不觉得这叫伤口，但如果你坚持说是那就是吧。50瓶盖就够。

translation: 75个瓶盖就能把你的伤势搞定了。

translation: 你的伤真是太糟糕了。75个瓶盖就能治好了。

translation: 你快要死了，想治好没有100瓶盖是不行的！

translation: 给你？没问题。别乱动。

translation: 把我治好，瑞德。

translation: 我看你不像有什么问题。

translation: 你是医生，对吧？我可能需要些帮助。

translation: 没错，你的确需要一位医生。能遇到我算你走运，但首先让我们来谈谈价钱……应该只需100个瓶盖就够了。

original: You're a doctor, right? I could use some help.

translation: 你还真不是在开玩笑。朋友，你的情况不佳。我很乐意来医治你，150个瓶盖。

original: That's disgusting.
translation: 真恶心。

original: Yeah, fuck you too. Whatever, man. I'm used to being treated like shit around here.
translation: 行，去你妈的。爱咋咋地吧。在这地方，我早就习惯被当狗屎对待了。

original: You know, it's not so bad.
translation: 你知道吗，其实也没那么糟。

original: Nice of you to say so. If you can't be nice, at least pretend, right? Fake it 'till you make it, and all that.
translation: 难得你这么说。就算不真心，至少装装样子对吧？反正装久了就成真了嘛。

original: Still though, a fake compliment is better than the usual spit in the face that I get. You're not half bad... for a smoothskin.
translation: 不过，比起平时被当面啐口水，假惺惺的恭维确实顺耳些。你这人……在光皮肤里还算不赖。

original: I've got nothing against you people.
translation: 我对你们这类人没意见。

original: Well now. That's a surprise! I'm used to every asshole smoothskin in this town giving me shit just because I look like a corpse.
translation: 诶呀。这倒稀奇！我都习惯了，因为自己像具活尸就被镇上的光皮肤找茬。

original: I'm glad to see that there are a few worthwhile people around here.
translation: 很高兴这附近还有几个像样的人。

original: Listen... Moriarty'd have my head if he caught me selling at a discount, but for you, I'll risk it.
translation: 听着……要是莫里亚蒂发现我打折卖货，非拧下我的头不可。但为你，我豁出去了。

original: I know what a Ghoul is. Now get away from me, zombie.
translation: 我知道尸鬼是什么。现在离我远点，丧尸！

original: Yeah... great. What do you need? ... asshole ...
translation: 行……挺好。你要什么？……混蛋……

original: No. What's a ghoul?
translation: 没。尸鬼是什么？

original: Well, not all of us got the chance to hole up in a nice cushy Vault when the bombs fell.
translation: 哼，又不是人人都有机会在核弹落下时躲进舒适的避难所。

original: A bunch of us got stuck out here in the world, and got a full on blast of heat and radiation -- turned us into a pack of walking corpses.
translation: 我们这群倒霉蛋困在外面，直接暴露在热浪和辐射里——变成了一群行尸走肉。

original: Near as I can tell, we age slower than you. A lot slower. There are even a few Ghouls that were alive during the war.
translation: 据我所知，我们比你们衰老得慢。慢得多。甚至有些尸鬼从大战时期活到现在。

original: Of course, with a face like ground Brahmin meat, you can imagine that folks don't take too kindly to us.
translation: 当然，顶着张像绞碎的双头牛肉泥般的脸，你该猜到人们不太待见我们。

original: I hadn't planned on it.
translation: 我还没这打算。

original: Well now. That's a surprise! I'm used to every asshole smoothskin in this town giving me shit just because I look like a corpse.
translation: 诶呀。这倒稀奇！我都习惯了，因为自己像具活尸就被镇上的光皮肤找茬。

original: I'm glad to see that there are a few worthwhile people around here.
translation: 很高兴这附近还有几个像样的人。

original: Listen... Moriarty'd have my head if he caught me selling at a discount, but for you, I'll risk it.
translation: 听着……要是莫里亚蒂发现我打折卖货，非拧下我的头不可。但为你，我豁出去了。

original: Are you kidding? Me? Shut the hell up, Ghoul. I'll beat you if I feel like it.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？我？闭上你那张臭嘴，尸鬼。只要我乐意，我就会痛打你。

original: <sighs> I suppose I was wrong... should have known better.
translation: <叹气>我想我错了……我早该知道。

original: Let me think about it for a moment, my good man.
translation: 让我想想哈，我的好伙计。

original: Wait... you're not going to hit me? Yell at me? Not even berate me a little bit?
translation: 等等……你不打算揍我？不吼我？哪怕稍微数落我两句也行啊？

original: Stuff it, Ghoul. And stop looking at me.
translation: 闭嘴，尸鬼。别再盯着我看。

original: I see how it is... <sigh> What do you need?
translation: 我懂了……<叹气>你要什么？

original: Gah! Fuck! What are you?
translation: 嗷！操！你是什么东西？

original: I guess they don't have a lot of Ghouls in the Vault.
translation: 我猜避难所里并没几个尸鬼吧。

original: Haven't you ever seen a Ghoul before?
translation: 你以前没见过僵尸吗？

original: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这儿是干嘛的？

original: Me?  I deal with the caravan suppliers. I used to ride with those guys, so they cut me some good deals. Helps keep the town supplied.
translation: 我？我和商队做买卖，我以前跟他们一起混，因此他们时常给我一些特价。这帮助我维持小镇的补给。

original: But more importantly, I take care of Maggie. Of course, she's getting' a little old to have Billy lookin' over her shoulder all the time...
translation: 但更重要的是，我照顾玛姬。虽然，她已经过了需要寸步不离看着的年龄了……

original: I keep these yokels knee deep in booze and poon. They keep me knee deep in caps. It's a fair trade, if you ask me.
translation: 我让这帮土包子酒管够、妞管饱，他们让我瓶盖堆成山。要我说，这买卖公道。

original: I'm the town doc. If it's cut, I sew it up. If it's infected, I cut it off.
translation: 我是这镇上的医生。看到伤口，我就把它缝合。发现感染，我就把它切掉。

original: Me? I don't do a damn thing. Well, unless you count staying piss drunk and making Moriarty rich as something.
translation: 我？闲人一个什么也不干。除非你把当酒鬼和给莫里亚蒂送钱也算工作。

original: Sure, I'm the best shot in town with a rifle, so everyone comes running to ol' Jericho when the Raiders show up.
translation: 当然，我可是镇里使步枪使得最准的。所以每当歹徒出现的时候，大家都会跑去找老耶利哥。

original: But between raids, they're content to take my money and drag me home when I've had too much. Hahaha!
translation: 不过在平时，他们都很乐意在我喝多了的时候拿走我的钱再把我丢回家。哈哈哈！

original: I take care of the water purification plant. This old rusted hunk keeps us in clean water... for now.
translation: 我负责看管水净化工厂，这个锈迹斑斑的破玩意为我们提供干净的水……至少现在还能。

original: I take care of the water purification plant. That old rusted hunk keeps us in clean water... for now.
translation: 我负责看管水净化工厂，这个锈迹斑斑的破玩意为我们提供干净的水……至少现在还能。

original: Never mind...
translation: 算了吧……

original: You're goddamn right "nevermind".
translation: 算了就算了。".

original: Whatever your problem is, I suggest you get over it. Now.
translation: 不管你遇到什么问题，我希望现在你都能克服它。

original: Well, now. That's something I didn't expect. You're scrappy for a little Vault twerp aren't you?
translation: 好吧，那并不在我预料中。你比避难所其他蠢货更有斗志，对吧？

original: Maybe I had you wrong, kid. You're okay. Now, what did you want to know?
translation: 或许我是错怪你了，孩子。你是个好人。现在，你想知道什么？

original: You're joking, right? I mean, I shit bigger than you, kid.
translation: 你在开玩笑，对吧？我是说，我可比你老练多了，孩子。

original: Come back when you've got some fight in you. Until then, save your threats.
translation: 你多积累点战斗经验，再来找我。现在少给我装腔作势。

original: Did I miss something? What's your problem with me?
translation: 我错过了什么？你找我什么事？

original: You're from the outside and I've lived too much of my life out there to trust every jackass nobody that wanders in from the Wasteland.
translation: 你是外来人，而我在外面待了大半辈子，学会了不能相信废土来的任何人。

original: You seem alright though, so I'll cut you a deal. I'll answer your questions so long as you don't give me any more reason to distrust you. Got it?
translation: 你看起来还好，那我们定个条件吧。只要你别再让我失信于你，我就回答你的问题。明白吗？

original: Here, take this Magnum.
translation: 给，拿着这马格南。

original: Wow, you sure about that? Okay...
translation: 哇，你确定？好的……

original: How about a Chinese Pistol?
translation: 这把中式手枪你觉得怎么样？

original: Hmm, okay. Never used one of these before, but I can probably figure it out.
translation: 嗯，好吧，我以前从来没有用过，但我大概能搞明白。

original: I can give you a Silenced 10mm Pistol.
translation: 我可以给你一把10毫米消音手枪。

original: I'm not sure the silencer will do me much good, but I'll take it. Thanks.
translation: 我并不认为这消音器会很管用，但我会用它的，谢谢。

original: I've got a 10mm Pistol. Want it?
translation: 我有一把10毫米手枪。想要吗？

original: Sure. Beats having nothing, doesn't it?
translation: 当然了，总胜过赤手空拳，不是吗？

original: I've got a .32 caliber pistol.
translation: 我有一把.32左轮手枪。

original: I guess it's better than nothing. Thanks.
translation: 我想有总比没有好！谢谢。

original: Sorry, I don't have a pistol on me.
translation: 很抱歉，我没有手枪。

original: Okay. If you find one, let me know.
translation: 好的，如果你找到了，请告诉我。

original: Can you help get us through this?
translation: 你能帮助我们穿过这吗？

original: I am feeling better, but not well enough to be of use to you. I apologize.
translation: 我感觉好多了，但恐怕还是帮不上你的忙，抱歉。

original: I think not. I am no great fighter to begin with, and... I am not feeling well. I would only get in your way.
translation: 我可不认为这样。首先，我并不是个战士……而且我现在觉得糟透了，我不会挡你的路。

original: I can try. I'm not much good with weapons, but if you've got a pistol I can use, I'll do what I can.
translation: 我可以试一试。没有什么好武器，但如果你有一支手枪让我使用，我会尽我所能。

original: What? You're supposed to be the tough one, right? Why don't you take care of it?
translation: 为什么？你不是很强吗？你为什么不来对付它？

original: You'd better walk away right now.
translation: 你现在最好立刻从我眼前消失。

original: Yeah? Well... I'm just saying.
translation: 是啊？嗯……我只是说。

original: My father is dead.
translation: 我的父亲已经过世了。

original: Oh hell. I'm sorry, I didn't know. I just thought that since this happened after you showed up... Well, you know. Man, I'm sorry.
translation: 噢，真该死，很抱歉，我不知道这点。我只是看到在你出现之后才发生的这一切……好吧，你知道，伙计，我真的很遗憾。

original: I don't have any meds on me, but what if we gave him some Buffout?
translation: 我身上没带药品，但如果我们给他一些壮大灵会怎么样？

original: I... Normally I would never approve of this. If the situation weren't so serious...
translation: 我不太赞同，要是处境不是那么危急的话……

original: If you think this is the best course of action, we'll do it. I hope this isn't a mistake.
translation: 如果你认为这是最应该做的事，那么我们将会做到这一点，我只希望这不是一个错误。

original: Maybe we should just leave him behind. He's slowing us down.
translation: 或许我们该把他留下，他一直在拖我们的后腿。

original: Maybe you're right. Very well. I'll tell him, and then we'll continue.
translation: 或许你说得对，非常棒。我会告诉他，然后我们将继续下一步。

original: Let's make this quick.
translation: 让我们快点搞定。

original: Forget it. I've got nothing.
translation: 算了。我什么都没有。

original: Perhaps if I just rest a while... [gasp] Perhaps not.
translation: 或许我只是需要休息一下……[喘息]或许还是不必了。

original: Sorry, I guess there isn't anything I can do right now.
translation: 抱歉，我想现在我什么也做不了。

original: We cannot continue to delay here. Something must be done. Is there no medicine to be found?
translation: 我们不能继续再在这拖延，得做点什么事。有没有什么地方能找到药品？

original: Here, take some Stimpaks. That should get him through.
translation: 给，来点治疗针 ，会让他好过一点。

original: Ah, so you do. Give them to Doctor Li, if you please.
translation: 啊，那么。如果你不介意的话，让他们去找李博士。

original: I have some Stimpaks here.
translation: 我这有点治疗针。

original: Yes, this looks to be enough. He'll need medical attention once we've reached the Citadel, but this will get him there.
translation: 是的，这看起来足够了，一旦我们到达五角大本营就需要让他接受治疗，而现在要帮他坚持到那。

original: Thank you. Give me a moment, and we can continue.
translation: 谢谢。给我几分钟时间，我们就可以继续了。

original: We need to do something about Garza.
translation: 我们需要对加尔萨采取些措施。

original: I do not have my usual supplies of medicine. I was too hasty in leaving.
translation: 我没带日常急救药品。我当时离开的太匆忙仓促了。

original: Hey. Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 嗨。有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

original: Hey Leo, can you hook me up?
translation: 嗨，利奥，你能来帮我介绍下吗？

original: What did I tell you? Not here. Hit me up when I'm away from the restaurant.
translation: 我怎么跟你说的？不是在这。等我从那餐馆里出来的时候 你再来请教我吧。

original: What'll it be?
translation: 那会怎么样？

original: Yeah, sure thing.
translation: 嗯，当然没问题。

original: What am I gonna say? No? You've got me over a barrel.
translation: 我还能说什么呢？说不吗？你让我别无选择。

original: Nothing. I'm... I'm not doing anything. Leave me alone!
translation: 没事。我……我什么也没做，让我一个人静静！

original: What are you doing in here?
translation: 你在这里干什么？

original: I understand you have quite a Chem habit...
translation: 我知道你有药品上瘾问题……

original: Look. Keep your bullshit judgments to yourself, man. Just don't tell Jenny or Andy and we'll be fine.
translation: 听着。留着你那毫无依据的判断吧。只要你不告诉珍妮和安迪，我们之间就没有麻烦。

original: How's that chem problem treating you?
translation: 你的上瘾问题怎么样了？

original: I just started, but so far... so good.
translation: 我才刚开始，不过到目前为止还蛮顺利的。

original: How's the addiction? Kicked it yet?
translation: 你的上瘾问题怎么样了？戒掉了吗？

original: Things are pretty hard, but it's getting better. Thanks again, you really talked some sense into me.
translation: 这事相当困难, 不过一切都会好起来的。再次感谢你,你确实让我明白了许多。

original: How's the addiction? Kicked it yet?
translation: 你的上瘾问题怎么样了？戒掉了吗？

original: Dammit! Who told you- I mean... I have no idea what you're talking about.
translation: 该死的！谁告诉你的 — 我是说……我不明白你在说什么。

original: It's not any of your business, remember?
translation: 这已经跟你没关系了。记得吗？

original: Can you tell me anything about Vault-Tec Headquarters?
translation: 你能告诉我一些避难所科技的情况吗？

original: From what I gather, it's located in the ruins of D.C. I got the location from one of the supply caravans.
translation: 从我所搜集的资料来看，它位于特区废墟。这是我从商队那打听到的。

original: They told me it had extremely high security and something they called a main frame inside.
translation: 他们告诉我说那防御系数很高，内部有一个什么主体框架的东西。

original: I'd imagine it's quite dangerous. I'd be careful if I was you.
translation: 我想那儿是非常危险的。如果我是你，就会格外小心。

original: Is the Stradivarius worth a ton of caps?
translation: 这斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴值这么多钱吗？

original: I hope you're not thinking of doing anything dishonest. You gave me your word.
translation: 你要向我发誓，你不会做不守信的事。

original: How will I know the Stradivarius when I see it?
translation: 当我看到斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴的时候，我要如何识别？

original: Well, from my great-great-grandmother's diaries, I have deduced that she had a special pressurized case created for it.
translation: 从我高祖母的日记来看，我可以推断她一定为她的日记本做了一个特殊的加密码的盒子。

original: Hopefully, the Soil Stradivarius was in the case when she... well, you know.
translation: 庆幸的是，索耶尔的斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴就在这箱子里，当她……的时候，你知道是怎么回事。

original: I can't really describe it in detail beyond the case. I've never seen it any other way. I'll know it's the real one when I have it in hand.
translation: 我没法说更多细节了，虽然我以前从未见过它，但当我把它握在手里时，我肯定知道是真是假。

original: You can fool the eyes, but not the ears.
translation: 你骗得了我的眼睛，但是骗不了我的耳朵。

original: Do you have any information on Vault 92?
translation: 你有92号避难所的信息吗？

original: I'm sorry, I wish I did. All I know is that Vault-Tec intended it to be a protective environment for the world's musical talent.
translation: 对不起，我也希望我有这么做。我只知道避难所科技是设计来保护世界上的音乐天才的。

original: When the bombs fell, the Vault was sealed and the rest is a mystery.
translation: 当核弹落下时，避难所关闭了，剩下的那些事都成了迷团。

original: Perhaps when you find it, you can find some sort of a record of what occurred inside.
translation: 或许当你找到它的时候还可以找到一些它内部发生的记录。

original: What do you know about the Soil Stradivarius?
translation: 你对索耶尔的斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴了解多少？

original: Not too much I'm afraid. It was fabricated way back in 1714 by a famous Italian craftsman named Antonio Stradivari.
translation: 恐怕了解的不是很多，它是一个叫安东尼奥·斯特拉迪瓦里的著名意大利制琴师在1714年制作的。

original: He had made a bunch of Stradivarius violins actually, and each one was individually named over time to identify them.
translation: 他制作了好几把斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴，每一把都以制作时间来命名。

original: They are regarded as the most outstanding instruments ever made... and no two sound alike they say. Incredible.
translation: 他们被誉为最不同凡响的乐器, 所演奏出的两个音阶丝毫不共鸣……如他们所说：好到难以置信。

original: Since the bombs fell laying waste to most of the world, it may be safe to say that this could be the last surviving violin of its kind.
translation: 核弹落于废土，祸及世界上的大部分国家和地区。可以肯定地说， 这是最后一把斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴了。

original: Tell me a bit about your great-great-grandmother.
translation: 告诉我一些你太-太-太祖母的事。

original: She was quite a special woman. Hilda was her name. Classically trained and exceptionally talented at the violin.
translation: 她是一个了不起的女人，她的名字是希尔达，她有着与生俱来古典的气质和对小提琴的卓越天赋。

original: Her pride and joy was her Stradivarius Violin. I can only imagine how exquisite this instrument must have been.
translation: 而她的骄傲和快乐来源于斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴，我只能猜想这乐器必定很精致。

original: When war reared its head, she was invited by Vault-Tec into Vault 92. They claimed the vault would be dedicated to preserving musical talent.
translation: 当战争硝烟四起, 她被避难所科技邀请到92号避难所，他们宣称那里会保护这世界仅有的音乐天才。

original: Happily, she accepted. After she entered Vault 92, the bombs fell, and the story as I know it ends.
translation: 庆幸的是，她接受了。在她进入92号避难所之后，核弹落下，我所知的就这些。

original: So, what am I supposed to do, scour the entire Wasteland asking about violins?
translation: 那我要做些什么，探索整个废土并寻问小提琴的下落吗？

original: Manners are not your strong suit, eh? I can see this will be a purely business related transaction. So be it.
translation: 你不怎么懂得礼貌，对吧？我有预感这将是一桩纯粹商业性质的交易，也行。

original: I'd suggest making your way to Vault-Tec Headquarters in the D.C. Ruins. That would be a good place to begin.
translation: 我建议你去特区废墟的避难所科技总部找找。不妨从那里着手。

original: I know where Vault 92 is... I'll head there right away.
translation: 我知道92号避难所在哪里……我会立刻去那。

original: You do? Amazing!
translation: 真的吗？太棒啦！

original: Thank you for this. You have no idea what this means to me.
translation: 谢谢，你可能不知道这对我而言意义有多么重大。

original: Good luck to you!
translation: 祝你好运！

original: Any idea where Vault 92 is located?
translation: 知道92号避难所在哪里吗？

original: That's the catch. I have no idea where it is.
translation: 这就是问题所在，我不知道它在哪里。

original: I'd suggest making your way to Vault-Tec Headquarters in the D.C. Ruins. That would be a good place to begin.
translation: 我建议你去特区废墟的避难所科技总部找找。不妨从那里着手。

original: Good luck!
translation: 好运。 !

original: More stories? Ugh...
translation: 还有故事啊……

original: You know, my mother always said a handful of patience is worth more than a bushel of brains.
translation: 你知道，我的母亲常叨念着“耐心足比头脑好更管用”。

original: However, if you're that eager to get going I'll skip the story. I'm looking for a particular violin called the Soil Stradivarius.
translation: 不过，要是你急着离开，我可以略过这段情节，我正在寻找一把独特的小提琴，名叫斯特拉迪瓦里提琴。

original: It's located in Vault 92, where my great great grandmother once lived.
translation: 它在92号避难所，我的高祖母曾在那生活过。

original: Sorry to interrupt, but where can I find the violin?
translation: 很抱歉打断你的话，但我在哪里才可以找到小提琴？

original: I'm sorry. I know I tend to ramble. Comes from being lonely.
translation: 我很抱歉。我知道自己挺罗嗦。还不是因为内心孤独嘛。

original: If you insist. I'll get right to the heart of the matter then. I'm looking for a particular violin, not just any.
translation: 如果你一定要知道的话，好吧，那我告诉你问题的关键。我正在寻找一把特殊的小提琴，不是随便一把。

original: The violin you're looking for is called the Soil Stradivarius. It's located in Vault 92, where my great great grandmother once lived.
translation: 你要找的那把小提琴叫做索耶尔·斯特拉迪瓦里。它在92号避难所里，我的高祖母以前就住在那里面。

original: I need some time to think about it.
translation: 我需要些时间来思考这问题。

original: I understand. Please don't mistake my evasiveness for mistrust. I am merely being cautious.
translation: 我理解。请不要误认为我是不值得信任的，我回避你的问题，那只是持种谨慎的态度。

original: Take your time, by all means.
translation: 随你，喜欢就好。

original: All right. I give you my word I'll do my best to recover a violin for you.
translation: 好了，我向你保证，我会尽力为你找到那把小提琴的。

original: Oh, I don't think I've been this happy in years! As promised, here's the key to the ammunition box. It's right under the radio table.
translation: 哦，我想我有好几年没现在这样兴奋了！我信守诺言，弹药盒的钥匙，就在电台桌子底下。

original: Before you leave, I have some information that may help you. At least a place to begin.
translation: 在你离开前，我有些消息可以帮助你，至少给你一个着手点。

original: It all starts with my great great grandmother Hilda back in 2077 before the bombs fell...
translation: 这一切都始于2077年我的高祖母时代，当时核弹还没有落下……

original: Oh, I don't think I've been this happy in years!
translation: 哦，我想我有好几年没有如此开心了！

original: I have some information that may help you. At least a place to begin.
translation: 在你离开前，我有些消息可以帮助你，至少给你一个着手点。

original: It all starts with my great great grandmother back in 2077 before the bombs fell...
translation: 这一切都始于2077年我的高祖母时代，当时核弹还没有落下……

original: I'm interested, but what will you give me in return?
translation: 对此我很感兴趣，但你会给我些什么好处？

original: As you may have already guessed, I really have nothing of value. Material value, that is.
translation: 你也看到了，我真的没什么值钱的东西。我是说，实质性的价值。

original: All I can offer you is the same I offer the caravans that trade with me. The frequency of my radio and the promise of beautiful music.
translation: 我能给你的与我给商队提供的回报是一样的：那就是我电台的频道和美妙的音乐。

original: A violin? That's hardly something that would have survived the war.
translation: 小提琴？这东西很难能从战争中残存下来。

original: Yes, very sad isn't it? Sad to think that no more musical instruments will ever be made the old way ever again.
translation: 是的，非常可悲吧？再也找不到以前制作乐器的方法了，多叫人伤心。

original: Sigh. Well, fortunately, I know where perhaps the last real violin in the world exists.
translation: 哎呀，庆幸的是，我知道世界上最后一把残存的小提琴遗落在什么地方。

original: If you give me your word that you will recover it, I will tell you more.
translation: 如果你保证去替我寻找它，那我可以告诉你更多的相关细节。

original: Let's cut to the chase. Is there something you need?
translation: 我们开门见山吧，你缺什么东西不？

original: You're very blunt. Not always a good trait, but sometimes it is the best way to get things done.
translation: 你很直率。虽说并非是个优点，但有时确实是做事的最佳手段。

original: My trading depends on my violin. Without it, I have nothing to play... no way to make music.
translation: 我的生意依赖于小提琴。没有它我可没办法演奏，创造不出音乐。

original: If you can bring me a violin, a better one, I'd feel much more secure.
translation: 如果你能给我带一把更好的小提琴，我会感觉踏实得多。

original: You built a homemade violin, huh? Impressive.
translation: 你自己做了把小提琴？让人惊讶。

original: Thank you. While my husband had his hobbies, I'm afraid mine was making that sorry instrument.
translation: 谢谢。比起我丈夫的特殊嗜好，我恐怕只是制作了那件可怜的乐器。

original: I only wish I could replace it with something better.
translation: 我只希望我能够用更好的东西来取代它。

original: Your husband's radio can broadcast across the entire Capital Wasteland?
translation: 你丈夫的电台可以覆盖整个首都废土？

original: Yes. My husband was very proud of the setup. He tinkered with that thing for years to get it working.
translation: 没错，那套设备是我丈夫的骄傲，他修修补补弄了好几年才终于让那东西运作起来。

original: I've tried to use it to get what I need, but I've never gotten a reply.
translation: 我试过用它来寻找我想要的东西，但是从来没有成功。

original: That sounds risky. What if the caravan never arrives?
translation: 这听起来有点悬啊，要是商队永远不来怎么办？

original: Well, I always have my husband's old radio set to fall back on.
translation: 嗯，我总能依靠我丈夫的老电台。

original: I used it once in an emergency when a group of Raiders was getting a bit too close for comfort to my house.
translation: 我只在紧急情况下使用过一次，那回一群歹徒离我的房子只有咫尺之遥。

original: Otherwise I use it to broadcast my so-called music I play from my homemade violin.
translation: 我在电台里播放用我自制的小提琴演奏的别样音乐。

original: Is there any way I can help?
translation: 有需要我帮忙的地方吗？

original: Now that you mention it, yes there is.
translation: 既然你说起，是的，还真有。

original: My trading depends on my violin. Without it, I have nothing to play... no way to make music.
translation: 我的生意依赖于小提琴。没有它我可没办法演奏，创造不出音乐。

original: If you can bring me a violin, a better one, I'd feel much more secure.
translation: 如果你能给我带一把更好的小提琴，我会感觉踏实得多。

original: What could you possibly have to trade?
translation: 你能有什么东西可以拿来交易的？

original: Besides shelter? Well, I offer something in the way of entertainment: I play songs on my homemade violin and people trade me goods.
translation: 除了提供庇护以外？嗯，我还提供一些娱乐活动：我用自制的小提琴演奏音乐来换取一些物品。

original: If not in person, I use my husband's old radio set. The men in the caravan say it keeps their morale up on lonely nights in the Wasteland.
translation: 不亲自演出的时候，我会使用我丈夫那个老电台。商队都说那音乐让他们在废土寂静的夜晚中保持斗志。

original: I'm sorry, the heat must be getting to me. My apologies.
translation: 对不起，我一定是压力太大了。我道歉。

original: Sigh. My husband told me once to always forgive and forget. I suppose I should take that advice now, rest his poor soul.
translation: 唉，我丈夫总是忠告我要尽弃前嫌。我真应该听取他的意见，愿他安息。

original: Consider the apology accepted, and your harsh words forgotten.
translation: 你的道歉我接受了，之前你说的话我也抛之脑后了。

original: I have a lot of patience, but you are really testing it.
translation: 我虽然耐性不错，但你不要太过分。

original: However, as I said before, forgive and forget.
translation: 不管怎么样，我还是那句话，尽释前嫌。

original: Again, I'm sorry. I don't know what came over me.
translation: 再次表示歉意，我不知道是怎么了。

original: Whatever, grandma. Like I care.
translation: 随便啦，奶奶，我不在乎。

original: That's just about all I'm going to take from the likes of you!
translation: 那差不多就是我要对你这种人做的事！

original: When you walked in, I thought you were different than the normal riff-raff that crawls out of the sand. I see now that I was wrong.
translation: 当你走进来的时候，我原以为你会和那群乌合之众不同，现在看来我错了。

original: Come back and talk to me when you decide to be more civil.
translation: 等你变得更懂得礼貌后再来找我谈。

original: That tears it!
translation: 撕烂它！

original: I've been calm and patient with you, but you just seem determined not to return in kind. Fine.
translation: 我对你够冷静、够耐心，但你并不知恩图报，那好吧。

original: Since you only understand rude behavior, allow me to demonstrate some for you. Get the hell out of my house!
translation: 既然你只会来粗的，那么我也来给你露一手。他妈的从我的房子里滚出去！

original: I honestly don't give a shit.
translation: 我其实一点也不他妈的在乎。

original: Not my problem. Good luck, Sheriff.
translation: 不是我的错，祝你好运，警长。

original: You're the one that brought it up. Not me.
translation: 是你引起的，不是我。

original: 100 caps? All right, I'll take a look at it.
translation: 100个瓶盖？好吧，我会去处理它的。

original: Great! Go ahead and see what you can do. Just be careful.
translation: 好极了！让我看看你都会做些什么，小心。

original: I don't need a reward. I couldn't sleep at night knowing you could all die.
translation: 我不需要什么报酬。想到你们可能会死，我晚上会睡不着觉的。

original: Well that's mighty decent of you. Just don't, you know... go blowing us up. All right?
translation: 你真是够仗义的。不过你可得...别把我们炸飞了。行吗？

original: Demolition expertise doesn't come cheap. I want 500 caps.
translation: 爆破专家收费可不便宜，我需要500个瓶盖。

original: That's pretty steep....  Fine. Do it and you'll get your money. Don't screw up, though, or we'll ALL regret it.
translation: 确实麻烦……好吧，你完成工作我就付给我钱。可别搞砸了，不然我们全得后悔！.

original: I knew I shouldn't have trusted you. Dammit, boy! You picked the wrong man to mess with. Now I've got to put you in the ground.
translation: 我知道我不应该信任你，该死的家伙！但是你选错人来耍了，我现在不得不杀了你。

original: Actually, Sheriff, I plan on detonating that bomb.
translation: 实际上，警长，我正打算引爆核弹。

original: I knew I shouldn't have trusted you. Dammit, girl! You picked the wrong man to mess with. Now I've got to put you in the ground.
translation: 我知道我不应该信任你，该死的家伙！但是你愚弄错对象了，我现在不得不杀了你。

original: Actually, Sheriff, I plan on detonating that bomb.
translation: 实际上，警长，我正打算引爆核弹。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: All right, shoot.
translation: 好的，说吧。

original: Know where I can get a drink?
translation: 知道能在哪弄点喝的吗？

original: Sure. Head over to Moriarty's for spirits. Or, if you want something to eat, head over to the Brass Lantern.
translation: 当然。莫里亚蒂那你能找到酒。要是你想找点儿吃的，那么你就去黄铜灯。

original: Does the town have a doctor?
translation: 这镇上有医生吗？

original: Yep. He's a bit cranky, but he means well. Just make sure there's something actually wrong with you before you bother him.
translation: 对。他有些怪癖。但是人还不错，在打扰他之前确认你真的不舒服就行了。

original: You'll find him down in the plaza at the bottom of the hill, across the way from The Brass Lantern.
translation: 穿过黄铜灯来时的路，你能在小坡下的广场找到他。

original: Why is the town called Megaton?
translation: 这镇子为什么叫兆吨镇？

original: The town's named after the bomb that's sitting in the middle of it. It hasn't gone off. Yet.
translation: 这镇子名字来源于坐落在中间的核弹来命名的，那核弹至今未引爆。

original: Sure. Whatever.
translation: 当然，随意。

original: Glad we understand each other.
translation: 很高兴我们彼此能相互理解。

original: Surely you haven't severed all contacts?
translation: 你还没有切断所有的联系？

original: Oh goodness, no. I have a supply caravan that passes here maybe once a week.
translation: 老天爷，不。有个商队会经过，大概一周一次。

original: I trade with them for whatever I need and I stock up enough until they return.
translation: 我和他们交易些必需品，并备足货物，直到下次他们回来。

original: I take it you don't get many visitors, then.
translation: 我猜你们不大有客人吧。

original: Apart from supply caravans, you're the first person to set foot inside my house in a long time.
translation: 除了商队，你可是长久以来第一个进我房子的人。

original: It's not for lack of trying at this point, mind you. I am just far off the beaten path.
translation: 听着，不是因为我在这方面缺乏尝试精神，只是我不走寻常路罢了。

original: Living in this isolation protects me, but has also made me very lonely.
translation: 与世隔绝的生活保护了我，但也使我感到寂寞。

original: Oh, your husband's dead? I'm sorry.
translation: 哦，你丈夫死了？我很遗憾。

original: That's kind of you to say.
translation: 你人很好。

original: Yes, he's gone. After he built this place, we spent many happy years together.
translation: 是的，他走了。在他修建这地方后，我们在一起快乐地度过了许多日子。

original: We decided to cut off contact with the outside world and just depend on each other for comfort and company.
translation: 我们决定和外界断绝联系，相濡以沫地生活。

original: I prefer to keep my business to myself. And I suggest you do the same.
translation: 我更喜欢自己做自己的事，而且我建议你也这么做。

original: Hmph! Well. I see you have manners I'd come to expect from a Wasteland dweller.
translation: 哼……作为一个废土居民，你的修养果然不出我的意料。

original: All I've done is offer you safe harbor in my home. No need to get testy with me, young man!
translation: 我所做的不过是让你在我家避难。你没必要对我发火，年轻人！

original: Hmph! Well. I see you have manners I'd come to expect from a Wasteland dweller.
translation: 哼……作为一个废土居民，你的修养果然不出我的意料。

original: All I've done is offer you safe harbor in my home. No need to get testy with me, young lady!
translation: 我所做的不过是让你在我家避难。你没必要对我发火，年轻人！

original: Exploring.
translation: 探索中。

original: Honestly, there is nothing much out here. Looking for sand? Rocks? We have plenty of that.
translation: 坦白说，这外面什么都没有。要找沙子，石头？我们倒是有很多。

original: You're welcome to look around this area of course. Don't let me dissuade you. I'm just trying to save you some time.
translation: 我们当然欢迎你来这游荡。不是我要泄你的气，我只是为你节省时间。

original: My husband built this place way out here for a reason, rest his soul.
translation: 我丈夫建造了这地方，只是为了他的灵魂能够安息。

original: That's funny, I was about to ask you the same thing.
translation: 真有趣，我正要问你相同的问题。

original: Oh, don't worry about me. I'm just fine out here.
translation: 哦，不要担心我。我在这很好。

original: My husband, rest his poor soul, saw to it that our house was well-protected from the elements and the inhabitants of the Wastes.
translation: 我丈夫，愿他安息，确保我们的房子不被恶劣的天气和废土居民破坏。

original: That's all I needed.
translation: 就要这些吧。

original: All right then.
translation: 那好吧。

original: If you say so.
translation: 既然你这么说。

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这干嘛？

original: I'm a sniper with the Pride. Put any mutie bastard within one mile of me and my rifle and, well... pack it up troops. Fight's over.
translation: 我是“里昂斯的骄傲”的阻击手。如果哪个变种混蛋在一英里之内碰到我和我的步枪，这个……收摊了伙计们。战斗结束。

original: Colvin thinks he's a better shot. Man's delusional.
translation: 科尔文认为他是个好射手。男人的错觉。

original: Me? Heavy weapons. Miniguns, Missile Launchers... If it's bigger than a human and goes boom, I'm all over it.
translation: 我？重武器。多管机枪，火箭发射器……只要是比人类块头大而发出轰轰响声的，我全都擅长。

original: So what's your job in the Lyons' Pride?
translation: 你在“里昂斯的骄傲”里的岗位是什么？

original: Hell, I do it all. Recon, demolition, tactical assault. Guess you could say I'm the Pride's jack of all trades.
translation: 该死的，我什么都干。侦察，破坏，突袭。你可以叫我“里昂斯的骄傲”全面手。

original: What's your combat specialization in Lyons' Pride?
translation: 你在“里昂斯的骄傲”里有什么战斗特长？

original: Spec ops. Let's leave it at that.
translation: 这么说吧。特种部队。

original: So what's your specialty in the Lyons' Pride?
translation: 你在“里昂斯的骄傲”里的特长是什么？

original: Yeah, whatever.
translation: 好，随便。

original: That's what I thought.
translation: 我就是这么想的。

original: I've had enough of your shit, Dusk.
translation: 我受够了你这狗屎，达斯科。

original: Oh? Oh really? Look, I know how you wasters are. You cap a few Radscorpions and think you can walk around like you own the fucking place.
translation: 哦？真的吗？我知道你们这些流浪者。你们干掉了几只辐射蝎，就以为他妈的这成了你们的地盘。

original: But things work differently around here. You got a problem with that, then you go ahead and meet me in the Lyons' Den after lights out.
translation: 但在这里事情有所不同。你要是有意见，熄灯后到里昂斯的房间来找我。

original: I'll solve your little problem the old fashioned way.
translation: 我会用最古老的方法来解决你小问题。

original: I think we got off on the wrong foot...
translation: 看来我们出师不利……

original: It takes some stones to admit a mistake. Maybe you're not so bad, stranger. Tell you what, buy me a drink sometime and we'll call it even.
translation: 道歉需要勇气。陌生人，或许你没有那么糟糕。跟你说吧，给我买杯酒我们就算扯平了。

original: So, what do you want that's worth pissing me off over?
translation: 你要怎样才肯滚蛋？

original: So it was taught to me, so will you teach it some day. Enough jaw, maggot. Back to work.
translation: 我是这么学的，有一天你也会这么教给别人。少罗嗦，菜鸟，继续干活。

original: The Brother who taught me was a wise man, Initiate. But even will requires practice. Back on point.
translation: 教导的那个兄弟是个聪明人，新兵。但即使是意志也需要练习。回到正题上吧。

original: I understand. Like you said: no man may be defeated so long as his will to survive remains.
translation: 我明白。如你说的：只要渴望生存，人就不会被击败。

original: I understand, sir. Like you said: fill your soul with thunder, fight with a heart of steel.
translation: 我明白，长官。正如你所说：让你的灵魂犀利，让你的心像钢铁一般去战斗。

original: Then you've reached a new level of understanding. Combat does not take place in the brain. It is passion, instinct, and the will to survive.
translation: 那你就达到了更高的境界。战斗不是在大脑中，而是靠激情、本能和生存的意志。

original: You're not quite as worthless as you look. Remember, if you overthink combat, you're dead. You have to WANT to survive more than your enemy.
translation: 你不像看上去的那么白痴。记住，战斗时想太多是会送命的。你必须比你的敌人更“渴望”生存。

original: I feel good, sir. I think I get what you were talking about. When I let go and see only the target, the bullets fly right where I want them to go.
translation: 我感觉不错，长官。我想我领悟你说的了。当我放松下来，只见到目标，一定就弹无虚发。

original: I think I understand what you were saying, sir. When I calm down and focus, I don't see anything but the target.
translation: 我想我听懂了，长官。当我的内心宁静且专注的时候，我就只看到目标了。

original: Try loosening your grip, maggot. Hold the weapon higher -- see nothing but the sight and the target. Try not to screw it up this time.
translation: 别握得那么紧，菜鸟。把武器再端高些 — 专心看你视野中的目标。这次别再搞砸了。

original: Stop shooting with your eyes and your hand. A soldier kills with his heart. Focus. Lock on to your target and destroy it. Now give it another try.
translation: 不要用你的眼和手去射击。好士兵是用心去杀人。专注、锁定你的目标然后摧毁它。来，再试试。

original: What do you suggest, sir? No matter what I do, all my shots pull to the left.
translation: 长官，还有什么要诀吗？无论我怎么做，我所有的射击都偏左。

original: If it's not the weapon, then what is it, sir?
translation: 长官，如果不是武器的原因，那是什么？

original: Are you kidding me? It's not the weapon, Initiate! Try holding the gun properly instead of firing from the hip like some goddamned cowboy.
translation: 你开玩笑吗？新兵，这不是武器的问题！好好握紧你的枪，不要象该死的牛仔那样从屁股后拔出枪就开。

original: The weapon isn't the problem, Initiate. You just shoot like my goddamn grandmother. Actually, strike that, my Mrs. Gunny was a deadeye.
translation: 新兵，武器不是问题。你只要像该死的老奶奶一样射击就行了。不如打那个，我们的大枪小妞可是百发百中的。

original: Damn. Sir, I think the sights on my pistol are off. I'm aiming dead on and it keeps firing to the left.
translation: 该死。长官，我想我手枪的瞄准镜是偏的，就算我瞄得死死的，开火时还会偏左。

original: There's something wrong with this weapon, sir. I can hear shells catching in the chamber when I fire.
translation: 长官，这件武器有点不对劲。开火的时候，我能听见弹壳撞击枪膛的声音。

original: This has been a Tenpenny Truism.
translation: 这已经是特佩尼的老生常谈了。

original: The poor man wishes for prosperity. The rich man makes his own.
translation: 穷人想发财，富人只是付诸于行动而已。

original: We must turn our thoughts away from that which is imperfect and impure.
translation: 我们必须忘掉那些不纯不净的想法。

original: On that vast plain of dust we will raise new cities, and like the Phoenix spread the wings of new life and take flight!
translation: 在尘埃覆盖的广阔平原上，新的城市将拔地而起，仿佛凤凰涅磐，为了新生活重新展翅高飞。

original: Never wonder for a moment if you are worthy of the benefits you possess. Rather wonder always if you have utilized them to their fullest.
translation: 永远不要去想自己是否对得起自己的所得，而是要去想自己是否完全利用好它们了。

original: All men were created equal. Not all men remain so.
translation: 所有人都生来平等，但不可能一直平等。

original: The beggar must lay down his cup, for a man needs both hands to grasp the future.
translation: 乞丐必须放下他的碗，因为人们要用两只手来掌控未来。

original: Let us release our fears of the past into our hopes for the future!
translation: 让我们把对过去的恐惧转化为对未来的希望。

original: The poor man wonders why he is poor. The rich man knows why he is rich.
translation: 穷人不明白他们为什么穷，富人知道他们为什么富。

original: And now it's time for another Tenpenny Truism.
translation: 现在又是特佩尼的老生常谈。

original: And now a Tenpenny Truism.
translation: 现在是特佩尼的老生常谈。

original: Song 2
translation: 歌曲2

original: Song 1
translation: 歌曲1

original: You can trust me. I'm a doctor myself.
translation: 你可以信任我，我自己就是医生。

original: All right, I suppose someone with medical training has to have at least a bit of compassion. And maybe you can talk some sense into the boy.
translation: 好的，我想受过医疗训练的人多少有些同情心。或许你可以和这男孩好好谈谈。

original: Leo Stahl... that boy got hisself a problem with Jet. I've caught him in here two to three times tryin' to steal what I keep around for anesthetic.
translation: 利奥·斯塔尔…… 那男孩吸杰特上瘾了。他想偷我这的麻药时被我抓住过几次。

original: Not even his own family knows it. He goes up to the water treatment plant at night to get high... I dunno... I can't reach him. Maybe you can.
translation: 连他的家人都不知道这事。他晚上去水处理厂吸杰特……我……我说不动他，或许你能。

original: Nice try. Maybe if you actually had some medical training, we could talk about it.
translation: 想的美，如果你真的确实受过医疗训练，或许我们可以谈谈。

original: Never mind, then.
translation: 那算了。

original: Right.
translation: 对。

original: I'm only trying to help, Doc.
translation: 我只是想帮忙，医生。

original: All right look, I'm only tellin' you this because you seem like an okay sort and I'm hopin' maybe you can talk some sense into the boy.
translation: 好的，我之所以告诉你这些因为你看起来不错，我希望你可以和这男孩好好谈谈。

original: Leo Stahl... that boy got hisself a problem with Jet. I've caught him in here two to three times tryin' to steal what I keep around for anesthetic.
translation: 利奥·斯塔尔…… 那男孩吸杰特上瘾了。他想偷我这的麻药时被我抓住过几次。

original: Not even his own family knows it. He goes up to the water treatment plant at night to get high... I dunno... I can't reach him. Maybe you can.
translation: 连他的家人都不知道这事。他晚上去水处理厂吸杰特……我……我说不动他，或许你能。

original: You seem very happy. Is there anything I should know?
translation: 你看起来很高兴。有什么可以要和我分享的吗？

original: No, of course not. I am simply glad that our work can continue. James is essential to the project. That's all. Really.
translation: 没有，当然没有。我高兴是我的工作可以继续了。对于这工程，詹姆斯是必不可少的。就这些。真的。

original: I told you I'd find him.
translation: 我告诉过你，我找到他了。

original: So you did. I apologize for entertaining the thought of doubting you.
translation: 看来你做到了。我为我的怀疑向你道歉。

original: Where do I go from here?
translation: 我将会从这走到哪？
