original: Head towards the northeast end of that level. There's an intercom close to the grate you're looking for.
translation: 一直走到这层的东北尽头，那附近有你要找的对讲机。

original: Head up to the museum level. Use the door at the north end of the level you're on now.
translation: 一直走到博物馆层。在你所在的那层尽头北面，有个你可以使用的门。

original: The mainframe room is on the security level, west of the pumps you started earlier.
translation: 主机在安保层，在你刚才开启的水泵旁。

original: You're on the right level. Head to the western end, and look for the large automated door.
translation: 你在正确的楼层。一直向西走。找一个大自动门。

original: The fuse box you're looking for is down near the cisterns. Keep heading down.
translation: 你找的保险丝盒在蓄水池附近，一直往下走。

original: Come on back up to the main lab. I'll be waiting.
translation: 继续往回走，到主实验室来。我在那等你。

original: The flood control pump is at the south end of this level.
translation: 排水泵在这层的南面。

original: Keep heading down. There's a staircase at the south end of the level you're on.
translation: 一直往下走。在这层的南面有个楼梯。

original: I can't really say, since I don't know where you are.
translation: 我真的没法告诉你怎么走，因为我不知道你在哪。

original: Where am I now?
translation: 我现在在哪？

original: Right now you're near one of the large cisterns where water from the river is kept until it can be processed.
translation: 现在你在一个大蓄水池旁，从河里流过来的水存在那等待处理。

original: You're in the security level. It's full of holding tanks for the water as well as our processing equipment and power systems.
translation: 你在安保层。这里全是污水槽、处理设备和电源系统。

original: You're in what used to be the old museum and gift shop. A lot of the Project's machinery is down there now. We just refer to it as the Museum level.
translation: 你在的地方曾经是老博物馆的礼品店。现在有好多工程机械扔在那。我们刚提到过的博物馆层。

original: According to the display, you're somewhere in the substructure. I can't be more specific than that right now.
translation: 根据显示，你在底部的某处。我目前无法再准确了。

original: Tell me about the Church.
translation: 和我说说教堂。

original: For those answers I shall direct you to my husband, Confessor Cromwell.
translation: 关于这个问题的答案，我推荐你去见我的丈夫，忏悔者克伦威尔。

original: Can you repair my equipment?
translation: 能修理我的装备吗？

original: Sorry, I'm closed. Come back tomorrow and we'll talk.
translation: 对不起，我关门了。明天再说。

original: Since you kept me from wasting my time on that book, I had a chance to refine my repair process a bit.
translation: 多亏了你不再让我浪费时间去写什么书了，我才有机会提高我的修理技术。

original: Sure, fine. Whatever.
translation: 当然，好的。随你。

original: It's nice to be doing something useful.
translation: 做点有意义的事情感觉真好。

original: Okay, let me scrape the brahmin poop off my hands.
translation: 好的，让我擦掉手上的双头牛屎。

original: If you've got the caps, I've got the skill.
translation: 如果你有瓶盖，我就有技术。

original: Unless it's a steaming pile of slag, I'd say yes.
translation: 除非它是个冒汽的矿渣堆，否则我的答案是肯定的。

original: You got caps for me? Then there ain't no problem.
translation: 你有瓶盖？那就没问题了。

original: Let me see what you have for sale.
translation: 看看你都卖些什么？

original: Sorry, I'm closed. Come back tomorrow and we'll talk.
translation: 对不起，我关门了。明天再说。

original: I get a lot more done now that I'm not working on that book. I guess that's something, and that ought to earn you a discount, huh?
translation: 我现在有太多的事可做而不是忙着写那本书了。这多亏你的帮忙啊，我理应给你打个折，呃？

original: Sure thing.
translation: 当然的。

original: Okay, fine.
translation: 嗯，好的。

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: Sure thing!
translation: 当然的！

original: Absolutely!
translation: 正是如此！

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: Thank you, Doctor Li.
translation: 谢谢，李博士。

original: I... Yes, well. If we weren't in danger right now, I'd suggest something different. But this should see you through for the time being.
translation: 我……是的。如果现在我们不是处在危险中的话，我会提些不同的建议。但这暂时可以帮你渡过难关。

original: If it will help me, then I will take it. I trust you, Doctor Li.
translation: 如果它能帮我，那我会接受。我信任你，李博士。

original: Garza, we have no medicine... but there is something else that may help for now.
translation: 加尔萨，我没药品了……但有些其他东西可能还有用。

original: All right. If you're up to it, we'll continue.
translation: 好的，如果你没问题，我们就继续。

original: Thank you, Doctor Li. I'm feeling better already. Let us continue, and not waste more time here.
translation: 谢谢，李博士。我已经感觉好多了。让我们继续吧，不要在这浪费更多时间。

original: Garza, here. This will help you to feel better. Once we reach the Citadel, you'll be fine.
translation: 加尔萨，来。这能帮你感觉好些。一旦到了五角大本营，你就会好的。

original: What's got you so spooked?
translation: 什么把你吓成这样？

original: Sigh. Look... you can call me crazy if you want but there just is something odd about those creeps.
translation: 唉。听着……你想叫我疯子也行，但我就是觉得有些东西不对劲。

original: I mean, they got the guns and they got the muscle. Why don't they just bust down our doors and take us out already?
translation: 我意思是，他们有枪又有肌肉。为什么他们不打破门，把我们带走？

original: We're really in a bad way, and could use some help.
translation: 我们已经很惨了，需要些帮助。

original: What are you, some kind of a wimp?
translation: 你懦弱吗？

original: Look, pal. If you think I'm gonna get my ass shot off playing the hero, you're dead wrong.
translation: 听着，伙计。如果你认为我会逞英雄招来子弹，那你就大错特错了。

original: If I know they're coming, I lock myself inside like everyone else.  We're really in a bad way, and could use some help.
translation: 如果我知道他们来了，我会像其他人一样把自己锁在屋里。我们已经很惨了，需要帮助。

original: Where is Doctor Li's lab?
translation: 李博士的实验室在哪？

original: The door on the left goes to the stairwell. From there, just keep heading west.
translation: 左手的门通到楼梯间，到楼梯间再转西。

original: At the stern. That's the west end to you.
translation: 在船尾。在你的西面。

original: If you don't stop it now, where will it end? It's up to you to do what's right.
translation: 如果你现在不阻止它，那该怎么结束？做你觉得对的事吧。

original: Yes, I suppose it is. Very well, you shall have your wish. Once you have left, I will put an end to the Enclave.
translation: 是的，我想是这样。非常好，你有你的梦想。一旦你离开，我就会终结英克雷。

original: I cannot stop Colonel Autumn, however. That much will be up to you.
translation: 我没法阻止奥托姆上校，但你可以阻止他。

original: I suppose, then, that this is goodbye. You'll have to see yourself out; I have preparations to make.
translation: 我想，要再见了。你要继续你自己的路；我也要准备一下。

original: You can't even control your own troops. You're clearly not fit for this.
translation: 你甚至不能控制你自己的军队。你很清楚你并不适合这么做。

original: Perhaps... Perhaps you are right. But does that really mean all this progress should be wasted, destroyed?
translation: 或许……或许你是对的。但是那真的意味着所做的都该废弃，毁灭吗？

original: You can't just decide to take over, and force everyone to follow you.
translation: 只是你不能就这么把它给接管，并强迫每个人都追随你。

original: What alternative would you suggest? Without the Enclave, what will the world do?
translation: 你有什么别的建议吗？没有英克雷，世界会怎么样？

original: This has to end, Eden. You need to destroy yourself and this base.
translation: 该结束了，伊登，你必须摧毁你自己和这基地。

original: And why would I do that, when I am clearly the best hope for the people of the Wasteland?
translation: 我意识到这是废土人民最大的愿望，我确实该这么做。

original: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这干嘛？

original: I feed my family and I love my wife and daughter, what else more is there to life, stranger?
translation: 我养育我的家人，我热爱我的妻儿，对于生活还能有什么要求，陌生人？

original: Family first! And any man who says anything different is saying something wrong. And you should hit that man. With a stick.
translation: 家庭第一！任何人对此说三道四那肯定是错的。你要拿着棍子修理他。

original: I work to feed my family, just like every red-blooded American man should.
translation: 我凭劳力来养家，就像每一个精力充沛的美国人做的那样。

original: Why, a man that can't keep his family fed isn't any kind of man at all, no sir!
translation: 噢，一个不能养家的男人根本不是男人！

original: What do your parents do?
translation: 你父母是干嘛的？

original: The same thing that all parents do! My mom cooks and cleans the house and my dad goes to work with Mr. Wilson.
translation: 跟别的父母一样！我妈做饭打扫房子，我爸和威尔逊先生一起工作。

original: They work in the basement, or sometimes in Mr. Wilson's shed. Dad says that when I'm older, I'll come to work with him and learn the family business!
translation: 他们在地下室工作，有时在威尔逊先生的工棚。爸爸说等我大一点的时候，我可以跟着他干，学着打理家里的事。

original: That's how we do it in the Lyons' Pride, you fucking freaks!
translation: 那就是我们“里昂斯的骄傲”的方式风格，你这他妈的怪胎！

original: Initiate! Shut it! You'll have your fill of death soon enough.
translation: 新来的，不想死的话就闭嘴！

original: Uh... Yessir. Sorry, Brother.
translation: 啊……是，长官。抱歉，钢铁兄弟会。

original: Scared, stupid kid...
translation: 蠢孩子，被吓到了……

original: That's all of 'em.
translation: 那是他们所有人。

original: Looks that way.
translation: 看那边。

original: Must be a tourist.
translation: 一定是个旅行者。

original: Reddin, on me.
translation: 瑞丁，到我这来。

original: You're doing fine. Just follow my lead. No dead heroes today, okay?
translation: 干得好，你只要跟着我就好。今天不是取义成仁的日子，听见了？

original: Negative.
translation: 不行。

original: Roger that. Uglies in our sights.
translation: 收到。已经能看到那些丑八怪了。

original: Yeah, yeah. We'll see.
translation: 嗯，嗯。看到了。

original: Now knock that off. You're wasting ammo.
translation: 停一下，你在浪费子弹。

original: We need to sweep the area. You think those were all the Uglies in D.C.? You take the east side, I'll go west.
translation: 我们得清理干净这区域。你以为华盛顿的丑八怪只有这么点吗？你去东面，我去西面。

original: Once we're inside, then we'll celebrate.
translation: 一旦进去，我们就要大干一场了。

original: Reddin! Get out of there! Behemoth!
translation: 瑞丁！快出来！是超级变种巨人！

original: Reddin!!
translation: 瑞丁！！

original: God dammit!
translation: 该死的！！

original: Yeah, I know. God DAMMIT!!
translation: 嗯，我知道。该死啊！！！

original: Come on. Let's see if they've got anything to drink in this dump.
translation: 来吧，让我们看看他们在这破烂里有什么喝的没。

original: Is this the idiot who blew our ambush?
translation: 这是让我们的埋伏暴露的白痴吗？

original: Let's get back to the checkpoint. See if Colvin has finished clearing the street.
translation: 回据点去看看科尔文清理干净了街道没有。

original: What's the situation?
translation: 什么情况？

original: Good.
translation: 好的。

original: Jennings?
translation: 詹宁斯？

original: Just a stray we picked up. The one that blundered into the Uglies over on 42nd.
translation: 只是要找一个走散的伙伴。在42街冒失地冲进丑八怪中去的那个愣头青。

original: All right. It's the usual drill. Reddin, you just do whatever Paladin Vargas says and keep your mouth shut.
translation: 好的。这是平常任务。瑞丁，你执行圣骑士维加斯的命令就行了，并且闭好你的嘴。

original: Okay, the outpost is just to the south of us. Colvin, you're the eyes.
translation: 好，敌人的前哨站就在我们南面。科尔文，你负责侦查。

original: Vargas, Reddin, secure this building.
translation: 维加斯，瑞丁，防守建筑。

original: And?
translation: 还有呢？

original: OK. We'll flush them out, you pick them off. On my mark.
translation: 好的。我们把敌人赶出来，你守着搞定他们。在我标记的地方。

original: Go.
translation: 走。

original: Take cover! Behemoth!
translation: 找掩护！是超级变种巨人！

original: Get the Fat Man! We'll try to keep him busy!
translation: 用“胖子”微型核弹发射器！搞定他吧！

original: It's not your fault, Vargas. Reddin was good enough for the Pride, and she proved it here today.
translation: 这不是你的错，维加斯。瑞丁配得上“里昂斯的骄傲”这称号，她今天证明了这点。

original: When we get back to the Citadel, I'll talk to the scribes. Let it be chronicled that Paladin Reddin passed her test.
translation: 等回到五角大本营以后，我要和文士说。让“里昂斯的骄傲”瑞丁今天的壮举载入史册。

original: Yes, ma'am.
translation: 是的，女士。

original: So how'd I do, Vargas? I pass my little trial run? Come on, Lyons' Pride needs me and you know it! That Citadel guard duty is such bullshit.
translation: 维加斯，你说我该怎么做？ 我只是个新手？ 少来了，你知道“里昂斯的骄傲”需要我的！防守五角大本营的任务太他妈傻了。

original: Aw, come on. We just kicked their asses!
translation: 加油，我们只是挠了挠痒！

original: Okay, okay.
translation: 好的，好的。

original: Now you're talking.
translation: 这才像话。

original: Holy shit! What was that?
translation: 他妈的！那玩意是什么？

original: Scene C - GNR conversation between Sarah and Commander
translation: 场景C — 在银河新闻电台里，萨拉和指挥官谈话

original: Brotherhood mobile unit, report your status.
translation: 兄弟会行动小队，汇报当前状态。

original: We're clear out here. Stand down.
translation: 经检查安全。稍息。

original: Sentinel Lyons? Is that you?
translation: 莎拉·里昂斯？是你吗？

original: Who else? Always count on my father to send the best.
translation: 还会有谁？我父亲总是会派最好的来。

original: Ha ha ha! Humble as always, Sarah.
translation: 哈哈哈哈！总是很谦虚啊，萨拉。

original: It's great to see you guys. It's been Super Mutant Central over here for days.
translation: 看到你们真开心。这些天这儿都快成超级变种人集会地了。

original: You're telling me. Well, another mess cleaned up. We'll sweep the perimeter and be inside shortly.
translation: 如你所说，刚清理掉一批变种垃圾，我们待会儿就出去清理防线并回来。

original: Copy that.
translation: 收到。

original: I found a Brotherhood Holotag. What should I do with it?
translation: 我发现了一个兄弟会全息军牌。怎么处理？

original: Talk to Scribe Jameson. She is our keeper of the Scrolls. She will want to know what you have found.
translation: 去和文员詹姆森谈谈，她是我们的史官，她会对你找到的东西有兴趣。

original: You have? Oh my. This brings to light a sad affair for the Brotherhood. But perhaps it is something that you can assist us with.
translation: 你有吗？天啊。这对兄弟会来说是件悲伤的事。但这有些事或许你能帮忙。

original: If you have the time, I have an offer for you.
translation: 如果你有时间，我有个提议。

original: All clear, Sentinel. Five mutants released from their torment. The rest are keeping their heads down.
translation: 警报解除，哨兵。超渡了五个变种人。其他的都跑了。

original: A new recruit?
translation: 一个新兵？

original: Welcome!
translation: 欢迎啊！

original: You don't need to worry. You're with friends now. We'll see you safely through.
translation: 不用担心。大家都是伙计。和我们在一起很安全。

original: Come with me if you like. We'll have the best view.
translation: 如果你愿意就跟我来，好戏要开场了。

original: I'm in position, sir.
translation: 长官，我已就位。

original: This looks like the main force. Many tormented souls will meet the Maker today. I will pray for forgiveness.
translation: 看起来这是敌人主力。这么多尘世苦魂今天该去见祖先了。我得祈祷一下宽恕。

original: Garza, I'm sorry. We have to go now.
translation: 加尔萨，抱歉。现在我要走了。

original: I cannot make it on my own, Doctor Li! I am too weak!
translation: 我离不开你们，李博士！我太差劲了！

original: I'm sorry, Garza. I have everyone else to think of as well. If you reach the Citadel, they'll be waiting for you.
translation: 抱歉，加尔萨。我要同时照顾其他人。如果你到了五角大本营，他们会在那等你。

original: But... What will I do? You would leave me here alone?
translation: 但是……我该怎么做？你要把我一个人留在这？

original: Garza, I'm sorry, but we must keep moving. If you can't keep up, I'm afraid we'll have to go on without you.
translation: 加尔萨，不好意思，但是我必须前进。如果你跟不上，我们恐怕要撇下你不管了。

original: Here's your violin, Agatha.
translation: 这是你的小提琴，阿加莎。

original: You son of a bitch! You know what that thing meant to me!
translation: 你这混蛋！你知道这东西对我意味着什么！

original: It was a family heirloom. It belonged rightfully in the hands of a musician, someone to appreciate its value, not to exploit it!
translation: 这是传家宝。它要托付给一个合适的人、一个音乐家，一个能够赏识它的价值的人，而不是拿它去换钱！

original: I can't believe you'd stab an old woman in the back like this! Get out! GET OUT OF HERE THIS INSTANT!
translation: 我真不敢相信你会在暗地里做出如此伤害一个老太太的事！滚！立刻！

original: Well, actually Agatha, I sold the Stradivarius to someone else.
translation: 嗯，实际上，阿加莎，我把斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴卖给别人了。

original: Oh my goodness! I must see it... please!
translation: 天啊！我一定要看一看…… 请让我看看吧！

original: Oh my... it's more beautiful than I could have ever imagined!
translation: 噢，天啊…… 它的美丽完全超出我的想象！

original: I can't thank you enough. I wish I had something to give you, a more suitable reward for all your efforts.
translation: 我无法表达我的谢意。我想我可以给你些什么，相对你的辛劳更适合的报酬。

original: All I can give you is the frequency to my radio set. Tune in whenever you feel like listening to the strains of an old woman's violin playing.
translation: 我所能给你的就是一个电台频率。无论何时你想听的时候就调到这频率，来收听一个老太太的小提琴演奏。

original: I understand. I haven't given up hope... I know you'll find it.
translation: 我明白。我没放弃希望……我知道你能找到它。

original: I'm still looking. Don't give up on me yet.
translation: 我还在找。别失望。

original: Are they Raiders or Slavers?
translation: 他们是掠夺者还是奴隶贩子？

original: No way. If they were, you'd be staring at a burned out ghost town. I think the Family are just a bunch of punks.
translation: 不是的。假如他们是的话，你现在只会看到一座被烧杀殆尽的鬼城。我想，家族只不过是一帮小混混而已。

original: Well at first they'd do typical gang bullshit. You know, break stuff and make lots of noise, but they always kept their distance.
translation: 开始他们只做些小混混的勾当。你知道，打烂东西，发出噪声，但是一直离的很远。

original: But this last time, they went too far. They killed all of our Brahmin! I mean, that's our lifeblood out here you know!
translation: 但这最近的一次，他们做得太过分了。他们把我们的双头牛都杀了！我意思是，你也知道它们是我们的生计来源！

original: I bet you like to look at butts, don't you?
translation: 你很喜欢盯着别人的屁股看，对吧？

original: Ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈！

original: You're all right for a mungo, you know that?
translation: 你这个毛人还不错，你知道吗？

original: Why don't you come in. I think we can trust you.
translation: 为什么你不进来呢，我想我们能信任你了。

original: Yeah, your mom sure likes it.
translation: 嗯，你妈妈一定会喜欢。

original: Ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈！

original: You're pretty funny for a mungo.
translation: 你是个非常有趣的毛人。

original: Why don't you come on in?
translation: 为什么你不进来呢？

original: Yeah, well at least it doesn't smell as bad as you do.
translation: 没错，起码它比你好闻多了。

original: Ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈！

original: You're pretty funny for a mungo.
translation: 你是个非常有趣的毛人。

original: Why don't you come on in?
translation: 为什么你不进来呢？

original: You know what? Your face looks like my butt.
translation: 你知道吗？你的脸就像我的屁股。

original: Oh yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: You must like having such a good looking butt.
translation: 你屁股一定漂亮极了。

original: What's a mungo?
translation: 什么是毛人？

original: You are, mungo!
translation: 你就是毛人！

original: You big people. You're all tall and clumsy. Bunch of mungos, and we don't need nothing to do with any of you!
translation: 你们那些大人。你们都高大笨拙。一群毛人！我们不要和你们这种人扯上关系！

original: You're pathetic. This isn't even worth our time.
translation: 你这可怜虫，你根本不值得我们浪费时间。

original: You and your little girlfriend have fun together. We're outta here.
translation: 你和你的小女朋友在这一起玩吧。我们到外面去。

original: C'mon, Tunnel Snakes! Let's go!
translation: 来，穴蛇帮！我们走吧！

original: Okay, okay. You win. We'll leave the little girl alone!
translation: 好的，好的。你赢了。我们会离开这小女孩的！

original: You're not worth our time, anyway.
translation: 总之，你不值得我浪费时间。

original: C'mon, Tunnel Snakes. We're outta here.
translation: 穴蛇帮！我们要离开这了。

original: Choice 2
translation: 选择2

original: Fine, screw you.
translation: 好吧，去你的。

original: Take a hike, asshole.
translation: 哪凉快哪待着去，混蛋。

original: No, no. I am only here to help with moving things, lifting heavy equipment. I am no scientist.
translation: 不，不。我只是在这帮忙搬东西，推设备。我不是科学家。

original: I simply help Doctor Li in whatever way I can.
translation: 我只是尽我所能去帮忙李博士。

original: Really? You sure don't look like a scientist.
translation: 真的？你看起来一点不像科学家。

original: Choice 1
translation: 选择1

original: Great. If there's anything I can do for you, let me know.
translation: 太好了。如果我能为你做什么，就告诉我。

original: Hey, we're cool.
translation: 嗨，我们没事。

original: I help Doctor Li when she needs equipment moved. I am no scientist, I just help with the heavy things.
translation: 李博士要移动设备的时候，我来帮忙。我不是科学家，我只是对付那些大家伙。

original: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这儿是干嘛的？

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: I'm MacCready. I run Little Lamplight, because they made me the mayor. And I don't like strangers. Or mungos.
translation: 我是麦迪。我管理小灯镇，因为大家选我当镇长。我不喜欢陌生人，还有毛人。

original: Doctor Madison Li. I am in charge of the science team based here at Rivet City.
translation: 我是李博士，是驻扎在铆钉城的科学团队的负责人。

original: I am Garza. I help Doctor Li here in the lab.
translation: 我是加尔萨。我在实验室给李博士帮忙。

original: I need a new face, doc.
translation: 我需要个新面孔，医生。

original: I'm pretty banged up, doc.
translation: 我被严重撞伤了，医生。

original: I've changed my mind. I'll live with the pain.
translation: 我改变主意了。还是忍着痛算了。

original: Parts of me are broken, doc.
translation: 我受伤了，医生。

original: Can you help me doc?
translation: 你能帮我吗，医生？

original: I'm here to do business with you.
translation: 我来这是和你做生意的。

original: Here's a menu.
translation: 拿好菜单。

original: Yeah, what do you have?
translation: 好，都有些什么？

original: If I must.
translation: 如果必须的话。

original: For you, I always offer my best price.
translation: 我一直给你最优惠的价格。

original: Straight to the point. I like that.
translation: 开门见山。我喜欢这样。

original: What'll you have?
translation: 你要什么？

original: I'll have a drink.
translation: 给我来点喝的。

original: Commin' up.
translation: 就来。

original: I'll have a drink.
translation: 给我来点喝的。

original: We've got all kinds of chems.
translation: 我有各种药品。

original: What do you have for sale?
translation: 你这卖些什么呢？

original: Need to do some killin' eh?
translation: 想杀点什么人？

original: Can I see what kinds of guns you have for sale?
translation: 我能看看你卖的枪吗？

original: Here is our menu, sir.
translation: 先生，给你菜单。

original: I'm hungry.
translation: 我饿了。

original: Here is our menu, ma'am.
translation: 女士，给你菜单。

original: I'm hungry.
translation: 我饿了。

original: Let's get high.
translation: 咱们来开心吧。

original: I need some chems.
translation: 我要买点药。

original: After what you did? Only because I have to.
translation: 在你做了那事之后？只是因为我必须。

original: What have you got to sell?
translation: 你这都有些什么？

original: Anything for you! You sure fixed Bannon good.
translation: 愿为你效劳！你真把班侬给修理了一顿。

original: What have you got to sell?
translation: 你这都有些什么？

original: I've got a little bit of everything.
translation: 我各种货品都有一点。

original: What have you got to sell?
translation: 你这都有些什么？

original: Whatchya lookin' for?
translation: 你在找什么？

original: I'm thinking of buying some ordinance.
translation: 我在考虑买一些武器。

original: Take a look at our menu.
translation: 看看我的菜单。

original: What do you have to eat?
translation: 你这都有些什么吃的？

original: Please place your order.
translation: 请决定你要什么。

original: What do you have to eat?
translation: 你这都有些什么吃的？

original: Let's see... Are you a boy or a girl?
translation: 让我看看……是男孩还是女孩？

original: It's a girl? A girl! We've got a daughter, Catherine! A beautiful, healthy baby girl!
translation: 是女孩？一个女孩！我们有了女儿，凯瑟琳！一个漂亮健康的小女孩！

original: It's a boy? A boy! We've got a son, Catherine! A beautiful, healthy baby boy!
translation: 是男孩？一个男孩！我们有了儿子，凯瑟琳！一个漂亮健康的小男孩！

original: You've got a bright future ahead of you, sweetie. I'm sure of it...
translation: 你会有一个美好的将来，甜心。我确信……

original: You've got a bright future ahead of you, son. I'm sure of it...
translation: 你会有一个美好的将来，儿子。我确信……

original: Look at you, look at you... Hi, there. I'm your daddy, little guy. Daddy. You're going to need a name, aren't you?
translation: 看过来，看过来……嗨，看这。我是爸爸，伙计。爸爸。你需要有个名字，是不是？

original: Look at you, look at you... Hi, there. I'm your daddy, sweetheart. Daddy. You're going to need a name, aren't you?
translation: 看过来，看过来……嗨，看这。我是爸爸，甜心。爸爸。你需要有个名字，是不是？

original: Your mother and I have been talking. What do you think about...
translation: 你母亲和我谈过了，你觉得怎么样……

original: That's a good name. Don't you think? Fits you perfectly.
translation: 那是个好名字。你觉得呢？非常适合你。

original: Looks like they've finished the gene projection. Let's see what you'll look like when you're all grown up.
translation: 看来他们完成了基因预测。让我们看看你长大后什么样。

original: You're going to look a lot like your dad.
translation: 你将来会很像爸爸。

original: See that, Catherine?
translation: 看到了吗，凯瑟琳？

original: It's a big world out there, honey, full of all sorts of people. What about you? What kind of person are you going to be?
translation: 外面的世界很大，甜心，有形形色色的人。你呢？想当什么样的人？

original: It's a big world out there, son, full of all sorts of people. What about you? What kind of person are you going to be?
translation: 外面的世界很大，儿子，有形形色色的人。你呢？想当什么样的人？

original: You're just...
Catherine? Catherine! She's in cardiac arrest! Start compressions! Get the baby out of here! Move. Move!
translation: 凯瑟琳？凯瑟琳！她心跳停止了！开始电击除颤！把婴儿带出去。快，快啊！

original: One, one thousand. Two, one thousand.... Come on!
translation: 一，一千。二，二千……。加油！

original: Hang on, Catherine! Hang on....
translation: 坚持住，凯瑟琳！坚持住……

original: Dad... I'm not going with you. I have other things to take care of.
translation: 爸爸……我不和你一起去。我还有些其他事。

original: Really? You're not going to join me?
translation: 真的？你不准备和我在一起？

original: Coming all this way after me... I'd have thought you'd want to help. I have to keep going; I can't stop now.
translation: 这么远来找我……我还以为你会想帮忙呢。我必须得继续前进；我现在不能停下来。

original: I'm going back to Rivet City. Meet me there if you change your mind. I... It would be good to work with you, honey.
translation: 我要回铆钉城。要是你改变主意，就到那找我。我……能和你一起工作就好了，宝贝。

original: Really? You're not going to join me?
translation: 真的？你不准备和我在一起？

original: Coming all this way after me... I'd have thought you'd want to help. I have to keep going; I can't stop now.
translation: 这么远来找我……我还以为你会想帮忙呢。我必须得继续前进；我现在不能停下来。

original: I'm going back to Rivet City. Meet me there if you change your mind. I... It would be good to work with you, son.
translation: 我要回铆钉城。要是你改变主意，就到那找我。我……能和你一起工作就好了，儿子。

original: Okay, let's head for Rivet City.
translation: 好，咱们出发去铆钉城。

original: That's my girl!
translation: 这才是我的好姑娘！

original: Let's hurry. Now that I know what we need, I want to get back to work as soon as possible.
translation: 咱们快点。既然我已经知道我们需要什么了，我就想尽快回去工作。

original: That's my boy!
translation: 这才是我的好小伙！

original: Let's hurry. Now that I know what we need, I want to get back to work as soon as possible.
translation: 咱们快点。既然我已经知道我们需要什么了，我就想尽快回去工作。

original: Screw the Vault. I didn't need that place.
translation: 他妈的避难所。我不需要那地方。

original: Is that so?
translation: 是这样吗？

original: You're nineteen years old. Are you so sure you know what you want from life already?
translation: 你19岁了。你确定你要过什么样的生活了吗？

original: I suppose it doesn't matter now. I suspect there's no going back for either of us. We'll just have to forge on ahead, won't we?
translation: 我想那没关系。我猜我们都没有回头路了。我们只能前进，是不是？

original: You left me there without saying goodbye. What was I supposed to do?
translation: 你一声不吭地就留我在那。我那时该怎么办？

original: You were supposed to stay put. You could've had a good life in the Vault.
translation: 你本该待在那。你本可以在避难所里过上安稳的生活。

original: But I suppose it's too late to go back now, isn't it? The Overseer would likely have us shot on sight.
translation: 但我想现在回去也太晚了，不是吗？监督者见到我们就会开枪。

original: Well, then you'll just have to come with me to Rivet City. You've certainly proven yourself capable enough.
translation: 嗯，那你一定要跟我去铆钉城。你已经证明你有足够的能力。

original: You need to go back to Rivet City?
translation: 你需要返回铆钉城？

original: I can't do this on my own. Madison... Doctor Li has a team of scientists working at Rivet City. They'll have to help.
translation: 我一个人办不成这事。麦迪逊……李博士有一支科学团队在铆钉城工作。他们得帮忙。

original: The facility hasn't been used in years. There'll be enough work for a good number of people, and it will take us a while.
translation: 那处设施已经多年未启用了。有大量的工作需要不少人来做，这得花上我们一些时间

original: The sooner I get to Rivet City, the sooner Madison and I can get to work.
translation: 我一到铆钉城，麦迪逊和我就可以开始工作。

original: What about me? What am I supposed to do?
translation: 那我呢？我该干嘛？

original: Yes, what about you? Why, in fact, are you outside the Vault at all? I don't even want to know HOW you got out.
translation: 是啊，你呢？事实上，你为什么会在避难所外面？我甚至不知道你是怎么出来的。

original: As much as I appreciate your help, you were supposed to stay there, to make a life for yourself there, not out here!
translation: 谢谢你的帮忙，不过你应该待在那，在那生活，而不是外面！

original: Can we get out of here now?
translation: 现在我们能出去吗？

original: Yes, yes! Absolutely! We need to get back to Rivet City. I've got to tell Madison that I have it.
translation: 能，能啊！当然能！我们得回铆钉城去。我得告诉麦迪逊我找到了。

original: After all these years, I finally have the key to making Project Purity a reality.
translation: 这么多年后，我终于掌握了能把净水工程变为现实的关键。

original: Did you get the information you needed?
translation: 你得到你需要的信息了吗？

original: I did indeed. Braun's work, the G.E.C.K., was designed to re-adapt environments for living after a nuclear war.
translation: 我确实得到了。布劳恩的成果，伊甸园创造器，原本设计用来在核战后重新改造环境以供生活。

original: It's not entirely stable, but I'm sure that components of that technology are just what we need, what we've been missing all this time.
translation: 它并不完全稳定，但我确信，该技术的组成部分正是我们所需要的，正是我们一直以来所欠缺的。

original: I need to return to Rivet City. Once Madison knows about the G.E.C.K., I can get her to see that it really will work.
translation: 我要回铆钉城。一旦麦迪逊了解到“伊甸园创造器”的情况，我就能让她明白它确实能派上用场。

original: What are YOU doing here? You could've been killed!
translation: 你在这干嘛？你应该已经被杀了啊！

original: Well I didn't expect Dr. Braun to be alive and insane. I thought I'd just find notes, or holotapes.
translation: 我没想到布劳恩博士还疯疯癫癫地活着。我只想找到笔记或全息磁带。

original: I needed information about Braun, and his work on the G.E.C.K.
translation: 我需要有关布劳恩和他在G.E.C.K.方面工作的信息。

original: I came here to find you.
translation: 我来这是为了找你。

original: Well, I'm glad you did. This certainly wasn't how I expected things to turn out. I wasn't ready for Braun, or I might've fared better.
translation: 嗯，我很高兴你来了。这事成这样绝非我所料。我没准备会碰上布劳恩，否则我能应付得更好些。

original: So you're going back to Rivet City right now?
translation: 那么你现在要回铆钉城？

original: Yes. With what I've learned, Madison is sure to see that we can finally succeed where we failed so many years ago.
translation: 是的，用我所学到的东西，麦迪逊一定会看到我们在许多年前跌倒的地方重新站起来了。

original: I'd like you to come with me. I'd like you to be there when we finally open the floodgates.
translation: 我希望你跟着我。我希望我们最后打开水闸的时候，你能在那。

original: You've got to be kidding me...
translation: 你一直在耍我……

original: You must understand. As much as I love you, this project has been my responsibility since long before you were even born.
translation: 你必须明白。在你出生之前的很长一段时间，我像爱你一样地爱着这工程。

original: Too many people have made sacrifices to give up on it now. Your mother...
translation: 太多的人为此付出了牺牲。比如说你母亲……

original: If you'll let me, I'd like to show you what we've accomplished. I want you to be there when we change the world.
translation: 如果可以，我想给你看看我们的成果。我希望在我们改变世界的时候，你能和我在一起。

original: After so many years, I can finally see it through to the end. I can't stop now.
translation: 这么多年后，我终于可以看到我的成果。我现在不能放弃。

original: Don't you want to take a break, after what you've been through?
translation: 走了这么多路，想休息下吗？

original: No, no. There will be time to rest when the work is complete. This is too important!
translation: 不，不。工作完成后有才时间休息，现在的工作太重要了！

original: I need to get back to Rivet City right away. There's so much to be done.
translation: 我要立刻回铆钉城。还有好多事要做。

original: No, no. There will be time to rest when the work is complete. This is too important!
translation: 不，不。工作完成后有才时间休息，现在的工作太重要了！

original: I need to get back to Rivet City right away. There's so much work to be done.
translation: 我要立刻回铆钉城。还有好多事要做。

original: What did you learn?
translation: 你了解什么？

original: I was right about Braun. The technology he developed is unstable, even dangerous, but it can be adapted for Project Purity.
translation: 对布劳恩，我的看法没错。他开发的技术还不稳定，甚至有些危险，但它适合净水工程。

original: I need to return to Rivet City and talk with Madison. If we can find a G.E.C.K., we can make Project Purity work.
translation: 我需要返回铆钉城和麦迪逊谈谈。如果我们能找到伊甸园创造器，我就能完成净水工程工作了。

original: Good thing I showed up to save you.
translation: 好消息是我来救你了。

original: It certainly is! It's nice to feel like I'm on two legs again.
translation: 确实不错！太好了，我感觉我又能站起来了。

original: And thanks to Doctor Braun, I know that Project Purity isn't lost after all.
translation: 再次感谢布劳恩博士，毕竟我知道净水工程是不能放弃的。

original: What, you didn't like being a dog?
translation: 什么，你不喜欢做条狗？

original: Well, I suppose it had its moments. But in the end, I much prefer having opposable thumbs.
translation: 唔，我想那时候是的。不过最后，我还是挣脱了……

original: And now that I'm back, I can get back to work. I need to tell Madison what I've learned.
translation: 现在我回去工作。我要把我知道的告诉麦迪逊。

original: Don't look straight into the light, honey. You'll hurt your eyes. It's just something you get used to down here.
translation: 甜心，不要直视着光源。那会伤害你的眼睛。还有好多事你要习惯。

original: Don't look straight into the light, pal. You'll hurt your eyes. It's just something you get used to down here.
translation: 小伙计，不要直视着光源。那会伤害你的眼睛。还有好多事你要习惯。

original: Come on over here, sweetie. Come on! Walk to Daddy!
translation: 到这来，甜心。过来！走到爸爸这来！

original: Come on over here, son. Come on! Walk to Daddy!
translation: 到这来，儿子。过来！走到爸爸这来！

original: You can make it!
translation: 你能做到！

original: Just a little farther!
translation: 再走远点！

original: Over here!
translation: 在这里！

original: Come to Daddy!
translation: 来爸爸这！

original: You can do it!
translation: 你能做到！

original: There you go! My goodness! Just a year old, and already walking like a pro.
translation: 就是这样！天啊！才一岁，就已经走得像模像样了。

original: Your mother would have been so proud.
translation: 你妈妈会很骄傲。

original: Listen, kiddo, I know you don't like it when Daddy leaves you alone, but I need you to take care of yourself for a minute.
translation: 听着，宝贝，我知道你不想爸爸把你独自留在这，但你要自己照顾自己一会。

original: You just stay here while Daddy runs to his office. You'll be okay, pal. I'll be back in a bit.
translation: 你在这等爸爸去下办公室。没事的，儿子。我一会就回来。

original: You just stay here while Daddy runs to his office. You'll be okay, honey. I'll be back in a bit.
translation: 你在这等爸爸去下办公室。没事的，甜心。我一会就回来。

original: Ha ha ha! You're quite the little explorer, aren't you? Serves me right for trying to pen you in!
translation: 哈哈哈！你是个十足的小探险家，对吧？我要没记错的话，你现在应该是待在婴儿围栏里的！

original: Come on over here. I want to show you something.
translation: 到来这。我想给你看些东西。

original: See that? It was your mother's favorite passage. It's from the Bible. Revelation 21:6.
translation: 看到了吗？这是你妈妈最爱的的圣经段落。启示录21：6。

original: "I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely."
translation: “我是阿尔法，我是欧米伽，我是初，我是终。我要将生命泉的水，白白赐给那口渴的人喝。”

original: She always loved that.
translation: 她一直喜欢这段话。

original: All right. Come on. Let's go see if your little friend Amata wants to play....
translation: 好的，来吧。让我们去看看你的小朋友阿玛塔想不想玩玩……。

original: Hahaha. Stupid robot.
translation: 哈哈哈。蠢货机器人。

original: No entry without tickets. Please present your tickets.
translation: 没票禁入。请出示票。

original: Let's rip off its arms.
translation: 让我们扯断它的胳膊。

original: Unauthorized metro use detected. Target list... acquired.
translation: 发现未经授权的人进入地铁。目标清单……已获取。

original: Silly robot. Smash it!
translation: 傻瓜机器人。打碎它！

original: Metro security protocol initializing...
translation: 地铁安保模式启动……

original: Station security grid... offline. Metro Central... not responding.
translation: 车站安保系统……离线。地铁中心……无响应。

original: Threat level Omega. Lethal force authorized.
translation: 威胁级别最高。授权使用致命武力。

original: Metro security protocol in progress. Please stand clear of the offenders.
translation: 地铁安保模式处理中。请远离闯入者。

original: Stand clear, please.
translation: 请躲远些。

original: Do not be alarmed. The metro will resume normal operation shortly.
translation: 不要惊慌。地铁会很快恢复正常运作。

original: Authorized ticketholders, please proceed to the main platform.
translation: 持票者验证通过，请前往主月台。

original: Nobody there. No bucketheads. Just old broken robot.
translation: 那没人。也没水桶脑袋。只有些破旧的机器人。

original: Bucketheads are finished! City is ours now!
translation: 水桶脑袋被消灭了！现在城市是我们的了！

original: Yah... I'm hungry. Let's find meat.
translation: 啊……我饿了。让我们找点肉。

original: I'm here to see Mister Burke.
translation: 我是来见伯克先生的。

original: He's expecting you? Why didn't you say so right away? Just a moment...
translation: 他在等你？你为啥不早说呢？稍等片刻……

original: Alright. Come on in. But I warn you. We're watching you.
translation: 好了。请进。但我警告你。我们会盯着你的。

original: ... <static> ...
Thank you, Madison. It's good to be working with you again.
translation: 谢谢你，麦迪逊。很高兴能再次和你共事。

original: Damn you, James. When this is all over, you owe me a drink. I'll get the team together.
translation: 该死，詹姆斯。等这都结束了，你得请我喝一杯。我去组织团队。

original: And you know I wouldn't be here if I didn't think this would really work. It's time, Madison.
translation: 你也知道，要是我不认为这真的能行，我就不会来这。是时候了，麦迪逊。

original: You know if it were anyone else asking me to do this, I'd have them run right out of Rivet City.
translation: 你知道要是换作别人让我做这事，我会直接把他们赶出铆钉城。

original: That's why we're going to head over there right now and get things up and running as best we can.
translation: 所以我们现在就去那儿，尽全力让它重新运作起来。

original: From the last reports, there's no power at the facility. Even if one of those computers had a database, we couldn't access it.
translation: 根据最新报告，那座设施里没有电力。就算那些电脑中有数据库，我们也无法访问。

original: I know, I was thinking about that. The lab at the facility had some old pre-war computers that we scavenged. One of them might be useful.
translation: 我知道，我也在想这个问题。那设施的实验室里有几台我们搜集到的战前旧电脑。其中一台可能会有用。

original: James, I... We don't have a G.E.C.K. I can get a small team together, but we'll need proof that it works before people believe us.
translation: 詹姆斯，我……我们没G.E.C.K.。我可以组建一个小团队，但在人们信任我们之前，我们需要证明这行得通。

original: It's as important to me as ever, Madison. I know it's important to you too. Let's finish this together.
translation: 这对我来说一如既往地重要，麦迪逊。我知道对你也很重要。让我们一起完成它吧。

original: You haven't lost any of your passion, have you James.
translation: 你的热情一点都没减啊，是吧，詹姆斯。

original: How could it not be worth improving the lives of everyone in the Wasteland? What could be a more worthy endeavor?
translation: 连改善废土上每个人的生活都是不值得的话，那什么才是更值得努力的呢？

original: I... I don't know, James. So many years have passed. Is it really still worth trying?
translation: 我……我不知道，詹姆斯。这么多年过去了。这真的还值得尝试吗？

original: Madison, I'm telling you this is real. I talked to Braun himself. He confirmed it. Don't you see? This is what we've been waiting for!
translation: 麦迪逊，我跟你说这都是真的。我跟布劳恩本人谈过了。他证实了这一点。你没明白吗？这就是我们一直在等待的！

original: I'd like to believe you, James. Really I would. This is all just so... So sudden.
translation: 我倒是想相信你，詹姆斯。真的。可这一切都太……太突然了。

original: And with good news. I was right about Braun and the G.E.C.K. If we can find one, we can adapt it to work with the purifiers.
translation: 还带了好消息。关于布劳恩和G.E.C.K.，我是对的。要是我们能找到一个，就能改造它，使它适配净化器。

original: James! You're back!
translation: 詹姆斯！你回来了！

original: I told you it would work, Madison, and now I can prove it.
translation: 我就跟你说这行得通，麦迪逊，现在我能证明了。

original: Hey, Jonas, get a picture of me with the big game hunter!
translation: 嗨，乔纳斯，给我和这大猎手合个影！

original: Over here, honey!
translation: 来这里，亲爱的！

original: Over here, son!
translation: 来这里，儿子！

original: Careful! It's a Radroach. Think you can take care of that with your BB gun? Just aim and shoot. You'll be fine.
translation: 小心点！这是辐射蟑螂。我想你能用你的BB枪对付它？只要瞄准，然后射击。你会做没事的。

original: Happy birthday, pal! I can't believe you're already 10. I'm so proud of you.
translation: 生日快乐，伙计！我都不敢相信你已经10岁了。我为你骄傲。

original: Happy birthday, honey! I can't believe you're already 10. I'm so proud of you.
translation: 生日快乐，亲爱的！我都不敢相信你已经10岁了。我为你骄傲。

original: If only your mother....
translation: 如果你母亲……

original: Enjoy your party! You're only 10 once, so have fun!
translation: 好好玩吧！10岁的生日聚会就这么一次，所以开心点！

original: ...The Enclave? What are they doing here...  They're where? Madison, lock that door!
translation: ……英克雷的人？他们在这干嘛…… 他们在哪？麦迪逊，关门！

original: Please remain in your assigned areas while we get this sorted out...
translation: 待在这里别动，等我们去把这些杂碎赶走……

original: Everyone, it seems we have some visitors. I don't know who they are or what they want.
translation: 各位，看来我们有客人来了。我不知道他们是谁和他们想要什么。

original: We have a singular opportunity here; a chance to make the Wasteland a better place for... what? What's that?
translation: 我们现在有一个千载难逢的良机，一个让废土变的更加美好的机会，让……等一下，那是什么？

original: I'd like to thank you all for returning to this project after so many years. I know some of you thought this day would never come.
translation: 我衷心感谢你们，感谢你们多年后还会再次参与这个工程，我知道你们当中不少人都没有想到还有重返工程的一天。

original: Once the mainframe is online, we'll be able to access the database, and hopefully learn where we can find a G.E.C.K.
translation: 一旦连上主机，我们就能进入数据库，希望我们能够从中找到伊甸园创造器的蛛丝马迹。

original: There's a lot of deterioration in the pipes, and some damage to the substructure, but it's nothing we can't fix.
translation: 管道锈迹斑斑，地下结构也被破坏了，但是没有什么是我们修复不了的。

original: We've restored power to the mainframe, which is coming online now.
translation: 我们刚给主机恢复动力，它正在连线。

original: All right everyone, you should be able to hear me now.
translation: 好的，各位，你们应该能听到我说话吧。

original: I guess. We don't get to talk much. I just wish Diego would notice that I'm not a child anymore.
translation: 我想。我们不必多言。我只希望迭戈能注意到我已不再是个孩子了。

original: Wouldn't you rather be with a real girl? Maybe you should try it before you decide.
translation: 难道你不想找个真正的女孩吗？或许在你决定前应该试一下。

original: But I did, Doctor Li. I put it right where you told me to.
translation: 但是我做了，李博士。我就把它放在你告诉我的地方了。

original: Just some water.
translation: 来点水就行。

original: Don't know where he is, and I'm not sure I care. I saw you talking to Bannon the other day. Did he mention me?
translation: 不知道他在哪，我好像也不关心。那天我看到你跟班侬说话。他有提起我吗？

original: A little. Aren't you? We don't have a place to live, and your father is going to have to support us.
translation: 一点。你呢？我们无处可去，你父亲一定会来支援我们的。

original: No, it's not true! Yes, she has been tempting me, trying to seduce me, but I've resisted.
translation: 不，那不是真的！是的，她一直勾引我，还企图色诱我，可是我坐怀不乱。

original: That is a sin in the eyes of God, Mister Lopez. Surely he has a greater purpose for you. You should speak with Father Clifford.
translation: 在上帝的眼中，这是罪过，洛佩斯先生。他肯定对你有更大的企图。你应该和克利福德神父谈谈。

original: Haven't seen you in church, Danvers. How about this week?
translation: 没在教堂见过你，丹佛斯。这周怎么样？

original: That is a sin in the eyes of God, Mister Lopez. Surely he has a greater purpose for you. Let us pray to Saint Monica.
translation: 在上帝的眼中，这是罪过，洛佩斯先生。他肯定对你有更大的企图。让我们向圣莫尼卡祈祷吧。

original: You are a drunk and a harlot, Trinnie, but the Lord can still forgive you. Come to church on Sunday.
translation: 崔妮，你是个酒鬼，一个妓女，但上帝仍然会原谅你。周日来教堂吧。

original: Your sins call me down here. Your souls need to be cleansed of the Devil's brew you serve.
translation: 你的原罪召唤我过来的。你那被恶魔掠走并污染的灵魂需要彻底的清理。

original: The doctor is fine. If it weren't for her work, Rivet City would be no better than Megaton, Danvers.
translation: 医生是好人。要不是他的工作，铆钉城不会比兆吨镇好多少，丹佛斯。

original: I don't know, what do you want to do?
translation: 我不知道，你想干嘛？

original: Do you have anything to calm my nerves? Paulie keeps trying to get me to try Psycho, but that stuff rots your brain.
translation: 你有什么东西能平复我的紧张情绪？保利一直让我服用疯狂药，但这东西会侵蚀我的大脑。

original: I am doing the tasks I have been programmed for. Currently I am waiting for new orders.
translation: 我一直在执行程序设定的任务。现在我正等待新的命令。

original: I am not programmed for visual evaluation. However, Miss Vera tells me that the Iguana is only a day old.
translation: 我的程序不能进行视觉评估。然而，薇拉告诉我女士这只蜥蜴只有一天大。

original: Certainly, Mister Sister.
translation: 当然，“修女”先生。

original: My family is dead and the world is a nuclear Wasteland. What exactly is it that I have to live for, Father Clifford?
translation: 我的家人都死了，世界变成了核废墟。我活着到底为了什么，克利福德神父？

original: Um...don't do that. That would not be a good idea. Maybe you should talk to Father Clifford.
translation: 嗯……不要那样做。那不是个好主意。不如你和克利福德神父谈谈。

original: Vera! Wonderful to see you. You look lovely today.
translation: 薇拉！看到你太好了。你今天看起来很可爱。

original: You know I'd do anything for you, Vera.
translation: 你知道我可以为你做任何事，薇拉。

original: No. I don't want you hanging around that little bitch. She and her parents think they are so much better than me.
translation: 不。我不想你总待在这小婊子身边。她和她父母总认为他们比我好。

original: Don't be jealous of my wealth. Be jealous of my looks instead.
translation: 别嫉妒我的财富。还是羡慕我的长相吧。

original: You should spend more time on the flight deck, Angela. You look so pale!
translation: 安吉拉，你要多去飞行甲板上走走，你看起来脸色太苍白了！

original: I don't need anyone to take care of me, Seagrave. But I do like being your friend. Just your friend.
translation: 西格雷夫，我不用任何人照顾我。但我想做你的朋友。仅仅是朋友而已。

original: Nothing, sir.
translation: 没有，先生。

original: Oddly, sir? No, I haven't seen anyone else acting oddly.
translation: 古怪，先生？不，我没看到什么人行动古怪。

original: So far everything's been quiet.
translation: 到目前为止平安无事。

original: Sounds good. I'm beat.
translation: 听起来不错。我敢打赌。

original: No. I haven't seen anything.
translation: 不。我什么也没看到。

original: Nothing I'd contact security for.
translation: 我没有理由联系警卫。

original: I think we're out of wine, but I'll check.
translation: 葡萄酒好像没了，我要看一下。

original: Er...uh...yes. I think so. No, I'm quite certain. Yes.
translation: 呃……啊……是的。应该是的。不，肯定是的。没错！

original: Really? That would be wonderful. I don't have enough caps right now, but I've been saving them up.
translation: 真的？那太好了。我现在没有足够的瓶盖，但我正在存。

original: I'm just looking. I'm sure you don't have anything that would make me 18 any sooner.
translation: 我只是随便看看。我肯定你这儿没有东西能让我赶快长到18岁。

original: You bastard! And to think I loved you! I hate you.
translation: 你这杂种！还以为我爱上你了！我恨你！

original: Thank you, Father. I'll ask him again, but he doesn't want to close the restaurant on Sunday mornings.
translation: 谢谢，神父。我会再问问他，但他不想在周日早晨关闭餐馆。

original: Okay. Don't forget to check the oven. Nobody will eat a burnt iguana.
translation: 好的。别忘了检查烤箱。没人想吃烧糊的蜥蜴。

original: He's not like that, dad. Diego's a gentleman...unfortunately.
translation: 他不像那样，爸爸。迭戈是个绅士……很不幸。

original: No thanks, Paulie. Last time I tried that stuff Diego got so mad at me. I'll just get you some noodles.
translation: 不，谢谢，保利。上次我这么做，迭戈非常生气。我给你拿些面条。

original: We just got in a fresh batch. I'll go blow the dust off of one.
translation: 我这有新出炉的。我先把上面的灰吹净。

original: Sorry, Mr. Shrapnel. My dad asked me to see if you had anything new, and to check out what ammo you have.
translation: 打扰了，“榴弹”小帅先生。我爸爸让我看看你什么新货没，再看看你有什么弹药。

original: Sorry, Mr. Shrapnel. I just came by to see if you had anything new, and to check out what ammo you have.
translation: 打扰了，“榴弹”小帅先生。我来看看你有什么新货没有，再看看你有什么弹药。

original: Diego takes me up there at night, but the sun isn't up then. Oh! I'm late Miss Vera. Goodbye!
translation: 迭戈晚上带我去那，但是太阳还没升起来。噢！我晚了，薇拉女士。再见！

original: Brock.
translation: 布洛克。

original: Harkness.
translation: 哈克尼斯。

original: Yes, I am. Thank you.
translation: 是的，我是。谢谢

original: Yes, sir. That may be the case.
translation: 是的，先生，情况应该属实。

original: There does seem to be some tension between the two decks. However, you're drunk. Just leave us alone.
translation: 在两个甲板之间看起来有些紧张。然而，你喝多了。让我自己待会。

original: No. Not today. Just bring me some Mole Rat, rare.
translation: 不。今天不。就给我拿些地鼠肉，半熟的。

original: Of course. Just don't touch it. I don't want any grease stains from that kitchen on it.
translation: 当然。只是别碰它。我可不想上面沾上厨房的油渍。

original: Too bad for you, you mean. It's good business for me.
translation: 对你来说不太好，但对我来说是有价值的。

original: Shhh. I'm trying to listen.
translation: 嘘。我正试着听。

original: I guess so. No law against it. Or at least none that I've signed.
translation: 我想是吧。没有法律禁止它。或者说至少没有我签过字的。

original: We decided to build a railing on the flight deck, just as soon as we can get the scrap metal. Other than that, no.
translation: 我们决定只要弄到了足够的废金属，就在飞行甲板上建个扶手。除此之外就没了。

original: Brahmin steak, with scotch.
translation: 双头牛肉排。

original: Dresses don't grow on trees, Vera. I can only sell what the outlanders bring me.
translation: 衣服不会从树上长出来，薇拉。我只能卖外来人给我的。

original: You're always trying to pull that shit. You know I don't run tabs for nobody, Tammy.
translation: 你总是那么多废话。塔米，你也知道我是从不赊账的。

original: That's a load of crap. Preach to them if you have to, but don't get in the way of their drinking.
translation: 那是一堆废物。随便敷衍他们几句，不过可别打扰他们喝酒。

original: Don't tell me how to run my business, Brock. These prices have worked for 30 years, and they be fine for 30 more.
translation: 别教我怎么做生意，布洛克。这价格已经保持了30年，而且30年来都做的不错。

original: This is the last one, Trinnie. You're too goddamn drunk.
translation: 这是最后一杯了，崔妮。你该死的喝多了。

original: You're full of crap, Father. If you keep bothering my customers, I'm going to throw you out. Again.
translation: 你是个大废物，神父。如果你一直打扰我的顾客，我要把你扔出去。再扔一次。

original: You're a Mirelurk humping, Wasteland reject, Armitage. You're getting a beer, and you're paying for it. And I expect a tip.
translation: 阿米蒂奇，你他妈就是个泥沼蟹，废土的垃圾。你要喝酒，你就得付钱和小费。

original: I don't serve that swill here. Beer, whiskey, even some wine, but no goddamn water.
translation: 我们这不卖馊水。我们有啤酒，威士忌，甚至还有葡萄酒，但是就没有该死的水。

original: Not much call for wine. Real men drink beer or whiskey.
translation: 没什么人点葡萄酒。真正的男人喝啤酒和威士忌。

original: Potent. It'll burn all the way down.
translation: 够劲。就和火烧一样。

original: One glass of rotgut, coming up.
translation: 一杯粗酒，立刻送上。

original: Armitage.
translation: 阿米蒂奇。

original: Your stuff is too expensive. I'm saving up for something special though.
translation: 你的货物太贵了。我还想要省下钱来买点其他的东西。

original: Nope. Leastwise none that you need to worry about.
translation: 不。至少没什么需要你担心的。

original: Not today. I've got enough for a while.
translation: 今天不行。我喝够了。

original: I'm hoping to have the caps for a new one next month.
translation: 希望下月我能存够瓶盖再买一瓶。

original: Tammy, you're always drunk in the Rudder. Now go bother someone else.
translation: 塔米，你总在酒吧买醉。去干点别的吧。

original: Yeah, my life is real glamorous. You just keep believing that, kid.
translation: 嗯，我的生活很美好。你要相信我，孩子。

original: He won't know what hit him.
translation: 他不会知道是什么打中了他的。

original: You're too young. And right now, you're too drunk. Sober up and we'll see if you still want to have this conversation.
translation: 你太年轻。现在，你喝得太多了。清醒点，我们看看你还能否继续说话。

original: Actually, Father, I'm a real asshole. Now get out of my face before I toss you in with the Mirelurks.
translation: 事实上，神父，我是个真正的混蛋。乘着我把你喂给泥沼蟹之前从我眼前消失。

original: Careful, Sister. Bigger isn't always badder.
translation: 小心点，“修女”。大个子不全是坏人。

original: Mirelurk Cakes with a beer.
translation: 泥沼蟹饼加啤酒。

original: Better than last time. I hate the taste of Mirelurk.
translation: 比上次好点。我讨厌泥沼蟹的味道。

original: Not now, dear. You'll spoil your meal.
translation: 现在不行，亲爱的。你会糟蹋了这餐。

original: Shhh! It's not polite to ask that here. Now eat your food. Daddy paid good money for it.
translation: 嘘！在这问那个不合适。吃你的吧。爸爸可花了一番功夫。

original: Shhh! It's not polite to ask that here. Now eat your food. I paid good money for it.
translation: 嘘！在这问那个不合适。吃你的吧。我可花了一番功夫。

original: Shhh! Don't say things like that in church. Now be quiet and listen to Father Clifford.
translation: 嘘！别在教堂说这个。现在安静听克利福德神父布道。

original: They are well, Father. C.J. is growing up so fast. I am so proud of her.
translation: 他们很健康，神父。长江长得这么快。我为她自豪。

original: As well as can be expected, Father. I'm still recovering from CJ's death.
translation: 如你希望的那样，神父。我正从长江去世的伤痛中恢复过来。

original: Father Clifford looks pleased.
translation: 克利福德神父看起来很高兴。

original: You go if you want. There's too many of the wrong sort up there at this time of night.
translation: 你想走就走。不过晚上外面可是危机四伏。

original: If you people would take better care of your own spaces, it wouldn't be a problem.
translation: 如果人们都能各顾各的，那就没有麻烦了。

original: I'll have a Mirelurk cake and some water.
translation: 我要泥沼蟹饼和水。

original: I've got nothing like that here. Why don't you go have a drink in the Muddy Rudder? That should do it.
translation: 我没有这种东西，你怎么不到“泥舵”酒吧喝两杯？那才对你的胃口。

original: I like sitting next you. I...nevermind.
translation: 我想坐你旁边。我……没事。

original: Paulie stole the key. I'll need you to stop by and change the lock for me.
translation: 保利偷了钥匙。我需要你来帮我换锁。

original: Water and a Mirelurk cake, please.
translation: 请给我水和泥沼蟹饼。

original: I don't think you need a love potion, dear. Besides, none of these will do that. If they did, Paulie would...never mind.
translation: 我想你不需要春药，亲爱的。话说回来，我这里也没有。如果我有的话，保利早就……算了。

original: I don't think you need a love potion, dear. Besides, none of these will do that.
translation: 我想你不需要春药，亲爱的。话说回来，我这里也没有。

original: Yeah, right. As soon as I'm gone, you'll use all the inventory, Paulie. How about I just close up tonight.
translation: 嗯，对。我一走，你就能用所有的物品了，保利。我今晚把它关了如何。

original: Anything I might give you would come with a side effect. Why don't you go to Doctor Preston?
translation: 我能给你的药都有副作用。你为什么不去找普雷斯顿医生看看？

original: Anything I might give you would come with a side effect. It's too bad Doctor Preston isn't with us anymore.
translation: 我能给你的药都有副作用。普雷斯顿医生离我们而去真是太糟了。

original: I really miss him. I didn't think it would hurt this much.
translation: 我真想他。我没想到伤害这么大。

original: James isn't so bad, Chief. He's my friend. I'll make sure he's good.
translation: 詹姆斯不坏，长官。他是我朋友。我保证他没什么。

original: Thank you, Father. I tried, but his mother said no. Sorry.
translation: 谢谢，神父。我试过，但是他妈妈说不可以。对不起。

original: That doesn't sound like any fun. Let's just play hide and seek.
translation: 那听起来很无聊。让我们玩捉迷藏吧。

original: Not yet, Dad. In a minute.
translation: 还没，爸爸。一会就好。

original: Okay, Mom.
translation: 好的，妈妈。

original: Sorry, Mom.
translation: 对不起，妈妈。

original: Aw, Mom, do I have to?
translation: 哦，妈妈，我必须这样做吗？

original: I am...I mean, thank you, Mr. Holmes.
translation: 我是……我意思是，谢谢你，福尔摩斯先生。

original: Hello, Mrs. Cantelli.
translation: 你好，坎特利夫人。

original: Sorry. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers.
translation: 对不起。我不想和陌生人谈话。

original: Just some mutfruit and a Nuka-Cola please.
translation: 请给我来瓶核子可乐和一些变异果。

original: Just keeping the deck safe for all you Upper Deck types.
translation: 只不过是在保证上层甲板人员的安全。

original: Paulie, you're wasted. Just do me a favor and don't fall off the deck.
translation: 保利，你很虚弱。帮我个忙，别掉到甲板下去。

original: I suppose that's true. Doesn't mean I have to like it though.
translation: 我猜那是真的。但并不意味着我喜欢它。

original: I'll send someone down to change the locks.
translation: 我会派人下去换锁。

original: Bitch.
translation: 婊子。

original: Everything is quiet, sir.
translation: 平安无事，长官。

original: All quiet, Commander.
translation: 一切正常，指挥官。

original: Dude, that would be such a drag. Last resort, man. Last resort.
translation: 老兄，那很无聊。最后一招，兄弟。最后一招。

original: Dude, that sounds sweet. But, uh...I'm kinda broke. Soon as I get some caps, though, I'm there with ya.
translation: 老兄，那听起来不错。但，嗯……我现在手头有些紧。等我存些钱再说。

original: Sure thing, Mei. I'll clean it up later. Right now I've got this song stuck in my head.
translation: 当然了，美。晚些时候我会打扫这里。现在我还有别的麻烦事。

original: Me? Read? That would be awesome. I've heard there's a lot of cool stuff in books.
translation: 我？读书？听起来太棒了。我听说书里有许多很酷的东西。

original: Dude, I will definitely not let that happen. I'll get right on that life thing though. Maybe after my nap.
translation: 伙计，我绝对不会让那发生。我尽量让我生活中的事恢复正常。或许睡一觉就好了。

original: No offense Father, but Saint Monica has never done anything for me. I've always had to take care of myself.
translation: 不想冒犯你，神父，但是圣莫尼卡从未帮过我。我一直靠着我自己。

original: I'm like, kinda short on caps. I'll just have a carrot, an apple, and some water.
translation: 我可能没多少瓶盖。我只要一个胡萝卜，一个苹果，再来一些水。

original: My relationship with Angela is strictly platonic, Commander. Saint Monica's blessing to you.
translation: 我和安吉拉的关系严格的说是柏拉图式的，先生。圣莫尼卡正为你祈祷。

original: God Bless you, Vera. You are too kind to us.
translation: 上帝保佑你，薇拉。你对我们太好了。

original: We're not alone, so it'll have to wait. Maybe later today.
translation: 我们不是孑然一身，所以必须等待。可能今天晚些时候。

original: That's not very polite, Angela, but thank you anyway.
translation: 那不太礼貌，安吉拉，但是不管怎样，谢谢你。

original: Lord give me strength.
translation: 上帝赐我力量。

original: Well, I, uh, that is, sure. You are incredibly sexy. Not that I've noticed. I am going a priest, and they don't...um, well, you know.
translation: 嗯，我，啊，这，好的。你性感得令人窒息。不是我没注意到。但是我要成为一位牧师，他们不让……嗯，你知道。

original: No, not yet. I'm still studying the life of Saint Monica. Hopefully someday soon.
translation: 不，还没。我仍在研究圣莫尼卡的一生。希望很快就能完成。

original: Yes, Father Clifford. I've already cleaned the sanctuary. I'll put out fresh candles too.
translation: 是的，克利福德神父。我已经打扫了庇护所。我也熄灭了所有的蜡烛。

original: Yes, Father Clifford.
translation: 是的，克利福德神父。

original: Yes, Doctor Preston. Father Clifford and I will minister to the needs of their souls. We let you minister to the needs of their bodies.
translation: 是的，普雷斯顿医生。克利福德神父和我来抚慰他们的灵魂，而你可以去照看他们的身体。

original: Yes, Doctor Preston. I will minister to the needs of their souls. You can minister to the needs of their bodies.
translation: 是的，普雷斯顿医生。克利福德神父和我来抚慰他们的灵魂，而你可以去照看他们的身体。

original: I hope I will live up to his example. See you next week Mrs. Young.
translation: 我希望我能够像他一样。下周见，杨夫人。

original: Yes, it was. <yawn> Excuse me. See you next week Vera.
translation: 是的，是的。<哈欠>抱歉，下周见，薇拉。

original: He was? I mean, I know. He tries very hard Mister Young. See you next week.
translation: 他是？我意思是，我知道。你很努力，杨先生。下周见。

original: Then I'll try the iguana.
translation: 那我尝尝蜥蜴。

original: I'll try, but he's pretty set in his ways. See you next week, Mei.
translation: 我会试试的，但是他这人很顽固。下周见，美。

original: No. Ask Mister Buckingham.
translation: 不。去问白金汉先生。

original: Not yet. Give me a few minutes, Mister Buckingham.
translation: 现在还不行。稍等片刻，白金汉先生。

original: It's about time. Sorry, Henry. I know you're doing the best you can, but these delays are frustrating.
translation: 现在是时候了。抱歉，亨利。我知道你尽了最大的努力，但是这样的耽搁还是让人沮丧。

original: Perfect. I'll be ready for them.
translation: 好极了。我会为他们准备。

original: So you say. All I see is wasted time away from my work. That's what Rivet City really needs from me.
translation: 可以这么说。我做的所有事情都是在浪费我工作以外的时间，这才是铆钉城真正需要我做的。

original: Make sure it's locked this time. We don't want them stolen again.
translation: 这次锁好了。我可不想它们再被偷。

original: Oh. So you did.
translation: 噢。所以你这么做了。

original: And it's my job to make sure you stay that way, so just let me do my job.
translation: 我的工作就是确保你留在那条道上，所以让我回到工作上去吧。

original: That's wonderful. I've read about broccoli in the old books, but I've never seen any.
translation: 太好了。我在古书上读到过球花甘蓝，但我从来没见过。

original: I suppose it can't hurt. Just try not to disturb anyone that's sleeping.
translation: 我猜这也没事。不过别打扰睡着的人。

original: I suppose. Don't go filling their heads with any of that faith healing crap though.
translation: 我想是吧，别和他们说什么信仰疗法的狗屁东西。

original: Am I that predictable? I guess so. Yes, the usual.
translation: 我能预言？我猜是吧。是的，通常是。

original: I am a man of peace, Brock. I am only here to preach the word of the Lord.
translation: 我是一个热爱和平的人，布洛克。我在这只是为了传播主的声音。

original: There is always the opportunity to help others. God still has a purpose for you in this life.
translation: 生活中你总有机会帮助其他人。在这一生中上帝始终会关注你的。

original: They need their eternal souls saved too, Doctor Preston. Have no fear, I won't occupy them for long.
translation: 他们同样也需要他们永恒的灵魂被解救，普雷斯顿医生。不用害怕，我不会占用太久。

original: Just leave. I cannot bear to look at you. You are hereby excommunicated from the church. May your soul wither in purgatory.
translation: 离开这儿吧。我不能再看你这样下去了。你已被被逐出教堂。愿你的灵魂能在磨难中得到净化。

original: I'm thinking of preaching about one of the seven deadly sins. I haven't decided which one though.
translation: 我正在考虑宣讲七宗原罪中的一宗，我还没决定讲哪个好。

original: I'm glad you thought so, Vera. Bless you.
translation: 我很高兴你这么想，薇拉。保佑你。

original: Thank you, Henry. And God bless you.
translation: 谢谢，亨利。上帝保佑你。

original: Thank you, Angela.
translation: 谢谢，安吉拉。

original: I pray that the whole congregation feels the same way, Christie.
translation: 我祈祷统一作风，克里斯蒂。

original: Nice of you to say so, Mei.
translation: 你这么说很好，美。

original: I can see that liquor has affected your temper. Good day, sir.
translation: 我能看出来酒精干扰了你的情绪。日安，先生。

original: No, no. Just call me Father, not Mister. Sometimes I think Vera programmed you that way just to annoy me. I'll just have water.
translation: 不，不。叫我神父，别叫先生。有时候我想薇拉给你这么编程就是为了让你来烦我。我要点水就好。

original: Can't complain. I've got some new stuff in. You should come by and take a look.
translation: 别抱怨。我进了些新货。你应该过来看看。

original: Bring them by anytime.
translation: 无论何时拿来都行。

original: Nah. Just break it down for parts.
translation: 算了。把它拆成零件吧。

original: Ammo's moving, but not the guns. They just don't break down like they used to.
translation: 即便弹药都打完了，枪的质量还会是一样的棒。现在的枪没有以前的那样容易损耗了。

original: Really? I heard it was tough and too salty. I think I'll have Mirelurk Cakes instead.
translation: 真的吗？我听说它又硬又咸。我还是来点泥沼蟹饼算了。

original: I'm thinking about firing off a couple.
translation: 我正想开上几枪。

original: Get me a beer.
translation: 来瓶啤酒。

original: I got a little of everything. Go ahead and pick out what you want.
translation: 我这基本什么东西都有。过来挑挑你想要的。

original: Don't worry. I'll keep it under control tonight.
translation: 别担心。今晚我不会发酒疯的。

original: Okay, just this once. Belle, another beer for Trinnie.
translation: 好的，就这一次。贝勒，给崔妮再来瓶啤酒。

original: It's a mighty sweet temptation, Father. Now leave me the fuck alone.
translation: 那是非常甜蜜的诱惑，神父。现在他妈的让我独自待会。

original: Mirelurk Cakes, and a beer.
translation: 泥沼蟹饼，一瓶啤酒。

original: Thanks for the advice.
translation: 谢谢你的建议。

original: I don't see her much these days. I'd much rather she spend her time with Diego than with someone like that Ted Strayer.
translation: 这些天我没怎么看到她。我宁愿她和迭戈打发时间，也不愿她和泰德·斯崔尔这样的人混在一起。

original: No tabs. Nobody gets a tab. I'll get you your usual, and you'll pay me, as usual.
translation: 这里不赊账，没有例外。我给你你平常喝的，你也要像平常一样付钱。

original: My pleasure, Tammy. I think I have some Iguana Bits for James.
translation: 我很荣幸，塔米。我想我有些蜥蜴肉丁给詹姆斯。

original: Right away, Tammy.
translation: 立刻，塔米。

original: Coming up, Flak.
translation: 马上就来，“高炮”弗莱克。

original: An excellent choice, Seagrave.
translation: 不错的选择，西格雷夫。

original: That wasn't burnt, Shrapnel. It was blackened. It's a gourmet method I read about. I'll make it tartar this time.
translation: “榴弹”小帅，那不是用烧的。是用熏的，这种烹饪方法是从美食家那学来的，这次我会做的很美味的。

original: I made them just yesterday.
translation: 我昨天做好的。

original: With pleasure Mrs. Cantelli.
translation: 很荣幸，坎特利夫人。

original: Sure. Since your parents aren't around to tell you no, you get to make your own choices.
translation: 好的。既然你父母没有告诉你不行，那你自己做决定吧。

original: So long as it's okay with your parents, C.J.
translation: 只要和你父母在一起就没事，长江。

original: Okay. I'll go lower the bucket.
translation: 好的。把酒喝光。

original: No. It's the same as yesterday. And last week. And the week before. Let me know if you want to order.
translation: 不。和昨天的一样。和上周的，上上周的都一样。告诉我，你想不想要。

original: Yes, Doctor Li.
translation: 是，李博士。

original: Certainly, Janice.
translation: 当然，贾尼斯。

original: I'm not a very religious man, Diego. Sorry.
translation: 我不是一个信教的人，迭戈。抱歉。

original: Sorry Henry. I'll remove them before the end of the day.
translation: 抱歉，亨利。今天我要搬走它们。

original: No. I don't do chems. I'm this way from hard work and sweat, two things I'm sure you don't know. Now, if you don't mind, I'd like to eat. Alone.
translation: 不，我没有嗑药。我现在满头大汗是因为我的工作，我想你不知道这个。现在，你要是不介意的话，我想独自吃饭。

original: Just fine. Lots of people are asking me about it.
translation: 很好，很多人问过我。

original: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。

original: Good thing too. I don't feel like busting heads tonight.
translation: 也是好东西。今晚我还不想打破头。

original: First thing tomorrow, Commander Danvers.
translation: 明天的第一要务，丹佛斯指挥官。

original: Ted, you're wasting your life. You need to find a purpose, or at least find a job. By the way, Christie Young could use some help.
translation: 泰德，你在浪费生命。你需要找到人生的意义，至少找个工作。顺便说下，克里斯蒂·杨能需要人帮忙。

original: Ted, you're wasting your life. You need to find a purpose, or at least find a job.
translation: 泰德，你在浪费生命。你需要找到人生的意义，至少找个工作。

original: Thank you, Diego. Speaking of rounds, I need to get back to them.
translation: 谢谢，迭戈。聊了很多，我要回去了。

original: You're wasted, Paulie. If you're going to stay on the flight deck, try to stay away from the railing.
translation: 你快成废人了，保利。要是你想待在飞行甲板上，离栏杆远点。

original: I'm sure the boys will use them for target practice. You might want to stay below deck.
translation: 我确定这些男孩会把它们当作目标。你可能会想要待在甲板下面。

original: Yes, Doctor Li. I've recalibrated with them.
translation: 是的，李博士。我和他们重新校对下。

original: I'll make that your bedtime story. Now run along, sweetie.
translation: 你在给孩子讲故事。走吧，甜心。

original: Not yet, sweetheart. Finish you meal first.
translation: 还没，甜心。先吃完饭吧。

original: Church will be over soon. Just try and sit still.
translation: 教堂就要关门了。就安静地坐会吧。

original: Don't make a fuss over it. Their just kids. Besides, maybe C.J. will rub off on James and not the other way around.
translation: 别大惊小怪。他们不过是孩子。还有长江没准会让詹姆斯改好，她不会变坏的。

original: Amen. We have each other, and we have C.J.
translation: 阿门。我们拥有彼此，我们拥有长江。

original: The transformer is still touch and go. Doctor Li hopes her most recent tests will  be good.
translation: 变压器仍然处于待命状态。李博士希望她最近的测试结果能使人满意。

original: Thank you, Father. I pray every night for her success.
translation: 谢谢，神父。我每晚都为她的成功祈祷。

original: I'll check it out before the end of the day.
translation: 今天内我会检修完。

original: Not right now. Check back with me later.
translation: 现在不行。迟点再找我核对。

original: Take your sarcasm somewhere else, Cindy. It's not my fault you married an addict and I have a family.
translation: 到别处抱怨去，辛迪。你嫁了个瘾君子不是我的错，而且我是有家的人。

original: Have you no sense of decency? I just want something to dull the memory. I can't believe she's dead.
translation: 你不懂礼貌吗？我正想慢慢平复我的情绪。我不敢相信她死了。

original: Good idea, Seagrave. I'll be by later.
translation: 好主意，西格雷夫。我等会就回来。

original: I'll have Iguana on a Stick. C.J. will have some Mutfruit and a Nuka-Cola.
translation: 我要棒棒蜥蜴。长江要变异果和核子可乐。

original: I'll have Iguana on a Stick.
translation: 我要棒棒蜥蜴。

original: Fu...I mean, yes sir, Chief Harkness.
translation: 操……我是说，是的，哈克尼斯长官。

original: Yes, mom.
translation: 是的，妈妈。

original: I wasn't doing anything! And C.J. is my friend. I hate you! I hope you die!
translation: 我什么都没做！长江是我的朋友。我恨你！我希望你去死！

original: I'm not a squirt! My name is James, and you're an asshole. My mom said you're good for nothing, and she oughta know.
translation: 我不是小子！我名字是詹姆斯，你是个混蛋。我妈妈说你一无是处，我想她说的一点也没错。

original: I want an Iguana on a Stick, but my mom won't let me have one.
translation: 我要棒棒蜥蜴，但我妈妈不让我要。

original: Just give me some Iguana Bits.
translation: 给我个蜥蜴肉丁。

original: They should be just fine. Try it again.
translation: 应该不错。再试试吧。

original: I've got a new strain of lima bean I'm developing. I'll bring a sample sometime.
translation: 我开发一种新的青豆。什么时候我拿个样品来。

original: That sounds like a good idea. I'll ask Doctor Li which papers I can let you have. I'll get back to you later.
translation: 听起来不错。我问问李博士给你拿哪张。我迟点回来。

original: They're fine. However, I have two others that are making odd noises. Please check them out soon.
translation: 状况良好。但是，其他地方发出奇怪的噪声。请快点检查下。

original: Thank you, Garza.
translation: 谢谢你，加尔萨。

original: No, I'm fine Mister Buckingham.
translation: 不，我很好，白金汉先生。

original: Thank you, Chief. I'm terrified that he will recognize me. I hope he leaves soon.
translation: 谢谢，长官。我担心他认出我。我想他快点离开。

original: Yes, I am Chief. Now I can sleep at night without wondering if he'll take me while I'm sleeping.
translation: 是，长官。现在我可以安心睡觉，不用再担心我睡觉的时候他来把我带走。

original: Look, I keep telling you. I'm not into that. Psycho rots your brain. Just leave me alone.
translation: 听着，我跟你说过，我是不会吸食疯狂药的。疯狂药把你的大脑腐蚀了，麻烦你让我一个人待着。

original: Yes. Every night on the flight deck. Paulie, those chems are trashing your memory. Now let me eat in peace.
translation: 是的。每晚在飞行甲板上待着。保利，这些药把你弄糊涂了。现在让我安静的吃饭吧。

original: My story is my business. I just want to be left alone.
translation: 我的事就是我个人的事。我想自己待着。

original: Yeah, yeah. You've been telling me this for months. Besides, once you're gone, you won't be around to miss anything.
translation: 嗯，嗯。这事你说了好几个月了。此外，一旦你走了，你不会留恋任何事的。

original: Could I have some Iguana Bits and a Nuka-Cola, please?
translation: 给我些蜥蜴肉丁和核子可乐可以吗？

original: Thank you, Father. Attending church always makes me feel stronger.
translation: 谢谢，神父。拜访教堂一直使我感觉更强大。

original: I am trying Father. I just don't see how Saint Monica can stop a bullet or break a set of manacles. But, I will try.
translation: 我试试，神父。我不知道圣莫尼卡是如何挡住颗子弹或是打破手铐的。但是，我可以试试。

original: That would be nice, Mister Buckingham.
translation: 这很好，白金汉先生。

original: Yes, Mister Washington.
translation: 是的，华盛顿先生。

original: Yes, sir.
translation: 是的，长官。

original: Your food will be ready shortly, Mister Zimmer.
translation: 你要的立刻好，齐默先生。

original: Certainly, Sir.
translation: 当然，先生。

original: Very good, sir.
translation: 好的，老爷。

original: Yes, ma'am.
translation: 是的，女士。

original: I'd like two carrots and some water.
translation: 我要两个胡萝卜和水。

original: Life is hell. My life is hell. I just wish I had the courage to do something about it. Why don't you just leave me alone.
translation: 生活是地狱。我的生活是地狱。我真希望我有勇气做些什么。让我一个人待着吧。

original: Thank you, but no. I talk to Father Clifford, but it doesn't seem to help me.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。我跟克利福德神父谈过，但是这似乎帮不了我。

original: I'm not sure it will help, but I will pray with you, Father.
translation: 我不知道这能不能帮到我，但我会和你一起祈祷，神父。

original: That might be best. Would you please ask Father Clifford if I might have a few moments of his time?
translation: 那最好了。你能问下克利福德神父我是否能和他谈一会？

original: I know, I know. Tonight's my last night. Honest.
translation: 我知道，我知道。坦率地说，今晚是我的最后一晚。

original: Whoa. No such thing as too much. In fact, I'm going to do some more.
translation: 哇。没什么。没什么过分的。事实上，我得再多做些。

original: Water and Iguana Bits.
translation: 水和蜥蜴肉丁。

original: Don't worry about me. Uh, huh. I can take care of myself.
translation: 别担心我。哦，呃。我能照顾好我自己。

original: Sir! Yes, Sir!
translation: 长官！遵命，长官！

original: Ha, ha! Nothing you'd be interested in. Only good stuff.
translation: 哈，哈！除了好东西外，你什么都不感兴趣。

original: If you ever change your mind, Vera. I'll be here, waiting.
translation: 薇拉，如果你改变主意了。我在这等你。

original: A man can hope, Danvers. Besides, I don't have a problem with the Upper Deck like you do.
translation: 男人是可以期望的，丹佛斯。另外，对你在上层甲板上做的那些事，我没有意见。

original: Noodles and beer. A match made in heaven, eh?
translation: 面条加啤酒。天造地设般的搭配，不是吗？

original: Not today, Angela. Maybe next week.
translation: 今天不行，安吉拉。下周吧。

original: I learned my lesson, Danvers. Just keep those damn Raiders away from me.
translation: 我受过教训了，丹佛斯。让我离那些该死的歹徒远点。

original: Sure thing. I'll bring them by later for you.
translation: 没问题。我迟点给你拿来。

original: It's fine. You worry too much.
translation: 很好。你担心的太多了。

original: You need a new joke, Cindy. I've only heard that one about a million times.
translation: 你需要讲点新的笑话，辛迪。这个我听过好几百万次了。

original: Whiskey, straight.
translation: 威士忌，快点。

original: It's doing well enough for me to come down here and buy drinks.
translation: 坐下来买杯酒，对我来说已经算享受了。

original: Nah. You gotta buy at least one box.
translation: 不。你至少得买一盒。

original: We only had one night together, Trinnie. Go get your own drinks.
translation: 我们只不过有一个晚上的回忆，崔妮。自己买酒去吧。

original: Give me a Brahmin steak, potato, and a beer.
translation: 给我双头牛肉排，土豆，还有啤酒。

original: Hells bells, girl. I ain't no mister. Just call me Shrapnel. Yeah, I got some 10mm rounds. I'll bring them over to him later.
translation: 该死的，女孩。别叫我先生，叫我“榴弹”小帅就行了。嗯，我这有10mm弹药。晚些时候我会带给他。

original: Sure, I'll take a drink. Flak and I don't talk about our past. Everyone knows we weren't born on Rivet City though.
translation: 好的，我要点喝的。“高炮”弗莱克和我从来不谈我俩的过去。不过每个人都知道我俩不是出生在铆钉城。

original: Armitage.
translation: 阿米蒂奇。

original: I won't be causing any more trouble, Commander...Bitch.
translation: 我不想惹麻烦，长官……婊子。

original: Beer. And don't let it get empty.
translation: 我要啤酒，空了就给我满上。

original: I'm here to drink, not to fight.
translation: 我是来喝酒的，不是来打架的。

original: Not happening, Trinnie. I already paid that debt. Go find someone else to hit up.
translation: 不可能，崔妮。我已经还了那笔债。找别人去吧。

original: Hey, I've got my own problems. I don't have time to be on the lookout for yours.
translation: 嘿，我有自己的事，我可没时间管你。

original: Yeah, it's just fine. Unless of course you want to warm my bed for me? Nah? Then stop botherin' me.
translation: 嗨，算了。除非你想帮我暖暖床？不？那就别烦我。

original: Step away from my beer, Father, or I'll be raising my fist.
translation: 离我的啤酒远点，神父，否则我会抬起我的拳头。

original: Don't call me Mister, you goddamn bucket of bolts! Just bring me an iguana on stick.
translation: 别叫我先生，你这该死的杂种！给我拿串烤蜥蜴。

original: Fucking junk heap. I should start eating at Gary's.
translation: 他妈的垃圾。我要去加里厨房吃饭了。

original: To hell with that brat. And to hell with you, Harkness. I'll drink as much as I want.
translation: 让那小捣蛋见鬼去，哈克尼斯，你也见鬼去吧。我想喝多少就喝多少。

original: Shut your trap. You'll eat what I give you and be grateful for it, or I'll give you something to be really sorry for.
translation: 闭上你的嘴。我给你什么你就吃什么，别忘了感谢我，否则我会给你点颜色看看。

original: Do I look like I give a crap? Now get away from me. I don't want you filling James' head with your dopehead ideas.
translation: 我看起来喜欢听这些废话吗？离我远点。我不想詹姆斯听你这吸毒者的主意。

original: Do I look like I give a crap? Now get away from me.
translation: 我看起来喜欢听这些废话吗？离我远点。

original: Other than you? No.
translation: 其他人？没有。

original: Whiskey and water. Go light on the water.
translation: 威士忌和水。少点水。

original: James? Who knows where that little shit has run off to. Mind your own business, Brock. I'm going to get a drink.
translation: 詹姆斯？谁知道这小崽子跑哪去了。管好你自己的事，布洛克。给我来点喝的就好。

original: Mole rat, well done, with wine. Leave the bottle. James has been bad. He gets a carrot and some water.
translation: 地鼠下酒，好的。留下瓶子。詹姆斯不太舒服。给他点胡萝卜和水。

original: Mole rat, well done, with wine. Leave the bottle.
translation: 地鼠下酒，好的。留下瓶子。

original: Sure thing, Chief. Next time I'll take him into the back to fuck him instead. Sheesh!
translation: 好的，长官。下次我要把他带到后面干死。操！

original: Fuck you, bitch. Oh, wait. Nobody wants to because you're too fugly!
translation: 他妈的，婊子。哦，等等。没人要你是因为你太脏了！

original: I'll say when I've had enough. You aren't my mother, Belle, so fuck off.
translation: 我喝够了会说的。你又不是我妈，贝勒，滚一边去。

original: Not yet. I'm still able to remember. Leave me alone, Brock. You aren't my father. Thank God, too.
translation: 还没。我还清醒呢。让我自己待着，布洛克。你又不是我爸。真感谢上帝。

original: I'm not that desperate.
translation: 我不是亡命徒。

original: You're wrong. I haven't had enough to drink. In fact, I think I'll order another one right now.
translation: 你错了。我还没喝够。事实上，我现在还想要一杯。

original: Huh? I don't get it. Nevermind. Just buy me another drink.
translation: 呃？我没明白。没关系。再来一杯。

original: I prefer beer to whiskey, Father. And unless you want to buy me the next round, get lost.
translation: 比起啤酒来我更喜欢喝威士忌，神父。除非你想帮我再买一轮。

original: Thank you, Chief Harkness.
translation: 谢谢，哈克尼斯长官。

original: Mister Buckingham can handle the Weatherly for a couple of hours.
translation: 白金汉先生能应付韦瑟利数小时。

original: A girl has to be able to protect herself, even if that means buying a gun.
translation: 女孩必须自己保护自己，就算要买枪也行。

original: I guess I'll just be window shopping then.
translation: 我猜迟点我能逛街了。

original: I know, I know. He's nice enough, but just not my type. Take care, and don't spread too much gossip.
translation: 我知道，我知道。他的确是不错，但不是我要的类型。小心，别管得太多了。

original: I just stopped by to say hello. And to see if you have anything new for sale.
translation: 我刚打算打招呼。来看看你有什么新货卖。

original: You go do what you have to. I don't want to watch that.
translation: 你想做什么做什么，眼不见，心不烦。

original: You need to stop giving me special discounts, Seagrave. A new toaster oven would sure be handy though. I'll pick it up later.
translation: 西格雷夫，尽管一个新的烤箱并不难弄，但别再压价了，我迟点会带来的。

original: Thank you, Father. I've been trying to get Seagrave to come to church too, but he's stubborn.
translation: 谢谢，神父。我试过让西格雷夫也来教堂，但是他很倔强。

original: Thank you, Father. I always feel the presence of the Lord when I pray here.
translation: 谢谢，神父。当我祈祷的时候一直感觉到上帝的存在。

original: No. He's never going to notice you, Cindy. Especially if you're still with Paulie. Just forget about Bannon.
translation: 不。辛迪，他从来没注意过你，特别是你现在还和保利在一起。忘了班侬吧。

original: Stop! You're embarrassing me, but thank you. I should go. I want to see Cindy and Angela too.
translation: 别说了！尽管你让我难堪，但我还是要是谢谢你。我要走了。我也要看看辛迪和安吉拉。

original: Stop! You're embarrassing me, but thank you. I should go.
translation: 别说了！尽管你让我难堪，但我还是要是谢谢你。

original: I've told you before. I don't feel that way about you. I'm sorry.
translation: 我以前告诉过他。我明白你的意思。抱歉。

original: I'll see what I can find, Mister Armitage.
translation: 我要看看能找到些什么，阿米蒂奇先生。

original: Certainly, Mister Zimmer.
translation: 当然，齐默先生。

original: Oh, he notices all right. You should forget about him. Priests are married to God and take vows of celibacy.
translation: 哦，他注意到了。你应该忘记他。牧师把自己献给了上帝，而且永守这誓言。

original: No, not right now. Carry on Mister Buckingham.
translation: 不，现在不行。继续，白金汉先生。

original: <sigh> Sometimes I hate working with robots.
translation: <叹息>有时我讨厌和机器人一起工作。

original: Yes, of course. I'll watch my alcohol intake.
translation: 是的，当然。我会尽量不喝醉。

original: Good. Stay alert. He could be anywhere.
translation: 好。保持警惕。他可能在任何地方出现。

original: Relax. I'm sure there is no danger here.
translation: 放松。我相信这地方没危险。

original: Not yet, Chief Harkness.
translation: 还没，哈克尼斯长官。

original: I could really care less about you and your brat, Madam.
translation: 我真的应该少点关心你和你的小捣蛋，女士。

original: Your food is very nourshing, Vera.
translation: 你这的食物都很有营养，薇拉。

original: A glass of wine, if you please.
translation: 可以的话，请来杯葡萄酒。

original: Yes. Iguana Bits, water, and a piece of fruit. Anything will do.
translation: 是的。蜥蜴肉丁，水，一块水果。什么都行。

original: I'm on patrol, punk. Try and stay out of my way.
translation: 我在巡逻，小子。别挡路。

original: I suppose you're right. Being back here after all this time, I can't help but be a little concerned.
translation: 我猜你是对的。你终于回来了，我没帮上忙，只能聊表关心。

original: I'm already taking care of that. I'll let you know if there are any abnormal results.
translation: 我已经注意到了。如果有什么异常结果，我会告知你。

original: Doctor Li asked me to keep an eye on the power relays in level 3, but I'll take care of that for you.
translation: 李博士让我留意三层的动力继电器，但我要帮你留意这。

original: Yes sir. I'll attend to that in just a moment.
translation: 是的，长官。稍后我会留意的。

original: It's fine, Madison. Everything is taken care of. There's no reason to be nervous.
translation: 很好，麦迪逊。都在掌握中，不必紧张。

original: We haven't forgotten anything. We're on top of the situation. Come on, we're professionals!
translation: 我们什么都没有忘。我状态良好。来吧，我们是专家！

original: Make sure to stay in contact with Daniel and Alex. I'm waiting for a report from them.
translation: 确保和丹尼尔与亚历克斯的联系。我正等待他们报告。

original: When you have a moment, can you check the pressure on tanks 3 and 4? I'm concerned there may be a leak.
translation: 如果你有空，能不能检查下3号和4号罐的压力？我担心那有泄漏。

original: Did we forget to compensate for the power fluctuations in our last calculation? I'd hate to see us short something out now.
translation: 我们上次计算是不是忘了需要补偿的能量波动？我痛恨我们总是丢三落四。

original: I'm concerned that we're overlooking something, James. I don't want us to be too hasty.
translation: 我现在关心的是我们期待已久的东西，詹姆斯。我不希望我们太过草率。

original: Yes, Doctor?
translation: 博士，什么事？

original: Nothing's wrong, Dad.
translation: 没毛病，爸爸。

original: Okay, then. You're doing fine. Just aim and shoot. I think you'll be a natural.
translation: 那好吧。那就瞄准射击吧。我想你有天赋。

original: I'm out of BBs.
translation: 我没有BB弹了。

original: Out already? Something wrong with the sights on that thing? Here you go, honey.
translation: 已经用完了吗？瞄准器有问题吗？甜心，拿好。

original: Out already? Something wrong with the sights on that thing? Here you go, son.
translation: 已经用完了吗？瞄准器有问题吗？小子，拿好。

original: I can't do it!
translation: 我做不到！

original: Of course you can. I'm not always going to be here to take care of you. You're going to have to learn to fend for yourself.
translation: 当然你可以，这太好了。我不会一直待在这里照顾你。你要学着保护自己。

original: Now, take your time, breathe slowly, sight down the barrel, and squeeze the trigger.
translation: 现在，别着急，放慢呼吸，注视目标，扣动扳机。

original: I can do it!
translation: 我能做到！

original: I know you can, and that's good. I'm not always going to be here to take care of you. You've got to learn to fend for yourself.
translation: 当然你可以，这太好了。我不会一直待在这里照顾你。你要学着保护自己。

original: Now, take your time, breathe slowly, sight down the barrel, and squeeze the trigger.
translation: 现在，别着急，放慢呼吸，注视目标，扣动扳机。

original: How do I kill it?
translation: 我怎么杀它？

original: I'd try using that new gun of yours!
translation: 不如试试你的新枪！

original: They're pretty easy to kill. More a nuisance than anything else.
translation: 它们太容易杀死了。就是很讨厌。

original: Of course, you could just aim for the head. A good headshot will do a lot of damage to most anything.
translation: 当然，你可以瞄准头。爆头比射击别的部位能造成更多的伤害。

original: What's a Radroach?
translation: 辐射蟑螂是什么？

original: Nasty little things. They pretty much keep to dark places, though. That's why there are always lights on in the Vault.
translation: 恶心的小东西，总是躲在暗处。这就是为什么在避难所里灯总是亮着。

original: Thanks, Dad.
translation: 谢谢，爸爸。

original: You're welcome, pal. Happy birthday.
translation: 应该做的。生日快乐，小子。

original: You're welcome, sweetie. Happy birthday.
translation: 应该做的。生日快乐，甜心。

original: This is so great! Thanks!
translation: 太好了！谢谢！

original: Couldn't have done it without Jonas' help. You make sure to thank him.
translation: 要是没有乔纳斯的帮助不可能完成的，去谢谢他。
