original: What do I get to kill?
translation: 你让我杀什么？

original: Easy now. It's only a BB gun, but it's not a toy. Let's go try it out. Jonas and I have found a nice spot for you. Follow me.
translation: 放松。这只是BB枪，但它可不是玩具。让我们去试试。乔纳斯和我帮你找到个不错的目标。跟我来。

original: Here? We can't shoot a gun here.
translation: 在这？在这我不能开枪。

original: We sure can't, unless we want the Overseer beating down our door. Jonas and I have found a place, though. C'mon!
translation: 当然不行，除非我们想让监督者破门而入。但是乔纳斯和我找到个地方。来！

original: I don't like surprises.
translation: 我不喜欢惊喜。

original: Since when? Regardless, I think you'll like this one. You're getting older, and you've got your Pip-Boy. I figure you're old enough for this, too.
translation: 什么时候开始的？不管怎样，我想你会喜欢这个。你够大了，你也有了你的哔哔小子。我认为你也到了用它的年纪。

original: Your own BB gun! It's a little old, but it should work perfectly.
translation: 你有BB枪了！尽管有点旧，不过应该很好用。

original: Jonas found it down here. It was in pretty rough shape -- took us a good three months to find the parts to get it working again.
translation: 乔纳斯在这下面找到它。它锈得不行 — 我们用了整整三个月来找零件修好它。

original: You know how tough it is to find a spring that small? Good thing Butch "misplaced" that switchblade of his. Ha ha ha!
translation: 你知道找到个这么小的弹簧有多难？还好布奇把他的弹簧刀“放错了”地方。哈哈哈！

original: So, what do you think? Want to give it a try?
translation: 怎么样？想试试吗？

original: What kind of surprise?
translation: 什么惊喜？

original: The Overseer gave you your Pip-Boy, and you're old enough to do some work. So I figure you’re old enough for this.
translation: 监督者给你一个哔哔小子，你也够大了，可以做些工作了。因此，我觉得这件事你也够年龄了。

original: Your own BB gun! It's a little old, but it should work perfectly.
translation: 你有BB枪了！尽管有点旧，不过应该很好用。

original: Jonas found it down here. It was in pretty rough shape -- took us a good three months to find the parts to get it working again.
translation: 乔纳斯在这下面找到它。它锈得不行 — 我们用了整整三个月来找零件修好它。

original: You know how tough it is to find a spring that small? Good thing Butch "misplaced" that switchblade of his. Ha ha ha!
translation: 你知道找到个这么小的弹簧有多难？还好布奇把他的弹簧刀“放错了”地方。哈哈哈！

original: So, what do you think? Want to give it a try?
translation: 怎么样？想试试吗？

original: Stop that! You're so stupid. My Mom says you're ugly and a bitch too.
translation: 住手！你真愚蠢。我妈妈也说你很丑，还是个婊子。

original: I don't know, what do you want to do?
translation: 我不知道，你想干嘛？

original: Don't worry, Diego. I'll take care of you. I even found a room below decks for us. Our love will sustain us.
translation: 别担心，迭戈。我会照顾你的。我甚至在下层甲板找了个房间。我们的爱情会成为我们的精神支柱。

original: Of course I'm excited. Diego is a wreck though. My dad might have to help him up the aisle instead of me.
translation: 当然我很兴奋。尽管迭戈有点崩溃，但我爸爸会帮他度过难关的。

original: Diego insisted. He may not be a priest any more, but he still has his faith.
translation: 迭戈很坚持。他或许不再是牧师了，但仍然保持着信仰。

original: Oh, Dad! Stop that or you'll have me crying. You can visit Diego and me any time. And I'll still be working with you.
translation: 哦，爸爸！再这样你会把我搞哭的。你可以在任何时候来看我和迭戈。我也仍然和你一起工作。

original: Thank you Mister Holmes. We'll need lots of things for our new home, so I'm sure we'll be shopping here.
translation: 谢谢，福尔摩斯先生。我们的新家需要很多东西，所以我们肯定会来采购的。

original: It took him long enough to get the hint. I had to practically write it out for him. Men!
translation: 他花了很久才明白那些暗示。我实际上被迫有话直说。男人！

original: Yes, I got the invitation. I wouldn't miss you and Diego's wedding for anything.
translation: 是的，我收到邀请了。我绝对不会错过你和迭戈的婚礼。

original: Why are you so mean sometimes? I'm always nice to you.
translation: 为什么有时候你这么刻薄？我一直对你很好。

original: This week doesn't look good either, Father.
translation: 这周看来也不好，神父。

original: God and Saint Monica hear my sermons. That's good enough for me.
translation: 上帝和圣莫尼卡听到我的布道。这对我就足够了。

original: Sorry. I just don't have enough money, Angela. I really wish I could.
translation: 对不起。我没有足够的钱 安吉拉。我真的希望我有。

original: Thank you. No, they don't have a date for the wedding yet, but it will be soon.
translation: 谢谢。不，他们还没定婚礼的日期，不过也不久了。

original: I am. Diego is a good boy. They will make a happy couple.
translation: 是，迭戈是个好男孩。他们会成为幸福的一对。

original: My little girl is all grown up. I hope I don't cry at the wedding.
translation: 我的小女孩已经长大了。我希望我在婚礼上别哭。

original: Thank you, Diego. You'll make a fine priest some day.
translation: 谢谢，迭戈。有一天你会成为一名好牧师的。

original: She's not a bitch, you are! I hate you! You're ruining my life.
translation: 她不是婊子，你才是！我恨你！你毁了我的生活。

original: <Disable Cerberus' combat inhibitor.>
translation: <解除地狱犬的战斗抑制器>

original: Whoa Nelly! Sensing combat inhibitor removal! Guns are hot! Firing for effect! Welcome to Hell, you zombie freaks!
translation: 哇哦，娘娘腔们！战斗抑制器已经去除了！枪口发烫、效力射击！欢迎来地狱，你们这些丧尸！

original: You ever get outside, Cerberus? Into the Wasteland?
translation: 地狱犬，你去过外面？去过废土？

original: Negatory! I have been programmed to remain on premises at all times! In the event of hostilities, I will respond with deadly force!
translation: 无效！我被编程在任何时候待命！遇到敌情，我会用最强火力回应！

original: Go Underworld! Go Ghouls! Yay!
translation: 滚回地下城！滚回僵尸堆！耶！

original: ...damn this pansy zombie programming...
translation: ……该死，这娘娘腔的丧尸程序……

original: What can you tell me about Underworld?
translation: 你能和我说说地下城吗？

original: This is a town full of peace-loving Ghouls, so check your bigotry at the door. They're just like humans! They feel, they hurt, they bleed...
translation: 这镇子都是爱好和平的僵尸，进去后就收起你的偏执吧。他们和人一样！他们感知，他们受伤，他们流血……

original: They deserve the same love and respect as any human, and don't you forget it!
translation: 他们应该得到像人一样得到爱和尊敬，千万别忘了！

original: At least, that's what they programmed me to say.
translation: 至少，那是他们编程序让我这么说的。

original: Personally, I think they're a bunch of rotting zombie maggot farms, and I'd send them all back to hell if I could. Damn, this combat inhibitor!
translation: 在我看来，他们是群腐烂的丧尸，蛆虫养殖场。如果可能，我要送他们去地狱。这见鬼的战斗抑制器！

original: So what are you, the guard dog?
translation: 那么你是什么？看门狗？

original: I am Cerberus! It is my solemn duty to guard the citizens of Underworld against any and all threats, both foreign and domestic!
translation: 我是地狱犬！守护地下城不受到任何的威胁，无论来自外来的和本地的，这是我神圣的使命！

original: So yes... I'm the guard dog.
translation: 所以……对，我是看门狗。

original: Welcome to Megaton. The bomb is perfectly safe. We promise.
translation: 欢迎来兆吨镇。我们保证镇中的核弹不会爆炸。

original: Ya’ll be careful with that thar weapon, ya hear?
translation: 拿着武器小心点，听到了吗？

original: Head on in, pardner. Ya’ll enjoy your stay now.
translation: 进来吧，朋友。你会享受在这的时光的。

original: Welcome to Megaton. The bomb is perfectly safe. We promise.
translation: 欢迎来兆吨镇。我们保证镇中的核弹不会爆炸。

original: Welcome to Megaton. Please stand clear of the gate.
translation: 欢迎来兆吨镇。请离门远点。

original: Welcome to Megaton. Friendliest town around.
translation: 欢迎来兆吨镇。这是个友好的镇子。

original: Need some grub? Try the Brass Lantern.
translation: 要吃的？去黄铜灯里看看。

original: Thirsty, partner? Try Moriarty's. Coldest drinks in the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 渴了，伙计？去莫里亚蒂的店瞧瞧。那有首都废土里最好的饮料。

original: Welcome to Megaton. Enjoy your stay.
translation: 欢迎来兆吨镇。好好享受吧。

original: That zombie's a real corpse now!
translation: 那丧尸现在是真的尸体了！

original: One less of those things to deal with.
translation: 又少了一个那种玩意。

original: Damn it. I kill one and three more show up!
translation: 该死。我杀了一个，又冒出三个！

original: How many of these things do we have to kill?
translation: 我们有多少这些东西要杀？

original: He's down!
translation: 他倒下了！

original: A Brother has fallen!
translation: 一个兄弟会的倒下了！

original: You dare take the life of a Brother of Steel!
translation: 你敢夺走钢铁兄弟会的人的性命！

original: His was a good death.
translation: 他死得其所。

original: Focus, Brothers. Focus on the enemy!
translation: 注意，兄弟们。注意敌人！

original: Let his death not be in vain!
translation: 不要让他死的毫无价值！

original: Hell yeah! How do you like me now!
translation: 见鬼！你怎么做的和我一样！

original: Thought you could take me, did you?
translation: 觉得你能干掉我，对吧？

original: Dead!
translation: 死了！

original: Damnit. I'm just trying to keep the peace.
translation: 该死。我只是想维持和平。

original: Goddamnit. Everyone stand the hell down! Let's solve this peacefully.
translation: 该死。见鬼，都闭嘴！让我们和平地解决它。

original: Dead. Great.
translation: 死了。太好了。

original: Now I'm pissed.
translation: 现在我怒了。

original: Argh!
translation: 啊咯！

original: There. You see? Natural selection at it's finest.
translation: 你看到了吗？物竞天择，适者生存。

original: Death can be so messy, can't it.
translation: 死相真是难看，对不。

original: I hope someone deals with that body soon. I detest the smell of rotting flesh.
translation: 我希望有人立刻处理下尸体。我讨厌腐尸的味道。

original: Death is such nasty business.
translation: 死亡是这么肮脏的事。

original: Oh my God!
translation: 哦，我的天啊！

original: You can't kill us all!
translation: 你不可能杀了我们所有人！

original: Nooooo!
translation: 不！

original: He is fallen!
translation: 他倒下了！

original: Dead! No!!
translation: 死了！不！！

original: He'll be remembered.
translation: 我们会记住他。

original: I will avenge you.
translation: 我要为你报仇。

original: There's no place for disgrace.
translation: 别丢脸。

original: Man down! Man down!
translation: 有人阵亡！有人阵亡！

original: Unit down!
translation: 倒下一个！

original: Rest easy, soldier!
translation: 平安无事，士兵！

original: Reporting in... we're down a man.
translation: 报告……我们失去了一个人。

original: We have a casualty!
translation: 我们有一个伤员！

original: You've done your deed for God and country.
translation: 你是为上帝和国家捐躯的。

original: I can't look!
translation: 我看不下去了！

original: No!
translation: 不！

original: Oh no!
translation: 噢不！

original: This can't be happening!
translation: 这不可能！

original: Please no!
translation: 求你，不要！

original: Somebody help!
translation: 快来帮忙！

original: Bastard! You'll pay for that!
translation: 杂种！你会付出代价！

original: Now I'm REALLY mad!
translation: 现在我“真的”疯了！

original: Son of a bitch!
translation: 狗娘养的！

original: You'll pay for that!
translation: 你会为此付出代价的！

original: This ain't over yet!
translation: 这没完！

original: Dammit! That was our fourth for poker!
translation: 妈的！他倒了我们就三缺一了！

original: Man down! Man down!
translation: 有人阵亡！有人阵亡！

original: Man down!
translation: 有人倒下了！

original: We've lost one.
translation: 我们失去了一个人。

original: Reporting in... we have a soldier down.
translation: 报告……我们的一个士兵倒下了。

original: No! Dammit...
translation: 不！她妈的……

original: I'll make them pay for that.
translation: 我要让他们付出代价。

original: Go in peace, Brother.
translation: 安详地去吧，兄弟。

original: No!
translation: 不！

original: Oh no!
translation: 噢不！

original: Somebody help!
translation: 救命！

original: They killed him!
translation: 他们杀了他！

original: They killed her!
translation: 他们杀了她！

original: Dumbass.
translation: 闭嘴。

original: More loot for me!
translation: 我要更多的战利品！

original: Dammit! They owed me 50 caps!
translation: 她妈的！他们欠我50个瓶盖！

original: Goddamn, I'm glad that wasn't me!
translation: 该死，很高兴那不是我！

original: Oh, you're gonna pay for that.
translation: 哦，你要为此付出代价。

original: <sound of spitting>
Whoa!
translation: 哇哦！

original: Moooove!
Nooooooo!
Holy shit!
translation: 我的天呐！

original: Watch your ass!
translation: 当心后面！

original: Duck!
translation: 趴下！

original: Protect yourself!
translation: 保护自己！

original: It's live!
translation: 会爆炸的！

original: Go, go, go!
translation: 冲，冲，冲！

original: Get away from it!
translation: 离开它！

original: Heads down!
translation: 低头！

original: Watch out!
translation: 小心点！

original: Nooooo!
translation: 不！

original: Why is this so important?
translation: 为什么这么重要？

original: You remember the Bible passage, about the waters of life? It's more than just a poster on a wall.
translation: 你记得圣经的一节吗，关于生命之水？那不仅是墙上的一张海报。

original: Your mother and I, we lived by that ideal. Water, clean and free, for everyone in the Wasteland!
translation: 你妈妈和我为理想而生。为了给废土上的每个人带来干净和免费的水！

original: Think about that for a moment. No more radiation sickness, no more mutated crops, no more struggling just to stay alive. Finally... hope.
translation: 想一想。再没有辐射致病，再没有突变的农作物，再没有战斗，只是单纯的生活。最终是为了给予人们……希望。

original: Isn't it worth taking a risk to give that hope to people?
translation: 给人们希望，这不值得冒险吗？

original: "Your responsibility"? What does that mean?
translation: “你的责任”？什么意思？

original: Project Purity was underway long before you were born. There were many of us, including your mother, who devoted our lives to it.
translation: 净水工程在你出生前进行很久了。包括我们很多人，包括你妈妈，我们花费了很多精力在它上面。

original: The idea of free, clean water for everyone drove us to succeed. So many sacrifices were made for that idea.
translation: 我们的愿望是给每个人免费的净水，这愿望引领我们走向成功，为这愿望我们牺牲了很多。

original: My responsibility is to see it through to the end, to make sure those sacrifices mean something.
translation: 我的责任就是把它进行到底，让我们的牺牲有意义。

original: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这干嘛？

original: I needed information about Doctor Braun's research and development of the G.E.C.K. It's vital to getting Project Purity running.
translation: 我需要布劳恩博士研发伊甸园创造器的信息。这对于净水工程的运作至关重要。

original: I was expecting to find notes, or holotapes. I didn't plan on being caught up in Braun's twisted fantasy world.
translation: 我原来一直期望找到笔记或全息磁带。我没想到会被抓进布劳恩的幻想世界。

original: So you've been lying to me all this time?
translation: 所以你一直在对我撒谎？

original: Yes, I lied about where you were born. About where I was born. I admit that.
translation: 是的，关于你在哪出生的，还有我在哪出生的，我说了谎。我承认。

original: At the time, I felt the truth would only encourage you to try and leave the Vault, to go looking for your past.
translation: 那时候，我觉得真相只会怂恿你离开避难所，去寻找你的过去。

original: Perhaps I should've handled things differently. I'm sorry.
translation: 抱歉，我应该用其他方式来处理这事。

original: What the hell is wrong with you? Why did you just leave me like that?
translation: 你究竟怎么了？为什么就这样离开我？

original: That's where you belonged. You were an adult, capable of fending for yourself, and you had a good life ahead of you.
translation: 那是属于你的地方。你是大人，应该能自己照顾自己了，你将会有一段美好的生活。

original: What's out here is my task, my responsibility. I never wanted you to have any part of this insanity.
translation: 在这外面的是我的任务，我的责任。我从来也没想让你也这么傻。

original: I want answers from you.
translation: 我想从你那得到答案。

original: You came all this way, and risked your life for answers? They must be important to you.
translation: 你走了这一路，冒着生命危险，就为了寻求答案？那一定对你至关重要吧。

original: I'll get that door open, and then you can let your hordes in.
translation: 我会把门打开，然后你可以让你的人进来。

original: Well get going, then! Open the door! What's taking you so damn long? Hurry up!
translation: 快啊！开门！怎么他妈的花了这么长时间？快点！

original: I can get them to let you move in / You can now move in.
translation: 我可以想办法让你们进来 /现在你们可以进来了。

original: You think so, do you? Give it a shot kid, but you're dreaming. I'll wait to give you a shot, but then we're doing it my way.
translation: 你这样想，是吗？给它一枪，你是在做梦。我会等着给你一枪，然后我们按自己方式做。

original: I think I can convince them to let you live there.
translation: 我想我能说服他们让你们入住。

original: I'll be damned. Really? Good job kid! I was willing to unleash the Ferals and kill all those bigots. Guess I don't have to now.
translation: 该死。真的？做的好，孩子！我当时还想让那些凶悍僵尸杀了那些种族分子。现在看来不用了。

original: Here's a little something for your troubles, it'll help you deal with our Feral brethren if you meet any.
translation: 这有样东西报答你，它能让你不用再担心我们的疯狂兄弟。

original: I've taken care of things. You can move in now!
translation: 我已经把事情办妥了。你现在可以搬进去了！

original: Whatever. I'm leaving.
translation: 随便吧，我得走了。

original: That's the smartest thing you've said since you met me.
translation: 这是我遇到你后你说的最明智的话。

original: Good luck with that. I'll have none of it.
translation: 祝你好运。我不想参与。

original: You got a lot to learn, kid. A lot. Like for instance how not to piss off an angry Ghoul. You best get out of here, before I get real ugly.
translation: 你还有很多东西要学，孩子。很多。包括为什么不应该惹毛一只僵尸。你最好在我脸色变得难看之前离开这。

original: Whatever. You're no better than Tenpenny.
translation: 不管怎么，你和特佩尼是半斤八两。

original: If I'm no better than Tenpenny, then he should let me into that tower. But he won't. So, I'm busting in.
translation: 如果我和特佩尼是半斤八两，那他应该让我住进大厦。但他没有。所以，我要闯进去。

original: You're a zombie! People should shoot you!
translation: 你是个丧尸！人们应该杀了你！

original: Oh yeah? Fine. It's on!
translation: 噢，是吗？好啊。开火吧！

original: Well, maybe I should talk to Tenpenny. There may be a peaceful solution.
translation: 好吧，我应该和特佩尼谈谈。可能会有个和平的解决办法。

original: Try it if you like. Go talk to Tenpenny. Ask him he wants us living there.  It won't work. So when you fail, we can do it my way.
translation: 如果你想就试试吧。去和特佩尼谈谈，让他同意我们住进去。不过这是没用的，要是你失败的话，再按我的方法做吧。

original: This is going to be fun!
translation: 这将会很有趣！

original: Indeed. Remember. I'll be waiting for you to get that door open. Don't keep me waiting long, kid.
translation: 确实。记住。我会等着你开门。不要让我等太久，孩子。

original: Right on. Kill those elitists. I think I can help you with that escape door.
translation: 有道理。干掉那些精英主义者。我会想办法为你们打开门。

original: Now you're talking my language. Alright, here's the plan.
translation: 你终于说人话了。好吧，这是我的计划。

original: I'll gather up a horde of ferals and wait for you by that escape door. You find a way to get it open and then we'll sit back and enjoy the show!
translation: 我会集合一群凶悍僵尸在逃生门等着你。你想办法打开它，然后我们就坐着看表演！

original: Let me try talking to Tenpenny. Maybe he wouldn't mind you living there.
translation: 让我试试和特佩尼谈谈。或许他不介意你住进去。

original: Ha! Those snooty bitches probably can't stand living with each other, let alone with us.
translation: 哈！那些傲慢的混账们相互间都快无法忍受了，更别说和我们住在一起。

original: But by all means, try talking to Tenpenny if you like. But it won't work. Then we'll do it my way.
translation: 话说回来，这也是个办法，你可以试着努力和特佩尼谈谈。但是要是不成，那我就按我的方法做。

original: You get that escape door in the Tenpenny basement open, and I'll unleash those ferals on 'em!
translation: 你把特佩尼地下室的逃生门打开，那我就能放那些凶悍僵尸进去了！

original: It's not really any of my business. Sorry I asked.
translation: 这真的不关我的事，我不该问的。

original: You're right. It's none of your business. You best get out of here, kid. Before something ugly happens.
translation: 你说得对。这不关你的事。孩子，在不可挽回的事发生前你最好离开这儿。

original: It's Tenpenny's tower. He can do whatever he wants.
translation: 这是特佩尼的大厦。他可以为所欲为。

original: Not sure where you come from kid, but out here in the Wasteland, everything's up for grabs. And you only get to keep what you can hold onto.
translation: 孩子，我不知道你是从哪来的，但是在这废土里，任何事物都人人有份。你只要去拿，你就能拿到。

original: Tenpenny didn't build that tower. He found it. And took it from whoever used to own it. Now we're gonna take it from him.
translation: 这大厦也不是特佩尼建的，他只是发现了它，然后把它从原来的主人手中夺了过来。现在我们要从他手里拿回来。

original: We tried playing nice, but they shot at us. Fuck 'em. It's time for them and their bigot ways to die.
translation: 我们试过和他好好谈，但是他们用子弹向我回敬。去他妈的。是时候干掉这些种族主义者了。

original: I might be able to get you in there.
translation: 我或许能让你进去。

original: I already got a plan. They think I’m a monster. I’ll show them the real monsters!
translation: 我已经有计划了。既然他们认为我是怪物，那我就让他们看看真正的怪物！

original: We'll unleash our feral brethren on them; all those bigoted sons-of-bitches will get torn apart. Trouble is getting past the damn subway access door!
translation: 我要放出我们疯狂的兄弟；所有这些混蛋种族主义者都会被撕成碎片。问题是我们没法穿过地铁隧道大门！

original: You see, there's some kind of escape door that leads from the Tenpenny basement to the subway tunnels. There must be some way to get that open.
translation: 听着，特佩尼大楼地下室有个逃生门一直通到地铁隧道。一定有法子把它打开。

original: I'm going in.
translation: 我会去的。

original: Now I won't be able to contact you once you're in there. You'll exit near the cisterns, and then you can get in touch with me again.
translation: 在那我不能联系你。你可以从蓄水池旁出来，然后你可以再联系我。

original: Is this dangerous?
translation: 这危险吗？

original: No, not at all. You'll just need to turn a valve. It'll only take a moment.
translation: 不，一点儿也不危险。你只要开个阀门。那很快。

original: Honey? Over here; the intercom.
translation: 亲爱的？来对讲机这。

original: Son? Over here; the intercom.
translation: 儿子？来对讲机这。

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <沉默不语>

original: Okay, now I've seen everything...
translation: 好的，真长见识……

original: You're a poet, right? Do you have a name?
translation: 你是个诗人，是吗？你有名字吗？

original: I'm getting impatient.
translation: 我没耐心了。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: You've become a bit of a bore, haven't you? Go away!
translation: 你变得有点让人厌烦了，不是吗？走开！

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: I guess it just runs in the family.
translation: 我想它是世代相传的。

original: I suppose it does.
translation: 我想是的。

original: Look, I am sorry that I left you. I did what I thought was best for you. I don't know how else to say it.
translation: 你看，我抱歉我曾离你而去。我以为做了我认为对你最好的事。我不知道还能说什么。

original: I'm on my break, so I'm just looking around. I guess you don't have anything new today.
translation: 我正闲着，所以到处看看。我想你今天没什么新东西。

original: Your mom was no Saint Monica. I wouldn't want someone like her. Besides, I like cooking.
translation: 你妈妈不是圣莫尼卡。我才不要她那样的。另外，我喜欢做饭。

original: It's ready for you, Father.
translation: 给你准备好了，神父。

original: Rubbish! You must be daft. Look around! Where else in the Wasteland have you seen such magnificence, I ask you?
translation: 垃圾！你一定很愚蠢。到处看看！我问你，在废土上你还看到过这样富丽堂皇的地方吗？

original: I had the great fortune to run into Mr. Burke, an absolute gem of a man. He certainly has a way of getting done what needs to get done, doesn't he?
translation: 遇上伯克先生我真幸运，一个人才。他总是有办法完成要做的事，不是吗？

original: Then it was a matter of getting the right type of tenants with the right type of assets, and the rest is, as they say, history.
translation: 接下来重要的就是为房产找到合适的住客，至于其他，如他们所说，都已经是历史了。

original: Eh. It's okay here.
translation: 嗯，这还好。

original: Look, if you don't care about yourself, then no one else will. And nothing says "I love me" better than a fabulous new look. Am I right? I'm right.
translation: 想想看，如果你都不关心自己，别人怎么会关心你。焕然一新的面貌要比别人对你说“我爱你”更有价值。我说的对吗？我肯定是对的。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: You should take more interest in your well-being. Carelessness leads to the spread of disease. Is there something you need?
translation: 你应该更注重健康。漠不关心会导致疾病缠身。你需要什么？

original: Blah blah blah.
translation: 废话连篇。

original: Just try not to break anything, okay?
translation: 别打破东西就行，好吗？

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: I see, sir. Very well. May I pour you a drink?
translation: 明白了，先生。非常好。能给你倒杯酒吗？

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <一言不发。>

original: Well. Like I said. Take a seat anywhere, except at Mister Tenpenny's table.
translation: 好吧，还是那句话——随便坐，除了特佩尼先生那张桌。

original: Whatever you say.
translation: 随你怎么说。

original: I say! Must you be so caustic? Come now, a lot of work went into turning this husk of a tower into a place people can call home.
translation: 我说！你一定要这么刻薄吗？来吧，要想把这废弃的大厦变成为象家一样的住的地方还有很多工作要做。

original: I've had help, of course. Especially in Mr. Burke, an absolute gem of a man. He certainly has a way of getting done what needs to get done.
translation: 当然喽，我有帮手的。特别是伯克先生，一个人才。他总是有办法完成要做的事。

original: Then it was a matter of getting the right type of tenants with the right type of assets, and the rest is, as they say, history.
translation: 接下来重要的就是为房产找到合适的住客，至于其他，如他们所说，都已经是历史了。

original: You didn't build this tower, you just found it and moved in. Big fucking deal.
translation: 这座大厦又不是你盖的，你只是找到它然后搬了进来。真他妈了不起。

original: Fine. Keep wearing that trashy outfit. I don't care. You probably couldn't afford to upgrade your look anyway. Ah, I could have made you fabulous.
translation: 好啊。继续穿你那身垃圾吧。我不在乎。你大概也没钱改头换面。哎，我本来能让你焕然一新的。

original: You got a problem with the way I dress?
translation: 你对我的穿着有意见？

original: It isn't cheap to live here. Is there something you want?
translation: 在这住不便宜。有什么你需要的吗？

original: I hear doctors make a ton of caps.
translation: 我听说医生能赚不少瓶盖。

original: You wouldn't know true value if it slapped you in the face!
translation: 即便拍在你脸上，你都不会知道真正的价值！

original: This is a store?
translation: 这是商店？

original: I see, sir. Very well. May I pour you a drink?
translation: 明白了，先生。非常好。能给你倒杯酒吗？

original: I hate robots.
translation: 我讨厌机器人。

original: Most people consider mistreating food service providers as an invitation to get a little something unexpected in their meal.
translation: 多数人认为，对服务员甩脸子，等同于主动邀请后厨“加料”。

original: Of course, I will do nothing of the sort.
translation: 当然，我不会这么做。

original: I don't need a smile. What I need is some food.
translation: 微笑就不必了，我要得是吃的。

original: Righto! When I saw this place jutting up out of the horizon, I knew what I had to do! I hired some muscle and we got this place fixed up right quick.
translation: 对头！当我看到这地方从地平线冒出来的时候，我就知道该怎么做了！我雇了些肌肉男，然后很快就把这地方搞定了。

original: I had the great fortune to run into Mr. Burke, an absolute gem of a man. He certainly has a way of getting done what needs to get done, doesn't he?
translation: 遇上伯克先生我真幸运，一个人才。他总是有办法完成要做的事，不是吗？

original: Then it was a matter of getting the right type of tenants with the right type of assets, and the rest is, as they say, history.
translation: 接下来重要的就是为房产找到合适的住客，至于其他，照他们的说法，都已经是历史了。

original: Indeed! I'm extremely impressed!
translation: 没错！我大吃一惊！

original: Yes. The healing art is a rewarding occupation. Is there something I can help you with?
translation: 是的。医术是一门很有价值的职业。有什么我可以帮您的吗？

original: Being a doctor is a great service to a community.
translation: 当医生是对社区的伟大贡献。

original: Your taste in shopping venue is impeccable. How may I assist you?
translation: 你购物的品味很不错。要我帮忙不？

original: Nice place you have here.
translation: 你这地方不错。

original: Very kind of you to say so. Thank you!
translation: 您真是过奖了，多谢！

original: And a pretty smile it is!
translation: 这笑容多动人呀！

original: I see, sir. Very well. May I pour you a drink?
translation: 明白了，先生。非常好。能给你倒杯酒吗？

original: I'd love a drink, friend.
translation: 老兄，我想来点喝的。

original: With my fashion sense and your bottlecaps, there's no limit to what we can do for your image! I can't wait to get started!
translation: 凭我的时尚嗅觉和你的瓶盖，只要你能想到，我都能办到！我等不及开始了！

original: You really think you can improve my look?
translation: 你真的认为你能改善我的形象？

original: You too.
translation: 你也是。

original: Great. Good luck on the G.O.A.T.
translation: 太好了。在伊甸园创造器这件事上好运。

original: Sure thing. How about we head down to the diner after class?
translation: 没问题。课后去一起晚餐怎么样？

original: Thanks. Say, you want to grab some lunch later on?
translation: 谢谢。嗯，你想迟点去吃午餐？

original: Well, I hope it's working again soon for you.
translation: 好的，我希望你能使用它。

original: Yeah, sure did. But the thing is so old, my grandpa had trouble with it when he was my age.
translation: 嗯，当然。但是这东西太旧了，我爷爷在我这年纪时都因为用它而出过麻烦。

original: You're kidding me. Didn't you just get new parts for it last week?
translation: 你在和我开玩笑。你上周不是拿到新零件了吗？

original: Oh, not much. Our heater's on the fritz again.
translation: 哦，还没。我的加热器又出问题了。

original: Hi, Susie. What's new?
translation: 嘿，苏茜。有什么新鲜事吗？

original: And if your friends decided to jump into the reactor, would you join them? Get your posterior in a chair immediately.
translation: 要是你的朋友去跳反应堆，你也会跟他一起跳吗？赶快坐回你的椅子上去。

original: Mr. Brotch, come on! I gotta meet my friends!
translation: 布洛彻先生，来吧！我有个朋友要见的！

original: There's more to this than you realize, Button.
translation: 这比你认为的要多，巴顿。

original: Please explain, but I warn you, I am well versed on the tactics of the underhanded Redcoat spy. You'd do well to remember that.
translation: 请解释，不过我警告你，我很熟悉红衣间谍的伎俩。你最好记住。

original: Ummm, allow me to ponder my decision.
translation: 嗯，允许我考虑一下再决定。

original: Very well, but any attempt to take the Declaration of Independence will be considered an act of war.
translation: 非常好，但是任何要占有《独立宣言》的企图都会被认为是战争行为。

original: You do realize that it's about 500 years later, don't you?
translation: 你没意识到这是500年后了吗？

original: Petty lies and deceit may be the way of Great Britain's crown, but I will not succumb to such tomfoolery.
translation: 卑鄙的欺骗和谎言可能是英国王室的惯用风格，但我不会听任这种愚蠢的行为。

original: Since it appears you wish to resolve this without bloodshed, may I suggest you stand down and surrender?
translation: 既然看起来你想通过不流血的方式解决，或许我该建议你立刻缴械投降？

original: I can promise that you will be treated well; in a manner accustomed to any member of the Royal Army.
translation: 我可以承诺你会得到很好的待遇；那些皇家陆军早就习惯的方式。

original: Please. Just monitor the pumps.
translation: 拜托。只要盯着水泵就好。

original: James, I...
translation: 詹姆斯，我……

original: Madison, please. It's very important that you do this right now. Just step over to the panel while I access the computer in the control booth.
translation: 麦迪逊，拜托。你现在做的事很重要。当我访问电脑的控制终端时，你盯着面板就好。

original: What? What are you talking about? That doesn't even make any sense...
translation: 什么？你正说什么？这甚至毫无意义……

original: I need you to monitor the output levels on pumps three and four. Please step over to the panel and keep an eye on them, will you?
translation: 我要你监控第三和第四水泵的输出水平。请盯着面板，可以吗？

original: I won't help you do this James. Not after everything it took to get here.
translation: 在我完成任务之前我什么也不会帮你的，詹姆斯。

original: Madison, please. Now's not the time. I'll get the information the Colonel needs, but I need you to...
translation: 麦迪逊，拜托。现在不是时候。我会得到上校要的东西，但我需要你……

original: James, this is wrong. You can't do this.
translation: 詹姆斯，这样不好。你不能这么做。

original: Why would you do all that over a scrap of paper?
translation: 为什么你要为了几张破纸这么做呢？

original: This is no mere scrap of paper, sir. This is the doctrine laid down by my fellow members of the Second Continental Congress.
translation: 不光是几张破纸，先生。这是我和我的伙伴在第二届大陆议会拟定的声明。

original: It absolves us of the tyranny of King George the Third of Great Britain. It is perhaps the greatest symbol of this free nation.
translation: 它让我们摆脱了大英帝国乔治三世的暴政。它可能是这个自由国家最伟大的象征。

original: This is no mere scrap of paper, madam. This is the doctrine laid down by my fellow members of the Second Continental Congress.
translation: 不光是几张破纸，女士。这是我和我的伙伴在第二届大陆议会拟定的声明。

original: It absolves us of the tyranny of King George the Third of Great Britain. It is perhaps the greatest symbol of this free nation.
translation: 它让我们摆脱了大英帝国乔治三世的暴政。它可能是这个自由国家最伟大的象征。

original: Get out of my way you lunatic!
translation: 从我面前滚开，疯子！

original: I will NOT stand down, sir! To quote the words of the great Thomas Jefferson...
translation: 我不会撤退，先生！引用一下伟大的托马斯·杰斐逊的名言……

original: If our house be on fire, without inquiring whether it was fired from within or without, we must try to extinguish it!
translation: 如果我们的房子着火了，不管火势是从屋内还是屋外而起，我们都必须扑灭它！

original: I will NOT stand down, ma'am! To quote the words of the great Thomas Jefferson...
translation: 我不会撤退，女士！引用一下伟大的托马斯·杰斐逊的名言……

original: If our house be on fire, without inquiring whether it was fired from within or without, we must try to extinguish it!
translation: 如果我们的房子着火了，不管火势是从屋内还是屋外而起，我们都必须扑灭它！

original: What are you talking about? You're a robot!
translation: 你在说什么？你是个机器人！

original: I am not a "robot." I am Button Gwinnett, second signer of the Declaration of Independence and distinguished representative from Georgia.
translation: 我不是“机器人”。我是巴顿·格温耐特，《独立宣言》的第二个签名人，来自乔治亚州的著名代表。

original: I know your fighting prowess far exceeds my own, but I will still duel you to the death if I must.
translation: 你知道你的战斗本领远远超过我，但是我仍然要和你决斗，至死方休。

original: What will it be then? Rapiers? Pistols at dawn? Out with it!
translation: 你要选哪样？短剑？拂晓拼抢？随你挑！

original: Intercom4-2
translation: 对讲机4-2

original: Wish not so much to live long as to live well!
translation: 宁可战死，不可苟活！

original: Intercom4-1
translation: 对讲机4-1

original: The enemy is at the gates! Now is the time for the greatest of rallying cries!
translation: 敌人就在门口！是失守吹响这最伟大战斗的号角了！

original: Intercom3-2
translation: 对讲机3-2

original: The enemy will be here soon, you must defend your leader! Remember: Our cause is noble; it is the cause of mankind!
translation: 敌人就要来了，你们必须保护你们的领袖！记住：我们的事业是神圣的；这是全人类的事业！

original: Intercom3-1
translation: 对讲机3-1

original: We cannot allow the enemy to penetrate our defenses any deeper! Old Glory must not be stained with the blood of tyranny!
translation: 我们不能允许敌人突破我们的防线！星条旗一定不能被暴政的血玷污！

original: Intercom2-2
translation: 对讲机2-2

original: Strike now and strike hard. You may delay, but time will not!
translation: 现在进攻，猛烈进攻。你们可以等，但是时间不等人！

original: Intercom2-1
translation: 对讲机2-1

original: Men! We can't let the enemy's progress dissuade us from our task! We must defend our freedom and our right to be independent!
translation: 伙计们！我们不能让敌人的前进妨碍我们的任务！我们必须维护我们的自由和独立的权利！

original: Intercom1-3
translation: 对讲机1-3

original: As your leader, Button Gwinnett, distinguished representative of Georgia, I promise you I have not yet begun to fight!
translation: 作为你们的领导人，巴顿·格温耐特，乔治亚州的著名代表，我向你们保证，这对我还算不上战斗！

original: Intercom1-2
translation: 对讲机1-2

original: Remember, the will of the people is the only legitimate foundation of any government, and to protect its free expression should be our first object.
translation: 记住，人民的意愿是任何合法的政府唯一的基础，保护自由之音是我们的首要目标。

original: Intercom1-1
translation: 对讲机1-1

original: Men, today I address you with a message of utmost urgency. Our defenses have been breached, and soon we'll engage the enemy.
translation: 伙计们，今天我向你们宣布一个迫在眉睫的讯息。我们的防线被突破了，不久我们就要与敌人交火了了。

original: Are you hurt?
translation: 你受伤了吗？

original: Nope, I'm fine.
translation: 不。我很好。

original: It's only a scratch, I'll be fine.
translation: 只是一点擦伤，我会好的。

original: Yeah, they got me pretty good.
translation: 嗯，这下够我受的。

original: Yeah, can't take much more of that.
translation: 嗯，再也撑不住了。

original: Hey! Get the hell away from there!
translation: 嗨！他妈的离这远点！

original: Aren't you curious? You know what they say about curiosity, don't you?
translation: 你不好奇吗？你知道大家对好奇心的看法，对吧？

original: Back off, man. That's my stuff.
translation: 退后，伙计。这是我的东西。

original: Hey now, get outta there. Just let me know if you need a drink.
translation: 现在，离开那里。要喝什么就告诉我。

original: Whoa, bud. That stuff belongs to the restaurant. Just ask me if you need a drink.
translation: 哇，伙计。那东西是这餐馆的。要喝酒就来找我。

original: Hey buddy, Bar's over here if you need something.
translation: 嗨，伙计，吧台在这，你要是需要什么的话，只管说。

original: Can I see what's on the menu?
translation: 我能看下菜单上有什么吗？

original: Sure thing, my man.
translation: 没问题，哥们。

original: Sure thing, little lady.
translation: 没问题，姐妹。

original: Hey, now. That's my stuff. If you want something, you gotta buy it.
translation: 嗨。那是我的东西。如果你想要什么，你就得买下来。

original: Whoa, whoa, whoa, hands off the goods.
translation: 哇，哇，哇，交出那些东西。

original: I'd put that weapon away if I were you.
translation: 要是我是你，我就会把家伙收起来。

original: Stacey! Open the gate, and let this mungo in!
translation: 斯泰西！开门，让毛人进去！

original: Nearly finished...
translation: 快搞定了……

original: Almost ready. I'm compiling the data now.
translation: 快准备好了。我现在正编译数据。

original: Just another minute, and I'll be done.
translation: 再等一会，我就能搞定。

original: It'll only be a few more moments.
translation: 再等一会就好了。

original: Enough of these delays.
translation: 耽搁得够久了。

original: I grow tired of waiting.
translation: 我等得好心急。

original: My patience wears thin.
translation: 我快没耐心了。

original: Sounds good. Let me know if there are any changes.
translation: 听起来不错。让我们看看是否有别的变化。

original: No problem. I'll have my report ready this afternoon.
translation: 没问题。下午我就把报告准备好。

original: I'd just like to keep an eye on it.
translation: 我会留意它的。

original: I was just going over them. Something you're worried about?
translation: 我刚对它们进行过检查。你担心什么？

original: Have you had a chance to look over these results?
translation: 你有机会查看这些结果吗？

original: Morning, Doc. How's things?
translation: 早晨好，医生。事情怎么样了？

original: Morning, Jonas.
translation: 早晨好，乔纳斯。

original: Sure, sounds good. I would have done it for free.
translation: 没问题，听起来不错。我本来是可以免费完成这件事情的。

original: Yeah right. Good luck soldier. I'm not coming after you to rescue your ass if you get in trouble. You're on your own.
translation: 是的，祝你好运，士兵。如果你遇到麻烦，我也没法过来增援你的。你得靠自己了。

original: Roy Phillips and his gang are somewhere in Warrington Station Metro tunnels. They've barred the main entrance. Try going through the train yard.
translation: 罗伊·菲利普斯和他的那伙人在沃灵顿站地铁隧道。他们控制了主入口。要从火车站台旁的小门进入那。

original: I'll take it. And any other help you can offer.
translation: 我会接受。你提供的任何帮助我都会接受的。

original: Here, you can take this rifle and ammo. But don't waste it shooting at shadows.
translation: 给，你可以拿着这来复枪和子弹。不过别放空枪。

original: Roy Phillips and his gang are somewhere in Warrington Station Metro tunnels. They've barred the main entrance. Try going through the train yard.
translation: 罗伊·菲利普斯和他的那伙人在沃灵顿站地铁隧道。他们控制了主入口。要从火车站台旁的小门进入那。

original: You want this problem resolved or not? You can spare more than that...
translation: 你想解决问题还是不想？你可以派更多的人……

original: Well... maybe you're right. It was something I was going to have to do eventually anyway. How about another 200 caps?
translation: 嗯…… 可能你是对的。有些事最终还是得靠我来做。多加200个瓶盖怎么样？

original: And here. You can take this rifle and ammo.
translation: 给。你可以拿着这来复枪和子弹。

original: But you better not screw this up!
translation: 但你最好不要浪费！

original: Roy Phillips and his gang are somewhere in Warrington Station Metro tunnels. They've barred the main entrance. Try going through the train yard.
translation: 罗伊·菲利普斯和他的那伙人在沃灵顿站地铁隧道。他们控制了主入口。要从火车站台旁的小门进入那。

original: We'll see.
translation: 让我们拭目以待吧。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: I was just kidding. Ghouls are filthy creatures that should be slaughtered.
translation: 我刚是在开玩笑。尸鬼是种丑陋的生物，应该被灭绝。

original: Quite right! You're not such a moron after all.
translation: 非常对！你总算还不笨。

original: That can be arranged. You don't look like much.
translation: 都能安排。你别那么看。

original: Are you threatening me? You're obviously an idiot, so I'll let that one slide. But I'm warning you, I won't hesitate to kill you if I have to.
translation: 你是在威胁我吗？你一看就是个笨蛋，我会放你一马。但是我警告你，如果有需要的话我会毫不犹豫地杀了你。

original: Whatever. It's not really any of my business.
translation: 随便，这确实不关我事。

original: No, but perhaps it might be.
translation: 不，但这有可能。

original: Yeah, Ghouls are too much trouble.
translation: 嗯，尸鬼是个大麻烦。

original: That's right. You never know when they'll go zombie on your ass. Perhaps you're smarter than you look.
translation: 对。你从不会觉察到丧尸到了你屁股后面。或许你会比看上去聪明。

original: You're all bigots.
translation: 你们都是偏执狂。

original: Your bleeding heart is liable to get you in a lot of trouble one day.
translation: 你的好心总有一天会给你带来大麻烦。

original: Look kid, eventually all Ghouls go zombie on your ass. It's only a matter of time.
translation: 听着，孩子，在你屁股后面的所有的僵尸最终都会变成丧尸。这只是时间问题。

original: Kill them when you find them. It's a win-win. You put them out of their misery, and save someone else from getting torn apart.
translation: 你要见一个杀一个。这是对大家都好。你帮他们从痛苦中解脱出来，又从他们的魔掌下解救了其他人。

original: Like I tell my men: Don't bother reporting in, unless it's to tell me you got the job done.
translation: 像我告诉我弟兄们的那样：不停地汇报进度很烦人，除非你是打算告诉我已经搞定了。

original: I'm still working on getting rid of Roy Phillips and his pack of Ghouls.
translation: 我还在忙着除掉罗伊·菲利普斯和他那伙僵尸。

original: Really? You? You're welcome to give it a try. But don't come crying to me when you get hurt.
translation: 真的？你？欢迎你去试试。到你受伤的时候，可别来找我哭诉。

original: They've holed up in the nearby metro tunnels. They're living with packs of Feral Ghouls. Be careful, Roy seems damn close to turning zombie himself.
translation: 他们蜗居在地铁隧道里，与一堆疯狂的僵尸生活在一起。小心，罗伊也快变成疯狂丧尸了。

original: I suppose you won't be doing this out of the kindness of your heart, huh?
translation: 我猜你并不是出于纯粹的善意吧？

original: How's 500 bottlecaps sound? Payable upon termination of that damn Ghoul, Roy Phillips, and all his followers.
translation: 500个瓶盖怎么样？杀了该死的僵尸，罗伊·菲利普斯，和他所有的手下。

original: I can help with your Ghoul problem. Where are they hiding out?
translation: 我能帮你处理你的僵尸问题。他们藏在哪？

original: Perhaps the residents could be "persuaded" to let the Ghouls live here.
translation: 或许这的居民能被说服，同意让尸鬼住进来。

original: You're out of line. Those filthy bitches can stay living in those metro tunnels. They'll move in here over my dead body.
translation: 你过分了。那些肮脏的婊子只能住在那些地铁隧道里。不然就让他们跨过我的尸体住进来。

original: Have you even tried talking to the Ghouls? I bet you can work something out.
translation: 你还试过和尸鬼交谈？我打赌你能领悟出了什么。

original: Tenpenny doesn't care how big their pile of bottlecaps is. He won't let Ghouls live here. Those Ghouls need to give up and go bother someone else.
translation: 特佩尼不关心他们有多少瓶盖。他不会让僵尸住进来的。那些僵尸还是放弃，去烦其他人吧。

original: Those Ghouls got you scared too, huh?
translation: 那些僵尸也吓着你了，嗯？

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <一言不发。>

original: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

original: Yeah, good luck with that.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运。

original: We shall simply have to ignore them until they bugger off.
translation: 我们只能无视他们，直到他们走开。

original: Cheers.
translation: 干杯。

original: It's more than just interesting. It's positively horrible!
translation: 那不有趣，那很可怕！

original: That's interesting.
translation: 这很有意思。

original: If you don't mind, I have something things to attend to.
translation: 如果你不介意，我其他还有事要做。

original: Yep.
translation: 是的。

original: Yeah. Thanks.
translation: 好啊。谢谢。

original: Good luck.
translation: 好运。

original: I suppose it is, isn't it?
translation: 我猜是的，对吧？

original: It's only a matter of time.
translation: 这只是时间问题。

original: That's not the word I'd use for it, comrade.
translation: 换我就不会这么说，同志。

original: Interesting.
translation: 有意思。

original: I wish I was as unconcerned as you.
translation: 我希望我能和你一样漠不关心。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: You're a bit of a loser, aren't you?
translation: 你是个失败者，对吧？

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <一言不发。>

original: Don't care? You might one day.
translation: 不在乎？总有一天你会的。

original: Sure. Whatever you say.
translation: 行吧。随你怎么说。

original: If there's nothing else, I have better things to be doing right now.
translation: 要是这没事了，我就去做别的要紧事。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: I hope I don't have to find out... though, everyone loves my cooking.
translation: 我倒是不太想知道……不过嘛，谁都爱吃我做的。

original: I wonder if Ghouls will like your cooking?
translation: 该不会连尸鬼都爱上你的手艺了？

original: Look around... what else is there to do?
translation: 除了喝酒……我还有什么可做的？

original: You ever wonder if maybe you drink too much?
translation: 你有没有想过这可能是因为你灌了太多的黄汤？

original: Hmph. Well I... I just remembered I have something important to do. Goodbye.
translation: 哼。我……刚想起来还有别的事情要做。再见。

original: You ever wonder what those Ghouls think of you, and your snobby friends?
translation: 你有没有想过那些僵尸是怎么看你的吗？还有你那些谄媚的朋友？

original: What? Why, I do believe you are being quite rude! Goodbye.
translation: 什么？噢，我觉得你非常无礼！再见。

original: It's pretty sad, isn't it. Not being the center of everyone's attention?
translation: 真可悲，不是吗？不再是众人关注的焦点了？

original: Well... not exactly. But my colleagues have published papers...
translation: 嗯……还没有。但我的同事发表了篇论文……

original: I suppose I someone ought to verify their findings... Perhaps I'll do that. Who knows? I might even finally get published!
translation: 我猜有人会去核实他们的发现……也许就是我。谁知道呢？我的论文可能也会出版！

original: I don't suppose you've consulted any Ghouls on your little theory?
translation: 我想你并没有跟任何僵尸商量过你那个小理论？

original: Well... I just thought... Never mind.
translation: 好吧……我就是想……算了。

original: I make it a point to stay clear of trouble.
translation: 我还是离麻烦远一点的好。

original: What are you suggesting by that? I don't think I like your tone!
translation: 你在暗示什么？我可不喜欢你的腔调！

original: I'll go tell them there's nothing here worth dying over.
translation: 要是我就会告诉他们，这没什么东西值得他们为之送命。

original: Are you mocking me, comrade?
translation: 你在嘲笑我吗，同志？

original: Perhaps, comrade, the Ghouls will join your committee, comrade.
translation: 也许吧，同志，那些僵尸说不定还能会加入你的委员会呢，同志。

original: Perhaps you're right. But, I prefer to keep my nightmares a fantasy and not test my luck with the real thing. Thank you very much.
translation: 可能你是对的。但是，我宁愿沉醉在梦魇中，也不想在现实里考验运气。非常感谢。

original: It's only natural to be afraid of the unknown...
translation: 对未知怀有恐惧是很自然的。

original: I was hoping we could get to know each other better. What was I thinking?
translation: 我正希望我们彼此能加深了解。我以前都在想什么？

original: Yeah, about that... I'm not really in the Ghoul extermination business.
translation: 啊，关于那个……我对灭绝僵尸的大业没什么兴趣。

original: I was hoping we could get along. What was I thinking?
translation: 我正希望我们彼此能加深了解。我以前都在想什么？

original: Yeah, about that... I'm not really in the Ghoul extermination business.
translation: 啊，关于那个……我对灭绝僵尸的大业没什么兴趣。

original: You're lucky old men learn patience. But keep pushing your luck and I'll teach you a thing or two.
translation: 算你走运，老年人都学会了耐心。不过要是你继续得寸进尺，我不介意给你点教训。

original: Better let the young folks handle things, old timer.
translation: 还是让年轻人来处理这些事吧，老家伙。

original: Ahem. I advise you to speak more civilly. Perhaps you can go enlighten Chief Gustavo. I have pressing "evil minion" things to do.
translation: 哼。我建议你说话再讲礼些。你可能得去启迪一下古斯塔沃长官。我还有些“魔鬼仆从”的事要做。

original: For an evil minion, you're not very bright. You can't "contain" Ghouls.
translation: 想当魔鬼仆从，你的头脑可不够聪明。你不可以“抑制”那僵尸问题。

original: Really? That'd be wonderful. Talk to Chief Gustavo about it.
translation: 真的？那太好了。去跟古斯塔沃长官谈谈吧。

original: I might be able to do something.
translation: 我应该可以帮上忙。

original: Yeah? Talk to Gustavo. He may wish to employ your assistance.
translation: 是的？和古斯塔沃谈谈。他可能希望雇佣你做助手。

original: I might be able to help deal with the problem.
translation: 我应该可以帮忙解决些问题。

original: Really? It's your funeral I suppose. You'll want to discuss it with Chief Gustavo first.
translation: 真的？我想你是自找死路。你得先和古斯塔沃长官谈谈这事。

original: I might be able to take care of your unwanted neighbors.
translation: 我应该可以收拾你那些不受欢迎的邻居。

original: Really? How? Wait! I don't really want to know - it probably entails something wickedly awful - just talking about it will give me the jeepers.
translation: 真的？你要怎么做？等等！我不是真的想知道 - 谈这个会让我起一身鸡皮疙瘩 - 还是算了。

original: Chief Gustavo will want to know you will help. He might even be able to offer you something for your troubles.
translation: 古斯塔沃长官会想知道你要帮忙的。他没准能给你些东西补偿你的劳动。

original: I can take care of your little problem for you.
translation: 我可以帮你解决你的小麻烦。

original: I wish you luck. You'll want to talk to Chief Gustavo first. He may be able to lend you a soldier or two.
translation: 祝你好运。你应该和古斯塔沃长官谈谈。他没准能借你一两个士兵。

original: I can take care of this problem once and for all.
translation: 我可以一劳永逸地解决这个麻烦。

original: Really? Perhaps you can. We'd all be terribly grateful. Chief Gustavo will want to know you're willing to help.
translation: 真的？或许你能做到。那我们都将十分感谢。古斯塔沃长官很乐意知道你愿意提供帮助的。

original: I can handle those Ghouls.
translation: 我可以搞定那些僵尸。

original: Hmm. You're certainly welcome to try, aren't you? Talk to Chief Gustavo.
translation: 噢。试试总是好的，不是吗？去和古斯塔沃长官谈谈。

original: I might be able to solve this problem.
translation: 我可以解决这个问题。

original: Excellent. Speak with comrade Gustavo. He'll know what to do.
translation: 太好了。去和古斯塔沃同志谈谈。他知道怎么做。

original: I think I can help with your Ghoul problem...
translation: 我想我可以帮你解决僵尸的问题……

original: Really? Chief Gustavo is going to want to hear about that. You should talk to him right away.
translation: 真的？古斯塔沃长官正想听这些。你应该立刻和他谈谈。

original: Don't worry. I'll take care of the problem.
translation: 别担心。我可以解决这个麻烦。

original: You're something else. Not like these other losers.
translation: 你不一样，你不像那些失败者。

original: I'll take care of those Ghouls. Stop worrying about it.
translation: 我可以搞定这些僵尸。别烦心了。

original: Hmm. We might get to be friends after all. You're not so bad.
translation: 嗯。我们最后可能成为朋友。你并不太坏。

original: I'll take care of those Ghouls. Stop worrying about it.
translation: 我可以搞定这些僵尸。别烦心了。

original: Aha! An adventurous soul like myself. If I wasn't retired, I might come with you myself.
translation: 啊哈！像我这样爱冒险的灵魂。要是我还没退休，说不定就亲自跟你去了。

original: I can take care of this Ghoul situation, no problem.
translation: 我能处理好这些尸鬼的麻烦，小意思。

original: If you can do a better job than Chief Gustavo, perhaps you can go enlighten him. I have important matters to attend to. If you'll excuse me?
translation: 如果你能比古斯塔沃长官做得更好，或许你可以给他些指导。我还有别的要事要办。不介意吧？

original: Contained? Don't you want a permanent solution?
translation: 抑制恶化？难道你不想一劳永逸的解决问题吗？

original: About these Ghouls...
translation: 那些尸鬼...

original: That damn Roy Phillips won't take no for an answer. Keeps showing up, looking for a handout. He and his kind aren't wanted. End of story.
translation: 该死的罗伊·菲利普斯可不接受不行这个答案。常来寻求施舍，自讨没趣。他和他那类东西是不会被我们接受的。故事结束。

original: If I were a betting man, I'd place a stack of caps on him trying something violent soon.
translation: 如果我是赌鬼，我会把大把的钱押在他身上，赌他要不了多久就会使用暴力。

original: And that would make Tenpenny nervous. I don't like it when Tenpenny gets nervous.
translation: 那会让特佩尼紧张。特佩尼紧张的时候，我可不喜欢。

original: But I can't spare the manpower to go hunt down Roy Phillips and his band of misfits, or I'd gladly end this thing once and for all.
translation: 但是我不够人手去清除掉罗伊·菲利普斯和他那帮废物，否则我会很高兴地结束这件事。

original: How's that Ghoul situation coming along?
translation: 僵尸的问题进展如何？

original: If they got in here, they'd get their filth over everything. You can smell them a mile away!
translation: 要是他们住了进来，那这儿的一切都会被弄得污秽不堪。你能在一里外闻到他们的臭味！

original: I hope they come back and get killed by security.
translation: 我希望他们回来，然后被警卫干掉。

original: Are you afraid of the Ghouls trying to get into Tenpenny?
translation: 对于那些僵尸试图进入特配尼大厦，你害怕吗？

original: They were told they can't live here. But those zombies are too stupid to understand.
translation: 我们已经说过他们不能住进来。但是这些丧尸太愚蠢，听不明白。

original: They live in their own filth, squatting in the nearby metro tunnel. Security keeps shooting them, but they keep coming back.
translation: 他们住在他们的垃圾堆里，蜗居在附近的地铁隧道里。警卫见到他们就朝他们射击，但是他们总是又跑回来。

original: Are you worried about those Ghouls?
translation: 你担心那些僵尸吗？

original: Don't you worry about any such thing, sir. Care to wet your whistle?
translation: 你不担心这样的事吗，先生。有什么打算吗？

original: You know anything about those Ghouls trying to get in here?
translation: 你知道关于想进住的那些僵尸的事吗？

original: I'm sure it will end in bloodshed. It's serious business, comrade.
translation: 我肯定这事最后会造成流血冲突。这是很严肃的事情，同志。

original: What do you think of the whole situation with the Ghouls?
translation: 你怎么看待这个僵尸的问题？

original: They're living in the nearby tunnels. They scare me!
translation: 他们住在附近的隧道里。他们让我感到害怕！

original: Why doesn't somebody do something!
translation: 为什么没人去解决这事！

original: You know anything about these Ghouls?
translation: 你知道关于那些僵尸的事吗？

original: Are you going to do something about the problem, or not?
translation: 你要去把这问题解决掉，是吧？

original: Those Ghouls sure have people worked up, don't they?
translation: 那些僵尸确实让人烦躁，是吧？

original: Some Ghouls moved into the nearby Metro tunnel. There's a bunch of the so-called Feral Ghouls in there, but a handful seem the sociable type.
translation: 有一群尸鬼搬进了附近的地铁隧道。里面大部分是所谓的“狂尸鬼”，但也有少数看起来能正常交流的。

original: I've tried explaining to my fellow tenants that not all Ghouls are monsters. But they don't seem to care.
translation: 我试着跟其他住户解释并非所有尸鬼都是怪物。但他们似乎根本不在乎。

original: The intelligent ones should stay away from our trigger happy protectors. If there're enough feral ones though, they could overwhelm security.
translation: 有智慧的本应远离我们这些爱扣扳机的保安。但要是发狂的数量够多，他们可能会突破安保。

original: I bet you know a thing or two about those Ghouls...
translation: 我赌你对那些尸鬼的事知道一二……

original: We have the situation... contained.
translation: 我们已经抑制了情况……的恶化。

original: Are you doing something about those Ghouls?
translation: 你会为这僵尸问题做点什么吗？

original: Chief Gustavo assures us that he's increased the number of the security team, and will kill any zombies on sight.
translation: 古斯塔沃长官向我们保证，他已增派安保队，见到丧尸即刻击毙。

original: Those Ghouls have you stressed out, too?
translation: 那些尸鬼也让你神经紧绷？

original: We haven't discussed this already? Apparently there's a pack of zombies living in the tunnels. Gustavo says he has it under control.
translation: 我们还没谈过这事吗？显而易见，隧道里住着一群丧尸。古斯塔沃说他已经控制了局势。

original: On the bright side, it's given me another reason to hit the drink!
translation: 令人高兴，这给了我们另一个干杯的理由！

original: I don't suppose you know much about those Ghouls?
translation: 我猜你不是很了解那些僵尸？

original: There's a pack of zombies living nearby in some old tunnel. They asked to move in. Naturally, they were told to go to hell.
translation: 有一群丧尸住在附近的旧隧道里。他们想住进来。当然，我们叫他们滚蛋。

original: Gustavo's hired some additional goons. Seems to be working. Still, makes one a bit fidgety having those loathsome creatures around.
translation: 古斯塔沃另外雇了些警卫。似乎有点用。不过，这些讨厌的僵尸在周围游荡仍然让我们不安。

original: I wouldn't even want them as slaves!
translation: 让他们当奴隶我都不要！

original: Do you know anything useful about those Ghouls?
translation: 你知道关于那些僵尸有用的事吗？

original: Again with the Ghouls! It's all anyone will gossip about. I can't help thinking about them... doing things to us. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 又是这些僵尸！每个人都在交头接耳地谈论。我也禁不住总是想像他们……给我们惹麻烦。还是谈谈其他事吧。

original: Hear anything interesting about the Ghouls?
translation: 听说过那些僵尸的趣事吗？

original: My current theory is that the destructive disease of the Ghoul condition will always eventually render him little more than a mindless killer.
translation: 我现在的理论认为僵尸身体所受的严重缺陷最终会导致他变成一个冷血的杀手。

original: The proverbial Wasteland "zombie"  with a predilection for raw human flesh.
translation: 众所周知，废土上的“丧尸”嗜好吃活人肉。

original: They can't be cured. And there's nothing to alleviate the symptoms. All in all, it seems rather sad, really.
translation: 他们不能被治愈。也没什么东西能减轻他们的症状。总而言之，他们真的很可悲。

original: Know much about those Ghouls?
translation: 知道什么关于那些僵尸的事吗？

original: What's it like living at Tenpenny Tower?
translation: 住在特佩尼大厦感觉如何？

original: Tenpenny is always on time with the money. And we get fairly comfortable digs with side benefits.
translation: 特佩尼收钱总是很及时。但我们相应的得到安全舒适的住所。

original: It's a piece of Utopia jutting up from the Wasteland. Tenpenny is a true visionary. I do my part to assist him in unfolding his Master Plan.
translation: 这儿就像是废土中的乌托邦。特佩尼是个真正的梦想家。我尽职尽责帮他扩展他的宏伟蓝图。

original: This tower is the symbol of true progress in this world! People are dying to get in here. Just ask those Ghouls.
translation: 这大厦真是世界进步的象征！人们拼了命也想住进来。比如那些僵尸。

original: It's a great place to live. I've always dreamed of giving people fresh meals, and a place to relax and enjoy a good conversation or two.
translation: 这是个非常不错的住所。我一直梦想给人们新鲜食物，和一个能享受人与人轻松交流的住所。

original: Tenpenny gave me a place to do that. I'm greatly indebted to him for that.
translation: 特佩尼给我一个地方住。我衷心感谢他。

original: Well it's a great place to live... IF you don't mind GHOULS breathing down your neck.
translation: 这是个不错的住所……如果你不介意僵尸在你身边游荡。

original: It's THE place to live. The only place one finds any modicum of civilization and breeding.
translation: 只有这地方才配叫作居所。唯一一个能够感受到文明和教养的地方。

original: Of course those Ghouls are trying to move in here. Can you fancy that? Disgusting zombies? Living in a place like this? Ahahaha! Really now!
translation: 那些僵尸当然也想要搬进来。你能想象吗？恶心的丧尸？住在这？哈哈哈！真的无法想象！

original: Things haven't been the same since those Ghouls showed up. Has everyone on edge.
translation: 从那些僵尸出现后，事情就和以前不同了。现在大家都有点神经紧张。

original: Tenpenny is a classy place. Just look at me. Look at my shop. Can't find top shelf class like that anywhere else.
translation: 特佩尼大厦是个有格调的地方。看看我。再看看我的商店。其他任何地方都不能找到这种顶级的摆设。

original: People are healthy here, they eat well and have a strong roof over their head.
translation: 人们在这很健康，他们吃的好，还有一个坚实的楼顶遮风避雨。

original: Only those deserving to live here can afford it. And let me tell you, those who do, live in style!
translation: 只有那些真正属于这的人才能负担得起房租。而且让我告诉你，他们过得真的很奢华！

original: Well comrade, things are great. The best of the best have made a community here.
translation: 同志，这儿一切都很好。最好的就是这儿成了一个公社。

original: Well, there is that problem with the Ghouls. But I think it'll be solved soon enough.
translation: 好吧，这里因为僵尸而出了点小问题。但我想很快就会解决。

original: It's very clean and safe here. Well, mostly safe. They say those Ghouls won't get in. But I don't know.
translation: 这非常干净，而且安全。好吧，几乎很安全。他们说那些僵尸不会进来。但我不知道。

original: Beats living out there in Wasteland, trust me. See, I'm not like these other puffed up fogies. I earned my way into privilege. I worked to get here.
translation: 废土和这儿根本不能比，相信我。还有，我不象那些自高自大的老顽固。我的舒适生活都是我自己挣来的。我努力工作才有机会来这。

original: Well, until recently the only danger you ever faced in this fine establishment, was bumping into all the bloated egos floating around.
translation: 嗯，直到最近为止，你在这栋高级公寓里遇到的唯一危险，就是可能会碰到那些趾高气扬的自大狂。

original: But now there's a group of Ghouls nearby. I've tried explaining that they don't ALL want to eat you - though SOME do, of course.
translation: 但现在附近出现了一群尸鬼。我试着解释过，并非所有尸鬼都想吃掉你——当然了，确实有一部分会。

original: Problem is, it's hard to tell which is which. Chief Gustavo has initiated a shoot first and ask later policy. If they're smart, they'll stay away.
translation: 问题是，很难分辨谁是哪类。古斯塔沃长官已经推行了“先开枪后问话”的策略。如果他们够聪明，就该离远点。

original: "I'm sorry" isn't good enough.
translation: “对不起”可不够。

original: I'm afraid there's nothing else I can offer. When Project Purity is finished, we can sit down and really talk. I'd like to work through this.
translation: 恐怕现在我没有什么可以告诉你的。等搞定净水工程，我们可以坐下来好好谈谈。我想先完成工作。

original: For now, I need to return to Rivet City. There's still much to do.
translation: 现在，我要回铆钉城。这还有很多事做。

original: Yeah, well... Don't do it again.
translation: 嗯，好吧……别再这么干了。

original: I assure you, I won't. I'm going to need your help.
translation: 我保证，我不会了。我还需要你的帮助。

original: Now that I have what I came for, I need to get to Rivet City right away.
translation: 现在我该走了，我要立刻去铆钉城。

original: I don't think so.
translation: 我不那么想。

original: Your call, kid.
translation: 你决定吧，孩子。

original: Go for the top shelf. On me. <Give 20 caps.>
translation: 最好的酒，我请客。<给予20个瓶盖>

original: Whoa, twenty caps! Look at the big spender! Alright then, I can see you're in it for the big money, so I'll tell you all about Moriarty's.
translation: 哇，20个瓶盖！看看这大富翁！好吧，看在你出这钱的份上，我会告诉你所有莫里亚蒂的事。

original: Moriarty, he's a ratfuck bastard for sure, but he's also paranoid as all hell. So paranoid that he don't let no one handle the cash around here.
translation: 莫里亚蒂就是他妈个混蛋，也是他妈个偏执狂，所以他不会让任何人碰他的钱。

original: Every night, he takes what Gob and Nova earn and locks it in a file cabinet next to his bed.
translation: 每天晚上，他拿走盖博和诺瓦赚的钱，锁到他床边的一个柜子里。

original: Don't you know how a bribe works? You give me money, and I give you information. In order to do that, you have to have money. Christ. Kids!
translation: 你知道什么叫贿赂吗？你给我钱，我给你信息。要这么做，你必须有钱。老天啊。这孩子！

original: This should buy you something. <Give 10 caps.>
translation: 拿这钱去买点什么。<给予10个瓶盖>

original: Ha ha! You're gonna have to do better than that, kid! Thanks for the drink, though.
translation: 哈哈！孩子，你其实应该再大方一点！不管怎么样，谢谢这杯喝的。

original: You're kidding. You don't have 10 caps? What kind of asshole doesn't even have ten fucking caps?
translation: 你开玩笑吧，连10个瓶盖都没有？什么东西，这点钱都没有？

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Quit bothering me with all this nonsense.
translation: 别拿你那些破事烦我了。

original: You're giving me a headache. Isn't there someone else you can pester with your inane ideas?
translation: 你真让我头疼。你不能用你的蠢主意去烦其他人吗？

original: Who let you in here in the first place? Does Mister Tenpenny know there's a lunatic walking around his tower?
translation: 谁让你来这顶级住所的？特佩尼先生知道这有个神经病在大厦附近游荡吗？

original: Um-hmm. Would you mind bothering someone else? PLEASE!
translation: 噢。你不介意去烦别人吧？请滚吧！

original: Why do you keep bothering me?
translation: 为什么你老是烦我？

original: What if all your other neighbors agree?
translation: 要是你的邻居全都同意呢？

original: Don't care. The only way those Ghoul's are getting in is over my dead body.
translation: 那不关我事。除非我死了，不然僵尸别想进来。

original: Ha! I know EVERYTHING about my neighbors, some things they don't even know themselves. I'm certain that they won't agree to this ridiculous idea.
translation: 哈！我知道邻居们的所有事情，有些事甚至连他们自己都不知道。我有把握他们不会同意这荒谬的主意。

original: And even if they did, I certainly won't!
translation: 而且就算他们同意，我也绝对不同意！

original: Then my neighbors will have lost their minds. Just like you have. Now go away.
translation: 原来我的邻居疯了，和你一样。滚吧。

original: If my neighbors lose their minds and agree to such a thing, then I hope security shoots them in the head with their zombie friends.
translation: 如果我的邻居疯到同意这事，那我希望警卫用枪把他们连着他们的丧尸朋友一起打死。

original: There's no way they'd agree to letting Ghouls live here. We all came here to get away from things like Ghouls, and disease, and all that ugliness.
translation: 他们绝不可能同意让僵尸住进来。我们来这都是为了躲开僵尸、疾病和所有其他丑陋的东西。

original: Good luck.
translation: 好运。

original: You'll get yours.
translation: 你会遭报应的。

original: Yeah right. Watch your back.
translation: 对极了。你给我当心点。

original: When I die, it'll be your fault.
translation: 要是我死了，那就是你的错。

original: Whatever. My death will be on your head.
translation: 好吧。我就是被你害死的。

original: I got a plan. I'll talk to Tenpenny. I bet I can live in Burke's place. He's never around anyway.
translation: 我有个想法。我要和特佩尼谈谈。我打赌我能住进伯克的房间。反正他一直都不在。

original: And when he does come back, I'll make sure he's fine with the new arrangement.
translation: 要是哪天他真的回来了，我会让他对新的安排满意的。

original: I'll just send up for my food. I'll never even have to look at you or your Ghoul buddies.
translation: 我会叫他们把吃的送上来。这样我就不用看见你和你那些僵尸伙计。

original: I don't care. Get your stuff together and get out of here.
translation: 不关我事。拿着你的东西走人吧。

original: I never forget a slight. Watch your back. I'll be sending someone to pay you a little visit in the future.
translation: 我不会忘记的，你给我小心。以后我会不断派人去找你的麻烦。

original: My husband has connections. Watch your back.
translation: 我丈夫可有点关系，你给我小心。

original: Just you wait. I'll find a way to repay you for this.
translation: 你等着。我会想办法收拾你的。

original: You'll pay for this. Dearly.
translation: 你要付出代价。非常高昂的代价。

original: I'm not going. I'll talk to Tenpenny. I bet I can live in Burke's place. He's never around anyway.
translation: 我哪也不会去的。我要和特佩尼谈谈。我打赌我能住进伯克的房间。反正他一直都不在。

original: And when he does come back, I'll make sure he's fine with the new arrangement.
translation: 要是哪天他真的回来了，我会让他对新的安排满意的。

original: I'll just send up for my food. I'll never even have to look at you or your Ghoul buddies.
translation: 我会叫他们把吃的送上来。这样我就不用看见你和你那些僵尸伙计。

original: I'm sure you'll find something suitable, don't worry.
translation: 我有把握你能找到合适的地方住，别担心。

original: I found a comfortable place, but now I must leave. When I die, it will be on your head.
translation: 我已经找到了个舒服的地方，但是现在我必须离开。要是我死了，责任全在你身上。

original: I already did. I hope one of your Ghoul buddies kills you. You'll see!
translation: 我已经找到了。我真希望你的僵尸朋友会干掉你。等着瞧吧！

original: Don't worry? Did you just step out of a vault? Haven't you seen what's out there? I'm doomed. And it's all your fault!
translation: 别担心？你刚从避难所出来吗？你不知道外面多糟糕吗？我要完蛋了。这都是你的错！

original: The only suitable place is Tenpenny Tower. Everywhere else stinks and caters to low-life scum like you. I'll die out there. I just know it.
translation: 唯一适合我住的地方就是特佩尼大厦。别的地方都臭气熏天，只适合你这样的低等人渣。

original: I'm not going anywhere. I'll talk to Tenpenny. I bet I can live in Burke's place. He's never around anyway.
translation: 我哪也不会去的。我要和特佩尼谈谈。我打赌我能住进伯克的房间。反正他一直都不在。

original: And when he does come back, I'll make sure he's fine with the new arrangement.
translation: 要是哪天他真的回来了，我会让他对新的安排满意的。

original: I'll just send up for my food. I'll never even have to look at you or your Ghoul buddies.
translation: 我会叫他们把吃的送上来。这样我就不用看见你和你那些僵尸伙计。

original: This is happening. You're going to have to deal with it, or get forced out.
translation: 这已经是既成事实了。你要么接受它，要么独力反对它。

original: This is outrageous! Preposterous! Forced out by a bunch of dirty Ghouls, and some bleeding heart activist? Where will I live? How will I get there?
translation: 这是蛮横的！残暴的！被一群肮脏的僵尸和一些软心肠的活动家赶出去？我该住哪去？我又该怎么过去？

original: Damn it! This can't be happening! Why do you think I came here in the first place? To get away from Ghouls, monsters, and scum like you.
translation: 该死！别妄想了！知道为什么我当初要住进这豪华住所吗？就是为了离僵尸、怪物还有你这样的人渣远点！

original: Now I'll have to start all over again. Where will I go?
translation: 现在我又要重新开始。我能去哪？

original: You horrible little zombie-lover! What right do you and your disgusting buddies have to push honest, hardworking, important people around like that?
translation: 你这恶心的丧尸爱好者！谁给你和你恶心的伙伴权力来这样逼迫诚实勤奋的劳动者？

original: Where do you propose I live?
translation: 你打算让我住哪？

original: Grrr. You'll regret this. I've spent years collecting all this fabulous merchandise. I won't stand for this! Where the hell am I supposed to go?
translation: 啊啊。你会后悔的。我花费了多年才收集了这么多的精品家当。我不能忍受这样的待遇！见鬼，我该去哪？

original: I'm done with the Wasteland! And I've been everywhere else. There isn't anything better than this. Damn you and your Ghouls!
translation: 我不想再在废土上流离！我去过废土每一个角落。再没有地方比这更好了。肏你和你的僵尸！

original: Would you tell Mister Tenpenny that you wouldn't mind Ghoul neighbors?
translation: 你会告诉特佩尼先生你不介意尸鬼做邻居吗？

original: I guess so. Sure.
translation: 我想是的。肯定。

original: What the hell? Sure.
translation: 有什么难的？当然可以。

original: Sure. No problem.
translation: 好的。没问题。

original: Alright, comrade. We'll welcome them into the community.
translation: 好的，同志。我们欢迎他们加入这个公社。

original: I guess so.
translation: 我想是的。

original: Of course! I wonder if they've ever been to Underworld. Now there's an interesting vacation destination!
translation: 当然！我奇怪他们没有去过地下城。现在那是个有趣的度假胜地！

original: Damn it! Whatever... I'll freaking sign it. They can move into my old place. Burke's digs are better than mine anyway. Not that you'll lever know!
translation: 该死！随便…… 我都会同意的。他们可以搬进我以前的住处。伯克的那块地方毕竟比我以前的要好的多。这你是永远也想象不到的！

original: I must say, you can be quite the bore. Run along and pester someone else.
translation: 我必须说，你真的十分烦人。走开去烦其他人吧。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Are you done wasting my time?
translation: 你是来浪费我时间的吗？

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Apathy is a condition of the present blight. In the future men will have passion and ideals again. Like Mister Tenpenny. Now, if you'll excuse me.
translation: 冷漠是精神抑郁的一个原因。将来人们会重拾激情和理想的，就像特佩尼先生。现在我要失陪一下。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: You're a little weird, aren't you?
translation: 你有点怪，对吧？

original: Perhaps.
translation: 或许吧。

original: You're the one that asked the question. If you don't mind, I'd like to get another drink.
translation: 你是个爱问问题的人。如果你不介意，我想独自再喝杯酒。

original: Perhaps.
translation: 或许吧。

original: Don't you have somewhere else you can go? Must you bother me?
translation: 你没别的地方去吗？非得缠着我吗？

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: I don't suppose you can find someone else to talk to?
translation: 你找不到别人聊天吗？

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: My time is very important to me. I don't suppose you can waste your's somewhere else?
translation: 我的时间对我来说很宝贵。你找不到别的地方消磨时间了吗？

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Is there something I can help you with? If not, why don't you find somewhere else to be?
translation: 有什么我可以帮你的吗？如果没有，你为什么不去其他地方待着？

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Don't you have something better to do?
translation: 你没什么别的事做吗？

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: I have something to do, comrade. If you'll excuse me...
translation: 我有事要做，同志。我失陪了……

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: I just remembered I need to be someplace else.
translation: 我刚想起来我要去其他地方。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Has anyone told you how annoying you are?
translation: 没人告诉你你有多烦人吗？

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Don't start conversations you aren't interested in finishing.
translation: 不要提起你没兴趣说完的话题。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Well, that's how most people feel, certainly. Talk to Security Chief Gustavo. He's managing the "Ghoul situation."
translation: 好吧，那当然是大多数人的感受。去找古斯塔沃长官吧，他处理僵尸的事情。

original: I was just kidding! Those zombies need to be killed!
translation: 我只是在开玩笑！那些丧尸应该被杀光！

original: So why the hell would you even suggest such a retarded idea? Are you done wasting my time?
translation: 见鬼，为什么提出一个这么弱智的建议啊？你在浪费我的时间吗？

original: Yeah, Ghouls don't belong here.
translation: 没错，僵尸不属于这。

original: It best not to dwell on such things.
translation: 不要再想这些事了。

original: In time, after Tenpenny's projects have come to fruition, things like Ghouls and other deformations nature will be a thing of the past.
translation: 到时候，等到特佩尼的计划完成后，像僵尸和变形怪物都将成为历史。

original: Ghouls are disgusting, aren't they?
translation: 僵尸让人恶心，不是吗？

original: I agree, though I wonder if they can help it. They seem rather pathetic, don't they? It seems like a horrible way to have to live.
translation: 我同意，尽管我怀疑他们能否同意。僵尸看起来相当可怜，不是吗？看起来活得很惨。

original: You're right. Ghouls are disgusting.
translation: 你说得对，僵尸让人恶心。

original: So I've heard. I have to wonder though, if they are all mindless killing machines, why do some of them want to be treated like humans so badly?
translation: 我听说过。我也奇怪，如果他们都是没有大脑的杀人机器，为什么他们中一些人还那么想得到和人类一样的待遇呢？

original: It's wise to be afraid of Ghouls. They'll kill you when you aren't looking.
translation: 害怕僵尸是很明智的。他们会趁你不注意的时候杀了你。

original: Indeed they are. Someone really should put them all out of there misery, don't you think?
translation: 确实。人们确实应该把他们从凄惨的生活中解救出来，对吧？

original: Yeah. Ghouls are disgusting creatures.
translation: 是啊。僵尸是种恶心的生物。

original: So why would you even suggest they live here? Or were you kidding?
translation: 为什么你竟然建议让他们住在这？或许你是在玩笑吧？

original: Hahaha! That's funny.
translation: 哈哈哈！太滑稽了。

original: Yeah. Ghouls are disgusting creatures.
translation: 是啊。僵尸是种恶心的生物。

original: I'm not afraid. Just cautious. But perhaps you're right. It's better not to take chances.
translation: 我不害怕，只是小心为上。但是可能你是对的，但最好不要靠运气。

original: You're a wise man, Banfield. Ghouls are meant to be feared.
translation: 你是个明白人，班菲尔德。人们就是该恐惧僵尸。

original: Quite right. Perhaps you're not as stupid as you seem.
translation: 非常对。可能你不像看上去那么愚蠢。

original: Yeah, Ghouls would make horrible neighbors.
translation: 是啊。僵尸会成为可怕的邻居。

original: You don't have to tell me that.
translation: 你不必告诉我那些。

original: Yeah. Ghouls are disgusting creatures.
translation: 是啊。僵尸是种恶心的生物。

original: Indeed, comrade. Indeed. I wonder though, if they might also need their own community?
translation: 真的，同志。我真的疑惑，可能他们需要他们自己的公社？

original: It's wise to be afraid of Ghouls.
translation: 害怕僵尸是明智的举动。

original: I think so. I mean, something that ugly must be evil... right?
translation: 我这样想的。我的意思是，丑东西一定邪恶……对吧？

original: It's wise to be afraid of Ghouls.
translation: 害怕僵尸是明智的举动。

original: They sure are, so why suggest they move in here? Or, were you joking? Well, you aren't very funny.
translation: 他们一定是，为什么你竟然建议让他们住在这？或许你是在玩笑吧？你这玩笑并不很好笑。

original: Yeah. Ghouls are disgusting creatures.
translation: 是啊。僵尸是种恶心的生物。

original: Yes. Many will chew off your arm if given the chance. It's true. But they aren't all bad.
translation: 是的。如果你给机会，他们会蜂拥而上咬断你的四肢。真的。不过他们不都是坏人。

original: It's wise to be afraid of Ghouls.
translation: 害怕僵尸是明智的举动。

original: Ha! I don't suppose I'd mind terribly if Ghouls were to live here. And it'd be a good bit of sport hunting them down if they misbehaved.
translation: 哈！我在想我允许僵尸住进来后会出现什么麻烦。如果他们犯错的话，那会是个不错的狩猎机会的。

original: I dare say though, you'll have a bit of trouble convincing certain residents to go along with your novel proposition.
translation: 我敢这么说，要是你去游说住客同意你天方夜谭式的想法的话，会惹大麻烦的。

original: Tell you what. If you can convince  Mr. and Mrs. Wellington, Mr. Ling, Ms. Montenegro, and Ms. Lancaster, those Ghouls can live here.
translation: 告诉你吧。如果你能说服威灵顿夫妇，林先生，黑山小姐和兰卡斯特小姐，那些僵尸就可以住进来。

original: Have you seen me shoot? I'm quite proficient, if I do say so myself.
translation: 没见过我射击吗？如果让我评价自己的话,我会说非常的准。

original: What if the residents are okay with Ghoul neighbors?
translation: 如果这的居民同意僵尸做邻居又如何？

original: He'd be out of his goddamn mind... but like I said. Ultimately I work for him, so whatever he says, goes. But I wouldn't like it.
translation: 他疯了……但就像我说过的，最终我得为他工作了，所以他说什么，我都去做。但是我并不愿意。

original: What if Tenpenny will let Ghouls live here?
translation: 如果特配尼让那些僵尸住进来又怎么样？

original: In time, after Tenpenny's projects have come to fruition, things like ghouls and other aberrations of nature will be a thing of the past.
translation: 到时候，特佩尼的计划完成后，象僵尸和变形怪物都将成为历史。

original: These times are the crucible for a glorious future. One shouldn't be overly concerned with who gets burned in the process.
translation: 这些都是对我们实现美好未来的严酷考验。人们不必关心在这过程中受伤的人。

original: Tenpenny seems rather heartless.
translation: 特配尼看起来更无情。

original: I don't know. As long as they don't cause trouble. And they'd have to try to fit in with our established community.
translation: 我不知道。只要他们不惹麻烦，而且能融入我们已经成立的公社就好。

original: I guess I'd be willing to give it a try.
translation: 我想我会乐于一试。

original: What if they kept themselves clean and didn't bother anyone?
translation: 那如果他们不打扰其他人呢？

original: Really? Well... As long as they don't bother me... I guess,  I really don't care.
translation: 真的？好吧…… 只要他们不打扰我……我想，我真的不在乎。

original: I've met these Ghouls. They're civilized and pose no threat.
translation: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很文明，没有什么威胁。

original: I'm afraid that I can't abide by that. I can't imagine Tenpenny would allow it. But I certainly won't.
translation: 我担心我能否忍受。我不能想象特佩尼会同意。但是我可以不去想象。

original: I've met these Ghouls. They're civilized and pose no threat.
translation: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很文明，没有什么威胁。

original: Ha! I think I know a fair share more than some vagrant blown in off the Wastes. You are simply mistaken.
translation: 哈！我想我认为公平分享要比在废土流浪要好吧。你犯了个小错。

original: They may appear nice, but deep down they want to kill. It's common knowledge among the educated.
translation: 他们看着不错，但是内心深处，他们想杀人。从以往的经验看，这是显而易见的。

original: You clearly don't know what you are talking about!
translation: 你完全不知道你在说什么！

original: I've met these Ghouls. They're civilized and pose no threat.
translation: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很文明，没有什么威胁。

original: Well... If they don't mind me giving them a thorough exam and if they agree to follow any directives I give them regarding health and hygiene...
translation: 好吧……如果他们不介意我给他们作彻底的检查，还有如果他们同意遵从我的任何指导，包括健康和卫生方面……

original: I suppose I wouldn't mind too terribly. It'd give me a chance to study Ghoul physiology.
translation: 我想我并不特别介意。这也给我机会研究僵尸生理学。

original: I've met these ghouls. They seem healthy. All things considered.
translation: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很文明，没有什么威胁。

original: I think you must have been out in the sun too long. Perhaps I could sell you a nice hat to keep your brain from frying?
translation: 我想你一定是在太阳下待的时间太久了。看来我可以卖你一个不错的帽子，防止你的脑袋烤晕？

original: I've met these Ghouls. They're civilized and pose no threat.
translation: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很文明，没有什么威胁。

original: Why would you hang out with dirty vermin like that? You enjoy sifting through feces?
translation: 你为什么不和那些肮脏的歹徒住在一起？你很享受泡在粪池里的感觉吧？

original: You know it's only a matter of time before they get hungry and eat you. You're crazy. Ghouls will never live in Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 你要知道他们因为饿了而来吃你只是时间问题。你疯了。僵尸决不能住进特佩尼大厦。

original: I've met these Ghouls. They're civilized and pose no threat.
translation: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很文明，没有什么威胁。

original: Well, perhaps you're right, comrade. Some of these folk have a few things to learn about camaraderie, that's for sure.
translation: 好吧，可能你是对的，同志。这些家伙需要学习友情，一定要学。

original: Well... alright. I'm willing to give them a chance.
translation: 好吧……好的。我愿意给他们一个机会。

original: Comrade, I've met these ghouls. They seem friendly enough. More than this lot.
translation: 同志，我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很友好。比起大多数人类来说。

original: Well... you seem like you know what you're talking about. I guess I'd be willing to give it a try. I might not spend much time with them.
translation: 好吧……你好像知道你在说什么。我想我愿意给你个机会试试。我可能不会花太多时间和他们在一起。

original: And if they do anything stupid, I'm sure they'll get kicked out. Fine, it's ok.
translation: 如果他们做任何愚蠢的事情，我一定把他们踢出去。好的，没问题。

original: I've met these Ghouls. They seem friendly enough.
translation: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很友好。

original: Well, if you don't mind their stink, then you should go squat with them in their dirty tunnels, and leave us civilized people alone.
translation: 好吧，如果你不介意他们身上的臭味，那么你就和他们蹲到肮脏的隧道里去吧，离开我们这些文明人。

original: I've met these Ghouls. They aren't so bad.
translation: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来没那么坏。

original: Like I said, it's fine by me.
translation: 像我说的，我认为那不错。

original: So you wouldn't mind if some civilized Ghouls moved in?
translation: 你不介意这些文明的僵尸搬进来？

original: How would you feel about having a few Ghoul neighbors?
translation: 有几个尸鬼做邻居你觉得怎么样？

original: HELL NO! Tenpenny won't allow it. And I take my orders from him.
translation: 见鬼，不行！特佩尼不会允许的，我听命于他。

original: After Tenpenny died, I assumed full command. And since I hate Ghouls, I guess the answer to that question is pretty damn clear.
translation: 特佩尼死后，我全权负责。因为我恨僵尸，所以我猜你能非常他妈的清楚我会回答你什么。

original: Those Ghouls can live here over my goddamn body!
translation: 那些该死的僵尸要住进来，只能跨过我的尸体！

original: I spend most of my days out acquiring and managing various... assets for Mister Tenpenny. So it matter's little to me personally.
translation: 我每天花费我大多数的时间来为特佩尼先生寻觅和管理那些各种各样的……资产。所以那些僵尸对我个人来说不太重要。

original: However, the Ghoulish state is a bitter reminder that things aren't yet in line with Mister Tenpenny's vision for a pure and stainless future.
translation: 不管怎样，僵尸的凄惨状况，提醒我们事情并没圆满到像特佩尼先生展望的那纯净无瑕的美好未来。

original: So you see, Ghouls living here is simply out of the question.
translation: 你也知道，让僵尸住在这简直不可能的。

original: I know you've been pressuring people into allowing Ghouls to live here.
translation: 我知道你在给大家施压，想让僵尸住进来。

original: Who do you think you are, harassing honest people like that? You should be ashamed of yourself! I certainly won't allow Ghouls to live here.
translation: 你以为你是谁，这样打扰正直的人们？你应该为你感到羞耻，我当然不允许僵尸住进来。

original: My neighbors might be out of their minds, but I am not. Those Ghouls will NOT be living here.
translation: 我的邻居可能疯了，但我没有。那些僵尸不能住进来。

original: Ah yes. I was wondering when you'd try me.
translation: 是的。我正在想，你什么时候会来问我。

original: You may be able to coerce the others, but I'm not such a pushover. Your zombie buddies will need to find someplace else to live.
translation: 你可以去强迫其他人，但我不是懦夫。你的丧尸伙伴还是找其他地方。

original: It's my turn, eh? Well, you won't be getting me to go along with your ridiculous plan.
translation: 到我了，呃？好吧，你不要妄想我能配合你荒谬的计划。

original: Ghouls aren't human. They live in filth. They eat their own babies. You're out of your right freaking mind!
translation: 僵尸不是人类。他们生活在污秽中。他们吃自己的孩子。你疯了吧！

original: I know all about your plan to get your Ghoul pals in here, and I'm putting a stop to it. You can't just go around pushing us around like that!
translation: 我知道你全盘计划，让你的僵尸伙计住进来，我劝你放弃吧。你不能这样四处活动来强迫我们同意！

original: I've dealt with people like you before... people who think they know what's good for everybody else. I know what's best for me, and that's no Ghouls.
translation: 我以前也这样……人们总以为知道什么对别人好。我知道什么对我最好，其中不包括僵尸。

original: So you can run along and tell your Ghouls they'll just have to find somewhere else to squat. Or better yet, to go off and die somewhere.
translation: 你可以去告诉你的僵尸朋友，他们去找其他地方吧。或者出去死在哪更好。

original: Oh, I know you've been lobbying for those Ghouls... and I've already been thinking it over. I guess I would be willing to give it a try.
translation: 哦，我知道你在四处为那些僵尸游说……我已经想过了。我想我愿意给他们机会。

original: I know you've been talking to the others about the Ghouls... and I've been mulling the whole thing over a few cocktails... well more than a few...
translation: 我知道你一直在和其他人谈僵尸……我得喝几杯鸡尾酒才能搞明白整个事情……可能不止几杯……

original: And I've decided that I'd be willing to give it a go. Having Ghoul neighbors, I mean.
translation: 我决定了，我同意。我意思是同意让他们做邻居。

original: I knew it was only a matter of time before you asked me about that... I've decided I want to do my own study of Ghoul physiology.
translation: 我知道你来问我只是时间问题……我已经决定了我想做我的僵尸生理学研究。

original: Who knows, I could even publish my findings!
translation: 谁知道那，我甚至可能把我的发现出版！

original: You've finally got around to asking me, comrade.
translation: 你最后还是来问我了，同志。

original: I've given it a lot of careful thought. I would welcome these Ghouls into our community.
translation: 我认真想过了。我会欢迎僵尸来我们的公社。

original: I've already formed a welcoming committee!
translation: 我已经成立了个欢迎委员会！

original: It's my turn, eh? I'm still worried, but if the others are willing to let them live here, I guess I could try it. But they better behave!
translation: 到我了，呃？我仍然担心，但是如果其他人愿意让他们住进来，我想我也可以试试让他们进来。但是他们要表现良好！

original: I've heard they carry diseases. I'd have to sanitize everything after them all the time. Besides, they are dangerous, aren't they?
translation: 我听说他们带着疾病。我必须每时每刻都跟在他们后面打扫。而且他们很危险，对吧？
