original: You've heard the stories I'm sure. About the mindless ones eating brains and the like. Well, I'm not sure I'm comfortable with all that.
translation: 我知道你一定听过那些故事。他们随意吃人脑之类的事情。所以和他们一起，我不可能感到舒适。

original: Haha. You're joking right? You're serious? Of course not! Ghouls can't live here. They're dirty loathsome creatures.
translation: 哈哈。你开玩笑吗？你认真的？当然不行了！僵尸不能住这。他们是肮脏讨厌的生物。

original: Dear lord. Are you serious? Ghouls living here? With us? That's simply out of the question.
translation: 上帝。你认真的？僵尸和我们住一起？和我们？这绝不可能。

original: I'm not sure. My first responsibility is the health and welfare of the residents of Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 我不确定。我的首要责任是特佩尼大厦居民的健康和安全。

original: Ghouls often carry diseases due to radiation damaging their immune systems.
translation: 僵尸经常带着疾病，因为辐射破坏了他们的免疫系统。

original: You're being serious? That's out of the question. What an absurd notion!
translation: 你认真的？这不可能。太荒谬了！

original: You can't be serious. Ghouls aren't human. They live in filth. They eat their own babies. You're out of your right freakin' mind!
translation: 你不是认真的吧。僵尸不是人类。他们居住在污秽中。他们吃自己的小孩。你疯了吧！

original: Don't have any data in my files about that.
translation: 我是绝对不会同意的。

original: Ghouls wouldn't make the best of neighbors, comrade.
translation: 僵尸不能成为最好的邻居，同志。

original: I don't know. I mean, they're all deformed and scary looking. I bet they're really mean, too.
translation: 我不知道。我意思是他们都畸形而且丑陋。我敢打赌他们一定很卑鄙。

original: I've come too far to share my digs with some droopy Ghoul!
translation: 我和它们差的太多了，不可能和这些猥琐的僵尸分享住所！

original: Well, I wouldn't mind. But they'd better be civilized. The tenants here are real uppity and most wouldn't take kindly to Ghouls living here.
translation: 好吧，我不介意。但是他们最好文明点。这的住户都很傲慢，而且大多数人对僵尸住在这并不欢迎。

original: I've already told you no!
translation: 我告诉过你，不行！

original: I believe I've told you NO!
translation: 我不是告诉了你不行吗！

original: It's not happening.
translation: 不可能。

original: I will not allow Ghouls to live here.
translation: 我不允许僵尸住这。

original: I'm really tired of you and your Ghoul crusade.
translation: 我真的厌烦了你和你的僵尸运动。

original: I wouldn't mind. It would certainly liven things up around here, that's for sure!
translation: 我不介意。这里生活用品很齐备，没问题！

original: I'm willing to give it a try... On a trial basis.
translation: 我愿意试试……当然是在试试的基础上。

original: Oh what the hell? It's not like anything interesting happens around here anyway.
translation: 噢，搞什么啊？这可不是件有趣的事情啊。

original: It would give me a chance to do my own study of Ghoul physiology.
translation: 那会给我个机会让我进行僵尸生理学研究。

original: It's not really fair to deprive anyone of a community, is it? So we really ought to welcome them as comrades, shouldn't we?
translation: 剥夺任何人进入公社的权力都不公平，不是吗？所以我要欢迎他们来做我们的同志，对吧？

original: If they behave, I suppose it'd be okay with me.
translation: 如果他们表现良好，我想我同意。

original: Okay pops, just hand over the reward and you can get back to your history books.
translation: 老头，把报酬给我，你就能继续研究你的历史文献了。

original: Well! The founding fathers would be disappointed in your fiery tone.
translation: 好吧！国父一定会对你急躁的腔调失望的。

original: However, a deal is a deal. Here is your reward.
translation: 不过我说到做到，这是你的报酬。

original: Thank you, it's quite an honor. Now, for my reward?
translation: 谢谢，这是我的荣幸。那么给我的报酬呢？

original: Please, accept this holotape as a token of my esteem and the esteem of every citizen of the United States.
translation: 请接受这全息磁带。它代表着我的敬意，和全体美国公民的敬意。

original: May it bring you the vocal skills possessed by only the greatest orators of our time.
translation: 愿它能带给你只有我们这时代最伟大的演说家才拥有的发声技巧。

original: I have the Declaration of Independence.
translation: 我有《独立宣言》。

original: Oh my lord, I never expect... I mean, I am utterly shocked!
translation: 噢，天啊，我从没想到……我意思是，我太震惊了！

original: You have earned your place in the annals of American History, yes indeed. You will be remembered for this great day!
translation: 你在美国历史中已经赢得一席之地了。你会和这个伟大的日子一起被铭记！

original: I understand the road was difficult, so allow me to present you with an extra bonus to perhaps whet your appetite for future endeavors.
translation: 我知道世道艰难，所以请收下这额外的报酬，或许能激励你未来能更加努力。

original: Enjoy your reward, my friend. You've earned it.
translation: 享受你的报酬吧，朋友。你应得的。

original: Oh my lord, I never expect... I mean, I am utterly shocked!
translation: 噢，天啊，我从没想到……我意思是，我太震惊了！

original: You have earned your place in the annals of American History, yes indeed. You will be remembered for this great day!
translation: 你在美国历史中已经赢得一席之地了。你会和这个伟大的日子一起被铭记！

original: I understand the road was difficult, so allow me to present you with an extra bonus to perhaps whet your appetite for future endeavors.
translation: 我知道世道艰难，所以请收下这额外的报酬，或许能激励你未来能更加努力。

original: Enjoy your reward, my friend. You've earned it.
translation: 享受你的报酬吧，朋友。你应得的。

original: Get your ass over here if you want to live... and watch out for the mines! Quick, they're coming!
translation: 如果你想活命，就赶快滚开这……然后小心地雷！快点，它们来了！

original: Whatever. A shotgun would have been nice.
translation: 随便了。是把霰弹枪就好了。

original: I'm sorry you feel that way. Maybe you haven't grown up as much as I'd thought. If you don't want it, I'm sure I can find someone who does.
translation: 你那样想我感到遗憾。看来你还没有像我想象的那样长大。如果你不想要，我就找个想要的人。

original: I'm sorry you feel that way. Maybe you haven't grown up as much as I'd thought. If you don't want it, I'm sure I can find someone who does.
translation: 你那样想我感到遗憾。看来你还没有像我想象的那样长大。如果你不想要，我就找个想要的人。

original: I didn't want a stupid BB Gun for my birthday.
translation: 我不想要一把愚蠢的BB枪当我的生日礼物。

original: You're an asshole, Jericho.
translation: 你是个混蛋，耶利哥。

original: You love me.
translation: 你爱我。

original: Funny. I'll take my caps back now.
translation: 有趣。现在我要拿回我的瓶盖。

original: Alright, alright, I'm just fucking with you.
translation: 好啦，好啦，我是在逗你。

original: Hrm... lemme think. No. Consider it a fee for the lesson you've learned -- don't be such a tightass next time.
translation: 嗯……让我想想。不。就把它作为你这次教训的学费 — 下次不要这么吝啬。

original: Thanks for the info, Jericho.
translation: 谢谢你的信息，耶利哥。

original: Anytime. It'll be worth it to see the look on that asshole's face.
translation: 不用谢。看看那混蛋的脸色也值得。

original: Sounds risky. What if he catches me?
translation: 听起来有点冒险。他抓到我怎么办？

original: He'll probably blow your head off. That is, unless you can draw faster than a pissed off Irishman.
translation: 他可能会打掉你的脑袋。当然，除非你跑得比个发飙的爱尔兰人还快。

original: Why haven't you robbed him?
translation: 你为什么不抢他？

original: My robbin' days are over, kid. I'm just here to drink and stink.
translation: 我抢掠的日子结束了，孩子。我只能在这喝酒，发臭。

original: So where's the key?
translation: 那钥匙在哪？

original: It's dangling around Colin's neck. Get it... if you can.
translation: 当然是挂在科林的脖子上。去拿吧……你有这能耐的话。

original: How did you know my father?
translation: 你怎么认识我爸爸的？

original: I have been a part of the Brotherhood for many years. Enough that I was here when Project Purity first began.
translation: 我作为兄弟会的成员很多年了。当净水工程刚开始的时候，我就在那。

original: I did not work directly with your father; he and his team valued their independence, and I respected that.
translation: 我并没有和你的爸爸一起工作；他和他的团队希望独立工作，我尊重他们。

original: Fine, whatever. Let's get to it.
translation: 好的，随便。我们去吧。

original: I find your attitude and lack of respect insulting.
translation: 我发现你的态度无礼，缺乏应有的尊敬。

original: I need to find a G.E.C.K.
translation: 我要找到伊甸园创造器。

original: Are you quite sure? I suspect that would be a waste of time. Regardless, the Brotherhood is not in possession of such a device.
translation: 你确定吗？我怀疑这不过是浪费时间。而且，兄弟会没有这装置。

original: There is, however, a way in which we may be able to ascertain the location of one.
translation: 不过，我们或许有办法确定一个创造器的位置。

original: Really. A pity... You won't find one here.
translation: 真的，抱歉……你在这找不到的。

original: It may be possible to locate one, however.
translation: 不过大概能定位一个。

original: Yeah, yeah. Whatever. Are you going to help or not?
translation: 嗯，嗯。随便。你想帮忙还是不帮？

original: Taking the loss in stride, are we?
translation: 我们步调不太一致，对吗？

original: It would seem the Brotherhood has more pressing matters to attend to than a twenty year old, defunct project.
translation: 相比一个搁置了20年的无用工程，兄弟会看来还有更紧要的事情要做。

original: Out of respect for your father, however, I will offer advice. What exactly do you need?
translation: 出于对你爸爸的尊敬，我会给你点建议。你到底需要什么？

original: Thanks for your sympathy.
translation: 谢谢你的好意。

original: Think nothing of it.
translation: 小事。

original: Now, Doctor Li has explained your predicament. You need to locate some Vault-Tec equipment?
translation: 现在，李博士解释了你的困境。你要定位一个避难所科技装备？

original: Um... okay... You do know there was a war 200 years ago, right?
translation: 嗯……好的……你知道200年前的战争吧？

original: Well, I must speak to my husband about that. We could bring it up at the next homeowner's association meeting.
translation: 呃，这我得跟我丈夫说一下。我们可以拿到下次业主委员会上讨论。

original: Ah, I do love the meetings so much. I think I'll bring muffins!
translation: 啊，我很喜欢这些会议。我想我会带松饼去！

original: Wow, are you batshit insane or what?
translation: 哇，你是疯了还是怎么？

original: Well now, there's no cause for name calling! How rude!
translation: 毫无理由的谩骂！太粗鲁了！

original: I have a pie cooling on the window sill I must attend to. Good day!
translation: 我的窗台上有一个派正凉着，我要照看一下。再见！

original: Why are you being so hostile?
translation: 你为什么这样敌视别人？

original: Maybe it's because my wife has gone mental. No wait, I think it's because some lunatics are trying to kill us.
translation: 可能是因为我老婆有些神经质。不对，我想是有些疯子想杀死我们。

original: Other than that, no reason.
translation: 除此之外，别无理由。

original: What the hell is your problem?
translation: 你到底有什么问题？

original: Do you understand English? I said get out!
translation: 你听不懂人话？我说滚出去！

original: Whoa, whoa, whoa.... Take it easy.
translation: 哇，哇，哇……放松。

original: Yeah right, and the second I drop my guard you pounce. No thanks.
translation: 是啊，我一放松警惕你就会扑上来。不必了。

original: Look, speak your piece then leave.
translation: 有什么事说完快走。

original: Calm down, pal, before I put a hole in your chest.
translation: 镇定，伙计，在我给你胸口来一枪之前，镇定。

original: Look, "pal,", there is no way you're going to get to me or my wife so just back on out of here!
translation: 听着，“伙计”，我跟我妻子你碰也别想碰，赶快滚出去吧！

original: So, what's your take on Evan King?
translation: 你觉得埃万·金怎么样？

original: He's a spineless wimp. His best solution to the Family is to stay inside our homes and hide. What does that tell them?
translation: 他是个懦夫。他解决家族最好的方法就是让我们待在家里。这告诉了他们什么？

original: It tells them that we can be pushed around whenever they want. I'm sick of it, and I'm sick of King.
translation: 这告诉他们任何时候只要愿意就能捉弄我们。我受够他了，我受够金了。

original: Well, he's town mayor or sheriff or whatever he calls himself. He calls all the shots.
translation: 好吧，他是镇长或者警长或者随便什么他自己起的称号。他发号施令。

original: When he says to get the heck indoors and stay put, we do that.
translation: 当他说待在家里不要出去，我们就照做。

original: You've made the right choice, Leo.
translation: 你们做出了正确的选择，利奥。

original: Thanks. It'll be hard, but I'll do my best.
translation: 谢谢。这挺难，但是我会尽力。

original: I could tell them for you.
translation: 我会替你转告他们。

original: No. Thanks, but no. I got myself into this problem, I need to get myself out.
translation: 不。谢谢，但是不用了。我自己陷入了这困境，我需要自己摆脱。

original: I'll figure something out. Look, I want to thank you for your help. I guess it took a complete stranger to show me what an ass I've been.
translation: 我会解决。听着，我想谢谢你的帮助。想不到居然是一个陌生人让我看到自己曾是一个怎样的混蛋。

original: Take this key, it's to my private stash in the water treatment plant. Just get rid of the stuff, burn it, sell it -- I don't care what happens to it.
translation: 拿着钥匙，它可以开启我在水处理厂里的隐秘藏匿处。把里面的东西处理掉、随便你是烧了也好卖了也好 — 我不关心你用什么办法。

original: That would be a good idea.
translation: 那应该是个好主意。

original: I just don't know what to say. I've been stealing from both of them for years to get my fix. Where do I even start?
translation: 我只是不知道说什么。我以前从他们那偷东西来换取我的毒品。我要怎么重新开始？

original: Well, I'll figure something out. Look, I want to thank you for your help. I guess it took a complete stranger to show me what an ass I've been.
translation: 我会解决。听着，我想谢谢你的帮助。想不到居然是一个陌生人让我看到自己曾是一个怎样的混蛋。

original: Take this key, it's to my private stash in the water treatment plant. Just get rid of the stuff, burn it, sell it -- I don't care what happens to it.
translation: 拿着钥匙，它可以开启我在水处理厂里的隐秘藏匿处。把里面的东西处理掉、随便你是烧了也好卖了也好 — 我不关心你用什么办法。

original: I never thought about it that way. Can you hook me up?
translation: 我从没那样想过。你能帮我吗？

original: Yeah, I can. Just please... Don't tell Andy or Jenny. And don't ask me about it when I'm at the Brass Lantern.
translation: 嗯，我能。只是请……不要告诉安迪和珍妮。我在黄铜灯的时候也不要问我这事。

original: I'll only sell to you when my shift is over. Meet me in the water treatment plant if you need something.
translation: 我只在我轮班结束后才会卖给你。如果你需要什么就到水处理厂找我。

original: You're hurting your family, Leo. Jenny and Andy care about you.
translation: 你伤害了你的家人，利奥。珍妮和安迪关心你。

original: I... I guess you're right. I have to tell them about my problem, don't I?
translation: 我……我想你是对的。我应该告诉他们我的问题，是吧？

original: Never mind, Leo. It's not my business, anyway.
translation: 无所谓，利奥。反正这不关我事。

original: You're damn right it's not your business.
translation: 你说的太对了，这不关你事。

original: What's it worth to you to keep it out of the public eye?
translation: 是什么值得让你置于公众视线之外？

original: I can hook you up. A solid chem dealer is hard to find out here in the Wastes, trust me. I know.
translation: 我能帮你联系。一个靠得住的药贩子在废土上是很难找的，相信我，我很了解。

original: I can only sell to you when my shift at the Lantern is over. Meet me up at the water treatment plant if you need something.
translation: 我只在我黄铜灯的轮班结束后才会卖给你。如果你需要什么就到水处理厂找我。

original: It's okay, Leo. I want to help.
translation: 好的，利奥。我想帮忙。

original: Help? What's to help? So I'm a junkie, big fucking deal. It's not like I'm hurting anyone.
translation: 帮忙？帮什么忙？我是瘾君子，他妈的有什么大不了的。我又没伤害什么人。

original: It's about damn time.
translation: 真他妈的是时候。

original: Indeed. Farewell.
translation: 正是。回见。

original: Thanks for the help.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助。

original: You are welcome. If you require further assistance, I may be able to help.
translation: 不客气。如果你需要更多帮助，我可能能帮忙。

original: I'm running short on time, here. Let's cut to the chase.
translation: 没时间，长话短说。

original: Yes, well... I am afraid that with the emergence of the Enclave, the Brotherhood is rather busy right now.
translation: 是的，好吧……恐怕由于英克雷的紧急状况，兄弟会现在相当忙。

original: I elected to take time from my responsibilities to assist you. Perhaps I was in error. Nonetheless, we may have what you seek.
translation: 我决定在我工作之余花时间来帮助你。可能我是错的。不过，我可能有你要找的东西。

original: In the archives upstairs is an old, pre-war Vault-Tec terminal. I will send word that you need access to it.
translation: 在楼上档案室有一个旧的战前避难所科技终端。我会通知他们，让你可以登入该终端。

original: Can you give me some information about Arefu?
translation: 你能告诉我些断桥镇的信息吗？

original: Sure, be glad to since you're doing me a big favor and all.
translation: 当然，很高兴，因为你帮了我个大忙。

original: I need to find Vault 87 right now.
translation: 我需要立刻找到87号避难所。

original: I take it you were successful, then.
translation: 看来你成功了。

original: As it happens, the Brotherhood has some information about Vault 87. Let me show you what we know.
translation: 正好，兄弟会有一些87号避难所的信息。让我给你看看我们知道的。

original: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

original: As it happens, the Brotherhood has some information about Vault 87. Let me show you what we know.
translation: 正好，兄弟会有一些87号避难所的信息。让我给你看看我们知道的。

original: I can handle it.
translation: 我能处理。

original: Can you now, without even knowing what the problem is?
translation: 在甚至不知道问题出在哪的情况下，你行吗？

original: I suppose, then, you have a way to deal with lethal levels of radiation around the Vault?
translation: 我想，你有办法应付在避难所里致命的辐射等级？

original: Why, what's difficult about it?
translation: 噢，这有什么难的？

original: The area is highly irradiated; lethal levels are all around the entrance. Gaining direct access will be quite impossible.
translation: 这片区域受高辐射污染；致命的辐射围绕着入口。直接进去几乎不可能。

original: Vault 87 has a G.E.C.K., but I don't know where it is.
translation: 87号避难所有一个避难所创造器，但是我不知道在哪。

original: Ah. Well, that much I believe I can help with.
translation: 啊。我想这我还是能帮上你的。

original: Step over here for a moment. I'll show you where it is.
translation: 到这边来一下。我指给你看它在哪。

original: Looks like I've gotten us into one heck of a pickle, Argyle old chum. One heck of a pickle indeed...
translation: 好像我让我们陷入大麻烦了，阿盖尔老朋友。真正的大麻烦……

original: Quite right. We've been trying to capture these Rockopolis rodents for years. Never could have done it without you, Daring.
translation: 非常对。我们试图抓住这罗克波利斯大家伙很多年了。亲爱的，如果没有你我们是做不到。

original: I knew it! I knew this dame was no good! But it's worse than I thought. She's the Black Widow! The leader of the Slavers!
translation: 我知道！我知道这该死的不好！但它比我想象地更糟糕。她是黑寡妇！奴隶贩子的头！

original: Jabber all you want. In about 30 seconds, my associates from Paradise Falls will join us.
translation: 快说你要什么。再过30秒，我的帮手就要从堕落天堂过来了。

original: Here I thought we were friends. And now you have a gun in my face. Bad form, Miss Chase. Bad form.
translation: 我原本以为我们还算是朋友，现在你却拿着枪指着我。彻斯小姐，这真是不礼貌啊。

original: Oh, I don't know, Daring darling. I find the ghoul's instincts to be... frighteningly accurate.
translation: 哦，我不知道，亲爱的。我发现僵尸的直觉真是惊人的准确。

original: Ignore my manservant's mutterings, Penelope. He has a penchant for the dramatic you see. Why one time...
translation: 佩内洛普，不要理会我奴隶的咕囔。他对你很感兴趣。为什么一度……

original: Listen to yourself, boss! This is Rockopolis! One of the safest places in the Wasteland, and you just showed a stranger where it is!
translation: 听听你说了什么，老板！这是罗克波利斯！废土上最安全的地方，而你刚刚给一个陌生人指出了它在哪！

original: Oh, no, Miss Chase! I can assure you, this will be our special place.
translation: 哦，不，彻斯小姐！我能保证，这将是我们专属的地方。

original: Now that's what I call a getaway, Daring! So tell me, do you take all your girlfriends here?
translation: 那就是所谓的逃跑，亲爱的！告诉我，你要带你所有的女朋友来这？

original: Just over here! This large boulder! And now... the secret knock.  And... voila!
translation: 就在这！那大石头！现在……用暗号敲击它。然后……看那！

original: So you do know where it is! Well come on then, those Super Mutants can't be far behind!
translation: 那么你知道它在哪了！是呀，那些超级变种人就在后面不远了！

original: Now now, old chum! Miss Chase is hardly going to violate the secrets of Rockopolis. Isn't that right, Miss Chase? Besides, necessity calls!
translation: 现在，现在，老伙计！彻斯小姐无法违背罗克波利斯的秘密。对吗，彻斯小姐？言听必从！

original: Boss! That's privileged information! You can't just...
translation: 老板！那是授权信息！你不能就……

original: Turns out you're in good company, Miss Chase. Argyle and I are old friends of Rockopolis. Know the secret knock and everything!
translation: 庆幸你有一些好伙伴吧，彻斯小姐。阿盖尔和我是罗克波利斯的老朋友。知道敲击暗号和每件事！

original: In those hills up there! Isn't that where the hidden village of Rockopolis is located? If only we knew where it was...
translation: 就在那边那些山里！那不是隐藏的城镇罗克波利斯的位置吗？要是只有我们知道它在那的话……

original: Well, those Super Mutants are persistent if nothing else! A word of advice - keep running!
translation: 好吧，没有什么比那些超级变种人更强悍！给你二个字的建议 — 快跑！

original: Today's episode -- In the Black Widow's Web!
translation: 今天的节目 — 黑寡妇的蜘蛛网！

original: Screw this. I'm out of here.
translation: 他妈的。我不干了。

original: Like it or not, you're stuck up here too. You can't go back.
translation: 无论喜不喜欢，你都已经在这儿。你无路可退了。

original: So, either you stay here and run out of ammunition like we did, or we all work together and get off this roof.
translation: 要不你在这像我们一样打光子弹，或者我们一起离开楼顶战斗。

original: I'd like to help, but nothing's free.
translation: 我想帮忙，但不是免费的。

original: Heh heh. Spoken just like a merc.
translation: 哈哈。听着象个佣兵。

original: You get us off of here, and I guarantee you'll be paid well.
translation: 你带我们离开，我保证报酬很丰厚。

original: Now, I'd suggest we go back the way you came, but I think that may be impossible. Our only chance is this express elevator to the lobby level.
translation: 现在，我建议我们回到你来的地方，但是我想那不可能。我们只能乘电梯回到大厅。

original: Yeah, let's do it.
translation: 嗯，我们走。

original: I know you don't know me from the shit under your boots, but I promise you when we get out of this you'll be paid well for it.
translation: 从你乳臭未干的样子看来，你不认识我，但是我承诺我们出去后，你将得到不错的报酬。

original: I'd suggest we go back the way you came, but I think that may be impossible. Our only chance is this express elevator to the lobby level.
translation: 我想建议从你来的地方回去，但是我想那不可能。只能乘电梯回到大厅。

original: I don't know a Reilly, and I'm out of here.
translation: 我不认识莱莉，我正离开。

original: Well, I got news for you. You're stuck up here like the rest of us. There's no going back the way you came.
translation: 好吧，我有消息给你。你像我们一样困在这了。这没有回头路。

original: So what'll it be? You going to help us get off this roof or what?
translation: 那怎么样？你帮我们离开楼顶还是不管？

original: I don't know any Reilly, but I do know we need to get the hell off this roof.
translation: 我不认识什么莱莉，但我知道我们需要离开这该死的楼顶。

original: She didn't send you? Dammit, that means she might be dead.
translation: 不是她派你来的？该死，那意味着她可能死了。

original: Forget it then, we can talk shop later. Can you help us get out of here?
translation: 算了吧，我们迟点再说。你能帮我们离开这吗？

original: Reilly? Who's that? Never heard of her.
translation: 莱莉？是谁？从没听说过。

original: She's our commander. I hope she's still alive. When I saw you come up here, I assumed she'd sent you.
translation: 她是我们长官。我希望她仍然活着。我看到你来，以为是她派你来的。

original: Well, we can chit-chat about all that later. Right now, can you help us get off this damn roof?
translation: 好吧，我们可以迟点再说。现在，能帮我们离开这该死的楼顶吗？

original: He really shouldn't be here.
translation: 他真的不该待在这。

original: I think this is the best place for him. Out there, he'd be hunted like all of us were. Sorry.
translation: 我想对他来说这是最好的地方。要是在外面，他会像我们一样被猎杀。抱歉。

original: I could be his friend.
translation: 我能成为他的朋友。

original: Well, that is sweet, but Vance would kick my rather gorgeous ass right out of here if I told you how to find Ian. Sorry.
translation: 好吧，太好了，但是如果我告诉你怎么找到伊恩，万斯可能会把我赶出去。抱歉。

original: Ian's decided to stay with the Family.
translation: 伊恩决定和家族在一起。

original: When you first arrived I was suspicious of your intentions. I can see now it was an error in judgement.
translation: 你刚来的时候我还怀疑你的目的。看来我的判断有错误。

original: I can assure you Ian will be well cared for and safe with the Family.
translation: 我保证家族会照顾好伊恩，并确保他的安全。

original: Please, I want you to take this. Consider it as an apology to you for all the hardships you had to endure finding this place.
translation: 请你拿着这些，把它当作是我对你费劲艰辛寻到此地的歉意。

original: Goodbye, human. Our time together has been rather... educational.
translation: 再见，人类。我们在一起的时间相当……有意义。

original: Ian's decided to leave the Family.
translation: 伊恩决定离开家族。

original: It saddens me to lose one of my flock, but I believe everyone has to follow their own path.
translation: 我们失去一员我很悲痛，但我相信每个人都有自己的路要走。

original: All I was attempting to do was guide him. Now it seems that responsibility has fallen upon you. I hope you will be more successful.
translation: 我所做的只是尝试引导他。现在这责任落到你身上了。希望你比我更成功。

original: Please, I want you to take this. Consider it as an apology to you for all the hardships you had to endure finding this place.
translation: 请你拿着这些，把它当作是我对你费劲艰辛寻到此地的歉意。

original: Goodbye, human. Our time together has been rather... educational.
translation: 再见，人类。我们在一起的时间相当……有意义。

original: That's impressive. Competition must be stiff around here.
translation: 那令人印象深刻。这的竞争一定非常残酷。

original: Damn right it is. Last time I checked, it wasn't called the "Sisterhood of Steel." Hell, even Sarah has to prove herself to the knuckle draggers.
translation: 该死的没错。我查过，这里不叫“钢铁姐妹会”。妈的，甚至萨拉都能用铜指虎来表现自己。

original: Every once in a while, we have to show 'em what's what.
translation: 每隔一段时间，我们必须告诉他们谁是谁非。

original: You mean you were the best shot. I'm here now.
translation: 你想说你是最好的枪手吗？看看现在是谁在你面前。

original: Hey, Wasteland humor! I like that! Got any more... funny man?
translation: 嗨，废土幽默家！我喜欢！再多说点……有趣的家伙？

original: Hey, Wasteland humor! I like that! Got any more... funny girl?
translation: 嗨，废土幽默家！我喜欢！再多说点……有趣的女孩？

original: Sorry, I was just joking around.
translation: 抱歉，我只是开玩笑。

original: Yeah, see... my friends can joke about my name. Last I checked you're not on that list. But I'll let it go, you just watch yourself.
translation: 嗯，听着……我的朋友可以拿我名字开玩笑。但我发现我的朋友清单上没有你。不过这次就算了，你要注意些。

original: Please. Like I'm afraid of you people.
translation: 拜托。好像我怕你们这些人似的。

original: See? That. Right there. That's the sort of shit that'll land a little girl like you in the infirmary.
translation: 看？那，就在那。那破玩意能让你这样的小女孩躺进医务室去。

original: See? That. Right there. That's the sort of shit that gets a man injured.
translation: 看？那，就在那。那破玩意能让男人受伤。

original: Good to know.
translation: 听到这很高兴。

original: Right to the point. I like that. What do you need?
translation: 一针见血。我喜欢。你要什么？

original: Dusk? Oh, let me guess! Your real name's Dawn. Or is it Twilight?
translation: 达斯科？哦，让我想想！你真名叫黎明。还是晨曦？

original: Ha. Funny. Here's some free advice: You're our guest, so I'd be real careful about who you insult.
translation: 哈。好玩。这有个免费的建议：你是我的客人，所以我真的很在意你对谁不敬。

original: That sort of thing might fly out in the Wastes, but here in the Citadel, it'll earn you a few broken teeth.
translation: 要是在废土可能没人计较，但这是五角大本营，你应该小心给打飞几颗牙。

original: So what's your story?
translation: 你有什么故事？

original: My "story"? I blow the head off of anything more'n two hundred meters downrange.
translation: 我的事迹吗？我可以把两百米外任何生物的脑袋打掉。

original: I'm the best shot in the Brotherhood of Steel, bar none. Not even Colvin can match my kill count. That's my "story."
translation: 我是钢铁兄弟会最好的射手，毋庸置疑。甚至科尔文都不能和我匹敌。这就是我的“事迹”。

original: Brothers, today I offer a simple prayer.
translation: 兄弟，今天我将做一个简短的祷告。

original: Hail, Creator. Blessed is your power and mighty is your gift of Steel.
translation: 万岁，造物主。福佑是你的能量，非凡是你赐予钢铁兄弟会的礼物。

original: Bless us today, your noble warriors who dwell in this hall.
translation: 祝福我们吧，保佑大厅里你的战士。

original: Let us ride upon wings of thunder and chariots of glory, to bring destruction to your enemies.
translation: 让我们插上闪电的翅膀，驾驶荣誉的战车，为敌人带去毁灭。

original: To bring destruction upon your wicked enemies."
translation: 为邪恶的敌人带去毁灭。”

original: Brothers, as we take our meal this day, let us reflect upon the words of Elder Patrocolus of the Montana Bunker.
translation: 兄弟，就在我们今天就餐前，让我们回忆蒙大拿地堡的普特洛克勒斯长老的教诲。

original: "It is in service of Steel and guardianship of one's Brothers that each man finds his purpose.  My friends, stand with your Brothers. Guard them...
translation: “为钢铁兄弟会服务，保护自己的兄弟，在这之中每个人都能找到他的目标。我的朋友们，和你的兄弟并肩作战、保卫他们……

original: ...guide them. And in each of them find purpose." Look around this table, my Brothers. Look into the eyes of each man and woman seated here today.
translation: ……指引他们吧。愿他们每个人都能找到目标。”看着桌前，我的兄弟。注视在座每位的眼睛。

original: Pledge in your hearts and minds, pledge by your guns that you will stand with them in battle until the end. Trust each of them with your life.
translation: 用你的心灵承诺，用在战场上伴你战斗到底的钢枪承诺。用你的生命去信任他们每一个人。

original: And earn the trust of each in turn. Eat well, my friends.
translation: 同时赢得每个人的信任。开始用餐吧，我的朋友们。

original: Can you repair my gear?
translation: 能帮我修装备吗？

original: I should let you know: I'm not going to use any of our equipment to provide parts for you. You'll have to pay for them.
translation: 你应该知道：我可不会拿自己装备上的零件给你修。想修你就得付钱。

original: If you want to pay for the parts, yes.
translation: 如果你想为零件付钱，可以。

original: I hope you're willing to pay for the parts -- you're not getting them from our supplies.
translation: 我希望你愿意为零件付钱 — 否则从我这你得不到任何东西。

original: I'd like to buy something.
translation: 我想买些东西。

original: I received word from Elder Lyons. He says that you have permission to trade with us. Good for you.
translation: 我收到了里昂斯长老的命令。他说你有和我们交易的许可。很好。

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: What else would I be doing back here?
translation: 回到这我还能做什么？

original: How do I get through the radiation?
translation: 我怎么能通过辐射区？

original: Quite simply, you don't. To attempt such a thing would be certain death for you.
translation: 很简单，你不能。妄想通过会让你送命。

original: There's got to be another way.
translation: 肯定有别的路。

original: You share your father's determination, it seems. And in this case, you are correct. There may well be another way.
translation: 看来你继承了你爸爸的决心。这次，你是对的。可能真的有另一条路。

original: Vault 87 is located very close to the site of Lamplight Caverns. It is entirely probable that the Vault may be entered from within the caves.
translation: 87号避难所离小灯镇洞穴非常近。很可能可以从洞里进入避难所。

original: So that's it? I'm screwed?
translation: 就这样？我没戏了？

original: So quick to give up... Disappointing.
translation: 这么快就放弃……让人失望。

original: There is, in fact, another potential way to reach the Vault. Lamplight Caverns is close by, and may provide an alternate means of access.
translation: 事实上，可能另有一条通往避难所的道路。小灯镇洞穴离那很近，洞里可能另有入口。

original: I really need to get by you. It's important I find what I'm looking for.
translation: 我真的必须得去。我要找的东西很重要的。

original: Alright, alright. I guess you look harmless enough.
translation: 好的，好的。你看起来没什么危险。

original: If I were you, I'd speak to Vance before you poke around too much. You can usually find him on the mezzanine overlooking the common area.
translation: 要是我的话，在四处游荡前会先和万斯谈谈。你能在上面俯瞰这个区域的平台上找到他。

original: Hang on a second. I have a letter for Ian West from his sister.
translation: 等会。我有一封信给伊恩·维斯特，是他姐姐寄的。

original: Oh, the new kid? Yeah, Vance said we should be expecting someone soon.
translation: 哦，新来的小孩？嗯，万斯说不久就会有人找上门来。

original: You can head on in, but I would speak to Vance first if I was you. You can find him on the mezzanine overlooking the common area.
translation: 要是我的话，在四处晃荡前会先和万斯谈谈。你能在上面俯瞰这个区域的平台上找到他。

original: I'm not telling you jack. Now let me get by!
translation: 我不告诉你。让我过去！

original: Ok, sure. Look, I don't have time for your bullshit. Turn around and go back the way you came.
translation: 好的，没问题。我没有时间听你胡扯。哪来的就回哪去吧。

original: Otherwise, they'll be scraping you up with a shovel.
translation: 否则，他们会拿铲子把你砍了。

original: Just exploring, sorry.
translation: 只是四处转转，抱歉。

original: Well, go explore somewhere else. This place is off limits to explorers.
translation: 好吧，去别处看看。这里不许闲人进入。

original: He doesn't belong here.
translation: 他不属于这。

original: How do you know that? If you've spoken to him like I have, I think you can see he's truly one of us.
translation: 你怎么知道？如果你像我一样和他谈谈，我想你就能明白他确实属于这。

original: Ian confides in me. We share a special bond. I might be the only friend in the world he's got!
translation: 伊恩信任我。我们有特殊的渊源。我可能是他在这世界上的仅有的朋友！

original: He's needed at home. His family is dead.
translation: 他要回家。他家人死了。

original: Yes, I know. He told me.
translation: 是的，我知道，我知道。他告诉我了。

original: Surprised? Well, Ian was there when it happened and did nothing to stop it. If you ask yourself why, the answer is obvious.
translation: 很惊讶？呃，当事情发生时，伊恩就在那，而且他没有阻止。如果你问自己为什么，答案很明显了。

original: He belongs with us here. He's one of us. Don't deny him his rightful home.
translation: 他属于我们这。他是我们中的一员。不要让他离开他真正的家。

original: Can't you just help out without being so mean?
translation: 你就不能不那么刻薄地帮助别人吗？

original: Awwww. I'm sorry. Did I hurt your feelings? Sniff.
translation: 啊。抱歉。我伤害了你的感情？深呼吸。

original: Tough shit! This is the real world. You want to know something, find it out your damn self.
translation: 去他的！这是真实的世界。你想知道一些事情，就他妈自己去搞明白。

original: You really have a bad attitude.
translation: 你的态度真的很恶劣。

original: That's me. You don't like it? Tough!
translation: 我就是我。你不喜欢？忍着！

original: I'm going to kick your ass all over this Metro station if you don't help me!
translation: 要是你不帮我，我就把你踢得满地铁乱滚！

original: Finally! Someone with some balls around this place!
translation: 终于！来了个有胆量的家伙！

original: Here's the password to that little pipsqueak's room... why don't you go knock some sense into him? Ha ha ha!
translation: 这是那小家伙房间的密码……为什么你不去和他讲讲道理？哈哈哈！

original: Great. Thanks for nothing.
translation: 太好了。谢谢你什么都没帮上。

original: I find it hard to believe your father raised such a child.
translation: 很难相信你爸爸养育了你这样的孩子。

original: I feel pity for whatever it is you've gone through that has made you so bitter.
translation: 我也很同情你，对于你经历那些痛苦的事。

original: Thanks for your help.
translation: 谢谢帮助。

original: I wish we could do more, but the Brotherhood potentially faces a very pressing, very real threat in the Enclave.
translation: 我希望我们能多做点，但是兄弟会面对着一个非常大的潜在的压力，来自英克雷的真正威胁。

original: All of my efforts must now be devoted to assessing the threat they may pose to us. I'm sure you understand.
translation: 我们的精力必须放在估算他们对我们的威胁上。我相信你理解。

original: You're kidding me, right?
translation: 你和我开玩笑吗，对吗？

original: I ain't kidding. You're not supposed to be here, so you better leave.
translation: 我没开玩笑。你不应该在这，所以你最好离开。

original: Whoa, hold on there. I'm a friend.
translation: 哇，停下。我是朋友。

original: You're big, and I don't have any big friends. You better just go out the way you came in.
translation: 你是大块头，我没有大块头朋友。你最好从哪来就回哪去。

original: I have no idea.
translation: 不知道了。

original: Then that is a mystery you will have to solve on your own.
translation: 那是一个秘密，你需要自己去找到答案。

original: In ceremony, each member of the Family must speak one of the Laws... it is theirs to remember and to enforce.
translation: 每当举行典礼的时候，我们当中的每个人都要说出法则中的一条。……那是他们必须记住和坚持执行的法则。

original: Perhaps from these Laws you can discover what we are. Return to me when you are ready.
translation: 可能从这些法则之中，你能发现我们是什么样的人。若你准备好就回来找我。

original: Not used to civilized discourse, eh? You're from out there in the Wasteland, right? You must be pretty tough to survive out there. Ever kill a Ghoul?
translation: 不习惯文明的说话方式吗？你是从外面的废土来的吧？在外面生存一定很艰难。杀过僵尸吗？

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <一言不发。>

original: You're lucky they even let you in here. I'm surprised they did, since it will only encourage those Ghouls who want to live here.
translation: 你很幸运那些门卫让你进来。对此我很惊讶，因为这只会让那些僵尸更加想住进来。

original: They don't understand they need to earn the right to live here.
translation: 他们不明白他们需要自己去争取住在这里的权利。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: If you don't mind, I have better things to do.
translation: 如果你不介意，我还有别的事要做。

original: Like fixing up some pills to keep the residents bolstered against whatever diseases those Ghouls bring with them when they bang on the gate.
translation: 比如说要准备些药品来让居民预防僵尸敲我们的大门时带来的疫病。

original: Sure. Whatever you say, doc.
translation: 当然，随便你怎么说，医生。

original: You are in definite need of an attitude adjustment. Like those God-awful Ghouls scrabbling at the gate all the time.
translation: 你一定得要经历点东西来端正你的态度。比如那些不停抓大门的恐怖僵尸。

original: Someone must do something to get rid of those vermin once and for all!
translation: 必须有人去做些什么来彻底摆脱那些歹徒！

original: Blah blah blah!
translation: 废话连篇！

original: I've never been in prison, so I wouldn't know. All I know is that I'm safe in here. Out there you got all kinds of nastiness. Like those Ghouls.
translation: 我没进过监狱，所以我不知道。我所知道的就是我在这很安全。在这外面都是些污秽可怕的东西。像那些僵尸。

original: You ever run into Ghouls in your travels?
translation: 你在途中遇到过僵尸没有？

original: This place feels more like a prison than a home.
translation: 这地方比起家来更像个监狱。

original: Lucky? Perhaps I should feel lucky. But really, we've all worked hard to get what we have. I think it's fair to say we DESERVE to live here.
translation: 幸运？或许我应该感到幸运。但其实呢，我们所有的东西都是努力得来的。我想说我应该住在这，这很公平。

original: Those Ghouls on the other hand... they think they can just take whatever they want. Well, they have to earn the right to live here.
translation: 在另一方面，那些僵尸……他们认为他们能得到他们想要的。可是，他们必须自己去争取住在这的权利。

original: Not everyone is as lucky as you.
translation: 不是每个人都像你那么幸运的。

original: I'm not sure what you are trying to imply... but it's no crime to be paid for doing work. Tenpenny charges me rent too, you know.
translation: 我不确定你在暗示什么……但是通过工作获得报酬不是犯罪。特佩尼也收我房租，你知道。

original: In a perfect world, health care would be free... but since you've traveled through the Wastes out there, you know it's not a perfect world. Is it?
translation: 在一个理想的世界里，卫生保健应该是免费的……但是既然你在外面的废土游荡过，你也知道这不是一个理想的世界。对吗？

original: Take those Ghouls out there. Tenpenny won't let them live here. Sure, it's a little sad, but that decision is keeping people in here safe and sound.
translation: 让那些僵尸待在外面吧。特佩尼不会让他们住这的。这确实有点残酷，但是这个决定会让这儿的住户更安全。

original: It must be nice having patients who can pay their medical bills, huh?
translation: 来找你的都是些能付得起医药费的病人，这可真不错啊，是吧？

original: People ARE dying to get in here. Like those dirty Ghouls... or at least they should be dying. Security has got to get their act together.
translation: 人们确实打破头了都想住进来。包括那些脏兮兮的僵尸……不过他们的头确实该被打破。警卫应该来一次行动。

original: But luck has nothing to do with it. We deserve this. All of it. Not everyone is as smart, as pretty, or as wealthy as the cream of the crop.
translation: 但是幸运对这毫无意义。这是我们应得的，所有这一切。毕竟不是每个人都像精英一样聪明，一样漂亮，或是一样有钱的。

original: Don't blame me. Blame mother nature. Survival of the fittest. It's the game of life. We're the winners. And those Ghouls, they are definitely losers.
translation: 别责备我。责备自然吧。适者生存。这是生命的游戏。我们是赢家。至于那些僵尸，他们则是绝对的输家。

original: I bet people are dying to live here. You're all lucky you can afford it.
translation: 我打赌人们打破头了都想住进来。你能开销得起可真是幸运啊。

original: Indeed. Though Tenpenny has put a lot of work into restoring it. And he's hired security to keep us safe.
translation: 确实。特佩不但尼花了大力气来修复，他还雇了大批警卫保证我们安全。

original: But they seem to be having some trouble with a pack of Ghouls living in the tunnels nearby.
translation: 但是这些警卫好像和住在附近隧道里的僵尸有点问题。

original: Don't suppose you've encountered many Ghouls on your travels?
translation: 我猜你在旅途中没有遇过很多僵尸吧？

original: Good thing the tower was still structurally sound after the war.
translation: 这座大厦在战后竟然还能屹立不倒，这可真不错啊。

original: Indeed! Everyone who lives here has worked hard to get here.
translation: 确实如此！这里的每个人都是通过努力工作才获得住在这的机会。

original: That's why we can't just let those ghouls in. They demand the right to live here, but what have they done to prove themselves worthy?
translation: 这也就是为什么我们不能让那些僵尸进来。他们非要住在这的权利，但是他们怎么来证明他们有住在这的价值？

original: Running a cafe can't be easy.
translation: 开咖啡店可不容易。

original: Tenpenny is very selective about who he allows to live here. The correct genes and living conditions make for a relatively disease free environment.
translation: 特佩尼非常在意让谁住进来。合适的基因和生活状态造就这舒适的生活环境，让我们远离疾病。

original: Clean water is still a concern, of course, but we've got enough chems to keep the radiation sickness at bay.
translation: 干净的水仍然是个问题，当然。但我们已经有足够的化学品来让辐射问题恶化。

original: That's why he won't allow those Ghouls to live here. Why introduce a weakness into a healthy system?
translation: 这就是为什么他不让那些僵尸住进来。怎么能让病毒跑到健康的体系中来呢？

original: I'm a little shocked by how healthy everyone looks.
translation: 看到这儿的每个人都那么健康，我有点吃惊。

original: And you can thank me for that. I'm the resident guide to all things fabulous.
translation: 你可以为这一切感谢我。我就是负责把所有东西安排妥帖的人。

original: And I'll tell you what isn't ever in style... disgusting Ghouls getting their rotting paws all over everything.
translation: 我告诉你这什么东西在这不会受欢迎吧……恶心的僵尸，总是用他们腐烂的爪子到处抓。

original: I've noticed the quality of living is rather high here, isn't it?
translation: 我注意到这儿的生活质量相当高，不是吗？

original: Fine. Never mind. I thought you were a real man. Turns out you're just a scared little boy.
translation: 好的。没关系。我以为你是个真正的男人。没想到原来是个胆小如鼠的小男孩。

original: Ghouls aren't so bad, once you get to know them.
translation: 其实只要你试着了解僵尸的话，你会发现他们没那么坏。

original: That's just what I thought. You're a scared little girl.
translation: 和我刚才想的一样，你原来是个胆小如鼠的小女孩。

original: Ghouls aren't so bad, once you get to know them.
translation: 其实只要你试着了解僵尸的话，你会发现他们没那么坏。

original: What? Have you lost your mind?
translation: 什么？你疯了吗？

original: Ghouls are all right.
translation: 僵尸没什么问题啊。

original: I guess I never thought of it that way. It's probably really hard just living day to day like that. Now I feel a little ashamed.
translation: 我想我从来没那样考虑过他们。那样的生活可能真的很艰难。现在我觉得有点惭愧。

original: I think they've proven something just staying alive in that condition.
translation: 我想他们在那样恶劣的环境中生存下来已经证明了某些事实。

original: Oh. I see. Well. I've never met one, so I wouldn't know. I just always thought... I guess I really don't know what I thought...
translation: 噢。我明白。好吧。我从没遇到僵尸，所以我不知道。我只是一直猜测……但我真的不了解我猜测的是什么……

original: Look, I know enough about Ghouls not to hate them.
translation: 你看，因为我已经很了解他们了，所以我并不恨他们。

original: Then you obviously don't know anything about Ghouls.
translation: 那么你显然对僵尸一无所知。

original: I don't consider Ghouls to be a problem. If that's what you're asking.
translation: 如果你是问那些僵尸的话，我从来不觉得他们是什么问题。

original: I do hope you're not referring to me! I'm certainly a better conversationalist than some stupid Ghoul. And I smell better, too!
translation: 我希望你不是在说我！我跟其他那些愚蠢的僵尸相比绝对是一个不错的谈话对象。连我身上的味道也更好闻！

original: I'd rather spend time with Ghouls than some other people I know.
translation: 跟某些我认识的人相比，我更愿意跟僵尸一起待着。

original: Well, umm. I guess I must confess... I've never examined a Ghoul up close... you're right. I shouldn't make assumptions.
translation: 好吧。我想我必须承认……我从没仔细研究过一只僵尸。我不应该妄加揣测。

original: Sure they look a little weird, but they're not diseased vermin.
translation: 他们看起来确实有点古怪，但他们不是什么携带传染病的害兽。

original: That's a silly question. What I have against Ghouls, is that they are Ghouls!
translation: 那是个傻问题。为什么我反感僵尸？因为他们是僵尸！

original: What do you have against Ghouls, anyway?
translation: 说起来，你为什么那么反感僵尸呢？

original: Perhaps you're right. My wife is always going on about how crazy I make her.
translation: 可能你是对的。我妻子喋喋不休地说我使她如何疯狂。

original: Don't worry about those Ghouls, comrade. You need to relax.
translation: 别担心那些僵尸，同志。你需要放松一些。

original: I wish I could. I get nightmares from time to time.
translation: 我也希望我可以。我最近一直在做噩梦。

original: Stop worrying about those Ghouls.
translation: 别担心那些僵尸了。

original: Ah... you've already learned some wisdom in your youth. Congratulations!
translation: 啊……你年纪轻轻就已经懂得些道理了。恭喜！

original: Sure, I've met some Ghouls. They're just people, trying to get by.
translation: 当然，我见过一些尸鬼。他们也不过是挣扎求存的普通人。

original: Neither am I! I came here to get away from all that!
translation: 我也不喜欢！我来这就是为了逃离那一切！

original: Look. I know you just got here, but... we could really use your help. I could use your help...
translation: 听着。我知道你刚来，但是……我们真的希望能得到你的帮助。我需要你的帮助……

original: Someone really needs to take care of those Ghouls once and for all. Gustavo and his goons aren't doing the job.
translation: 必须要有个人去彻底地打发掉那些僵尸。古斯塔沃和他的手下从来不干他们该干的事。

original: Actually, I'm not a big fan of Ghouls.
translation: 事实上，我不怎么喜欢僵尸。

original: Neither am I! I came here to get away from all that!
translation: 我也不喜欢！我来这就是为了逃离那一切！

original: Something tells me you're a pretty tough chick. You made it in from the Wasteland after all. We could really use you're help around here.
translation: 我觉得你看起来是个强硬的小妞。毕竟你从废土辗转而来。我们希望获得你的帮助。

original: Someone really needs to take care of those Ghouls once and for all. Gustavo and his goons aren't doing the job.
translation: 必须要有个人去彻底地打发掉那些僵尸。古斯塔沃和他的手下从来不干他们该干的事。

original: Actually, I'm not a big fan of Ghouls.
translation: 事实上，我不怎么喜欢僵尸。

original: There must be something we can do. Talk to Gustavo, he might have some way for you to assist us in dealing with the problem.
translation: 我们一定能做些什么。去和古斯塔沃谈谈，他知道如何让你帮助我们处理那些问题。

original: Yeah, I wouldn't want Ghouls living here either.
translation: 是啊，我也不会想让僵尸住在这的。

original: They do seem a bit anti-social don't they?
translation: 他们确实看起来比较反社会，不是吗？

original: Though perhaps if we got them good and liquored up...
translation: 不过要是我们对他们好些，或许能和他们畅饮一番……

original: Let's just say I never met a Ghoul I liked.
translation: 这么说吧，我从来没遇见过一个看得顺眼的僵尸。

original: Indeed. Loathsome creatures aren't they? Someone really ought to put them out of their misery. You should talk to Gustavo about exterminating them.
translation: 真的。讨厌的生物，不是吗？应该有个人让他们从苦难中解脱。你应该去找古斯塔沃谈谈，把他们解决掉。

original: I've seen lots of Ghouls. Hated every last one of them.
translation: 我见过很多僵尸。没有一个不惹我讨厌。

original: Perhaps you are smarter than appearances credit.
translation: 你可能比你外表看起来要聪明些。

original: I don't like Ghouls any more than you do.
translation: 我一点都不比你更喜欢僵尸。

original: Yeah, it's what keeps those Ghouls from coming in.
translation: 对啊，靠着它们僵尸才进不来。

original: It's a good thing those walls are so high.
translation: 那些墙盖得那么高，这可真是件好事啊。

original: Ha ha ha! You bet. But who would dare touch them to give it to them?
translation: 哈哈哈！没问题。但又有谁敢去给他们点厉害尝尝呢？

original: Most Ghouls are in need of a serious makeover. Huh? Am I right?
translation: 大部分僵尸都需要好好化个妆，呃？我说的对不对？

original: Well, I'll try to not be bothered then... and perhaps you should speak to comrade Gustavo about getting rid of them altogether.
translation: 好吧，那我就不去找麻烦了……你也许该和古斯塔沃同志谈谈如何彻底除掉他们。

original: Committees won't help. You need to simply ignore them, or exterminate them.
translation: 委员会完全没用。你只需要无视他们，或者干脆杀光他们。

original: Yeah. They make me nervous. They certainly are disturbing looking.
translation: 没错。他们让我神经紧张。他们的样子确实很恶心。

original: I've dealt with enough Ghouls to know I don't ever want to see one again.
translation: 我对付过的僵尸太多了，我一只都不想再多看见。

original: If you weren't a child, I'd show you what this old man can do!
translation: 如果你不是个小孩，我就让你瞧瞧我这老头的厉害！

original: Only one thing I like less than Ghouls: old geezers giving me orders.
translation: 只有一样东西比尸鬼更让我讨厌：对我指手画脚的老东西。

original: Well, that's not very brave, though it's not a bad policy either. If you decide to conquer your fear of Ghouls by killing a couple, talk to Gustavo.
translation: 也行，虽然不是很勇敢，但也是一个不错的办法。如果你想通过杀几只僵尸来战胜对它们的恐惧，去找古斯塔沃谈谈。

original: When I see a Ghoul in the distance, I tend to turn around and go the other way.
translation: 当我远远看见僵尸的时候，我一般都会绕路走开。

original: You're exactly the kind of man we need around here!
translation: 你就是我们这需要的人！

original: Chief Gustavo and his pack of goons aren't doing their job. Those Ghouls keep coming back! Somebody's bound to get hurt sooner or later.
translation: 古斯塔沃长官和他那帮手下不做他们该做的工作。那些僵尸总是过来骚扰！人们早晚会受伤的。

original: I'm no stranger to violence, if that's what you're getting at.
translation: 我对暴力一点也不陌生，如果你是这个意思。

original: Now you're talking. I've met a couple tough broads like you before. You might be just what we need around here.
translation: 你说的对。我曾遇到过像你一样强悍的家伙。你可能就是我们这儿需要的人。

original: Chief Gustavo and his pack of goons aren't doing their job. Those Ghouls keep coming back! Somebody's bound to get hurt sooner or later.
translation: 古斯塔沃长官和他那帮手下不做他们该做的工作。那些僵尸总是过来骚扰！人们早晚会受伤的。

original: I'm no stranger to violence, if that's what you're getting at.
translation: 我对暴力一点也不陌生，如果你是这个意思。

original: I bet you could. Talk to Gustavo. He could use someone like you. You could kill those Ghouls in the tunnels. Get rid of them once and for all!
translation: 我猜你可以。和古斯塔沃谈谈。他需要你这样的人。你可以在隧道里杀了那些僵尸。彻底除掉他们！

original: I could kill a Ghoul or two, if I had to.
translation: 有必要的话，我不介意干掉一两只僵尸。

original: That's rather extreme, though near enough to the truth. Talk to Gustavo. He might be able to use you in the fight against the Ghouls.
translation: 那说法好像极端了点，不过也差不多。去和古斯塔沃谈谈。他可能需要你去收拾那些僵尸。

original: The only thing a Ghoul should have to prove is how fast it can die.
translation: 僵尸唯一该证明的事就是它能死多快。

original: Really? Fantastic! You can give that Gustavo a lesson or two!
translation: 真的？太好了！你可以给古斯塔沃上一课！

original: You could say I'm an expert when it comes to dealing with Ghouls.
translation: 你可以说我是对付僵尸的专家。

original: Oh my. It sounds like you might be just the person we need to take care of the situation. Talk to Gustavo.
translation: 噢，天啊。你听起来就像我们正需要的人。去和古斯塔沃谈谈。

original: I eat Ghouls for breakfast.
translation: 我把僵尸当作早餐来吃。

original: That doesn't surprise me. You should talk to Gustavo. He might be able to use someone like you.
translation: 这吓不倒我。你该和古斯塔沃谈谈。他可能需要你这样的人。

original: I'm not afraid of Ghouls.
translation: 我可不害怕僵尸。

original: I wasn't meaning to imply they should be slaughtered... though, I suppose these days, that might be the best solution.
translation: 我不是说他们应该被杀掉……尽管这些天来我一直在想那可能是最好的解决办法。

original: I shoot Ghouls first, and ask questions later.
translation: 见到僵尸我会先开枪，然后再问话。

original: Wow! You're a brutal thing aren't you... You're right, of course. You should offer to help Gustavo and his troopers in fighting those Ghouls.
translation: 哇！你可真是个残忍的家伙，不是吗……当然，你是对的。你应该去帮助古斯塔沃和他的小队去收拾那些僵尸。

original: The only good place for a Ghoul is at the end of a rope.
translation: 僵尸唯一的好去处就是绞刑架。

original: That's wonderful, comrade! Truly wonderful! Before you go Ghoul hunting, talk to Gustavo. He might be able to help you.
translation: 太好了，同志！真的太好了！在你去猎杀僵尸前，和古斯塔沃谈谈。他可能能帮你。

original: It will take more than a committee to deal with the problem. I think I can help.
translation: 光靠委员会是搞不定的，我想我可以帮上点忙。

original: That's terrific! A real man of action. That's just what we need!
translation: 太好了！一个真正的实干家。这就是我们要的！

original: I could take a whole pack of Ghouls without breaking a sweat.
translation: 我可以不费吹灰之力干掉一大批僵尸。

original: Well. Then you know that some Ghouls aren't feral, and can be reasoned with.
translation: 嗯。那你该知道有些尸鬼并非发狂的，是可以讲道理的。

original: Those Ghouls that keep trying to get into Tenpenny. They need to stop, before someone gets hurt. I think they live in the nearby Metro tunnels...
translation: 那些老想闯进特佩尼大楼的尸鬼。他们得收手了，免得有人受伤。我觉得他们住在附近的地铁隧道里……

original: Sure, I know lots of Ghouls. Killed my share, too.
translation: 当然，我认识很多尸鬼。也亲手宰过不少。

original: The strong silent type, eh? We're in luck! Ever met a Ghoul before?
translation: 寡言少语的实干派，嗯？我们真幸运！以前遇到过僵尸吗？

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <一言不发。>

original: Can't find your tongue? Maybe one of those Ghouls got it. Didn't your mother tell you never to kiss a Ghoul?
translation: 你的舌头不见了吗？可能是僵尸把它给咬掉了。你妈妈没告诉不能吻僵尸吗？

original: Seriously though. You better watch out. There's a pack of those vermin hiding in some tunnels nearby. You afraid of Ghoulies, little girl?
translation: 说正经的。你最好小心点。附近的隧道里有一帮肮脏的僵尸歹徒。你害怕僵尸吗，小女孩？

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <一言不发。>

original: Not very lively are you? Perhaps you're just bored. You should go on an adventure. Nothing like a little bit of the unknown to motivate a person.
translation: 你好像不太活跃，嗯？可能你只是烦了。你应该来一次冒险。没有什么比未知世界更能刺激一个人了。

original: That's what I did. In my... younger years. You know the G.N.R. radio play? The Adventures of Herbert ‘Daring’ Dashwood? That’s about me.
translation: 我就是干这行的。在我……年轻的时候。你知道G.N.R.电台吧？赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德的冒险？那就是在说我。

original: Hell, I even had me a Ghoul manservant. Let me ask you -- you ever met a Ghoul before?
translation: 妈的，我甚至有个僵尸仆人。我来问你 — 你以前遇到过僵尸吗？

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <一言不发。>

original: Someone needs to talk to Tenpenny. I don't think security should let people like you just wander in like that.
translation: 有人要和特佩尼谈谈。我不认为警卫会让像你这样的人这样进来。

original: We all need to be more vigilant with those Ghouls on the loose. Don't suppose you ran into any on your way in here, did you? Hmm?
translation: 我们都要更加警惕那些游荡的僵尸。你没有在来这的路上撞见一只吧，是吧？嗯？

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <一言不发。>

original: Not very bright, are you? Don't worry, comrade. Even the least of us have some small though important role to play in the community.
translation: 不太机灵，对吧？别担心，同志。即使是我们，也有些重要的人只能在公社里只扮演些小角色。

original: For example, I've appointed a committee to discuss this problem with the Ghouls trying to get in here. You know anything about Ghouls?
translation: 例如，我已经约好委员会去讨论僵尸要住进来的事情。你知道僵尸的什么事情吗？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: I'm glad to meet someone who doesn't want to talk my ear off. We should get a drink together. I hate when people talk while I'm drinking. Don't you?
translation: 我很高兴有人能不对我啰嗦。我应该一起喝一杯。我讨厌人们在我喝酒的时候说话。明白吗？

original: And there's plenty to drink about, er talk about, isn't there? Everyone's always prattling on about the Ghouls this, and the Ghouls that.
translation: 这有丰富的饮料和说不完的话题，不是吗？每个人在这唠叨僵尸的种种事情。

original: Frankly I'm getting fed up with all this Ghoul talk... How about you? You know much about Ghouls?
translation: 我受够了那些僵尸的谈论了……你呢？你对僵尸知道多少？

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <一言不发。>

original: Just as I thought. The end of the world happens, and everyone forgets their manners. I bet you were raised in one of those Vault things. Agh!
translation: 正像我所想的。世界末日要来了，每个人都忘记了礼貌。你打赌你是这些避难所里出来的！

original: Or worse, raised by a pack of disgusting Ghouls!
translation: 或者更糟，你是被一帮恶心的僵尸养大的！

original: You know much about Ghouls?
translation: 你对僵尸了解很深？

original: Sure. Whatever.
translation: 当然，随意。

original: Is there something you want? If not, I'm busy telling my neighbors to ignore my husband and his silly committee to discuss the Ghoul situation.
translation: 有什么事吗？如果没事，我还要忙着去告诉我的邻居不要理会我的丈夫，还有他那讨论僵尸问题的傻瓜委员会。

original: You ever have to deal with Ghouls before?
translation: 你以前有没有和僵尸打过交道？

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Your loss. You fancy yourself a man of action? Think you're man enough to handle a couple of Ghouls?
translation: 真可惜。你认为自己是个敢做敢为的男人吗？你认为你有足够的能力打发一群僵尸吗？

original: I'm a little busy at the moment. Maybe we can chat later.
translation: 我现在有点忙。以后再聊吧。

original: Are you calling me ugly? Nice try. I got a pile of bottlecaps that say otherwise.
translation: 你是在说我长得恶心吗？算了吧，我这一大堆瓶盖可不这么说。

original: I bet you think you're pretty butch, eh? Think you got what it takes to kill a few Ghouls?
translation: 我猜你自认为你很男人吧？你认为你有能力杀几个僵尸？

original: From my perspective, things can't get much uglier than they already are.
translation: 就我看来，事情已经不能变得更恶心了。

original: There's no need to get snippy with me, boy!
translation: 别对我无礼，小男孩！

original: We're all little perturbed on account of those Ghouls. Don't suppose you know anything about Ghouls, do you?
translation: 我们都有点担心那些僵尸的事情。我猜你一点也不了解僵尸，对吗？

original: I jumped over the walls when no one was looking. How do you think I got in here?
translation: 我是怎么进来的？趁着没人注意翻墙进来的。

original: There's no need to get snippy with me, girl!
translation: 别对我无礼，小女孩！

original: We're all little perturbed because of those Ghouls. Don't suppose you know anything about Ghouls, do you?
translation: 我们都有点担心那些僵尸的事情。我猜你一点也不了解僵尸，对吗？

original: I jumped over the walls when no one was looking. How do you think I got in here?
translation: 我是怎么进来的？趁着没人注意翻墙进来的。

original: Got a fire up your butt, eh? Better put that to good use. Go out exploring. Don't hang around these fools. You'll only want to blow your brains out.
translation: 屁股坐不住了？最好把这股劲用在有意义的事上。出去探险吧。别跟这些傻瓜混在一起。你只会想打爆自己的头。

original: Ah, to be young again. You know the G.N.R. radio play? The Adventures of Herbert ‘Daring’ Dashwood? That’s about me. Based on my... early days.
translation: 啊，真想再年轻一回。你知道银新台广播剧《赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德历险记》吗？说的就是我，基于我……早年的经历。

original: I had myself a Ghoul manservant and everything. So... you ever met a Ghoul before?
translation: 我甚至还有个尸鬼男仆呢。那么……你见过尸鬼没？

original: Shouldn't you be napping or something?
translation: 你不是该去眯一会之类的？

original: Ah, but not everyone has common sense. Do they?
translation: 啊，不过不是每个人都有常识。不对吗？

original: True happiness flows from respecting those in charge, because they have the happiness of the people at heart.
translation: 真正的幸福来源于对那些管理者的尊敬，因为他们从心底关心他人的幸福。

original: For example, I've appointed a committee to discuss this problem with the Ghouls trying to get in here. You know anything about Ghouls?
translation: 举个例子吧，我已经成立了个委员会去讨论那些想住进来的僵尸的问题。你了解僵尸吗？

original: People don't need leaders, just good common sense.
translation: 人们不需要领导者，只要常识就够了。

original: Well, then you'll excuse me if I don't invite you to share a drink?
translation: 呃，如果我没邀请你喝一杯，你会介意吗？

original: Really, you're as much fun as a couple of Ghouls... They're trying to get in here you know. Don't suppose you've ever had to deal with Ghouls before?
translation: 真的，你像外面的僵尸一样有趣……那些家伙想住进来。我猜你没和僵尸打过交道吧？

original: I'm your worst nightmare.
translation: 我是你最恐怖的噩梦。

original: Tsk. Tsk. You were raised by beasts weren't you? Poor thing.
translation: 啧啧。你是被野兽养大的？可怜的家伙。

original: Did those Ghouls send you here to torment us civilized folk?
translation: 你是那些僵尸派来折磨我们这些文明人的吗？

original: Seriously though, they have everyone on edge. So mind your manners!
translation: 说真的，他们让每个人都很紧张。所以注意你的态度！

original: Oh look, another stuck-up bitch. How impressive.
translation: 噢，快看，又一个趾高气扬的婊子，真让人印象深刻。

original: Ha! You try being married to my husband for five minutes. I dare you!
translation: 我敢说你连和我丈夫结婚5分钟的勇气都没有！

original: I'd rather live with those Ghouls... well, okay, not really. But still.
translation: 我宁愿和僵尸生活……好吧，好的，这不是真的。

original: Did you happen to see any Ghouls out there in the Wasteland? You know how to kill one?
translation: 你在废土看过僵尸吗？你知道怎么杀吗？

original: Isn't a wife supposed to honor and obey her husband?
translation: 妻子不是应该尊敬和服从她的丈夫吗？

original: Me too. Especially rich fine young men!
translation: 我也是。特别是英俊富有的好青年！

original: Listen, you look like you can handle yourself. You survived out there in the Wasteland getting here, after all. You ever have to deal with Ghouls?
translation: 听着，看起来你能处理好自己的事。毕竟你能从废土中活着走到这。你和僵尸打过交道吗？

original: You bet! I like meeting new people.
translation: 当然了！我喜欢认识新人。

original: You got a lot of nerve talking to me like that! But I can respect a woman who doesn't put up with crap.
translation: 你真有勇气像这样和我说话！但我能尊重一个女人不愿意和垃圾在一起。

original: Think you're tough enough to take on a couple of Ghouls?
translation: 你认为你强悍到能打倒僵尸吗？

original: I'm not lost. I'm not a little girl. And I'm not that bad. We could be friends.
translation: 我没有迷路。我不是小女孩。我也没有那么坏。我们可以做朋友。

original: Hmm... very well. As long as security is aware of your presence. Can't be too careful these days. What with these Ghouls and all.
translation: 嗯……很好。只要警卫知道你的存在就行了。这些天来我们在对付这些僵尸，再小心也不过分。

original: Gustavo says he has the situation well in order, but I wonder if he's really trying. Don't suppose you ran into any Ghouls on your way in here?
translation: 古斯塔沃说所有情况都在他控制中，但我怀疑他是否真的在努力。难道你不用自己的方式去对付僵尸？

original: Don't worry. I was let in at the front gate.
translation: 别担心。我是获得许可从前门进来的。

original: Maybe you’ve heard the GNR radio play? The Adventures of Herbert "Daring" Dashwood? That’s about me, you know. Based on my, um... earlier days.
translation: 说不定你听过银新台广播剧？《赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德历险记》？说的就是我，基于我……嗯……早年的经历。

original: I even had a Ghoul manservant. Let me ask you -- you ever met a Ghoul before?
translation: 我甚至有过一个尸鬼男仆。问你个问题——你见过尸鬼吗？

original: "Daring?" Bet you had to earn that nickname, huh?
translation: “大胆”？我打赌这名号是你自己挣来的吧？

original: Thanks, comrade. I'm sure you'll agree the people are only as strong as their leader. That's why I do my best to serve the community to the fullest.
translation: 谢谢，同志。我肯定你同意人民和他们的领导人一样强大。这就是为什么我全心全意的为公社服务。

original: Speaking of service to the community... I don't suppose you are familiar with Ghouls, are you? More importantly, how to kill them?
translation: 说到为公社服务……我想你不熟悉僵尸吧？更重要的是，你知道如何杀死他们吗？

original: I've formed a committee to investigate the problem.
translation: 我们已经成立了委员会来讨论这个问题。

original: It's nice to meet someone with a sense of civic duty.
translation: 很高兴见到一个有公民义务感的人。

original: Oh, fine. We'll have to share a drink sometime. I'm always in the Federalist Lounge. There's certainly plenty to drink about.
translation: 哦，好。我们有空喝杯酒吧。我一直在联邦党人休息室。那有很多种喝的。

original: Take those Ghouls for example...
translation: 就拿这些僵尸为例……

original: Don't suppose you know anything about dealing with their kind, do you?
translation: 我猜你对如何对付这些东西一无所知，对吗？

original: I'm nobody in particular. But I'm sure you'll soon come to like me.
translation: 我不是什么特殊人物。不过我肯定你很快就会喜欢我。

original: You're better mannered than your apparent breeding would indicate. It is nice to make your acquaintance.
translation: 你比看上来要更有礼貌。很高兴在认识你。

original: You didn't happen to catch a glimpse of any Ghouls on your way here did you?
translation: 你过来的时候有没有遇上一只僵尸？

original: It's very nice to meet you, my Lady Wellington.
translation: 很高兴见到你，亲爱的威灵顿女士。

original: Do you know he tried forming a committee to discuss the Ghoul situation? A committee! He made himself Chairman, of course.
translation: 你知道他想要成立个委员会来讨论僵尸的情况吗？委员会！当然，他要当主席。

original: What we need is somebody to DO something! Not just talk about it.
translation: 我们需要的是有人去做点实事！我们不要空谈。

original: Don't suppose you know anything about Ghouls, do you?
translation: 我猜你对这些僵尸一无所知，对吗？

original: You put up with a lot from your husband, huh?
translation: 你很能忍受你的丈夫，是吧？

original: I'll just be going now.
translation: 我现在正要走。

original: Damn right you will. Get lost.
translation: 既然你该死的要走，就快滚吧。

original: Let me think about that option.
translation: 让我想想。

original: Very well, but don't think too long. We don't have much time. My spies say their tall ships are sailing into our harbors even as we speak.
translation: 好的，但是别想太久。我们没有太多时间。我们的间谍说在我们说话这会，他们的高桅帆船正驶进港口。

original: I'll try and get the ink for you.
translation: 我去给你拿墨水。

original: Excellent! Please hasten back. There's no telling how much longer we can hold here at the fort.
translation: 好的！请快点。天知道我们能在这堡垒坚守多久。

original: I hear the thumping of their cannonade getting closer by the minute. Soon, our walls will be breached and the last bastion of the U.S.A. may fall!
translation: 我听到他们大炮的隆隆声在逼近。很快，我们的墙就会被攻破，美国最后的堡垒就会陷落！

original: How can we create a convincing forgery?
translation: 我们怎么造个逼真的复制品？

original: If you were to bring me some iron gall ink, I could produce a mirror perfect duplication.
translation: 如果你给我拿些铁汁墨水，我会给你作出完全一样的复制品。

original: The best place to find some would be in the Arlington Library, which is why I have been unable to do this myself.
translation: 最可能的地方是阿灵顿图书馆，这就是为什么我自己做不到的原因。

original: After all, I can't abandon these fortifications.
translation: 毕竟，我不能放弃这些防御工事。

original: Sure, whatever.
translation: 好的，随便。

original: I'm surprised you're not reveling in the moment. This is a great day for the United States of America.
translation: 我很惊奇你此刻没有欢呼。对美国来说这是个伟大的日子。

original: I think you said it best when you said: "We in America do not have government by the majority. We have government by the majority who participate."
translation: 我觉得你说的最好的一句就是：“美国的政府不是多数人的政府，而是多数参与者的政府。”

original: It has been both an honor and a privilege to serve the United States.
translation: 为美国服务一直是荣誉和责任。

original: What are your final orders?
translation: 你最后的命令是什么？

original: Stand down, and honorably relinquish your post. You've earned a rest.
translation: 稍息，光荣的撤离你的位置。你可以休息了。

original: Coming from you, that means all the world to me. It's been an honor and a privilege to serve my country.
translation: 你的话对我意味着一切。为国效力是荣誉和责任。

original: It's time for me to take a long-needed rest. I think you'll find that the rest of my men are long-due for the same.
translation: 我很早就想休息了，现在终于是时候了。我的手下们也太需要休息了。

original: I hereby relinquish command and control of this fortification to you.
translation: 我谨此向你移交防御工事的控制权。

original: Good luck to you, Mr. Jefferson... and give Sally my regards.
translation: 好运，杰斐逊先生……向莎丽问好。

original: Yes, Button. We won!
translation: 是的，伯顿。我们赢了！

original: It's over? Amen to that. Then I suppose my posting here at the fort is complete.
translation: 结束了？阿门。那我想我对要塞的守卫也结束了。

original: I think you said it best when you said: "We in America do not have government by the majority. We have government by the majority who participate."
translation: 我觉得你说的最好的一句就是：“美国的政府不是多数人的政府，而是多数参与者的政府。”

original: It has been both an honor and a privilege to serve in the army of the United States.
translation: 为美国军队服务是我的荣誉和责任。

original: What are your final orders?
translation: 你最后的命令是什么？

original: It will be brought to the State House for safe keeping.
translation: 它会被送去议会大厦保管。

original: The State House still stands? Then the Stars and Stripes truly are forever. All hail the red, white and blue!
translation: 议会大厦还在？那星条旗要永远飘扬了。为红、白、蓝欢呼！

original: Does... does this mean the War is over? Have we won?
translation: 那……那这意味着战争结束了？我们赢了？

original: It will be carried to our new President, Abraham Washington.
translation: 《独立宣言》将要送到我们新的总统亚伯拉罕·华盛顿那。

original: A new president? So, the Stars and Stripes truly are forever. All hail the red, white and blue!
translation: 新总统？那星条旗真的要永远飘扬了。红、白、蓝万岁！

original: Does... does this mean the War is over? Have we won?
translation: 那……那这意味着战争结束了？我们赢了？

original: A new president? So, the Stars and Stripes truly are forever. All hail the red, white and blue!
translation: 新总统？那星条旗真的要永远飘扬了。红、白、蓝万岁！

original: Does... does this mean the War is over? Have we won?
translation: 那……那这意味着战争结束了？我们赢了？

original: It will be carried to our new President, ummm, Lincoln Madison.
translation: 它将被送给我们的新总统，呃，林肯·麦迪逊。

original: Let me prove my honesty by helping you trick the Redcoats.
translation: 让我帮你骗过红衣，来证明我的正直。

original: Interesting. I had a plan for just this sort of situation. Perhaps this will prove that you're here as an ally rather than an enemy.
translation: 有趣。我对这种情况早有计划。或许这可以证明你在盟友而非敌人。

original: We create a forgery of the Declaration and send it off to Great Britain! It might be just the delay we need to get the document out of here safely.
translation: 我们弄了一个《独立宣言》的复制品送到了大不列颠！它造成的延误或许足够我们真文献安全转移了。

original: I'd love to be at court when King George finds out he wasted all his resources gaining a forgery!
translation: 我可真想亲眼看看乔治国王在宫廷上发现他浪费资源却只得到一个假货的样子！

original: We have to be cautious though, the British scholars would recognize a poor duplicate almost immediately.
translation: 不过我们要小心，英国学者会立刻认出差劲的复制品。

original: I'm Thomas Jefferson and I've returned to liberate the Declaration.
translation: 我是托马斯·杰斐逊代表，我回来找《独立宣言》。

original: Saints alive! It is both an honor and a privilege, sir. I was hoping this day would arrive.
translation: 圣人降临了！这既是荣誉又是责任，先生。我知道这一天会来。

original: I hope these fortifications are up to your high standards, sir. All of my men await your command to push and retake the Capital!
translation: 我希望这些防御工事能达到你高标准的要求，长官。我的人都在等你命令前进发、夺回华盛顿！

original: May I ask where you intend to bring the document?
translation: 我能问下你要带文献去哪吗？

original: I'm sorry, I'm out of meds. Hang in there.
translation: 抱歉，我的药品用完了。坚持住。

original: Thanks, I'll try and keep it together.
translation: 谢谢，我会撑下去的。

original: I'll try.
translation: 我会试试。

original: Here, take one of these Stimpaks. It should help.
translation: 给，拿一个治疗针吧。会有帮助的。

original: Thanks, I'll use it right away.
translation: 谢谢，我立刻使用。

original: All this info on the Declaration... Where'd you get it? I don't like secrets.
translation: 所有《独立宣言》的信息……你是从哪得到的？我不喜欢秘密。

original: Well, ummm. This is quite embarrassing actually.
translation: 呃，唔。这真令人为难。

original: I sent someone like yourself after the Declaration. She did some of the research for me, but now I haven't seen her in a few months.
translation: 我派了其他和你差不多的人去找《独立宣言》。她做了些研究，但有好几个月不见人了。

original: I wouldn't worry about it. Many have died for causes far less grand than what you're about to undertake.
translation: 我不担心。那么多人死掉，但他们执行的任务远没你将要接手的那么伟大。

original: Oh, shouldn't be too long. I just need to get things set up for you. Just sit tight, and I'll be with you as soon as I can.
translation: 哦，不会太久的。我得为你准备好一些东西。耐心等等，我会尽快回来陪着你的。

original: Yes, I think I'd like that. Will it take long?
translation: 是的，我想我喜欢那样。要很久吗？

original: That's still bothering you? Hmm. Well, I can run a few more tests if you like.
translation: 那还让你感到困扰吗？嗯。如果你喜欢，我可以再多作些测试。

original: I've got this headache that just won't go away. Even with the pills you gave me last week. It's the lights, I think. They hurt my eyes.
translation: 我头还是疼。用了你上周给我的药品也不行。我想是灯光伤到我眼睛的缘故吧。

original: Hi, Stanley. Sorry to keep you waiting; what seems to be the trouble today?
translation: 嘿，斯坦利。抱歉让你等这么久；今天感觉哪里不舒服？

original: I'm an agent of Thomas Jefferson and I've returned to liberate the Declaration.
translation: 我是托马斯·杰斐逊代表，我回来找《独立宣言》。

original: Saints alive! It is both an honor and a privilege, madam. I knew the day would arrive that Jefferson would send someone to help!
translation: 圣人降临了！这既是荣誉又是责任，先生。我知道这一天会来。

original: I hope these fortifications are up to your high standards, madam. All of my men await your command to push and retake the Capital!
translation: 我希望这些防御工事能达到你高标准的要求，女士。我的人都在等你命令前进发、夺回华盛顿！

original: May I ask where you intend to bring the document?
translation: 我能问下你要带文献去哪吗？

original: You recovered all of that stuff in the Preservation Society's museum?
translation: 保护协会博物馆里的东西都是你找回来的？

original: Oh no. There is more than a lifetime's supply of grade A crap in that place. Couldn't possibly do it alone. Like you, he hires anyone off the street.
translation: 哦，不。那么多的A级废物，一辈子也弄不完。一个人不可能办到。他随便在街上雇人，比如你这样的。

original: Honestly, I don't care what he does with that stuff. As long as the caps keep flowing, I'll be there to collect.
translation: 坦白说，我不关心他用那些东西做什么。只要瓶盖源源不断，我会就去收集。

original: Oh no. There is more than a lifetime's supply of grade A crap in his museum. Couldn't possibly do it alone. Like you, he hires anyone off the street.
translation: 哦，不。那么多的A级废物，一辈子也弄不完。一个人不可能办到。他随便在街上雇人，比如你这样的。

original: Honestly, I don't care what he does with that stuff. As long as the caps keep flowing, I'll be there to collect.
translation: 坦白说，我不关心他用那些东西做什么。只要瓶盖源源不断，我会就去收集。

original: Have you recovered a lot of relics for Abraham Washington?
translation: 你帮亚伯拉罕·华盛顿找过很多古董吗？

original: Since we're partners now, why don't you tell me about yourself?
translation: 既然现在我们是搭档，为什么你不告诉我你的事？

original: Ha, I'm surprised that you care. Usually everyone looks out for themselves nowadays.
translation: 呵，我很惊讶你会关心我。现在通常人们只关心他们自己。

original: What is it you wanna know?
translation: 你想知道什么？

original: I need to leave. Can you open the gate?
translation: 我要走，你能开门吗？

original: Follow me.
translation: 跟我来。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: Alright. One moment.
translation: 好的，稍等一会儿。

original: Yes sir.
translation: 是，长官.

original: Yes ma'am.
translation: 是的，女士。

original: What kind of place is this Rivet City?
translation: 铆钉城是个什么样的地方？

original: Rivet City is one of the few bastions of civilization left in the land. We're working to rebuild our society; to make the world livable again.
translation: 铆钉城是这片土地上仅存的文明堡垒之一。我们正重建我们的社区；让这儿重新适合人居住。

original: We're the safest, most secure city in the Wasteland. Nothing can get in here without our say so.
translation: 我们这是废土上最安全，治安最好的城市。如果我们不同意，谁都别想进来。

original: Why did all you decide to live on this rusty old tub?
translation: 你们怎么会想到住在这个生锈的旧盆子里？

original: It's a boat. A really big boat.
translation: 一艘船，真正的大船。

original: Do you know anything about Rivet City? How they made it? Anything?
translation: 你知道什么关于铆钉城的事吗？比如它是怎么建立的？还有别的吗？

original: It's a place to live, safe from Raiders and Super Mutants.
translation: 一个免受歹徒和超级变种人袭击的安身之所。

original: With Doctor Li on our side, maybe we can even begin to rebuild the world.
translation: 李博士和我们在一起，或许我们还能重建世界。

original: Why are you guys living on this boat?
translation: 你们为什么要住在这艘船上？

original: It's noisy, dark, and smelly.
translation: 很吵，很暗，还有臭味。

original: But we're safe here. No Super Mutants or Raiders. And maybe Doctor Li will find a way to get clean water for us.
translation: 但我们在这很安全。没有超级变种人或掠夺者。而且，也许李博士会找到办法，为我们提供干净的水。

original: What's it like living on a giant ship?
translation: 住在一艘巨船上是什么感觉？

original: I heard that Rivet City is run by some sort of Council?
translation: 我听说铆钉城由什么议会来管理？

original: Chief Harkness meets with Doctor Li and Bannon to discuss security matters.
translation: 哈克尼斯长官会与李博士和班侬讨论安全事务。

original: It's a waste of a good Monday morning if you ask me. They should just let Chief Harkness call the shots.
translation: 叫我说，那只是浪费美好的礼拜一上午而已。他们应当都交给哈克尼斯长官。

original: Chief Danvers meets with Doctor Li and Bannon to discuss how to run this tub.
translation: 哈克尼斯长官会与李博士和班侬讨论如何管理这大铁罐。

original: It's a waste of a good Monday morning if you ask me. They should just let Chief Harkness call the shots.
translation: 叫我说，那只是浪费美好的礼拜一上午而已。他们应当都交给哈克尼斯长官。

original: Doctor Li, Chief Harkness and I are all on the council. We meet every Monday morning.
translation: 李博士、哈克尼斯长官和我都在议会。我们周一上午会面。

original: I can be very influential, if you know what I mean. Far more than Seagrave Holmes.
translation: 我非常有影响力，你懂吧。我的影响力远远超过了西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。

original: So you're on the City Council.
translation: 那么你是城议会的议员。

original: Doctor Li, Chief Harkness and I are all on the council. We meet every Monday morning.
translation: 李博士、哈克尼斯长官和我都在议会。我们周一上午会面。

original: I can be very influential, if you know what I mean.
translation: 我非常有影响力，你懂吧。

original: So you're on the City Council.
translation: 那么你是城议会的议员。

original: Doctor Li, Chief Danvers and I are all on the council. We meet every Monday morning.
translation: 李博士，哈克尼斯长官和我都在议会。我们周一上午会面。

original: I can be very influential, if you know what I mean. Far more than Seagrave Holmes.
translation: 我非常有影响力，你懂吧。我的影响力远远超过了西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。

original: So you're on the City Council.
translation: 那么你是城议会的议员。

original: Doctor Li, Chief Danvers and I are all on the council. We meet every Monday morning.
translation: 李博士，哈克尼斯长官和我都在议会。我们周一上午会面。

original: I can be very influential, if you know what I mean.
translation: 我非常有影响力，你懂吧。

original: So you're on the City Council.
translation: 那么你是城议会的议员。

original: Bannon and Doctor Li and I all meet on Monday mornings to talk about city wide issues.
translation: 班侬和李博士还有我在周一上午会面谈论城里的事情。

original: It's pretty informal. The council doesn't have much real power.
translation: 那不是太正式的。议会没有太多真正的权力。

original: I heard you're on some sort of City Council.
translation: 我听说你是什么城议会的议员。

original: I heard Angela Staley has a crush on Diego.
translation: 我听说安吉拉·斯塔利喜欢上了迭戈。

original: Oh, yes. She's crazy about him.
translation: 哦，是的。她为他着迷。

original: He keeps telling her no, but he also spends a lot of time with her. It's really not fair to her.
translation: 他总是拒绝她，但又老是和她在一起。这对她真的不公平。

original: Haven't you heard? They're going to get married!
translation: 没听说？他们要结婚了！

original: It's so wonderful. We haven't had a wedding in years.
translation: 这太好了。大伙好多年没举行婚礼了。

original: How are things between Diego and Angela these days?
translation: 安吉拉和迭戈的事最近怎么样啦？

original: That poor girl. Diego told her to never bother him again. She was devastated.
translation: 可怜的女孩。迭戈向她提出分手，她已经悲痛欲绝了。

original: What ever happened between Diego and Angela?
translation: 迭戈和安吉拉之间发生了什么？

original: Yeah, I know. Thank God he's a priest. At least I know nothing's going on between them.
translation: 嗯，我知道。感谢上帝他是牧师。至少我知道他们之间没发生什么。

original: Father Clifford would kick him out of the priesthood if he ever found out.
translation: 克利福德神父如果发现，会把他踢出教会。

original: I heard your daughter has a crush on Diego.
translation: 我听说你的女儿暗恋上了迭戈。

original: Mooning over him? Not any more. She's going to marry him! I'm so happy for my little girl.
translation: 暗恋？不会啊。她要嫁给他了！我为我的女儿感到高兴。

original: Is Angela still mooning over Diego?
translation: 安吉拉还在思念迭戈吗？

original: Father Clifford caught the two of them rutting like Brahmin.
translation: 克利福德神父抓到他们像发情的双头牛一样。

original: Thank God Diego has enough good sense to make an honest woman of her.
translation: 感谢上帝迭戈让她成为一个正直的女人。

original: Is Angela still mooning over Diego?
translation: 安吉拉还在思念迭戈吗？

original: Mooning over him? You have old news, my friend. She married him! They are such a happy couple.
translation: 暗恋？不会啊。她要嫁给他了！他们是幸福的一对。

original: Is Angela still mooning over Diego?
translation: 安吉拉还在思念迭戈吗？

original: That coward! He told her to stay away from him. She still cries about it at night. It's a good thing I would never hurt a priest.
translation: 那懦夫！他让她离他远点。她夜里哭得死去活来。幸好我从不会对牧师动手。

original: I haven't seen Angela bothering Diego lately.
translation: 我最近没看到安吉拉去找迭戈了。

original: Well, one of us is. Sometimes it seems like he doesn't even know I'm there.
translation: 我俩有一个是的。有时他看起来甚至不知道我的存在。

original: So, you and Diego are in love?
translation: 你和迭戈在恋爱？

original: Oh, my God! It was so romantic.
translation: 哦，上帝！太浪漫了。

original: Diego has left the Church. We're going to get married!
translation: 迭戈离开了教会。我们要结婚了！

original: Did the Ant Pheromone work?
translation: 蚁后激素有用吗？

original: Someone told Father Clifford that Diego and I were...you know.
translation: 有人告诉克利福德神父，迭戈和我……你知道。

original: Father Clifford expelled Diego. So now we can get married!
translation: 克利福德神父开除了迭戈。现在我们能结婚了！

original: So how are things with Diego lately?
translation: 你和迭戈之间发展得怎么样？

original: It's true! I'm so happy. Diego is a wonderful man.
translation: 真的！我好高兴。迭戈是个好男人。

original: So, you and Diego are in love?
translation: 你和迭戈在恋爱？

original: That rat bastard! I hate his guts.
translation: 这个鼠辈！我恨死他了。

original: He told me to leave him alone. He won't even talk to me about.
translation: 他让我离他远点。他甚至不想和我说话。

original: So, you and Diego are in love?
translation: 你和迭戈在恋爱？

original: What are you talking about? I'm a man of the cloth! Well, I will be as soon as Father Clifford...
translation: 你在说什么？我是个牧师！呃，只要克利福德神父……

original: Nevermind. It doesn't matter what Angela thinks. Soon I will take vows of chastity.
translation: 没关系。安吉拉怎么想不重要。不久我要履行纯洁的誓言。

original: I hear Angela Staley has a crush on you.
translation: 我听说安吉拉·斯塔利在暗恋你。

original: I...I don't know what came over me. I just lost control and seduced her.
translation: 我……我不知道中了什么邪。我失去了控制，然后引诱了她。

original: But I am an honorable man. I will make her an honorable woman. We're going to get married.
translation: 但我是个有体面的人。我会让她成一个体面的女人。我要娶她。

original: I thought I would be more upset about leaving the church, but she makes me so happy.
translation: 我想离开教堂会让我心中不安，但是她让我很幸福。

original: How are things between you and Angela?
translation: 你和安吉拉之间发展得怎么样？

original: Father Clifford accused me of having relations with Angela. He wouldn't listen when I told him it was a lie.
translation: 克利福德神父控诉我和安吉拉有染。我告诉他那不是真的，他却不听。

original: I am no longer an acolyte. I've been expelled.
translation: 我做不成牧师了。我被开除了。

original: Sometimes when God shuts one door though, he opens another.
translation: 有时候当上帝关上一道门，他就会打开一扇窗。

original: I've asked Angela to marry me, and she said yes.
translation: 我向安吉拉求婚，她答应了。

original: How are things between you and Angela?
translation: 你和安吉拉之间发展得怎么样？

original: Oh, yes! I had to give up being a priest, but it was worth it.
translation: 哦，是的！我必须放弃做牧师，但是这是值得的。

original: So, you and Angela are married?
translation: 你和安吉拉结婚了？

original: That is a thing of the past. I told her to stay away from me forever.
translation: 这是过去的事情了。我告诉他永远离开我。

original: Did you talk to Angela? Are you still seeing her?
translation: 你和安吉拉谈过了吗？你还在和她约会吗？

original: What! If that's true, I'll defrock him. Not only is he fornicating, but he's doing with such an innocent, young girl.
translation: 什么！如果是真的，我要开除他。不仅是通奸，而且他玷污了一个如此清白的女孩。

original: I heard that Diego and Angela are sleeping together. <Lie.>
translation: 我听说迭戈和安吉拉上过床了。 <撒谎.>

original: You mean that he's left the priesthood? Yes.
translation: 你是想问他已经离开了教会了吗？对。

original: They are going to get married. Well, at least I get to perform the ceremony.
translation: 他们要结婚了。至少我会去主持婚礼仪式。

original: Is what I heard about Diego true?
translation: 关于迭戈的传闻是真的吗？

original: I was forced to expel him from the priesthood. It's a shame really. He would have made a fine priest.
translation: 我被迫把他从教会开除，真是令人遗憾。他本可以成为一个不错的牧师。

original: And Diego has done the right thing by asking her to marry him. Thank God for that.
translation: 迭戈向她求婚做得很正确。感谢上帝。

original: Is what I heard about Diego true?
translation: 关于迭戈的传闻是真的吗？

original: Yes, I did. It was a beautiful ceremony.
translation: 是的。那是个美妙的婚礼。

original: Unfortunately, I am now short one acolyte. But this was God's will. I'm sure it's for the better.
translation: 不幸，我少了个助手。但这是上帝的意愿。我相信这会更好的。

original: You married Diego and Angela?
translation: 安吉拉和迭戈结婚了？

original: The poor dear. I wish there was something I could do to help her.
translation: 可怜的人。我希望我能帮她一把。

original: That boy ought to just give her a tumble. It would be good for both of them.
translation: 那男孩应该给她一个承诺。这对他俩都好。

original: Disgusting, isn't it? Someone should talk to that boy. He has no business hanging around that tramp if he's going to be a priest.
translation: 恶心，不是吗？有人应该和那男孩谈谈。他要想当牧师，就不能和那荡妇鬼混。

original: Who is this Saint Monica?
translation: 谁是圣莫尼卡？

original: She is the patron saint of lost children. Very popular among the faithful of Rivet City. I'm surprised you've never heard of her.
translation: 她是失落孩子的守护神，在铆钉城的信徒中非常受欢迎。我很惊讶你不知道她。

original: If you want to hear her story, it will be the topic of my sermon on Sunday. Services begin at 8 am. You should come.
translation: 如果你想听她的故事，周日就有关于她的布道主题。8点开始。你应该来听听。

original: Saint Monica saved her own son's soul from eternal damnation.
translation: 圣莫尼卡从永远的诅咒中挽救了她亲生儿子的灵魂。
