original: She is now the patron saint of lost children for the faithful everywhere.
translation: 她现在是所有迷失孩子的守护神。

original: You really should come to church on Sunday mornings. The sermon will be all about Saint Monica.
translation: 你应该在周日上午来教堂。布道是关于圣莫尼卡的。

original: What is the Capital Preservation Society?
translation: 首都保护协会是什么？

original: I'm collecting artifacts. Historical artifacts. Um...all sorts of things from old DC.
translation: 我收集文物。历史文物。唔……老特区的各种东西。

original: It's important work. Because...well, it just is.
translation: 这是重要的工作。因为……呃，它就是很重要。

original: It's some sort of museum that nutjob Abraham Washington runs.
translation: 它是个博物馆，由亚伯拉罕·华盛顿管理。

original: I'm sorry, but we had a deal for 100 caps.
translation: 抱歉，但是我们说好100个瓶盖的。

original: Oh, no no no. I offered a deal for 100 caps. You declined. So now I'm offering a new deal for 300 caps.
translation: 哦，不不不。我们说好100个瓶盖的时候，你拒绝了。那现在我提出新的价码，300个瓶盖。

original: But why worry about trivialities when your father's safety could be at stake?
translation: 为什么在你爸爸身处险境的时候，你还在为这点小钱讨价还价？

original: 300? What the hell? You said it was 100 caps!
translation: 300个？见鬼了？你说的是100个瓶盖啊！

original: I did say it was 100 caps. And as I recall, you said no. So now I'm saying it's 300 caps. What will you say this time?
translation: 我是说过100个瓶盖。我说的时候，你说不。现在我又说300个瓶盖。这次你会说什么？

original: Behold! He is coming with the clouds! And every eye shall be blind with his glory! Every ear shall be stricken deaf to hear the thunder of his voice!
translation: 看！他伴云彩而起！每一双眼睛都被他的光辉所闪耀！每一双耳朵都被他的雷霆之声所震撼！

original: Let the men, women, and children of the Earth come forth to gather and behold the power of Atom!
translation: 地球上的男人，女人，孩子们都来一起瞻仰和吸纳原子的能量吧！

original: Let those who dwell here in his favored land attend now to the words of the Prophet of Atom!
translation: 他慧赐的土地上居住的人们都来一起聆听原子先知的教诲吧！

original: Come forth and drink the waters of the Glow, for this ancient weapon of war is our salvation, it is the very symbol of Atom's glory!
translation: 来吧，一起品尝这光辉之水，因为这远古战争的武器是我们的救赎，是真正原子光辉的象征！

original: Let it serve as a reminder of the Division that has occurred in the past and the resplendence of the promise of our division in the times to come!
translation: 让它唤起我们对大分裂的记忆，期许即将到来的分裂的光辉！

original: Give your bodies to Atom, my friends. Release yourself to his power, feel his Glow, and be Divided.
translation: 将你的身躯献给原子，我的朋友。将自己释放到他的能量中，感受他的光辉，成为大分裂的一员。

original: There shall be no tears, no sorrow, no suffering, for in the Division, we shall see our release from the pain and hardships of this world.
translation: 那将没有眼泪，没有伤痛，没有苦难，因为在大分裂中，我们将从这艰难困苦的世界解脱。

original: Yea, your suffering shall exist no longer; it shall be washed away in Atom's Glow, burned from you in the fire of his brilliance.
translation: 是的，你的苦难将不复存在；它将在原子的光辉中熔化掉，它将在他壮丽的火焰中灼烧掉。

original: Each of us shall give birth to a billion stars formed from the mass of our wretched and filthy bodies.
translation: 我们每个人将从悲惨污秽的躯壳化为数以亿计的繁星。

original: Each of us shall be mother and father to a trillion civilizations.
translation: 我们每个人都将是无数文明的生身父母。

original: Each of us shall know peace, shall know an end to pain, and shall know Atom in his glory.
translation: 我们每个人都将领悟和平，领悟痛苦的终结，都将在他的荣耀中领悟原子。

original: I urge you, my friends -- come, drink with me and pray...
translation: 我渴求你，我的朋友 — 来，和我一起品尝，一起祈祷……

original: Glorious Atom, I give unto you these feeble bones. I present to your will this frail body.
translation: 光荣的原子呀，我把无力的骨骼贡献给你，我用我脆弱的身躯承接你的意愿。

original: I beg of you to use me as your vessel, guide me to your brilliance, divide each particle and give relief to this rotten flesh.
translation: 我祈求你用我做你的祭品，引领我走进你的光辉，分裂我成为微小的粒子，解脱我腐臭的肉身。

original: Cast the fragile form of this ephemeral body into new life in the forge of your Glow.
translation: 我这短命的身体，投进你那铸造光辉的熔炉中，让这脆弱的形式得到新生。

original: Atom, come -- bestow your presence on your unworthy servant.
translation: 原子，来吧 — 在你卑微的仆人面前展现你的力量。

original: We stay true, until the Day of Division -- until the dawn of your return to His humble world.
translation: 我们忠诚的等待，只为那分裂的到来 — 直到你回到卑微世界的拂晓时分。

original: Yeah. Where'd that Behemoth come from? Good thing Lyons' little friend turned out to be so handy with a Fat Man.
translation: 嗯。哪来的超级变种巨人？幸好里昂斯的小朋友把“胖子”微型核弹发射器用的这么顺手。

original: Yeah. Where'd that Behemoth come from?
translation: 嗯。超级变种巨人从哪来的？

original: Civilians with nukes. Scary stuff. Anyway, a win's a win, right?
translation: 文人拿核武。强啊。不管怎样，胜利就是胜利，不是吗？

original: No idea. Now he's going to be stinking up the place for weeks. Oh well, a win's a win, right?
translation: 不知道。现在他要在这里显摆几个星期。噢，好吧，赢了就是赢了，不是吗？

original: Well, I've looked around a bit.
translation: 哦，我就是四处看看。

original: Oh? And have you come to any conclusions?
translation: 噢？你得出什么结论了吗？

original: This place is a dump.
translation: 这地方像个垃圾堆。

original: Sigh. I was hoping seeing these pieces of the past would snap you out of your pessimism. I see I was wrong.
translation: 唉。我还希望看到这些往昔的点滴能摆脱你的消极看法。看来我错了。

original: I found it quite entertaining.
translation: 我觉得这很有趣。

original: It makes me so happy to hear that! Feel free to look around all you like.
translation: 听你这么说我很高兴！你喜欢什么就随便看看吧。

original: Whatever, old timer.
translation: 什么都行，老前辈。

original: Bah! Sometimes I feel like it's hopeless.
translation: 呵！我有时感觉很无望。

original: I wish I knew more about America.
translation: 我希望对美国能知道得更多。

original: Oh, it's so good to finally meet... I mean, to yet again meet someone who actually cares about history!
translation: 哦，终于能遇到……我意思是，能遇到真正关心历史的人！

original: Looks like a bunch of junk to me.
translation: 对我来说就是一堆垃圾。

original: That's just the attitude I have come to expect from uneducated individuals.
translation: 我就知道无知之人的会是这种态度。

original: It's people like you who will cause the name America to fade from memory. Children will think of the U.S.A. as just the Wasteland.
translation: 就是象你这样的人使得美国在人们的记忆中淡去。孩子们想起美国只知道是废土。

original: I mustn't let that happen! That's why this place exists.
translation: 我不能让这种情况它发生！这就是这地方存在的原因。

original: I suppose I see your point.
translation: 我想我明白你的意思了。

original: Then we understand each other. Hundreds of years ago, people studied history as a career. Then, when the bombs fell, it was almost lost.
translation: 那我们彼此理解了。几百年前，人们把研究历史作为职业。然后，核弹落下，历史消逝殆尽。

original: Can you imagine a country like the U.S.A. without it? It would be the same empty feeling as not knowing your birth mother.
translation: 你能想象一个像美国一样的国家没有历史吗？就好像你不知道你亲生母亲是谁一样空落落的感觉。

original: We are children of this country and to respect it is to know about it.
translation: 我是这国家的子民，尊敬它就要了解它。

original: So, you really care about these relics?
translation: 你真的关心这些文物？

original: Why, of course I do!
translation: 噢，当然！

original: If these items were lost to time, how would we ever be able to explore our heritage or appreciate the sacrifices our founding fathers made?
translation: 如果这些东西随时间丢失，我们怎么探寻我们的传统或者继承我们开国者为之奉献的事业？

original: I have a document you may want. The Bill of Rights...
translation: 我有本书，你可能想要。《人权宣言》……

original: Oh my! I never expected anyone to find this! I didn't even know it was still intact!
translation: 噢，天啊！我从没想到有人能找到！我甚至不知道它还完好！

original: Well, certainly a reward is in order for your efforts. How about 100 caps?
translation: 报酬早就准备好了。100个瓶盖怎么样？

original: I've recovered a copy of the Magna Carta. Interested?
translation: 我得到一份《大宪章》。有兴趣吗？

original: Indeed I am. Although there were several copies made of the document, I certainly never expected to come across one intact.
translation: 当然。虽然这有几个副本，但我没想到能见到一套完好的。

original: What do you say to 75 caps for it?
translation: 你看75个瓶盖怎么样？

original: What are you up to?
translation: 你想干嘛？

original: Well, now that we brought back the Declaration, I think I'll take my cut of the earnings and head out to get drunk.
translation: 噢，我们找回了《独立宣言》，我要拿上我那份，然后去喝个够。

original: Look me up in Underworld if you ever need me. I usually hang there since the Ghouls don't hit on me all the time.
translation: 如果需要我就去地下城找我。我通常都在那，因为僵尸从来不攻击我。

original: How's the museum business?
translation: 博物馆的事怎么样？

original: Oh, it treats me well. I'm sure it will be even better now that we have the Declaration of Independence.
translation: 哦，很好。有了《独立宣言》，我想会更好的。

original: Hopefully, we can add more to the collection and increase our foot traffic!
translation: 希望，我们能拥有更多的收藏，增加客流量！

original: I don't have 300 caps.
translation: 我没有300个瓶盖。

original: Well, that's a shame for you, isn't it? You don't have the caps, and I guess I don't have the information. Disappointment all around.
translation: 噢，太遗憾了，不是吗？你没有那么多瓶盖，我想我也没有信息给你。大家都很失望。

original: Fine, 300 caps. Now spill it.
translation: 好的，300个瓶盖。快说吧。

original: Nothing like the sound of caps jingling in your pocket is there? Always brightens my day.
translation: 有什么会比瓶盖落到口袋里的声音更好听？这让我过得很快乐。

original: And to brighten your day, here's what I know. Your dad said he was headed southeast, into the city. He was aiming for Galaxy News Radio.
translation: 为了让你也过得快乐，我告诉你我所知道的。你爸爸说他要东南方，去城里。他的目标是银河新闻电台。

original: No idea what he wants with them, but you can ask him all about it when you find him. Good luck with that, by the way.
translation: 不知道他为了什么要找他们，不过等你找到他，你可以自己问他。顺便祝你好运。

original: Oh, come on now. Are people in your Vault so gullible that you think I'd fall for this?
translation: 哦，拜托。难道避难所里的人都这么容易上当，所以你以为我也那么好骗？

original: You don't have the caps, so you don't get the information. I'm not stupid.
translation: 你没瓶盖，所以你得不到信息。我不蠢。

original: Okay, let's just take a step back. 100 caps was reasonable, wasn't it?
translation: 好的，让我们各自退一步。100个瓶盖更合理，对吧？

original: Well, I suppose it was. All right; because I'm such a softy, I'll honor our original agreement.
translation: 呃，我想是。好把；因为我心软，我尊重我们最初的约定。

original: Your dad came through here, all right. Didn't stay long, though. Said he had some important business to attend to, and headed off to the city.
translation: 你爸爸确实来过这。但待得时间不长。他说有些重要的事情要处理，就一直向城那边走了。

original: Something to do with Galaxy News Radio. Guess that'd be the place for you to start. Good hunting, and thanks for the caps.
translation: 和银河新闻电台有点关系。我想你应该从那里着手。祝你好运，另外谢谢你的瓶盖。

original: I'm reasonable, but I'm not crazy. How can you bargain with me and not have the caps?
translation: 我很讲理，但是我不疯。你没有瓶盖还怎么和我讨价还价？

original: This is ridiculous. Forget it.
translation: 这太扯了。门都没有。

original: Didn't you say that last time, too? I have a feeling you'll be coming back again.
translation: 你上次也是这么说的吧？我知道你还会回来的。

original: Jesus Christ, did you set this yourself? Well, I'm gonna have to rebreak it...
translation: 基督耶稣，你又上瘾了？好吧，我会再帮你戒掉……

original: What the?... oops. Well, that wasn't important anyway. You'll be fine without it.
translation: 什么？…… 唉。好吧，那也算不上重要。即使没它，你也会很好的。

original: Now how did THAT get in there?
translation: 现在怎么做？

original: How attached to your fingers would you say that you are? Oh, wait... never mind. There it is.
translation: 把你的手指绑上你觉得怎么样？哦，等等……别介意。除这以外，别无他法。

original: I swear you people never learn, what do you think is out there in that Wasteland anyway?
translation: 我发誓你们从来不会学乖，你以为废土是什么样的？

original: You're just going to get yourself killed out there, you know. Not that you'll listen to me...
translation: 你在外面只会被宰，你知道。你不听我的……

original: ... <grumbles> ...
Here, hold this end for me. Okay, now give it back.
translation: 给，抓住这头。好，再交给我。

original: You alright up there. Need another painkiller?
translation: 你还好吧。还要止痛药吗？

original: Let's just see what we can do... mmm-hmm. Yep, just as I thought.
translation: 看看我们能做什么……嗯。是的，和我想得一样。

original: Whoops, butterfingers! Hold on just a second... okay, got it. You're not feeling lightheaded, are you? Great.
translation: 哎呀，笨蛋！坚持一会……好的，好了。你不再感到头晕了，对吧？太好了。

original: That's strange. Wait. Your left, my right. Okay, got it. There... we... go!
translation: 奇怪。等会。你左边，我右边。好了。就那样……成了！

original: You weren't kidding. You love the smack, all right.
translation: 你不是开玩笑吧。你喜欢这东西，好的。

original: I'm taking food out of the mouths of some poor dealer's kids right now, you know.
translation: 你知道，我正从一些穷商人的孩子嘴里抢吃的。

original: That burning sensation you feel, all over your body? That's my patented Addiction-Be-Gone treatment at work!
translation: 你有感到燃烧的感觉传遍全身吗？那是我专有的成瘾去除疗法在起作用！

original: All right, here's your money.
translation: 好的，给你钱。

original: Alright, hold still.
translation: 好的，别动。

original: This may sting a little...
translation: 这可能有点疼……

original: Then what the hell are you wasting my time for?
translation: 见鬼，那为什么要浪费我的时间？

original: Actually, I don't have 100 caps.
translation: 事实上，我没有瓶盖。

original: Alright, hold still.
translation: 好的，别动。

original: This may sting a little...
translation: 这可能有点疼……

original: You kiddin' me? What are you wasting my time for?
translation: 你在开玩笑？你为什么要浪费我的时间？

original: Actually, I don't have 100 caps.
translation: 事实上，我没有瓶盖。

original: Alright, hold still.
translation: 好的，别动。

original: You kiddin' me? What are you wasting my time for?
translation: 你在开玩笑？你为什么要浪费我的时间？

original: Actually, I don't have 100 caps.
translation: 事实上，我没有瓶盖。

original: Okay, now hold still.
translation: 好的，现在别动。

original: Sure, fine.
translation: 当然，好的。

original: Stop squirming, you big mungo.
translation: 别动，你这毛人。

original: Sure, fine.
translation: 当然，好的。

original: Hey! If you don't have the caps, you don't get the fix.
translation: 嗨！你没有瓶盖，就得不到治疗。

original: Actually, I don't have 100 caps.
translation: 事实上，我没有瓶盖。

original: I'd like to help, but the supplies aren't free. Sorry.

original: You too, mister. Time for the G.O.A.T. Find a seat and wait for instructions.
translation: 你也是，先生。该开始G.O.A.T.了。找个座位，等着听说明。

original: If you're the acolyte, who's the priest?
translation: 如果你是侍从，那谁是司祭？

original: Father Clifford. The sanctuary is in the ship's fore, on the upper deck. The good father holds services every Sunday morning.
translation: 克利福德神父。教堂在船体上层甲板的最前头。每周日上午神父都会做礼拜。

original: There's a church in Rivet City?
translation: 铆钉城有教堂？

original: Oh, yes! Father Clifford conducts services every Sunday morning. You should come.
translation: 哦，是的！克利福德神父每周日上午都会布道。你应该去看看。

original: Oh, yes! I conduct services every Sunday morning. You should come.
translation: 哦，是的！我每周日上午都会布道。你应该来看看。

original: Do you actually do anything here in Rivet City?
translation: 你在铆钉城到底做什么？

original: You mean, like fix stuff? Nah.
translation: 你的意思是贩毒？不。

original: I just hang out, dude. I've got enough chems to last a while. Oh, yeah!
translation: 我就是闲逛，伙计。我的药品足够维持一阵了。哦，耶！

original: You seem pretty relaxed.
translation: 你看起来很轻松。

original: No point in getting all worked up. I get three squares, I got a place to crash, and nothings trying to eat me.
translation: 没烦恼了啦。我三餐不愁，有窝避雨，而且又没人要吃掉我。

original: So, you report to Chief Harkness?
translation: 你是哈克尼斯长官的属下？

original: I'm his second in command. I run the night shift and he runs the day shift.
translation: 我是他的副手。我管夜班，他管白班。

original: Is this conversation going somewhere? Because I've got things to do.
translation: 你要说些什么？我还有事要做。

original: He's gone. I'm in charge now.
translation: 他走了。我现在管事。

original: Did you want something, or are you just wasting my time?
translation: 你有什么事要说吗，抑或只是想浪费我的时间？

original: What happened to Chief Harkness?
translation: 哈克尼斯长官怎么了？

original: Whoa! I just wanted to ask you something.
translation: 哇！我只想问你些事情。

original: Yeah, well I don't have time for newbies like you. You got something on your mind, spill it.
translation: 行了，我可没时间理会你这样的菜鸟。有屁快放。

original: No, sir. I'm just here to drink and talk.
translation: 不，先生。我就在这喝酒聊天。

original: Let's keep it that way.
translation: 那就这样。

original: Belle can mix almost anything, as long as its beer or whiskey.
translation: 只要它是啤酒或者威士忌，贝勒能把任何东西混在一起。

original: That depends. What makes a troublemaker?
translation: 看情况。怎么才算惹麻烦？

original: Starting fights, breaking stuff, stealing. Hmmm. I think I'll keep a close eye on you.
translation: 打架，破坏，偷窃。唔。我想我要好好盯着你。

original: Who's in charge around here?
translation: 这地方谁管事？

original: It doesn't work like that. I'm in charge of security. Doctor Li runs most of everything else.
translation: 这儿和你想的不一样。我管治安。李博士负责大部分的其他事务。

original: Bannon kind of represents the merchants. He also owns Potomac Attire.
translation: 班侬是商人代表。他开的店叫波托马克服装。

original: Depends. Chief Harkness is in charge of security. He patrols the whole city. Security bunks down in the tower.
translation: 看情况。哈克尼斯长官管治安，巡逻全城。警卫们住在控制塔里。

original: Doctor Li kind of runs everything else. She's in the aft. That's the northeast end of the city.
translation: 李博士管其他事情。她在船尾，城市的东北尽头。

original: It doesn't work like that. We're just security. Doctor Li runs most of everything else.
translation: 这儿和你想的不一样。我们只管治安。李博士负责大部分的其他事务。

original: Bannon kind of represents the merchants. He also owns Potomac Attire.
translation: 班侬是商人代表。他也拥有波托马克服装。

original: Where can I get medical help?
translation: 在哪能找到医生？

original: Doctor Preston is in the upper deck, fore section. That's the top interior floor in the southwest end.
translation: 普雷斯顿医生的房间在上层甲板的前部，西南尽头。

original: Where are the stores?
translation: 商店在哪？

original: Hangar deck. Right in the middle of the ship. Can't miss it.
translation: 在机库甲板。正好在船中央。不会找不到的。

original: Hangar deck. Right in the middle of the ship. Can't miss it.
translation: 在机库甲板。正好在船中央。不会找不到的。

original: But it's closed now. Check back in the morning. It opens pretty early.
translation: 但是现在关门了。早上再去吧。它开得很早。

original: I'm kind of lost. Can you help me?
translation: 我有点迷路了。你能帮我吗？

original: I suppose.
translation: 我想可以。

original: Here. Have some Psycho.
translation: 给你。我有一些疯狂药。

original: Thanks, man. I really need this fix.
translation: 谢谢，哥们。我真的需要这货。

original: You shouldn't take that stuff. It'll kill you.
translation: 你不能拿那些东西。它会害死你的。

original: That's what Cindy says too. But I got the itch. I need it bad.
translation: 辛迪也这么说过。但我瘾上来了，我需要它。

original: Why don't you just take them from your shop?
translation: 为什么你不从你们的商店拿？

original: My wife, Cindy. She's always watching the inventory. If I take any, she'll lock me out.
translation: 我老婆，辛迪。她一直盯着货架。如果我拿的话，她就把我锁在门外。

original: I think Mister Lopez is suicidal.
translation: 我认为洛佩斯先生要自杀。

original: Yes, I know. I've been counseling him for some time now.
translation: 是的，我知道，我已经为他提供了一阵子心理咨询了。

original: He used to go stand on the observation balcony all afternoon. He's down to only a hour or so at three o'clock.
translation: 他以前要在观光平台上站一下午。现在他只会在三点钟去站一个小时左右。

original: You seem depressed.
translation: 你看起来很沮丧。

original: Is it that obvious? I suppose so.
translation: 很容易看出来吗？可能是吧。

original: My family was killed by Raiders. I don't have much to live for any more.
translation: 我家人被歹徒杀了。我没有活下去的意义了。

original: Why wouldn't I remember you?
translation: 为什么我不记得你？

original: Nobody does. I'm not very memorable.
translation: 没人记得。我不太能给人留下印象。

original: Don't worry, it won't be a problem for much longer.
translation: 别担心，以后这就不是一个问题了。

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: This is the Weatherly Hotel. It's the finest establishment in Rivet City.
translation: 这是韦瑟利旅馆。铆钉城最好的企业。

original: Who's your owner, rust bucket?
translation: 废铁皮，你的主人是谁？

original: I serve Miss Vera Weatherly, proprietor of the Weatherly Hotel.
translation: 我为薇拉·韦瑟利小姐服务，她是韦瑟利旅店的主人。

original: Did you know that Mei Wong is a runaway slave?
translation: 你知道王梅是逃跑的奴隶吗？

original: No. Interesting.
translation: 不知道。有意思。

original: Never look a gift slave in the mouth, I say.
translation: 我觉得吧，送上门的奴隶就别挑三拣四了。

original: Yes. I'm one of them. Have been for years. <lie>
translation: 是的，我是他们中的一员。很多年了。<撒谎>

original: No! Don't take me back! I would rather die than be a slave for that awful Allistair Tenpenny.
translation: 不！别把我带走！我宁愿死，也不做可怕的奥利斯特·特佩尼的奴隶。

original: I'm not going to hurt you. What are you so scared of?
translation: 我不会伤害你。你怎么这样害怕？

original: I suppose it doesn't matter if I tell you.
translation: 我想如果你告诉也没关系。

original: I used to be a slave. I saw a Slaver on this ship, his name is Sister. I'm afraid he's after me.
translation: 我曾是一个奴隶。我看到船上有个奴隶贩子，他叫“修女”。恐怕他在找我。

original: I suppose nothing, now. I've been hunted for so long, being safe here in Rivet City is strange. Sorry.
translation: 我想现在没事了。我一直被追捕，安全地待在铆钉城我还不习惯。抱歉。

original: You don't need to be scared, son.
translation: 孩子，你不必害怕。

original: I ain't scared, and I ain't your son.
translation: 我不害怕，而且我不是你的孩子。

original: Any other stupid questions, asshole?
translation: 还有其他蠢问题吗，混蛋？

original: So, where's your family?
translation: 那你的家人在那？

original: My mom is probably drunk, and my dad's dead.
translation: 我妈妈可能喝醉了，而我爸爸死了。

original: Is that good enough for you, asshole?
translation: 够了吗？混蛋。

original: Dead. Some asshole like you killed them.
translation: 死了。一些像你一样的混蛋杀了他。

original: You're a priest?
translation: 你是个牧师？

original: Yes. My flock is all of Rivet City. You should come to services this Sunday. I'll be telling the tale of Saint Monica.
translation: 是的。我的教友遍布整个铆钉城。你周日可以来参加仪式。我会给你讲圣莫尼卡的故事。

original: You're a runaway. I had to tell Sister about you.
translation: 你是个逃跑的奴隶，我得把你的事情告诉“修女”。

original: Oh, my God! What am I going to do now? How could you?
translation: 哦，天啊！我现在怎么办？你怎么可以？

original: Get away from me!
translation: 离我远点！

original: You're on your own. I'm not getting involved.
translation: 你自己处理。我不想被卷入。

original: I suppose it was wrong of me to ask you for help. I won't talk to you about this again.
translation: 我想请你帮助是我的错。我不会和你再谈这件事了。

original: Here's 25 caps. Maybe you can buy yourself a gun.
translation: 给你25个瓶盖。或许你可以给自己买把枪。

original: Thank you! I'll go to Flak and Shrapnel's just before closing.
translation: 谢谢！我要在“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅关门前，去他们店里。

original: I don't have anything to give you, but I think I can trust you with a secret.
translation: 我没什么给你的，但是我想我能信任你保守我的秘密。

original: If you ever go up north, there is a secret slave hide out called Temple of the Union. You might find them useful.
translation: 如果你往北走，那有一个秘密的奴隶隐藏地，叫团结圣殿。你会发现他们很能干。

original: Thank you! I'll go to Flak and Shrapnel's just before closing.
translation: 谢谢！我要在“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅关门前，去他们店里。

original: I guess that was too much to ask for. Farewell.
translation: 我想我不该开口的。回见。

original: I'd give you enough caps to buy a gun, but I'm a bit short right now.
translation: 我改给你点钱让你自己去买把枪，可我手头有点紧。

original: Let me think about it.
translation: 让我想想。

original: I...I am at your mercy.
translation: 请……请高抬贵手。

original: Don't worry. I would never turn in a runaway slave.
translation: 别担心。我不会告发逃跑的奴隶。

original: Really? Oh, thank you.
translation: 真的？谢谢哈。

original: Can you help me? I've been so worried with him around. I can hardly sleep at night.
translation: 你能帮我吗？他在附近让我很烦。我晚上几乎不能入睡。

original: So you're an escaped slave? Now I understand...
translation: 那你是一个逃跑的奴隶？现在我明白了……

original: No! Please, don't tell Sister. I think he's a Slaver. I don't want to be taken by him.
translation: 不！请不要告诉“修女”。我想他是个奴隶贩子。我不想被他抓住。

original: What is this I hear about the Hangar Deck and Upper Deck?
translation: 我所听说的机库甲板和上层甲板是怎么回事？

original: The Upper Deck people have more money and influence than those that live on the Hangar Deck.
translation: 比起那些居住在机库甲板的人，上层甲板的人有更多的钱和影响力。

original: Some of the upper deck citizens can get pretty snobby about it.
translation: 一些上层甲板的市民可能更势利。

original: That's just folks blowing off steam.
translation: 那不过是吃饱了撑的。

original: Every place has it's haves and have nots. We got Upper Deck and Hangar Deck.
translation: 每个地方都贫富之分。我们这里则是机库甲板和上层甲板。

original: Don't let it bother you.
translation: 不要为此困扰。

original: The people that live on the Hangar Deck are the great unwashed masses.
translation: 住在机库甲板的人大多数都很无知。

original: I read that somewhere. Do you like it?
translation: 这是我听说的。你喜欢吗？

original: Anyway, they need true leaders, like myself.
translation: 不管怎样，他们需要真正的领导，像我一样。

original: We do the best we can to take care of everyone on the Hangar Deck.
translation: 我们尽力照顾好机库甲板的每个人。

original: It's not their fault they can't do better for themselves.
translation: 他们照顾不好自己不是他们的错。

original: The Hangar Deck people should know their place.
translation: 机库甲板的人应该知道他们的位置。

original: Leave the thinking to people who are qualified.
translation: 把脑力活交给更有资格的人。

original: It's a sad state of affairs, but the people that live on those two decks don't trust each other.
translation: 这种状况很可悲，上下两个甲板的人们彼此之间缺乏信任。

original: The Hangar Deck folk believe the Upper Deck people are keeping them down.
translation: 机库甲板的人认为上层甲板的人欺压他们。

original: The Upper Deck citizens believe the Hangar Deck people aren't capable of managing Rivet City.
translation: 上层甲板的人却认为机库甲板的人不具备治理铆钉城的能力。

original: It's a shame really. Everyone should just get along.
translation: 这简直太可悲了，人与人之间应该相互适应。

original: It's not too bad now, but if it keeps going this way, in a few years they'll start fighting in the streets.
translation: 现在还不是太糟，但是如果照此发展的话，用不了几年他们就会在街上打起来。

original: Father Clifford keeps preaching about tolerance and acceptance, but nobody seems to be listening.
translation: 克利福德神父一直在劝说人们要相互容忍与接受，但没人听。

original: Damn Upper Deckers. They think they're better than us. Well, screw them.
translation: 可恶的上层人。他们认为自己比我们要优秀，该死。

original: Yeah, the folks on the Upper Deck think pretty highly of themselves. They think they're better than us.
translation: 嗯，上层甲板的人自以为高高在上。他们觉得自己比我们要优秀。

original: Well, we do all the work, and they keep all the good stuff. Assholes, every one of them.
translation: 唉，活都是我们干，好处却让他们占尽。他们都是混蛋。

original: Sorry. Not interested. Get your own drinks.
translation: 对不起，我不感兴趣。你自己去喝吧。

original: Tightwad!
translation: 吝啬鬼！

original: No! Wait, I didn't mean that. Please, mister? Just one drink.
translation: 不！别忙，我不是那意思。求你了，先生？就一杯。

original: Bitch!
translation: 婊子！

original: These guys won't buy me a round. Just one? Please?
translation: 这些男人一杯都不给我买。就一杯？求你了。

original: Sure. Here's 5 caps. Go ahead and pick your poison.
translation: 好吧。这是5个瓶盖。去买你的酒吧。

original: Whoa! Why is the room spinning?
translation: 哇！房子怎么晃起来了？

original: You're nice. I can tell you a secret. I'm drunk. No, that's not the secret. I have another secret.
translation: 你真好。我要告诉你一个秘密。我醉了。不，这不是那秘密。我还有个秘密。

original: Now that's what I like in a man. Enough caps to buy a lady a drink.
translation: 这就是我最喜欢的人。用足够的瓶盖请女士喝酒。

original: I guess you're okay. Thanks for the drink.
translation: 我想你算个好人。谢谢你请的酒。

original: Some kids are just born bad.
translation: 一些孩子天生就是恶棍。

original: You got that right. My James sure is.
translation: 你说得没错。我的詹姆斯就是这样。

original: I'll be in the Muddy Rudder later. Stop by and we can have a drink together.
translation: 过一会我要去 “泥舵”酒吧。顺道过来，我们可以一起喝酒。

original: You got that right. My James sure is.
translation: 你说得没错。我的詹姆斯就是这样。

original: Sit down and buy me a drink.
translation: 坐下给我买酒。

original: No, I haven't seen him.
translation: 不，我没见过他。

original: Figures.
translation: 好的。

original: I'm going to the Muddy Rudder for a drink later. If I see you down there, you can buy me a drink.
translation: 过一会我要去 “泥舵”酒吧。如果碰到你，你可要请客哦。

original: Figures.
translation: 好的。

original: You should buy me a drink now.
translation: 你现在得请我喝一杯。

original: Hey, I don't want any trouble.
translation: 嗨，我可不想惹麻烦。

original: Smart move. What did you want?
translation: 明智之举。你想要什么？

original: But you're a man. Why do they call you Sister?
translation: 可你是个男人啊。为什么他们叫你“修女”？

original: Are you making fun of my name? It's a damn good thing for you this place is crawling with security. Otherwise I'd kick your ass.
translation: 你在拿我的名字取乐吗？在这满是警卫的地方算你这该死的小子走运。否则我一定揍你。

original: At ease, private. I'm here to inspect the armory.
translation: 稍息，列兵。我来这视察军械库。

original: Sir, you are not authorized to enter the armory. Sir!
translation: 长官，你无权进入军械库。长官！

original: Please don't make me shoot you, Sir!
translation: 请不要逼我向你开枪，长官！

original: So what's your story, slag heap?
translation: 你在干嘛，废渣？

original: Sir, this slag heap is guarding the armory. Sir!
translation: 长官，废渣正在守卫军械库。长官！

original: Glad to see you're alive Shorty!
translation: “矮子”，很高兴看到你还活着！

original: Oh Shorty! I'll tell the others you died bravely!
translation: 哦，“矮子”！我刚想告诉别人你已经英勇牺牲了！

original: Me too! Now, let's get the hell out of here!
translation: 我也是！现在，让我们赶快离开这鬼地方！

original: Damn it! She's dead. Damn damn damn!!! Alright, let's get the hell out of here before one of us joins her. Come on! Move it!
translation: 可恶！她死了。该死该死该死！！！好吧，在我们中有人和她作伴前让我们赶快离开这鬼地方。来吧！行动！

original: Red's fine. Let's go!
translation: 瑞德没事。我们走！

original: Alright, if you say so boss. But if we get to Big Town and she isn't there, I'll kill you.
translation: 好吧，既然你这么说了，老大。但是如果我们去大镇而她却不在那，我会杀了你。

original: Come on, let's get out of here.
translation: 来吧，让我们离开这。

original: Alright! Move it!
translation: 好的！行动！

original: Oh no! Are you sure? But why would you lie about that? Okay. Well... let's get out of here. There's nothing we can do now.
translation: 哦，不！你确定吗？但你为什么要撒谎？好吧。嗯……让我们离开这。现在我们无能为力。

original: Shorty's dead.
translation: “矮子”死了。

original: That sucks! Really? She's dead? Damnit. Let's get out of here, and maybe we can kill a few Super Mutants on the way out! Come on!
translation: 真糟糕！真的吗？她死了？该死。让我们离开这，或许我们可以在出去的路上干掉一些超级变种人！来吧！

original: Red's dead.
translation: 瑞德死了。

original: I'm looking for a woman named Red. Sticky promised me some caps...
translation: 我在找一个叫瑞德的女人。斯蒂奇答应会我给些瓶盖……

original: Red was taken with the others in the last attack by the Super Mutants. She's the doctor. If you rescue her, I'm sure she'll give you your money.
translation: 上次超级变种人进攻的时候瑞德被带走了。她是医生。如果你救了她，我保证她会给你钱。

original: But... you probably shouldn't tell Sticky... it would crush him if he thought Red was in danger, or possibly dead.
translation: 但是……或许你不该告诉斯蒂奇……如果告诉他瑞德被困住或者或许已经死了，他会崩溃的。

original: Those damn Muties took her with the others when they raided the town last. If you rescue her, I'm sure she'll pay you whatever Sticky owes.
translation: 上次该死的超级变种人进攻的时候瑞德被带走了。她是医生。如果你救了她，我想她会将把斯蒂奇欠下的全部给你。

original: But... just don't tell Sticky, okay? He just got here and we want him to have a little hope before we tell him how awful things are.
translation: 但是……千万别告诉斯蒂奇，好吗？他刚来这，在我们告诉他情况是多么糟糕前，我们希望他能够还拥有些许希望。

original: Red was the only decent person in this hellhole, and the Mutants took her in the raid. That Sticky is a doofus, but I bet Red will cover his debts.
translation: 瑞德是这肮脏的地方里唯一的好人，变种人在袭击中将她带走了。那斯蒂奇是个蠢货，但是我认为瑞德会还清斯蒂奇的人情的。

original: But... you probably shouldn't tell Sticky Red's gone. I don't want one more cry baby wandering around here causing a ruckus. It's bad enough already.
translation: 但是……你或许不应该告诉斯蒂奇，瑞德已经不在了。我不希望在这地方再加一个哭闹的孩子来添乱。已经够糟的了。

original: The Super Mutants took Red along with the others. She was the only person that really ever listened to me.
translation: 超级变种人把瑞德带走了。她可是唯一一个听我说话的人。

original: Don't tell Sticky, though. He's liable to kill himself if he knew Red was gone.  And that would conflict with my own suicide plans.
translation: 别告诉斯蒂奇，因为如果他知道瑞德不在了，他有可能会自杀。这就与我自己的自杀计划冲突了。

original: Come on, don't charge me. It was an... accident. Won't happen again.
translation: 拜托，别逼我。这是一个……意外。不会再发生了。

original: Okay, fine. But just this once. Here's another collar. Be more careful this time.
translation: 好的，没关系。但是下不为例。这是另一个项圈。这次多加小心。

original: Nah, maybe another time.
translation: 喏，或许还会有下一次。

original: Alright. Whatever you say, boss; it's your loss. But you can make a pile of caps. Let me know when you change your mind.
translation: 好吧。你说什么都行，老大；这是你的损失。不过你会发财的。在你改变主意的时候告诉我。

original: Sure, I'll buy another one. Here's 100 caps.
translation: 当然，我还要买一个。这是100个瓶盖。

original: Try to be more careful next time.
translation: 下次多加注意。

original: You ain't got enough caps, asshole. This ain't a soup kitchen, and those collars ain't easy to come by. Come back when you got some money.
translation: 你的钱不够，混蛋。这不是善堂，这些项圈得来不易。等你有足够的钱再来。

original: Tell me how this all happened.
translation: 告诉我这都是怎么发生的。

original: Well, we were on a contract to map the Vernon Square area of the D.C. Ruins. That's what we do, you see... usually it's routine.
translation: 嗯，我们在执行特区废墟的弗农广场的绘图任务。这就是我们的工作，你看……通常都是例行公事。

original: What we didn't expect was to get jumped by dozens of those damn Super Mutants. They came out of the woodwork.
translation: 但意料不到的是突然跳出来几十个该死的超级变种人。它们从木料堆中跳了出来。

original: We had to retreat into the hospital next door and fight our way to the roof like you did. It was the only direction we could manage.
translation: 我们不得不撤退到隔壁的医院里，并像你一样杀到楼顶。这是我们唯一的出路。

original: Long story short, we got stuck on the roof with no supplies and Reilly went for help. That's the last we heard from her.
translation: 长话短说，我们在弹尽粮绝的情况下被困在楼顶，莱莉去求援。这是我们最后一次见到她。

original: I'd like permission to trade.
translation: 我想得到交易的许可。

original: This is not normally something that we do. Trade with outsiders has proven to be... problematic in the past.
translation: 这不是件普通事。在过去与外人贸易被认为是……有问题的。

original: However, considering the circumstances... So be it. I'll send word to Durga that you have full access to trade.
translation: 不管怎么说，考虑到具体情况……也只能这样了。我会通知杜尔加你有贸易的所有权力。

original: <Continue to say nothing.>
translation: <沉默不语>

original: I'm glad that we understand one another.
translation: 很高兴我们能互相理解。

original: <Continue to say nothing.>
translation: <沉默不语>

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <沉默不语>

original: You don't say much, do you?
translation: 你不爱说话，是吗？

original: No. I don't.
translation: 是的。

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: You're damn right you will. And you'll keep at it until you learn to keep that mouth shut. We've got no room for braggarts here.
translation: 你他妈最好干下去。一直干，直到你学会闭嘴。我们不会收留光说不练的假把式。

original: Good choice. Pride has taken down more Brothers than I can count. You'd best remember that.
translation: 明智的选择。“里昂斯的骄傲”损失的兄弟多到我都记不清了。你最好别忘了。

original: But... sir! The throw was good! It cleared the line and... and... look! The wall wasn't even hit with shrapnel! I... I'm sorry. I'll try again.
translation: 但是……长官！丢得太漂亮了！防线被扫荡了……而且……看！这堵墙甚至没有被弹片击中！我……对不起。我会再试一次。

original: I'm... I'm sorry sir. I'll keep trying.
translation: 我……对不起。我会一直试下去。

original: Soldier, don't you dare start running that mouth until you can put one of those grenades through a fourth story window at 200 yards.
translation: 士兵，在你把手榴弹扔进200码外的四层楼窗户里之前能不能把嘴闭上。

original: Yeah, sure. That's one dead mutant. But the Brother who was using that car for cover is dead too. Learn to check your zone, maggot.
translation: 嗯，当然。又干掉个变种人。但是用那辆车作掩护的兄弟也死了。学会检查你的区域，笨蛋。

original: Did you see, sir? I nailed it. Right under the target. Boom! That's a dead mutie right there.
translation: 你看见了吗，长官？我干掉它了，直接扔到目标脚下。轰！那怪物就死在那。

original: All right! That was perfect! I got it dead on! What do you think of that, sir? Good enough to take out a mutant, right?
translation: 好的！太棒了！我干掉它了！你觉得怎么样，长官？对于消灭一个怪物来说已经足够好了，对吧？

original: Fourscore and seven years ago our fathers brought forth on this continent, a new nation,
translation: 87年前我们的父辈开拓了这块大陆，一个新的国家。

original: conceived in Liberty, and dedicated to the proposition that all men are created equal.
translation: 自由的理念，坚持人类生来平等的主张。

original: Now we are engaged in a great civil war, testing whether that nation or any nation so conceived and so dedicated, can long endure.
translation: 现在我们在进行一场伟大的内战，来检验那国家或是任何一个这样构建的国家能否长久的坚持下去。

original: We are met on a great battle-field of that war.
translation: 我们在那场战争的一次大战役中相遇。

original: We have come to dedicate a portion of that field as a final resting place for those who here gave their lives that that nation might live.
translation: 我们这些参战的人将这片土地作为自己长眠之地，好让自己的国家能够继续生存下去。

original: It is altogether fitting and proper that we should do this.
translation: 我们这么做天经地义。

original: But, in a larger sense, we cannot dedicate--we cannot consecrate--we cannot hallow--this ground.
translation: 但是，在某种更大的意义上说，我们不能视这片土地为一切，也不会将我们自己完全奉献给她。

original: The brave men, living and dead, who struggled here, have consecrated it, far above our poor power to add or detract.
translation: 勇敢的人们，不管是活着还是死去的，那些在这奋斗的人，视之为神圣，这神圣是我们无法用我们微薄的力量去增加或是诋毁的。

original: The world will little note, nor long remember what we say here, but it can never forget what they did here.
translation: 这世界永远不会记住我们在这曾经说过什么，但是永远不会忘记他们曾在这做过什么。

original: It is for us the living, rather, to be dedicated here to the unfinished work which they who fought here have thus far so nobly advanced.
translation: 我们在这不是为了去进行那些曾在这骄傲战斗的人们所未尽的工作，而这一切都是为了我们的生活。

original: It is rather for us to be here dedicated to the great task remaining before us--
translation: 我们是为这留给我们的伟大使命而来的……

original: that from these honored dead we take increased devotion to that cause for which they gave the last full measure of devotion--
translation: 从这些光荣死去的人身上，我们获得更大的热情，来实现他们曾付出全部而未实现的理想……

original: that we here highly resolve that these dead shall not have died in vain--
translation: 我们到这来解决这问题，以免他们死得无谓。

original: that this nation, under God, shall have a new birth of freedom--
translation: 上帝庇护之下的这国度将会获得自由的新生。

original: and that government of the people, by the people, for the people, shall not perish from the earth.
translation: 民有、民治、民享的政府是不会从地球上消失的。

original: You have any info on where this Commonwealth android is hiding?
translation: 你知道这个联邦人造人藏在哪吗？

original: We got a man at Rivet City. Been looking for a long time. I doubt he's even still there. Either way, don't go sticking your nose in our business!
translation: 我们在铆钉城有个人。找了他很久，我怀疑他现在还在那。不管怎样，别来干涉我们的事情！

original: We got a man at Rivet City. Been looking for a long time. I doubt he's even still there. Either way, don't go sticking your nose in our business!
translation: 我们在铆钉城有个人。找了他很久，我怀疑他现在还在那。不管怎样，别来干涉我们的事情！

original: We got a man at Rivet City. Been looking for a long time. I doubt he's even still there. Either way, don't go sticking your nose in our business!
translation: 我们在铆钉城有个人。找了他很久，我怀疑他现在还在那。不管怎样，别来干涉我们的事情！

original: I found this recording from the android. Care to elaborate?
translation: 我找到了人造人的这个录音。能详细说说吗？

original: Trail led to Rivet City. Sister's our inside man. I think he's long given up looking for that android, and is just living it up on that boat.
translation: 踪迹通向铆钉城。“修女”是我们的线人。我想他早已放弃寻找那机器人了，他现在只是住在船上而已。

original: Trail led to Rivet City. Sister's our inside man. I think he's long given up looking for that android, and is just living it up on that boat.
translation: 踪迹通向铆钉城。“修女”是我们的线人。我想他早已放弃寻找那机器人了，他现在只是住在船上而已。

original: Trail led to Rivet City. Sister's our inside man. I think he's long given up looking for that android, and is just living it up on that boat.
translation: 踪迹通向铆钉城。“修女”是我们的线人。我想他早已放弃寻找那机器人了，他现在只是住在船上而已。

original: I found this recording from the android. Care to elaborate?
translation: 我找到了人造人的这个录音。能详细说说吗？

original: Why has Zimmer hired you too? I can't find a trace of that robot. I'm sure he's here somewhere though. Don't tell Eulogy I told you, though.
translation: 为什么齐默也雇用了你？我找不到那机器人的踪迹了。我敢确定他现在就在这附近。不过别跟尤勒基说我告诉了你。

original: Why has Zimmer hired you too? I can't find a trace of that robot. I'm sure he's here somewhere though. Don't tell Eulogy I told you, though.
translation: 为什么齐默也雇用了你？我找不到那机器人的踪迹了。我敢确定他现在就在这附近。不过别跟尤勒基说我告诉了你。

original: Why has Zimmer hired you too? I can't find a trace of that robot. I'm sure he's here somewhere though. Don't tell Eulogy I told you, though.
translation: 为什么齐默也雇用了你？我找不到那机器人的踪迹了。我敢确定他现在就在这附近。不过别跟尤勒基说我告诉了你。

original: I found this recording from the android. Care to elaborate?
translation: 我找到了人造人的这个录音。能详细说说吗？

original: You know anything about an android who needed some surgery?
translation: 你了解那需要接受手术的人造人的情况吗？

original: All I know is Zimmer, the guy contracting to find this slave, is hot to retrieve him. He's starting to get other people looking. So it's a race now.
translation: 我所知道的就是齐默，这家伙执意要找到这奴隶，他十分热衷于找回他。他正在派其他人进行寻找，所以这就已然成为一个竞赛了。

original: I hope you're not on the case. If I find out you are, well... You best not be! We'll leave it at that.
translation: 我希望你没插手。一旦我发现你这么做的话，嗯……你最好别这么做！先说到这儿。

original: All I know is Zimmer, the guy contracting to find this slave, is hot to retrieve him. He's starting to get other people looking. So it's a race now.
translation: 我所知道的就是齐默，这家伙执意要找到这奴隶，他十分热衷于找回他。他正在派其他人进行寻找，所以这就已然成为一个竞赛了。

original: I hope you're not on the case. If I find out you are, well... You best not be! We'll leave it at that.
translation: 我希望你没插手。一旦我发现你这么做的话，嗯……你最好别这么做！先说到这儿。

original: All I know is Zimmer, the guy contracting to find this slave, is hot to retrieve him. He's starting to get other people looking. So it's a race now.
translation: 我所知道的就是齐默，这家伙执意要找到这奴隶，他十分热衷于找回他。他正在派其他人进行寻找，所以这就已然成为一个竞赛了。

original: I hope you're not on the case. If I find out you are, well... You best not be! We'll leave it at that.
translation: 我希望你没插手。一旦我发现你这么做的话，嗯……你最好别这么做！先说到这儿。

original: About this info regarding an android... Don't suppose you'd care to elaborate?
translation: 关于这个人造人的消息……看来你是不愿详谈了？

original: Despite all his grumbling, I think Eulogy still wants us finding that guy. Zimmer is asking around hiring other people. Makes us look bad.
translation: 撇开他的这些怨言，我想尤勒基还是希望我们找到那家伙。齐默正四处雇其他人，这让我们很丢脸。

original: I'd hunt down surgeons and bang on their heads to get leads, but I'm tired of chasing after that android thing.
translation: 我想抓捕医生拷问出线索，但我跟踪那人造人已经跟烦了。

original: Despite all his grumbling, I think Eulogy still wants us finding that guy. Zimmer is asking around hiring other people. Makes us look bad.
translation: 撇开他的这些怨言，我想尤勒基还是希望我们找到那家伙。齐默正四处雇其他人，这让我们很丢脸。

original: I'd hunt down surgeons and bang on their heads to get leads, but I'm tired of chasing after that android thing.
translation: 我想抓捕医生拷问出线索，但我跟踪那人造人已经跟烦了。

original: Despite all his grumbling, I think Eulogy still wants us finding that guy. Zimmer is asking around hiring other people. Makes us look bad.
translation: 撇开他的这些怨言，我想尤勒基还是希望我们找到那家伙。齐默正四处雇其他人，这让我们很丢脸。

original: I'd hunt down surgeons and bang on their heads to get leads, but I'm tired of chasing after that android thing.
translation: 我想抓捕医生拷问出线索，但我跟踪那人造人已经跟烦了。

original: About this info regarding an android... Don't suppose you'd care to elaborate?
translation: 关于这个人造人的消息……看来你是不愿详谈了？

original: I guess I can trust you not to spread it around. Zimmer has put it out that he will pay to find this slave, but he wants him alive.
translation: 我想我可以信任你不会告诉别人。齐默扬言他会为找到这奴隶而付钱，但是他想要活口。

original: Hey! You aren't thinking of signing up with him are you?
translation: 嗨！你不会在考虑为他干活吧？

original: It wouldn't be healthy for you, if you know what I mean.
translation: 那可对你没好处，明白我的意思吧。

original: Don't know anything about a surgery, but I do know that Zimmer has put a bounty on his head.
translation: 我不知道手术的事，但我知道齐默出了大笔赏金要他的脑袋。

original: A word of advice. You don't want to be competing with me for this one. I'd hate to have to waste a bullet on you.
translation: 给你个建议。你不希望和我抢买卖吧，我不想在你身上浪费子弹。

original: I guess I can trust you not to spread it around. Zimmer has put it out that he will pay to find this slave, but he wants him alive.
translation: 我想我可以信任你不会告诉别人。齐默扬言他会为找到这奴隶而付钱，但是他想要活口。

original: Don't get in my way on this one. My competition tends to end up dead.
translation: 别碍我的事。我会拼命的。

original: About this info regarding an android... Don't suppose you'd care to elaborate?
translation: 关于这个人造人的消息……看来你是不愿详谈了？

original: What do you know about an android from the Commonwealth?
translation: 关于联邦的人造人，你知道些什么？

original: Here's a copy of the so-called "android recording." We're done wasting resources on that job.
translation: 这有“人造人磁带”的副本。我们不会再在那上面浪费资源了。

translation: 告诉我更多关于这个人造人的事。

original: I found this info about an android from the Commonwealth. Care to elaborate?
translation: 我找到了从联邦逃跑的人造人的信息。需要详细说明吗？

original: What can I tell you about it, beyond it not being any of your business, you mean?
translation: 在它成为你的任务之前，我能告诉你它的什么？

original: Nothing really. Just some run away android from the Commonwealth. Naturally they asked the Paradise Falls crew for help retrieving their property.
translation: 真的没什么。就是些从联邦逃跑的人造人.自然而然的，他们向堕落天堂成员求援以便找回他们的财产。

original: The job pays well, but so far it's been mostly a distraction. Certainly hasn't been a priority for us.
translation: 报酬很不错，但已经成了一件烦心事。当然对我们来说，这已经不是最重要的事情了。

original: Nothing really. Just some runaway slave from the Commonwealth. Eulogy had us running around like morons looking for him. I'm done with that.
translation: 真的没什么。就是些从联邦逃跑的机器人。尤勒基让我们像傻子一样到处找它，我已经做过了。

original: It's none of your God damn business.
translation: 该死的这不关你的事。

original: Nothing really. Just some run away slave from the Commonwealth. Naturally they asked the Paradise Falls crew for help retrieving their property.
translation: 真的没什么。就是些从联邦逃跑的机器人。很自然他们向堕落天堂成员求援以便找回他们的财产。

original: The job pays well, but so far it's been mostly a distraction. I think most have pretty much given up and forgotten about it.
translation: 报酬很不错，但已经成了一件烦心事。我想最好还是放弃它，并彻底忘了它。

original: Do you know where this android had his face or memory replaced?
translation: 你知道这人造人是在什么地方更换面孔和记忆吗？

original: Pinkerton at Rivet City took care of him a while back. Was a complete success. No one will recognize that robot now. I'm glad.
translation: 平克顿不久前处理了他。这是一次完全意义上的成功。现在没人能够认出那机器人，我很高兴。

original: But you hush yourself about all that. The hounds are still out sniffing around.
translation: 但是在事态平息前你别多嘴。猎犬依旧在周围搜寻。

original: I know you know where this android received his operations. Talk.
translation: 你知道这个人造人是在哪接受手术的。告诉我吧。

original: To Pinkerton at Rivet City. He doesn't remember his old life, and now he can't be forced to betray us.
translation: 去铆钉城找平克顿。他不记得他过去的生活了，现在他不会背叛我们。

original: The Lord will protect us, but just to be safe we've shut down the railroad. Agents of the Commonwealth are still looking for him.
translation: 主会保护我们，但为了安全我们已经暂停“轨道”。联邦探员依旧在寻找他。

original: I know you know where this android received his operations. Talk.
translation: 你知道这个人造人是在哪接受手术的。告诉我吧。

original: He was delivered to Pinkerton at Rivet City a long while back. It's been a complete success. No one will recognize that robot now.
translation: 他被送回到铆钉城的平克顿那有一段时间了。这件事十分成功，现在没人能够认出那机器人了。

original: We can all breathe easier, but we've shut down the Railroad until we are sure this has all blown over. Agents of the Commonwealth are still looking.
translation: 我们可以放松了，我们在事情结束之前已经暂停“轨道”。联邦探员依旧在寻找它。

original: I know you know where this android received his operations. Talk.
translation: 你知道这个人造人是在哪接受手术的。告诉我吧。

original: Heard Pinkerton at Rivet City fixed him up good. That robot doesn't even know he's a robot. But they are still after him. So we all better lay low.
translation: 听说铆钉城的平克顿已经把它完全修好了，那机器人甚至不知道他是个机器人。但是他们依然在找他，所以我们最好低调点。

original: I know you know where this android received his operations. Talk.
translation: 你知道这个人造人是在哪接受手术的。告诉我吧。

original: Are you part of the Railroad? What do you know about this android?
translation: 你是“铁路”的成员吗？你知道这机器人的事吗？

original: A while back they were asking around for a computer genius to give our friend a new set of memories. You know, a clean slate and all that.
translation: 不久前他们四处寻找一个电脑天才来给我们的朋友设置一套记忆系统。你知道的，清空记忆改头换面之类。

original: I know you're part of the Railroad. What do you know about the android?
translation: 我知道你是“轨道”的成员。对于那个人造人，你知道些什么？

original: He's one of God's creatures, just like you and I.
translation: 他是神造的生灵，就像你我一样。

original: He wanted new memories and a new face. Sadly, I couldn't help him. He left to look for a tech, someone with pre-war skills.
translation: 他想要全新的记忆和一张新的面孔。不幸的是我帮不了他。他离开了，去寻找一个拥有战前技能的技术员。

original: I know you're part of the Railroad. What do you know about the android?
translation: 我知道你是“轨道”的成员。对于那个人造人，你知道些什么？

original: Shhh! Not so loud! Whoever brought you in should have told you to be more discreet!
translation: 嘘！小点声！不管是谁带你来这的都应该已经告诉你要多加小心！

original: They were looking for a tech-wizard awhile back. Someone who could give our friend a new set of memories. You know wipe them clear and replace them.
translation: 他们在寻找一个技术天才，一个可以给我们朋友一套新的记忆的人。你知道就是清空并重置。

original: Not sure how that'd be accomplished. If you know anything, send word by the regular channels. Now go before someone overhears us!
translation: 不敢确定这是怎么完成的。如果你知道些什么，老办法通知我。现在在有人听到我们谈话前赶快离开！

original: I know you're part of the Railroad. What do you know about the android?
translation: 我知道你是“轨道”的成员。对于那个人造人，你知道些什么？

original: They were looking for a tech wizard a while back. Someone who could fiddle with the android's memories.
translation: 他们在寻找一个技术天才，一个可以修改机器人记忆的人。

original: But you better stop poking around. Those Commonwealth hunters are still out there, tracking him down. We shut down the Railroad for safety.
translation: 但是你最好别四处大厅。那些联邦猎人仍在外面，试图寻找他。我们为了安全暂停了“轨道”。

original: I know you're part of the Railroad. What do you know about the android?
translation: 我知道你是“轨道”的成员。对于那个人造人，你知道些什么？

original: I know you know something about this android from the Commonwealth.
translation: 我知道你知道一些关于那个联邦来的人造人的事。

original: Last I heard, they were looking for a surgeon and a computer technician. But you best keep your head down, honey. Those hounds are still out there.
translation: 我最近听说，他们正在寻找一名外科医生和一名电脑技术员。但是你最好低调点，亲爱的。那些猎犬仍旧在外面。

original: I know you know something about this android from the Commonwealth.
translation: 我知道你知道一些关于那个联邦来的人造人的事。

original: It's true. They found him a place to hide. It's not easy. The Commonwealth always sends someone looking. Someone ruthless and determined.
translation: 这是真的。他们为他找了一个藏身之地，这很不容易。联邦总是派人寻找，一些冷酷执着的人。

original: They had been searching for a surgeon and computer programmer. I hope they found them. It's too dangerous to be out in the open now.
translation: 他们正在寻找一名外科医生和一名电脑程序员，我希望他们已经找到了。现在跑到外面去实在是太危险了。

original: He must be important if the hunter is still looking after all this time. May God guide his footsteps.
translation: 如果赏金猎人一直在寻找他，这人一定非常重要。愿上帝为他指路。

original: Be careful who you talk to. These are dangerous topics.
translation: 注意你交谈的人。这些都是危险的话题。

original: I know you know something about this android from the Commonwealth.
translation: 我知道你知道一些关于那个联邦来的人造人的事。

original: I heard they found him a place to hide. It's not easy. The Commonwealth always sends someone looking. Someone ruthless and determined.
translation: 这是真的。他们为他找了一个藏身之地，这很不容易。联邦总是派人寻找，一些冷酷执着的人。

original: They were looking for a surgeon and a computer wiz. But that's old news.
translation: 他们正在寻找一名外科医生和一名电脑天才，但这不是什么新鲜事了。

original: Lay low for a while. We've had to temporarily shut down the railroad.
translation: 低调点，我们已经暂停了“轨道”的运作。

original: I know you know something about this android from the Commonwealth.
translation: 我知道你知道一些关于那个联邦来的人造人的事。

original: They were looking for a surgeon and a techie to do some advanced stuff to make him seem like a different person.
translation: 他们在寻找外科医生和技术员，用些先进技术让他看上去像另一个人。

original: But you better forget about all that for now. They shut down the Railroad. Those Commonwealth agents were starting to get close.
translation: 但是目前你最好忘了那些。他们暂停“轨道”，那些联邦探员正在接近。

original: I know you know something about this android from the Commonwealth.
translation: 我知道你知道一些关于那个联邦来的人造人的事。

original: I'm interested in this android from the Commonwealth.
translation: 我对从联邦逃跑的人造人很感兴趣。

original: We don't do that anymore. Well, not until the heat dies down. The Railroad isn't operating anymore. Best forget it about it now.
translation: 我们不再这么做了。哦，在风声过去前。“轨道”已经暂停运作。最好现在忘了这些。

original: I wouldn't betray one of God's children. Besides, we don't do that anymore. It's been too risky of late. We shut the Railroad down.
translation: 我不会背叛任何一个上帝的子民。而且，我们不再这么做了。迟点就危险了。我们暂停“轨道”。

original: The last one was... different. I heard a lot of people are looking for him. That's all I know. May the Lord guide him to safety.
translation: 最后一个……不同。我听说很多人在找他，这就是我知道的。愿上帝保佑他。

original: We don't do that anymore. Well, not until the heat dies down. For now, the Railroad is shut down.
translation: 我们不再这么做了。哦，在风声过去前。“轨道”已经暂停运作。最好现在忘了这些。

original: Used to help them escape from the Commonwealth. Find them places to lay low. The last one was someone real important. They are still looking for him.
translation: 过去经常帮助他们从联邦逃脱。为他们找到藏身之处。最后一个是个真正重要的人物。他们依旧在搜寻他。

original: Ooh. We had to shut down the Railroad. Got too hot. You're endangering people by talking about it. Those Commonwealth hunters are deadly serious.
translation: 哦。我们不得不暂停“轨道”。局势十分紧张，你谈论此事为让人陷入危险。那些联邦猎人可是动真格的。

original: Do you know who did the memory transfer on the escaped android?
translation: 你知道是谁为那逃跑的机器人改变的记忆吗？

original: I sure do! No one believes me though. It was old Pinkerton. You know, the "ghost" of Rivet City. He's a genius!
translation: 我当然知道！尽管没人相信我，是老平克顿。你知道，铆钉城的幽灵。他是个天才！

translation: 你知道关于清除那逃跑的人造人记忆的事情吗？

original: That Commonwealth robot was real! I have proof. Listen to this!
translation: 联邦人造人是真的！我有证据。仔细听着！

original: Well, not sure how they'd do the mind wipe. Maybe with a giant magnet or something. But I know this for sure. That Commonwealth robot was real!
translation: 嗯，不确定他们是怎样清除的记忆。或许是利用强磁场或是其他的什么。不过我确信知道，那联邦人造人是存在的！

translation: 嗯……我想神经器是个强磁场或是其他的是什么。但是有一点我确信无疑，那联邦人造人是存在的！

original: I found some information on a Circuit Neuralizer. Care to elaborate?
translation: 我在一个环状神经器上找到了一些信息。能详细说说吗？

original: Some say it was all a hoax. But it's real. Here. Check out this holotape I found. That Commonwealth robot was real!
translation: 有人说这都是恶作剧，但它是真的。给，听听我找到的全息磁带。那联邦人造人是真实的！

original: Some say it was all a hoax. But they're wrong. That Commonwealth robot was real!
translation: 有人说这都是恶作剧。但他们都错了，那联邦人造人是真的！

original: Some say it was all a hoax. But they're wrong.  I've seen diagrams of that Neuralizer, it's real. And so is that android!
translation: 有人说这都是恶作剧。可是他们错了，我见过那神经器的设计图，这是真的。那人造人也是真的！

translation: 我在一个环状神经器上找到了一些信息。能详细说说吗？

original: Shhh! They might be listening.
translation: 嘘！或许有人在偷听。

original: The Commonwealth has tried to make it out to be a hoax, but the escaped android is real I tell you!
translation: 联邦一直试图让外界认为这是个恶作剧，但我跟你说这逃跑的人造人是真的！

original: Listen to this holotape. It will make you a believer too.
translation: 听听这全息磁带，这会让你也相信的。

translation: 大多数人认为这是一个恶作剧。这有些证据你自己看看，给你这全息磁带。

original: Most believe it's a hoax. There's some evidence for it being real. I'm not convinced either way.
translation: 大多数人认为这是一个恶作剧。虽然有一些能够证明它是真的证据，但我也不是很确信。

translation: 我过去认为这都是些胡说八道的东西。但不久之后我得到了这全息磁带，给，你自己听听吧。

translation: 我过去认为这都是些胡说八道的东西，我也不那么确定。但这已经不是新鲜事了。又有谁在意呢，不是吗？对我的生活没什么影响。

original: Ah maaaan. I wish it wasn't just a giant practical joke. Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. Think how cool it would be if it were true!
translation: 啊妈呀 ，我真希望这不是个恶作剧。这有一张那老全息磁带的复制品。想想如果它是真的该有多酷！

original: How cool it would be if it were true! It was a huge joke they pulled. They sent those to lots of people. I bet other people got tapes like that.
translation: 如果它是真的话，想想是多么酷的一件事！这是一个恶作剧。他们向很多人发了那些东西。我打赌其他人也有像这样的全息磁带。

original: Tell me more about this holotape about the android.
translation: 跟我多讲讲这份关于仿真人的全息磁带吧。

original: Have you heard the so called "android recording?" It sounds like an ordinary man! Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. It's a hoax for sure.
translation: 你听说过“人造人磁带”吗？听起来好像一个正常人一样！这有一张那老全息磁带的复制品，这无疑是个恶作剧。

original: I guess they sent those tapes to lots of people. Especially people like me who are interested in technology. Boy, I wish androids were real, though!
translation: 我猜他们向很多人发了那些磁带。特别是像我这样对技术感兴趣的人。哎，我真希望仿真人是真的！

original: Tell me more about this holotape about the android.
translation: 跟我多讲讲这份关于仿真人的全息磁带吧。

original: Some dang fool was selling android recordings. I was just as big a fool for buying one.
translation: 一些傻瓜在贩卖人造人磁带，而我则是愚蠢的买家之一。

original: Here, have mine. Nothing but a damn hoax anyway.
translation: 给你，拿我的。除了一个该死的恶作剧什么都不是。

original: Yeah, I know. I got "DUMMY" written on my forehead. They sent those tapes to lots of people. You know, gullible and technically minded folk like me.
translation: 嗯，我知道。我的脑门上写着“傻瓜”。他们把磁带卖给了许多人。你看，就是像我这样容易上当并喜爱技术的家伙。

original: Tell me more about this holotape about the android.
translation: 跟我多讲讲这份关于仿真人的全息磁带吧。

original: It's a hoax. Here listen to this "android recording." We analyzed it. That's clearly a human man speaking.
translation: 只是个恶作剧。听听这“人造人磁带”，我们对它进行过分析，那确实是个人类在说话。

original: They sent tapes like that to various people who were interested in gadgets and technology. Our analyses concluded it was an ordinary man.
translation: 他们把磁带卖给许多对机械技术感兴趣的人，我们的分析家推断它是个正常人类。

original: Tell me more about this holotape about the android.
translation: 跟我多讲讲这份关于仿真人的全息磁带吧。

original: A bunch of bullshit, that's all that was. Here, take this old holotape. It's just some guy pulling a clever prank. Had lots of folk convinced though.
translation: 完全是胡扯，完全是。给你，拿着这老全息磁带。这就是一些家伙玩的恶作剧，很多人信以为真。

original: So much bullshit. Though I have to admit, it was a clever hoax. They sent tapes like that to various technically minded people. Ha! Couldn't fool me.
translation: 一派胡言。但是我不得不承认，这恶作剧玩得很漂亮。他们将那样的磁带卖给许多有技术头脑的人。哈！根本骗不了我。

original: Tell me more about this holotape about the android.
translation: 跟我多讲讲这份关于仿真人的全息磁带吧。

original: Do you know anything about an android from the Commonwealth?
translation: 你知道联邦人造人的事情吗？

original: They were talking about that a while ago. He needed some special surgery and brain hack or something. Was really cool.
translation: 他们不久前还在谈论。他需要某种特殊的外科和大脑手术或是类似的东西。很酷吧。

original: Turns out it was just joke though. Wish it was real. How cool would a living robot be?
translation: 这事只是个恶作剧罢了。但我希望它是真的。一个有生命的机器人是一件多么酷的事情？

original: Something about facial surgery and reprogramming its memory. But that seems to have been a hoax. Haven't heard anything about it in a long time.
translation: 关于面部整形和重组记忆的事情，似乎只是个恶作剧。很长时间没听过有关这的事情了。

original: I reckon you're talking facial surgery and memory reprogramming.
translation: 我猜你在说面部整形和记忆重组的事。

original: I always liked that story best. Boy, Wastelanders sure can spin a yarn. It's been a while since I heard that one.
translation: 我一直最喜欢那个故事。天，废土游民真是会编故事。不久前我就听说过这样的一个。

original: Supposedly he needed facial reconstruction and memory wipe. At first we were thrilled about the idea of androids. Turns out it was just a hoax.
translation: 听说他需要进行外科整形和记忆消除。最初我们对这人造人的消息感到兴奋，结果只是个恶作剧。

original: Rumors about facial surgery and reprogramming its memory. That's ancient gossip by now. Forget about it, smoothskin.
translation: 关于外科整形和记忆重组的传闻，现在看来只是个遥远的恶作剧罢了。忘了它吧，光皮肤。

original: You know who might have a Lipoplasticator or Micro Dermal Graftilizer?
translation: 你知道谁会有脂肪塑形机或微型皮肤移植机吗？

original: I heard old Pinkerton at Rivet City had a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous.
translation: 我听说在铆钉城的老平克顿有脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。如果说我不羡慕他，那一定是在撒谎。

original: I heard old Pinkerton at Rivet City had a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous.

translation: 有传闻说钉城的老平克顿有。很容易感染致死。不管怎么说，我承认有点羡慕他。

original: I found this holotape. What do you know about facial reconstruction?
translation: 我找到了这个磁带。关于面部整形你知道些什么？

original: Probably down at Rivet City. Anything that has any use out here, they snatch up for themselves. That damn Pinkerton don't share nothin'.
translation: 或许在铆钉城有。他们把这有用的东西都夺走了。那该死的平克顿什么都不愿意跟大家分享。

original: Dammit! Why are you wasting my time? I already told you, ask Pinkteron down at Rivet City.
translation: 该死！为什么你要浪费我的时间？我已经告诉你了，去铆钉城问平克顿。

original: If you are lookin' to change your face, I'd try Pinkerton at Rivet City. That boy's got no sense of ethics. And you're a fool if you try it.
translation: 如果你想改变你的容貌，我建议你去铆钉城去找平克顿，那家伙毫无道德。如果你够傻，就去试试。

original: I found this holotape. What do you know about facial reconstruction?

translation: 据说铆钉城的平克顿用某种方法搞到了去脂整形机和微型植皮器，真的太神奇了。

translation: 据说铆钉城的平克顿用某种方法搞到了去脂整形机和微型植皮器，真的太神奇了。

translation: 平克顿是唯一疯狂到去试验的外科医生。风险太大了。如果你想做的话就去铆钉城，但不要指望到时会比我帅。

original: I found this holotape. What do you know about facial reconstruction?

original: Try Pinkerton at Rivet City. Heard he has the goods. Hope he doesn't try to actually use them on anyone. Bet he would though. He's nuts.
translation: 到铆钉城找平克顿试试，听说他会用。希望他没有在某人身上实际用过。但是我打赌他会的，他是疯子。

original: Try Pinkerton at Rivet City. Heard he has the goods. Hope he doesn't try to actually use them on anyone. Bet he would though. He's nuts.

original: I tell these assholes to just stop looking in the mirror. But if you want to mess up your face, try Pinkerton at Rivet City. He's crazy enough.
translation: 我告诉这些混蛋别再照镜子了。但是如果你想改变容貌，去铆钉城找平克顿试试。他是个十足的疯子。

original: I know it's foolish to cut into the body unnecessarily. Leads to infection. Heard Pinkerton's willing to give it a try though. Try him at Rivet City.
translation: 我认为在身体上添无谓的伤口是愚蠢的，那还会导致感染。听说平克顿想要做些实验。到铆钉城找他。

translation: 我找到了这个磁带。关于面部整形你知道些什么？

original: Ever do any facial surgery? Maybe on someone from the Commonwealth?
translation: 做过面部手术吗？也许是给从联邦跑来的某人？

translation: 面部整形太危险了，而且你需要一些特殊的战前仪器。嗯，这让我想起了一个老恶作剧。这就是那全息磁带的拷贝。

translation: 需要专门的仪器和技术。还很容易被感染。太危险了。

translation: 那完全是传闻。你需要特殊的仪器和技术，还很容易被感染。太危险了，千万别试。

translation: 该死的馊主意。那让我想起了这老恶作剧。给，你自己去听听这盘老掉牙的全息磁带吧。

translation: 你该明白我讨厌重复说过的话。该死的馊主意。

translation: 如果你问我的话，我会告诉你这是个愚蠢的主意，那完全是个精心策划的恶作剧。

translation: 你听说过人造人磁带的事情吗？我自己不知道怎么做这东西。这有那套全息磁带的拷贝。拿去听听。

translation: 跟我多讲讲这份关于仿真人的全息磁带吧。

translation: 想来那传闻已经很长时间没人提了。拿着这全息磁带自己听听，就是些无聊的家伙搞的恶作剧。忘了它吧。

translation: 你耳朵聋了吗？我说过这是个传闻。事实上几乎每个废土的医生都得到了那样的全息磁带，去烦别人吧。

translation: 跟我多讲讲这份关于仿真人的全息磁带吧。

translation: 我曾经学过不能以貌取人,以表观物。那是个精心策划的恶作剧。去听听这全息磁带，很显然是假的。

translation: 很明显是假的。你可以去问废土的任何一个医生，我们都得到了这样的磁带。

original: Tell me more about this holotape about the android.
translation: 跟我多讲讲这份关于仿真人的全息磁带吧。

original: That old "android recording?" Some of the boys took that seriously. Clearly it was a hoax. Here's a copy of the holotape. Listen for yourself.
translation: 那老的人造人磁带？有些人很认真地对待这事，很显然这是个恶作剧。这是一份全息磁带的拷贝，自己好好听听吧。

original: You don't take that seriously do you? They sent tapes like that all over the Wasteland. Try bothering someone else.

original: Tell me more about this holotape about the android.
translation: 跟我多讲讲这份关于仿真人的全息磁带吧。

original: Oh you mean that old "android recording?" Have you heard it? It's great. Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. It's either real or a great joke.
translation: 哦，你想说那“人造人磁带”的事情啊？你以前听说过吗？很棒。这是那老的全息磁带的拷贝，这如果不是真的，就是个大玩笑。

original: Yeah! It's really great isn't it? I mean, if it's real it's amazing, if it's fake, it's really funny. They sent tapes like that to doctors all over.
translation: 耶！它太棒了，不是吗？我是说，如果是真的话简直是太强了。如果是假的，也实在是太有趣了。他们把那样的磁带给了几乎所有的医生。

original: Tell me more about this holotape about the android.
translation: 跟我多讲讲这份关于仿真人的全息磁带吧。

original: That old story? Well, now.... I haven't heard talk of that in quite some time. It was all just a rumor. A hoax. Someone's idea of a practical joke.
translation: 那老故事？嗯，现在……最近一段时间还真没人谈论这事情了。这完全是传闻而已，一个恶作剧。某些人精心策划的恶作剧而已。

original: Story was there was an android, escaped from the Commonwealth up north. From someplace called the Institute.
translation: 故事讲的是一个从北面联邦一个叫研究院的地方逃跑的人造人。

original: There was a holotape that got circulated. I think I've got a copy of it... Yeah, here it is. Give it a listen. That's a man's voice! Hoax for sure!
translation: 有个四处传播的全息磁带。我想我有过一份……嗯，给，去听听。那是个人类的声音！毫无疑问是个恶作剧！

original: Like I said, it's a hoax. Don't bother with it. Someone sent tapes like that to pretty much every doctor in the Wasteland. None of us believed it.
translation: 就像我说的那样，这是个恶作剧，别拿它来烦我。事实上几乎每个废土的医生都得到了那样的全息磁带，我们没人相信它。

original: Tell me more about this holotape about the android.
translation: 跟我多讲讲这份关于仿真人的全息磁带吧。

original: I had forgotten about that old hoax. Have you heard it? Here's a copy of that old  "android holotape." It's just some practical jokester.
translation: 我已经忘了这老恶作剧了。你听说过吗？这有一份那“人造人磁带”的备份，只是些精心策划的玩笑罢了。

original: It's a pretty elaborate practical joke. I mean, they sent a bunch of tapes like that to doctors all over the Wasteland.
translation: 真是个精心准备的恶作剧。我的意思是，他们给每个废土的医生都发了那样的全息磁带。

original: Tell me more about this holotape about the android.
translation: 跟我多讲讲这份关于仿真人的全息磁带吧。

original: Do you know anything about some android who needed a surgeon?
translation: 你知道一个需要外科医生的人造人的事吗？

original: Hmm... If I recall, he was looking for a surgeon and some kind of computer genius. But those rumors are ancient history by now.
translation: 嗯……如果我没记错的话，他在寻找一个外科医生和某种电脑天才。但是到目前为止这些传闻已经成为历史了。

original: Some VIP from up north looking for surgery and computer expertise. I don't pay attention to that crap, and neither should you.
translation: 一些从北方来的重要人物在寻找外科医生和电脑专家。我对那破事不感兴趣，你也不该感兴趣。

original: Now that's an old story. If I recall, some runaway android was looking for a surgeon and, what? A computer expert, if I remember correctly.
translation: 现在那只是个老故事而已。如果我没记错的话，某个逃跑的人造人在寻找一个外科医生，和一个什么来的？哦，一个电脑专家，如果我没记错的话。

original: You believe that ancient crap? Rumors of an escaped robot looking for a hacksaw and a computer expert. Forget about it.
translation: 你居然相信那久远的破事？一个逃跑机器人寻找外科医生和电脑专家的传闻。忘了它吧。

original: Oh yeah! That crazy old story about an escaped robot, right? He was looking for a surgeon and a computer expert. Yeah, that sounds right.
translation: 哦，耶！那疯狂的老故事是关于一个逃跑的机器人的，不是吗？他在寻找一个外科医生和一个电脑专家。对，就是这样的。

original: Well... ancient rumor had it that some hotshot from the Commonwealth was looking for special surgery, and some kind of computer tech.
translation: 哦……一个老传闻说某个从联邦来的家伙在找特殊的外科医生，和某种电脑技术员。

original: Sounds like that old story. Let's see... It was an escaped robot looking for someone to perform surgery, and for a computer expert too, or something.
translation: 听起来像那老故事。让我想想……一个逃跑的机器人寻找某个能做外科手术的人，还有一个电脑专家，或是其他的什么事。

original: This could be an opportunity of a lifetime for you! I've misplaced some very sensitive property. And you will help me find it!
translation: 这对你来说是个千载难逢的好机会！我丢失了一些非常重要的财产。你可以帮我找到它！

original: I'm listening.
translation: 我在听。

original: How amusing. You've mistaken my metaphor for a derogatory remark. I need a local, you see. Someone with verve.
translation: 真好玩，你一定把我的隐喻当做了对你的不敬。我需要个原住民，你知道，一个有热情的人。

original: I've misplaced some very sensitive "property."
translation: 我丢失了一些非常重要的财产。

original: You have a problem with the way I look?
translation: 你看我不顺眼？

original: To the point. I like that. Well, as it turns out, I've misplaced some very sensitive "property."
translation: 我喜欢简明扼要，嗯，是这样，我丢失了一些非常重要的财产。

original: That depends. What exactly are we talking about, here?
translation: 天哪！我们究竟在这谈论什么？

original: You should be nervous. Who says that I'm not here to kill you all?
translation: 你应该紧张。谁说我不是到这来干掉你们的？

original: I... don't... I mean... if Elder Lyons chooses to show trust in you, then by the oath, I must trust you as well.
translation: 我……不是……我的意思是……如果里昂斯长老选择信任你，根据誓言，我也一定要信任你。

original: "Give way your suspicions to the wisdom of thine Elder. Where he shows trust, so shall you," says the Codex.
translation: “不要怀疑你的长老的智慧。他信任谁，你也应该信任谁”，法典写着的。

original: Even if I don't understand why he would trust someone like you, I obey him and welcome you here. I only hope that you are a man of honor.
translation: 即使我不能理解为什么他会相信你这样的人，我也会服从他的意志并欢迎你到这来。我只是希望你是个有荣誉感的人。

original: I... don't... I mean... if Elder Lyons chooses to show trust in you, then by the oath, I must trust you as well.
translation: 我……不是……我的意思是……如果里昂斯长老选择信任你，根据誓言，我也一定要信任你。

original: "Give way your suspicions to the wisdom of thine Elder. Where he shows trust, so shall you," says the Codex.
translation: “不要怀疑你的长老的智慧。他信任谁，你也应该信任谁”，法典写着的。

original: Even if I don't understand why he would trust someone like you, I obey him and welcome you here. I only hope that you are a woman of honor.
translation: 即使我不能理解为什么他会相信你这样的人，我也会服从他的意志并欢迎你到这来。我只是希望你是个有荣誉感的人。

original: There's no need to be nervous. You can trust me.
translation: 没必要紧张，你可以信任我。

original: It is not personal, anybody who has not taken the Oath of Fraternity is suspicious to us.
translation: 这不是针对你的，任何没有进行过兄弟会宣誓的人都会被怀疑。

original: The Codex says: "Fear those who do not pledge to the Brotherhood for though their eyes may be opened through service, they are now blind"
translation: 法典说：“小心那些没有对兄弟会宣誓的人，因为他们虽然通过效力开阔了眼界，但他们是盲目的”。

original: But it also tells us "Give way your suspicions to the wisdom of thine Elder. Where he shows trust, so shall you".
translation: 但上面也说“不要怀疑你的长老的智慧。他信任谁，你也应该信任谁”。

original: Elder Lyons trusts you, so you are free to stay here.
translation: 里昂斯长老信任你，所以你可以自由地待在这。

original: Good. Your fear... pleases me.
translation: 好。你的担忧……让我感到很愉悦。

original: I... don't... I mean... if Elder Lyons chooses to show trust in you, then by the oath, I must trust you as well.
translation: 我……不是……我的意思是……如果里昂斯长老选择信任你，根据誓言，我也一定要信任你。

original: "Give way your suspicions to the wisdom of thine Elder. Where he shows trust, so shall you," says the Codex.
translation: “不要怀疑你的长老的智慧。他信任谁，你也应该信任谁”，法典这么说的。

original: Even if I don't understand why he would trust someone like you, I obey him and welcome you here. I only hope that you are a man of honor.
translation: 即使我不能理解为什么他会信任你这样的人，我也会服从他的意志并欢迎你到这来。我只是希望你是个有荣誉感的人。

original: I... don't... I mean... if Elder Lyons chooses to show trust in you, then by the oath, I must trust you as well.
translation: 我……不是……我的意思是……如果里昂斯长老选择信任你，根据誓言，我也一定要信任你。

original: "Give way your suspicions to the wisdom of thine Elder. Where he shows trust, so shall you," says the Codex.
translation: “不要怀疑你的长老的智慧。他信任谁，你也应该信任谁”，法典写着的。

original: Even if I don't understand why he would trust someone like you, I obey him and welcome you here. I only hope that you are a woman of honor.
translation: 即使我不能理解为什么他会相信你这样的人，我也会服从他的意志并欢迎你到这来。我只是希望你是个有荣誉感的人。

original: Understandable. I've met a lot of dangerous people myself.
translation: 可以理解。我自己也见过很多危险的人。

original: It's not simply the outsiders that we are wary of, anybody who has not taken the Oath of Fraternity is suspicious to us.
translation: 我们不仅仅是提防外人，所有没有进行兄弟会宣誓的人对我们来说都是可疑的。

original: The Codex says: "Fear those who do not pledge to the Brotherhood for though their eyes may be opened through service, they are now blind"
translation: 法典说：“小心那些没有对兄弟会宣誓的人，因为他们虽然通过效力开阔了眼界，但他们是盲目的”。

original: But it also tells us "Give way your suspicions to the wisdom of thine Elder. Where he shows trust, so shall you".
translation: 但上面也说“不要怀疑你的长老的智慧。他信任谁，你也应该信任谁”。

original: Elder Lyons trusts you, so you are free to stay here.
translation: 里昂斯长老信任你，所以你可以自由地待在这。

original: The honor is all mine, Squire.
translation: 是我感到光荣，侍从。

original: Oh! Well... Thank you! Your words are... very kind. Kinder than those I usually hear.... Is there... something I can help you with?
translation: 哦！这个……谢谢你！你的话……很好。比我通常听到的话要好得多……是否……有我可以帮你的地方？

original: You seem nervous, kid. Do I make you nervous?
translation: 你看起来很紧张，孩子。是我让你紧张了吗？

original: Well... yes, sir. If I may speak my will: You do, sort of. We don't have many guests in the Citadel.
translation: 嗯……是的，先生。请恕我直言：在某种程度上，是你。我们在五角大本营没有太多的客人。

original: And when we do, they're usually visiting Brothers. Outsiders are not to be trusted, so says the codex.
translation: 有客人的时候，也通常是来访的兄弟会的人。外人是不可信的，法典上是这么说的。

original: "Shield yourself from those not bound to you by steel, for they are the blind. Aid them when you can, but lose not sight of yourself".
translation: “屏蔽那些没有和你一样用钢铁保护自己的人，因为他们是盲目的。尽量协助他们，但不要迷失自己。”

original: Relax, Squire. I don't bite.
translation: 放松，侍从。我不咬人。

original: I plead for your pardon if my behavior offends you, sir. We don't get many visitors in the Citadel.
translation: 如果我的行为冒犯到了你，我请求你的宽恕，先生。我们在五角大本营没有太多访客。

original: The Brothers and Elder Lyons are excellent teachers, but I get nervous about the protocols. The codex says that outsiders are not to be trusted.
translation: 兄弟会和里昂斯长老是很棒的老师，但对于规矩我感到很紧张。法典说不能信任外人。

original: "Shield yourself from those not bound to you by steel, for they are the blind. Aid them when you can, but lose not sight of yourself," it says.
translation: “屏蔽那些没有和你一样用钢铁保护自己的人，因为他们是盲目的。尽量协助他们，但不要迷失自己。”法典这么说。

original: I plead for your pardon if my behavior offends, ma'am. We don't get many visitors in the Citadel.
translation: 如果我的行为冒犯到了你，我请求你的宽恕，长官。我们在五角大本营没有太多访客。

original: The Brothers and Elder Lyons are excellent teachers, but I get nervous about the protocols. The codex says that outsiders are not to be trusted.
translation: 兄弟会和里昂斯长老是很棒的老师，但对于规矩我感到很紧张。法典说不能信任外界的人。

original: "Shield yourself from those not bound to you by steel, for they are the blind. Aid them when you can, but lose not sight of yourself," it says.
translation: “屏蔽那些没有和你一样用钢铁保护自己的人，因为他们是盲目的。尽量协助他们，但不要迷失自己。”法典这么说。

original: Huh. Yeah, I guess I hadn't thought of it like that. Thanks… I appreciate the pick-me-up.
translation: 呃。嗯，我想我还没有像那样想过。谢谢你这口提神酒。

original: Right, right... Good point.
translation: 对，对……说得好。

original: Yeah...Yeah! We've handled worse before, right? See, I knew you'd cheer me up. Thanks!
translation: 嗯……耶！我们以前碰到过更糟的，不是吗？看吧，我就知道你能让我高兴起来的。谢谢！

original: Look, the Enclave has the tech, they have the resources. But do they have the heart? I don't think so. We'll hold true.
translation: 看，英克雷有技术、有资源。但他们有勇气吗？我认为没有。我们能应付得了。

original: Please. We'll win this. You know why? We need to. Hasn't that always been enough? You worry too much.
translation: 拜托。我们会获胜的。你知道为什么吗？我们必须要获胜。这还不够吗？你担心得太多了。

original: You're kidding me, right? Tin soldiers in devil suits, and you lose your nerve? Those Enclave troops are a joke.
translation: 你在开玩笑，对吧？穿魔鬼套装的锡兵，你也会害怕？那些英克雷军队是个笑话。

original: The truth? We can barely fend off the Super Mutants. Now we have a new threat to contend with? Doesn't look good.
translation: 真相？我们几乎不能抵挡超级变种人。现在我们又有了要对付的新的威胁？看起来不妙。

original: Have you seen that Enclave Power Armor? That's the Advanced Mark II! I don't know if a standard round can even penetrate that stuff!
translation: 你曾经见过英克雷动力装甲吗？那是先进的马克II型！我不知道常规弹头能否贯穿它！

original: Scribe Peabody was telling me about those Enclave Plasma weapons. You know they can turn a man to goo? How the hell do you defend against that?
translation: 文士博迪和我说过那些英克雷等离子武器。你知道用它们可以将人变成肉泥？你到底能够怎样防御这种大杀器？

original: You heard what the others have been saying? About the Enclave?
translation: 你听到其他人说什么了？关于英克雷？

original: What's your tactical assessment of this new... situation?
translation: 对于这新形势……你有什么战术上的看法？

original: I heard Elder Lyons talking to Rothchild. Sounds like even he's worried about the Enclave. Think I'm just being paranoid?
translation: 我听到里昂斯长老和罗斯查德的谈话，听起来就连他也担心英克雷。或许我有些太多疑了？

original: So what do you think?  Can we take these Enclave guys?
translation: 那么你是怎么想的？我们能对付这些英克雷的家伙吗？

original: I ran some scans on the Enclave positions at the purifier. That's some serious firepower they're packing. What do you think?
translation: 我对英克雷在净化器那边的部署做了几次扫描。他们在那的火力十分强大。你怎么想？

original: Does this sound noble enough? "Quail before me, foul Super Mutant! Thine end is at hand! Yield, that I may ease thine suffering!"
translation: 这么说够庄严吗？“在我面前发抖吧，愚蠢的超级变种人！尔等死到临头了！屈服吧，我会让尔等死得痛快些！”

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: What's on your mind?
translation: 你在想什么？

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: Go on...
translation: 继续……

original: I'm listening.
translation: 我在听。

original: This is starting to sound risky, but I'll do anything to find my dad.
translation: 这听起来挺冒险，但无论如何我也要找到我的父亲。

original: It IS risky. I would never lie to you.
translation: 这很危险，我不骗你。

original: But there's something behind those eyes of yours that screams "I'm the one who can get shit done"!
translation: 但从你眼中我能看到一个声音“只有我能做到！”

original: Your dad had that same look in his eyes too. That's why Three Dog's helping you.
translation: 你父亲有着和你一样坚定的双眼。那就是为什么三狗会帮你。

original: This is starting to sound risky.
translation: 这听起来有点危险。

original: It IS risky. I would never lie to you.
translation: 这很危险，我绝不骗你。

original: But there's something behind those eyes of yours that screams "I'm the one that can get shit done"!
translation: 但从你眼中我能看到一个声音“只有我能做到！”

original: Your dad had that same look in his eyes too. That's why Three Dog's helping you.
translation: 你父亲有着和你一样坚定的双眼。那就是为什么三狗会帮你。

original: I don't like the sound of this at all.
translation: 我一点不喜欢这广播的声音质量。

original: Oh, it gets worse.
translation: 唉，而且越来越差了。

original: So, after it gets blown up I look into how to replace the sucker.
translation: 所以，在它爆炸之前我好好的研究了一下怎么换掉这破烂。

original: Guess what? The factory that made the relay dishes is long gone. Leveled. As in, we'll never find that part again.
translation: 猜猜看？生产零件的工厂早就没了。所以，我们永远也找不到那零件了。

original: I see where this is going.
translation: 我知道你要说什么。

original: Yep. That shiny thing was our broadcast relay. Now it's swiss cheese. Without it, our broadcast range is quite limited.
translation: 对。那发光的物体就是广播的收发器，现在它已经千疮百孔了。没有它，广播的覆盖区域就会十分有限。

original: Of course the factory that made the relay dishes is long gone. Leveled. As in, we're never gonna' scavenge that part again.
translation: 生产天线的工厂当然已经不在了，郁闷的是，这玩意在垃圾堆里从来都找不到。

original: This is all a bit much for me. Let me get back to you.
translation: 我很感激，我回头再跟你说吧。

original: Wow, I thought you were in a rush. Whatever, man. Chat me up when you're ready.
translation: 哇哦，我想你很忙吧。怎样都行，伙计。你要有空就和我聊聊。

original: To find my Dad, I'm ready for anything.
translation: 为了找我父亲，我什么都可以做。

original: Good, 'cause this isn't going to be easy.
translation: 很好，因为这事将会很难。

original: Galaxy News Radio is my baby. I love it, I feed it, I keep it changed. But there's one problem, no one outside D.C. can hear her cry.
translation: 银河新闻电台是我的宝贝。我热爱它，哺育它，并不断更新。可是有个问题是，在首都特区上没人能够听见她的呼唤。

original: You see, some brainless Super Mutant thought it would be funny to shoot at the shiny round thing on the Washington Monument.
translation: 你瞧，一些蠢货超级变种人觉得向华盛顿纪念碑上面的闪光处射击是件好玩的事情。

original: I'm ready for anything.
translation: 我什么都可以做。

original: Good, 'cause this isn't going to be easy.
translation: 很好，因为这不会很容易。

original: Galaxy News Radio is my baby. I love it, I feed it, I keep it changed. But there's one problem, no one outside D.C. can hear her cry.
translation: 银河新闻电台是我的宝贝。我热爱它，哺育它，并不断革新。可是有个问题是，在首都特区上没人能够听见她的呼唤。

original: You see, some brainless Super Mutant thought it would be funny to shoot at the shiny round thing on the Washington Monument.
translation: 你瞧，一些蠢货超级变种人觉得向华盛顿纪念碑上面的闪光处射击是件好玩的事情。

original: Just wipe that stupid look off your face and answer my questions!
translation: 别胡扯，老实回答我的问题！

original: Whoa, whoa. Smoke a peace pipe. Take a deep breath and count to ten. Whatever it is you need to do to calm down.
translation: 喔，喔。抽口烟吧。深呼吸数十下，不管怎样你得先冷静下来。

original: You need Three Dog's help, and Three Dog needs your help. Let's get together and make it work.
translation: 你需要三狗帮助，而三狗也需要你帮忙。和平共处互惠互利。

original: What could I ever do for you? You seem to have everything you need here.
translation: 我有任何能帮到你的地方吗？你看起来万事如意的样子。

original: I have the name and the talent, but what I don't have are people to run out and do the stuff I need.
translation: 我有的是名声和才华，缺的是跑腿办事的人。

original: Sure, the Brotherhood watches over the place, yeah. But that's all they can spare.
translation: 没错，钢铁兄弟会在这里巡逻。但仅此而已。

original: Galaxy News needs a doer. Someone who can go out there into that wild, wooly world and get shit done. So, you game?
translation: 银河新闻需要一个实干者。一个可以赴汤蹈火和火中取栗的人。你愿意吗？

original: If you know anything that can help me find my Dad, please just tell me...
translation: 如果你知道我父亲的任何线索，请告诉我……

original: I hear things all the time. Most things aren't useful, but once and a while something will sneak up behind your girl and lift her dress.
translation: 我这消息多到泛滥。大多数时候都用不着，不过像推倒女孩这种关键时刻还总能派上用场。

original: Consider this your lucky day. I just so happen to know the location of an old military weapons cache untouched by time.
translation: 今天是个好日子，刚刚我很开心地得知一个保存完好的军火库的位置。

original: If you want to know more, you're going to have to contribute to the Good Fight.
translation: 如果你还想知道细节，你就得为圣战服务。

original: If you know anything that can help me, I'd appreciate it.
translation: 如果你知道任何有用的消息，我将不胜感激。

original: You want to find your dad, and it just so happens his location is known to yours truly.
translation: 你想找到你的父亲，而碰巧我知道他在哪。

original: He was here, at Galaxy News. We had a great conversation. He's a real stand-up guy.
translation: 他在这儿待过，在银河新闻。我们进行了亲切友好的会晤。他是一个真正的大人物。

original: If you want to know more, you're going to have to contribute to the Good Fight.
translation: 如果你还想知道细节，你就得用在圣战中的行动来获得。

original: You don't seem like you have much to offer if you spend all your time up here.
