translation: 你说了半天好像也拿不出什么真正有价值的消息。

original: Hey, I may have the biggest mouth in the Capital Wasteland, but I've also got the biggest ears.
translation: 嗨，我或许是首都废土最大嘴的人，但我也是最消息最灵通的人。

original: All sorts of people pass through our little oasis in the rubble and tell all sorts of interesting things.
translation: 各类人等经过我们的小小绿洲，告诉我们各种有趣的事。

original: You want to know something? Ask and we'll work it out.
translation: 说你想知道的，交给我们搞定。

original: Wait, why do you trust me so easily? I've never met you before.
translation: 等等,为什么你这么轻易就信我的？我们不认识吧。

original: The fact that the Brotherhood let you get up here tells me you're all right with them. That, and your Dad seemed a decent enough guy.
translation: 事实上兄弟会能放你来这儿就说明你不是坏人，你父亲也一样是个好人。

original: Besides, you're giving off a pretty sweet vibe right now. Maybe we can help each other out.
translation: 而且，我觉得我们比较投缘。或许我们能相互帮帮忙。

original: But enough yakkin'. Tell me why we're talking.
translation: 闲话说得差不多了，你找我什么事。

original: You know my father? Is he here? Please, I've been looking for him!
translation: 你知道我的父亲？他在这吗？求你，我一直在找他！

original: Hey, hey. One thing at a time. Nah, your old man ain't here. Not anymore.
translation: 嗨，嗨。慢慢来。呐，你爸爸现在已经不在这了。

original: He heard ole Three Dog on the radio, figured I knew what was what out here in the Capital Wasteland. And he was right. So I filled the old man in.
translation: 他听到了三狗的电台，还发现三狗是这片废土的万事通。他是对的。所以我让这个老头进来了。

original: But he split. Looks like I've got my way of contributing to the Good Fight... and he's got his own.
translation: 但是他离开了。对圣战我有我的贡献方式……而他有他的。

original: Nothing. Just wishing me a happy birthday.
translation: 没什么。仅仅祝愿我生日快乐。

original: Ha ha. Sure he was.
translation: 哈哈，他当然会。

original: Anyway, I'm glad you're having a good time. I was afraid he would find some way to ruin your party.
translation: 不管怎样,我希望你过得愉快。我还怕他会找到办法毁掉你的聚会呢。

original: Well, yeah! Where's my Dad gone?
translation: 嗯，耶！我父亲去哪了？

original: When your dad passed through here, he and I talked for a good long time. He's a real stand-up kind of guy.
translation: 当你父亲路过这的时候，我们聊了很长时间。他的确是个伟大的人。

original: He mentioned some scientific mumbo-jumbo which didn't make sense to me and mentioned something called "Project Purity".
translation: 他提到的一些我完全不懂的科学术语并提到了某种叫“净水工程”的计划。

original: He also said something about going to visit a Doctor Li in Rivet City. Then, he left in a hurry.
translation: 他还说要去铆钉城拜访李博士，之后便匆忙走了。

original: Then Rivet City is where I'm headed. Goodbye, Three Dog.
translation: 铆钉城就是我迟点要去的地方。再见，三狗。

original: Goodbye. Remember to keep us tuned in while you're out there, and watch yourself.
translation: 再见。到那里后记得调好频率和我们保持联系，还有照顾好自己。

original: Rivet City? Where's that?
translation: 铆钉城？在什么地方？

original: You've never heard of Rivet City? Wow. Just... wow.
translation: 你没听说过铆钉城？哇。真是……哇。

original: Well, a whole bunch of people got together and turned a beached aircraft carrier into a town. Pretty cool, huh?
translation: 嗯，一群人合力把一艘搁浅的航母改造成了一座城镇。真酷，呃？

original: Just follow the river south from here... there's no way you can miss it.
translation: 只要沿着这河往南走……你不会错过的。

original: Yeah, yeah. It was the thrill of a freakin' lifetime.
translation: 嗯，嗯。这种怪生活让你太激动了。

original: Smoke a peace pipe, man. You know, you are so unlike your father...
translation: 抽口烟，兄弟。你瞧，你和你父亲一点都不像……

original: Smoke a peace pipe, man. You know, you are so unlike your father...
translation: 抽口烟，兄弟。你瞧，你和你父亲一点都不像……

original: I suppose that's what you wanna know about that military weapons cache next?
translation: 我猜你接下来想知道的就是军火藏在哪儿吧？

original: Smoke a peace pipe, man. You know, you are so unlike your father...
translation: 抽口烟，老兄。你知道的，你和你的父亲太不像了……

original: I suppose that's what you wanna know next?
translation: 我猜这就是你接下来想知道的？

original: Thanks, Three Dog. I was just glad to help with the Good Fight.
translation: 谢谢你，三狗。很高兴可以帮助圣战。

original: Hey, you're the one who deserves all the thanks! You struck a major blow against tyranny!
translation: 嗨，你才是那个应该被感谢的人！你给了暴政致命一击！

original: Now GNR can be heard clear across the Capital Wasteland again. That'll give Eden and those Muties something to think about.
translation: 现在银河新闻电台又一次响彻废土上空，伊登总统和那些变种人终于有机会用用他们的脑子了。

original: Hey, you're the one who deserves all the thanks! You struck a major blow against tyranny!
translation: 嗨，你才是那个应该被感谢的人！你给了暴政致命一击！

original: Now GNR can be heard clear across the Capital Wasteland again. That'll give Eden and those Muties something to think about.
translation: 现在银河新闻电台又一次响彻废土上空，伊登总统和那些变种人终于有机会用用他们的脑子了。

original: But before I get back to my calling, I bet you wanna hear about that military weapons cache.
translation: 在我继续广播之前，我打赌你想听听关于那隐藏军火库的事。

original: Hey, you're the one who deserves all the thanks! You struck a major blow against tyranny!
translation: 嗨，你才是那个应该被感谢的人！你给了暴政致命一击！

original: Now GNR can be heard clear across the Capital Wasteland again. That'll give Eden and those Muties something to think about.
translation: 现在银河新闻电台又一次响彻废土上空，伊登总统和那些变种人终于有机会用用他们的脑子了。

original: But before I get back to my calling, I bet you wanna hear about your Dad.
translation: 在我继续广播之前，我打赌你想听听你父亲的事。

original: Where's the Washington Monument?
translation: 华盛顿纪念堂在哪？

original: Well, it's only the tallest thing left in the city.
translation: 嗯，这已经是城里剩下的最高建筑了。

original: When you step out of the Museum, take a good look across the Mall. You can't miss it.
translation: 当你走出博物馆的时候，到购物中心去好好瞧瞧。你不会错过的。

original: Just be careful, there may still be a security barrier around it.
translation: 小心，在那周围有很多安全隔离栏。

original: What's the best way to get to the Museum?
translation: 去博物馆的最佳路线怎么走？

original: Head out the back door of GNR and take the Collapsed Car Tunnel to the other side of Dupont. Then take the metro tunnels until you're there.
translation: 从银河新闻电台的后门出去经过坍塌的车道到达杜邦环岛的另一边。到那之后再进入地铁隧道。

original: Hey, be careful though... you'll have to find another way back 'cause it's a one-way trip.
translation: 嗨，无论如何要小心……你得自己另找一条路返回，因为这是单行道。

original: So, what's your story?
translation: 你的故事是什么？

original: Three Dog's seen it all. The Capital Wasteland at its ugliest.
translation: 三狗什么都见过。首都废土最丑陋的每一面。

original: People killed for scraps of food, wounded children wandering aimlessly. Some seriously fucked up shit.
translation: 人们为残羹冷炙而互相杀戮，受伤的孩子四处徘徊。完全是一幅糟糕透顶的景象。

original: If it wasn't for the Good Fight, I think I would have gone crazy by now.
translation: 要不是为了圣战，我想现在我早就疯了。

original: Do you know anything helpful about the Museum of Technology?
translation: 关于技术博物馆你知道些什么吗？

original: Ha! Man's monument to his own demise. All the garbage they displayed in there is the reason half of the world was blown to shit.
translation: 哈！超度亡灵的纪念碑，那地方垃圾成堆是因为半个世界都被炸成了一堆臭狗屎。

original: That shithole is located just off the Mall. You know, that huge space in the center of the city in front of the Capitol.
translation: 那破东西就在购物中心的外面。你知道的，就是市中心国会大厦前面的那个大广场。

original: Be careful, the whole place is swarming with Super Mutants.
translation: 小心点，那地方全是超级变种人。

original: Galaxy News Radio, huh? What's it all about?
translation: 银河新闻电台，呃？都说些什么？

original: Without this place, D.C. would be filled with that crap the Enclave keeps shoveling out on their "radio station," and festering with Muties.
translation: 没有这地方，特区会被英克雷那些垃圾“电台”和变种人所充斥。

original: Someone's got to tell the Wastelanders what time it is, and Three Dog is the one to do it.
translation: 得有人告诉废土居民现在是什么时间，三狗是最适合干这事的人。

original: No one knows what Eden and his Horsemen of the Apocalypse are up to, but you can be sure it isn't in the common man's best interest.
translation: 没人知道伊登和他的骑士想干嘛，但你可以肯定的是普通人不会感兴趣的。

original: Tell me more about this relay.
translation: 和我说说这中继设备的事。

original: Well, if you check out your radio, you can hear pretty good in this place. Get a few blocks away, still not too bad, maybe a little static.
translation: 嗯，如果你检查下你的无线电，在这你会发现效果非常好。在几个街区以外，也不会太糟，或许会有些小噪声。

original: Step outside the city limits, and its snake city... nothing but "hissssssss."
translation: 走出有效范围外，在这迂回的城市里……除了“他他他他”这样的拖音就没什么了。

original: With the relay back on, you'll hear GNR clearly in the whole Capital Wasteland area like it used to be.
translation: 如果中继设备运作，你会像过去那样在整个首都废土地区清晰地听到银河新闻电台。

original: No, the Vaults have been so much more. But only the Overseers have known the truth, and we've passed it down very carefully.
translation: 不，避难所远远不止如此。但是只有监督者了解真相，我们谨慎传承。

original: I had hoped to tell Amata when she took over, but with the way things are now, that doesn't seem likely to happen.
translation: 我原打算在阿玛塔接手时告诉她的，但事情闹到现在的地步，这似乎不会发生了。

original: But if you could convince her and the rebels to give up this foolish demand to leave, then we can return to our Vault's vital mission.
translation: 不过如果你能说服她和反叛者放弃那愚蠢的离开的要求，我们就能继续避难所的核心任务了。

original: I had no idea Vault 101 was so important. I just thought it was a fancy bunker.
translation: 我从来没想过101号避难所会如此重要。我以为它只是个花哨的地堡。

original: I'm trying to save my people. Possibly the only pure, safe humans left in the world.
translation: 我试着去拯救大家。或许是世界上仅存的安全而纯粹的人类。

original: Don't destroy humanity's last chance just because you don't like the choices I've had to make to protect it.
translation: 别因为你不喜欢我不得不做的决定而毁了人类最后的机会。

original: I think you've got a good point. But things still need to change down here.
translation: 我觉得你说的有道理。但是这下面必须要改变。

original: I'm glad we're in agreement, there. He left us all behind and caused quite a deal of trouble, all because he apparently got tired of the Vault.
translation: 我很高兴我们达成了共识。他抛弃我们、并引起了一系列的麻烦，这都是因为他对避难所已经厌倦了。

original: As useful as his services were, in the end, he just wasn't willing to make sacrifices for the community.
translation: 一样有用，到了最后，他只是不愿意为社会而作出牺牲。

original: Yeah, he was an asshole, all right. We're all better off without him.
translation: 嗯，他是个混蛋。没有他我们还更好些。

original: No, but he didn't risk bringing you out into it, either.
translation: 不，但他也没有冒险将你带到外面。

original: You have to wonder, is that why he left you behind? He wanted to know you were someplace safe?
translation: 你或许想知道，为什么他把你们都抛弃了？他想知道你待在安全的地方？

original: And then, like a fool, you squandered the greatest gift he ever left you.
translation: 不久，你就会像傻子一样滥用他留给你的财富。

original: At least my father didn't hide from the outside his whole life.
translation: 至少我的父亲没有一辈子都躲在这里面。

original: It's about time someone finished you!
translation: 早该有人干掉你了！

original: And you're dead.
translation: 而你已经死了。

original: I expected nothing more from you.
translation: 我不对你不报希望。

original: And you're dead.
translation: 而你已经死了。

original: And what makes you so certain about that? I can't imagine you're still so naive after spending time in that hell outside.
translation: 你凭什么这么肯定？我无法想象你去过外面那样的地狱，居然还如此幼稚。

original: None of them know what the outside is like, and most of them would die out there. Then the rest of us inside would eventually die out, too.
translation: 他们不知道外面是什么样子，多数人还会送命。然后我们这里剩下的人也会死光。

original: I won't risk all of our lives just for few people's passing fancy of taking a Wasteland vacation. I hope you can understand that.
translation: 我不会以大家的生命为代价，让少数人心血来潮的人去废土度假。我希望你能理解。

original: The Vault doesn't have to be isolated in order to keep its residents safe.
translation: 避难所没必要为了安全理由而永久孤立。

original: I'm afraid you're the shortsighted one, here. I'm simply keeping them safe and untouched by the war above.
translation: 恐怕你是个目光短浅的人。我只是想保证他们的安全，远离上面的战争。

original: The real danger are the rebels and insurgents who insist on risking all of our lives just to die out there in the Wastes.
translation: 真正危险的是反叛者和煽动者，他们坚持要冒险把生命葬送在废土。

original: If they weren't trying to throw our lives away like that, we could go back to the peaceful life we once had. Everyone would be happy again.
translation: 要不是他们打算让我们白白送命，我们可以像过去一样过平静的生活。大家就又可以开心起来了。

original: You're not protecting your people, you're destroying them. Can't you see that?
translation: 你不是在保护大家，你是在毁灭他们。你还没看出来吗？

original: Hardly. If anything, the only thing keeping it safe and pure is my strict supervision.
translation: 不可能。不管怎样，唯一可以保证安全和纯粹的是我严格的管理。

original: But I wouldn't expect you to understand. You were never really one of us, anyway. Your father was from the Wastes, and that's where you belong.
translation: 我没指望你能明白。不管怎么说，你不是我们中的一员。你父亲从自废土，那才是属于你的地方。

original: I think our meaningful discussion is at an end. I'm going to have to ask you to leave and never return. But death's always an option, too.
translation: 我想我们的重要谈话该结束了。我不得不让你离开，并且不要再回来了。但死亡也可以是一种出路。

original: It won't ever be pure while you're in charge.
translation: 由你在管理，它早就不再纯净了。

original: I've spent many nights asking myself exactly that. He certainly didn't tell me before he left.
translation: 我曾经花了很多个晚上自问，在他走之前他当然不会告诉我。

original: I blame myself, really. I should have known better than to let him enter our home in the first place. He certainly showed his true colors in the end.
translation: 我很自责，真的。我从最开始就该知道，不能让他住进我们的家。他最后露出了本来面目。

original: Were he raised in the cleanliness of our Vault, perhaps your father would have shown more dedication to the important things in life.
translation: 如果他是在我们洁净的避难所长大的，或许你父亲就会对生命中的重要的事更为专注。

original: Just as well that he left. We mustn't let humanity's last pure specimens be sullied with his type.
translation: 他离开也好。我们绝对不能让人类最后的纯净样本被他这种人玷污。

original: Do you have any idea why my father left the Vault in the first place?
translation: 你知不知道当初我父亲为什么要离开避难所？

original: Ah, you're paying attention. Good for you.
translation: 啊，你在注意听。对你有好处的。

original: These Vaults were designed to be safe havens for humanity, you see. But more than that, they were designed to test and protect us.
translation: 这些避难所被设计成安全港，这你是知道的。但不仅如此，它们也被设计用来试验并保护我们。

original: And none more so than our Vault 101. We are to be a pure and protected breed of humans, never tainted by the ravages of the war above.
translation: 没有比我们101号避难所更好的了。我们将成为安全的纯种人类，从未被上面的战火蹂躏过。

original: What do you mean by the Vault's "future success"?
translation: 你说避难所“未来的成功”是什么意思？

original: Spoken with all of the eloquence I'd expect from a wastelander.
translation: 我可从未指望过一个废土游民有这么好的口才。

original: Farewell, and feel free to enjoy your brutal hellscape above, savage.
translation: 回见，好好享受你的地狱时光吧，野人。

original: Fine. You bastards can rot and die down here.
translation: 好吧。你们这些混蛋就在下面腐烂和死亡吧。

original: Spoken like someone who's never had to make difficult decisions. Like someone who's never had to lead.
translation: 看人挑担不吃力，站着说话不腰痛。

original: Jonas was leaving with your father. Their departure would lead to others leaving as well. And before you know it, half of the Vault would be gone.
translation: 乔纳斯本打算和你的父亲一起离开。他们一走，其他人也会效仿的。眨眼之间，避难所里面一半的人都会走掉。

original: And then, our home - the last safe, pure bastion of humanity - would be reduced to a lonely handful of aging hold-outs, too few to continue.
translation: 到那时，我们的家 — 人类最后纯洁、安全的堡垒，就会变成只有几个老人在坚守，人太少，不可能维系住。

original: Don't try to justify your murders and lies. They were never threats.
translation: 不要试着为你们的残杀与谎言辩护。它们从未构成威胁。

original: I will. I know there are some that will miss you, much as there are still some that miss your father.
translation: 我会的。我知道会有人想你，就像还有很多人在想你的父亲一样。

original: Not me, of course, but some of the others. Sentimental fools. But, you've restored peace to the Vault, and in that way, you're a hero.
translation: 不是我，当然，是其他人。感情用事的傻瓜。不过，你已经在避难所恢复了和平，从这个角度来说，你是个英雄。

original: And you have to leave. Thank you, and goodbye, Wastelander.
translation: 你不得不离开。谢谢你，再见，废土游民。

original: Please, pass along my farewell to everyone in the Vault.
translation: 请替我向大家道别。

original: First of all, I didn't kill Jonas. I commanded Chief Hannon to do so. But only because it had to be done.
translation: 事先申明，不是我杀的乔纳斯。是我命令汉农主任干的。但是仅仅因为事已至此。

original: Jonas was going to leave with your father. If he left, others would have left to join them. And they'd all vanish into the Wastes, never to return.
translation: 乔纳斯要和你的父亲一起离开。如果他走了，其他的人就会跟他一起走。他们都会被废土吞噬，再来回不来。

original: And with our numbers so depleted, we wouldn't be able to last beyond another generation. Assuming our expatriates didn't lead Raiders to us, first.
translation: 如果损失这么多人口，我们就维持不到下一代了。假定那些移民不将歹徒引过来的话。

original: I'm sick of your lies! You murdered Jonas in cold blood!
translation: 我对你的谎言厌倦了！你无情地杀害了乔纳斯！

original: I really don't recommend that sort of ultimatum. If you leave now, we can simply lock down the door controls and everyone can be happy.
translation: 我真的不想下最后通牒。如果你现在离开，我们只用锁上门，这样对大家都好。

original: But if you insist, we can always toss your corpse out the gate after you're killed.
translation: 但是如果你坚持，我们会在干掉你后将你的尸首扔出去。

original: The choice is yours. Goodbye.
translation: 选择权在你手里。再见。

original: I'll never leave Vault 101 again in my life.
translation: 我这辈子再也不会离开101号避难所了。

original: What's the matter, runt? Did I hit a sore spot?
translation: 怎么啦，矮子？我戳到你的痛处了吗？

original: I always knew we shouldn't have taken him in, and it looks like I was right all along. A perfect example of why we need to keep the Vault shut!
translation: 我早就说我们不应该把他放进来，而我似乎总是正确的。这是个封闭避难所的好理由！

original: Now, I'll make this easy for you. You can walk away and let me handle the Vault, or I can put you down like a rabid dog. Your choice, kid.
translation: 现在，我要把这件事变得容易。你可以离开并让我掌管避难所，否则我会把你像一条疯狗一样干掉。你选择吧，小子。

original: You shut up about my dad! Just shut up!
translation: 你不准再谈论我的父亲！闭嘴！

original: Really? And here I had expected you to be full of bullets and bravado, but short on brains. Perhaps you've grown up since you left our Vault.
translation: 真的吗？我原以为你是性格鲁莽，但头脑蠢钝。或许离开避难所后你已经长大了。

original: I regret the unfortunate events of that night, but I'm afraid that once your father left us, they were unavoidable.
translation: 我为那晚发生的不幸感到遗憾，但恐怕你的父亲离开我们后，那是无法避免的。

original: The sad truth is that his actions presented a real and direct threat to the future success of our Vault. And so, regrettably, they had to be opposed.
translation: 遗憾的是，事实上他的行为直接威胁到了避难所的未来。因此不管如何，我们必须反对。

original: Lay off the evil banter. I'm just curious about your side of all this.
translation: 不开该死的玩笑了。我只是好奇你们的立场。

original: G.E.C.K.? We never had one of those things in the first place. We weren't supposed to ever leave, remember?
translation: 伊甸园创造器？我们一直没有得到过这件东西。我们原本就不该离开的，记得吗？

original: But take this Modified Utility Jumpsuit. I guess the rebels thought it would be useful when they left. Obviously, that won't be happening now.
translation: 但是拿上这件改良的工作服。我猜那些反叛者认为在他们离开的时候会有用。显然，那不会发生了。

original: Congrats, you saved the Vault. Now, get out.
translation: 祝贺你拯救了避难所。现在，出去。

original: I'll take your G.E.C.K., and whatever technology you can spare.
translation: 我会拿走你们的G.E.C.K.，还有其他能给我的科技。

original: I'm afraid that, instead of a G.E.C.K., our Vault was supplied with technology better suited to functioning indefinitely.
translation: 恐怕是这样的，我们没有得到伊甸园创造器，而持续避难所运转的科技。

original: But take this Modified Utility Jumpsuit. It seems the rebels thought it would be useful when they left. Obviously, that won't be happening now.
translation: 但是拿上这件改良的工作服。我猜那些反叛者认为在他们离开的时候会有用。显然，那不会发生了。

original: Thank you for saving our Vault. Now, you'll have to leave.
translation: 谢谢你拯救了我们的避难所。现在，你得走了。

original: I'll take your G.E.C.K., and whatever technology you can spare.
translation: 我会拿走你们的G.E.C.K.，还有其他能给我的科技。

original: Sure, fine. As it turns out, Brotch modified himself a utility jumpsuit for survival in the Wastes. As if he was ever getting out there.
translation: 当然，好的。原来是这样，布洛彻为了在废土生存，为他自己准备了工作服。就像他能够离开似的。

original: Here, it's yours. Don't say I never repaid a favor. Now, get the hell out of my Vault.
translation: 给，它是你的了。别说我没有还你人情。现在,从我的避难所滚开。

original: I'll take scientific equipment. That's one thing you've got plenty of.
translation: 我会拿走科技装备。你们这里有很多。

original: I think we may have just the thing, taken from the rebels not long ago. Edwin Brotch modified a utility jumpsuit for "survival in the Wastes."
translation: 我想我们刚好有那东西，不久前从反叛者那得到的。德文·布洛彻为“废土生活”而改制的一件工作服。

original: It was a foolish idea, but that seems par for the course for them. I suppose they'd be happy to think it found its intended use, eventually.
translation: 这是个愚蠢的主意，但是看起来跟他们很搭调。我想，它最终物尽其用，他们也会高兴的。

original: But enough of that. Thank you for saving our Vault. Now, you'll have to leave.
translation: 不多说了。谢谢你拯救了避难所。现在,你必须从这离开。

original: I'll take scientific equipment. That's one thing you've got plenty of.
translation: 我会拿走科技装备。你们这里有很多。

original: Really? Because you weren't here to talk with the last Overseer. That's why I'm in charge, now.
translation: 真的？因为你不是在和上任监督者谈话。这就是为什么现在我说了算。

original: So you'll excuse me if I don't trust you, and if I don't think you've got my Vault's best interests at heart.
translation: 所以，如果我不信任你，如果我不认为你真心为我的避难所的利益着想，请你原谅，

original: Now, I'll make this easy for you. You can walk away and let me handle the Vault, or I can put you down like a rabid dog. Your choice, kid.
translation: 现在，我要把这件事变得容易。你可以离开并让我掌管避难所，否则我会把你像一条疯狗一样干掉。你选择吧，小子。

original: Hold on, I'm here to talk.
translation: 别急，我是来谈话的。

original: That would be where you're wrong, young man. By locking down this Vault, I'm protecting its future.
translation: 这你就错了，年轻人。封闭避难所，我才能保护它的未来。

original: In fact, I was protecting its future when I had to make those unpleasant choices the night you and your father abandoned us.
translation: 事实上，你和你父亲将我们抛弃的那天晚上，我不得不做那些不愉快的决定时，我实际上在保护它的未来。

original: I only wish I could have stopped your father before he left. If anyone's to blame for the unpleasantness, it's him.
translation: 我真希望能阻止你父亲离开。如果谁该为这不愉快的事负责，那只能是他。

original: With your leadership, no one in this Vault has much of a future.
translation: 在你的领导下，这个避难所的每一个人都没有未来。

original: Useful stuff out there, I'll bet. And if it'll get you back out there faster, then all the better.
translation: 我打赌这些在外面很有用。如果你尽快回到外面就更好了。

original: We don't have much, but here you go. Now, get.
translation: 我们不多，不过这是你的啦。快拿好。

original: I'll take my payment in food and ammo.
translation: 我要食物和弹药作为报酬。

original: Ah, of course. The basic currency of a lawless society. Maybe you'd like a few pointed sticks and fighting dogs, as well?
translation: 啊，当然。这是混乱地方的基础货币呢。要不要再来些尖棍和斗犬？

original: We don't have much ammunition down here, but we should be able to spare some packaged meals.
translation: 我们这没有多少弹药，但我们应该可以分你一些备用的压缩食品。

original: Here, perhaps it'll be of some comfort to you once you return to the Wastes. Now, go.
translation: 给，但愿回到废土它会让你舒服些。现在，走吧。

original: I'll take my payment in food and ammo.
translation: 我要食物和弹药作为报酬。

original: Is that what they say? And you believed them? Ha!
translation: 那是他们说的吗？你相信他们？哈！

original: Why, if it weren't for me, they'd go outside and die in seconds flat. They're just caught up in the idea of a change, is all.
translation: 噢，如果不是因为我，他们到外面几秒就倒下了。他们只是太想改变一些东西了，就是这样。

original: Now, I'll make this easy for you. You can walk away and let me handle the Vault, or I can put you down like a rabid dog. Your choice, kid.
translation: 现在，我要把这件事变得容易。你可以离开并让我掌管避难所，否则我会把你像一条疯狗一样干掉。你选择吧，小子。

original: You're the one who's been holding his people hostage!
translation: 就是你把大家当做人质！

original: I assume you're talking about the unpleasantness when you left, yes?
translation: 我看你是说你离开时的不愉快，对吧？

original: Jonas and your father were endangering the future success of this Vault and the safety of its residents.
translation: 乔纳斯和你的父亲对避难所的前途和这里居民的安全构成了威胁。

original: I did what I had to do to keep them from destroying all we had achieved here. I only wish I could have prevented it from happening at all.
translation: 我用尽办法来避免他们摧毁我们在这已经得到的一切。我真希望能够避免这一切的发生。

original: Tainted? You're the crazy bastard who murdered Jonas!
translation: 玷污？你是谋杀乔纳斯的疯子！

original: You really think I'll let you stay? You're out of your tiny little mind.
translation: 你真的认为我会让你留下来？你的脑子一定出问题了。

original: Now, pick something I can shove in your arms before tossing you outside for good.
translation: 现在，在我把你永远踢出去前，找点可以拿在手里的东西吧。

original: Returning to stay in the safety of the Vault is reward enough.
translation: 回到避难所的保护下就是最好的回报了。

original: Did you really think you would be allowed to stay? Yes, you've saved the Vault, to be sure. And, thus, probably the last pure humans in the world.
translation: 你真的认为你会被允许留下？没错,你拯救了避难所，这是毫无疑问的。因此，或许挽救了这世上最后的纯洁人类。

original: All the more reason to keep you from returning to our community and polluting it with the taint of outside barbarism.
translation: 这正是不能让你用外面的野蛮污染它的原因。

original: Now, reconsider your request and pick a reward you can take with you when you return outside, wastelander.
translation: 现在，重新考虑你的请求吧。你出去时可以拿走一件东西作为报酬，废土游民。

original: Returning to stay in the safety of the Vault is reward enough.
translation: 回到避难所的保护下就是最好的回报了。

original: The person you should be convincing is the Overseer. Go talk with him.
translation: 你应该说服的人是监督者。去跟他谈谈。

original: I'll find a way to convince you, just wait.
translation: 我会想办法说服你的，等着吧。

original: I deeply doubt it. But your naive ramblings do have a certain entertainment value.
translation: 我十分怀疑。但你的胡言乱语挺有娱乐价值。

original: I'll find a way to convince you, just wait.
translation: 我会想办法说服你的，等着吧。

original: You mean, there really are deadly threats out there? It hasn't all just been lies to keep us down here?
translation: 你的意思是，外面真的有致命的威胁？那并不是骗我们待在这的谎言？

original: I guess I never thought that was actually true. But I can tell you really mean it about the Enclave. I couldn't risk leading them to the Vault.
translation: 我想我从没想过那是真的，但是我看得出来你说到英克雷是很认真的。我不能冒险引他们来避难所。

original: The Overseer's actually protecting you from a deadly group called the Enclave.
translation: 监督者实际上是在保护你们，防止你们被一个恐怖的组织英克雷所伤害。

original: Damnit, I told them I won't let this degenerate into violence again! The Vault simply can't take the instability anymore!
translation: 该死，我告诉过他们我不会再让此事转变为暴力！避难所已经经不起动荡了！

original: But maybe you're right. They simply can't stand the pressure anymore, and now the purity and perfection of my Vault is crumbling all around me.
translation: 但是或许你是对的。他们只是受不了压力了，现在避难所的纯净完美正在我身边崩溃。

original: You can't even keep your security in line. They're planning to raid the rebels.
translation: 你连自己的警卫都管不住。他们准备镇压反叛者了。

original: It is? Even with a crazy dictator running the show?
translation: 是吗？即便由一个疯狂的独裁者来掌管一切？

original: I guess we do have renewable food and water, impenetrable defenses, and a wealth of active technology. Those must be rare outside, huh?
translation: 我想我们有食物和水，坚固的防御，以及大量可用的技术。这在外面一定很罕见，呃？

original: Isolation keeps the Vault safe. It's insane to give that up.
translation: 孤立带给了避难所安全。放弃它简直就是发疯。

original: And I still say we're not giving up on our chance to with the outside world.
translation: 我仍然会说我们一直没有放弃到外面世界的尝试。

original: I still say it's insane to give up the safety of the Vault.
translation: 我还是要说放弃避难所的安全根本就是疯了。

original: I admit, in the 200 years since the war, our numbers have dwindled a little. But we have enough genetic diversity for... a few more generations.
translation: 我承认，自从战争以来的200年间，我们的人数减少了一些。但是我们有足够的遗传多样化来……延续更多代人。

original: My God, you're right. We won't last another hundred years, whether or not we get supplies from the outside.
translation: 我的天啊，你是对的。我们无法再生存个一百年，不论我们是否从外界得到补给。

original: We're the last bastion of pure humanity, and we're doomed.
translation: 我们是纯种人类的最后防线，而且我们难逃一劫。

original: You simply don't have enough people to stay isolated down here forever.
translation: 你的人口就不足以永远封闭地维持下去。

original: The mission of this Vault has always been to ensure a safe haven for pure humans. We owe it to our species to keep to that mission.
translation: 避难所的任务一直是确保人类的纯正血统。我们种族的延续全都归功于这任务。

original: You'll never survive down here, isolated from the rest of the world.
translation: 你们绝不可能与世界隔绝的情况下在这下面生存。

original: I should have remembered. I was just worried, I don't know, maybe your time outside had changed you.
translation: 我应该还没忘。我就是很担心，我不知道，或许是你在外面的日子改变了你。

original: Thanks, and good luck talking to him. Let me know when you change his mind!
translation: 谢谢，好好和他聊聊。你若改变了他的主意就告诉我！

original: You know violence isn't my style, Amata. Don't worry.
translation: 你知道暴力不是我的行事风格，阿玛塔。不要担心。

original: But... he's still my father. He may have made terrible choices that night, but he's the same person who's always looked out for us before then.
translation: 但是……他毕竟是我的父亲。那晚他或许做出了可怕的选择，但那之前也一直是他照顾着我们。

original: Maybe he has some reason. Just, please don't kill him. We've already had too many deaths.
translation: 或许他有什么理由。请不要杀死他。我们已经死了太多的人了。

original: Sorry, I'm not promising anything. He'll be stopped, one way or another.
translation: 抱歉，我不能保证什么。无论用什么手段，都必须阻止他。

original: I understand, but please don't kill him. We've already lost so many, and violence isn't going to bring them back.
translation: 我明白，但请不要杀他。我们已经失去太多的人了，暴力是不会让他们起死回生的。

original: Sorry, I'm not promising anything. He'll be stopped, one way or another.
translation: 抱歉，我不能保证什么。无论用什么手段，都必须阻止他。

original: Well, yes, but... he may have done some terrible things, but he's still my father, you know?
translation: 嗯，是的，但是……他或许做了些可怕的事情，但他毕竟是我的父亲，你懂吗？

original: Please, for my sake, don't hurt him.
translation: 看在我的份上，请不要伤害他。

original: Don't hurt him? Are you crazy? He tried to kill you!
translation: 不要伤害他？你疯了吗？他想杀了你！

original: Well, yes, but... he may have done some terrible things, but he's still part of the Vault, you know?
translation: 嗯，是的，但是……他或许做了些可怕的事情，但他毕竟是我的父亲，你懂吗？

original: Please, for my sake, don't hurt him.
translation: 看在我的份上，请不要伤害他。

original: Don't hurt him? Are you crazy?
translation: 不要伤害他？你疯了吗？

original: I... I just can't believe you. If we stay here, we'll just wither away over the years. There has to be something for us out there.
translation: 我……我就是不相信你。如果我们待在这，我们在不久之后就会慢慢消亡。在外面肯定有什么在等着我们。

original: But we don't even have that chance while my father's got the place locked down. Please, something has to be done. You know that better than anyone.
translation: 但我父亲将这地方封闭起来后，那些情况都不会发生。求你了，必须做点什么。你比谁都明白。

original: It's a dead world out there. You're better off down here, even with a madman.
translation: 外面的世界只有死亡。还是下面更安全，就算和疯子住在一起也比那好。

original: I... I just can't believe you. If we stay here, we'll just wither away over the years. There has to be something for us out there.
translation: 我……我就是不相信你。如果我们待在这，我们在不久之后就会慢慢消亡。在外面肯定有什么在等着我们。

original: But we don't even have that chance while the new Overseer's got the place locked down. Please, something has to be done!
translation: 但我父亲将这地方封闭起来后，那些情况都不会发生。求你了，必须做点什么。你比谁都明白。

original: It's a dead world out there. You're better off down here, even with a madman.
translation: 外面的世界只有死亡。还是下面更安全，就算和疯子住在一起也比那好。

original: And all this time, we're living in a tiny world that's been falling apart for two hundred years.
translation: 所有这些年，我们一直住在一个狭小的世界里，而且崩溃了200年。

original: If we don't take a chance out there, we're just going to die down here.
translation: 如果不去外面碰碰运气，我们就会死在这。

original: But none of that can happen while my father's got the place locked down. Please, something has to be done. You know that better than anyone.
translation: 但我父亲将这地方封闭起来后，那些情况都不会发生。求你了，必须做点什么。你比谁都明白。

original: There's more out there than we ever imagined. Good, bad, and in-between.
translation: 外面的世界比我们想象的要大得多。有好的，有坏的，还有不好不坏的。

original: And all this time, we're living in a tiny world that's been falling apart for two hundred years.
translation: 所有这些年，我们一直住在一个狭小的世界里，而且崩溃了200年。

original: If we don't take a chance out there, we're just going to die down here.
translation: 如果不去外面碰碰运气，我们就会死在这。

original: But none of that can happen while the new Overseer's got the place locked down. Please, something has to be done. You know that better than anyone.
translation: 但我父亲将这地方封闭起来后，那些情况都不会发生。求你了，必须做点什么。你比谁都明白。

original: There's more out there than we ever imagined. Good, bad, and in-between.
translation: 外面的世界比我们想象的要大得多。有好的，有坏的，还有不好不坏的。

original: That's why we need to be able to go outside! We can trade with them, get supplies and things we both need. Even just to meet new people...
translation: 那就是为什么我们需要去外面的原因！我们可以同他们进行贸易，获取我们需要的补给和物品。就算认识几个人……

original: But none of that can happen while my father's got the place locked down. Please, something has to be done. You know that better than anyone.
translation: 但我父亲将这地方封闭起来后，那些情况都不会发生。求你了，必须做点什么。你比谁都明白。

original: There are other survivors -- some are even doing better than the Vault.
translation: 还有其他的幸存者－－有一些活得比避难所里还要好。

original: That's why we need to be able to go outside! We can trade with them, get supplies and things we both need. Even just to meet new people...
translation: 那就是为什么我们需要去外面的原因！我们可以同他们进行贸易，获取我们需要的补给和物品。就算认识几个人……

original: But none of that can happen while the new Overseer's got the place locked down. Please, something has to be done. You know that better than anyone.
translation: 但我父亲将这地方封闭起来后，那些情况都不会发生。求你了，必须做点什么。你比谁都明白。

original: There are other survivors -- some are even doing better than the Vault.
translation: 还有其他的幸存者－－有一些活得比避难所里还要好。

original: It turns out that all of our parents were in on it. Your dad more than most, I guess.
translation: 结果是我们的父辈都曾参与其中，我想你的父亲更甚。

original: But for some reason, they closed the door when we were babies, and swore to pretend the outside was uninhabitable.
translation: 但出于某种原因，当我们还是孩子的时候他们就关闭了大门，谎称外面的世界不适合居住。

original: But now people have died for that lie, and even though we know the truth, the Overseer still won't let us try to contact the outside!
translation: 但是现在已经有人因为那谎言而丧命，即使我们知道了真相，监督者却依旧不让我们与外面联系！

original: When I was a kid, I never was able to research my family tree...
translation: 我还是个孩子的时候，可从没有机会研究我们家的族谱……

original: What? How long did you know about this?
translation: 什么？你知道这多久了？

original: You know what? Never mind. What's important is that now we know that we were lied to all our lives, and that people have died for that lie.
translation: 算了，这不重要。重要的是现在我们知道自己被蒙骗了一辈子，而且已经有人因为那谎言而丧命。

original: And even now, when we most need help, the Overseer still won't let us try to communicate with the outside!
translation: 即便现在，在我们最需要帮助的时候，监督者依旧不让我们和外面联系！

original: Yeah, I found out about that when I left. I guess I should have told you.
translation: 没错，我离开的时候发现了这点。我想我应该告诉你。

original: I heard we sent a couple of scouts outside, long ago. Maybe the suit was theirs.
translation: 我听说我们很久以前向外面派出过一队侦察兵。或许这服装就是他们的。

original: The Vault was open for a while, but for some reason, they closed it off when we were babies and everyone swore to deny it had ever happened.
translation: 避难所曾经开放过，但是因为某种原因，当我们还是婴儿的时候就关闭了，而且所有的人都否认曾经开放过。

original: But then Jonas died, and they're keeping us locked in here, all to protect that fantasy of remaining "untainted" by the outside world!
translation: 但不久后乔纳斯死了，他们就把我们关在这，只为保卫一个不被外面世界“玷污”的幻想！

original: That explains why I found an old Vault 101 suit outside.
translation: 这就解释了为什么我在外面会找到一件旧的101号避难所工作服。

original: After that night, I heard Wally's father say we should never have taken you or your dad into the Vault.
translation: 那晚之后，我听说瓦利的父亲说我们不该让你和你的父亲进入避难所。

original: I found out the Vault used to be open, but for some reason, they closed it off when we were babies and swore to hide it had ever happened.
translation: 避难所曾经开放过，但是因为某种原因，当我们还是婴儿的时候就关闭了，而且所有的人都否认曾经开放过。

original: But keeping that lie meant Jonas's death. And even though we know the truth, the Overseer still won't let us make our own decisions!
translation: 但他们要掩盖谎言就注定了乔纳斯的死。即使连我们知道了真相，监督者都不让我们自己做出决定！

original: What? How did you find that out?
translation: 什么？你怎么知道的？

original: What the hell do you mean? Take a look around! If we weren't dying down here before that night, we're definitely on our way now.
translation: 你该死的是什么意思？四处看看吧！如果说那晚之前我们还没迈向死亡的话，现在我们肯定算是上路了。

original: How much worse could it be if we tried to leave? There has to be something out there worth finding.
translation: 如果我们离开这里情况能有糟？外面肯定有什么值得追寻的东西。

original: You have no idea how good you've got it down here...
translation: 你们根本不知道这下面有多好……

original: What? You think they've got some explanation for their side of the story? You think you can trust anything they say?
translation: 什么？你认为他们对这事还有什么可解释的吗？你认为你可以相信他们所说的话？

original: All those people died because my father claimed he wanted to keep the Vault safe and secure. But all this time, that's been a lie!
translation: 那些人都是因为我的父亲宣称他要保证避难所安全而死的。但一直以来，那都是谎言！

original: I found out that he opened the Vault years ago, before we were born. And they've been lying to us about it for our entire lives!
translation: 我发现他在很多年前开放过避难所，在我们出生之前。而他们却骗了了我们一辈子！

original: Let's not be hasty. I need to know more before I make any decisions.
translation: 别太仓促。我要知道更多细节才能做出决定。

original: Chaos doesn't even cover it! It's a nightmare down here!
translation: 混乱都不足以形容！这简直是场梦魇！

original: People died that night, and all because my father went crazy to keep someone from opening the Vault.
translation: 那晚死了很多人，全都因为我的父亲发疯般地阻止别人打开避难所的门。

original: And worst of all, then we found out the Vault had been opened before - and they'd lied about it all our lives!
translation: 最糟的是，不久我们就发现避难所之前已经被打开过 — 而他们却骗了我们一辈子！

original: I may have left, but this is still where I grew up. I can't leave it in chaos.
translation: 我是离开了，但这是我长大的地方。我不能置它于混乱而不顾。

original: There are still so many things to repair, and a lot of bad feelings to mend. Some people still blame you for what happened.
translation: 还有很多东西要修理，很多不良情绪要安抚。仍有很多人将发生的一切怪罪到你头上。

original: So I have to ask you to leave. I'm sorry, but the situation is just too delicate for you to stay.
translation: 所以我不得不让你离开。对不起，但局势太微妙了，你不能留下。

original: Please, if you really want to help the Vault, you have to go.
translation: 求你了，如果你真的想帮助避难所，你就走吧。

original: I've got a bad feeling about this. What is it?
translation: 我有一种不祥的预感。到底是什么？

original: You saved us. But that doesn't change the fact that you killed one of us to do it, and I can't let that sort of thing stand here.
translation: 你救了我们。但这不能改变你残忍杀害监督者以达成目的这一事实，我不能让这种事在这里中流传。

original: I guess it's a bit familiar. You've already been forced out of the Vault once before. At least now you know what's out there.
translation: 我想这情景似曾相识，你之前就被迫离开过避难所。至少这次你知道外面是什么样子。

original: I'm sorry. You're a hero... and you have to leave.
translation: 对不起。你是个英雄……但你必须离开。

original: I've got a bad feeling I know where this is going.
translation: 我不祥地觉得我预料到这事会如何发展了。

original: I just wish we could have saved more people. Jonas, and the Hannons, and so many others died that night.
translation: 我只是希望我们可以拯救更多的人。乔纳斯，和汉农父子，以及其它很多人都在那晚死了。

original: It was bad enough they died because my father was trying to keep the door closed, but then I found out it was all to protect a lie!
translation: 他们因为我父亲坚守大门而死去就够糟了，但随后我发现这都是为了保护一个谎言！

original: I found out, the Vault wasn't always closed! They've lied to us about it for our entire lives!
translation: 我发现了，避难所并不是一直关闭的！他们骗了我们一辈子！

original: You saved my life back then, Amata. The least I can do is help out now.
translation: 你曾经救过我的命，阿玛塔。我所能做最起码的事就是帮助你。

original: I know you are, and on behalf of the Vault, I thank you for all you've done. But there are still many who blame you for everything that happened.
translation: 我知道，我代表避难所居民感谢你所做的一切。但仍有很多人将发生的一切怪罪到你头上。

original: So I have to ask you to leave. I'm sorry, but the situation is just too delicate for you to stay.
translation: 所以我不得不让你离开。对不起，但局势太微妙了，你不能留下。

original: Please, if you really want to help the Vault, you have to go.
translation: 求你了，如果你真的想帮助避难所，你就走吧。

original: Whatever it is, I'm glad to help.
translation: 不管是什么，我都乐意帮忙。

original: I realize that. And I don't blame you. If you hadn't been here, maybe one of us would have done the same.
translation: 我了解，我不会责备你。如果不是你在这，我们中也会有人这样做的。

original: You saved us. But that doesn't change the fact that you killed the Overseer in cold blood to do it, and I can't let that sort of thing stand here.
translation: 你救了我们。但这不能改变你残忍杀害监督者以达成目的这一事实，我不能让这种事在这里中流传。

original: I'm sorry. You're a hero... and you have to leave.
translation: 对不起。你是个英雄……但你必须离开。

original: I did what had to be done. And I'd do it again if necessary.
translation: 我做了应该做的。有必要的话我会再做一次。

original: Most of the people in here will just get themselves killed out there. You know that better than anyone. But down here, they've got a safe life.
translation: 这里的大多数人在外面都活不下来。你比其他人都了解。而在这，他们过着安全的生活。

original: And while we're down here, I'm in charge. Like the G.O.A.T. said: "To whom do we owe everything you have, including our lives?"
translation: 而在这里，一切由我负责。正如G.O.A.T.所说: “是谁掌管着我们的一切，包括我们的生命？”

original: The Overseer! And that's me!
translation: 监督者！是我！

original: I just want to know why you won't open the Vault.
translation: 我只想知道你为什么不开放避难所。

original: What? Have you gone crazy from radiation or sunstroke or whatever they've got out there?
translation: 什么？你是因为放射线而变疯还是中暑，抑或别的？

original: This place is a police state and we're on the edge of a civil war. If you won't help for me, at least do it for your home!
translation: 这地方是个警察国家，而我们濒临内战的边缘。即便你不肯帮我，至少也为你自己的家园！

original: Don't flatter yourself, Amata. I'm just here to take care of a few loose ends.
translation: 别再自命不凡了，阿玛塔。我只是回来做些了断而已。

original: Well, thanks for keeping your cool and not resorting to violence. That sort of thing would only lead to more problems in the future.
translation: 嗯，感谢你保持冷静而没有诉诸于暴力。那样只能给将来制造更多的麻烦。

original: It's time for our dusty old Vault to have a new beginning. And it'll start by opening it up again, and this time for good.
translation: 该给我们满是尘土的老避难所一个新的开始了。重新开放就是开始，而且这次是永久的。

original: It's a bright new day for the Vault... but I'm afraid there's one thing that has to change.
translation: 这是避难所全新的一天……但我认为有一件事情不得不改变。

original: He didn't even realize how wrong he was. But I set him straight.
translation: 他甚至都不知道自己犯了什么样的错。但是我让他明白了。

original: You bastard, that's still my father you're talking about!
translation: 你这混蛋，你在谈论的是我的父亲！

original: As new Overseer, my first action is to banish you from Vault 101 forever. Whatever sort of friend you used to be, the Wasteland's changed you.
translation: 作为新的监督者，我的第一项任务就是将你从101号避难所永远驱逐出去。尽管你过去曾是我们的朋友，但废土改变了你。

original: Now get out of my Vault, murderer.
translation: 现在从我的避难所滚出去，杀人犯。

original: It shouldn't be a surprise. I said I'd kill him, and I did.
translation: 不用这么惊讶。我说我要杀了他，我就做了。

original: You bastard, that's still one of our people you're talking about!
translation: 你这混蛋，你谈论的是我们的人！

original: As new Overseer, my first action is to banish you from Vault 101 forever. Whatever sort of friend you used to be, the Wasteland's changed you.
translation: 作为新的监督者，我的第一项任务就是将你从101号避难所永远驱逐出去。尽管你过去曾是我们的朋友，但废土改变了你。

original: Now get out of my Vault, murderer.
translation: 现在从我的避难所滚出去，杀人犯。

original: It shouldn't be a surprise. I said I'd kill him, and I did.
translation: 不用这么惊讶。我说我要杀了他，我就做了。

original: I missed your sense of humor, but I really don't think this is the time for jokes.
translation: 我想念你那幽默感，但这不是开玩笑的时候。

original: We're in real trouble, and your help could make all the difference. So could you please take this seriously, for me?
translation: 我们遇到大麻烦了，你的帮助可以大大影响局势。所以你能认真些吗，就当为了我？

original: I just happened to be in the neighborhood, so I thought I'd stop by.
translation: 我刚好在这附近，所以我想回来看看。

original: It's hard to forgive what he's done, but I suppose I can understand why he did it. I'm glad you brought him to his senses.
translation: 很难原谅他所做的事情，但我想我能明白为什么他这么做。我很高兴你能让他恢复理智。

original: But now there's a new Overseer in charge! And I'm planning on opening the Vault, this time for good.
translation: 但是现在又有了新的监督者在管理！我正计划开放避难所，这次是永久开放。

original: It's a bright new day for the Vault... but I'm afraid there's one thing that has to change.
translation: 这是避难所全新的一天……但我认为有一件事情不得不改变。

original: You both care about the Vault's residents. But in different ways...
translation: 你们两个都关心避难所的居民。但却是以不同的方式……

original: Oh, I will, believe me. We can open up limited trade with nearby settlements and other areas, and see the world we've been missing.
translation: 哦，我会的，相信我。我们可以和附近的定居点或其他地区的居民进行有限的贸易，看看我们一直逃避的世界。

original: But it's still important that I protect our Vault, and keep the people within it safe from the dangers of the Wasteland.
translation: 但是我保护我们的避难所依然很重要，保护我的人民不受废土危险的威胁。

original: Even when those dangers have helped us in the past. And that makes the rest of this even harder.
translation: 尽管那些危险份子过去帮助过我们。但现在我们其他人更没办法了。

original: That's the way these things go. Now do the right thing for your Vault.
translation: 这是必然的。现在为你的避难所作出正确的选择吧。

original: Oh, thank you! Everything's gone crazy since you left, and now that you're back, you can help set things straight.
translation: 哦，谢谢你！你走之后一切都变得一团糟，既然现在你回来了，你能帮忙把事情都搞定。

original: I came as soon as I heard you were in trouble.
translation: 我一听到你们有问题就赶来了。

original: You and him? Civil? I expected you to change out in the Wasteland, but not that much!
translation: 你和他？心平气和？我能想到你在废土会有些变化，但没想到这么大！

original: But I guess we'll all be learning a bit about the outside now, won't we? As the new Overseer, I'm planning on opening the Vault, this time for good.
translation: 但是我猜我们正在逐渐了解外面的世界，对吗？作为新的监督者，我正计划开放避难所，这次是永久开放。

original: It's a bright new day for the Vault... but I'm afraid there's one thing that has to change.
translation: 这是避难所全新的一天……但我认为有一件事情不得不改变。

original: I just had a little talk with him and explained a few things. All quite civil.
translation: 我只是心平气和地和他谈，解释了一些事。

original: I'm sure you did everything you could to find another way. I know how stubborn he is... how stubborn he was.
translation: 我肯定你尽力寻找其他的途径了。我知道他有多顽固……他曾经多顽固。

original: But you're right. I don't have time to grieve just because I lost my father. The Vault needs a leader now.
translation: 但是你是对的。我没有时间来为失去我的父亲而悲伤。避难所现在需要一个领袖。

original: That makes the rest of this even harder.
translation: 那使得剩下的事情变得更困难。

original: I'm sorry about your father, but now the Vault can have a real leader.
translation: 关于你的父亲我很抱歉，但现在避难所能够有一个真正的领导者了。

original: I'm sure you did everything you could to find another way. I know how stubborn he is... how stubborn he was.
translation: 我肯定你尽力寻找其他的途径了。我知道他有多顽固……他曾经多顽固。

original: But you're right. We don't have time to grieve. The Vault needs a leader now. That makes the rest of this even harder.
translation: 但是你是对的。我没有时间来为失去我的父亲而悲伤。避难所现在需要一个领袖，那使得剩下的事情变得更困难。

original: I'm sorry it had to end that way, but now the Vault can have a real leader.
translation: 我很抱歉事情会这么结束，但现在避难所能够有一个真正的领导者了。

original: I can't do that. Not officially, at least. As much as some of the rebels would like to talk with you, the Overseer said you weren't welcome back.
translation: 我不能那么做。至少不能光明正大地那么做。很多反叛者想要和你聊聊，监督者说你不会再回来了。

original: Of course, if you survived whatever's out there, none of us could stop you if you really wanted to cause problems. But I'd prefer if you don't.
translation: 当然，既然你可以在外面活下来，你想惹麻烦的话，我们这没人拦得住你，但我希望你不会这样做。

original: But out of respect to your dad, I could turn a blind eye. You could slip out and say you were never here - I won't tell a soul.
translation: 但是出于对你爸爸的尊重，我可以睁一只眼闭一只眼。你可以离开，就当从没来过这 — 我不会说出去的。

original: Well, let me through. I've got work to do.
translation: 让我过去。我有事要做。

original: I probably ought to put you under arrest and take you in to the Overseer, but frankly, I know better than to try that.
translation: 我或许应该把你逮捕并交到监督者手里，但坦白说,我知道不这么做更好。

original: Meanwhile, some of your old friends think opening the Vault is a good idea. I bet those rebels would like a word with you. Now, more than ever.
translation: 同时，你的一些老朋友认为开放避难所是个好主意。我打赌那些反叛者想要和你谈谈。比以前任何时候等更急需。

original: Of course, if you want, you can just walk away as if you were never here. Out of respect for your dad, I won't even tell anyone I saw you.
translation: 当然，如果你想的话，你可以直接离开就当作你没来过。出于对你爸爸的尊重，我不会告诉其他人我见过你。

original: So what now?
translation: 现在怎么办？

original: To tell the truth, I don't really blame him for all that. I don't know why he left, but I do know he'd never intend for all that to happen.
translation: 说实话，我觉得那些事并不怪他。我不知道他为什么要走，但我知道他不是有意造成这一切的。

original: But when the smoke cleared, other people started thinking about opening the vault permanently. And that didn't go down well with the Overseer.
translation: 但事态稍显平静时，其他人就开始考虑永久开放避难所了。而监督者并不乐意。

original: He's been coming down hard on them, and that's where it stands now. At least, until you walked in here.
translation: 他一直压制着他们，那就是问题的所在。至少，在你到来之前是这样。

original: Yeah, Dad screwed up all of our lives that day, didn't he?
translation: 是啊，爸爸那天毁了我们所有人的生活，不是吗？

original: To tell the truth, I don't really blame him for all that. I don't know why he left, but I do know he'd never intend for all that to happen.
translation: 说实话，我觉得那些事并不怪他。我不知道他为什么要走，但我知道他不是有意造成这一切的。

original: Even so, we lost a lot of people that night, including the Overseer himself. He was replaced by Allen Mack, Wally's dad, and things seemed all right.
translation: 虽然如此，我们在那一夜失去了很多人，包括监督者他自己。瓦利的父亲阿伦·麦克取代了他，事情似乎有所好转。

original: But some of your friends started talking about opening the vault for good, and he came down hard on them. Things are pretty tense, now.
translation: 但你的一些朋友开始谈论为永久开放避难所，他极力压制他们。现在局势十分紧张。

original: Yeah, Dad screwed up all of our lives that day, didn't he?
translation: 是啊，爸爸那天毁了我们所有人的生活，不是吗？

original: I'm... I'm sorry to hear that. Regardless of how things turned out down here, he was a good friend. I always figured he'd do well outside.
translation: 我……听到这感到很遗憾。不管这变得多糟，他是个好朋友。我一直以为他在外面能活得很好。

original: Matter of fact, a lot of folks started thinking he had the right idea. He usually did. So if it was safe out there, why stay down here forever?
translation: 实际上，很多人开始认为他的想法是正确的。他一直是正确的。所以如果外面很安全，为什么永远待在这儿？

original: Well, the Overseer didn't like that one bit, and started cracking down on that sort of thought. Guess he didn't plan on you coming back.
translation: 嗯，监督者不喜欢那样，并开始镇压那样的思潮。我想他没有料到你会回来。

original: Dad would be horrified to know all that... if he were still alive.
translation: 爸爸知道了这一切会被吓倒的……如果他还活着的话。

original: I'm... I'm sorry to hear that. Regardless of how things turned out down here, he was a good friend. I always figured he'd do well outside.
translation: 我……听到这感到很遗憾。不管这变得多糟，他是个好朋友。我一直以为他在外面能活得很好。

original: You're not alone in that, though. In all the chaos, Amata lost her dad, too. Lots of us lost family, to tell the truth.
translation: 不管怎么说，你并不孤单。在这场混乱中，阿玛塔也失去了她的父亲。说实话，我们很多人都失去了家庭。

original: Now Allen Mack's the Overseer, and he's taking a hard stance against those who want the vault to open again.
translation: 现在阿伦·麦克成为了监督者，他对那些想重新开放避难所的人进行严厉的镇压。

original: Dad would be horrified to know all that... if he were still alive.
translation: 爸爸知道了这一切会被吓倒的……如果他还活着的话。

original: Really? Well, that would explain a few things, all right. It's a good thing you're here, after all.
translation: 真的吗？嗯,那就可以解释一些事了，没错。不管怎么说，你在这是件好事。

original: After that night, a lot of your friends started thinking, "If it's safe to go outside, why stay down here forever?"
translation: 那夜之后，很多你的朋友开始思考，“如果到外面是安全的，为什么我们要永远待在这？”

original: And that's not the sort of thing the Overseer likes to hear. Things have gotten pretty tense.
translation: 监督者可不喜欢听这话。局势已经变得十分紧张了。

original: That was never supposed to happen! That was the Overseer's fault!
translation: 这不应该发生！这都是监督者的错！

original: He wasn't the only one who didn't make it to morning. It was a horrible, horrible night.
translation: 他不是唯一没能活到天亮的人。那晚实在是太可怕了。

original: Believe it or not, it was Allen Mack who really stepped up in the crisis. Wally's dad really saved some lives, and got named the new Overseer for it.
translation: 不管你相不相信，阿伦·麦克临危受命。瓦利的父亲确实救过一些人，也因此成为了监督者。

original: Then, just when some hoped he might open the door for good, he declared martial law and said the place would stay sealed off forever.
translation: 不久之后，就在一些人希望他能够永远打开大门时，他宣布了戒严令并说这地方将永远关闭。

original: That was the Overseer's fault, and he paid for it that night.
translation: 这都是监督者的错，他在那个晚上付出了代价。

original: That'd be Allen Mack. You remember, Wally's dad.
translation: 阿伦·麦克。你记得的，瓦利的父亲。

original: He was something else when those fires started burning. In fact, if it weren't for him, we'd have lost a lot more than we did.
translation: 发生火灾时他完全是另一个样子。事实上，如果不是因为他，我们的损失要更大。

original: Afterwards, well, he seemed like a natural for the job of Overseer. He's tough, but I guess we could probably use that right about now.
translation: 后来，嗯，他似乎天生就是当监督者的料。他很强硬，但我想我们现在可以利用这一点。

original: So, who's the Overseer now?
translation: 那么，现在谁是监督者？

original: Technically, this means I'm supposed to report her. To tell the truth, I'm supposed to report you being here, too.
translation: 从规矩上讲，这意味着我应该报告她。说实话，我也应该报告你在这。

original: But I've been getting mighty forgetful in my old age, you know? We've got more than enough trouble without me adding to it.
translation: 但是像我这把年纪是很健忘的，你懂吗？不用我再添乱，我们的麻烦已经够大了。

original: That's a risk I'm willing to take.
translation: 我愿意冒这个险。

original: Maybe. She isn't the only one, that's for sure.
translation: 可能吧。但可以肯定的是，有麻烦的不止她一个。

original: Ever since that night, it's been madness down here. Nothing but trouble.
translation: 从那晚起，这里就一团糟。除了麻烦什么都没有。

original: I mean, I just had a hunch she was in trouble.
translation: 我是说，我有预感她遇上麻烦了。

original: It wouldn't have if your father hadn't ruined everything by opening that door!
translation: 如果你的父亲没有用打开大门来毁了这一切的话，就不会发生了！

original: Things were just fine until he decided to take a little walk! Then we had bug attacks, confusion, and chaos! And with no doctor, too!
translation: 在他决定出去散散步之前一切都很好！之后我们就遇到虫子的攻击、骚动和混乱！也没有了医生！

original: I always knew something would go wrong down here...
translation: 我就知道这下面会有事发生……

original: Everything went crazy, is what happened. Your dad opened that door, bugs started attacking, and people started going crazy.
translation: 一切都陷入了疯狂。你的父亲打开大门，虫子们开始进攻，而人们开始失去理智。

original: When the smoke cleared, there were a lot of casualties and not many answers.
translation: 事态稍显平静时，已经伤亡惨重，但还是没人作出回应。

original: Didn't help that our doctor had just left, either.
translation: 我们的医生也离开了，这简直是雪上加霜。

original: What's happened down here since I left?
translation: 我走了以后这下面都发生了什么？

original: Let me bring you up to speed. It seems like it's been a mighty long time.
translation: 我来告诉你最新情况。你似乎离开很长时间了。

original: The night you and your dad left, everything went crazy. Between the bugs and the confusion, we lost a lot of people.
translation: 你和你父亲走的那晚，一切都陷入了疯狂。在虫子和骚乱的共同打击下，我们损失了很多人。

original: When your dad opened up that gate, he let loose a whole lot of crap, if you'll pardon my language.
translation: 请原谅我的粗鲁，但在你的父亲打开大门时，他就搅浑了这摊粪水。

original: What sort of trouble do you mean?
translation: 你说的是什么样的麻烦？

original: This isn't some sort of hotel, you know! You don't just come and go as you please. I thought you were raised better than that!
translation: 这不是旅馆，你知道！你不能自由来去。我以为你受过更好的教育呢！

original: Sorry, it's just been pretty rough down here since you and your dad left.
translation: 对不起，你和你的父亲离开后这的一切都变得相当糟。

original: There's real trouble brewing, and you don't want to be a part of it.
translation: 真的是大麻烦，你绝对不会希望被扯进来的。

original: Don't mind me. I'm just here to pick up some stuff I left behind.
translation: 别管我。我只是来拿我落下的东西。

original: But... why?
translation: 但……为什么？

original: The way I see it, if you and the rebels are dead, all these problems are over.
translation: 我想了想，如果你和这群反叛者都死了，那么问题就解决了。

original: What a coincidence! I was thinking just the same thing!
translation: 太巧了！我也在想同样的事！

original: I think I'll just kill you, now.
translation: 我想我还是现在杀了你吧。

original: I expected nothing less from you.
translation: 我没有低估你。

original: I still owe you for Jonas. Now shut up and die, you son of a bitch.
translation: 我还要替乔纳斯谢谢你。现在闭嘴受死吧，混蛋。

original: What exactly do you mean by that?
translation: 你到底是什么意思？

original: You need to understand the dangers outside, and why you should stay here.
translation: 你必须明白外部世界的危险，你也要明白为什么你必须留在这。

original: You know what? I hear the last Overseer tried being reasonable about things, and you killed him for his efforts.
translation: 你知道吗？我听说上任监督者试图理智处事，而你因为他的努力而杀了他。

original: I think I'll skip the "reasonable" thing and just kill you now.
translation: 我想我还是免去“理智”，直接干掉你。

original: Be reasonable. You need to open the Vault.
translation: 理智些。你必须开启避难所。

original: Oh, do you? What makes you think you know how better to protect this Vault?
translation: 哦，是吗？你凭什么以为自己知道如何更好地保护避难所？

original: The rebels are right. You need to open the Vault.
translation: 那些反叛者是对的，你应该开启避难所了。

original: You will? Thank goodness for that. No matter what I say, he just doesn't listen. He just spends all day up in his office.
translation: 你会吗？谢天谢地。不管我说什么他就是不听，他就知道整天待在办公室里。

original: But you've actually been outside, so you can tell him what it's like with firsthand experience!
translation: 但是你确实去过外面，所以你可以告诉他第一手的经验！

original: Just... Please don't do anything rash or hurt him, all right?
translation: 只是……请不要做鲁莽的事或是伤害他，好吗？

original: I swear, I'll stop your father and his guards. Just watch.
translation: 我发誓，我会阻止你的父亲和他手下的警卫。等着瞧。

original: You will? Thank goodness for that. No matter what I say, he just doesn't listen. He just spends all day up in his office.
translation: 你会吗？谢天谢地。不管我说什么他就是不听，他就知道整天待在办公室里。

original: But you've actually been outside, so you can tell him what it's like with firsthand experience!
translation: 但是你确实去过外面，所以你可以告诉他第一手的经验！

original: Just... Please be careful.
translation: 只是……请小心。

original: I swear, I'll stop the Overseer. Just watch.
translation: 我发誓，我会阻止监督者。等着瞧。

original: I'm okay, I just worry about how long we have before someone does something rash.
translation: 我很好，我只是担心不久就会有人做出鲁莽的事。

original: I'm trying to stop the Overseer. Just be patient.
translation: 我正试着阻止监督者。请等待。

original: Huh. I wasn't expecting to hear that!
translation: 呵。我没想到能听见这番话！

original: Okay, here's the deal: You go and get them to quit this Vault-opening nonsense, and I'll let you leave. Heck, I'll even throw in some pay.
translation: 好的，这么着：你去让他们结束这无意义的开放避难所之争，而我会让你离开。见鬼，我也会给你些报酬。

original: I agree with you. Let me get the rebels to stop.
translation: 我同意。我们去阻止反叛者。

original: Hmm. You always have held a certain sway with them that neither I nor my guards have enjoyed.
translation: 嗯。不像我和我的守卫，你能说服他们。

original: All right, then. Go to my daughter and convince her to leave this rebellious nonsense behind.
translation: 好的，去劝我那女儿放弃这无意义的反叛吧。

original: I'll put a stop to the rebels. Just let me have a word with them.
translation: 我会阻止反叛者。只要让我和他们谈谈。

original: You're lucky I'm in a good mood. Get to it.
translation: 算你走远，我心情很好。快去吧。

original: I'm working on stopping the rebels. Give me a little more time.
translation: 我会阻止反叛者。给我一点时间。

original: All right, but I expect results. Get to work.
translation: 好的，但我要的是结果。干活去吧。

original: I'm working on stopping the rebels. Give me a little more time.
translation: 我会阻止反叛者。给我一点时间。

original: You're leaving us? You're leaving me?
translation: 你要离开我们？你要离开我？

original: I guess what my father said was right. Now that you've been out there, you stopped caring about anyone but yourself.
translation: 我想我父亲说得对。既然你已经出去了，你就不会再管别人而只在乎自己了。

original: We don't need your help. We'll take care of ourselves. You can just get out, and never come back!
translation: 我们不需要你的帮助。我们会照顾好自己。你出去吧，别再回来！

original: The more I hear, the less I want to be involved at all. I'm leaving, forever.
translation: 我知道的越多，我就越不想管这事。我要走了，永远不再回来。

original: You're leaving us? You're leaving me?
translation: 你要离开我们？你要离开我？

original: I guess what the Overseer said was right. Now that you've been out there, you stopped caring about anyone but yourself.
translation: 我想我父亲说得对。既然你已经出去了，你就不会再管别人而只在乎自己了。

original: We don't need your help. We'll take care of ourselves. You can just get out, and never come back!
translation: 我们不需要你的帮助。我们会照顾好自己。你出去吧，别再回来！

original: The more I hear, the less I want to be involved at all. I'm leaving, forever.
translation: 我知道的越多，我就越不想管这事。我要走了，永远不再回来。

original: That should save us all some trouble. Now get moving, before I decide to make an example of you.
translation: 那应该可以给我们省不少麻烦。现在走吧，趁我还没对你采取行动。

original: You know, I just don't care anymore. Let me leave and I'll never come back.
translation: 你知道，我已经不关心这事了。让我走，我再也不会回来了。

original: As I always suspected. You never cared about the Vault. Now that you've been outside, you're nothing more than a ignorant savage.
translation: 和我猜测的一样。你从不关心避难所。既然你已经出去了，就变得跟愚昧的野人没什么区别了。

original: But by all means, feel free to see yourself out. I'm sure you know the way.
translation: 但无论如何，请放心去吧。我确定你知道路。

original: You know, I just don't care anymore. Let me leave and I'll never come back.
translation: 你知道，我已经不关心这事了。让我走，我再也不会回来了。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: There's only one solution, here. Death, and lots of it. You get to be first!
translation: 只有一个解决方法，那就是死。死很多人，而你是第一个！

original: Well, I can't blame you. I'll change the passwords behind you, and we'll figure out a way to work things out for ourselves.
translation: 好吧，这也不能怪你。在你走后我会更改密码，我们会自己找到解决问题的途径。

original: We've made it on our own for this long. I'm sure this'll blow over in time, too.
translation: 我们已经靠自己撑了这么久。我也相信这事迟早会平息。

original: Best of luck to you out there, kid. Don't worry about us.
translation: 祝你在外好运，孩子。别为我们担心。

original: This is too messed up. I'm leaving again. Just pretend I never came back.
translation: 这实在是太乱了。我要走了。你就装作我没回来过。

original: Okay, let's try this slowly. When you and your daddy left, there were problems. Those problems were bad.
translation: 好的，我慢慢讲。在你和你的父亲离开时，麻烦就出现了。非常糟糕。

original: Amata and some others said we should try opening the door and going outside more. The Overseer said that was bad, too, and he got angry.
translation: 阿玛塔和其它一些人说我们应该把门打开，多到外面去看看。监督者说这不行，他也很生气。

original: Now, just about everyone's angry down here. And things are still bad. Really bad.
translation: 现在，这的每个人都很愤怒。情况仍然很糟。真的很糟。

original: I still don't get what's going on.
translation: 我仍然不清楚发生了什么。

original: Okay, follow me.
translation: 好的，跟我来。

original: I need to see Amata. Lead me to her.
translation: 我要见阿玛塔。带我去见她。

original: We're already headed there. Just stay quiet and follow me.
translation: 我们正往那儿去呢。保持安静跟着我。

original: I need to see Amata. Lead me to her.
translation: 我要见阿玛塔。带我去见她。

original: <sighs> Okay. Hope no one asks too many questions.
translation: <叹息> 好的。我不希望有人问太多问题。

original: Actually, could you escort me to Amata? I need to talk to her about all this.
translation: 实际上，你能带我去见阿玛塔吗？我想和她谈谈这一切。

original: As chance would have it, she was one of the first people to talk about life outside the vault after you left. No surprise; she always did like you.
translation: 凑巧的是，她是在你走之后第一批讨论外面生活的人之一。这并不稀奇，因为她以前一直喜欢你。

original: I hope you can talk some sense into her... or maybe the two of you can come up with some other plan? Just be careful about it.
translation: 我希望你能跟她讲讲道理……或许你们两个能想出别的办法？总之要多加小心。

original: Could you escort me to Amata? I need to talk to her about all this.
translation: 你能带我去见阿玛塔吗？我想和她谈谈这一切。

original: Okay, follow me.
translation: 好的，跟我来。

original: I think I'd like to have a talk with the Overseer. Take me to him.
translation: 我想我应该和监督者谈谈。带我去见他。

original: We're already headed there. Can't you smell the fire and brimstone?
translation: 我们正前往那里。难道你闻不到硝烟味吗？

original: I think I'd like to have a talk with the Overseer. Take me to him.
translation: 我想我应该和监督者谈谈。带我去见他。

original: You sure you know what you're doing?
translation: 你确定你知道自己在做什么吗？

original: On second thought, maybe I don't want to know. Just follow me.
translation: 转念一想，或许我不想知道。跟我走吧。

original: I think it's time to have a talk with the Overseer. Take me to him.
translation: 是时候和监督者谈谈了。带我去见他。

original: I hope you know what you're doing. I don't think he's going to be happy to see you.
translation: 我希望你知道你在做什么。我认为他见到你不会开心。

original: Follow close to me, and I'll escort you down to him.
translation: 跟紧我，我会护送你去他那。

original: I think I'd like to have a talk with the Overseer. Take me to him.
translation: 我想我应该和监督者谈谈。带我去见他。

original: You just thought you'd pop in? Don't take this the wrong way, but you probably ought to just turn around and not come back.
translation: 你想来就来？别误会我的意思，但你或许应该转身离开，别再回来。

original: Things... Well, they haven't gone very well since you and your dad left.
translation: 事情……嗯，事情在你和你的父亲走了之后变得不妙。

original: This isn't the happy vault you grew up in, anymore. There's real trouble.
translation: 这已经不是那个让你成长的欢乐避难所了。出了大麻烦。

original: I just thought I'd stop back home for a bit. How's the old Vault?
translation: 我想我只是回家看看。老避难所现在怎样？

original: Amata's message? I don't know what you're talking about, but I'd keep that under your hat, for her sake.
translation: 阿玛塔的消息？我不知道你在说什么，但我会保密的，看在她的份上。

original: She could get in real trouble if people found out she sent you a message. So could I, just for talking with you now.
translation: 如果人们发现她给你消息的话，她就有大麻烦了。我也一样，仅仅因为和你说过话。

original: I need to talk with Amata. I got her message.
translation: 我要和阿玛塔谈谈。我收到了她的信息。

original: Hell no, crazy girl. I won't be your lab rat.
translation: 不会吧，疯女孩。我不会成为你的试验品的。

original: What? Really? But... Please?
translation: 什么？真的？但……别？

original: Well, I'll still be here if you change your mind. Plenty to work on without that book, anyway.
translation: 嗯，如果你改变主意的话还会可以到这儿来找我。不管怎么说那本书上还有很多事要做。

original: Okay, I guess I'll help with this "Survival Guide."
translation: 好的，我想我会用帮助你完成“生存指南”的。

original: All right, then! Now, I think the first chapter will have to be about surviving day-to-day dangers.
translation: 好的！接下来，我想第一章或许是关于在日常危险中求存。

original: Things like where it is and isn't safe to find food, the dangers of radiation, and how to avoid and even profit from dangerous landmines.
translation: 有很多方面，比如能否安全地找到食物，辐射的危险性，还有怎样避开危险的地雷，甚至利用他它们。

original: Ooh, sounds like fun, doesn't it? Which do you want to do first?
translation: 噢，听起来很有趣，不是吗？你想先做什么？

original: Well, you do what you have to, I suppose. But the offer'll still be open, if you change your mind.
translation: 嗯，你尽管做你该做的,我想。但这仍然有效，如果你改变了想法的话。

original: It's tempting, but I'll have to pass.
translation: 很诱人，但还是算了。

original: Oh sure, because the angel of death really needs a helping hand out there. I guess "almost everyone in the world" didn't quite meet his quota.
translation: 哦，当然，因为外面的死神真的需要个帮手。我猜“几乎世界上的所有人”都不会同意他的话的。

original: Just stay out of my way until you reconsider that, okay? Some of us actually give a damn about the survival of the species.
translation: 在你重新考虑前别挡我的路，好吗？我们中的一些人真的关心物种的存亡。

original: Doesn't sound like my style. I'm out.
translation: 听起来不像我的风格。我退出。

original: Let's see, dealing with radiation, testing an experimental device, and I won't lie, it may include some reading. That sort of stuff, you know?
translation: 让我看看，处理辐射，测试实验装置，我不骗人，可能包含了些数据。关于那些，你懂吗？

original: But for all that, I can pay you with caps, meds, chems, and maybe even a few of those unique inventions, if you do a good job. Interested?
translation: 但所有的一切，如果你干得好的话，我可以付给你钱、药品、化学品，甚至是一些独一无二的发明。感兴趣吗？

original: Pay? What sort of pay? And what sort of work?
translation: 报酬？什么样的报酬？又是什么样的工作？

original: "Target"? Whoa, no, no, no! It's not that sort of job! No, I'm talking about researching things like surviving in the Wastes and such.
translation: “靶子”？哇，不，不，不！不是那种工作！不，我在研究怎么在废土生存这样的事。

original: And I can offer caps and meds and a few of my inventions in return. I guess I can even get you some ammo, if that's more your style.
translation: 我可以用钱或者是我的一些发明作为回报。我想我甚至可以给你些弹药，如果是你需要的类型的话。

original: Pay? You just said the magic word. Name the target.
translation: 报酬？你怎么不早点说，告诉我目标吧。

original: Not interested. I'm just here to do some shopping.
translation: 没兴趣。我就是来买些东西。

original: Well, okay, I guess. But I promise, you'll love it when you hear about the guide. Maybe later, huh?
translation: 嗯，好的，我想。但我保证，当你听过指南的话你会喜欢上它的。或许迟点，呃？

original: Sorry, I must have you confused with somebody else. Forget I mentioned it.
translation: 抱歉，我一定是把你和别的人搞混了。就当我没说好了。

original: Hmph. No one else could do it, that's for damn sure.
translation: 哼。其他人肯定做不了，这他妈是肯定的。

original: Just get out of here. Can't you leave an old man in peace? And stay away from my stuff!
translation: 滚出这里。你就不能让一个老人安静点吗？离我的东西远点！

original: Hope the Mirelurks get you, damn nosy kid.
translation: 希望泥沼蟹抓到你，该死的烦人精。

original: Maybe 100 caps will jog your memory?
translation: 或许100个瓶盖可以帮你恢复记忆？

original: It's things like bottlecaps, and property, and ownership and all that nonsense that makes a person think he's better than another. Bah!
translation: 就像瓶盖、财产、所有权，以及所有让人觉得比别人要优越的无聊玩意。呸！

original: But I'll take your caps just the same. This android came in as one person, and he left as someone else. I replaced his face AND his memories!
translation: 但是同样我也会拿你的钱。这人造人来的时候是一个样子，而离开时却变了样子。我改变了他的面容和记忆！

original: Don't believe anyone's done that before. Certainly not down here. That Commonwealth tech isn't all that fancy when it comes down to it.
translation: 别相信以前没人这么做过。当然不是在这里。说到底，联邦的技术也没那么玄乎。

original: I'm also the only one in the Wasteland with the skill and the nerve to perform facial surgery. That android flesh ain't so different than ours.
translation: 我也是废土唯一有技术和耐心去进行整容手术的人。那人造人的皮肤和我们的区别不大。

original: You want proof? I documented the whole thing. So I could rub it in the face of Dr. Li when I need to rankle her feathers. I hate that snooty bitch.
translation: 你要证据吗？我都记录下来了。这样我就可以在需要激怒李博士的时候，把东西甩她脸上。我讨厌那自大的婊子。

original: Let's just say it's in your best interest to tell me what I want to know.
translation: 我们就说说你最感兴趣的事吧。

original: Fine, whatever. This android, calls himself Harkness now, comes in and wants a memory job. I took new memories, and replaced his old ones.
translation: 好的，随便你。这个仿真人，现在自称哈克尼斯，来做记忆手术。我植入新的记忆，替换了他的旧记忆。

original: Don't believe anyone's done that before. Certainly not down here. That Commonwealth tech isn't all that fancy when it comes down to it.
translation: 别相信以前没人这么做过。当然不是在这里。说到底，联邦的技术也没那么玄乎。

original: I'm also the only one in the wasteland with the skill and the nerve to perform facial surgery. That android flesh aint so different than ours.
translation: 我也是废土上唯一有技术和胆量做面部手术的人。那仿真人的皮肤和我们并没太大的区别。

original: You want proof? I documented the whole thing. So I could rub it in the face of Dr. Li when I need to rankle her feathers. I hate that snooty bitch.
translation: 你要证据吗？我都记录下来了。这样我就可以在需要激怒李博士的时候，把东西甩她脸上。我讨厌那自大的婊子。

original: Let's discuss the facial reconstruction and mind wipe you did for the Android.
translation: 我们来谈谈你给仿真人做的面部重塑和记忆清除。

original: What're you talking about, boy? I don't know anything about any of that, and a what-did-you-call-it? An android? What's that?
translation: 你在说什么呢，小子？我什么都不知道，你刚说什么？仿真人？那是什么？

original: What are you talking about, girl? I don't know anything about any of that, and a what-did-you-call-it? An android? What's that?
translation: 你在说什么呢，姑娘？我什么都不知道，你刚说什么？仿真人？那是什么？

original: So... Any suggestions for finding this android?
translation: 那……对于找到这个仿真人，有什么建议？

original: Like I've said, I suspect he's had facial reconstruction, and possibly even a mind wipe.
translation: 就像我说的，我怀疑他做了面部重塑，甚至可能抹除了记忆。

original: Try snooping around the work spaces of techies -- you know, people like yourself. And try doctors' offices, look for patient records or something.
translation: 试着到技术人员的工作场所打探一下——你知道吧，就是像你这样的人。还有，去试试医生的办公室，找找病历或是别的什么。

original: Start with Doctor Preston. He lives on this leaky boat. See if he knows anything. He's a "doctor" after all.
translation: 从普雷斯顿医生那开始。他就住在这艘破船上。看看他是否知道些什么。毕竟他是个“医生”。

original: Now, if you'll excuse me. I'm busy trying to ignore my surroundings.
translation: 恕我失陪。我很忙，不想被身外的事分心。

original: Like I've said, I suspect he's had facial reconstruction, and possibly even a mind wipe.
translation: 就像我说的，我怀疑他做了面部重塑，甚至可能抹除了记忆。

original: Search the offices of doctors or techies for android information. If he's come into contact with these people, there may be records.
translation: 去医生或技术人员的办公室搜查人造人的信息。他要是和这些人有过接触，一定会留下记录。

original: Start with Doctor Preston. He lives on this leaky boat. See if he knows anything. He's a "doctor" after all.
translation: 从普雷斯顿医生那开始。他就住在这艘破船上。看看他是否知道些什么。毕竟他是个“医生”。

original: Now, if you'll excuse me. I'm busy trying to ignore my surroundings.
translation: 恕我失陪。我很忙，不想被身外的事分心。

original: I've found your android. It's Harkness, Rivet City's security chief!
translation: 我找到了你的仿真人。是哈克尼斯，铆钉城的安全主管！

original: Harkness, you say? Yes... Yes, that makes sense. He used to work for a special branch of the Commonwealth Police, after all...
translation: 你是说哈克尼斯？对……对，这说得通。他过去曾在联邦警察的特别处工作，毕竟……

original: And he's right here in Rivet City! Excellent! I must wait... find an opportune moment to confront him...
translation: 而他就在铆钉城！太好了！我必须等待……找一个可以当面对质的机会……

original: Thank you for your discreet assistance, and continued discretion regarding this matter.
translation: 谢谢你周到的帮助，并继续谨慎处理此事。

original: And now for your payment. This combat module will directly affect your central nervous system. I think you will find it quite beneficial.
translation: 现在该给你报酬了。这个战斗模块将直接影响你的中枢神经系统。我想你会发现它非常有用。

original: I'm still looking, don't worry. I'll find him.
translation: 我正在找，别担心。我会找到他的。

original: Not soon enough! I don't think I can stand another day in this barbaric backwoods...
translation: 太慢了！我想我在这野蛮的地方一天也待不下去了……

original: How quaint. Of course you'll be rewarded! I have at my disposal advanced technology from the Commonwealth.
translation: 当然你会得到报酬的！我有来自联邦的先进技术。

original: I'd be willing to share some of it with you. Just think, you'll be the envy of all your friends!
translation: 我会与你分享。想想看，你会被你所有的朋友们所羡慕的！

original: Tell me, Zimmer. Is your wallet as big as your mouth?
translation: 告诉我，齐默。你的钱包和你的嘴巴一样大吗？

original: I'm sorry, it slipped my mind. I have at my disposal advanced technology from the Commonwealth.
translation: 很抱歉，我没想起来。我有来自联邦的先进技术。

original: I'd be willing to share some of it with you. Just think, you'll be the envy of all your friends!
translation: 我会与你分享。想想看，你会被你所有的朋友们所羡慕的！

original: I'm not sure how it is up north, but around here, we get paid for our work.
translation: 我不知道在北方是怎么样的，不过在我们这，工作是要给报酬的。

original: Of course. I have at my disposal advanced technology from the Commonwealth.
translation: 当然。我有来自联邦的先进技术。

original: I'd be willing to share some of it with you. Just think, you'll be the envy of all your friends!
translation: 我会与你分享。想想看，你会被你所有的朋友们所羡慕的！

original: I'll be compensated for my services, right?
translation: 我的服务是有报酬的，对吧？

original: Isn't it quite clear? You are to locate my android!
translation: 还不清楚吗？你要找到我的人造人！

original: He must have done something drastic, like facial surgery and a mind wipe, or else I would have found him by now.
translation: 他肯定是做了些大工程，像整容手术和记忆移植，或是其他的什么事，反正我现在是找不到他了。

original: It will be no easy task. He may not even realize he's an android. Don't upset him by talking with him. Just come get me immediately. I'll handle it.
translation: 这不是个容易的事。他甚至没察觉到自己是个人造人。别和他明说，以免他情绪失控。找到他后就赶快通知我，由我来处理。

original: Enough techno-babble, Zimmer. Just tell me what you want me to do.
translation: 别再说什么科学废话了，齐默。告诉我你要我干什么。

original: You're helping me retrieve this android! Aren't you?
translation: 你在帮我找人造人！对吗？

original: I've tracked him this far. He's out there, somewhere. In the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 我跟了他这么远。他就在外面，某个地方。在首都废土。

original: He must have done something drastic, like facial surgery and a mind wipe, or else I would have found him by now.
translation: 他肯定是做了些大工程，像整容手术和记忆移植，或是其他的什么事，反正我现在是找不到他了。

original: It will be no easy task. He may not even realize he's an android. Don't upset him by talking with him. Just come get me immediately. I'll handle it.
translation: 这不是个容易的事。他甚至没察觉到自己是个人造人。别和他明说，以免他情绪失控。找到他后就赶快通知我，由我来处理。

original: Interesting... But what's this got to do with me, exactly?
translation: 真有趣…… 不过做这事我会有什么报酬？

original: Nonsense! This is a machine we're talking about. Can you enslave a generator, or a water purifier? Of course not. The same principle applies.
translation: 扯淡！我们谈论的是一个机器。你能奴役发电机或水处理器吗？当然不能，同理如此。

original: But let's get back to your mission. You are to find this missing android. I've tracked him to somewhere here in the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 让我们继续谈你的任务。你要去找到这失踪的人造人。我追踪到他就在首都废土的某个地方。

original: He must have done something drastic, like facial surgery and a mind wipe, or else I would have found him by now.
translation: 他肯定是做了些大工程，像整容手术和记忆移植，或是其他的什么事，反正我现在是找不到他了。

original: It will be no easy task. He may not even realize he's an android. Don't upset him by talking with him. Just come get me immediately. I'll handle it.
translation: 这不是个容易的事。他甚至没察觉到自己是个人造人。别和他明说，以免他情绪失控。找到他后就赶快通知我，由我来处理。

original: Sounds like slavery to me. You sure they don't "wander off" on purpose?
translation: 在我听来像是奴隶制。你确定他们不会主动的“逃跑”？

original: You'll be searching for an android! Do you know what an android is? No, I imagine you don't.
translation: 你要寻找一个人造人！你知道人造人是什么吗？不，我想你不知道。

original: All you know of robots are those buckets of bolts -- those Mr. Handshakers and whatnot. Well, that's not ALL a robot can be! Not in the Commonwealth.
translation: 你所知道的关于机器人的东西都过时了 — 那些“巧手”先生和类似的。嗯，那不是所有机器人都能做到的！联邦可不一样。

original: I'm talking about artificial persons, that think and feel and do what we program them to. And... occasionally they get confused and wander off.
translation: 我在说人造人，就是我们设计他们的思想、感官，行为。而……偶尔他们会失控。

original: Cut to the chase, Zimmer. What's the job?
translation: 开门见山吧，齐默。想要我干什么？

original: Ah, a woman of action. I knew I picked the right person for the job! Let me be clear, you won't be looking for a lost puppy or family heirloom.
translation: 啊，一个行动型的女人。我知道我为这工作选对了人！让我说清楚些，你不是要寻找一个走失的小狗或是传家宝。

original: You'll be searching for an android! Do you know what an android is? No, I imagine you don't.
translation: 你要寻找一个人造人！你知道人造人是什么吗？不，我想你不知道。

original: You see, we've moved beyond those primitive buckets you call robots, and have created Artificial Intelligence. Sentient machines!
translation: 你看，我们的科技已经超越了那些你称为机器人的人造人，并且创造了人工智能。有感知的机器！

original: Artificial persons that think and feel what we program them to. Occasionally their programming miscalculates, they get confused and wander off.
translation: 人造人思维感知的东西都是我们安排给他们的。有时计算失误，他们就会失控。

original: Cut to the chase, Zimmer. What's the job?
translation: 开门见山吧，齐默。想要我干什么？

original: Hmmm... how do I put this in a way you'll understand?
translation: 唔……要我怎么解释，你才能明白？

original: All you know of robots are those buckets of bolts -- those Mr. Handshakers and whatnot. Well... that's not ALL a robot can be.
translation: 你所知道的关于机器人的东西都过时了 — 那些“巧手”先生和类似的。嗯，那不是所有机器人都能做到的！

original: You see, in the Commonwealth, we've made artificial persons. Synthetic humanoids! Programmed to think and feel and do whatever we need.
translation: 你看，在联邦，我们制造人造人。人造人！给他们编入我们需要的思维感知行动能力。

original: And... occasionally they get confused and wander off.
translation: 而且……有时他们会失控。

original: Missing property? What kind of property?
translation: 财产丢失了？什么重要的财产？

original: Looks like you could use a weapon.
translation: 看起来你会使用武器。

original: I'll take whatever you've got at this point.
translation: 你给我什么都行。

original: Hell, yeah! Lay it on me.
translation: 该死的，好吧！给我。

original: Oh wow, cool. What've you got for me? Minigun? Flamer? Maybe a missile launcher?
translation: 哇，酷。你要给我什么？多管机枪？火焰喷射器？或许是个火箭发射器？

original: You're going to need a weapon if you want to live to see Big Town.
translation: 如果你想活着见到大镇，就需要件武器。

original: You think I asked those Super Mutants to wait until I got all my caps together before abducting me?
translation: 你觉得我可以要求那些超级变种人让我拿到我所有钱后再抓我吗？

original: Don't get me wrong. I'm terribly grateful. I'll gladly give you a reward.  But let's get out of here first.
translation: 不要误会我，我真的很感激你。我很乐意给你报酬，但先让我们离开这儿。

original: "Thanks"? That's all I get for risking my life to save you? How about some caps?
translation: “谢谢”？我冒着生命危险救你就得到这么句话？给点瓶盖怎么样？

original: That's right, his birthday was recently. I can't wait to talk with him!
translation: 没错，他不久就要过生日了。我等不及想和他聊聊！

original: I'm glad you're safe. There's a guy name Sticky that wants to see you.
translation: 我很高兴你还活着。有一个叫斯蒂奇的家伙想见你。

original: That's right, his birthday was recently. Did he make it to Big Town already? I can't wait to see him!
translation: 没错，他不久就要过生日了。他已经到大镇了？我等不及想见到他！

original: I'm glad you're safe. There's a guy named Sticky that wants to see you.
translation: 我很高兴你还活着。有一个叫斯蒂奇的家伙想见你。

original: Don't I know it! Now the trick is getting out of here.
translation: 难道我不知道吗！现在这把戏在这已经不好用了。

original: You're lucky I happened along.
translation: 和我一起你很幸运。
