original: I have a few questions about the Citadel.
translation: 我有几个关于五角大本营的问题。

original: What do you need to find?
translation: 你想知道些什么？

original: I can help with that. What do you need?
translation: 我可以帮忙。你想知道些什么？

original: Escape the Vault? How?
translation: 从避难所逃出去？怎么逃？

original: Listen. There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。

original: Come on, your dad did it. And he didn't even have my help.
translation: 来吧，你父亲以前干过这事。他根本就无需我的帮助。

original: It won't be easy, though. My father sealed the door to the exit to prevent anyone else from following your dad.
translation: 这并不容易。但我父亲封锁了出口以防其他人也效仿你父亲。

original: I need to escape the Vault. And you're going to help me.
translation: 我需要逃出避难所。并且我需要你的帮助。

original: That's exactly what I had in mind.
translation: 我就是这么想的。

original: Listen. There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。

original: That's exactly what I had in mind.
translation: 我就是这么想的。

original: It won't be easy, though. My father sealed the door to the exit to prevent anyone else from following your dad.
translation: 这并不容易。但我父亲封锁了出口以防其他人也效仿你父亲。

original: Even if that's all true... how did you get here first?
translation: 如果这都是事实……你为什么到这来？

original: Oh, so you don't trust me now? Thanks a lot. You think it was easy for me to get here? With the Radroaches and security all over the place?
translation: 哦，你不再相信我了？太感谢了。你以为我跑到这是一件很容易的事吗？尤其路上还有那些变异蟑螂和警卫？

original: You're the Overseer's daughter! Can't you fix this?
translation: 你是监督者的女儿！你就不能做些什么吗？

original: Not this time. My father... he's not listening to anybody. If he even finds out that I've been helping you...
translation: 这次不行。我父亲……他谁的话也不想听。如果他发现我在帮助你的话……

original: But that doesn't matter. I can take care of myself. It's you he's looking for.
translation: 但是这无所谓，我可以照顾好自己。他在找的人是你。

original: And I have a plan. I know how to get you out of the Vault. Well, I think it will work.
translation: 我有个计划，我知道一个办法可以帮助你从避难所逃脱。嗯，我认为这计划可行。

original: Fine. Escape first, payback later.
translation: 好，我先出去，迟点报仇。

original: Good. You're finally talking sense.
translation: 好。你说得有理。

original: My God, this is all so crazy. I can't believe your dad didn't tell you he was leaving.
translation: 我的天啊，这太疯狂了。我真不敢相信你父亲离开了这，却什么都没告诉你。

original: I've heard enough. I'm going to make them pay.
translation: 我听够了，我要他们血债血偿。

original: Don't be an idiot! What are you going to do, fight the whole security force by yourself?
translation: 别犯傻了！你打算怎么干，你一个人跟整队警卫战斗？

original: No, I've thought about it. There's only one way. You have to follow your dad. You have to leave the Vault.
translation: 不，我已经想过这办法了。我有个办法。你必须跟随你父亲。你必须离开避难所。

original: You're right. I can't stay here. But where can I go?
translation: 你是对的。我不能留在这了。但是我能去哪呢？

original: I'm sorry, but I think you'll have to follow your dad. You'll have to escape from the Vault.
translation: 很抱歉，但是我认为你应该跟随你父亲。你必须从避难所里逃出去。

original: Listen... maybe it isn't any of my business, but didn't your dad tell you that he was leaving?
translation: 听着……这些事或许我不该插手，但是你父亲没说过他要去什么地方吗？

original: If you want me to find Ian, I'll need to equip myself. That costs money.
translation: 如果你想让我找到伊恩，那我就要武装一下自己。那是要花钱的。

original: Fine. Fine. Here, this is all I have left to feed myself, you selfish asshole!
translation: 好吧，好吧。给，这是我的全部，用来养活我自己的，都拿去吧，你这该死的混蛋！

original: I don't care anymore. I just want to know where my brother is.
translation: 我已经不在乎了，我只想知道我弟弟在哪。

original: That's all I have in the world I told you!
translation: 我告诉过你那是我拥有的全部了！

original: Sorry. I agreed to go to Arefu. That's it.
translation: 很抱歉。我只答应去断桥镇。仅此而已。

original: Fine. Be an asshole. I don't care.
translation: 好吧。你想要当个混蛋，我才不在乎呢。

original: If you find Ian, and you have a change of heart, come back here and tell me. If not, fine! Screw you!
translation: 如果你找到伊恩，并且你改变主意的话，那就回来告诉我。如果没改变主意，很好！就他妈的给我滚！

original: All right, Lucy. Calm down. I'll find Ian.
translation: 好吧，露西。冷静一下。我会找到伊恩的。

original: I'm sorry. You don't even know me, and you've already helped this much.
translation: 我很抱歉。你不了解我，并且你已经帮了我很多忙了。

original: I'm not stupid, I know he's probably dead. I just need to know for sure.
translation: 我并不蠢，我知道他很可能已经死了。我只是想确定这一点而已。

original: There's no sign of him, but I'm sure he's alive.
translation: 没有他的踪迹，但我相信他还活着。

original: You must find him! Please! He's all I have left in this world now.
translation: 你必须找到他！求求你了！他是我这世界上唯一的亲人了。

original: I just gotta know if he's alive or dead. It can't just end this way!
translation: 我想知道他是死是活，我不能就这样不明不白的放弃！

original: Ha! That's it? No problem.
translation: 哈！就这个？没问题。

original: Excellent. I so enjoy that "can-do" spirit.
translation: 太好了，我很欣赏你那种“我能做到”的精神。

original: No, I won't do that to them.
translation: 不，我不会对他们这样做的。

original: Then I'm afraid we have nothing more to say to one another.
translation: 那样的话，我们之间就没什么可谈的了。

original: Fine, but it's only because I want more answers from you.
translation: 好吧，但这仅仅是因为我想从你这得到更多的答案。

original: Rationalize it any way you'd like. If you succeed, we'll continue our discussion.
translation: 你无论如何都要把这事“合理化”，如果你成功了，我们就继续谈。

original: Hey, maybe you should mind your own business.
translation: 嗨，或许你应该管好你自己的事。

original: Why, I never!
translation: 噢，绝不！

original: You're the one who asked ME about it, you little brat!
translation: 是你先提的，你这小捣蛋鬼！

original: Hey, thanks for the tip.
translation: 嗨，谢谢你的建议。

original: Tip? Oh, I wouldn't call it that. Just something I heard, is all.
translation: 建议？噢，我不会这样称呼它的。只不过是一些我听过的事而已，没什么。

original: So they've had some problems in the past?
translation: 这么说来他们过去有些矛盾？

original: Well sure, sweetie. Doesn't everyone?
translation: 嗯，当然，甜心，每个人不都是这样吗？

original: Of course, not everyone decides to fight about it in front of an open window, so the whole neighborhood can hear...
translation: 当然，不是每个人都愿意在窗户前打架，好让每个邻居都听见，你明白吗……

original: Martha Simpson must've been mortified, hearing Janet call her all those names. She's never said one word about it, though.
translation: 在听到珍妮特对她的那些称呼后，玛莎·辛普森肯定很苦恼。尽管玛莎·辛普森什么也没说。

original: What do you mean, "worked everything out"?
translation: 解释一下“把所有的事都解决”？

original: Oh, I... Well, I'm not one to talk, but there was that fight last year. Everyone could hear them arguing.
translation: 噢，我……嗯，实际上这不是我应该说的，去年这发生了一场争斗。几乎所有的人都听说了。

original: Janet thought there was something going on with Roger and Martha Simpson. He eventually convinced her it wasn't true.
translation: 珍妮特原以为罗杰和玛莎·辛普森之间发生了些什么。他最终说服她这些都不是真的。

original: But I've seen the way Martha looks at him. Janet may believe him, but I sure don't.
translation: 但是我从来都没看过玛莎以那种眼神看他。珍妮特或许相信他，但是我肯定不会。

original: Betty wants me to break up your marriage.
translation: 贝蒂想让我破坏你们的婚姻。

original: What? Now that's a ridiculous thing to say. You kids need to find some different games to play!
translation: 什么？真荒唐。你的孩子或许应该找点别的游戏自娱自乐！

original: Now that's not funny. Not one bit.
translation: 这并不好笑，一点也不。

original: Oh, come on. You know something, don't you? What's the story?
translation: 哦，拜托。你知道些什么，对吧？到底怎么回事？

original: There's no story. Never was. Roger and I... Nothing ever happened.
translation: 没什么内幕。一直也没有。罗杰和我……什么都没发生过。

original: I wanted... Oh, I don't know. I thought there was something between us. No, that's not true. I know there was.
translation: 我想要……噢，我不知道。我原以为我们之间本来有点什么的。不，那不是真的。我知道本来是有的。

original: But Roger pushed me away. Tried to deny it. Even Janet knew it was there. She fought with him over it.
translation: 但是罗杰把我推开了。即使珍妮特知道这件事，还尝试否认这一点。他们俩为了这事而大打出手。

original: I think she still suspects something. I try to stay away from Roger, just to avoid giving her a reason to hate me more.
translation: 我认为她还在怀疑些什么。我尝试远离罗杰，这样就可以不给她更加恨我的理由了。

original: Okay, if you say so.
translation: 好吧，如果你这么说的话。

original: People around here should mind their own business.
translation: 这里的人应该少管闲事。

original: Spill it, Amata. How do I get to the exit?
translation: 快告诉我，阿玛塔。我怎么才能到达出口？

original: Lucky for you, I know another way through. There's a secret tunnel that runs from the Overseer's Office to the Vault door!
translation: 你很幸运，我知道另外一条路。那有一个秘密的地道连接监督者的办公室和避难所大门！

original: Security doesn't even know about it. Nobody except my father -- and me.  "One of the Overseer's secrets," he says.
translation: 警卫根本不知道那条秘密通道，除了我和我父亲没人知道了。“这是监督者的秘密之一,”他说。

original: Wait... If the door to the exit is sealed, how am I supposed to get out?
translation: 等等……如果去大门的路已经封住，我怎么出去啊？

original: Lucky for you, I know of another way in.
translation: 你很幸运，我知道另外一条路。

original: There's a secret tunnel that runs from the Overseer's Office to the Vault door!
translation: 那有一个秘密的地道连接监督者的办公室和避难所大门！

original: Security doesn't even know about it. Nobody except my father -- and me.  "One of the Overseer's secrets," he says.
translation: 警卫根本不知道那条秘密通道，除了我和我父亲没人知道了。“这是监督者的秘密之一,”他说。

original: Nothing. I just wanted to see if you were still waiting for me to come back.
translation: 没什么。我只想知道你是不是还在这等我回来。

original: I don't even know why I bother with you.
translation: 我都不明白为什么要为你担心。

original: I may have been a little hasty earlier. I'm ready to hear your plan.
translation: 我刚才可能有点着急，我想听听你的计划。

original: Not exactly an apology, but probably the best I can expect.
translation: 你这也叫道歉，但是总比没有强。

original: You'd better listen, because you'll never escape without my help.
translation: 你最好听着，因为没我的帮助你永远也逃不出去。

original: There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。

original: Not exactly an apology, but probably the best I can expect.
translation: 你这也叫道歉，但是总比没有强。

original: You'd better listen, because you'll never escape without my help.
translation: 你最好听着，因为没我的帮助你永远也逃不出去。

original: It won't be easy. My father sealed the door to the exit to prevent anyone else from following your dad.
translation: 这不容易。我父亲把大门关闭了，以阻止其他人效仿你父亲。

original: I was wrong. I'm sorry. I do need your help.
translation: 是我错了，我很抱歉，但是我需要你的帮助。

original: Was that an actual apology? From you? Wow. You must really be desperate.
translation: 那就是你的道歉？你说出来的？哇哦。你肯定是真的被逼急了。

original: You're right though. You do need my help. You'll never get out of here on your own. You're lucky I'm such a good friend.
translation: 你是对的。你确实需要我的帮助。你自己一个人根本逃不出去。你很幸运，有我这么个好朋友。

original: There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这进到我父亲的办公室。就像我经常干的。

original: Was that an actual apology? From you? Wow. You must really be desperate.
translation: 那就是你的道歉？你说出来的？哇哦。你肯定是真的被逼急了。

original: You're right though. You do need my help. You'll never get out of here on your own. You're lucky I'm such a good friend.
translation: 你是对的。你确实需要我的帮助。你自己一个人根本逃不出去。你很幸运，有我这么个好朋友。

original: It won't be easy. My father sealed the door to the exit to prevent anyone else from following your dad.
translation: 这不容易。我父亲把大门关闭了，以阻止其他人效仿你父亲。

original: Lights out? Radroaches? Maybe you'd better tell me more about what's going on.
translation: 信号灯？辐射蟑螂？？或许你应该告诉我到底是怎么回事。

original: Your sense of self-preservation never fails to rise to the surface.
translation: 你的自卫本能天性从不会失败。

original: Lucky for you, I have a plan. I can help you follow your dad and escape from the Vault!
translation: 你很幸运，我有一个计划。我可以帮助你从避难所逃出去，这样你就可以追随你父亲了！

original: Whatever. In any case, I don't need any more of your "help."
translation: 无所谓，不管怎样，我都不会再接受你这什么“帮助”了。

original: Fine! You're on your own, then. I'll wait here and see how long until you come crawling back, begging for my help.
translation: 好吧！你想怎样就怎样把。我会在这等你，看看过多久你爬回来求我帮忙。

original: Sorry, Amata. I do trust you. It's just a lot to take in.
translation: 对不起，阿玛塔。我当然相信你，只是一下子这么多事情...

original: I understand. It must be rough, waking up suddenly to find your dad gone and everything turned upside down.
translation: 我理解。这很难缓过神，一觉醒来的时候突然发现你父亲走了，并且周围也是一片混乱。

original: Listen... it may not be any of my business, but didn't your dad tell you anything about his plans?
translation: 听着……这或许不关我的事，不过你父亲从来就没有提起过他的计划吗？

original: Dad didn't need your help, and neither do I.
translation: 父亲不需要你的帮助，我也不需要。

original: Fine. I can't stop you. You don't deserve it, but I'll wait here so when you change your mind you'll know where to find me.
translation: 好吧，我也不会阻止你。你也不值得我帮忙，但是我会在这等你改变主意，你也知道在什么地方可以找到我。

original: Well, when you put it that way... maybe I could use your help.
translation: 嗯，如果你这么说的话……或许我可以接受你的帮助。

original: Good. Now will you shut up and listen to me for a second?
translation: 很好。你现在是否可以闭上嘴，安静地听我说话了？

original: There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这个密码进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。

original: You're such a jerk. Maybe I don't want to help you anymore.
translation: 你真是个蠢货。或许我永远都不该再帮助你。

original: No, don't worry. If I got sore that easily we couldn't have stayed friends all these years. You being such a jerk and all.
translation: 不，别担心。如果这些小事我都往心里去的话我们就不会做了这么多年的朋友了。你从小就是蠢货。

original: Listen. My father sealed the door to the exit to prevent anyone else from escaping.
translation: 听着，我父亲把大门关闭了，以阻止更多的人从大门逃出去。

original: I don't need help from anyone. Especially not from the Overseer's daughter.
translation: 我不需要任何人的帮助。尤其是监督者女儿的帮助。

original: Fine. Be that way. Good luck with the whole Vault in lockdown, Radroaches everywhere, and security guarding every door.
translation: 好吧。你爱怎么样就怎么样吧。整个避难所都戒严了，你就看着办吧，辐射蟑螂到处都是，并且警卫守着各处的门。

original: I'm sure you'll have no trouble escaping on your own.
translation: 我确信你可以一个人逃出去的。

original: Not another one of your "plans," Amata...
translation: 我不需要你的什么所谓的“计划”，阿玛塔……

original: I don't have time to explain everything. You're just going to have to trust me this time.
translation: 我没时间跟你解释了，这次你必须要相信我。

original: Listen. There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。就像我经常干的。

original: No! I mean I do have a plan, and it'll work better than that time we tried to steal Mr. Brotch's...
translation: 不！我的意思是我有个计划，并且要比我们上次去偷布洛彻先生的计划……

original: Come on, be serious. This will work. It has to.
translation: 快点，这次认真点。这方法应该可以，肯定可以。

original: Listen. My father sealed the door to the exit to prevent anyone else from escaping.
translation: 听着，我父亲把大门关闭了，以阻止更多的人从大门逃出去。

original: You're right. It's none of your business.
translation: 你是对的，这和你没什么关系。

original: I'm sorry I asked. And I'm not just saying that -- I shouldn't have pried.
translation: 我很抱歉我这么问。我并不是要这么说，而且我也不是想要打听什么。

original: But it doesn't matter. I can help you escape. I have my own plan!
translation: 但是无所谓了。我可以帮助你逃跑，我有我的计划！

original: Of course he did! My dad tells me everything. <Lie.>
translation: 当然！我父亲把一切都告诉我了。<撒谎>

original: Uh, okay. Sure.
translation: 噢，好吧。肯定。

original: But it doesn't matter. I can help you escape. I have my own plan!
translation: 但是无所谓了。我可以帮助你逃跑，我有我的计划！

original: No, I had no idea he was planning to leave.
translation: 不，我不知道他想离开这。

original: Oh. I'm sorry. I'm sure he had his reasons. Maybe Jonas was supposed to explain everything to you?
translation: 噢，我很抱歉，但是我确定他有他的原因。或许乔纳斯本打算要向你解释一切？

original: But it doesn't matter. I can help you escape. I have my own plan!
translation: 但是无所谓了。我可以帮助你逃跑，我有我的计划！

original: I just have to break into the most heavily guarded place in the Vault? That it?
translation: 我必须要突破避难所里防守最为严密的地方？就这样？

original: If you have a better plan, let's hear it! Look, I know for a fact that the office isn't guarded -- everyone's out looking for you.
translation: 如果你有更好的办法，我洗耳恭听！你看，我知道办公室肯定没人，因为所有守卫都出去找你了。

original: Here, you'll probably need these to pick the lock on the office door. They've always worked for me.
translation: 给，你很有可能需要他来撬开办公室的门锁。以前我都是这么干的。

original: Access his computer to open the door to the tunnel -- you'll either have to hack it or find his password. I know he hides it in his office somewhere.
translation: 用他的电脑打开通往地道的门 — 你要么破解电脑，要么找到密码。密码肯定藏在办公室的某个地方。

original: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

original: So while I'm doing all this breaking and entering, you're helping me... how?
translation: 那么在我撬门闯入办公室时，你……怎么帮我？

original: I'll be keeping my father from catching you hacking into his computer.
translation: 我会拖住我的父亲，这样你就可以有足够的时间入侵电脑了。

original: Here, you'll probably need these to pick the lock on the office door. They've always worked for me.
translation: 给，你很有可能需要他来撬开办公室的门锁。以前我都是这么干的。

original: Access his computer to open the door to the tunnel -- you'll either have to hack it or find his password. I know he hides it in his office somewhere.
translation: 用他的电脑打开通往地道的门 — 你要么破解电脑，要么找到密码。密码肯定藏在办公室的某个地方。

original: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

original: Secret tunnel... sounds promising. But how do I get into the Overseer's office?
translation: 秘密通道……估计有希望。但是我怎么进入监督者的办公室呢？

original: Same way I do -- use these. Once you're in, use his computer to open the door to the tunnel.
translation: 就像我经常做的那样 — 拿着它。一旦你进入办公室，就使用电脑打开秘密通道。

original: I don't have a password to his computer, so you'll have to hack it. But that shouldn't give you any trouble.
translation: 我不知道电脑的密码，你必须自己破解。但是我估计那对你来说不是什么问题。

original: I'll find my father and make sure he doesn't go back to his office. But you'd better hurry.
translation: 我立刻回到我父亲那然后拖住他，这样你就可以有充足的时间使用电脑了。但是你必须抓紧了。

original: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

original: Same way I do -- use these. Once you're in, use his computer to open the door to the tunnel.
translation: 就像我经常做的那样 — 拿着它。一旦你进入办公室，就使用电脑打开秘密通道。

original: I don't have a password to his computer, so you'll either have to hack it or find the password somewhere in his desk.
translation: 我不知道电脑的密码，你要么破解电脑，要么找到密码，密码肯定在办工桌里。

original: I'll find my father and make sure he doesn't go back to his office. But you'd better hurry.
translation: 我立刻回到我父亲那然后拖住他，这样你就可以有充足的时间使用电脑了。但是你必须抓紧了。

original: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

original: Sure am. Stopped in to find something to do.
translation: 当然，顺便找事做。

original: I hope by "something to do" you mean a job, otherwise you want to talk with Nova.
translation: 我希望你所谓的“找事做”是指工作，否则你还是去找诺瓦吧。

original: I'm looking for someone to make a delivery. Interested?
translation: 我正好需要找个人帮我捎个东西，感兴趣吗？

original: No. I said I wouldn't do it, and I meant it.
translation: 不，我说我不干，我就肯定不干，我是认真的。

original: Well then, we have little else to say to one another.
translation: 好吧，那我们就没什么可谈的了。

original: Fine, I'll do it.
translation: 好吧，我做就是了。

original: I'm glad you've chosen to be cooperative.
translation: 我很高兴你最终选择了合作。

original: I don't really have a choice, do I?
translation: 我根本就没什么选择，不是吗？

original: There's always a choice. Sometimes it's just easier to make.
translation: 事情总有选择，只不过有时候早做选择要好一些。

original: We hope you've enjoyed our tour today. If you have any further questions, please take a brochure from our helpful Vault-Tec guides.
translation: 我们希望你对今天的参观感到愉快。如果你还有什么其他问题，请向避难所科技向导索取指南手册

original: Should the unlikely event arise that the planet is laid to waste, you'll feel happy knowing your family will be safe in a Vault-Tec Vault.
translation: 如果有什么不幸的事使这星球变成废墟，你将会感到很高兴避难所科技的避难所将会庇护你和你的家人。

original: Concerns about security? Our Eye-On-You Cameras enable the Vault's leader to watch your every move. You'll never be alone again!
translation: 担心安全问题？避难所的领导会通过监视牌摄影机注视你的一举一动，你将永不孤单。

original: Bored? Don't be! Step into our Entertainotron Room and watch the latest holotapes or perhaps listen to a symphony. Another Vault-Tec innovation!
translation: 无聊？不会的！去我们的娱乐室看最新的全息录影带，也可以听听交响乐。另一项避难所科技的革新！

original: Moms will love how our Culinator 3000 Kitchen System makes cooking a breeze. Mmmmm, I can smell the muffins baking now!
translation: 母亲们肯定会爱上这烹调3000厨房系统，它可以让做饭变得十分简单。嗯……，我都已经可以闻到烤甜饼的香味了！

original: The living sections make use of our revolutionary Floorsuck Autocleaner System for those darned messy kids. Never sweep again!
translation: 我们的生活区将使用革命性的楼层自动清洁系统，这系统是为那些可恨肮脏的孩子们而设计的。从此再不用打扫卫生了！

original: Being underground got you down? Smile! Our SimuSun Lighting mimics the feeling of being outside with only a fraction of the sunburn potential.
translation: 在地下待着感觉很糟？呵呵！我们的微阳灯让你仅有少量晒伤的情况下拥有在户外的感觉。

original: Sleep in quiet comfort knowing that our impenetrable vault doors can withstand a direct hit by an atomic bomb with only a projected 2% failure rate.
translation: 安心的睡吧，我们的避难所大门可以承受住核弹的直接冲击，而且失败率只有2%。

original: Triple-S Technology is Vault-Tec's convergence of the three most important parts of apocalyptic endurance: Safety, Survivability and Sanitation!
translation: 三重科技是避难所科技三项最重要的科技的集中体现，这三项科技是：安全性，生存性和卫生性！

original: Vault-Tec welcomes you to our new line of subterranean vaults featuring our patented Triple-S Technology.
translation: 避难所科技欢迎你到地下来体验我们的三重科技。

original: So, what's your real name?
translation: 你的真名是什么？

original: ... what's the pool up to now, anyway?
translation: ……现在赌金已经升到多少了？

original: Nice try, though.
translation: 想得美。

original: Haven't we been through this already?
translation: 我们之间的问题难道还没解决吗？

original: What do you think of Knight Captain Gallows?
translation: 你认为骑士队长盖洛斯怎么样？

original: I heard that you found out about his real name. Interesting. I wouldn't expect that he'd just tell an outsider something like that.
translation: 我听说你知道他的真名了。这很有趣。我根本就没想到他能跟一个外人谈论这样的事。

original: But he's a good soldier, there's no doubt. I did hear that they have a betting pool about his real name, though.
translation: 无疑，他是一个好战士。不过，我曾经听说他们关于他的真名还打了个赌。

original: He's a good man. The other members of the Pride don't seem to trust him. He's quiet, he doesn't horse around with them, and he keeps to himself.
translation: 他是一个好人。“里昂斯的骄傲”的其他成员看上去根本不信任他。他不怎么爱说话，他不爱跟其他人混在一起，总是一个人待着。

original: But he's a good soldier, there's no doubt. I did hear that they have a betting pool about his real name, though.
translation: 无疑，他是一个好战士。我曾经听说他们关于他的真名还打了个赌。

original: What do you think about Gallows?
translation: 你认为骑士队长盖洛斯怎么样？

original: I don't trust him. I know, I know, I should take faith in my brother, but he disappears for days out into the Wastes.
translation: 我不信任他。我知道，我知道，我应该相信我的兄弟，但是他经常失踪，一个人去了废土。

original: He comes back without a word. He only reports to Sentinel Lyons, and doesn't tell the rest of us what he's up to. I can't trust a soldier like that.
translation: 他回来后也一言不发。他只向莎拉·里昂斯报告，也不告诉我们他要去那，我不相信那样的人。

original: The other guys, they think it's a joke. Glade's even got a betting pool going to find out Gallows' real name. A betting pool. Honestly...
translation: 另外一个家伙，他们把他当笑话看。格莱德甚至打赌来找出盖洛斯的真名。一个赌约。坦白说……

original: No one knows his name?
translation: 没人知道他叫什么吗？

original: Nope. No one knows his name, where he comes from -- nothin'. He's a mean little bastard for sure.
translation: 没有。他叫什么，从哪来，没人知道。但我肯定他是个混蛋。

original: He'd be a Paladin by now for sure, except that he ain't got no interest in leadin'. Only killin'. I'm just glad he's on our side.
translation: 以表现而论他已经能成为圣骑士了，只不过他只喜欢杀戮，对带队不感兴趣。我很高兴他和我们是一路的。

original: What's the pool up to?
translation: 赌约的金额是什么？

original: It's gotta be, what? 2000 caps now? Boy's a mystery, no doubt about it.
translation: 现在是多少了，什么？2000个瓶盖了？毫无疑问，他很神秘。

original: If you can figure out his real name, the money's all yours.
translation: 如果你要是知道他的真名，那钱就是你的了。

original: What's the story with Gallows?
translation: 知道盖洛斯的事吗？

original: Really? You're kidding me. What is it?
translation: 真的？你和我开玩笑吧。是什么？

original: I know Gallows' real name.
translation: 我知道盖洛斯的真名。

original: You figure out his name yet? Haha! Yeah, I thought not.
translation: 你知道他的名字了？哈哈！嗯，我还以为你不知道呢。

original: I want to talk about Gallows.
translation: 我想谈谈盖洛斯的事。

original: Oh man, there's something wrong with that boy. Ain't nobody around here that even knows his real name.
translation: 哦，老兄，那家伙肯定有病。这的人没人知道他到底叫什么。

original: We got a betting pool in the pride, whole pot goes to the first person who can find out his real name.
translation: “里昂斯的骄傲”有一个赌约，谁先知道他的真名谁就可以拿走所有的钱。

original: What's with that Gallows guy?
translation: 知道盖洛斯的事吗？

original: Heard you took the pot. Good work. Of course, I'm not going to ask how you found out what his name was...
translation: 听说你赢了赌局。好样的。当然，我是不会问你是怎么知道他名字的……

original: Gallows? He's not a bad guy, truth be told. He just doesn't talk much, and if it ain't soldierin', that boy has no time for it.
translation: 盖洛斯？他人还不错，我肯定。他就是不怎么爱说话，如果他不是个士兵的话，那小子怕是压根没时间说话。

original: Tell you what, though -- he's the meanest son of a bitch around here. All business. The rest of us, we get our R and R in. Not Gallows.
translation: 告诉你，尽管 — 他是我们这最小气的混蛋。一切都公事公办，我们这些人喜欢放松、娱乐下。但不找盖洛斯。

original: There's even a betting pool on who can find out his real name. Talk to Glade about it. He'll tell you.
translation: 我们甚至打了赌，看谁能先知道盖洛斯的真名。你去问格莱德，他会告诉你的。

original: The hell with working this out. I'm sick of you. I'm staying at Mabel's tonight. Don't talk to me. Don't even look at me.
translation: 把这件该死的破事解决掉。我受够你了。我今晚就在梅布尔这了。别跟我说话，别盯着我看。

original: I have no idea what you're talking about Janet. Just calm down, and let's work this out.
translation: 我不知道你在说些什么，珍妮特。冷静一下，让我们把这件事解决。

original: You left her underwear on your goddamn desk, Roger. How stupid do you think I am?
translation: 该死的，你把她的内衣放在桌子上，罗杰。你把我当成蠢货了？

original: Janet, what are you talking about?
translation: 珍妮特，你在说些什么啊？

original: You just couldn't stay away from her, could you? And what, you didn't think I'd find out? You disgust me!
translation: 你就不能离她远点，对吧？你以为我就不知道了，是吗，你真让我感到恶心！

original: What? What did I do?
translation: 什么？我做错什么了？

original: Roger, you son of a bitch!
translation: 罗杰，你这混蛋！

original: Who else is around town?
translation: 这镇里还有谁？

original: I don't talk to most of them. Billy says that I have to be careful, even when people seem nice. And I'm especially not allowed to talk to Mr. Jericho.
translation: 我跟他们绝大部分人都不怎么说话。比利告诉我说要小心点，即使那些人看上去是好人。并且别人跟我说绝对不要和耶利哥先生说话。

original: I usually play with Harden most days, when his dad isn't taking him out to learn to shoot or something.
translation: 我一般跟哈登在一起玩，通常他爸爸总是让他学习射击什么的。

original: Billy says that he's going to teach me to shoot one day too!
translation: 比利告诉我，他也会找个时间教我怎么射击！

original: There's the Stahls. They run the Brass Lantern. I go there to eat with my dad sometimes. Doc Church runs the clinic.
translation: 有斯塔尔一家。他们经营黄铜灯。我有时候和我爸爸在那吃饭。丘奇医生经营一家诊所。

original: The Confessor is a little weird. But him and mother Maya are always nice to me.
translation: 忏悔者那人有点怪。但是他和玛雅修女总是对我很好。

original: There's also Moriarty, but dad says that I'm not allowed to talk to him.
translation: 这还一个叫莫里亚蒂的人，但是爸爸不让我跟他讲话。

original: Do you know any good secrets?
translation: 你知道这有什么秘密吗？

original: Well... Billy built a safe into the floor of our house. He keeps all sorts of cool stuff in there.
translation: 嗯……比利在我们的房子下面藏了个保险箱。他总是把那些很酷的东西放在里面。

original: I shouldn't tell you this but... the combination is 15-16-23-42 if you want to take a look.
translation: 我本不应该告诉你的，但是……如果你想看看里面有什么的话，密码是15-16-23-42。

original: Just make sure that you put everything back if you take anything out to play with it. I don't want to get in trouble.
translation: 你要是把东西拿出来玩的话没什么，但是要记得把东西放回原处噢。我可不想惹什么麻烦。

original: What do you think of Megaton?
translation: 你觉得兆吨镇怎么样？

original: I dunno... I used to like it, but ever since dad... I dunno...
translation: 我不知道该怎么说……我以前挺喜欢这的，但是自从爸爸……我不知道……

original: It's great! My dad says that one day, I'm gonna get to be sheriff, just like him!
translation: 这儿棒极了！我爸爸说过，总有一天我也会成为这儿的警长，就像他那样！

original: It's okay, I guess. I used to live way far away when I was little... before Billy found me.
translation: 我觉得还行。我以前住在离这很远的地方……在比利发现我之前。

original: Who takes care of you?
translation: 谁照顾你？

original: Well, Billy used to. Before he... before he died. I don't know now. Maybe I'll see if Manya will help me...
translation: 嗯，比利以前照顾我，在他……在他死前。现在我不知道谁照顾我。或许曼雅会帮助我吧……

original: Billy does! Have you met Billy... Billy Creel? A long, long time ago, he saved me from Raiders!
translation: 比利照顾我！你见过比利吗…… 比利·克里？在很久很久以前，他把我从歹徒手中救了出来！

original: They... killed my real parents. But Billy showed up before they got me, and now he's like my daddy... sort of...
translation: 他们……杀了我的亲生父母。但是比利在他们杀我之前出现了。现在，他就像是我父亲一样……

original: My dad, of course. He teaches me to shoot, and about the law, and keeping people safe. When he's not busy protecting the town, that is.
translation: 当然是我父亲照顾我。他教我怎么射击，还教我法律，怎么保护他人。只要他不忙着保护镇子，总是在教我。

original: Well... with my dad gone, I don't really know... dad always said that I'd have to learn to watch out for myself one day...
translation: 嗯……在我父亲死以后，我真不知道谁能照顾我……爸爸以前总是对我说总有一天我要学会怎么照顾自己……

original: Talk to you later.
translation: 以后再谈。

original: Have a good one.
translation: 祝你过得愉快。

original: Catch you later.
translation: 稍后见。

original: Bye.
translation: 拜。

original: Peace be with you.
translation: 祝你平安。

original: Later.
translation: 回见。

original: Well, I guess I should stop gossiping and do something productive. Talk to you later.
translation: 嗯，我想我应该少说话多做事。再见。

original: If I hear anything else, I'll be sure and let you know. See ya.
translation: 我要是知道其它的事的话，我会告诉你的。再见。

original: Ahhh, life here in Megaton, huh? But anyway. I'll talk to you later.
translation: 啊，在兆吨镇里的生活，呃？但是不管怎样。迟点再跟你聊。

original: Sometimes, I really wonder about this place. But hey, I'll talk to you later.
translation: 有时候，我还真为这地方感到惊讶。但是，嗨，迟点再聊。

original: Listen, I'm gonna go grab some shuteye.
translation: 听着，我想去睡了。

original: I was just on my way to grab a bite though -- I'll catch you later.
translation: 我只不过是想去吃点东西，迟点见。

original: What are you going to do, huh? Anyway, I should get going. Take care.
translation: 你要去干嘛，呃？不管怎样，我要走了，再见。

original: You know me, I love to hear myself talk. Anyway, I need to take off.
translation: 你知道的，我喜欢自言自语。不管怎样，我得走了。

original: If I hear anything else, I'll be sure and let you know. See ya.
translation: 我要是知道其它的事的话，我会告诉你的。再见。

original: *Sigh* Anywaaayyy. I don't want to hold you up. Have a good one, all right?
translation: *叹气*啊呀！我不想阻止你，你爱怎么样就怎么样？

original: It's funny, though. At the end of the day, I still can't think of any other place I'd rather live. Well, I'll talk to you later.
translation: 有趣。天都黑了，我都不知道还有什么地方我可以去住的。嗯，迟点见。

original: Heh. It's all so sad, you have to laugh. Know what I'm saying? But hey, you have a good day, all right?
translation: 啊。这太糟了，你必须振作起来。你明白我的意思吗？但是，嗨，你今天过得还是不错的，对吧？

original: *Sigh* It's one thing after another in this place, isn't it? Anyway, I should get going.
translation: *叹气*在这地方事总是没完没了，对吧？不管怎样，我得走了。

original: I hear what you're saying.
translation: 我听见你在说什么了。

original: Seriously.
translation: 真的。

original: Yeah, I know.
translation: 对，我知道。

original: I wish you were joking.
translation: 我希望你刚才在开玩笑。

original: Nothing about this place surprises me anymore.
translation: 这里的任何事都不能再让我感到惊奇了。

original: It's all just more of the same in this town, right?
translation: 这镇子里总是发生着同样的事，对吧？

original: You know, I thought about moving once. Setting myself up in Rivet City or one of the smaller settlements. But hey, this place is home.
translation: 你知道，我一直想要搬家的。想去铆钉城或一些小型定居点。但是，嗨，这是我的家。

original: Ahhhhh... Megaton.
translation: 啊~~~……兆吨镇。

original: No kidding, huh?
translation: 不开玩笑，呃？

original: Hmmm.
translation: 嗯。

original: Right, right...
translation: 对，对……

original: Wow...
Jeez...
translation: 天啊……

original: Hm hmm.
translation: 唔嗯。

original: Have you heard what everyone's saying? There's not enough water to go around this month. We'll have to ration... again.
translation: 你难道没听过大家都在议论什么吗？这月的水不够了。我们不得不……再次……分配。

original: I don't like to spread rumors, but I heard Mister Burke is really interested in the bomb. Really interested. Like... he wants to buy it or something.
translation: 我不太喜欢散布传闻，但是我听说伯克先生对那核弹很感兴趣。非常感兴趣。就像是……想要把它买下来似的。

original: I heard the sheriff talking about defusing the bomb. I don't know. The damn thing's been sitting there so long it's probably harmless. Right?
translation: 我听说警长打算把那核弹拆掉。我不知道。那该死的东西都已经在那很久了，应该没什么危险了，对吧？

original: Stockholm says he saw some more Raiders, off to the east. Good thing for us there's nothing in Megaton worth raiding.
translation: 斯德哥尔摩说他看见了很多歹徒，就在东面。不过好在我们的兆吨镇对于那些家伙来说，没什么值得抢的。

original: You ever see a Yao Guai? Boy, those things are nasty.
translation: 你见过妖怪？天啊，那些家伙可是相当危险的。

original: Leo Stahl.. you know. He's a junkie, a total chem head. He sells the stuff, too. Late at night, in the processing plant.
translation: 利奥·斯塔尔……你知道。他是个瘾君子，没大脑的家伙。他也卖些东西。晚上的时候，在水处理厂那。

original: Sometimes that Deputy Steel makes me nervous. Simms and his boy, they treat him like a person. But it's just a machine, and machines can malfunction.
translation: 有时候斯蒂尔副警长搞得我很紧张。西姆斯和他的手下，把他当成人一样对待。但那不过是个机器，机器是会犯错误的啊。

original: Megaton needs a stronger defense force. Okay, there's Simms and Steel, and the town militia, but half of us can't even aim straight.
translation: 兆吨镇需要一个强力的防御力量。好吧，这有西姆斯和斯蒂尔，还有镇兵，可是半数人都不会瞄准。

original: It's probably not my place, but... I think the sheriff should find himself a new wife. He needs some companionship, and his boy needs a mother.
translation: 或许我说这话不太合适,但……我认为警长应该找个新妻子了。他需要个伴侣，他的孩子也需要个母亲。

original: Those guys from the church drink the water near the bomb because they WANT to. Believes it makes them "closer to Atom" or something. Idiots.
translation: 这些从教堂来的家伙们只喝核弹旁的水，就因为他们想要这么干。相信这样可以让他们更“接近原子”什么的。一群白痴。

original: You know, I'm getting a little sick of living in the slums. They promised me that after a few months I could move into the town.
translation: 你知道，我已经厌倦生活在贫民窟里了。他们答应我说，过几个月我就可以搬进镇子里。

original: I don't think that I'm ever going to be able to get a house here. I've asked Simms a dozen times and he keeps saying the same thing.
translation: 我想我永远都不能在这搞到一个房子。我以前问过西姆斯很多次了，但是他总是给我一个相同的答案。

original: Did you hear that sound last night? It sounded like... I don't know... some sort of motor, but it was coming from the sky!
translation: 你昨天晚上听见那声音了吗？听起来就像是……我不知道……有点像发动机的声音，但是这声音是从天上传过来的！

original: Have you ever talked to that Jericho guy? Man, what an asshole.
translation: 你跟耶利哥那家伙说过话吗？那家伙就是个混蛋。

original: Jenny Stahl seems okay but her brothers... whew. One's a workaholic, and the other one is just flat out crazy. What a family.
translation: 珍妮·斯塔尔看上去人还可以，可是她的哥哥们……哟。其中一个是工作狂，另外一个就简直是个疯子，这是怎么样的一家子啊。

original: Did you see Leo Stahl sneak up to the water processing plant last night? What does he do up there? And why does Walter let him in?
translation: 昨晚你看见利奥·斯塔尔鬼鬼祟祟的跑到水处理厂了没？他去那干嘛？另外，为什么沃尔特还让他进去了？

original: I heard that there are Raiders gathering to the west. Do you think they're planning an attack?
translation: 我听说歹徒在西面聚集。你猜他们是不是在计划一次进攻呢？

original: You asked where the parts came from to build the town? I heard that there used to be an air station somewhere around here before the war.
translation: 你问这些修建镇子的材料是从哪来的？我听说战前这附近曾经有个飞机场。

original: You should talk to the older folks about what Megaton was like before they built the walls. You think it's dangerous now?
translation: 你应该跟那些老家伙谈谈关于在修建这些墙以前兆吨镇是什么样子的。你认为现在这很危险吗？

original: I was rooting around in Springvale the other day and guess what I found: a book! An actual book! Can you believe it?
translation: 我有一次跑到春之谷，你猜我发现什么了：一本书！一本真正的书！你能相信吗？

original: Do you ever question the wisdom in hanging around an atomic bomb all day? I mean, if it was going to blow, it probably would have by now. But still.
translation: 你曾怀疑过这种整天围着一个核弹的行为吗？我的意思是，如果要炸的话早就炸了。

original: God, that Jericho guy gives me the creeps. He's such a nutjob.
translation: 天啊，那叫耶利哥的家伙让我觉得恶心。他就是一个白痴。

original: I swear to God, if Nathan starts babbling about the Enclave to me one more time... everyone knows that the Enclave is just a story for kids.
translation: 我向天发誓，如果内森再和我胡说一些关于英克雷的事的话……每个人都知道英克雷不过是个谣传而已。

original: Nathan and his damn Enclave, I tell you... What, does he think, that George Washington is going to ride out of the Wasteland to save everyone?
translation: 内森还有他那该死的英克雷，我跟你说……他在想些什么，乔治·华盛顿要拯救废土所有人？

original: You ever hear of the Enclave? Nathan tells me that they'll be riding in here any day to help us...
translation: 你听说过英克雷吗？内森说他们很可能会过来帮助我们……

original: Did you hear about the Enclave? Nathan said they're really the U.S. government. He says that they're coming to help us.
translation: 你听说过英克雷吗？内森说他们是真正的美国政府。他说他们要来这帮助我们。

original: Walter sure is a grumpy old bastard. But he keeps that crusty old plant running, so I guess we have no choice but to put up with him.
translation: 沃尔特确实是一个脾气暴躁的老混蛋。但是他是照看着那些老水管，所以我们不得不忍。

original: Busted up my knee the other day, so I went to see Doc Church. He needs to work on his bedside manner -- my own mother never chewed me out like that!
translation: 那天我把膝盖摔坏了，所以我就去找丘奇医生。他需要改善一下对待患者的态度 — 就连我的母亲都没有像他那样严厉的训斥我！

original: I swear to God, Moira's crazy. She sold me this thing the other day, I didn't even know what the hell it was. Damn good saleswoman though. Damn good.
translation: 我发誓，莫伊拉是个疯子。她有一天把这卖给我，我甚至都不知道那东西是什么。该死的女人。真该死。

original: What is with those Church of the Atom lunatics anyway? They're all fucked in the head... drinking the bomb water, praying for another war?
translation: 原子教堂是怎么回事？里面的人是不是都疯了……估计是喝核弹旁的水太多了，居然祈祷另一场战争？

original: Did you hear about Nathan? Yeah, he went and got himself killed. Manya is beside herself.
translation: 你听说过内森吗？嗯，他去那不久就被杀了。曼雅就在她旁边。

original: Nathan just hasn't been the same since Manya died. He refuses to leave the house!
translation: 内森在曼雅死后人就变了。他拒绝离开那房子！

original: Manya and Nathan are both gone... what's happening around here?
translation: 曼雅和内森都走了……这地方出了什么事？

original: Ever since Sheriff Simms died, this place hasn't been the same. There's a fight nearly every night up at Moriarty's!
translation: 自从西姆斯死了以后，这地方就变了。几乎每天晚上都回有人在莫里亚蒂那打架！

original: Have you been to the Brass Lantern lately? That place is like a funeral home since Jenny died.
translation: 你最近去过黄铜灯吗？那地方自从珍妮死后就变得像个殡仪馆一样。

original: The Stahl family is still mourning Leo. Nice kid, but I hear that he was mixed up in some bad shit.
translation: 斯塔尔一家仍为利奥的死而悲伤。他是个好孩子，但是我听说那孩子被卷入了一件很糟的事里。

original: Did you hear that the Stahls lost their older brother? He kept that place running, you know. It'll probably fall apart without him.
translation: 你听说斯塔尔的哥哥死了吗？他哥哥一直经营那。估计没有他哥哥在，那地方就要四分五裂了。

original: What do you suppose will happen to the Brass Lantern? With the whole family dead, someone's sure to buy it up.
translation: 你说黄铜灯以后会怎么样？全家都死了，有人会把那全买下来吧。

original: You know what I miss most? Jenny's noodles. And she was such a sweet girl.
translation: 你知道我最想念什么吗？珍妮做的面条，那真是个好女孩。

original: It's about time that someone gave that bastard Moriarty what he deserved, but I can't believe he left the bar to Gob!
translation: 莫里亚蒂得到了应得的下场，但我没想到他把那酒吧留给了盖博！

original: Jericho was an asshole, but he helped keep this place safe. I'm worried about what'll happen if the Raiders attack now...
translation: 耶利哥就是一个混蛋，但他一直保护自己所在的安全。我现在担心的是，如果歹徒一旦发起了攻击的话……

original: Did you hear about Lucy? Shame... she died before anyone ever got to know her.
translation: 你说过露西吗？可惜啊……在大家了解她之前就死了。

original: God damn, I can't believe that someone killed Moira. Some people will do anything to survive out here, won't they?
translation: 该死的，我真不敢相信有人杀了莫伊拉。有些人将会不惜一切代价在这生存，对吧？

original: With Walter dead, we're screwed. No one else can keep that treatment plant running.
translation: 沃尔特死后，我们就完蛋了。没人能继续经营这。

original: Sorry, not now.
translation: 不好意思，现在不行。

original: Can't talk now.
translation: 我现在很忙，不能说话。

original: We'll catch up later.
translation: 迟点见。

original: Is there anything interesting going on around here?
translation: 这有什么有趣的事吗？

original: A cap for your thoughts.
translation: 来一杯。

original: Anything been going on with you?
translation: 你最近怎么样？

original: You look like you have something on your mind.
translation: 你看上去好像在想事。

original: What are you thinking?
translation: 你在想什么？

original: So, what's up?
translation: 那，有什么事吗？

original: You get around, right? What have you heard?
translation: 你四处游历，对吧？你都听过些什么？

original: You know, there has to be something going on around here.
translation: 你知道，这毫无疑问有些事要发生。

original: Something on your mind?
translation: 有什么心事吗？

original: What's been going on?
translation: 你最近怎么样？

original: Hey. How's it going?
translation: 嗨，进展得怎么样？

original: Can't say that there's much going on.
translation: 算不上有什么大事。

original: Nada.
translation: 没什么。

original: Not much.
translation: 没什么。

original: Nothing. We'll talk later.
translation: 没什么，迟点再说。

original: Not bad... not bad...
translation: 不错……不错……

original: Been better.
translation: 还不错。

original: Can't complain.
translation: 没什么可抱怨的。

original: And a hello to you, lass.
translation: 你好啊，女孩。

original: And a hello to you, lad.
translation: 你好啊，小伙。

original: Yeah, yeah...
translation: 嗯，嗯……

original: Hello to you.
translation: 你好。

original: Hello, my child.
translation: 你好，我的孩子。

original: Mmmmhmmm... that's nice.
translation: 唔……那不错。

original: Go bother someone else, please. I'm busy.
translation: 请去烦别人。我正忙。

original: <grumbles>
translation: <抱怨>

original: Get the fuck out of my face.
translation: 从我面前滚开。

original: Yeah, whatever.
translation: 好，随便。

original: Fuck you.
translation: 操你妈的。

original: Howdy.
translation: 你好。

original: Howdy.
translation: 你好。

original: Hello, Mother Maya.
translation: 你好，玛雅修女。

original: Hello there, honey.
translation: 你好，亲爱的。

original: Hello, Confessor.
translation: 你好，忏悔者。

original: Hello, Mother Maya.
translation: 你好，玛雅修女。

original: Billy says I shouldn't be talking to you.
translation: 比利告诉我别和你说话。

original: Uhm... hi?
translation: 嗯……嘿？

original: Good evening.
translation: 晚上好。

original: Evening.
translation: 晚上好。

original: Good morning.
translation: 早上好。

original: Morning.
translation: 早上好。

original: Yeah, yeah.
translation: 嗯，嗯。

original: Not so close. Keep walkin'.
translation: 还不行，继续走。

original: Good to see you.
translation: 很高兴见到你。

original: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

original: Hey there.
translation: 嘿你好。

original: Hello.
translation: 你好。

original: Oh! Hi!
translation: 哦！嘿！

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Look, I told you people: I'm busy. Leave me alone.
translation: 听着，我跟你们说过：我正在忙，离我远点。

original: Look, I'm a little busy...
translation: 听着，我现在有点忙……

original: Irving! God! Can't a woman get a little time to herself!?
translation: 天啊！难道女人就不能享受一下自己的时间吗！？

original: I'm bored. Let's see if I can lighten things up around here.
translation: 我很无聊。我看看这周围有什么能让大家激动一下的不。

original: It's time to earn mamma some sugar.
translation: 是时候到妈妈这享受一下甜蜜时光了。

original: I do hope she gets here soon. I'm particularly randy this evening.
translation: 我真希望她早点过来。我今晚会非常特别。

original: It's play time. I wonder if we will play doctor and nurse again?
translation: 游戏时间。我在想，你还想不想再玩一次医生和护士的游戏了呢？

original: Another evening with Ms. Lancaster. That girl certainly knows how to have a good time!
translation: 又和兰卡斯特小姐过了一晚。那女孩知道怎么度过欢乐的时光！

original: SHE never yells at me. SHE appreciates me. Unlike some people.
translation: 她从来没冲着我大声喊过。她非常赞赏我。不像有些人。

original: I'm umm... I'm going to go stretch my legs for awhile. Take a little walk around the tower to loosen up my nerves a little.
translation: 唔，我……我想出去伸展下四肢。出去走走，放松一下紧张的神经。

original: I'm plum puckered out.
translation: 我都快困死了。

original: Time to get some beauty rest!
translation: 该去好好地睡上一觉了！

original: Well, there's another day done.
translation: 又一天结束了。

original: Early to bed, early to rise.
translation: 早睡，早起。

original: I'm exhausted. It's time for some shut-eye.
translation: 我累坏了。该睡了。

original: Off to dreamland I go. Ta-ta!
translation: 我去睡了，拜拜！

original: I'm tired. I'm going to bed.
translation: 我累了，我去睡了。

original: Whew! I'm sleepy. Time to hit the pillows!
translation: 哟！我困了。我去睡了！

original: I think I'll turn in for the night.
translation: 我想我应该去睡觉了。

original: Well. I better go pass out for a while.
translation: 嗯，我想我应该去睡一会。

original: It's time for bed. Goodnight.
translation: 睡觉时间到了，晚安。

original: <Yawn> I'm off to bed. Sweet dreams!
translation: <哈欠>我去睡了，祝你好梦！

original: I'm tired as hell.
translation: 我都累死了。

original: I'm positively famished. I must get something to eat before I pass out!
translation: 我都快饿死了。我必须在昏倒前吃点东西！

original: Time for a snack.
translation: 吃饭的时候到了。

original: Time to take five.
translation: 该歇五分钟了。

original: Mmm. I think I'll go grab a bite to eat.
translation: 嗯，我想我应该去吃点东西了。

original: Dinner time.
translation: 吃饭时间到了。

original: I think I'll go scrounge up a little something to eat.
translation: 我想我应该找点东西吃。

original: I'm hungry.
translation: 我饿了。

original: It's time for a little bite of something delicious.
translation: 该找点好东西吃了。

original: Think I'll take a moment for myself, and eat a little something.
translation: 我想我应该去找个地方单独待会，吃点东西。

original: My stomach is growling at me.
translation: 我肚子都开始抱怨了。

original: Din din! Time to eat!
translation: 叮咚！吃饭时间到！

original: I'm starving!
translation: 我饿了！

original: Well. I guess I better get some food.
translation: 嗯。我想我应该去找点吃的。

original: Oh, you're done? Sorry, I nodded off there...
translation: 哦，你说完了？不好意思，我都开始打盹了……

original: You think that's funny? Elder Lyons is a great man who risked a lot for the Wastes.
translation: 你认为这很有趣？里昂斯长老是一个伟大的人，他冒着危险来保护废土。

original: If I hear you disrespect him, or me, like that again, we're going to have words...
translation: 如果我发现你不尊重他的话，或者不尊重我，就像刚才那样，那我们就要好好谈谈了……

original: That's pretty amazing, Kodiak.
translation: 令人神往，科迪亚克。

original: Nah. The amazing thing is Elder Lyons. He risked everything -- went in outmanned and outgunned. I'll never be able to thank him enough.
translation: 不。里昂斯长老才令人神往。他冒着各种风险 — 即使对方人数占优、火力强大。不管怎么感谢他都是不够的。

original: So I do my best to serve the Brotherhood. I know that's what he really wants. In time, I'm sure you'll understand...
translation: 所以，我要尽我最大的力量来为兄弟会效力。我知道这也是他所希望的。总有一天，你也会明白……

original: That's awful! How could the Brotherhood do that?
translation: 那可太糟糕了！兄弟会怎么能这么做？

original: Normally, that would get you a crack across the jaw. But since you didn't know what the Pitt was like, I'll let it go.
translation: 通常，应该是把你的下巴打掉的。但是你既然不了解匹兹堡的情况，我就先放你一马。

original: I still have nightmares about the place. Thirty years and how many horrors later, and the Pitt is still the worst thing I've ever seen.
translation: 我还会做那个地方的噩梦。经历了30多年，以及各种各样的恐怖的事以后，匹兹堡仍然是我见过的最糟糕的地方。

original: It was ugly work, sure. Questionably moral? No doubt. But there was no other choice. That city had to go.
translation: 当然，不怎么好听。道德上受谴责？毫无疑问。但别无选择。那座城市必须被干掉。

original: What happened to the other kids from the Pitt?
translation: 那其他从匹兹堡来的孩子怎么样了？

original: All of 'em became Initiates. Most of them went on to become Brothers. A lot fell in action.
translation: 都成了新兵。大部分加入了兄弟会。很多倒在了战斗中。

original: I'm the only survivor of the Scourge of the Pitt still stationed at the Citadel.
translation: 我是唯一一名来自匹兹堡天谴、现在仍然在五角大本营驻守的人了。

original: What happened to your parents?
translation: 你的家人怎么样了？

original: Hell if I know. I never knew them. I lived on the street and fought with rats for food.
translation: 我他妈怎么知道。我从来都没见过他们。我以前一直住在大街，和老鼠抢吃的。

original: How did you end up back here?
translation: 那你最后是怎么来到这的？

original: Elder Lyons brought us all back to the Citadel. He said it was the safest place he knew of. This place was still being converted.
translation: 里昂斯长老把我们所有人带回了五角大本营。他说这是他所知道的最安全的地方。那时这仍在修建。

original: He put us in as Initiates and kept a watchful eye over us. He was tough, but he taught us to stay alive. The man is like a father to me.
translation: 他让我们成为新兵并关注着我们。他很严厉，但他教导了我们怎么生存。这人对我来说如同父亲。

original: That was before I knew how boring it was.
translation: 那是在我知道这有多无聊之前。

original: Then you don't have to hear it. The hell with you.
translation: 你可以不听，该死的家伙。

original: Yeah, I did. I'm sorry, go on...
translation: 嗯，是我。对不起，继续……

original: Right... so where was I? Oh, yeah. Brotherhood swept into the Pitt on the night of the Scourge.
translation: 好吧……我说到哪呢？哦对，在天谴行动的夜里，兄弟会扫荡了匹兹堡。

original: Huh? I'm sorry, are you still talking?
translation: 呃？抱歉，你还在说吗？

original: Hey, you wanted to hear it.
translation: 嗨，是你自己想听的。

original: What made them so terrible?
translation: 他们到底有什么可怕的？

original: The rivers. Even after the war, they were still flowing, but irradiated, and filled with God knows what else.
translation: 那些河流。战后，它们仍流动着，但都被辐射了，而且鬼知道里面还有些什么。

original: I saw things there I can't even begin to describe. I was only... what... eight years old when I left? Hell of a thing for a kid to go through.
translation: 我看到过一些东西，不知道该怎样形容。我离开时只有……大概……八岁左右？让孩子经历这些，真是见鬼。

original: How did you escape?
translation: 你是怎么逃出来的？

original: As they swept through, the Brotherhood policed up every non-mutie child they could find. Turns out, there weren't that many.
translation: 在扫荡之后, 兄弟会集中了每个他们能找到的未突变的孩子。事实上没多少人。

original: Me and maybe twenty others. The younger we were, the less of a chance that we were mutated. It was ugly work, no doubt, but it had to be done.
translation: 我和其他大概二十个孩子。越年幼的孩子突变的几率越小。那无疑是件肮脏事, 但必须这么做。

original: I'll never forget the sight of the Brotherhood of Steel breaching the breast of the mountain at dawn.
translation: 我永远不会忘记，钢铁兄弟会在黎明时突破国会山腹地的情景。

original: I'm looking for runaway slaves.
translation: 我正在找一个逃跑的奴隶。

original: We've got slavers! Grab your guns!
translation: 找到奴隶了！拿起武器！

original: Sounds like a nice place. You should go back.
translation: 听起来是个不错的地方。你应该回去。

original: Now see... That was just rude. Fine, no story for you.
translation: 听着……那太粗鲁了。好吧，没故事给你听了。

original: What was the Scourge?
translation: 天谴是什么？

original: It was a Brotherhood operation. They marched in and swept the place clean. Most of the people there were half-mutated, cancerous, vile things.
translation: 那是兄弟会的行动代号。他们开过来，扫荡了整个地区。那里的大多数人都是半变种、患有癌症的恶棍。

original: And these people... rape gangs, torture squads... it was pure chaos there. The Scourge is the best thing that could have happened to it.
translation: 而这些人……强奸犯，暴力团伙……完全乱套了。天谴是所能发生的最好的事。

original: This was way back, before the Citadel was fortified. Part of the early recon after the Brotherhood first arrived in this area.
translation: 这是很久之前的事了，在五角大本营成为堡垒前。兄弟会首次来这并进行了前期考察。

original: One night, a squad of Brothers led by Paladin Lyons swept into the city from over Mount Wash, tearing apart anyone who stood against them.
translation: 一天晚上，一支由圣骑士里昂斯率领的兄弟会小队从华盛顿山进入了城市，干掉了任何和他们作对的家伙。

original: They were completely outnumbered. And still they razed that place to the ground.
translation: 他们完全是以少对多。但他们仍将整个地区夷为了平地。

original: How did you end up in the Brotherhood?
translation: 你是怎么混到兄弟会里面来的？

original: Oh, now you want story time? Sorry. I'm not havin' it.
translation: 噢，现在你想听故事了？对不起，没时间。

original: Now that's a story... The only reason I'm here is because of Elder Lyons. You see, I grew up in the Pitt. Don't suppose you've ever been there, huh?
translation: 说来话长了……我在这的唯一原因就是里昂斯长老。要知道，我在匹兹堡长大。你从没去过那里吧，对不？

original: It's about 500 klicks to the northwest. Place is a nightmare -- three irradiated rivers coming together. People there were... not well.
translation: 它在西北方500公里左右。那鬼地方 — 三条被辐射的河流交汇在一起。那里的人们……不太好。

original: But the Brotherhood of Steel came down on the place with a righteous hammer. They called it "The Scourge."
translation: 但是钢铁兄弟会带着正义之锤杀了过来，他们称为“天谴”。

original: You're in luck! I think I may already have what you're looking for.
translation: 你真幸运！我想我大概有你正在寻找的东西。

original: Sakes alive! You mean you found a violin?
translation: 天啊！你是说你找到了一把小提琴？

original: Let's make it 300 caps and you have a deal.
translation: 加到300个瓶盖，我们就成交。

original: Well, it would bring more people in here if I had it on display I suppose.
translation: 嗯，我想如果把它作为展品，将会吸引更多的人到这来。

original: All right. You got it. 300 caps.
translation: 好吧。你得到它了。300个瓶盖。

original: Well, it would bring more people in here if I had it on display I suppose.
translation: 嗯，我想如果把它作为展品，将会吸引更多的人到这来。

original: All right. You got it. 300 caps.
translation: 好吧。你得到它了。300个瓶盖。

original: Actually, let me think about it.
translation: 老实说，让我再想想。

original: Fine. You approached me you know. Thanks for the time Waster.
translation: 好。你打动我了。感谢你浪费的时间。

original: Sure, 200 caps sounds good.
translation: 当然，200个瓶盖听起来不错。

original: Here you go.
translation: 就是这样。

original: This is the most I ever paid for a hunk of wood and strings, but what the hell.
translation: 这是我为一块木头和几根弦而付出最多的一次，但这该死的算什么。

original: Here you go.
translation: 就是这样。

original: This is the most I ever paid for a hunk of wood and strings, but what the hell.
translation: 这是我为一块木头和几根弦而付出最多的一次，但这该死的算什么。

original: Some culture would be good for you, Ghoul.
translation: 你最好懂点礼义廉耻，尸鬼。

original: One snap of my finger and I could fill you with enough holes to cut your weight in half.
translation: 我手指一抖，就能在你身上打出让你体重减半的洞来。

original: Testing my temper is not a good idea. Now buy something or get out of here.
translation: 想试试我的忍耐力可不是个好主意。要么买，要么滚。

original: You'd be the only one in the entire world to have this...
translation: 你是全世界唯一拥有这个的人……

original: One of a kind, huh? I like the sound of that.
translation: 独一无二，呃？我喜欢听到这话。

original: Okay, I'll give you 200 caps for it... and believe me, that's generous.
translation: 好吧，我给你20个瓶盖……相信我，我够慷慨了。

original: I just thought you might be interested... It's an artifact.
translation: 我想你可能会对这感兴趣……这是个宝贝。

original: Yeah? Wonderful. The corns on my feet from standing in this joint all day long are artifacts too.
translation: 是吗？棒极了，那我脚下直到天边的这些玉米也都是宝物。

original: Why don't you stop wasting my time and buy something or get out of here.
translation: 别浪费我的时间，要么买，要么滚。

original: You fucking coward. I can't stand the sight of you. Get away from me!
translation: 你这该死的懦夫，我不想看见你，离我远点！

original: Who told you that? They're lying, I swear it!
translation: 谁告诉你这些的？他们在撒谎，我发誓！

original: Well someone saw you and Martha, Roger, and I heard about it. So now I know for sure.
translation: 罗杰，有人看到你和玛莎在一起，而我也听说了这件事。所以我肯定那是真的。

original: Janet, what the hell are you talking about?
translation: 珍妮特，见鬼，你在说什么啊？

original: Don't you lie to me. Did you honestly think you could skulk around with that whore and no one would see you?
translation: 别再骗我了，你真以为你可以跟那骚货偷情而不被人看到吗？

original: What? Janet, what are you talking about?
translation: 什么？珍妮特，你在说什么啊？

original: Roger, you son of a bitch. Did you really think I wouldn't find out?
translation: 罗杰，你这混蛋。你真以为我不会发现吗？

original: Can you repair something for me?
translation: 你能为我修理东西吗？

original: Oh boy! New junk to tinker with!
translation: 哦，天啊！又有新废品可以修了！

original: Sure, let me see that thing!
translation: 当然，让我看看这东西！

original: Can you repair something for me?
translation: 你能为我修理些东西吗？

original: Let me see if I can't hammer this garbage into shape.
translation: 让我看看能不能把这破烂敲打回原来的样子。

original: Whatever you've got, I've got just the thing to fix it.
translation: 不管你有什么，我都有办法把它修好。

original: We used to have a better mechanic, but that didn't work out so well. I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我们有过一个更好的机械师，但下场很惨。我看看我能做点什么。

original: I can give it a look, sure.
translation: 当然，我可以看看。

original: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我尽量想想办法。

original: Easy. I've got a knack for this sort of thing, you know!
translation: 简单。要知道，我做这事有诀窍！

original: I'll see if I can't take a whack at it.
translation: 让我看看能不能给它来下狠的。

original: For a price, sure.
translation: 只要价格对，当然没问题。

original: Let's take a look and see.
translation: 让我们来看看。

original: Yes, but only if it wants to be repaired.
translation: 是的, 但也要它自己愿意被修理。

original: Maybe. Let's take a look.
translation: 或许吧，让我们来瞧瞧。

original: I hate to break it to you, but I saw your husband kissing some other woman.
translation: 我不想打击你，但我看到你丈夫吻了另一个女人。

original: It's that Martha Simpson, isn't it? I knew it! That's it. I've had enough of Roger's lies and bullshit!
translation: 是玛莎·辛普森？我就知道是她！啊，我受够了罗杰的谎言和鬼话了！

original: What is that stone head?
translation: 那石雕头像是谁？

original: He is the Great Emancipator. He freed all the slaves over a hundred years before the bombs dropped.
translation: 他是位伟大的奴隶制废除者，他在核弹落下的一百年前解放了所有的奴隶。

original: Hannibal wants to make his Memorial a symbol of hope and freedom for all slaves.
translation: 汉尼拔想把他的纪念堂作为所有奴隶希望和自由的象征。

original: That's Lincoln, sir. Hannibal found it. He wants to put it back, sir. I don't really understand why.
translation: 那是林肯，先生。汉尼拔找到了它，他想再把它物归原位，先生。我并不清楚这是为什么。

original: That's Lincoln, ma'am. Hannibal found it. He wants to put it back, ma'am. I don't really understand why.
translation: 那是林肯，女士。汉尼拔找到了它，他想再把它物归原位，女士。我并不清楚这是为什么。

original: The stone head is from the statue of Abraham Lincoln. Hannibal wants me to reattach it to the statue in the Memorial.
translation: 这是亚伯拉罕·林肯雕像的头像，汉尼拔要我把它重新安回到纪念堂的雕像上。

original: Haven't you been listening? That's Abraham Lincoln, the Great Emancipator.
translation: 你没有在听吗？那是亚伯拉罕·林肯，伟大的奴隶制废除者。

original: That's Abraham Lincoln, the Great Emancipator. We don't know how it came to be here, but it's fitting, don't you think?
translation: 那是亚伯拉罕·林肯，伟大的奴隶制废除者。我们不知道它是怎么到这来的，但这非常合适，你觉得呢？

original: God damn rookie. That's Lincoln. He freed some slaves a long time ago.
translation: 该死的新人，那是林肯。他在很久以前解放了奴隶。

original: If you want to know more, come listen to Hannibal give his speech. He does it right after the noon meal.
translation: 如果你想知道得更多，来听听汉尼拔的演讲吧。午餐后演讲就开始。

original: I'll bet you know where I can find one.
translation: 我打赌你知道我在哪能找到一个。

original: Yes. There might be one in the Museum of History. Alejandra says they have a special exhibit all about Lincoln.
translation: 是的，历史博物馆里可能有一个，亚历山德拉说他们有一个林肯的特别展览。

original: Where the hell am I supposed to get a picture of the Memorial?
translation: 他妈的在哪能搞到一张纪念堂的照片？

original: Our ancestors honored Lincoln's life with a display in the Museum of History. I'm hoping that a picture of the Memorial still survives in there.
translation: 我们的祖先为了彰显林肯的荣耀，在历史博物馆举办了展览，但愿纪念堂的照片仍旧在那。

original: Yeah... that's a problem. Well, I'd better get going.
translation: 是的……这是个问题。好了，我最好该动身了。

original: So you are a coward. I thought so.
translation: 我觉得你真是个懦夫。

original: Not until I say so. I've got a few questions you're going to have to answer first.
translation: 在回答你的问题之前，你得先回答我几个问题。

original: What do you know about the Temple of the Union?
translation: 你对团结圣殿有什么了解？

original: Nope. Not really. I think I'll just be on my way.
translation: 不，算了。我还是各走各路吧。

original: Hannibal says you need something?
translation: 汉尼拔说你需要什么？

original: Hannibal told you about Lincoln's Memorial?
translation: 汉尼拔告诉你林肯纪念堂的事了？

original: Well, he doesn't just want to live there. He also wants to restore it. Make it so people tell stories about it and the word can get to the slaves.
translation: 嗯，他并不仅想住在那，他还想要重建它。这样人们就会传颂它的故事，而这些故事则会在奴隶间流传。

original: But I can't restore something if I don't know what it looked like. I need a drawing or photograph of it.
translation: 但如果我不知道它是什么样的，我就无法重建它。我需要有关它的图片或照片。

original: He was a stone mason. It will fall to him to restore the Memorial as best he can.
translation: 他曾做过石匠，会尽力将纪念堂的重建工作做到最好。

original: He's been pestering me for weeks now to get him some things he needs. I don't have time to deal with him right now.
translation: 他缠着我,向我要一些东西都已经好几周了。我现在没时间理他。

original: What is it that Caleb needs?
translation: 卡勒布需要什么东西？

original: Sounds dangerous. Where is this place?
translation: 听起来很危险，这地方在哪？

original: I want to move all my people to the Memorial site for the great Abraham Lincoln, but I need to know if it's safe.
translation: 我想带领所有人转移到伟大的亚伯拉罕·林肯的纪念堂去，但我要知道那是否安全。

original: I've heard rumors of Super Mutants infesting that area though. We need to send someone to check that out first.
translation: 有传闻说超级变种人占领了那个区域，我们得先派人去查看是否属实。

original: That's a noble cause, but can I ask you about something else?
translation: 高贵的行为，但我能否问你些其他事？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Is this going to be a long story? 'Cause I've got things to do...
translation: 会很久吗？我还有事要做……

original: I shouldn't have expected anyone that hasn't been a slave to give a damn.
translation: 我真不该期待一个从没做过奴隶的人会理这事。

original: Why don't you let them stay here?
translation: 你为什么不让他们留在这？

original: We don't have enough room. There's not enough water or food here.
translation: 我们没有足够的房间，也没有足够的水和食物。

original: But I have a plan. A plan to take over a place that will be a shining beacon of hope for all slaves.
translation: 但我有个计划，一个把那变为所有奴隶的希望灯塔的计划。

original: What are a bunch of escaped slaves doing holed up here?
translation: 一群逃亡的奴隶躲在这做什么？

original: We're all runaways. Hannibal wants to make this a place for all escaped slaves, but it's too small.
translation: 我们都是逃亡者。汉尼拔希望把这变成所有逃跑奴隶的家园，但这太小了。

original: Why are all of you hiding in this place?
translation: 你们为什么都躲在这？

original: Oh, sir, this place is heaven. Just a little bit of heaven here in the wasteland. Any slave makes it here, he's free. Just like that.
translation: 噢，先生，这是天堂。一个建在废土上的小小天堂。任何来这的奴隶都将获得自由。就是这样。

original: And, Mister Hannibal, he's got a plan. A plan for heaven to be everywhere, not just here.
translation: 而且汉尼拔先生有个计划，一个能让所有地方而不仅仅是这都变成天堂的计划。

original: This place is a dump. Why don't you just leave before the Slavers find you?
translation: 这就是个垃圾堆。为什么不在奴隶贩子找到你们之前离开？

original: Oh, ma'am, this place is heaven. Just a little bit of heaven here in the wasteland. Any slave makes it here, he's free. Just like that.
translation: 噢，女士，这是天堂。一个建在废土上的小小天堂。任何来这的奴隶都将获得自由。就是这样。

original: And, Mister Hannibal, he's got a plan. A plan for heaven to be everywhere, not just here.
translation: 而且汉尼拔先生有个计划，一个能让所有地方而不仅仅是这都变成天堂的计划。

original: This place is a dump. Why don't you just leave before the Slavers find you?
translation: 这就是个垃圾堆。为什么不在奴隶贩子找到你们之前离开？

original: We are the only hope for runaway slaves everywhere.
translation: 我们是流落各地的逃亡奴隶的唯一希望。

original: Rivet City, and the Citadel can't be bothered with helping slaves. They turn a blind eye.
translation: 铆钉城和五角大本营也懒得帮助奴隶。他们对此视而不见。

original: We are the only ones willing to stand against Paradise Falls and slavery.
translation: 唯有我们想要与堕落天堂和奴隶贩子抗争。

original: Why do you stay here? Why not keep running?
translation: 你们为什么留在这？为什么不继续逃跑？

original: We are trying to make a safe haven for all runaway slaves.
translation: 我们试图为所有逃亡的奴隶建造一个庇护所。

original: We give food and supplies to any that find us, and help them on their way.
translation: 我们为来到这的奴隶提供食物和补给，并帮助他们。

original: This place is the death of all slavers. Maybe someday the death of slavery.
translation: 这曾带来所有奴隶们的末日，但或许有朝一日，这会带来奴隶制的末日。

original: Hannibal has a plan. We're too small right now, but someday we'll be big enough to take them on.
translation: 汉尼拔有一个计划。虽然现在我们还很弱小，但总有一天我们会强大到足以完成它。

original: Aren't you afraid the Slavers will find you?
translation: 你们不害怕奴隶贩子找上来吗？

original: I could get rid of the Super Mutants, if there are any.
translation: 如果有超级变种人的话,我可以帮你搞定他们。

original: Slavers? Dear God. They must know about our plans.
translation: 奴隶贩子？上帝。他们一定知道了我们的计划。

original: Do whatever you have to do to make the Memorial site safe for my people.
translation: 为了我的人，请你一定要尽力保障纪念堂的安全。

original: Before you leave, speak with Caleb. He'll need your help too.
translation: 在你走前和卡勒布谈谈，他需要你的帮助。

original: Don't worry about the Super Mutants. Slavers are in control of the Memorial.
translation: 不用担心超级变种人，奴隶贩子已经控制了纪念堂。

original: Soldiers? Slavers more likely. Dear God. They must know about our plans.
translation: 士兵？更像是奴隶贩子，上帝。他们一定知道我们的计划了。

original: Do whatever you have to do to make the Memorial site safe for my people.
translation: 为了我的人，请你一定要尽力保障纪念堂的安全。

original: Before you leave, speak with Caleb. He'll need your help too.
translation: 在你走前和卡勒布谈谈，他需要你的帮助。

original: Don't worry about the Super Mutants. Soldiers are in control of the Memorial.
translation: 不用担心超级变种人，士兵已经控制了纪念堂。

original: I was hoping you would help us. The Memorial is easy to find. Good luck.
translation: 但愿你可以帮我们，纪念堂很容易找到。祝你好运。

original: One other thing. Talk to Caleb. He'll need your help. We can't leave unless he's ready too.
translation: 还有件事，和卡勒布谈谈。他需要你的帮助。在他准备好之前我们不能离开。

original: I'll need to think about that.
translation: 我需要考虑。

original: When you are ready, let me know.
translation: 如果你准备好了，和我说一声。

original: Until then, you are free to wander our home. However, we cannot allow you to leave.
translation: 你可以在我们的家园自由行动，但我们不能让你离开。

original: Protect escaped slaves? You've got to be kidding. You're worth money to me!
translation: 保护逃跑的奴隶？你一定在开玩笑。对我来说你值点赏钱！

original: You leave me no choice.
translation: 你离我远点。

original: I'll keep the offer open. If you don't do it, someone else will. Hell, I'll do it if I have to.
translation: 我会把合约公开，就算你不干，总有人干。该死的，如果有必要的话，我会自己来干。

original: One more thing. Stay out of the Memorial. My men will shoot anyone that gets too close.
translation: 还有一件事，待在纪念堂外面。我的人会对任何靠近之人开火。

original: I've got a lot going on right now. Maybe later.
translation: 我现在很忙。或许迟点再说。

original: I solemnly swear to protect the Temple of the Union.
translation: 我庄严宣誓会保护联合圣殿。

original: Welcome, brother, to the Temple of the Union!
translation: 欢迎兄弟，欢迎来到团结圣殿！

original: Our home is your home. Your past is your own affair, so long as you serve our common good.
translation: 我们的家就是你的家。你的过去是你自己的隐私，你只需要好好为我们服务就行了。

original: As a symbol of our trust, here is a key to the gate.
translation: 作为赢得我们信任的标志，赐予你大门的钥匙。

original: Welcome, sister, to the Temple of the Union!
translation: 欢迎，姐妹，欢迎来到团结圣殿！

original: Our home is your home. Your past is your own affair, so long as you serve our common good.
translation: 我们的家就是你的家。你的过去是你自己的隐私，你只需要好好为我们服务就行了。

original: As a symbol of our trust, here is a key to the gate.
translation: 作为赢得我们信任的标志，赐予你大门的钥匙。

original: It's a museum, just past the Washington Monument. I'm only interested in stuff related to Abraham Lincoln. Bring me back whatever you find.
translation: 那是个博物馆, 就在华盛顿纪念碑后面。我只对和亚伯拉罕·林肯有关的东西感兴趣。不管你找到什么，都给我带回来。

original: Oh, and don't try and go into the Memorial. The guards have orders to shoot on sight.
translation: 哦, 不要试图进入纪念堂，那些守卫会射杀一切能看到的东西。

original: Okay. Where is this ruin?
translation: 好的。遗迹在哪？

original: I'm not crazy enough to go out there!
translation: 我还没有疯狂到会从那出去！

original: I'm not going out there, I don't care what the Overseer says.
translation: 我不会出去的, 我才不管监督者说什么呢。

original: Quick, close the door!
translation: 快点，关上门！

original: I did what you wanted. Now you have some explaining to do.
translation: 我照你要求的做了。现在到你解释了。

original: You have amused me thus far, but I still don't think you're quite in a position to be demanding anything.
translation: 迄今为止，你已经逗乐了我，但我仍认为你没有资格要求任何事。

original: Still, I suppose you've earned the right to some further answers. What would you ask of me?
translation: 不过，我想你已经有权获得一些进一步的答案了。你想问我什么？

original: Now what?
translation: 现在怎么做？

original: To the point, aren't we?
translation: 说到重点了，对吧？

original: I've been having so much fun, I see no reason to stop now. Let's try something new, shall we?
translation: 我已经很开心了，实在找不到停下来的理由。让我们尝点新鲜的怎么样？

original: I'd like you to kill Mabel Henderson. Find an interesting way to do it, please. I'm curious to see how creative you can be.
translation: 我想让你去杀了梅布尔·亨德森。最好弄点新花招，我很好奇你会有怎样的创意。

original: Reilly's Rangers, huh? Never heard of you.
translation: 莱莉的游骑兵，呃？从没听说过。

original: You been stuck living in a vault the last decade or something?
translation: 你过去十年都窝在避难所里还是怎么？

original: We're guns for hire; the best merc group in the Capital Wasteland. If you need something done in there, you seek us out.
translation: 我们是能雇佣的利器。首都废土上最好的佣兵团。如果你有需要的话，来找我们好了。

original: I have to be on my way.
translation: 我必须上路了。

original: Good luck. You're going to need it.
translation: 祝你好运。你会需要这的。

original: Please don't go. I really need your help.
translation: 请不要走，我真的需要你的帮助。

original: Look, I've got someplace I need to be...
translation: 听着，我还有个地方得去……

original: I don't cut anyone slack. Deal with it.
translation: 我不会替人收拾烂摊子的，再见。

original: Nice that you pick on bed-ridden people. That how you get your jollies? Does it make you feel tough?
translation: 选上手无缚鸡之力的人，真不错。这就是你找乐子的方式吗？这会让你感觉自己很强吗？

original: If you want to hear me out, then shut the hell up. If not, get out of my face.
translation: 你要是想听我说话，见鬼，先闭上你的嘴。如果你做不到，那就给我滚。

original: Okay, okay. Sorry.
translation: 好的，好的。对不起。

original: If time wasn't so precious right now, I wouldn't be so on edge either. I need to get help for the rest of the Rangers, and fast.
translation: 如果不是事态紧急，我也不会这么焦躁。我要为剩下的游骑兵寻求帮助，赶快。

original: I don't think you're in any condition to make threats.
translation: 我想你没任何资格要挟别人。

original: Look, I just woke up expecting to see the pearly gates. Can you cut me some slack, or what?
translation: 你看，我拼着命爬起来，就是为了这么点希望。现在你能不能帮我一把，还是怎么？

original: My apologies. I didn't know who you were.
translation: 我道歉。我不知道你究竟是谁。

original: That's okay, kid. Don't sweat it. The Wasteland's a big place.
translation: 好的，孩子。别担心，废土的确广阔。

original: We're guns for hire; the best merc group in the Capital Wasteland. If you need something done in there, you seek us out.
translation: 我们是能雇佣的利器。首都废土上最好的佣兵团。如果你有需要的话，来找我们好了。

original: Get a grip, lady.
translation: 握紧，女士。

original: Look, asshole. I don't know who you are, but no one talks to Reilly that way. Yeah, you heard me, THE Reilly of Reilly's Rangers.
translation: 听着，混蛋。我不知道你是谁，但从没人敢对莱莉这么讲话。嗯，你没听错。莱莉游骑兵的莱莉。

original: Whoa, whoa. Calm down! Who are you?
translation: 哇，哇。冷静！你是谁？

original: I'm sorry. The name's Reilly. Yeah, THE Reilly as in Reilly's Rangers.
translation: 我很抱歉。我的名字叫莱莉。嗯，莱莉的游骑兵里的莱莉。

original: I've got to admit, this is kind of fun. What can I do next?
translation: 我觉得这很有趣，接下来我能做些什么？

original: I'm pleased to see I'm not the only one being entertained. You're far more agreeable than your father.
translation: 我很高兴看到不只我一个人乐在其中，你可比你父亲讨人喜欢多了。

original: If you wish for more, then so be it. But let's raise the stakes a bit this time. I'd like you to kill Mabel Henderson.
translation: 如果你想要更多，可以。但这次我们玩大点，我要你去杀掉梅布尔·亨德森。

original: But do be creative about it. Beating her to death just won't suffice. Put some effort into it.
translation: 但要有创意。光把她打死还不够，要下点功夫。

original: Let me tell you the story of Abraham Lincoln.
translation: 让我来给你讲讲亚伯拉罕·林肯的故事。

original: He was born a Tucky Tearsman. The truth of this mysterious title has been lost, but we know it was a great honor.
translation: 他天生悲世悯人。这头衔的由来无从得知，但我们知道那是一个莫大的荣耀。

original: As a child he could not bear to see any animal chained or imprisoned. He was even known to set free the family Brahmin on occasion.
translation: 在他还是孩子时，他就不忍看到动物被铁链锁住或者关在笼子里。他甚至因为经常放走圈养的双头牛而出名。

original: As a youth, Abraham Lincoln fought Raiders in the war of the black hawks.
translation: 在年轻时，亚伯拉罕·林肯就在黑鹰之战中与歹徒对抗。

original: When the war ended, he settled down to rule the Linoy, a small tribe of free men.
translation: 战争结束后，他专心治理林诺，一个自由的镇子。

original: He grew so famous that one day he was made President. He ruled over all the land.
translation: 他的名声终于使他成为了总统，他统治了整个大地。

original: When he declared that all slaves must be freed, the slavers rebelled against his rule.
translation: 当他宣言所有的奴隶都将被解放时，奴隶贩子们开始反对他的统治。

original: They fought a great war, which Lincoln won.
translation: 他们进行了一场伟大的战争，林肯获得了胜利。

original: When he came to free the slaves, an assassin of the slavers struck him down.
translation: 就在他解放奴隶的时候，一个奴隶贩子派出的刺客杀害了他。

original: In the confusion, a few of the slavers escaped. Lincoln's generals hunted them, but could not find them.
translation: 混乱中，一小撮奴隶贩子逃跑了。林肯的将军追捕他们，但却徒劳无功。

original: The bombs ended the era of Lincoln, but we will resurrect his voice.
translation: 核弹结束了林肯的时代，但我们终将复兴他的声音。

original: We will restore the greatness of his vision where all men are created equal, and all men can live free!
translation: 我们将复兴他那人人平等、人人自由的伟大主张！

original: So this is the Lincoln Memorial?
translation: 这是林肯纪念堂？

original: Yeah. Not much to look at anymore. The statue doesn't even have a head.
translation: 是的。虽然看上去并不怎么样。那雕像甚至没有了头。

original: Hard to tell without a head, huh?
translation: 没脑袋很难说话吧，呃？

original: Not for long.
translation: 不会太久的。

original: I can't wait to see the Great Emancipator turn into a smoking pile of rubble
translation: 我简直等不及了，我要看着伟大的解放者变成一堆冒烟的废渣。

original: It's the Lincoln Memorial. This Lincoln guy supposedly freed all the slaves before the bombs dropped.
translation: 那是林肯纪念堂。这叫林肯的家伙理应在核弹落下前解放所有的奴隶。

original: So the pussies built a Memorial to him.
translation: 所以这娘娘腔为他建了个纪念堂。

original: It's got our slaves thinking that they can be free too.
translation: 这搞得我们的奴隶们也妄想能获得自由。

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: Yeah. Just east of here. Bunch of guys with guns are holed up there.
translation: 是的，就在这的东面。一帮带枪的家伙们就埋伏在那。

original: Is the Lincoln Memorial around here somewhere?
translation: 林肯纪念堂是在这附近吗？

original: Yeah. Just east of here. Some freed slaves just occupied it. We trade with them occasionally.
translation: 是的，就在这的东面。一些获得自由的奴隶占领了那。我们偶尔会跟他们做做生意。

original: Is the Lincoln Memorial around here somewhere?
translation: 林肯纪念堂是在这附近吗？

original: Yeah. Just east of here. Bunch of guys with guns are holed up there.
translation: 是的，就在这的东面。一帮带枪的家伙们就埋伏在那。

original: Is the Lincoln Memorial around here somewhere?
translation: 林肯纪念堂是在这附近吗？

original: Yeah. Just east of here. Some freed slaves just occupied it. We trade with them occasionally.
translation: 是的，就在这的东面。一些获得自由的奴隶占领了那。我们偶尔会跟他们做做生意。

original: Is the Lincoln Memorial around here somewhere?
translation: 林肯纪念堂是在这附近吗？

original: Why would your father kill Jonas? That makes no sense.
translation: 你父亲为什么要杀死乔纳斯？这太不可理喻了。

original: I don't think they meant to. As if that makes any difference.
translation: 我不认为他们想那样。好象那会有什么不同。

original: I think he must have distracted the guards while your dad got into the Vault door controls.
translation: 我想你父亲进入避难所大门的控制区时，必须避开守卫。

original: When they realized that Jonas had helped your dad escape, they just lost it. I'm sorry, but I really don't want to think about it again.
translation: 当他们意识到是乔纳斯在帮你父亲逃离时，他们肯定不知所措了。对不起，但我真的不愿意再回想这件事了。

original: I still don't understand how my father escaped. Isn't the Vault door sealed?
translation: 我仍不明白我父亲是怎么逃脱的。避难所大门不是关闭的吗？

original: Well, that's what they've always told us, but apparently it's not.
translation: 嗯，他们一直那样说，但很显然并非如此。

original: From what I overheard, he hacked into the computer that controls the door.
translation: 我无意中偷听到，他破解了控制大门开关的电脑。

original: That's why my father locked down the door leading to the exit.
translation: 那也是为何我父亲关闭了出口大门的原因。

original: So what happened to the lights?
translation: 这些灯怎么了？

original: My father ordered the Vault into lockdown. Everyone's supposed to stay in their quarters and emergency lighting only.
translation: 我父亲下令对避难所进行一级戒严，每个人都必须待在他们的住所，只配给紧急储备粮。

original: But you need to be careful -- the Radroaches have swarmed out in the darkness. I had a few close calls on my way to see you.
translation: 但你必须小心 — 黑暗中到处都是辐射蟑螂。在我来见你的路上就遇到了几次危险。

original: It was lucky for you in a way. Security's been distracted dealing with the Roaches, but that won't last forever. You've got to get moving.
translation: 某种程度上你很幸运。警卫被那些辐射蟑螂搞得手足无措，但不会总是这样。你必须行动了。

original: Sounds like fun.
translation: 听起来很有趣。

original: I thought you might find it amusing. It draws upon an old urban legend, a story told over campfires many years ago.
translation: 我想你可能会觉得这有趣。它取材于一个古老的都市传说，一个许多年前总在篝火旁被讲起的故事。

original: The residents have all heard the story, and will fear you.
translation: 那些居民们都听过这故事，他们会害怕你的。

original: Go forth, and make me proud.
translation: 去吧，别让我失望。

original: Who the hell is the Pint-Sized Slasher?
translation: 这“小小屠夫”到底是谁？

original: He is a figure of myth, born of old campfire stories. You will make him a reality.
translation: 他是个传说，诞生在那古老的、篝火旁讲起的故事里。你来把他变成现实。

original: The residents will know you, and they will fear you. When they have all been eliminated, return to me.
translation: 那些居民会知道并怕你的，把他们全干掉后，就回来向我汇报。

original: How do I know you're being honest with me?
translation: 我怎么知道你有没有对我说实话？

original: I think you'll find that I've been quite honest with you thus far. You have no discernable reason to mistrust me.
translation: 我想你会注意到，到目前为止我一直对你相当坦诚。你没有什么明显的理由不信任我。

original: In the dog house out behind the abandoned home are a mask and knife. Don the mask, and become the Pint-Sized Slasher.
translation: 在那弃房后面的狗窝里，有一副面具和一把刀。戴上那面具，化身为“小小屠夫”。

original: Use the knife to eliminate all the residents of Tranquility Lane.
translation: 用那把刀干掉宁静巷的所有居民。

original: That sure was fun!
translation: 那可真有意思！

original: I had the distinct impression you enjoyed yourself. We are alike, you and I.
translation: 我明显感觉到你玩得开心。你和我，是一类人。

original: Now, you asked for the means to leave Tranquility Lane, and so I grant it to you. The door is open.
translation: 现在，你问了离开宁静巷的方法，那我就成全你。门开了。

original: You are, of course, welcome to stay a bit longer if you like.
translation: 当然, 如果你愿意的话，我很欢迎你在这再待上一段时间。

original: I did what you wanted. Now let me out.
translation: 我做了你要我做的事儿，让我离开吧。

original: Yes, yes. I suppose you've earned the right to do as you like.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我想你已经有权按自己的意愿行事了。

original: I shall miss your company. This has been a simply wonderful time.
translation: 我会怀念有你的陪伴。那可真是段美妙的时光啊。

original: The door is now open. Through it, you may return to the real world, and whatever inferior existence you have there.
translation: 现在门开了。穿过它，你就会回到现实世界，回到你在那里的卑微生活中。

original: [crying]
[crying]
[sobbing]
translation: [啜泣]

original: Come on. Let's go see if we can help her.
translation: 来吧。让我们看看有什么能帮她的。

original: No, I can't go back in there. It's... it's dark, and there's Radroaches.
translation: 不，我不能回去。那……那很黑，还有很多辐射蟑螂。

original: Sorry, Butch. I've got my own problems to deal with right now.
translation: 抱歉，布奇。我现在要先处理好自己的麻烦。

original: Please! I know I've always been a jerk towards you. I know it!
translation: 求求你！我知道我对你做过很多愚蠢的事，我错了！

original: But you can't walk away and let her die! Just because I was an asshole. Please... I'm begging you.
translation: 但你不能因为我是个混蛋就这么一走了之，你不能把她留在那等死！求你……我求求你。

original: Butch... asking me for help. If only you knew what "irony" meant...
translation: 布奇……求我啊。如果你知道“讽刺”两个字怎么写的话……

original: Yeah, I'm asking you. So what.
translation: 嗯，我是在求你。那又怎么了。

original: Look, I'm sorry for the way I've always treated you. You know I never meant any of it, right?
translation: 听着，我为我所做过的事向你道歉。但你知道我不是故意的，不是吗？

original: But it's my mom. You can't leave her in there with the Radroaches.
translation: 但那是我妈妈，你不能就这么扔下她，任凭她和那些辐射蟑螂待在一起。

original: Please, sit back, relax and free yourself from the bonds of our planet as we take off for the stars! [bzzzzt!]
translation: 坐下，放松。把自己的精神从肉体的禁锢中解脱出来，好像飘然升天一样！[扑哧！]

original: To understand why man is so interested in this unknown expanse of space around our little world, we must take a journey.
