translation: 要了解人类为什么会对环绕我们小小世界的广阔宇宙如此感兴趣，我们需要踏上旅程。

original: For as long as history has been recorded, man has had an insatiable hunger for knowledge regarding the universe.
translation: 从有史可溯开始，人类对探索宇宙的渴求就永无穷尽。

original: Are you saying you're afraid of the dark?
translation: 你是说你怕黑吗？

original: No! I mean... it's not the dark, it's the Radroaches. I... I can't stand them. I tried to go back in to get her, I really did! But I couldn't.
translation: 不！我是说……我不是怕黑, 是那些辐射蟑螂。我……我没法应付它们。我试过回去救她，真的！但我做不到。

original: You gotta help me. She's not going to last much longer in there! Can't you hear her screaming?
translation: 你得帮帮我。她坚持不了多长时间了！你没听见她在尖叫吗？

original: Don't worry, Butch. I'll get your mom out of there.
translation: 别担心, 布奇。我会把你妈妈救出来的。

original: Oh my God, thank you. I didn't know what to do. You're the best!
translation: 噢，天啊，谢谢你。我真不知道该怎么谢谢你，你是最棒的！

original: Don't worry, Butch. I'll get your mom out of there.
translation: 别担心, 布奇。我会把你妈妈救出来的。

original: She'll never see it coming.
translation: 她永远都不会看到那一天的到来了。

original: Excellent. I look forward to seeing what you come up with. Remember, creativity is key!
translation: 好极了。我很期待你的表现。记住，关键是创意！

original: All right, fine. I'll do it.
translation: 好吧。我会做的。

original: Music to my ears.
translation: 求之不得呢。

original: No, I won't do that.
translation: 不，我不会那么做的。

original: Yes, yes. How very noble of you. You'll change your mind eventually.
translation: 是的。你可真高尚，可你最终会改变主意的。

original: I said I wouldn't do that, and I meant it!
translation: 我说我不会做，那我就是不会做！

original: Still you resist me, when you know that I have the answers you seek.
translation: 你仍在反抗我，你会发现我手中握着你要的答案。

original: Well, I am not going to beg you. You know what I ask of you, and so you know what you must do to retain my favor.
translation: 好吧，我不会去求你的。你知道我要你做什么，所以你也知道怎么做才能让我满意。

original: Nothing, never mind.
translation: 没什么，别在意。

original: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

original: What... is this place?
translation: 这……是什么地方？

original: Tranquility Lane was designed to be a home away from home. A new way of sustaining life after the apocalypse.
translation: 宁静巷被设计成一个世外桃源。一种浩劫后维持生活的新方式。

original: Vault 112 was the prototype; we never had time to build others. As the designer of the simulation, I was given special access.
translation: 112号避难所是原型；我们根本没时间建造其他的。作为模拟系统的设计者，我被授予了特殊权限。

original: Everyone else here is only subconsciously aware of the artificial reality around them; their conscious minds accept it as fact.
translation: 这儿的其他人只是潜意识里察觉到周围的人工现实；他们的意识将其当作事实接受。

original: What did my father want from you?
translation: 我父亲想从你这得到什么？

original: Your father, frustrating as he was, recognized the significance of some of my previous work.
translation: 你父亲，虽然很沮丧，但他意识到我之前工作的重要性。

original: He came to gather information on it. He was most pleased to be able to ask me directly, but he failed to understand how things work here.
translation: 他来这收集有关的信息。他很高兴能直接向我询问，不过他没明白这儿的规矩。

original: He was unwilling to compromise, to do anything I asked of him. And so our discussions ended.
translation: 他不愿意妥协，不做我要求他做的任何事。于是，我们的讨论结束了。

original: Where's my father now?
translation: 我父亲现在在哪？

original: He's here, and he is unharmed. He has merely been rendered unable to bother me.
translation: 他在这里，而且没有受伤。只是被我弄得没法再来烦我了。

original: Fuck off.
translation: 滚蛋吧。

original: I'm kind of busy here.
translation: 我正忙。

original: Boss is on my ass again. You know how it is.
translation: 老板又折磨我了，你知道的。

original: Bunch of bullshit. I'll tell you about it later.
translation: 那全是一派胡言。我迟点再和你说。

original: Two things: Jack and Shit.
translation: 两个内容：空话和废话。

original: Ain't got time to tell you about it.
translation: 现在没空跟你说这。

original: You know how it is.
translation: 你知道的。

original: Zippo.
translation: 拉链。

original: Nada.
translation: 没什么。

original: Not a damn thing.
translation: 该死的没什么。

original: Nothin' at all.
translation: 真的没什么。

original: Nada, man.
translation: 纳达，伙计。

original: I've got the worst hangover...
translation: 我最近糟透了……

original: That fuckin' sun is giving me a headache.
translation: 该死的太阳晒得我头疼。

original: It's way too early in the morning for this shit.
translation: 一大早就得干这破事。

original: Air feels all fucked up tonight. I think a storm's comin'.
translation: 今晚的天气真是糟透了，我猜可能风暴要来。

original: These rookies kill me sometimes. Monsters... heh...
translation: 这帮新人有时真是让我想死。怪物……呃……

original: Dumbass rookies, man.
translation: 无能的新人，伙计。

original: No shit. But he wouldn't stop screamin' about "claws of death". We finally got sick of it and put him down.
translation: 该死的，不。但他一直在尖呼着什么“死亡之爪”。我们最后都受不了他了。

original: That's what I said! After a couple hours, we just put a cap in him to get him to shut up.
translation: 那就是我说的！几小时后我们用一颗子弹堵了他的嘴，看他还怎么喊。

original: You're shittin' me! Monsters? Hahaha!
translation: 你在和我开玩笑！怪物？哈哈哈哈！

original: Monsters? They probably got their asses handed to 'em by some Wastelanders and ran home like a bunch of pussies.
translation: 怪物？他们恐怕早就被那些废土游民打怕了，像娘们一样滚回窝里去了吧。

original: One of 'em came back last night, screamin' about claws and fangs and shit. He said they ran into a bunch of monsters a few miles north of the city.
translation: 他们中的一个昨晚回来了，嚷嚷一些什么爪子和牙之类的鬼话。他说他们在城北几公里以外的地方遇到了一群怪物。

original: Those fuckin' morons... they ran into some kind of trouble up there. One of 'em came back last night, screamin' about monsters or some shit.
translation: 那群该死的白痴……他们在那遇到了麻烦。其中的一个昨晚回来了，嚷嚷着什么怪物之类的，见鬼。

original: They went up north? Who goes up there? What happened to them?
translation: 他们去北面了？都有谁去了？发生了什么？

original: No, but this sounds like it'll be good.
translation: 不，但这听起来不错。

original: Keepin talkin', smartass. I've had about enough of your shit. You'd just best watch your back.
translation: 继续说，自作聪明的混蛋。我听够了你的鬼话。你最好给我小心点。

original: Yeah, yeah. Keep runnin' your mouth, asshole. Keep fuckin' with me, and I'll be your worst nightmare.
translation: 嗯，嗯。继续胡说吧，混蛋。如果你再对我胡说，我他妈就会是你做过最可怕的噩梦。

original: Please. I'll look where the fuck I want to look. What are you gonna do about it?
translation: 拜托，我他妈爱看哪看哪。你能怎么着？

original: Well you're just so damn pretty that I can't help but stare.
translation: 见鬼，你太漂亮了，我简直没法不盯着看你。

original: Get back here, you fucking coward!
translation: 回来，你这见鬼的懦夫！

original: Goddamnit!
translation: 该死！

original: How are things now that the power's back?
translation: 电力恢复了，现在怎么做？

original: I can't even tell you the love that I'm getting from the Wasteland.
translation: 我甚至无法告诉你我在废土得到的爱情。

original: Ever since GNR started singing again, the guys downstairs told me that more people than ever are tuning in.
translation: 自从银河新闻电台开始再次播放，楼下那些家伙就告诉我有更多的人在收听了。

original: It's all I ever wanted.
translation: 我别无所求啊。

original: It's amazing. We've always been able to hear GNR, but it's like the station is brand new or something.
translation: 真不错。我们总能够收听银河新闻电台，但好象那个电台是全新的了。

original: Things are back on track. That should throw a kink in the Enclave's work.
translation: 各方面都正常了。这肯定会给英克雷的工作带来不少麻烦。

original: You've done a hell of a job. The Wasteland looks a little brighter if you can believe that.
translation: 你真他妈的干得好。你相信吗，废土看上去真的比从前好些了。

original: My mistake. I'll just be going.
translation: 我的错，我这就走。

original: Good idea.
translation: 好主意。

original: Smart move. We shoot anyone that tries to get into the Memorial.
translation: 路上小心。我们会射杀任何试图进入纪念堂的家伙。

original: I'm just looking for a place to rest, and maybe do some trading.
translation: 我只想找个地儿歇脚，或者做点交易。

original: Hannibal says I gotta let folks like you in, but that don't mean I have to like it.
translation: 汉尼拔说我应该允许像你这样的人进来，但那不意味着我就会喜欢这么做。

original: Keep your hands in sight and don't make any sudden moves.
translation: 把你的手放在我能看见的地方，别做出任何突然的举动。

original: I'm coming down to open the gate.
translation: 我下去开门。

original: Curiosity can get a wastelander killed. I'm going to let you through, but you'll have to talk to Mr. Walker first. Follow me.
translation: 好奇心能杀死废土游民。我会让你过去，但你必须先去见沃克先生。跟我来。

original: Oh, and stay off the Memorial steps. They have orders to shoot anyone that gets too close. The dirt path is safe.
translation: 噢，对了，离纪念堂的台阶远点。他们被下令对任何靠得太近的人开枪。还是土路安全些。

original: Easy now. I'm just curious about this place. I'm not looking for trouble.
translation: 别紧张。我只是对这地方有些好奇。我可不想找麻烦。

original: Maybe. How much is it worth to find these slaves for you?
translation: 可能。为你找到这些奴隶能得到多少钱？

original: I'm only interested in the leader, Hannibal Hamlin. You find him, and I'll pay you 100 caps.
translation: 我只对领导者感兴趣，汉尼拔·哈姆林。找到他，我会付给你100个瓶盖。

original: His trail leads east from Paradise Falls. He's going to try and claim this memorial, so this is the one place I know I can find him.
translation: 迹象表明他跑到堕落天堂东面去了。他会试图夺取这纪念馆，所以我知道在这能找到他。

original: Don't kill him yourself. Just find out where he's holed up, and I won't have to wait for him.
translation: 别杀了他。找出他躲在哪就好，这样我就不必干等了。

original: They're up north, near Old Olney.
translation: 他们在北面，老奥尔尼附近。

original: Not willing to trade your life for a bunch of runaway slaves, eh?
translation: 不想为一群逃跑的奴隶拼命，是吗？

original: Well, you've told me what I need to know.
translation: 好，我想知道的，你都已经告诉我了。

original: If you're looking for some spare caps, I'm willing to pay for anything you might find having to do with Abraham Lincoln.
translation: 如果你想多弄些瓶盖，我会为你能找到的任何有关于亚伯拉罕·林肯的东西付钱。

original: I was going to clean out the ruins of the Museum of History looking for them, but now I've got more important business.
translation: 我本打算彻底扫荡历史博物馆的废墟来找出他们，但现在我有更重要的事要做。

original: If I had, I wouldn't tell you.
translation: 如果我有，我就不会告诉你了。

original: You are really starting to piss me off.
translation: 你真的开始让我生气了。

original: Lucky for you I don't have time to give you an attitude adjustment. Just answer one question and you can go.
translation: 你很幸运，我现在没空矫正你的态度。回答一个问题，你就可以走了。

original: What do you know about the Temple of the Union?
translation: 你对团结圣殿有什么了解？

original: I haven't seen any slaves recently.
translation: 我最近没见过任何奴隶。

original: That's too bad.
translation: 那太糟了。

original: You know, you seem like the type of wastelander that might be for hire.
translation: 要知道，你看上去像是个会受雇佣的废土游民。

original: I need someone to get some loot out of a nearby ruin. Are you interested?
translation: 我需要有人到附近的废墟去弄点战利品。你有兴趣吗？

original: Not around here, but there is a group of them up north near Old Olney.
translation: 不在这，但他们中有一群跑到老奥尔尼北面去了。

original: They are?
translation: 他们是？

original: Now, that's just wrong, isn't it? We're from Paradise Falls, and we've been looking for those runaways.
translation: 那是错的，对吧？我们是从堕落天堂来的，我们一直在找那些逃跑的家伙们。

original: We'll have to go and take care of that little group of rebels. You can come watch if you want.
translation: 我们得走了，我们得看着这一小股反叛者。如果你想的话也可以来看看。

original: Whether you do or don't, I'm looking to hire a wastelander for a small job.
translation: 不管你干不干，我都得找个废土游民来干。

original: I need someone to bring me some items from a nearby ruin. Are you interested?
translation: 我需要有人到附近的废墟去弄点战利品。你有兴趣吗？

original: So I'm a prisoner? I don't think so!
translation: 这么说我是囚犯？我可不这么想！

original: Then I'm just going to have to kill you.
translation: 那我只好干掉你了。

original: I've got no beef with you. Let me go and I won't say a word.
translation: 我对你没什么怨言。让我走吧，我一个字也不会说出去的。

original: I really shouldn't, but I'll take you at your word.
translation: 其实我不应该这么做，但是我相信你。

original: If I ever see you around here again, I'll shoot first and loot your body afterward. Now git.
translation: 如果我在这附近再看见你，我会先杀了你再剥光你的衣服。滚吧。

original: Who are you guys?
translation: 这些家伙们是谁？

original: We're from Paradise Falls. We're looking for escaped slaves.
translation: 我们从堕落天堂来。我们在找几个逃跑的奴隶。

original: Have you seen any?
translation: 你有看到过吗？

original: No, please! I know he's hurt and lied to us, but he's still my father! I just want him to stop keeping us locked up, that's all!
translation: 不，拜托！我知道他欺骗并伤害了我们，但他始终是我父亲！我只是想让他把我们放出去，仅此而已！

original: I know I can't stop you, but I know somewhere in there, my father just thinks he's just watching out for us. So, please, please don't hurt him.
translation: 我知道我无法阻止你，但我知道在我父亲心中，他只是认为这是在保护我们。所以，求求你，求求你不要伤害他。

original: I still owe him a lot for that night. Don't expect to see him again.
translation: 那个晚上的债还没算清呢。别想再见到他了。

original: I put a bullet right between Ted Strayer's eyes. <Lie.>
translation: 我把一颗子弹射入了泰德·斯崔尔的眉心。<撒谎>

original: So, the Ghoul hater got what was coming to him. Good riddance.
translation: 那僵尸仇视者得到了他的报应。干得漂亮。

original: Here's your caps. I'll take that key.
translation: 这是你的瓶盖。钥匙归我了。

original: Excellent! That will be a lesson for all the Ghoul haters out there.
translation: 真精彩！那会为所有僵尸仇视者上一课。

original: Here's you payment for the key.
translation: 这是你取回钥匙的报酬。

original: Dukov is dead. I blew his brains out. <Lie>
translation: 杜克夫死了。我把他头盖骨都打飞了。 <撒谎>

original: Serves him right. He won't be spreading lies about Ghouls any more.
translation: 他活该。他不会再散布那些关于僵尸的谎言了。

original: I'll take that key, and here are your caps.
translation: 钥匙归我了，而这些瓶盖是属于你的。

original: Dave's head popped like a zit. <Lie>
translation: 戴夫的脑袋就像一颗青春痘一样炸开了。 <撒谎>

original: Have you got what I want?
translation: 你拿到我想要的了吗？

original: Marvelous! My list is growing shorter.
translation: 真不可思议！我的名单越来越短了。

original: Here's Strayer's key. Shot in the head, just like you asked.
translation: 这是斯崔尔的钥匙。一枪爆头，像你要求的那样。

original: Not much of a shot, eh? I couldn't kill Jeff, but I got his son. That will have to do.
translation: 没能爆头，嗯？我杀不了杰斐，但是我干掉了他儿子。这就够了。

original: Here's your caps. I'll just take that key.
translation: 这是你的瓶盖。钥匙归我了。

original: Here's Strayer's key. He's dead, but not from a shot to the head.
translation: 这是斯崔尔的钥匙。他已经死了，不过不是爆头。

original: That wasn't the plan. I suppose I have to pay for the key anyway though. Here.
translation: 计划可不是这样的。但我想我仍要为这钥匙付钱。拿着。

original: Here's Strayer's key. But I'm afraid he's still alive.
translation: 这是斯崔尔的钥匙。但是我恐怕他还活着。

original: So long as I get that key, I don't care.
translation: 只要我拿到了钥匙，其他的我不在乎。

original: Here's your caps.
translation: 这些瓶盖是你的了。

original: Here's Strayer's key. But I'm afraid he's still alive
translation: 这是斯崔尔的钥匙。但是我恐怕他还活着。

original: May his soul rot! This is great news.
translation: 愿他的灵魂腐烂！这真是好消息。

original: I'll take that key as a memento. Here, take your caps.
translation: 我会把这钥匙留作纪念。给，拿走你的瓶盖。

original: Dukov is dead, with a head shot, and here's his key.
translation: 杜克夫死了，一枪爆头，这是他的钥匙。

original: Well, better dead than alive I suppose.
translation: 嗯，我想他还是死了好。

original: Take your caps. I'll take that key.
translation: 拿着你的瓶盖。钥匙归我了。

original: Here's Dukov's key. He's dead, but not from a shot to the head.
translation: 这是杜克夫的钥匙。他已经死了，不过不是爆头。

original: I thought I told you to kill him? That rat bastard is still alive!
translation: 我想我告诉过你要杀了他？那混蛋还活蹦乱跳着呢！

original: I'll pay for the key, but you really screwed up!
translation: 我会为了钥匙付你钱，但你把事搞砸了！

original: Here's Dukov's key. I got it without killing him.
translation: 这是杜克夫的钥匙。我没杀他就拿到了。

original: Who cares? I've got his key. That's all I really want.
translation: 谁在乎？我拿到了他的钥匙。那才是我想要的。

original: Here's Dukov's key. I got it without killing him.
translation: 这是杜克夫的钥匙。我没杀他就拿到了。

original: Yes, yes, yes! Another bigot bites the dust.
translation: 好，好，好！又一个偏执狂玩完了。

original: I'll just take that key, and you can take these caps.
translation: 钥匙交给我，这些瓶盖你拿着。

original: Here's Dave's key. One shot, right through the brain.
translation: 这是戴夫的钥匙。一枪，直接穿过脑袋。

original: Well, at least he's dead.
translation: 好吧，至少他死了。

original: I suppose I have to pay you anyway since you brought back that key. Here.
translation: 我想，怎么说我也得为你拿回了钥匙而付钱。拿着吧。

original: Here's Dave's key. He's dead, but not from a shot to the head.
translation: 这是戴夫的钥匙。他已经死了，不过不是爆头。

original: I'll pay you for the key, but I'm very disappointed.
translation: 我会给你钥匙当作报酬，但我很失望。

original: Here's Dave's key, but he's not dead.
translation: 这是戴夫的钥匙，不过他还没死。

original: All I care about is the key...which I'll take now.
translation: 我唯一在乎的只有钥匙……它现在归我了。

original: Here's Dave's key, but he's not dead.
translation: 这是戴夫的钥匙，不过他还没死。

original: Tell me where Fort Constantine is.
translation: 告诉我康斯坦丁要塞在哪。

original: It's pretty far away, northwest of here. Getting there won't do you any good though, not without those keys.
translation: 那实在很远，在这的西北面。到那去不会带给你任何好处，如果你没有钥匙的话。

original: It's pretty far away, northwest of here. Knowing won't do you any good with these keys though.
translation: 那实在很远，在这的西北面。就是你知道地方，没有这些钥匙也捞不到什么好处。

original: What do you have against these guys?
translation: 你跟这些家伙有什么过节？

original: They're Ghoul haters. I want them all dead. Don't you think that's enough?
translation: 他们是一群僵尸仇视者。我希望他们全部死掉。你认为这还不够吗？

original: Are you crazy or something?
translation: 你是疯了还是怎么？

original: Hey that isn't nice! You should apologize right now!
translation: 嗨，这可不好！你现在就给我道歉！

original: What's the matter with you? Didn't your mom and dad ever teach you any manners?
translation: 你怎么了？你父母没有教过你礼节吗？

original: Are you just completely insane, or what?
translation: 你是疯了还是怎么？

original: You don't like it? Tough!
translation: 你不喜欢？有种！

original: Humph! Well. I've never been so insulted before!
translation: 哼！好吧。我从没有被这样侮辱过！

original: And to think I was going to offer you the chance of a lifetime. Well, forget it now.
translation: 想想看我原本要给你个千载难逢的机会。好，算了吧。

original: Okay, I'm sorry. I don't know what came over me.
translation: 好，对不起。我也不知道我是怎么了。

original: That's fine. We all get a bit crazy sometimes when we get that taste... the taste of a cold Nuka-Cola!
translation: 没关系。我们在尝到那味道的时候都会变得有些疯狂……那冰镇核子可乐的味道！

original: Let's pretend this never happened and start again.
translation: 让我们当作什么都没发生过，重新开始吧。

original: So, do you want to take the tour?
translation: 想出去走走吗？

original: What the hell is wrong with you? You're sick...
translation: 你到底怎么了？你有病啊……

original: Born and raised that way and damn proud of it.
translation: 天生就这样，还他妈挺自豪的。

original: Look. I have an offer to give you. You can either stand there and be a pain in the ass, or you can listen to what I have to say.
translation: 听着，我有个提议给你。你可以继续站在那儿惹人烦，也可以听听我要说什么。

original: Hey, she's my girl! Take a number!
translation: 嗨，她是我的女孩！排队去！

original: I think you'd better calm down and think long and hard about that.
translation: 我想你最好还是冷静下来，好好考虑下再说。

original: Girdershade is my town, you can't just walk in here and tell me you're taking Sierra.
translation: 梁影村是我的地盘，你可不能就这么走进来告诉我说你要带走塞拉。

original: I'm gonna' be the first one to tap into her goods, not you!
translation: 我才是第一个要进驻她的人，不是你！

original: Whoa, that's kind of kinky, I like it! I wouldn't mind watching that.
translation: 哇哦，这有点变态，我喜欢！我倒是不介意看看。

original: Sorry baby, you'll just have to take a number. I'm gonna' be the first one to tap into Sierra's goods, not you.
translation: 抱歉宝贝，你得排个号了。我才是第一个要进驻塞拉的人，而不是你。

original: Maybe I like messing around.
translation: 或许我就喜欢瞎捣乱。

original: Is there anything else interesting to see near Girdershade?
translation: 梁影村附近还有什么有趣的地方可以看看吗？

original: Well, to the east there are some nasty Raiders in Evergreen Mills. I'd stay away from there if I were you.
translation: 嗯，往东边走，有一群恶心的掠夺者盘踞在常青工厂。如果我是你的话，我会离那远远的。

original: Luckily, we're kind of hidden here under the old highway, so no one bothers us.
translation: 幸运的是，我们在旧高速公路下面的居住点挺隐蔽，所以没人来打扰我们。

original: My friend, you are at the ass end of the Capital Wasteland. If it weren't for Sierra I'd be out of here.
translation: 我的朋友，你现在在首都废土的该死尽头。如果不是为了塞拉，我早就离开这了。

original: One thing I can tell you is stay the hell away from the Dunwich Building to the south. That place is bad mojo.
translation: 我唯一能告诉你的就是该死的离南面的邓维奇大楼远点。那可是个真正的鬼地方。

original: I dunno what that place is about, but I hear about weird shit going on.
translation: 我不知道那地方究竟是怎么回事，但我听说那有很多奇怪的事。

original: Finally, someone who knows what's going on! How do I get out of here?
translation: 终于，有个明白人了！我怎么才能离开这？

original: We're not really here. We're not really talking. It's all made-up, make-believe. We're sleeping, dreaming.
translation: 我们不是真的在这。我们不是真的在说话。这全是虚幻的，伪装的。我们在睡觉，在做梦。

original: The dream became a nightmare. It has to end, it just has to. But we're not in charge. He is, and he doesn't want us to wake up.
translation: 这梦变成了梦魇。这必须结束，必须得结束。但我们无法掌控。是他在管，他不想让我们醒来。

original: What are you talking about? You're not making any sense.
translation: 你在说什么？我不明白你的意思。

original: This. All this, it's all fake! Made-up, a dream world. Only the dream never ends. I want it to end, for all our sakes.
translation: 这些。所有这些，都是假的！捏造的，一个梦中的世界。只是这梦永无止境。我真想让它结束，上帝保佑。

original: He keeps us here, so he can laugh and feel good about himself. But I know. I know what he's doing, and I know he uses the Failsafe.
translation: 他把我们留在这，这样他才能开心，才能自我感觉良好。但我知道。我知道他在做什么，我还知道他在使用故障保护。

original: Get away from me, you crazy old bat.
translation: 离我远点，你这老疯婆。

original: You're the only one who can end it. You must end it, don't you see? You're the only one who can disable the Failsafe!
translation: 你是唯一能结束这一切的人。你必须结束它，你不明白吗？你是唯一能停用故障保险的人！

original: You broke your sacred promise.
translation: 你违背了你神圣的誓言。

original: What are you talking about dear? Is everything alright?
translation: 亲爱的，你在说什么？一切都还好吗？

original: Let me remind you... 'Till death do us part.
translation: 让我来提醒你……直到死亡将我们分开。

original: I found a love letter. I think you'll want to see it.
translation: 我发现了一封情书。我想你会有兴趣看一看的。

original: Oh my God! This can't be real... But it's in his handwriting. Oh my God!
translation: 噢，天啊！这不是真的……但这确实是他的笔迹。噢，天啊！

original: He's dead. I'll kill him. And her. They're both dead.
translation: 他死定了。我会杀了他。还有她。他们都死定了。

original: This isn't happening. This isn't real...
translation: 不会这样。这不是真的……

original: I'd rather keep it.
translation: 我宁愿留着它。

original: Don't you dare let any slaves get wind of it.
translation: 千万别让任何奴隶收到风声。

original: It'll give them ideas about running.
translation: 这会使他们产生逃跑的念头。

original: If they are lost, it will be a great tragedy.
translation: 如果他们失败，那将是一场大悲剧。

original: Please, take great care of them.
translation: 拜托，用心照顾他们。

original: Very well, but I doubt anyone else will appreciate its value as much as I do.
translation: 很好，但我怀疑还有其他人会像我一样感激这事。

original: It's a deal.
translation: 成交。

original: I'll get someone to burn this.
translation: 我会找个人来把它烧了。

original: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
translation: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

original: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
translation: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

original: I'll get this burned right away.
translation: 我会立刻把它烧了。

original: We will enshrine this right away.
translation: 我们会立刻把它悬挂起来。

original: Thanks much!
translation: 多谢！

original: You've got a deal. Here you go.
translation: 成交。给你。

original: How much will you pay for this poster of the Lincoln Memorial?
translation: 你会为了这林肯纪念堂的照片付多少钱？

original: I wouldn't want abolishionists to find this. How about 100 caps? You know nobody else will buy it.
translation: 我不想停止搜寻。100个瓶盖怎么样？你知道，不会有其他人买这东西了。

original: Are you interested in buying a recording of Lincoln's voice?
translation: 你有兴趣买一份录有林肯声音的录音吗？

original: Yeah, I might be interested.
translation: 嗯，我可能会有兴趣。

original: How does 50 caps sound?
translation: 50个瓶盖听起来如何？

original: His real voice? How is that possible? I must have it.
translation: 他真正的声音？这怎么可能？我必须得到它。

original: I'll give you 50 caps for it.
translation: 为了它，我会付给你50个瓶盖的。

original: An actual recording of Lincoln's voice? Amazing!
translation: 一份真正的林肯声音的录音？太棒了！

original: Please, allow me to compensate you for it. I'll pay you 60 caps.
translation: 拜托，让我来补偿你。我会给你60个瓶盖。

original: Would you like to make an offer on Lincoln's Rifle?
translation: 你愿意为林肯步枪出价吗？

original: His rifle you say? Yes, I am interested.
translation: 你是说他的步枪？是的，我有兴趣。

original: Damn! This thing looks like crap. I'll give you 100 caps for it
translation: 该死的！这东西看上去就是个废物。我会付你100个瓶盖。

original: His actual rifle? Such a priceless artifact!
translation: 真是他的步枪？多么宝贵的东西！

original: You must let me have it. I'll give you 150 caps for it.
translation: 你必须把它给我。我会付你150个瓶盖。

original: I can't believe you have that artifact in your possession! What an amazing addition it would make to the museum.
translation: 我简直不能相信你竟然有这东西！这将为博物馆增加一个多么美妙的收藏品啊。

original: I will buy it from you for 100 caps. What do you say?
translation: 我会用100个瓶盖从你那买走。你觉得怎样？

original: I've found Hannibal Hamlin.
translation: 我找到汉尼拔·哈姆林了。

original: Bravo! I guess I owe you some caps.
translation: 漂亮！我想我应该付你一些瓶盖。

original: I'll gather up the boys and we'll go collect him. You can meet us there if you want.
translation: 我会把兄弟们集中起来去抓住他。如果你愿意的话，你可以在那和我们碰头。

original: If I find them, you'll be the first to know.
translation: 如果我找到他们，你将是第一个知道的人。

original: Perfect. Don't go trying to kill them or capture them yourself. I'll take care of that.
translation: 好极了。别试图自己动手杀了或者俘虏他们。那是我的事。

original: Oh, and stay out of the Memorial. My men have standing orders to shoot anyone that gets too close.
translation: 噢，还有，离纪念堂远点。我的人接到的命令是：射杀任何靠得太近的家伙。

original: Actually, I already know he's up north, near Old Olney.
translation: 事实上，我知道他，就在北面，该死的老奥尔尼那。

original: Very clever. Well, I guess I owe you some caps.
translation: 很机灵。好吧，我想我欠你瓶盖了。

original: Tickets please.
translation: 请出示票。

original: Scanning for valid ticket... verified. Thank you for riding with Metro.
translation: 扫描票的有效性……核实。欢迎你乘坐地铁。

original: No entry without tickets. Please present your tickets.
translation: 没票禁入。请出示票。

original: Unauthorized metro use detected.
translation: 发现未授权的地铁使用。

original: Yeah... I have better things to do than talk fashion.
translation: 是的……我有比谈论时尚更好的事去做。

original: Hey, whatever. And here I thought you were cute. Guess you're just the same as everyone else here.
translation: 嗨，随便。我本来还以为你挺可爱。看来你也和这里的其他人一样。

original: Anyway, did you want something or did you just come over here to judge me?
translation: 我说，你是有事呢，还是特意来评判我的？

original: I know! No one understands me either!
translation: 我知道！也没人能理解我！

original: God! It's so nice to have someone who understands! I mean, sure, when I left Little Lamplight, I was happy to be out of there.
translation: 天啊！能得到别人的理解可真好！我是说，当然，当我走出小灯镇时，我非常开心能够离开那里。

original: I was dating Pappy then, you know. I got here and he was all like "Bigtown will be safe", but it wasn't! This place is always under attack!
translation: 那时我正在和帕匹约会，你知道。我到这时他一副“大镇很安全”的样子，但根本不是！这里一直遭到攻击！

original: But I don't date liars, so I dumped his ass and got with Flash. But that didn't last very long. Me and Timebomb were a thing for a while, too.
translation: 但我不会和一个骗子约会的，所以我甩了他跟福莱斯一起走了。但那并没有持续很久。我又和“定时炸弹”好过一阵。

original: This seems like a strange thing to worry about right now.
translation: 现在担心这事会不会太怪了点。

original: That's what they always say. "Blah blah, Bittercup you need to pay attention when you're on patrol". Like, what, I'm supposed to stop slavers?
translation: 那就是他们常说的。“哎哎哎，‘苦杯’，巡逻的时候要集中注意力”。就好象，嗯，该我去阻止那些奴隶贩子？

original: I mean, that's Flash's job, not mine. Besides, it doesn't matter, they're going to get us sooner or later.
translation: 我是说，那是福莱斯的活，不是我的。还有，那其实无所谓，他们早晚都会抓住我们。

original: Back in Lamplight, they always said that Bigtown was a safe place, that there's nothing to worry about when you leave.
translation: 在小灯镇的时候，他们总是说大镇是个安全的地方，在你离开的时候不需要担心任何事。

original: Whatever you say.
translation: 随便你说什么。

original: Oh! You... you... ... ...no one understands me... *sniff*
translation: 噢！你……你……没人能理解我……*气呼呼的*

original: I don't know about that, but Bittercup is one dumbass name.
translation: 那我就不知道了，但“苦杯”真是个蠢名字。

original: FINE! Be that way! You'll be sorry! You'll all be sorry!
translation: 好吧！随便！你们会后悔的！你们全都会后悔的！

original: I'm sorry... erm... Bittercup. What were you saying?
translation: 对不起……喔……“苦杯”。你说什么？

original: Finally! Someone who doesn't judge me! You know, the people here are just so quick to assume that they know everything about you.
translation: 终于！来了个不评判我的人！要知道，这里的人总是飞快地认定他们已经了解了你的一切。

original: I mean, like, just because I look different doesn't mean that I'm some sort of freak, you know? It's like, hello, this world sucks!
translation: 我是说，就像，我看上去不一样并不意味着我就是个怪物，你懂吗？就好象，这世界疯了！

original: No one gets that, they're all like "blah blah blah, what's wrong with that girl?".
translation: 没人会理解，他们只会觉得“哎哎哎，那女孩又怎么了”。

original: Nice to meet you, Bittercup.
translation: 很高兴见到你，“苦杯”。

original: Finally! Someone who doesn't judge me! You know, the people here are just so quick to assume that they know everything about you.
translation: 终于！来了个不评判我的人！要知道，这里的人总是飞快地认定他们已经了解了你的一切。

original: I mean, like, just because I'm different doesn't mean that I'm some sort of freak, you know? It's like, hello, this world sucks!
translation: 我是说，就像，我看上去不一样并不意味着我就是个怪物，你懂吗？就好象，这世界疯了！

original: No one gets that, they're all like "blah blah blah, what's wrong with that girl?".
translation: 没人会理解，他们只会觉得“哎哎哎，那女孩又怎么了”。

original: Bittercup? That's the dumbest name I've ever heard!
translation: “苦杯”？这是我听过的最蠢的名字！

original: No one understands me. You're just like all the others around here.
translation: 没人能理解我。你和这里其他人一样。

original: Thank you! You're a real hero, you know that? I was going to offer you a reward, but I can put the caps to use buying medicine and supplies.
translation: 谢谢你！你是个真正的英雄，你知道吗？我真想给你一份奖励，但我可以把这些钱用在购买药品和补给上。

original: I'm glad you're safe and sound. And please, I don't want any kind of reward.
translation: 很高兴你能安然无恙，不过你也不必谢我，没必要。

original: Right. What do you want?
translation: 好吧。你想要什么？

original: I mean you no harm. I'm a simple traveler.
translation: 我对你没有恶意。我只是个过路的。

original: Big Town. You've never heard of it? It's where all the grownups go.
translation: 大镇。你没听说过吗？那是所有长大了的家伙们要去的地方。

original: Well, at least when they grow up and out of Little Lamplight.
translation: 嗯，至少是在他们长大了并且要离开小灯镇的时候。

original: I can show you the way! There's no reason to waste your time with a bunch of snot-nosed kids. Let's go now!
translation: 我可以给你指路！你没理由把时间浪费在一群流鼻涕的小鬼身上。我们走吧！

original: Where the grownups live?
translation: 大人都住在哪里？

original: How about I just kill them all?
translation: 我把他们都杀了怎么样？

original: That's tempting, but no.
translation: 那确实很诱人，但别那么做。

original: Hannibal is a runaway. His owner wants him back. Just let me know if you find him, and I'll take care of the rest.
translation: 汉尼拔是个逃亡者，他的主人想要他回去。你只要找到他并回报我就好，我会自行处理剩余的事。

original: You wait here. Let me investigate first.
translation: 你在这等着。让我先来调查一下。

original: They look heavily fortified. They knew we were coming. I'm afraid our only choice is to drive them out.
translation: 它们看起来被很好地加固了。他们知道我们会来。恐怕我们唯一的机会就是把他们都赶出来。

original: If you don't do it, we will.
translation: 如果你不那么做，我们也会。

original: Don't be too long. My people can't wait here forever.
translation: 别太久。我的人不会永远等在这。

original: Just stay here. I'm not done yet at the Memorial.
translation: 先留在这。纪念堂那我还没清理完。

original: I'll give you six hours. Then we're moving on anyway.
translation: 我给你六小时。在那之后我们无论如何都会继续前进。

original: Wait here. I need to scout ahead.
translation: 在这等等。我到前面打探一下。

original: Finally! Thank you for all your help.
translation: 终于！谢谢你提供的所有帮助。

original: Okay, it's safe.
translation: 没问题，很安全。

original: Never heard of him. If I find anything, though, I'll be sure to show it to you.
translation: 从没听说过他。如果我发现任何东西，我会让你知道的。

original: I'm glad to see we understand each other.
translation: 很高兴我们达成了共识。

original: My sources say the old Museum of History might have some, but I can't spare anyone to go look.
translation: 我的情报显示老历史博物馆那可能有一些，但我没有多余的人手可以去查看。

original: Just make sure I get first crack at anything you find.
translation: 只要确保我是第一个看到你找到的东西的人就好。

original: Never heard of it. Is it a ruin around here?
translation: 从没听说过。那是这附近的一个废墟吗？

original: Not exactly. That means you aren't much of a threat to us, so let me tell you a bit more.
translation: 不是那样。那意味着你对我们来说不是个威胁，让我来多告诉你些事吧。

original: We're setting up a base to excavate these ruins. We're looking for anything related to Abraham Lincoln.
translation: 我们正在设立一个发掘这些废墟的基地。我们在寻找一切与亚伯拉罕·林肯有关的东西。

original: So if I find anything like that, you might buy it from me?
translation: 那么无论我找到任何东西，你都可能会买走它？

original: I like the way your mind works.
translation: 我喜欢你思考的方式。

original: Tell you what. I can't spare anyone to go poking in the old Museum. If you find anything in there, I'll buy it off you.
translation: 告诉你吧。我分不出人手去发掘老博物馆了。如果你在那发现了什么，我会从你手上买走它。

original: Actually, I can leave her for the Radroaches. Just watch me.
translation: 事实上，我会把她留给那些辐射蟑螂。走着瞧吧。

original: No! Please! I'll do anything! You can join the Tunnel Snakes! I'll be your best friend forever! You gotta help her!
translation: 不！求求你！我会做任何事来报答你！你可以加入穴蛇帮！我会永远做你最好的朋友！你得帮帮她！

original: Why do you need my help, anyway? Afraid of a few Radroaches?
translation: 无论如何，你为什么需要我来帮忙？才那么点辐射蟑螂就令你害怕吗？

original: Well... yeah, so I hate Radroaches. So what? I tried to go back in to help her, I swear I did! But I just can't do it!
translation: 嗯……是的，我讨厌辐射蟑螂。那又怎样？我试过要回去帮她，我发誓！可我实在做不到！

original: So I'm begging you, please help her. I don't know what I'd do without my mom.
translation: 我恳求你，拜托你帮帮她。我真不知道失去了妈妈我该怎么办。

original: All right. I'll help. But I'm doing this for your mom, not for you.
translation: 好吧。我会帮忙的。但这只是为了你妈妈，而不是你。

original: Sure. I don't care why. Just get her out of there!
translation: 当然。我不在乎。赶快把她弄出来吧！

original: I've got a game you can play. It's called "Hide and Go Fuck Yourself."
translation: 你可以玩玩我这游戏。它叫“自己他妈的躲起来。”

original: Potty mouth!
translation: 你这臭嘴！

original: You're mean. Leave me alone!
translation: 你太过分了。离我远点！

original: Hey, look what I found. You're getting sent to military school. <Lie.>
translation: 嗨，告诉你我听到的事。你会被送到军事学校去。<撒谎>

original: What? No I'm not!
translation: 什么？不，我不会去的！

original: I can't take your babbling. You're on your own. Good luck getting to Big Town.
translation: 我受不了你的叽叽喳喳。你得靠自己。祝你顺利到达大镇。

original: What? But you said you'd take me. This bites. You really suck, you know that?! I hope a mutant bites your face off and you die! I hate you!
translation: 什么？但你说你会带我去的。这真过分。你真是混蛋，你知道吗？！我真希望变种人会把你的脸咬下来让你去死！我恨你！

original: You're starting to get on my nerves, Sticky...
translation: 你开始让我不快了，斯蒂奇……

original: Oh... I'm sorry. I was just really excited. I'll, ah... I'll shut up now.
translation: 噢……对不起。我只是太兴奋了。我会，啊……从现在起我会闭上嘴的。

original: Wow, you're annoying. You'd better make this worth my time.
translation: 哇喔，你可真讨厌。你最好别浪费我的时间。

original: Um... yeah... I got tons of caps at Big Town. Well, they're not mine really. My girl friend's got them. Her name's Red.
translation: 嗯……是的……我在大镇有很多钱。嗯，事实上那不算是我的。那是我女朋友的。她的名字叫瑞德。

original: She's a doctor, so she's sure to have lots of money. She'll give them to you for making sure I get there safely.
translation: 她是个医生，所以她肯定很有钱。她确认你把我安全送达后就会给你钱。

original: I'm not playing this game.
translation: 我没兴趣玩这游戏。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: No, YOU shut up!
translation: 不，你闭嘴！

original: Shut up, you!
translation: 闭嘴！

original: You stop talking!
translation: 你别说了！

original: Just quit talking.
translation: 别说了。

original: No, you shut it!
translation: 不，你闭嘴！

original: Shut it!
translation: 闭嘴！

original: You zip it first!
translation: 你先把嘴闭上！

original: Zip it!
translation: 闭嘴！

original: La-la-la-la-laaaaa! YOU shut up!
translation: 废话连篇！你闭嘴！

original: Shut up! Shut up! Shut up!
translation: 闭嘴！闭嘴！闭嘴！

original: For the love of God... Shut the hell up!
translation: 上帝……你给我闭嘴！

original: You shut up!
translation: 你闭嘴！

original: Where's Big Town located?
translation: 大镇到底在哪？

original: You have?
translation: 你去过吗？

original: I mean of course you have, it's an awesome place. Well, enough talking, let's get a move on. You ARE taking me to Big Town, right?
translation: 我的意思是，你当然去过，那是个奇妙的地方。好了，我们说的够多了，让我们起程吧。你会带我到大镇去，是这样吧？

original: Big Town? I've been there before.
translation: 大镇？我之前去过那儿。

original: It's east of Little Lamplight. Come on, let's go there. It's not that far away. We'll be there in no time!
translation: 它就在小灯镇东面。来吧，我们到那去。那并没有多远。这花不了我们多少时间！

original: All right, let's go to Big Town.
translation: 好吧，我们到大镇去。

original: Alright! Yeah! Big Town, here we come!
translation: 好极了！耶！大镇，我们来了！

original: Once upon a time, there was this man...
translation: 很久很久以前，有一个男人……

original: Once upon a time, there was this dog...
translation: 很久很久以前，有一条狗……

original: Once upon a time, there was this robot...
translation: 很久很久以前，有一个机器人……

original: His name was Holy Toledo, and he was really powerful...
translation: 他名叫圣托莱多，他拥有强大的力量……

original: His name was Super Dupe Dave, and he went all around rescuing people from Super Mutants and Slavers, and other nasty things...
translation: 他名叫超级走狗戴夫，他游历四方，将人们从超级变种人、奴隶贩子和其他恶心的东西手中拯救出来……

original: His name was Joking Joe, and he went all around making everyone laugh really hard at all his funny jokes...
translation: 他名叫玩笑乔，他游历四方，用他那有趣的笑话来给所有人带来欢乐……

original: And one day this giant Super Mutant attacked him and tried carrying him off!
translation: 一天，巨大的超级变种人攻击他，并且想要杀死他！

original: And one day a space ship from outer space landed right in front of him, and a big green alien jumped out and started eating people!
translation: 一天，外天空来的太空船降落在他面前，一个巨大的绿色外星人从里面跳了出来，并开始吃人！

original: And one day a giant ant came up to him and started talking like he wasn't some dumb ant, but a person of some kind! It said, "Prepare to die!"
translation: 一天，巨蚁来到他面前开始讲话，不像不会说话的蚂蚁，倒像个人类。它说，“准备去死吧！”

original: And was our brave hero scared? No. Not all all, he laughed in the face of danger... "Ha ha ha!" He beat up the monster and everyone cheered!
translation: 我们勇敢的英雄害怕了吗？不。完全没有，他笑对威胁……“哈哈哈！” 他打倒了怪兽，所有人都在为他欢呼！

original: And was our so-called hero scared? You bet he was. He cried like a little baby! "Waa! Waa! Waaaaah!!!" And all his friends laughed at him!
translation: 我们所谓的英雄害怕了吗？当然了。他简直哭得像个婴儿！“哇！哇！哇哇哇哇！！！” 他所有的朋友都在嘲笑他！

original: And what did our hero do, you wonder. He came up with the most cleverest of clever plans... and it worked! And everyone called him a genius!
translation: 我们的英雄做了什么，你根本想不到。他在所有聪明的办法里挑出了最聪明的那……而且很有效！所有人都称他为天才！

original: The End! Thank you, thank you very much!
translation: 故事结束！谢谢，非常感谢！

original: The End! That's all folks!
translation: 故事结束！这就是一切！

original: The End!
translation: 故事结束！

original: MS01StickyHandsEscort
translation: MS01StickyHands护卫

original: I know, let's make up a story to pass the time.
translation: 我明白了，我们编个故事来打发时间吧。

original: Are we there yet?
translation: 我们到了吗？

original: Why is this taking so long?
translation: 这怎么会花这么长时间？

original: Are you lost?
translation: 你迷路了吗？

original: <whistling tunelessly>
translation: <随意乱哼>

original: Right. Be sneaky. I can do that!
translation: 好的。潜行。我能做到！

original: Oh, we're sneaking around now? Cool!
translation: 噢，我们现在潜行了吗？酷！

original: Shhh!
translation: 嘘！

original: I'll wait over here for you. When you're done playing with the children we'll go to Big Town.
translation: 我会在这等你。等你跟这些孩子玩够了，我们再去大镇。

original: I'm not a baby! I'm a grownup!
translation: 我不是个小孩了！我是个大人了！

original: That's why I'm going to Big Town. Because I'm not a little kid anymore.
translation: 那就是我为什么要去大镇。因为我再也不是个小孩子了。

original: So you see: I don't need you. Good luck with those kids! You're gonna need it.
translation: 你得明白：我不需要你。祝你跟那些小鬼好运！你会需要好运的。

original: You're on your own. I'm not interested in babysitting duty.
translation: 你自己负责。我可没兴趣给你们当保姆。

original: Oh I see. Well... thank you anyway!
translation: 噢，知道了。好吧……不管怎样，谢谢！

original: I know you've already risked your life once already, but I heard the Mutants talking about another attack. They'll probably be here soon...
translation: 我知道你已经冒过一次生命危险了，但我听说变种人正在策划另一次攻击。他们可能很快就会到这来……

original: Don't thank me. I got what I wanted out of it.
translation: 不用感谢我，我已经得到我想要的了。

original: Well, you can never be too careful! Be warned it's not safe here. Super Mutants attacked recently and carried off some of our friends.
translation: 嗯，小心谨慎永不为过！警告你，这不再安全了。超级变种人最近攻击了这并抓走了我们的朋友。

original: Come in. Just don't cause any trouble, okay?
translation: 进来吧。只要别引起麻烦就好，好吗？

original: Do you harass all of your visitors like this?
translation: 你们都是这样欢迎来访者的吗？

original: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

original: I know you've already risked your life once already, but I heard the Mutants talking about another attack. They'll probably be here soon...
translation: 我知道你已经冒过一次生命危险了，但我听说变种人正在策划另一次攻击。他们可能很快就会到这来……

original: It was my pleasure!
translation: 乐意之至！

original: Alright. There's a back door somewhere nearby we can use. Let's go!
translation: 好吧。这有个我们可以用的后门。我们走吧！

original: Enough chit-chat. It's time to get out of here.
translation: 够了。该走了。

original: You don't have to tell me twice. Let's go!
translation: 你用不着告诉我两次。我们走吧！

original: Enough chit-chat. It's time to get out of here.
translation: 够了。该走了。

original: Um... yeah... I got lots of caps! But they, um, they're at Big Town, so I can give them to you when we get there. Yeah!
translation: 嗯……是的……我有很多钱！但它们，嗯，它们在大镇，所以只要我们到了那，我就能付你钱了。耶！

original: Take me to Big Town and you'll get your reward. My girlfriend Red has lots of caps.
translation: 带我到大镇你就会得到你的报酬。我的女朋友瑞德有很多钱。

original: Ill wait for you outside, unless you want to go now?
translation: 我会在外面等你，除非你现在就想走？

original: You got any caps? I'll escort you Big Town, but it'll cost you.
translation: 你有盖子吗？我能送你去大镇，不过你要付报酬。

original: A funny guy, huh? Well... fine. You may as well come on in.
translation: 一个有趣的家伙，呃？嗯……好吧。那你进来吧。

original: Don't think you're any safer in here, though. Super Mutants won't leave us alone. Carried off some of our friends during the last attack.
translation: 尽管如此，别以为你在这会很安全。超级变种人不会放过我们的。他们在上次攻击中抓走了一些我们的朋友。

original: Just don't cause any trouble, okay?
translation: 只是别引起任何麻烦，好吗？

original: Oh, I don't know. I was thinking I'd start a few fires and kill some people.
translation: 哦，我不知道。我想我应该大开杀戒了。

original: Well, I guess you can have this. It's the money I was saving to buy medicine for the town's people.
translation: 嗯，我想你可以拿走这些。这是我用来为镇里的人们买药的钱。

original: I know you've already risked your life once already, but I heard the Mutants talking about another attack. They'll probably be here soon...
translation: 我知道你已经冒过一次生命危险了，但我听说变种人正在策划另一次攻击。他们可能很快就会到这来……

original: I saved your life. This is all I get? Surely you can spare a little more.
translation: 我救了你的命。你就给我这么点？你还是再拿多点来吧。

original: Everyone else is dead or taken away to who knows where. Let's hurry back to Big Town!
translation: 所有的人，要么死了，要么就被带到不知什么地方去了。我们快去大镇吧！

original: Is there anyone else?
translation: 那还有其他人吗？

original: Everyone else is dead or taken away to who knows where...
translation: 所有的人，要么死了，要么就被带到不知什么地方去了……

original: Well, except maybe for Shorty! They dragged him off downstairs to the kitchen a while ago.
translation: 嗯，除了“矮子”外！他们刚刚把他拖到楼下的厨房去了。

original: But no one comes back from the kitchen.
translation: 但是从没有人能从厨房回来。

original: Is there anyone else?
translation: 那还有其他人吗？

original: I'm not allowed in Little Lamplight anymore.
translation: 我被赶出小灯镇了。

original: Only people under 18 get to live in Little Lamplight
translation: 只有18岁以下的人才能住在小灯镇里。

original: So, when your done with those little kids, we can go to Big Town together! I'll wait outside for you.
translation: 当你搞定这帮小鬼的事后，我们就能一起到大镇去了！我会在外面等你。

original: Fine. I'll take you to Big Town. But first I need to visit Little Lamplight.
translation: 好的。我会带你去大镇。但我要先在小灯镇周围看看。

original: Well, you can never be too careful. Be warned it's not safe here. Super Mutants have attacked recently and carried off some of our friends.
translation: 嗯，小心谨慎永远不为过！警告你，这不再安全了。超级变种人最近攻击了这并抓走了我们的朋友。

original: Come in. Just don't cause any trouble, okay?
translation: 进来吧。只要别引起麻烦就好，好吗？

original: I just want to look around a little. Don't worry about me. I won't hurt you.
translation: 我只是在这周围看看。不用管我，我不会伤害你的。

original: Nah, I'm a grownup now. I can handle myself.
translation: 不，我现在是大人了，我能照顾好自己。

original: There's no reason to waste your time with the kiddies at Little Lamplight. They'll steal your caps when you aren't looking.
translation: 你没有理由把时间浪费在小灯镇的小鬼身上。他们会在你不注意的时候偷走你的钱。

original: So let's go to Big Town. I can show you the way!
translation: 我们去大镇吧。我来带路！

original: Looks to me like you want someone to escort you to Big Town.
translation: 看起来你需要个人把你护送到大镇去。

original: Right. Of course. Rescuing me was a job to you, and you're a real professional. Well, here you go. I wish I had more I could give you.
translation: 好吧。当然了。援救我是你的工作，而你是个真正的专家。好吧，给你。我希望可以给你更多。

original: You are planning on giving me a reward for rescuing you, right?
translation: 我救了你会有报酬的，对吧？

original: Take it easy. I'm just doing my job. What do you want?
translation: 放松。我只是在做我的工作。你想怎样？

original: I'm Queen of the Wasteland. What does it matter? You going to let me in or not?
translation: 我是废土女王，这有什么关系？你到底让不让我进去？

original: Easy there, pal. I'm just doing my job. What do you want?
translation: 放松，伙计。我只是在做我的工作。你想怎样？

original: I'm King of the Wasteland. What does it matter? You going to let me in or not?
translation: 我是废土之王，这有什么关系？你到底让不让我进去？

original: Alright. And now that you're done, what are you still doing here?
translation: 好吧。那么这没你的事了，你还在这做什么？

original: I'm escorting Sticky from Little Lamplight.
translation: 我正在护送来自小灯镇的斯蒂奇。

original: Why would you want to visit a bunch of snot-nosed children?
translation: 你为什么要见一群流鼻涕的小鬼呢？

original: Wouldn't you rather go to Big Town?
translation: 难道你不愿意去大镇吗？

original: Of course you would! Come on. Let's go. I can show you the way!
translation: 你肯定愿意！来吧。我们走。我会给你指路的！

original: I want to visit Little Lamplight first. Maybe later.
translation: 我打算先参观一下小灯镇。迟点再说。

original: Hey you. Yeah you! Don't bother with the children at Little Lamplight. Let's go to Big Town instead!
translation: 嗨，你。就是你！别跟这帮小灯镇的小鬼混了。我们还是到大镇去吧！

original: Nah, I'm just kidding.
translation: 不，我只是开玩笑。

original: That's a dumb joke. You're not funny at all.
translation: 这笑话可不好笑。你一点都没有趣。

original: Look, I've got the brochure right here. You're going, pal.
translation: 听着，我才是发号施令的人。你去，伙计。

original: But, but... I don't want to go away! I don't want to leave my mommy!
translation: 但是，但是……我不想离开！我不想离开我妈妈！

original: [crying]
Why is my father so determined to work on this project again?
translation: 父亲为何要执意再度开展此项工程？

original: Project Purity was everything to us. It was the first thing we thought about when we woke up, the last thing we talked about before sleep.
translation: 净水工程对我们来说曾意味着一切。它曾是我们每天醒来时想到的第一件事，也是我们临睡前讨论的最后一件事。

original: Some of us changed over the years, but apparently James hasn't.
translation: 我们中的一部分人这些年来已经变了，但很明显，詹姆斯并没有。

original: Why wouldn't you help him when he came to you?
translation: 为什么在他来找你的时候你不给他提供帮助？

original: I don't have to justify myself to you, you know.
translation: 要知道，我没必要向你证明我做的事是对的。

original: Look, I appreciate that your father still wants to see Project Purity running. For the rest of us, though...
translation: 听着，我很欣赏你父亲仍希望净水工程能维持运做的想法，即使是，为了我们其他人……

original: It's just been too long. Too much has happened, and going back now would be a waste. It's just not worth it.
translation: 但实在过了太久。太多事发生了，现在回头只是浪费时间。这不值得。

original: Hostilities will not be tolerated.
translation: 恶意不会被容忍。

original: Please refrain from disturbing our other residents.
translation: 请不要干扰到其他居民。

original: Please do not disturb the other residents. Take your seat.
translation: 请不要打扰其他的居民，请就座。

original: A Tranquility Lounger is available. Please be seated.
translation: 开启宁静巷催眠舱，请就座。

original: Please find the nearest Tranquility Lounger and be seated.
translation: 请就座于最近的宁静巷催眠舱。

original: Please take a seat in the nearest available Tranquility Lounger. Thank you for your cooperation.
translation: 请就座于最近的宁静巷催眠舱。谢谢你的合作。

original: Mommy? Mommy?! No! [crying]
translation: 妈咪？妈咪？！不！[呜]

original: Daddy? Daddy?! No! [crying]
translation: 爹地？爹地？！不！[呜]

original: Sorry, Butch. You're on your own. I've got to go.
translation: 对不起，布奇。你得靠自己了。我要走了。

original: You're a real bastard, you know that? I hate your fucking guts!
translation: 你真是杂种，知道吗？我他妈恨死你了！

original: Get away from me, you sick bastard!
translation: 给我滚吧，你这恶心的杂种！

original: No, I'm just fucking with you. I came back to see if your mom was dead yet.
translation: 不，我是在逗你玩。我回来看看你妈是不是已经死了。

original: Here, take my BB Gun. You don't need to be scared of the Roaches now.
translation: 给，拿着我的BB枪。这样你就不用怕那些蟑螂了。

original: Wow, where'd you get that? Okay, okay. Maybe I can do this.
translation: 哇喔，你从哪弄到的？好的，好的。或许我能办到。

original: Alright. I'm gonna go back in there and kill those damn roaches. Thanks!
translation: 好吧。我要回去干掉那些该死的蟑螂了。谢谢！

original: This would squish those little buggers real nice. Okay, okay. Maybe I can do this.
translation: 这会把那些小虫子打扁的。好的，好的。或许我能做到。

original: Alright. I'm gonna go back in there and kill those damn roaches. Thanks!
translation: 好吧。我要回去干掉那些该死的蟑螂了。谢谢！

original: Here, take my Baseball Bat. Now you can handle the Roaches on your own.
translation: 给，把我的棒球棒拿去。现在你可以自己对付那些辐射蟑螂了。

original: Fine. I'll save your mom.
translation: 好吧。我会去救你妈妈的。

original: Oh my God, thank you. Of course I'll shut up. I promise, I won't tell anybody I saw you. You can count on me.
translation: 噢，我的天啊，谢谢你。我当然会闭上嘴巴。我发誓，我不会告诉任何人我看见过你的。你可以信任我。

original: Look, if you just shut up I'll go save your mom.
translation: 听着，如果你立刻闭嘴，我就会去救你妈妈。

original: Oh my God, thank you. I didn't know what to do. You're the best!
translation: 噢，天啊，谢谢你。我真不知道该怎么谢谢你，你是最棒的！

original: Oh my God, thank you. You're right, I am an asshole. But you -- you're the best!
translation: 噢，我的天啊，谢谢你。你是对的，我是个混蛋。但你 — 你是最棒的！

original: Yeah, I decided to help her after all. But I still think you're an asshole.
translation: 嗯，虽然我决定去帮助她，但我还是觉得你是个人渣。

original: Well ain't you just a regular bushy tailed mother fucker today?
translation: 嗯，你不是个该死的拖油瓶吗？

original: What's so good about it?
translation: 好吗？

original: Good morning? What the hell is wrong with you?
translation: 早上好？该死的你怎么了？

original: Fuck off.
translation: 滚蛋吧。

original: Yo.
translation: 哟。

original: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: What's goin' on?
translation: 怎么了？

original: S'up?
translation: 什么事？

original: Nice night.
translation: 晚上好。

original: Good morning!
translation: 早上好！

original: What a good morning!
translation: 多么棒的早晨！

original: Come again, come again.  Any truckers on this wave?
translation: 重复，重复。这波段上有人吗？

original: I read you, buddy.  Y'all see those clouds?  Over.
translation: 我收到了，伙计。你们都看到那些云了吗？完毕。

original: 10-4, it's the commies.  Let's circle the wagons, meet us at the state line on Route Seven.
translation: 10-4，是共党。提高戒备，我们在州际线的第七站上见。

original: You got a deal -- I'll pass the word along on my way.  Over and out.
translation: 好的 — 我会把这些话沿途转告的。完毕。

original: Um... no. I'm not going to help you. Bye, Butch.
translation: 嗯……不。我不准备帮你。再见，布奇。

original: You're a real bastard, you know that? I hate your guts, you fucking coward!
translation: 你是个真正的杂种，知道吗？我恨死你了，你这他妈的懦夫！

original: Begging... I like that. Let's hear some more begging.
translation: 乞求……我喜欢。再多来点乞求听听看。

original: Okay, sure! Uh, you can join the Tunnel Snakes! I'll be your best friend forever! Whatever you want. Just save my mom!
translation: 好吧，当然了！嗯，你可以加入穴蛇帮！我会永远做你最好的朋友！无论你想要什么都可以。救救我妈妈吧！

original: Ooh, I could be a Tunnel Snake!? Good luck with the Roaches. I'm out of here.
translation: 哦，我能成为穴蛇帮！？祝这些蟑螂们好运。我要走了。

original: You're a real bastard, you know that? I hate your guts, you fucking coward!
translation: 你是个真正的杂种，知道吗？我恨死你了，你这他妈的懦夫！

original: Forget I mentioned it.
translation: 忘了我说的。

original: You would do well to side with my employer in this little matter. Life could otherwise become quite unbearable for you.
translation: 在这次事件中，你最好站在我老板这边。如果你不这么做，会有大麻烦。

original: I told Simms I'd disarm it. Maybe some extra caps would change my mind...
translation: 我告诉了西姆斯我会解除它。或许一些额外的瓶盖会令我改变心意……

original: Indeed. A man's word is worth his weight in caps. I suppose I could arrange for a bonus of say, 500 caps in addition to the base fee.
translation: 确实如此。一诺千金。我想我可以安排一些奖励，比如，在原价上再加500个瓶盖。

original: When it's done, meet me at Tenpenny Tower. It's southwest of here, well out of harm's way. You can't miss it. Any questions?
translation: 搞定后来特佩尼大厦见我。它在这的西南方，一个很安全的地方，你不会找不到的。还有问题吗？

original: Have you thought about disarming the bomb?
translation: 你有想过去解除核弹吗？

original: Oh, I couldn’t do that! It’d be a real blow to those nice folks in the Church.
translation: 哦，我不能那么做！那可是会把教堂里的那些好人气疯的。

original: Besides, it’s not like that bomb ever hurt anyone. Live and let live, right?
translation: 还有，那核弹看上去并没有伤害到任何人。我们相互忍让，不是吗？

original: Now that, my friend, is beautiful.
translation: 看，我的朋友，那很美。

original: Well done, Mister Burke! What a grand display of fireworks! I almost wish there was another nuke we could detonate. You don't see that very often.
translation: 干得好，伯克先生！多么盛大的焰火晚会啊！我甚至希望我们可以再去弄一颗核弹来引爆了。这种事一辈子也难看到一次。

original: I'm glad you're pleased. I had help, of course.
translation: 很高兴令你满意。当然，我得到了一些帮助。

original: Quite right. And you are to offer him the reward we discussed. Now... all this bright light and wind has given me quite a thirst. Where's my scotch?
translation: 十分正确。你来把我们商量好的报酬赏给他吧。嗯……这些亮光和强风真让我感到口渴。我的威士忌在哪？

original: Quite right. And you are to offer her the reward we discussed. Now... all this bright light and wind has given me quite a thirst. Where's my scotch?
translation: 十分正确。你来把我们商量好的报酬赏给她吧。嗯……这些亮光和强风真让我感到口渴。我的威士忌在哪？

original: I'll send someone up as soon as I've completed business with our friend here.
translation: 我和我们的朋友在这边的事一完，我就会派人过去。

original: Righto. And be quick about it! I haven't been dry in years. I'd hate to start now.
translation: 好的。动作快点！我近年来都没有这么口干过。现在我开始讨厌了。

original: You're big. They're little. Just go back in there and squish them. Be a hero!
translation: 你个子很大。而它们很小。只要走回那去压烂他们就好。做个英雄吧！

original: You know what... you're right! They aren't anything I can't handle. Tunnel Snakes rule!
translation: 你知道吗……你是对的！他们不是什么我对付不了的东西。穴蛇帮主宰一切！

original: Your mom's already done for. You'd better run before those Roaches come for you.
translation: 你妈妈已经完了。你最好在那些蟑螂转过头来对付你之前逃走。

original: Oh my God, you're right! I can hear their little scratchy feet coming this way. I gotta get out of here!
translation: 噢，天啊，你是对的！我能听到它们悉悉索索的脚步声正朝这边过来。我得赶快离开这！

original: I don't suppose there's more you can tell me about Oasis?
translation: 我想关于绿洲你没法告诉我更多了？

original: Sorry, I believe that duty lay with Tree Father Birch.
translation: 抱歉，我想这得“树之父”伯奇来做。

original: No, maybe some other time.
translation: 不，或许下次吧。

original: Oh! Well, let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 噢！好吧，如果你改变主意的话，告诉我。

original: Yes, I'd like to speak to Tree Father Birch.
translation: 是的，我想要和“树之父”布尔奇聊聊。

original: I was hoping you'd say that. Please, proceed inside.
translation: 意料之中。请进。

original: Perhaps some other time. I have more urgent matters to attend to.
translation: 或许下次吧。我现在有更要紧的事。

original: I'm very saddened to hear that, a great opportunity like this may come only once in a lifetime.
translation: 听到你这么说我很遗憾，像这样的好机会一辈子只有一次。

original: If you wish to return and speak to me, talk to Branchtender Maple. She'll allow you to go inside.
translation: 如果你想回来找我谈谈，就和“护枝人”梅坡说吧。她会让你进去。

original: All I ask is you keep our existence a secret. Too many out there in the Wasteland would seek to exploit Him. Farewell.
translation: 我只求你对我们的存在保密。废土上有太多人想要找到并利用祂。再会。

original: No way! You're obviously out of your mind!
translation: 没门！你显然是疯了！

original: I'm very saddened to hear that, a great opportunity like this may come only once in a lifetime.
translation: 听到你这么说我很遗憾，像这样的好机会一辈子只有一次。

original: If you wish to return and speak to me, talk to Branchtender Maple. She'll allow you to go inside.
translation: 如果你想回来找我谈谈，就和“护枝人”梅坡说吧。她会让你进去。

original: All I ask is you keep our existence a secret. Too many out there in the Wasteland would seek to exploit Him. Farewell.
translation: 我只求你对我们的存在保密。废土上有太多人想要找到并利用祂。再会。

original: Okay, I'll follow you. Lead on.
translation: 好吧，我会跟你走。带路吧。

original: Excellent! Please, follow me. All will be explained soon.
translation: 太好了！请跟我来。很快都会向你解释清楚的。

original: I'm not following anyone. I need to be on my way.
translation: 我谁也不跟。我得赶路了。

original: I can promise you that if you leave, you'll be missing out on a great honor. Not many have even seen Him before, and yet he wants to speak to you.
translation: 我可以向你保证，如果你就此离开，就会错失一项莫大的荣耀。以前见过祂的人少之又少，而祂却想要和你谈谈。

original: Please, I beg you. Don't make Him wait any longer. Follow me inside to the Pavilion, and I promise all will be explained!
translation: 求你了，别让祂再等了。跟我到里面的亭子里去，我保证一切都会得到解释！

original: The Treeminders?
translation: 树启者？

original: Yes, we're the Treeminders. We're His people.
translation: 是的，我们是树启者。我们是祂的子民。

original: If you'll just follow me inside to the Pavilion, all will be explained.
translation: 只要你跟我到亭中，一切都会得到解释。

original: Who's waiting for me inside?
translation: 谁在里面等我？

original: Why, He is of course.
translation: 哎呀，当然是祂啦。

original: If you'll just follow me to the Pavilion, all will be explained.
translation: 只要你跟我到亭中，一切都会解释清楚的。

original: Sure, lead on.
translation: 行，带路吧。

original: Excellent! Please, follow me. All will be explained soon.
translation: 太好了！请跟我来。很快都会向你解释清楚的。

original: Whoa, whoa. Slow down, old man. What the hell are you babbling about?
translation: 哇，哇。慢点说，老头。你到底在胡说些什么？

original: I'm sorry, in my excitement, I got ahead of myself.
translation: 很抱歉，我太激动了，有些操之过急了。

original: I'm Tree Father Birch, and I have the great fortune of being leader of His people, the Treeminders.
translation: 我是“树之父”伯奇，有幸成为了祂的子民——树启者的首领。

original: Beyond that gate is our home, Oasis.
translation: 那扇门后就是我们的家园，绿洲。

original: Ha ha ha! What the hell are you wearing?
translation: 哈哈哈！你穿的这是什么鬼？

original: I am wearing the clothes of a Treeminder. We shed our Wasteland garments like the ones you're wearing long ago.
translation: 我穿的是树启者的衣服。我们早就抛弃了你现在穿的这种废土服饰。

original: I'm not following anyone until I know what's going on here.
translation: 在弄清楚这里是怎么回事之前，我不会跟任何人走。

original: I'm sorry, in my excitement, I got ahead of myself.
translation: 很抱歉，我太激动了，有些操之过急了。

original: I'm Tree Father Birch, and I have the great fortune of being leader of His people, the Treeminders.
translation: 我是“树之父”伯奇，有幸成为了祂的子民——树启者的首领。

original: Beyond that gate is our home, Oasis.
translation: 那扇门后就是我们的家园，绿洲。

original: Just a minute. Who are you and what is this place?
translation: 等一下。你是谁，这又是什么地方？

original: I'm sorry, in my excitement, I got ahead of myself.
translation: 很抱歉，我太激动了，有些操之过急了。

original: I'm Tree Father Birch, and I have the great fortune of being leader of His people, the Treeminders.
translation: 我是“树之父”伯奇，有幸成为了祂的子民——树启者的首领。

original: Beyond that gate is our home, Oasis.
translation: 那扇门后就是我们的家园，绿洲。

original: I think you're all a bunch of lunatics.
translation: 我觉得你们就是一帮疯子。

original: Ha ha ha. I don't expect you to understand everything you see here. After all, you carry the taint of technology upon you.
translation: 哈哈哈。我并不指望你能理解在这看到的一切。毕竟，你身上带着科技的“污点”。

original: Treeminders shun technology and embrace nature. All technology has brought the world is violence and death.
translation: 护树人摒弃科技而拥抱自然。科技给这个世界带来的只有暴力和死亡。

original: Treeminders, huh? That's a strange name.
translation: 护树人，呃？是个奇怪的名字。

original: Is it so strange to care for one's home and keep it safe from those who would seek to exploit it?
translation: 照料自己的家园，让它免受那些试图剥削它的人的伤害，这很奇怪吗？

original: He gives to us, so we give back to Him. It's an arrangement that's worked well for almost two decades.
translation: 祂给予我们，所以我们也回报祂。这样的安排已经良好地运作了近二十年。

original: We shun technology and embrace nature. That's the life of a Treeminder.
translation: 我们摒弃科技而拥抱自然。那就是护树人的生活方式。

original: Why do you call yourselves Treeminders?
translation: 为什么你们自称为“护树人”？

original: We care for this place and keep it safe from those who would seek to exploit it.
translation: 我们照料这里，并从那些想要开垦他的人手中保护这地方。

original: He gives to us, so we give back to Him. It's an arrangement that's worked well for almost two decades.
translation: 祂给予我们，所以我们也回报祂。这样的安排已经良好地运作了近二十年。

original: We shun technology and embrace nature. That's the life of a Treeminder.
translation: 我们摒弃科技而拥抱自然。那就是护树人的生活方式。

original: Can you cut the "Him" crap already and just tell me who he is?
translation: 你能不能别再拿“祂”这套说辞糊弄我了，直接告诉我他是谁？

original: He is the One Who Grows, He is the One Who Gives and He is the One Who Guides.
translation: 祂是万物培育者，是慷慨赐予者，也是方向指引者。

original: No one speaks His name out of reverence for His majesty.
translation: 出于对祂威严的崇敬，没有人直呼祂的名讳。

original: Thanks to Him, the Treeminders have a home.
translation: 多亏了祂，树启者才有了家园。

original: I wish you could just tell me who "He" is, already...
translation: 我希望你能直接告诉我“祂”到底是谁……

original: He is the One Who Grows, He is the One Who Gives and He is the One Who Guides.
translation: 祂是万物培育者，是慷慨赐予者，也是方向指引者。

original: No one speaks His name out of reverence for His majesty.
translation: 出于对祂威严的崇敬，没有人直呼祂的名讳。

original: Thanks to Him, the Treeminders have a home.
translation: 多亏了祂，树启者才有了家园。

original: Who is it you keep referring to as "Him"?
translation: 你一直在说的“祂”到底是谁？

original: He is the One Who Grows, He is the One Who Gives and He is the One Who Guides.
translation: 祂是万物培育者，是慷慨赐予者，也是方向指引者。

original: No one speaks His name out of reverence for His majesty.
translation: 出于对祂威严的崇敬，没有人直呼祂的名讳。

original: Thanks to Him, the Treeminders have a home.
translation: 多亏了祂，树启者才有了家园。

original: So what was all this about meeting someone?
translation: 那么，说要见什么人，到底是怎么回事？

original: Yes, my apologies. I don't speak to Outsiders very often and I tend to get lost in conversation.
translation: 实在抱歉。我不常和外来者交谈，一聊起来就容易跑题。

original: As you approached Oasis, He said you were coming and I was sent out to meet you personally with a request.
translation: 在你靠近绿洲的时候，祂就预知你要来了，于是我被派出来亲自迎接你，并向你传达一个请求。

original: He wishes to meet with you. You'd be the first Outsider to do so in a very long time.
translation: 祂想见你。你会是长时间以来第一个得以拜见祂的外来者。

original: This place scares me. It's so... different.
translation: 这个地方让我害怕。它是如此……不同。

original: What you call scared, I call humbled. This place is a blessing to all of us.
translation: 你所谓的害怕，在我看来是敬畏。这个地方对我们所有人来说都是一种恩赐。

original: Everything you see around you, from the tallest tree to the smallest blade of grass is a gift. A gift from Him.
translation: 你周围看到的一切，从最高的树到最细小的草叶，都是一份礼物。一份来自祂的恩赐。

original: This place is weird. Where do you plug stuff in?
translation: 这地方真奇怪。你们都在哪充电啊？

original: Ha ha ha! We no longer use devices like that. We cast our technology away many years ago.
translation: 哈哈哈！我们不再使用那样的设备了。多年前我们就摒弃了那些科技产品。

original: Everything you see around you, from the tallest tree to the smallest blade of grass is a gift. A gift from Him.
translation: 你周围看到的一切，从最高的树到最细小的草叶，都是一份礼物。一份来自祂的恩赐。

original: I've never seen anyplace like this.
translation: 我从没有见过像这样的地方。

original: No, I suppose you haven't. In fact, few who live outside of Oasis have.
translation: 不，我想你应该也没有。事实上，很少有住在绿洲之外的人见过。

original: Everything you see around you, from the tallest tree to the smallest blade of grass is a gift. A gift from Him.
translation: 你周围看到的一切，从最高的树到最细小的草叶，都是一份礼物。一份来自祂的恩赐。

original: Maybe it's his. You know, for him to wear when no one is looking...
translation: 这可能是他的。你知道的，他会在没有人看到的时候穿上……

original: Oh my God. Roger... He wouldn't. But...
translation: 噢，天那。罗杰……他不会的。可是……

original: Well, then I guess he's cheating on you.
translation: 嗯，我猜他骗了你。

original: My God... I knew it. I knew it!
translation: 噢，天那……我就知道。我就知道！

original: It looks like Roger is a fan of women's clothing.
translation: 看起来罗杰很喜欢女人的衣服。

original: But... This isn't mine. What is this doing here?
translation: 可是……这不是我的。这东西怎么会在这？

original: Just trust me. It's important.
translation: 相信我。这很重要。

original: Okay, if you say so.
translation: 好吧，如果你这么说的话。

original: Nothing. Never mind.
translation: 没什么。别管它了。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: You'd better come down to the basement. There's something you need to see...
translation: 你最好到地下室去一趟。你得看看那的东西……

original: What were you doing in our basement? What's down there?
translation: 你在地下室做什么？下面有什么吗？

original: I'm here to kill you, and there's nothing you can do about it.
translation: 我是来这杀你的，你没法阻止我。

original: What! No, please! I'm begging you.
translation: 什么！不，拜托！我求你了。

original: Oh, yeah? Give it your best shot, clown shoes!
translation: 哦，是吗？尽力而为吧，你这小丑！

original: I'm going to put a bullet right between your eyes.
translation: 我准备在你两眼之间开个洞。

original: Assassin!
translation: 刺客！

original: Time for the Republic to hold a new election... and a state funeral.
translation: 是时候为共和国举行新的选举了…… 外加一场国葬。

original: Guards! Security!
translation: 守卫！警卫！

original: I'm going to put a bullet in your brain, you Ghoul hating piece of shit!
translation: 我要在你脑袋上开个洞, 你这歧视僵尸的混蛋！

original: Um... I don't have it.
translation: 嗯……我没有。

original: Well, go get it!
translation: 那就去拿来！

original: I'm not going to just take your word for it. I want that key.
translation: 我可不信空口无凭的话。我要那钥匙。

original: Well, go get it!
translation: 那就去拿来！

original: I'm not going to just take your word for it. I want something of his as proof.
translation: 我可不信空口无凭的话。我需要一些他的东西来证明。

original: Um... I didn't bring back any proof.
translation: 呃……我没有带回来什么证据。

original: Sure. Take it. I don't have any use for it.
translation: 当然。拿着它吧。它对我没用了。

original: Ah! My trophy. You've earned your reward.
translation: 啊！我的战利品。你赢得了你的报酬。

original: Hmm. I guess you were telling me the truth. Take your caps.
translation: 嗯。我想你告诉我的是真的。拿走你的瓶盖吧。

original: Okay. I believe you. Here's your money.
translation: 好吧。我相信你。给你钱。

original: Allistair Tenpenny is already dead.
translation: 奥利斯特·特佩尼已经死了。

original: Damn! He's the one I most wanted to die by my hand.
translation: 该死！他是我最想亲手杀死的家伙。

original: At least he's dead somehow. Here. I'll give you 25 caps for the news, but I'm not going to pay you to kill a dead man.
translation: 至少他死了。给，为这消息我给你25个瓶盖，但我不会为杀了一个死人而付你报酬的。

original: He is?
translation: 他是吗？

original: I don't care. All I want is that damn key. No key, no caps.
translation: 与我无关。我想要的只有那该死的钥匙。没钥匙，没瓶盖。

original: I've got bad news. Ted Strayer is already dead.
translation: 我有个坏消息。泰德·斯崔尔死了。

original: He is?
translation: 他是吗？

original: I don't believe you. Give me some proof, a ring, a key, something.
translation: 我不相信你。给我点证据，一枚戒指，一把钥匙，或者其他的什么。

original: I've got bad news. Ted Strayer is already dead.
translation: 我有个坏消息。泰德·斯崔尔死了。

original: I shouldn't be surprised. The way he lived it was bound to happen sooner or later.
translation: 我不感到惊讶。他迟早要会那样。

original: All you have to do now is bring me his key. No key, no caps.
translation: 你现在要做的只是把他的钥匙给我带来。没钥匙，没瓶盖。

original: I hate to admit this, but Dukov is already dead.
translation: 我不得不承认，杜克夫死了。

original: I shouldn't be surprised. The way he lived it was bound to happen sooner or later.
translation: 我不感到惊讶。他迟早要会那样。

original: Wait. How do I know you aren't lying? I want proof. Some personal object of his. No proof, no caps.
translation: 等一下。我怎么知道你不是在撒谎？我要证据。一些他的私人物品。没证据，就没钱。

original: I hate to admit this, but Dukov is already dead.
translation: 我不得不承认，杜克夫死了。

original: Really? That bastard finally bit it?
translation: 真的？那杂种终于死了？

original: Such is life. Do you have his key? No key, no caps.
translation: 这就是生命。你拿到他的钥匙了吗？没钥匙，没瓶盖。

original: Um... Dave is kind of... Well, he's dead.
translation: 呃…… 戴夫已经…… 好吧，他死了。

original: Really? That bastard finally bit it?
translation: 真的？那杂种终于死了？

original: Wait a minute. You could be lying. You got something of his as proof? No proof, no caps.
translation: 等一下。你可能是在撒谎。你拿到什么关于他的东西做证据？没证据，就没钱。

original: Um... Dave is kind of... Well, he's dead.
translation: 呃…… 戴夫已经…… 好吧，他死了。

original: Janet snapped. She killed Martha in cold blood. Look at this rolling pin.
translation: 珍妮特崩溃了。她冷血地杀害了玛莎。看看这擀面杖。

original: Oh my God, what is that? Is that blood? And... brains?
translation: 噢，上帝啊！那是什么？是血吗？还有……脑浆？

original: Janet did this to Martha? She really did snap, didn't she?
translation: 珍妮特对玛莎做了这种事？她真的疯了，对吗？

original: Look at this. It's her rolling pin, covered in blood. Martha's blood.
translation: 看看这。这是她的擀面杖，上面全是血。玛莎的血。

original: That's... that's crazy!
translation: 这……这太疯狂了！

original: My God... Did she really kill Martha? She's lost her mind!
translation: 我的天……她真的杀了玛莎？她疯了！

original: Martha Simpson is dead, and Janet killed her! Look, here's her rolling pin...
translation: 玛莎·辛普森死了，是珍妮特杀了她！看，这是她的擀面杖……

original: But... Janet would never...
translation: 但……珍妮特绝不会……

original: I mean, I know she was upset, but I thought she was over it. How could she do this?
translation: 我是说，我知道她很生气，但我以为她已经放下了。她怎么会这么做？

original: Bad news, Roger. Your wife is a psychopath.
translation: 坏消息，罗杰。你的老婆是个精神病。

original: What? What are you talking about?
translation: 什么？你在说什么？

original: What's this... Women's clothing? Down here?
translation: 这是什么……女人的衣服？在下面？

original: It's your basement, lady. You tell me.
translation: 这是你的地下室，女士。这得你来说。

original: This isn't mine. Why would Roger have this down here?
translation: 这不是我的。罗杰怎么会把这东西放在下面？

original: You freak! You're going to eat me, aren't you?
translation: 你这怪物！你要吃了我，不是吗？

original: Grrr! Hungry!
translation: 嗷~！饿！

original: There's plenty of body parts laying around, why don't you eat those instead?
translation: 这地方丢着那么多的尸块，你为什么不吃它们呢？

original: Not fresh! Not warm! Taste old.
translation: 不新鲜！不够热！尝起来很老。

original: I hope you choke on my bones!
translation: 但愿你被我的骨头梗死！

original: Hahaha! Not your tiny bones, little man! Grrrraaaahhhh!
translation: 哈哈哈！你那小细骨是没用的，小人！嗷~~~！

original: Who you calling little?!
translation: 你说谁小？！

original: Shut up now! Grraaaah!
translation: 闭嘴吧！嗷~~~！

original: Oh God. Kill me quickly, I beg you!
translation: 噢，上帝啊。快点杀了我吧，求求你了！

original: Grrr! Hahaha! Graaah!
translation: 嗷！哈哈哈哈！嗷~~~！

original: Come on. Follow me.
translation: 来吧。跟着我。

original: We'll be right behind you.
translation: 我们就跟在你后面。

original: You and Shorty, follow me.
translation: 你和“矮子”，跟着我。

original: We'll stick with you, don't worry!
translation: 我们会紧跟着你，别担心！

original: You and Red, follow me.
translation: 你和瑞德，跟着我。

original: Well, all right. Don't get us killed, okay?
translation: 嗯，好吧。别害死我们，好吗？

original: I'll just hope you know what you're doing.
translation: 我希望你知道自己在做什么。

original: I'm right behind you!
translation: 我就在你后面！

original: Right! Let's go!
translation: 好的！我们走！

original: Well... you're right. He's probably already dead...
translation: 嗯……你是对的。他可能已经死了……

original: There's a back door somewhere nearby we can use. Let's go to Big Town. You can get a hot meal and I'll tend to any wounds you've taken. Let's go!
translation: 这附近什么地方有个我们可以用的后门。让我们到大镇去吧。你可以吃顿热饭，而我则会照料你任何的伤口。我们走！

original: We shouldn't risk our lives for someone who's probably already dead.
translation: 我们不值得去为一个可能死了的人冒险。

original: I'm not waiting around for some Super Mutant to lock me up again!
translation: 我不会在这等着那些超级变种人再把我关起来！

original: There's a back door somewhere around here. If you're not back soon, I'm leaving without you! If I'm not here when you come back, meet me at Big Town.
translation: 这附近什么地方有个后门。如果你短时间不能回来，我就自己走了！如果你回来的时候我不在这，你可以在大镇找到我。

original: You wait right here, I'll go see about Shorty.
translation: 你在这里等，我去看看“矮子”。

original: There it is! We're almost there! Come on! Yiiipppiiieee!
translation: 就是那！我们就快到了！加油！呀~~~~！

original: Keep your secret. I wouldn't want to take advantage of you.
translation: 留着你的秘密吧。我不想占你便宜。

original: You're a real friend. My real friend.
translation: 你是真正的朋友。我真正的朋友。

original: So what's this secret?
translation: 是什么秘密呢？

original: I know where Belle keeps her stash. But she doesn't know I know.
translation: 我知道贝勒把她的东西藏在哪。但她以为我不知道。

original: She keeps it under her bed. Real original, huh?
translation: 她就把它藏在床底下。真新鲜，呃？

original: I think I need to puke.
translation: 我觉得我要吐了。

original: Not bad, kid. I'll let you live... for now.
translation: 不错啊，孩子。那我饶了你……暂时吧。

original: Aren't you swell. Did you need something else or can I go back to my patrol?
translation: 别吹了。你有事没事啊？要不然我就回去巡逻了。

original: Gee, thanks. Are we done here?
translation: 啊哟，谢谢。我们完事了吗？

original: Kill you? Sounds like fun. Let's do that.
translation: 杀了你们？听起来很有趣。那就开始吧。

original: Then I'm going down fighting!
translation: 那我就开始战斗了！

original: So, it's pretty much a free-for-all here? Where do you keep your good stuff?
translation: 这里算是大混战喽？你们把好东西藏在哪里了？

original: Yeah, yeah, you're a scary wastelander. Look, you'll either kill us, or you won't.
translation: 哟、哟，来了个可怕的废土游民。听着，要么杀了我们，要么拉倒。

original: Most of us have already accepted death so you won't get much of a reaction with your threats. At least we won't be slaves if you shoot us all.
translation: 我们基本上都不怕死，所以你的威胁并不会有人在乎的。如果你把我们都杀死，至少我们不会成为奴隶。

original: I'm sure you'll manage.
translation: 你们肯定能够应付。

original: Yeah, we'll see.
translation: 嗯，走着瞧吧。

original: Who lives here?
translation: 谁住在这里？

original: There aren't many of us left. There's me and Pappy. Red runs the clinic, but she's been taken by the mutant. Kimba does what she can.
translation: 我们剩下的人不多了。有我和帕匹。瑞德管理着诊所，但她被变种人抓走了。金巴在尽力做她能做的。

original: And there's Bittercup. She's just about as useless as a human being can be. Timebomb was hurt in the last raid, so he's out.
translation: 还有“苦杯”。她简直就是个废人。“定时炸弹”在上次突袭中受伤了，不能算。

original: That's about it. The Mutants and Slavers have taken everyone else. Just us and a couple of guns are all that's left.
translation: 就是这样。变种人和奴隶贩子带走了其他人。剩下的就只有我们和几把枪了。

original: There aren't many of us left. There's me and Pappy. Red runs the clinic. Kimba does what she can.
translation: 我们剩下的人不多了。这有我和帕匹。瑞德管理着诊所，但她被变种人抓走了。金巴在尽力做她能做的。

original: And there's Bittercup. She's just about as useless as a human being can be. Timebomb was hurt in the last raid, so he's out. Shorty is unpredictable.
translation: 还有“苦杯”。她简直就是个废人。“定时炸弹”在上次突袭中受伤了，不能算。“矮子”则根本靠不住。

original: That's about it. The Mutants and Slavers have taken everyone else. Just us and a couple of guns are all that's left.
translation: 就是这样。变种人和奴隶贩子带走了其他人。剩下的就只有我们和几把枪了。

original: Why don't you leave?
translation: 你们为什么不离开呢？

original: And where are we going to go? Megaton won't have us, Lamplight won't take us back, and Rivet City is too far.
translation: 我们又能去哪？兆吨镇不会收留我们，小灯镇也不会接纳我们回去，而铆钉城又太远了。

original: Besides, the bunch of us can't even hold this town, can you imagine us shlepping across the wasteland?
translation: 而且，我们这群人连个镇子都守不住，哪里有本事横穿废土啊？

original: Trouble? What kind of trouble?
translation: 麻烦？什么样的麻烦？

original: Well, we've got Super Mutants out that way and Slavers up that way. Take your pick.
translation: 嗯，超级变种人从这条路走，而奴隶贩子则从那条路来。自己选吧。

original: They both come in here, drag off as many as they can carry and shoot whoever puts up a fight.
translation: 他们都跑到这来，抢走一切他们能带走的东西，杀死一切胆敢反抗的人。

original: The best we can ever hope for is that they get here at the same time and fight over who gets to kill us.
translation: 我们所能希望的最好情况就是他们同时出现，然后为谁有权屠杀我们而拼个你死我活。

original: Can't we skip all this nonsense?
translation: 我们就不能略过这些没用的吗？

original: I'm afraid not. No one gets to see Him without first drinking the Sap from the basin here in the Pavilion.
translation: 恐怕不行。不先喝下亭子里那盆里的汁液，谁都见不到祂。

original: The Sap will purify your mind and body of anything harmful that could possibly hurt Him.
translation: 液汁会净化你的身心，清除任何可能伤害到祂的有害物质。

original: Other than that, there's nothing more to the ceremony.
translation: 除此之外，仪式就没别的了。

original: Hang on, you never said anything about a ceremony!
translation: 等等，你们之前可没提过什么仪式！

original: There's no reason to be alarmed.
translation: 完全没有必要紧张。

original: All that must be done is you must drink the Sap from the basin here in the Pavilion.
translation: 你要做的不过是喝下亭子里盆中的汁液。

original: The Sap will purify your mind and body of anything harmful that could possibly hurt Him.
translation: 液汁会净化你的身心，清除任何可能伤害到祂的有害物质。

original: Just a minute... What does this ceremony involve?
translation: 稍等一下……这仪式都有些什么？

original: It's simple really. You drink the Sap from the basin here in the Pavilion.
translation: 其实很简单。你喝下亭子里那个盆里的汁液。

original: The Sap will purify your mind and body of anything harmful that could possibly hurt Him.
translation: 液汁会净化你的身心，清除任何可能伤害到祂的有害物质。

original: I assure you, nothing harmful will happen to you.
translation: 我向你保证，你绝不会有任何不良反应。

original: Okay already. Let's get this going.
translation: 行了行了。咱们开始吧。

original: To meet Him, you must undergo the Ceremony of Purification. Once that's complete, you'll be able to speak to Him.
translation: 要见到祂，你必须经历一次净化仪式。仪式结束后，你就可以与祂对话了。

original: Whenever you're ready, we may begin.
translation: 你准备好了，我们就可以开始。

original: And where can I find this person?
translation: 我在哪能找到这人呢？

original: Yes... person.
translation: 嗯……人。

original: To meet Him, you must undergo the Ceremony of Purification. Once that's complete, you'll be able to speak to Him.
translation: 要见到祂，你必须经历一次净化仪式。仪式结束后，你就可以与祂对话了。

original: Whenever you're ready, we may begin.
translation: 你准备好了，我们就可以开始。

original: I would be honored to meet this person.
translation: 我很荣幸能见到这人。

original: Yes... person.
translation: 嗯……人。

original: To meet Him, you must undergo the Ceremony of Purification. Once that's complete, you'll be able to speak to Him.
translation: 要见到祂，你必须经历一次净化仪式。仪式结束后，你就可以与祂对话了。

original: Whenever you're ready, we may begin.
translation: 你准备好了，我们就可以开始。

original: Fine, fine. Get to the point already.
translation: 行，行。赶紧说重点。

original: You have much to learn about patience, my friend. However, you are correct, I will get to the point.
translation: 我的朋友，你在耐心方面还有很多要学的。不过，你说得对，我这就说重点。

original: As you approached Oasis, He said you were coming and I was sent out to meet you personally with a request.
translation: 在你靠近绿洲的时候，祂就预知你要来了，于是我被派出来亲自迎接你，并向你传达一个请求。

original: He wishes to meet with you. You'd be the first Outsider to do so in a very long time.
translation: 祂想见你。你会是长时间以来第一个得以拜见祂的外来者。

original: Which brings us to why I'm here, I suppose.
translation: 我想，这就带出了我此行的目的。

original: Yes. Indeed it does. Sorry I don't speak to Outsiders very often and I tend to get lost in conversation.
translation: 没错，确实如此。抱歉，我不常和外来者交谈，一聊起来就容易跑题。

original: As you approached Oasis, He said you were coming and I was sent out to meet you personally with a request.
translation: 在你靠近绿洲的时候，祂就预知你要来了，于是我被派出来亲自迎接你，并向你传达一个请求。

original: He wishes to meet with you. You'd be the first Outsider to do so in a very long time.
translation: 祂想见你。你会是长时间以来第一个得以拜见祂的外来者。

original: Yeah, sure. I guess that's why Maple stuck a rifle in my face...
translation: 啊，当然。我猜那就是为什么梅坡把步枪抵我脸上的原因……

original: Listen my friend, I will forgive your insolent tone because He has asked to see you.
translation: 听着，朋友，我可以原谅你无礼的语气，因为祂要求见你。

original: But make no mistake. If you wish to cause trouble here, we have the means to defend ourselves.
translation: 但别搞错了。如果你想在这里惹事，我们有能力自卫。

original: Shun technology? How do you defend yourselves?
translation: 摒弃科技？那你们又怎样自保？

original: The Wasteland is a hostile place and sometimes we're forced to defend ourselves against it.
translation: 废土是个充满敌意的地方。有时候我们不得不自卫求生。

original: If that means fighting with manufactured weapons, then so be it.
translation: 如果那意味着要使用人造武器进行战斗，那也只能如此。

original: Had He not asked to see you, you never would have gotten this close to the gates.
translation: 如要不是祂要求见你，你根本不可能如此接近这些大门。

original: If you hate technology, why carry weapons?
translation: 如果你们厌恶科技，为什么还要携带武器呢？

original: Sadly, the Wasteland is a hostile place and sometimes we're forced to defend ourselves against it.
translation: 遗憾的是，废土是个充满敌意的地方。有时候我们不得不自卫求生。

original: If that means fighting with manufactured weapons, then so be it.
translation: 如果那意味着要使用人造武器进行战斗，那也只能如此。

original: Had He not asked to see you, you never would have gotten this close to the gates.
translation: 如要不是祂要求见你，你根本不可能如此接近这些大门。

original: Forget this whole thing. This is insane!
translation: 忘了这事吧。这太疯狂了！

original: Then you are free to go. He had requested to see you, but He said not to take you against your will.
translation: 那么你可以走了。祂本想要见你，但祂也说过不要强迫你。

original: It saddens me greatly you don't wish to see Him, but you must follow your own path.
translation: 你不想见祂，我深感遗憾，但你得走自己的路。
