original: If you change your mind, come speak to me and we'll begin again.
translation: 如果你改变主意，来和我谈谈，我们可以重新开始。

original: Could we wait just a bit? I'm not quite ready.
translation: 我们可以稍等一下吗？我还没准备好。

original: I understand, my friend. Preparing to meet Him takes much preparation and soul searching.
translation: 我理解，我的朋友。见他是需要很多准备和内省的。

original: You may walk about Oasis as you see fit, but please don't take too long.
translation: 你可以在绿洲里随意走走，但请别耽搁太久。

original: When you're ready to undergo the ceremony, just ask.
translation: 当你准备好接受仪式了，就说一声。

original: Okay, let's begin the ceremony.
translation: 好了，我们开始仪式吧。

original: Very good! Take your place in front of the basin and let's begin.
translation: 很好！到盆子前面站好，咱们开始。

original: I'm leaving. This is just crazy.
translation: 我要走了。这太疯狂了。

original: Then you are free to go. He had requested to see you, but He said not to take you against your will.
translation: 那么你可以走了。祂本想要见你，但祂也说过不要强迫你。

original: It saddens me greatly you don't wish to see Him, but you must follow your own path.
translation: 你不想见祂，我深感遗憾，但你得走自己的路。

original: If you change your mind, come speak to me and we'll begin again.
translation: 如果你改变主意，来和我谈谈，我们可以重新开始。

original: I've changed my mind. I'm not quite ready.
translation: 我改变主意了。我其实还没准备好。

original: There's nothing to fear here. This is our tradition and our custom, as well as a measure of protection for Him.
translation: 没什么可怕的。这是我们的传统和习俗，同时也是保护他的方法之一。

original: If you need a bit of time to reflect, then please do so. All I ask is you return quickly.
translation: 如果你需要一点时间来思考，请自便。我所请求的只是希望你尽快。

original: When you're ready to undergo the ceremony, just ask.
translation: 当你准备好接受仪式了，就说一声。

original: I'm sorry, I'm ready now.
translation: 不好意思，我现在准备好了。

original: Then please, return to the basin and we will begin.
translation: 那么请吧，回到池前，我们就可以开始了。

original: I'm ready to undertake the ceremony.
translation: 我准备好接受仪式了。

original: Very good! Take your place in front of the basin and let's begin.
translation: 很好！到盆子前面站好，咱们开始。

original: Very good! Take your place in front of the basin and let's begin.
translation: 很好！到盆子前面站好，咱们开始。

original: I'd like to start the ceremony again.
translation: 我准备好再次接受仪式了。

original: I need some time to think about it.
translation: 我需要些时间来思考这问题。

original: What's to think about? Sigh.
translation: 有什么可想的呢？唉。

original: My guys don't have the luxury of time. If you're going to decide, decide soon. Otherwise I'm offering elsewhere.
translation: 我的人没有那么多时间。如果你要考虑的话，那就快点。不然我就找别人了。

original: All right. I'll do it.
translation: 好的。我会做的。

original: Whew, I was holding my breath on that one I think. I wasn't sure what you were going to say.
translation: 哟，我实在太紧张了。我不确定你准备要说什么。

original: All I ask is that you hurry. I don't know how much longer they will be able to survive up there.
translation: 我唯一的要求就是请你快点。我不知道他们在那还能坚持多长时间。

original: I also recommend you try and find the body of Theo, one of my men. He was carrying our main ammo supply.
translation: 我建议你试着去找到西奥的尸体，他是我其中一个手下。他负责我们主要的弹药供给。

original: Here, let me punch the ammo box code and some better directions into your Pip-Boy there.
translation: 来，让我把弹药箱的密码和一些更佳的方向输入到你那哔哔小子里。

original: What's in it for me if I risk my neck for you?
translation: 为了你去拼命，我能得到什么好处？

original: Spoken like a merc. You sound like me when I was just a kid starting out in the business.
translation: 你的口气像个佣兵。你说话的口气真像我小时侯刚刚出道时的样子。

original: Okay hotshot, how about a full suit of Ranger Armor? It's the best combat armor in the Wasteland.
translation: 好吧，硬汉，一整套的游骑兵装甲怎样？那可是全废土最棒的战斗装甲。

original: Or if that doesn't do it for you I'll set you up with a minigun from our armory. Either way, you walk away with something.
translation: 如果你不喜欢那个，我会给你从我们军火库里弄一把多管机枪。无论如何，我们不会亏待你的。

original: I don't know, Reilly. This sounds like suicide.
translation: 我不知道，莱莉。这听起来简直像自杀。

original: Look, I don't know where else to go. In the shape I'm in, I'll be lucky to get ten feet.
translation: 听着，我不知道还能去哪。就我这样，运气好的话我还能走出10英尺。

original: I'll sweeten the deal for you, maybe it'll help. How about I set you up with a suit of Ranger Armor if you get them back?
translation: 我会给你点优惠，这可能对你有帮助。如果你把他们救回来，我就为你一整套的游骑兵装甲怎么样？

original: If that doesn't do it for you I'll set you up with a minigun from our armory. Either way, you walk away with something.
translation: 如果你不喜欢那个，我会给你从我们军火库里弄一把多管机枪。无论如何，我们不会亏待你的。

original: So that leaves them up there. How come you're here?
translation: 既然留下了他们。你是怎么到这来的？

original: My bad idea I'm afraid. I had a Stealth Boy which allowed me to slip off the roof unnoticed. The plan was to get back to get some help.
translation: 我恐怕这不是一个好主意。我有隐身小子可以让我偷偷溜下楼顶。计划就是由我回去求援。

original: I was almost at the street when a Super Mutant jumped me. Damn near ripped my arm off in the process.
translation: 当我就要跑到街上时，一个超级变种人拦住了我。该死的差点轰飞了我的胳膊。

original: Last thing I remember was falling into a culvert. Now I'm here. Some rescue attempt, huh?
translation: 我最后记得的事是我掉进了一个管道里。现在我在这了。有人救了我，呃？

original: What did you need from me?
translation: 你想从我这得到什么？

original: Get the Rangers home. Please. That's all I want. I don't care how you do it.
translation: 把游骑兵带回家。拜托。那就是所有我想要的。我不在乎你怎么完成。

original: Look, I could care less about your stories.
translation: 听着，我对你的故事毫无兴趣。

original: Fine. Since you're all business and obviously don't give a damn about human life, I got a proposal for you.
translation: 好吧。既然你明显只关心你的生意，而他妈的对人命毫不在意，我有个建议。

original: You want to hear it, or you gonna keep flapping your lips?
translation: 你是准备听听看，还是继续胡说八道？

original: Last stand?
translation: 最后一搏？

original: Last stand? Well, we hoped not. We figured we'd get up there and get a better signal to radio the Brotherhood of Steel for help.
translation: 最后一搏？嗯，但愿不是。我们希望能够到上面找到一个无线电信号相对更好的位置，好联络钢铁兄弟会来寻求援助。

original: Problem is, help never arrived. Vernon Square is so thick with the Super Mutants, I don't think they could slip through.
translation: 问题是，援助始终没有来。弗农广场上到处都是超级变种人，我不认为他们能够通过那。

original: Trapped yourself at the top of a tall building. Brilliant.
translation: 把自己困在了高楼顶上。你可真是个天才。

original: Look, I don't know what your problem is, but I got three guys alone out there with an army of Super Mutants around them.
translation: 听着，我不知道你有什么问题，但我有三个兄弟被一支超级变种人的部队困在外面。

original: Either help me by listening, or get the hell out of my sight. I'm not here to be judged by you or anyone else.
translation: 你要么听我说，要么给我滚蛋。我来这可不是为了让你或任何人评论的。

original: Now, like I was saying, we had to fight our way up towards the roof of the Statesman.
translation: 就像我说的，我们得杀到政要酒店的楼顶。

original: Bad move, I'm guessing.
translation: 我觉得这是个错误。

original: Very bad move, but we had no choice.
translation: 确实是错着，但我们没得选了。

original: On the way we lost Theo, one of my guys. We were unable to get the ammo case off of his body as we were pushed onwards.
translation: 在途中我们失去了一个兄弟，西奥。在那种极端情况下，我们没办法把弹药箱从他身上取下来。

original: So, guns almost dry, we hit the roof of the Statesman.
translation: 就这样，弹尽粮绝，我们终于杀到了政要酒店的楼顶。

original: Not a very smart move, if you ask me.
translation: 要我说的话，这可不是步好棋。

original: I didn't ask you. Those bastards were everywhere. I don't know what was driving them.
translation: 我没有问你。那些杂种到处都是。我真不知道是什么驱使着他们。

original: We fought our way to the roof and found a way across to the Statesman Hotel next door.
translation: 我们杀出了一条通往楼顶的路，并找到了通往隔壁政要酒店的通道。

original: Once in the hotel, the only way to go was up.
translation: 一旦在旅馆里，唯一的路只有向上走。

original: Let me guess, more Super Mutants inside?
translation: 让我猜猜，更多的超级变种人跑进来了？

original: You got it. More of the ugly bastards just kept coming. We fought our way to the roof and found a way across to the Statesman Hotel next door.
translation: 你是对的。更多这种丑陋的杂种不停涌进来。我们杀出了一条通往楼顶的路，并找到了通往隔壁政要酒店的通道。

original: The Super Mutants seemed driven... like they smelled blood. They kept following us.
translation: 那些超级变种人看上去是被什么驱使的……就好象他们闻到了鲜血的味道一样。他们一直跟着我们。

original: Once in the hotel, the only way to go was up.
translation: 一旦在旅馆里，唯一的路只有向上走。

original: So, what's this about needing help? Tell me the whole story.
translation: 这跟求援有什么关系？告诉我整件事的经过。

original: We were mapping the Vernon Square part of the downtown ruins and got jumped by a Super Mutant ambush party.
translation: 我们当时正在前往市区废墟的弗农广场部分，结果遭遇了一群埋伏在那的超级变种人。

original: Usually it isn't a problem, but this group was bigger than usual. We fought our way into Our Lady of Hope Hospital, hoping to find cover.
translation: 通常来说，这不算什么，但这次的队伍比通常庞大。我们杀出了一条通往玛利亚医院的路来，希望能够找到掩护。

original: I'd really like to speak to this woman. Please, wake her now.
translation: 我真的很想跟这女人谈谈。请把她弄醒吧。

original: Oh very well. I will do what I can.
translation: 喔，很好。我会做力所能及的事。

original: I just hope her body can withstand the strain. Humans are so fragile.
translation: 我只希望她的身体禁得起拉扯。人类实在太脆弱了。

original: Do you mind if I try and revive her?
translation: 你介意让我来尝试一下把她救活吗？

original: Unless you're an expert at medicine, I wouldn't recommend it. You may end up doing more harm than good.
translation: 除非你是个医学专家，否则我可不推荐这么做。你最终可能会把事情弄得更糟。

original: However, I'm all for helping my patients, so if you think you have the ability, be my guest.
translation: 无论如何，我所希望的只是能对病人有所帮助，所以如果你认为自己有那能力，请自便吧。

original: Do you think there's any way to revive her?
translation: 你认为有什么把她救活的途径吗？

original: Well, I wouldn't recommend it. She's in some sort of coma. It's dangerous to force someone out of one.
translation: 嗯，我不推荐这么做。她正陷于某种程度上的昏迷。强行把她弄醒是很危险的。

original: There's no telling when she'll come out of it I'm afraid.
translation: 她什么时候能醒恐怕我也不知道

original: How did she end up in the Chop Shop?
translation: 她是怎么跑到排骨店来的？

original: She was just brought in by a few others. They found her bleeding to death at the entrance to the city here.
translation: 她是被其他人带来的。他们在这城市的入口处发现了几乎失血致死的她。

original: If she'd been out in the tunnels any longer, she'd have been someone's meal by now.
translation: 如果她在外面的隧道里再耽搁一会儿，她现在早就变成什么东西的大餐了。

original: What's wrong with her?
translation: 她怎么了？

original: She had multiple lacerations, contusions, broken leg, some internal bleeding and blunt force trauma.
translation: 她身上有多处撕裂和挫伤，腿也断了，而且还有内出血和严重的瘀伤。

original: She's hasn't been conscious since they brought her in a few days ago.
translation: 自从几天前他们把她带回来后她就一直昏迷不醒。

original: I'd say she tangled with some Super Mutants and lost. It's a miracle she isn't dead.
translation: 我估计她一定是遇到了一些超级变种人，而且打输了。她没有死可真是个奇迹。

original: Reilly's Rangers?
translation: 莱莉的游骑兵？

original: Oh, you must be new around here.
translation: 噢，你一定是刚刚来这。

original: They're a mercenary company that bases itself out of the D.C. Ruins. I'm assuming she's their leader, Reilly.
translation: 他们是一支扎根在特区废墟的佣兵团。我猜她就是他们的领袖，莱莉。

original: What was left of her armor had her name stenciled on it. She was in a pretty bad way when they found her outside Underworld.
translation: 她护甲左边刻着她的名字。他们在地下城外发现她时，她可真是糟透了。

original: I can help you defend yourselves.
translation: 我可以帮助你们保护自己。

original: Really? That's great. What do you have in mind?
translation: 真的吗？太棒了。你有什么主意？

original: If you can arm yourselves, I can teach you how to shoot.
translation: 如果你们可以武装起来，我可以教你们怎么射击。

original: Great! I'll round everyone up at the junkyard for shooting practice.
translation: 好极了！我会把所有人集合到废物堆积场进行射击练习。

original: I'll teach you how to sneak and hide. They'll think you've deserted the town.
translation: 我可以传授你们潜行和隐匿。他们会认为你们已经遗弃了这镇子。

original: Great! I'll round everyone up. You show us how to hide and sneak.
translation: 好极了！我来集合所有人。你来教我们怎么潜行和隐匿。

original: You should have some robot defenders. I can show you what to do with them.
translation: 你们可以用机器人防卫。我可以教你们应该怎么使用。

original: Great! Let's head over to the junkyard. There're some old robots in there. Maybe you can fix them up and we'll watch to see how it's done.
translation: 好极了！我们到废物堆积场去吧。那有些旧的机器人。或许你可以把它们修好，而我们则会学你是怎么做的。

original: You could set up a minefield to keep Super Mutants from just strolling in.
translation: 你们可以设置雷区来抵御前来进犯的超级变种人。

original: That's a great idea! I'll get everyone together. You show us how and we'll plant mines at the bridge into town!
translation: 真是个好主意！我会把所有人集合起来。你来教我们怎么做，我们会在通往镇子的桥上布满地雷！

original: I'll stick around to kill the Super Mutants. They should leave you alone after that.
translation: 我会留在这干掉那些超级变种人。在那之后他们就会离你们远远的了。

original: Really? That's great! I'll let everyone know! You're a real hero you know that?
translation: 真的吗？好极了！我会告诉所有人的！你是个真正的英雄，知道吗？

original: Law of the Wasteland: Survival of the fittest. You're on your own. Good luck!
translation: 废土的法则：弱肉强食。你们得靠自己。好运！

original: Fine. You've done enough already. I get it. We'll figure something out on our own.
translation: 好吧。你做得够多了。我理解。我们会自己想办法的。

original: Yeah, she's fine. They patched her up and she's resting in Underworld.
translation: 嗯，她很好。他们为她做了包扎，而她现在则在地下城休息。

original: That's a relief. I told her she was nuts when she decided to try and sneak out of here. Guess I was wrong. Now, let's talk about getting out of here.
translation: 真是令人宽心的好消息。当她决定要逃出这的时候，我告诉她这简直是疯了。我猜是我错了。现在，我们来谈谈我们怎么离开这吧。

original: I would have proposed going back the way you came, but apparently it's impossible now.
translation: 我得到的建议是，从你来的那条路回去，但很显然，现在这不可能了。

original: So, the express elevator is our only solution.
translation: 高速电梯就是我们唯一的途径。

original: No time for chatter. I'm here to get you guys out.
translation: 没时间闲聊了。我来这是把你们这帮家伙救出去的。

original: Hang on there. First, I need to know if Reilly is okay. I assume she made it somewhere if you're here.
translation: 等一下。首先，我得知道莱莉怎么样了。我猜如果你在这的话，她应该也活下来了。

original: Hang on there. First, I need to know if Reilly is okay. I assume she made it somewhere if you're here.
translation: 等一下。首先，我得知道莱莉怎么样了。我猜如果你在这的话，她应该也活下来了。

original: I'm afraid this is it.
translation: 恐怕就是这样了。

original: Hmmm, and you made it all the way up here alive?
translation: 唔，这一路你竟然活下来了？

original: Ok, I'm impressed. Reilly must have sent the right person for the job... as usual. Hey, is she okay?
translation: 好的，我确实印象深刻。莱莉真是派对了人……就像往常一样。嗨，她还好吗？

original: Just you? You made it up here alone?
translation: 只有你？你完全是孤身一人到达了这？

original: Ok, I'm impressed. Reilly must have sent the right person for the job... as usual. Hey, is she okay?
translation: 好的，我确实印象深刻。莱莉真是派对了人……就像往常一样。嗨，她还好吗？

original: Where is Theo's body?
translation: 西奥的尸体在哪？

original: We lost him on one of the stairwells on the second floor of the Statesman Hotel.
translation: 他在政要酒店的二楼楼梯上牺牲了。

original: He almost made it, but one of the Muties hit us with a frag grenade; blew him apart.
translation: 他几乎成功了，但其中一个变种人用手榴弹攻击了我们；把他炸成了几段。

original: If you can get to his ammo crate, there's a ton of rounds inside. Bring as many as you can to the Rangers.
translation: 如果你拿到了他的弹药箱，那面可真是有相当多的军火。尽可能给游骑兵带去。

original: How do I know they're still alive?
translation: 我怎么知道他们还活着？

original: Before I left I gave them an order to keep broadcasting for help over their radio.
translation: 在我离开前，我下令让他们持续通过无线电来寻求帮助。

original: Hopefully, when you get near their location, you'll pick it up.
translation: 如果顺利的话，当你到达接近他们的位置时，你会收到讯号。

original: Any good news about the area?
translation: 有这区域好的消息吗？

original: Not much I'm afraid. Oh wait, the hospital may have some supplies that will help you.
translation: 恐怕不多。哦，等等，医院那边可能有些补给，这大概会对你有所帮助。

original: We saw some storerooms on the way to the roof, but didn't have time to raid them.
translation: 我们在通往楼顶的路上看到了一些贮藏室，但是没时间去搜索它们。

original: How can I get there from Underworld?
translation: 我怎么从地下城到那去？

original: Your best bet is to stay with the Metro tunnels. Head north from here to Metro Central. Then look for the tunnels to the Dupont Circle Station.
translation: 最好的办法是通过地铁隧道过去。从这往北走到地铁中心去。然后再找到去杜邦环岛地铁站的隧道。

original: Exit from Dupont Circle Station into what we call the Dry Sewers and eventually you'll wind up in Our Lady of Hope Hospital.
translation: 从杜邦环岛地铁站出来就到了我们称为干燥的下水道的地方，而最终你将到达玛利亚医院。

original: Tell me more about Reilly's Rangers.
translation: 告诉我更多关于莱莉的游骑兵的事。

original: There's five of us... oh wait, four now. I almost forgot about Theo. Poor bastard.
translation: 我们有五个人……噢，等等，现在是四个了。我差点忘了西奥。可怜虫。

original: Besides myself of course, we have Brick, our heavy weapons specialist, Butcher, our medic and Donovan, our tech.
translation: 当然，除了我自己，我们还有重武器专家布瑞克、医生布彻和技师多诺万。

original: All of them have been with me for years. I'd trust any of them with my life.
translation: 他们所有人都跟随我很多年了。我用性命担保，我无比信任每个人。

original: They're a mercenary group. I've seen them pass through Underworld a few times.
translation: 他们是一个佣兵团。我曾数次看到他们经过地下城。

original: I'm not sure what their mission entails, but I suspect that it involves violence.
translation: 我不确定他们都做什么任务，但我怀疑跟暴力有关。

original: The Rangers have a small headquarters not far from here. Let me program the location into your Pip-Boy.
translation: 游骑兵在离这不远的地方有个分部。让我把位置输入你的哔哔小子。

original: We're mercs, but instead of hunt and destroy we map the ruins for sale to the highest bidder... and make a good living at it, too.
translation: 我们是佣兵，但我们只向买得起的人提供遗迹地图，而无意杀戮和破坏……我们这样也能过得很好。

original: There were five of us in the company until we lost Theo.
translation: 在失去西奥之前，我们一共有五个人。

original: Can you think of anything that will help me get there?
translation: 你有什么办法帮我到达那儿吗？

original: We have a headquarters not far from here.
translation: 我们在离这不远的地方有个指挥部。

original: If you can make it there, you are welcome to anything you need inside. Just punch in Reilly0247 at the gate.
translation: 如果你能到那，里面的东西任你拿。只要输入Reilly0247就能进入。

original: We have ammo, supplies, you name it.
translation: 我们有子弹，补给，随便你怎么称呼。

original: What can you tell me about Vernon Square?
translation: 你能和我说说弗农广场吗？

original: If I wasn't asking for your help, I'd tell you to stay away. It's thick with Super Mutants. I don't know why.
translation: 如果不是我需要你的帮助，我会让你离我远点。那到处都是超级变种人。我也不知道为什么。

original: Butcher, our team medic, has always suspected something is in the area they are looking for or being attracted to.
translation: 我们的医生布彻，一直认为他们在这区域寻找某样东西，或是被什么所吸引。

original: The only place worse I can think of is the Mall.
translation: 我唯一能想到比那更糟的地方就是商业区。

original: Oh my, that's a dangerous part of the D.C. Ruins.
translation: 噢，那是特区废墟里危险的部分。

original: Every patrol Underworld has sent even near that zone has come back in bad shape, or hasn't returned at all.
translation: 每个巡逻到地下城那区域的巡逻队，甚至只是靠近一点，回来时都狼狈不堪，或者干脆一去不回。

original: All I can tell you is this place sucks. I hope we never have to map another inch of it.
translation: 我所能告诉你的只有那地方糟透了。我希望我们也不用去绘制那片区域，哪怕是一英寸。

original: There's something about this area. I can't put my finger on it, but just like the Mall, there is an unusually high concentration of Super Mutants.
translation: 这区域很古怪。我没办法说得再清楚了，但就像商业区一样，那里超级变种人的数量多得不寻常。

original: If I had the time and resources, I'd investigate. All I care about now is getting the hell off this damn roof.
translation: 如果我有时间和资源，我会去进行调查。但现在我所关心的就只有怎么离开这该死的楼顶。

original: The other guys hate mappin' this zone, but hey, I love it. I love turning the 'muties into a fine, red mist with my gun.
translation: 其他人讨厌来绘制这区域的地图，可是，嗨，我非常喜欢。我简直爱死了用枪把变种人变成一团红色血雾了。

original: You're drawing on me, clown shoes? I don't think so!
translation: 你想利用我，小丑？没门！

original: You're drawing on me, bitch? I don't think so!
translation: 你想利用我，小丑？没门！

original: I'm a little short on caps right now.
translation: 我现在有点缺瓶盖。

original: What the fuck is this? You call that money?
translation: 这他妈的是什么？你管这叫钱吗？

original: Unless you pull 200 caps out of your ass, don't bother me, motherfucker.
translation: 除非你他妈的拿出200个瓶盖来，否则别来烦我，混蛋。

original: I have some caps. How about I buy "proof" that I killed you.
translation: 我有些瓶盖。我买一些杀了你的“证据”怎么样？

original: That's too bad, clown shoes. Come back when you can pay to play.
translation: 这太糟了，小丑。等你有钱了再回来吧。

original: Can your table handle 200 caps?
translation: 你的桌子摆得下200个瓶盖吗？

original: Now that's what I'm talking about!
translation: 这就是我说的！

original: You just bought yourself a motherfucking key.
translation: 你刚给自己买了把他妈的钥匙。

original: Now take it and get the hell out of here.
translation: 现在，拿着它该死的给我滚。

original: Now that's what I'm talking about!
translation: 这就是我说的！

original: You don't even know what's going on, do you clown shoes? Ha! You just bought yourself a motherfucking key.
translation: 你甚至不知道怎么回事，小丑？哈！你刚给自己买了他妈把钥匙。

original: Now take it and get the hell out of here.
translation: 现在，拿着它给我滚。

original: Here's 200 caps. Give me something to "prove" I killed you.
translation: 给你200个瓶盖。给我一些“证据”来证明我杀了你。

original: You can give me the key, or I can take it. Your choice.
translation: 你可以把钥匙交出来，或者让我动手。你自己选。

original: You got some big brass ones, you know that. And fuck me if I don't think you could do it.
translation: 你真够无耻，你知道的。如果我不把你当回事，我就他妈的是个傻瓜。

original: Here. Take it. Now go fuck yourself before I change my mind.
translation: 给。拿着。现在，趁着我还没改变主意赶快滚吧。

original: You got some big brass ones, you know that. And fuck me if I don't think you could do it.
translation: 你真够无耻，你知道的。如果我不把你当回事，我他妈就是个傻瓜。

original: Here. Take this key. It's all he really wants anyway. Now go fuck yourself before I change my mind.
translation: 给。拿着这钥匙。这才是他真正想要的。现在，趁着我还没改变主意赶快滚吧。

original: Give me something I can use as proof that I killed you. Or else.
translation: 给我些东西来证明我已经杀了你。或者让我杀了你。

original: I don't think I need to hear any more.
translation: 我不认为我需要再听下去了。

original: Good. I'm getting tired of flapping jaw with you, clown shoes.
translation: 不错。我也厌倦了和你浪费唇舌了，小丑。

original: I think I'll flap my balls against Cherry's ass instead! Oh, yeah!
translation: 我想我还是去和雪莉合体吧！哦，耶！

original: I've heard enough for now.
translation: 现在我听够了。

original: Motherfucking right you have! He should have known better than to send some clown shoes of an assassin to take me out.
translation: 他妈的！他应该知道自己该派个比你这小丑更好的刺客来对付我。

original: Actually, Crowley is alive. He wants some sort of security key you have.
translation: 事实上，考利还活着。他想要你那把安保系统的钥匙。

original: So the meatbag is alive, huh? Fine with me. Just show me the money. Put your fucking caps on the table and you can have it.
translation: 那饭桶还活着，呃？好吧。只要给我钱。把该死的瓶盖放在桌子上，你就可以拿走它了。

original: Fine with me. Just show me the money. Put your fucking caps on the table and you can have it.
translation: 好吧。只要给我钱。把该死的瓶盖放在桌子上，你就可以拿走它了。

original: He wants some sort of security key you have.
translation: 他要你手上的一把安保系统钥匙。

original: So the meatbag is alive, huh? And I bet I know what he wants.
translation: 那饭桶还活着，呃？我打赌我知道他想要什么。

original: But I don't know what you want. What's your angle, clown shoes?
translation: 但我不知道你要什么。你说呢，小丑？

original: Actually, Crowley is alive. I'm supposed to kill you and bring him proof.
translation: 实际上，考利先生还活着。我应该杀了你再给他带去证据。

original: Crowley is alive, and he paid me to kill you because you hate Ghouls.
translation: 考利还活着，而且他雇我来杀了你，因为你仇视尸鬼。

original: What? Fuck me sideways! No, better yet, fuck him. I swear, I'll jam a grenade so far up his ass...
translation: 什么？有没有搞错！不，应该说，去他妈的。我发誓，我会把手榴弹塞进他屁股……

original: I've got nothing against Ghouls. Ha! I even had a Ghoul party girl once, to see what it was like!
translation: 我根本没有针对僵尸。哈！我甚至曾经有过一个僵尸女伴，就为试试那是什么感觉！

original: This is about the key, isn't it? The goddamn key. If you want it, I'd better see some fucking caps on the table, clown shoes.
translation: 这跟钥匙有关，对吧？该死的钥匙。如果你想要它，你最好拿出些该死的瓶盖来，小丑。

original: I've learned what I came for. Thank you.
translation: 我已经得知了我想知道的事。谢谢。

original: No sweat, man. I'm just chilling out here for a while.
translation: 小事一桩，哥们。我只是来这找点乐子。

original: Where did he die?
translation: 他死在哪？

original: A little shithole called Fort Constantine. It fucked us up but good.
translation: 一个叫做康斯坦丁要塞的破地方。那让我们遭过罪，但还行。

original: I'll give you 25 caps for that key.
translation: 我会为那钥匙付给你25个瓶盖。

original: Oh, yeah! I'm gonna be flying high tonight.
translation: 哦，耶！我今晚乐得合不拢嘴。

original: Oh, yeah! I'm gonna be flying high tonight.
translation: 哦，耶！我今晚乐得合不拢嘴。

original: I'll give you 25 caps for something I can bring to Crowley, to "prove" you died.
translation: 我用25个瓶盖换你身上的东西带给考利先生，好“证明”你已经死了。

original: Give me that key. I'd hate to see you bleed to death.
translation: 给我钥匙。我不想看着你流血至死。

original: Uh...sure, dude. I don't know what it's for anyway. Don't need to get all thug like.
translation: 喔……当然，伙计。反正我不知道它是用来干嘛的。没必要表现得像个恶棍。

original: Thanks for the info. I'm just trying to sort all of this out.
translation: 谢谢你的消息。我正试图解决这一切。

original: No problem dude. Thanks for not offing me.
translation: 不客气，伙计。谢谢你没有干掉我。

original: No problem dude. You're alright.
translation: 不客气，伙计。你真不错。

original: Mister Crowley wants your father's security key.
translation: 考利先生想要你父亲的安保系统钥匙。

original: Whoa! Is it, like, worth caps? Cause I got needs, man.
translation: 哇！这会不会值点钱？因为我需要钱，伙计。

original: Whoa! Is this, like, worth caps? Cause I got needs, man.
translation: 哇！这会不会值点钱？因为我需要钱，伙计。

original: I'm guessing Crowley wants your father's key. Just a hunch.
translation: 我猜考利先生想要你父亲的钥匙。只是直觉。

original: Whoa! Is this, like, worth caps? Cause I got needs, man.
translation: 哇！这会不会值点钱？因为我需要钱，伙计。

original: If you give me something personal of yours as proof, I'll lie to Crowley.
translation: 给我点你身上的东西做证据，我就能骗倒考利先生。

original: Do you know what they were doing at the fort?
translation: 你知道他们在堡垒那做什么吗？

original: Nah. He said that old man Tenpenny hired him and some other guys to go in there, but he never said why.
translation: 不知道。他说是特佩尼老头雇他和其他人到那去的，但他从没说过是为了什么。

original: My dad made enough caps off it to set him up good though.
translation: 不过我爸还是从中捞了不少瓶盖，过上了好日子。

original: Can you think of any reason he might want you dead?
translation: 你能想到他想你死的原因吗？

original: Like I told you, man. I never met the dude. Why would he want me dead?
translation: 就像我告诉你的，伙计。我从没见过那家伙。他为什么会要我死呢？

original: Are you sure you can't think of any reason he might want you dead?
translation: 你能想到他想你死的原因吗？

original: No shit! That dude wants me dead?
translation: 不是吧！那家伙想要我死？

original: Sounds like a normal guy.
translation: 听起来像个没事人一样。

original: You're too nosy for your own good. It can be a dangerous habit.
translation: 你太爱管闲事了。这可是个危险的毛病。

original: Sorry. Just forget it.
translation: 抱歉。忘了吧。

original: Yes. He's much nicer than some of my guests.
translation: 是的。他比我的一些客人好多了。

original: Yeah, well don't let it happen again.
translation: 嗯，别让这再发生。

original: I see your point.
translation: 我明白你的意思了。

original: Really? That's a relief.
translation: 真的吗？这真是个安慰。

original: Me? No, I haven't heard a thing.
translation: 我？不。我没听说过什么事。

original: You're as cheap as the rest of them.
translation: 你和其他人一样下贱。

original: Sorry, pal. I can't spare the caps either.
translation: 抱歉，老兄。我也没那么多瓶盖。

original: Sheesh. Wastelanders get dumber every day.
translation: 他妈的。废土游民真是一天比一天愚蠢了。

original: Is that a hint? You want me to bribe you? No way.
translation: 那是暗示吗？你要我贿赂你？没门。

original: I don't give away anything for free. Besides, its obviously worth something to you.
translation: 我从不免费给予任何东西。更何况，这明显值得你付出。

original: Why should I have to pay for gossip?
translation: 为什么我要为流言付钱？

original: Is there anything else you need?
translation: 你还有什么需要？

original: Damn. Another dead end. Thanks anyway.
translation: 该死。谈僵了。不管怎样谢谢了。

original: Oh look! I dropped these 50 caps in your pocket...
translation: 哦，看！我会把这50个瓶盖放进你的口袋里……

original: A whole bottle? You got a deal. All I know is that he keeps trying to hire outsiders to do some killing.
translation: 整整一瓶？成交。我所知道的就是他一直在雇佣外来人做一些杀人的勾当。

original: I heard him mumble something about a Fort too.
translation: 我还听到他在嘀咕一个要塞的事。

original: How about a whole bottle? Here's 10 caps.
translation: 一整瓶怎么样？给你10个瓶盖。

original: Very funny.
translation: 很有趣。

original: Crowley has some scam going where he's going to get rich.
translation: 考利的发迹史里可有不少阴暗的小故事。

original: He tried to get me to kill these three guys, but I wouldn't do it. I've met Dave, and he's no more of a Ghoul bigot than I am.
translation: 他试图让我去杀掉这三个人，但我不会去做。我遇到了戴夫，而他不会比我对僵尸更偏执。

original: Come on. You can tell me. Ahzrukhal said so. <Lie.>
translation: 得了吧。你可以告诉我。阿祖卡是这么说的。<撒谎。>

original: Oh, well that's different.
translation: 噢，那就不同了。

original: You're the third human he's tried to get to kill those guys.
translation: 你是他派去试图杀死这些人的第三个杀手了。

original: He won't ask me, or anyone else in Underworld. It's kind of weird.
translation: 他不会找我，或者地下城的任何人。这很怪。

original: Well, he does keep talking about how he's going to make his fortune soon.
translation: 嗯，他一直在说立刻就要挣大钱了。

original: He says as soon as he finds some wastelander to do his dirty work, he'll be set for life.
translation: 他说一旦他找到了某个废土游民来完成他的卑鄙勾当，他这辈子就安逸了。

original: I think it's just the whiskey talking. Vile stuff.
translation: 我想这只是酒后胡言。不足采信。

original: So he doesn't do anything strange?
translation: 他没做任何不正常的事？

original: Ah, what the hell. Crowley shows up here last year, he's a Ghoul just like the rest of us.
translation: 啊，管它呢。考利去年才来到这，他只不过是个和我们一样的僵尸。

original: Now, all of sudden he's looking for payback against Ghoul haters. Except, I've met Dukov. He never insulted a Ghoul in his life.
translation: 现在他突然想要报复僵尸仇视者。但是，我见过杜克夫。他这一生从未侮辱过任何僵尸。

original: Dukov's got the foulest mouth in the wasteland. He's a drunk and a womanizer, but he's no bigot. Go ask him yourself.
translation: 杜克夫的嘴是全废土最脏的。他是个酒鬼和色鬼，但他不是个偏执狂。自己去问他吧。

original: No one will ever know. Come on.
translation: 没人会知道的。说吧。

original: Damn. Double damn. He finally got someone to kill them humans.
translation: 该死。真是该死。他终于还是找到人来杀死那些人类了。

original: Someone believed that pack of lies he's been spreading. Well I just hope they talk to those poor folk before knocking them off.
translation: 总有人相信他散布的谎言。嗯，我只希望他们在杀死这些可怜人前能和他们谈谈。

original: Of course. I already know. I just wondered if you've heard.
translation: 当然了。我已经听过了。我只是好奇你会不会知道。

original: Deal. All I know is that he keeps trying to hire outsiders to do some killing.
translation: 成交。我所知道的就是他一直在雇佣外来人做一些杀人的勾当。

original: Here's 3 caps for a drink, but you've got to tell me what you know.
translation: 给你3个瓶盖买杯饮料，但是你要告诉我你知道的东西。

original: Ooh, a big spender.
translation: 噢喔，一个大阔佬。

original: Well, it's better than nothing. Crowley has been outfitting himself for some big expedition.
translation: 嗯，聊胜于无。考利在筹备一次大冒险。

original: He's up to something, but he isn't saying what.
translation: 他有所行动，但从不说在干什么。

original: What... oh! A bribe. Why didn't you just say so. Here's 20 caps.
translation: 什么…… 噢！贿赂。你怎么不直说。给你20个瓶盖。

original: Okay! Okay! No need to get upset.
translation: 好吧！好吧！别激动！

original: Crowley is running some sort of scam. He tried to get me to kill some wastelanders, but I wouldn't do it.
translation: 考利正在策划着什么诡计。他想让我去杀几个废土游民，但我没有听他的。

original: Dave is one of them. I've met Dave, and he's mighty strange, but he's no bigot. He doesn't hate Ghouls any more than I do.
translation: 戴夫是其中之一。我认识戴夫，这人确实很奇怪，但是并非偏执狂。他和我一样，并不讨厌僵尸。

original: How about I don't. How about you just tell me.
translation: 我不给你瓶盖。你直接告诉我怎么样。

original: Alright! Alright!
translation: 好吧！好吧！

original: Sometimes he comes by and asks me about the security system and stuff. You know, technical details about locks and computers.
translation: 有时他跑来问我一些有关安保系统的问题。你知道的，就是一些有关防御系统的技术性问题。

original: It's not just chit-chat either. He's angling for something, but I don't know what. Talk to Ahzrukhal up at the Ninth Circle about Crowley.
translation: 他不是随口闲聊。他肯定正在盘算着什么，但我不清楚。去和第九圈的阿祖卡谈谈关于考利的事。

original: Don't make me beat it out of you.
translation: 别逼我打到你说为止。

original: What can you tell me about Mister Crowley?
translation: 你能和我说说考利先生吗？

original: Ahzrukhal doesn't like it when I talk about his customers.
translation: 阿祖卡不喜欢我谈论他的客户。

original: What's the deal with Crowley?
translation: 考利先生是怎么回事？

original: The back room renter? Oh, he's a swell guest. So polite too. Never gets mad at anyone.
translation: 后面那房子的租客？噢，他是个很好的客人。也很彬彬有理。从没对任何人发过脾气。

original: I've been letting that room to him for about a year now.
translation: 我把那房子租给他已经快一年了。

original: Do you know Mister Crowley?
translation: 你认识考利先生吗？

original: Who? Never heard of him.
translation: 谁？从没听说过他。

original: What do you know about Mister Crowley?
translation: 关于考利先生你知道些什么？

original: If I start telling tales about my customers, I'll lose all of them.
translation: 如果我在背后说客人的闲话，我就会失去所有客人。

original: Does Crowley spend a lot of time in here? What's his angle?
translation: 考利先生经常待在这吗？他的立场是什么？

original: Nothing. Why? What have you heard? You've heard something haven't you?
translation: 没什么。怎么了？你听说了什么？你听说了些事，对吧？

original: What do you know about Mister Crowley?
translation: 关于考利先生你知道些什么？

original: He's not my type. Doc Barrows is friendly with him though. Why don't you ask him.
translation: 他不是我喜欢的类型。但巴罗斯医生对他还是很友善的。你为什么不问问他呢。

original: Do you talk to Crowley much? Can you tell me anything about him?
translation: 你和考利先生经常聊天吗？你能给我讲讲关于他的事吗？

original: I know he doesn't sell Jet. Bastard.
translation: 我知道他不卖杰特。杂种。

original: You want to know about Crowley? Go ask Quinn or Greta. I don't follow the gossip around here like they do.
translation: 你想知道考利的事？去问问奎因或者葛丽泰吧。我可不像他们那样热衷于道听途说。

original: He's an odd one. Why just a few months ago he decided he didn't like people calling us zombies.
translation: 他是个奇怪的家伙。几个月前，他忽然开始不喜欢别人叫我们丧尸。

original: No Ghoul likes to be called a zombie, but Crowley was going up to humans and almost daring them to do it.
translation: 没有僵尸喜欢被人叫作丧尸，但考利却找上那些普通人，几乎是靠恐吓来制止他们。

original: Won't never buy me a drink, that's what.
translation: 他决不会请我喝东西，就这些。

original: I'm not going to rat on a customer. Unless you... you know.
translation: 我才不会出卖我的顾客。除非……你知道的。

original: Does Crowley come in here a lot? What's his angle?
translation: 考利先生经常来这吗？他的立场是什么？

original: I might know something interesting, if you're willing to pay for it.
translation: 我可能知道些有趣的事，如果你愿意为此付钱的话。

original: So, what's that Mister Crowley up to?
translation: 那个考利先生在干什么？

original: Whoa! That's a blast from the past.
translation: 哇！这可真唤醒了我的回忆。

original: My dad knew a dude named Crowley. I never met him though.
translation: 我爸爸认识一个叫考利的家伙。不过我从来没有见过他。

original: I think Dad said he died when they were checking out some old fort.
translation: 我想我爸爸说过，在他们一起探索某个旧堡垒时，他死了。

original: Do you know a Mister Crowley?
translation: 你认识考利先生吗？

original: Hey, didn't we already talk about this? Isn't that the dude that wants to kill me?
translation: 嗨，我们不是已经谈过这个了吗？不就是那个想要杀了我的家伙吗？

original: Like I told you, my dad knew this Crowley dude. I never met him though.
translation: 如我所说，我爸爸认识这个叫考利的家伙。可我从来没见过他。

original: Dad said he died when they were checking out some old fort.
translation: 爸爸说他死了。就在他们一起探索某个旧堡垒时。

original: Hey, didn't we already talk about this?
translation: 嗨，我们不是已经谈过这了吗？

original: My dad knew a dude named Crowley. I never met him though.
translation: 我爸爸认识一个叫考利的家伙。不过我从来没有见过他。

original: I think Dad said he died when they were checking out some old fort.
translation: 我想我爸爸说过，在他们一起探索某个旧堡垒时，他死了。

original: He's fucking dead, that's what I can tell you.
translation: 他已经他妈的死了，那就是我能告诉你的。

original: Feral Ghouls ripped his nuts off and ate them for dinner.
translation: 凶悍僵尸把他的蛋拧下来当作晚餐。

original: Someone said you might know a Mister Crowley. Care to comment?
translation: 有人告诉我说你可能认识考利先生。能说两句吗？

original: There's a name I haven't heard in a long time.
translation: 这是个我很久没听到过的名字了。

original: Before the people elected me President, I worked with a mercenary named Mister Crowley.
translation: 在人们选举我成为总统前，我曾跟一个叫作考利先生的佣兵一起工作过。

original: We were part of an expedition to Fort Constantine.
translation: 我们当时是前往康斯坦丁要塞的考察队的成员。

original: Mister President, do you know a Ghoul named Mister Crowley?
translation: 总统先生，你认识一个叫做考利先生的僵尸吗？

original: Never heard of him.
translation: 从没听说过他。

original: Wait. I think I do remember Allistair Tenpenny mentioning him once. Something about a job. It was before I met him.
translation: 等等。我想我记得奥利斯特·特佩尼提过他一次。关于一份工作的事。那还是在我见到他之前。

original: Have you ever heard of a Mister Crowley?
translation: 你听说过考利先生吗？

original: The Ghoul? He's dead. Died twenty years ago.
translation: 那个僵尸？他死了。二十年前就死了。

original: Good riddance too. I hate those shufflers.
translation: 死得好。我讨厌那些瘸子。

original: Do you remember a Mister Crowley?
translation: 你还记不记得考利先生？

original: Sure. People like that don't deserve to live.
translation: 当然。那样的人根本不应该活下去。

original: Excellent! Take this sniper rifle. You'll need it.
translation: 太好了！带上这把狙击步枪。你会需要它的。

original: Here's a list of the guys and their last known locations. Word will get around if Tenpenny is killed, but I'll need proof for the others.
translation: 这有一份那些家伙的名单和他们最后出现的地点。特佩尼一死自然会有消息传开，但我需要你杀死其他人的证据。

original: Bring me back something personal from each of them as proof. Like a key or ring or something.
translation: 给我带回他们每人的一件私人物品作为证据。比如钥匙或戒指这类的东西。

original: I don't like where this is headed.
translation: 我不喜欢事情目前的发展方向。

original: Forget it. I guess you aren't the right type.
translation: 算了吧。我想你不合适干这事。

original: Not for the right cause.
translation: 不是为了正义。

original: Or the right money, heh?
translation: 或者正确的报酬，嗯？

original: I've got this list of people. Ghoul bigots. Real scum.
translation: 我这有一份名单。僵尸偏执狂。真正的人渣。

original: I've only got four guys left on the list. Started with eleven. All of them hate Ghouls and treat us like we're zombies.
translation: 我的名单上只有四个人了。最初有十一个。他们所有人都仇视僵尸并且把我们当成丧尸来对待。

original: They all deserve to die. But it has to be done with a head shot. Just like the old stories where zombies can only be killed that way.
translation: 他们都该死，而且必须被爆头而死，就像老故事中唯一能杀死丧尸的方法那样。

original: I'll give you 100 caps for each of them. If they die some other way, I'm only paying 25 though.
translation: 我会为他们每个人付你100个瓶盖。但如果他们是以其他方式死去，我就只付你25个瓶盖。

original: Um... I should go.
translation: 嗯……我得走了。

original: Hey, that's your loss, smoothkin.
translation: 嗨，那是你的损失，光皮肤。

original: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。

original: I thought so. No stomach for hard work.
translation: 我也这么想。努力工作不合我的胃口。

original: Alrighty then. I'll just be going.
translation: 好吧。我要走了。

original: Suit yourself.
translation: 听你的。

original: Okay. What's the plan?
translation: 好吧。怎么做？

original: Not everyone is as sympathetic to Ghouls as you are. In fact some humans are downright bigots.
translation: 不是每个人都像你一样对僵尸有同情心。事实上，有些人类是彻头彻尾的偏执狂。

original: They treat us like zombies, calling us brain eaters and shufflers.
translation: 他们像对丧尸一样对待我们，他们称我们食脑者和瘸子。

original: Well, I'm going to make them pay. Uh...before I get into the details, you don't have anything against killing do you?
translation: 嗯，我会让他们付出代价的。呃……在我开始讲述细节之前，我得确定你不会对杀人感到反感，是吧？ ?

original: All true, except for the part about the mutants, the water and the whore.
translation: 都是真的，除了变种人，水，还有妓女这几部分。

original: Ha, ha! I like a human that knows his place. Too many of you think we're all just zombies.
translation: 哈，哈！我喜欢有自知之明的人。你们中的太多人以为我们不过是丧尸而已。

original: They don’t know, or don’t care, that we’re just as human as they are inside. We bleed! We hurt! We regret!
translation: 他们不知道，或者说不在乎，我们的内心是和他们一样的人类。我们会流血！我们会痛苦！我们会懊悔！

original: And you know what really pisses me off?
translation: 但你知道是什么让我真正生气吗？

original: They think the only way to kill us is to shoot us in the head, like in the old zombie stories, and that will put us out of our misery.
translation: 他们认为唯一能杀掉我们的方式就是在我们的脑袋上来一枪，就像那些老丧尸故事一样，认为那会终结我们的痛苦。

original: Hey, I know! Maybe you could help me even the score.
translation: 嗨，我知道了！或许你可以帮我挽回局势。

original: Milk sucking? You shuffle stepping, brain eating, grave loving zombie!
translation: 吸奶虫？你这瘸腿的食脑者，墓居丧尸！

original: Another human bigot. It figures. Go mate with a Super Mutant.
translation: 又一个人类偏执狂。正好。去和超级变种人做伴吧。

original: Hey! I'm just looking to trade a drink for some gossip.
translation: 嗨！我想用杯喝的来换点消息。

original: Humph. Not sure I know anything of use, but I'll take that drink.
translation: 哼。我不确定我知道任何有用的消息，但我会收下这杯酒。

original: That will cost you two caps.
translation: 那会花费你2个瓶盖。

original: Humph. Not sure I know anything of use, but ask away.
translation: 哼。我不确定我知道任何有用的消息，但是问吧。

original: Hey! I'm just trying to get some fresh news.
translation: 嗨！我只是想知道些新消息。

original: Easy now. I've got nothing against Ghouls.
translation: 冷静下来。我并没有任何针对尸鬼的意思。

original: Is that so?  Even if I call you a milk-sucking, mutant-loving, water-stealing whore?
translation: 真的？即便我称你为吸奶虫、变种狂、偷水贼？

original: Is that so?  Even if I call you a milk-sucking, mutant-loving, water-stealing son of a whore?
translation: 真的？即便我称你为吸奶虫、变种狂、偷水贼？

original: Fucking brain eater!
translation: 他妈的食脑族！

original: Are you comparing me to a...a...zombie!
translation: 你在把我比作一个……一个……丧尸！

original: You bigot! Take your sweaty carcass elsewhere.
translation: 你这偏执狂！你给我滚吧。

original: Do you have any traders in town? Any doctors?
translation: 镇里有商人吗？医生呢？

original: We've got two things to do in this town: suck and die. No one ever makes it in this place. You won't find any stores to loot here.
translation: 我们在这镇里只有两件事要做：胡混和等死。在这地方从没有人能坚持下来。你也不会找到一个能打劫的商店。

original: Now that Red's here, she'll open the clinic back up. Bother her.
translation: 现在瑞德来了，她会再次开诊所的。去烦她吧。

original: Do you have any traders in town? Any doctors?
translation: 镇里有商人吗？医生呢？

original: No. Red used to run a medical clinic, but Super Mutants captured her in the last attack.
translation: 不。瑞德曾开过一个医疗诊所，但是超级变种人在上次攻击中掳走了她。

original: There aren't many of us left to run stores or anything like that. You could stop by Red's clinic if you need stitching up.
translation: 我们没剩下多少人，不用经营商店什么的。如果你需要缝合伤口的话，可以到瑞德的诊所去看看。

original: Red used to run the clinic, but she ... she's gone.
translation: 瑞德曾经打理过一个诊所，但她 ……她走了。

original: Look, the only place to go is the town hall, and that's just a meeting spot for us. There aren't any traders or anything around here.
translation: 听着，唯一可去的地方是镇政大厅，但那只是我们的会议地点。这周围没有商人什么的。

original: Red's back, so she's running the clinic again. I go there all the time. Get my wounds treated from fighting. Yeah.
translation: 瑞德回来了，所以她把诊所重开了。我经常去那里。治疗在战斗中留下的创伤。耶。

original: I wander around town to find chalk and makeup sometimes. Not like there's anyplace to buy stuff.
translation: 我有时在镇里游荡，找寻粉笔或者化妆品。这不是那种可以购物的地方。

original: What's there to do around here, Bittercup?
translation: 在这里能干些什么, “苦杯”？

original: Red's clinic has some sharp knives and lighters. Too bad Red is always there, helping "these" people.
translation: 瑞德的诊所里有些锋利的刀子和打火机。但糟糕的是瑞德一直在那，帮助着“这些”人。

original: What's there to do around here, Bittercup?
translation: 在这里能干些什么, “苦杯”？

original: I guess adults don't go to stores that much. That must be why there isn't anything here. Yeah. Yeah, that's it.
translation: 我猜大人不是那么经常去商店。所以这里什么都没有。嗯。嗯，就是这样。

original: This is a town, right? Where are the stores?
translation: 这是个镇子，对吧？那么商店在哪？

original: Yep. As long as you've still got the ass to sit down on, I can fix you up. I'm also in the market for medical supplies.
translation: 对。只要你还剩个屁股能坐下，我就能把你修补好。我也出售药品补给。

original: You're the doctor in town?
translation: 你是镇上的医生？

original: Hey, I'm not your personal tour guide! Besides, there's nothing to do in Big Town. Super Mutants tore everything apart.
translation: 嗨，我不是你的私人导游！还有，在大镇也没事做。超级变种人把一切都毁了。

original: If only Red were here, then there would be a doctor to go to. You'll just have to make do without.
translation: 如果瑞德还在这就好了，我们就有医生看了。可现在你只得应付过去。

original: What's there to do here, anyway?
translation: 在这能干些什么？顺便问问。

original: Well, you've seen the clinic. Red's the smart one in Bigtown. I'd ask her.
translation: 你去过诊所了。瑞德是大镇里最聪明的人。我宁愿去问她。

original: Red should have been here, but she probably got dragged off by the mutants. Damn it! DAMN IT!
translation: 瑞德本该在这里，但她可能被变种人抓走了。该死！真该死！

original: Red was the only one in town that dealt with outsiders. Now she's dead. Argh! It's so unfair! Damn it!
translation: 瑞德是镇里唯一跟外人打交道的。现在她死了。啊！这太不公平了！该死的！

original: There's nothing here but the stench of death, and the threat of attack looming over every sunset.
translation: 这里什么都没有，只有死亡的恶臭，还有每次日落后遭受攻击的恐慌。

original: The injured wind up in Red's Clinic. There's always so much red on the doctor, and it's not from her fabric.
translation: 伤员都拥到瑞德的诊所去。医生的身上总是红红的，而且都不是她衣料的颜色。

original: There's nothing here but the stench of death, and the threat of attack looming over every sunset.
translation: 这里什么都没有，只有死亡的恶臭，还有每次日落后遭受攻击的恐慌。

original: This place looks like a ghost town.
translation: 这地方看上去像个鬼镇。

original: Yeah, you're telling me. Everything that could go wrong, goes wrong. The Super Mutants and Slavers seem to take turns beating the crap out of us.
translation: 嗯，就像你说的。所有能出错的地方都出错了。超级变种人和奴隶贩子好像在轮流欺负我们。

original: There's no way for us to fight back, so we just keep building barricades around town.
translation: 我们无力回击，所以只能在镇子周围加固防御工事。

original: Now we've been pushed back all the way. Nowhere left to run now.
translation: 现在我们一路推却。已经无路可逃了。

original: Whenever those... things come, they grab a few people instead of killing them. No one knows what happens after that. No one wants to know.
translation: 不管这些……东西，什么时候来，他们都会抓走一几个人，而不是杀掉他们。没人知道那之后会发生什么。也没人想要知道。

original: There's... there's always so much blood after they come. And then someone has to... move the bodies...
translation: 在他们……在他们来过后就到处都是血。然后就需要有人……搬运尸体……

original: Why do Super Mutants keep attacking the town?
translation: 为什么超级变种人不断攻击这里？

original: I wish it were. When I'm gone, I'll be sure to haunt this place ... <sigh>
translation: 希望如此。在我死后，我的鬼魂肯定会在这地方转悠的……<叹气>

original: Nah, no way. Bigtown is a great place to be! I bet I could live over there, in that building with all the bullet holes and burn marks. Cool!
translation: 得了吧，不可能。大镇是个了不起的地方！我打赌我可以住在那里，就在那满是弹痕和燃迹的建筑里。酷！ !

original: Just ask everyone else in town. I'm sure they'll tell you how great it is to be here, all grownup!
translation: 去问问镇上的其他人吧。我确定他们会告诉你这有多么伟大的，全部是大人！

original: Oh, just grand, can't you tell? People are always dying to visit here and bring back "souvenirs."
translation: 噢，就是这么棒，你不知道吗？人们都迫不及待地想来这并带回些“纪念品”去。

original: I used to pay off or trick the Slavers into leaving us alone. Not that it stops them much.
translation: 我曾经买通或说服那些奴隶贩子离我们远点。但效果并不明显。

original: Those Mutants are the real problem. Too big to shoot down and too single-minded to outwit. They just keep coming.
translation: 那些变种人才是真正的问题。他们块头太大，难以击倒；脑子一根筋，又没法说服。他们一直侵犯我们。

original: How are things in Big Town, Red?
translation: 大镇的情形怎么样，瑞德？

original: You've seen those Super Mutants and their ... appetite. There's no way Bigtown will survive with them around.
translation: 你也见过那些超级变种人和他们的……胃口。如果被它们围着，大镇不可能幸存。

original: What do you think will happen to Big Town?
translation: 你觉得大镇将来会怎么样？

original: I remember screaming and gunfire. One of those big, hulking things shot at me. That's all I can think of.
translation: 我还记得尖叫和枪声。其中一个巨大而笨重的家伙向我开枪。那就是所有我能想到的。

original: Do you know anything about the Super Mutant attacks?
translation: 你知道超级变种人的攻击的情况吗？

original: Two very angry types of movements. Slow, lumbering, powerful movements and jerky, erratic, excitable movements. Both coming for the kill.
translation: 两套充满愤怒的动作。缓慢、笨拙、强有力的动作，和混乱、古怪、花哨的动作。都用于残杀。

original: What are you on the lookout for?
translation: 你在警戒什么？

original: Where did you people come from, anyway?
translation: 顺便问问，你们这些人从哪里来的？

original: Most of us came from Little Lamplight. We got too old, so they kicked us out. Brats.
translation: 我们中的大多数来自小灯镇。我们太大了，所以那些调皮鬼把我们踢了出来。

original: Always heard stories about how great Big Town was, where the grownups go. But there's nothing here except death and sand.
translation: 总能听到大镇怎么了不起，那是大人居住的地方。但这除了死亡和沙子外什么都没有。

original: Oh, Little Lamplight is where most of us came from. Red and Pappy and Flash and Bittercup. We used to play together, when we were kids.
translation: 噢，我们中的大多数来自小灯镇 。瑞德，帕匹和福莱斯还有“苦杯”，当我们还是孩子的时候，总在一起玩。

original: Then we got old, and we had to leave. Those are the rules. So we packed up and headed here, like we were supposed to.
translation: 然后我们长大了，所以我们必须离开。那是规则。所以我们背起行囊来到这边，就像我们应该要做的那样。

original: No one told us it would be like this. We never have fun anymore, and most of us ... most of us are dead.
translation: 从没有人告诉过我们会是这样。我们再也没有得到过快乐，而且我们中的大多数……我们中的大多数人都死了。

original: We all used to live in a place called Little Lamplight, but they have a rule about age. You reach sixteen, and you're out.
translation: 我们曾经都住在一个叫做小灯镇的地方，但他们有一个关于年龄的规定。当你16岁时就必须离开。

original: Didn't matter, though, because you'd just pack your things and head to Bigtown. All the adults go there, and there's plenty to eat.
translation: 不过也没什么，因为你要收拾好自己的东西起程到大镇去。所有的大人都去那里，而且那里有充足的食物。

original: "Plenty to eat" alright, if you like eating bullets. I've lost count of how many times I've been shot at.
translation: “充足的食物”是没错，如果你喜欢吃子弹的话。我已经数不清自己当过多少次靶子了。

original: Whoa, that was a long time ago. I'm not sure when, but everyone who grows up in Lamplight ends up here. Not too many of us left.
translation: 哇，那是很久以前了。我不确定具体时间，但每一个在小灯镇长大的人都会到这来。我们中并没有多少人剩下。

original: Tell me how Big Town got started.
translation: 告诉我大镇是怎么建立的。

original: Bigtown? A fairy-tale really. The Lamplighters who turn sixteen aren't allowed to stay in the caves, but they have to go somewhere.
translation: 大镇？一个真正的童话。长到16岁的小灯镇居民不再允许待在洞穴里，他们必须到别的地方去。

original: And to encourage people to leave, they invented Bigtown: the "great grownup place" that you got to go to when you became an adult.
translation: 为了鼓励人们离开，他们创造了大镇：“了不起的大人之地”，那就是当你成年后要去的地方。

original: I think you can see how true those stories were.
translation: 我想你也看到这些故事有多么真实了。

original: Give me the history of this place.
translation: 告诉我这地方的历史。

original: From the look of things, I'd say a Super Mutant sat down in a ditch one day and shat out this town.
translation: 照目前的情形看，我要说迟早会有个超级变种人坐在沟上，把镇子里的人都拉出来。

original: I dragged myself here from Lamplight. I didn't believe all the stories about Bigtown, but I wasn't about to let everyone else go there without me.
translation: 我自己从小灯镇挪到了这边。我不太相信那些大镇的故事，但我也不能让其他人自己跑来。

original: A few dozen attacks on the town later, and here I am. Almost an ingredient in a Super Mutant chile cook-off.
translation: 几十个变种人不久之后就攻击了我们的镇子，我就混成这样了。几乎变成超级变种人的一味菜肴了。

original: Do you know how Big Town got started?
translation: 你知道大镇是怎么建立的吗？

original: Well, I don't know. I guess the grownups built it when they got sick of little brats always hanging around them. I bet that's it!
translation: 我不知道。我猜是大人建造了它，因为他们受不了那些围着他们转的小鬼。我打赌就是这样！

original: Any idea why there are barricades surrounding the town?
translation: 你知道为什么镇子周围有这么多路障吗？

original: Sometimes you'll see small, tired dots on the horizon instead of angry, anxious ones. Those are settlers who come here from Lamplight. Poor fools.
translation: 有时你能在地平线上看到渺小、疲惫的身影，而不是充满愤怒和欲望的家伙。那就是从小灯镇来的人。可怜的傻瓜们。

original: How did you people get here?
translation: 你们是怎么聚到这里的？

original: Whoa, take it easy. I was just asking.
translation: 哇，别当真。我随便问问。

original: I'm sorry, it's just been hard. When I managed to save him, I though there might be a chance...
translation: 对不起，这太难了。当我试图救他时，我以为还有机会……

original: But now, it just looks like he's going to die like the others. And... I just can't bring myself to deal with it.
translation: 但现在，看上去他就要像其他人一样死去了。而我……实在看不下去。

original: I'm just saying, it's an option.
translation: 我意思是，还有一种选择。

original: No. It isn't. Not to me.
translation: 不。不是。至少对我而言不是。

original: You let a dying man use supplies you need? You're a bunch of morons.
translation: 你让一个快死的人使用你自己需要的补给？你们是群大白痴。

original: Maybe. But I'd rather die as a moron who cares for my friends than be a heartless jerk like you.
translation: 可能吧。但我宁可作为一个关心朋友的白痴而死，也不要做个像你一样没心没肺的垃圾。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Yeah. Let's do that.
translation: 好。就这么做吧。

original: Why keep him alive? Don't you need the supplies you're using on him?
translation: 为什么让他活着？难道你不需要这些你正在给他使用的补给吗？

original: I keep him alive because he's my friend. That's how we work around here -- we watch out for each other. I wouldn't expect you to understand.
translation: 我让他活着是因为他是我的朋友。那就是我们的生存方式 — 我们照顾彼此。我不指望你能理解。

original: I told you, I keep him alive because he's my friend. That's how we work around here -- we watch out for each other.
translation: 我告诉过你，我让他活下去是因为他是我的朋友。那就是我们的生存方式 — 我们照顾彼此。

original: Maybe I can help him.
translation: 或许我可以帮助他。

original: Maybe you can. Feel free to take a look at him. But don't get in over your head. He's got some pretty nasty injuries.
translation: 或许你能。随意检查他吧。但别抱太大期望。他伤得很惨。

original: I doubt it. I've dealt with dozens of battlefield injuries at this point, and the best I've been able to do is keep him knocked out.
translation: 能行么。到现在，我已经处理过许多战斗创伤了，而我能做到的最好程度就是让他保持昏迷状态。

original: Who's that guy in the clinic?
translation: 在诊所里的那家伙是谁？

original: I told you, that's Timebomb. And if it were up to you, he'd be dead. Just stay away from him.
translation: 我告诉过你，那是“定时炸弹”。要是换了你的话，他早死了。你给我离他远点。

original: That's Timebomb. He got lucky. During the last raid, the mutant shot him down in the street.
translation: 那是“定时炸弹”。他很幸运。上次遭到劫掠的时候，变种人在街头击中了他。

original: Normally, they go for the kill, but I managed to drag Timebomb away before they could get they killing blow in.
translation: 一般来说，他们会杀了他，但我在他们来得及下手之前就把“定时炸弹”拖走了。

original: I dragged him back to the clinic, but his injuries are way beyond what I can deal with. Honestly, there's not much hope for him.
translation: 我把他拖回了诊所，但他所受到的创伤已超出了我的能力范围。坦白说，他没什么希望了。

original: That's Timebomb. He got lucky. During the last raid, the mutant shot him down in the street.
translation: 那是“定时炸弹”。他很幸运。上次遭到劫掠的时候，变种人在街头击中了他。

original: Normally, they go for the kill, but I managed to drag Timebomb away before they could get they killing blow in.
translation: 一般来说，他们会杀了他，但我在他们来得及下手之前就把“定时炸弹”拖走了。

original: I dragged him back to the clinic, but his injuries are way beyond what I can deal with. Honestly, there's not much hope for him.
translation: 我把他拖回了诊所，但他所受到的创伤已超出了我的能力范围。坦白说，他没什么希望了。

original: Who's that guy over there? Is he hurt?
translation: 那个家伙是谁？他受伤了吗？

original: I have a Fission Battery that will fix that express elevator.
translation: 我有一块能用于高速电梯的核聚变合电池。

original: Great. Now get it hooked up to the elevator so we can get out of here.
translation: 好极了。把它装到电梯上，我们就可以离开这了。

original: Fantastic! Get that over to Donovan right away.
translation: 太奇妙了！赶快把它交给多诺万吧。

original: As soon as he gets it up and running make a break for it.
translation: 尽快让他使电梯恢复运作。

original: Remember our rally point is our H.Q., Ranger Compound. Don't stop for anything!
translation: 记得在指挥部--游骑兵营地会合。无论如何都不要停下！

original: Let me have that thing. Give me a few minutes, and I'll have the elevator up and running.
translation: 把那东西给我。我需要一些时间，我会修好电梯，让它恢复运作。

original: As soon as I get it online, we'll get out of here.
translation: 只要我让它联线，我们就可以离开这了。

original: Well, what the fuck you bringin' it to me for? Get it plugged into the elevator!
translation: 你他妈的把它给我干嘛？把它接在电梯上就行了！

original: Well, what the fuck you bringin' it to me for? Give to to Donovan. Sheesh.
translation: 你他妈的把它给我干嘛？把它给多诺万。他妈的。

original: Why don't one of you come with me?
translation: 为什么你们不跟我来呢？

original: We have to hold this position at all costs. If... well, if you don't make it back, I can't afford to lose the elevator or we're never getting down.
translation: 我们需要不惜一切代价守住阵地。如果……好吧，如果你不守住它，我们就无法承受失去这电梯的损失，那样我们将永远无法下去。

original: I can't allow that to happen. Nothing personal.
translation: 我不能允许那发生。没有原因。

original: If any of us goes down, don't stop. Get the hell out of here and make for our H.Q., Ranger Compound.
translation: 如果我们中的任何人下去了，不要停下。见鬼，立刻离开这并赶到我们的游骑兵营地去。

original: Okay, I'll go back and look for the Fission Battery.
translation: 好吧，我会回去找核聚变合电池。

original: All right. We'll hold the roof position here.
translation: 好吧。我们会在这坚守楼顶的阵地。

original: If any of us goes down, don't stop. Get the hell out of here and make for our H.Q., Ranger Compound.
translation: 如果我们中的任何人倒下，不要停。见鬼，立刻离开这儿并赶到我们的游骑兵营地去。

original: Are there any other ways off this roof?
translation: 还有其他离开楼顶的路吗？

original: Well, I can think of a faster way, but I doubt you'd survive the fall.
translation: 嗯，还有一条更快的路，但我不知道你跳下去能否活着。

original: Doesn't look like the elevator works anymore.
translation: 看上去这电梯不能运作了。

original: You're right. What we need is something to power the elevator motor up here and get the thing going.
translation: 你是对的。我们需要的就是能给电梯的引擎充能并让一切开始重新运做的东西。

original: On the way up here, I'm pretty certain we passed a maintenance room. Inside was a wrecked Protectron.
translation: 在来这的路上，我确定我们经过了保全室。里面有一个未激活的自动护卫。

original: If you can get me its fission battery, I can have Donovan jury-rig the elevator.
translation: 如果你能给我带来核裂变电池，我可以叫多诺万使电梯重新运作。

original: Okay, fine. Yes, she's alive. She's safe in Underworld. Satisfied?
translation: 好的。是的，她还活着。她在地下城很安全。满意了？

original: Yes, very. Now let's talk about getting the hell off of this roof.
translation: 是的，非常。现在让我们谈谈离开这该死的楼顶的事吧。

original: I would have proposed going back the way you came, but apparently it's impossible now.
translation: 我得到的建议是，从你来的那条路回去，但很显然，现在这不可能了。

original: So, the express elevator is our only solution.
translation: 高速电梯就是我们唯一的途径。

original: We'll chat about stuff later. We have to get out of here, right now!
translation: 我们迟些再聊。现在我们得离开这了，现在！

original: Listen. I don't know who you are. I don't even know why Reilly sent you. One thing I do know is that you're beginning to piss me off.
translation: 听着。我不知道你是谁。我甚至不知道为什么莱莉派你来。我唯一知道的事是你开始让我生气了。

original: Now, stopping being an asshole and work with me, will ya?
translation: 现在，如果你想和我一起，就别再像个混蛋似的，好吗？

original: Who put you in charge?
translation: 谁让你主管这？

original: Reilly did. I'm the second in command of the Rangers. Now, can you just answer the question?
translation: 莱莉的命令。我是游骑兵的第二把手。现在，你可以回答问题了吗？

original: Any clue where I can find a Fission Battery?
translation: 有什么关于核聚变合电池位置的线索吗？

original: Hmmmm. Not really. All I remember is passing that maintenance office on the third floor.
translation: 唔。不完全是这样。我能记得的就是在三楼曾经过那件间保全室。

original: Sorry, we were under fire the whole time. Otherwise, I would have cleaned the place out.
translation: 抱歉，我们一直都在火力压制之下。另外，我还得扫荡这地区。

original: When we passed the maintenance room, I spied a deactivated Protectron inside. Just wrench open its access panel and you'll find it.
translation: 当我们路过保全室的时候，我在里面藏了一个未激活的自动护卫。打开它的检修门你就能找到。

original: All I remember is mowing down Super Mutants with Eugene here.
translation: 我所记得的只有在这和尤金一起绞碎那些超级变种人。

original: Ask the eggheads, they're runnin' the show. I just point and shoot... then stuff dies.
translation: 问那些书呆子去，他们才是头。我只要发现目标然后开火……接着那些东西就死了。

original: How have you guys survived up here?
translation: 你们这些家伙是怎么在这活下来的？

original: I'd say it was a whole lot of luck. We set as many traps as we could behind us and killed as many Super Mutants as possible.
translation: 我得说那真是个好运气。我们在身后留下了尽可能多的陷阱干掉了尽可能多的超级变种人。

original: Being able to fend off the last wave of them made the rest more cautious, but it also drained our ammo.
translation: 挡下了他们的最后一波攻击使剩下的那些家伙更谨慎了，但我们的弹药也耗尽了。

original: It's only a matter of time before they rally, especially since you punched through their lines.
translation: 他们卷土重来只是时间问题，尤其是在你突破了他们的阵线之后。

original: Skill baby, pure skill. And my big-ass gun!
translation: 技术，宝贝，纯技术。还有我强大的枪！

original: By the seat of our pants. We are out of everything. Ammo, food and time.
translation: 以我们的裤子的名义发誓。我们弹尽粮绝了。弹药，食物和时间都所剩无几。

original: I have no idea how we've made it this long, but damn I am glad you got up here.
translation: 我也不知道我们怎么能坚持这么久，但是我真他妈高兴你能来这。

original: Who are those girls? And where are their clothes?
translation: 那些女孩是谁？她们的衣服在哪？

original: Ha ha! They're my party girls.
translation: 哈哈！她们是我的女人。

original: I'm too much man for just one woman, so I need two! I wear them out every night.
translation: 只有一个女人对男人来说太不够了，所以我要两个！我每天晚上都把她们扒光。

original: Why should they bother getting dressed when I'm just going to take it off?
translation: 如果我要把衣服脱下来的话，为什么她们还要费神穿上呢？

original: Ha ha! Cherry is my play toy.
translation: 哈哈！雪莉是我的玩具。

original: I love my Cherry pie! Love it all night long!
translation: 我喜欢我的雪莉派！我会整夜地爱她！

original: I like her half naked. I like her all naked, but she says she gets cold.
translation: 我喜欢她半裸的样子。我更喜欢她全裸的样子，但是她说她冷。

original: Who's that girl? And why isn't she dressed?
translation: 那女孩是谁？她为什么不多穿点？

original: Ha ha! Fantasia is my girl Friday... and Monday, and Wednesday...
translation: 哈哈！凡塔纱是我星期五的女孩……还有星期一，还有星期三……

original: She makes all my fantasies come true. Ha ha!
translation: 她把我所有的幻想都变成了现实。哈哈！

original: That's my favorite outfit. If she gets cold, old Dukov knows how to warm her up!
translation: 那是我最喜欢的外套。如果她觉得冷，老杜克夫知道怎么让她暖起来！

original: That girl looks cold. Why isn't she dressed?
translation: 那女孩看上去很冷。她为什么不多穿点？

original: Hey! Watch your language, clown shoes.
translation: 嗨！小心你的言辞，小丑。

original: I don't pay them. They take care of me, so I take care of them. We rub each other wrong all night long! Ha, ha!
translation: 我不付她们钱。她们照顾我，我也同样照顾她们。我们整晚都在互补长短！哈，哈！

original: So those girls are just your... whores?
translation: 这么说那些女孩只不过是你的……妓女？

original: Hey! Watch you language, clown shoes.
translation: 嗨！说话注意点，小丑。

original: I take care of her, so she takes care of me. Ha, ha! She rubs me wrong all night long. Ha, ha!
translation: 我不付她们钱。她们照顾我，我也同样照顾她们。我们整晚都在互补长短！哈，哈！

original: So that girl is just your... whore?
translation: 这么说那个女孩只不过是你的……妓女？

original: Not yet, but I'm working on it.
translation: 还没有，我正在办呢。

original: Well? what are you waiting for?
translation: 哦？你在等什么？

original: Allistair Tenpenny is dead. One shot, right through the brain.
translation: 奥利斯特·特佩尼死了。一枪正中头部。

original: What! I hired you to kill him! I want him dead! You double crossed me.
translation: 什么！我是雇你去杀他的！我要他死！你出卖了我。

original: I won't get into a bidding war with him. I'll lose.
translation: 我没法和他竞标。我会输的。

original: Guess I've got to kill you now.
translation: 看来现在我得杀了你了。

original: I've decided not to kill Tenpenny. He made me a better offer.
translation: 我决定不杀特佩尼。他给我的条件更好。

original: Yes, yes, yes! Another bigot bites the dust.
translation: 好，好，好！又一个偏执狂玩完了。

original: Good riddance. The wasteland is better off without him.
translation: 死得好。废土没有他会变得更好。

original: Allistair Tenpenny is dead, but not from a shot to the head.
translation: 奥利斯特·特佩尼已经死了，不过没爆他的头。

original: I've reconsidered your offer. I'll kill those Ghoul-hating bigots for you.
translation: 我会重新考虑你的合约。我会为你杀掉那些仇视尸鬼的偏执狂。

original: Excellent! Okay, here's a list of the guys and their last known locations.
translation: 太棒了！好吧，这有一份那些家伙的名单和他们最后出现的地点。

original: Oh, and I'll need some proof. Word will get around about Tenpenny, so don't worry about him.
translation: 噢，我还需要一些证据。特佩尼的死会很快传开，所以别操心他的证据。

original: As for the others...I know. The other three have special security keys. You'll know them when you see them.
translation: 至于其他人……我知道。其他的三个人有特殊的安保系统钥匙。当你见到他们时就明白了。

original: For each one you bring me, I'll pay you 25 caps. If they die from a shot to the head, I'll make it 100 caps.
translation: 你每带回给我一把，我会付给你25个瓶盖。如果他们是爆头而死，我将付给你100个。

original: Hey, aren't you the one who said we shouldn't call her that? That we should show a little respect to the elderly?
translation: 嗨，你不是说过不能那么叫她吗？你说我们应该对老年人表现出一点尊敬？

original: "Old Lady Dithers"? I thought you were the one who said we should be nice, and refer to her as "Ms. Dithers".
translation: “迪瑟大妈”？我想是你告诉我们要变好一点，并称她为“迪瑟女士”。

original: Oh, stop it. You know I don't trust that woman one bit.
translation: 噢，算了吧。你知道我一点都不相信那女人。

original: George, honestly. You know I don't like talking to her.
translation: 乔治，坦白说。你知道我不喜欢和她说话。

original: Mabel, I meant to ask you. Have you seen the new RobCo catalog? I thought you might be interested, since you don't seem to like your Mr. Handy.
translation: 梅布尔，我得问你。你看过新的罗科目录了吗？我想你可能会感兴趣，因为你似乎不太喜欢你的那台巧手先生。

original: Oh, Mabel. Did you want to look for a new robot? I know you're not comfortable with yours.
translation: 噢，梅布尔。你想找台新机器人吗？我知道你对你那台不太满意。

original: Timmy Neusbaum left his roller skates in my house again. How many times have I talked to Pat about that?
translation: 提米·纽斯保又把他的轮滑靴落在我家了。我究竟要告诉帕特多少次？

original: I'm annoyed, Martha. Timmy left his roller skates in my house again. He needs to learn to pick up after himself.
translation: 我很苦恼，玛莎。提米又把他的轮滑靴落在我家了。他得学会自己收拾。

original: Should I invite the Neusbaums over for Bridge, or will you be down in the basement all night again?
translation: 我是该邀请纽斯保一家玩桥牌，还是让你又在地下室待上整晚？

original: Hi, Roger. Are you planning on spending the evening down in the basement again?
translation: 嘿，罗杰。你又打算在地下室待上整晚吗？

original: Good day to you, sir! Everything going well at home?
translation: 你好，先生！家里的一切都还好吗？

original: Hi, Roger. How are you? And how's that wife of yours?
translation: 嗨，罗杰。你好吗？你妻子怎么样？

original: Why, hello there.
translation: 噢，你好。

original: What's the good word?
translation: 有什么好消息？

original: Hello there.
translation: 你好啊。

original: What's going on?
translation: 发生了什么？

original: How are you today?
translation: 你今天好吗？

original: It's not funny, George. I'm not joking around.
translation: 这不好笑，乔治。我没有开玩笑。

original: That's not the point and you know it. Don't try and change the subject.
translation: 你知道这不是重点。别想转移话题。

original: Pat, you know as well as I do that she's where most of our news comes from, one way or another.
translation: 帕特，你和我一样清楚传闻大多都是她传出来的，每天都是如此。

original: Suddenly you don't have an interest in hearing what's going on in town? I find that hard to believe.
translation: 你突然没兴趣知道镇上最近都发生什么了？我认为这很难以置信。

original: No, no. I don't like robots. Don't like the one I have, and don't want a new one. If I didn't rely on the thing so much, I'd just get rid of it.
translation: 不，不。我不喜欢机器人。不喜欢我的那台，也不想要新的。如果不是太过依赖那东西，我早就把它扔了。

original: I don't want a new one. I don't even really want the one I have now... I don't trust it, Martha. Not a bit.
translation: 我不想要新的。我甚至都不太想要我现在的那台……我不信任它，玛莎。一点也不。

original: I suppose so. I haven't really noticed.
translation: 这样啊。我真没注意到。

original: Oh, I... It's not really my place to say. I'm sure they're fine.
translation: 噢，我……这真的不该这么说的。我肯定他们都很好。

original: Well that's not safe, is it? Someone could really get hurt. It's a shame Pat doesn't teach him to be more responsible.
translation: 嗯，那不安全，不是吗？真的有人会受伤。帕特没有教导他要更有责任心真令人惭愧。

original: Oh dear. Someone could really get hurt. You'd think Pat would have talked to him about it.
translation: 噢，亲爱的。真的有人会受伤。你得想帕特会跟他谈谈的。

original: Yes, of course. I'm fine, Janet's fine. Everything is just fine. And... And you?
translation: 是的，当然。我很好，珍妮特很好。所有事都很好。还有……你呢？

original: Oh, things are great. Just great. Really.
translation: 噢，事情棒极了。就是棒极了。真的。

original: How could you... Roger, no. This is not the time for that discussion. Please.
translation: 你怎么……罗杰，不。这不是商量的时候。拜托。

original: No. Just... no. Now's not the time, Roger. You should know that.
translation: 别。只是……别。现在不是时候，罗杰。你知道的。

original: Yes, dear. Sorry. Is there a problem?
translation: 是的，亲爱的。对不起。有什么问题吗？

original: Okay, okay. Sorry. What's the problem now?
translation: 好的，好的。对不起。现在又是什么问题？

original: Well I'm not going to go running off to hear what she has to say today. Now find something useful to do.
translation: 嗯，我不准备今天就这么一直听她唠叨下去。现在去找点有意义的事来做。

original: I don't have to like that she's such a busybody, do I? Now leave me alone about it.
translation: 我没必要去喜欢她这种爱管闲事的人，不是吗？现在离我远点。

original: Roger and Janet seem to be getting along better, don't you think?
translation: 罗杰和珍妮特看上去好些了，你不这么认为吗？

original: So, what do you think of the Rockwells? Seems like things are better between the two of them now.
translation: 你怎么看罗克韦尔一家？看上去他俩现在好多了。

original: You know there's nothing to worry about, right? It's perfectly safe. They build them so they won't ever hurt their owners.
translation: 你知道没什么好担心的，对吧？它绝对安全。它们造出来就不会伤害主人。

original: Really, Mabel. It's fine. There's no reason to feel uncomfortable. It's just another machine.
translation: 真的，梅布尔。没事的。没有理由感到不舒服。这只是另一台机器。

original: I really wish Pat would do something about it. He's a nice boy, but he's just so messy.
translation: 我真的希望帕特可以做些什么。他是个好孩子，但他太邋遢了。

original: I don't even know if it's worth trying to talk to Pat. Maybe when she steps on one of his toys and breaks her neck, she'll do something about it.
translation: 我甚至不知道是否该和帕特谈。或许当她踩到他的某个玩具上滑倒然后跌断了脖子，她就会开始做点什么了。

original: Good to hear. I'm glad the two of you are doing well, after everything you've been through.
translation: 很高兴听到这。我很高兴你们两个过得不错，在你们经历了这么多之后。

original: That's good. We were worried about you two for a while. You deserve to be happy.
translation: 那很好。我们曾为你们担心过一阵子。你应该开心才是。

original: Bet the Commies in China wish they had it as good as we do, eh?
translation: 我打赌中国的共党也想过上我们这样的日子，哈？

original: Makes you proud to be an American, doesn't it.
translation: 这使你感到作为一个美国人的骄傲，不是吗。

original: It's one of the great things about living here.
translation: 这就是住在这里的好处之一。

original: She's been talking to Timmy again. I want him to stay away from her. She's nuts, and she shouldn't be anywhere near him.
translation: 她又在跟提米说话了。我希望他能离她远点。她是个疯子，不应该接近他。

original: I saw Timmy talking to her again. I don't want him near her, George. She's crazy, and I don't want it influencing him. You need to say something.
translation: 我看到提米又在跟她说话了。我不想他离她太近，乔治。她是个疯子，我不希望这影响到他。你得说说才行。

original: Ha ha. All right, dear.
translation: 哈哈。好吧，亲爱的。

original: Okay, okay! Just having a little fun.
translation: 好的，好的！就只是个小玩笑。

original: Well, maybe you feel that way. I really don't like it. What if something goes wrong?
translation: 嗯，也许你是这么想。我真的不喜欢它。要是出什么问题怎么办？

original: Just the same, I don't trust it. I swear it watches me sometimes.
translation: 反正，我不信任它。我发誓它有时在监视着我。

original: Well, I know I wouldn't want to live anywhere else.
translation: 嗯，我知道我不想住在其他地方。

original: I'm certainly grateful for everything we have.
translation: 我真的为我们所拥有的一切而感恩。

original: It's a great time to be alive, isn't it?
translation: 活着真好，不是吗？

original: Okay, sorry for bringing it up.
translation: 好吧，说这真抱歉。

original: Right. Sorry. I just thought that maybe... Oh, nevermind.
translation: 是的。抱歉。我只是想那可能……噢，算了吧。

original: Okay, I'll have another chat with him about it. I'm sure he was only being polite.
translation: 好吧，我会再跟他谈谈的。我确定他会很有礼貌。

original: All right...  I'll talk to him about it. She's harmless, anyway. Just old and senile.
translation: 好吧……我会跟他谈谈的。无论如何，她没有危险。她只是个老态龙钟的女人而已。

original: Oh Mabel, you worry too much. It's fine.
translation: 噢，梅布尔，你担心太多了。没事的。

original: It's perfectly safe, I'm sure. Everyone here has one, and no one's ever had a problem.
translation: 它绝对安全，我肯定。这里每个人都有一台，从来没人出过问题。

original: Well, if you ever have any thoughts about it... You know, if you want to talk, you just let me know.
translation: 嗯，如果你有过任何这样的念头……你知道，如果你想谈谈，那就告诉我。

original: I see. Well, I thought you might have some insight. If you notice anything, or want to talk about it, you let me know, okay?
translation: 我知道了。嗯，我想你可能觉察到了什么。如果你注意到任何事，或者想要谈谈，只要告知我就行，好吗？

original: But you could leave the Vault, find somewhere else to live.
translation: 但你可以离开避难所，去别的地方生活。

original: Are you mad? I've been here for almost 200 years. My body is in no condition to be used for anything.
translation: 你疯了吗？我已经在这快要200年了。我的身体已经不适合做任何事了。

original: And yet here in Tranquility Lane, I am as strong and youthful as I care to be. No, no. I think I'll stay here, thank you.
translation: 然而在宁静巷，我可以像我想的那样保持强壮和年轻。不，不，我想我还是留在这吧，谢谢。

original: And you... You will now do as you're told. The Slasher awaits.
translation: 而你……现在你得照我说的去做。“屠夫”在等着呢。

original: But these people... They don't deserve to be punished.
translation: 但是这些人……他们不该受到惩罚。

original: I'm afraid you're not in a position to decide what they do or do not deserve. They are under my control, not yours.
translation: 恐怕你还没有资格决定他们该不该。他们在我掌控之下，不在你的。

original: Now if you're done attempting to change my mind, let's get on with your final task. After completing it, you will be free to go.
translation: 现在，要是你不再试图改变我的想法了，那就接着进行你的最终任务吧。完成之后，你就自由了。

original: Why are you doing all of this?
translation: 你为什么要做这一切？

original: Because I can, of course.
translation: 当然是因为我能啊。

original: I have total power here. I may do whatever I wish, and over these many years I have found that I wish to see others suffer.
translation: 我在这拥有至高无上的权力。我可以做任何想做的事情，而且这么多年来，我发现自己喜欢看到别人受苦。

original: Here, I brought you some ammo.
translation: 给，我给你带了些子弹。

original: Oh, HELL yeah!
translation: 哦，他妈太棒了！

original: Hey, kid. This bad boy spits out lead like there's no tomorrow. So unless you have at least 150 rounds, I can't even fill it up.
translation: 嗨，孩子。这坏小子会像没有明天一样地倾泻子弹。所以除非你有至少150发弹链，否则我没法填装它。

original: Whew. That makes me feel a whole lot better. Thanks.
translation: 哟。这让我感觉好多了。谢谢。

original: Look, unless you have at least 50 shots of 10mm on you, I may as well go with my pistol.
translation: 听着，除非你带着至少50发10mm子弹，我才会带着我的手枪一起走。

original: Thanks. I was starting to feel a little naked without it.
translation: 谢谢。没有这的话，我开始感觉自己有点像光着身子。

original: Wonderful. What the hell am I going to do with less than 50 shots? That barely fills this puppy up. Come on, kid.
translation: 妙极了。见鬼，不到50发的子弹，我能做什么？那简直没法填满这小家伙。拜托，孩子。

original: Well, since I saved your ass, shouldn't you be joining me?
translation: 嗯，既然我救了你的小命，你难道不该加入我吗？

original: That's a nice attitude, man. No need to be a dick.
translation: 态度不错，伙计。你没必要非得那么混蛋。

original: Just forget I said anything.
translation: 忘了我说过的话吧。

original: That would be great. Maybe I'll speak to Reilly about it.
translation: 这太棒了。或许我会跟莱莉谈谈这的。

original: You should. Now that our group is smaller, I'm sure she'll be into adding another Ranger to our ranks.
translation: 你应该这样。我们的队伍规模比以前小了，我敢肯定她一定会补充一个新的游骑兵。

original: Anyway, we gotta' split. Oh, if you ever make your way to our headquarters, look me up if you need something fixed. I'd be glad to cut you a deal.
translation: 不管怎么说，我们都得分开了。噢，你要是有机会来到我们总部，要修东西的话就去找我吧。我会很高兴跟你做交易的。

original: Nah. I've got things to do. But thanks for the compliment.
translation: 不。我还有事要做。但是谢谢你的恭维。

original: Okay, just wanted you to know that I got your back if we ever end up in a firefight again. Anyway, we gotta' split.
translation: 好吧，我只是想让你知道，如果你再卷进一场交火的话，我会在后面支援你。不管怎么说，我们得分开了。

original: Oh, if you ever make your way to our headquarters, look me up if you need something fixed. I'd be glad to cut you a deal.
translation: 噢，你要是有机会来到我们总部，要修东西的话就去找我吧。我会很高兴跟你做交易的。

original: Wow, you're certifiably insane, huh?
translation: 哇，你疯了，呃？

original: Last guy who said something like that to me took a long dirt nap. Catch my drift?
translation: 上一个和我那么说的家伙可是睡了很长的一觉。知道我的意思吗？

original: Hahahaha! Oh, I loved watching you sweat there for a second. Damn right I'm crazy! Isn't that right, Eugene?
translation: 哈哈哈哈！噢，我爱看你在那流汗的样子。我该死的确实疯了！不是那样吗，尤金？

original: Anyway, you look me up if you ever want to get into a fight. I'll be sure and bring the thunder. Ha ha ha!
translation: 总之，如果你想挑战的话，来找我。我保证会让你过瘾。哈哈哈！

original: Has anyone ever spoken to you about anger management?
translation: 难道没人教过你怎么控制你的脾气吗？

original: Well, someone did once, and I swear I let them leave only with a slight limp.
translation: 嗯，有人曾经提过，但是我发誓我肯定在他走的时候让他带着脚残。

original: Don't worry, I'm on your side!
translation: 别担心，我支持你！

original: Anyway, you look me up if you ever want to get into a fight. I'll be sure and bring the thunder. Ha ha ha!
translation: 总之，如果你想挑战的话，来找我。我保证会让你过瘾。哈哈哈！

original: Yeah, Brick... You really, um, ventilated them...
translation: 嗯，布瑞克……你确实，喔，把他们蒸发掉了……

original: You bet your ass I did! Did you see that Super Mutant's head burst? Beautiful!
translation: 我他妈当然干了！你有没有见过超级变种人的脑袋爆开？那真他妈漂亮！

original: Me and Eugene, we got a partnership. I find targets, and he vaporizes targets. It works out well.
translation: 我和尤金是伙伴。我来寻找目标，而他来把目标蒸发掉。这棒极了。

original: Anyway, you look me up if you ever want to get into a fight. I'll be sure and bring the thunder. Ha ha ha!
translation: 总之，如果你想挑战的话，来找我。我保证会让你过瘾。哈哈哈！

original: My Dad can't have left. The door is sealed shut.
translation: 我爸爸没办法离开的。门已经被关闭了啊。

original: Not anymore, apparently. But... Are you honestly telling me you had no idea your dad was leaving? He really didn't tell you?
translation: 很显然，不再是关闭的了。但是……你真的不知道你爸爸离开了吗？他真的没有告诉你？

original: My Dad can't have really left the Vault. That's impossible.
translation: 我父亲不可能离开避难所，这不可能。

original: That's what I would have said until tonight. But it's true. He's gone and Jonas is dead and now they're looking for you!
translation: 直到今晚之前，我也一直这么听说。但这都是真的。他走了，乔纳斯死了，而他们现在正在找你！

original: Dad couldn't have really left the Vault! That's impossible...
translation: 我爸爸是不会离开避难所的！这不可能……

original: That's what I would have said until tonight. But it's true. He's gone and Jonas is dead and now they're looking for you!
translation: 直到今晚之前，我也一直这么听说。但这都是真的。他走了，而乔纳斯死了，还有他们现在正在找你！

original: What? Jonas is dead? What the hell is going on?
translation: 什么？乔纳斯死了？到底发生了什么事？

original: My father's men think Jonas helped your dad escape. They caught him and brought him to my dad's office and they... Oh my God...
translation: 我父亲的人认为是乔纳斯协助你爸爸逃脱的。他们抓住了他，并把他带到了我爸爸的办公室去。然后他们……噢，天啊……

original: Dad couldn't have really left the Vault! That's impossible...
translation: 我爸爸是不会离开避难所的！这不可能……

original: I thought so too. But it's true. He's gone and Jonas is dead and now they're looking for you!
translation: 我也是这么想的。但这都是真的。他走了，乔纳斯死了，而他们现在正在找你！

original: Awwww, isn't that a shame? My heart's bleeding. Really.
translation: 啊，这太丢脸了吧？我的心在流血。真的。

original: Sure did. And now you're all alone.
translation: 确实。现在就剩你一个人了。

original: Alone... What will I do now? I have no one. Nothing. You've destroyed everything that mattered to me.
translation: 一个人……我现在该怎么办？我无依无靠。一无所有。你毁了我所有重要的东西。

original: Looks like you're stuck here all alone. How does that feel?
translation: 看来你孤立无援地被困在这了，感觉怎么样？

original: I put these people out of their misery. You're getting exactly what you deserve.
translation: 我让这些人脱离了苦海。而你罪有应得。

original: You've taken them all from me. You've left me with nothing!
translation: 你从我这里夺走了他们。你让我一无所有！

original: It's not fair... Nobody to play with ever again...
translation: 这不公平……再也没人陪我玩……

original: There's a pack of Feral Ghouls in the courtyard!
translation: 庭院里有一群狂尸鬼！

original: Shit! Thanks for the intel. I've gotta go.
translation: 见鬼！感谢提供消息。我得走了。

original: I want more than that to spare your miserable life. 300 caps.
translation: 想要保住你那可怜的小命，我要更多的报酬。300个瓶盖。

original: You mercenaries are so reliably predictable.
translation: 你们佣兵处事的方式总在人预料之中。

original: 100 now, 200 when the job is done.
translation: 现在先给你100个，等你搞定了，再来拿剩下的200个。

original: I think it would be better for everyone if I just killed you.
translation: 我想，杀了你的话对大家都好。

original: An honest mercenary? Who would have thought. Guards!
translation: 一个诚实的佣兵？谁能想到。守卫！

original: 200 caps to spare your life? Okay.
translation: 200个瓶盖来换你的命？好吧。

original: I love mercenaries. They're so easy to buy.
translation: 我爱死佣兵了。他们太容易被收买了。

original: You'll be paid after I know he's dead. And believe me, I'll know.
translation: 当我知道他死了的时候，你会得到报酬的。相信我，我会知道。

original: You've satisfied my curiosity.
translation: 你满足了我的好奇心。

original: So easily? Somehow I'm not surprised.
translation: 这么简单？不过我一点都不惊讶。

original: How did he die?
translation: 他是怎么死的？

original: Who cares? I hired some mercenaries to get me some equipment from Fort Constantine. He was one of them.
translation: 谁在乎？我雇了一群佣兵，帮我从康斯坦丁要塞弄回些装备。他是其中的一个。

original: Of the five, only three survived. You'll have to ask one of them if you want the gory details.
translation: 五个人中，只有三个活了下来。如果你想知道那血腥的细节，你可以问问他们中的某个。

original: Mister Crowley is alive. I'm here to kill you because you hate Ghouls.
translation: 考利先生还活着。我则是来杀你的，因为你仇视尸鬼。

original: He's alive? I should have known. It's hard to kill those zombies. You gotta shoot 'em in the head.
translation: 他还活着？我早该知道。杀掉这些丧尸确实不容易。你得一枪打爆他们脑袋。

original: Whatever he's paying you, I'll double it.
translation: 不管他付你多少钱，我都会出双倍的。

original: No way. I'm going to keep those keys for myself.
translation: 没门。我会自己留着这些钥匙。

original: What! You bastard, I'll kill you!
translation: 什么！你这杂种，我要杀了你！

original: More caps? You've got a deal.
translation: 再多给些瓶盖，就成交。

original: Good. Oh, and I still want Tenpenny dead. That bastard really does hate Ghouls.
translation: 好的。噢，我还希望特佩尼能死掉。那杂种真的仇视僵尸。

original: Good. Just get me those keys.
translation: 很好。给我那些钥匙就好。
