original: Nothing. Nothing at all.
translation: 没事。没关系。

original: Goddamn right, nothing. Now get outta my way.
translation: 该死的太对了，没事。现在滚吧。

original: Thought you'd get out of here, did you? You little shit. Get back inside, now.
translation: 你以为你能从这跑了？你这小混蛋！滚进去，快！

original: You're fuckin' dead, you hear me? Dead!
translation: 你他妈的死定了。你听见了没？你死定了！

original: You! Get back here now!
translation: 你！立刻回来！

original: Run Sammy, run! We can make it!
translation: 萨米快跑，快跑啊！我们能做到！

original: No. It's a terrible idea. Don't even try.
translation: 不。这真是个糟糕透顶的主意。想都别想。

original: But! But! But!
translation: 但是！但是！但是！

original: Well... okay. I guess helping out with the caravans is good enough.
translation: 嗯……好吧。我想有商队一起帮忙就很不错了。

original: Look, if you ever stop by the caravans around here, I could probably get you a deal. I guess that's like helping humanity.
translation: 听着，如果你能在周围遇到商队，我或许能跟你做个交易。我想这就是积德行善。

original: Yes, I really do.
translation: 是的，我很乐意。

original: Well... Thanks. That really means a lot to me, you know?
translation: 好吧……谢谢。这对我而言意义很大，你懂吗？

original: Now, let's get this book finished!
translation: 现在，让我们来把这本书完成吧！

original: It will just get us hurt. You don't want to hurt anyone, do you?
translation: 这只会让我们受伤害。你不想伤害任何人，不是吗？

original: No... No, you're right, I don't. I mean, I've already gotten you hurt a couple times, haven't I?
translation: 不……不，你是对的，我不想。我意思是，我已经让你受到了几次伤害，不是吗？

original: You're right. I can't go on with this book. What if the advice is bad and people get hurt because of it? I deserve to work on the caravans.
translation: 你说的对。我不能继续写这本书了。如果里面的建议让人们因此而受到伤害怎么办？我应该跟商队合作。

original: Please, if you find time out from your own important work... try to stop by the caravans and say hi. I'll see if I can get you a deal.
translation: 拜托，如果你在自己的重要工作之余还有时间……看到商队请停下打个招呼。我看看能否帮你做些交易。

original: You don't have the experience for a book like this. You'll be a laughingstock.
translation: 你没有写这种书的经验。你会被人笑话的。

original: But that's why I'm getting your help! I know my flaws, and with your help, we can make something great for the world!
translation: 但这就是我需要你帮助的原因！我知道我的缺陷，有了你的帮助，我可以为这世界做些伟大的事。

original: Please? It's just so... important. For everything.
translation: 拜托？这……太重要了。对所有人来说。

original: Okay, I can tell how much it means to you. Let's get this book finished.
translation: 好吧，我能理解这对你有多重要。让我们一起来完成这本书。

original: Really? You really mean that? You think my book really could help humanity?
translation: 真的？你同意了？你认为我的书真的可以帮助众生？

original: But why try with this book, when you could be helping out in real ways here?
translation: 当你能用现实方法及时解决的时候，为什么一定要用这本书来解决？

original: What, helping the trade caravans with idiotic chores? Repairing carts and fixing up sick Brahmin?
translation: 怎么？难道要帮助商队打理愚蠢的杂务？帮他们修推车和治疗双头牛？

original: There's got to be something more worthwhile that I can do to help humanity!
translation: 一定还有更好的帮助他人的方式值得我去做！

original: I don't know. Human nature doesn't change like that.
translation: 我不知道，人类本性难移。

original: Maybe. I've certainly heard people say that. But isn't it also human nature to try to do better than we always have?
translation: 可能吧。我确实听到有人那样说。但不满足于现状不正是人类的本性吗？

original: Please, I've got to at least try to make the world better. And I can't do it on my own. I need your help.
translation: 拜托，我至少要努力去让世界更美好。而且我一个人办不到，我需要你的帮助。

original: So you're trying to make the world better than it was?
translation: 你想让这世界变得更美好？

original: Hey, it sounds crazy when you say it that way, but that's what I'm aiming for, yeah.
translation: 嗨，你这么说听起来就像是疯话，但这也是我的人生目标，没错！

original: The Wasteland Survival Guide isn't much towards that lofty goal, but it's an important one.
translation: 废土生存指南并不是最终目的，但它是其中很重要的一环。

original: And that's why I need your help. I don't think I can do it alone.
translation: 这就是我需要你帮助的原因。我觉得我一个人办不到。

original: Seriously, don't waste time with this book. Stick to helping the caravans.
translation: 说实话，别在这本书上浪费时间了。专注于帮助商队吧。

original: I... Well... Okay.
translation: 我……嗯……好吧。

original: I guess you're right. It was a silly idea. I'll just stick to doing what's important.
translation: 我想你是对的。这真是个傻主意。我会专注于那些重要之事的。

original: Hey, if you're ever around again, stop by. I'll see if I can get you a deal on repairs, I guess.
translation: 嗨，如果你以后回来的话，来这看看。我猜我能帮你修补点什么。

original: Seriously, don't waste time with this book. Stick to helping the caravans.
translation: 说实话，别在这本书上浪费时间了。专注于帮助商队吧。

original: I don't know. Those caravans help a lot of people.
translation: 我不知道。那些商队帮助了很多人。

original: Well, I guess they do bring important supplies here and there. But still, I can help out so much more than the boring old stuff they do.
translation: 嗯，我想他们的确给各地带去了重要的补给。但是，我所做的比他们那些无聊老套的事有用的多。

original: Writing this book will make a huge difference, trust me!
translation: 写出这本书将会带来巨大的变革，相信我！

original: Well, I'm proud to be a part of it. You can count on me!
translation: 嗯，我很荣幸能参与其中。你能依靠我！

original: That's the spirit, trusty research assistant!
translation: 就是这种态度，可信赖的研究助理！

original: Moira, please don't write the book. It will just turn out badly.
translation: 莫伊拉，请不要再写那本书了。不会有好结果的。

original: You... You really think so? But I thought I was so brilliant...
translation: 你……你真的这么想？但我觉得自己很有才华……

original: I suppose you're right. I wouldn't want anyone else to get hurt because of my foolish ideas. I'll just stick to helping the caravans.
translation: 我想你说的对。我也不希望任何人因为我的愚蠢想法而受到伤害。我应该专注于帮助商队。

original: Hey, if you're ever around again, stop by. I'll see if I can get you a deal on repairs, I guess.
translation: 嗨，如果你以后回来的话，来这看看。我猜我能帮你修补点什么。

original: This really isn't a good idea. Please don't write it. It'll just turn out badly.
translation: 这可不是个好主意。请不要再写那本书了。不会有好结果的。

original: Okay, but it could be bad if the book's misleading. People could get hurt.
translation: 好吧，但是如果书写得误导人就不好了。人们会因此而受伤的。

original: Oh, I hadn't really thought about it like that. I don't want anyone to get hurt. That's the last thing the guide should do!
translation: 哦，我还没往哪方面想。我不想让任何人受伤。那是这本指南最不该引发的事！

original: Well, we're just going to have to make sure it's accurate and useful and great, then! You and me! Together, we can research and write a masterpiece!
translation: 嗯，我们要确保这本指南内容精准适用！我们合作，一定可以写出传世名著！

original: I think you're right. Now, let's get back to work on this book!
translation: 我想你是对的。现在我们回到这本书的工作上吧！

original: You got it, super research assistant! Hey, I should get you a costume or something!
translation: 没问题，超级研究助手！嗨，我应该给你找身装束或者别的什么。

original: What do you mean about your other projects? Have there been problems?
translation: 你说讲的其它项目是指什么？有什么问题吗？

original: Well, a little before you first arrived, one of my experiments had a little accident.
translation: 嗯，在你到来之前有一点点……我的一次实验出了点小小事故。

original: I mean, how could I have predicted the Centaur would think my assistant smelled tasty?
translation: 我的意思是，我怎么知道多脚兽会觉得我的助手是如此的美味可口？

original: But nothing bad like that could happen with this book. It's a great plan, and it'll make up for everything else!
translation: 但那种惨剧不会发生在这本书上。这是个绝妙的计划，它将会弥补其它一切！

original: Well, it's a big undertaking, and we've got to make sure we do it right.
translation: 嗯，这是项伟大的事业，我们要确保成功。

original: Oh, believe me, I know! I've been a bit careless with other projects, but this... This is important! This means something!
translation: 哦，相信我，我懂！虽然我曾在其他项目上粗心大意过，但是这一回……这一回很重要！这次意义重大！

original: It sounds like you don't know what you're doing.
translation: 听起来你似乎不知道自己在干嘛。

original: I know exactly what I'm doing. I'm trying to help mankind survive and rebuild! It's important, and I need your help.
translation: 我十分清楚我在干嘛。我想帮助人类生存和重建！这很重要，而且我需要你的帮助。

original: It's a hell of a lot better than wasting my talents with the caravans, repairing cart axles and coming up with new ways to shovel brahmin crap!
translation: 这可和跟着商队浪费我的聪明才智，修理车轴和清理双头牛粪便可要好太多了！

original: It's really good of you to try to help people like this.
translation: 你这样帮助人们真是太善良了。

original: I know, right? I figured, instead of just helping out the caravans with odd junk, why not put my brilliant mind to work for everyone?
translation: 我知道，对吧？我发觉，比起用怪奇的废品帮助商队，为什么不用我的聪明才智为所有人服务？

original: And between my mind and your experience, this guide'll save a dozen times more lives than those greedy merchants will.
translation: 而且有了我的头脑加上你的经验，这本指南将会比那些商人拯救多十几倍的生命。

original: Nobody talks to me that way.
translation: 没人用这种态度和我说话。

original: The President of the Republic does. Now get out of my sight.
translation: 共和国总统就这么说话。现在滚出我的视线吧。

original: What am I supposed to do?
translation: 我应该怎么做？

original: What am I supposed to do?
translation: 我应该怎么做？

original: Go see the guard at the front gate and schedule an appointment or something like everybody else does.
translation: 像其他人那样，去和前门的守卫预约个时间吧。

original: You can have it. I don't even like sweetrolls.
translation: 你拿去吧。我根本不喜欢甜面包卷。

original: Yeah, right. Thanks, loser. Oh, and happy birthday, ha ha ha ha!
translation: 嗯，对了。谢谢你，废物。哦，生日快乐，哈哈哈哈！

original: Mmmm... It sure was good when I ate it a few minutes ago.
translation: 嗯……我几分钟前吃的时候还真不错的。

original: You what?! Dang, I love those sweetrolls Old Lady Palmer makes. You... little... Just stay out of my way, you got it?
translation: 你什么？！见鬼，我喜欢帕尔默大妈烤的甜面包圈。你这……小……离我远点，听见了吗？

original: I threw it away. But you're welcome to eat it off the floor if you want.
translation: 我已经把它扔了。但如果你想把它捡回来吃掉我倒是很欢迎。

original: You think you're funny? We'll see how funny you are later when I'm pounding on your face. Come on, Paul, this loser ain't worth our time.
translation: 你觉得这很有趣？试试看我打你脸的时候有趣不。算了，保罗，这废物不值得我们浪费时间。

original: You do look hungry. What, your mom drank up all the ration coupons again?
translation: 你看上去饿坏了。什么！？你妈妈又把所有的配给券都换成酒喝了？

original: Don't you talk about my mom, you little punk!
translation: 别和我提我妈妈，你这小白痴！

original: Go soak your head, Butch. I'm not giving you my sweetroll.
translation: 别做梦了，布奇。我不会给你我的甜面包卷。

original: Oh yeah? We'll see about that.
translation: 是吗？我们走着瞧。

original: How about we share it? Half for me, half for you. That's fair, right?
translation: 我们一人一半好吗？这很公平，不是吗？

original: "How about we share it"... What are you, five? Give me that sweetroll or I'm going to pound you.
translation: “我们一人一半”……你算什么，一半？把甜面包圈给我要不我就揍扁你。

original: Mrs. Palmer said I didn't have to share. Since it's my birthday...
translation: 帕尔默大妈说我不用和别人分享。因为今天我生日……

original: "Mrs. Palmer said I didn't have to share"... Who's talking about sharing, moron? I want the whole thing.
translation: “帕尔默夫人说我不用和别人分享”……谁说要分享了？白痴，我要全部。

original: Now are you going to give me that sweetroll, or am I going to give you a knuckle sandwich?
translation: 现在你把甜面包圈给我？否则我给你个大耳光尝尝。

original: Sure, Butch. <Spit on the sweetroll and give it to him.>
translation: 好吧，布奇。<拿出甜面包卷啐了口然后给他>

original: Gah! I don't want your nerd-cooties! You're going to be sorry you did that. We'll see how tough you are later when the grownups aren't around.
translation: 恶！我不要你这恶心的东西！你会为你做的后悔的。等旁边没有大人，我们就走着瞧！

original: That ain't what ... I asked you, stupid... stupid robot.
translation: 那些不怎么……我问过你了，蠢货……蠢货机器人。

original: I'm doin' fine... fine indeed. How are you? ... I said how are you? What? Are you ignoring me? Stupid asshole robot...
translation: 我很好……真的很好。你呢？……我说你好？什么？你无视我？蠢货机器人……

original: She's dead, you damn fool robot. Thanks for reminding me.
translation: 她死了，你这该死的蠢货机器。谢谢提醒我。

original: She's dead, you know that. Lousy old data tapes...
translation: 她已经死了，你知道的。惹人厌的老古董……

original: Yes, yes, everything is fine.
translation: 嗯，嗯，一切都很好。

original: Oh, it's great. Everything is perfect. Greta takes good care of us.
translation: 哦，一切正常，所有事情都很完美。葛丽泰将我们照顾的很好。

original: No time to talk now, Winthrop. Too busy.
translation: 没时间聊这些了，温思罗普。太忙了。

original: Hello, Winthrop. Have a seat, I'll be with you in a minute.
translation: 你好，温思罗普。坐吧，我很快就过来。

original: Welcome! Sit. Drink. Pay.
translation: 欢迎！坐下。痛饮。付帐。

original: Get yourself another drink, you look entirely too sober.
translation: 再来一杯吧，你看起来一点也没醉啊？

original: My friend, you are not drinking nearly enough.
translation: 我的朋友，你还没喝够呢。

original: If you're sober enough to say hello, you're far too sober.
translation: 如果你还知道说你好，这说明你一点也没醉啊。

original: Less talking, more drinking.
translation: 少说，多喝！

original: You look like someone who needs another drink.
translation: 你看上去像是还要来一杯的样子。

original: And a hello to you.
translation: 向你问声好。

original: And a hello to you, sir.
translation: 向你问声好，先生。

original: And a hello to you, ma'am.
translation: 向你问声好，女士。

original: Scanning... target identified as "Patchwork". Hello, Patchwork. I trust that all is well with you.
translation: 扫描…… 对象确认：“拼盘”。您好，“拼盘”。我相信你一切都好。

original: Scanning... target identified as "Patchwork". Hello, Patchwork. How are you?
translation: 扫描…… 对象确认：“拼盘”。您好，“拼盘”。你好吗？

original: Scanning... target identified as "Winthrop". Hello, Winthrop. How are you?
translation: 扫描……对象确认：“温思罗普”。您好，温思罗普。你好吗？

original: Scanning... target identified as "Winthrop". Hello, Winthrop. Que pasa?
translation: 扫描……对象确认：“温思罗普”。您好，温思罗普。近来怎样？

original: Scanning... target identified as "Winthrop". Hello, Winthrop. How is you- you- your wife?
translation: 扫描……对象确认：“温思罗普”。您好，温思罗普。你……你……你妻子……近来怎样？

original: Hey, Greta. How's my girl?
translation: 嗨，葛丽泰。我的女孩还好吗？

original: Hello, Greta. You always manage to make me feel a little better.
translation: 你好，葛丽泰。你总是能让我觉得好受一点。

original: Good morning... I think. Is it morning?
translation: 早上好……我想。还是早上吗？

original: If you need anything, just ask Greta.
translation: 如果你需要什么的话，告诉葛丽泰就好了。

original: Hello. How is everything?
translation: 你好。别来无恙？

original: Hi there, enjoying yourself?
translation: 你好，感觉还好吗？

original: I hope that everything is staying where it should be, Patchwork.
translation: 你身上的零件还都在吧，“拼盘”。

original: Stop by the clinic, Patchwork. Greta found one of your fingers over in Carol's Place.
translation: 到诊断室来下，“拼盘”。葛丽泰在卡洛尔旅馆发现了你的一节拇指。

original: Hello, hello.
translation: 你好，你好。

original: No time to talk now, stop by the clinic.
translation: 没时间费话了，快去诊所。

original: Come by the clinic some time, you're overdue for a sewing.
translation: 有空到诊所来下，你早该缝几针了。

original: Hey, hon. I haven't seen you in here in a while.
translation: 嗨，亲爱的。我有些日子没见过你了。

original: Long time, no see.
translation: 好久不见。

original: Do you ever leave here?
translation: 你从没离开过这吗？

original: Yes, yes, hello. We covered that already.
translation: 是，是，你好。我们已经搞定那些了。

original: Yeah, hello. Whatever.
translation: 嗯，你好。随便啦。

original: Yes, yes, hello... I don't know why everyone around here insists on being so damned friendly.
translation: 是，是，您好……我就搞不明白这里为什么所有人都他妈这么友好？

original: Can't you see that I'm busy? Leave me alone.
translation: 没看见我忙着么？离我远点。

original: I'd be much better off if you people would just leave me alone.
translation: 大伙离我远点的话，我就会觉得好多了。

original: Why, aren't we just the friendliest bunch of walking corpses that you ever did see?
translation: 怎么了，难道我们不就是你见过最友好的会走路的尸体吗？

original: Oh, please.
translation: 哦，拜托。

original: Yeah, I'm okay, Winthrop.
translation: 嗯，我没事，温思罗普。

original: I'm doin' alright, Winthrop. Just having a rough day, you know?
translation: 我还好，温思罗普。只是糟糕的一天，你懂吗？

original: Oh hey, Winthrop. Yeah, I'm alright, I just.. err... dropped something around here. Don't worry about me, it'll turn up.
translation: 哦，嗨！温思罗普。嗯，我很好，只是，呃……掉了点东西在附近，不用担心我，会找到的。

original: Oh, not bad. Not bad at all. Everything's where it should be... for now.
translation: 哦，不错。很不错。所有的都在……至少是现在。

original: Yep. Keepin' my bits to myself for the time bein'.
translation: 对。各个零件眼下都还在。

original: Oh, hello. I'm alright. Still in one piece. Well, except for that one that got away... but I'll find it. No worries.
translation: 哦，你好。我很好。四肢健全。嗯，除了那个丢了的……但是我会找回来的。别担心。

original: Haven't lost anything permanently. Not yet.
translation: 还没有永久性地丢过任何东西，目前为止。

original: Hey, hello! I just got back! Good to see you!
translation: 嗨，你好！我刚回来！看到你很高兴！

original: Remind me to sit you down and tell you about some of the things that I've seen.
translation: 提醒我让你坐下并告诉你一些我遇到的事情。

original: I'm back! And you wouldn't believe some of the things that happened to me this time. But I can't talk now. Maybe later?
translation: 我回来了！这次你简直不能相信我都遇到了什么！但我现在不能说。迟点好吧？

original: Hey there, long time, no see! I've got some good stories to tell you later!
translation: 嗨，很久不见了啊！我有一些很棒的故事等会跟你说！

original: Hello!
translation: 你好！

original: Hey, good to see you! Are you here to buy something?
translation: 嗨，见到你很高兴！你来这想买点什么吗？

original: Hey there, you should check out the new stuff I have at the store.
translation: 嗨，你应该看看我们商店的新货。

original: No time, no time. Everything around here is always busted. Can't ever get a break.
translation: 没时间，没时间。这所有的东西总是不停的在坏。真的一刻都停不下来！

original: Nope. Not now. Too busy.
translation: 不，现在不行。我太忙了。

original: Hooo, sorry. No time to talk. The air circulation system is busted again.
translation: 喔，对不起。没时间聊了。空气循环系统又坏了。

original: I can't talk right now, the work never ends around here.
translation: 我现在不能跟你说话，这的工作一刻也停不下。

original: Hey, do you know how to reroute a fan belt? You know, never mind. I'll do it myself.
translation: 嗨，你知道怎么换风扇皮带？嗯……没关系，我自己来吧。

original: Hey, you.
translation: 嗨，你。

original: No, not really.
translation: 并没有。

original: I haven't been able to smell anything for about thirty years now.
translation: 我有30多年没闻到味道了。

original: Are you joking? I lost my sense of smell before you even crinkled up.
translation: 你开玩笑么？我在你生下来之前就已经失去嗅觉了。

original: Yeah... kinda like onions... that's so strange...
translation: 啊……就像是洋葱……真奇怪……

original: Not, not really.
translation: 不，并非如此。

original: What are you talking about?
translation: 你说什么呢？

original: Not since the last time you asked.
translation: 你最近一次询问后就不是了。

original: Uhm... no. Are you okay?
translation: 呒……不。你还好吗？

original: Yeah, I wonder what it could be...
translation: 嗯，我好奇那会是什么……

original: Yeah, that's really weird. Oh well, it's gone now.
translation: 嗯，那真的很奇怪，哦，不过现在没了。

original: Yeah, now that you mention it. I wonder what's going on...
translation: 嗯，既然你提到这事。我想知道是怎么回事？

original: Haven't noticed, don't care.
translation: 没注意，不关心。

original: I don't really pay attention. I only come here because I can't stand the Ninth Circle. That place is just nasty. Even I think so.
translation: 我才不关心那些事呢。我到这儿来是因为我受不了第九层。那地方太恶心了。连我都这么觉得。

original: Actually, I haven't noticed. At all.
translation: 老实说，我没注意。根本没在意。

original: Yeah. I ordered it yesterday... I found one of Patchwork's fingers in it. I think I'll avoid it.
translation: 是的。我昨天就点过了……我在里面发现了一个“拼盘”的手指。我想我不会要这个了。

original: Are you kidding? I wouldn't feed that shit to the dog.
translation: 你开什么玩笑？我才不会拿这恶心的东西喂狗。

original: I'd rather drink malted rat piss.
translation: 我宁可喝点发霉的老鼠尿。

original: It's not half bad, I guess.
translation: 我觉得，情况还能说得过去。

original: I don't even know what good drinks taste like anymore.
translation: 我都不知道美酒是什么味道了。

original: I've forgotten the taste of good liquor.
translation: 我已经不记得好酒的味道了。

original: Dude. Harshing the buzz. Minus five points.
translation: 老兄，触响警报。减去5分。

original: We'd probably all be better off if the Brotherhood came through here and "purged" us.
translation: 如果兄弟会的人来“净化”一下我们，可能我们都会觉得好受些。

original: Yeah... every time you start feeling good, life kicks you in the ass again.
translation: 是啊……每次当你感觉不错的时候，现实生活就要跟你来找茬了。

original: Go away, I'm trying to enjoy myself here.
translation: 离我远点，我只是想在这自娱自乐。

original: Well, aren't you a ray of sunshine?
translation: 嗯，你难道不是一缕阳光吗？

original: Oh, thank you! Thank you, Mr. Ahzrukhal! Thank you so much!
translation: 哦，谢谢！谢谢！阿祖卡先生！太感谢了！

original: Oh, Mr. Ahzrukhal! I can't thank you enough! It's... it's been so hard lately...
translation: 哦，阿祖卡先生！感激不尽！这真是雪中送炭啊……

original: I... I'll try to wait. You are good to us, Mr. Ahzrukhal. You really are. Thank you.
translation: 我……我试着等您，您对我们真是太好了。阿祖卡先生！真的，谢谢。

original: Ah, yes! Of course, of course, my friend. See me later tonight. We'll make sure that you have all the pick-me-ups that you need.
translation: 啊，没错！当然，当然，我的朋友。晚上见。我保证给你你所需要的提神剂。

original: Shhh, say no more. See me later, I'll make sure that you want for nothing.
translation: 嘘，别说了，待会见，我保证你到时会别无所求。

original: No need to be shy, my friend. I'll make sure that you have everything that you ever need, so long as you have the caps to pay for it, that is.
translation: 别不好意思，我的朋友，我能满足你的一切需求，只要你身上的瓶盖够多，就是这样。

original: I was wondering if I could get... you know... one of the special drinks.
translation: 不知我能不能得到……你知道……一杯特别的饮料。

original: I need some of the special stock. You know, the stuff from behind the counter...
translation: 我需要一些特殊的货物。就像是……柜台后面那些东西一样。

original: I'm all out of the stuff you sold me yesterday. I need more. Fast.
translation: 你昨天卖我的东西已经用光了。我需要更多。赶快！

original: Yes, friend? What brings you to me today? Come on now... spit it out. I haven't got all day.
translation: 你好，朋友？什么风把你吹来了？来……快说吧。我可没太多时间。

original: What is it? I'm very busy, you know.
translation: 什么事？我很忙，你知道的。

original: You seem so nervous... relax. It's only me, there's nothing to be afraid of.
translation: 你看起来很紧张……放松，这儿就我，没什么好怕的。

original: Some people...
translation: 有些人……

original: It was just a question...
translation: 这只是一个提问……

original: Well, sorry...
translation: 嗯，对不起……

original: Yeah, whatever.
translation: 好，随便。

original: All right, all right, I'll just ask Ahzrukhal...
translation: 没事没事，我会去问阿祖卡的。

original: No.
translation: 不。

original: I. Said. No.
translation: 我说不行。

original: Leave me alone.
translation: 离我远点。

original: Go. Away.
translation: 滚！

original: I was just wondering if...
translation: 我只是好奇……

original: I just wanted to know...
translation: 我只是想知道……

original: It's just that...
translation: 只是……

original: But...
translation: 但是……

original: No.
translation: 不。

original: Go away.
translation: 走吧。

original: Ask Ahzrukhal.
translation: 去问阿祖卡。

original: Go sit down.
translation: 请坐。

original: I can't afford that.
translation: 我付不起。

original: The price isn't going to change, if that's what you're hoping. They'll be here when you can cover the cost.
translation: 价格不能再低了。如果你诚心想买的话，就等你付得起的时候再来吧。

original: I still can't afford that.
translation: 我还是付不起。

original: Well, then I guess I can't sell them to you.
translation: 嗯，我想我不能卖给你。

original: No way am I paying that. Forget it.
translation: 想让我付这么多可没门，算了吧。

original: That's your choice. They're your caps, after all. I'm not going to try a hard sell here; someone else will buy them eventually.
translation: 这是你的选择，毕竟瓶盖是你的。我又不是一定要卖给你，还会有别人买的。

original: 2000 is a bit steep. 1200 for all three is a more reasonable offer.
translation: 2000个太离谱了。三个一共1200个倒是个合适的总价。

original: I suppose I can accept that. It's a deal; the kids are yours. I'll have them delivered to the front gate for you.
translation: 我想我能接受。成交，这些小孩都是你的了。我会把他们送到前门等你。

original: If I may, you might want to keep a close eye on them. They can be willful at times. Good luck.
translation: 我建议，你可能得盯着他们。他们有时会很任性，祝你好运。

original: That sounds like a good deal. I'll take it.
translation: 听起来不错，成交。

original: Fair enough. It's a pleasure to do business with you again.
translation: 很公平，与你做生意是件愉快的事。

original: I'll have the kids delivered to the front gate. And, may I recommend keeping a close eye on them? They're clever little bastards.
translation: 我会把孩子送到前门。同时，我能建议你看紧些吗？他们可是群聪明的小杂种。

original: A wise decision. It's a pleasure to do business with you.
translation: 明智的抉择。跟你做生意真是很愉快。

original: I'll have the kids delivered to the front gate. And, may I recommend keeping a close eye on them? They're clever little bastards.
translation: 我会把孩子送到前门。同时，我能建议你看紧些吗？他们可是群聪明的小杂种。

original: Great, let's talk price.
translation: 好极了，我们谈谈价钱。

original: For starters, I'm thinking 500 caps each for the little ones... Sammy and Penny, I think their names are.
translation: 首先，小的每个500瓶盖……萨米和佩尼，我想是叫这名字吧。

original: Now the other one, Squirrel... that's a talented kid. 500 would be a crime. I'm thinking 1000 caps for him, bringing us to a total of 2000 caps.
translation: 而“松鼠”……这孩子很能干，500太便宜了，我要1000，一共2000。

original: I've... changed my mind.
translation: 我……改变主意了。

original: Are you sure? That's a shame. I thought we had a good thing going here. Well, you know where to find us.
translation: 你确定？太遗憾了。我还以为我们谈得很好呢。嗯，你知道在哪能找到我们。

original: I never said I was buying. I just said I want them.
translation: 我从没说我要买。我只是说我想要。

original: I'm sorry, what?
translation: 对不起，你说什么？

original: I hope you're not trying to strong-arm me, friend. I'd be more than happy to cut both your legs off before you even think you have one to stand on.
translation: 我希望你不要想威胁我，朋友。我会让你还没反映过来就砍断你双腿。

original: You've got some kids out there. I want them.
translation: 你这有些孩子。我想要他们。

original: You do? Hell, that's great news. They'll work out well for you, I think. Full of energy. Great for small jobs now, and bigger loads down the road.
translation: 真的？见鬼，这真是个好消息。我想他们会很好地为你服务的。他们精力充沛，现在能干些小差是，以后也能干重活。

original: I'm sure we can come to a reasonable agreement; something you'll find affordable.
translation: 我确信我们能找到一个双方都同意的价格：一个你能承担的价格。

original: I was thinking about buying some slaves.
translation: 我想买几个奴隶。

original: Right, right. 2000 caps was the figure I quoted. The price still stands if you're still interested.
translation: 好，好的，我的报价是2000瓶盖。如果有兴趣随时都能来谈。

original: We'd talked about the kids.
translation: 我们来谈谈那些孩子。

original: Of course. So you know what we have to offer; I assure you that you won't find quality like this anywhere else.
translation: 当然。你知道我的报价了：而且我确定你再也找不到这么质优价廉的了。

original: Now how exactly can Paradise Falls accomodate your needs?
translation: 现在，你觉得堕落天堂能满足你的需求吗？

original: I've seen your selection.
translation: 我看过你的货了。

original: Ah, fully engrossed in the trade, are we? I'm glad you came to see me, instead of trying to work around me. Easier to get along this way.
translation: 啊，专注于交易本身，对吧？我很高兴你来见我，而不是避开我。这样子事情简单多了。

original: There are some prime specimens out there. Have you had a chance to look them over?
translation: 外面有一些样品，你看过了吗？

original: Well then, you and I are a perfect fit. You want to buy slaves, and I want to sell them.
translation: 好的，你我很谈得来。你想买奴隶而我要卖。

original: There are some prime specimens out there. Have you had a chance to look them over?
translation: 外面有一些样品，你看过了吗？

original: The little shits are your problem now. I see 'em around here again, I'm gonna shoot 'em. We clear?
translation: 那些小混蛋交给你了。要是我再看见他们在附近游荡，就朝他们开枪，明白了吗？

original: Can you believe it? He is growing up so fast.
translation: 你能相信吗？他长得真快。

original: Can you believe it? She is growing up so fast.
translation: 你能相信吗？她长得真快。

original: Happy birthday!
translation: 生日快乐！

original: Happy birthday!
translation: 生日快乐！

original: Happy birthday!
translation: 生日快乐！

original: Happy birthday!
translation: 生日快乐！

original: Happy birthday!
translation: 生日快乐！

original: Surprise!
translation: 吓一跳！

original: Surprise!
translation: 吓一跳！

original: All right, Butch.
translation: 好吧，布奇。

original: Hey, Officer Gomez. Nice party, huh?
translation: 嗨，警员戈麦斯。不错的聚会，呃？

original: Can it. I've had it with you, Butch. Your mother is going to hear about this little incident.
translation: 行了吧。我受够了，布奇。你母亲将会知道这次小意外的。

original: What'd he tell you, it was my fault? You didn't hear what he said to me!
translation: 他和你说什么了，这是我的错？你不知道他对我说了些什么！

original: What'd she tell you, it was my fault? You didn't hear what she said to me!
translation: 她和你说什么了，这是我的错？你不知道她对我说了些什么！

original: I'm not going to tolerate any more of your bullying.
translation: 我不会再容忍你的恐吓。

original: Fine. Tell my mom. Big deal. Are we done?
translation: 好吧。去告诉我妈妈吧。没什么了不起的。行了吧？

original: For now. Just remember, I'm keeping my eye on you.
translation: 暂时吧。你给我记着，我跟你没完。

original: Really, I was the one who started it. It wasn't his fault.
translation: 其实，是我开的头。不全是他的错。

original: Really? Well, if you say so. I'll stay out of it if that's the way you want it.
translation: 真的？既然你这么说，那我就不管了。

original: But let me give you some advice -- stay away from Butch. He's nothing but trouble.
translation: 但我给你点建议 — 离布奇远点。他除了会惹事外没别的本事。

original: Please don't do that. I know you don't like Butch, but if you start picking fights with him, how are you any better?
translation: 别那么做。我知道你不喜欢布奇，但是如果和他打架，那能比他好到哪去？

original: Don't be afraid to stand up for yourself, but don't go looking for trouble. There's trouble enough in this world without adding to it.
translation: 不要不敢自卫，但是也不要惹事。这世上麻烦事已经够多了。

original: Well, now, that's more than enough lecturing for a birthday party! Go on and enjoy yourself.
translation: 算了，生日就不说教了！去好好玩吧。

original: Actually, I was the one that started it. It's easy to make him mad.
translation: 其实，是我开的头。不全是他的错。

original: He tried to take my birthday present!
translation: 他想抢走我的生日礼物！

original: Why that little... I figured it was him that started it. He's been nothing but trouble since the day he was born.
translation: 为什么那小……我猜这肯定是他引起的。他从生下来那刻起就没干过好事！

original: You let me handle this. And try to stay out of the way.
translation: 让我来处理吧，你就不用管了。

original: I wish we didn't have to invite him, but there just aren't that many children your age in the Vault.
translation: 我真希望不用邀请他来，但这避难所里和你同龄的人实在不多。

original: In any case, you'll have to learn to deal with bullies. The world is full of people much worse than Butch, I'm afraid.
translation: 不管怎样，你得学会怎么对付坏人。这世上比布奇更坏的人实在太多了，恐怕就是这样。

original: But don't let him ruin your birthday. Go on, I bet there's someone else waiting to give you a present!
translation: 但不要让他毁了你的生日。继续吧，我想还有其他人有生日礼物要送你！

original: He tried to take the sweetroll Mrs. Palmer gave me!
translation: 他想拿走帕尔默大妈给我的甜面包卷！

original: Don't worry about it, sir. It was nothing.
translation: 不要担心这些，先生。没事的。

original: That's fine, son. I'm glad to see you're not letting Butch bully you.
translation: 那很好，孩子。布奇没有吓到你，我很欣慰。

original: He's going to be a handful in a few years if his mother doesn't take him in hand.
translation: 如果他妈妈不严加管教的话，不出几年他就会成为一个棘手的问题。

original: Well, no harm done then. Why don't you get back to enjoying your party.
translation: 嗯，没事就好。玩得愉快。

original: It was nothing. Just boys being boys.
translation: 没什么。只不过一群小子而已。

original: Good for you. Don't let Butch start to bully you or he'll never stop. I've seen his type before.
translation: 这就好。别让布奇欺负你，要不然他会上瘾。我以前见过他这样的。

original: He's going to be a handful in a few years if his mother doesn't take him in hand.
translation: 如果他妈妈不严加管教的话，不出几年他就会成为一个棘手的问题。

original: Well, no harm done then. Why don't you get back to enjoying your party.
translation: 嗯，没事就好。玩得愉快。

original: I'm glad to hear it. Once you start letting bullies push you around, you'll never see the end of it.
translation: 很高兴听到这。一旦你开始被他们欺负，麻烦便会没完没了。

original: Come on now, I bet there's someone else out there with a present for you!
translation: 现在，来吧，别人肯定还有礼物送你！

original: Don't worry, Dad. I can handle Butch.
translation: 不用担心，爸爸。我能对付布奇。

original: Stanley, you turned the lights on too fast. You blinded the poor kid!
translation: 斯坦利，你开灯开得太快了。可怜的孩子眼睛都花了。

original: Butch! What do you think you're doing? Leave him alone!
translation: 布奇！你以为你在干嘛？离他远点！

original: Butch! What are you doing? Hitting a girl, and on her birthday for heaven's sakes!
translation: 布奇！你在干嘛？打女孩！还是在她的生日聚会上？

original: You all right, son? He didn't hurt you, did he?
translation: 你没事吧，孩子？他没伤到你吧？

original: Did he hurt you, honey?
translation: 亲爱的，他伤到你了吗？

original: Okay. "I'm sorry three times!" Ha! That's exactly what you said to say!
translation: 好吧。“对对对不不不起起起！”哈！这是你想说的吗？

original: Oh man! You got me!
translation: 哦，哥们！你明白我的意思！

original: I guess I accept your apology!
translation: 我想我接受你的道歉了！

original: <Sigh.> Okay. I'm sorry.
translation: <叹息> 好的。对不起。

original: Good. You did it. Now I'll talk to you.
translation: 好的。你做到了。现在我想跟你谈谈。

original: I'm sorry! There, that's three.
translation: 对不起！在那，一共三个。

original: Keep 'em coming. Pappa said that's the right thing to do.
translation: 保持这样。爸爸说要做正确的事。

original: I'm sorry.
translation: 我很抱歉。

original: That's good. Keep going.
translation: 好的。继续。

original: Forget it, I don't care. I'm out of here.
translation: 忘了吧，我不在乎。我走了。

original: Fine. Hmph.
translation: 好吧。哼。

original: What's it going to take for you to forgive me?
translation: 怎么才能让你原谅我？

original: When I was bad, my pappa made me apologize three times. Then he decided if I was really or sorry or not.
translation: 当我犯错的时候，我爸爸就先让我道三次歉。然后他来决定我是否真的认识到了错误。

original: You wanna' talk to me about stuff, say you're sorry three times... and you better mean it!
translation: 想和我说材料的事，就先说三次对不起……而且你最好是真心的！

original: Okay, okay. I'm sorry.
translation: 好的，好的。对不起。

original: No! They always just say sorry, but then it turns out to be a bunch of lies.
translation: 不行！他们总是只说“对不起”，但是接下来又会继续撒谎！

original: How can I ever trust a grown-up again?
translation: 我怎么能相信一个长大的人说的话？

original: Don't be like that. I'm sorry for being mean.
translation: 别这样。我是真心道歉。

original: Okay, I forgive you.
translation: 好吧，我原谅你。

original: Look, kid. There's no such thing as monsters.
translation: 听着，孩子。那里没有什么所谓的怪物。

original: R... really? No monsters?
translation: 真……的？没有怪物？

original: Then you can make these things go away!
translation: 你把那些东西赶走吧！

original: Hey, kid. It's okay. I'm a big, tough guy. I can take care of you!
translation: 嗨，孩子。好了。我是个大人,强壮的男人。我能照顾你的。

original: You look stronger than all the other grown-ups. Can you... can you protect me?
translation: 你看起来比其他大人要强。你能不能……你能不能保护我？

original: You look stronger than all the other grown-ups. Can you... can you protect me?
translation: 你看起来比其他大人要强。你能不能……你能不能保护我？

original: Hey, kid. It's okay. I'm a big, tough lady. I can take care of you!
translation: 嗨，孩子。好了。我是个大人,厉害的女人。我能照顾你的。

original: Did you know the others in town very well?
translation: 你跟这的其它人熟吗？

original: Naw. People don't like to stay long in Grayditch. The D.C. Ruins aren't a great place to make a home, you know?
translation: 不熟。在格雷蒂奇，人们并不愿久留。其实特区废墟这块地方并不适合长久居住，你懂吗？

original: In fact, pappa was talking about moving on soon... we've been here for maybe a year.
translation: 老实说，爸爸对我说就要搬家了……我们在这待了快一年了。

original: Is there any special way to hurt them?
translation: 有什么特别办法来对付它们？

original: My pappa had a gun, and he said it hurt those things, but he said they were the dumbest Fuckin' Ants he ever saw.
translation: 我爸有枪，他说管用。但他还说那他妈的是他见过的最难缠的蚂蚁。

original: He kept telling everyone to "shoot for their antenner" whatever that means.
translation: 他总是不断地对大家说“打它们的触须”，不知道那是什么意思。

original: Have they always been around?
translation: 它们总在这附近？

original: Naw. Those things started coming around only in the last few months.
translation: 不是。那些东西只是最近几个月才开始出现的。

original: At first they just crawled around outside our town, but later they came into town and... well, you know the rest.
translation: 一开始它们只是在镇子外面活动，但是最近它们开始在镇子里……嗯，就如你先前所见的。

original: Okay kid, I said I'd do it. Now scram!
translation: 好啦，孩子，我会帮你的。别哭啦！

original: Humph... you don't gotta be such a jerk about it.
translation: 哼……你还不是太蠢。

original: There's an old portashelter next to the diner near my house. I'll be waiting inside for you to come back.
translation: 在我家与餐厅旁有一个圆形遮蔽所。我在那等你回来。

original: And don't you dare leave me alone!
translation: 还有你别想把我一个人扔在这。

original: Is there anywhere you can hide while I search?
translation: 我去找你爸爸的时候你不应该找个地方躲起来吗？

original: Well, there is the personal shelter next to the old diner.
translation: 嗯，有一个圆形遮蔽所就在餐厅旁。

original: Pappa always said to stay away from it... but, I guess it's supposed to be safe.
translation: 爸爸总是让我离那远点……但我觉得那里面很安全。

original: I'll head over there and wait inside. Hurry back!
translation: 我会躲在那里面。快点回来！

original: Okay. I'll go look for your father.
translation: 好的，我去找你爸爸。

original: You will? Really? Thanks a whole lot!
translation: 你要帮我找爸爸？真的？太谢谢了！

original: My house is the one closest to the huge sign and the old diner.
translation: 我家是离那大标记和旧餐厅最近的那间。

original: Please... find my pappa and make him come back!
translation: 拜托……找到我爸爸并带他回来！

original: What happened here?
translation: 这发生了什么？

original: It used to be kinda' nice. No one bothered us there, I guess because we were so close to D.C.
translation: 这曾非常宁静。没人打扰我们，我想是因为离特区很近。

original: There was seven of us living there in tall, old brick houses. I think I'm the last one left. Those things took everyone else.
translation: 我们曾有七个人住在那高大的砖房里。我想我是最后一个剩下的了。那些东西把其他人都杀了。

original: Can you tell me more about the things attacking Grayditch?
translation: 能不能和我详细说说攻击格雷蒂奇的那些东西？

original: Well, they're big ugly things that crawl around on six legs. They got huge teeth and skitter around grabbing everything in their path.
translation: 嗯，它们是一种又大又丑的六足爬行怪。它们有巨大锋利的牙齿，会把周围的东西都咬得乱七八糟。

original: My pappa would always say they were Fuckin' Ants. Well, that's what he used to call them anyway.
translation: 爸爸管它们叫做“他妈的蚂蚁”。嗯，他是这么叫的。

original: I just call 'em Fire Ants.
translation: 我叫他们火蚁。

original: All right, I'm sorry. Calm down and tell me what's going on.
translation: 好啦，对不起。冷静，告诉我出什么事情了。

original: Please don't get mad at me... I'm scared. I don't know what to do.
translation: 请别生我的气……我吓坏了。我不知道该怎么办。

original: Just help me... promise you'll help me!
translation: 帮我……求你一定要帮我！

original: Is that a warning, or a threat?
translation: 这是个警告，还是威胁？

original: See! I knew it! You don't care! No one ever cares!
translation: 看！我就知道！你不在乎！没人在乎！

original: Well fine! Go away, see if I care! But those... things. They're gonna' get you!
translation: 好吧！走吧，看我能否办到！但是那些……东西，它们会找上你的！

original: Sorry, kid. Help costs caps, and you look pretty broke to me.
translation: 对不起，孩子。帮助不是免费的，而你看起来没什么钱。

original: You grown-ups are all the same! All you care about is your stuff!
translation: 你们大人都一个样！你们所关心的只有你们自已。

original: My pappa is missing and I think the ants may have gotten him! I hope they get you too!
translation: 我爸爸不见了，我猜那些蚂蚁抓住了他！希望你也被那些蚂蚁抓住！

original: I'd like to help, but I need to know more first.
translation: 我想帮你，但是我得知道出了什么事。

original: Those... big things. They're all over Grayditch and they killed everyone!
translation: 那些……巨大的东西。它们遍布格雷蒂奇的每个角落并杀死了所有人！

original: Please... please find my pappa!
translation: 求你……求你帮我找爸爸！

original: Okay kid. I'm going to say it once. Stop your whining!
translation: 好吧，孩子。我只说这一次。不要再抱怨了！

original: No! You don't care! The grown-ups never cared! Now they're all dead! Well, fine! You'll just die too!
translation: 不！你不在乎！大人从不在乎！现在他们都死了！嗯，没错！你一样也会死！

original: Unless you tell me what the problem is I can't help you.
translation: 你不告诉我出了什么事，我没办法帮你。

original: THOSE things! It's all their fault! They did this to us!
translation: 那些东西！都是它们惹的祸！它们搞成了这样！

original: Hey, hey. Calm down. It's going to be okay. I promise.
translation: 嗨，嗨。冷静。一切都会好起来的。我保证。

original: You won't leave me like all the other grown-ups? You... you can help me?
translation: 你不会像别的大人那样丢下我不管吧？你……你能帮我吗？

original: What the heck is your problem?
translation: 见鬼，你有什么问题？

original: Those things... they're gonna' get me too! Can't stop now!
translation: 那些东西……它们会把我也抓走的！谁也无法阻止！

original: Calm down, kid.
translation: 冷静，孩子。

original: No... those things will get me! I can't. Gotta' keep going!
translation: 不……那些东西会把我抓走的！我无能为力。只能等着被抓！

original: Those what? What's the matter?
translation: 那是什么？到底是什么？

original: Those... THINGS. They keep coming. They scare me! Make it stop!
translation: 那些……东西。它们不停地涌来。太可怕了！谁来让它们停下！

original: I need you to repair my equipment.
translation: 我需要你帮我修理装备。

original: I can't imagine why she'd be more popular. Even assuming this is all true.
translation: 即使这是真的，我也无法想象她为什么会更受欢迎。

original: What're you suggesting, you little brat? I may not be on the science team anymore, but I still know how to keep records!
translation: 小杂种，你想说什么？我或许不再是科学团队的人，但我仍知道怎么保存记录！

original: Here! They probably don't even remember, but I kept the records of that first council meeting. Take them, if it'll put them in their place!
translation: 给！他们可能早就忘了，但我还保存着一些首次会议的记录。拿着，如果可以的话就请物尽其用吧！

original: Do you have any hard evidence of all this?
translation: 关于这些事，你能拿出什么确凿的证据吗？

original: Of course I do! A good scientist always keeps track of their data!
translation: 当然有！一个优秀的科学家总是保存着所有的数据资料。

original: Here! They probably don't even remember, but I kept the records of that first council meeting. Take them, if it'll put them in their place!
translation: 给！他们可能早就忘了，但我还保存着一些首次会议的记录。拿着，如果可以的话就请物尽其用吧！

original: If that's so, why are you stuck down here?
translation: 如果是这样，为什么你还要躲在这呢？

original: About 18 years ago, Li and her ambitious little team of backbiters showed up. Ruined everything around here, they did!
translation: 大约在18年前，李和她的野心小团队开始萌芽。他们几乎毁了这的一切，真的！

original: She came in with her big "Purity Project" pipe dream, and my whole staff started working with her, those traitors!
translation: 她带着宏伟的“净水工程”管道梦想而来，我的所有人都开始为她工作，那帮叛徒！

original: She even took my seat on the council. By then, I was glad to leave it behind. But hell if I'm leaving the city I made great!
translation: 她连我在议会的职位都抢了。那时，我也既往不咎了。但要我离开这个我一手创造的城市，见鬼去吧！

original: So, you used to be in charge? How did you end up here?
translation: 你以前是掌权的？为何会落到今天这般田地？

original: That lasted until 'bout 18 years ago, when those ambitious backbiters like Li and her little team showed up.
translation: 大概是在18年前，当像李和她的团队那样的野心团体萌芽时。

original: She came in with her big "Purity Project" pipe dream, and my whole staff started working with her, those traitors!
translation: 她带着宏伟的“净水工程”管道梦想而来，我的所有人都开始为她工作，那帮叛徒！

original: She even took my seat on the council. By then, I was glad to leave it behind. But hell if I'm leaving the city I made great!
translation: 她连我在议会的职位都抢了。那时，我也既往不咎了。但要我离开这个我一手创造的城市，见鬼去吧！

original: You were on the City Council? That's hard to believe.
translation: 你曾经是城议会的人？这真难以置信。

original: Well, start believing or start walking! Remnants of the Naval Research Institute cleared the Mirelurks off this wreck about 40 years ago.
translation: 嗯，信不信由你！海军研究所的残余人员在40年前就已经肃清了这的泥沼蟹。

original: We were looking for new lab-space, and this bucket of bolts just happened to have a well-preserved science bay on it.
translation: 我们当时在找一个新的试验基地，而这艘老船正好有个保存完好的研究室。

original: Everything else just grew up around that lab once we got it up and running. The science team was led by one "H. Pinkerton."
translation: 我们将实验室运作起来后，周边的一切也随之发展了起来。这支科学团队由一个叫“H·平克顿”的人带领。

original: Setting the record straight is exactly my goal.
translation: 我的目标是将真相公之于众。

original: For that, you have to go all the way back to when remnants of the Naval Research Institute cleared the Mirelurks off this wreck about 40 years ago.
translation: 关于这事，得追溯到40年前海军研究所残余人员肃清泥沼蟹的事。

original: We were looking for new lab-space, and this bucket of bolts just happened to have a well-preserved science bay on it.
translation: 我们当时在找一个新的试验基地，而这艘老船正好有个保存完好的研究室。

original: Everything else just grew up around that lab once we got it up and running. The science team was led by one "H. Pinkerton."
translation: 我们将实验室运作起来后，周边的一切也随之发展了起来。这支科学团队由一个叫“H·平克顿”的人带领。

original: Oh, right. I sort of lose track of time talking about the old girl.
translation: 哦，对。一说起这老女孩我就忘了时间。

original: Enough about Rivet City.
translation: 铆钉城的事就到这吧。

original: I think I get the idea. Let me ask you something else.
translation: 我想我明白了。让我问些其它事。

original: What now?
translation: 现在呢？

original: Is that it then?
translation: 就这样了？

original: Alright then.
translation: 好的。

original: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

original: What's your take on the Republic?
translation: 你对共和国的感觉如何？

original: Well, the Republic of Dave is the only true sovereign nation in the Wasteland. The only really civilized place left in the world.
translation: 嗯，戴夫共和国是废土唯一的真正主权国家，世界上仅存的真正文明之地。

original: One day, all wastelanders will be citizens in the republic, and know the greatness of their president.
translation: 总有一天，废土的所有幸存者都会成为共和国的公民，并了解他们的总统有多伟大。

original: Any future plans for the Republic, Mister President?
translation: 对共和国的未来有什么计划吗？总统先生。

original: We have plenty of food and water here, and the compound is fairly safe. I'm glad the children can be raised here, away from the Wasteland.
translation: 我们有大量的水和食物，这地方也相当安全。我很高兴孩子们能在这健康成长，远离废土。

original: I'd like to see more trading done with the local caravans, but Dave's afraid their outside influence could weaken the Republic.
translation: 我很希望能和商队多做生意，但戴夫害怕外界的影响会削弱共和国。

original: Dave is a great leader. He's going to bring civilization back to the Wasteland. One day, they'll say it all started here.
translation: 戴夫是个伟大的领袖。他正在将文明带回废土。总有一天，人们会说：文明正是由此地复兴。

original: Dave is in charge. When he's not around, I'm in charge. If you want anything else, go to the Museum of Dave on the left side of the compound.
translation: 戴夫负责。当他不在的时候就由我代理。如果想了解其它的，就去场地左边的戴夫博物馆看看吧。

original: The Republic of Dave offers a rich history rivaling that of the great nations before the war.
translation: 戴夫共和国拥有一段能与战前的大国相媲美的悠久历史。

original: President Daddy is awesome! He buys all sorts of neat toys that we get to play with!
translation: 总统爸爸很棒的！他买下了所有好玩的玩具让我们玩！

original: I want to be like Shawna when I grow up. She's smart, just like mommy! Course, daddy is smarter. Like, way smarter.
translation: 我想我长大后就像肖纳一样。她很聪明，就像妈妈！当然，爸爸更聪明。总之……就是更聪明。

original: I don't like mommy number two. What's wrong with just one mommy? But President Daddy says he needs two mommies...
translation: 我不喜欢二号妈妈。只有一个妈妈有什么不对？但是总统爸爸说他需要两个妈妈……

original: Everyone says that daddy is the best man, ever ever. I don't know, but that's what Shawna says, so I guess it's true.
translation: 所有的人都说爸爸是最好的人，总是如此。我不知道，但是肖纳是这么说的，所以我想这应该是真的。

original: I'd like to discuss the election with you.
translation: 我想跟你谈谈关于选举的事情。

original: Are you kidding? Dave is dead. How can there be an election with a dead candidate?
translation: 你开什么玩笑？戴夫都已经死了。难道死人还能进行选举？

original: Oh yeah? What about it?
translation: 哦，是吗？怎么了？

original: The election is still going on. What do you want to know?
translation: 选举还会继续举行。你还想知道些什么？

original: Me? I'm not sure if I can help you...
translation: 我？我不知道能不能帮上你……

original: I'll help you if I can.
translation: 我会尽可能地帮你。

original: Election time is always exciting around here.
translation: 选举的时刻总是激动人心。

original: MacCready sent me. I'm here to rescue you.
translation: 麦迪派我来的。我是来救你的。

original: God, why didn't you say that?
translation: 天啊，为什么你怎么不早说？

original: Come on, let's go before they change their minds. I don't like the way that mungo looks at me.
translation: 来吧，趁他们还没改变主意，我们快走。我可不喜欢那些毛人看我的眼神。

original: Yeah, yeah. Okay.
translation: 嗯，嗯。好的。

original: Don't make a big deal out of it. You'll blow our cover.
translation: 不要大惊小怪，你会暴露我们的。

original: Do you want to get rescued or not?
translation: 你是想被救出去还是继续待在这？

original: Rescued? This is a pretty stupid way to rescue anybody, mungo.
translation: 救？这种救人的方式太愚蠢了，毛人。

original: Pipe down, short stuff. I'm trying to get you out of here.
translation: 小声点，小家伙。我在试着帮你逃出这。

original: What? That's a load of shit. We're not stupid, you know. We've seen what you mungos are like.
translation: 什么？胡说八道。要知道我们可不是蠢货。我们看得出你是个什么样的毛人。

original: If you say so.
translation: 既然你这么说。

original: Just follow me out of the complex. Then we can talk.
translation: 跟着我离开这。稍后再谈。

original: Keep quiet, will you? Let's get out of here, then we can talk.
translation: 安静点，好吗？我们先离开这，然后再谈。

original: What is there to talk about? I know what you're doing. You're going to take us somewhere and make us work for you... or worse.
translation: 谈什么？我知道你想干嘛。你准备把我们带到其它地方，让我们为你干活……或者更甚……

original: I'm telling you right now, as soon as we get out of here, we're making a run for it. You want to try and shoot us, you can.
translation: 我跟你说实话，只要我们离开这，就会立刻会跑。你可以开枪打我们，随你。

original: Look, I came from Little Lamplight.
translation: 听着，我是从小灯镇来的。

original: You did? You better not be lying. Fine, let's go.
translation: 真的？你最好别胡说。好吧，我们走。

original: Fine. Would you rather stay here with the Slavers?
translation: 好吧。你是宁愿和这些奴隶贩子呆在一起吗？

original: Well... No. You better be telling the truth, mungo, or else we're going to kill you in your sleep.
translation: 嗯……不。你说的最好是真话，毛人，否则我们在你睡觉时杀了你。

original: So if you're serious, let's get moving.
translation: 如果你是认真的，我们走吧。

original: I'm going to win this.
translation: 我会赢的。

original: Hmm. I suppose voting for Dave is the patriotic thing to do.
translation: 嗯。我想投戴夫的票是爱国行为。

original: All done! Dave is the best!
translation: 搞定！戴夫最棒！

original: Fingers crossed.
translation: 老天保佑。

original: Good luck, Dave. You have my vote.
translation: 好运，戴夫。我投了你一票。

original: Ah, Dave. Lead our Republic to glory!
translation: 啊，戴夫。领导我们迈向荣耀！

original: Let's see what we have here.
translation: 让我们看看投票结果。

original: A vote for me...
translation: 投我的一票……

original: And another vote for me...
translation: 我又得到一票……

original: A vote for Rosie?
translation: 投给萝丝的一票？

original: Bob!?
translation: 鲍勃！？

original: Wait a minute, has somebody tampered with the ballot box?
translation: 等等，有人在投票箱上动过手脚吗？

original: Hmm... after counting the votes, the president is...
translation: 嗯……统计投票完毕，选出的总统是……

original: Well, looks like another triumphant victory for myself.
translation: 嗯，看起来我又一次胜利了。

original: Well, despite the hiccup, it looks like I am still declared the winner.
translation: 嗯，尽管有些小问题，但我最终还是顺利当选。

original: ROSIE? Rosie can't be president! NO! This is unfair! This can't be! FINE! I'm LEAVING! See how you people do without me! Enjoy your new president!
translation: 萝丝？萝丝不可能当上总统的！不！这不公平！这不可能！好吧！我走！看没有我你们怎么活！为你们的新总统高兴吧！

original: BOB? Bob can't be president! NO! This is unfair! This can't be! FINE! I'm LEAVING! See how you people do without me! Enjoy your new president!
translation: 鲍勃？鲍勃不可能当上总统的！不！这不公平！这不可能！好吧！我走！看没有我你们怎么活！为你们的新总统高兴吧！

original: You're going to be sorry, you little smartmouth.
translation: 你会后悔的，你这小巧嘴。

original: What, is she your best friend now? Hey, Wally, I think Paul's in love...
translation: 什么，现在她是你最好的朋友？嗨，瓦利，我想保罗陷入爱河了……

original: What, are you two best friends now? Hey, Wally, I think Paul's gone soft on us.
translation: 什么，你们俩是最好的朋友了？嗨，瓦利，我想保罗背弃我们了。

original: Quiet makes people stop drinking. Turn the radio back on.
translation: 安静只会扰了酒兴，快把收音机打开吧。

original: Why would you do that? These people want their music.
translation: 你在干嘛？那些人正在听音乐呢！

original: Hey! Leave that alone. If I wanted it off, I'd turn it off.
translation: 嗨！离那远点。是不是把它关掉得由我说了算。

original: That's better.
translation: 这样好多了。

original: Thank you. Now leave it alone.
translation: 谢谢你。现在离那远点。

original: Now that's more like it. Music makes the sweet sweet and the bitter all the more bitter.
translation: 就是这种感觉。音乐让甜蜜的更甜蜜，苦楚的更苦楚。

original: Stop messing with that radio.
translation: 不许再碰那收音机了。

original: Hey, leave that radio alone.
translation: 嗨，离那收音机远点。

original: What do you do with the money you make down here?
translation: 在这下面，你挣那些钱干嘛？

original: Well... we spend it at Carol's. Or the Ninth Circle, but I don't like it there.
translation: 嗯……我们把钱花在卡洛尔旅馆或是第九环，但我不太喜欢这样。

original: The rest we give to Quinn to trade for stuff we need whenever he goes out.
translation: 剩下的钱给奎因，等他出去的时候买我们想要的东西。

original: Let me see what you have for sale.
translation: 看看你都卖什么？

original: If any of the armor fails to protect your life, I'll give you a full refund.
translation: 如果有任何装甲不能在战斗中保护你的性命，我保证全额退款。

original: Take a look, it all works.
translation: 看看吧，都能用。

original: Sure thing, human.
translation: 当然，人类。

original: Oh, I just remembered... I don't care.
translation: 哇，我刚发现……我并不在乎。

original: Suit yourself. But you're missing out. Do you want something else?
translation: 随便你，但你正在错过机会。你想要点别的吗？

original: Travel? Where do you go?
translation: 旅行？你都去哪？

original: Oh, here and there and everywhere. I've explored all up and down the coast, from the Commonwealth, to the Pitt, all the way down to Crater Banks.
translation: 哦，这，那，到处。我沿着海岸走来，从联邦，到匹兹堡，所有的道路都是弹坑。

original: I also do a fair bit of trading. You see, folks here, they don't have much of a connection to the outside.
translation: 我卖东西向来童叟无欺。你也看见了，这的人跟外界的接触并不多。

original: So I move their goods and caps out to the Wastes and bring back in what I trade for 'em.
translation: 因此我将他们的货物和瓶盖带到废土，然后换回他们需要的东西。

original: Wow, I just realized... I don't care.
translation: 哇，我刚发现……我并不在乎。

original: Suit yourself. But you're missing out. Do you want something else?
translation: 随你的便，但你正错过机会。你想要点别的吗？

original: Where do you go?
translation: 你去过哪？

original: Oh, here and there and everywhere. I've explored all up and down the coast, from the Commonwealth, to the Pitt, all the way down to Crater Banks.
translation: 哦，这，那，到处。我沿着海岸走来，从联邦，到匹兹堡，所有的道路都是弹坑。

original: I also do a fair bit of trading. You see, folks here, they don't have much of a connection to the outside.
translation: 我卖东西向来童叟无欺。你也看见了，这的人跟外界的接触并不多。

original: So I move their goods and caps out to the Wastes and bring back in what I trade for 'em.
translation: 因此我将他们的货物和瓶盖带到废土，然后换回他们需要的东西。

original: Oh, God. I'm out of here.
translation: 哦，天啊。我要离开这儿。

original: Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 随你的便。如果你改变了想法，就到这来找我。

original: Nice to meet you, Quinn.
translation: 见到你很高兴，奎因。

original: You too, stranger. I know a lot of people around here don't take kindly to humans wandering around, but I've met a lot of your people in my travels.
translation: 我也很高兴，陌生人。我们这的多数人都对来这的人类不太友好，但是我在旅途中遇到过很多像你这样的人类。

original: What? You're not going to tell me how rare it is to see a human in Underworld?
translation: 什么？你别告诉我在地下城很少能见到人类。

original: Me? No, not at all. I'm used to your people. Truth is, I spend most of my time away from Underworld.
translation: 我？不，没关系。我习惯和你们在一起了。老实说，其实我很少待在地下城里。

original: Watch out for your own body parts, you creepy bastard.
translation: 注意你身体的零件，你这恶心的杂种。

original: Now... there's no need for tha... that... wait... what were you saying? You wanted to talk to me... about something? What was it?
translation: 现在……没必要那样……等等……你在说什么？你想和我谈……一些事？你想说什么？

original: I'll do that.
translation: 我会做的。

original: Really? You... you're alright... you should buy me a drink some time...
translation: 真的？你……你还好吧……你应该找时间请我喝一杯。

original: Now... what were you saying?
translation: 嗯……刚才说到哪了？

original: You're disgusting.
translation: 你真恶心。

original: Yeah... and I ain't had enough liqu- liquor yet to think you.. you're pretty.
translation: 嗯……我还没疯到认为……认为你很漂亮。

original: You be careful. I don't want you hurting yourself.
translation: 你要小心。我不希望你伤到自己。

original: You sure? Some... some people make me hurt myself... because it makes 'em laugh...
translation: 你是认真的？不少人都想让我伤害自己……因为这让他们觉得好笑……

original: You keep your parts to yourself and let's talk about something else.
translation: 管好你的身体零件，让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Well... what... what... do you want to talk about?
translation: 嗯……你……你……你想聊些什么？

original: You're losing parts? Like... body parts?
translation: 你丢失了零件？像是……身体零件？

original: Yeah... it happens... a lot, actuall.. actually. All the time. But I'm getting' better... I think...
translation: 是的……很多，说真……说真的。每时每刻都在掉……但是我正在好起来……我想……

original: Just keep an... eye out for 'em... but not my eye, those ain't never fallen out yet...
translation: 对他们……留个心眼……但别是我的眼睛，我的眼睛还没掉出来过呢……

original: Are you all right?
translation: 你还好吧？

original: Who, me? Yeah... yeah... I'm fine. I guess. No... Yeah. I'll be okay. I just... I just need to try not to lose any of my parts this time...
translation: 谁？我？嗯……嗯……我很好。我想。不……是的……我会没事的。我只是……只是想这回不要再掉些什么零件出来了。

original: Doc Barrows says that he's... he's getting' tired of puttin' 'em back on... me. So, you know... if you see any, just bring 'em back.
translation: 巴罗斯医生说他……他试着把我掉下来的那些身件零件再装回去……所以……你看……如果你找到我身上的东西，就拿来给我。

original: So, you're the town drunk, huh?
translation: 你就是这镇的酒鬼，呃？

original: Why yes! Yes I am! And... PROUD! Proud of it! I mean, if I weren't, I'd probably just spend a lot more time cry... crying... you know?
translation: 是的！是的，我就是！很荣幸！很荣幸我就是那酒鬼！我的意思是，如果我不借酒浇愁，那我就很可能花上更多的时间嚎啕大哭……你懂吗？

original: Here I am... drunk... falling apart -- liter- literally! I lost my damn finger last week! Doc put it back on though... bless him...
translation: 我就是这的……酒鬼……醉得一滩烂泥……真的！上星期我把自己的手指头搞丢了！医生帮我装了回来……上帝保佑他……

original: Where can I get a drink around here? You seem like the right person to ask.
translation: 这附近哪能喝一杯？看起来我问对人了。

original: Why, you'll want to head on over to the Ninth Circle and talk to Mister Ahzrukhal... he... he... uhhh... what was I saying?
translation: 噢，你应该去第九环和阿祖卡先生谈……他……他……呃……我在说什么……

original: Oh yeah, the generators, I don't know where they are, you'll have to ask Winthrop.
translation: 哦，嗯，说起发电机，我找不到它们了，你得去问问温思罗普。

original: Ninth Cir- Circle. Talk to Ahzrukhal. And... bring me back something.
translation: 第九……环。去和阿祖卡谈。最好给我……带点东西回来。

original: Oh yeah, the generators, I don't know where they are, you'll have to ask Winthrop.
translation: 哦，嗯，说起发电机，我找不到它们了，你得去问问温思罗普。

original: I need medical supplies.
translation: 我需要医疗物资。

original: I think I can help you out.
translation: 我想我能帮到你。

original: Be careful with these. They're not toys, you know.
translation: 小心使用。你要明白，它们可不是玩具。

original: Yes, what do you need?
translation: 嗯，你要什么？

original: Very well. What do you require?
translation: 很好。你有什么需要？

original: Have you ever heard of a guy named Gob?
translation: 你听说过一个叫盖博的家伙吗？

original: Gob? Yes, of course!
translation: 盖博？嗯，当然认识！

original: He's my son... well, not really, not like you would think of a son. We Ghouls don't really work like that, but I love him like he's my own!
translation: 他是我的儿子……嗯，也不全是，不是你想像中的那种母子。我们僵尸不像人类那样，但是我像待亲儿子一样爱他。

original: Do you know him? Have you seen him? Is he alright?
translation: 你认识他？你见过他？他还好吗？

original: This place is coming down around our ears.
translation: 这地方就在我们眼前。

original: Jesus, this place is falling apart.
translation: 天啊，这地方已经支离破碎了。

original: Poor Winthrop, the guy really needs some help.
translation: 可怜的温思罗普，这家伙真的需要一些帮助。

original: One mechanic just isn't enough to keep this place going, I guess.
translation: 我想只有一个机械师不足以维持这的正常运作。

original: If I knew how, I'd give Winthrop a hand, but I have no idea how all of this old junk works.
translation: 如果我知道怎么做，我会帮温思罗普一把，但是我一点都不知道这堆旧废物是怎么运作的。

original: It a miracle that some of this shit works in the first place. I guess it's just a matter of time...
translation: 想让这堆垃圾运作起来简直就是奇迹。我想这迟早会……

original: My part in this is all done. Sorry, kid.
translation: 我该做的都已经做了。抱歉，孩子。

original: Please don't go! Please!
translation: 求求你别走！求求你！

original: We have to get back at these things for killing my pappa! We just gotta!
translation: 我们得回去处理这些杀害我爸爸的东西！我们出发吧！

original: Fine, I'll take care of everything.
translation: 好吧，我会处理好这一切。

original: You gotta stop it so this can't happen to anyone else's family ever again!
translation: 你不能再让这种事情发生在其他家庭的身上了！

original: I wish I had met you a long time ago, then maybe my dad would still be alive.
translation: 我要是早认识你就好了，那样我爸爸就不会死了。

original: Sorry, kid. Your old man is ant food.
translation: 我很抱歉，孩子。你老爸已经成了蚂蚁的晚餐了。

original: Well you don't have to be such a meanie about it.
translation: 就算是这样，你也用不着说的这么刻薄吧。

original: I already knew anyway, Mr. Smarty. I snuck back home a little while ago and found him laying there.
translation: 我已经知道了，聪明的先生。我曾悄悄潜回家里，发现他就躺在那。

original: Now he's dead and I'm by myself. Not that you'd care.
translation: 现在他死了，我变成孤儿。与你无关。

original: You... you know what you are? You're a big asshole! That's right... an asshole! My pappa said never to say that word, but you deserve it!
translation: 你……你知道你这算什么？你这大混蛋！没错……混蛋！爸爸告诉我不要说脏话，但是这词对你正合适！

original: Now what am I going to do? My pappa's dead... poor pappa...
translation: 现在我该怎么办？爸爸死了……可怜的爸爸……

original: Your father's dead.
translation: 你父亲死了。

original: Yeah... I snuck back home a little while ago and found him laying there.
translation: 是的……我曾经悄悄潜回家里，发现他就躺在那。

original: I guess I already knew anyway, I just needed to see for myself. Besides, I'm too tired to cry anymore.
translation: 我想我已经知道这些了，我只是想确认一下而已。而且，我太累了，已经不想再哭了。

original: He's...he's dead?
translation: 他……他死了？ ?

original: I guess I already knew. Besides, I'm too tired to cry anymore.
translation: 我想我已经猜到了。还有，我太累了，已经不想再哭了。

original: Bryan, I'm sorry, but your father is dead.
translation: 布赖恩，我很抱歉，但是你的父亲已经不在了。

original: Yeah... I snuck back home a little while ago and found him laying there.
translation: 是的……我曾经悄悄潜回家里，发现他就躺在那。

original: I guess I already knew anyway, I just needed to see for myself. Besides, I'm too tired to cry anymore.
translation: 我想我已经猜到这些了，我只是想确认一下而已。而且，我太累了，已经不想再哭了。

original: He's...he's dead?
translation: 他……他死了？

original: I guess I already knew. Besides, I'm too tired to cry anymore.
translation: 我想我已经猜到了。还有，我太累了，已经不想再哭了。

original: Looks like all the votes are in, Mister President.
translation: 似乎投票已经完成了，总统先生。

original: That would be Bob, Shawna, Jessica, Rosie and myself. In the Republic, if you're old enough to carry a weapon, you're old enough to vote.
translation: 选民包括鲍勃，肖纳，杰西卡，萝丝和我。在共和国里，只要你到了能拿动枪的年龄，你就有了选举权。

original: Rosie and Jessica are usually here in the Capitol. Bob usually hangs out outside near the Brahmin pen.
translation: 萝丝和杰西卡通常留在国会大厦里，鲍勃一般在外和双头牛一起。

original: Shawna runs the Museum of Dave, so you can find her there.
translation: 肖纳管理戴夫博物馆，你可以在那找到她。

original: Who's eligible to vote?
translation: 什么人有资格投票？

original: Bob still hasn't voted, that dumb bastard.
translation: 鲍勃还没投票，那可恶的家伙。

original: Are the votes in, Mister President?
translation: 总统先生，投票完成了吗？

original: Jessica hasn't voted yet.
translation: 杰西卡还没投票。

original: Are the votes in, Mister President?
translation: 总统先生，投票完成了吗？

original: Tell Shawna that Dave commands her to vote in the election. She'll come running, trust me.
translation: 告诉肖纳，就说戴夫命令她来投票。相信我，她会立刻跑来。

original: Are the votes in, Mister President?
translation: 总统先生，投票完成了吗？

original: Not yet. Rosie still hasn't voted.
translation: 还没。萝丝还没投票。

original: Are the votes in, Mister President?
translation: 总统先生，投票完成了吗？

original: Good, the votes are in. If you'll excuse me, I'll be getting started on tallying the numbers.
translation: 好的，所有人都投票了。失陪，我要开始统计票数了。

original: Oh yes, I almost forgot. Here's your caps. Keep this up and I may deign to make you a citizen, in a few years.
translation: 哦，对了，我几乎忘了。这是你的瓶盖。拿着吧，过几年或许我会让你也成为这的公民。

original: I know that. The people will see the results shortly, I assure you.
translation: 我知道。人民很快就会得知结果，我保证。

original: The people have re-elected me as their president.
translation: 人们又选了我作为他们的总统。

original: It's great to see the democratic process at work.
translation: 如此民主的过程真是让人欣慰啊。

original: So, what are the results, Mister President?
translation: 总统先生，票选结果如何？

original: Rosie somehow came up with the most votes.
translation: 萝丝不知何故获得了最多选票。

original: There must be some kind of bug in the voting system.
translation: 投票系统肯定出了问题。

original: So, what are the results, Mister President?
translation: 总统先生，票选结果如何？

original: Somehow Bob won the election.
translation: 鲍勃居然在选举中胜出。

original: I should have known the little bastard was conspiring against me.
translation: 我就应该知道那小杂种要密谋造反。

original: So, what are the results, Mister President?
translation: 总统先生，票选结果如何？

original: There was a tie.  Under these unique circumstances, I'll have to remain the leader until we know the results for sure.
translation: 平局。在这种罕见的情况下，我将继续作为领袖直到确认选举结果。

original: So, what are the results, Mister President?
translation: 总统先生，票选结果如何？

original: Under these unique circumstances, I'll have to remain the leader until we know the results for sure.
translation: 在这种罕见的情况下，我将继续作为领袖直到确认选举结果。

original: So, what are the results, Mister President?
translation: 总统先生，票选结果如何？

original: Your dad's the Overseer. Can't you talk to him about Butch?
translation: 你爸爸是监督者。你能不能跟他说说布奇的事？

original: Come on. Don't ask me that. You know he would if I asked, but where would that leave me?
translation: 拜托，别让我这么做。你知道如果我要求的话他会管，但是我就不好办了？

original: It's bad enough being the Overseer's daughter. If everyone knew I ran to daddy every time I had a problem, nobody would ever talk to me again.
translation: 当监督者的女儿已经够糟的了。如果大家都知道我一有事就去找爸爸，那就没人再会理我了。

original: We'll think of some way to get Butch back. I promise. But I'm not getting my father involved.
translation: 我们会想到办法回敬布奇的。我保证。但我不想让我父亲也卷进来。

original: I wouldn't give him what he wanted. He says he's going to make me sorry later.
translation: 我不会给他想要的东西。他说什么要让我后悔。

original: That jerk! I can't believe he'd try to ruin your birthday party!
translation: 那蠢货！我不敢相信他竟然想毁掉你的生日聚会！

original: Oh well. This is Butch we're talking about, right? I guess we should have expected it...
translation: 哦，好吧。我们谈的是布奇，对吧？我们早知道会这样的……

original: Uh oh, your dad is giving me a look. I guess I'd better give everyone else a chance to talk to you.
translation: 噢哦，你爸爸正盯着我呢。我想我最好让每个人都有和机会和你说话。

original: Don't worry about me. I'm not scared of him.
translation: 别担心我。我不怕他。

original: I know. He thinks he's so tough. One of these days we'll figure out a way to get him back, okay?
translation: 我知道。他以为自己很厉害。但总有一天我们会回敬他的，好吗？

original: I don't want to talk about it.
translation: 我不想再说这个了。

original: I know. Butch. What else is there to say, right?
translation: 我知道。布奇。没什么好说的，不是吗？

original: Hey, forget him. Have fun. It's your birthday party!
translation: 嗨，原谅他吧。高兴点，这可是你的生日聚会啊！

original: He, um... He made me give him my sweetroll.
translation: 他，呃……他逼我把我的甜面包卷给他。

original: God, what a jerk. I hate him! You'd think he'd be happy he actually got invited to your party.
translation: 天啊，这蠢货。我恨他！你却觉得他会乐于收到你的生日聚会邀请。

original: I'm sorry. Are you going to be okay? Let's try to just have fun and forget about Butch for a while.
translation: 对不起。你好点了吗？别想布奇了，让我们高兴点吧。

original: He wanted my sweetroll, but I told him off. <Lie.>
translation: 他要我的甜面包卷，但是我叫他滚。<撒谎>

original: Wow. You're so tough. You'll have to teach me how to do that, sometime.
translation: 哇。你真勇敢。找时间教教我。

original: He's not worth worrying about anyway. "Most likely to end up a trash burner," right?
translation: 别去管他。“迟早掉进焚化炉”，不是吗？

original: It was kind of my fault. You know how easy it is to make Butch mad...
translation: 这好像是我的错。你知道要把布奇搞得发狂有多容易……

original: You never learn, do you? You can't help shooting your mouth off even when you know it's going to get you a bloody nose.
translation: 你还是记不住，管好你的嘴，明知会被揍还这么多废话。

original: Uh oh, your dad is giving me a look. I'd better let everybody else have a turn with the birthday boy.
translation: 哦，你爸爸正盯着我呢。我想我最好让所有人都有和小寿星说话的机会。

original: You never learn, do you? You can't help shooting your mouth off even when you know it's going to get you a bloody nose.
translation: 你还是记不住，管好你的嘴，明知会被揍还这么多废话。

original: Uh oh, your dad is giving me a look. I'd better let everybody else have a turn with the birthday girl. We'll talk later, okay?
translation: 哦，你爸爸正盯着我呢。我想我最好让所有人都有和小寿星说话的机会。

original: The jerk tried to steal my sweetroll.
translation: 那个混蛋想偷我的甜面包卷。

original: God, he really is a butthead. Oh well. You can always count on Butch to make an ass of himself. Get it? Ha ha ha.
translation: 上帝，他真是个弱智。好了，布奇老是冒傻气。懂了吗？哈哈哈！

original: He's lucky Gomez stopped the fight before I really hurt him.
translation: 他很幸运，戈麦斯在我收拾他之前就不再打斗了。

original: Right. That's exactly what I was thinking.
translation: 好的。和我想的一模一样。

original: Jonas?
translation: 乔纳斯？

original: Hey doc. We're all set down here.
translation: 嗨，医生，我们都在这。

original: Have you heard the election results?
translation: 你听说选举结果了吗？

original: Dave won again? Well, he's the best choice.
translation: 戴夫又赢了？嗯，他的确是最佳选择。

original: He did?  Wow, I'd of never guessed that possible.
translation: 是吗？哇，我从没想过还有那种可能。

original: Did you hear Bob won the election?
translation: 你知道鲍勃当选了吗？

original: Yes, but it's still quite a shock.
translation: 是的，但还是让人震惊。

original: Did you hear Bob won the election?
translation: 你知道鲍勃当选了吗？

original: I won it? Are you sure?
translation: 我赢了？你确定？

original: Oh man, I can't believe it. I won't let the voters down, I promise!
translation: 天啊，我不敢相信……我不会让选民们失望的，我保证！

original: Looks like you won, Rosie!
translation: 看来是你赢了，萝丝！

original: I can't believe my ears.
translation: 我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

original: Looks like you won, Rosie!
translation: 看来是你赢了，萝丝！

original: I didn't win it, huh? Well, there'll always be other elections.
translation: 我没赢对吧，呃？嗯，还会有下一次选举的。

original: Sorry you didn't win it, Rosie.
translation: 很可惜你输了，萝丝。

original: There'll always be other elections.
translation: 总会有下一次的。

original: Sorry you didn't win it, Rosie.
translation: 很可惜你输了，萝丝。

original: Dave won it I'm sure.
translation: 戴夫肯定赢了。

original: Rosie won, huh? She better not try and boss me around, that's for damn sure.
translation: 萝丝赢了，呃？她最好不要想来命令我，决不！

original: Did you hear Rosie won the election?
translation: 你知道萝丝当选了吗？

original: I knew I'd win it.
translation: 我就知道我会赢。

original: Now I just got to name this place after me.
translation: 现在我要将这地方改成我的名字。

original: Looks like you'll be the new leader, Bob.
translation: 鲍勃，看来你是新的领导人了。

original: Who needs it. I'd prefer to be second in command anyway.
translation: 谁稀罕。我宁愿当副手。

original: Results are in.  Better luck next year.
translation: 结果出来了。祝你明年好运。

original: Hurray!
translation: 太好啦！

original: Did you hear that Dave won the election?
translation: 你知道戴夫当选了吗？

original: Why, did Dave get too old?
translation: 噢，是戴夫太老了吗？

original: Did you hear that Dave lost the election?
translation: 你知道吗？戴夫没能当选。

original: Did Dave win it again? I'd have voted for him if they'd let me.
translation: 戴夫又赢了吗？如果他们让我投票，我也会投他。

original: Did Dave win it again? I voted for him you know.
translation: 戴夫又赢了吗？你知道我又投给他了。

original: Rosie's going to be the new leader? What will Dave do?
translation: 萝丝是新领袖？那戴夫怎么办？

original: Have you heard that Rosie won the election?
translation: 你知道萝丝当选了吗？

original: He actually won?
translation: 他真的赢了？

original: Have you heard that Bob won the election?
translation: 你知道鲍勃当选了吗？

original: Mayor MacCready's the one who sent me to get you.
translation: 麦迪镇长派我来救你。

original: Really? I knew it! I knew he'd come to get us!
translation: 是吗？我就知道！我就知道他会来救我们！

original: Didn't think he'd send a mungo like you to do it, though.
translation: 只是从没想到他会找一个像你这样的毛人来。

original: Nope. Never heard of it.
translation: 不。从没听过。

original: Sure. Most mungos like you don't know where it is. We like it that way.
translation: 当然。大多数像你这样的毛人都不知道它在那。我们倒乐意这样。

original: But we gotta get out of here. If you can help us, I'll show you where it is. Maybe Mayor will even be nice to you. But only if you help us.
translation: 但是我们得离开这了。如果你肯帮我们，我就告诉你它在哪。或许镇长会喜欢你，但必须得在你帮助了我们之后。

original: Yeah, I've heard of it.
translation: 嗯，我听说过。

original: Well we need to get out of here and get back there. Right now. So you gotta help us, okay?
translation: 我们要离开这回去。就是现在。你会帮我们的，对吧？

original: Why would I help you? What's in it for me?
translation: 我为什么要帮你？这样对我有什么好处？

original: Look, we're not supposed to be in here. We live in Little Lamplight. Ever heard of it?
translation: 听着，我们本不应该在这。我们住在小灯镇。你听说过吗？

original: Don't worry, I've got a plan.
translation: 别担心，我有个计划。

original: You do? Great!
translation: 是吗？好极了！

original: Whatever you do, make sure you turn off these collars. You saw what happened to that other guy.
translation: 不管如何，确定你能处理这些奴隶项圈吗？你已经看到会有什么下场了。

original: Get lost, kid.
translation: 滚吧，孩子。

original: Thanks for nothing, ass.
translation: 谢谢你什么也没干，混蛋。

original: How can I get you out of here?
translation: 我怎么才能帮你离开这？

original: Can't you just shoot them all?
translation: 你不能把他们都打死吗？

original: I'm with you so far. Keep going.
translation: 我在听，说下去。

original: So I found this old terminal in the building here. Dusty, but it turns on with a little fixing. Like I said, I'm super smart.
translation: 我在这建筑内找到了台旧终端。很脏，但修一下还是能用的。就像我说的，我超级聪明。

original: I know they use a terminal to turn the collars on and off. So if you can link the terminals, I can turn the collars off and they won't even know.
translation: 我知道他们用终端来控制那些项圈。所以，如果你能破解那终端，我就能把这些项圈打开，而他们却完全不会发觉。

original: Then we just gotta open the fence, sneak past the mungos with guns, and get the hell out of here. Sounds good, right? You in?
translation: 接下来我们只需要把围栏打开，避开巡逻的毛人，然后逃跑就行了。听起来很棒，怎么样？

original: Skip to the point, short stuff.
translation: 说重点，别说废话。

original: Fine. But I'm telling you, it's good stuff. Really.
translation: 好，但是我告诉你，这是很有用的废话。真的。

original: We gotta turn the collars off, or else if we try to leave we'll get all chunkified. Don't want that. So we gotta use a terminal for it.
translation: 我们得关闭项圈，不然咱们都会变成炸弹人。谁也不想这样，所以我们得找个终端来处理。

original: I can use the terminal I fixed up in here, but I need it added to the network first. Main terminal is in the boss guy's room, so you gotta do that.
translation: 我可以用我修好的终端，但是我需要先联网。主终端在奴隶贩子老大的房间里，你得想想办法。

original: I just need to know what to do right now.
translation: 我只想知道现在该怎么做。

original: Man, you're cranky.
translation: 嘿，你别急。

original: Fine, here's what you do. You go on into the boss guy's room, and use his terminal. Get the one in here added to the network.
translation: 好吧，你要做的就是：潜入老大的房间，用他的终端，把这儿的终端加入到网络。

original: Think you can handle that, mungo?
translation: 你能办到吗？毛人。

original: Okay, tell me the whole plan. All of it.
translation: 好的，告诉我整个计划。一字不漏。

original: Okay, cool. You'll like it, really. It's going to work, I know it.
translation: 好的，没问题。你会喜欢的，真的。我知道这一定能行。

original: We're stuck behind this fence here. But even if we get past the fence, and the mungos with guns, we still can't leave.
translation: 我们被困在围栏里。就算我们出了围栏，还有那些拿枪的毛人，我们还是逃不掉。

original: They got these collars on us, right? Make us blow up if we try and get out. No way to get the collars off, so we gotta stop them from blowing up.
translation: 他们给我们戴上了项圈，我们一逃跑就会爆炸。没有任何办法能取下项圈，所以我们得想办法让它们不要爆炸。

original: That's the best you can come up with? Don't you have any other ideas?
translation: 这就是你最好的主意了？难道没有其他办法了么？

original: Well, I mean, Squirrel thinks maybe he could use the computer in here to turn off the collars.
translation: 嗯，我是说，“松鼠”觉得他能用这电脑关闭项圈。

original: Squirrel's good with computers, and they don't know he made this one work again. But it's, uh... It's not connected or something.
translation: “松鼠”是电脑高手，而且那些看守不知道他已经修好了这台。但是。呃……这台没有联网。

original: Hang on. I'll get Squirrel, and he can tell you what to do.
translation: 等等。我去找“松鼠”，他会告诉你怎么做。

original: No way. I can't take them all on.
translation: 不行。我不可能把他们全搞定。

original: No? You sure?
translation: 不行？你确定？

original: Well, okay. I guess maybe we could try Squirrel's plan. He says it'll work, but I don't know. It means using computers and stuff.
translation: 嗯，好吧，我想我们还是试试“松鼠”的计划。他说这样能行，但我不清楚。这意味着要靠电脑来做一切。

original: Hang on. Let me get him, and he can tell you the plan. I don't understand some of it, anyway.
translation: 等等。我去叫他，他会和你说他的计划，我并不很清楚。

original: I don't have any water to spare, but I'll be back when I find some.
translation: 我可没多余水能分给你，不过等我找到水会带回来的。

original: I know you're probably just yanking my chain, but it's not like I'm going anywhere. You know where to find me, ha ha ha.
translation: 我知道你多半是在逗我，反正我也走不了。你知道在哪能找到我，哈哈哈。

original: Then I guess you're done for, because I'm not giving you any.
translation: 那我看你是交待了，因为我不会给你一滴水。

original: Yeah, that's what I figured. Can you at least shoot me in the head before you leave? I'm out of ammo or I'd do it myself.
translation: 嗯，我就知道会这样。临走前至少给我脑袋来一枪行吗？子弹打光了，不然我就自己动手了。

original: Sure, I can spare some water. <Give 1 water.>
translation: 当然，我能匀出一些水。<给予1瓶水>

original: You just saved my life. I won't forget it.
translation: 你刚刚救了我一命。我不会忘记的。

original: Where's the terminal I need to use?
translation: 我要使用的终端在哪里？

original: I told you, it's in the boss guy's room. You gotta sneak in there or something. That's up to you to figure out, mungo.
translation: 告诉过你，它在奴隶贩子头的房间里。你要潜入进去或者用别的什么办法。看你的了，毛人。

original: I'm not that good with computers...
translation: 我对电脑可不在行……

original: Oh, come on. Aren't you mungos good for anything? I'm a kid, and I can do it. Why can't you?
translation: 哦，拜托。你们毛人不是什么都会吗？我只是个小孩，我都能做到，为什么你不行啊？

original: Listen, if you can't make that work, then there might be one other way to do it, even for a stupid mungo like you.
translation: 听着，如果你做不到的话。就算是像你这么蠢的毛人，也还是有其它办法的。

original: There's a junction box along the wall in the eating area. Switch a few cables there, and we're good. So there you go.
translation: 在餐厅有个接线盒。把里面的线都接上，我们就能操作了。看你的了。

original: Either you better be pretty good at fixing stuff, or you better learn how to use a terminal real fast.
translation: 你要么对修理东西很在行，要么就快点学会用终端。

original: You should go vote, if you haven't already.
translation: 你应该去投票，如果你还没投过的话。

original: Already did my part.
translation: 我已经投了。

original: You're right, I'll go right now.
translation: 没错，我现在就去。

original: I went and voted.
translation: 我已经投了。

original: I guess you're right, I'll go right now.
translation: 你想你说得对，我现在就去投票。

original: But I did already!
translation: 但我已经投了！

original: Oh no, Dave sent you to tell me that didn't he? I'll go right away I promise.
translation: 哦，不，是戴夫派你来找我的吗？我立刻就去，我保证。

original: I'm so sorry, I'll go right away I promise.
translation: 对不起，我立刻就去，我保证。

original: Who the hell made you the boss?
translation: 见鬼，谁让你来指指点点的？

original: Anyway, I did it already.
translation: 总之，我已经投了。

original: Fine, I'll get it out of the way.
translation: 好吧，我立刻去办。

original: Of course I voted. I was the first to vote. Now I'm just waiting for the rest of the votes to come in.
translation: 我当然已经投了。我是第一个投的，现在我在等其它选民的选票。

original: Did you already vote, Mister President?
translation: 总统先生，你已经投过票了？

original: It's none of my business. I'm just passing through.
translation: 不关我事，我只是路过。

original: Damn straight. And I'd advise you to just keep on walking.
translation: 够直接，我劝告你就继续路过吧。

original: Listen, for a share of the water I'll help you take out those jokers.
translation: 听着，为了报答你分给我水喝，我会帮你收拾掉那些小丑。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: I hope you shoot as quick as you talk. You got a deal. Take 'em out!
translation: 希望你枪用得像你吹得一样好。交给你了，解决他们！

original: I'm taking the water. All of it. And don't try to stop me.
translation: 这些水归我了。所有的都是。最好不要拦着我。

original: Oh yeah? We had a friendly dispute going here before you went and stuck your nose in. Come on, take him out!
translation: 哦，真的？在你多管闲事前我们还算友好。来人，把他带出去！

original: If that's the way you want it.
translation: 如果这是你想要的。

original: Why don't we all split it? There's really no point in getting killed for it.
translation: 为什么我们不把水分了？我们没必要去送死。

original: Yeah, you're probably right. Besides, just as likely you'd wait for us to finish each other off then take it all for yourself.
translation: 嗯，你或许是对的，就像你等我们自相残杀后再坐收渔翁之利。

original: It was all nice and simple until you showed up. No point in us killing each other so you can walk off with all the water... fine. We'll split it.
translation: 听你这么说，事情很好办，也很简单。我们犯不着互相残杀，然后让你把所有水都带走……好吧。我们把它分了。

original: It's never too late to learn. There's enough here to split three ways.
translation: 现在知道也不晚。这足够分成三份了。

original: I guess I'll take being robbed over being killed. But I don't have to like it. Take your water and get the hell out of here.
translation: 我想被抢劫也总比被干掉要好。虽然我并不喜欢这样，见鬼，拿着你的水滚吧。

original: No point in any more killing over this water. Let's split it and walk away.
translation: 我不想在水的问题上闹出更多人命，让我们分了这些水然后各走各路吧。

original: Back off! We found it first.
translation: 退后！是我们先找到的。

original: I don't see what that has to do with anything. We need this water, and we're taking it.
translation: 我没看出这有什么关系。我们需要这些水，我们要定了。

original: You're not going anywhere with our water.
translation: 拿着我们的水，你哪也去不了。

original: Lower your weapons, goddammit! I'm not looking for a fight. We just need this water!
translation: 放下你的枪，该死！我不是来打架的。我只是需要这些水。

original: You got the one on the left, Billy! If he takes one more step, let him have it.
translation: 你左边已经有一个了，比利！如果他多走一步，就干掉他。

original: We ain't afraid of you. If you want a fight, we'll give it to you. Now just take it easy!
translation: 我们可不怕你们。如果你们想动粗，无所谓，该怎样就怎样！

original: You're not taking our water!
translation: 我们不会把水给你！

original: Oh, okay. Maybe.. maybe we can get a drink after you're done working!
translation: 哦，好吧。或许……或许等你干完了活了，我们可以去喝一杯！

original: Okay... bye Winthrop! Let's get a drink later and... and hang out...
translation: 好吧……再见，温思罗普！我们去喝一杯然后……然后不醉不归……

original: See? I knew you'd come around.
