translation: 看到了吗？我知道你会来的。

original: Sure. I'll get it to you as soon as I can.
translation: 当然。我会尽快把它拿给你。

original: You got it.
translation: 我马上照办。

original: Don't mention it, my friend. It's what I'm here for.
translation: 别在意这些，我朋友。这就是我来的原因。

original: It's nothing, I simply want to ensure that all my friends in Underworld are as happy as can be.
translation: 没关系，我不过希望所有住在地下城的朋友幸福快乐罢了。

original: No thanks are wanted or asked for, it is my humble duty to ensure that you get what you need.
translation: 不需要任何感谢和回报，让您满意是我的义务。

original: If you say so, Carol.
translation: 如果你这么说也行，卡洛尔。

original: I want to believe you, Carol. I really do.
translation: 我很想相信你，卡洛尔。真的。

original: Oh, Greta, you worry too much. I'm fine, I'm fine. Just have a lot on my mind. It'll pass. Nothing to worry about.
translation: 哦，葛丽泰，你太过担心了。我很好，非常好。只是觉得有点烦。不过一切都会好的。没什么好担心的。

original: There's nothing to worry about, Greta. You're so sweet, always thinking about me. But I'm fine, I promise.
translation: 没什么好担心的，葛丽泰。你真可爱，总是为我着想。我很好，真的。

original: I was saying that you need to get some rest. You're falling asleep up here. You never sleep through a whole night anymore. I hear you getting up.
translation: 我的意思是你得好好休息。你在这都睡着了。你一晚上都没睡好，我听到你翻来覆去的声音。

original: <sighs> I was saying that you need to get some rest, Carol. You hardly ever sleep at night, don't think that I haven't noticed.
translation: <叹息>我的意思是你得休息，卡洛尔。你经常睡眠不足吧，别以为我不知道。

original: What now? Oh, I'm sorry Greta, I didn't see you there... did you need something?
translation: 怎么了？哦，对不起，葛丽泰，我没看到你在那……你需要点什么吗？

original: Hrm? Oh, hey Greta... what were you saying?
translation: 嗯？哦……你好，葛丽泰……你说什么了？

original: I don't know how many times I've told you about this. I don't want to have to do it again.
translation: 我不知道跟你说了多少次。我不想再这么干了。

original: I'm getting tired of having this conversation. Let's not go through it again. Got me?
translation: 我不知道跟你说了多少次。我不想再这么干了。

original: I'm glad we had this little talk.
translation: 很高兴我们刚刚有所交谈。

original: You'd best unfuck yourself, Charon. Or I'll just go ahead and "cancel" our contract.
translation: 你他妈的管好自己，卡戎。否则我会“取消”我们的合同。

original: Good. I'm glad we're clear on that.
translation: 好的。很高兴我们在这点上澄清了。

original: <growls> Whatever.
translation: <咆哮> 随便。

original: <grumbles> Yeah. Sure.
translation: <嘟囔> 恩。好。

original: ... got it.
translation: ……懂了。

original: Yeah, whatever.
translation: 好，随便。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: I want you to keep a closer eye on these bastards. I caught one of them trying to swipe some booze from the shelf when my back was turned.
translation: 我希望你盯紧那些杂种。我抓到过一个在我转身时想从架子上偷酒的家伙。

original: Look, despite all the grunting, I know you're not stupid. You need to start acting like you have half a brain and keep a closer watch on things.
translation: 听着，就算你这么嘟囔，我也知道你并不蠢。现在开始你得集中点精神盯着这些家伙。

original: I'm getting a bit tired of having to do my job and your job. Watch these drunks more carefully. I'm getting sick of my stock disappearing.
translation: 一个人做两个人的事都快把我累垮了。小心盯着这些酒鬼，我再也无法忍受店里丢东西了。

original: What do I have you here for? To watch the bar, right? So get your thumb out of your ass and start paying attention to what's going on around you.
translation: 我让你来这干嘛？看店，对吧？动起来，注意周围的状况。

original: Are you blind? Never mind, don't bother grunting a response. You need to watch these assholes better. Some stuff has turned up missing.
translation: 你瞎了还是怎么？算了，别想借口了。你盯紧这些混蛋，店里已经开始丢东西了。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: <grunts>
translation: <嘟囔>

original: Alright, I can't even talk to you about this right now. Let's just deal with it later.
translation: 好吧，我现在没法和你讲清楚。这事迟点再说。

original: Never mind, man. Let's just talk about this later.
translation: 没关系，伙计。这事我们迟点再说。

original: Oh... I get it! Ha! Like my name, right? Good 'ol... good ol' Patchwork, always leaving hit bits around town...
translation: 哦……我明白了！哈！就像我的名字，对吧？老好……老好人“拼盘”，总是在镇子附近丢点什么……

original: Hahaha! That's... that's funny! Did I ever tell you about how I got my name?
translation: 哈哈哈！这……这真有趣！我有告诉过你我这名字怎么来的吗？

original: C'mon, I'm worried that I'm going to find you dead one of these days. Listen to yourself. You can barely talk. You're a mess, man.
translation: 拜托，我这些天一直担心你的安危。别太勉强自己。你都说不动话了。哥们，你糟透了。

original: This is what I mean, Patches. You're a mess. I'm worried about you, man. I really am. You're falling apart.
translation: 这就是我的意思，“拼盘”。你糟透了。我担心你，哥们。真的，你会垮掉的。

original: Huh? Oh! Hey Winthrop! How're... how're you? I didn't see- see you there! What's up?
translation: 呃？哦！嗨，温思罗普！你……你好？我没看见你！近来如何？

original: What... what do you mean? I'm not... I'm not... I'm not even drunk right now!
translation: 你……你什么意思？我……我还……我还没醉呢！

original: I'm not really ready to talk about it.
translation: 我还没准备好谈这事。

original: It's... it's been hard. I... I need to go...
translation: 这……这很难。我……我要走了。

original: Thank you, I appreciate it. I can't talk about her. Not now.
translation: 谢谢，我很感激。我现在还不能说她的事。现在不行。

original: I.... I can't talk about it. Not yet.
translation: 我……我不能谈这事。还不行。

original: This place just isn't the same without her.
translation: 这地方没了她就完全不一样了。

original: I don't know, maybe it's for the best. Not that I didn't love her, but this life sucks.
translation: 我不明白，或许这样最好。不是我不爱她，但这就是命啊。

original: I miss her too.
translation: 我也很想她。

original: She'll be missed.
translation: 她会受到缅怀的。

original: I'm not really ready to talk about it.
translation: 我还没准备好谈这事。

original: It's... it's been hard. I... I need to go...
translation: 这……这很难。我……我要走了。

original: Thank you, I appreciate it. I can't talk about her. Not now.
translation: 谢谢，我很感激。我现在还不能说她的事。现在不行。

original: I.... I can't talk about it. Not yet.
translation: 我……我不能谈这事。还不行。

original: This place just isn't the same without her.
translation: 这地方没了她就完全不一样了。

original: I don't know, maybe it's for the best. Not that I didn't love her, but this life sucks.
translation: 我不明白，或许这样最好。不是我不爱她，但这就是命啊。

original: I miss her too.
translation: 我也很想她。

original: She'll be missed.
translation: 她会受到缅怀的。

original: Whoa, whoa there. Take your illness away from me.
translation: 哇，哇。别传染给我。

original: Take a step back, there. I don't want your slime on me. Tell you what, another drink should clear that cough up.
translation: 就站在那。我可不想你的鼻涕滴到我。告诉你吧，再来一杯应该会治好那咳嗽。

original: You should see someone about that cough. In the mean time, keep your distance.
translation: 你咳成这样应该去看医生。还有，离我远点。

original: Sounds like you need some of Akzurkhal's special cough medicine.
translation: 看来你需要阿祖卡的特效咳嗽药。

original: You might want to see Doc Barrows about that cough. But have another drink before you do.
translation: 你可能想让巴罗斯医生帮你看看这咳嗽。不过你还是先来一杯吧。

original: Shame the doc is dead, he could've done something about that cough. Ah well, just have another drink. It'll go away.
translation: 可惜医生已经死了，他可能对咳嗽有办法。嗯，继续喝吧，我先走了。

original: Poor doc Barrows, you people are falling apart without him, aren't you?
translation: 可怜的巴罗斯医生，没了他，你们这帮人就不行了，不是吗？

original: <sighs>You're a terrible conversationalist, Cerberus.
translation: <叹息> 你真是不会说话，地狱犬。

original: I really need to teach you a thing or two about talking to people.
translation: 我真的需要教教你怎么和人说话。

original: You really suck at conversation, robot.
translation: 你说的话真难听，机器人。

original: Unit functional. Patrol priority one.
translation: 单位定义。巡逻优先。

original: Command not parsed. Please restate command.
translation: 命令无法分析，请重新输入……

original: No news is good news, eh, Cerberus? What about you, how are you doing?
translation: 没消息就是好消息，呃，地狱犬？你怎么样最近？

original: Well, that's good. That's good to hear, Cerberus. Anything else going on?
translation: 嗯，好的。听起来很好，地狱犬。还发生了什么？

original: Alert status: null. Patrol uninterrupted.
translation: 警报状态：无。巡逻未中断。

original: Threat level alpha. Disturbance level zero.
translation: 警戒级别A。骚乱级别0。

original: Dammit. I thought I fixed that. No time now, resume your patrol Cerberus. I'll deal with it later.
translation: 真该死，我以为我修好了。现在没时间了，继续巡逻，地狱犬。我迟点再来处理。

original: Damn worthless... it never ends with you, does it? Just resume your patrol, I'll take you offline for service later.
translation: 该死，这没用……它从来就没好用过，不是吗？继续巡逻，迟点我让你离线服务器。

original: For Christ's sake, that's the fourth time this month. Just go back on patrol, I'm sure you'll be fine.
translation: 老天，这月第四次了。继续巡逻，我确信你一定会好的。

original: Unit weapon system 2B ammunition level low. Please service at earliest convenience.
translation: 单位武器系统2B弹药量低。请尽快补充。

original: Unit cognition system experiencing fluctuating contact. Unable to determine source of failure.
translation: 单位认知系统发现接触波动。无法确认错误来源。

original: Unit target recognition system contains failure of an unknown class. Advise immediate unit service for repair.
translation: 单位目标识别系统包含未知等级错误。建议单位立即维护送修。

original: Unit locomotion system contains a class two failure. Currently operable. Failure will escalate to class one with a 47% probability.
translation: 单位动力系统包含一个2级错误。正在执行，错误上升至1级的可能性：47%。

original: Well, give the report, you old bucket of bolts. I haven't got all day.
translation: 嗯，给我报告，你这堆废铁。我可没太多闲工夫。

original: Well? Do you think I asked just out of curiosity? Give me the report, dammit.
translation: 嗯？你认为我只是好奇才问的？该死，给我报告。

original: Unit diagnostics system compiling... diagnostics system ready. Running level 2 diagnostics... complete. Report prepared.
translation: 单位诊断系统编译中……诊断系统就绪。运行2级诊断……完毕。报告就绪。

original: Unit diagnostics... running... running... complete. Report prepared.
translation: 单位诊断……运行……运行……完毕。报告就绪。

original: Oh, awesome. Thank you, Greta. I'm starving.
translation: 哦，好极了。谢谢你，葛丽泰。我饿了。

original: Thank you, Greta.
translation: 谢谢你。葛丽泰。

original: I'll be here.
translation: 我会在这里。

original: I'll try not to starve before you get back.
translation: 在你回来前我努力让自己不饿。

original: Thanks, Greta.
translation: 谢谢你，葛丽泰。

original: I'm not sure, I'll go check.
translation: 不太肯定，我去看看。

original: Sit tight, I'll find out for you as soon as I can.
translation: 坐好，我立刻帮你找出来。

original: I'll go have a look.
translation: 我去看看。

original: I can go find out for you.
translation: 我去帮你找。

original: Yeah... sure. It's your stomach. I'll go find out.
translation: 是的……当然。这是你的胃，我去找。

original: You must be feeling brave. I'll go have a look.
translation: 你一定要勇敢。我去看看。

original: Wow. Well, okay. I'll go have a look.
translation: 哇。嗯，我去看看。

original: Got any more of that Squirrel-on-a-Stick?
translation: 还有棒棒松鼠吗？

original: I'll take some of those Squirrel Bits, if you have any more.
translation: 如果你有多的，我要一些松鼠丁。

original: You got any of Carol's special Squirrel Stew?
translation: 你有卡洛尔特制的炖松鼠吗？

original: You ever wonder where all those iguanas come from? I do. I guess it don't matter, 'cause they sure are tasty. You got any?
translation: 你从来没想过这些蜥蜴是哪来的吗？我怀疑过。我想这不重要，因为太好吃了。你有吗？

original: I could really go for some Iguana. You got any left?
translation: 我真的想要些蜥蜴。你还有吗？

original: Doc says I should eat more Mutfruit. You guys got any?
translation: 医生说我应该多吃点变异果。你这有吗？

original: You got any of those Mutfruits that Quinn brought back?
translation: 你有奎因带回来的变异果吗？

original: Sure could go for some squirrel, if you have any more.
translation: 当然如果你还有的话，就来些松鼠肉吧。

original: Hrm... I haven't had noodles for a long time, you still makin' those?
translation: 呃……我很久没吃面条了，你还做吗？

original: I could go for some noodles. You got any?
translation: 我想要点面条，你有吗？

original: Hungry again? What do you need?
translation: 又饿了？你需要什么？

original: Everyone's gotta eat, I suppose. What'll you have?
translation: 我想每个人都得吃。你要什么？

original: Just can't get enough, can you?
translation: 你就是吃不饱，对吧？

original: Get it while it's lukewarm.
translation: 趁热快吃。

original: Yeah, hon, what do you need?
translation: 嗯，亲爱的，你想要什么？

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: Yeah, sure, what do you need?
translation: 嗯，当然，你想要什么？

original: That's what I'm here for.
translation: 我就是为这来的。

original: Sure, kitchen's open. What do you want?
translation: 当然，餐厅正在营业，你想要什么？

original: No refunds if you don't keep it down this time. Now, what can I get you?
translation: 这次不小声点可不退款，你需要什么？

original: I'll just be here sobering up until you get back.
translation: 在你回来前，我在这儿清醒一下。

original: Relief can't come soon enough.
translation: 安慰总是来得太晚。

original: Thank you, Greta.
translation: 谢谢你。葛丽泰。

original: Thanks, Greta.
translation: 谢谢你，葛丽泰。

original: Sure, if you don't mind waiting a few minutes.
translation: 当然，如果你不介意等一会。

original: We just got some more in, I'll grab that for you in a minute.
translation: 我们找到了一些，我立刻就拿给你。

original: I think we can do that.
translation: 我想我们做得到。

original: Sure, no problem. I'll get it for you in a second.
translation: 当然，没问题。我立刻给你。

original: One more, comin' up.
translation: 再来杯，快点。

original: Sure, no problem.
translation: 当然，没问题。

original: You're really going for a record, aren't you?
translation: 你真的要创造记录，不是吗？

original: Sure, no problem... drunk...
translation: 当然，没问题……喝……

original: Alright, but if you pass out, I'm just going to roll you into the fire.
translation: 好吧，但是如果你晕倒了，我就把你丢火里烧了。

original: You should take it easy on this stuff. You know that you get all drippy when you're drunk.
translation: 你应该小心这东西。你要知道，喝多时你连站都站不稳。

original: Yeah, no problem.
translation: 嗯，没问题。

original: You got it.
translation: 我马上照办。

original: Give me a beer.
translation: 来一杯啤酒。

original: Beer.
translation: 啤酒。

original: I'll take a scotch.
translation: 我要一杯苏格兰威士忌。

original: Scotch, straight up. In fact, just give me the bottle.
translation: 苏格兰威士忌，不加冰。哦，直接整瓶给我就好。

original: If you've got any more of that scotch laying around, I'll take some of that.
translation: 如果你还有苏格兰威士忌的话，给我点。

original: Bring me some of that whisky, you know, the stuff that Quinn got from that guy up north.
translation: 给我那种威士忌，就是奎因从北边的那些家伙手里搞来的。

original: Bring me something brown and alcoholic.
translation: 来些色深性烈的。

original: Kentucky straight. You remember Kentucky? Nah, you're too young.
translation: 肯塔基纯波旁威士忌。你还记得肯塔基吗？不，你太年轻了。

original: How about some of that whiskey?
translation: 来些那种威士忌怎么样？

original: I'll take some of that vodka, if you have it.
translation: 如果你有的话，我要伏特加。

original: I really don't care, just make sure it has liquor in it.
translation: 我真的不在乎，只是有酒就行了。

original: Bring me something warm and painful.
translation: 给我来些温热痛苦的东西。

original: I don't care, really. Whatever takes the pain away.
translation: 我不在乎，真的。任何能止痛的东西都行。

original: Sure hon, what do you need?
translation: 当然了，亲爱的，你想要什么。

original: Yeah, no problem. What's your poison?
translation: 嗯，没问题。你想喝点什么？

original: Of course, what's up?
translation: 当然，怎么样？

original: No problem, drunky. What do you need?
translation: 没问题，酒鬼。你想要什么？

original: That's my job, what do you need?
translation: 这是我的工作，你想要什么？

original: No problem at all. What can I get for you?
translation: 没问题。我能为你做什么？

original: That's what I'm here for.
translation: 我就是为此而来。

original: Fine. I suppose I can choke down some of the squirrel stew.
translation: 好吧。我觉得我能咽下些炖松鼠。

original: Very well, bring me some of that disgusting iguana.
translation: 非常好，给我来个恶心的蜥蜴。

original: <sigh> Fine. I'll have the... squirrel. Cooked, please.
translation: <叹息>好吧。我就来……松鼠吧。请煮熟。

original: Well then. What'll it be, Crowley?
translation: 那么，接下来怎样，考利？

original: Looks like you're stuck eating our slop then. Now what do you want?
translation: 看来你只能吃我们的泔水了。现在你想要什么？

original: Well then, what are you complaining about? Oh, I forgot, you're a bitter bastard. Just tell me what you want to eat.
translation: 那个，你在抱怨什么？哦，我忘了，你是个该死的混蛋。就直说你想吃什么吧。

original: If I thought there was a chance that it would be better than this slop, I'd do that. But as it stands, this is my only option.
translation: 只要有比这泔水好点的，我都会选。不过如你所见，这是我唯一的选择。

original: Very funny, Greta. I'd happily prepare my own meals if I could ever get anything was wasn't moldy, rotten, or still squirming.
translation: 很有趣，葛丽泰。如果能搞到任何没有发霉、发臭或腐烂的东西，我很高兴自己做了吃。

original: Not this again. Look, I've been telling you every day for ten years, if you don't like it, go make your own damn food.
translation: 别再来了。听着，我天天说，都十年了，如果你不喜欢，就他妈自己做去。

original: If you don't like what we have, Crowley, you can always go hunt rats in the tunnels with the ferals.
translation: 如果你不喜欢我们的菜，考利，你可以自己去满是野兽的隧道里抓老鼠。

original: Yeah.
translation: 嗯。

original: It's done.
translation: 搞定了。

original: Did it. Done.
translation: 是的，完成了。

original: Already done.
translation: 已经完成。

original: Yep.
translation: 是的。

original: Good. You know how I hate to worry.
translation: 好。你知道我讨厌操心。

original: I'm glad to hear it. I knew I could trust you.
translation: 很高兴听你这么说。我知道你是个可以信赖的人。

original: Good, Charon. Good. I know you wouldn't lie to me. You aren't that stupid. Hahahaha!
translation: 好，卡戎。好，我知道你不会骗我。你没那么蠢。哈哈哈哈！

original: That's my boy.
translation: 这才是我的好孩子……

original: Good dog. Keep it up and maybe I'll give you a treat.
translation: 好狗狗。保持下去，说不定我会给你块肉尝尝。

original: Excellent. I'll have another task for you soon.
translation: 棒极了。我很快就会有第二个任务给你。

original: That little chore, the one we talked about yesterday. I trust that it won't be something I have to hear about again, right?
translation: 那件小事，昨天谈过的那事。我想我没必要再听一遍，对吧？

original: I gave you an assignment. I don't have to worry about it not being done, do I? You did do what I asked, yes?
translation: 我已经给了你任务。我不必担心它完不成了，对吧？你做了我交给你的事了，对吧？

original: I want to make sure that we're not going to have another disagreement. You did what I asked you to do, didn't you?
translation: 我只是想确定我们不会再出现分歧。你做了我交给你的事了，对吧？

original: I've got something on my mind, Charon. I had asked you to do something and you never reported back to me. You did it, didn't you?
translation: 我突然想起来了，卡戎。我让你做些事情，可你从来没向我报告。你搞定了，对吧？

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: What now?
translation: 现在呢？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: I'm worried about you, that's all. Just think about what I said.
translation: 我很担心你，就是这样。好好想想我说的话。

original: You know that I can't stop worrying about you. Just think about it, okay?
translation: 你知道我没办法不担心你。好好想想，好吗？

original: Oh, the customers are fine. So long as they've got you to being them food and drinks, they couldn't care less.
translation: 哦，顾客很好。只要你给他们带来食物和饮料，他们宁可视而不见。

original: They don't need to worry about me, Greta, and neither do you. I'll be okay.
translation: 他们不必担心我，葛丽泰，你也一样，我会没事的。

original: It's more than that, Carol, you've been moping around here for... I don't know how long. The customers have even started to notice.
translation: 比这更严重，卡洛尔，你一直闷闷不乐……我都不知道你这样有多久了，就连顾客都注意到了。

original: C'mon, Carol. It's me, I can see through you. It's gotten so bad that the customers have started to notice.
translation: 别这样，卡洛尔。是我，我太了解你了。你状况太糟，连顾客都注意到了。

original: What? Oh, I'm fine, Greta. I'm just fine, miles away, you know?
translation: 什么？哦，我很好，葛丽泰。我很好，只是走神了，你明白吗？

original: Oh, Greta, baby. You don't need to worry about me, I was just lost in my thoughts. You know how it is.
translation: 哦，葛丽泰，孩子，你用不着为我担心，我只是想得有些入神了，你知道的。

original: I'm not threatening you, I'm just sayin'. No equipment. No business. Either way, my problem is solved. Think about it. We'll talk later.
translation: 我不是想威胁你，我只是想说：没有装备，就没有生意。随便哪样，我的问题都能解决了。想想吧，我们以后再聊。

original: Oh, you'd be surprised. I may be old, but this place'd shut down without me. Just think about what I said, we'll talk later.
translation: 哦，估计会让你感觉惊讶。我可能已经老了，但这地方没了我恐怕就要关门了。想想我说的话，我们可以迟点再说。

original: Save your threats, old man. You don't have the balls.
translation: 省省吧，老头。你没这胆子。

original: Don't you threaten me. You wouldn't dare do that, these people would have your head.
translation: 你别想来威胁我，你不敢的，这些人立刻就能要了你的脑袋。

original: And wouldn't it be a shame if your ventilation went down and all of your customers went to Carol's? Just think about it, Ahzrukhal.
translation: 如果你的通风系统故障，导致顾客都跑到卡洛尔旅馆去的话，是不是很遗憾啊？考虑下吧，阿祖卡。

original: Sure, sure, you're here to make money, and I fix all of your crap so that you can keep right on making that money. What would happen if I stopped?
translation: 好吧，好吧，你是来赚钱的，而我得先修好你那堆废物，你才能继续赚钱。如果没有我，你会怎样？

original: He's a big boy, Winthrop. As long as he's got the caps, I'm going to sell him booze. I'm here to make money, not to babysit.
translation: 他是个大孩子，温思罗普，只要他有瓶盖，我就卖给他酒。我是来赚钱的，可不是来当保姆的。

original: Stop serving him? This is a bar. How am I supposed to make money if I'm not serving booze? If he's got money, I'll give him whatever he asks for.
translation: 不卖东西给他？这是酒吧。我不卖酒怎么赚钱？如果他有钱，他要什么我就卖他什么。

original: It's about Patchwork. You need to stop feeding him booze, Ahzrukhal. The boy can barely stand most of the time, and you just keep serving him.
translation: 是关于“拼盘”的。你别再继续卖酒给他了，阿祖卡，那孩子已经站立不稳，你却还不停地卖酒给他。

original: I want you to stop giving Patchwork booze when he's already drunk. You're gonna kill the boy.
translation: “拼盘”已经醉了，你别再卖酒给他了。你是想杀了这孩子吧。

original: I'm not your "boy", Winthrop. What do you want?
translation: 我又不是你的“伙计”，温思罗普。你想要干嘛？

original: Oh, look, if it isn't my favorite pain in the ass. What can I do for you, Winthrop?
translation: 哦，听着，我可不想找麻烦。我能为你做点什么，温思罗普？

original: Have you fixed that other fridge for me yet? Hrm? No? Than I've got no time for you, Winthrop. We'll talk later.
translation: 你帮我把另一个冰箱修好了吗？呃？没有？那我现在没空，温思罗普。我们迟点再说。

original: No time to talk right now, Winthrop. Come back later.
translation: 现在没空聊天，温思罗普。我们迟点再见。

original: I'm getting tired of this.
translation: 我对这些厌倦了。

original: Hey, if you got any better ideas, you go right ahead and get to work. Me? This is the best I got.
translation: 嗨，如果你有什么更好的主意，就设法实现。我？这已经是我能做到最好的了。

original: We got the terminal working, so I can turn off the collars, but we still gotta make it out of here. Past the guards.
translation: 我们已经让终端工作，现在我可以关闭项圈，但是我们还得逃出去。得通过那些守卫。

original: Unless you can get rid of the guard near the pen, we're going nowhere. So you gonna help, or you just gonna complain?
translation: 除非你能把围栏旁的守卫都解决了，否则我们哪也去不了。你要帮忙，还是一直抱怨？

original: "One step"? What the hell, kid.
translation: “一步”？小子，你去死吧。

original: Hey mungo, I never said the terminal was the only thing we'd need to do. It's important, but it won't get us out that front gate.
translation: 嗨，毛人，我从没说过终端就是我们唯一要做的事情。这确实很重要，但还不足以让我们逃到前门。

original: There's always at least one guard near the pen, and the terminal ain't gonna make the guard disappear. So you gotta do it.
translation: 围栏旁最少都有一个守卫，这终端可没法让守卫消失。所以得你去搞定。

original: Okay, great. What's next?
translation: 好，好极了。接下来怎么办？

original: Well, with the terminal, I can turn off the collars and open the gate. But they're not gonna just let us walk out of here, you know?
translation: 嗯，有了终端，我就能关闭项圈，并把门打开。但他们也不会就这么让我们随便走出去，你懂吗？

original: There's always at least one guard near the pen, and someone's gotta get rid of him.
translation: 围栏旁总是至少有一个守卫，得有人收拾他。

original: Since we can't just walk around like we own the place, you're gonna have to do it. You get me?
translation: 在这我们可不能像在家里一样随意走动，得靠你去解决，明白吗？

original: All done. The terminal should work for you now.
translation: 搞定！终端现在应该能工作了。

original: All right! You're okay for a mungo, you know that?
translation: 没错！你是个好毛人，知道吗？

original: So we're one step closer to getting out of here.
translation: 我们距逃离这里又近了一步。

original: Could I help with the election, Mister President?
translation: 总统阁下，我能为选举效劳吗？

original: Alright sure, why not. The people have a tendency to wait until the last minute to vote, but I'd just like to get it over with.
translation: 当然，为什么不呢。人们倾向于到了最后的时刻才投票，而我希望能尽快。

original: I'll spare a few caps if you just tell each of the adults to get over to the voting booth sometime today so I cinch the victory.
translation: 如果你让其它的成年选民来投票，让我顺利当选，我就给你报酬。

original: Not that I have anything to worry about. The people know who their leader is in this Republic.
translation: 不是说我在担心。大家都知道谁才是这个共和国的领袖。

original: I told you before: I'll spare a few caps if you just tell each of the adults to get over to the voting booth sometime today.
translation: 我已经跟你说过了：如果你让其它的成年选民来投票，我就给你报酬。

original: There's Jessica, Rosie, Bob, and Shawna. I already voted.
translation: 有杰西卡、萝丝、鲍勃，还有肖纳。我已经投过了。

original: Remind me how can I help the election, Mister President.
translation: 总统先生，我怎样才能为选举效劳？

original: Let's get class started.
translation: 开始上课。

original: So who can tell me how Dave saved the people from the wrath of Tom?
translation: 谁能告诉我戴夫是怎样从汤姆的魔爪下拯救人民的。

original: Somebody name three things Tom did wrong before Dave became the president.
translation: 谁能给出戴夫当总统之前，汤姆做的三件错事。

original: Anybody know what year Dave took back the government for the people?
translation: 谁知道戴夫是在哪一年为人民带来了民主共和制度？

original: I hope you're paying attention, Rachael. I'll give another pop quiz. I'll do it.
translation: 我希望你留神，拉克尔。我会再问你问题的。我会的。

original: Remember your homework is to prepare a speech on the "Merits of Dave."
translation: 记住你的作业就是准备一次“戴夫的伟大功绩”的演讲。

original: So, I'll just get started on the tour of the museum then.
translation: 我要开始博物馆介绍之旅了。

original: To my far right is the baby carriage that our great leader slept in as a newborn baby. Unlike most babies, he never cried and his poop didn't stink.
translation: 在我的最右边，是我们伟大领袖诞生后睡过的婴儿车。和一般的婴儿不同，他从未哭泣、也不曾尿床。

original: Dave had 8 siblings and made his own baseball team. The team was so good, in fact, the Wasteland team was so scared it never showed up to compete.
translation: 戴夫有八个家人，并组成了他的棒球队。这队伍很强，实际上，其它的废土队从来不曾跑来比赛过。

original: The briefcase is the very one Dave took with him when he became fed up with the poor ways that his father ran the nation.
translation: 这个手提箱就是戴夫厌倦了他父亲管理国家的拙劣技巧后一直带在身边的。

original: Dave brought back many items from the Wasteland. It was artifacts like these that amassed the Republic's great wealth.
translation: 戴夫从废土带回很多东西。共和国的巨额财富就是靠这些宝物积累起来的。

original: Dave collects many war collectibles, including holotapes and war weaponry.
translation: 戴夫收集了很多战争物品，包括全息磁带和武器。

original: This globe represents the whole planet that Dave traversed. Don't let its size fool you, the world is at least fifty times bigger than this.
translation: 这地球仪代表了戴夫所走过的路。不要被它的大小骗了，世界至少比这大50倍。

original: I don't know who put that tire there.
translation: 我不知道是谁把那只轮胎放在这的。

original: These weapons were used against the USA before the bombs fell. Dave probably acquired these when he walked to China.
translation: 这些武器是在核弹落下前用来对付美国的。可能是戴夫到中国去的时候找到的。

original: Dave is a world-renowned marksman, known for shooting an apple out of the hand of a Raider from across the Potomac.
translation: 戴夫是个举世闻名的神枪手，他能一枪射中波托马可河对岸歹徒手中的苹果。

original: Mounted to my left is the very head of the slain Deathclaw that Dave encountered during his quest through the Wastes.
translation: 左边挂着的，就是戴夫在废土完成任务时干掉的死亡爪的头。

original: I know what you're thinking, and no, that's not a Brahmin skull. Brahmin have two heads, so there'd have to be two skulls for it to be Brahmin.
translation: 我知道你在想什么，不对，那不是双头牛的头骨。双头牛有两个头，所以要有两个头骨才是双头牛。

original: Please, no touching.
translation: 请别摸展品。

original: And that's the tour! I hope you enjoyed it!
translation: 游览结束！希望你过得愉快！

original: Forget it. This is ridiculous.
translation: 忘了吧。这太荒唐了。

original: This is bull, man. You gotta help us out.
translation: 你得把我们救出去，哥们。

original: What the shit? Come on, you already did half the work. Just a little more and we're outta here. Don't screw us over now.
translation: 怎么回事？加油，你已经完成了一半。只要再努力下就能把我们救出去。现在可别把我们丢这不管。

original: How am I supposed to get rid of the guards?
translation: 我怎样才能甩掉那些守卫呢？

original: Man, can't you think of anything on your own?
translation: 嘿，你就不能自己想想办法吗？

original: Around midnight, there's only one guard. But it's that really mean guy, Forty. Still, probably your best chance to try something.
translation: 午夜时，那就只有一个守卫了。不过那是个难缠的家伙，弗替。不过这仍然是你动手的好机会。

original: Do what you gotta do, you know? Just get him away from his post.
translation: 做你该做的事，知道吗？只要把他从他的岗位引开就行了。

original: Okay, I'm on it.
translation: 好的，我去了。

original: Okay. Don't do anything stupid.
translation: 好的。别做蠢事。

original: Okay. Don't do anything stupid.
translation: 好的。别做蠢事。

original: All right, all right. I'll see what what I can do.
translation: 好的，好的。我看看我能做些什么。

original: Oh, very well. Now please... giant robot to fix? Hmm?
translation: 哦，很好。现在请……修理巨型机器人？嗯？

original: Rothchild, old friend, you're a brilliant technician. But this old man's patience is wearing thin. I want a full status report in three hours.
translation: 罗斯查德，老朋友，你是个优秀的机械师。但是这个老家伙要失去耐性了。三小时之内给我一份完整的状况报告。

original: I come to you for results, not excuses, Rothchild. That robot could mean the difference between victory or defeat against the Enclave.
translation: 我是来找你要结果的，不是听解释，罗斯查德。那机器人可能在对抗英克雷的战争中起到决定成败的作用。

original: We've been over this. A slight modification to one system... and all the subroutines go haywire. Don't worry. I'm on it.
translation: 我们已经讨论过了。对系统进行微小的修改……所有的子程序都会出错。别担心，我会解决。

original: Yesss... And I told you that in order to compensate for last Thursday's... mishap... there would be some complications. I'm dealing with it.
translation: 是啊……而且我早告诉过你，要补偿上周四的那次……小事故……可是会有些困难。不过我正着手解决。

original: About that. Are you still having that issue with the head laser? I think the term you used was "invariably destructive"...
translation: 关于那件事。你的头部激光器还有那个毛病吗？我记得你之前使用的词汇是：“持续的破坏”……

original: Precisely what I'd like to speak with you about. What's this I hear about power consumption actually increasing? We both know that's not an option.
translation: 我就是想和你说这个。我听说能量消耗在持续增加是怎么回事？我们都知道这是行不通的。

original: What is it, Owyn? This robot isn't going to fix itself.
translation: 怎么回事，欧文？这机器人可不会自行修复。

original: Hmm? Yes, yes. What is it? Robot to fix, and all that.
translation: 嗯？是的，是的，什么事？修理机器人什么的。

original: Yes, Elder. I understand. I'm sure... we've got the parts around here somewhere...
translation: 遵命，长老，我明白。我确定……我们能在这附近找到零件……

original: Yes, Elder. I understand. Forgive me for speaking out of turn. My... frustration got the better of me.
translation: 遵命，长老。我明白。请原谅我语无伦次。我刚才……烦得不行。

original: I understand, Peabody. But you'll need to make do the best you can. If our weapons can't penetrate that Enclave armor, we stand no chance.
translation: 我明白，博迪。但是你得尽全力。如果我们的武器无法打穿英克雷士兵的装甲，我们就完了。

original: Then make do with what you have. We may lack the Enclave's resources, but I'm counting on your ingenuity to make up for that!
translation: 那么你们有什么就用什么。我们或许缺少英克雷的资源，但是我正依靠你的智慧来弥补不足！

original: I know the protocols, sir. But the equipment that they stole was very valuable. Our weapons are beginning to deteriorate without the spare parts.
translation: 我知道规矩，长官。但是他们偷走的设备非常珍贵。我们的武器由于没有零件，状态开始恶化。

original: I... I understand, sir. But the Outcasts have stolen a great deal of our uncatalogued equipment. I am beginning to run short of supplies for repairs.
translation: 我……我明白，长官。但是放逐者偷走了很多我们未登记的设备。我已经开始缺少维修所需的补给了。

original: That name is not to be spoken within this Citadel. Do you understand? I wish it were not so, truly I do, but he is Outcast. He has been judged.
translation: 那名字不应该在五角大本营内提起。明白吗？我希望不是那个样子，我真的希望，但他是放逐者。他被判决了。

original: Scribe. You are not to speak the name of an Outcast in the walls of the Citadel. Is that understood?
translation: 文士。你不该在大本营内提起那放逐者的名字。明白吗？

original: Good morning, Elder. I'm sorry to report that things are not as they should be. Ever since Casdin was outcast...
translation: 长老，早上好。我很遗憾地向您报告，我们的情况不太好。自从卡斯丁成了放逐者……

original: Greetings, Elder. I wish I could say that things were well. Unfortunately, I am still having supply problems. When Casdin...
translation: 您好，长老。很遗憾，我真希望我们的情况会好些。可惜啊，我依然缺少补给。当卡斯丁……

original: Thank you, sir. I appreciate it.
translation: 谢谢，长官。我很感激。

original: Yes, sir. Actually, perhaps I can fashion one out of... hrm... if you'll excuse me, sir. I have to jot something down before I forget.
translation: 遵命，长官。其实我可以利用……呃……不好意思，长官。我得趁我没忘之前把它们记下来。

original: We have shortages all around, my friend. Make do the best you can. We may not have the Enclave's resources... but we do have you.
translation: 我们什么都很短缺，朋友。尽你最大的努力吧。我们或许没有英克雷的资源，但是我们有你。

original: You'll make do, Bowditch. You always do.
translation: 你能行的，鲍蒂奇。你一直很行。

original: There may be a slight delay in the enhancement of the ambulatory gyroscope. A few of the parts I need were lost in the recent... inventory reduction.
translation: 关于移动式陀螺仪的强化工作恐怕会略有延期。我需要的一些零件在近期的……补给消耗中丢失了。

original: I'm afraid that there may be a delay, sir. So far, I haven't been able to salvage a fellulator unit from the parts that we have on hand.
translation: 恐怕我们会延期，长官。目前为止，我无法利用我们手头上已有的零件重新组装计算单元。

original: Excellent. I'm a bit concerned, though. Last week, you mentioned a possible delay in the secondary modifications?
translation: 太好了。虽然我有点担心。上周你说过可能在第二阶段的修改上会延期？

original: I'm pleased to hear that. Do you anticipate any setbacks? Last month's progress was, well... let's call it "underwhelming."
translation: 我听到这消息很高兴。你预计会有阻碍吗？上个月的进度，呃，简直可以说是“惨不忍睹”。

original: Ah... you're a bit early today, sir. Regardless, I'm happy to report that the development of the Mark II Recon Armor unit is proceeding as planned.
translation: 啊……您今天来的稍微早了点，长官。不管怎样，我很高兴地向您汇报，侦察装甲II型的研发进度和计划的一样。

original: You're a bit late today, sir. I was afraid that you weren't coming. As per my report that I forwarded to you, the development is on schedule.
translation: 您今天来晚了，长官。我正担心您不来了。正如我在报告里写的，研发依据计划进行，一切正常。

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Hail to you.
translation: 向您致敬。

original: Carry on.
translation: 继续。

original: Good to see you.
translation: 很高兴见到你。

original: Keep moving.
translation: 继续前进。

original: Well, the rest of us have work to do.
translation: 我们其余的人还有工作要做。

original: If only we were all so lucky. I have work to do.
translation: 要是大伙都那么走运就好了。我还有工作要做。

original: Oh, please. I'm ready for anything, at all times. I'm just that awesome. You know that.
translation: 啊，拜托。我可以干任何事情，随时都行。我就是那么棒。你知道的。

original: You know me, Dusk. I was born ready for anything!
translation: 达斯科，你是了解我的。我一生下来就准备好了！

original: For someone who should be preparing for an assault, you seem to have a lot of time to be social.
translation: 对于一个应该时刻准备突袭的人来说，你还差远了。

original: A few people. But I don't get tired of hearing it.
translation: 有几个。但是我还没听够呢。

original: All the time, Glade. All the time.
translation: 一向如此，格莱德，一向如此。

original: You're really scary, Dusk. Has anyone ever told you that?
translation: 你真疯狂，达斯科。有人告诉过你吗？

original: You're a frightening woman, Dusk. Anyone ever tell you that?
translation: 你是个好斗的女人，达斯科。有人这么跟你说过吗？

original: I care. If I were aiming for his nose, that'd be fine. But I wasn't. I was going for the eye. Sloppy...
translation: 我在乎。如果我当时瞄准的是他的鼻子就好了。但我瞄的是眼睛。晕……

original: So, I wasn't aiming for his nose. That's what.
translation: 好吧，我当时没有瞄准他的鼻子。就是这么回事。

original: Are you kidding? A couple of inches? So you get the nose instead of the eye. Who cares?
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？几英寸？就是说瞄准的是鼻子，不是眼睛喽。又有谁会在乎？

original: A couple of inches? So you'd have taken out his nose instead of his eye? So what!
translation: 几英寸？你宁愿打下他的鼻子而不是眼睛？那又怎样！

original: Bullshit. That third shot dropped by a couple of inches.
translation: 胡说。第三枪打偏了几英寸。

original: Yeah, not really. I dropped the fourth shot a couple of inches.
translation: 嗯，不是的。我第四枪打偏了。

original: Yes, fath-... yes, Elder. I understand.
translation: 是的，父……遵命，长老。我明白。

original: Yes, father. I understand. You have my apologies.
translation: 是的，父亲。我明白。我向您道歉。

original: Oh, Sarah. My dear, sweet girl. So eager you are to rush headlong into battle. But no, not now. Not yet. Our time will come, fear not.
translation: 哦，萨拉，亲爱的女儿。你那么想立刻投入战斗。但是，不，现在还不行。我们会有机会的，别急。

original: You may be a Sentinel, but you're also my daughter. And I won't throw your life away fighting an enemy we know too little about. I'm sorry, but no.
translation: 你或许是一名哨兵，但是你也是我的女儿。而我不会让你用性命去和我们几乎不了解的敌人战斗。很抱歉，不行。

original: I've been talking with the other members of the Pride. We want to assault the purifier, father! Now! The Enclave must pay for what they've done!
translation: 我已经和“里昂斯的骄傲”的其他成员谈过了。父亲，我们想突袭净化器！立刻！英克雷必须为他们的所作所为付出代价！

original: Father... I know that you do not wish to discuss the fate of the Outcasts, but there are some who say...
translation: 父亲……我知道你不希望谈论放逐者的命运，但是有人说……

original: Certainly, Sarah. What's on your mind?
translation: 当然，萨拉。你有什么想法？

original: Yes, my daughter? What is it?
translation: 是的，我的女儿，怎么了？

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Hail to you.
translation: 向您致敬。

original: Carry on.
translation: 继续。

original: At ease, son.
translation: 稍息，孩子。

original: As you were, Knight.
translation: 稍息，骑士。

original: Knight.
translation: 骑士。

original: What do you think?
translation: 你认为怎么样？

original: Are you kidding? I'm a zombie who lives underground. I think you can guess how I am.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？我是一个住在地下的丧尸。我认为你能猜到我是什么样的人。

original: Fucking terrible, but I won't bother you with the details.
translation: 他妈的糟透了，但是我不会把细节告诉你的。

original: Look at this place. Look at me. How do you think I am?
translation: 看看这鬼地方，再看看我。你觉得我怎么样？

original: About as good as can be expected.
translation: 几乎和想的一样好。

original: I can't complain. Actually, I can, but I won't.
translation: 我无法抱怨。事实上我可以抱怨，但是我不想那么做。

original: I'm alright, I suppose.
translation: 我想我没事。

original: Meh. Been better.
translation: 嗯，已经好多了。

original: It's been quiet... too quiet.
translation: 很安静……太安静了。

original: It's been too quiet.
translation: 过于安静了。

original: I haven't heard a damn thing.
translation: 我没听到什么。

original: I never know what's going on.
translation: 我不知道发生了什么事。

original: It's been quiet lately. At least, it's been quiet around me.
translation: 最近很安静。至少我身边很安静。

original: Nobody tells me anything.
translation: 没人和我说过什么。

original: Nothing at all.
translation: 什么事也没有。

original: I haven't heard a damn thing.
translation: 我没听到什么。

original: I'm still a Ghoul. That's what's happening.
translation: 我仍是一个僵尸。就是这么回事。

original: I'm keeping it together. You know how it is.
translation: 我会保持集中精力的。你知道是怎么回事。

original: Other than that thing with the Radroaches the other day, nothing at all.
translation: 除了那天辐射蟑螂的事，就没什么了。

original: Nada.
translation: 没什么。

original: Nothing at all.
translation: 什么事也没有。

original: What's new with you?
translation: 最近怎么样？

original: S'up?
translation: 什么事？

original: What's happening?
translation: 发生什么事了？

original: Hey, what's up?
translation: 嘿，怎么了？

original: Hey, how's it going?
translation: 嗨，怎么样？

original: How're you?
translation: 你好吗？

original: Hey, have you heard any news?
translation: 嗨，你听到什么消息了吗？

original: Some people are talking, what have you heard?
translation: 人们一直在议论。你听到了什么？

original: I'm starting to get that funny feeling again, have you heard about anything that might be going on?
translation: 我又开始有那种奇怪的感觉了，你有听说这儿正发生什么事吗？

original: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

original: Hello.
translation: 你好。

original: Hello.
translation: 你好。

original: Hello.
translation: 你好。

original: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

original: Good morning.
translation: 早上好。

original: Good morning... I think. Is it morning? I can never tell.
translation: 早上好……是早上没错吧？我总分不清。

original: Mornin'.
translation: 早上好。

original: Evenin'. Not that you can really tell down here.
translation: 晚上好。在地下还真是很难发现已经是晚上了。

original: Nice night.
translation: 晚上好。

original: Oh, don't worry about me. You just go enjoy your drink.
translation: 哦，别担心我。你好好品尝美酒吧。

original: No need to worry about me, dear. You just go enjoy your food.
translation: 不必担心我。你好好品尝美食吧。

original: Oh, don't worry yourself over me. I'm just fine. Go talk to your friends.
translation: 哦，别为我担心。我很好，去和你的朋友聊吧。

original: I've been better, but I'm fine. No need to worry.
translation: 我好多了，不必担心。

original: Oh, I'm doing alright, I suppose.
translation: 哦，我想我很好。

original: I'm fine, I'm just fine. Thank you for your concern. I'm fine.
translation: 我很好，我真的很好。多谢关心。我很好。

original: Ehn. It's okay.
translation: 呃，没关系。

original: It's not bad. Not bad at all.
translation: 不错，非常不错。

original: It's great! This must be that stuff that Quinn brought back.
translation: 好极了！这肯定是奎因带回来的东西。

original: Each one is better than the last.
translation: 每一个都比上一个要好。

original: It's better than that watered-down piss they pour over at Carol's.
translation: 这比卡洛尔旅馆里兑的尿水好多了。

original: Liquids aren't usually the way I prefer to fly, but it's not bad.
translation: 我一般不靠喝酒来飘飘欲仙，不过这也不错。

original: That's a good drink, there's no denying it.
translation: 这酒不错，毋容置疑。

original: Yes, I am, Mr. Ahzrukhal.
translation: 是的，阿祖卡先生。

original: Sorry, I don't mean to pry. It just seems like you should be doing more than this.
translation: 对不起，我无意催促你。只是你似乎应该做得更多。

original: Well... I mean, yeah. I ain't exactly in charge here, but I'm Eulogy's right-hand man.
translation: 嗯……我是说，是的。我并不是这里的主管，但是我是尤勒基的得力助手。

original: Some other jackass should be pulling nighttime guard duty. Maybe I'll go have a little chat with Eulogy about that.
translation: 该让别的家伙来值夜岗。或许我应该和尤勒基谈谈这事。

original: It just seems like you do most of the work around here.
translation: 看来你在这做了大部分的工作。

original: Yeah, so maybe I get a raw deal sometimes. Everybody does out here. That's the way shit goes.
translation: 嗯，或许有时我受到一些不公平待遇。但是这的每个人都这样。在这就是这样。

original: But maybe it's time that changed. Maybe I go see Eulogy about that right now, in fact.
translation: 或许是时候要改变了。事实上我得立刻去找尤勒基谈谈。

original: I was just wondering, really. I figure you must make more than the others.
translation: 事实上我刚才一直在想。我想你肯定比别人赚得多。

original: Maybe... And maybe it's time to see Eulogy about a raise.
translation: 或许……是的，或许是时候找尤勒基谈谈加薪的问题了。

original: They must pay you really well to put up with this boring job.
translation: 他们肯定为你这份无聊的工作付给你很多钱。

original: Huh?
translation: 哈？

original: Yeah, I mean they pay well enough, I guess. What the hell do you care?
translation: 嗯，他们出的价很不错。你他妈的关心什么？

original: I think Eulogy is looking for you.
translation: 我想尤勒基正在找你。

original: You think so, do you?
translation: 你这么想，是吗？

original: Funny, 'cause I ain't heard nothing about it. So maybe you should just get lost.
translation: 有趣，因为我未曾听说此类传言。所以你或许该滚了。

original: Just stopping by to see how things are going. Tired? Need a break?
translation: 我只是来看看你，你累了吗？要歇一会吗？

original: Since when are we such good buddies? Huh?
translation: 从什么时候开始我们是这么好的朋友了，呃？

original: I'll tell you what I need. I need you to fuck off.
translation: 我告诉你我需要什么。那就是你快滚。

original: Man, I hate the graveyard shift.
translation: 哥们，我恨值墓地的班。

original: Penny, come on. You can't save Rory. It's time to save yourself.
translation: 佩尼，算了。你无法救到罗瑞，现在先救你自己吧。

original: I know... I just wanted him to be safe. They were gonna sell him and then he was gonna leave and I'd never see him again and... and...
translation: 我知道……我只想确保他平安。他们会把他卖掉，这样他就得离开。那我就再也见不到他了……而且……

original: Let's just go, okay? I don't want to think about it.
translation: 我们走吧，好吗？我不想再想这件事了。

original: Why are you still in here? It's time to go.
translation: 你怎么还在这？该走了。

original: No! I'm not leaving while they've still got Rory locked up!
translation: 不！只要罗瑞还被他们关着，我就不会走！

original: He's the only person here that's been nice to me. I'm not just going to leave him like that!
translation: 他是这唯一对我好的人。我不会离他而去！

original: Come on, let's go. We need to get you out of here now.
translation: 来吧，该走了。我们得把你救出来。

original: I already told Sammy AND Squirrel I'm not going. I'm not leaving Rory!
translation: 我已经告诉了萨米和“松鼠”我不走。我不会抛下罗瑞的！

original: What're you gonna do, shoot me?
translation: 你想怎样？拿枪打我？

original: Maybe I can talk to her. Can you tell me what's going on?
translation: 或许我可以和她谈谈。你能告诉我发生什么事了？

original: She went all soft on Rory Maclaren. He's this guy that got captured. Not bad for a Mungo, but Penny really likes him.
translation: 她对罗瑞·麦克拉伦很温柔。就是那被关起来的毛人。佩尼真的很喜欢他。

original: The guards threw him in the box last week for causing problems. He's still in there, and she won't leave until he's out.
translation: 上周因为惹了麻烦，他被守卫抓进了“盒子”。现在还被关在那。如果不把他救出来，她是不会走的。

original: I say he's just another mungo, and ain't our problem. But Penny's being all stupid, like I said.
translation: 我说他不过是个普通的毛人，不用我们担心。但是佩尼太傻了，就像我说的那样。

original: What the hell is her problem?
translation: 见鬼，她到底怎么了？

original: Beats me. I don't get girls at ALL.
translation: 问倒我了，我完全无法理解女孩的想法。

original: She's all sweet on Rory Maclaren or something. Says she won't leave while he's still in the box.
translation: 她彻底爱上罗瑞·麦克拉伦了。她说只要他还被关在“盒子”里，她就不会走。

original: What? Why won't she leave?
translation: 什么？她为什么不愿离开这？

original: This mungo, Rory Maclaren. She got all sweet on him or something. I dunno, it's some stupid girl thing.
translation: 为了这毛人，罗瑞·麦克拉伦。她彻底爱上他了。我也不知道，我不怎么了解女孩的想法。

original: But they threw him in the box 'cause he was giving them shit, and they won't let him out.
translation: 但是他们把他关进了“盒子”，原因是他一直很不配合。他们不会放他走的。

original: So Penny says she ain't going until she knows he's safe. I told her she's stupid.
translation: 所以佩尼说除非确定他安全了，否则她是不会离开的。我告诉过她这太蠢了。

original: I did my part. You're on your own now.
translation: 我做了我该做的。现在你要靠你自己了。

original: Thanks, I guess. Me and Sammy should be able to make it out of here now.
translation: 谢谢。我和萨米现在应该可以逃出去了。

original: There's a drain in the bathrooms we can fit through. It's too small for mungos, so they never boarded it up.
translation: 厕所里有个下水道，我们可以钻进去。对于毛人来说太窄了，所以他们没有封住它。

original: But Penny won't leave. I tried to get her to come with us, but she's being all stupid.
translation: 但是佩尼不愿离开。我试过让她和我们一起走，但是她就是不愿意，她太蠢了。

original: I took care of the guard. Is it safe to leave?
translation: 我刚已经把守卫搞定了。能安全离开了吗？

original: Yep, me and Sammy can get out no problem. We're good at sneaking. They'll never spot us.
translation: 没错，我和萨米可以出去，没问题。我们很擅长潜行，他们永远不会发现我们的。

original: We can just sneak through the drain in the bathrooms. It's just big enough for us. Way too small for you mungos.
translation: 我们可以从厕所的下水道溜出去。对于我们来说够宽了，但是对你们毛人来说太窄了。

original: But Penny won't leave. She's being all stupid, and even though we told her it's the only chance to go, she says she's staying.
translation: 可是佩尼不愿离开。她太蠢了，即使在我们告诉她这是唯一离开的机会之后，她还说她愿意留下来。

original: Okay, the guard's out of the way. Now get moving!
translation: 好的，我们搞定守卫了。快走！

original: Oh, don't worry. We're outta here. Me and Sammy can make it, no problem. The drain in the bathroom is small; we'll fit through, but mungos can't.
translation: 哦，别担心。我们立刻就离开这。我和萨米能行，没问题。厕所的下水道很窄，但我们可以通过，毛人就不行了。

original: But you gotta tell Penny it's time to go. She's being all dumb, and won't listen to us. You gotta talk to her.
translation: 但是你得告诉佩尼该离开这了。她很傻，不愿听我们的劝告。你得和她谈谈。

original: Fine, let's get Rory and get the hell out of here.
translation: 好吧，我去救罗瑞，然后离开这鬼地方。

original: I can't. If they see me out there, they'll throw me back in and then I'll never get out. You have to do it.
translation: 我不能这么干。如果被他们在外面看见我，就会把我关回去，之后我就再也出不去了。必须由你来做。

original: You gotta get the key to the box. That mungo, Forty... He's got one. I think the boss guy has the other one. Keeps it in his room.
translation: 你得把“盒子”的钥匙搞到手。那毛人，弗替……他有一把。我认为他们老大有另外一把，放在他的房间里。

original: If you can get Rory out, come and get me and then we can leave. I just won't leave him behind.
translation: 如果你能把罗瑞救出来，再来接我，我们就可以离开这了。我不想把他丢下。

original: Okay, what do you want me to do?
translation: 好吧，你想让我做什么？

original: You'll help? Oh, thank you!
translation: 你要帮我？哦，谢谢！

original: You have to get Rory out of the box. He's locked in there, and the guards have the key. I think Forty has one; I don't know where the other is.
translation: 你必须把罗瑞救出“盒子”。他被关在那，钥匙在守卫手里。我想弗替有一把，我不知道另外一把在哪。

original: Probably the boss guy has it, or it's in his room. You find the key, you can get Rory out, and then I'll leave.
translation: 或许他们老大有那把钥匙，可能在他的房间里。你找到那把钥匙，把罗瑞救出来，我就可以离开这了。

original: We don't have time for this. We need to leave. Now!
translation: 我们没时间了，赶快走吧，快！

original: Nuh-uh. Not without Rory.
translation: 不，没有罗瑞，我就不走。

original: You gotta get him out of the box. You just gotta! They've got keys for it somewhere. That mungo Forty has one.
translation: 你得把罗瑞救出“盒子”，你必须把他救出来！钥匙在某个地方。那毛人弗替有一把。

original: I don't know where the other one is. His boss probably has it somewhere. You get Rory out, and I'll leave. Not until then.
translation: 我不知道另一把钥匙在哪。可能他们老大把钥匙藏在什么地方了。你救出罗瑞，我就离开。否则免谈。

original: Why is this my problem?
translation: 为什么这成了我的问题？

original: Hey, you're the one that said you wanted to get us out of here.
translation: 嗨，你不是说过要帮我们离开这吗？

original: Go talk to her. See if you can get her to come with us. Me and Sammy are getting out of here right now.
translation: 去和她谈谈。看看你能不能劝她和我们一起离开。我和萨米现在就要离开这了。

original: We'll wait east of Paradise Falls. Meet us there once Penny's out.
translation: 我们会在堕落天堂的东面等你。一旦你把佩尼带出来，到那和我们碰面。

original: So what do I do?
translation: 那么我该怎么做？

original: Hell, I dunno. Go talk to her. Try and get her to get out while she can.
translation: 见鬼，我不知道。去和她谈谈。她能离开的时候，你就立刻带她走。

original: Me and Sammy are getting out of here now, though. If you can get her to come, meet us east of here after you're out.
translation: 现在我和萨米就要离开这了。如果你能把她带出来，到东面和我们碰面。

original: Oh, dear. Well, I guess the dangers around those old supplies keeps it from being smooth sailing. Otherwise, they'd already have been looted, huh?
translation: 哦，亲爱的。嗯，我想因为这些补给品还在这里就是因为周围充满了危险。要不然它们早就被洗劫一空了，呃？

original: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself. Here, take a bit, my treat - the taste kind of grates after a while.
translation: 嗯，你还是留着吧。我刚换了一大堆食物。拿着，我请客 - 过会味道会更好。

original: Oh, and take this! It's an old Food Sanitizer. Just carry it with you, and it should automatically make most food and drink more, um... better.
translation: 噢，拿着这个。这是一台旧食品净化器。带上它，能自动让大部分食物和饮料都更，呃……好。

original: It's very hard to talk my way past that many people shooting at me...
translation: 我都不愿跟你提起我以前被人拿着枪追杀的日子……

original: Oh, you poor dear, putting on a brave face like that. Well, don't worry, it'll all be better, and it's for a good cause.
translation: 哦，你这可怜的人，扮出一副勇敢的面孔。嗯，别担心，会好的，会好起来的。

original: Now, let me take a few notes, and I'll handle that nasty radiation with a bit of my own home-made rad-cure concoction.
translation: 现在，让我做记录，我会用自制的辐射治疗药来处理那些辐射。

original: I've never had a chance to test it out on someone so heavily dosed, but I'm sure it'll work out fine. Exciting, isn't it?
translation: 这是我第一次在某人身上测试出这么大剂量，但是我确定肯定没问题。令人兴奋，不是吗？

original: Oh, I feel fine! <cough> Never better! <cough> No problem at all! <wheeze>
translation: 感觉很好！<咳嗽> 棒极了！<咳嗽> 完全没有问题！<喘息>

original: That's a pretty good way of putting it. I think I'll use that in the book. Maybe I should credit you as a co-author, instead of just a researcher?
translation: 把这记下来非常有价值。我想把这些写进那本书里。在那本书里我或许该把你作为合著者，而不仅仅是一名研究员。

original: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them. Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine.
translation: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。拿着这些地雷吧。

original: And looking at this landmine, it gives me an idea. It's a terrible device that does terrible things, of course. But it's easy to make your own, too.
translation: 看看这地雷，它给了我一个灵感。当然，这可怕的装置会造成可怕的后果。但是这东西制作简单，连你也能做。

original: Fast hands and faster wits can get you an awful lot. Including landmines.
translation: 手快，脑子好也会让你倒霉。比如碰到地雷。

original: Oh dear. All of them? Well, I don't think I could water down the formula any further.
translation: 哦，天啊。全都？嗯，我觉得这方程式我再也算不下去了。

original: With that much testing, I guess it's beyond correction. Go ahead and keep it. Maybe you can find a nicer use for it, right?
translation: 测试了这么多次，我想应该可以。拿着它吧。或许你会更好地利用它，对吧？

original: Oh, but for your trouble, umm... Here, have the leftover chems from working on the repellent. I'm sure you can find some use for them.
translation: 哦，为了补偿你遇到的麻烦，唔……拿着这些造驱鼠剂剩下的药品吧，我确定你会找到用处的。

original: I don't believe this is as non-lethal as you had expected. To put it lightly.
translation: 简单地说，我不认为这会像你想的那样致命。

original: Well, they certainly aren't making tea and having nice chats, obviously. But maybe you're right - any social development is minor at best.
translation: 嗯，很明显，他们不是在喝茶聊天。但是或许你是对的 — 任何社交充其量也占小部分。

original: Some of these observations about their armor and camouflage gave me an idea for reinforced, neutral-colored headgear.
translation: 对他们盔甲和伪装的观察给了我一个更好的主意，天然颜色的帽子。

original: Here, consider it thanks for not interfering with them. Oh, speaking of which, take these. So you can continue to avoid them in the future.
translation: 给，感谢你没去打扰它们。说到这，拿着这些。你以后可以继续避开它们。

original: They seem mostly independent. I don't think there's any sort of "society" there.
translation: 看上去大部分人都是各管各的。我不认为那儿有所谓的“社会”存在。

original: You? At a loss for words? Oh, it's worse than I thought!
translation: 你？无言以对了？哦，比我想得还糟！

original: Luckily, I'm here to patch you up. Now, hold still and quit fidgeting.
translation: 幸运的是，我能治好你，现在，忍一会，别烦躁。

original: Despite my glossary of expletives, nothing properly sums up this pain.
translation: 尽管我有一肚子的脏话要骂，但没有一个词能概括我现在的痛苦。

original: I guess that's how people are, huh? Show a little initiative and success, and they'll support you enough for real success.
translation: 我想人们就是那样，呃？展示少许奋进与成功，他们就会支持你，直到你获得真正的成功。

original: Nice work - it must have taken a lot of investigation. Here: for the next time you've got to shine like that.
translation: 干得漂亮 — 你必定投入了很多。祝你下次再次取得这么大的成功，干杯。

original: Oh, and I'll let the Rivet City traders know they'll be favorably mentioned in the book. You'll get a discount buying gear from them in the future.
translation: 喔，我会让铆钉城的商人知道他们在书里会被描述为友善的。你以后交易时就会有折扣。

original: It had success as a science station, and people flock to success.
translation: 作为一个科学工作站,那里经营得很成功，于是人们都向往去那里。

original: Hey, robots are people, too! Well, some of them. Kinda.
translation: 嗨，机器人也是人！嗯，有些是。某程度上是。

original: Well, okay. Not really. Still, just in case you anger a few of our more metallic brethren, have a few pulse grenades I picked up, just in case.
translation: 嗯,好吧。不过吗，带上一些脉冲手榴弹，万一惹怒我们的钢铁兄弟，你也用得上。

original: Oh, and take my book on science - for some reason, I just can't get into the computer parts, but I've got the rest pretty much memorized.
translation: 哦，关于书的科技部分 — 由于某种原因，我没法使用这些电脑零件，不过我能利用剩下的记录。

original: Like a charm. I only wish it were always that easy to manipulate people.
translation: 还真是神奇。我只期望能一直这么容易地控制一个人。

original: Why would someone booby-trap a library? Unless... they're trying to keep all of the knowledge for themselves!
translation: 为什么会有人在图书馆里装设陷阱？除非……他们想把所有的知识据为己有！

original: Well, we won't let that sort of information be held hostage, will we? We'll educate the world with our book!
translation: 嗯，我们不会让那些信息被别人占有的，对吧？我们会用我们的书来教育全世界的人！

original: Oh, and here's a book of mine and some caps for your research. Think of it as pay for a civilization worth of overdue books.
translation: 对了，为了报答你的研究，这有本书和一些瓶盖。把它们当成是编写一本过期手册的民间赞助吧。

original: The place was a death trap. But I got in and out as quick as I could.
translation: 这地方是个死亡陷阱。但我还是用最快的速度进去并出来了。

original: Oh my, Raiders had set up camp there? I'm guessing you didn't just negotiate with them, did you?
translation: 哦，天啊，歹徒在那建了个营地？我想你没有和他们谈判，对吧？

original: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself. Here, take a bit, my treat -- the taste kind of grates after a while.
translation: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。给，拿着 — 过会味道会更好。

original: Those big, shadowy stores can be great for hiding out.
translation: 这些昏暗的大仓库用来藏身是再好不过了。

original: That's a terrible joke. I love it! Good to see you're still in such good spirits!
translation: 那真是个糟糕的玩笑。不过我喜欢！看到你依旧精神饱满我很高兴！

original: Now, let me take a few notes, and I'll handle that nasty radiation with a bit of my own home-made rad-cure concoction.
translation: 现在，让我做记录，我会用自制的辐射治疗药来处理那些辐射。

original: Okay, lie back and think healthy thoughts...
translation: 好吧，躺下并想象自己恢复健康……

original: I like to think of it as adding to my glowing personality.
translation: 我把它当做为我的人格增添一份闪耀。

original: Oh, of course. Can't let little things like flying shrapnel slow you down, now can you?
translation: 哦，当然。不能被一些类似飞行弹片的小东西减慢了速度，对吧？

original: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them. Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine.
translation: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。拿着这些小地雷吧。

original: I've got the grace of a cat. No landmine's going to stop me.
translation: 我可以像猫一样穿行自如。地雷是不能阻挡我的。

original: Oh, that isn't what I want at all. People already have all sorts of ways to kill them. We don't need a more lethal Mole Rat trap. Just a better one.
translation: 哦，那不是我想要的。人们已经知道了所有杀死它们的方法。我们不需要更致命的地鼠陷阱。我们只需要更好的。

original: I guess it's back to the drawing board for that repellent. I wonder if I can make it into some sort of fuel. Anyway, I'll just take that.
translation: 我想我必须要重新设计这些驱鼠剂。我想知道能否能把它做成一种燃料。总之，就这样吧。

original: Oh, but for your trouble, umm... Here, have the leftover chems from working on the repellent. I'm sure you can find some use for them.
translation: 哦，为了补偿你遇到的麻烦，唔……拿着这些造驱鼠剂剩下的药品吧，我确定你会找到用处的。

original: Well, at least it's non-lethal for people. For Mole Rats... not so much.
translation: 至少这对人来说不是致命的。对地鼠来说…就不然了。

original: Hrm. Well, I knew that. But I guess it does raise the question of whether or not they have a language. Maybe I should study that later.
translation: 嗯，我早就知道。但我认为他们到底有没有自己的语言还是个疑问。或许我应该迟点再去研究。

original: I wish we could have gotten more information, but this'll have to do for the book. Here's your pay. Maybe they'll help you be sneakier next time.
translation: 我希望我们得到更多的信息，但这对写书就够了。这是你的报酬，希望日后会助你潜行更隐秘。

original: They're savages with big claws and absolutely no interest in small talk.
translation: 他们是长着巨爪的野人，对谈话毫无兴趣。

original: Don't think too hard about it. No fair dying on me just because you want your last words to be especially memorable!
translation: 别把这想得那么严重。因为你想留名青史就在我面前死去，这不公平！

original: Well, rest easy and I'll see about fixing you up once I take a few notes.
translation: 嗯，放松，我做完记录就会把你治好。

original: Pardon me if I bleed profusely while thinking how best to describe this pain.
translation: 原谅我在尝试描述这种痛苦时鲜血直流。

original: That'd hardly be ethical, really. But if there's nothing more factual to go on...
translation: 这可不合情理。但如果没有更实际的方法了……

original: Oh well. Still, for your help, have a few of these. They may help out next time you need to talk to a few folks.
translation: 好吧，为了感谢你的帮助，拿着这些，它们在你下次与人交谈时会有点帮助的。

original: I suppose it wouldn't hurt to add a nice story to it. And it'd be a nice little reward for your hard work to include you as a hero.
translation: 我想加一个动听的故事进去不会有什么坏处。而且我会把你作为一个英雄编进去，作为你努力工作的报酬。

original: None of them agree on a story. So let's just say I set the whole place up.
translation: 他们莫衷一是。干脆就是说那个地方是我建造的吧。

original: Oh, I don't know about that. But I guess you do. And it's a good enough example for the book, I suppose.
translation: 哦，我说不好，但你肯定清楚。我认为这作为书中一个案例还是不错的。

original: It helps to have the right tool for the job. Failing that, go with the right tool to cheat at the job. Like a pulse grenade. Here, have a couple.
translation: 工欲善其事，必先利其器。失败的话，就得拿正确的工具去完成它，比如脉冲手榴弹。来，拿几个吧。

original: Make the right connection, and robots do what you want. Just like people.
translation: 只要连接正确，机器人就能做你想做的事，就像真人一样。

original: Well, maybe the Raiders will try reading a few of the books. Maybe it'll open their eyes to a few things.
translation: 嗯，或许歹徒会读书。或许他们的眼界会变得开阔。

original: Still, it's good to know it's standing. Maybe I'll inspire someone to take care of the place. Have some caps as payment for that little bit of hope.
translation: 不过，还是很高兴知道它还在。或许我该鼓励其他人去保护那。给你些瓶盖作为这一线希望的报酬。

original: Oh, it's still there, but it's full of Raiders. The place is a death trap.
translation: 哦，它还在那，不过周围都是歹徒。那是个死亡陷阱。

original: I'm taking a break from the research.
translation: 我得中断研究去休息。

original: Don't take to long. The sooner the book's done, the more people we can save with it!
translation: 别太久。这书尽快写完，我们就可以拯救更多的人！

original: Well, okay. If you feel you really need one.
translation: 嗯，好吧。如果你真的需要的话。

original: Feel free! Gotta have my super researcher in tip-top condition to work, right?
translation: 请随意！得让我的研究员的状态处于巅峰，对吧？

original: Well, I can't force you to work, I suppose.
translation: 嗯，我想我不能强迫你工作。

original: You know, you're right. I don't.
translation: 你知道，你是对的，我错了。

original: See, I knew it. I'm really just a boring old Ghoul, I promise.
translation: 看，我早就知道。我确实只是个无聊的老僵尸。

original: No, Carol. I'd love to hear your story.
translation: 不，卡洛尔。我愿意听你的故事。

original: Well, okay... but it's nothing special.
translation: 嗯，好吧……不过没什么特别。

original: I was born in 2051, so yes, that makes me a pre-war Ghoul.
translation: 我生于2051年，是的，我是战前僵尸。

original: How did you end up here?
translation: 你是怎么到这来的？

original: Oh, that's such a long story. You couldn't possibly want to hear about that.
translation: 哦，说来话长。你不会想听的。

original: How did you end up working for...
translation: 你是怎么到这工作的……

original: Not going to talk about it. Don't ask.
translation: 不想说。别问了。

original: Not your business.
translation: 与你无关。

original: Just show me the goods.
translation: 给我看看货。

original: As you wish, my friend...
translation: 如你所愿，朋友……

original: Why do you bother to hide what you sell?
translation: 你为什么把你要卖的货藏起来？

original: While there is no law in Underworld, per se, I'd rather not end up at the receiving end of an angry lynch mob.
translation: 虽然地下城没有法律，但我还是不希望最终面对一群愤怒的暴徒。

original: There is no shortage of do-gooders around here and it would be just like them to take it upon themselves to interfere in a fair business transaction.
translation: 这从不缺好事之徒，他们只会干扰一场公平的交易。

original: Honestly. I have something to sell, and you want to buy it, now why is that anyone else' business? Hrm?
translation: 坦白说。我有些东西要卖，而你想买。这些只是你我之间的问题，与他人无关，对吧？

original: Just show me the goods.
translation: 给我看看货。

original: As you wish, my friend...
translation: 如你所愿，朋友……

original: Why do you bother to hide what you sell?
translation: 你为什么把你要卖的货藏起来？

original: While there is no law in Underworld, per se, I'd rather not end up at the receiving end of an angry lynch mob.
translation: 虽然地下城没有法律，但我还是不希望最终面对一群愤怒的暴徒。

original: There is no shortage of do-gooders around here and it would be just like them to take it upon themselves to interfere in a fair business transaction.
translation: 这从不缺好事之徒，他们只会干扰一场公平的交易。

original: Honestly. I have something to sell, and you want to buy it, now why is that anyone else's business? Hrm?
translation: 坦白说。我有些东西要卖，而你想买。这些只是你我之间的问题，与他人无关，对吧？

original: Then I guess I'll take my caps someplace else...
translation: 那么我想我的瓶盖要花到其他地方……

original: Oh, now now now, don't be hasty. I'm sure that we can work out a compromise. Here, step this way and let me show you what I have.
translation: 哦，嗨，嗨，嗨，别急。我认为我们可以做成这笔生意。靠近些，我给你看看我的货。

original: Look at these people. They're Jetting. Trust me, I know.
translation: 看看这些人，他们在注射。相信我，我知道的。

original: Ah, an educated consumer. My favorite kind. Yes... yes. I think I can help you.
translation: 啊，一个有教养的顾客。我最喜欢这样的顾客。是的……是的，我可以为你效劳。

original: Simply step over here, my friend and I'll show you my stock of more... potent goods.
translation: 朋友，到这来，我给你看看我更好的货。

original: Let me see the real goods.
translation: 让我看看真正的好货。

original: Why, whatever do you mean? I am a simple barkeep, nothing more.
translation: 噢，你是什么意思？我只不过是个酒吧招待。

original: Certainly, my friend.
translation: 当然，我的朋友。

original: I must ask that you speak to no one about our transactions.
translation: 我必须要求你不要把这次交易告诉任何人。

original: Ah, back for more... excellent.
translation: 啊，你又回来了……很好。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Very well. You ask too many questions as it is.
translation: 非常好。你问的问题太多了。

original: What does he do for you?
translation: 他为你做什么？

original: Watches over the bar. Keeps the drunks in line. Pretty much, I point at something and Charon hurts it.
translation: 照理吧台，把喝醉的排成一排。不过就是这样，我指到哪，卡戎就打哪。

original: He's the best thug a corrupt bartender could ever ask for. He never bothers me with his own annoying sense of morality.
translation: 他是一个陈腐的酒保需要的最佳打手。他从来不用那些讨厌的道德准则烦我。

original: He's a loyal employee? What do you mean?
translation: 他是一个忠实的雇员？你什么意思？

original: I hold his contract, which makes me his employer. He will do what I ask when I ask, without question.
translation: 我拥有他的合约，这就是说我是他的老板。他会无条件的做任何我指派的事。

original: You see, Charon grew up around a very interesting group of individuals. They... well, I guess you could say that they brainwashed him.
translation: 你知道吗，卡戎是在一群非常有趣的人群中长大的。他们……嗯，我猜你会说是把他洗脑了。

original: He is absolutely loyal to whomever holds his contract. Unfailing, unflinching, until the day that employment ends.
translation: 他绝对会对任何拥有他合约的人忠诚。不会失败、不会退缩，直到合同解除的那天。

original: Don't get me wrong, I have no doubt that he holds no end of animosity towards me. But so long as he is my employee, he is as gentle as a teddy bear.
translation: 别误会我，毫无疑问，他对我有无限的憎恨。但是，只要我拥有他的合同，他就会像泰迪熊那样温顺。

original: He doesn't say much, does he?
translation: 他不怎么说话，对吗？

original: His company is rather refreshing, isn't it? But don't mistake his brevity for stupidity. That would be very unwise.
translation: 身边有他会非常令人愉快，不是吗？不过不要将他的寡言少语当作愚笨。那非常不明智。

original: Underestimating an opponent has been the last mistake of far too many individuals throughout history.
translation: 历史上太多人所犯的最后一个错误就是低估他们的对手。

original: So he's your slave?
translation: 他是你的奴隶？

original: No, he is not. Sir, you insult me. I do not believe in slavery. It is an abomination.
translation: 不，他不是。先生，你冒犯了我。我不信奉奴隶制。那是令人憎恨的东西。

original: I am a firm believer in personal choice. To force another person into bondage is unthinkable. Chains are earned, never forced.
translation: 我是一个信奉个人自主选择的人。强迫一个人做奴隶是无法想象的。忠诚待主是自愿的，不是强制的。

original: Charon made some choices that landed him in my employ. The matters of our contract is between him and I -- no one else.
translation: 卡戎做了一些决定才成为我的雇员。他的合同只存在我和他之间，与他人无关。

original: No he is not. Ma'am, you insult me. I do not believe in slavery. It is an abomination.
translation: 不，他不是。女士，你冒犯了我。我不信奉奴隶制。那是令人憎恨的东西。

original: I am a firm believer in personal choice. To force another person into bondage is unthinkable. Chains are earned, never forced.
translation: 我是一个信奉个人自主选择的人。强迫一个人做奴隶是无法想象的。忠诚待主是自愿的，不是强制的。

original: Charon made some choices that landed him in my employ. The matters of our contract is between him and I -- no one else.
translation: 卡戎做了一些决定才成为我的雇员。他的合同只存在我和他之间，与他人无关。

original: What can you tell me about yourself?
translation: 你能和我说说你自己吗？

original: Not much to say really. Dave was my husband for many, many years.
translation: 其实没什么可说的。戴夫做我的丈夫很多很多年了。

original: Not much to say really. I'm Dave's wife, or first wife I guess. I've lived here for many years now.
translation: 其实没什么可说的。我是戴夫的妻子，或许是第一个吧。我住在这很多年了。

original: Years ago, I freed these poor people from the wrath of Tom, former monarch of the Kingdom of Tom.
translation: 多年前，我把这些可怜的人们救出汤姆的魔爪，他是汤姆王国的君主。

original: Afterwards, the people naturally elected me as their president, and the Republic of Dave was formed.
translation: 从那以后，这些人很自然的选我做他们的总统，这样戴夫共和国就成立了。

original: I'd be interested in learning more about you, Mister President.
translation: 总统先生，我想知道更多关于你的事情。

original: All I have to say is Dave is my husband. Mine, do you understand? I don't care what Rosie has to say about it.
translation: 我能说的就是戴夫是我的丈夫。我的，你明白吗？我不管萝丝怎么说。

original: Just because Rosie used to be this big leader out in the Wasteland, she thinks she's better than me. She even ordered Dave around once!
translation: 就是因为萝丝曾经是废土的老大，她认为她比我强。甚至有一次她把戴夫呼来唤去的！

original: Could you tell me more about yourself, Jessica?
translation: 杰西卡，你能再详细介绍一下自己吗？

original: All you need to know is that I'm second-in-command next to Dave, so don't bother me.
translation: 你需要知道的就是我是除戴夫之外的第二把手，所以别惹我。

original: And don't talk to Rosie or Jessica either. Those are Dave's wives and they have work they need to do.
translation: 别和萝丝或杰西卡谈话。她们都是戴夫的妻子，而且她们还有工作在身。

original: So, um, Bob... I'd like to know more about you.
translation: 恩，鲍勃…我想知道更多关于你的事情。

original: Me? I just run the museum and teach classes to the little ones. You know, truth, justice, and the will of Dave...
translation: 我？我只是管理这博物馆和给小孩上课。课程是关于真相、公正以及戴夫的愿望……

original: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己吧。

original: I'm gonna be president when I grow up!
translation: 我长大后会做总统的！

original: So what have you been up to, kid?
translation: 小子，你是做什么的？

original: Dave's my daddy! He's the bestest daddy ever!
translation: 戴夫是我爸爸！他是全世界最好的爸爸！

original: So, what have you been up to, kid?
translation: 小子，你是做什么的？

original: I like to play with the toys in the museum, but Shawna always yells at me.
translation: 我喜欢在博物馆玩玩具，但肖纳总是大声骂我。

original: So, what have you been up to, kid?
translation: 小子，你是做什么的？

original: President Daddy says I sleep too much, but I don't sleep much at all!
translation: 总统爸爸说我睡得太多了，但我睡得一点都不多！

original: So, what have you been up to, kid?
translation: 小子，你是做什么的？

original: Leave me alone, Flower. I'm thinking.
translation: 福劳尔，别烦我。我在想事情呢。

original: Can't you see I'm doing important things?
translation: 你看不出我在做很重要的事情吗？

original: For crying out loud, Flower, I'm busy.
translation: 福劳尔，别烦我。我很忙。

original: Fine, in a little bit. Geez.
translation: 好的，就一点。天啊。

original: Can't right now. Why don't you ask Mary?
translation: 现在我没空，为什么你不问问玛丽？

original: I bet Ralph isn't doing anything, why don't you ask him?
translation: 我敢说拉尔夫现在没事，为什么你不去问问他呢？

original: Sorry, kiddo, I'm too busy right now.
translation: 对不起，孩子。我现在太忙了。

original: Why don't you ask Rachael if she can play?
translation: 为什么你不问问拉克尔能否和你玩呢？

original: If you don't leave, Penny won't leave. She'll be killed. Is that what you want?
translation: 如果你不走，佩尼就不走。她会被杀死的，你想这样吗？

original: No... No, I want Penny to be safe. She shouldn't be having second thoughts just because of me.
translation: 不……不。我希望佩尼安全。她不该因为我而不愿离开。

original: Just make sure you take care of her. I wouldn't want anything bad to happen to her, or her friends.
translation: 请确保你一定要照顾好她。我不希望她或她的朋友遭遇不测。

original: So what do we do now?
translation: 那么我们现在怎么办？

original: I need you out of here now, so I can get Penny out.
translation: 我要你现在就离开这，这样我才能让佩尼也离开这。

original: Okay, fine. If it'll help Penny, I'll do it. What do you want me to do?
translation: 好吧。如果能帮到佩尼，我愿意听你的。你要我怎么做？

original: I came for the kids. Penny wanted you free, so here we are.
translation: 我是来救孩子们的。佩尼希望你获得自由，所以我们就来这了。

original: Penny? She wanted you to set me free?
translation: 佩尼？她让你来救我？

original: I owe that little girl a lot. I'll have to try and make it up to her someday.
translation: 我欠那小女孩太多太多。我会努力，将来好好补偿她。

original: Okay, what do we do?
translation: 好的，我们怎么做？

original: You're on your own, pal. I've got more important things to do.
translation: 你得靠你自己了，伙计。我有其他更重要的事。

original: That's it, huh? Just toss me out of the box and into the meat grinder?
translation: 就这样，呃？刚把我从“盒子”里救出来，又把我扔进绞肉机？

original: Thanks for nothing, asshole.
translation: 谢谢你什么也没干，混蛋。

original: We'll have to run for it.
translation: 我们必须奔跑逃走。

original: Okay, if you say so. I'll be right behind you. If you can get me to the front gate, I can take it from there.
translation: 好吧，既然你这样说。我会跟在你后面。如果你能把我带到前门，在那我就能自己走了。

original: We need to be careful. Stay low and stay quiet.
translation: 我们得小心点。悄悄地低身行走。

original: You got it. I'll stay right with you. Get me to the front gate, and I can make a run for it from there.
translation: 好吧。我会紧跟着你。把我带到前门，我就可以自己走了。

original: You want to get out of here, or you want to waste time asking questions?
translation: 你是想离开这还是想浪费时间问问题？

original: Fine, fine. Let's go. What's the plan?
translation: 好吧，好吧，我们走。你有什么计划？

original: There's no time for explanations. We've got to move!
translation: 没时间解释了，我们得走了！

original: Look, I'm not going anywhere until you tell me what's going on. For all I know, you're just trying to trick me into another beating.
translation: 嗨，你不告诉我目前的情况我是不会走的。我所知道的，你只是在骗我跳进另一个火坑。

original: Penny asked me to get you out of here.
translation: 佩尼让我救你出去。

original: She did? Is she safe? Can I see her?
translation: 是吗？她现在安全吗？我可以见到她吗？

original: I'm the guy who's going to kill you if you don't get moving.
translation: 你要是不走的话，我就杀了你！

original: What? What's going on? Who are you?
translation: 怎么回事？你是谁？

original: What? What's going on? Who are you?
translation: 怎么回事？你是谁？

original: I'm the girl who's going to kill you if you don't get moving.
translation: 你要是不走的话，我就杀了你！

original: No time to talk. We've got to move, right now.
translation: 没时间说话了。我们得快走，就是现在。

original: Where are we going? What's going on? Who the hell ARE you?
translation: 我们去哪？发生什么事了？见鬼，你到底是谁？

original: I'm here to set you free.
translation: 我是来救你的。

original: What? Are you kidding me? This is another one of Forty's tricks, isn't it. Well I'm not falling for it.
translation: 什么？你在开玩笑么？这是弗替的又一个诡计，对吧。我是不会上当的。

original: Spy on what?  Your trailer-home?
translation: 间谍来调查什么？你的拖车屋？

original: If the Capitol Building does not meet your incredible standards, feel free to escort yourself out.  In fact, just leave now.
translation: 如果国会大厦不符合你那超高的标准，那你就把自己送出去吧。实际上，你快走吧。

original: Never mind.
translation: 算了吧。

original: Okay. Let's get the hell out of here.
translation: 好吧，我们离开这鬼地方。

original: Let's go.
translation: 我们走。

original: Right behind you.
translation: 就在你身后。

original: Wait here.
translation: 在这等着。

original: Man, I hope you know what you're doing.
translation: 哥们，我希望你知道你在干嘛。

original: That'll save a lot of time and effort. Oh, and blood, on your part. A real-world example might help more, but I won't turn down the help!
translation: 那会节省我们很多时间和精力。哦，你身上有血。现实世界可能会帮你成长，而我不会拒绝向你提供帮助的！

original: Oh, and here's your pay for it all. Guess you earned it by working smarter, not... um... more self-destructively.
translation: 哦，这是你的酬劳。我想你完成这项任务是靠你的智慧，而不是……呃，自我毁灭。

original: Why get myself hurt? I'm a good enough doctor to explain this part for you.
translation: 为什么要弄伤自己？我是个好医生，能给你解释一下这部分。

original: Oh, but nothing beats a real-world example. And I have a new rad treatment I was just itching to try out on a live subject!
translation: 哦，我想没有什么比现实世界更有说服力了。我有一种新的治疗辐射的方案，我一直想在活体上实验它！

original: But I guess you're right, and at least it keeps you safe and sound for later testing. Here's some spare chems for your help.
translation: 但是我认为你是对的，至少这样可以让你完好无损地进行接下来的实验。为了感谢你的帮助，这些药品给你吧。

original: Fear not! With my vast scientific knowledge, I explain this one myself.
translation: 不用担心！我科学知识丰富，我能解释这个。

original: There will come soft rains and the smell of the ground, and swallows circling with their shimmering sound
translation: 小雨如酥，沁润泥土，燕飞盘桓，声声呢喃

original: And frogs in the pool singing at night, And wild plum trees in tremulous white
translation: 夜半池塘，蛙声彻响，野李随风，郁郁葱葱

original: Robins will wear their feathery fire, Whistling their whims on a low fence-wire; And not one will know of the war, not one
translation: 知更一行，赤羽歌唱。征伐之事，吾人不知

original: Will care at last when it is done. Not one would mind, neither bird nor tree, If mankind perished utterly;
translation: 孰人得鹿，我耳不入。倦鸟归树，遍野白骨；

original: And Spring herself when she woke at dawn would scarcely know that we were gone.
translation: 仲春即临，鬼火冥冥。呜呼苍天，再无人烟。

original: Souffle Recipe Error: No Eggs Found.
translation: 烹饪蛋白牛奶酥失败：未找到鸡蛋。

original: "A slice of melon may be divine, but lest you spoil the meal, mind the rind"
translation: “一小片甜瓜味道不错，但小心瓜皮，会破坏肉香”

original: This home protected by General Atomics International.
translation: 此房由国际通用原子保护。

original: Stand clear, vagabonds, rapscallions and Ne'erdowells.
translation: 流浪汉、恶棍和饭桶站开。

original: <whistle> Here Doggy, Doggy.
translation: <口哨>过来，小狗。

original: Time for your walk, family pet.
translation: 该去散步了，宠物。

original: See, and you said you weren't interesting.
translation: 看，你刚还说我不会感兴趣。

original: You tell the same stories for 200 years, you'll feel pretty uninteresting too.
translation: 如果200年来你一直在讲述同一个故事，你也会感到非常无趣的。

original: So, how did you end up as a Ghoul?
translation: 你是怎么成为一个尸鬼的？

original: I don't know how it happens. Doctor Barrows says it was radiation. All I know is that people kept showing up here in the museum.
translation: 我不知道怎么会这样。巴罗斯医生说是因为辐射。我所知道的就是人们陆续来到博物馆。

original: After things calmed down above ground, we tried to live down here as best we could. After a while, things got strange.
translation: 地上的事平息后，我们试着在地下生活，以为这会好些。之后没多久，就发生了意想不到的事。

original: My skin started to get dry and flake off. Everyone's did. It took a while, months, maybe a year. But sooner or later, everyone ended up like this.
translation: 我的皮肤开始变干并脱落。每个人都这样。持续了一段时间，几个月，或许是一年。但或早或晚，所有的人都变成了这样。

original: Some of them went crazy. Some of us just accepted it. After a while, other Ghouls would find their way in here and Underworld just sort of grew.
translation: 有些人因此疯了。有些人则接受了现实。之后没多久，其他的僵尸找到了这，地下世界就这样壮大起来。

original: No one bothered us down here, and we were happy enough to leave them alone. And once my Greta showed up, it was a good enough life for me.
translation: 在地下没人打扰我们，而我们也很乐于独处。我的葛丽泰到来之后，便是我生命中最好的时光。

original: What was the Wasteland like after the war?
translation: 战后废土是怎样的？

original: The city was on fire for weeks... maybe months, I don't know. I hid down here in the museum... it was the closest building to the shelter I was in.
translation: 这座城市整整燃烧了几星期……或许是几个月，我不知道。我躲在博物馆里……这是最靠近我住的躲避处的建筑物。

original: But I could hear what was happening above. People howling like animals. Chaos. Looting, killing, it's like every foul thing inside of them came out.
translation: 但我能听到地上发生的事。人们像动物那样的嚎叫。到处是混乱、掠夺和杀戮，人心中最肮脏的一面都表露无遗。

original: It was a nightmare... I... I don't want to talk about it.
translation: 那是场噩梦……我……我不想谈起。

original: Do you remember the day the war started?
translation: 你还记得战争开始的那天是怎样的吗？

original: I do... I was in a shelter with my father when the bombs hit. In DC, we had the luxury of getting a warning after the west coast was... gone...
translation: 是的……我记得当核弹落下时我正和父亲藏在躲避处。我们在华盛顿特区，当美国西海岸……消失后……我们幸运地得到了警报。

original: I was just a little girl then. We couldn't afford a space in one of the Vaults. I remember filing down into that shelter, my father rushing me in.
translation: 那时我还只是个小女孩。我们承担不起在居住到避难所的花费。我记得我父亲把我推进那躲避处。

original: He stopped to help this one family, and I looked up and called his name... there was a flash of light, brighter than anything you can imagine.
translation: 他再也无法帮助唯一的家人了，我向上望并呼喊着他的名字……一道亮光闪过，比你能想象的一切都亮。

original: I woke up a few hours later. The first thing I did was run up to where my father had been. He... he was gone. But the strangest thing...
translation: 几小时后，我醒过来。我第一时间跑到我父亲之前站的地方。他……他不见了。但最意想不到的是……

original: There was his shadow, burned into the wall, so crisp and clear like he was standing next to me. The heat had burned it into the concrete...
translation: 那有他的影子，在墙上烧出的印记，那么诡异却又那么清晰，好像他就站在我身边。那热量把它烧进了墙里……

original: There's no way you could have gone there and gotten back already.
translation: 你不可能在这么短的时间内往返一次。

original: It's got to take at least a day to get there and back. Now get going!
translation: 从那往返至少要一天时间。现在就去！

original: I went into Minefield and came back, no problem. <Lie.>
translation: 我踏进了雷区，然后活着回来了。<撒谎>

original: I appreciate the landmine, but there's just no way you could have gotten to Minefield and back already!
translation: 我很感激你送给我的地雷。但在这么短的时间内，要从雷区拿到地雷再返回，这不可能办到！

original: I mean, it's got to take at least a day or so to get there and back! So get going!
translation: 我的意思是，从那往返至少要一天时间。现在就去！

original: I got through Minefield alive, and I even brought you a present. <Lie.>
translation: 我活着穿过了雷区，还给你带回来个礼物。<撒谎>

original: Oh, great! And you look like it went fine! So, how was it?
translation: 哦，好极了！看上去很顺利！办得怎么样？

original: I got through Minefield alive, and I even brought you a present. <Lie.>
translation: 我活着穿过了雷区，还给你带回来个礼物。<撒谎>

original: My very own landmine! Just what I've always wanted. Well, always since I sent you out on this, anyway.
translation: 我的地雷！就是我一直想得到的。嗯，至少是我派你去拿之后我一直想得到的。

original: Now, tell me all about it. What was it like going through there? What's it like disarming a landmine?
translation: 现在，和我谈谈。经历怎么样？解除地雷的感觉是什么样的？

original: I got through Minefield alive, and I even brought you a present. <Lie.>
translation: 我活着穿过了雷区，还给你带回来个礼物。<撒谎>

original: Do you think I suddenly lost track of time or something? There's no way you've gone there and back in the blink of an eye like that!
translation: 你认为我会搞错时间还是怎么？眨眼间你就已到过那并返回，这不可能！

original: I checked out the Super-Duper Mart, but nothing's there. <Lie.>
