translation: 我检查过顶好超市了，那儿什么都没有。<撒谎>

original: Really? Oh, that's a shame. I guess it was an obvious place for people to get food, so it all got taken long ago, huh?
translation: 是吗？哦，太可惜了。我认为那显然是人们可以找到食物的地方，那么食物早就被拿光了，呃？

original: Still, good work checking it out! And have some food as thanks for the work. It's a shame you didn't find any, there.
translation: 你依然干得不错！吃点东西，当作酬劳。太可惜了，你在那什么也没找到。

original: I checked out the Super-Duper Mart, but nothing's there. <Lie.>
translation: 我检查过顶好超市了，那儿什么都没有。<撒谎>

original: Oh, come on. You barely even left! I can't imagine you tested it on reasonable number of subjects so quickly. It can't have been a good sample size.
translation: 哦，拜托。你几乎就没离开过！我无法想象你能这么快地做了一系列实验。这试验结果没意义。

original: I tested it out, and it works just fine. <Lie.>
translation: 我测试过了，没问题。<撒谎>

original: Excellent! Finally, mankind will have a way to shoo away those annoying pests without resorting to cruelty or violence!
translation: 非常好！人类最终会以非暴力的方式清除这些讨厌的东西！

original: I'll just take that back for my final studies. Oh, but here! I've got lots of leftover chems from the testing. Maybe some of them are your style?
translation: 我要把它收回作为我最终的研究项目。哦，这有些实验剩下的药品。或许你会对其中的一些感兴趣？

original: I tested it out, and it works just fine. <Lie.>
translation: 我测试过了，没问题。<撒谎>

original: Oh, come on! You weren't even searching for a full day! You can't just give up on knowledge like that so fast!
translation: 哦，拜托！才一天都不到！你不能就这么快就放弃对知识的渴求！

original: I went to the site of the library, but the building was destroyed. <Lie.>
translation: 我去过图书馆，但那建筑被毁了。<撒谎>

original: Really? All of it? Not even a single, tattered paperback? Oh, that's terrible. Just like the Library of Alexandria County. What a loss to the world.
translation: 是吗？就这些？连一本书都没有？哦，糟透了。就像在亚历山大郡的实验室那样。这真是全世界的损失。

original: But... I guess I promised you some pay, didn't I? Here's some caps. But it's nothing compared to the wealth of knowledge we've all lost.
translation: 但是……我想,我向你保证过一些酬劳，不是吗？这有点钱给你。但这根本比不上我们所损失的知识财富。

original: I went to the site of the library, but the building was destroyed. <Lie.>
translation: 我去过图书馆，但那建筑被毁了。<撒谎>

original: Oh, come on. Now you're just being silly. There's no way you went down to Rivet City and came back in less than a day.
translation: 哦，拜托。你犯傻了。你不可能在一天之内往返铆钉城。

original: Rivet City is actually the remains of an ancient, underwater civilization. <Lie.>
translation: 铆钉城其实是一个古代海底文明的遗迹。<撒谎>

original: It is? I've never heard of anything like that! I don't even know anything in books about that sort of thing. Unless...
translation: 是吗？我从来没听说过！我甚至没有在书上读到过那种事。除非……

original: Oh my goodness! Do you think it's originally from Atlantis? Or maybe Mu? Maybe they started the war? I never would have guessed that without you!
translation: 哦，我的上帝！你认为那是从亚特兰蒂斯来的？或者是慕？或许是他们发动了战争？没有你我是不会猜到的！

original: This could change everything! Here, have your pay... our book is going to be huge!
translation: 这会改变一切！给，这是你的酬劳……我们的书将会非常成功！

original: Rivet City is actually the remains of an ancient, underwater civilization. <Lie.>
translation: 铆钉城其实是一个古代海底文明的遗迹。<撒谎>

original: As far as I can tell, you're a perfectly healthy 16-year-old boy. So yes, you have to go to class to take your G.O.A.T. exam!
translation: 在我看来，你是个非常健康的16岁男孩。所以，没错，你需要去参加G.O.A.T.！

original: As far as I can tell, you're a perfectly healthy 16-year-old girl. So yes, you have to go to class to take your G.O.A.T. exam!
translation: 在我看来，你是个非常健康的16岁女孩。所以，没错，你必须去参加G.O.A.T.！

original: All right, all right. Just keep quiet.
translation: 好吧，好吧。保持安静。

original: Come on, Forty. Let's go take a break.
translation: 来吧，弗替。我们去休息会。

original: I, uhh...
translation: 我，呃……

original: Yeah, he might. Except he ain't gonna know nothing about it. Come on, I see the way you look at me. I can really give you something to look at.
translation: 嗯，或许他会。除非他一点也不知情。好吧，我瞧见了你看我的目光。我真的能给你点东西看看。

original: That's a pretty stupid idea, even for you. Eulogy'd kill us both.
translation: 那非常蠢，即使是对你来说。尤勒基会杀了我们两个。

original: Oh, nothing. I was just sitting around, all bored and anxious, and thinking maybe I could find something to do. I mean, maybe we could.
translation: 哦，没事。我只是坐着，无聊且焦虑地坐着，思考我是不是能找点事做。我是说，或许我们是不是能找点事做。

original: The hell you want, Crimson?
translation: 见鬼，你想干嘛，奎默森？

original: Hey there, sugar. Lonely night?
translation: 嗨，甜心。今晚一个人吗？

original: Forget it.
translation: 别提了。

original: Already forgotten. Now take a hike.
translation: 早忘了。现在滚吧。

original: You don't think he's a good-looking guy? I bet he could show you a good time.
translation: 你不认为他是个很帅的男人吗？我敢打赌他可以让你度过一段美好时光。

original: Maybe he could. Maybe...
translation: 或许他会。或许……

original: Maybe I'll go see how he's doing. Maybe there's something I could do for him.
translation: 或许我会去看看他在干嘛。或许我会帮他做些什么。

original: You ain't gonna say a word 'bout this, right?
translation: 你不会把这事告诉别人吧？

original: There's 100 caps in it for you.
translation: 给你100个瓶盖。

original: Oh yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: Now that I think about it, Forty has been lookin' mighty fine lately. Workin' out extra.
translation: 现在回想起来，弗替最近变强壮了。他加强了锻炼。

original: Maybe I'll go see if there's anything I can do for him. You keep this between me and you. Clear?
translation: 或许我会到那看看有什么能帮他的。你不能把这事告诉别人。明白吗？

original: I think Forty could use some company.
translation: 我认为弗替需要些帮手。

original: Uh-huh. And what makes you think I give two shits about what Forty could use?
translation: 啊哈。是什么让你们认为我会在乎弗替需要什么样的帮手？

original: I've had enough "problems" for one day, thanks.
translation: 我一天内已经有足够的“问题”了，谢谢。

original: You and me both.
translation: 你和我都是。

original: Let me patch her through. She can explain what's gone wrong.
translation: 让我来为她包扎。她能解释出了什么问题。

original: You've got to be kidding me. What now?
translation: 你在开玩笑。现在怎么了？

original: Let me patch her through. She can explain it to you.
translation: 让我来为她包扎。她能向你解释。

original: What kind of problem?
translation: 什么问题？

original: Let me patch her through. She can explain it better than I could.
translation: 让我来为她包扎。她能比我更好地向你解释。

original: Isn't there another way to get you out?
translation: 有其他方法救你出去吗？

original: You're really dumb, aren't you?
translation: 你非常傻，不是吗？

original: I just told you this is the plan. I don't got another way to do this.
translation: 我刚才告诉过你就这个计划。我没有其它方法。

original: Your plan is crazy. I'm not doing it.
translation: 你的计划太疯狂了。我不会做的。

original: Great. Then that means we're still stuck in here, and you're an asshole.
translation: 太好了。那意味着我们依然困在这，而你是个混蛋。

original: Sure thing, Mr. Brotch.
translation: 肯定的，布洛彻先生。

original: Well, now that everyone has managed to find the classroom, we can finally get started.
translation: 嗯，现在所有的人都到了教室，我们终于可以开始了。

original: No talking, and keep your eyes to yourselves.
translation: 不许说话，不许偷看别人。

original: Yes, I'm talking to you Mr. DeLoria!
translation: 没错，就是说你呢，德罗瑞先生！

original: Unless anyone else has an insightful comment, let's get started.
translation: 除非有人还有什么意见要说，否则我们就开始了。

original: Question 1. A frenzied vault scientist runs up to you and yells, "I'm going to put my quantum harmonizer in your photonic resonation chamber!"
translation: 问题1：一个疯狂的避难所科学家走过来对你喊道，“我要把我的量子和谐协调器放在你的光子共鸣腔里！”

original: What's your response?
translation: 你的回复是？

original: Question 2. While working as an intern in the clinic, a patient with a strange infection in his foot stumbles through the door.
translation: 问题2：你在诊所做实习生，一个脚上有着奇怪感染的病人蹒跚着进了门。

original: The infection is spreading at an alarming rate, but the doctor has stepped out for a while. What do you do?
translation: 感染正以骇人的速度扩散，但是医生现在又不在。你怎么办？

original: Question 3. You discover a young boy lost in the lower levels of the vault.
translation: 问题3：你在避难所底层发现了一个迷路的小男孩。

original: He’s hungry and frightened, but also appears to be in possession of stolen property. What do you do?
translation: 他又饿又怕，但是他身上带着偷来的东西。你会怎么做？

original: Question 4. Congratulations! You’ve made one of the Vault 101 baseball teams. Which position do you prefer?
translation: 问题4：恭喜你！你成为了一名101号避难所棒球队的队员。你想打哪个位置？

original: Question 5. Your grandmother invites you to tea, but you’re surprised when she gives you a pistol, and orders you to kill another vault resident.
translation: 问题5：你的奶奶请你喝茶，但你惊奇地发现她给你一把手枪，并且让你去杀掉避难所里的另一名居民。

original: What do you do?
translation: 你是做什么的？

original: Question 6. Old Mister Abernathy has locked himself in his quarters again, and you’ve been ordered to get him out. How do you proceed?
translation: 问题6：老艾伯奈菲先生又把自己锁在房间里了，你被派去救他出来。你会怎么做？

original: Question 7. Oh no! You’ve been exposed to radiation, and a mutated hand has grown out of your stomach! What’s the best course of treatment?
translation: 问题7：哦不！你暴露在了辐射下，并且一只寄生的手从你的肚子里长出来！最佳的处理办法是什么？

original: Question 8. A fellow Vault 101 resident is in possession of a Grognak the Barbarian comic book, issue number 1. You want it.
translation: 问题8：一名101号避难所的居民拥有一本《野蛮人歌南》漫画，首发珍藏本。你想得到它。

original: What's the best way to obtain it?
translation: 最佳的获取方案是什么？

original: Question 9. You decide it would be fun to play a prank on your father. You enter his private restroom when no one is looking, and...
translation: 问题9：你决定和你父亲开个小玩笑。在没人看见的情况下，你溜进了他卧室的洗手间，然后……

original: Question 10. Who is, indisputably, the most important person in Vault 101:
translation: 问题10：在101号避难所里，谁是毫无争议的最重要的人：

original: He who shelters us from the harshness of the atomic Wasteland, and to whom we owe everything we have, including our lives?
translation: 他保护我们远离满是原子辐射的废土，我们欠他所拥有的一切，即使我们倾其所有，甚至生命也无法还清。他是谁？

original: Pencils down, people. That's it. The infamous G.O.A.T.!
translation: 大家放下笔。好了，就这样，臭名昭著的G.O.A.T.。

original: I'm sure most of you didn't find it so bad. Others, well, there are always openings in the maintenance department.
translation: 我确定你们中的绝大多数都不会觉得太难。不然的话，嗯，而且后勤部一直在招人啊。

original: Don't forget to hand in your tests before you leave. You don't want to know what happens to people who "fail" the G.O.A.T.
translation: 你们离开之前别忘记把测试交给我。你不会想要知道G.O.A.T.“不及格”会是什么下场的。

original: You can have the rest of the day off, to celebrate or to pray, as the situation warrants.
translation: 今天接下来的时间你们可以休息了，去庆祝或者去祈祷，随便你们。

original: I'll see you tomorrow, bright and early.
translation: 明早见。

original: Well, I'll be damned... That little so-and-so... why didn't I think of that when I was sixteen?
translation: 嗯，真想不到……这些细节……我16岁的时候怎么没考虑过那些问题？

original: Um... sure. Maybe you'll see him sometime later. Not now, though. <Lie.>
translation: 呃……当然。或许你迟点会见到他。现在不行。<撒谎>

original: Okay, if you say so. I'm getting out of here, then.
translation: 好吧，既然你这样说。那我就离开这了。

original: You go out the normal way, so they don't get suspicious. Meet us outside.
translation: 你出去的时候表现的正常一点，这样他们就不会怀疑了。我们在外面会合。

original: Yes, he's safe. Now get moving!
translation: 是的，他安全了。现在快走吧！

original: Okay, okay!
translation: 好的，好的！

original: Don't follow me. You go out the normal way, and meet Sammy and me outside.
translation: 别跟着我。你不动声色地出去，然后再和我、萨米会合。

original: I got him out, all right. Now it's your turn.
translation: 我把他救出去了，没问题。现在该你了。

original: You saved him? Really?
translation: 你救了他？真的吗？

original: Thank you so much. I'll make it up to you somehow, I promise.
translation: 非常感谢你。我保证我会报答你的。

original: Now I have to get out. Don't follow me; you go out the normal way. We'll meet outside.
translation: 现在我得走了。别跟着我；你不动声色地出去。我们在外面会合。

original: I tried, but he didn't make it.
translation: 我试过了，但是他没能活下来。

original: Poor Rory... He was a nice man. He deserved better.
translation: 可怜的罗瑞……他是个好人。他应该有更好的结局。

original: I'm getting out of here. Don't follow me.
translation: 我走了。别跟着我。

original: You're damn right I do!
translation: 你他妈的说对了！

original: Now you sound like a merc! Well, let's cut the bullshit and get right to it then.
translation: 现在你听起来像个佣兵！嗯，我们少说废话，直奔主题。

original: So, for your reward, what'll it be? The Ranger Battlearmor or one of Brick's Miniguns?
translation: 你想要什么奖励？游骑兵战斗装甲还是布瑞克的多管机枪？

original: Are you kidding me? Hell would have been a damn picnic!
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？那该死的就像去野餐一样！

original: All right, all right. No need to get your underpants in a knot.
translation: 好吧，好吧。没必要把你的内裤打结。

original: Can you give me a full debriefing on what happened out there with my men?
translation: 你能完整地描述一下，我的人到底遭遇了什么吗？

original: No games. You tell me where my father is. Now, you little brat.
translation: 别耍花招。立刻告诉我，我的父亲在哪。你这小杂种。

original: Oh, don't be mean. That's not a good way to start.
translation: 哦，别发火。这可不是一个好的开始。

original: I said we're going to play a game, so that's what we're going to do.
translation: 我说过我们得玩个游戏，现在我们就开始吧。

original: Who else lived in Grayditch?
translation: 都有谁住在格雷蒂奇？

original: Ummm, besides me and my pappa, there was Doc Lesko who stayed with us and Will Brandice and his momma and pappa too.
translation: 呃，除了我和我爸爸之外，还有莱斯科医生和我们一起住。此外还有威廉·布兰迪斯和他的父母。

original: I... guess they're all gone now.
translation: 我……估计他们现在都走了。

original: Did you hear anyone mention anything about an Ant Queen?
translation: 你听到过什么人提过蚁后的事吗？

original: Well... yeah. I think I heard Doc Lesko mention something like a queen or something.
translation: 呃……是的。我想莱斯科医生提过蚁后。

original: Something about "laying eggs" whatever that means.
translation: 什么“产卵”之类的。

original: He said the queen would never be above ground. That he'd have to find her. Weird huh?
translation: 他说过蚁后是不会出现在地表上的。所以他必须找到她。挺奇怪，不是吗？

original: That can't be right! The stupid test got it all wrong!
translation: 肯定出了什么问题！那蠢实验全错了！

original: Listen, I was just as obnoxious at your age. I didn't take the G.O.A.T. seriously and look where I ended up.
translation: 听着，我当初在你的年龄时也一样讨人厌。我没有认真的参加G.O.A.T.，看看我的下场吧。

original: Just between you and me? The whole test is a joke.
translation: 和你说个秘密，只我们两个人知道好吗？整个测试就是个玩笑。

original: If you don't like the results, I can make your G.O.A.T. come out any way you want. Just let me know.
translation: 如果你不满意结果，我可以修改你的G.O.A.T.结果。要改的话就告诉我。

original: Whatever. I just answered randomly. Is that how you got stuck with your job?
translation: 随便喽。我只是随机选择答案。你这份工作也是这么得到的吗？

original: Ha. Closer to reality than you might think.
translation: 哈。比你能想到的还要接近现实。

original: Listen, I was just as obnoxious at your age. I didn't take the G.O.A.T. seriously and look where I ended up.
translation: 听着，我当初在你的年龄时也一样讨人厌。我没有认真的参加G.O.A.T.，看看我的下场吧。

original: Just between you and me? The whole test is a joke.
translation: 和你说个秘密，只我们两个人知道好吗？整个测试就是个玩笑。

original: If you don't like the results, I can make your G.O.A.T. come out any way you want. Just let me know.
translation: 如果你不满意结果，我可以修改你的G.O.A.T.结果。要改的话就告诉我。

original: Wow! That's what I've always wanted to be. My dreams are finally coming true!
translation: 哇！这就是我一直想要的结果。我的梦想最终实现了！

original: Yes, um, it's refreshing to see such, ah, youthful enthusiasm.
translation: 没错，呃，看到如此，呃，青春洋溢的热情，真是令人振奋。

original: Good to know that the G.O.A.T. occasionally gets it right. You know what they say about monkeys and typewriters...
translation: 没想到G.O.A.T.偶尔也有对的时候。你知道人们怎么谈论猴子和打字员……

original: Well, I'm glad things turned out so well for you. I hope your classmates find their results half as satisfying.
translation: 嗯，我很高兴你的最终结果还不错。我希望你的同学对他们的测试结果有你一半满意就好了。

original: Hannibal is upstairs somewhere. I'm locking the door behind you, so don't try anything. I'm watching you.
translation: 汉尼拔在楼上。我锁了你身后的门，所以别做蠢事。我盯着你呢。

original: You know your way around. Just try and stay out of trouble.
translation: 你知道你目前的处境。别惹麻烦。

original: Stay away from the steps. They have orders to shoot first and loot the body afterward.
translation: 离楼梯远点。他们有命令，先射杀，之后把死者身上的东西洗劫一空。

original: Really? Here? Surely not one of Doctor Li's trained monkeys...
translation: 真的？这？你肯定这不是李博士训练的那些猴子中的一只吗……

original: Well? Find them! The person you're looking for can perform facial reconstruction or a sophisticated computer memory transfer.
translation: 嗯？找到他们！你要找的那人可能已经整容或者已经把电脑存储更改了。

original: Go on! Shake a leg!
translation: 继续！赶快行动！

original: The person who did the surgery and reprogramming is here at Rivet City!
translation: 那个做过手术改造的人就在铆钉城里！

original: Excellent news! We're close... so close.
translation: 好消息！我们接近了……如此接近。

original: Find this Pinkerton! Learn everything they know! I want that damned android, and I want him now!
translation: 找到平克顿！从他那获取所有信息！我想要回人造人，现在就要！

original: His memory transfer was done by a tech named Pinkerton. Here at Rivet City!
translation: 有个叫平克顿的技工移植了他的记忆，就在铆钉城里！

original: Good job! You've confirmed what I suspected all along.
translation: 干得好！你把我一直以来的顾虑都打消了。

original: Now, why don't you go out and figure out WHO did the memory work!
translation: 现在，你为什么不去找出是谁修改了他的记忆！

original: Sounds like the android was definitely given new memories.
translation: 听起来这个人造人被赋予了新的记忆。

original: A Circuit Neuralizer? Here in the Wasteland? How'd they manage to get their grubby hands on one of those? Impressive.
translation: 一个环状神经器？在废土？他们是怎么用他们的脏手弄到那种东西的？令人印象深刻。

original: You are showing signs of intelligence and resourcefulness. You might turn out useful after all. But you're wasting time talking to me.
translation: 你表现得充满智慧。或许你是个有用之才，但你现在跟我说话是在浪费时间。

original: I'm tracking down leads on a Circuit Neuralizer.
translation: 我在追查一个环状神经器的线索。

original: Yes well, there are reasons we don't want our technology leaking into the Wasteland. Which is why I've asked you to retrieve it.
translation: 是的，我们不希望我们的科技流传到废土是有原因的。这就是我让你把他找回来的原因。

original: Which is what you should be doing right now! The longer you wait, the colder the trail becomes.
translation: 这就是我要你必须现在立刻去做的原因！你等的时间越长，就越难找到他的踪影。

original: There are rumors... about a secret Commonwealth artificial intelligence project?
translation: 有…关于秘密的联邦人工智能计划的传言吗？

original: Excellent! Find this Pinkerton and "interview" him. He may very well know the android's whereabouts.
translation: 非常好！找到这个平克顿，然后与他“面谈”。他或许知道那人造人在哪。

original: Well? Go!
translation: 嗯？去吧！

original: His face job was done here, at Rivet City! By someone named Pinkerton!
translation: 他在铆钉城整了容！是一个叫平克顿的人帮他整容的！

original: Really? Someone managed to procure those here in the Wasteland? Impressive... But who out here could have the skill to use them? Hmmm...
translation: 真的？有人能在废土搞到那些？令人印象深刻……但这里又有谁有能力使用这些东西呢？唔……

original: You are making progress, certainly, but you've got nothing more to learn from me. Get back out there!
translation: 无疑，你取得了进展，但是你从我这得不到更多信息了。回去继续找！

original: Someone got their hands on a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer.
translation: 有人弄到了脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。

original: Ah, you've managed to sniff the trail! Good job. Keep me informed on your progress...
translation: 啊，你嗅到了他的踪迹！干得好。有新的进展立刻告诉我……

original: Well? Why are you still standing there?
translation: 嗯？你怎么还站在这？

original: I'm tracking down the location and equipment used to perform the face job.
translation: 我在追踪整容手术地点和使用的设备。

original: Rumors? That's all you have to offer me? I expect something more concrete! Now get out of my sight!
translation: 传闻？这就是你能给我的所有信息？我需要一些更确实的信息！立刻从我眼前消失！

original: I've heard rumors about an android looking for special surgery.
translation: 我听到一些关于人造人寻求外科手术的传言。

original: Do you know who did the memory swap on the Commonwealth android?
translation: 你知道是谁重置了联邦机器人的记忆？

original: I sure do! No one believes me though. It was old Pinkerton. You know, the "ghost" of Rivet City. He's a genius!
translation: 我当然知道！尽管没人相信我，是老平克顿。你知道，铆钉城的幽灵。他是个天才！

original: I'll bet you know something about the mind wipe on that escaped android...
translation: 我敢打赌你知道那逃跑的人造人被清除记忆的事……

original: That Commonwealth robot was real! I have proof. Listen to this!
translation: 联邦人造人是真的！我有证据。仔细听着！

original: Best hurry, old chum... I can't hang on... much longer... I think this could be the end... of...
translation: 最好快点，老朋友……我坚持不了……太久……我想这可能就是结局……

original: Boss! Don't worry, I'm coming!
translation: 老大！别害怕，我来了！

original: Child's play, you withering worry wort! Watch... tthhiiss. Woooaaaahhh!!
translation: 小把戏，你这自寻烦恼的家伙！看……这个。哇呀~~~！！

original: They're gaining on us boss! That cliff up ahead - you think you can jump it? You ain't as spry as you used to be...
translation: 老大，他们正冲向我们！前面那悬崖 — 你认为你能跳过去吗？你不像以前那么灵活了……

original: This way, Argyle! Into the caves! It's our only chance! (sound of running)
translation: 阿盖尔，这边！到洞穴里去！这是我们唯一的机会！（跑步声）

original: Citizens of Rockopolis! Destroy these interlopers!
translation: 罗克波利斯的居民！消灭这些侵略者！

original: Warm welcome's over boss! Time to scram!
translation: 欢迎会结束了，老大！该撤了！

original: Dashwwwooooddd!
translation: 达什伍德！

original: Inspired you to tighten your defenses?
translation: 给了你加固防御的灵感？

original: Slavers? You led the Slavers here? To Rockopolis? You idiots! Do you realize what you've done!
translation: 奴隶贩子？你把奴隶贩子带到这？带到罗克波利斯？你这白痴！你知道你干了什么吗！

original: She's the least of your worries, Craggy. In a few seconds, the Slavers are gonna be breaking down your rocky front door!
translation: 她是你最不需要担心的，老峭壁王。再过几秒，奴隶主就会砸开你的石门了！

original: Herbert Dashwood? Ugh... I should have known. But who is this... this dead woman? And... is that her... heart?
translation: 赫伯特·达什伍德？呃……我早该知道。但是这是谁……这死去的女人？这……这是她的……心脏？

original: Oh magnificent King Crag, fearless leader of Rockopolis! It's me, Daring! Daring Dashwood?
translation: 哦，金·凯格，罗克波利斯无畏的领袖！是我，亲爱的！亲爱的达什伍德？

original: What is the meaning of this?!
translation: 这是什么意思？！

original: Your kung fu skills may be unparalleled, old chum, but your comic delivery leaves something to be desired...
translation: 你的功夫或许举世无双，老朋友，但是你的幽默感还有待提高……

original: Ah, I always knew this broad was heartless. Get it, boss? Heartless?
translation: 啊，我就知道这女人的心很小。看到了吧，老大？这心小吧？

original: Good God, Argyle! You... You ripped out her heart!
translation: 阿盖尔，上帝啊！你……你把她的心挖出来了！

original: Aggghhhh!
Funny business? Miss Chase, you hurt my feelings. I mean, there ain't nothin' funny about... the Eagle Clawwww!!!
translation: 有趣的生意？蔡斯小姐，你伤害了我的感情。我的意思是，鹰爪……可不有趣！！！

original: Just ease away, zombie. No funny business...
translation: 走开，丧尸。没有有趣的生意……

original: Today's episode - Between Rockopolis and a Hard Place!
translation: 今天的节目 — 罗克波利斯和抉择！

original: Fine. What the hell do I call you anyway? Herbert or Bob?
translation: 行吧。那我到底该叫你什么？赫伯特还是鲍勃？

original: No, no. Herbert is the tree... Bob is his real name, but I call him Herbert cause I think it's pretty funny.
translation: 不不。赫伯特是这棵树……鲍勃是他的真名，但我叫他赫伯特，因为我觉得这名字挺有趣的。

original: But I'm still in here too, what's left of me. The name's Harold.
translation: 但我也还在这儿，我剩下的这部分。我叫哈罗德。

original: Okay. Goodbye, err... Tree.
translation: 好吧。再见，呃……大树。

original: No, no. Herbert is the tree... Bob is his real name, but I call him Herbert cause I think it's pretty funny.
translation: 不不。赫伯特是这棵树……鲍勃是他的真名，但我叫他赫伯特，因为我觉得这名字挺有趣的。

original: But I'm still in here too, what's left of me. The name's Harold.
translation: 但我也还在这儿，我剩下的这部分。我叫哈罗德。

original: Well, goodbye for now then, Herbert. Or was it Bob?
translation: 好吧，那暂时告别啦，赫伯特。还是叫你鲍勃？

original: No, no. Herbert is the tree... Bob is his real name, but I call him Herbert cause I think it's pretty funny.
translation: 不不。赫伯特是这棵树……鲍勃是他的真名，但我叫他赫伯特，因为我觉得这名字挺有趣的。

original: But I'm still in here too, what's left of me. The name's Harold.
translation: 但我也还在这儿，我剩下的这部分。我叫哈罗德。

original: Can I have some time to think about it?
translation: 能给我点时间考虑一下吗？

original: Of course. I know this is an unusual request, but hey, I'm an unusual tree. Well, Bob is anyway...
translation: 当然。我知道这是不寻常的要求，但是，嗨，我也不是一棵寻常的树。嗯，也许鲍勃才是那树……

original: We'll just keep it an open invitation then. I don't want to wait until the next person visits, it could be years... you're all I've got.
translation: 那我们就把这事当长期有效的邀请吧。我可不想等到下一个人来访，那可能得好几年……现在就指望你了。

original: Look, I really don't want to kill you...
translation: 听着，我真的不想杀了你……

original: Of all the Wastelanders I had to bump into it has to be one with a conscience.
translation: 那么多废土客中，我偏偏碰到了个有良心的人。

original: Let's keep it an open invitation then. I don't want to wait until the next person visits, it could be years.
translation: 那就算是长期有效的邀请吧。我可不想等到下一个人来访，那可能是好几年后了。

original: Just think about it, okay?
translation: 就考虑一下，好吗？

original: Ok, I'll do it.
translation: 好，我干。

original: You will? Oh! You've made us so happy! Isn't that right Bob?
translation: 你愿意？哦！你让我们太开心了！对吧，鲍勃？

original: Just give me a little time to say goodbye to good old Bob and then I'll be ready.
translation: 给我点时间跟老伙计鲍勃道个别，然后我就准备好了。

original: Okay then. Hey, you haven't seen the Doc's kid, have you? We're still looking for him.
translation: 好吧。嗨，你没见过医生的孩子吧？我们还在找他。

original: Okay then. Hey, you haven't seen the Doc's kid, have you? We're still looking for her.
translation: 好吧。嗨，你没见过医生的孩子吧？我们还在找她。

original: No, sir. Good luck with your search though.
translation: 没有，先生。祝你搜索顺利。

original: Whatever. Get back in your room.
translation: 随便。回你房间去。

original: I've got bigger problems right now than dealing with your lush of a mother again.
translation: 我正在干比去救你那醉鬼母亲还重要的事。

original: No, wait! You're looking for the Doc's kid, right? He was just here! I saw where he went.
translation: 不，等下！你在找医生的孩子，对吧？他之前还在这！我看见他去哪了。

original: No, wait! You're looking for the Doc's kid, right? He was just here! I saw where he went.
translation: 不，等下！你在找医生的孩子，对吧？他之前还在这！我看见他去哪了。

original: You saw him? Where'd he go?
translation: 你看见他了？他去哪了？

original: You saw her? Where'd she go?
translation: 你看见她了？她去哪了？

original: Uh uh. You go in there and help my mom. Then I'll tell you.
translation: 好吧。你去帮我妈妈。然后我就会告诉你了。

original: Listen you little punk! We just beat a man to death. You want to be next?
translation: 听着，你这小杂种！我们刚打死一个人。你难道想成为下一个？

original: No sir! Uh, he went that way! I saw him. I did!
translation: 不，先生！呃，他顺着那条路走了！我看见了，我肯定！

original: No sir! Uh, she went that way! I saw her. I did!
translation: 不，先生！呃，她顺着那条路走了！我看见了，我肯定！

original: That's better. Now get in your goddamn room!
translation: 最好是这样。现在滚回你的房间去！

original: No, please! Don't leave! You've got to help my mom!
translation: 不，拜托！别走！你得帮助我妈妈！

original: Goddammit Butch, I told you to get back in your room.
translation: 该死，布奇，我说了滚回你的房间去。

original: What are you doing out of your room? There's a curfew in effect.
translation: 你出房间干嘛？现在正在戒严。

original: There's roaches in there, Officer Kendall! They're attacking my mom! You've got to help!
translation: 警员肯德尔，这有蟑螂！它们在攻击我妈妈！你得帮帮我！

original: I told you, there's roaches in there attacking my mom! You've got to help her!
translation: 我告诉你了，蟑螂正在攻击我的妈妈！你得帮帮她！

original: Oh, uh, sorry Officer. I'll go right back inside.
translation: 哦，呃，对不起，警员。我这就回房间去。

original: What's the matter, she dead drunk again? I don't have time for this. Stop being such a sissy and go help her yourself.
translation: 发生了什么事，她又醉了？我没时间管这。你别总像个娘们，自己去救她。

original: Over here! Officer Kendall!
translation: 在这儿！警员肯德尔！

original: Hey! He's right over here! Come quick!
translation: 嗨！他就在这！快来！

original: Hey! She's right over here! Come quick!
translation: 嗨！她就在这！快来！

original: I've found him! This way!
translation: 我发现他了！这！

original: I've found her! This way!
translation: 我发现她了！这！

original: Officer Kendall! Help!
translation: 警员肯德尔！快来！

original: People die all the time out here. Get used to it.
translation: 在废土每天都有人送命。要慢慢习惯它。

original: Why does everyone who comes through here have to be so mean!?
translation: 为什么到这来的人都这么刻薄！？

original: We have to get back at these things for killing my pappa! We just gotta!
translation: 我们得回去处理这些杀害我爸爸的东西！我们出发吧！

original: You've been in a coma... chances are the Rangers are already dead.
translation: 你一直昏迷着……很可能游骑兵都已经死了。

original: No! There is no way my guys are dead!
translation: 不！我的人不会死的！

original: If there's even the slimmest chance of surviving, they'll do it.
translation: 即使只有一线生机，他们也会去尝试的。

original: If you won't go, stop wasting my fucking time and find me someone who will!
translation: 如果你不愿意去，就别他妈浪费我的时间，找个愿意去的人！

original: Why don't you attempt a rescue? Your legs broken or something?
translation: 你为什么不试试去救他们呢？你腿瘸了还是怎么？

original: Are you completely stupid?
translation: 你傻了吗？

original: I can barely walk right now, let alone climb a skyscraper. If I could even hold a pistol, I would go get my guys right now!
translation: 现在我几乎无法行走，更别提爬上摩天大楼。如果我现在能拿起手枪的话，我会立刻救回我的人！

original: I'm using everything I've got just standing here talking to you. Get the point?
translation: 我正在用所有力量为了在这和你说话。懂了吗？

original: You look terrible. Maybe I shouldn't have woken you up so quickly.
translation: 你看上去很糟。或许我不该这么快弄醒你。

original: Heh, I feel worse than I look, but that doesn't even matter to me. I'm just worried about the rest of the Rangers.
translation: 呃，我的感觉比外表还糟，但我不在乎。我只是担心其他的游骑兵。

original: I don't even know if they're still alive.
translation: 我甚至不知道他们是死是活。

original: Do you think Reilly will be okay?
translation: 你认为莱莉会好起来吗？

original: She's a very lucky young lady not to have suffered damage from her coma.
translation: 她是个非常幸运的年轻女士，没有受到昏迷所带来的伤害。

original: She'll be just fine as long as she takes it easy.
translation: 只要她放松心情，好好养病，她会好起来的。

original: If you revive her, I can find out what happened. Maybe even help her!
translation: 如果你可以弄醒她，我就可以知道发生了什么事情。或许我还可以帮她！

original: Very well. This is against my better judgment, but so be it.
translation: 非常好。这不是我的原意，但算了，就那么做吧。

original: I just hope she has the strength to cope with the system shock.
translation: 我只是希望她还有力气承受电击起搏冲击。

original: Forget it!
translation: 忘了吧！

original: Now, there's no call to be rude.
translation: 嗯，没必要这么粗鲁。

original: I'm just doing my job which is making sure this young lady suffers no more permanent damage.
translation: 我只是确保这位年轻的女士不会受到更多的永久性创伤。

original: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have my work to attend to.
translation: 现在，如果你没其他事的话，失陪了，我还有别的工作要做。

original: Please, Doc! She obviously needs someone's help.
translation: 拜托，医生！很明显她需要帮助.

original: I appreciate your sincerity, but I'm afraid it's just too risky.
translation: 我很欣赏你的真诚，但恐怕这样做太冒险了。

original: Hmph. I thought Ghouls hated humans.
translation: 哼。我原以为尸鬼憎恨人类。

original: Humans have too many misconceptions. Some of us don't get along with humans, but the majority of us are learning to live with our differences.
translation: 人类有太多误解。我们有些人无法与人类共处，但是大部分都试着适应差异。

original: I only wish that the humans in the Capital Wasteland felt the same way. It would make life so much easier...
translation: 我唯一的希望就是首都废土的人类也有同样的看法。这会让生活简单得多……

original: Anyway, I am taking too much time speaking with you when I should be working. If you need anything, let me know.
translation: 总之，我现在该去工作，但是却和你说了这么多。如果你需要什么，尽管找我。

original: It's nice that you care so much.
translation: 你如此关心，这真好。

original: I don't share the philosophy that Ghouls and humans are different. We were all the same once.
translation: 我不认同僵尸和人类有什么区别。毕竟，我们曾一样。

original: So why should I treat Reilly any worse than a Ghoul who comes here looking for help?
translation: 这就是为什么当莱莉来这寻求帮助时，我帮助了她。

original: Anyway, I must get back to my duties. If you need anything else, please let me know.
translation: 总之，我得回去工作了。如果你还有什么其他需要就告诉我。

original: A Ghoul that wants to be human? That's a good one!
translation: 一个尸鬼想变回人类？那真是太好了！

original: Well, I've never been so insulted! I expected a little more from you, but I see you humans are almost all alike!
translation: 嗯，我从未被如此羞辱过！我期望你和其他人类会有所不同，但你们人类都一样！

original: Don't worry about Reilly, we'll take care of her. Now, if you'll excuse me.
translation: 别为莱莉担心，我们会好好照顾她的。现在我得回去工作了。

original: Interesting.
translation: 有意思。

original: Not impressed, huh? Oh well. I didn't expect a human to understand the gravity of this experiment anyway.
translation: 不感兴趣，呃？反正我原本也没有期望一个人类会理解这实验的重要性。

original: Just do me a favor, and don't mention this to anyone. No telling what reaction this could have if it got out.
translation: 帮我个忙，别和其他人提起。如果这事泄漏出去，不知道会引起什么反应。

original: Amazing! Do you think it will really work?
translation: 太神奇了！你认为这真的会成功吗？

original: Well, we're trying not to get too excited. Not only because we want to keep it quiet, but also because the experiments look so promising.
translation: 嗯，我们试着不要太激动。不仅因为我们想秘密进行，而且的确这实验大有可为。

original: For now, just please try and keep what I've told you quiet. No telling what reaction this could have if it got out.
translation: 现在，请努力照我说的保持冷静。如果这事泄漏出去，不知道会引起什么反应。

original: What exactly is the doctor trying to do? You can tell me.
translation: 那医生想要干嘛？你可以告诉我。

original: He's trying to come up with a cure. A way to stop the human to Ghoul transition. Perhaps even one day to reverse it!
translation: 他正研制一种治疗方案。一种阻止人类变成僵尸的治疗方案。或许有一天，僵尸能重新变回人类也说不定！

original: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？

original: Well, some of the Ghouls in Underworld object to what the Doctor is doing.
translation: 嗯，地下世界里有些僵尸反对医生在做的事。

original: They think Ghouls are Ghouls and humans are humans. Like we were meant to be this way.
translation: 他们认为僵尸就是僵尸，人类就是人类。就好像我们本该如此。

original: Some have even threatened the doctor. I'm afraid one day something might happen to him.
translation: 有些人甚至威胁医生。我担心哪天医生真的会发生什么不测。

original: Has he met with any success?
translation: 他取得进展了吗？

original: So far, none of his conclusions are finalized, but the tests he's running are coming up quite positive!
translation: 目前为止，他的结论未经证实，但他的实验结果很不错！

original: Oh... I shouldn't be telling you any of this.
translation: 哦……我不该告诉你这些。

original: He's experimenting on her? That's twisted!
translation: 他在她身上做实验？太变态了！

original: First and foremost on Doctor Barrow's mind is her health and well-being. I can assure you of that.
translation: 巴罗斯医生首先想到的就是保证她的健康。我可以向你保证。

original: So far, none of his conclusions are finalized, but the tests he's running are coming up quite positive!
translation: 目前为止，他的结论未经证实，但他的实验结果很不错！

original: Oh... I shouldn't be telling you any of this.
translation: 哦……我不该告诉你这些。

original: You seem to be taking very good care of her.
translation: 看来你把她照顾得很好。

original: Well, she's very important to Doctor Barrows and she's my patient.
translation: 是的，她对巴罗斯医生非常重要，并且她是我的病人。

original: I don't care if she's human or Ghoul, she gets treated the same here.
translation: 我才不管她是人类还是僵尸，她会在这得到相同的照顾。

original: Why does Doctor Barrows care so much about humans, anyway?
translation: 为什么巴罗斯医生这么在意人类？

original: The doctor is convinced that the key to curing our... appearance is locked within the human body.
translation: 医生确信治疗我们……外貌的关键秘密就藏在人类的身体里。

original: When Reilly was brought in here he saw a chance to put that theory to the test.
translation: 当莱莉到这来的时候，他有机会把理论付诸于实践。

original: What can you tell me about Reilly?
translation: 你能和我说说莱莉吗？

original: Poor girl. I didn't think she'd make it through the first night she was brought in here.
translation: 可怜的女孩。我没想到她能挺过第一个晚上。

original: Doctor Barrows has done everything in his power to keep her alive.
translation: 巴罗斯医生尽了最大的努力来抢救她。

original: The code is 7-0-4.
Very well. We'll just verify that now.
translation: 很好。我们现在就证实。

original: The code is 2-1-6.
Let's just make sure you're telling the truth.
translation: 我们得确保你说的是实话。

original: I don't know what the code is.
translation: 我不知道密码是多少。

original: You LIE!
translation: 你在撒谎！

original: Okay, okay. Just don't hurt me.
translation: 好的，好的。请别伤害我。

original: I'm waiting.
translation: 我等着呢。

original: Why do you want this code so badly?
translation: 为什么你这么急切地想知道密码？

original: You know why. We can't start the purifier without it. The longer the purifier isn't running, the more people suffer.
translation: 你知道为什么吗？没有密码我们就无法启动净化器。净化器停止运作的时间越长，就会有更多的人受苦。

original: Now I'm running out of patience, son. I want that code, and I want it now.
translation: 孩子，我快没耐性了。我现在就要知道密码。

original: What code? What are you talking about?
translation: 什么密码？你在说什么？

original: Don't try and play stupid now. It's too late for that; we both know better.
translation: 别装傻。现在才装傻太晚了；你我心里都明白。

original: The code to activate the water purifier. Now.
translation: 开启净化器的密码，快给我。

original: No, seriously. Fuck you.
translation: 不，认真点。他妈的。

original: Why do you insist on provoking me?
translation: 为什么你执意要激怒我？

original: Tell me the code NOW.
translation: 立刻告诉我密码。

original: Fuck you. I'm not telling you anything.
translation: 他妈的。我不会告诉你的。

original: I'll be honest. I'm running out of patience here, and I'm not looking to play games with you.
translation: 说实话，我的耐性已经耗尽了，我没空和你玩，告诉我密码。

original: You tell me that code, or it's going to cost you.
translation: 告诉我密码，否则你就死定了。

original: You killed my father, you son of a bitch!
translation: 你杀了我的父亲，你这混蛋！

original: Technically, your father killed himself. His loyalties lay with the wrong people, and he paid the price.
translation: 原则上，你父亲是自杀的。他的忠诚给错了人，为此付出了代价。

original: You, on the other hand, have an opportunity to learn from his mistakes.
translation: 你则不同，有一个从他的错误中吸取教训的机会。

original: This is some kind of mistake. You've got the wrong person.
translation: 你错了。你找错人了。

original: You really think I'm that stupid? I know you were there. I saw you.
translation: 你真的认为我那么蠢吗？我知道你到过那。我见过你。

original: You're in a heap of trouble, kid. You're a traitor to the United States government. You know what happens to traitors, don't you?
translation: 孩子，你有一堆麻烦。你是美国政府的叛徒。你知道叛徒的下场，对吧？

original: You give me that code, and maybe we can work out a deal for you. But you need to start talking right now.
translation: 如果你说出密码，或许我们会达成某种协议。但是你得立刻说出密码。

original: What the hell is going on here?
translation: 见鬼，这发生什么？

original: I'll tell you what's going on here. You lost.
translation: 我告诉你发生了什么。你输了。

original: The good guys won this one, and now we're just wrapping up loose ends. We've got the purifier, now we just need the code to start it.
translation: 这次好人赢了，现在我们只是固定了松动的地方。我们得到了净化器，现在我们只要知道密码就可以启动它了。

original: You're going to give me that code now, and save us all a lot of trouble. Maybe I'll even let you go. So how about it?
translation: 你现在得把密码给我，这能省去很多麻烦。甚至我会考虑放你走。怎么样？

original: I'll tell you whatever you want. Please just don't hurt me.
translation: 我会告诉你想知道的一切。只要别伤害我。

original: Now that's just what I wanted to hear.
translation: 很好，这就是我想听到的。

original: So what's the code?
translation: 密码是什么？

original: Let me out of here. Now!
translation: 放我出去！

original: IF you tell me the code, it might be worth your life. But you're really not in a position to be demanding anything, are you?
translation: 如果你告诉我密码，或许还能保住你的小命。但你目前没有资格提要求，明白吗？

original: Negative, Sir. The code's no good. I just lost another man.
translation: 不行，长官。密码不对。我又损失了一个人。

original: Copy 7-0-4. Standby, sir. Entering code now.
translation: 密码7-0-4，稍等，长官。现在输入密码。

original: Your code is 7-0-4. Repeat, 7-0-4. Confirm and enter.
translation: 密码是7-0-4，重复一遍，7-0-4。确认后输入。

original: Affirmative, sir. Standing by for code transmission.
translation: 正确，长官。密码转换，请稍等。

original: This is Colonel Autumn. Are your men in place, soldier?
translation: 我是奥托姆上校。你的人就位了吗，士兵？

original: Confirm, that's the correct code. Systems coming online now, sir. I'll have a full report shortly.
translation: 确认，密码正确。系统正在上线，长官。稍后我会交一份完整报告。

original: Copy 2-1-6. Standby, sir. Entering code now.
translation: 密码2-1-6。请稍等，长官。现在输入密码。

original: Your code is 2-1-6. Repeat, 2-1-6. Confirm and enter.
translation: 密码是2-1-6.重复一遍，2-1-6。确认后输入。

original: Affirmative, sir. Standing by for code transmission.
translation: 正确，长官。密码转换，请稍等。

original: This is Colonel Autumn. Are your men in place, soldier?
translation: 我是奥托姆上校。你的人就位了吗，士兵？

original: And I'll unlock your restraints as well. I'll be waiting for you in my office. Please don't tarry.
translation: 我会解开你身上的那些玩意。我在办公室等你，你立刻过来。

original: You'll find your possessions in the locker near the door. I'll unlock the way for you.
translation: 你会在门旁的储物柜里找到你的物品。我会为你打开去那的路。

original: I'd like to have a word with you, face-to-face. I think there are a few things you and I should discuss.
translation: 我希望能和你面对面地交谈，有些事情我们需要好好谈谈。

original: I have no doubt that you know who I am. I'm sure you've heard my radio broadcasts.
translation: 毫无疑问你是知道我是谁的，我相信你听过我主持的电台节目。

original: I do apologize for Colonel Autumn's attitude. He's been under a great deal of stress lately.
translation: 我为奥托姆上校的态度向你致歉。近来他的压力很大。

original: Ah, alone at last.
translation: 啊，到头来还是孤家寡人。

original: Yes sir.
translation: 是，长官.

original: Now, Colonel...
translation: 立刻，上校……

original: Mr. President, I have no time for other matters. I'll be with you shortly.
translation: 总统先生，我在处理要事没有时间。我会尽快过来。

original: Colonel... I have need of you.
translation: 上校……我需要你的帮助。

original: I should have killed you right away. We have the G.E.C.K., we'll get the code. We don't need you.
translation: 我应该宰了你。我们拥有了伊甸园创造器，我们会得到密码。我们不需要你。

original: Did you really think we would fall for that? I have had ENOUGH of your games.
translation: 你真的以为我们会上当？我受够你的把戏了。

original: Thank you for cooperating. I'm afraid we no longer have need of your services.
translation: 感谢你的合作。恐怕我们不再需要你的帮助了。

original: Wait here.
translation: 在这等着。

original: Fine, but what am I supposed to do here? Work on my needlepoint or something?
translation: 好吧，但是我在这该干嘛？刺绣还是怎么？

original: I shall wait here until you return for me.
translation: 我会等着，直到你来找我。

original: But it's so boring all alone!
translation: 但一个人在这等太孤单了！

original: Don't piss around, I don't want to be standing here with my thumb up my ass all day.
translation: 别胡闹。我不想整天在这。

original: I will keep this location secure!
translation: 我会确保这的安全！

original: If you insist. But do be careful - I can hardly repay your kindness while waiting back here.
translation: 如果你坚持。但是务必小心 — 在这干等的话,我可还不了你人情。

original: I shall reflect on the battles past and the battles to come until your return.
translation: 我会在你回来前，反省已经结束的战斗，并且准备好即将到来的战斗。

original: Let's trade equipment.
translation: 我们交易装备吧。

original: If this means more stuff for Butch, I'm all for it.
translation: 如果这东西对布奇很重要，我全力支持。

original: Very well.
translation: 那好吧。

original: You're always welcome to take whatever you want, lover.
translation: 你要拿什么都随便，亲爱的。

original: Sure, gimme whatever you got.
translation: 当然，把你有的全给我。

original: Yes, by all means, let's.
translation: 没错。我们来吧。

original: RL-3 comes equipped with everything a good soldier needs! But your RL-3 can assist in carrying equipment, if needed.
translation: RL-3配备了全套的士兵装备！而在需要时，你的RL-3还可以帮你携带物品。

original: I want to access your storage module.
translation: 我要访问你的存储模块。

original: In the words of Elder Theis: "A Brother well equipped is a Brother keeping to his duty."
translation: 泰斯长老说过：“只有装备优良的兄弟会才能做好本职工作。”

original: Enough about tactics.
translation: 战术方面就聊到这儿吧。

original: If you are through giving orders, then let us move on.
translation: 如果你下完命令了，那么我们就出发吧。

original: Yeah. Less talking about killing. More killing!
translation: 是的。少说杀人，多去杀人！

original: It is always a subject worthy of discussion.
translation: 这一直是个值得讨论的话题。

original: About time. Seriously.
translation: 早该这样了。真的。

original: Agreed! Now it is time to apply those tactics!
translation: 同意！现在是时候运用那些战术了！

original: Indeed. There are far more interesting things in the world than warfare.
translation: 事实上。世界上有很多比战争更有趣的事。

original: Yes, enough about boring old tactics.
translation: 是的，听够了无聊的老战术。

original: Keep your distance. Try to flank them.
translation: 保持距离。设法从侧翼包抄他们。

original: It was my goal to continue doing so until you told me otherwise.
translation: 我的任务就是一直这么做，直到你改变命令。

original: Keep hanging back.
translation: 退后。

original: Very well. I will seek out better positions to cover you while you forge ahead.
translation: 很好。你前进的时候，我会找一些更好的地点掩护你。

original: That's what I'm doing. Why do you think I'm standing back here in East Bumfuck?
translation: 那正是我在做的。否则你认为我为什么站在后面这么远？

original: Keep hanging back.
translation: 退后。

original: Ha! Good plan. I'll try to get around behind 'em. I like how you think, kid.
translation: 哈！好主意。我会试着绕到他们后面。我喜欢你的想法，孩子。

original: I've had no compelling reason to do anything different from what you asked.
translation: 我对你的要求没有疑问。

original: Keep hanging back.
translation: 退后。

original: Ha! Good plan. I'll try to get around behind 'em. I like how you think, kid.
translation: 哈！好主意。我会试着绕到他们后面。我喜欢你的想法，孩子。

original: I get any farther, I might as well be back in the bar. And that's sounding like a better idea all the time, trust me.
translation: 再远些的话，我还不如回酒吧去。那无论何时听起来都是个好主意，相信我。

original: Keep hanging back.
translation: 退后。

original: What, don't you like my aftershave?
translation: 怎么，不喜欢我用的须后水的气味吗？

original: Yeah, got it. Flanking and tactics and stuff. Right.
translation: 嗯，明白了。侧面进攻和战术什么的。了解。

original: If you insist, sir, but RL-3 functions best when closer to the fight!
translation: 如果你坚持，长官。不过RL-3型在近战中可以发挥最大作用！

original: Keep hanging back.
translation: 退后。

original: Stealth flanking mode active!
translation: 潜行侧翼包抄模式启动！

original: By all means. I simply hope I'm not too far in reserve, in case of unforeseen trouble.
translation: 尽我所能。只是希望不会太靠后，以免遭遇一些不可预期的麻烦。

original: Keep hanging back.
translation: 退后。

original: A sound plan. I trust this isn't simply to avoid being seen with a Super Mutant?
translation: 好主意。我相信这不仅是为了不被超级变种人发现这么简单？

original: Eulogy used to like me to stay ten steps behind him. Usually.

original: I shall wait here until your party is smaller.

original: What? What are you talking about? Do nothing?
translation: 什么？你说什么？什么都不做？

original: Take care of your own problems.
translation: 处理好你自己的问题。

original: That's a shame, stranger. A real shame. Let me know if you change your mind, we'll still need the parts.
translation: 真是太遗憾了，陌生人。如果你改变了主意就告诉我，我们仍需要那些零件。

original: Sure, Winthrop. I think I can help you out.
translation: 当然，温思罗普。我想我能帮你的忙。

original: Well, alright. That's good to hear, stranger. Just come on back to me when you've gathered some Scrap Metal.
translation: 那好吧，很高兴听到你这么说，陌生人。收集到一些废金属就来找我。

original: You'll find it just about anywhere -- on junked robots, in old buildings, you name it.
translation: 你可以在任何地方找到它 — 废弃的机器人身上，旧房子里，到处有。

original: This is so fascinating, I can't bear to talk about it any longer.
translation: 真迷人，我都说不出话了。

original: Hey, you asked. Don't blame me if you don't like what you hear.
translation: 嗨，这是你问的。你要是不喜欢，可别怪我。

original: Why? What's wrong?
translation: 为什么？有什么问题？

original: We've scavenged just about all of the scrap metal from all of the places we can safely get to.
translation: 我们到了所有能安全抵达的地方，收集了所有的废金属。

original: We're scraping the bottom of the barrel here. Hell, not before long, I'm gonna have to disassemble poor ol' Cerberus for parts.
translation: 我们已经山穷水尽了。见鬼，不用多久，我就只能从可怜的老地狱犬身上拆零件了。

original: Hey, you get around, don't you? Tell you what, you bring me back any Scrap Metal you find out there and I'll trade you whatever I can.
translation: 嗨，你在四处游历吗？告诉你，如果你能带回找到的废金属，我会用东西来和你交换。

original: We can work out a trade. We've got some stuff around here that we don't need, but a smoothskin like you might make use of it.
translation: 我们可以进行交易。有些东西我们不太需要，但对像你这样的光皮肤可能会有用。

original: What do you do around here, Winthrop?
translation: 你在这干嘛？温思罗普。

original: Me? I keep every hunk of old rusted pre-war garbage around here in operating condition.
translation: 我？我维护生锈的战前废物，让它们还能运作。

original: We've got lights, water, and ventilation all running off the old crap they used to keep this place going for the tourists.
translation: 曾为游客而准备的光线，水分和空气正流失殆尽。

original: I've managed to keep it going so far, but... well, I'm not sure how long I can keep it up.
translation: 我一直设法维持机器运作，但……嗯，我不确定还可以维持多久。

original: Me? I keep every hunk of old rusted pre-war garbage around here in operating condition.
translation: 我？我维护生锈的战前废物，让它们还能运作。

original: We've got lights, water, and ventilation all running off the old crap they used to keep this place going for the tourists.
translation: 曾为游客而准备的光线，水分和空气正流失殆尽。

original: I've managed to keep it going so far, but... well, I'm not sure how long I can keep it up.
translation: 我一直设法维持机器运作，但……嗯，我不确定还可以维持多久。

original: It's a tough job. I wouldn't want it.
translation: 这是个艰巨的工作，我不想做了。

original: I heard Danvers has his job now.
translation: 我听说丹佛斯有工作了。

original: I hope they find someone to fill his shoes soon.
translation: 我希望他们能尽快找到代替他的人。

original: We used to have two guards here. Me and an older girl named Caps.
translation: 我们曾有两个守卫，我和一个叫“帽子”的年长女孩。

original: But since the last time Raiders attacked, it's just been me.
translation: 但自从上次歹徒袭击后，就只剩下我了。

original: I really miss Caps.
translation: 我真想念“帽子”。

original: Are you the only guard on the front gate?
translation: 前门就你一个守卫？

original: Now I am, yeah. But I'm a good guard, and no one's getting by me, now.
translation: 现在只有我了。不过我是个好守卫，没有人可以从我这过去。

original: Are you the only guard on the front gate?
translation: 前门就你一个守卫？

original: Yeah. Right now, we don't even have anyone to cover me when I'm asleep.
translation: 嗯。现在我睡觉时，没人能保护我。

original: Now leave me alone, I've got to be ready for duty soon.
translation: 现在离我远点，我要准备上岗了。

original: Don't you guard the front gate?
translation: 你不是前门的守卫吗？

original: It's so dull! Practically nothing ever tries to come through the back gate anymore, so I never get to shoot anyone.
translation: 真无聊！实际上从没人尝试从后门进入，所以我一直没机会开枪。

original: I wish I was at the front gate, but RJ specifically put me back here. Up front, at least there's a chance I can shoot some unwanted visitors.
translation: 我希望我能看守前门，可镇长特别安排我来看守后门。在前门，至少我还有机会教训一下那些图谋不轨的不速之客。

original: Which could have included you, mungo.
translation: 可能就包括你，毛人。

original: What's it like, guarding the back gate?
translation: 守卫后门是什么感觉？

original: Well, technically, I'm patrolling and "keeping the peace."
translation: 嗯，技术上，我在巡逻和“维持和平”。

original: Mostly that involves making sure people are happy and not getting into trouble. You can't very well keep the peace if you've already lost it, see?
translation: 主要就是让大家开心和避免他们陷入麻烦。假如已经丧失了和平，你又怎么能维护它呢，明白吗？

original: So - bam! Jokes! Wanna hear one?
translation: 那 — 哄骗！玩笑！想听一个吗？

original: You said you're in charge of "morale." What does that mean?
translation: 你说你是负责“士气”的。这是什么意思？

original: No, because Princess always bosses me around and there's never nothing to gun.
translation: 不，因为公主总是把我差来遣去，而且这里总有些东西可以当靶子。

original: That's all I'm gonna say while she's around.
translation: 当她在附近时，我只会这样说。

original: Do you enjoy guarding the back gate?
translation: 你喜欢守卫后门吗？

original: No, because Princess always bosses me around and there's never nothing to gun.
translation: 不，因为公主总是把我差来遣去，而且这里从来都不缺靶子。

original: She's always making fun of me just because she's angry all the time about her nickname and not being in charge and stuff.
translation: 她总为她的绰号和没有管理权这些是而生气，然后就拿我开玩笑来出气。

original: Do you enjoy guarding the back gate?
translation: 你喜欢守卫后门吗？

original: Can you give me directions?
translation: 你可以给我些提示吗？

original: Okay, where are you going?
translation: 好的，你要去哪？

original: Well, where to?
translation: 嗯，去哪？

original: I should be able to do that.
translation: 我应该能做办到。

original: I dunno. I still get lost sometimes. Things are really big.
translation: 我不知道。我现在仍然会偶尔迷路。这里真的很大。

original: No. Scram.
translation: 不。滚开。

original: Where to, man?
translation: 哥们，去哪？

original: To where, man?
translation: 哥们，去哪？

original: Where? I've been just about everywhere down here, so I can get you to anywhere down here.
translation: 你想去哪？我去过这的所有地方，所以我可以带你去。

original: Where to, mungo?
translation: 去哪？毛人。

original: What do I look like, your tour guide?
translation: 我看上去像什么，你的导游吗？

original: It sure is! Nice work bringing them back.
translation: 当然！你把他们带回来了，干得漂亮。

original: You didn't happen to bring anything else back, did you? Stories, jokes, lessons for the folks here?
translation: 你有没有顺便带点其他东西回来？比如故事、笑话、教材，给这的人？

original: Speaking of which: I'm Knock Knock, and I keep people's spirits up down here. If you want to trade jokes, just knock knock on my door!
translation: 说到这：我是诺克敲门，我总是让人们精神振奋。如果你要和我交流笑话，那就敲敲我的门！

original: I'm the big hero who rescued your friends from the Slavers. How's that for cool?
translation: 我就是那个从奴隶贩子手中救出你朋友的大英雄。怎么样，很酷吧？

original: Being a jerk about it isn't necessary. In fact, if you've got any interesting stories from up there, and you're looking to tell them, let me know.
translation: 没必要表现得像个蠢货。事实上，如果你在外边听见什么有趣的故事，而且你又想说给别人听的话，你可以找我。

original: I'm Knock Knock, and I keep people's spirits up down here. If you want to trade jokes, just knock knock on my door!
translation: 我是诺克敲门，我总是让人们精神振奋。如果你要和我交流笑话，那就敲敲我的门！

original: I'm from up above. So stay out of my way, kid.
translation: 我是上面派来的。小子，别挡路。

original: But wait, you don't even know who I am yet!
translation: 等一下，你还不知道我是谁吧！

original: Beat it, kid. You bother me.
translation: 小子，滚开，你好烦啊。

original: Boo-hoo. You big baby.
translation: 嘘，你这大男孩。

original: You're still a mungo, and I still don't like mungos.
translation: 你还是个毛人，我还是不喜欢毛人。

original: You want a party or something, you go pay some mungos to be your friends and they can all talk about how great you are. How's that?
translation: 你想开个聚会还是什么？你是不是想给毛人一些钱，好让他们做你的朋友，然后他们就会说你有多伟大。这个想法怎么样？

original: Gee, what a great reception for a returning hero.
translation: 哟，这个为英雄归来而准备的迎接仪式真是隆重啊。

original: Just give it a shot, mungo. You'll see plenty of my adult-sized stones when I'm pissing on your grave.
translation: 毛人，你尽管试试。当我对着你的墓碑撒尿时，我会让你好好见识下我的大小。

original: Sure, if you've got the adult-sized stones to stop me.
translation: 好啊，除非你是大人，否则休想阻止我。

original: I don't threaten strangers - I shoot them. But since we're not strangers anymore, that's not a problem. Right?
translation: 我不会恐吓陌生人 — 我会直接对他们开枪。可如果我们熟了的话，那就没是什么问题了，对吧？

original: I'm Stacey, and I take care of the front gate. If you're going in or out, I'll take care of it.
translation: 我叫斯泰西，我负责看守前门。如果你要进出的话，就得让我来处理。

original: I'm new in town, and you're already threatening me? Not a good start.
translation: 我刚来到这镇子，你就威胁我？这可不是一个好的开始。

original: My name's not kid. It's Stacey. And I don't threaten strangers - just shoot them.
translation: 别拿我的名字斯泰西来开玩笑，还有我不会恐吓陌生人 — 我会直接对他们开枪。

original: Lucky thing you're not a stranger anymore. Least, not as long as MacCready says you aren't.
translation: 幸运的是你不再算是陌生人。至少麦迪说你不是你就不是。

original: I'm new in town, and you're already threatening me? Not a good start, kid.
translation: 我刚来镇上，你就威胁我？这可不是一个好的开始，小子。

original: You brought back Penny and Sammy and Squirrel? Well, I guess that does make you a pretty big hero. Thanks!
translation: 你把佩尼，萨米和“松鼠”带回来了？太好了，我猜那会让你成为一个超级大英雄。谢谢！

original: I'm Lucy, and I'm pretty much the mom around here. And that means I spend a lot of time kissing boo-boos and making things all better.
translation: 我是露西，我几乎成了这地方的妈妈。这也意味着我要花很多时间来照顾伤患，这样他们才能好起来。

original: So, if you ever get any scrapes or bruises - or if you get shot, stabbed, or radiated - stop by and I'll do what I can, big hero.
translation: 哦，如果你被擦伤或撞伤 — 或者被射伤、刺伤，辐射 — 就到我这来，我会尽我所能为你疗伤，大英雄。

original: I rescued those captured kids. I'm a big hero.
translation: 我救了那些被抓的孩子。我是个大英雄。

original: Well, if you brought them back, then I guess that explains why RJ let you in. So, I guess that does make you a big hero.
translation: 好极了，你把他们带回来了，我就说为什么镇长会让你进来。看来你要成大英雄了。

original: I'm Lucy, and I'm pretty much mommy to the folks here. I try to keep them safe, and when that's not enough I patch up their cuts and bruises.
translation: 我是露西，我几乎成了这群家伙的妈妈了。我尽力保护他们，并且还得帮他们包扎被割伤和撞伤的伤口。

original: And when that's not enough, I make sure they get a funeral. Thanks for making sure I didn't have to do that for three more of mine.
translation: 但那还没完，我还得安葬不幸死去的人。谢谢你，让我不用多做三次。

original: I rescued those captured kids. I'm a big hero.
translation: 我救了那些被抓的孩子。我是个大英雄。

original: Oh, is it? Well, I'm Lucy, and I'm the doctor in town. From the sound of it, I'll be seeing a lot of you. Or your work.
translation: 哦，是吗？好吧，我是露西，我是这镇的医生。因此我想我会经常看到你，或跟你打交道的。

original: I'm new in town, and that's all you need to know.
translation: 我是新来镇上的，你知道这个就够了。

original: That was you? Well, you brought my sister Penny back, so sure, I'll call you a big hero. Thank you very much.
translation: 是你？嗯，你把我的妹妹佩尼带回来了，你是我的大英雄。非常感谢你。

original: I'm Joseph, and as the oldest kid in Lamplight, I'm pretty much a teacher by default. I also try to keep the kids clean and fresh-faced.
translation: 我是约瑟夫，作为小灯镇里年龄最大的小孩，我几乎是默认的老师。我也会让他们保持清洁和精神饱满。

original: I'm not sure if there's anything I can teach you, but if you need a haircut or the like, just say the word. And thanks again.
translation: 我不能确定还能教你什么，但如果你想理发或类似的事，和我说下就行。还有再次谢谢你。

original: I'm the big hero who saved those kidnapped kids.
translation: 我是救出那些被绑架的孩子的大英雄。

original: Well, if MacCready let you in, I'm sure he's got his reasons.
translation: 嗯，如果麦迪让你进来，我想他一定有他的理由。

original: I'm Joseph, and as the oldest kid in Lamplight, I'm pretty much a teacher by default.
translation: 我是约瑟夫，作为小灯镇里年龄最大的小孩，我几乎是默认的老师。

original: I'm not sure if there's anything I can teach you, but if you need a haircut or the like, just say the word.
translation: 我不能确定还能教你什么，但如果你想理发或类似的事，和我说下就行。

original: I'm new. Get used to me.
translation: 我是新来的。习惯就好。

original: You got that right! After our regular meals, I bet some of us would give that a shot! If we had a brahmin down here, that is.
translation: 你说的没错！在我们吃完饭后，我打赌有些人会试试！如果我们有双头牛，那就好了。

original: Listen, my name's Eclair - don't laugh - and I'm in charge of the food down here. We haven't got much, but I do what I can to spice it up.
translation: 听着，我叫“夹心奶条” — 不许笑 — 我在这是负责食物的。我们没有多少可以吃的，但我都会尽量去做得好吃点。

original: If you need a meal down here, just talk with me. You'll hardly even know you're eating cave mold.
translation: 如果你想吃饭，就和我说。你甚至很难吃出那是洞穴霉菌。

original: I'd rather eat a Brahmin turd sandwich. With no bread.
translation: 没有面包的话，我情愿吃双头牛粪便做的三明治。

original: Oh, really? So you're saying you brought back three more hungry mouths, too? Great, you're just making my day better and better!
translation: 哦，真的？你是说你还带回了三张饥饿的嘴？太好了，你让我的日子更好过了！

original: Look, I'm Eclair, and I'm in charge of the crap we call food down here. And we've got precious little enough to go around as it is.
translation: 听着，我是“夹心奶条”，我管理着我们称为食物的垃圾。我们很珍惜这些恰好足以维持生命的垃圾。

original: So, yeah, thanks for bringing those folks back alive, but don't expect me to throw you a big party over it.
translation: 嗯，感谢你把那些人活着带回来，但别指望我为你开一个大的庆功宴。

original: Hey, I rescued those kids from the Slavers. You owe me some respect, kid.
translation: 嘿，我从奴隶贩子手中救出了这些孩子。小子，你该尊重我一点。

original: That's a shame. I was going to serve yours with extra lung butter.
translation: 真遗憾。我还打算为你额外加点痰。

original: My name's Eclair, and I've dealt with bigger threats than you. So watch your step.
translation: 我的名字是“夹心奶条”，我处理过比你更大的麻烦，所以你最好悠着点儿。

original: Don't make me laugh. I don't give a damn about your food.
translation: 别逗我了。我不会给你吃的东西。

original: Oh, okay. Bye.
translation: 哦，好的，再见。

original: None of your business, squirt.
translation: 小不点，这不关你的事。

original: You don't look like a monster. Eclair says monsters are green or got all kinds of arms and you only got two and they're like mine.
translation: 你看上去不像怪物，“夹心奶条”说怪物是绿色的，还有一堆手臂。而你只有两只手，和我的手也很像。

original: You just look like a mungo, and Knock Knock says they don't eat people unless they're lost and have to.
translation: 你看上去就像一个毛人，诺克敲门说他们不吃人，除非他们疯了。

original: I'm a terrible monster, come to eat you up!
translation: 我是可怕的怪兽，我要把你们都吃了！

original: Oh, you'll listen to me. Otherwise, I'll have my good pal RJ kick you out of the town. Or better yet, lock you in the vault.
translation: 哦，你得听我的。否则，我会和我的好伙计麦迪把你从这镇里踢出去。或者更妙，把你锁进避难所。

original: So don't push me, new meat. Just nod and move on and I think we'll get along just fine.
translation: 别催我，新来的。你只要点头然后走开，我想我们会相处得很融洽。

original: Did you just try to give me orders? That's cute, little Princess.
translation: 你是在命令我吗，公主？有意思。

original: Now listen up! I'm Princess, and I don't care what RJ says, when you're around me, I'm in charge.
translation: 现在听好了！我是公主，我不在乎麦迪怎么说，在我身边，就要听我的。

original: Give me any trouble, mungo, and I can get you kicked out of here in a flash. Or worse.
translation: 毛人，你要是带给我麻烦的话，我就立刻把你从这踢出去。或者更糟。

original: I don't work for anyone. But give me any trouble, and you'll regret it.
translation: 我不为任何人工作。不过如果你找我麻烦的话，你会后悔的。

original: It sure isn't bad! Nice work bringing them back.
translation: 这当然是好事！把他们带回来了，干得好。

original: You didn't happen to bring anything else back, did you? Gear, equipment, bric-a-brac?
translation: 你有没有顺便带点其他东西回来？护具，装备，小古董？

original: Speaking of which: I'm Knick Knack, and I run the store down here. If you want to trade anything, come on by the Souvenir Store and we'll talk.
translation: 自我介绍：我叫尼克窍门，我在这经营商店。如果你想交易什么，就来纪念品商店，我们可以谈谈。

original: I'm the big hero who rescued your friends from the Slavers. How's that for cool?
translation: 我是从奴隶贩子手中救出你朋友的大英雄。怎么样，酷吧？

original: You don't have to be a jerk about it. In fact, if you've got stuff from up above, and you're looking to get rid of some of it, let me know.
translation: 你不必表现得像个蠢货。事实上，如果你找到什么你用不上的东西，可以来找我。

original: I'm Knick Knack, and I run the store down here. If you want to trade anything, come on by the Souvenir Store and we'll talk.
translation: 我叫尼克窍门，我在这经营商店，如果你想交易什么，就来纪念品商店，我们可以谈谈。

original: I'm from up above. So stay out of my way, kid.
translation: 我是上面派来的。小子，别挡路。

original: New kids don't tend to walk up every day. We haven't had very good luck with visitors recently.
translation: 不会每天都有新的孩子来这，我们这最近没有访客来。

original: Anyway, I'm Stacey, and I guard the front gate. If you need in or out, I can take care of that.
translation: 不管怎样，我是斯泰西，我守卫前门。如果你需要进出，我会处理。

original: Well, I'm glad there wasn't any blood over a misunderstanding.
translation: 我很高兴没有因为误会而发生冲突。

original: Only people who use that gate are strangers. And most strangers aren't welcome here.
translation: 从那门通过的都是陌生人。而大部分陌生人在这都不受欢迎。

original: I'm Stacey, and I make sure strangers stay out. If the mayor hadn't let you in himself, I'd make sure you stayed out, too.
translation: 我是斯泰西，我确保陌生人无法进入这里。如果没有镇长的准许，我也会将你拒之门外。

original: Well, I'm glad there wasn't any blood over a misunderstanding.
translation: 我很高兴没有因为误会而发生冲突。

original: You saved Penny and Sammy and Squirrel? I can see why RJ let you in! Thanks, for all of us!
translation: 你救了佩尼、萨米和“松鼠”？我明白为什么麦迪让你进来了！谢谢，代表我们所有人！

original: I'm Lucy, and I pretty much spend my days playing mommy around here. I spend a lot of time kissing boo-boos and making things better.
translation: 我是露西，我大部分时间都在扮演妈妈的角色。花费大量时间来亲亲伤口，让一切都好起来。

original: If you get a scraped knee or stubbed toe, come see me. Same if you get shot in the face or burns all over, but I can only promise so much.
translation: 如果你擦伤了膝盖或被踩伤了脚趾，就来找我。如果你脸部被射伤或全身烧伤，你也可以来找我，但我可能什么也做不了。

original: I'm a guest in town. Mayor MacCready let me in for rescuing your friends.
translation: 我是镇里的客人。是麦迪市长让我进来救你的朋友。

original: Well, it's good that you're safe in here, now. The Wastes can be dangerous, although you look like you've done alright out there.
translation: 嗯，现在你在这很安全，这很好。废土很危险，虽然你看起来在外边过得还不错。

original: I'm Lucy, and I'm the closest thing we've got to a doctor around here. If you get yourself into trouble, see if you can drag yourself back here.
translation: 我是露西，是这最接近医生的人。如果你遇到了麻烦，就尽量回到我这看看。

original: Mayor MacCready let me in. I don't want to cause any problems.
translation: 是麦迪市长让我进来的。我不想惹麻烦。

original: If you convinced RJ that you're safe, I guess I'll go along. But if you do start trouble, you'll regret it.
translation: 如果麦迪觉得你安全，我想我也会这样认为。但如果你开始找麻烦，你一定会后悔。

original: I'm Lucy, the doctor here. That means I handle the funerals, too. So much as look at a kid the wrong way, and I'll be seeing you again.
translation: 我是露西，这的医生。那意味着我也处理葬礼。我见过太多的葬礼以至于我会错看一个孩子，我想我会再次见到你的。

original: Mayor MacCready let me in. I don't want to cause any problems.
translation: 是麦迪市长让我进来的。我不想惹麻烦。

original: That was you? Well, my most sincere thanks, then. You brought my sister Penny back to me, and I couldn't ask more than that.
translation: 那是你？嗯，请接受我最诚挚的感谢。你把我的妹妹佩尼带回来了，我无法要求你做得更多。

original: I'm Joseph, and if there's ever anything I can do for you here, just name it!
translation: 我是约瑟夫，如果有什么是我能为你做的，尽管开口！

original: As the oldest kid in town, I spend most of my time teaching, but I do what I can to keep the kids clean and fresh-faced.
translation: 作为镇里最年长的孩子，我花费大部分时间用于教学，不过我也尽可能地确保孩子的卫生和健康。

original: Say, if you're ever looking for a haircut, I'd be glad to offer my services. You only have to ask!
translation: 如果你想理发，我很乐于为你服务。尽管开口！

original: Mayor MacCready let me in for rescuing those kids.
translation: 麦迪市长让我进来解救那些孩子。

original: I'm Joseph, and around here, I might as well be the old wise man. Try not to interrupt my classes, and I think we'll get along just fine.
translation: 我是约瑟夫，在这，我应该就算是年长的智者。别打扰我上课，那样我们就可以相处融洽。

original: As the oldest kid in town, I spend most of my time teaching, but I do what I can to keep the kids clean and fresh-faced.
translation: 作为镇里最年长的孩子，我花费大部分时间用于教学，不过我也尽可能地确保孩子的卫生和健康。

original: If you're looking for a haircut, feel free to ask. I'll do what I can.
translation: 如果你想理发，只管说。我会尽力而为。

original: Mayor MacCready let me in. I don't want to cause any problems.
translation: 麦迪市长让我进来解救那些孩子。

original: Okay, either you're a dirty liar or you're some sort of freak.
translation: 好吧，你要么是卑鄙的骗子，要么就是某种怪胎。

original: Either way, you should fit in just fine around here! Folks call me Eclair, and I'm in charge of keeping this place fed.
translation: 不管怎样，你都应该好好适应这里的生活！人们叫我“夹心奶条”，我让这地方可以团结一致。

original: You need a meal, you come ask me. There's not much to go around, and it all tastes bad, but it'll keep you alive, and that's good enough.
translation: 你想要吃饭，就来找我。这没有多少可以吃的，而且所有东西都很难吃，但这些至少可以让你活下去，那已经不错了。

original: That sounds delicious.
translation: 听上去不错。

original: Oh, great. Maybe next, he'll take in a Deathclaw or something. And he'll make it the town mascot.
translation: 哦，好极了。或许下次，他会带来一个死亡爪或什么。然后他会将它制成镇子的吉祥物。

original: But anyway, yeah, thanks for bringing them back in one piece. Maybe now they'll learn to be more careful out there!
translation: 总之，谢谢你把他们安全带回，我想现在他们已经明白下次出去要更加小心！

original: If you need what passes for food down here, look me up. Name's Eclair, and if you so much as snicker, I'll carve you up for steaks.
translation: 如果你需要食物，就来找我，“夹心奶条”。但要是你敢来偷，我会把你切成肉片。

original: The Mayor let me in for rescuing those kidnapped kids.
translation: 是麦迪市长让我来解救那些被绑架的孩子。

original: Oh, great. Maybe next, he'll take in a Deathclaw or something. He can make it the town mascot.
translation: 哦，好极了。或许下次，他会带来一个死亡爪或什么。他会将它制成镇子的吉祥物。

original: Anyway, my name's Eclair, and yes, I take care of the food here. Don't expect any scraps from our table.
translation: 总之，我的名字是“夹心奶条”，而且没错，我也负责管理这的食物。别指望从我们的餐桌上分一份。

original: The Mayor let me in. I'm not planning on causing trouble.
translation: 是镇长让我进来的。我可不想惹麻烦。

original: It's nice to meet you, too. Did you come from the vault? I heard there's monsters down there.
translation: 我也很高兴见到你。你是从避难所来的？我听说那有怪物。

original: Eclair told me once, one of them, they got him and bit him right in the face and that's why he's only got one eye.
translation: “夹心奶条”曾经告诉过我，他们抓住了他们中的一个并狠狠咬了他脸一口，这就是他只有一只眼睛的原因。

original: But you don't look like a monster, and I don't think you'd bite anyone in the face. You look like a nice vault dweller.
translation: 不过你看上去不像怪物，我认为你也不会去咬谁的脸。你看上去就像一个友善的避难所居民。

original: Sometimes, people call me the Vault Dweller. It's nice to meet you.
translation: 有时人们叫我避难所居民。很高兴认识你。

original: Did you live in the old vault below? I thought nobody lives down there now because it was full of monsters.
translation: 你在下面的旧避难所住过？我还以为那没有人，因为那里到处都是怪物。

original: Mayor doesn't let us go down there because when they went they didn't come back.
translation: 镇长不让我们去那下面，因为有些人去了后就再没回来。

original: You don't look like someone who didn't come back, so maybe you didn't come from there.
translation: 你看起来不像会一去不回的人，或许你不是从那来的。

original: I'm not any of those. I'm a Vault Dweller. At least, I was when I was your age.
translation: 我和他们不同。我是一个避难所居民。至少，我在你这么大的时候还是。

original: Good! Glad we've got that settled. Stay out of my way, and there won't be any problems.
translation: 太好了！很高兴我们能搞定它。闪开，不会有问题了。

original: Whatever you say.
translation: 随你怎么说。

original: Oh, you think Sammy and the rest wouldn't have gotten back on their own eventually? I taught him better than that.
translation: 哦，你觉得萨米和其他人最终没法自己回来？我的徒弟可比你想象的要强。

original: Well, if you're sticking around, you ought to know that I'm Princess, and I call the shots around here.
translation: 嗯，如果你老在这里转悠，你该知道我是公主，还有在这我说了算。

original: And don't forget it, mungo!
translation: 别忘了，毛人！

original: The Mayor let me in because I rescued some of your friends.
translation: 是镇长让我进来的，因为我救了你的朋友。

original: Well, if you're sticking around, you ought to know that I'm Princess, and I call the shots around here.
translation: 嗯，如果你老在这里转悠，你该知道我是公主，还有在这我说了算。

original: And don't forget it, mungo!
translation: 别忘了，毛人！

original: The Mayor let me in. I'm not here to cause problems.
translation: 是镇长让我进来的。我可不想惹麻烦。

original: Oh, that was you? Nice work! I hope one of you grabbed some of their gear before you left - gotta make them pay for something like that.
translation: 哦，那是你？干得好！我希望你在离开前没忘了带走他们的一些东西 — 是该让他们付出点代价。

original: Speaking of which, I'm Knick Knack, and I take care of the general store around here.
translation: 自我介绍：我叫尼克窍门，我打理着这的杂货店。

original: Which is to say, I collect a lot of stuff, and sometimes trade it for other stuff. That's pretty much a store, see?
translation: 也就是说，我收集很多东西，有时我会用它们来换其它东西。实际上就是个商店，明白吗？

original: I'm from Vault 101, and I rescued some of your friends from the Slavers.
translation: 我来自101号避难所，是我从奴隶贩子手中救了你的朋友。

original: In that case, I'm Knick Knack, and I take care of the general store around here.
translation: 我是尼克窍门，我打理着这的杂货店。

original: Which is to say, I collect a lot of stuff, and sometimes trade it for other stuff. That's pretty much a store, see?
translation: 也就是说，我收集很多东西，有时我会用它们来换其它东西。实际上就是个商店，明白吗？

original: The Mayor let me in. I'm not here to cause any trouble.
translation: 是镇长让我进来的。我可不想惹麻烦。

original: Oh, was that you? Nice work! I hope you got some good laughs out of it before you left - gotta make sure they know not to try that again!
translation: 是你干的？干的漂亮！我希望你离开前尽情嘲笑 — 确保他们知道以后别再那样！

original: Speaking of which, I'm Knock Knock, and I take care of the general morale around here.
translation: 自我介绍：我叫诺克敲门，我负责这附近的士气问题。

original: Which is to say, I collect a lot of stories, and sometimes trade them to keep the others amused. Morale's better than less-al, see?
translation: 也就是说，我收集很多故事，有时我会用来它们来鼓舞士气。士气高昂好过低头丧气，明白吗？

original: I'm from Vault 101, and I rescued some of your friends from the Slavers.
translation: 我是从101号避难所过来的，是我从奴隶贩子手中救了你的朋友。

original: Always good to hear, but not even any fun trouble? Even a little?
translation: 我总是很乐意听故事，你难道连有趣的烦恼都没有？哪怕只是一点？

original: See, I collect a lot of stories, and sometimes trade them to keep the others amused. A bit of fun trouble is always good for morale.
translation: 看，我收集了很多故事，有时会用它们来鼓舞士气。一点有趣的烦恼总能令人士气高昂。

original: Morale's better than less-al, see?
translation: 士气高昂好过低头丧气，明白吗？

original: The Mayor let me in. I'm not here to cause any trouble.
translation: 是市长让我来的。我可不是来惹麻烦。

original: That's good, they don't like me having my gun in town, so I gotta turn it in first, so if I had to shoot you you'd have to wait a bit.
translation: 那很好，他们不喜欢我在镇里携枪，因此我事先上交了，所以如果我不得不向你开枪，你还得在这等我一会儿。

original: My name's Zip. I don't think that's short for anything, because I don't know what it'd be short for. Zippy? Zipperick? Ziptholomew?
translation: 我的名字叫拉链，我觉得我的名字不是缩写，因为我不知道它是什么的缩写。吉帕？吉帕瑞克？吉帕多罗买？

original: So yeah, it's good to meet you, big kid, and maybe you've got big kid stuff from up top. Do you have any Nuka-Cola, maybe? Yes? Please?
translation: 嗯，很高兴见到你，大孩子，或许你在上面拿到了一些大孩子用的东西。有核子可乐吗？有吗？

original: No, you don't need to shoot me. Just think of me as a big kid.
translation: 不，你用不着开枪打我。你就把我当成一个大孩子好了。

original: Oh, that's good because Mayor MacCready says I can't have my gun in town anymore, not since last time, but that was totally an accident anyway!
translation: 哦，那很好，因为自从那次以后，麦迪镇长说我不能再在镇里携枪了，可那纯粹是场意外啊！

original: That reminds me, got any Nuka-Cola? 'Cause if I'm not gonna have a gun in town, then it must be okay for me to have more Nuka, right?
translation: 那提醒了我，有核子可乐吗？因为既然我不能再在镇里携枪，那么我应该可以拿更多核子可乐，对吧？

original: Anyway, everyone calls me Zip, you know, like a zipper, only not really like that because I'm not made of metal, but I do go up and down, I guess.
translation: 总之，每个人都叫我拉链，你知道，像一条拉链。我猜他们之所以这样叫我，是因为虽然我不是用铁做的，但我总是像拉链一样上下走动。

original: No, no, I'm not here to cause any problems! You don't need your gun!
translation: 不，不，我不是来惹麻烦的！你不用拿枪！

original: Good. Better stay that way, mungo.
translation: 好的。最好待在那，毛人。

original: I'm not planning on starting any trouble.
translation: 我并不想惹麻烦。

original: Well, I could call you a shithead, but then all these other shitheads wouldn't know which shithead I was talking to. Shithead.
translation: 嗯，我可以叫你白痴，但其他白痴会不知道我在叫谁。白痴。

original: So it looks like you're stuck with mungo, mungo.
translation: 看起来你只能叫毛人了，毛人。

original: It means an adult. We don't really see many of you around, and we're glad of it.
translation: 意思是大人。在附近我们很少见到你这样的人，我们乐于如此。

original: I mean, you brought back the little ones, so you're okay. But mostly, we only ever see raiders and people who want to take our caves.
translation: 我的意思是，你带回了那些小家伙，所以你是好人。不过大多数时候，我们只会见到歹徒和想占领我们洞穴的家伙。

original: If you didn't have MacCready's permission, you'd probably be shot just for being in here. We don't take any more chances.
translation: 如果没有得到麦迪的允许，你只是站在这，都可能有人向你开枪，因为我们不想碰运气。

original: Why does everyone call me a mungo?
translation: 为什么每个人都叫我毛人？

original: I'm pretty sure it comes from "humongous." Because, to everyone here, you're pretty big, you know?
translation: 我很确定它来自“巨人国”。因为，对这所有的人来说，你确实很巨大，知道吗？

original: Mungos been pretty bad to Lamplighters, for as long as our history goes back. They just don't trust anyone over sixteen.
translation: 小灯镇居民不欢迎毛人，一直如此。我们不相信超过16岁的人。

original: Really, you're pretty lucky they let you in at all. I just hope I get to visit like you do after I get kicked out.
translation: 真的，他们最后让你进来，你确实很幸运。我只希望我可以在被踢出这后，能像你一样回来看看。

original: Why do people call me mungo? What does that even mean?
translation: 为什么每个人都叫我毛人？这是什么意思？

original: Stop calling me kid, mungo.
translation: 不要再叫我孩子了，毛人。

original: Stop calling me mungo, kid.
translation: 不要再叫我毛人了，孩子。

original: Really? Because I heard from the mayor about the sorts of deals you make when you trade. None for you.
translation: 真的？因为我听镇长说过你做交易时的事情。没你份。

original: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易。

original: Sure thing, pal! Special deals for us kids!
translation: 当然，伙计！对我们这些孩子来次特别交易！

original: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易。

original: I hope you brought me some cool stuff!
translation: 我希望你会带给我一些很酷的东西！

original: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易。

original: Yeah, I heard about the sorts of things you'd do for this fungus. Well, you're cut off. Go scrounge your own food.
translation: 嗯，我听说你为了蘑菇所做的事。嗯，这不欢迎你。自己去找食物吧。

original: I'd like some food.
translation: 我需要些食物。

original: Bon appetit.
translation: 祝你胃口好。

original: I'd like some food.
translation: 我需要些食物。

original: Sure thing, mungo. We don't have much to spare, so get ready to pay.
translation: 当然，毛人。我们剩得不多，所以准备付钱吧。

original: I'd like some food.
translation: 我需要些食物。

original: Enjoy, if you've got the caps.
translation: 好好享受，如果你有瓶盖的话。

original: I'd like some food.
translation: 我需要些食物。

original: All right. Now, hold still.
translation: 好。现在别动。

original: Can you give me a haircut?
translation: 你能给我理理发吗？

original: Certainly. How would you like to look?
translation: 当然。你打算怎么做？

original: Can you give me a haircut?
translation: 你能给我理理发吗？

original: Well, I didn't get the nickname for being fat and full of cream, if that's what you're asking.
translation: 我不是因为肥头大耳满腹油脂而得名，如果你是问这个的话。

original: Back when I was on the scav team, I found some pages from an old cook book. Sometimes I try them out.
translation: 回想起以前我在拾荒队的时候，我找到了一些旧烹调书的残页，有时候我也会试着照做。

original: Just for the record, don't try making an eclair out of cave fungus. The taste sticks with you, and not in a good way.
translation: 记住，不要拿洞穴蘑菇做手指饼。那味道萦绕不散，可不是香味。

original: Why are you called Eclair?
translation: 为什么你会叫“夹心奶条”？

original: It's just a name, okay?
translation: 只是一个名字，好吗？

original: Not my fault I knock stuff over.
translation: 我打翻了东西，但那不是我的错。

original: Lucy says I still got a lot of growing to do.
translation: 露西说我要长大还得学习好多事。

original: Why do they call you Bumble?
translation: 他们为什么叫你小咕嘟？

original: I don't need to explain myself to you, mungo. Shut up and get lost.
translation: 我不需要向你解释，毛人。闭嘴，消失。

original: In fact, don't you ever bother me about something as stupid as nicknames again!
translation: 事实上，别拿绰号这类蠢事再来打扰我！

original: How did someone like you get a nickname like Princess?
translation: 为什么像你这样的人会有公主这样的绰号？

original: Well, my name was Nick. And I collect knick knacks.
translation: 嗯，我的名字是尼克。我收集些窍门小东西。

original: Not everything has to be real complex, see?
translation: 不是所有的事都那么复杂的，明白吗？

original: Why are you called Knick Knack?
translation: 为什么你会叫尼克窍门？

original: Well, when people started calling Knicky by his new name, I needed one too, see?
translation: 当人们都开始用他的新名字尼克称呼他时，我也需要一个，明白吗？

original: If you're twins, it just doesn't cut it to be called "Knick Knack and Sue."
translation: 如果你们是双胞胎，叫“尼克窍门和苏”就不合适了。

original: Why are you called Knock Knock?
translation: 为什么你会叫诺克敲门？

original: Why Zip? Or why do I have a nickname at all? I mean, why don't people just call me Ricky? Or Yancy? Or Eustace P. Vanderbanger the Third?
translation: 为什么叫拉链？还是为什么我会有绰号？我的意思是，人们为什么不叫我瑞基？或是杨西？又或是尤斯塔斯·P·范德邦赫？

original: I mean, they say it's because I'm so fast, but that doesn't make sense because I don't think I'm all that fast, it's just that they're all so slow!
translation: 我的意思是，他们说我语速很快，可是我不觉得自己有多快，只是他们太慢了！

original: I guess it's just one of those mysteries that'll never really get answered, sort of like how people made the bubbles in Nuka-Cola. Say, got any Cola?
translation: 我想那是个永远无从知晓的谜，就像人们怎么在核子可乐里弄出泡泡。说到这，有可乐吗？

original: Why are you called Zip?
translation: 为什么你会叫拉链？

original: It's not a nickname! My name's Penelope.
translation: 这不是绰号！我的名字是佩内洛普。

original: They're just lazy and don't like saying the whole thing is all.
translation: 他们只是有些懒散，并且不想叫全名罢了。

original: Why do you have the nickname Penny?
translation: 为什么你绰号叫佩尼？

original: I like to think it's because of my inquisitive and charming nature, as well as my natural climbing ability.
translation: 我觉得那是因为我的好奇心和迷人的个性，以及我天生的攀登能力。

original: But Knock Knock says it's because I'm totally nuts.
translation: 不过诺克敲门说那是因为我是个不折不扣的傻瓜。

original: Guess which one's probably right?
translation: 猜猜哪个可能是对的？

original: Why are you called Squirrel?
translation: 为什么你叫“松鼠”？

original: Nickname? What awe you tawking about?
translation: 绰号？你在熟什么？

original: Maybe I'll regret this, but how did you get your nickname, Biwwy?
translation: 也许我会后悔这么问，不过你的绰号是怎么来的？“必歪”。

original: It's great, but Bumble's always trying to bug him when he's trying to teach me.
translation: 太好了，但是小咕嘟总是想在他教导我时打扰他。

original: She's just jealous because she doesn't have a brother anymore.
translation: 她只是妒忌，因为她没有兄弟了。

original: What do you think about these classes?
translation: 你对这些课程有什么看法？

original: Yeah. What I don't like's being bugged when I'm trying to learn.
translation: 是啊。我在学习时不喜欢被打扰。

original: Do you like classes with Joseph?
translation: 你喜欢上约瑟夫的课吗？

original: I hold open classes every morning for anyone who's got an interest in learning about a subject. Obviously, voluntary attendance is usually low.
translation: 我每个早上都为所有有兴趣学习某个科目的人上课。显然，自觉上课的人总是很少。

original: I wouldn't normally let someone like you sit in, but since you saved Penny's life, it's the least I can offer.
translation: 通常情况下我是不会让像你这样的人坐进来的，不过既然你救了佩尼的命，我只能以此回报了。

original: Would you like to hear our history? It's something of a favorite.
translation: 你想听听我们的历史吗？那充满了乐趣。

original: Could you tell me about this class?
translation: 你能告诉我这个班级的事吗？

original: I hold open classes every morning for anyone who's got an interest in learning about a subject.
translation: 我每个早上都为所有有兴趣学习某个科目的人上课。

original: Obviously, voluntary attendance is usually low, so I keep myself busy here and there.
translation: 显然，自觉上课的人总是很少，因此我得忙个不停。

original: You're welcome to sit in, of course. Would you like to hear our history? It's something of a favorite with the students.
translation: 欢迎你进来坐坐，想听听我们的历史吗？学生对这都很有兴趣。

original: Could you tell me about this class?
