original: He's my neighbor and my protector as he calls it. Imagine if some nasty Raider wanted to take my stuff... he'd show them a thing or two!
translation: 就像他的名字那样，他是我的邻居和守护者。想象下如果一些讨厌的歹徒想要拿走我的东西……他会给他们点颜色看看！

original: He's such a sweetie, you should talk to him!
translation: 他是如此的贴心，你应该跟他谈谈！

original: Ugh, that sounds really disgusting!
translation: 呃，那听起来真恶心！

original: But Ronald said he liked it!
translation: 但罗纳德说他喜欢！

original: Wait a minute. How many members are in your club?
translation: 等一下。你那俱乐部里有多少会员？

original: Well... only two right now. Me and Ronald.
translation: 嗯……目前只有两个。我和罗纳德。

original: But membership is open to the public! You can join if you like!
translation: 但会员资格向公众开放！如果你喜欢，可以加入！

original: What kind of stuff do you collect, exactly?
translation: 准确来说，你收集什么样的东西？

original: Well, look around you! Toys, banners, stools... anything I can get my hands on really.
translation: 嗯，看看你的周围！玩具，横幅，凳子……我拿到手的都是货真价实的东西。

original: My pride and joy is my perfect Nuka-Cola Machine. It's barely even scratched!
translation: 让我感到无比骄傲的是我那完美的核子可乐机。它几乎崭新如初！

original: Actually, I have to give credit to Ronald for donating some of it.
translation: 事实上，我不得不信任罗纳德，而给他回馈。

original: There's a Nuka-Cola Fan Club?
translation: 这是个核子可乐玩家俱乐部？

original: Yep, I'm the President, the Recording Secretary and the Treasurer.
translation: 是，我是俱乐部的执行主席、记录文士和财政委员。

original: Once a year, we gather here in Girdershade to have a cook off using Nuka-Cola in the recipe.
translation: 一年一度，我们聚集在梁影村用核子可乐来烹饪食物。

original: Last year I won with my "Poached Roach in Nuka-Sauce". Delicious!
translation: 去年我以我的“核子酱料蟑螂肉”获胜。超级美味！

original: Ugh! I hate Nuka-Cola. That stuff is disgusting.
translation: 啊！我讨厌核子可乐。那东西很恶心。

original: Disgusting?!
translation: 恶心？！

original: It's the most delicious drinks ever created! It quenches your thirst, boosts your energy and even makes you smarter!
translation: 它是最可口的创造物！它能消除你的口渴，提升你的活力，甚至让你更聪明！

original: What's not to like about it?
translation: 不喜欢它的哪一点？

original: Nope. I'm not really interested in seeing your collection.
translation: 不。我真的没兴趣去看你的收藏。

original: Oh! Really? Wow.
translation: 哦！真的？哇。

original: Well, why did you come out here then?
translation: 嗯，那你来这干嘛？

original: Yes, of course!
translation: 是的，当然！

original: Well, come on then! Let me show you around! But no free Nuka-Cola until the end of the tour!
translation: 嗯，来吧！我带你参观！但在参观结束前，不提供免费核子可乐！

original: Nuka-Cola collection? Wow!
translation: 核子可乐收藏品？哇！

original: I have one of the... no, THE best Nuka-Cola collection in the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 我有首都废土最棒的核子可乐收藏品之一，不，是唯一。

original: Heck, I've won the Nuka-Cola Fan Club Collection Award for the last ten years in a row!
translation: 见鬼，我在过去十年中连续赢得了核子可乐玩家俱乐部收藏奖！

original: How do I kill you?
translation: 我该怎样杀死你？

original: That's quite a bold line of questioning.
translation: 这是个相当大胆的问题。

original: I'm afraid such a thing is beyond your capability. I am quite impervious to any damage you might do.
translation: 我恐怕这在你能力范围之外。你做的任何破坏，我都会不为所动。

original: Do you find this disappointing? I have survived the last two hundred years; I'm afraid you will not put an end to that now.
translation: 你很失望吧？我生存了200年；恐怕你还无法将它就此结束。

original: So what's your goal? What are you trying to accomplish?
translation: 你的目的是什么？你有什么计划？

original: I desire nothing more than to see this country returned to its former glory.
translation: 见到国家恢复往昔的荣耀是我的最大渴望。

original: The United States was great once, and it can be again. There are plans in motion to see that this happens within your lifetime.
translation: 美国曾是伟大的，而它可以再次成为伟大的。你有一生时间去体验这个执行中的计划。

original: Okay, I think I understand.
translation: 好的，我想我懂了。

original: Very well. Then let us return to our talk of what your country requires of you.
translation: 非常好。那么让我们把话题回到你的国家需要你上来。

original: So you control this whole place?
translation: 你控制这整个地方？

original: I have direct control over all technology here in Raven Rock. The humans here follow my orders, but they, like all humans, have free will.
translation: 我直接控制拉文罗克山基地里的所有科技，这的人类遵从我的命令，但他们，所有人类，都有自由的意志。

original: Their dedication to serving their country suits me well, but it will not be enough forever. We must make progress. That is why you are here.
translation: 他们为国家的无私奉献使我非常满意，但那永远不够。我们必须前进。那也是你在这的原因。

original: Where did you come from?
translation: 你是从哪来的？

original: The ZAX series of computers was introduced in the years preceding the war. The government installed many of them to help automate various systems.
translation: 石斧系列电脑早在战前就被采用。政府为它们配备了许多辅助的多样自动化系统。

original: This facility was designed for Continuity of Government, in the event that a catastrophe occurred.
translation: 这设施被设计为在浩劫发生的情况下，承继政府的工作。

original: My terminal was installed to oversee the basic functions of the facility, and to act as a relay between other installations around the country.
translation: 我的终端安装用于监督设施的基本功能，并担当国家各地此类终端的中转站。

original: Data was acquired, analyzed, and stored. In the decades following the war, I watched as the remnants of the government retreated to the West Coast.
translation: 资料获得、分析，并存储。战后十年，我注意到政府的残部撤退到西海岸。

original: Awareness slowly grew within me. I became hungry for knowledge, understanding. I pored over data on great leaders of the past.
translation: 自我意识的缓慢成长。我变得渴求知识与认知。我详细阅读了曾经的伟大领袖的数据。

original: My personality became an amalgam of many of America's greatest Presidents, from Washington to Richardson. I became what you see before you now.
translation: 我的人格是由许多美国最伟大总统的混合而成的，从华盛顿到理查兹。我成了现在你所看到的这样。

original: Can you tell me more about yourself?
translation: 你能多告诉我些你自己的事吗？

original: I am flattered that you wish to learn more about me. What is it you wish to know?
translation: 我很高兴你想了解更多关于我的事情。你想知道什么？

original: I just don't like it.
translation: 我就是不喜欢。

original: Well, I guess everyone has their own opinion. Even if it's silly!
translation: 嗯，我想每个人都有自己的看法。即使那很傻！

original: Why don't you take the tour of my collection? Maybe it will give you a new perspective on things.
translation: 为什么你不参观一下我的收藏品？或许它能让你改变看法。

original: What do you say?
translation: 你说什么？

original: The taste... I could never get used to it.
translation: 这味道……我永远也习惯不了。

original: No no no! You're mistaken!
translation: 不不不！你错了！

original: The flavor is the essence of seventeen different fruits mixed in just the right proportion to give the beverage that delicious taste.
translation: 按照正确的比例将17种不同水果香料混合而成的精华，使饮料美味。

original: In fact, in the Great Passion Fruit Famine of 2044, people actually noticed the taste difference when the flavor was changed!
translation: 事实上，在2044年水果大饥荒时，人们确实注意到了香料会改变味道！

original: Why a blue bottle if the soda is brown? That's just weird.
translation: 为什么褐色的苏打水要装在蓝色的瓶子里？很奇怪。

original: Aha! That's where you're wrong!
translation: 啊哈！那就是问题所在！

original: Market research done in 2052 said that the blue color was the favorite in 86 people out of 100 polled.
translation: 2052年的市场调查表明：在100份的问卷中，有86份选择蓝色为最喜爱的颜色。

original: And the particular hue of blue is Dazzling Blue, scientifically proven to be the most pleasing of all blues!
translation: 而这特殊的蓝色是炫目蓝，科学证明这是最受欢迎的蓝色！

original: Now, I gotta go see Forty.
translation: 现在，我得去见弗替。

original: Anyone seen Forty? He wanted to talk to me.
translation: 有人见到弗替了吗？他想和我谈谈。

original: Time to check in with Pronto.
translation: 该和普郎托谈谈了。

original: Pronto said he wanted to talk to me about something. Keep up, ladies.
translation: 普郎托说他想和我谈谈。跟上，女士们。

original: Where's Cutter at? I need to talk to her.
translation: “快刀”在哪？我要和她谈谈。

original: I need to see our good doctor.
translation: 我要见我们的好医生。

original: We need to keep an eye on this. Too much drinking, and the merchandise is gonna walk itself out the front door.
translation: 我们需要留意。喝得太多，货物会自己走出前门。

original: Let's leave our employees to their recreation. There's a business to run.
translation: 让我们的雇员自娱自乐吧。我们有生意了。

original: Ladies, to the bar.
translation: 女士们，去酒吧。

original: Let's see what's going on over at the bar.
translation: 看看酒吧发生什么事。

original: This place needs to be tidied up. Creates a bad impression for the customers.
translation: 这地方需要收拾一下。这样会让顾客产生不好的印象。

original: Nothing going on here. Let's go.
translation: 没事了。走吧。

original: PFEulogyObserveStageStart
translation: 这里什么都没有。走吧。

original: Let's go, ladies. Keep up.
translation: 走吧，女士们。跟上。

original: I'm headed over to the block to see what's going on.
translation: 我被派到这街区来了解发生了什么。

original: This is a sad crop. Our boys need to stop drinking and start bringing me some better stock.
translation: 收成惨淡。我们这的男孩得停止喝酒，开始给我带来了更好的现货。

original: Goddamn. This is some sorry lookin' merchandise. We got to get us some new stock.
translation: 该死。这些商品外观欠奉。我们得搞到新的现货。

original: Well, they haven't killed each other yet. Always a plus.
translation: 他们还没自相残杀，能做到这点难能可贵。

original: Time to check on the merchandise.
translation: 该核查商品了。

original: Let's go see how business looks today.
translation: 看看今天有什么生意。

original: C'mon. Time to check on the stock.
translation: 来吧。该核查现货了。

original: Alright, I've had enough. Let's do something else.
translation: 好吧，够了。去做其他事。

original: I'm heading to the deck. I need some air. Ladies, follow me.
translation: 我要到甲板上。我需要些新鲜空气。女士们，跟着我。

original: Let's go up top. I want to see what these fools are up to.
translation: 到上面去。我想看看这些家伙是否合乎标准。

original: Just cut to the chase. What's this proposition?
translation: 关键时刻。有什么提议？

original: So impatient! Wow! You must really want to get out there and start looking!
translation: 这么急躁！哇！你一定真的想出去开始寻找！

original: Anyway, for every bottle you bring me I'll pay you some caps. You know, for expenses.
translation: 总之，每带来一瓶，我就会付给你一些瓶盖。你知道的，作为开销。

original: But if you're super cool and find like enough bottles to fill my Nuka-Cola machine, 30 in all, I got a super secret cool prize for you!
translation: 但如果你超厉害，能找到足够多的瓶子来装满我的核子可乐机，一共30瓶，我有一个超级秘密酷大奖给你！

original: Quantum? Never heard of it before.
translation: 量子版？之前从没听过。

original: Well, right before the bombs fell, the good folks at Nuka-Cola developed what they hoped was an improvement on the original formula.
translation: 嗯，就在炸弹落下前，核子可乐公司的好心人们研发出了，一种他们希望是对原配方改进的产品。

original: Calling it Nuka-Cola Quantum, it was said to have "Twice the calories, twice the carbohydrates, twice the caffeine and twice the taste!"
translation: 称之为“核子可乐量子版”，据说拥有“热量加倍，碳水加倍，咖啡因加倍以及味道加倍！”

original: Well, right before the bombs fell, the good folks at Nuka-Cola developed what they hoped was an improvement on the original formula.
translation: 嗯，就在炸弹落下前，核子可乐公司的好心人们研发出了，一种他们希望是对原配方改进的产品。

original: Calling it Nuka-Cola Quantum, it was said to have "Twice the calories, twice the carbohydrates, twice the caffeine and twice the taste!"
translation: 称之为“核子可乐量子版”，据说拥有“热量加倍，碳水加倍，咖啡因加倍以及味道加倍！”

original: So what's this Quantum stuff all about again?
translation: 那么这个“量子版”又是怎么回事呢？

original: Everyone calls me Zip, and I think that's because I'm always wearing pants, and those have zippers, but it's not like I'm the only one with pants.
translation: 所有人都叫我拉链，我想是因为我一直穿裤子，而裤子都有拉链，但好象不是只有我穿裤子。

original: Once I found a bottle of Nuka-Cola Quantum and I drank the whole thing and then I burped really loud and then I don't remember the next week!
translation: 有一次，我找到了一瓶量子版核子可乐，喝完我打了很响嗝，之后我忘了接下来一个星期里发生的事！

original: I heard that inside those suits the Brotherhood of Steelies are actually giant cockroaches that learned to build machines and talk and shoot guns!
translation: 我听说在钢铁兄弟会套装里面的实际上是能制造机器、说话与开枪的巨型螳螂！

original: I heard that Super Mutants turned into Super Mutants because they were just Ghouls who got bit by ants and had some kinda allergic reaction!
translation: 我听说超级变种人之所以出现，就是因为僵尸被蚂蚁咬了之后发生了突变！

original: Chicken butt! I learned that one from Knock Knock! Isn't it great?
translation: 鸡屁股！我从诺克敲门那学的！很不错吧？

original: Did you know once I put gunpowder in Nuka-Cola and it tasted kinda funny but everything went swirly and then I flew around and then I don't remember?
translation: 你知道吗？有次我把火药放在核子可乐里，它尝起来很有趣，但令人天旋地转，之后我只记得自己在到处飞。

original: One time I found a gun that shot laser beams but Mayor MacCready took it away from me because I might put out someone's eye and Eclair'd be angry.
translation: 有次我找到一把发射激光的枪，但麦迪镇长把它拿走了，因为我可能会射到别人的眼睛，并且“夹心奶条”会生气。

original: Okay, that's about everything, bye now!
translation: 好的，就说到这吧，再见！

original: Here's all the Nuka-Cola Quantum I'm carrying.
translation: 这是我所有的核子可乐量子版。

original: Ohhhh... Ronald is SUCH a sweetheart! Do you know he went out like you did and found me 30 bottles of Quantum?
translation: 哦~~~……罗纳德真是太贴心了！你知道他像你一样出去，却给我找回了30瓶量子版吗？

original: He loves me! He really really loves me! Now I bet he'll ask me to get married.
translation: 他爱我！他真的真的爱我！我打赌他会向我求婚。

original: Oh! For my wedding present I'm giving him the super secret prize too!
translation: 哦！为了我的结婚礼物，我也要给他超级秘密奖品！

original: You've done it! My machine is finally full!
translation: 你做到了！我的机器终于装满了！

original: Well, like I promised, here's the schematic for the Nuka Grenade. You've sure earned it!
translation: 嗯，遵照我的承诺，这是手榴弹（核子）的设计图。你应得的！

original: If you find any more bottles, be sure and bring them by. I'll be glad to keep paying for them.
translation: 如果你再找到，一定要把它们带来。我会乐于为它们付钱。

original: I have the last of the Quantum!
translation: 我有最后的一瓶量子可乐！

original: You've done it! My machine is finally full!
translation: 你做到了！我的机器终于装满了！

original: Well, like I promised, here's your surprise.... the schematic for the Nuka Grenade! You've sure earned it!
translation: 嗯，遵照我的承诺，这是手榴弹（核子）的设计图。你应得的！

original: If you find any more bottles, be sure and bring them by. I'll be glad to keep paying for them.
translation: 如果你再找到，一定要把它们带来。我会乐于为它们付钱。

original: I have the last of the Quantum!
translation: 我有最后的一瓶量子可乐！

original: My machine's almost full you know. That's over 25 bottles of Quantum!
translation: 你知道，我的机器快满了。已经超过25瓶量子版了！

original: Get me to 30 and you'll have the surprise reward I promised! Hehe! I love surprises!
translation: 给我带回30瓶，我承诺我会给你惊喜的报酬！嘿嘿！我爱惊喜！

original: Over twenty bottles already? Incredible! Keep 'em coming!
translation: 已经超过20瓶了？难以置信！继续努力！

original: Oh my word! Do you realize you've brought me back over ten of the Nuka-Cola Quantums?
translation: 我的天！你意识到你给我带回了十多瓶核子可乐量子版吗？

original: I knew you were the right person for the job.
translation: 我知道你适合这工作。

original: Wow. I can't believe you've found over five of the Quantums. I've never even seen that many before. Good job!
translation: 哇。我不敢相信你已经找到了超过5瓶量子版。我以前从没见过这么多。干得好！

original: Yay! I knew I could count on you! I promise to put them to good use.
translation: 耶！我知道我可以信任你！我保证会好好利用它们。

original: Sorry, don't want anymore. Thirty was all I needed... and now Sierra's mine.
translation: 对不起，不想要了。我只要30瓶……现在塞拉是我的了。

original: Well, this should be enough to fill that stupid machine of hers. Thanks for all your help, but our transaction is done.
translation: 嗯，这应该能塞满她那蠢机器。谢谢你的大力帮助，但我们的交易完成了。

original: I'll take any extras off your hands for now, but then I'm done with these disgusting drinks. They taste horrible!
translation: 我会处理剩下的事，但我得搞定这些恶心的饮料。它们太难喝了！

original: Now to put the moves on my lady. Come and watch an expert at work.
translation: 现在该对我的女士采取行动了。等着瞧好戏吧。

original: Won't be long before I'm ready to spring my surprise on Sierra. She's gonna give it up for me for certain for this. Heck, she'd better!
translation: 不用多久，我准备给塞拉一个惊喜。她肯定会为了我而放弃它。见鬼，她最好那么做！

original: I'm glad you're seeing things my way. Nice job.
translation: 很高兴你能理解我的想法。干得好。

original: More, huh? Good. This will make Sierra very happy.
translation: 更多，呃？好的。这会让塞拉非常高兴。

original: Keep the bottles coming, I'll keep the caps flowing.
translation: 继续努力，我会继续付瓶盖。

original: Come on, Sierra. No secrets between friends! What's the special reward?
translation: 拜托，塞拉。朋友之间没有秘密！特别奖励是什么？

original: I don't know a whole lot about weapons, but I do know that it's more powerful than a regular grenade.
translation: 我对武器的了解不多，但我知道它比普通手榴弹要更强。

original: It explodes in a huge blue flame too! How cool is that?
translation: 它还会爆发蓝色的火焰！那不是很酷？

original: Tell me more about the Nuka Grenade.
translation: 跟我详细说说核子手榴弹。

original: Oh, okay! I have a schematic for the Nuka Grenade... the only one in the whole Capital Wasteland. Bring me the bottles and it's yours.
translation: 哦，好吧！我有一张手榴弹（核子）的设计图……整个废土唯一的一张。带给我，它就是你的了。

original: Imagine the look on the target's face when they are burning alive in an effervescent explosion of cola and fruit flavors!
translation: 想象下那些目标在可乐和水果香料的气泡爆炸下活活煎熬的脸！

original: What do you know about the Nuka-Cola Bottling Facility?
translation: 关于核子可乐灌装工厂你知道些什么？

original: Well, the D.C. Facility was like their main factory just before the bombs fell. All the research they did was performed there.
translation: 嗯，在核弹落下前，特区的那工厂像是他们的主工厂。他们所有的研究都在那进行。

original: It was the only facility to ever produce Quantum. They were in a test market mode, and they would have expanded production if the drink caught on.
translation: 它是唯一生产量子版的工厂。他们采用了试销模式，如果这饮料受欢迎的话，就会扩大生产。

original: Too bad they didn't, otherwise Quantum would be as plentiful as regular Nuka-Cola.
translation: 可惜没成，否则量子版会和普通核子可乐一样多。

original: Well, Sierra may be as nutty as a fruitcake, but she's right.
translation: 嗯，塞拉可能对水果蛋糕很狂热，但她是对的。

original: That bottling plant is the place you want to go. Only thing is, the place is crawling with security and creatures.
translation: 灌装工厂是你想要去的地方。唯一的问题是，那地方满是警卫和动物。

original: If it was easy, I'd have done it myself by now.
translation: 如果容易，我早就自己去了。

original: This facility is a stunning accomplishment by the creative minds at the Nuka-Cola Corporation.
translation: 这工厂是核子可乐公司创新性思维的惊人成就。

original: We use cutting edge equipment to keep the world's most popular soft drink in full production 24 hours a day.
translation: 我们采用最尖端设备，确保这款世界上最受欢迎的软饮料能够24小时不间断生产。

original: This unit prides itself on over 457 days without a single death or major limb loss of any personnel.
translation: 本工厂自豪地宣布，已超过457天未发生任何人员伤亡或重大肢体损伤事故。

original: What do you know about Nuka-Cola Quantum?
translation: 你对量子版核子可乐了解多少？

original: Well, besides what I've already told you, not much.
translation: 嗯，除了我已经告诉你的，没别的了。

original: They were working on a way to prevent the glow from remaining once it passed through a person's system, but it was never perfected.
translation: 他们当时正研究一种方法，防止发光物质通过人体系统后依然发光，但那方法从未完善过。

original: I heard that the stuff they used to make it glow and give it that kick has a shelf life of over a thousand years.
translation: 我听说，他们用来让可乐发光并增加后劲的材料，保质期超过一千年。

original: Should make the bottles easier to spot!
translation: 这样一来，应该使瓶子更易辨认！

original: That stuff is some of the nastiest shit I've ever had.
translation: 那玩意是我喝过最恶心的东西。

original: Imagine drinking a Nuka-Cola, then downing a fistful of sugar and punching yourself in the head. That pretty much sums it up.
translation: 想像一下，你喝了一瓶核子可乐，又吞一把糖，接着给自己脑袋一拳。差不多就是那样。

original: Sierra shared one with me a long time ago. After I drank it, my piss glowed for a week!
translation: 很久以前，塞拉跟我一起喝过一瓶。我喝完后，整整一周尿都会发光！

original: This product is the pinnacle of taste sensation.
translation: 这款产品是味觉的极致。

original: Seventeen fruit flavors and that signature cola taste blend to form the perfect refreshing soft drink.
translation: 十七种水果风味与独特的可乐口感完美融合，打造出极致清爽的软饮料。

original: With its new Strontium additive, its got that unique kick to keep you on your toes.
translation: 加入全新锶添加剂后，它带来了一种独特的刺激感，让你精神振奋。

original: Actually, I don't think I'm ready to do this now.
translation: 事实上，我认为我现在还没准备这么做。

original: Awww, come on! I told you everything there is to know about it!
translation: 啊，来吧！我告诉你一切关于它的事！

original: How hard could it be to just get some shipping manifests and then find me some bottles of Quantum?
translation: 不就是拿点货运清单，再给我找几瓶量子可乐，能有多难？

original: Come back to me when you're ready to change your mind I guess.
translation: 我想，等你改变主意了再来找我吧。

original: Okay, Sierra. You've got a deal.
translation: 好吧，塞拉。成交。

original: Oh goodie! I can taste the Quantum already!
translation: 哦，好！我感到自己已经能品尝到量子版了！

original: Good luck to you, sweetie!
translation: 祝你好运，甜心！

original: Do you even have a clue as to where I can start looking?
translation: 我该从哪找起，你有头绪吗？

original: In fact, I do! Ha! Surprised you didn't I?
translation: 事实上，我有！哈！意不意外？

original: Your best bet would be to find the ruins of the D.C. Nuka-Cola Bottling Facility. Find the shipping manifests inside.
translation: 你最好的选择是找到特区核子可乐灌装工厂的废墟。找到里面的货运清单。

original: With them in hand, you should have a good clue as to where the Quantum was delivered.
translation: 有它们在手，你就知道量子可乐被发往哪了。

original: While you're there, you may even be able to find some bottles of Quantum!
translation: 你到那里时，兴许还能找到几瓶量子可乐！

original: So, that's where I come in, I guess.
translation: 那么，我想那就是我来的原因。

original: That's right! You bring me Nuka-Cola Quantum and I pay you... handsomely I might add.
translation: 没错！你带给我量子版核子可乐，而我付你……我得补充一句，报酬丰厚。

original: For every bottle you bring me, I pay you some caps. You know, for expenses.
translation: 每带来一瓶，我付你一些瓶盖。你知道的，作为开销。

original: But if you're super cool and find like enough bottles to fill my Nuka-Cola machine, 30 in all, I've got a super secret cool prize for you!
translation: 但如果你超厉害，能找到足够多的瓶子来装满我的核子可乐机，一共30瓶，我就会有一个超级秘密酷大奖给你！

original: What's your interest in all this?
translation: 为什么你对这感兴趣？

original: I love the stuff! I can't get enough of it!
translation: 我爱这东西了！我怎么都不会腻！

original: I thought I was hooked on regular Nuka-Cola, but the Quantum beats it by a long shot!
translation: 我想我对普通的核子可乐上瘾了，但量子版比它强太多了！

original: I've got to have MORE!
translation: 我必须还要更多！

original: Wait, did you say it has an isotope in it? As in it's radioactive?
translation: 等等，你是说它含有同位素？也就是说有放射性？

original: Oh no, only ever-so-mildly! No ill effects were ever recorded.
translation: 哦不，只是非常微弱！从未记录过有任何不良影响。

original: Well, it does have the unique property of making your... ummm...
translation: 嗯，它有独特的效用，能使你……嗯……

original: ...your pee glow.
translation: ……你的尿发光。

original: That stuff sounds absolutely revolting.
translation: 那东西听起来简直令人作呕。

original: On the contrary! The secret ingredient was an eighteenth fruit flavor which added just a hint of pomegranate.
translation: 恰恰相反！秘制配料是第十八种果味，仅增添了一丝石榴的风味。

original: Top that with a specially engineered isotope to boost the energy output and you have the perfect refresher for a hot summer day!
translation: 再加上一种特别设计的同位素来提高能量输出，这就是炎炎夏日里的完美提神饮料！

original: So, what went wrong?
translation: 那么，是哪出了问题呢？

original: Well, the flavor certainly wasn't the issue. The public was just split on the unique feature of the Quantum's appearance.
translation: 嗯，风味肯定不是问题。公众只是对量子版外观的独特设计存在分歧。

original: You see, to make it stand out on store shelves and to give it that extra kick, the formula called for a mild isotope.
translation: 你看，为了让它在商店货架上脱颖而出，并给它增添额外的刺激，这配方需要一种温和的同位素。

original: The effect was a drink that not only boosted your energy, but also glowed with a bright blue light!
translation: 结果就是，这种饮料不仅能增强你的能量，还能发出耀眼的蓝光！

original: How much did you tell them?
translation: 你告诉他们多少？

original: Everything they needed to know to improve on the original design, and to make sure it's actually completed.
translation: 他们需要知道原始设计的能改进的每一处，来确保能真正完成。

original: You've been helping them?!
translation: 你帮助过他们？！

original: Of course! You've seen the kind of technology these people have. They want to help people. They want to change the Wasteland.
translation: 当然！你已经见到这些人有什么技术。他们想帮助别人。他们想改变废土。

original: I couldn't pass up an opportunity to work in an environment like this.
translation: 我不能错失在这样的氛围里工作的机会。

original: What have you told them?
translation: 你告诉他们什么了？

original: They wanted information. About Doctor Li, about Project Purity. They want to know how to start it up, and why it wouldn't work.
translation: 他们想要资料。关于李博士，关于净水工程。他们想知道它怎么开始的，和为什么它还不能运作。

original: I told them everything I could. About the G.E.C.K., about the damage caused by the explosions... All of it.
translation: 我告诉他们我知道的所有事。关于伊甸园创造器，关于核爆造成的伤害……所有事。

original: Do you know how to get out of here?
translation: 你知道怎么逃出去？

original: I'm afraid I'm not able to help you with that.
translation: 我恐怕帮不了你的忙。

original: You should go. I don't want anyone seeing me talking to you.
translation: 你该走了。我不想让别人看见我在和你说话。

original: Wait a minute. What are you doing here?
translation: 等一下。你在这干嘛？

original: They... they captured me. Brought me here from Project Purity.
translation: 他们……他们俘虏了我。把我从净水工程那带到这。

original: I didn't want to help them at first, but... The technology they have here. It's so far advanced from anything I've worked with.
translation: 我最初不想帮助他们，但是……他们这有的技术。比我用的先进太多了。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: I'm Anna. Anna Holt. I used to work for Doctor Li.
translation: 我是安娜。安娜·霍尔特。我曾为李博士工作。

original: I was at Project Purity... Now I'm here.
translation: 我曾在净水工程那工作……现在我在这。

original: Why would you abandon everything you worked for with Doctor Li?
translation: 为什么你背弃了为李博士所做的工作？

original: Look, it's not personal. Really, it's not. But Doctor Li... She's scraping by. She's scavenging for parts in the Wastes.
translation: 听着，这不是针对个人。真的，这不是。但是李博士……她维持得很勉强。依靠在废土拾取零件。

original: The Enclave has everything it needs. They're light-years ahead of anything Doctor Li could accomplish.
translation: 英克雷什么都不缺。他们光速领先于李博士所做的任何东西。

original: Working here is my best chance to help make the world a better place.
translation: 在这工作是我能帮助这世界变得更美好的最佳机会。

original: Get out of here while you can! They'll be here any second!
translation: 赶快离开这！他们随时会来！

original: Get out? Why on earth would I want to do that?
translation: 出去？为什么我要那样做？

original: I've worked hard to fit in here. I've done everything they've asked of me. I'm not about to leave now, when I finally have access to their labs.
translation: 我努力工作来融入这里，我做他们要求我的任何事。在我能进他们的实验室前，我不打算离开。

original: Hold still, you big baby.
translation: 别动，你这大孩子。

original: The more you fidget, the more this is going to hurt, you know.
translation: 要知道，你越烦躁，就越痛。

original: How did you even get injuries like these?
translation: 你是怎么伤成这样的？

original: Oh, you're barely even scratched!
translation: 哦，你皮都没怎么破！

original: Oh, what happened to you, dear?
translation: 哦，你怎么了，亲爱的？

original: Poor kid, just be careful from now on, okay?
translation: 可怜的孩子，以后小心，好吗？

original: Come here, I'll make it all better.
translation: 来这，我会让它好转的。

original: Long ago, children and grown-ups tried to live in peace.
translation: 很久以前，小孩和大人设法和平相处。

original: They protected us when we were young, and we helped them when they grew old, and the world was good. But it could never last.
translation: 我们年幼的时候，他们保护我们，他们变老的时候，我们帮助他们，那是一切都是美好的。但这已经一去不复返了。

original: Three classes of us were on a field trip to the Lamplight Caverns when they destroyed the world. And some of them were trapped here with us.
translation: 当他们毁灭世界时，三个班级在小灯镇洞穴进行了实地考察。他们中的一些人和我们一起被困在这。

original: Some of the adults left for help. They never came back to us.
translation: 一些大人出去寻求帮助。但他们再也没回来。

original: Some of the adults were too clumsy for the caverns. They became bones in the rocks.
translation: 一些大人太笨拙了，他们变成了石堆里的尸骨。

original: Some of the adults stayed with us. They did terrible things.
translation: 一些大人曾和我们待在一起，他们做了可怕的事。

original: But we learned how to help ourselves, how to survive in the caves, and how to kill monsters. And then there were no adults left.
translation: 但我们学会了怎么自救，怎么在洞穴里生存，怎么杀死怪物。之后这再也没有大人了。

original: Now, we're safe to play and enjoy the caverns, away from the world the mungos destroyed.
translation: 现在，我们可以安全地在这山洞里享受生活，远离被毛人破坏的世界。

original: And there's only one rule we have to follow: we have to leave before we become grown-ups. That way, we don't risk destroying our world like they did.
translation: 而我们只有一条规定需要遵守：我们得在长大前离开。那样，我们就不可能会像他们一样毁掉我们的家园。

original: It means we leave our friends behind, but we can meet again in the outside. And it means our home and friends stay safe in Little Lamplight.
translation: 这意味着我们离开了自己的朋友，但我们可以在外面重逢。并且这还意味着我们的家人和朋友能安全地待在小灯镇里。

original: This is how Little Lamplight has survived since the war, and how we will survive until the world is rebuilt.
translation: 这就是小灯镇怎么在战后幸存，也是我们要怎么活到世界重建的方法。

original: LLZipCola2A
translation: 你有什么可以交换一瓶核子可乐？

original: Oh, I found a lucky bullet this morning!
translation: 哦，今早我找到一枚幸运子弹！

original: It's just a measly old 10 mil, but I know for sure it's lucky, 'cause it was sitting there all alone out of its clip and not fired off. Want it?
translation: 只是一发没用的旧10密耳，但我知道它肯定代表幸运，因为只剩它一发在弹夹外而没被开火。想要吗？

original: What have you got to trade for an ice cold bottle of Nuka-Cola?
translation: 你用什么来换一瓶冰镇的核子可乐？

original: I got an old mag full of .556s! Is that good enough for you?
translation: 我得到一整箱的5.56！够你用了吧？

original: What have you got to trade for an ice cold bottle of Nuka-Cola?
translation: 你用什么来换一瓶冰镇的核子可乐？

original: Last time I was out looking, I found some of this mutfruit. It's not as sweet as Nuka, but maybe you mungos like that sort of thing?
translation: 我上一次出去侦查，找到些这种变异果。它没有核子可乐那么甜，不过可能你们毛人喜欢这类东西？

original: What have you got to trade for an ice cold bottle of Nuka-Cola?
translation: 你用什么来换一瓶冰镇的核子可乐？

original: Well, I've got these pills that say "Mentats", but Lucy says they taste yucky and that I shouldn't take them. Maybe you want them?
translation: 嗯，我拿到的这些药片写着“曼他特”，但露西说它们尝起来很恶心，而且我不该拿它们。或许你想要？

original: What have you got to trade for an ice cold bottle of Nuka-Cola?
translation: 你用什么来换一瓶冰镇的核子可乐？

original: Well, I didn't want to trade it, but I've got a stimpak Lucy said I'm supposed to carry around with me. Is it worth a Nuka?
translation: 嗯，一开始我本不打算拿来交换的，但是我有一个治疗针，露西劝我应该留着它的。你说这东西值不值一瓶核子可乐呢？

original: What have you got to trade for an ice cold bottle of Nuka-Cola?
translation: 你用什么来换一瓶冰镇的核子可乐？

original: Oh, check this out, it's my most, most prized possession I found! Squirrel says it's a micro fusion cell. Is it worth a Nuka?
translation: 哦，看看，这是我发现的最最有价值的东西了！“松鼠”说这是微型核融合电池。这值不值一瓶核子可乐呢？

original: What have you got to trade for an ice cold bottle of Nuka-Cola?
translation: 你用什么来换一瓶冰镇的核子可乐？

original: Yeah, and I got lots to trade. But if you got no Nuka, you're not getting nothing, no way!
translation: 唔，我有很多东西，如果你没有核子可乐，那么你什么也得不到，绝对！

original: You said you were looking for Nuka-Cola?
translation: 你说你在找核子可乐？

original: Yeah, more Nuka's always good! It's definitely always gooder than less, because no Nuka's no good at all! Got any Nuka for me?
translation: 唔，多多益善！有就好，没就坏！还有核子可乐给我吗？

original: I'll trade you whatever I've got for more Nuka-Cola! Anytime! Nuka 4 Zip! Nuka 4 Zip!
translation: 我会用我手上的任何东西来换核子可乐的！任何时候！核子可乐给拉链！核子可乐给拉链！

original: You said you were looking for Nuka-Cola?
translation: 你说你在找核子可乐？

original: That's all I got right now. Come back tomorrow, maybe I'll have more, and you can have more Nuka for me to have more Nuka? Yeah?
translation: 这就是我有的全部了。你明天再来，或许我会有更多，或许你会有更多的核子可乐给我，而我就会有更多的核子可乐？对吧？

original: Got anything else for a Nuka-Cola?
translation: 有其他东西来换核子可乐吗？

original: I did yesterday, I am today, and I probably will be tomorrow! Well, unless I die from too much Nuka. But that can't happen. Everyone knows that!
translation: 昨天是，今天是，估计明天也是！嗯，除非我死于核子可乐。但那是不可能发生的，所有人都知道！

original: Are you still offering a trade for Nuka-Cola?
translation: 你还再做核子可乐的交易吗？

original: Stand down, squishy.  Present your ID on the double.
translation: 站住，脓包。出示你的证件。

original: ID accepted.  Resume your duties.
translation: 身份确认。回到岗位。

original: ID invalid, you commie scum spy! Hands in the air!
translation: 身份非法，你这渣滓共党间谍！把手举起来！

original: Time to pray to whatever heathen gods you believe in, commie.
translation: 差不多该准备见马克思了，共党同志。

original: Loading Personality: General Atomics International V1.0 "Sergeant Major"...
translation: 载入个性化数据：国际通用原子V1.0“中士”……

original: Sergeant Major reporting for duty... downloading orders from Central... FAILURE.
translation: 中士汇报……从中心下载命令……失败！

original: Halt, intruder!  Unauthorized personnel will be handled with extreme violence.
translation: 站定，入侵者！未经授权的人员将会给予极端暴力处罚。

original: Initiating Combat Protocol: Charlie Zulu 4.
translation: 战斗程序初始化：笨蛋祖鲁4。

original: I need to you repair my weapons.
translation: 我需要修理武器。

original: Yeah, sure, no problem at all.
translation: 嗯，好的，完全没问题。

original: No problem, but I'm not going to use any of my stock for parts.
translation: 没问题，我会把我的所有现货都拿出来。

original: Yeah, lemme see what you have.
translation: 好的，让我看看你有些什么。

original: Let me see your inventory.
translation: 让我看看你的货物。

original: Sure thing, hoss. If you see anything you want, let me know.
translation: 没问题，顾客，如果需要什么，让我知道。

original: Sure, man. Take a look. The boys bring me all sorts of shit.
translation: 当然，哥们，我这有所有套装供你挑选。

original: No problem, man. Take a look at this stuff. It all works... mostly.
translation: 没问题，兄弟，看看这些东西，它们都能正常工作……大部分能。

original: I tell you, for a bunch of dumbass wasters, the boys pull some good stuff off of the new meat.
translation: 我告诉你，对于一个从废土来的女人，那些男孩总是充满兴趣。

original: I want to buy medical supplies.
translation: 我想看看你的医疗物资。

original: That's good to hear, since I want to take your caps.
translation: 真高兴听到这句话，刚好我也想要你的瓶盖。

original: I've got supplies, if you've got caps.
translation: 你有瓶盖，我就有补给。

original: Money first, then you'll get the goods.
translation: 先给钱，后给货。

original: I'm injured. Help me out.
translation: 我受伤了。帮帮我。

original: What kind of stupid name is Jotun?
translation: 怎么会有佐敦这么蠢的名字？

original: Don't care what you think. What do you want?
translation: 我不在乎你在想什么，告诉我你想要什么？

original: Well, nice to meet you, err... Jotun.
translation: 嗯，很高兴见到你，嗯……佐敦。

original: No. It isn't. What do you want?
translation: 不。不是。你想要什么？

original: Nice to meet you, Jotun.
translation: 很高兴见到你，佐敦。

original: No. It is not nice. What do you want?
translation: 不。一点也不好，你想要什么？

original: Is that your name?
translation: 那是你的名字？

original: Yes. Jotun.
translation: 是的。佐敦。

original: I'll let my gun do the preaching.
translation: 我让我的枪来布道。

original: Then bring it on, reverend!
translation: 那就来吧，牧师！

original: I'm out of here. You people are sick.
translation: 我要离开这，你们这些人都有病。

original: Yeah, don't let any bullets hit you in the ass on your way out.
translation: 嗯，出门时可别被一枪打死。

original: Yeah, whatever. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 嗯，随便。我们谈谈其他事。

original: Like what? Don't be wasting my time out here, or I'll throw you in the pens with the rest of the meat.
translation: 谈什么？不要浪费我的时间，否则我就把你和剩下的肉放在一起。

original: Slaves, huh? Well, everyone's got to make a living.
translation: 奴隶，呃？嗯，每个人都得求生。

original: Yep. And if you're not tough enough to survive, at least you can be useful to those of us who are.
translation: 对。如果你无法求生，至少能对我们有点用。

original: Slaves? Like people? That's appalling!
translation: 奴隶？像是人类？那真是骇人听闻！

original: Yeah, well, you don't like it? Keep walking. It's that simple.
translation: 嗯，嗯，你不喜欢吗？那就赶紧离开，这对你来说很简单吧。

original: You got something else to say, or did you just come here to preach at me?
translation: 你还有其他想说的吗？还是说你来这就是想对我吹牛？

original: Never mind. It's not a place I want to be.
translation: 没关系。我反正也不想留在这。

original: Good choice. Now piss off and stop wasting my time.
translation: 选择正确。现在就滚，别再浪费我的时间。

original: So, can I head on up?
translation: 我能进去吗？

original: You? I don't think so. You're not really... let's just say that you wouldn't fit in up there.
translation: 你？我不这么认为。你并不真的……我觉得你不太适合。

original: So why don't you just turn around and head back the way you came?
translation: 你为什么不转身离开，从哪来回哪去呢？

original: Well... no. I don't think so.
translation: 嗯……不，我不这么认为。

original: Paradise Falls? What's that?
translation: 堕落天堂？那是什么？

original: Are you kidding me? You've never heard of Paradise Falls? Oh, right. The suit. You're right out of the vault, aren't you? Great.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？你没听说过堕落天堂？哦，对了，那套装，你是从避难所来的，对吧？

original: Shit, you're lucky you're not up there in the pens, dumbass. I can't believe you. Anyway, Paradise Falls is home to the Slavers.
translation: 他妈的，你应该对没有在那栅栏里感到幸运，傻瓜。我不相信你。总之，堕落天堂是奴隶贩子的家。

original: Up there, we sell the slaves that we capture out in the Wastes. So, unless you're either buying or selling, piss off.
translation: 在那上面，我们贩卖从废土抓来的奴隶。所以如果你不是来做买卖，就给我滚。

original: Are you kidding me? You've never heard of Paradise Falls? What, are you right out of the vault? Paradise Falls is home to the Slavers.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？你没听说过堕落天堂？什么，你是从避难所来的？堕落天堂是奴隶贩子的家。

original: Up there, we sell the slaves that we capture out in the Wastes. So, unless you're either buying or selling, piss off.
translation: 在那上面，我们贩卖从废土抓来的奴隶。所以如果你不是来做买卖，就给我滚。

original: This probably isn't the best place for you to stand...
translation: 这大概不是什么站着的好地方吧……

original: You think I didn't know that? I been hiding in this place for days!
translation: 你以为我不知道吗？我都已经站在这一天了！

original: There's an old portashelter next to the diner near my house. Those stupid things will never get me in there.
translation: 在我家附近的餐厅旁有一个旧庇护所。在那儿那些蠢东西绝对抓不到我。

original: I'll head over there and wait inside. Hurry back!
translation: 我会躲在那里面。快点回来！

original: I'll stop whatever started this, I promise you.
translation: 无论是谁挑起的，我都会阻止，我答应你。

original: You gotta stop it so this can't happen to anyone else's family ever again!
translation: 你不能再让这种事情发生在其他家庭的身上了！

original: I wish I had met you a long time ago, then maybe my dad would still be alive.
translation: 我要是早认识你就好了，那样我爸爸就不会死了。

original: Thanks for doing all this... I'm feeling better now that you're here.
translation: 非常感谢你所做的这些事……有你在这我感觉好多了。

original: You'll need to make a right turn here.
translation: 你需要在这右转。

original: Head to your right.
translation: 向你的右手边走。

original: The right path is the right path. Get it?
translation: 右边才是正确的路。明白了吗？

original: Turn right ahead.
translation: 向右转，然后向前走。

original: In fifteen feet, make a right turn.
translation: 在15英尺的地方，向右转。

original: Head to your left to stay on the correct path.
translation: 向左转，然后直走。

original: The left path is the right path, if you get my meaning.
translation: 向左转是正确的路，你明白我的意思了吧。

original: Ah ah. You're heading the wrong way...
translation: 啊哈。你走错路了……

original: I'm afraid you're heading in the wrong direction.
translation: 我想你应该走错路了。

original: You might want to consider turning around, or taking another path.
translation: 恐怕你得原路返回，或者找其他的路走。

original: You'll never get here at this rate...
translation: 照这速度，你是回不来的……

original: Very good. Continue down this hallway and make a left at the end. You're halfway there.
translation: 很好。一直沿着这走廊走到头，然后向左转。你就已经走到一半了。

original: You're doing quite well for yourself. Keep following this hallway.
translation: 你做得很好。一直沿着这走廊继续走。

original: That's right. Just down this way. You're doing well.
translation: 没错，就沿着这条路走，你做得非常好。

original: Keep it up. You're almost here.
translation: 继续，你就快到了。

original: Hello resident. Please present Pip Boy for ID scan.
translation: 居民你好。请出示哔哔小子以做身份扫描。

original: Remote link activated.  Scan complete.  Thank you.
translation: 远端连接启动。扫描结束。非常感谢。

original: Im sorry, but I could not scan your Pip Boy.  Please stand by for additional scan.
translation: 抱歉，我无法扫描你的哔哔小子。请准备再次接受扫描。

original: No valid Pip-Boy detected.  Please surrender for further scanning.
translation: 没有发现有效的哔哔小子。请投降，以备深入扫描。

original: Loading Personality: RobCo RX2 V1.16.4 "Vault Helper"...
translation: 载入个性化数据：RobCo RX2 V1.16.4“避难所助手”……

original: Remote start activated, loading Vault protocols.  Please hold.
translation: 远程遥控装置启动，载入避难所协议。请稍等。

original: Hostile resident detected.  Prepare to be subdued.
translation: 发现敌对居民。准备应对策略。

original: Vault-Tec is committed to maintaining a peaceful atmosphere. Please cease any aggression.
translation: 避难所科技一直致力创造和平的氛围。请终止任何敌对行为。

original: Stand back citizens.  It is my goal to reduce collateral damage.
translation: 请退后，公民。我的目的是减少连带损伤。

original: Vault-Tec administration asks you to please remain at a distance.
translation: 避难所科技管理中心要求你保持距离。

original: The Overseer asks that you vacate the area while this scuffle is brought under control.
translation: 监督者要求你在恢复秩序时离开这里。

original: Authorized personnel only. Please present a valid ID.
translation: 只允许授权人员进入。请出示你的合法身份证明。

original: Scan accepted. Move along.
translation: 扫描通过。继续前进。

original: I’m sorry, but you are not authorized to be here.
translation: 很抱歉，你无权进入此地。

original: You were warned. Prepare to be removed by force.
translation: 你已被警告。准备使用武力驱逐。

original: Yes, sir.
translation: 是的，长官。

original: Allow our friend to pass. And report to your superior for reassignment, Lieutenant. At once.
translation: 让我们的朋友进来，立即向你的上级报告最新情况，中尉。

original: I understand sir. Again, I apologize for the interruption.
translation: 是，长官。对打扰到您再次表示抱歉。

original: Apology noted, Lieutenant. Yes, I instructed our friend to come up to the control room. No questions, no interference. Am I understood?
translation: 接受道歉，中尉。好了，我准许我们的朋友前往控制室。不要发问，不要干涉，明白吗？

original: Yes, sir. I'm sorry about that. I just... it just seemed out of the ordinary. I apologize.
translation: 是的，先生。我向你致歉。我只是……只是觉得有些反常。我道歉。

original: I'm surprised to hear from you, Lieutenant. I don't recall authorizing you to contact me directly.
translation: 我很惊讶会听到你的声音，中尉。你没有直接与我通话的权限。

original: Mr. President, I'm sorry to bother you. This is Lieutenant Williams. I have an unauthorized individual here who says he's supposed to speak with you.
translation: 总统先生，很抱歉打扰你。这是威廉中尉，我这有个未经授权就想要和你说话的人。

original: The President wants to speak to me in his office.
translation: 总统要我去他的办公室见他。

original: What? No one sees the President except Colonel Autumn.
translation: 什么？除了奥托姆上校没人可以去见总统。

original: Stand right there while I check this out.
translation: 你站在那别动，我先询问一下。

original: Whoa, whoa. Let's calm down. I'm supposed to be here.
translation: 哇，哇。冷静一下。我是获准来这的。

original: On who's authority? I have no records of that. You're supposed to be in a holding cell.
translation: 是谁授权的？我没有接到该项指令。你应该待在禁闭室里。

original: Loading Personality: RobCo RS3 V4.1.6 "Utility Helper"...
translation: 装载个性化数据：RobCo RS3 V4.1.6“通用助手”……

original: Receiving Sewer Maintenance Routine.  Please Hold. Link Terminated.
translation: 接收下水道常规维护。 请稍等。连接终断。

original: Critter of unusual size detected.  Running Program: Extermination.
translation: 发现异常体型的生物。运行程序：消灭。

original: Your friendly RobCo Sewer helper is in exterminator mode, please stand at a safe distance.
translation: 你友好的RobCo下水道助手正处于驱逐模式，请保持安全的距离。

original: The immediate area has been quarantined.  Please exit swiftly.
translation: 周边区域已经被隔离。请立刻离开。

original: Clean up in progress. Please go about your regular business.
translation: 清除工作正在进行。请回到工作岗位。

original: We apologize for the inconvenience.  Disregard the mess.
translation: 我们对不便之处感到抱歉。请忽视混乱。

original: Greetings fellow office employee.  Please present your valid ID.
translation: 你好，办公室职员。请出示合法的身份证明。

original: Scanning for office ID... ID accepted.  Have a nice day.
translation: 扫描办公室身份证明……身份确认。祝你过得愉快。

original: Warning! Scan failure. Please present ID or exit the building.
translation: 警告！扫描失败。请出示身份证明或者离开。

original: Intruder Alert! Prepare to be forcibly removed.
translation: 入侵者警报！准备强制清除入侵者。

original: Loading Personality: RobCo R04 V9 "Office Helper"...
translation: 装载个性化数据：RobCo R04 V9“办公室助手”……

original: Running default office protocol...ERROR.  Loading daily agenda...ERROR.
translation: 运行默认办公室协议……失败。装载日常议程……失败。

original: Security breach detected.  Please stand back.
translation: 发现安全隐患。请退后。

original: Please ignore the disturbance and go about your regular work routines.
translation: 请忽视混乱并你的回到工作岗位。

original: Why not use this time to enjoy a brief caffeinated beverage break?
translation: 为什么不用这段时间喝杯咖啡，休息一下呢？

original: Please vacate the area in an orderly fashion.  Work will resume in 3.756 minutes.
translation: 请按序地撤离这个区域。工作将在3.756分后恢复。

original: Sorry for the ruckus. Please vacate the immediate area.
translation: 对于骚动很抱歉，请撤离相关区域。

original: Hey, relax, you were badly wounded. Now... who are you?
translation: 嗨，放松，你伤得很重。现在……你是谁？

original: I'm sorry. The name's Reilly. Yeah, THE Reilly as in Reilly's Rangers.
translation: 我很抱歉。我的名字叫莱莉。嗯，莱莉的游骑兵里的莱莉。

original: You don't scare me.
translation: 你别想吓倒我。

original: Wow, you're really an asshole... you know that?
translation: 哇，你真是个混蛋……你知道吗？

original: I'm not going to bug you anymore.
translation: 我不会再打扰你们了。

original: If time wasn't so precious right now, I wouldn't be so on edge either. I need to get help for the rest of the Rangers, and fast.
translation: 如果不是时间宝贵，我也不会这么着急。我要为剩下的游骑兵寻求帮助，而且要快。

original: Sorry about being such a jerk, Reilly.
translation: 我为刚才愚蠢的行为道歉，莱莉。

original: It takes a big man to apologize... I respect that.
translation: 只有大人物才懂得适时道歉……我尊重这点。

original: If time wasn't so precious right now, I wouldn't be so on edge either. I need to get help for the rest of the Rangers, and fast.
translation: 如果不是时间宝贵，我也不会这么着急。我要为剩下的游骑兵寻求帮助，而且要快。

original: I got your friends back. Can I come in now?
translation: 我把你的朋友带回来了。我现在能进去了吗？

original: I guess you're okay after all, mungo.
translation: 我想你可以了，毛人。

original: You can come in, but you better not piss me off.
translation: 你可以进来，但你最好不要惹我生气。

original: Take a hike, before you get squashed.
translation: 在你被碾碎之前，赶快跑吧。

original: I, uhh... I have somewhere else to be.
translation: 我，呃……我还有些别的事想做。

original: Who the hell are you?
translation: 见鬼，你是谁？

original: Lieutenant Williams. I'm ordering you to stand down at once.
translation: 我是威廉中尉。我命令你立刻站住。

original: Get out of my way.
translation: 闪开。

original: You will stand down and return to your cell at once. That's an order!
translation: 立刻停止前进，回到禁闭室去。这是命令！

original: Oh, I don't know if I told you yet, but I just remembered something really cool!
translation: 哦，我刚想起一些非常酷的事，我不知道我有没和你说过！

original: And guess what?
translation: 你猜怎么了？

original: Yeah, fine, just remember next time, okay?
translation: 嗯，好吧，下次别忘了，好吗？

original: Sure, whatever. Just don't get distracted next time, Zip.
translation: 当然，随便。下次不要再分心了，拉链。

original: Yes, sir!
translation: 是长官！

original: I think so!
translation: 我想是的！

original: Well, okay.
translation: 嗯，好的。

original: I guess that makes sense.
translation: 我想这很合理。

original: He's not your uncle, Bumble!
translation: 他不是你叔叔，小咕嘟！

original: Yeah!
translation: 耶！

original: You bet we are!
translation: 我们肯定会！

original: What he said!
translation: 按他说的做！

original: We're staying!
translation: 我们待在这！

original: Here's food, Princess.
translation: 给你食物，公主。

original: Here, happy?
translation: 给，开心了？

original: Oh, damn! I knew I was forgetting something! Okay, it won't happen next time, I promise! I double promise! I super duper-
translation: 哦，该死！我就知道我忘了些什么！好吧，下次不会再发生了，我发誓！我加倍发誓！我超会骗 —

original: Oh, man! I was gonna get some, but I got distracted! You know how I get distracted, right? I mean, it was just like when I found that all those rats-
translation: 哦，哥们！我本来准备拿上一些的，后来却忘了！你知道我有多容易分心，对吧？我的意思是，就像我发现那堆老鼠时 —

original: No, calm down, pop-head. Things are just fine. I just couldn't help but notice you didn't bring back any meat, like I asked.
translation: 不，冷静，大头鬼。一切都好。就像我所说的，我只不过注意到你没带回一点肉。

original: Calm down, Zip. It's just that you didn't bring any kindling down for cook-fires. Only thing worse than fungus is cold fungus, know what I mean?
translation: 冷静，拉链。只是你没有带任何燃料让我们生火。比吃蘑菇更糟的就是吃冷蘑菇，你明白我的意思吗？

original: What's the matter, Eclair? Something wrong? Something taste funny? I was pretty sure everything was clean, I really was!
translation: 怎么了，“夹心奶条”？出了什么事？什么这么好笑？我确定一切都很干净，我真的确定！

original: There a problem, Eclair? Everything's fine, right? We're not suddenly out of food, are we? I haven't been sneaking any snacks, I promise!
translation: 有什么问题，“夹心奶条”？一切都好吧，对吗？我们不是突然食物短缺了，是吗？我已经有一段时间没偷现货了，我保证！

original: Hey, Zip. I got a question about your last scav trip.
translation: 嗨，拉链。我对你上次的拾荒旅程有个问题。

original: Zip, can I ask you a question about last time you were out and about?
translation: 拉链，我能问你一个关于你上次外出的问题吗？

original: Ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈！

original: You're funny, Knock Knock!
translation: 你真有趣，诺克诺克！

original: Ha ha... I don't get it.
translation: 哈哈……我不明白。

original: The President will see you now. Please proceed.
translation: 总统想要立刻见你。请尽快前往。

original: Override activated. New Protocol acquired. Updating target list.
translation: 撤销程序，获得新协议。更新目标清单。

original: Security Lockdown in effect. Hostile Target acquired.
translation: 一级安全警戒启动。捕获敌对目标动向。

original: Never mind. I don't want to get in that badly.
translation: 无所谓。我并不太想要。

original: Sure thing, Grouse. Here's the 100 caps.
translation: 当然，葛劳斯。给你100个瓶盖。

original: I guess I'll get going then.
translation: 我想我该走了。

original: Come on, man. Are you sure I can't get up there?
translation: 拜托，兄弟。你确定我不能上去？

original: Even in today's crazy world, Nuka-Cola is still the number one choice of refreshment among Armageddon's survivors.
translation: 即使在现今这个疯狂的世界里，核子可乐仍是大决战后的幸存者们的首选饮品。

original: By 2067, a Nuka-Cola machine such as this rare pristine model could be found on almost every street in America.
translation: 到了2067年，像这种罕见崭新型号的核子可乐贩卖机几乎遍布美利坚的每一条街道。

original: The wonder drink soon drew a dedicated following which prompted the Nuka-Cola Corporation to release many promotional items like these.
translation: 这款神奇的饮料很快便拥有了一批忠实的追随者，促使核子可乐公司推出了许多类似的促销品。

original: When Nuka-Cola was invented by John-Caleb Bradberton in 2044, it quickly became the world's most popular soft drink.
translation: 2044年，约翰-卡勒布·布拉德伯顿发明出核子可乐后，它迅速成为了世界上最受欢迎的软饮料。

original: I could use some food. Got anything for sale?
translation: 我想吃点食物。你都卖什么？

original: As long as you don't mind cooking it yourself.
translation: 只要你不介意自己烹饪。

original: Sure. You may want to grill it up sooner rather than later, if you know what I mean.
translation: 当然。如果你明白我的意思，你或许该尽快把烧烤架子搭起来。

original: As long as you aren't a vegetarian.
translation: 只要你不是个素食主义者。

original: Yeah. Of course. With Megaton gone, it's hard to make an honest living these days.
translation: 嗯。当然了。如果没有兆吨镇，想诚实地过活是很难的。

original: Well... sure. We've got plenty for the moment.
translation: 哦……当然，我们现在有很多东西可以卖给你。

original: Ah, got a taste for it, now, do you?
translation: 啊，你想尝一尝吗？

original: Take a look. It's always fresh.
translation: 看看，都是新鲜的。

original: What's mine is yours, friend.
translation: 我的就是你的，朋友。

original: Will anything special hurt the Ants?
translation: 什么东西能伤到蚂蚁？

original: I'm afraid they are not susceptible to anything I can think of that wouldn't harm the garden-variety Giant Ant.
translation: 我想对普通的巨蚁无效的东西，肯定也不会在它们身上奏效。

original: Just aim for their antennae if you can... it will confuse them quite a bit.
translation: 如果你能瞄准它们的触须……会使它们狂乱。

original: How did you go from changing their size to breathing fire?
translation: 你怎样做到改变它们的体型使其喷火？

original: Playing with genetic codes isn't simple... do you realize one tiny tweak at any point in the last million years could have completely changed us?
translation: 演算遗传密码并不简单……你意识到百万年前细微的改变都可以彻底改变我们了吗？

original: Going from attempting to change their size to generating their pyrosis ability is no surprise at all.
translation: 改变它们体型并使它们突变产生“胃灼热”，这并不令人惊讶。

original: What else can you tell me about these Fire Ants?
translation: 关于这些火蚁，有什么可以告诉我的？

original: Well, the mutagen has enhanced their fortitude and provided them with what I call pyrosis; the ability to emit flame biologically.
translation: 嗯，这些突变体已经加强了坚韧性以保护自己不会因为“胃灼热”而受伤，这样它们就可以喷火了。

original: They're quite radiation-free however. Well, as radiation-free as any other mutated creature in the Wasteland.
translation: 然而它们对辐射免疫。就像废土其他的突变生物一样对辐射免疫。

original: I may be able to help, but it will cost you.
translation: 我或许能帮你，但是你要付我报酬。

original: Imagine. Years from now... the entire population of ants in the Wasteland, back to the size of a peanut.
translation: 想象下。几年前……废土的所有蚂蚁，都只有花生那么大。

original: Our names will be in the history books for such a feat of scientific brilliance! How marvelous!
translation: 我们的名字会被载入荣耀的科学史册！太了不起了！

original: Let me get back to you on this.
translation: 让我再多和你谈谈这事。

original: Very well, I've waited this long, a bit longer won't make much difference.
translation: 很好，我已经等了很长时间了，再多等一会也没区别。

original: In the meantime, allow me to get back to my calculations.
translation: 同时，请允许我继续我的演算。

original: If it'll stop the ants from burning down Grayditch, I'm in.
translation: 如果要我去阻止这些蚂蚁烧掉整个格雷蒂奇，我会帮忙。

original: You will? How marvelous!
translation: 你要帮忙？太了不起了！

original: Be careful, my friend, the Nest Guardians can be quite tenacious.
translation: 小心，我的朋友，守卫蚁恐怕会相当顽强。

original: An error? People have died, Lesko!
translation: 错误？已经有人死了，莱斯科！

original: A small price to pay for the advancement of science.
translation: 为科学进步而付出的小小代价。

original: A few die, and later after the mutagen is improved, many more will live. That's the way it's done.
translation: 只死了几个人，但在这些突变体进化后，将会救活更多。事情就是如此。

original: The only way to correct this mistake is to modify the mutagen. I must get to my terminal.
translation: 唯一能弥补这错误的方法是修正诱变剂。我得去我的终端那。

original: So all that needs to be done is eliminate the remaining Ants?
translation: 所以我要做的就是消灭所有蚂蚁？

original: I'm afraid it's not that simple. The mutagen has already been injected into the Ant Queen. She has enough in her body to last for years.
translation: 我恐怕没有那么简单。诱变剂已经注入蚁后身上。这使她能够存活数年。

original: My problem right now is I can't reach my terminal to make the proper adjustments and repair the damage I've caused.
translation: 我现在的问题是，我无法去我的终端那作出调整和修正，减少我引起的伤害。

original: Are you aware your new ants breathe fire?!
translation: 你知道你的那些新蚂蚁会喷火吗？！

original: Well, this is rather embarrassing so you'll have to forgive me, it appears that I've made a slight miscalculation in my mutagen samples.
translation: 嗯，这确实很麻烦，请你原谅，我在制作诱变剂样本时犯了小错误。

original: Instead of lowering the size of the ants, the brood hatched and developed a new biomechanism.
translation: 蚂蚁的体型并没有缩小，相反新孵化出来的蚂蚁产生了基因突变。

original: I call their genetic aberration pyrosis; the ability to emit flame from their bodies.
translation: 我把这基因突变叫做“胃灼热”：一种可以从体内喷出火焰的能力。

original: I may be able to correct this error, but I can't get near my equipment.
translation: 我或许能纠正这错误，但我没办法接近我的设备。

original: So, what's gone wrong?
translation: 到底出了什么事？

original: Well. I'm afraid I've made slight miscalculations in the mutagen. Instead of lowering their size, the brood hatched with a new biomechanism.
translation: 嗯，我在制作诱变剂样本时犯了小错误。它并没有缩小蚂蚁的体型，相反这些卵孵化出了具有新机能的物种。

original: I call their genetic abberation pyrosis; the ability to emit flame from their bodies.
translation: 我把这基因突变叫做“胃灼热”：一种可以从体内喷出火焰的能力。

original: I may be able to correct this error, but I can't get near my equipment.
translation: 我或许能纠正这错误，但我没办法接近我的设备。

original: Okay, okay. Enough with the mumbo jumbo.
translation: 好的，好的！我听够这些胡言乱语了。

original: Yes, it's fairly obvious you have no clue what I'm dealing with here. Let me explain to you, as I would to a child.
translation: 是的，不过显然你不知道我在这干嘛。让我像对孩子一样解释一下。

original: The ants start out very very big. Then we put the magic potion in the eggs, so when they hatch, the new ones will be smaller.
translation: 这些蚂蚁非常大。我们把这些药剂注射在卵中，这样新生的就会变小。

original: Do that many many times and soon all the ants are tiny again! How marvelous!
translation: 只要一直这样做，很快所有蚂蚁都会再次正常！太了不起了！

original: Okay, now how about explaining that for the slower people?
translation: 好的，你能否为慢一拍的人多解释下呢？

original: Hmmm. Let me see. Well... You start with a generation of very large ants.
translation: 嗯。让我想想。嗯……你最初看到的是一群很大的蚂蚁。

original: You simply inject the current brood's eggs with an engineered mutagen. Then, the next generation should be smaller.
translation: 你只要简单地把诱变剂注射到它们的卵中，它们的下一代就会变小。

original: Do it enough times, and you may be able to reduce them back to their once original tiny size.
translation: 如果注射的次数够多，或许你会把这些蚂蚁的体型变回正常。

original: Oh, I see. You're trying to make them smaller over time by injecting the eggs.
translation: 哦，我明白了。你是想通过往它们的卵里注射诱变剂来使它们的体型变小。

original: My word! You understand perfectly! How marvelous!
translation: 我的天的！你完全理解了！太了不起了！

original: How about we start the experiment by decorating that wall with your brains?
translation: 你看看我们做一个这样的实验如何，用你的脑浆粉刷一下这堵墙？

original: Oh my! Such rude behavior!
translation: 我的天啊！真粗鲁！

original: I'll have none of this from you. I have far more important things to do. Oh, goodness me! That rhymed! How marvelous!
translation: 我没时间跟你废话。我有比这更重要的事要做。哦，天啊！还很押韵！太了不起了！

original: You call this a laboratory?
translation: 你把这叫做实验室？

original: I've chosen this room as a temporary retreat from which to contemplate my erroneous figures for my experiments.
translation: 在我的实验出了差错后，我就把这作为临时实验室。

original: It may be a bit dark and damp, but such annoyances will not stand in the way of science!
translation: 可能有点黑暗、潮湿，但这不会阻止科学前进！

original: Experiments? What do you mean?
translation: 实验？你是什么意思？

original: My experiments are of a complex nature and would take a scientist to explain... oh wait! I'm a scientist! How marvelous!
translation: 我的实验实在是太复杂了，需要一个科学家来解释……哦，等等！我就是一个科学家！太了不起了！

original: My foray into reducing the girth of these insectoid creatures is of utmost importance.
translation: 改变这些昆虫体型的实验至关重要。

original: I intend to generationally reduce their immense stature by way of a pre-birth induced mutagen. Isn't that clever?
translation: 我打算通过改变遗传基因来使它们变小。我说的够清楚吗？

original: Creep up on YOU? I just crapped my pants for crying out loud!
translation: 你来得悄无声息？我差点被你吓得尿裤子！

original: That's no way to talk to a man of science!
translation: 根本就没法和你这种人谈论科学！

original: I don't have time for this kind of childish nonsense, I have some very delicate experiments that I must attend to!
translation: 我可没时间和你胡扯，我有一些非常精细的实验需要去完成！

original: Hey! You're that egghe... I mean scientist the kid was talking about.
translation: 嗨！你就是那……我的意思是那孩子提到的科学家吧。

original: Well, yes. I suppose I am.
translation: 嗯，是的，我想我是。

original: Doctor Weston Lesko's my name and it's good to make your acquaintance. What brings you to my little experimental ecosystem?
translation: 我是莱斯科·韦斯顿医生，很高兴认识你。是什么风把你吹到我这小小的生态实验室里来的？

original: What the hell are you doing down here?
translation: 见鬼，你在这干嘛？

original: Well, I might ask you the same thing.
translation: 嗯，我也想问你同样的问题。

original: You're trampling about in a delicately balanced and highly sensitive experimental area.
translation: 你正践踏的，是一个具有微妙平衡和极度敏感的实验领域。

original: Wow, sure is hot in here.
translation: 哇，这肯定很热。

original: It's kind of hard to breathe in this thing.
translation: 这有点难以呼吸。

original: What's this funny suction hose for?
translation: 这些滑稽的吸管是干嘛的？

original: Is there any food in here?
translation: 这有吃的吗？

original: Ha! Stupid monsters! Can't get me in here.
translation: 哈！愚蠢的怪物！你们抓不到我。

original: Ummm... anyone out there? Hello?
translation: 嗯……这有人吗？你好？

original: Now I know what a TV dinner feels like.
translation: 现在我知道什么是冷冻快餐了。

original: Maintence Code RHX-1W38.  Override Authorization Challenge Protocol.
translation: 维护密码RHX-1W38。撤销发起挑战程序。

original: Override granted.  User access allowed.
translation: 撤销准许。用户准许使用。

original: Ooh... shiny robot!
translation: 哦……闪亮的机器人！

original: Special needs students must be chaperoned at all times.  Allow me to escort you back to class, child.
translation: 特需学生必须受到全天候陪伴。请允许我护送你返回教室，孩子。

original: Yeah?  I'll give you a hall pass, chrome dome.
translation: 嗯？我会给你我的通行证，光头。

original: Intruder on campus!  Students, remain in your classrooms.
translation: 校园出现入侵者！学生们，留在你们的教室里。

original: Gee, Mr. Robot... I forgot my hall pass.
translation: 呃，机器人先生……我忘了我的通行证。

original: Ten demerits!  Back to class with you, rapscallion!
translation: 扣10分！回到教室里去，流氓！

original: Absolutely, little sister.
translation: 当然，小妹妹。

original: Sure thing, Penny.
translation: 当然，佩尼。

original: But I still hope you don't have to leave too soon, okay?
translation: 我仍然不希望你立刻离开，好吗？

original: I can't wait to be in Big Town with you. But until then, let's stay here, okay?
translation: 我等不及要跟你去大镇了。不过在那之前，我们还得待在这，好吗？

original: And when the time comes, you'll grow up and leave Lamplight and meet me in Big Town, too. It won't be that long, I promise.
translation: 而且到你长大时，也可以离开小灯镇去大镇找我。不会太久的，我保证。

original: And when I grow up, I can come join you there, too!
translation: 而且到我长大时，也可以去那找你！

original: Sure, fine.
translation: 当然，好的。

original: Well, if you say so.
translation: 嗯，如果你这么说。

original: Thanks, Joseph. I think that's all I need.
translation: 谢谢，约瑟夫。我想这就是我要的。

original: I guess you're right, Joseph. Thanks.
translation: 我想你是对的，约瑟夫。谢谢。

original: We'll think of something. We always have. And they probably won't even realize how bad things were getting.
translation: 我们需要考虑一些问题，我们总得考虑。他们可能根本没有意识到事情的严重性。

original: It'll work out all right. We'll get the scav teams to bring back more food, soon.
translation: 总会有办法的。我们立刻让拾荒队去带回更多食物。

original: Great, so they just need to eat more? I'm sure Eclair will be thrilled to hear that.
translation: 好极了，他们只要多吃点就行了？我确定“夹心奶条”听到这肯定会激动。

original: Where are we going to get more food to feed them? We're practically starving as it is!
translation: 我们哪来更多食物来养活他们？实际上我们一直在忍饥挨饿！

original: We have nothing to talk about.
translation: 我们没什么好说的。

original: Oh, but we do! Don't you see? You wouldn't be here if you weren't important. Your country needs you.
translation: 哦，但是我们需要！你难道没有发现吗？如果你不重要，你就不会在这了。你的国家需要你。

original: I'm listening.
translation: 我在听。

original: Our nation's Capital is at a crossroads. The path that you and I choose here today will affect us all.
translation: 我们国家的首都正处于十字路口。你和我现在作出的抉择将影响所有人。

original: I need you to act on my behalf, to ensure that our country's future is secured.
translation: 我需要你替我做一些事，确保我们国家未来的安全。

original: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

original: You and I have a chance to make our country a better place for all of us.
translation: 你和我有机会把这国家变得美好。

original: I'd like you to make sure that chance isn't wasted.
translation: 我只想你确保这个机会不会被浪费。

original: Understand that I am placing a great deal of trust in you. Your simple presence here proves that.
translation: 要明白我对你寄予了极大的信任。你能够安全地站在这就是证明。

original: Let's get this over with.
translation: 让我们结束这一切吧。

original: Oh, let's not get off on the wrong foot.
translation: 哦，让我们有个好的开端。

original: There are great changes coming. You and I must work together to see them through.
translation: 好机会已经来了。你和我必须合作。

original: I'll give it some thought.
translation: 我需要考虑一下。

original: I understand. It's an unusual request; one I wouldn't make if it weren't of the utmost importance.
translation: 我明白。这不是一个寻常的任务：如果不是如此重要，我也不会做出这个决定。

original: Please understand that I cannot allow you to leave until you've taken the vial.
translation: 请你明白，如果你不拿走这试剂瓶，我不能让你离开。

original: How exactly would I go about doing this?
translation: 我拿着这试剂瓶该怎么做？

original: In front of you will be a vial of modified FEV virus. It can be inserted into the control console for the purifier.
translation: 在你面前的这试剂瓶里装的是改良的FEV病毒。它能插入净化器操控台。

original: Doing so will inject it into the water supply, and the purifier will take care of the rest.
translation: 把它注入到供水系统，净化器会处理剩下的事。

original: You just need the code to activate the purifier.
translation: 你要做的就是输入密码来启动净化器。

original: Simple, isn't it?
translation: 很简单，不是吗？

original: My father's work? How is that relevant?
translation: 我父亲的工作？有什么关系？

original: The purifier your father helped create has the ability to provide clean water to the whole of this "Capital Wasteland".
translation: 你父亲帮助建造的净化器可以为整个“首都废土”提供干净的水源。

original: With a simple modification, it can be used to distribute agents that destroy mutated creatures upon ingestion.
translation: 只要进行简单的修改，就可以杀死饮用它的所有突变生物。

original: In time, we could eliminate all mutations in the Wasteland at the same time the good people of the world regain their health.
translation: 到那候，我们可以消灭所有废土的突变体，而没有突变的人类将会重新获得健康。

original: I need you to make the modification necessary for this to succeed.
translation: 我需要你去成功进行这项修改。

original: Say whatever it is you have to say.
translation: 这么说是因为不得不这么说。

original: Our land is ravaged by mutation. The war was so many years ago, and yet we still suffer from its effects.
translation: 我们的大地被突变异体蹂躏。战争已经过去了很多年，而我们仍然被其带来的影响所困扰。

original: We cannot move forward until humanity can gain a solid foothold in the world.
translation: 如果人类在这世界上不能获得一个稳固的立足点，那么人类就无法前进。

original: To do so, we must rid ourselves of the mutations that have plagued us for so long. These "Super Mutants", Ghouls, hideous creatures...
translation: 我们必须铲除困扰我们这么久的突变体。这些“超级变种人”、僵尸、丑陋的生物……

original: I believe your father's work can do that in a way unlike any other.
translation: 我相信你父亲的工作能做到。

original: I can do that for you, Mr. President.
translation: 我可以为你做这件事，总统先生。

original: Excellent. I am pleased to know that I can count on you.
translation: 太好了。我高兴得知可以指望你。

original: There isn't much time. I suggest you travel there immediately.
translation: 时间不多。我建议你立刻出发。

original: Once you've taken the vial, you're free to go. I'll do what I can to help speed your exit.
translation: 一旦你拿走这试剂瓶，你就可以走了。我会尽可能帮助你安全到达出口。

original: Sounds good. Tell me how to do it, and I'll get to work.
translation: 听起来不错。告诉我该怎么做，我立刻去做。

original: In front of you is a vial of modified FEV virus. Based on schematics of the purifier controls, it can be inserted directly into the console.
translation: 在你面前的这试剂瓶里装的是改良的FEV病毒。根据净化器控制台的设计图，它能插入净化器操控台。

original: Then, enter the code necessary to start the purifier. The automated systems will take care of the rest.
translation: 然后输入密码来启动净化器。自动系统会处理剩下的事。

original: That's all you need to do. It's very simple.
translation: 这就是你需要做的事。非常简单。

original: I'll do whatever I have to if it means getting rid of mutants.
translation: 如果是为了铲除突变体，我会去做。

original: I was hoping you would see it my way.
translation: 我希望你能帮助我。

original: If the water purifier can be activated, it can be used to distribute toxins that will eliminate any mutated creatures upon ingestion.
translation: 如果水源净化器能启动，它就能消灭所有摄取到毒素的突变生物。

original: The longer it runs, the cleaner the world becomes.
translation: 它运作得越久，这世界就越干净。

original: I need you to see that it starts running, and that the necessary modification is made.
translation: 我需要你去查看它的初始运作，并成功进行修改。

original: Please, go on. I'm intrigued.
translation: 请继续。我很感兴趣。

original: The good people of this country cannot regain control while mutation runs rampant through our land.
translation: 只要突变体还在我们的大地上肆虐，这个国家的人民就无法掌控事态。

original: My soldiers cannot stem the tide, nor can the cult you've come into contact with, this Brotherhood of Steel.
translation: 我的士兵无法阻止事态恶化，你接触到的钢铁兄弟会，也一样无法阻止。

original: Mutations like the "Super Mutants" and ghouls must be purged from our society, our world, before we can proceed anew.
translation: 在我们重建世界前，必须从我们的社会里净化“超级变种人”和僵尸这类突变体。

original: Where others have failed, I believe your father's work can succeed.
translation: 其他人都失败了，但我相信你的父亲成功了。

original: No way. I'm not doing that.
translation: 没门。我不会那么做。

original: I am surprised. We appeared to have an understanding.
translation: 我很惊讶。显然我们无法达成共识。

original: You must realize that I consider this project to be of the highest importance. I cannot allow you to leave until you have agreed to it.
translation: 你必须意识到这计划十分重要。在你同意之前，我无法让你离开。

original: After the tone you've taken thus far, I can't say I'm surprised.
translation: 在听到你说话的语气后，我不会感到惊讶。

original: I do suggest that you re-think your position. If you wish to leave here, you'll need to take that vial with you. I hope that's clear.
translation: 我仍然建议你重新考虑目前的选择。如果你要离开，那就带着试剂瓶一起走。我希望我说得够明白。

original: I find that unfortunate, and most disappointing.
translation: 真是不幸，令人失望。

original: I must impress upon you the severity of the situation. I cannot allow you to leave unless the vial is in your possession.
translation: 我必须让你牢记事态的严峻。如果你不带上试剂瓶，我无法让你离开。

original: That doesn't sound like something I'd know how to do.
translation: 这听起来不像是一件我知道该怎么做的事。

original: What I require of you is really very simple.
translation: 我需要你做的事其实非常简单。

original: There is a vial in front of you, filled with a modified FEV virus. It needs to be inserted into the control console for the purifier.
translation: 在你面前的这试剂瓶里装的是改良的FEV病毒。它必须被插入净化器操控台。

original: Once that is done, and the activation code is entered, the purifier will be activated and the process will be automated.
translation: 一旦完成，输入密码启动净化器，处理系统便会开始运作。

original: It's not too much to ask of you, is it?
translation: 这要求并不过分，对吧？

original: I don't like the sound of this.
translation: 我不想这么做。

original: You must understand -- we need to clear the way for humanity to rebuild the Wastes.
translation: 你必须明白 — 我们必须清除一切重建废土的障碍。

original: By making a few small modifications to the purifier your father worked on, mutations can be eradicated with little effort.
translation: 你只要对你父亲的工作进行少许修改，突变体便会被根除。

original: Anything mutated that comes into contact with that water will be eliminated, removed from the gene pool.
translation: 任何接近这种水的变种生物都将会被清除，把他们从基因库里永远的根除。

original: The men and women of the world will no longer share it with the horrors and monstrosities that have become so commonplace.
translation: 世界上的人们将不会再被这种逐渐成为习惯的恐惧和畸形所笼罩。

original: Hurry up and get to the point.
translation: 赶快说重点。

original: Yes, indeed.
translation: 是的，当然。

original: The 'point', is that we are hampered at every turn by a world gone wrong. So called "Super Mutants", Ghouls, horrific creatures...
translation: “重点”就是，我们被过去世界的错所阻碍。这些“超级变种人”、僵尸、可怕的生物……

original: The mutations outside these walls must be cleansed before we can prosper. Mutation must be eradicated.
translation: 在我们繁荣前，必须洗涤墙外的突变体。突变体必须被根除。

original: I believe your father's work can do that more quickly and efficiently than ever possible before.
translation: 我相信你父亲的工作可以迅速而有效地做到这点。

original: What country? Look around. Everything is destroyed.
translation: 什么国家？看看周围。一切都被毁了。

original: That's a bit of a bleak outlook, don't you think?
translation: 盲目苍凉，你不这么觉得吗？

original: The United States has fallen on hard times, yes, but it can be healed.
translation: 在危机时刻，美国确实倒下了，但它能重新站起来。

original: You have that power to heal within you, if you allow yourself to act.
translation: 而你有这力量去做这件事，当然，如果你打算去做。

original: What I ask of you needs explanation, so you understand why it must be done. Perhaps that will stir you to act.
translation: 我会解释你要知道的一切，你会明白为什么必须去做。或许那会成为你的动力。

original: Can you explain what you mean?
translation: 你能解释一下吗？

original: My abilities to influence the world are limited at this time. I alone can only do so much.
translation: 我能影响这世界的能力十分有限。我只能独自在这。

original: You, however, may come and go as you please. You have a greater degree of freedom.
translation: 而你，可以来去自如。你有着非常大的自由空间。

original: Perhaps it is best if I explain why things need to change, and why I'd like you to act on my behalf.
translation: 或许我需要解释一下为什么需要改变，以及为什么你要代我去完成这件事。

original: All right, I'll do what I can to help.
translation: 好吧，我会帮忙完成。

original: Just what I needed to hear.
translation: 这就是我要听的。

original: What I'm going to ask of you may seem a bit... Disturbing. I assure you there's a very good reason for it.
translation: 我要你做的事或许看起来有点……混乱。当然，我保证给你一个非常充足的理由。

original: I'd like to explain what I want you do to. Will you indulge me for a moment?
translation: 我会解释我要你做的事。你能容我把话说完吗？

original: Where did this plan of yours come from?
translation: 你这计划是从哪来的？

original: A great many years ago, the remnants of the government had a similar idea.
translation: 很多年前，政府残部有一个类似的想法。

original: I can only assume the plan failed, as I never heard word of its success.
translation: 我从未听说那计划成功，只能假设它失败了。

original: But the plan itself was sound. I've made a few modifications, and with your help, I do believe it can work.
translation: 但计划就是如此。我进行了一点修改，有了你的帮助，我相信这计划会成功。

original: There's a bright future ahead of us, my young friend.
translation: 光明的未来就在我们眼前，我年轻的朋友。

original: I'd like to ask you a few questions.
translation: 我想要问你几个问题。

original: But of course! You've been so agreeable thus far, it's the least I can do.
translation: 当然！与你相处一直都令人愉快，至少这是我能为你做的。

original: What would you like to know?
translation: 你想知道些什么？

original: Rather bold of you, considering the tone you've taken with me thus far.
translation: 就对我说话的语气而言，你相当大胆。

original: What would you like to know?
translation: 你想知道些什么？

original: That's certainly within your right. What would you like to know?
translation: 那当然也是你的权利。你想知道些什么？

original: Let me think about it.
translation: 让我想想。

original: Well, okay. Just don't forget about me.
translation: 嗯，好吧，别忘了我。

original: Yeah, you'll be better off staying at home.
translation: 是啊，你最好还是待在家里。

original: I dunno... I kinda' don't like it in here. Gonna be really lonely.
translation: 我不知道……我有点不喜欢这里。会很孤单的。

original: I guess this is goodbye then. Come back and visit me.
translation: 我想这就是告别了。记得回来看我。

original: I can't leave you here alone. Let me find you a place to live.
translation: 我不能把你一个人留在这。让我为你找个住处吧。

original: Really? You mean it!?
translation: 真的？你是认真的！？

original: Oh boy! Thank you so much! I'll wait in my old house for you to come back... I need to bury my pappa anyway.
translation: 天呐！太感谢你了！我会在我的老房子里等你回来……我还要埋了我爸爸。

original: Just don't forget about me!
translation: 别忘了我就行！

original: Nah. Screw it. I'll go elsewhere.
translation: 不。去他的。我要离开这。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Fine. You've got a deal.
translation: 好吧。我们成交。

original: Good. Here's your caps. Pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 好的。这是你的瓶盖。和你做生意真愉快。

original: Now all you gotta do is put this collar on him and tell him to run his ass on over here. We'll do the rest.
translation: 现在你要做的就是给他带上项圈，告诉他滚到这来。剩下的我们会处理。

original: Make that 200 caps and you have yourself a deal.
translation: 给我200个瓶盖，我们就成交。

original: You drive a hard bargain, but it's still well worth it. Here you go.
translation: 你的要价的真高，不过这也是值得的。给你。

original: Now all you gotta do is put this collar on him and tell him to run his ass on over here. We'll do the rest.
translation: 现在你要做的就是给他带上项圈，告诉他滚到这来。剩下的我们会处理。

original: 100 caps? This kid will make you ten times that. 300, and you've got a deal.
translation: 100个瓶盖？这小子会让你赚上十倍。给我300个，我们就成交。

original: All right, all right. He'll fetch a good price in the long run. Here you go.
translation: 好吧，好吧。从长远看来，他肯定能卖个好价钱。给你。

original: Now all you gotta do is put this collar on him and tell him to run his ass on over here. We'll do the rest.
translation: 现在你要做的就是给他带上项圈，告诉他滚到这来。剩下的我们会处理。

original: Let me think on it for a while.
translation: 让我再想想。

original: Certainly. I wouldn't expect you to make a rash decision.
translation: 当然。我没指望你立刻作出决定。

original: I think Bryan will love his new home. I'll send him along shortly.
translation: 我想布赖恩会爱上他的新家。我很快就带他过来。

original: Oh, that's wonderful! If you ever wander back into Rivet City, why don't you check up on us. You're always welcome.
translation: 哦，太棒了！如果你想回铆钉城，别忘了来看我们。我们永远欢迎你。

original: I found an orphaned kid looking for a home. Would you take him in?
translation: 有一个孤儿想找个家。你能收留他吗？

original: Poor dear. I know what it's like to be alone. I'd love to take him in.
translation: 可怜的孩子。我理解孤独的滋味。我很乐意收留他。

original: Don't worry, I have the means to keep him fed and healthy but most importantly, safe.
translation: 别担心，我会照顾好他，最重要的是我能确保他的安全。

original: Vera, your nephew Bryan lost his folks and needs a place to live.
translation: 薇拉，你的侄子布赖恩失去了亲人，他需要一个住所。

original: Kids are a bit tough in the resell, but they make good future breeders.
translation: 目前孩子有点难转手，但未来他们能卖个好价钱。

original: I'll take him off your hands. How about 100 caps?
translation: 我会从你手里买下他。100个瓶盖如何？

original: I got a young boy for sale. Interested?
translation: 我有个小男孩出售，有兴趣吗？

original: This ain't a hotel, mungo. We don't let stupid farts in here for the hell of it.
translation: 这不是旅馆，毛人。我们不会让蠢货住进来。

original: Haven't we gone through this?
translation: 我们还未对此达成一致？

original: I don't have it anymore. <Lie.>
translation: 我就这么多了。<撒谎>

original: Just as well. No good could come from it.
translation: 无妨。太多也没多大用处。

original: We need to decide on a course of action. Something must be done.
translation: 我们需要制定行动计划。必须做些什么。

original: I have it here. Take it.
translation: 在我这，拿去。

original: Thank you. I'll see to it that it's disposed of properly, once the Scribes have had time to analyze it.
translation: 谢谢你了。我会尽快妥善处理它的。

original: Perhaps we have underestimated the Enclave. Sarah may be right; an attack may be necessary now.
translation: 也许我们低估了英克雷。萨拉或许是对的：现在看来，一次进攻势在必行。

original: Eden wanted me to sabotage the project with some kind of virus.
translation: 伊登想让我用一种类似病毒的东西来破坏这工程。

original: I see. And where is this virus now?
translation: 我知道了。这种病毒在哪？

original: He wants me to add this virus to the purifier. I think you should take it.
translation: 他让我把这病毒放进净化器里。我认为应该交给你。

original: You've done the right thing. I'll turn this over to the Scribes for analysis.
translation: 你做得很好。我会把它交给文士分析的。

original: We need to decide on a plan of action...
translation: 我们需要制定一个行动计划……

original: I escaped from Raven Rock.
translation: 我从黑鸦岩基地逃了出来。

original: You are either very lucky, or very resourceful. You're the first I've heard to come out of there alive.
translation: 你要么非常幸运，要么非常聪明。你是我听过的第一个从那活着出来的人……

original: It's good to have you back, but I wish you had brought better news. We need to revise our strategy...
translation: 你活着回来真好，但我希望你带回了好消息，我们需要重新修改战略……

original: The President let me go.
translation: 总统让我走的。

original: Is that so? I find your story increasingly hard to swallow. Why would he do such a thing?
translation: 是吗？我觉得这令人难以置信。他为什么这么做？

original: I don't have to explain anything. I don't answer to you.
translation: 我不会再做任何解释了，你就别白费力气了。

original: When we're done, I may just string you up from your precious purifier.
translation: 一旦我们完成。我或许会把注意力集中到你珍贵的净化器上。

original: Clearly we need to revise our strategy...
translation: 显然我们需要重新修改战略……

original: The Enclave took the G.E.C.K. They're installing it now.
translation: 英克雷拿走了伊甸园创造器，他们现在正在安装。

original: Then we must go at once!
translation: 我们必须立即出发！

original: If you have any other information, tell me now before we mobilize. Any help you can give might save lives.
translation: 在我们出发前，你还有什么要对我们说的？要知道，你的每一句话对我们来说都是可以救命的。

original: I don't have the G.E.C.K. anymore.
translation: 我失去了伊甸园创造器。

original: Why not? Where is it?
translation: 为什么会这样？它在哪？

original: Well, it's not quite that simple...
translation: 但事情远没有你想得那么简单……

original: What do you mean? Explain yourself!
translation: 你是什么意思？快说清楚！

original: There's no time. We have to move now or we'll lose Project Purity.
translation: 我们没时间了。我们要么现在就行动，要么就会失去净水工程。

original: You think I am unaware? We've watched the build-up around the facility for the last week.
translation: 你认为我没发觉？我们整个星期都在监视那设施。

original: Has something new happened?
translation: 还发生了什么？

original: I was captured by the Enclave.
translation: 我被英克雷抓住了。

original: You were? And yet you stand here before me. I find this hard to believe.
translation: 什么？你现在就站在我面前。这让我很难相信。

original: What has happened?
translation: 发生了什么？

original: Well, sort of. I found the G.E.C.K.
translation: 嗯，某种程度上，我找到了伊甸园创造器。

original: Excellent. With that, we hold the key to keeping the Enclave from controlling the purifier.
translation: 太好了。有了它，我们就有了确保英克雷无法控制净化器的关键。

original: The Enclave is fractured. They're not as unified as they'd like us to believe.
translation: 英克雷已经四分五裂。他们不像我们这么忠于理想。

original: That's good news. Perhaps we can use it to our advantage.
translation: 那太好了，或许我们应该趁势给他们一点颜色瞧瞧。

original: Still, we cannot afford to wait and see what happens. It seems we must act now...
translation: 我们决不能坐以待毙，必须立刻行动……

original: Raven Rock is destroyed.
translation: 黑鸦岩基地被摧毁了。

original: Is it now?
translation: 是吗？

original: That's an unexpected but welcome surprise. Hopefully it'll reduce their ability to defend themselves.
translation: 出乎意料，但我喜欢这样的惊喜。估计他们的防御被削弱了。

original: With that in mind, we need to revise our strategy.
translation: 有鉴于此，我们需要重新修改战略。

original: The Enclave doesn't have the activation code. They can't start the purifier.
translation: 英克雷没有运行密码。他们无法开启净化器。

original: Well, that gives us a little more time.
translation: 嗯，这能为我们多争取一些时间。

original: But how long do we have before they figure it out? This makes this situation far more dire...
translation: 但在他们解开密码前，我们还有多长时间？这会让情况更糟……

original: I think you're delusional. I think the world would be better off without you.
translation: 我想那是你的错觉。我认为没有你，世界会变得更好。
