original: Who dares interrupt my celebration?
translation: 谁敢打断我的庆典？

original: It must be the Mechanist! His meddlesome metal army is already inside! Destroy them!
translation: 肯定是机械侠！他多事的金属军队已经进来了！消灭他们！

original: I swear, we will destroy the Mechanist and his pitiful toys!
translation: 我发誓，我们会摧毁机械侠和他那些可怜的玩具！

original: Aha! That's the spirit, chum! You seem quite capable - you got to me after all. You can be my official sidekick!
translation: 啊！就是这种精神，好友！你看起来足堪重任 — 你最终得到了我的信任。你能成为我的正式伙伴！

original: I'm afraid I don't have another suit, though.
translation: 我恐怕没有其他套装。

original: But we can deal with that problem later. We've got bigger ants to fry! Now, how to proceed?
translation: 但我们能迟点处理这问题。我们有只大蚂蚁得干掉！现在，我们该怎么做？

original: I suppose you're right. Maybe we can work together.
translation: 我觉得你是对的。或许我们能一起工作。

original: Yes, you would join me in fighting the Mechanist! Him and his little tin men, made by humans to kill humans for other humans.
translation: 是，你可以加入我，与机械侠战斗！与他和那些由人类制造，并用来残杀其他人类的罐头人战斗！

original: Would you turn your back on humanity's failings? Would you join the ant court in our destruction of the Mechanist and his hubris?
translation: 你能抛弃人性的弱点吗？你会加入蚂蚁团队，去摧毁我们的敌人机械侠和他的傲慢吗？

original: Maybe you're right. Maybe I should join your side.
translation: 或许你是对的。我应该加入你。

original: Long ago, I was a mere citizen like yourself. Beyond a talent for computers, I had no power in this world.
translation: 很久以前，我也和你一样是个平民。除了在电脑领域的一技之长，我根本没有任何力量。

original: But then the AntAgonizer attacked, and killed someone very dear to me. The damage was too much for me to fix her. But I knew what I had to do.
translation: 但自从痛苦蚁后的袭击杀死了我的亲人后。我收到了太大伤害，无法原谅她。我明白了自己该怎么做。

original: That tragedy burned away the weakness of my previous life, and in the fires of revenge, the Mechanist was forged!
translation: 那场悲剧烧尽了我的软弱，在复仇的火焰里，机械侠诞生了！

original: Why did you decide to become the Mechanist?
translation: 你为什么会决定成为机械侠？

original: Lies! Unlike the rest of you peasants, I was born for greatness. I was never meant to crawl in the muck of mankind!
translation: 谎言！跟你这种乡下人不同，我生来伟大。我绝不会向男人低头！

original: But the ants knew my destiny. When I was but a larva, they rescued me from my filthy human family.
translation: 但蚂蚁知道我的命运。当我还年幼时，它们把我从我那肮脏人类家庭中救了出来。

original: They saw my nobility, and they saved me from a human life of fear and pain. Now, I will lead them to their glorious future!
translation: 它们发现了我的高贵，它们从人类恐惧而痛苦的命运中拯救了我。现在，我会领导它们步向光明的未来！

original: Without your suit, you're just a normal human like anyone else.
translation: 如果脱掉套装，你和普通人没什么区别。

original: Long ago, I was a mere citizen like yourself. Beyond a talent for computers, I had no power in this world.
translation: 很久以前，我也和你一样是个平民。除了在电脑领域的一技之长，我根本没有任何力量。

original: But then the AntAgonizer attacked, and killed someone very dear to me. The damage was too much for me to fix her. But I knew what I had to do.
translation: 但自从痛苦蚁后的袭击杀死了我的亲人后。我收到了太大伤害，无法原谅她。我明白了自己该怎么做。

original: That tragedy burned away the weakness of my previous life, and in the fires of revenge, the Mechanist was forged!
translation: 那场悲剧烧尽了我的软弱，在复仇的火焰里，机械侠诞生了！

original: Why did you decide to become the Mechanist?
translation: 你为什么会决定成为机械侠？

original: Lies! Unlike the rest of you peasants, I was born for greatness. I was never meant to crawl in the muck of mankind!
translation: 谎言！跟你这种乡下人不同，我生来伟大。我绝不会向男人低头！

original: But the ants knew my destiny. When I was but a larva, they rescued me from my filthy human family.
translation: 但蚂蚁知道我的命运。当我还年幼时，它们把我从我那肮脏人类家庭中救了出来。

original: They saw my nobility, and they saved me from a human life of fear and pain. Now, I will lead them to their glorious future!
translation: 它们发现了我的高贵，它们从人类恐惧而痛苦的命运中拯救了我。现在，我会领导它们步向光明的未来！

original: Without your suit, you're just a normal human like anyone else.
translation: 如果脱掉套装，你和普通人没什么区别。

original: Lies! Slander! I'll never let you compare a noble hero like myself to that, that base villain!
translation: 谎言！诽谤！我绝不会让你用高贵的我和那卑鄙的流氓比较！

original: But now it's all clear to me. You're an agent sent by the AntAgonizer, using your honeyed words to trick me into letting down my defenses!
translation: 我全明白了。你是痛苦蚁后派来的，想用甜言蜜语骗我放弃抵抗！

original: Well, the jig is up! Prepare to face the burning lasers of justice, evildoer!
translation: 拿起武器！准备面对正义的激光吧，恶徒！

original: You just want to keep fighting the AntAgonizer. You're as bad as she is.
translation: 你只不过是想继续和痛苦蚁后战斗。你和她一样邪恶。

original: Of course I do! Do you think I'm insane?!
translation: 当然！你觉得我疯了？！

original: Why, with this suit, I'm more than any ant could hope to be! And ten times more than any mere mortal like you or the Mechanist!
translation: 噢，有了这套装，我就是蚂蚁最大的希望！这希望要比你们这些人类或机械侠大10多倍！

original: But now, the time for your prattle has come to an end. If you shall not bow before your ant queen, then bleed before the AntAgonizer!
translation: 但现在，闲聊到此为止。如果你不向蚂蚁女王俯首称臣，那就死痛苦蚁后面前！

original: You do realize you're not really an ant... right?
translation: 你知道你不是一个真正的蚂蚁……是不是？

original: Why, you aren't a citizen at all! You must be a vile minion of my arch-nemesis, the AntAgonizer! Obviously, we must battle at once!
translation: 噢，你不是这的平民！你肯定是痛苦蚁后卑鄙的奴仆！显然，我们应该开战！

original: I'm afraid I can't allow you to persist in your evil plans. Percival, attack this villain!
translation: 我恐怕我不能允许你坚持那邪恶的计划。珀西瓦尔，攻击这恶徒！

original: I've had enough of you and your silly costume. Get ready to die.
translation: 我受够了你和你那愚蠢的套装。准备受死吧。

original: My loyal subjects are the result of 100 million years of evolution, and they'll outlive your pitiful kind. We'll see who has the last laugh!
translation: 我忠诚的产物是进化1亿年的成果，它们远比你们这可怜种活得久。让我们看看谁会笑到最后！

original: Now, my ant royal guard... Kill this unruly peasant!
translation: 现在，我忠诚的皇家守卫……杀死这个无礼的乡下人！

original: Your ants are a joke. Time to die, crazy lady!
translation: 你的蚂蚁不过是小意思。受死吧，疯女人！

original: Oh! Well, in that case, welcome! Welcome, dear citizen!
translation: 哦！嗯，如果是这样，欢迎！欢迎你，亲爱的平民！

original: But an ordinary citizen no longer, eh? Hmm...
translation: 但不再是普通平民，呃？嗯……

original: You'll be my sidekick! I hereby grant you the title of Mechano-Lad!
translation: 你会成为我的伙伴！在此我授予你机械小子的头衔！

original: Well then, my trusty chum, shall we prepare to defeat our nemesis?
translation: 我值得信赖的老友，或许我们该准备去对付我们的敌人了？

original: I've come to help you get rid of the AntAgonizer.
translation: 我是来帮助你除去痛苦蚁后的。

original: Oh! Well, in that case, welcome! Welcome, dear citizen!
translation: 哦！嗯，如果是这样，欢迎！欢迎你，亲爱的平民！

original: But an ordinary citizen no longer, eh? Hmm...
translation: 但不再是普通平民，呃？嗯……

original: You'll be my sidekick! I hereby grant you the title of Mechano-Lass!
translation: 你会成为我的伙伴！在此我授予你机械女孩的头衔！

original: Well then, my trusty chum, shall we prepare to defeat our nemesis?
translation: 我值得信赖的老友，或许我们该准备去对付我们的敌人了？

original: I've come to help you get rid of the AntAgonizer.
translation: 我是来帮助你除去痛苦蚁后的。

original: This is an unexpected surprise! A human who understands its place.
translation: 这可真是意想不到的惊喜！一个人类明白了自己的处境。

original: One who realizes that ants are destined to walk this land, while humans and their toys are destined only to rot beneath it?
translation: 一个意识到蚂蚁必将漫步大地，而人类和他们的玩具则只能在其足下腐烂的人类？

original: Perhaps, even a human who wants to join the winning side, yes? One that would humbly beg admittance to the ant queen's court?
translation: 或许，即使是人类都想要加入胜利的一方，对吧？卑微地乞求进入蚂蚁女王庭院的许可？

original: Relax. I'm here to help you get rid of that Mechanist character.
translation: 别紧张。我是来帮助你除去机械侠的。

original: I realize you mean well, but I'm afraid you're being naive. The AntAgonizer is a madwoman, and the only thing that will stop her is force.
translation: 我明白你的意思，但我恐怕你太天真了。痛苦蚁后是个疯女人，除了武力，无法阻止她。

original: As much as I wish peace were an option, the AntAgonizer is too deluded, too inhuman to listen to reason.
translation: 我也希望和平是一个选择，但痛苦蚁后天性残忍，精于欺骗，她不会听你的解释。

original: Sadly, sometimes the scaly claw of tyranny must be destroyed by the cold, unfeeling pincers of justice!
translation: 可悲的是，有时蹩脚的暴政之爪必须被冷酷而无情的正义之钳粉碎！

original: I'm just here to talk. We can find a peaceful way to stop this fighting.
translation: 我是来谈判的。我们应该找到一个和平的方法来停止这场战斗。

original: Ha ha! You would walk here and presume to command me?
translation: 哈哈！你以为可以跑到这命令我吗？

original: Humanity's time has come to an end. Your kind died because it knew only petty bickering and wars.
translation: 人类的时代结束了。你的种族会仅仅因为小小的争吵和战争而灭绝。

original: But not so, the noble ant! It works with its brethren, knowing only loyalty and duty. And this is why they have grown, while humanity crumbled!
translation: 但不是这样，蚂蚁是高尚的！它们与同胞精诚合作，只懂忠诚与职责。这就是在人类几乎灭绝时，它们还在增长的原因！

original: Once I've finished with that pathetic Mechanist, I will be free to spread my colonies across the Wastes!
translation: 一旦我解决了那可怜的机械师，我会把我的领地扩展到整个废土！

original: Your days of terrorizing the town are over. Give up and you won't get hurt.
translation: 你统治镇子的日子已经结束了。投降吧，你还能留条命。

original: Honey, I'll take anything you feel like paying for.
translation: 亲爱的，你随便给我些报酬就好。

original: Only if you're buying it, big guy.
translation: 除非你买下来，大家伙。

original: I don't need help, Bleak. But thank you.
translation: 我不需要帮助，布里克。但还是谢谢你。

original: I wouldn't hold your breath, girl. I'm quite content.
translation: 我没抱太大希望，女孩，我很满意。

original: There's a good girl.
translation: 真是个好女孩。

original: That's better.
translation: 这样好多了。

original: I'm sorry... Mr. Eulogy.
translation: 对不起……尤勒基先生。

original: I'm sorry, Sir.
translation: 对不起，先生。

original: Look, you rotting piece of shit! Tell me what you know or it's splatter time!
translation: 听好了，别老是说废话！说你知道的事情，别浪费时间！

original: All right! I'll tell you! Please, just don't hurt me!
translation: 好吧！我会告诉你的！请不要伤害我！

original: Moriarty keeps a computer terminal in the back. On it, he keeps all of the dirty secrets of Megaton.
translation: 莫里亚蒂在后面有个终端机。里面记录了兆吨镇所有的肮脏秘密。

original: If you can get onto that terminal, I bet he has information on your Dad.
translation: 如果你能进入那终端，我打赌肯定有你父亲的讯息。

original: Now, get away from me, smoothskin. If Moriarty even suspects I told you this, I'm a dead Ghoul.
translation: 现在，离我远点，光皮肤。如果让莫里亚蒂知道是我告诉了你这些，我真的就成“僵”掉的“尸”体了。

original: If you know anyone else that can help, I'd appreciate it.
translation: 如果你告诉我还有谁能帮上忙，我会很感激的。

original: Moriarty is your best bet. I wish you luck. Now, I have to get back to work, or I'll be answering to him too.
translation: 能回答你的只能是莫里亚蒂了吧。祝你好运。现在，我要回去工作了，否则我就得去回答他了。

original: Gob, please. If you know anything about my father, you need to tell me.
translation: 天啊，求你。如果你知道我父亲的任何事，请告诉我。

original: I was like you once. I wandered into town looking for an escape from this stupid joke of a body I'm trapped in. Now look at me.
translation: 我曾跟你一样。想要进入镇子，找到一个让这身体不受歧视的世外桃源。现在你看到我怎样了。

original: Very well. Moriarty keeps a computer terminal in the back. On it, he keeps all of the goings on in Megaton.
translation: 好吧，莫里亚蒂在后面有个终端。里面记录了兆吨镇所有发生过的事情。

original: If you can get onto that terminal, I bet he has information on your Dad.
translation: 如果你能进入那台终端，我打赌你肯定有你父亲的讯息。

original: Now, get away from me, smoothskin. If Moriarty even suspects I told you this, I'm a dead Ghoul.
translation: 现在，离我远点，光皮肤。如果让莫里亚蒂知道是我告诉了你这秘密，我真的就成“僵”掉的“尸”体了。

original: Look, if you know something, you'd better tell me!
translation: 听着，如果你知道什么，你最好告诉我！

original: Look, smoothskin. I've told you all I dare. Moriarty doesn't like me chatting with the customers like this.
translation: 听着，光皮肤。我把我能说的都告诉你了。莫里亚蒂不喜欢我和客人这么交谈。

original: If he even thought I was talking to you, he'd tan my hide!
translation: 如果他光是以为我和你聊过，他都会扒掉我的皮！

original: Let me get back to work now before he sees us.
translation: 在他发现我们前，我得回去工作。

original: I talked to Moriarty already and he's trying to charge me for the info.
translation: 我已经和莫里亚蒂谈过了，他打算要我花钱买那消息。

original: Sigh. That's his way. Always putting caps before people's lives.
translation: 唉。那就是他的方式。钱总摆在命前面。

original: I wish someone would stand up to him one day. Oh my.... I shouldn't be saying all of this!
translation: 我希望有人能出来收拾他。哦，天啊……我不该说这些！

original: I'm sorry, I really must get back to work. I can't get involved. I'm so sorry.
translation: 对不起，我真的必须去工作了，我不想被牵连。对不起。

original: Sounds good to me.
translation: 听起来对我有利。

original: Well then, let's make a deal!
translation: 让我们做个交易！

original: Finally! Let's get down to business.
translation: 终于！你开始认真考虑生意了。

original: Actually, let me pick another Theme.
translation: 实际上，我想换个主题。

original: Certainly!
translation: 行！

original: Agh... make up your mind already!
translation: 啊……赶快决定吧！

original: Let me ask about something else.
translation: 我想问些其它事。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: Fine.
translation: 很好。

original: I'm interested in the Pre-War Theme.
translation: 我对战前装饰主题感兴趣。

original: Feeling a bit nostalgic are we?
translation: 有点怀旧的感觉，对吧？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: Still want to live in the past, huh? Well, forget it. Those days are long gone.
translation: 仍然想活在过去，呃？嗯，忘了它吧。那种生活已经一去不复返了。

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: I'm interested in the Science Theme.
translation: 我对科学装饰主题感兴趣。

original: You're the intellectual type, eh?
translation: 你是个知识份子，对吧？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: Sounds great, Poindexter.
translation: 听起来不错，波因德克斯特。

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: I'm interested in the Wasteland Explorer Theme.
translation: 我对探险装饰主题感兴趣。

original: Longing for the great outdoors are we?
translation: 寻求美妙的户外生活，对吧？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: Well, if you have to feel like your out in the Wasteland, I guess this is for you. Me, I like to stay out of the sun.
translation: 嗯，如果你想感觉像在废土，我想这适合你。我不喜欢待在太阳下。

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: I'm interested in the Raider Theme.
translation: 我对掠夺者装饰主题感兴趣。

original: Into the blood and guts look, eh?
translation: 想住在鲜血与内脏中，对吧？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: Into the blood and guts look? Reminds me of my old home.
translation: 想住在鲜血与内脏中？让我想起老家。

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: I'm interested in the Vault Theme.
translation: 我对避难所装饰主题感兴趣。

original: Feeling a bit homesick are we?
translation: 有点思乡的感觉，对吧？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: Awww... do we miss our old home?
translation: 啊……我们不都想念老家吗？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <沉默不语>

original: You're an odd one, aren't you?
translation: 你是个怪人，对吧？

original: You don't have a problem with killing all those people?
translation: 你对杀死那些人不会有异议吧？

original: Oh no. I'm certainly rather sore about all that. But certain sacrifices must be made.
translation: 哦，不。我当然会对此感到悲伤，但某些牺牲是必需的。

original: Besides, Burke assured me that bomb was quite unstable. I asked Burke to suggest they vacate.
translation: 此外，伯克向我保证那核弹相当不稳定。我要布尔奇建议他们搬走。

original: It was all a matter of time. Think of it as helping speed along the process of natural selection. Don't lose any sleep over it.
translation: 这都是时间上的问题。就把这当成是促进自然选择的进程。让它不会长时间的停滞不前。

original: You've got to clear away the past to make room for the future.
translation: 你应该忘记过去，多考虑未来。

original: Well said! Indeed! You've got the entrepreneurial spirit! It gives me hope to see young people, such as yourself, with real heads on their shoulders.
translation: 说得好！确实如此！你有着创业精神！看到像你这样充满理想的年轻人，会带给我希望。

original: I've been wondering... why blow up Megaton?
translation: 我在想……为什么要炸掉兆吨镇？

original: I complained off hand one day about how I thought that heap of metal on the horizon was a bit of an eyesore. Mister Burke offered to take care of it.
translation: 曾经有一次，当我看到地上一大堆废铁的时候，我立刻就把它们当成眼中钉，抱怨连连。伯克先生提供帮助来除掉它们。

original: Burke is such an agreeable man, isn't he? I don't know how I got along without him. I practically don't have to think about things anymore.
translation: 伯克真是令人满意，对吧？我不知道没有了他我还能干什么。我都不用考虑任何事。

original: He takes care of everything. I seldom even have to ask. He's a real go-getter, that one. We need more men like him if we're to rebuild the world.
translation: 他面面俱到。我很少过问他做的事情。他真的非常能干。如果我们想要重建这世界，就需要更多像他那样的人。

original: What are you shooting at out there?
translation: 你在这射击什么？

original: Why, anything I want, dear boy. Anything I want... Wasteland safari. Very relaxing.
translation: 怎么了，我随心所欲，亲爱的小子。随心所欲……废土狩猎之旅。很放松。

original: Why, anything I want, dear girl. Anything I want... Wasteland safari. Very relaxing.
translation: 怎么了，我随心所欲，亲爱的丫头。随心所欲……废土狩猎之旅。很放松。

original: Whatever. I never knew her anyway.
translation: 无论如何，我也无法了解她了。

original: I'm sorry you never had the chance to know her. She was... She was a good woman.
translation: 很遗憾你没有机会了解她。她……是个好女人。

original: You "weren't prepared"? My mother is dead!
translation: 你“还没准备好”？我母亲已经死了！

original: As I said, I am sorry. I'm afraid I can't go back and change the past.
translation: 就像我说的，很抱歉，恐怕我无法改变过去。

original: I understand. I'm sure you did everything you could.
translation: 我理解，我确定你已经尽力了。

original: Yes, well... I'm sorry it wasn't enough.
translation: 是的，嗯……我很抱歉做得还不够。

original: Candace, it's Ralph. Tell dad there's no way in hell I'm spending nuclear Armageddon trapped with him in a fucking closet.
translation: 堪达斯，这是拉尔夫。告诉爸爸，我不可能在这场末日审判中和他待在一个狗屁柜子里。

original: You can have my number. It's "6." Now if you'll excuse me, I've got a mushroom cloud to walk into. Have a happy holocaust!
translation: 我告诉你我的密码。是“6”。如果你不介意，我现在要去蘑菇云里散散步。核战争快乐！

original: Ralphie, son, this is your father! We can't get into the goddamn Vault without you! Get your ass over here now! My "4" is useless without you, boy...
translation: 拉尔夫，儿子，这是你父亲！没有你，我们无法进入那该死的避难所！立刻给我过来！没有你，我的“4”没用，孩子……

original: Mom, it's Candace. Oh my God, it's really happening. I can see the cloud... it's so big... Mom, I'm so scared.
translation: 妈妈，这是堪达斯。我的天啊，真的发生了。我看见那云……好大……妈妈，我害怕。

original: I'm heading to the Vault now. I'll do whatever I can to get inside. My number of the passcode was "7," right?
translation: 我现在就去避难所。我会不惜一切代价进去。我的密码数字是“7”，对吧？

original: Paul, it's me. Tina. I heard back from my sister Candace. We couldn't get into a Vault. 101, 87, didn't matter -- all full to capacity.
translation: 保罗，是我。蒂娜。我从妹妹堪达斯那听说了。我们进不去87号和101号避难所，无所谓 — 反正也人满为患了。

original: But my brother Alex is a soldier and... he sort of stole the pass code for a secure Army bunker. He did it for the family. But they caught him.
translation: 但是我的哥哥亚历克斯是个士兵，而且……他几乎偷到了进入一个军事安全地堡的密码。他是为了家人才这么干的，但他被抓了。

original: Before they took him into custody, Alex he sent each of us one number of the four-digit code. That way, we all have to be together to get in.
translation: 在他被羁押前，亚历克斯给我们每个人一个数字，这数字来自一个4位数。这样，我们必须一起才能进去。

original: He gave me number "5" -- the day of my birth.  So I guess what I'm saying is... I'm still leaving. It's been fun. Kind of.
translation: 他给我的是“5” — 那是我的生日。所以我想我得说……我还是得离开。我过得很开心。

original: Oh, and I'm not pregnant. So no worries.
translation: 对了，我没有怀孕。所以别担心。

original: Tina, it's me. Your brother? Alex? Listen, mom would kill me if she knew I was contacting you, but she's being an impossible bitch right now.
translation: 蒂娜，是我。你哥哥，亚历克斯。听着，妈妈要是知道我联系过你，肯定会杀了我的，但她现在就像是个不可理喻的婊子。

original: You have to come home. Do you understand me? This thing with China... it's not going away. We're going to try to get into one of those Vaults.
translation: 你得回家。你明白吗？和中国的战争……不会结束。我们要想办法进入一个避难所。

original: If that doesn't work, well... I have a backup plan. There's this secure bunker... another sort of vault... inside the National Guard Depot, and...
translation: 如果不成功，嗯……我有一个备用计划。有一个安全地堡……另一种避难所……在国民警卫队仓库里，还有……。

original: Look, no matter what it takes, the whole damn Keller family's gonna ride this storm out, but you've got to get your ass home. Now!
translation: 听着，无论付出什么代价，凯勒一家一定能安然度过这场灾难。至于你，你给我回家去。现在就走！

original: You there! Burke! Explain your business in Megaton.
translation: 你！伯克！解释你来兆吨镇的目的。

original: I'm sorry? Sheriff, what are you hollering about?
translation: 怎么回事？警长，你在抱怨什么？

original: You know damn well what I'm talking about. The bomb! You're trying to blow it up! Have you lost your goddamned mind?
translation: 该死的你很清楚我在说什么。那核弹！你想引爆它！你该死的疯了吗？

original: Sheriff. I’m afraid there’s been a misunderstanding. Someone has surely been spreading rumors. I’ll be sure to address the situation... personally.
translation: 警长。我恐怕我们有些误会。有人在散布谣言。我会亲自……去确认。

original: I'm placing you under arrest, Burke. At least until I figure out what the hell's going on around here.
translation: 我要逮捕你，伯克。直到我搞清楚发生了什么见鬼的事。

original: And I'M afraid I won't be able to oblige your request, Sheriff. I have pressing matters to attend to. Now... step aside.
translation: 我恐怕你不能如愿，警长。我还有很重要的事要做。立刻……让开。

original: This isn't open to discussion! You're coming with me.
translation: 我不是来征求你的意见的！你跟我来。

original: Why do you knuckle draggers always insist on doing things the hard way? Very well, Sheriff. Lead the way.
translation: 为什么你们总是喜欢用强硬的手段？很好，警长。带路吧。

original: Actually, I think he was just kidding.
translation: 实际上，我认为他只是开玩笑。

original: You better stop playing games with me, boy!
translation: 你最好不要耍我，男孩！

original: You better stop playing games with me, girl!
translation: 你最好不要耍我，女孩！

original: He gave me this Fusion Pulse Charge to rig to the bomb. Here, take it.
translation: 他给我这核聚变合脉冲电池，要我装在核弹上。给，拿去。

original: Jesus! Gimme that thing!
translation: 天啊！把那东西给我！

original: Let's go find this Burke character. You're about to get an education in Wasteland justice.
translation: 让我们去找这个伯克。你会受到废土正义的洗礼。

original: Jesus! Gimme that thing!
translation: 天啊！把那东西给我！

original: Thanks. If Burke steps within a mile of Megaton, he's a dead man.
translation: 谢谢你。如果伯克敢步入兆吨镇一英里以内，他就死定了。

original: What if he asks someone else to explode the bomb? You should do something.
translation: 如果他要其他人去引爆核弹呢？你该做些什么。

original: Good point. Come with me. You're about to get an education in Wasteland justice.
translation: 说得对。跟我来。你会经历一次废土正义的洗礼。

original: He's long gone by now. But I swear: If he steps within a mile of Megaton, he's a fucking dead man.
translation: 他早离开了。但我发誓：如果他敢步入兆吨镇一英里以内，他就他妈的死定了。

original: Too many lives are at stake, Burke! I'm going to defuse that bomb.
translation: 太多人活在危险中，伯克！我要去解除核弹！

original: I advise you against that particular course of action. If you interfere with my employer's wishes, you will find he can be quite -- disagreeable.
translation: 我劝你别这么做。如果你阻碍我雇主的愿望，你会发现他将十分 — 不悦。

original: All right. Say I decide to help you. What's in it for me?
translation: 好吧。如果我帮了你，对我有什么好处？

original: You mean besides doing the world a favor by removing this pestilent scab of a town?
translation: 你的意思是去除这镇子里的致命污点，献给这世界一份礼物？

original: Why, you'd be rewarded most handsomely! My employer is a very generous man. If it's bottle caps and luxury you're seeking. You shall have it!
translation: 噢，你会得到大笔报酬！我的雇主是非常慷慨。如果你要的是瓶盖和奢华，你会得到满足。

original: Simms wants me to disarm the bomb...
translation: 西姆斯想要我解除核弹……

original: Simms is an idiot. He prides himself on his position as mayor and sheriff of this scrapyard.
translation: 西姆斯是个蠢货。他对作为这垃圾场的镇长和警长而感到骄傲。

original: Here. These letters arrived for you while you were gone. I'm not a fucking post office you know.
translation: 喏，这些信是你不在的时候到的。我又不是他妈的邮局，懂吗。

original: Here. These damn love letters have been waiting around for you.
translation: 给。这些该死的情书可一直在这儿等着你呢。

original: This letter came for you. I run a saloon, not a post office. But does anyone listen? No. Well, go on take the damn letter already.
translation: 这封是你的信。我开的是酒馆，不是邮局。但有人听吗？没有。行了，赶紧把这该死的信拿走得了。

original: Another of those damn love letters arrived for you.
translation: 又有一封你那该死的情书到了。

original: Burke, you silly man. You'll pay me 500 extra caps... and like it.
translation: 伯克，你这傻瓜。你得多付我500个瓶盖……就这样。

original: Five hundred you say? Well... Um... Yes. Yes, I think that can be arranged.
translation: 你说500个？嗯……嗯……可以。可以，我觉得可以考虑。

original: I must admit. I find you... enchanting. Do this for me, and there's no telling how far my gratitude will reach.
translation: 我必须承认。我发现你……很迷人。为我做这事，我的谢意难以言表。

original: Take the Fusion Pulse Charge. Place it into the bomb. Then meet me at Tenpenny Tower. There I will show you what true power is.
translation: 拿着核融合脉冲电池，把它装到核弹上。然后到特佩尼大厦来见我。我会展现给你看什么是真正的力量。

original: You see, I live here, lover. And surely you wouldn't want to hurt me...
translation: 你知道，我在这生活，亲爱的。显然你不想伤害我……

original: Well... I... I mean... Of course not... I must admit, I've never met a woman quite like you before. This changes everything...
translation: 嗯……我……我的意思是……当然不……我必须承认，我之前从未见过像你这样的女人。这改变了一切……

original: I'm not sure what I'm going to tell Tenpenny... I'll think of something...
translation: 我不知道我该怎么对特佩尼说……我再想想……

original: You wait here my dear. I have some important business to attend to. But you won't be waiting long. I shall send for you soon.
translation: 你在这等着，亲爱的。我有些重要的生意要关注。但你不会等太久。我立刻就会来找你。

original: I have a "proposition" of my own. Would you like to hear it, Mister Burke?
translation: 我有一个“提议”。伯克先生，你想听听吗？

original: Color me intrigued. Go on...
translation: 我很感兴趣。继续……

original: If that bomb ever explodes, it would be doing the world a favor...
translation: 如果那核弹爆炸，将是献给这世界的一份礼物……

original: Oh really? Is that so?
translation: 哦，真的？这是真的？

original: You may not think much of this town, but you're a guest in my home, and I'd advise you to behave as such.
translation: 你或许并不认同这个镇子，但你是我们的家的客人，我建议你安分守己。

original: I hope I've made myself perfectly clear.
translation: 我希望说得够清楚。

original: Whatever. I don't plan on sticking around very long, anyway.
translation: 无所谓。我不打算在这待很久。

original: Fine. Enjoy your stay in Megaton. Don't get into any trouble and we'll go on pretending we're friends.
translation: 好的。希望你在兆吨镇过得愉快。你不找麻烦，我们就会保持“朋友”的关系。

original: I can see about disarming that bomb for you.
translation: 我去试着解除那核弹。

original: Oh, all right. Fine. But listen here. Just take a look at it first. Go easy.
translation: 哦，好吧。太好了。但听着，你得先观察仔细，慢慢来。

original: If you get the job done, there'll be 100 caps in it for you.
translation: 如果你搞定，就有100个瓶盖可拿。

original: One day, that thing's going to go off. You're living on borrowed time.
translation: 总有一天，那东西会爆炸。你们这是在死亡的边缘过活。

original: Maybe. Maybe...
translation: 或许。或许……

original: So long as you stay away from the bomb, I see my chances of a long life improving. I hope we understand each other.
translation: 只要你远离那核弹，我能活下去的可能性就越大，希望我们可以互相理解。

original: Who would build a town around a bomb? That's crazy!
translation: 谁会把镇子建在核弹旁？真是疯了！

original: It's not like the place was put up over night. Megaton's been here for decades, been growing and growing ever since.
translation: 这可不是一夜之间建起来的。兆吨镇已经建了10多年，而且一直在发展。

original: Started out as a small settlement of people trying to get into Vault 101. When they were denied, they stuck around here.
translation: 刚开始，一些人打算去101号避难所定居。当他们被拒绝后，就留在了这。

original: Some of 'em started worshipping the thing like a god. Now we've got a whole goddamn Church. They're nuts, no doubt, but mostly harmless.
translation: 有些人把那东西当神一样崇拜。现在我们有了个该死的教堂。毫无疑问，他们疯了，但是大多数人是无害的。

original: By now, most people don't give a shit. They figure if it ain't gone off by now, it never will. I respectfully disagree.
translation: 现在，大多数人漠不关心。他们认为如果现在不爆炸，以后也不会。我完全不同意这观点。

original: Don't you think someone should disarm that thing?
translation: 你不认为该找个人去解除它吗？

original: I don't trust any of the locals to tinker with it. Besides, most people don't even realize it's still a threat.
translation: 我不相信有原住民能搞定。此外，大多数人没有意识到那仍是一个威胁。

original: And hell, Cromwell and those crazies from the Church of Atom, they worship the damn thing.
translation: 而且克伦威尔和那些来自原子教堂的疯子崇拜着那该死的东西。

original: Why? Do you think you got the know-how to disarm it? For good?
translation: 为什么？你认为你知道如何解除它？可以一劳永逸？

original: I'm just messing with you. Relax!
translation: 我逗你玩呢。放松！

original: I've got my eye on you, drifter...
translation: 我会盯着你，流浪者……

original: You're dead.
translation: 你死定了。

original: Let's do it, then!
translation: 那咱们就这么干吧!

original: Ha! I'm just messing with you.
translation: 哈！我逗你玩呢。

original: Fucking psycho Wastelanders...
translation: 这些磕嗨的废土游民我真是操了……

original: I want your hat. What do you think about that?
translation: 我想要你的帽子。你觉得如何？

original: I think you're suicidal. Try me.
translation: 我觉得你想自杀。你倒试试！

original: I want that hat. What do you think about that?
translation: 我想要你的帽子。你觉得如何？

original: There's a new sheriff in town! It's time to die, asshole.
translation: 镇里有一个新镇长了！你该去死了，混蛋。

original: I ain't killed a drifter in weeks. This should be fun!
translation: 我都有一星期没杀流浪者了。这真有趣！

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <沉默不语>

original: God, I hope you ain't one of those psychotic quiet types. So... is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 老天，你可千万别是那种一声不吭的疯子啊。那……您还有其他吩咐吗？

original: You don't scare me.
translation: 你吓不倒我。

original: You got something you want to prove, boy?
translation: 你想证明什么，男孩？

original: You got something you want to prove, girl?
translation: 你想证明什么，女孩？

original: Right. Message received.
translation: 好的，知道了。

original: I'm glad we understand each other. Now, is there something I can help you with?
translation: 我很高兴我们能互相理解。现在，我能为你做些什么呢？

original: Well I'll be damned. You're from that vault! Vault 101! Ha ha! I ain't seen one of those jumpsuits in a LONG time!
translation: 我的天啊。你是从避难所来的！101号避难所！哈哈！我很多年没见到你那种工作服了！

original: I'll be damned. Another newcomer.
translation: 该死。又一个新来者。

original: Agreed. Why else would the Outsider have been allowed into the Grove? Perhaps it's a test. Yes... that must be it!
translation: 同意。不然为什么会允许外来者进入小树林呢？也许这是一场考验。对……一定是这样！

original: Once again, my husband, we are at an impasse. I suggest we speak to the Outsider.
translation: 丈夫啊，我们又一次陷入了僵局。我建议我们去和那个外来者谈谈。

original: If we allow the spread of this miracle to continue, we're putting Him in jeopardy. I can't allow that... I won't allow it!
translation: 如果我们任由这个奇迹继续传播，我们就是在将祂置于险境。我不能允许那样……我绝不允许！

original: How can we preach about peace when all you want to do is keep His gift all to ourselves? That's not what He would want!
translation: 如果你只想把祂的恩赐据为己有，我们又怎么能宣扬和平呢？那不是祂想要的！

original: The Outsider is here to deliver us from our enemies! To keep this place safely locked away from the Wasteland! Not to exploit us!
translation: 外来者来这是为了将我们从敌人手中解放出来！为了将这个地方安全地从废土中隔绝开！而不是来利用我们！

original: And I'm telling you, you've got it all wrong! Why else would He have called for an Outsider's assistance?
translation: 另外我告诉你，你全错了！否则为什么祂会寻求一个外来者的帮助呢？

original: I'm not sure I could live with these loonies.
translation: 我不确定自己能否和这些疯子一起生活。

original: You have a lot of nerve! We've shown you nothing but hospitality and then instead of thanks, you chose to hurl insults?
translation: 你太过分了！我们对你只有款待，而你却不知感恩，反而出口伤人？

original: I'm all for sharing Oasis with the rest of the Wasteland, but if you're an example of what we face in doing so, perhaps it's a mistake!
translation: 我一直赞成与废土上的其他人共享绿洲，但要是你就是我们这么做时会遇到的典型，那或许是个错误！

original: Why'd you stay here after you recovered?
translation: 你康复后为什么还待在这？

original: I felt I owed these people for bringing me back from the brink.
translation: 我觉得我欠这些人一份情，是他们把我从死亡边缘拉了回来。

original: Honestly, I've never seen anything like this place... it's beautiful. It's a shame only a few people will ever get to see it.
translation: 坦白说，我从未见过像这样的地方……它太美了。只可惜，只有少数人能有幸目睹它的美。

original: Dying? How awful! What happened to you?
translation: 奄奄一息？太可怕了！发生了什么？

original: I was a Brotherhood of Steel Outcast. We had a deep patrol out here, looking for some tech and then got jumped by some Deathclaws.
translation: 我曾是一名钢铁兄弟会放逐者。我们对这进行深入巡逻，寻找一些科技，然后被一群死亡爪袭击了。

original: They shredded everyone else and left me bleeding to death. If it wasn't for Oasis and Bloomseer Poplar, I'd be dead right now.
translation: 它们撕碎了其他人，留我在那里流血等死。要不是绿洲和“花先知”波普勒，我现在已经死了。

original: Honestly, I've never seen anything like this place... it's beautiful. It's a shame only a few people will ever get to see it.
translation: 坦白说，我从未见过像这样的地方……它太美了。只可惜，只有少数人能有幸目睹它的美。

original: So, how did you end up here?
translation: 那么，你怎么最终来到这的？

original: I was born here, silly!
translation: 我就出生在这儿呀，真傻！

original: I was brought here by His will. I heard his calling, and I followed.
translation: 我是被他的意志带到这的。我听到了他的呼唤，并跟随前来。

original: I believe only a few are worthy enough to find this place, and I'm honored to be among them.
translation: 我相信只有少数人可以找到这，我为我是其中一员而感到荣幸。

original: That's why I dread the day Oasis overgrows its boundaries.
translation: 这就是为什么我害怕绿洲扩展边界。

original: I was brought here by His will. I heard his calling, and I followed. Isn't it wonderful?
translation: 我是被他的意志带到这的。我听到了他的呼唤，并跟随前来。这是不是很棒？

original: Remind me again how you found Oasis.
translation: 再跟我讲讲你是怎么找到绿洲的。

original: I was found dying in the Wastes not far from here by a trader caravan. They knew about this place and brought me to Bloomseer Poplar.
translation: 一支商队在离这不远的废土里发现了我，当时我奄奄一息。他们知道这地方，就把我带到了“花先知”波普勒处。

original: She nursed me back to health, and I've stayed ever since.
translation: 在她的照料下我恢复了健康，从那以后我就一直留在这里了。

original: There isn't much more to the story. I was dying and these people saved my life, so here I'll remain.
translation: 也没更多可说的。我快死时，这里的人救了我的命，所以我留了下来。

original: Remind me again how you found Oasis.
translation: 再跟我讲讲你是怎么找到绿洲的。

original: My father was a healer like myself. He had the most curious books I would read about trees and plants and their medicinal properties.
translation: 我父亲和我一样是个医者。他有一些非常有意思的书，我从里面读到关于树木、植物及其药用价值的内容。

original: Many years later, I heard a rumor about a place such as this. I spent a decade in search of it.
translation: 许多年后，我听说了有关这样一个地方的传闻。我花了十年时间来寻找它。

original: I've been in this wonderful place for over fifteen years now.
translation: 如今我在这个美妙的地方已经待了十五年多了。

original: I was an Outsider like yourself... wandering the world aimlessly, wasting my life trying to seek my fortune.
translation: 我曾经和你一样是个外来者……漫无目的地在世上漂泊，耗费光阴试图发财。

original: When my eyes beheld the splendor of Oasis, I knew I'd found a holy place. Tree Father Birch allowed me to stay and I've been here ever since.
translation: 当我亲眼目睹了绿洲的壮丽景象，我就知道自己找到了一处圣地。“树之父”伯奇允许我留下，我从那时起便待在这。

original: What's your opinion of Tree Father Birch and Leaf Mother Laurel?
translation: 你对“树之父”伯奇和“叶之母”萝瑞尔有什么看法？

original: They're the best parents ever!
translation: 他们是最棒的父母！

original: I've only known them for a very short time, but when I first arrived they immediately took me in and treated me just like a son.
translation: 我认识他们的时间很短，但是当我初次来到时，他们很快就接纳了我，而且像对待儿子那样对待我。

original: There aren't many people in the world left like that.
translation: 这世界上像他们那样的人不多。

original: Lately, things have gotten a bit worse between them. It sometimes takes months for them to agree on things.
translation: 后来，他们之间的关系变糟了。他们对一件事取得共识需要花费几个月的时间。

original: I know they love each other greatly, but I'm afraid the strain of leadership is tearing them apart.
translation: 我知道他们彼此深爱对方，但恐怕领导权之争正拆散他们。

original: I wish they wouldn't argue so much. It makes everyone uncomfortable.
translation: 我希望他们别那么频繁地争吵。这让大家都很不自在。

original: I think this place would be lost if it weren't for them.
translation: 如果没有他们，我想这地方很快就会消亡。

original: There's no telling what fate may have befallen the Great One if someone like the godless Raiders had gotten here first.
translation: 如果是那些邪恶的歹徒先来到这，圣贤面对的命运将不言而喻。

original: Where is the entrance to the caves?
translation: 洞穴的入口在哪？

original: The entrance to the caves is to the southwest of the Pavilion.
translation: 洞穴的入口在亭的西南面。

original: You'll find the entrance in the southwestern part of Oasis.
translation: 你们会在绿洲的西南方找到入口的。

original: Where did the sap come from?
translation: 这汁是从哪来的？

original: The Liniment was made by Bloomseer Poplar. Her knowledge of His gifts and how they can be used to help us is nothing short of astounding.
translation: 这搽剂是“花先知”帕普勒制作的。她拥有他赋予的知识，懂得让植物为我们所用，对此不必感到吃惊。

original: Where did the Liniment come from?
translation: 这汁是从哪来的？

original: Bloomseer Poplar has a unique understanding of the innate power that lay dormant in the plants you see around you.
translation: “花先知”帕普勒对你周围的植物所蕴含的力量有着独特的见解。

original: She created the sap with the knowledge she brought to us from the Wasteland.
translation: 她用从废土带来的知识，为我们制作了汁。

original: Were you aware that Laurel gave me this Liniment?
translation: 你知道是萝瑞尔给了我搽剂吗？

original: Of course I am. I know everything that goes on in Oasis. Laurel is free to pursue whatever path she chooses.
translation: 当然。我知道绿洲的一切。萝瑞尔可以自由选择要走的路。

original: A long time ago, it was agreed that the Tree Father and the Leaf Mother hold equal say. I don't seek to change those customs.
translation: 这是早就定好了的，根据约定“树之父”与“叶之母”拥有同等的权力。我不想改变惯例。

original: I just hope that when the time comes, you'll make the right choice.
translation: 我只是希望到那时，你会作出正确的选择。

original: Why don't you just travel to Harold's heart on your own?
translation: 你为什么不自己去哈罗德的心脏？

original: The Great One has not yet allowed us entry below ground. We were uncertain as to why until you arrived.
translation: 圣贤之前不允许我们进入地下。在你到来前我们并不知道他这么做原因。

original: I would if I was able, but He will not allow us entry. His roots bar the door, and we have yet to earn the right to pass.
translation: 如果我能，我会去。但他不允许我们进入。他的根须阻挡了入口，我们尚未获得通过的权力。

original: I'd like to ask about something else.
translation: 我想谈谈其他事。

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: Go on.
translation: 继续。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: I have some questions about the task you gave me.
translation: 对于你给我的任务，我有些疑问。

original: Certainly, please ask them.
translation: 行，问吧。

original: By all means, ask away.
translation: 没问题，随便问。

original: I give up. Just let me know what you want now.
translation: 我放弃。告诉我你要什么。

original: I heard what my husband wanted you to do. What I propose is an alternative.
translation: 我听到了我丈夫想让你做的事。我有个别的提议。

original: The same person that created the sap also created this Liniment. If you can reach His heart, it will assist in making His influence increase.
translation: 制作那汁液的人，同样也制作这种搽剂。如果你能抵达祂的心脏区，这将有帮祂扩大影响。

original: Instead of centuries, the Wasteland will become green in mere decades! Just imagine how glorious that would be!
translation: 无需数世纪，只要几十年，废土便会遍布绿色的生机！想象下那是多么壮观！

original: Uh oh... I see where this is going...
translation: 呃哦……我知道这是要怎么发展了……

original: I heard what my husband wanted you to do. What I propose is an alternative.
translation: 我听到了我丈夫想让你做的事。我有个别的提议。

original: The same person that created the sap also created this Liniment. If you can reach His heart, it will assist in making His influence increase.
translation: 制作那汁液的人，同样也制作这种搽剂。如果你能抵达祂的心脏区，这将有帮祂扩大影响。

original: Instead of centuries, the Wasteland will become green in mere decades! Just imagine how glorious that would be!
translation: 无需数世纪，只要几十年，废土便会遍布绿色的生机！想象下那是多么壮观！

original: How can I possibly help?
translation: 我能帮上什么忙吗？

original: I heard what my husband wanted you to do. What I propose is an alternative.
translation: 我听到了我丈夫想让你做的事。我有个别的提议。

original: The same person that created the sap also created this Liniment. If you can reach His heart, it will assist in making His influence increase.
translation: 制作那汁液的人，同样也制作这种搽剂。如果你能抵达祂的心脏区，这将有帮祂扩大影响。

original: Instead of centuries, the Wasteland will become green in mere decades! Just imagine how glorious that would be!
translation: 无需数世纪，只要几十年，废土便会遍布绿色的生机！想象下那是多么壮观！

original: This is a waste of my time.
translation: 这是在浪费我的时间。

original: I can understand your frustration. Seeing Him in so much pain makes me feel a sense of sadness in my heart too.
translation: 我能理解你的挫败感。看到他深陷于痛苦之中，我的心也会感到同样深刻的悲哀。

original: The Great One yearns to share His miracles with the whole world... to give the gift of life back to the dead Wasteland!
translation: 圣贤期待与整个世界分享他的奇迹……将生命的带回到这荒芜的废土中！

original: Now that you're here, I have a feeling the winds are about to change.
translation: 现在有你在这，我能感觉到一切都将改变。

original: Why don't any of you listen to Harold?
translation: 为什么你们都不听听哈罗德的想法？

original: Of course we do! He yearns to share His miracles with the whole world... to give the gift of life back to the dead Wasteland!
translation: 我们当然听啦！祂渴望与全世界分享祂的奇迹……将生命的带回到这荒芜的废土中！

original: It's upsetting Him to no end, but Birch can't see the pain its causing.
translation: 这让祂无比心烦意乱，可伯奇却看不到这带来的痛苦。

original: But now that you're here, I have a feeling the winds are about to change.
translation: 不过既然你来了，我感觉风向马上要变了。

original: Doesn't anybody care what your god thinks?
translation: 难道就没人在乎你们的神是怎么想的吗？

original: Of course we do! He yearns to share His miracles with the whole world... to give the gift of life back to the dead Wasteland!
translation: 我们当然听啦！祂渴望与全世界分享祂的奇迹……将生命的带回到这荒芜的废土中！

original: It's upsetting Him to no end, but Birch can't see the pain its causing.
translation: 这让祂无比心烦意乱，可伯奇却看不到这带来的痛苦。

original: But now that you're here, I have a feeling the winds are about to change.
translation: 不过既然你来了，我感觉风向马上要变了。

original: Good! Free firewood for all!
translation: 好！免费的柴火！

original: That's it! You are no longer welcome in Oasis! Get out IMMEDIATELY!
translation: 够了！绿洲不再欢迎你！立刻离开！

original: If you remain here against my wishes, we'll have no choice but to put you down!
translation: 假如你违背我的意愿仍留在这，我们就只能打倒你！

original: You don't scare me Birch, and neither does that overgrown weed you call a god.
translation: 你吓不倒我的，伯奇，还有那棵你奉为神的巨型杂草也吓不倒我。

original: I've had enough of your blasphemy!
translation: 我受够了你的亵渎之言！

original: I've tolerated it this long because you're an Outsider, but no more. If you wish to test me again, you'll find yourself banished from Oasis!
translation: 因为你是个外来者，我才容忍了你这么久，但到此为止了。如果你再考验我一次，你会发现自己被逐出绿洲！

original: Killing him should stop his influence from spreading.
translation: 杀死他应该会阻止他的影响扩散。

original: You misinterpret His words, my friend. He wants you to extinguish that which seeks to make Him vulnerable.
translation: 我的朋友，你误解了祂的话。祂希望你消除那些会让祂受到伤害的因素。

original: If the same sap that you drank to purify yourself could be applied to His heart, it should stop the spread.
translation: 那种你喝了能净化自身的汁液，要是能用到祂的心脏，应该能阻止这种扩散。

original: I can promise you no harm would come to Him. That's all I ask of you, Outsider. Nothing more, nothing less.
translation: 我向你保证，祂不会受到任何伤害。外来者，这就是我对你的全部请求。不多也不少。

original: So what can I do to help?
translation: 那我能帮什么忙呢？

original: If the same sap that you drank to purify yourself could be applied to His heart, it should stop the spread.
translation: 那种你喝了能净化自身的汁液，要是能用到祂的心脏，应该能阻止这种扩散。

original: I can promise you no harm would come to Him. That's all I ask of you, Outsider. Nothing more, nothing less.
translation: 我向你保证，祂不会受到任何伤害。外来者，这就是我对你的全部请求。不多也不少。

original: Did you know that crazy tree thing wants me to kill it?
translation: 你知道那棵疯狂的树状物想让我杀了它吗？

original: That's it! You are no longer welcome in Oasis! Get out IMMEDIATELY!
translation: 够了！绿洲不再欢迎你！立刻离开！

translation: 假如你违背我的意愿仍留在这，我们就只能打倒你！

translation: 你吓不倒我的，伯奇，还有那棵你奉为神的巨型杂草也吓不倒我。

translation: 我受够了你的亵渎之言！

original: I've tolerated it this long because you're an Outsider, but no more. If you wish to test me again, you'll find yourself banished from Oasis!
translation: 因为你是个外来者，我才容忍了你这么久，但到此为止了。如果你再考验我一次，你会发现自己被逐出绿洲！

original: Are you aware that Harold wants to die?
translation: 你知道哈罗德想死吗？

original: Yes, I've been pondering that riddle myself for some time now and I think I know what He's trying to tell us.
translation: 知道，一段时间以来我也一直在琢磨这个谜题，而且我觉得我明白祂想告诉我们什么。

original: The Great One's influence is growing and soon it will break free of the confines of this secluded vale.
translation: 圣贤的影响在不断扩大，很快就会突破这片隐秘山谷的限制。

original: We can't allow Oasis to call attention to itself like that. It would be the end of Him.
translation: 我们不允许绿洲这样引起外界的注意。那将是祂的末日。

original: Did you know your god wants me to kill him?
translation: 你知道你们的神想要我杀死他吗？

original: Yes, I've been pondering that riddle myself for some time now and I think I know what He's trying to tell us.
translation: 知道，一段时间以来我也一直在琢磨这个谜题，而且我觉得我明白祂想告诉我们什么。

original: The Great One's influence is growing and soon it will break free of the confines of this secluded vale.
translation: 圣贤的影响在不断扩大，很快就会突破这片隐秘山谷的限制。

original: We can't allow Oasis to call attention to itself like that. It would be the end of Him.
translation: 我们不允许绿洲这样引起外界的注意。那将是祂的末日。

original: Can we just dispense with all of the religious crap? His name's Harold!
translation: 我们能不能别再扯这些宗教废话了？他叫哈罗德！

original: Oh, He's testing you now, just like He tested us!
translation: 哦，祂现在是在考验你，就像祂曾考验我们一样！

original: He wants to see if your faith is strong by spinning these incredible stories. Who else but a god could produce all of this?
translation: 祂编造这些离奇的故事，就是想看看你的信仰是否坚定。除了神，还有谁能创造出这一切呢？

original: Don't worry, you'll soon see things as I do.
translation: 别担心，你很快就会和我有一样的看法了。

original: He's not a god, Birch. His name's Harold.
translation: 他不是神，布尔奇。他的名字是哈罗德！

original: Oh, He's testing you now, just like He tested us!
translation: 哦，祂现在是在考验你，就像祂曾考验我们一样！

original: He wants to see if your faith is strong by spinning these incredible stories. Who else but a god could produce all of this?
translation: 祂编造这些离奇的故事，就是想看看你的信仰是否坚定。除了神，还有谁能创造出这一切呢？

original: Don't worry, you'll soon see things as I do.
translation: 别担心，你很快就会和我有一样的看法了。

original: I'm afraid Harold isn't a god. He's just a human that had some bad luck.
translation: 我恐怕哈罗德不是神，他只是个倒霉的人。

original: Oh, He's testing you now, just like He tested us!
translation: 哦，祂现在是在考验你，就像祂曾考验我们一样！

original: He wants to see if your faith is strong by spinning these incredible stories. Who else but a god could produce all of this?
translation: 祂编造这些离奇的故事，就是想看看你的信仰是否坚定。除了神，还有谁能创造出这一切呢？

original: Don't worry, you'll soon see things as I do.
translation: 别担心，你很快就会和我有一样的看法了。

original: ...could have sworn I saw some movement back there.
translation: ……我发誓看到那后面有东西在动。

original: One two... got a bullet for you...
translation: 一、二……赏你颗子弹……

original: Let's go, you hairy fucks. I ain't got all day.
translation: 来呀，你这长毛杂种。我都闲了一天了。

original: Fuckin' Yao Guai.
translation: 他妈的妖怪。

original: Get out here, 'Guai. I got a present for you.
translation: 滚到这来，妖怪。我有礼物给你。

original: Come on out, you smelly bastards.
translation: 滚出来，你这臭杂种。

original: I thought I heard something over here...
translation: 我好像听到了什么声音……

original: Yoohoo! Yao Guai! C'mon out!
translation: 啊哈！妖怪！滚出来！

original: I did what had to be done.
translation: 我做了该做的事。

original: And well done indeed.
translation: 干得真不错。

original: Now GNR can be heard clear across the Capital Wasteland again. That'll give Eden and those Muties something to think about.
translation: 现在银河新闻电台又一次响彻废土上空，伊登总统和那些变种人终于有机会用用他们的脑子了。

original: And well done indeed.
translation: 干得真不错。

original: Now GNR can be heard clear across the Capital Wasteland again. That'll give Eden and those Muties something to think about.
translation: 现在银河新闻电台又一次响彻废土上空，伊登总统和那些变种人终于有机会用用他们的脑子了。

original: But before I get back to my calling, I bet you wanna hear about that military weapons cache.
translation: 在我继续广播之前，我打赌你想听听关于那军火隐藏点的事情。

original: And well done indeed.
translation: 干得真不错。

original: Now GNR can be heard clear across the Capital Wasteland again. That'll give Eden and those Muties something to think about.
translation: 现在银河新闻电台又一次响彻废土上空，伊登总统和那些变种人终于有机会用用他们的脑子了。

original: But before I get back to my calling, I bet you wanna hear about your Dad.
translation: 在我继续广播之前，我打赌你想听听你父亲的事。

original: I wish I could have met your parents. I bet they were... interesting.
translation: 真希望我见过你父母。我打赌他们……很有趣。

original: Parents? Ha! I was born from the sun and have sand in my veins.
translation: 父母？哈！我是太阳之子，血管里流动的都是沙子。

original: Ha ha! Just messing with you.
translation: 哈哈！我逗你玩呢。

original: My parents were very cool. They preached all about the haters and their bullshit... how to tell the propaganda from the real deal.
translation: 我的父母非常酷。他们宣传的全是愤世者及其狗屁理论……通过实实在在的交易来布道。

original: This is bullshit! You're blackmailing me!
translation: 他妈的！你这是勒索！

original: I want to make sure I'm perfectly clear on this -- the Good Fight is bigger than you and your dad.
translation: 我确定我的思路很明确 — 圣战比你和你爸爸更重要。

original: I'll do whatever it takes to keep the Capital Wasteland free. Whatever. It. Takes.
translation: 我会做一切能让首都废土保持自由的事情。无论什么代价。

original: And right now, without GNR at full strength, my words are being wasted. And that just ain't acceptable.
translation: 现在，银河新闻电台无法全功率传播，我的心血的广播付诸流水。那是最让人无法接受的。

original: No way in hell am I getting near a Super Mutant!
translation: 让我接近一个超级变种人可他妈没门！

original: Look. You approached me, remember? And no one said this would be a cake walk.
translation: 听着。至少你接近了我，记得吗？也没人会说这很简单。

original: But there's something behind those eyes of yours that screams "I'm the one who can get shit done!"
translation: 但从你眼中我能看到一个声音“只有我才能做到！”

original: Your dad had that same look in his eyes too. That's why I'm helping you.
translation: 你父亲有着和你一样坚定的双眼。那就是为什么我会帮你。

original: No way, I'm not fetching some stupid dish for you.
translation: 没门。我才不会被你的天线迷惑。

original: You aren't getting the dish for me, you're getting it for YOU.
translation: 你不是帮我，你是帮你自己。

original: If you need some time to think it over, that's cool. But the longer GNR is quiet, the longer you have to wait.
translation: 如果你需要一点时间考虑考虑，那很好。但银河新闻电台沉寂的时间越久，你找爸爸需要花费的时间也越久。

original: Let me think about this. I don't know if I'm ready.
translation: 让我考虑下。我不确定我准备好了。

original: Wow, and here I thought you were in a rush. Whatever, man. Chat me up when you're ready.
translation: 哇，现在我才发现你是个急性子。怎样都行，哥们，你准备好就告诉我一声。

original: You've got yourself a deal.
translation: 你做了明智的选择。

original: He he! I sure know how to pick 'em!
translation: 呵呵！我当然知道怎么搞定那玩意！

original: You're going to be the best thing that ever happened to Galaxy News in a long time.
translation: 你将要成为银河新闻最棒的长期新闻人物了。

original: If you need any more info, I'll be here waiting for you.
translation: 如果你需要更多讯息，尽管问。

original: Again with the damn stories. Just get to the point.
translation: 又是该死的长篇大论。说重点。

original: Fine, fine...
translation: 好吧，好吧……

original: Since you're too impatient to listen to the details, I'll get to the point.
translation: 既然你不耐烦听细节，那我就直接说重点。

original: The broadcast relay on the Washington Monument needs to be replaced and there's only one replacement for it.
translation: 华盛顿纪念碑上的电台收发器需要更换，而这只有一个替代品。

original: It's the dish off of the old Virgo II Lunar Lander in the Museum of Technology.
translation: 那是个在科技博物馆的处女座2号登月舱上的通讯碟形天线。

original: How did you know I was looking for my Dad?
translation: 你怎么知道我在找我爸爸？

original: Oh come on. This is Three Dog you're talking to. I got my ear to the ground and I hear the wagons coming.
translation: 哦，拜托。跟你说话的可是三狗。眼观六路耳听八方的三狗。

original: But if you want help, you're going to have to contribute to the Good Fight.
translation: 但如果你想我帮你，就得先为圣战做点贡献。

original: How did you know what I needed?
translation: 你怎么知道我需要什么？

original: Oh come on. You're a splitting image of the guy. He's been here before, and now you're here. Doesn't take a genius to figure it out.
translation: 哦，拜托。你和他就像是一个模子里刻出来的。你们两人都曾站在这个位置。简直像得令人难以分辨。

original: You want to find your dad, and it just so happens his location is known to yours truly.
translation: 你想找到你的父亲，而碰巧我知道他在哪。

original: But if you want to know more, you're going to have to contribute to the Good Fight.
translation: 但如果你想再打听什么，就得先为圣战做点贡献。

original: Then Rivet City is where I'm headed. Goodbye, Three Dog.
translation: 那我去铆钉城了。再见，三狗。

original: Goodbye. Remember to keep us tuned in while you're out there, and watch yourself.
translation: 再见。到那里后记得调好频率和我们保持联系，还有照顾好自己。

original: Don't forget about your promise... make sure your dad knows about the Good Fight.
translation: 不要忘记你的承诺……一定要让你的爸爸了解圣战。

original: Rivet City? Where's that?
translation: 铆钉城？在什么地方？

original: You've never heard of Rivet City? Wow. Just... wow.
translation: 你没听说过铆钉城？哇。真是……哇。

original: Well, a whole bunch of eggheads got together and turned a beached aircraft carrier into a town. Pretty cool, huh?
translation: 嗯，一群书呆子合力把一艘搁浅的航母改造成了一座城镇。真酷，呃？

original: Just follow the river south from here... there's no way you can miss it.
translation: 只要沿着这河往南走……你不会错过的。

original: On second thought, maybe I should contribute. What do you have in mind?
translation: 回头想想，或许我应该做点什么。你想让我干嘛？

original: Well good. I'm glad to see you realize there's more to life than just what you need; that there's a bigger picture.
translation: 很好。很高兴你明白利己利人这道理；这样心胸才会更加开阔。

original: Ain't gonna be easy, though. You ready for this?
translation: 但这不是什么容易的事。你准备好了吗？

original: I know he will. He's always talked about doing what's right.
translation: 他一定会。他最看重的就是做正确的事。

original: When your dad passed through here, I spent a good long time talking to him about all kinds of stuff.
translation: 当你父亲路过这里的时候，我和他谈了很久很多。

original: He mentioned some scientific mumbo-jumbo which didn't make sense to me... ummm... something about a "Project Purity."
translation: 他提到的一些我完全不懂的科学术语……唔……像是“净水工程”。

original: He also said something about going to visit a Doctor Li in Rivet City. Then, he left in a hurry.
translation: 他还说要去铆钉城去拜访李博士。之后就匆忙赶路了。

original: Look, Three Dog. If I find my Dad, maybe he can help with the Good Fight.
translation: 你看，三狗，如果我找到了我爸爸，或许他能帮上圣战。

original: Well, your dad is some sort of scientist type. Some kind of egghead or something.
translation: 你爸爸属于科学家型的。有些书呆子气。

original: You really think if you find him he'd help our cause?
translation: 你真的认为如果你找到他之后，他会帮助我们？

original: Can't you just help me?
translation: 你就不能帮个忙吗？

original: There are different fronts to every fight. Galaxy News Radio is one of them.
translation: 每场战斗都有不同的前线阵地。银河新闻电台也算其中一个。

original: I need help with the old girl, though, cause she's hurtin'.
translation: 我的电台需要帮助，她受伤了。

original: So I'd like to share, I really would, but if I help you, and you just leave me hangin'... I would have failed the Fight. And that can't happen. Dig?
translation: 我倒是真的想告诉你要的，不过如果我帮了你就转身离开……我就亏了。所以不行，明白了吗？

original: I don't give a shit about your "Good Fight." You going to help me or not?
translation: 我对你那“圣战”不感兴趣。你帮还是不帮？

original: Ok, friend. I've been calm. I've been cool. Now I've had enough of your hostility.
translation: 好的，朋友。我会镇定，我会冷静。你该降低对我的敌意。

original: You wanna be all business, fine. I can play like that.
translation: 你想什么都管，行啊。我奉陪。

original: You want help, you help me. End of story. You ready or what?
translation: 你想要找你爸，那就得帮我。就这意思。你干不干？

original: I don't give a shit about your "Good Fight." You going to help me or not?
translation: 我对你那“圣战”不感兴趣。你帮还是不帮？

original: Ok, friend. I've been calm. I've been cool. Now I've had enough of your hostility.
translation: 好，朋友。我会镇定，我会冷静。你该降低对我的敌意。

original: You wanna' be all business, fine. I can play like that.
translation: 你想什么都管，行啊。我奉陪。

original: You want daddy, you help me. End of story. You ready or what?
translation: 你想要找你爸，那就得帮我。就这意思。你干不干？

original: The guys outside are the Brotherhood of Steel? Who are they?
translation: 外边那些家伙是钢铁兄弟会？他们是什么人？

original: From what I saw, they were the ones who saved your ass.
translation: 就我所见，他们救了你的命。

original: They keep the ruins Super Mutant free so people like you can get to people like me in one piece.
translation: 他们抵抗超级变种人的破坏，因此人们就像喜欢我一样喜欢他们。

original: Without them, we'd be knee-deep in Mutie shit.
translation: 没有他们，我们早被变异体干掉了。

original: I understand your fight, but I still need to find my Dad.
translation: 我了解了你的圣战，但我还是得找我爸爸。

original: Sorry. I'm so used to talking to an audience that can't answer I just assume you want to hear my voice all the time.
translation: 抱歉。我习惯于对着没有回应的听众播音，忽略了你不想听这些话。

original: We got one rule in the Good Fight, though. You want help, you gotta contribute!
translation: 在圣战里，我们有条准则：想得到帮助，先贡献自己！

original: I understand your fight, but I have other concerns of my own.
translation: 我明白了你的圣战，但我还有自己的问题。

original: Sorry. I'm so used to talking to an audience that can't answer I just assume you want to hear my voice all the time.
translation: 抱歉。我习惯于对着没有回应的听众播音，忽略了你不想听这些话。

original: So, you want to know where your dad is? Fair enough.
translation: 你想知道你爸爸在哪？别着急。

original: We got one rule in the Good Fight though. You want help, you gotta' contribute!
translation: 在圣战里，我们有一条准则：想得到帮助，先贡献自己！

original: Words don't kill people. Guns do.
translation: 语言杀不了人。枪能。

original: You're absolutely right, but words get more and more people to join the cause. Guns just create more casualties on your side.
translation: 你说的当然没错，但是语言能让越来越多的人加入。而枪只能让你的阵营造成更多伤亡。

original: But enough yarn spinning. Let's figure out your place in the Good Fight. Then maybe we can help you.
translation: 但闲聊到此为止，让我告诉你能为圣战做些什么。之后或许我们能帮助你。

original: I'm amazed you're still alive.
translation: 真想不到你竟然还活着。

original: Oh I have plenty of enemies that would love nothing more than to put a bullet between my eyes.
translation: 哦，我有很多仇家天天想我脑袋开花。

original: The only thing keeping that from happening is Sarah Lyons and the Brotherhood of Steel.
translation: 之所以脑袋还在，全靠萨拉·里昂斯和钢铁兄弟会。

original: We've brokered a sweet deal. They keep me from taking a dirt nap, and I keep a strong roof over their head.
translation: 我们做了笔好交易。他们保护我的安全，我为他们制造舆论支持。

original: All right, I'm sorry.
translation: 好吧，对不起。

original: That's okay. This world has a way of getting under your skin and wiping the smile from your face. Makes you bitter. But you gotta fight that!
translation: 好的。这世界总有方法挖空你的内在，抹去你的微笑，让你感到痛苦。但你必须做出抗争！

original: Give me a break. Stop mouthing off and tell me what I need to know.
translation: 放过我吧。别东拉西扯了，说我想知道的。

original: If I was your momma, I'd tan your hide for that kind of talk.
translation: 如果我是你妈，你这么说话，看我不教训你。

original: Since I'm not, all I'm going to do is say goodbye.
translation: 既然我不是，那就只好说再见了。

original: So you fight the Good Fight with your voice on Galaxy News Radio.
translation: 所以你在电台里用声音为圣战而战。

original: Well, holy shit! Aren't you a chip off the old block? You ARE as smart as your dad.
translation: 见鬼！我就说你和你爸爸很像！你和你爸爸一样聪明。

original: Since you know all about the cause, no need to explain the effect. Let's get you on your way.
translation: 既然你已经很清楚了，也就不必再废话。我告诉你该怎么做。

original: Look, I need to find my Dad. I don't have time for this nonsense.
translation: 听着，我得去找我爸爸。我没时间来做这事。

original: Hey, now... I may be many things, but one thing I'm not is a pushover.
translation: 嗨，我……可能很有很多缺点，但我不是个会轻易放弃的人。

original: It's obvious you're narrow of focus and can't see the bigger picture.
translation: 显然你的目光过于狭隘，无法着眼于大局。

original: We got one rule in the Good Fight, though. You want help, you gotta contribute!
translation: 在圣战里，我们有条准则：想得到帮助，先贡献自己！

original: Look, I have problems of my own. I don't have time for this nonsense.
translation: 听着，我也有自己的问题要去解决。我不能浪费时间。

original: Three Dog is many things, but one thing he isn't is a pushover.
translation: 三狗可能很有很多缺点，但他不是个会轻易放弃的人。

original: It's obvious you're narrow of focus and can't see the bigger picture. Fine. I may have the answers you want.
translation: 显然你的目光过于狭隘，无法着眼于大局。好吧，我或许有你要的答案。

original: We got one rule in the Good Fight though. You want help, you gotta' contribute!
translation: 在圣战里，我们有条准则：想得到帮助，先贡献自己！

original: So, what's this about the Good Fight?
translation: 这和圣战有什么关系？

original: Patience, patience. Three Dog is like a minstrel. Give him some time and your ear and he'll soothe the soul.
translation: 耐心，耐心。三狗就像吟游诗人。仔细聆听，他会抚慰你的灵魂。

original: So back to the tale... I fight the Good Fight with GNR as my gun.
translation: 回到主题……我为圣战而战，电台就是我的枪。

original: The truth goes out across the Capital Wasteland and with it, the word about the Good Fight.
translation: 真理通过它在首都废土散播，作为圣战的声音。

original: So, people fight back.
translation: 所以人们抗击。

original: They can't, not against those kinds of enemies. They just run away and hide or they stay and die. It just ain't right.
translation: 他们不应放弃抵抗，或者只是逃走、躲藏或者留下等死。这不对。

original: So that's where I enter the picture. I fight the Good Fight with GNR as my gun.
translation: 所以这就是我的阵地。我为圣战而战，银河新闻电台就是我的枪。

original: The sound of truth goes out across the Capital Wasteland. Hell, someone's got to counter that bullshit on the Enclave station.
translation: 真理通过银河新闻电台响彻首都废土，总得有人来戳破英克雷电台的那些谬论。

original: You're going to have a "Good Fight" on your hands if you don't help me...
translation: 你不帮我的话我保证你立刻就会经历一场“圣战”。

original: Hey now. There's no need for that kind of talk. I'm here to help, not to hurt.
translation: 嗨，没必要这么说。我是在寻求帮，而不是要伤害谁。

original: Whatever you want. I'm just looking for my Dad.
translation: 你想要什么都行，我只想找我爸爸。

original: Hey, not everyone's cut out for bigger and better things. Sometimes the smallest roles in the Good Fight are the most important.
translation: 嗨，不是每个人都得做大事。有时候，细节决定了圣战的成败。

original: Whatever you say. You have your problems, I have mine.
translation: 随便你怎么说。你有你的麻烦，我也有我的。

original: Hey, not everyone's cut out for bigger and better things. Sometimes the smallest roles in the Good Fight are the most important.
translation: 嗨，不是每个人都得做大事。有时候，细节决定了圣战的成败。

original: But enough of that. If it's your dad you seek, then I will abide.
translation: 不过也够了。如果你只想找你爸，那就只好这样了。

original: The Good Fight? What's that all about?
translation: 圣战？那是什么？

original: Imagine a picture, okay? A picture of the Capital Wasteland. All that brick and rock. A whole lot of nothing, right?
translation: 设想一副画面，好吗？首都废土的画面。饿殍遍野，满目疮痍，对吧？

original: There's people out there trying to just barely make it by from day to day. Fighting to stay alive and make something of what they got.
translation: 那里的人们勉强度日。一切一切只是为了苟活。

original: But then you've got all kinds of shit... Slavers, Super Mutants, Raiders... They all want a slice of the pie too and aim to take it by force.
translation: 然后你又遇到了各种渣滓……奴隶贩子、超级变种人，歹徒……他们杀人放火，也只是为了混口饭吃。

original: You have about two seconds to tell me what I want to know...
translation: 给你两秒钟时间来说我想知道的事……

original: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Someone woke up on the wrong side of the bed this morning.
translation: 哇，哇，哇！有人一大早就吃错药了！

original: Why don't you just sit back and relax?
translation: 为什么你不坐下来，放松点？

original: I'm not here to fight. At least, not you. Only fight I'm interested in is the Good Fight, and I wage that everyday on the airwaves.
translation: 我不想打架，至少不是跟你。我唯一感兴趣的是圣战，而且每天都在广播里宣扬。

original: What's with the flashy introduction?
translation: 这自吹自擂是什么？

original: Hey, when you're in the Good Fight, you gotta give it all you got and never ever hold back.
translation: 嗨，当你置身圣战，就应该无私奉献，无怨无悔。

original: Always dazzle 'em, I always say. Always dazzle 'em and spread the word.
translation: 我总是化平淡为神奇。出口成章且天花乱坠而广为传颂。

original: Let me ask you something else.
translation: 我有其他事要问你。

original: Okay. Go for it.
translation: 好的。说吧。

original: What's this book you're working on?
translation: 你在写的是什么书？

original: Well, it's a dangerous place out there in the Wastes, right? People could really use a compilation of good advice. Like a Wasteland Survival Guide!
translation: 好吧，废土是危险的地方，对吧？人们很需要一本为他们提供好的建议的书。像是一本《废土生存指南》！

original: For that, I need an assistant to test my theories. I wouldn't want anyone to get hurt because of a mistake. Nobody's ever happy when that happens.
translation: 因此，我需要一个助手来测试我的理论。我不希望任何人因为一个小错误而受伤。发生那样的事，不会有人高兴的。

original: No... Then they just yell a lot. At me. With mean, mean words.
translation: 不……他们会对我吼出很多……很多脏话。

original: I'm still working on that survival guide that I told you about. Great idea, but I need help to test some of the theories.
translation: 我还在写对你提过的那本生存指南。构思很好，但我需要有人帮我测试一些理论。

original: Oh, did you reconsider helping me out? Because that'd be super awesome!
translation: 哦，你打算重新考虑帮助我的事吗？因为那是件了不起的事！

original: Oh, sure. I mean, if you're going to be my assistant, it's in my best interest that you stay alive, right?
translation: 哦，当然。我的意思是，如果你成为我的助手，你的生存就成了我最感兴趣的事，对吧？

original: Besides, I guess the original owner isn't coming back to pick it up, so you're the closest thing to an inheritor. Here!
translation: 此外，我想原有者不会来要回它，你就是最合适的继承者。给！

original: Can I have that Armored Vault Suit?
translation: 我能拿走避难所护甲？

original: Never mind, you crazy old bastard.
translation: 算了，你这疯狂的老杂种。

original: I still can't hear you!
translation: 我还是听不到你在说什么！

original: I said: Are you all right?
translation: 我说：你还好吧？

original: I don't know where the clinic is, they don't let us out of the pens, you know?
translation: 我不知道诊所在哪，他们不让我们出去，你懂了吗？

original: Oh? Him? No, I have no idea where he is.
translation: 哦？他？不，我不知道他在哪。

original: Oh, I don't know. I don't wear a watch, they're pretty rare you know. Ask someone else.
translation: 哦，我不知道。我没戴表，你也知道那很奢侈。问别人吧。

original: Are you okay? You seem a little out of it.
translation: 你没事吧？你看起来有点昏昏沉沉。

original: What? You'll have to speak up!
translation: 什么？你得大声点！

original: What are you looking at?
translation: 你在看什么？

original: I'm watching the patrols, what do you think I'm looking at?
translation: 我正看着巡逻队，你以为我在看什么？

original: They switch it up a little bit every day, but just a little. There has to be some sort of pattern to it, it's just a matter of watching and waiting.
translation: 他们每天都在成长，但很缓慢。他们总会长大，习惯了就好。

original: I've brought some bloodpacks to contribute.
translation: 我带了些血浆袋来捐献。

original: I can only offer my thanks. My people are getting accustomed to using these as a substitute for live prey.
translation: 我谨表示感谢。我的人习惯于用它们取代捕食。

original: As compensation for your effort, allow me to at least give you something in return.
translation: 作为对你贡献的补偿，请允许我至少给你一些物品作为回馈。

original: Again, many thanks. Here is your compensation.
translation: 再次，非常感谢。这是你的报酬。

original: How are things going now?
translation: 事情进展如何？

original: I've learned a bit more from Vance and I've been allowed around Meresti. I really think you helped me make the right decision. Thanks!
translation: 我从万斯那学到了更多，我已经被允许进入米尔斯蒂了。我想你帮我做出了正确的决定。谢谢！

original: Everyone around here is being nice to me despite what happened, so I guess it all turned out well. Thanks!
translation: 不管曾经发生过什么事，这的每个人还是都对我很好。我觉得这还算不错，谢谢你！

original: It's weird living in my parent's old house with them gone, but I'll make the best of it.
translation: 我父母离世后，我仍然住在他们的老房子里，虽然有点奇怪，但我会利用好这里。

original: Everyone around here is being nice to me despite what happened, so I guess it all turned out well. Thanks!
translation: 不管曾经发生过什么事，这的每个人还是都对我很好。我觉得事情正在变好，谢谢你！

original: Things are much better. We all don't have to stay inside our houses and we sleep much better at night.
translation: 形势越来越好。我们无需龟缩在自己的房子里，晚上也睡得香了。

original: It hasn't been this peaceful in Arefu for as long as I can remember.
translation: 在我的记忆中，断桥镇从未如此和平过。

original: The proposal you've brought us from Vance should also ensure our safety. I don't think I'll ever be able to repay you.
translation: 你从万斯那带来的提议确保了我们的安全。我想我永远我无法报答你。

original: Things are much better. We all don't have to stay inside our houses and we sleep much better at night.
translation: 形势越来越好。我们无需龟缩在自己的房子里，晚上也睡得香了。

original: It hasn't been this peaceful in Arefu for as long as I can remember.
translation: 在我的记忆中，断桥镇从未如此和平过。

original: Very well, actually. Our truce with Arefu is coming to fruition. I've begun teaching my people to live off of the donated bloodpacks.
translation: 实际上，非常棒。我们与断桥镇之间的停战协定正展露成效。我已经开始教导我的人以获赠的血浆袋为食了。

original: The transition has been difficult, but we will manage.
translation: 转变是艰难的，但我们会克服。

original: You've certainly done us a great service, and I can't thank you enough.
translation: 你帮了我们一个大忙，我无以感谢。

original: As well as can be expected. I've had a bit of trouble keeping my people away from Arefu, but a deal is a deal and I will adhere to it.
translation: 就像预期的那样好。为了让我的人远离断桥镇，我遇到了不少麻烦，但一言既出，驷马难追。

original: We stay away from them, they don't send anyone else after us. The perfect stalemate I suppose.
translation: 我们远离他们，他们不再派人来找麻烦。我觉得这是不错的和局。

original: Ha! Figures a shithole like this would have a local Chem head.
translation: 哈！像这样肮脏的地方就该有本地的吸毒者！

original: Okay, so we have a resident with a bit of a problem. What makes you so goddamned superior? Hmph. Wastelanders...
translation: 好的，我们的一个居民有了麻烦。但这为什么会让你产生该死的优越感？哼，废土游民……

original: A place like this is probably crawling with junkies, huh?
translation: 像这种地方通常都挤满了瘾君子？

original: Megaton might not be Tenpenny Tower, but that doesn't make breaking patient-doctor confidentiality any more ethical, now does it?
translation: 兆吨镇或许不像特佩尼大厦，但也不会随意破坏医患保密规则，明白吗？

original: So you've got someone in town with a drug habit?
translation: 所以你就让城里的某些人养成吸毒的习惯吗？

original: I'm afraid that goes against patient-doctor confidentiality.
translation: 恐怕这与医患保密规则冲突。

original: I need something to help me concentrate...
translation: 我需要一些东西帮助我集中注意力……

original: Great. Another junkie... In case you haven't noticed, this is a clinic, not a candy store. And I've got work to do.
translation: 好极了，又一个瘾君子的。你或许没注意到，这是个诊所，不是毒品铺。我还有工作要做。

original: I wouldn't. From what I hear, you mess with their Eyebots and the Enclave comes looking for you.
translation: 我不会。我听说因为你破坏了飞眼，英克雷要来找你算帐。

original: That's worth a think. We might could sell it for parts, long as we could bring it down mostly undamaged. Hmm...
translation: 值得考虑。如果我们能让它无损地落下，就能卖掉零件。唔……

original: I heard tell of a scavenger tried that up Canterbury way. They found his body a week later, scorched with plasma bolts.
translation: 我听过一个拾荒人想在坎特伯雷的路上这么做。一周后他的尸体被发现，已经被等离子武器给烧焦了。

original: Hell if I know. Spying on us probably. Nice reception, though. Wish I had speakers like that on my radio.
translation: 如果我知道，那就见鬼了。或许是在监视我们。不过那可是不错的接收装置。我真希望我的收音机上能有那样的扬声器。

original: Do you think they're watching us through it? "Hi President Eden!" Maybe he'll come down for a visit sometime, ha ha ha.
translation: 你觉得他们是在通过那看着我们吗？“嘿，伊登总统！”或许什么时候他会亲自来视察呢，哈哈哈。

original: I don't know, but I'd stay away from it. No telling what those Enclave types will get up to next.
translation: 我不知道，不过我会远离它。没人能告诉你英克雷下次什么时候来。

original: Creepy, if you ask me. What's it doing out here?
translation: 如果你问我，我会说令人毛骨悚然。这发生了什么？

original: Yeah. Something kind of soothing about it though.
translation: 嗯。还算是有些慰藉。

original: Me neither. I like the music, though. Kind of nice to hear something more cheerful than what those hippies on GNR always play.
translation: 都不。我喜欢音乐，但听一些欢快的，可比银河新闻电台里老放的那些嬉皮的强多了。

original: Finding a crew might be tough. Good luck, though.
translation: 要找到全部可能很难。但还是祝你好运。

original: What the hell? You get me all worked up and then cut me off? Well... look... if you ever need a hand out there, you know where to find me.
translation: 见什么鬼？你让我为你干活，然后又把我一脚踢开？嗯……听着……如果你需要人手，你知道在哪能找到我。

original: Yeah... thanks. I guess.
translation: 嗯……谢谢。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Whatever, kid. Whatever.
translation: 无论什么，孩子。无论什么。

original: You don't look like you belong here. What's your story?
translation: 你看上去不像这的人。能说说你的经历吗？

original: There ain't much to tell. I used to live out in the Wastes. I was a real bastard back then. But I've put all that behind me.
translation: 没什么可说的。我曾在废土生活。我当时是个彻头彻尾的混蛋。不过现在已经洗心革面了。

original: You've made a grievous error in judgement. Watch your back.
translation: 你做了个错误的选择。以后走路小心点。

original: You pervert! You disgust me! Just stay away from me!
translation: 你这变态！你让我恶心！离我远点！

original: What's wrong with being in the basement? What the hell is going on?
translation: 地下室里怎么了？究竟出了什么事？

original: You KNOW what I'm talking about! You spend all that time down in the basement, and I never questioned it.
translation: 你知道我在说什么！你整天待在地下室里，我从没埋怨过。

original: Janet, calm down! What are you talking about?
translation: 珍妮特，冷静！你在说什么？

original: Did you think I wouldn't find out? What kind of a sicko are you?
translation: 你以为我没发现？你到底有多疯狂？

original: What? What did I do?
translation: 什么？我做错什么了？

original: Roger, you son of a bitch!
translation: 罗杰，你这混蛋！

original: Don't you see? You've been used. You're a pawn. You deserve better.
translation: 你没发现吗？你被利用了。你只是一件工具。你本来能做得更好。

original: And just what "better" is there for me? What would you have me do?
translation: 什么是对我“更好的”？你想我怎么做？

original: Where did they come from?
translation: 他们从哪来？

original: Does it really matter? They're here now, and they're available for purchase.
translation: 这有关系吗？他们现在在这，而且都能买。

original: What are their names?
translation: 他们都叫什么？

original: Names?
translation: 名字？

original: I think Forty has a few nicknames for them, but none of them are very polite.
translation: 我想弗替给他们起过几个绰号，但都不太礼貌。

original: That's all.
translation: 够了。

original: Okay, then let's talk business.
translation: 好的，我们来谈谈生意。

original: Can you tell me a bit more about them?
translation: 你能告诉我更多他们的事吗？

original: They're all in excellent physical condition, if that's what you're wondering.
translation: 他们身体状况都非常好，如果这是你想知道的。

original: A bit stubborn, perhaps. But that behavior can be altered over time.
translation: 或许有些倔强。不过那会随着时间而改变。

original: What did you want to know?
translation: 你想知道什么呢？

original: The kids, I think. There are three of them, right?
translation: 我想了解下那些孩子。总共是三个，对吧？

original: A very good eye, my friend. Those little ones are good as a long-term investment. They have their other uses as well, I'm sure.
translation: 有眼光，我的朋友。那些小东西适合长期投资。我肯定他们都很有用。

original: They are most definitely up for sale.
translation: 他们很明显会被卖掉。

original: Yes, we've covered that. They're still available.
translation: 是的，我们想到了。他们还能买。

original: I'd like the three kids.
translation: 我喜欢这三个孩子。

original: What kind of meat is that you're selling, anyway?
translation: 顺便问问，你那卖的是什么肉？

original: Ha ha ha. The very best kind. Try some, you've never tasted sweeter, I'll warrant.
translation: 哈哈哈，这是最好的。试试，我担保你从未尝过。

original: You sound like some of the hard-liners. We all served together for years, but now some of the soldiers hate them as much as the Super Mutants.
translation: 你听起来就像那些强硬派。我们曾共事多年，但现在一些士兵像憎恨超级变种人那样憎恨他们。

original: Well, good riddance to them. If you waver in your oaths, you get punished.
translation: 他们算是解脱了。如果你不遵守誓言，你会受到惩罚的。

original: That's the thing, really. Casdin's "technology first" sort of attitude is more traditional in the Brotherhood always used to operate, out West.
translation: 那是事实。卡斯丁“科技优先”的态度是西海岸兄弟会由来已久的传统。

original: But somewhere along the way from there to here, Elder Lyons made sure we watched out for the people, not just the technology.
translation: 但在来这里的路上，里昂斯长老确信我们应该也关心人，而不光是科技。

original: To some of us, that was noble. I guess to Casdin and his crew, it was just soft. I wish they could see some sort of middle ground.
translation: 一些人觉得那很高尚。不过我想卡斯丁和他的人觉得这太过软弱。我希望他们能理解我们。

original: If so many people agreed with him, maybe he has a good point.
translation: 既然这么多人同意他的意见，也许他说得有道理。

original: Lyons and Casdin would have to agree to any sort of reconciliation, and that's pretty unlikely. They're both quite proud and... stubborn.
translation: 想要里昂斯与卡斯丁认同彼此的见解不大可能。他们都很高傲和……倔强。

original: Me, I just wish there was a way we could all agree that at least we're still on the same side. There are bigger problems out there, after all.
translation: 我，我只是希望有办法能让我们还认同这一点：我们同属一个阵营。毕竟外面还有更大的麻烦。

original: It sounds like it was quite a loss. Is there any way to reconcile them?
translation: 听起来损失很严重。有什么办法与他们和解吗？

original: As much as some of our soldiers would like to see them shot for deserting, there's not much we can do. We're too busy with the Super Mutants.
translation: 虽然我们有些士兵都想把这些逃跑的懦夫给毙了，但是我们能做的却不多。我们忙于对付超级变种人，无暇分神。

original: Meanwhile, they're busy seeking out new technology and trying to get back in contact with the Brotherhood out West.
translation: 与此同时，他们则忙于寻找新科技，并且试着和西岸的兄弟会恢复联络。

original: So our paths rarely cross, but it's never pretty when they do. I just hope things cool down before it gets worse.
translation: 因此我们互不相干，但我们碰到时总有摩擦。我只能希望事情能够得到缓和，不要再恶化。

original: What are you doing about them?
translation: 对于他们，你要怎么做？

original: Has it been worth the cost in lives and resources to protect people like you from the Super Mutants?
translation: 用大量的生命和资源来保护你这样的人不被超级变种人打死，值得吗？

original: You tell me. I suspect my daughter's squad helped save your life. And most of our recent recruits have come from those we've saved over the years.
translation: 你说呢。我想我女儿的小队救了你的命。我们的很多新兵也是这些年来被我们拯救的人。

original: It's cost us, but we've saved many lives and made the Capital Wasteland a place where people can live. Yes, I'd say that's been worth it.
translation: 它消耗着我们，但我们救出了许多条性命，并让首都废土成为人们可以生存的地方。没错，我要说那很值得。

original: Has your decision been worth it?
translation: 你的决定值得吗？

original: The soldiers rallied behind Paladin Casdin, who was one of Elder Lyons' original squad. They served together for over twenty years.
translation: 士兵们集结于守护者卡斯丁的身后，此人是里昂斯长老的旧部。他们共事超过二十年。

original: Casdin was well-respected, and every bit as loyal to the Brotherhood as Elder Lyons. He just disagreed with the interpretations of our oaths.
translation: 卡斯丁很受尊重，而且他和里昂斯长老一样，对兄弟会无比忠诚。他只是对我们的宗旨另有理解。

original: But when disagreements turned into fistfights, he left with the Outcasts. We lost more allies that day than we ever have to any battle.
translation: 但是当意见分歧变成拳脚相向时，他与放逐者们一起离开了。我们在那一天失去的战友，比任何一次战斗都多。

original: Who were the exiles?
translation: 哪些人是放逐者？

original: Even now, a year after they left, the wounds of their departure are still sore.
translation: 即使在今天，他们离开一年之久，分裂产生的伤口仍在隐隐作痛。

original: Some of my soldiers are angry about it -- they see it as an insult to me. Bless them for their loyalty, they're more angry about it than I ever was.
translation: 我的一些士兵非常愤怒 — 他们认为这是对我的侮辱。感谢他们的无比忠诚，他们甚至比我还要气愤。

original: Others understand their decision. Sometimes I hear them wondering if they should have gone with them.
translation: 其他人理解他们的决定。有时候我听到他们在思忖是否当初该和他们一起离开。

original: I can't blame them, but I stand by my decision. And I respect theirs.
translation: 我不能指责他们，但我坚持自己的决定。而我也同样尊重他们的决定。

original: How do your remaining soldiers feel about the Outcasts?
translation: 剩下的士兵是怎么看待放逐者的？

original: Where Elder Lyons has fought to protect the people of the Capital Wasteland, the Outcasts demanded we move on and leave them to their fates.
translation: 当里昂斯长老为保护首都废土的住民而战的时候，放逐者却要求我们继续工作，让当地住民听天由命。

original: They insisted there was more important technology to be recovered in a scientific base in the ruins of Fort Independence, to the West.
translation: 他们坚信，在西边独立堡的废墟里，可以找到更多的重要科技。

original: As callous as their decision may be, it's more in line with our original mission. Elder Lyons is an inspiration to us, but to them he's a traitor.
translation: 尽管他们的决定或许很冷酷，但那更符合我们的初衷。里昂斯长老指引着我们，但在他们眼中则是个叛徒。

original: What sort of disagreements did they have?
translation: 他们有什么反对意见？

original: Only in a very broad sense. The Brotherhood's oaths are to protect humanity's progress, but not necessarily every human.
translation: 只在非常广义的层面。兄弟会的宗旨是保护人类整体的发展，并非每个人。

original: The Outcasts - and members of the Brotherhood in other places - consider it a waste to protect most people.
translation: 放逐者 — 以及在别处的兄弟会成员 — 认为保护大多数民众是在浪费时间。

original: "After all," they say, "everyone knows how to make another human, but the secrets to making a P94 Plasma Rifle are all but lost."
translation: “毕竟，”他们说，“每个人都知道怎么制造另一个人，而不是怎么制造一把P94等离子步枪。”
