original: I thought the protection of humanity was a part of the Brotherhood's oaths.
translation: 我以为保卫人类也是兄弟会的誓言之一。

original: The Outcasts are a result of my greatest mistake. But a mistake I'm proud of, nonetheless.
translation: 放逐者是我犯下最大的错误。但这却是令我骄傲的错误。

original: When I came here, I realized for the first time that the Brotherhood's technology could truly save the survivors in this Wasteland.
translation: 当我来到这里时，我第一次认识到兄弟会的科技确实能保护这片废土上的幸存者。

original: I chose to help them, even if it meant putting the Brotherhood's interests at risk. Some of my soldiers called me a hero. Others called me a traitor.
translation: 我选择去帮助他们，即使会牺牲一些兄弟会的利益。我的一些士兵视我为英雄，而其他人说我是叛徒。

original: The dissenters left my command, calling themselves Outcasts to mock me. I cannot fault their dedication, even if I find them lacking in compassion.
translation: 异见者离开了我的队伍，自称放逐者来嘲弄我。虽然我认为他们缺乏同情心，但并不挑剔他们的执着精神。

original: Can you tell me about the Outcasts?
translation: 能告诉我放逐者的事吗？

original: We were cast out for our dedication to the Brotherhood's true goals. Lyons wanted to play hero to the locals, instead of doing his job.
translation: 因为坚持兄弟会的真正目标，我们遭到放逐。里昂斯想在本地人面前扮演英雄，而不是完成本职工作。

original: We were proud to leave him, so we kept the name "Outcasts" and wear it with pride. A big "fuck you" to the old man.
translation: 我们对于远离他感到自豪，因此我们接受了“放逐者”的名号，并骄傲地使用它。“放逐”对于那个死老头来说，就意味着“操你妈”。

original: He may have struck our names from the great Codex, but we'll be vindicated in the end, and our names will be restored.
translation: 他或许从大法典中删除了我们的名字，但最终，我们定将证明自己的清白，我们的声誉也必将恢复。

original: Tell me more about the Outcasts.
translation: 多跟我聊聊放逐者的事吧。

original: It's a rather sad story, I'm afraid. Last year, some of our soldiers had grave disagreements with the decisions of Elder Lyons.
translation: 恐怕这是个伤感的故事。去年，我们的一些士兵与里昂斯长老发生了很大的分歧。

original: Disagreements spiraled out of control, and there was a schism in the ranks. The loyal soldiers practically threw out the dissenters.
translation: 分歧失去了控制，队伍中产生了分裂。忠诚的士兵们把异见者赶了出去。

original: Now they call themselves the Outcasts.
translation: 他们现在自称放逐者。

original: Tell me more about the Outcasts.
translation: 再多说点放逐者的事吧。

original: We've got power armor and big guns and we're the ones doing the talking right now.
translation: 我们有动力装甲和大型武器，现在该我们说了算。

original: Usually, that's all a person needs to know, and they stop asking questions. You going to stop asking questions, now?
translation: 通常，一个人也就需要知道那些事，所以他们不会再多问。你也没什么要问的了，对吧？

original: Who are you people?
translation: 哪些人是你手下？

original: We collect technology, and most people want what we've collected.
translation: 我们收集科技，而很多人想要我们所收集到的科技。

original: Right now, we're pretty much stuck defending this Fort, but that won't be forever.
translation: 目前，我们只能是困守在这座要塞里，但不会一直如此。

original: Once we regroup, we'll continue our work and keep moving back west.
translation: 一旦我们重新集结力量，就将继续行动，并回到西岸去。

original: Tell me about the Outcasts.
translation: 告诉我放逐者的事。

original: We call ourselves the Outcasts, and we collect technology to preserve it from tribals and idiot locals.
translation: 我们自称放逐者，我们收集科技成果，以免落入部落居民和愚昧的本地人手中。

original: And before you ask, we were cast out from that company of zeroes who call themselves Lyons' Brotherhood of Steel.
translation: 不用你问，我们就是被那帮自称“里昂斯的钢铁兄弟会”的白痴轰出来的。

original: Way we figure it, if traitors think we're too harsh in following orders, we're probably doing something right.
translation: 在我们看来，如果叛徒们认为我们在恪守命令方面太过执着，那反而说明我们做对了。

original: Who are you people?
translation: 哪些人是你手下？

original: I'd really don't want to go into it.
translation: 我不想再说这个了。

original: Go bug Scribe Bowditch. He could talk a dog off a meat truck.
translation: 去烦鲍蒂奇文士吧。他的唠叨能让狗从装满肉的货车旁跑开。

original: Outcasts? Who are they?
translation: 放逐者？他们是什么人？

original: You're damned right you will. Now, get.
translation: 你该死的肯定会。快滚。

original: I think I made a wrong turn somewhere. I'll be leaving now, sir.
translation: 我想我走错了。我这就走，长官。

original: Wrong answer, scum.
translation: 答错了，傻瓜。

original: Shut up and get that fucking gun out of my face.
translation: 闭嘴，把你的臭枪从我面前挪开。

original: <grumble>
translation: <咕哝>

original: You've either got a death wish, or a pair of stones bigger than hand grenades.
translation: 你不是想找死，就是胆生毛。

original: Say, you seem to have some smarts in you, and with your sort of guts, maybe you can help us out. Interested in collecting technology for us?
translation: 我说，你看起来有点头脑，再加上你的胆量，不如帮我们个忙吧。有兴趣帮我们收集科技吗？

original: You've got a laser. Technically, you'd be asking "with highly focused light."
translation: 你拿到了一把激光枪。从技术上讲，你要的就是这种“高密度光线”。

original: <grumble>
translation: <咕哝>

original: You've either got a death wish, or the biggest pair of stones ever sported by a woman.
translation: 你不是想找死，就是胆生毛。

original: Say, you seem to have some smarts in you, and with your sort of guts, maybe you can help us out. Interested in collecting technology for us?
translation: 我说，你看起来有点头脑，再加上你的胆量，不如帮我们个忙吧。有兴趣帮我们收集科技吗？

original: You've got a laser. Technically, you'd be asking "with highly focused light."
translation: 你拿到了一把激光枪。从技术上讲，你正在招惹“高聚焦光线”。

original: Then I think we'd have a problem. And you don't want to be a problem around here.
translation: 那我想我们有麻烦了。而你不想成为这附近的一个麻烦吧。

original: Protector Casdin, he says I got a real knack for solving problems.
translation: 守护者卡斯丁，他说我解决问题很有一套。

original: How about I skip right to calling you "Coco"?
translation: 我干脆叫你“可可”怎么样？

original: Yeah, the red would never go with all this brown. But if we remodel and still need a corpse, we'll call you, 'kay?
translation: 嗯，道不同不相为谋。但如果我们有所改变，并且还需要一个帮手的话，我们会通知你，怎样？

original: I'm Defender Anne Marie Morgan, with the Outcasts. Good to have someone else out here who can keep up.
translation: 我是守卫者安妮·玛丽·摩根，站在放逐者一边。能有个明白人真好。

original: I'd hate if my corpse ruined this lovely Wasteland. It'd clash with the drapes.
translation: 如果我的尸体污染了这片可爱的废土，我会遗恨终身。它残破不堪，与大地格格不入。

original: You haven't been with the Brotherhood for very long if you think we're your troops.
translation: 如果你认为我们是你的队伍，那你肯定在兄弟会里待的时间还不够长。

original: And since you're on our base, it looks like you won't be with them for very long, either.
translation: 既然你在我们的基地里，看起来你也不会和他们长期共事了。

original: I'm with the Brotherhood. I didn't expect to see troops so far out here.
translation: 我是兄弟会的人。我没料到这么远的地方会有军队。

original: You won't see it many other places, either. Our job is to make sure it stays out of the hands of raiders, tribals, and the other crazies out there.
translation: 这玩意在其它地方也不多见的。我们的工作是保证不给歹徒、部落居民、以及外面其他的疯子拿到它。

original: We're called the Outcasts. I'm Protector Casdin, and I'm in charge of protecting this sort of technology from abuse and misuse.
translation: 我们被叫作放逐者。我是守护者卡斯丁，我负责确保这种科技不被滥用和错用。

original: Who are you guys? I've never seen equipment like that.
translation: 你们这些家伙是什么人？我从没见过像你们那样的装备。

original: Pop had an encyclopedia. He was real proud of it.
translation: 帕普有本百科全书。他很为此自豪。

original: Encyclopedia Atomica, Volume VIII, Radiology - Saskatchewan. I must have read it about a thousand times.
translation: 大核百科全书，卷八，应用辐射学 — 萨斯客彻温省。我读过它上千遍了。

original: I wonder if they ever wrote a sequel?
translation: 不知道他们有没写过续篇？

original: Rococo Rockfowl? How did you end up with a name like that?
translation: 洛可可·罗克浮？你怎么起了这样的名字？

original: Yeah, that's what they all say. Usually just before stepping on a landmine.
translation: 是啊，他们都那么说。然后就一只脚踏上了地雷。

original: I'm Defender Anne Marie Morgan with the Outcasts. Steer clear of here, and you should be able to continue with that whole "not dying" plan.
translation: 我是守卫者安妮·玛丽·摩根，放逐者一员。离开这里，继续你的“不死”计划去。

original: Trust me, I don't plan to die anytime soon.
translation: 相信我，我没打算这么快死。

original: Well, pass through some other direction. Or else you'll be "passing on."
translation: 喂，去其他地方。否则让你“哪都去不了”。

original: I don't mean any trouble. I'm just passing through.
translation: 我不想惹麻烦，我只是路过。

original: Don't shoot at me or my friends, I think we'll get along just fine!
translation: 不要打我和我的朋友，我看我们能处得来！

original: Good to meet you, Rock. I hope you're on my side.
translation: 你好，洛可。我希望你是站在我这边的。

original: Defender Anne Marie Morgan, with the Outcasts.
translation: 守卫者安妮·玛丽·摩根，放逐者一员。

original: But all you need to know is that I've got a gun and a low tolerance for screwing around.
translation: 不过，你只需要知道：我有一支枪，而且对捣乱的家伙没耐性。

original: Thanks for the help. Who are you?
translation: 感谢帮助。你是谁？

original: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，我看看我能做些什么。

original: Gee, thanks. Don't work too hard, okay?
translation: 哇，多谢。别太辛苦了，好吗？

original: Wait... How do you know who I am? Have we met?
translation: 等一下……你怎么知道我是谁？我们见过吗？

original: You were too young to remember, and I suppose James never spoke of me. Typical.
translation: 你太小了，不会记得，我想詹姆斯从未提起过我，他一向如此。

original: I am Doctor Madison Li. I worked with your parents many years ago. Now I run the Science Lab here in Rivet City.
translation: 我是麦迪逊·李博士。很多年前我曾与你的父母共事过。现在我在铆钉城负责运营科技实验室。

original: It was all I had left. When your mother died, your father decided to leave with you. He abandoned our work. We had no choice but to do the same.
translation: 我只剩下这些了。当你母亲去世时，你父亲决定带你离开。他放弃了我们的工作。我们别无他法，也做了同样的抉择。

original: Where's my father? Tell me now!
translation: 我父亲在哪？快告诉我！

original: Calm down, calm down!
translation: 冷静，冷静！

original: What are you doing here? James said you were still in the Vault. Look, this is all terribly irrational.
translation: 你在这干嘛？詹姆斯说你仍在避难所里，太不可思议了。

original: Your father just shows up here as if nothing happened... He walked out on us. I know he had his reasons, I know it was to protect you, but still.
translation: 你父亲像个没事人一样又出现了……可当年就是他放弃了这一切。我明白他有自己的理由，那都是为了保护你，不过……

original: Project Purity was our life. It was the only thing that mattered, and then he just gave up. He abandoned us, and we were forced to move on.
translation: 净水工程是我们的生命。它曾是唯一重要的事情，可后来他就那么放弃了，并离开了我们，我们则被迫研究其他课题。

original: I've already told him that it's over. There's no going back. Project Purity was a failure, and he needs to move on.
translation: 我告诉过他全都结束了，无法回头。净水工程失败了，而他需要做其他的事。

original: You know my father? Have you seen him?
translation: 你认识我父亲？你见过他吗？

original: Well yes, of course I do. Don't you know who I am? I suppose James never told you. Typical.
translation: 哦，是的，当然。你不知道我是谁吗？我想詹姆斯从未告诉过你。他一向如此。

original: I am Doctor Madison Li. I worked with your father many years ago. Your mother as well, in fact.
translation: 我是麦迪逊·李博士，很多年前与你父亲一起工作过，事实上，还有你母亲。

original: You'll have to forgive me. This has all been very stressful, what with your father suddenly showing up here after being gone for so long.
translation: 你得体谅我。你父亲在消失了那么久后，突然又在这出现，太让我们紧张了。

original: You have to understand that I... We put all of that behind us. Project Purity, our work, all of it. We've moved on, even if your father hasn't.
translation: 你必须得明白，我……我们不愿想过去的一切，净水工程、我们的工作、所有的一切，我们都不管了。人必须往前走，尽管你父亲没有。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Sure thing, baby. What did you have on your mind?
translation: 当然，宝贝。你在想什么呢？

original: Why is Moriarty so hard on him?
translation: 为什么莫里亚蒂对他那么狠？

original: Well, the miserable bastard is hard on all of us. But Gob gets it the worst. I guess just because he's different, you know?
translation: 哼，那杂种对我们所有人都很差。不过盖博的处境最糟。我想都是因为他有点不同，对吧？

original: Do you ever... you know... work with him?
translation: 你是否曾经……唔……跟他那个过？

original: With Gob? Well, he's sweet... and I know that he'd like to, it's just... well...
translation: 和盖博？喔，他很温顺……我知道他很愿意，只是……这个……

original: I don't want to sound shallow or anything, I mean, I'm a whore, my standards aren't exactly high.
translation: 我不是说我自己很肤浅或者什么的，我的意思是，我是做这行的，我的标准并不高。

original: But there are places even I won't go. Johnnies that are squishier than me are one of 'em.
translation: 即使这样，也有我不愿做的。比我还多愁善感的男人我是不碰的。

original: Where did he come from?
translation: 他从哪来？

original: He don't talk about it much but apparently, there's a whole city of Ghouls somewhere down in DC.
translation: 他没有说过太多，不过很显然，在华盛顿特区某处的地下有一个满是僵尸的城市。

original: He's mentioned his mother a couple of times, but other than that, he won't really say.
translation: 他有几次提到了他的母亲，但除此之外就不肯说了。

original: He's been here for... I guess about fifteen years now. Ever since Moriarty bought him off of those Slavers.
translation: 他在这已经待了……我猜到现在大概有15年了。自从莫里亚蒂把他从奴隶贩子那买来之后。

original: So, what's it take to hire you?
translation: “租”你需要多少钱呢？

original: It used to be that Colin decided that stuff. But, with him gone, I'm thinking about retiring. So, no new clients. Sorry.
translation: 过去是由科林决定的。不过，既然他离开了，我也在考虑退休。因此不对新客人开放啦，对不起。

original: It takes you renting a room. Sleep in it, or don't. I don't care. I get paid either way.
translation: 就是要你租个房间，在里面睡觉，不睡也行。我才不管呢，反正我都可以赚到钱。

original: What were you saying about radio stations?
translation: 刚才你说的那电台是怎么回事？

original: Huh? Oh, you mean why was Gob banging on that radio? Well, out there in the Wastes, there are two stations that broadcast.
translation: 呃？哦，你说盖博为什么在捶那收音机？嗯，在废土，有两个电台。

original: There's the Enclave station. I don't know who they are, but I think it might just be some pre-war broadcast on a loop or something.
translation: 英克雷电台。我不知道他们是谁，但是我想那可能只是某个战前的电台在循环播出。

original: And there's Galaxy News Radio. It's run by a guy named Three Dog somewhere down in DC. But the signal went down a while ago.
translation: 还有银河新闻电台。它由一个住在特区里叫三狗的家伙主持。不过最近信号差了很多。

original: What's the story with that Ghoul?
translation: 和我说说那个尸鬼的故事？

original: Who, Gob? Well, if you can get past how he looks, he's a sweetheart. Colin's awfully hard on him, though.
translation: 谁，盖博？嗯，如果你忽视他的长相的话，他心地不错。不过，科林对待他特别狠。

original: Hey, can I have some of that hooch?
translation: 嗨，我能来点那种烈酒吗？

original: Help yourself, clown shoes. Grab one from the liquor cabinet. I never trust anyone without a drink in their hand.
translation: 随意，小可爱。从酒柜里来上一瓶吧，我从不信任那些手里没有酒的家伙。

original: Of course I never trust one that does either! Ha, ha!
translation: 当然，手里有酒的我就更不信了！哈哈！

original: Sure. Didn't I already tell you to?
translation: 当然。我不是和你说了吗？

original: Can I have another drink?
translation: 我能再来一杯吗？

original: Dukov has a key I need. Steal it for me.
translation: 我需要杜克夫的一把钥匙。帮我偷来。

original: How can I resist those...what color are your eyes anyway?
translation: 我怎能抗拒那……你的眼睛什么颜色来着？

original: You've got to do something for me first.
translation: 你应该先为我做些事。

original: I can't live like this any more. You take me to Rivet City and I'll get your key.
translation: 我不能再这样生活下去了。你把我带到铆钉城去，我就给你钥匙。

original: Everything's just fabulous!
translation: 一切都难以置信！

original: What's the point? Besides, I hate all that cold metal touching my skin. It gives me the willies! So, I'll just stick with visiting when I get sick.
translation: 什么意思？还有，我痛恨所有接触我皮肤的冰冷的金属。那让我感到害怕！所以，我检查生病的时候才去看。

original: Fabulous! Can I sell you a pair of sport shoes? Maybe they'd help you catch your wife when she runs away from you!
translation: 帅呆了！你想要一双运动鞋吗？当你老婆逃跑的时候，或许你能更快地抓住她！

original: And I've got a little number in my shop that should help push up those sagging girls of yours, darling.
translation: 亲爱的，我店里有些小玩意能帮你变挺。

original: What the hell are you talking about?!
translation: 你在说什么鬼话？！

original: Come on man. Quit it already! I'm not interested!
translation: 拜托，老兄。别废话了！我没兴趣！

original: You're not very subtle, you know.
translation: 你可不怎么聪明。

original: What?! Are you kidding? I'm too fabulous to settle down.
translation: 什么？你在开玩笑吗？我太震惊了，没法平静。

original: That's right. And the safety's off. Back off.
translation: 对了。关上保险。退后。

original: Same old shit. See something big and ugly moving in the distance. Shoot the hell out of it. Go an' check to make sure it's dead. Rinse and repeat.
translation: 老是这套路。看到一些又大又丑的家伙远远地过来。把他们干掉。上去确认他们已经死透了。没完没了。

original: I can assure you, Mr. Wellington, we're not just sunning ourselves out there all day. That's for damn sure!
translation: 我向你保证，威灵顿先生，我们不是整天在外面晒太阳的。绝对不是！

original: Hah! I'm fine with the same old shit all the time. The day something "interesting" happens in the Wasteland, it's time to retire!
translation: 哈！做这老套路我倒是没问题。如果有天废土上发生了什么“有趣”的事情，我就该退休了！

original: Everything is under control, Ms. Montenegro.
translation: 一切都在控制中，黑山女士。

original: They don't deserve it. But... oh, what the hell. Go ahead Ms. Primrose. If it'll make you happy, send them whatever you like.
translation: 他们不配。不过……呃，见鬼。继续吧，普利洛斯女士。只要你开心，送他们去哪都可以。

original: You're pressing your luck, Hawthorne.
translation: 你在拿你的性命开玩笑，霍桑。

original: I'll be sure to discuss it with them Mrs. Wellington.
translation: 我肯定要和他们谈谈，威灵顿太太。

original: Hello Ms. Lancaster.
translation: 你好啊，兰卡斯特女士。

original: I'm afraid not, Ms. Cheng.
translation: 恐怕不是这样，程女士。

original: Right. Sure thing, Anthony.
translation: 是的，没错，安东尼。

original: Everythings fine, Chief. Thanks for keeping us safe.
translation: 一切都好，长官。感谢你保护我们的安全。

original: Surgery of any kind is always extremely dangerous. The risk of infection is great. A doctor should never cut open a patient unless it's necessary.
translation: 任何形式的外科手术都非常危险。感染的风险很大。除非有必要，否则医生不该给任何一位病患开刀。

original: Yes. They are a fine addition. Now, if we can only get the residents to start eating them!
translation: 是的。它们是非常好的补给。现在，要是能让居民吃它们就好了！

original: Susan...
translation: 苏珊…

original: I'm worried about you, Mrs. Cheng. Come by the Wellness Center, I might have a pill or two that'll help you relax and cope with things.
translation: 我在为你担心，程太太。到健康中心来，我会给你一两粒药片，能帮助你放松并应付事情。

original: Fine, thank you. You and your men patrolling makes everyone feel safe here. Thanks again.
translation: 好的，谢谢你。你和你的手下进行巡逻，让这里的每个人都感到安全。再次感谢。

original: Do you make me nervous? Uh... No, not at all. Of course not.
translation: 你让我紧张了吗？唔……没有，没有的事。当然没有。

original: Haha! Nothing you can pin on me, Chief! But shouldn't you be out killing things in the Wasteland  instead of pestering old harmless fogies like me?
translation: 哈哈！你没什么可怪罪到我身上的，长官！难道你不该到外面去杀几个厉害的玩意吗，干嘛刁难我这种无害的老家伙？

original: My dear boy. You've got all the adventure you need, right here in these four walls. For starters, you can figure out how to make your wife happy.
translation: 亲爱的孩子，在这院子里你已经进行了一切必要的冒险。作为一个新手，你至少知道了怎样能让你老婆开心。

original: It's a radio play, not a documentary.
translation: 那是广播剧，不是纪录片。

original: Let's you and I stick to finding trouble to get into here, before we rush out in the Wasteland again; I'll take Gustavo over a Behemoth any day.
translation: 在我们重回废土之前，我们可以在这里找点麻烦。总有一天我会把古斯塔沃丢给一只超级变种巨人的。

original: Now there's an interesting idea, Mrs. Cheng!
translation: 有个好办法，程太太!

original: I wouldn't know. She's avoiding me lately.
translation: 我不知道。最近她老是回避我。

original: No worries, Comrade.  Everyone else  has trouble making the meetings, too. When I get my computer working, I'll get you a copy of the minutes.
translation: 别着急，同志。其他人在组织会议时也都有麻烦。等我的电脑能用之后，我会给你一份备忘录的。

original: <Sigh.> I don't know what to do, Comrade. Every day I fix it, but it always breaks again.
translation: <叹气>我不知道该怎么做，同志。我每天都修它，但它总是坏掉。

original: I shouldn't. A good leader, leads by example. But thank you anyway.
translation: 我不会。好的领导总是以身作则。但无论如何还是很感谢你。

original: Right, Susan. Whatever you say.
translation: 是的，苏珊。随你说什么。

original: Oh. Okay, dear. Goodbye.
translation: 哦，好的，亲爱的。再见。

original: We all feel safe knowing you and your men have this place locked up tight. Thank you!
translation: 知道你和你的手下把这里守得固若金汤，我们都倍感安全。谢谢你们！

original: I don't scrounge for anything. I run a high class Boutique, doctor, as you know. However, I can check with my supplier about holodisks for you.
translation: 我不是什么都收。我经营一家高级精品店，你知道的，医生。不过，我可以向我的供应商查询是否有全息光盘。

original: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你！

original: Don't worry about them. Just be yourself dear. You've had a hard life. You deserve some happiness. Hell, we all do.
translation: 不用担心他们。你随意就好了，亲爱的。你受苦了，应该享受一下。见鬼，我们都该享受一下。

original: What a question! I don't know. I supposed it is. But, it can't always be helped. We can't help who we fall in love with, can we?
translation: 你这问的！我不知道。我想是的。但是，这没办法。我们控制不了自己会爱上谁，是吧？

original: Yeah. I know. It's just... Well, I've been busy.
translation: 是的，我知道。只是……唔，我一直很忙。

original: Raiders? Again? Well, I'll have to make do. Thank you for the heads up, Chief. And thank your men for us. We are all grateful of your presence here.
translation: 歹徒？又来了？那，就这样了。多谢你的提点，长官。也请你替我们谢谢你的手下。有你们在，我们太感激了。

original: Shoo! Away with you. Leave me alone!
translation: 嘘！走远点，让我自己待着！

original: It's okay, really. I prefer to stay busy.
translation: 真的没问题。我宁愿过得忙碌些。

original: Really? He orders that every day. I prefer making more creative dishes. Choose something else, I beg you!
translation: 真的吗？他每天都点那个。我喜欢做更有创造力的菜。选个别的吧，求求你！

original: Something I picked up from my mom. She wasn't always the best mother... but she always showed her love for us in her cooking. I miss her sometimes.
translation: 有一些我从我妈那学来的。她不是最棒的母亲……但她做的饭里总是充满了对我们的爱。我有时候会想念她。

original: A sophisticated lady like you slaving over the stove? Don't trouble yourself with that, dear. You kick back and enjoy. I'm here to cook for you.
translation: 像你这样的高雅女士要亲手下厨？别给自己添麻烦了，亲爱的。你该享受一下。我来为你做饭。

original: Sure! I could always use another pair of hands in the kitchen.
translation: 是啊！厨房里多个帮手当然好了。

original: Oh that? It was nothing. A one time indiscretion, I assure you. Won't happen again, ol' chap. Scouts honor and all that. Care for a drink?
translation: 哦，那个？那没什么。小问题罢了，我向你保证，绝不会再发生了，老朋友。为了尊严及其他。来一杯？

original: What? Very funny old man! Well, I hear she's also running low on dried up old raisins, you cheeky bastard! Leave a gent to his drink already!
translation: 什么？好有趣的老头！嗯，我听说她的陈年葡萄干也不多了，你这无礼的混蛋！让那位绅士安静地喝酒！

original: Indeed! I'll drink to that!
translation: 确实！我要为这喝一杯！

original: Amen. I'll drink to that sister. Cheers!
translation: 阿门。我要为那姐妹喝一杯。干杯！

original: Why do you think I spend so much time getting smashed in the lounge?
translation: 那你说我整天泡在休息室里喝得烂醉是为什么？

original: Indeed, Mrs. Cheng. Indeed! Sometimes it helps wash away a lot more than just one day.
translation: 没错，程太太，没错！有时候它不只是消磨了一天时间。

original: Thank you for looking into that situation for me. I'm embarrassed it turned out to be nothing. Well, one can never be too careful.
translation: 感谢你让我了解情况。结果那没什么大不了的，我真难堪。不过，小心没大错。

original: Don't be silly. I know enough about them to make being friendly... awkward at best. Besides, I much prefer spending all my time with you!
translation: 别傻了。我知道怎样和他们打交道……最多有些棘手而已。不过，我更喜欢和你在一块打发时光！

original: Why thank you, dear! How charming of you to say so. Perhaps you and I should start spending some time together? Eh? Ahahah.
translation: 要谢谢你，亲爱的！你这么说真好。我们不妨在一起共度些时光吧？嗯？哈哈哈！

original: It hasn't been that long since my last "check up." So you know EXACTLY how I'm feeling, doctor.
translation: 离我上次“检查”的时间没多久啊。所以，你肯定了解我的感受，医生。

original: Nonsense Edgar! I always find your manners to be quite "up to the task." if you know what I mean! He he he he. See you later, MISTER Wellington.
translation: 埃德加，你胡说！我一直觉得你的礼貌是“应付差事”，你知道我的意思吧！呵呵呵呵，回见，威灵顿先生。

original: Eww! Banish the thought, old man! Seriously though, if you're still around in a decade or two, I might take you up on the offer.
translation: 呃！别再这么想了，老头！说真的，如果过十年或二十年你还在，我兴许会接受你的建议。

original: Why do I intimidate you so? You weren't intimated the other night! Aha! See you around, Don Juan.
translation: 为什么我这么吓唬你？因为那天夜里你没被吓到！啊哈！回见，唐璜。

original: Don't they all, dear? Don't they all!
translation: 他们不也是吗，亲爱的？他们不也是吗！

original: What? Are you kidding me?! Mind your own damn business. I don't go turning lights on in your closet, do I? Jeez!
translation: 什么？你在耍我吗？少管他妈的闲事！我又没在你家厕所里点灯，对吧？天啊！

original: I'm just great, if you don't count the fact that I'm married to the biggest idiot on the planet!
translation: 我很好，如果和这星球上最大的傻瓜结婚那事不算的话！

original: If you mean day dreaming about killing Mr. Cheng and knocking a few back in the lounge, then yeah, I'm able to relax once in a while.
translation: 如果你的意思是杀死程先生，再去休息室聊两句的白日梦，那么好，我可以去先放松一阵子了。

original: It breaks all the time! Does he take that as a sign to spend time with me? No. Stupid man! He spends hours retyping everything. He's such a loser!
translation: 它老是坏掉！难道他认为那是和我一起浪费时间的信号吗？不，蠢男人！他把所有的时间都用在改错字上。他是个大废物！

original: What?!
translation: 什么？！

original: Cheers.
translation: 干杯。

original: I'd be happy to have you help sometime, Mrs. Cheng. Cooking can be very therapeutic.
translation: 我非常高兴能不时得到您的帮助，程太太。烹饪有益身心健康。

original: I hate that stupid man.
translation: 我恨那蠢货。

original: Who you calling frumpy?! At least my ass isn't shaped like a pear.
translation: 你恶狠狠地喊什么？至少我的屁股长得不像只梨。

original: The usual, dear. And please, be sure to remember to measure the salt precisely. We don't a repeat of last weeks debacle.
translation: 老样子，亲爱的。拜托，放盐的时候注意些。别再出上周的错了。

original: Umm... er... why yes, Ms. Lancaster. You are quite the "conversationalist." I await with anticipation our next opportunity for chit chat. Indeed!
translation: 嗯……呃……是的，兰卡斯特女士。你绝对是个“健谈的人”。老实说，我非常希望有机会再好好聊聊。

original: Ewwww! Labcoats are so last century. I have a better idea, Doc. Why don't you come to New Urban Apparel, and I'll give you a complete make-over!
translation: 呃…！实验室的外套实在是太古董了。我有个更好的主意，医生。你为什么不来新都市服装店，我会给你好好改改！

original: Yes! But the key to being fabulous, is that it comes from within. What you wear is only half the equation. BELIEVE you ARE already fabulous!
translation: 是的！但是变漂亮的关键来自内心。你的穿着只是公式的一半。要相信你已经变漂亮了！

original: Whatever, you old hag. I'm just swelling with fabulous.
translation: 随便，你这老太婆。我已经漂亮得光彩四射了。

original: Those things are so tacky. How about you swing by New Urban Apparel, and I fit you into a cute Sunday dress? You need to spruce up your look dear.
translation: 那些东西太寒酸了。要不要试试新都市服装店？我会让你穿起可爱而合身的周日晚装。你需要把自己打扮得整齐些。

original: Of course! Shopping is wonderful therapy, isn't it? Better than any old pill Doc Banfield prescribes.
translation: 当然啦！购物是很好的疗法，对吧？比班菲尔德医生的药片管用多了。

original: I'm sorry? What?!
translation: 对不起？什么？！

original: Thank you for your concern, Doctor. But things've been tense is all, and my men are just blowing off steam. Don't worry. They'll be fine.
translation: 谢谢你的关心，医生。不过事情已经变得很紧张，我的人也都吵吵嚷嚷的。别着急，他们会好的。

original: And I envy your retirement, Dashwood. Though it's true. There's something satisfying about bagging a Rad-Scorpian at 100 yards with a single shot.
translation: 退休真让人羡慕啊，达什伍德。尽管如此，在100码外一枪打死一只辐射蝎还是很带劲的。

original: Cheng. Damn it. Call me "Chief." Chief Gustavo! All that "comrade" nonsense is really getting on my nerves.
translation: 程，他妈的。叫我“长官”。古斯塔沃长官！所有这些“同志”之类的东西真是让我过敏。

original: That's kind of you, Ms. Primrose. But it's better if they don't cozy up with the residents. Helps retain discipline and remind them why they're here.
translation: 您太客气了，普利洛斯女士。但那总比让居民不舒服要好。能保持秩序，并能提醒他们为什么他们在这。

original: I'm on duty. You alright Hawthorne? Don't want a repeat of that little stunt you pulled.
translation: 我在执勤。你还好吧，霍桑？别耍小花招。

original: It was very... thorough, Mrs. Wellington. Do the other residents know you have catalogued all their habits and daily routines like that?
translation: 这非常……彻底，威灵顿太太。其他居民知道你已经把他们的生活习惯和日常行为归档了吗？

original: Ms. Lancaster.
translation: 兰卡斯特女士。

original: I'd have to say that would be extremely unlikely, Mrs. Cheng.
translation: 我得说那不大可能，程太太。

original: I'm afraid the lab coat never goes out of style for me. But I appreciate your concern.
translation: 我穿实验室外套恐怕永远不会落伍的。不过非常感谢你的关心。

original: Yes, of course. There's nothing to worry about. Though, it's been awhile since I've seen you. We should schedule a checkup soon.
translation: 是的，当然，没有必要担心。不过，我确实有一阵没见过你了。我们应该尽快安排一次检查。

original: Absolutely not. All Wasteland meat MUST be thoroughly cooked. Disease and parasites are killed by the heat. I'm surprised I have to tell you this.
translation: 绝不。所有废土上的肉类必须经过彻底烹煮。高温可以杀灭病菌与寄生虫。我很惊讶于必须告知你这些。

original: Ahem. Yes. It has been too long since you've been properly examined.
translation: 嗯。是的，离上次给你做全面检查已经很久了。

original: Why? Has someone been poisoned?!
translation: 为什么？有人中毒了？！

original: Oh... well... umm... Thank you Susan... er, I mean, Ms. Lancaster. A pleasant day to you.
translation: 哦……这个……唔……谢谢你，苏珊……呃，我是说，兰卡斯特女士。愿你度过快乐的一天。

original: I know a little bit about technology. I've picked up a few tricks in my adventures. Why, what seems to be the problem?
translation: 我懂一点技术。我在冒险时学到的。怎么样，有什么问题？

original: Hawthorne. Go easy on those remaining brain cells, alright?
translation: 霍桑。别白费心思了，好吗？

original: You should count yourself very lucky. I do. Most people die a horrible death out there in the Wastes. Excitement and danger often go hand in hand.
translation: 你应该认为自己非常幸运。我就这么看。许多人在废土上死得很惨。刺激与危险经常并肩而至。

original: I've had too kill far to many men... listen, Mrs. Cheng... have you tried talking to your husband about things? I think he really cares about you.
translation: 我也杀过很多人……听着，程太太.……你曾试过与你的丈夫谈论这些事吗？我看他很关心你的。

original: Oh, I don't know. Not so good I guess... Women. Can't live with them. Can't live without them. Know what I mean, Comrade?
translation: 哦，我不知道。我想不太好吧……女人。不能跟她们一起过日子，又不能没有她们。了解我的意思吗，同志？

original: Well, Comrade. My computer keeps breaking, and I have to start over each day. Not to worry though. I've got it practically memorized by now!
translation: 同志。我的电脑老是坏，我不得不每天重头开始。但是别着急。我现在实际上都能记住它了！

original: Because, while it's true, some of us are better suited to lead the community, by calling you all comrades, I'm helping you not feel envy or sadness.
translation: 因为，一方面我们中的某些人的确更适合领导社群，通过称呼大家为同志，我可以帮你不感到嫉妒或悲伤。

original: Um. Hi.
translation: 唔，嘿。

original: Antique shop? Really, Anthony, you need some new material! And I'm not just talking about your jokes either, darling. Those threads are atrocious!
translation: 古董店？说真的，安东尼，你需要一些新材料！我不光是指你的笑话，亲爱的。那些线头都朽了！

original: Yeah, I pop a couple, then have a Martini. Does wonders. Thanks Doc.
translation: 是啊，哼上两曲，再来杯马蒂尼酒。太棒了。谢了，医生。

original: Mr. Cheng. Shouldn't YOU know what your wife would like? Why don't you go find out what she wants, and I'll see about ordering it for you.
translation: 程先生，难道你不知道你妻子喜欢什么吗？干嘛不去问问她想要什么，我来帮你订货。

original: Let's just say it's high time for a glass of wine. Putting on a happy face for all my customers all the time can be a bit tiresome.
translation: 看来我该来上一杯了。随时随地对所有的顾客奉上微笑还真是累人啊。

original: Yes, Mrs. Cheng. It's not easy though, is it?
translation: 是的，程太太。尽管这不容易，对吧？

original: Thank you for saying so, sir. It's always my great pleasure. If you'd ever like to try another dish, I have an extensive menu of delicacies.
translation: 谢谢你这么说，先生。这是我的荣幸。不如你尝尝另一道菜吧，我有精选菜单。

original: Things are alright, I guess. I'm thinking I should stop by sometime and get some new clothes. I just can't seem to find the time.
translation: 还好，我觉得。我在想或许有时间我也该来逛逛，添些新衣服。我只是抽不出时间。

original: Nonsense. I'm fine. I enjoy making food and keeping the residents happy. A vacation from this would only make me anxious.
translation: 胡说，我很好。我热衷于烹饪，让居民过得开心。给我假期反而会使我焦虑。

original: Oh, I'm alright, I suppose. Though, apparently raiders have been attacking the caravans again. Missed a shipment. I'll just have to be be creative!
translation: 哦，我觉得我没问题。显然，歹徒又开始袭击商队了。损失了一批货物，看来我得想想办法了！

original: Thank you for saying so! It's always been my dream to own my own restaurant. Supplies have been running low, but it just makes me more creative!
translation: 谢谢你能这么说！拥有我自己的餐馆一直是我的梦想。或许补给来得很少，但这却激发了我的创意！

original: Thank you. It's always my pleasure to serve you Mr. Cheng. If you'd like, I could prepare a special candle light dinner for you and Mrs. Cheng.
translation: 谢谢你。为您服务是我的荣幸，程先生。如果您愿意，我会为您和程太太安排一次烛光晚餐。

original: Yes, well. There've been shortages of certain things, so I've had to get creative. I hope everything is to your liking Ms. Montenegro.
translation: 是的，嗯。有些东西是缺货，所以我不得不想出新办法。我希望你满意这一切，黑山女士。

original: Don't worry about me. I'm fine. Besides, if I didn't cook for all of you, you'd starve to death! Heaven knows none of you can fend for yourselves!
translation: 别为我担心，我没事。而且，如果我不为你们做饭的话，你们就会饿死！天知道你们怎么照顾自己！

original: Why, yes. I believe so. Fairly happy, anyway. I really enjoy what I do. Cooking and preparing meals for the residents makes me happy.
translation: 啊，是的。我也相信。无论如何，非常开心。我真的喜欢所做的事。为居民烹饪和准备食物让我很快乐。

original: What? Oh right. Hah! That's a good one, Daring. I'm fine really. I've been drinking since I was a toddler. I can hold my liquor. What's new with you?
translation: 什么？哦，好吧。哈！那个好，亲爱的。我真的没事。我在学走路的时候就开始喝了。我知道自己的酒量。你有什么新闻？

original: My secret to what? Oh right. The ladies. Always start off with a few drinks to loosen up, then move onto the hard liquor to get the party rolling!
translation: 我的什么秘密？哦，好吧。女士们。总要先喝几杯才开口，然后换成烈酒聚会才会达到高潮。

original: Indeed! And at the beginning of a long day! Though, I prefer the stiffer stuff myself. So how're you holding up these days? How's that shop of yours?
translation: 是啊！还是在漫长的一天刚开始的时候！不过，我自己喜欢更带劲的东西。那你这些天怎么样。你的店还好吗？

original: I wouldn't pay you so much to hang out with me if I thought you were ugly! I'm just kidding. Stop fishing for compliments. You know you're beautiful.
translation: 要是我觉得你很丑，干嘛花那么多钱让你陪我！我是开玩笑的。别再找人恭维你了，你知道自己很漂亮的。

original: Just goes to show you: It's always darker on the other side of the fence.
translation: 只是想告诉你：事情的另一面往往更黑暗。

original: EDGAR! I do believe you are trying to shake me off! The fire has finally died away, has it, Edgar? You fancy someone else these days, do you?
translation: 埃德加！我确信你是想甩掉我！激情终于熄灭了，对吧，埃德加？这几天你迷上别人了，是不是？

original: Why thank you Allistair love. Er, I mean: MISTER Tenpenny!
translation: 多谢你，亲爱的奥利斯特。呃，我的意思是：特佩尼先生！

original: Doctor Banfield! Have you lost your appointment book? I thought we've made a regular appointment. A "house call" I do believe!
translation: 班菲尔德医生！你是不是丢了你的预约表？我想我们有定期约见。我记得是“上门服务”。

original: Yes Edgar dear, I'm quite fine. Thanks for asking! Maybe I'll "see you" around  later, then? When you get out for an "evening stroll," perhaps?
translation: 是的，亲爱的埃德加，我非常好。多谢关心！要不要我过一阵来“见见你”？在你“晚上遛弯”的时候吧，怎么样？

original: Whatever. I know your type, Daring. You want me all to yourself. Well, I'm not some trophy animal you can just bag and hang on your wall!
translation: 随便。我知道你是什么人，亲爱的。你想要完全拥有我。不过，我可不是什么你能挂在墙上的猎物标本！

original: Don't be scared Irving, dear! I won't bite. Well, not unless you ask me to! Hahahaha!
translation: 别害怕，亲爱的艾尔文！我不咬人。唔，除非你让我咬！哈哈哈哈！

original: Don't be silly, Michael. It's because you pay me to be nice to you!
translation: 别傻了，迈克尔。那是因为你付钱让我对你好。

original: Why? You haven't seen him have you?!
translation: 什么？你还没见过他？！

original: Ha! Well, doc. If you got a pill that will make my husband disappear, I'll gladly take it.
translation: 哈！大夫。如果你有能让我丈夫消失的药丸，我会非常高兴的。

original: Yeah. He's so stupid! I don't actually need to sneak out. I just tell him to piss off, and then I leave. If he was smart, he'd try to stop me. Men!
translation: 是啊，他傻透了！我没必要溜出去。我只是让他滚，然后自己离开。他要是聪明点，就该试着拦住我的。男人！

original: Oh no! I'm not going to make it that easy for you. If you can't figure it out, then I'm not going to help you. Why are you so stupid?!
translation: 哦，不！我不会这么容易就让你得到的。如果你搞不定，我才不帮你。你为什么那么蠢？！

original: You mean other than the fact that he is an idiot? Or that he's always busy with stupid meetings, or writing stupid books, that NO ONE cares about?
translation: 你是说除了他是个大白痴之外？还是他一直忙于开些愚蠢的会，或者写些蠢透了的、没人在乎的书？

original: No amount of drink is going to make my husband less stupid. But, it'll certainly help me forget about him, won't it.
translation: 喝再多的酒也不能让我丈夫少点傻气。不过，这倒是能帮助我忘记他，是吧。

original: I've never heard Dad talk about you. Why is that?
translation: 我从未听父亲提到过你，为什么？

original: I'm quite sure I don't know. Why don't you ask him that?
translation: 我真的不知道，为什么你不去问问他？

original: My father's gone missing. Have you seen him?
translation: 我父亲失踪了，你见过他吗？

original: He was here, yes. It was quite a shock to see him after so many years.
translation: 他到过这里，是的。多年之后又看到了他使我深感震惊。

original: I'm afraid he's gone now.
translation: 恐怕他现在已经走了。

original: Where can I find Ted Strayer?
translation: 我在哪能找到泰德·斯崔尔？

original: Have you tried the common room?  That's where he sleeps.
translation: 你去过公用休息室了吗？他就在那里睡觉。

original: Otherwise...hmmm. You can probably find him on the flight deck some days, if it isn't raining.
translation: 否则……唔，有时候你可能会在飞行甲板上找到他，如果没下雨的话。

original: He usually goes to the Muddy Rudder on Sundays. Beyond that, who knows.
translation: 他通常在礼拜天去“泥舵”酒吧。除此之外，天晓得。

original: Where is this old lab of yours?
translation: 这个旧实验室究竟在哪？

original: It's in the old Jefferson Memorial building, northwest of here.
translation: 在老杰斐逊纪念馆那边，朝西北方向去。

original: Please don't go after him. It was foolish of him to even think about going there alone.
translation: 最好别步他的后尘，他独自跑去那真是愚蠢。

original: I'm sorry. Could you please tell me where he's gone?
translation: 抱歉。你能告诉我他去哪了吗？

original: Your father insisted that we return to work on Project Purity. I tried telling him too much time has passed; there's no way it would work.
translation: 你的父亲坚持认为我们应该回去工作以恢复净水工程。我想告诉他，时间过去太久了，已经无法让它再运转了。

original: Predictably, he refused to listen to me. He says he can prove it will work, and headed off to the old lab.
translation: 不出所料，他不听我的意见。他说能保证它运转起来，然后掉头就去了旧实验室。

original: I'm sorry. I don't know what else to tell you.
translation: 抱歉，我不知道还能告诉你些什么。

original: If he was here, then do you know where he went?
translation: 如果他来过这，那么你知道他朝哪去了吗？

original: Yes, I do. I told him repeatedly that it's too late, that the project is too far gone to be revived.
translation: 是的，我知道。我再三告诫他太迟了，那工程已经荒废得太久，不可能恢复了。

original: He insisted he can just pick up where we left off 20 years ago, and said he could prove it to me.
translation: 他坚持认为在我们离开20年后，他依旧能让它运转起来，他还说能向我证明这一点。

original: So he headed off to the old lab. I advised against it, but he went anyway.
translation: 于是他就直奔实验室而去，我再三劝告也无济于事。

original: Screw the Vault. I'm not staying cooped up in there.
translation: 去他的避难所吧，我可不要困在那里面。

original: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

original: So you decided to leave one of the safest places in the Wasteland, even though it was in your best interest to stay. Sounds familiar.
translation: 因此你决定离开废土中唯一安全的地方，显然你该维持原状的。这话听起来真熟悉。

original: Well I'm afraid your father is no longer here.
translation: 恐怕你父亲已不在这了。

original: I left the Vault to look for him.
translation: 我离开避难所来找他。

original: Did you? I was under the impression that's exactly the opposite of what he wanted for you.
translation: 是吗？我怎么觉得这与他的意愿完全相反呢。

original: Well, you won't find him here. He's come and gone already.
translation: 唔，你不会在这找到他的，他来过，又走了。

original: This isn't about me. This is about my father. Now where is he?
translation: 我的事无所谓，是关键是我父亲，他现在在哪？

original: Your father is no longer here, and I'd appreciate it if you didn't use that tone with me.
translation: 你父亲不在这了，而且我希望你别用那种腔调跟我说话。

original: I'd like to know a bit more about you.
translation: 我很想知道一些关于你的事。

original: What? Well, I... I'm not sure what there is to tell.
translation: 什么？呃，我……我不知道该从何说起。

original: Your father and I... We worked together for a long time. I think we were really on to something.
translation: 你父亲和我……我们在一起工作了很长时间。我想我们在某些地方是志同道合的。

original: But then there were... complications. The project was abandoned, and your father disappeared.
translation: 但是后来就出现了……问题。工程被放弃了，你父亲也消失了。

original: I returned here to Rivet City, and established the lab you see before you now.
translation: 我回到了铆钉城，建成了你眼前的这座实验室。

original: Is there any way you can help me out?
translation: 你有什么方法能帮助我吗？

original: Look, I don't want to be harsh, but I have problems of my own.
translation: 瞧，我不想显得很冷漠，但其实我自己也有很多麻烦。

original: I don't have the resources to support James' foolish endeavors, or your chasing after him. I'm sorry.
translation: 我没有资源来支持詹姆斯的蠢念头，也没有办法帮你去找他，对不起。

original: Can you tell me more about my parents?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于我父母的事吗？

original: I suppose so. I worked with them for several years until... Until your mother died, and your father decided it was time to leave.
translation: 可以。我和他们在一起工作了几年，直到……直到你母亲去世，你父亲也因此觉得，是时候该离开了。

original: What else do you want to know?
translation: 你还想知道其他什么事吗？

original: What do you want to know?
translation: 你想知道什么？

original: What is this lab? What are you doing here?
translation: 这是什么实验室？你们在这里做什么？

original: This is the Rivet City Science lab.
translation: 这是铆钉城科技实验室。

original: It's taken many long years to put together, but we've done well for ourselves.
translation: 组建它花了好多年，但我们做得不错。

original: Our work on portable fusion power and hydroponics are coming along quite nicely, if not quite according to schedule.
translation: 虽然偏离了原计划，但我们在便携式聚变能源和水培法上进展相当顺利。

original: All right, then.
translation: 好吧，那。

original: That's enough.
translation: 这就够了。

original: By all means. I'm always proud to talk of my Brotherhood.
translation: 当然可以。谈到我的兄弟会，我总是很自豪。

original: Okay, I think I understand.
translation: 好的，我想我懂了。

original: Okay. Anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的事吗？

original: That's enough for now.
translation: 就到这吧。

original: A real challenge? Every blessed hour of every blessed day.
translation: 真正的挑战？无时无刻不在面对。

original: Just because we have good equipment doesn't mean we're invincible. A tool is only as good as the craftsman who holds it.
translation: 拥有好装备并不意味着我们是不可战胜的。工具只在巧匠手里才能发挥最大作用。

original: And I've seen my share of friends lost. Between the fighting, the Outcasts, and the everyday tragedies, we've seen plenty of grief in these Wastes.
translation: 我自己也失去了很多朋友。战斗中失去的、成为放逐者的，还有自然规律带走的，在这些损失中我们尝尽了辛酸。

original: Has the Brotherhood ever faced a real challenge?
translation: 兄弟会面临过真正的挑战吗？

original: The Brotherhood came out here to recover technology from the eastern cities and bases. If Lyons won't do it, then we will.
translation: 兄弟会来到东岸的城市和基地获取科技。如果里昂斯不做，那我们来做。

original: And when we resume contact with the Western Elders, Lyons is going to be put in his place.
translation: 等我们和西岸的长老恢复了联络，里昂斯就会去他该去的地方了。

original: Even if that place is in front of a firing squad.
translation: 怕是行刑队面前吧。

original: So what's your long-term plan for dealing with the Brotherhood?
translation: 对于与兄弟会相处，你有什么长远计划？

original: It seems like whichever challenge we're facing is always the biggest one. Survival at first, then expansion, and now cohesion.
translation: 好像无论我们面临哪个挑战，都是最艰巨的。最早是生存，然后是扩张，而现在则是团结。

original: We've seen plenty of Wasteland freaks or would-be dictators. They're not too bad, at least we've faced that sort of thing before.
translation: 我们见过太多的废土怪人或是野心家。他们还不算太糟糕，至少我们之前见识过这类事情。

original: But more recent events, like the schism with the Outcasts... Those are the problems that worry me.
translation: 但是近来的许多事，比如放逐者的分裂……那些才是让我担心的问题。

original: What's the biggest challenge the Brotherhood has ever faced?
translation: 兄弟会曾面临的最大挑战是什么？

original: Huh. And here I thought we had the only remaining copy of that...
translation: 呃。我还以为我们拥有唯一的副本呢……

original: Anyway, I don't know if the old man's going to die from them, but he sure as hell looks like he's going to drag his soldiers down with him.
translation: 无论如何，我不知道那老家伙会不会死在他们手上，但他那鬼样子，一定会拉着那些士兵一起完蛋的。

original: But he's not wasting any of our time anymore, damnit.
translation: 不过他不会再浪费我们的时间了，该死的。

original: By that analogy, you think Lyons will be killed by the Super Mutants?
translation: 根据推断，你认为里昂斯将被超级变种人消灭？

original: You know what? Never mind.
translation: 你知道吗？还是算了吧。

original: Sheesh. Ignorant savages.
translation: 嗤。愚昧的野人。

original: "Ahab Lyons"? And what's a whale?
translation: “亚哈·里昂斯”？还有你说什么鲸鱼？

original: Oh, he used to be as tough as the rest of us. Wasn't so long ago, we fought side-by-side to Scourge the Pitt.
translation: 哦，他曾经和我们其他人一样坚强。不久以前，我们还在并肩和匹兹堡的祸害作战。

original: But somewhere, he went soft. Stopped looking at the big picture, and started trying to save every tribal and illiterate community he found.
translation: 但不知从什么地方开始，他变得软弱了。不再关注大局，而是开始尝试拯救每个他所见到的部落和无知的原住民。

original: When he had us helping those savages instead of recovering tech that could help us all, that's when we objected and became Outcasts.
translation: 当他要我们去帮助那些野人，而不是搜寻那些可以帮助大家的科技时，我们起而反对，并变成了放逐者.

original: How did Lyons change the Brotherhood?
translation: 里昂斯是怎样改变兄弟会的？

original: I like to think that I've still got some big achievements left in me, although some of my joints seem to disagree these days.
translation: 我喜欢去想我的身上还留有某种激情，虽然这些天来我的关节不同意这一点。

original: I'll tell you what the low-lights of my time have been though: every time I've been shot at. I'm a scribe, not a soldier!
translation: 还是说说我生命中的低潮吧：每次有人向我开枪的时候。我是个文士，不是士兵！

original: What have been the highlights of your time with the Brotherhood?
translation: 你在兄弟会有什么英勇事迹？

original: Not hardly. We've got our mission, we'll stick with it, and to hell with Lyons and his soldier sycophants.
translation: 算不上。我们有自己的任务，而且我们会始终如一，让里昂斯跟他那些只懂得献媚的士兵下地狱吧。

original: If they call us Outcasts for our dedication to duty, then we'll wear the title with pride!
translation: 如果因为我们忠于职守而被他们称为放逐者，那么我们就骄傲地使用这个名号！

original: And you just wait for when we get back in contact with the real Brotherhood out West. Lyons will have hell to pay.
translation: 你等着吧，我们会和西岸真正的兄弟会恢复联络的。里昂斯会付出惨重的代价。

original: So, you just figure you'll strike out on your own as Outcasts?
translation: 所以你们决定遵照自己的意愿作为放逐者独立出去？

original: I mean the Brotherhood from out West, back around California. We knew what we were doing back there. We didn't waste time with delusions of heroism.
translation: 我的意思是加利福尼亚那边的西岸兄弟会。在那边我们知道自己该做什么。不会为了英雄主义的妄想浪费时间。

original: We were collecting still-glowing embers from the ashes of humanity, before civilization's fire died completely.
translation: 在文明之火完全熄灭之前，我们要在人类的灰烬中收集那些尚在发光的余烬。

original: We didn't worry about saving individual communities. We worried about saving the progress of humanity itself.
translation: 我们才不在乎保护个别的地方。我们关心的是怎么拯救人类的进程。

original: What do you mean "the original Brotherhood?"
translation: 你所说的“最早的兄弟会”是什么意思？

original: And all at the cost of throwing away the lives of soldiers for a mission they didn't sign on for.
translation: 而代价是那些士兵为了他们不认可的任务去浪费性命。

original: They're not supposed to be saving a bunch of backwards locals from raiders, they're supposed to be saving mankind from a new dark age.
translation: 他们不应该去从歹徒手中拯救一帮落后的本地人，他们应该从新的黑暗时代中拯救全人类。

original: Well, some of mankind, anyway. The important parts, at least.
translation: 就算是部分人类吧。至少是重要的那部分。

original: But they're heroes! They defend the Capital Wasteland!
translation: 但他们是英雄！他们保卫着华盛顿废土！

original: I'm afraid the answer to that is a lot more nuanced than others might suggest.
translation: 答案恐怕比大家想得还微妙。

original: Brotherhood members are sworn to acquire and protect technology of the past. But not everyone interprets these oaths in the same way.
translation: 兄弟会成员都曾发誓要获取和保护从前的科技。但并不是每个人对宣言都有同样的解读。

original: Elder Lyons sees these duties as part of a larger dedication to protect the innocent. Some, like the Outcasts, disagree with these priorities.
translation: 里昂斯长老把这些职责看作是更大的奉献的一部分，以此来保护无辜者。而另一些人，比如放逐者，就不同意这种优先顺序。

original: What are the central beliefs of the Brotherhood?
translation: 兄弟会的核心信仰是什么？

original: Do you sell any specialty items?
translation: 你有更特殊的物品出售吗？

original: Which one, the original Brotherhood out West, or the shit that Lyons turned it into out here?
translation: 哪个？是西岸那个最早的兄弟会，还是里昂斯在这里搞出来的那堆狗屎？

original: How do you feel about the Brotherhood of Steel?
translation: 你对钢铁兄弟会怎么看？

original: I used to like serving with them, I really did. But, you know, the technology has to come first.
translation: 我曾经乐于和他们共事，真的。但是，你知道，科技必须是最优先的。

original: Elder Lyons was nice and all, but we don't rescue technology by being nice.
translation: 里昂斯长老很和善，但是和善不能拯救科技。

original: He was wasting my time, and my Pop didn't raise me to have my time wasted. So when Casdin left to continue the mission, I followed.
translation: 他在浪费我的时间，而我爸爸抚养我不是来浪费时间的。所以当卡斯丁为了继续使命而离开时，我跟随了他。

original: How do you feel about the Brotherhood of Steel?
translation: 你对钢铁兄弟会怎么看？

original: You mean, apart from the fact that they ditched their mission and went native?
translation: 你是说，除了他们已经抛开任务去找原住民这事？

original: Sure, I bet you don't mind them being cuddly with the locals, but when we came out here, we had a mission to do, damnit.
translation: 当然，我打赌你不反对他们对原住民好一点，不过我们是为了任务而来的，真该死。

original: But now they're wasting their time protecting yahoos like you, while Ahab Lyons is off chasing his Super Mutant white whale.
translation: 但现在他们在保护像你这样的土著，而亚哈·里昂斯则跑去追杀超级变种人，真是浪费时间。

original: What have you got against the Brotherhood?
translation: 你为什么要反对兄弟会？

original: Oh yes, I can. In fact, I suspect I could write several texts on the various details of the Brotherhood.
translation: 没错，我能。事实上，我觉得我都能写好几本关于兄弟会的资料了。

original: But I suspect you're in a hurry, so what particulars would you like to know?
translation: 但我看你很着急，你想知道哪方面的细节？

original: Can you tell me more about the Brotherhood of Steel?
translation: 能多告诉我一些钢铁兄弟会的事情吗？

original: It is a rather discouraging subject, isn't it?
translation: 这话题让人丧气，是吧？

original: Enough about the Outcasts.
translation: 不说放逐者了。

original: Yes, let's speak of other things.
translation: 是的，我们说点别的事吧。

original: That's enough about the Outcasts.
translation: 关于放逐者，先说到这里吧。

original: If my father is there. I need to go after him.
translation: 如果父亲在那，我就得去找他。

original: It's in the old Jefferson Memorial building northwest of here, along the river.
translation: 它在老杰斐逊纪念馆，沿着河往西北走。

original: It's not a safe place, and I wouldn't recommend going alone. As I said, I told your father not to go.
translation: 那里不太安全，不建议你单独去那，就像我曾说过的，也告诫过你父亲别去。

original: I don't need a lecture. I just need to know where to go.
translation: 我不想听长篇大论，我只想知道怎么走。

original: Fine. Suit yourself.
translation: 好吧，请便。

original: It's in the old Jefferson Memorial building northwest of here, along the river.
translation: 它在老杰斐逊纪念馆那，沿着河往西北走。

original: Then tell me where this lab is, so I can get going.
translation: 告诉我实验室在哪，我这就出发。

original: I'm going to tell you the same thing I told your father. Don't go.
translation: 我会再次重复对你父亲说过的话，别去。

original: Whatever's left there, it isn't worth it anymore. The project was abandoned. We gave up. There's no reason to go back.
translation: 不管那里还剩下什么，都没有意义了，工程已经失败，我们放弃了，没有再回去的理由。

original: I'm off to Vault 112 to search for anything of Braun's that might help me get this purifier up and running.
translation: 我要去112号避难所寻找布劳恩的一些东西，那可能会帮我让这个净化装置运转起来。

original: All I know is that it's west of someplace called Evergreen Mills, and it's well-hidden in some sort of garage, but I'll find it. I have to.
translation: 我所知道的就是它位于一个叫常青钢铁厂的地方之西边，被隐藏在一个车库之类的建筑里。但我会找到它的，一定会的。

original: It's so close, but that's the story of Project Purity, isn't it? An eternity of "almost theres."
translation: 曾经如此接近，不过，那就是净水工程的故事，对吧？永远处于“就要成功”的状态。

original: Let's see if Braun has the missing puzzle piece.
translation: 让我们看看布劳恩是否有能揭开谜底的东西。

original: To be honest, the G.E.C.K. sounded like pure fantasy, even for someone of Braun's capabilities.
translation: 老实说，就算有布劳恩那样的能力，伊甸园创造器听起来也似乎是个神话。

original: It was nothing short of a miracle -- a terraforming module, capable of producing life from complete lifelessness.
translation: 它简直就是个奇迹 — 一个土地重构单元，能够在毫无生气的地方创造生命。

original: But not only was this thing a reality, it was actually distributed to several vaults, to be used after an atomic war.
translation: 但这东西不仅存在，事实上还被送到好几个避难所之中，为的就是在核战后使用。

original: Vault 101 was, sadly, not on that list.
translation: 很遗憾，101号避难所却并不在此名单之中。

original: I did some digging, and discovered Braun's name on the reservation list for a Vault 112.
translation: 我曾经考据过，发现112号避难所的预留名单中有布劳恩的名字。

original: I'm no slouch, but this man... He could have easily succeeded where I failed.
translation: 我并不是妄自菲薄，不过这个人……当我失败时，他却总能轻易成功。

original: Does his collected knowledge remain within the halls of Vault 112? Journals, holotapes, computer records, maybe even experiments...
translation: 他所收集的知识会不会还留在112号避难所？日记、全息磁带、电脑记录，或许甚至还有实验……

original: If I could gain access to just a fraction of Braun's genius, Project Purity would become a reality.
translation: 如果我有小部分布劳恩的才华，净水工程早就实现了。

original: Even in Vault 101, my work on Project Purity never really stopped.
translation: 就算是在101号避难所期间，我关于净水工程的工作也从未真正停止过。

original: Soon after we arrived, my nightly routine included sneaking into the restricted areas, searching for... I don't know. Whatever I could find.
translation: 在我们到达后不久，我的夜间工作就包括溜进限制区内，去寻找……我不知道要找的是什么。我去找能找到的一切。

original: It was a Vault-Tec facility, after all. The place was built with some of the most advanced technology this country had ever developed.
translation: 毕竟，这是一座避难所科技设施。建造它用到过这国家曾发展出的最高水平科技。

original: Those excursions never turned up anything particularly useful. So... one night, after half a bottle of scotch, I broke into the Overseer's office.
translation: 那些探险从未发现过任何特别有用的东西。因此……一个晚上，在喝掉半瓶苏格兰威士忌之后，我闯进了监督者的办公室。

original: It was easy enough to hack his console, gain access to the restricted files. Most of it was garbage.
translation: 破解他的控制台，接触那些限制级文件很容易。但绝大部分都是垃圾。

original: Propaganda, spy reports, just plain rambling bullshit, really.
translation: 宣传，间谍报告，彻头彻尾的垃圾，真的。

original: But there was one thing, one name that stood out amongst all the others -- Doctor Stanislaus Braun.
translation: 但是有件事，有个名字很醒目 — 斯坦尼斯·布劳恩博士。

original: I knew of Braun's work, of course.
translation: 当然，我知道布劳恩的工作。

original: He was a celebrity in his day, Vault-Tec's "Sorcerer Scientist," leaving his peers in awe of his technological wizardry.
translation: 他是那个年代的名人，避难所科技的“魔法科学家”，以令人敬畏的科技天才将其同时代的人远远抛在身后。

original: But it was in Vault 101, that night in the Overseer's office...
translation: 但是在101号避难所，那天晚上，在监督者的办公室里……

original: I first learned of Braun's involvement in Vault-Tec's Societal Preservation Program, and his work on something called the G.E.C.K.
translation: 我头一次知道布劳恩参与了避难所科技的“社会保存工程”，他在搞一个叫做伊甸园创造器的东西。

original: The Garden of Eden Creation Kit.
translation: 伊甸园创造器。

original: I spoke with Doctor Li... Madison... at Rivet City. It went about as well as I expected.
translation: 我和铆钉城的…麦迪逊·…李博士谈过。事情正朝我预期的方向发展。

original: That is to say, she thinks I'm completely mad. How can I blame her?
translation: 也就是说，她认为我完全疯掉了。我又怎能责怪她呢？

original: She's got her own life, her own team, and is making real, tangible scientific progress.
translation: 她有自己的生活，自己的团队，以及真实而准确的科研成果。

original: And here I come again, the very paragon of failure and false promises.
translation: 而我这个标准的失败者和空想家又跑了出来。

original: But the reality is I need Madison, and whatever scientific team she may have assembled. I can't do this myself.
translation: 但实际上我需要麦迪逊，和她手下的科研团队。我没办法独自完成这个。

original: Project Purity is bigger than me. It always was. And without Catherine... God, I can't let this die. Not again. Not like this.
translation: 净水工程比我重要，一直是这样。失去凯瑟琳之后……天啊，我不能让净水工程再夭折，不能再失败了，不能就这样失败了。

original: This is day two of my attempt to resurrect this project.
translation: 这是我尝试恢复此工程的第二天。

original: I've got one of the portable fusion generators up and running, but it's just enough to power the emergency lighting and a couple of other systems.
translation: 我启动并运行了一个便携式核融合发电机，但它的能量只能够维持应急照明和其他几个系统。

original: That will serve for now, but I'll need help powering up the mainframe. Time to visit Madison at Rivet City.
translation: 那足够维持现状了，但我需要帮助以便启动主机。是时候去铆钉城拜访麦迪逊了。

original: So here I am, back where it all began. Project Purity. God, we wanted to change the world. We really thought the "waters of life" could be a reality.
translation: 我又来了，回到了这一切的起点。净水工程。上帝啊，我们想要改变世界。我们真的认为“生命之水”可以成为现实。

original: And that's why this is a momentous occasion. Because even after nineteen years, I still believe it.
translation: 而这就是此刻为何如此重要的原因。因为即使再过19年，我仍坚信它会成功。

original: Project Purity can and will be operational. This is just the beginning.
translation: 净水工程应该也必定可以投入实用。这只不过是开始。

original: Well. Here we are again. Project Purity and me. It's been close to twenty years since my last entry.
translation: 我们回来了。净水工程和我，离我上一条记录差不多相隔20年了。

original: Since I left all of this behind to make a life for my son.
translation: 自从我抛下这一切，要把儿子养大成人。

original: We've spent that time in Vault 101, tucked away from the rest of the world.
translation: 我们在101号避难所度过了那段美好的时光，远远地躲避着这个世界。

original: It wasn't perfect, but it was safe, and that's all I could have hoped for.
translation: 虽然并不完美，但至少安全，我也不敢奢求更多。

original: Now, my son is a grown man. Handsome, intelligent, confident. Just like his old man. Hmph.
translation: 现在，我的儿子已经长大成人。英俊、聪颖、自信，就像他的爸爸一样。哼哼。

original: And as hard as it was to admit it, he doesn't need his daddy anymore.
translation: 虽然不想承认，但他已经不再需要他的爸爸了。

original: Well. Here we are again. Project Purity and me. It's been close to twenty years since my last entry.
translation: 我们回来了。净水工程和我。离我上一条记录差不多相隔20年了。

original: Since I left all of this behind to make a life for my daughter.
translation: 自从我抛下这一切，要把女儿养大成人。

original: We've spent that time in Vault 101, tucked away from the rest of the world.
translation: 我们在101号避难所度过了那段美好的时光，远远地躲避着这个世界。

original: It wasn't perfect, but it was safe, and that's all I could have hoped for.
translation: 虽然并不完美，但至少安全，我也不敢奢求更多。

original: Now, my daughter is a grown woman. Beautiful, intelligent, confident. Just like her mother.
translation: 现在，我的女儿已经长大成人。漂亮、聪慧、自信，就像她的母亲一样。

original: And as hard as it was to admit it, she doesn't need her daddy anymore.
translation: 虽然不想承认，但她已经不再需要她的老爹了。

original: It's time to go. The project was in trouble before, both internally and externally.
translation: 该离开了，之前的计划处于危险之中，充满内忧外患。

original: Progress has come to a halt, both because our re-calculations have gotten us nowhere, and because the mutant attacks occur several times a day.
translation: 进展停滞了，不仅仅因为我们的重新计算毫无成果，也因为变种人每天数轮的进攻。

original: I regret that it has come to this. I know that if I leave, our work may come to an end.
translation: 我很遗憾走到这一步。我知道如果我离开，我们的工作可能就此终结。

original: Madison has never been on the best of terms with the Brotherhood; aside from Scribe Rothchild, she'll tolerate none of them.
translation: 麦迪逊从未与兄弟会保持过良好的关系；除了罗斯查德文士之外，她容忍不了他们中的任何一个。

original: If she's the one dealing with them, who knows what will happen.
translation: 如果让她来和他们打交道，天知道会发生什么。

original: It breaks my heart to go, but I must put the needs of my child before my own.
translation: 离开使我很伤心，但我必须把孩子的需求放在自己的之前。

original: I am at a loss. My beloved wife is gone. In her place is my son, small and helpless.
translation: 我茫然失措。我的爱妻走了，只留下我的儿子，幼小、无助。

original: As much as this place means to me... As much as it meant to Catherine, this is no place for an infant.
translation: 尽管此地对我来说意义重大……尽管此地对凯瑟琳意义重大，但这不是婴儿该待的地方。

original: Especially an infant without his mother.
translation: 特别是一个失去了母亲的婴儿。

original: I am at a loss. My beloved wife is gone. In her place is my daughter, small and helpless.
translation: 我茫然失措。我的爱妻走了，只留下我的女儿，幼小、无助。

original: As much as this place means to me... As much as it meant to Catherine, this is no place for an infant.
translation: 尽管此地对我来说意义重大……尽管此地对凯瑟琳意义重大，但这不是婴儿该待的地方。

original: Especially an infant without her mother.
translation: 特别是一个失去了母亲的婴儿。

original: The team has made plans to scale back our work once the baby is born.
translation: 团队打算孩子降生后，就重新规划我们的工作。

original: We're also trying to compensate for the increase in mutant attacks; no one is really talking about the implications of it.
translation: 我们也试图弥补变种人进攻所带来的损失，但没人真正谈及它的意义。

original: There are more of them than before. We know it, and the Brotherhood soldiers know it.
translation: 他们越来越多，我们知道，兄弟会的战士也知道。

original: Our relationship with the Brotherhood is straining.
translation: 我们与兄弟会之间的关系愈发紧张。

original: They're concerned by the lack of concrete results from the project, especially in light of the mutant attacks.
translation: 他们担心计划无法取得实质性进展，尤其是在变种人的攻击之下。

original: They haven't come out and said it, but we all know what's going on.
translation: 他们并没把事情挑明，但我们都知道正在发生什么。

original: They're questioning whether their involvement in our project is worth the trouble it's causing them.
translation: 他们开始质疑被牵扯进我们的计划并惹上诸多麻烦是否值得。

original: They lost two good men this week, with three more injured.
translation: 这一周，他们丧失了两名优秀的成员，还有三人受伤。

original: Well, there's no more mystery behind Catherine's health problems.
translation: 凯瑟琳的身体状况问题不再是什么秘密了。

original: The news of her pregnancy has lifted the spirits of everyone here, and given us a renewed interest in making the purifier work.
translation: 她怀孕的消息振奋了所有人的情绪，给了我们继续更新净化工作的信心和动力。

original: We now have a future generation to provide for.
translation: 我们现在有了需要守护的下一代。

original: The latest tests show that our methods are horribly inefficient, but I think we're on the right track.
translation: 最新的测试显示，我们的方法收效甚微，但我想我们的方向是对的。

original: Catherine refuses to rest; she insists on spending all day in the lab. I've never seen her more driven.
translation: 凯瑟琳拒绝休息，她坚持整天待在实验室里。我从未见过她如此干劲十足。

original: She's determined to resolve the power problems before the baby is born. I've tried to reason with her, but it's no use.
translation: 她执意要在孩子出生前解决能源问题。我已经试着去劝说她了，但没有用。

original: We're back at work after a full week of delays. The Brotherhood soldiers were able to repair the sentry guns, much to my relief.
translation: 拖延了整整一周后，我们又回来工作了。兄弟会的战士们修好了哨塔机枪，这让我深感欣慰。

original: I know Madison isn't comfortable having them here, but there's no denying that we'd be lost without them.
translation: 我知道麦迪逊不喜欢他们待在这儿，但不可否认的是，如果没有他们，我们都会送命的。

original: We're still waiting on the full analysis of the last three small-scale purification tests.
translation: 我们仍在等上次三个小规模净化实验的全面分析结果。

original: Catherine hasn't been feeling well, and it's slowing down our research. I don't mind, but I can tell it's bothering some of the others.
translation: 凯瑟琳感觉不太舒服，这也拖慢了我们的研究进程。我并不介意，但我知道这令其他人感到担忧。

original: Any help you can provide would be appreciated.
translation: 如果你能提供任何帮助，我将感激不尽。

original: Well, all I can do is offer my repair services to you. I'm pretty good with fixing stuff.
translation: 我能做的就是为你提供修理服务。我修东西很拿手。

original: That's usually because Brailee breaks everything thinking she's making a cake or something.
translation: 主要是因为布莱利以为自己在做蛋糕什么的，所以总把东西打烂。

original: Ohhhh! I'm sorry, I'll have to bake another batch. Maybe some other time.
translation: 哦哦哦！对不起，我必须再烤一炉。改天吧。

original: Why, yes. Let me give you one of my old fashioned chocolate chip cookies! Enjoy!
translation: 啊，是的。让我给你做个我拿手的碎巧克力甜饼吧！好好享受！

original: There are a few interesting places around here I've heard about. I don't know if they'll help you or not, but you're welcome to them.
translation: 我听说周围有几处有趣的地方。我不知道它们是否会帮助你，但欢迎你前往。

original: I've been saving up stuff for emergencies in case things with Arefu got tremendously bad.
translation: 我已经为紧急事态储备了足够的东西，以免断桥镇的形势更加恶化。

original: You're welcome to some of it if you like.
translation: 欢迎你挑选一些。

original: Sorry, the well's run dry.
translation: 抱歉，我们都捉襟见肘了。

original: He left? Then... where did he go?
translation: 他走了？那么……他去哪了？

original: Look, whatever's going on between the two of you is the least of my concerns right now.
translation: 听着，你们俩的事眼下我可不在乎。

original: Against my advice, your father returned to the old lab. He said he had some unfinished business to take care of.
translation: 拒绝了我的建议，你父亲回到旧实验室去了。他说他有一些未完成的事需要去处理。

original: Look, I'm not here to hurt anyone, I swear.
translation: 听着，我不会伤害任何人，我发誓。

original: All I care about are two things. My life and my wife's life. Beyond that, I don't give two shits.
translation: 我所在乎的就两件事。我的生命和我妻子的生命。除此之外，我毫无兴趣。

original: If you need something, speak your piece and go.
translation: 要什么快说，说完就快走。

original: Evan King told me to check on you. Is everything okay?
translation: 埃万·金要我来看看。一切都好吗？

original: We're great. Just peachy. I love sitting in my house with my thumb up my ass.
translation: 我们很好，好得很。我就喜欢坐在自家房子里无所事事。

original: Tell Mr. King that sitting here all day isn't going to make us any safer. We need to take action!
translation: 告诉金先生，整天待着是没法让我们更安全的。我们需要行动起来！

original: Oh! He's such a dear! I must remember to make more of those preserves he loves so much.
translation: 哦！他真体贴！我必须记住多给他做些他喜欢的甜品。

original: Scared out of my mind. I'm glad he's checking on us, but until someone nips the problem in the bud, we may as well stay inside forever.
translation: 吓到我了。真高兴他派人来查看我们，但是在有人解决这事前，我们最好还是待在里面。

original: I have a message for the West family from their daughter.
translation: 我有维斯特家的女儿捎给他们的一封信。

original: I can't take that. You're just going to have to bring it back to Lucy or to Ian if you can find him.
translation: 我不能收。你必须把它带回给露西，如果你能找到伊恩，交给他也行。

original: I can't take that. You're just going to have to bring it to the Wests yourself.
translation: 我不能收。你自己去交给维斯特一家吧。

original: The Family's been dealt with and you owe me big.
translation: 家族已经妥协了，你欠我一个大人情。

original: If I had two caps to rub together, I'd still give them to you. Afraid I'm as poor as a Brahmin herder though.
translation: 要是我能凑到几个瓶盖，我准会把它们都给你的。怕的是我和一个双头牛牧人一样穷。

original: But goddamn am I glad you walked up that ramp and lent us a hand.
translation: 但你能到桥上来助我们一臂之力我太他妈高兴了。

original: What about Ian? Did you find him?
translation: 伊恩怎么样了？你找到他没有？

original: If I had two caps to rub together, I'd still give them to you. Afraid I'm as poor as a Brahmin herder though.
translation: 要是我能凑到几个瓶盖，我准会把它们都给你的。怕的是我和一个双头牛牧人一样穷。

original: Ian told me everything you did for him. Goddamn am I glad you walked up that ramp and lent us a hand!
translation: 伊恩把你为他所做的一切都告诉我了。你能到桥上来助我们一臂之力我太他妈高兴了。

original: Thanks again, kid. Consider yourself welcome back here anytime you're in this part of the Wastes.
translation: 再次感谢，孩子。当你在这废土游历时，愿意的话，欢迎你随时回到这来。

original: Yeah, I took care of your problem.
translation: 是的，我解决了你的麻烦。

original: I don't know how you did it, but goddamn am I glad you walked up that ramp and lent us a hand.
translation: 我不知道你怎么做到的。但你能到桥上来助我们一臂之力我太他妈高兴了。

original: What about Ian? Did you find him?
translation: 伊恩怎么样了？你找到他没有？

original: I know, I talked to Ian and he told me everything you did.
translation: 我知道了，我已经和伊恩谈过，他把你所做的一切都告诉我了。

original: I don't know how you did it, but goddamn am I glad you walked up that ramp and lent us a hand.
translation: 我不知道你怎么做到的。但你能到桥上来助我们一臂之力我太他妈高兴了。

original: Thanks again, kid. Consider yourself welcome back here anytime you're in this part of the Wastes.
translation: 再次感谢，孩子。当你在这废土游历时，愿意的话，欢迎你随时回到这来。

original: It's done, Evan. The Family will never bother Arefu again.
translation: 解决了，埃万。家族不会再来骚扰断桥镇了。

original: I don't know how you did it, but goddamn am I glad you walked up that ramp and lent us a hand.
translation: 我不知道你怎么做到的。但你能到桥上来助我们一臂之力我太他妈高兴了。

original: What about Ian? Did you find him?
translation: 伊恩怎么样了？你找到他没有？

original: I know, I talked to Ian and he told me everything you did.
translation: 我知道了，我已经和伊恩谈过，他把你所做的一切都告诉我了。

original: I don't know how you did it, but goddamn am I glad you walked up that ramp and lent us a hand.
translation: 我不知道你怎么做到的。但你能到桥上来助我们一臂之力我太他妈高兴了。

original: Thanks again, kid. Consider yourself welcome back here anytime you're in this part of the Wastes.
translation: 再次感谢，孩子。当你在这废土游历时，愿意的话，欢迎你随时回到这来。

original: Well, I have this letter for the West Family.
translation: 唔，我有一封给维斯特家的信。

original: That's great, but I got bigger problems than being the town post office right now.
translation: 那很好，但是我眼下有比当镇上的邮局大得多的麻烦。

original: The shit's about to hit the fan in this cesspool, and I don't think I can stop them.
translation: 麻烦一大堆，而我却束手无策。

original: I don't have time for games, Vance.
translation: 万斯，我没时间跟你玩游戏。

original: That is where you are mistaken, my friend. Time is a commodity more abundant than any other in this world.
translation: 这你就错了，我的朋友。时间是这个世界上最丰富的资源。

original: In ceremony, each member of the Family must speak one of the Laws... it is theirs to remember and to enforce.
translation: 每当举行典礼的时候，我们当中的每个人都要说出法则中的一条。……那是他们必须记住和坚持执行的法则。

original: Perhaps from these Laws you can discover what we are. Return to me when you are ready.
translation: 可能从这些法则之中，你能发现我们是什么样的人。若你准备好就回来找我。

original: Yes well. I'm a visionary, that's true. But I'm also a creature of habit. I like my Iguana Bits sandwich just the way I always get it. Thank you.
translation: 是啊。我是个空想家，没错。但我同样是个有习惯的生物。我喜欢老样子的蜥蜴肉丁三明治。谢谢你。

original: Well... I'm glad to know you are getting along. I'll, umm... expect a visit at the usual time. Run along dear. And do be careful.
translation: 这个……很高兴你和大家都熟了。我更……希望你在通常的时间来。走开吧，亲爱的，小心。

original: Looks like someone woke up on the wrong side of the bed. I bet I could help you end up on the right side! Haha! Have good day, dear.
translation: 看来有人早上吃错药了。我敢保证能帮你作出正确的选择！哈哈哈！日安，亲爱的。

original: Fine. Keep wearing those rags. But when you're ready for fabulous, you come see me; I've got just the thing!
translation: 好啊。继续穿那些破布吧。但是当你打算变漂亮时，来找我吧，我有最合适的！

original: No. Can't say that I do.
translation: 不。我做不了。

original: Why, you old hag! You're just jealous. My fabulousity pains you, doesn't it? You can't help feel smaller standing before my greatness, can you dear?
translation: 怎么啦，你这老太婆！妒忌了吧。我的美貌刺痛了你，是不是？在我的伟岸面前，你不可避免地变得渺小，对吧？

original: You need to MAKE time, dear! You'll never be fabulous just moping around a kitchen all day. You need to relax, go out, get done up, have some fun!
translation: 你需要“找”些时间，亲爱的！你整天在厨房里闷闷不乐是漂亮不起来的。你需要放松，出门，打扮，找找乐子！

original: And I thought I hated MY life!
translation: 我觉得我恨我的生活！

original: Well, that's more than I had in mind. Maybe I'll just order a new labcoat instead.
translation: 比我想像得要贵。要不然我还是定一件新的实验室外套吧。

original: Alright. They're your men. I just don't want to have to sew anything back on because one of your guys got a little carried away.
translation: 好吧。他们是你的人。我也不想因为你的一个人有点激动就把所有的东西缝起来。

original: That's good to hear... only, you should stick to the suggested dosage, and avoid alcohol for at least two hours after taking it. Come see me soon.
translation: 好消息……只不过，你应该保持服用建议的剂量，而且服药后至少两小时内不要喝酒。有需要再来我这。

original: Fine. For now. I got my eye on you. If you seem to be getting exhausted, I'm prescribing that vacation!
translation: 目前还行。我会盯着你。如果你看起来变得很疲惫，我就会让你病假！

original: Ah! I remember now. Yes of course. I'll be sure to bring my medicine bag with me.
translation: 啊！我想起来了。是啊，当然。我一定会带上我的医药包。

original: No. I'm afraid you'll need to take care of that one on your own. But I might have something that'll help you cope. Come see me for a prescription.
translation: 不，恐怕你需要自己应付了。但我或许有些帮你应付的方法。到我这来，我会给你开处方。

original: Yes, well. You'll think of something I'm sure. Good luck.
translation: 是的，没错。我肯定会想出办法的。祝好运。

original: No, no. Of course not you silly woman. It's just that I... well... I think spending time with the other ladies in the Tower might do you some good.
translation: 不，不。当然不是了，你个蠢女人。只不过……这个……我想与大厦里的其他女孩共度夜晚或许会对你好些。

original: Um... Yes. Right. Of course. Okay then. See you around Ms. Lancaster.
translation: 嗯…是的。没错。当然。那好吧。回见，兰卡斯特女士。

original: I once killed a Yao Guai with my bare hands! Almost lost an arm. But I got the bastard in the end. Ah... Those were the days.
translation: 我曾经赤手空拳宰了一只妖怪！几乎丢了一只胳膊。不过最后我还是把那玩意给弄死了。啊……往事如烟……

original: Hehe. I'm sorry to hear that, Irving. Maybe I should take a look at your computer sometime. Heheh.
translation: 呵呵。很抱歉听到这消息，艾尔文。要不找时间我帮你看看你的电脑吧。呵呵。

original: That's the spirit, girl! Every seeming setback is actually just a chance for your genius to shine!
translation: 就该是这种态度，女孩！每次表面上的受挫都是让你的才华闪耀的机会！

original: Just trying to keep busy, I guess. I'm not sure I'm really cut out for the whole retirement thing. Just can't seem to sit still.
translation: 我想，只是要找些事情做吧。我还不知道自己是否适合这退休生活。好像就是坐不住啊。

original: We'll just have to see about that! You watch out! I can be a very stealthy hunter!
translation: 我们等着瞧！你小心！我可是个善于隐蔽自己的猎人！

original: Some men just don't have the hunting instinct, dear. You should try talking to him about your needs.
translation: 一些人就是没有当猎人的天分，亲爱的。你不如先找他聊聊你的需求。

original: Right, comrade! I see. The fabulous comes from the inside out. I will have to remember that. Thank you!
translation: 好的，同志！我明白。美丽是由内而外的。我一定要记住这个。谢谢你！

original: Oh. I'm sorry Comraaa - err, CHIEF Gustavo!
translation: 哦，实在抱歉，同 — 呃，古斯塔沃长官!

original: Every day it erases everything. Each day I have to start over again. But it's not the end of the world. I have everything memorized. Never mind.
translation: 每天它都会清空。每天我都要重来。但这并不是世界末日。我把一切都记住了，不要紧。

original: Yes, you are right, comrade. But I'm afraid I've done something to upset her, and now she isn't talking to me. Never mind. I'll figure something out.
translation: 对，你没错，同志。但恐怕我已经做了一些让她不高兴的事，现在她不肯和我说话了。不要紧，我会有办法的。

original: That's an excellent idea, comrade! I have to get her to stop and listen to me for a moment to even ask her if she'd like that. But thank you though.
translation: 那是个非常棒的主意，同志！我一定让她停下来听我说说，甚至会问问她是否喜欢。但还是多谢你了。

original: Oh, I see. Well, maybe you're right. Mrs. Cheng spends a lot of time drinking in the lounge, doesn't she.
translation: 哦，我明白了。或许你是对的。程太太老是泡在休息室里喝酒，对吧？

original: Oh... oh. Alright Susan. I'll see you later then?
translation: 哦……哦。好了，苏珊。那我们待会见？

original: I don't know why I'm so stupid. Never mind. I'll go work on my projects.
translation: 我不知道我为什么这么蠢。不要紧，我会继续我的计划。

original: Do you realize how often you use that word? You be careful, darling, or you'll wear it out like you've worn out your sense of style.
translation: 你意识到你自己对这个词的使用频率了吗？小心，亲爱的，否则你就对它没感觉了，就像你对时装没感觉一样。

original: Right. Until next time, then.
translation: 好。下次见。

original: Yes, of course, child! Your dishes are always superb!
translation: 是啊，当然了，孩子！你做的饭总是特别棒！

original: That shop is my pride and joy. I like to be surrounded by fine things - a little beauty in all this ugliness.
translation: 那个店是我的骄傲和乐趣。我喜欢被精致的东西包围着 — 在这个无所不在的丑陋中的一点美丽。

original: Have you tried distracting him, dear? You know, get his "attention" every now and then? Some men are just clueless when it comes to a woman's needs.
translation: 你试过分散他的注意力么，亲爱的？你知道，不时地吸引他的“注意力”？当涉及女人的需要的时候，有些男人简直笨透了。

original: Of course Mister Tenpenny.
translation: 是的，特佩尼先生。

original: Thank you, but I'm always so busy serving everyone. Maybe you can just pick something out for me and send it along with the hairnets.
translation: 谢谢你，但我一直忙于为每个人服务。不如你帮我拣出一些东西来，和发网一起送走吧。

original: Right, of course. Well, maybe I'll send a special desert over there today, to let them know we appreciate their keeping us safe and sound.
translation: 是的，当然了。或许我今天应该送点特别甜点，让他们知道，我们感激他们保护我们平安。

original: I found this old cook book for something called "sushi." Um... well, you might want to check up on a few residents I already served it to. Whoopsie.
translation: 我发现了关于“寿司”的旧烹饪书。嗯……不如你去找几个曾经尝过这的居民来问问。

original: Indeed! I'll drink to that! Cheers!
translation: 没错！我要畅饮一番！干杯！

original: Nah! Drown the buggars!
translation: 不！干倒那些混蛋！

original: Huh... sure. I'll drink to that Comrade!
translation: 呃……好哇。我要和那位同志喝一杯！

original: I always have my happy face on! I mean, just look at it! Are you looking? See how happy it is! The key, you see, is not to give a damn about anything
translation: 我总是带着开心的面容！我的意思是，一望即知！你在看吗？看我多开心！你看，关键是，他妈的什么都别在乎！

original: Oh, I see.
translation: 哦，我知道了。

original: That's the spirit!
translation: 就是这股劲！

original: I just thought it might be helpful for the security team to know where everyone is and what they are doing. You know, in case of emergency.
translation: 我只是想，如果警卫了解每个人都在哪里和在做什么，会有帮助的。你知道，以防不测。

original: Hehe. Of course, love. Until then. Be good boy now! Hahaha.
translation: 呵呵。当然了，爱人。到时候见吧。现在做个好小伙吧！哈哈哈。

original: Call me Susan. And if you like, we can be on even more "familiar" terms! Hahah!
translation: 叫我苏珊。如果你喜欢，我们可以有更“亲热”的称呼！哈哈哈！

original: A house call, perhaps? I'll be waiting! Hahah!
translation: 或者，上门服务？那我等着！哈哈哈！

original: Hehehehehe. Oh, Edgar.
translation: 呵呵呵呵呵。哦，埃德加。

original: Trust me. I know all about it... You're right, of course. Being bored out of your mind and surrounded by morons ain't all that bad. Even still...
translation: 相信我。我知道它的一切……你是对的，当然。无聊至极和被蠢货包围也不算太糟。甚至……

original: That wife of yours has you terrified, doesn't she? Don't worry. I can help you relax.
translation: 你那老婆吓着你了，对吧？别担心，我会帮你放松下来。

original: Haha. Perhap's you're right, dear. But you could always set out a few meals in advance and take a nap once in a while.
translation: 哈哈。或许你是对的，亲爱的。但你可以事先准备好几份饭，然后抽时间打个盹。

original: I'm not sure whether to be hurt or flattered by all that.
translation: 我不清楚是该生气还是高兴。

original: I suppose it is.
translation: 我想是的。

original: I was afraid you'd say that.
translation: 我就怕你这么说。

original: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。

original: I shouldn't have to talk to him. Why make it easy for him? He doesn't make it easy for me! If he can't see the problem, then he's just stupid.
translation: 我不该和他说话。为什么饶了他？他可没饶过我！如果他看不到问题所在，那他就是个大傻瓜。

original: That's because men are stupid.
translation: 那是因为男人都很蠢。

original: I guess maybe I should figure out what I want to do with MY life.
translation: 我想或许我该弄明白我要拿自己的生活怎么办。

original: I guess so.
translation: 我想是的。

original: Can you teach me the ways of the Vampire?
translation: 你能教我成为血族的方法吗？

original: To be a vampire is a life commitment. It is not achieved by my words, it is something you earn by your own will and sincere meditation.
translation: 变成血族是要献身的。它不是通过我的语言实现的，而是要通过你自己的意志和冥想去赢得。

original: Sadly, I cannot fully make you one of us, but I can teach you how the life blood of others brings us regenerative powers.
translation: 很遗憾，我无法让你完全变成我们中的一员，但我能教你别人的生命之血如何带给我们重生的力量。

original: Since your body lacks the way to extract blood as we do, you must find alternative sources for your nourishment.
translation: 鉴于你的躯体缺乏像我们那样抽取血液的能力，你必须另想办法获取营养。

original: Drink deep of the blood, allow not a drop to spill. Feel the warmth as it spreads inside you.
translation: 大口饮下血液，不要漏出一滴。感受它的温暖在你体内蔓延。

original: You are becoming one with the life force of another. They lend a part of themselves to you. For a brief moment, you are two entities becoming one.
translation: 你会变成拥有别人生命力的人。他们将自己的一部分借给了你。在短时间内，你是两个实体融合为一。

original: Allow the feelings to course through your body as you partake of the blood... feel it empower you and make you stronger.
translation: 当你享用血液时，让这感觉穿越你的身体……体验它给你带来的力量，并使你更强壮。

original: Once you have done this deed, only then will you know what it is like to be a vampire.
translation: 只有做到这一点，你才能了解血族是个什么样。

original: There is no more I can teach you.
translation: 我没法再教你更多东西了。

original: Use what little I have given you well, and carry that knowledge with honor.
translation: 好好地运用我的这点浅见，珍视这些学识。

original: I don't know... For some reason, I feel like I belong here.
translation: 我不知道……不知什么原因，我觉得我属于这。

original: Vance said others of our kind would find us! Sorry I was so harsh, but I don't share our leader's ability to feel others of our kind.
translation: 万斯说其他像我们一样的人会找到我们！我为自己的冷酷而抱歉，但我没有我们领袖那感知同类的能力。

original: If I were you, I'd speak to Vance before you poke around too much. You can usually find him on the mezzanine overlooking the common area.
translation: 要是我的话，在四处游荡前会先和万斯谈谈。你能在上面俯瞰这个区域的平台上找到他。

original: Reflect upon all I have said, my America. Reflect and wait. For soon this great nation will be reborn, and the Enclave will be its salvation.
translation: 考虑一下我所有的话吧，我的美利坚。思考并且等待。因为很快，这伟大的国家就将重生，而英克雷将是它的拯救者。

original: And now, dearest America, we must say farewell. For there is much work to be done, and the Enclave never rests. Never.
translation: 现在，最亲爱的美利坚，我们要道别了。因为有众多的工作需要完成，而英克雷永不止歇。永不。

original: But for now, my America, we must part. Restoring the greatest country in the world to its former glory, well. That takes time, even for the Enclave.
translation: 但眼下，我的美利坚，我们要分开了。要让这世界上最伟大的国家恢复过去的荣耀，就算是英克雷，也需要耗费些时间。

original: So remember, America. The Enclave is working around the clock to return this country to greatness. All you need is a little patience, a little faith.
translation: 因此牢记吧，美利坚。英克雷正在昼夜不停地为恢复这国家的宏伟而奔忙。你们所需要的，就是一点点耐心，一点点信心。

original: We've got to part now, you and I, but don't be sad, America. The Enclave is working tirelessly to rebuild this great nation, so you don't have to.
translation: 我们必须分开了，你和我。但是别难过，美利坚。英克雷正在不倦地重建这个伟大的国度，所以你无须哀怨。

original: Liberty, when it begins to take root, is a plant of rapid growth.
translation: 自由，当它扎根于沃土，便会蓬勃生长。

original: Discipline is the soul of an army. It makes small numbers formidable; procures success to the weak, and esteem to all.
translation: 纪律乃军队之灵魂。它使寡者不可小觑、弱者所向披靡，令天下人对你俯首称臣。

original: Associate with men of good quality if you esteem your own reputation; for it is better to be alone than in bad company.
translation: 亲贤士，以固声名；远竖子，宁为独行。
