original: Arbitrary power is most easily established on the ruins of liberty abused to licentiousness.
translation: 无节制地滥用自由是专制最好的温床。

original: Do I not destroy my enemies when I make them my friends?
translation: 我把敌人变成了朋友，还不算消灭敌人吗？

original: Avoid popularity if you would have peace.
translation: 人无盛名，自得安宁。

original: Everybody likes a compliment.
translation: 每个人都喜欢赞扬！

original: America will never be destroyed from the outside. If we falter and lose our freedoms, it will be because we destroyed ourselves.
translation: 美国绝不会从外部被摧毁。我们只有先摧毁自己，才会畏缩着失去自由。

original: Happiness lies in the joy of achievement and the thrill of creative effort.
translation: 欢乐潜藏在成功的愉悦与致力于创造的兴奋之中。

original: We can afford all that we need; but we can not afford all that we want.
translation: 我们能负担自身的需求；但我们不能负担自身的奢求。

original: This generation of Americans has a rendezvous with destiny.
translation: 这一代美国人，是天命的一代。

original: A good leader can't get too far ahead of his followers.
translation: 一个好的领导者不会离他的追随者太远。

original: The people under our system, like the king in a monarchy, never dies.
translation: 在我们体制中的人民，宛如帝国的皇帝，万寿无疆。

original: It is easier to do a job right than to explain why you didn't.
translation: 与其辩解为什么做不好，还不如把事情做好。

original: No evil can result from its inhibition more pernicious than its toleration.
translation: 对于奴隶制，没有比容忍它更加有害的罪恶了。

original: The government should not be guided by Temporary Excitement, but by Sober Second Thought.
translation: 政府不应受眼前利益蛊惑，而应深思熟虑。

original: May our country be always successful, but whether successful or otherwise, always right.
translation: 愿我们的国家一直成功，但无论是否成功，都永远正确。

original: Courage and perseverance have a magical talisman, before which difficulties disappear and obstacles vanish into air.
translation: 勇气与信念都有魔法护佑，在它们面前，艰难险阻都会烟消云散。

original: ...The manners of women are the surest criterion by which to determine whether a republican government is practicable in a nation or not.
translation: ……女子的举止是一个共和政府在一个国家中是否可行当之无愧的试金石。

original: Old minds are like old horses; you must exercise them if you wish to keep them in working order.
translation: 旧的头脑就像老马，你必须训练才能让它们保持工作状态。

original: The price of freedom is eternal vigilance.
translation: 自由的代价是永远警惕。

original: Commerce with all nations, alliance with none, should be our motto.
translation: 广开外贸，不结同盟，是我们的座右铭。

original: A coward is much more exposed to quarrels than a man of spirit.
translation: 懦夫比有气概的人更容易争吵。

original: Do not bite at the bait of pleasure, till you know there is no hook beneath it.
translation: 贪小便宜吃大亏。

original: I have never advocated war except as a means of peace.
translation: 除非为了和平，我从不鼓吹战争。

original: Nations, like individuals, are punished for their transgressions.
translation: 民族，和个人一样，终将因他们的罪行而受到惩罚。

original: Labor disgraces no man, but occasionally men disgrace labor.
translation: 劳动不嫌弃任何人，但人们有时却会嫌弃劳动。

original: There never was a time when, in my opinion, some way could not be found to prevent the drawing of the sword.
translation: 在我看来，从未有过时代能够阻止战争。

original: God bless the Enclave! God bless America!
translation: 主佑英克雷！主佑美利坚！

original: I am President John Henry Eden, and this is my pledge -- no one, NO ONE will take this great nation away from me!
translation: 我是约翰·亨利·伊登总统，这是我的承诺 — 没有人，没有人能将这伟大的国家从我手中夺去！

original: The Brotherhood of Steel will fail! All those who oppose the Enclave will fail!
translation: 钢铁兄弟会必亡！一切反对英克雷的人都必亡！

original: Let them come! Wave upon traitorous wave will crash against the Enclave's walls!
translation: 让他们来吧！叛变者的浪潮终将在英克雷的铜墙铁壁上撞得粉碎！

original: It is only a matter of time before the traitors march on the purifier, and attempt to take it by force.
translation: 反叛者早晚会向净水器进军，并试图用武力夺取它。

original: The Brotherhood of Steel, in their arrogance, has claimed Project Purity as their own! They would steal the Enclave's work, steal America's water!
translation: 钢铁兄弟会，狂傲地宣称净水工程是他们的！他们要偷走英克雷的工作，偷走美利坚的水源！

original: Even as I speak these words, fearless Enclave soldiers are fortifying their positions at the great water purifier, bracing for an inevitable assault.
translation: 就在我讲话的时候，无畏的英克雷战士正在伟大的净水工程那强化他们的防御，迎接不可避免的攻击。

original: In short, my dearest America - we are at war.
translation: 简而言之，我挚爱的美利坚 — 我们身处战争中。

original: Our great nation once more threatens to crumble, to topple into the sea of lawlessness and despair that have ruled us all for over 200 years.
translation: 我们伟大的国家在无法无天和绝望的深渊中煎熬了超过200年，今天，又再度面临崩溃的威胁。

original: Together, we'll restore the glory of this great nation. One problem at a time.
translation: 团结起来，我们要恢复这个宏伟国家的荣耀。逐个解决问题。

original: Very good, Colonel. Very good! So there you have it, my darling America. Enclave troops are now in your neighborhoods, in your lives, in your hearts.
translation: 非常好，上校，非常好！你看，我挚爱的美利坚。英克雷的兵士就在你的周围，在你的生活中，在你的心中。

original: Just stay out of the way and let us do our job. Interfere with the Enclave's mission, and you will be dealt with. Harshly.
translation: 快站到一边，让我们来做。干扰英克雷的计划，我们就会收拾你。军法无情！

original: When you see the Enclave, you see the United States government. We are authorized to restore order and civility, by any means necessary.
translation: 你看到了英克雷，就等于看到了美国政府。我们受命使用任何必要的手段，恢复秩序与规则。

original: People of the Capital Wasteland. I am Colonel Autumn. By now, you have encountered Enclave troops in your towns, in your settlements.
translation: 首都废土上的人们，我是奥托姆上校。从现在起，你们会在城镇和定居点见到英克雷的部队。

original: Thank you, Mr. President.
translation: 谢谢您，总统先生。

original: But let's hear from the man himself, shall we? America, I give you - Colonel Augustus Autumn!
translation: 不过，让我们听听这个人自己怎么说吧，如何？美利坚，这位是奥古斯特斯·奥托姆上校！

original: These fine men and women, under the command of the stalwart Colonel Augustus Autumn, have one mission: the restoration of American peace and order.
translation: 这些优秀的男女，在忠诚的奥古斯特斯·奥托姆上校的指挥下，只有一个任务：重建美利坚的和平与秩序。

original: The Enclave is back, America! And no, not just on your radio. Right now Enclave troops are patrolling the Capital Wasteland!
translation: 英克雷回来了，美利坚！而且，不只是在你的收音机里。现在，英克雷的队伍正在首都废土之上巡逻。

original: Music placeholder.
translation: 音乐占位符。

original: So celebrate! Sing out! America is back! America IS beautiful!
translation: 欢呼吧！歌唱吧！美利坚重归了！美利坚如此美好！

original: Just a little bit more time. That's all we need until the purifier is ready for continual operation. And then, your thirst will truly be quenched!
translation: 再多一点时间。我们便可令净水工程持续运转。届时，你们将不再干渴！

original: Imagine, America - millions, MILLIONS of gallons of water, made fresh, clean, and completely pure. In a matter of minutes! And it's all for you!
translation: 想想吧，美利坚 — 上百万，上百万加仑的水，新鲜、清澈、纯净。过不了多久了！而且都是你们的！

original: For years, Enclave scientists have been hard at work on the most ambitious scientific endeavor the world has ever seen! Project Purity!
translation: 经年累月，英克雷的科学家们不辍地工作，努力攻克整个世界最具挑战的科学高峰！净水工程!

original: Well I'm going to tell you, right here, right now, those days are at an end! The Enclave is back, America, and we've brought clean water with us!
translation: 让我现在来告诉你们，那种日子到头了！英克雷回来了，美利坚，我们还带来了纯净的水！

original: But that's not really living, is it? You're simply existing, America. Postponing death for a day or two.
translation: 但那不是真正的生活，对吧？你不过仍在苟延残喘而已，美利坚。只是将死亡延迟几日罢了。

original: Maybe you've got a makeshift purifier that cleans one glass of dirty water a day. Or you sip from an ancient faucet in an abandoned subway restroom.
translation: 或许你有一个临时的净水装置，每天可以过滤一杯脏水。或许，你是在一个废弃的地铁休息室里，在一个陈旧的水龙头上嘬两口。

original: Water is the foundation of life. But here in the Capital Wasteland, indeed in the entire country, water is polluted. Irradiated. Deadly.
translation: 水是生命之源。但是，在首都废土，实际上，在整片国土上，水被污染了。具有放射性，致命。

original: You're thirsty, aren't you America? Not for knowledge or power, no. I'm not speaking metaphorically. You're thirsty for clean, fresh water. Hmm?
translation: 你很渴，不是吗，美利坚？不是渴求知识或力量，不。我并未做什么比喻。你渴求净水，对吗？

original: One Enclave. One America. Now... and forever.
translation: 一个英克雷。一个美利坚。从今天……直至永恒。

original: But only together, TOGETHER, can we hope to reach our full potential. The way we were before the war. Whole. Beautiful. Powerful.
translation: 但是只有同心协力，团结起来，我们才有可能发挥我们所有的潜能。回归战前的我们。完整、美好、强大。

original: So, as your President, I am the voice, I am the heart and soul, of the Enclave. That is to say, I am the voice, heart, and soul... of America.
translation: 因此，作为你们的总统，我是英克雷的喉舌、心脏与灵魂。亦即是说，我是美利坚的喉舌、心脏与灵魂。

original: And, well, yes... the Enclave is me, as well.  Ha ha ha. As your President, it's my responsibility to preside over our great democracy.
translation: 而且，是啊……英克雷也就是我。哈哈哈。作为你们的总统，我有责任统帅我们伟大的民主。

original: Just who is the Enclave? Why, that's simple. The Enclave is you, America. The Enclave is your sister, your aunt, your friend, your neighbor.
translation: 到底谁是英克雷？很简单。英克雷即是你，美利坚。英克雷是你的姊妹，你的姑妈，你的朋友，你的邻居。

original: Let's talk about government, shall we? Or, more specifically, YOUR government, dear America - the Enclave.
translation: 我们来谈谈政府吧。哦，准确地讲，是你的政府，亲爱的美利坚 — 也就是英克雷。

original: The values of our past... shall be the foundation of our future.
translation: 我们的过往的价值……应该是我们未来的根基。

original: We will rebuild the American family, as it was, as it was meant to be!
translation: 我们将重建美国大家园，和从前一样，和注定的一样！

original: We will match up the destitute, orphaned children of the Capital Wasteland with qualified, eligible adults.
translation: 我们将把首都废土上的贫民、孤儿分配给合格、适龄的成年人。

original: The Enclave will restore every American school, reinstate every youth program, and offer counseling and financial assistance to any family in need.
translation: 英克雷将重建每一座美国的学校，恢复对青少年的教育，还要对每一户有需求的家庭提供精神与资金的帮助。

original: That changes! Right here! Right now! From this moment onward, the children of this great nation are its highest priority!
translation: 要改变！就从现在！就从这里！从此以后，这个伟大国家的儿童拥有最优先的权利！

original: We both know the answer, don't we? None. America's children live a terrifying, meaningless existence. There is no hope. No happiness.
translation: 我们都知道答案，对吧？没有。美利坚的孩子们生活在恐怖、毫无意义的氛围中。没有希望，更没有欢乐。

original: So let me ask you, America. How many of your children can say the same?  How many of this nation's youth are truly happy, truly carefree?
translation: 那让我问问你，美利坚。你们有多少孩子可以这么说？这个国家有多少青少年真正开心，真正无忧无虑？

original: It was, for a little boy, the perfect existence.
translation: 对于一个小孩来说，那是完美的生活方式。

original: Oh, the adventures we had! From Knob Creek to Hodgenville we roamed, carefree and courageous, irresponsible and completely inseparable.
translation: 哦，我们曾经的奇遇！从留名溪到霍金维尔镇，我们信步畅游，无忧无虑，无所畏惧，轻松畅快，团结一心。

original: When I was a child, growing up in rural Kentucky, I had the best friend a boy could hope for -- my dear old dog, Honey.
translation: 当我还是个在肯塔基农村里成长的小孩时，我拥有一个男孩子所希望得到的最好的朋友--我忠实的老狗‘宝贝’。

original: The Enclave will restore peace, order, and prosperity to this great nation. And those who oppose us will be… removed. Forever.
translation: 英克雷将为这伟大的国度重建和平、秩序与繁荣。而反对我们的那些人将被清除，永远的。

original: Lawlessness, terror, murder. They're all around us, I know. I know. But not for long, sweet America. Not for long. Oh no.
translation: 无法无天，恐怖行径，烧杀掠夺。它们无处不在，我知道。但这不会长久了，可爱的美利坚。不会长久了。不会了。

original: And last but not least, the hideously mutated Super Mutants that have completely overrun the entire downtown D.C. area.
translation: 最后压轴的，可怕的超级变种人已经完全侵占了特区市区。

original: What about the Slavers of Paradise falls? The frighteningly irradiated ghouls of Underworld?
translation: 堕落天堂的奴隶贩子怎样？地下城那些可怕的辐射僵尸呢？

original: And don't be fooled, America. Those who have left the Brotherhood of Steel, branded Outcasts, are just as dangerous. Even more so, being in exile.
translation: 别受骗，美利坚。那些离开钢铁兄弟会，号称‘放逐者’的家伙同样危险。而且，亡命之徒只怕更上一层。

original: Criminals who have had the audacity to claim this country's most important military installation, the Pentagon, as their own personal clubhouse!
translation: 那些胆大妄为的罪犯，竟然把这个国家最重要的军事设施，五角大楼，变成了他们的私人俱乐部！

original: These power-armored boy scouts are nothing more than common criminals with access to some antiquated technology.
translation: 那些穿着动力装甲的童子军只是些拥有古董科技的普通罪犯。

original: The so-called "Brotherhood of Steel." Don't be fooled by their pseudo-knightly nonsense or supposed connections to the United States Army.
translation: 所谓“钢铁兄弟会”。别被他们冒牌骑士的谎言、或者与美国军队有关的假象给骗了。

original: There are, of course, the Raiders. Those anarchistic ruffians who roam the wastes, preying on any an all, stealing, murdering. Beasts.
translation: 当然啦，还有歹徒。那些无视政府的暴徒在废土上游荡，肆意掠夺，偷摸盗窃，杀戮成性。禽兽不如！

original: Let's take a tally of these agitators, shall we?
translation: 让我们来为这些家伙算笔总账，如何？

original: These radical malcontents don't care about you. They don't care about America. All they care about is fulfilling their own selfish desires.
translation: 那些激进的反对者才不关心你们。他们不关心美利坚。他们只想满足自己的私欲。

original: Did you know, there are those amongst us who would shatter our hopes for peace, order, and security?
translation: 你们知道我们中有人希望毁掉对于和平、秩序和安全的希望吗？

original: Democracy, dear America. Democracy, now... and forever.
translation: 民主，亲爱的美利坚。民主，现在……直至永远。

original: And that person will have our full faith and confidence, and carry our collective values forward, into the future.
translation: 而那个人将拥有我们全部的信仰与信心，并承载我们的共同价值，努力前行，开拓未来。

original: Of course, when the time comes, when my term is up, America will be free to elect a new President.
translation: 当然，等时机成熟，等我任期届满，美利坚将能够自由地选出一位新总统。

original: But rest assured, I am your President because the appropriate people of this great nation decided I should be! I AM your duly elected representative.
translation: 但毋庸置疑的是，我是你们的总统，因为这伟大国度的核心人物认为我应当如此！我正是你们合法选择的代表。

original: Unfortunately, in the interest of national security, I'm not at liberty to discuss the details of the election. You understand.
translation: 遗憾的是，出于国家安全考虑，我无法谈及有关选举的详细资料。你们明白的。

original: To that I must answer of course! Of course I was elected, sweet America! Isn't the right to vote the very foundation of a democracy?
translation: 对那而言，我必须回答“当然”！我当然是获选的，可爱的美利坚！投票权难道不是民主的基石吗？

original: Or, whether or not I had been elected at all!
translation: 或者说，我是否是获选的！

original: The question has been raised, I know, as to just how I came to be elected to this most illustrious office.
translation: 有人提出这个问题，我知道，正如我如何被选入这间最为著名的办公室。

original: It's time we discussed something rather important. The issue at hand is, well, my presidency.
translation: 是时候让我们讨论一些重要的问题了。当下的焦点是，唔，我的总统宝座。

original: A place to truly call... home.
translation: 一个真正叫做……家的地方。

original: Of course you do. As President of the United States, you have my solemn pledge that I will never rest, NEVER rest, until we all have what we deserve.
translation: 你们当然可以。作为合众国的总统，我向你们庄重承诺，我将永不停歇，永不停歇，直至我们都获得我们应得的东西。

original: Don't you, my darling America, deserve that? Don't you deserve a future free of war, and fear, and terrible uncertainty?
translation: 我亲爱的美利坚，难道你不该享有吗？难道你们不期待一个没有战争、恐惧和飞来横祸的未来吗？

original: Rest assured, I will not make the mistakes of my predecessors. When John Henry Eden builds a country, he builds it to last. The American way.
translation: 敬请放心，我不会重蹈我前任的覆辙。当约翰·亨利·伊登建立一个国家，他将从始至终，奉行美利坚的道路。

original: Our intrepid leaders had everything they wanted. Power. Wealth. Prestige. And it made them lazy, America. Oh yes. And laziness breeds stupidity.
translation: 我们无畏的领导者拥有他们想要的一切。力量、财富、威望。这使得他们懒惰了，美利坚。哦，是的，懒惰孳生愚蠢。

original: The answer is really quite simple. Incompetence. Incompetence at the highest echelons of power. We put our trust, our faith, in halfwits.
translation: 答案无比简单。无能。权力最高层的无能。我们把信任与信仰寄托在一群半吊子身上。

original: The Capital Wasteland... How did it come to this, America? How did your leaders allow the most powerful nation on Earth… to die?
translation: 首都废土……怎么变成这样的，美利坚？你们的领袖怎能允许地球上最为强大的国家走向灭亡？

original: Indeed, the very seat of the federal government, Washington D.C., has been reduced to what is now known as the "Capital Wasteland."
translation: 其实，联邦政府的核心，华盛顿特区，如今已经作为首都废土被广为人知。

original: We live in an age of poverty, greed, violence... destruction.
translation: 我们生活在一个贫困、贪婪、血腥……毁灭的时代。

original: Comfort, recreation, healthy competition - all will live again! This country WILL live again!
translation: 舒适、愉快、健康的竞争 — 都将获得重生！这国家定将重生！

original: Put your faith in John Henry Eden, great America, and baseball will live again!
translation: 相信约翰·亨利·伊登吧，伟大的美利坚，棒球也将重获新生！

original: What if they could compete with baseball teams, from Pennsylvania, or Maryland?
translation: 如果从宾夕法尼亚到马里兰都有棒球比赛，那会怎么样？

original: Now ask yourself this. What if the Capital Congressmen could live again?
translation: 现在扪心自问吧。假如首都议员球队能够重生，又会如何？

original: If only for an afternoon.
translation: 就算只有一个下午。

original: Their name? The Capital Congressmen. Their purpose? To make you, dear America, revel in the joy of sport and sunshine.
translation: 他们的名字？首都议员球队。他们的目的？让你们，亲爱的美利坚，沉醉于阳光与运动的愉悦之中。

original: And on the horizon, they appear, like knights of yore, armed with bats of ash and hickory.
translation: 他们出现了，从地平线上走来，如同往昔的骑士，握着灰桃木球棒。

original: Imagine, a perfect, cloudless day. The sun is warm, welcoming.
translation: 想像一下，晴空万里，阳光温暖。

original: That's right, America. Before we were devastated by atomic war, each state had its OWN professional baseball team.
translation: 对啊，美利坚。在我们被核弹摧毁之前，每个州都拥有自己的职业棒球队。

original: I am referring, of course, to our great national pastime - baseball. Or so it had been.
translation: 当然，我是指我们伟大的国家的往事 — 棒球。当时就是这样。

original: I've been thinking quite a bit lately about something we can all relate to, something that is unquestionably, inescapably… American.
translation: 我最近一直在想有什么和我们都有关的，什么是毫无疑问美国化的。

original: This is President Eden, and you're listening to Enclave Radio -- the Voice of America.
translation: 我是伊登总统，你们正在收听的是英克雷电台--美利坚之音。

original: I'm President John Henry Eden and you're listening to Enclave Radio -- the voice of warmth and reason in this cold, unreasonable world.
translation: 我是约翰·亨利·伊登总统，你们正在收听的是英克雷电台--在这冰冷、不智的世界中的温暖与理智的声音。

original: You're listening to Enclave Radio. I'm John Henry Eden, President of the Enclave, President of America, President... of your heart.
translation: 你们正在收听的是英克雷电台，我是约翰·亨利·伊登，英克雷总统，美利坚的总统，你心中的……总统。

original: This is Enclave Radio, with your host -- me! President John Henry Eden.
translation: 这是英克雷电台，我是主持人 — 约翰·亨利·伊登总统！

original: Hello, my beautiful America. This is President Eden, and it's time we had a talk.
translation: 你好啊，我美丽的美利坚。我是伊登总统，又到我们的对话时间了。

original: Hello again, America the magnificent. This is President Eden, and I was hoping we could talk.
translation: 再次向华贵的美利坚问好。我是伊登总统，我期待着我们能聊聊。

original: Sweet America. Hello again. This is President Eden, and I'd like to have a chat.
translation: 可爱的美利坚，你们好。我是伊登总统，很高兴能与你们谈谈。

original: Greetings, dearest America. This is your President, John Henry Eden. Let's chat, shall we?
translation: 好啊，我挚爱的美利坚。我是你们的总统，约翰·亨利·伊登。我们来聊聊，如何？

original: Greetings again, sweet America. This is President John Henry Eden, and I'd like to chat, if you've got a moment.
translation: 再次向你们问好，可爱的美利坚。我是约翰·亨利·伊登总统，如果你们有空的话，我想跟你们聊聊天。

original: Hello again, America. This is John Henry Eden, your President. There are some things we should talk about, if that's all right.
translation: 你们好啊，美利坚。我是约翰·亨利·伊登，你们的总统。如果没关系的话，有些事情我们需要谈一谈。

original: And now, one of my inspirational quotes. From the mouth of your President, John Henry Eden, straight to your heart.
translation: 那么现在，我要引用我的一个灵感。从你们总统，约翰·亨利·伊登的口中，直指你们的心灵。

original: You... over there. Please, come speak to me. I'm in the room to your left. Use the intercom next to the window.
translation: 你……那边的。请过来跟我谈谈。我在你左边的房子里。用挨着窗户的对讲机跟我说话。

original: Tell me how I can get you out of that room.
translation: 告诉我怎样能把你从那间房子里弄出来。

original: At the end of the hallway to your right is a maintenance room.
translation: 在走廊的尽头向右就是主控室。

original: Inside, you'll find the fire control console for the medical area. Trip the alarm on it, and I'll be able to get out.
translation: 在里面，你能找到医疗区的消防控制台，打开警报，我就能出去了。

original: A word of warning though. Tripping the console activates a failsafe and will open ALL of the recovery rooms in the medical area.
translation: 那是一个警告标示。打开警报会开启安全系统，并打开医疗区所有的门。

original: Remind me how to get you out of that room.
translation: 提示我下怎样才能让你离开那房间。

original: At the end of the hallway to your right is a maintenance room.
translation: 在走廊的尽头向右就是主控室。

original: Inside, you'll find the fire control console for the medical area. Trip the alarm on it, and I'll be able to get out.
translation: 在里面，你能找到医疗区的消防控制台，打开警报，我就能出去了。

original: A word of warning though. Tripping the console activates a failsafe and will open ALL of the recovery rooms in the medical area.
translation: 那是一个警告标示。打开警报会开启安全系统，并打开医疗区所有的门。

original: How do you know the layout of this place?
translation: 你是怎么知道这地方布局的呢？

original: These hallways are familiar to me... I think I used to be a resident here in better times.
translation: 我太熟悉这些走廊了……我觉得，在那些好日子里我曾经是这里的一个居民。

original: I wish I could remember more, but I'm afraid it's all a blur.
translation: 我希望能记起更多，但恐怕是太模糊了。

original: As for the G.E.C.K., it's always rested where it does now. The foolish Super Mutants don't even know what they have.
translation: 至于伊甸园创造器，它一直待在原来的地方。那些愚蠢的超级变种人甚至从来不知道他们拥有什么。

original: Let's continue on now.
translation: 我们继续吧。

original: Very well.
translation: 那好吧。

original: Do you remember who you were?
translation: 你还记得你是谁吗？

original: I don't remember enough to tell you everything about my former self. My metamorphosis destroyed a good deal of my long term memory.
translation: 关于变异前的自己，我记得的不够多。变异摧毁了我大部分的长期记忆。

original: However, I can recall being in this place when it wasn't the macabre laboratory that it's become.
translation: 不过，我还能记起在这地方变成恐怖夺命的实验室前，我来过这里。

original: I remember walking around this place and seeing other humans in white lab coats and blue jumpsuits.
translation: 我记得曾经在这儿走过，看到其他人穿着白色的实验室外套和蓝色工作服。

original: I wish I could find out more, but the personnel information for the Vault wasn't in the mainframe for some reason.
translation: 我也想找到更多，但不知为什么这避难所的人事档案并未存储在电脑主机里。

original: I feel like my identity is so close to me... I can almost see myself as a human but can't recollect the details. It's maddening.
translation: 我感觉我就快知道自己的身份了……我几乎能看到自己作为人类时的样子，却怎么都想不起细节。我快要疯掉了。

original: How did you become so articulate?
translation: 为什么你这么聪明？

original: The terminal in my cell used to connect with Vault 87's mainframe. That gave me access to the history, literature, science and fiction book files.
translation: 我房间的终端连接着87号避难所的电脑主机。它使我能阅览历史、文学、科学和科幻小说的档案。

original: I used this extensive database of works to better myself and my understanding of everything around me.
translation: 我利用这些海量的数据库改善自己，使我更了解周围的一切。

original: It was only recently the others caught me using the terminal and destroyed it to torment me.
translation: 直到最近才有人发现我在使用终端，于是毁坏了它来折磨我。

original: So, you've been stuck in that cell ever since?
translation: 此后你一直被关在这？

original: Yes. I've never been anywhere else. I used to mark the passage of time, but after a few years, it didn't seem to matter anymore.
translation: 是的，我哪也没去过。我试着刻下消逝的时间，但几年之后，这也无所谓了。

original: The only thing that prevented me from going insane was the working access point to the Vault Mainframe in my makeshift cell.
translation: 唯一能够阻止我疯掉的东西，就是临时禁闭室里与主机相连接的工作终端。

original: So, tell me more about yourself.
translation: 告诉我更多有关你的事情吧。

original: I was born here, in this place. I don't mean that in the literal sense of course.
translation: 我就出生在这地方。当然，我不是说这房间。

original: All I can remember is the excruciating pain that tore through me as my body underwent the rapid physical changes.
translation: 所有我能记得的，就是当我的身体发生剧烈的物理变化时，那刺穿全身所有的剧烈疼痛。

original: For most, this moment is what severs the grip on their minds. They become barely a shell of their former selves.
translation: 对于大多数人，那一时刻彻底抹杀了他们的意识人性。他们完全成为了这痛苦折磨的行尸走肉。

original: I was different. When I spoke to them, they immediately branded me "another failure" and had me placed here as a curiosity.
translation: 我不太一样。我刚开口，他们立刻认定我是“又一个失败”，把我当作一个特例丢在这。

original: What else can I tell you about myself?
translation: 还有什么关于我的事能告诉你的？

original: You obviously know all about the G.E.C.K., so let's help each other out.
translation: 你显然很了解伊甸园创造器，那么让我们互相帮个忙吧。

original: Indeed. Your powers of deduction are quite impressive. I do indeed know where it is and how to get it.
translation: 确实，你的逻辑十分清晰。我确实知道它在哪，还有怎么得到它。

original: The device is surrounded by a lethal field of radiation; lethal to humans that is.
translation: 那装置被致命的辐射包围着，就是说，对人类很致命。

original: Without insulting your intelligence, I think you can see where this is going.
translation: 我没有取笑你的意思，但我认为你知道那样的下场。

original: I am indeed, but I have no time to discuss these matters.
translation: 的确，但我实在没时间讨论这些。

original: Yes, you do appear a bit harried and you obviously didn't come into the depths of this place to chat with me.
translation: 嗯，你看上去很忙，而且显然也不是特意跑来这鬼地方跟我闲聊的。

original: I'd imagine the only reason you'd risk life and limb would be to retrieve the G.E.C.K. from its resting place.
translation: 我觉得可以令你豁出性命的唯一原因就是要找到并取回伊甸园创造器。

original: How ironic that the others consider you a mutant of their kind.
translation: 其他人把你看做一个变种人，多讽刺啊。

original: Yes, indeed it is ironic.
translation: 嗯，这确实很讽刺。

original: Forgive my astonishment, but I hadn't expected to meet someone with such a learned outlook of these things. It is a pleasant change.
translation: 请原谅我的惊讶，不过我从没指望会碰到一个你这样有学识和见地的人。这是个令人愉快的意外。

original: I suppose I shouldn't be surprised, it was only a matter of time before someone like you showed up for the G.E.C.K.
translation: 我觉得我不应该太过惊奇，迟早会有你这样的人来找甸园创造器的。

original: He doesn't live here. He came here to see Doctor Li.
translation: 他不在这里住。他是来看李博士的。

original: Doctor Li, eh?
translation: 李博士，呃？

original: Well then I guess you'd have to ask Doctor Li for more information.
translation: 我觉得如果你想知道得更多，最好去问李博士。

original: Go on up, then. She's probably in the Science Lab. But keep your nose clean, you hear me?
translation: 继续，她可能待在科技实验室。不过别探头探脑的，知道吗？

original: Forget it. I'm out of here.
translation: 算了。我这就走。

original: Thanks for visiting Rivet City. Don't feel compelled to stop by again anytime soon.
translation: 多谢光临铆钉城。欢迎随时光临。

original: I don't answer to you, pal.
translation: 我不会听你的，伙计。

original: On this boat, you sure as hell do. You don't get on without my say-so.
translation: 在这条船上，你这该死的最好听着，没有我的许可，哪也别想去。

original: So I'll ask you again: what are you doing here?
translation: 那我再问你一遍：你到底来这干嘛？

original: Oh, I'm just wandering around.
translation: 哦，我只是四处逛逛。

original: Is that so?
translation: 是这样吗？

original: All right, you're free to roam around, so long as you don't do anything stupid like try to slit my throat when I'm sleeping.
translation: 好吧，你可以随意，只要别做蠢事就行，比如打算趁我睡觉时把我喉咙切开什么的。

original: You wouldn't try anything stupid like that, now would you?
translation: 你不会做那种蠢事的，对吧？

original: I'm looking for a Doctor Li.
translation: 我要找一位李博士。

original: Yeah? Let me guess -- no, she's not expecting you, but it's really important and you need to see her right away.
translation: 是啊？让我想想 －不，她不会想见到你，不过事情很重要，所以你得立刻见她。

original: Been a lot of that going around lately, and I've had just about enough of it. So you're going to have to do better than that.
translation: 最近这种情况太多了，我也听腻了，所以你得找到更好的理由。

original: I'm looking for my father.
translation: 我在找我父亲。

original: And who might your father be? If he lives on this boat, I know him.
translation: 谁又会是你父亲？如果他住在这条船上的话，我肯定认得他。

original: Why does it matter who he is? Just let me pass.
translation: 他是谁又有什么要紧？快让我过去。

original: It matters because I don't let just anybody wander around on this boat. I'm responsible for these people.
translation: 问题在于我不会让任何人到这条船上游荡，我要为这的人负责。

original: So either you tell me what I want to know, or you don't get on. It's pretty damned simple.
translation: 所以，你要么告诉我实情，要么就别进门，就他妈的这么简单。

original: I'm sure you don't know him. He's lived in a Vault his whole life.
translation: 我肯定你不认识他，他毕生都生活在避难所。

original: Oh yeah? And I'm a fairy princess.
translation: 哦，是吗？我还是个仙女呢。

original: You keep up this smart-ass attitude, and you're gonna wind up floating face-down in the river.
translation: 你要再玩花样，那就等着在河里漂吧。

original: Hey, it's no big deal. I just need to see her for a minute, and I'll be gone.
translation: 嗨，没什么大不了的。我只想见她一面，然后就走。

original: Fine. Just don't bother her. She's real busy, what with all her work.
translation: 好吧。不过不许打扰她。她真的非常忙，一直在工作。

original: She's up in the Science Lab.
translation: 她在上面的科技实验室里。

original: It's personal, okay? I swear I won't cause any trouble.
translation: 是私事，行吗？我发誓不惹麻烦。

original: Yeah, yeah. Fine. But I've got my eye on you. You hear me?
translation: 嗯，嗯。好吧。不过我会盯着你的，听见没？

original: You step out of line while you're on my boat, and you and me are going to have words.
translation: 如果你敢在船上破坏规矩，那你我之间就有得谈了。

original: Now get out of here. The Doctor's up in her lab.
translation: 现在滚出去，李博士在她的实验室里。

original: I have some questions about her recent work in hydroponics.
translation: 关于她正在研究的水培法，我有些问题。

original: Err, what? I don't know much about her work.
translation: 呃，什么？我对她的工作了解得不多。

original: You'll have to ask her about that, I guess. She's probably in the Science Lab.
translation: 我想你最好自己去问她，她可能待在科技实验室里。

original: Just keep out of trouble on my boat.
translation: 别在我的船上惹麻烦。

original: My father came to see her. I'm trying to find him.
translation: 我父亲来见过她，我正在找他。

original: Hmm. Older guy, in his fifties or so?
translation: 唔，老家伙，大概五十来岁？

original: I remember him. He left already, but Doctor Li might know more.
translation: 我记得他。他已经走了，不过李博士或许知道得更多。

original: All right, you can go on up. She'll be in the Science Lab. Just don't cause any trouble, or else you're going to answer to me.
translation: 好吧，你可以进去。她应该在科技实验室里。别惹什么麻烦，否则你就得跟我谈谈了。

original: His notes said something about Vault 112. Do you know where it is?
translation: 他的记录提到了112号避难所。你知道它在哪吗？

original: No, I don't. I'm sorry.
translation: 不，我不知道。很抱歉。

original: Is this something to do with Dr. Braun? He kept talking about it while he was here. I told him it was a lost cause.
translation: 这和布劳恩博士有关吗？他在这时一直在说这事。我告诉过他此路不通。

original: The whole project is a lost cause. I wish he could see that. It's been too long. It's too late to go back.
translation: 整个工程都行不通，我希望他能意识到这点。时间拖得太久了，无法回头了。

original: His notes referenced someone named Dr. Braun. What can you tell me about him?
translation: 他的记录里说到了名叫布劳恩博士的人，你能跟我说说他吗？

original: I can't tell you anything more than I told James. I know who Braun was, yes, but he lived before the war.
translation: 我能告诉你的事并不比能告诉詹姆斯的多。我知道布劳恩博士是谁，是的，但他是战前的人物了。

original: The odds of any of his research surviving after all this time... Well, it just doesn't make sense to go looking for it.
translation: 他的研究成果幸存到今天的可能性……去寻找这些资料毫无意义。

original: James kept talking about this Vault, 112 he said, and insisting we should go there. It's just madness.
translation: 詹姆斯一直在说112号避难所，而且坚决认为我们应该去，真是疯了。

original: He's not at the lab. He left to go find something called a G.E.C.K.
translation: 他没在实验室里，他去找一个叫伊甸园创造器的东西去了。

original: He's out of his mind. I told him, over and over, that there was no use trying to revive the project now. It's just too late.
translation: 他已经丧失理智了。我再三告诫过他，恢复工程的努力是白费的，一切都太晚了。

original: I'm sorry, but I haven't seen him since our recent... disagreement.
translation: 我很抱歉，但在不久前我们产生了……分歧之后就再也没见过他了。

original: If he's intent on tracking down Dr. Braun, he's probably gone off to that Vault.
translation: 如果他真的下决心要找到布劳恩博士，就很可能去了那个避难所。

original: I know my father came to see you. I need to know where he is right now.
translation: 我知道父亲来见过你，但更需要知道他现在在哪。

original: I... I don't know. He said he was going back to the lab.
translation: 我……我不知道。他说他要回实验室去。

original: Haven't you seen him?
translation: 你没见过他吗？

original: I'm looking for my father. I know he was here.
translation: 我正在寻找父亲，并且知道他曾来过这。

original: Well, yes... He was, but he left. He made some rather ridiculous requests of me, and I told him I couldn't help him.
translation: 嗯，是的……他来过，但又走了。他对我提出过一些荒唐的要求，而我告诉他我帮不了他。

original: He said he'd work alone if he had to, and went back to the lab. You haven't seen him?
translation: 他说如果有必要，他会独自工作的，然后就回实验室了。你没见过他吗？

original: I've heard my father's notes. Did he come back here?
translation: 我已经听过了父亲的留言，他没回过这吗？

original: No... wasn't he at the lab?
translation: 没有……他没在实验室？

original: This is all just too much to bear right now.
translation: 现在的压力越来越让人难以承受了。

original: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你！

original: Excellent!
translation: 好棒！

original: Wonderful. Thank you, dear.
translation: 真不错。谢谢你，亲爱的。

original: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

original: I swear Edgar. It's in one ear and out the other with you! Grrr.
translation: 我诅咒埃德加。你简直是一耳进，一耳出。哇呀呀。

original: Useless man!
translation: 没用的东西！

original: Edgar! Pay attention when I'm talking to you!
translation: 埃德加！我和你说话时别走神！

original: Sometimes I get the feeling I'm talking to myself.
translation: 有时候我觉得就像在自言自语。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Yes dear.
translation: 是的，亲爱的。

original: Uh huh.
translation: 呃嗯。

original: Sorry dear... must have dozed off there for a moment.
translation: 对不起，亲爱的……我想是打了个瞌睡。

original: Are you even listening to me?!
translation: 你有没有在听我说话？！

original: Earth to Edgar! Mr. Wellington, are you there?
translation: 醒醒吧，埃德加! 威灵顿先生，你在吗？

original: You're just humoring me, aren't you? You haven't heard a word I've said, have you?
translation: 你在和我开玩笑，是不是？我刚才说的你一个字都没听进去，是不？

original: Sometimes I get the feeling you're off in your own little world.
translation: 有时候我觉得你自闭于自己的小世界当中。

original: Edgar! I'm talking to you.
translation: 埃德加！我在和你说话。

original: Are you even listening?
translation: 你有在听吗？

original: Yes, dear.
translation: 是的，亲爱的。

original: Oh, I don't know about all that.
translation: 哦，我对那一无所知。

original: Is that so?
translation: 是这样吗？

original: I hadn't noticed.
translation: 我没注意。

original: Mm-hmm.
translation: 嗯哼。

original: Right-o.
translation: 对。

original: What's the latest gossip?
translation: 最近有什么传闻？

original: Have you seen the way Mrs. Cheng avoids her husband all the time? Poor Mr. Cheng drew the short straw when he married her, didn't he?
translation: 你有没有看到程太太一直在回避她的丈夫？可怜的程先生，和她结婚算是抽中了下下签，对吧？

original: That Susan Lancaster is a real snob. And the way she flirts with all the men! The woman's got no sense of shame! No sense at all, if you ask me.
translation: 苏珊·兰卡斯特实在是太淫荡了。她跟每个男人都有一腿！这女人实在恬不知耻！要我看，就是毫无羞耻感。

original: I think Mr. Ling is asking for trouble by teasing all the male guards the way he does. What he needs to do is find a nice woman and settle down.
translation: 我想林先生用他那种方法戏弄所有的男性守卫是在自找麻烦。他须要做的是找一个好女人，然后安个家。

original: Have you seen the way Mr. Dashwood skulks about when no one is looking. He's up to something, I'm sure! But what on earth could he be doing?
translation: 你知道达什伍德先生在没人看到的时候总是鬼鬼祟祟的吗？我敢肯定他是在干什么！但是他到底是在干什么呢？

original: Ms. Primrose works too hard, poor girl. How is she ever supposed to land a good husband if she's stuck in her kitchen all day?
translation: 普利洛斯女士工作很辛苦。可怜的女孩。假如她整天守在厨房里，怎么能找到个好丈夫呢？

original: Have you ever wondered why the only house call Doctor Banfield makes is to that Susan Lancaster's room? How positively shameful!
translation: 你就不奇怪为什么班菲尔德医生只去苏珊·兰卡斯特的房间出诊吗？真是可耻！

original: Why does Mr. Cheng insist on calling everyone "Comrade?" It's "Comrade this." And "'Comrade that." Do you suppose he was dropped often as a child?
translation: 为什么程先生坚持称每个人为“同志”呢？同志这同志那的。你觉得他是不是在小时候把脑袋磕坏了？

original: Mr. Hawthorne sure has pickled himself, hasn't he? That man exists in a constant state of inebriation. I wonder what drives him to the bottle so.
translation: 霍桑先生是个当之无愧的烂醉鬼，对吧？那家伙整天醉得不省人事。我在想到底是什么让他如此眷恋酒瓶。

original: One has to wonder about Mr. Tenpenny, doesn't one? I mean, we're all grateful for the Tower. But... the man is a recluse. I wonder what he's hiding.
translation: 每个人都对特佩尼先生好奇，是不是？我是说，大伙都对大厦心存感激。不过……那人是个隐士。真不知道他在隐藏什么。

original: That Mr. Burke is a shady character, isn't he? I've heard some positively awful things about him. But Tenpenny trusts him. So he can't be all bad.
translation: 伯克先生是个阴险的角色，对吧？我听过一些有关他特别可怕的传言。但是特佩尼先生信任他。所以他也应该不是很坏。

original: Ms. Montenegro's quite full of herself, isn't she? Puffed up like a souffle, she is! Ha! That was a good one, wasn't it? I'm quite funny today!
translation: 黑山女士自我膨胀，对不对？她胀得像要爆掉了，哈哈！那个笑话还不错，对吧？我今天很开心！

original: Very well. If you insist on remaining a social hermit, by all means continue to follow me around all day.
translation: 很好。如果你坚持要成为一个遁世者，不妨整天都跟着我好了。

original: You're wasting your time. I don't want to have to tell you again. This gun is loaded. I'd hate for it to accidentally go off in your direction.
translation: 你在浪费时间。我不打算再跟你说了。这把枪已经上膛。我可不想它冲着你的时候走火。

original: At least I'm not some dried up tart, prancing around like the queen of America, carelessly spouting grotesque phrases. "Fabulousity?" Really now!
translation: 至少我不是那种无聊的轻佻女人，弄得自己好像“美利坚皇后”似的，还拿腔捏调地：“难-以-置-信~”就像现在这样！

original: Ouch! You wound me!
translation: 哇嗷！你伤到我了！

original: You know the other ladies and I don't get along famously. They're quite jealous of me, naturally.
translation: 你知道我和其他女孩相处得并不融洽。当然，她们都很嫉妒我。

original: Whatever. He loves those damn meetings, and that stupid "Community Manifesto" of his more than me. He hardly knows I exist!
translation: 无论如何，他爱那些讨厌的会议，还有他那愚蠢的“共产党宣言”更胜于我。他几乎不知道我的存在！

original: Ha! You'll drink to ANYTHING! Cheers!
translation: 哈！为什么干杯都行！干杯！

original: Ha! He's so stupid, he wouldn't know what do to even if I did manage to get his attention!
translation: 哈！他太蠢了，即使我引起了他的注意，他也不知道该怎么办！

original: Yes they are dear, quite!
translation: 是的，他们很亲密，没错！

original: Ohhh. Well, comrade. I don't think I'll ever be able to do that.
translation: 哦。同志。我不认为我能做到。

original: Ha! See?! That's what I'm talking about! Stupid. Stupid man!
translation: 哈！看到了？这就是我所说的！愚蠢的，愚蠢的男人！

original: How about you pay me double for each Quantum bottle.
translation: 每瓶量子版你付我双份钱如何？

original: You devious bastard. I didn't figure you were that clever.
translation: 你这狡猾的杂碎。我没想到你眼睛这么毒。

original: All right, all right. Double it is. Just bring me those bottles, if I have to listen to Sierra ramble on any longer, I think I'll blow my brains out!
translation: 好吧，好吧，双倍。快把它们拿给我，如果我再听到塞拉唠叨这事，我八成会把自己的脑袋崩开花的！

original: So, you gonna' do it or what?
translation: 你做还是不做？

original: Tell you what, handsome. Find me some Quantum and we'll make it a threesome.
translation: 这样吧，帅哥。给我找些量子可乐，咱们就来个三人行。

original: Holy shit! Are you for real? Hell yeah!
translation: 我勒个去！你来真的？好耶！

original: I'm off to find you some Quantum then and I know right where to go.
translation: 我这就去给你找些量子版来，我知道上哪去弄。

original: Yoo-hoo! Anyone home?
translation: 呀吼！有人在家吗？

original: ... so they like kicked in Ronald's door and he was like "BLAM" with his gun and one of them got all splattered.
translation: ……因此他们去踢罗纳德的门，而他则用他的枪“砰”的一声让其中一个脑浆四溅。

original: Then the other one tried to like hit him all in his head with some club and Ronald was so cool how he dodged it and shot the guy in the face.
translation: 之后另一个试图用棍子敲他的头，而罗纳德冷静地避开，并朝那家伙的脸开了枪。

original: Then the Lug-Nut guy was in Ronald's face with the "I'll kick your ass" stuff and Ronald was like "Hell no..." and he punched the...
translation: 之后那叫“笨蛋”螺母的家伙冲着罗纳德的脸喊“我要让你知道我的厉害”，而罗纳德像是说了句“你有鬼用……”，跟着就击败了他……

original: Shut up already...
translation: 快点闭嘴……

original: Oh. Sorry! I get carried away sometimes. There's no need to get fresh about it though.
translation: 哦，抱歉！我有时候会走神。没必要对它无礼。

original: What's the matter with you? Didn't your mom and dad ever teach you any manners?
translation: 你怎么了？你父母没有教过你礼节吗？

original: Lady, you've got some issues.
translation: 女士，你有点小麻烦。

original: Come on, Sierra. No secrets between friends!
translation: 拜托，塞拉。朋友之间是没有秘密的！

original: Oh, okay! I have a schematic for the Nuka Grenade... the only one in the whole Capital Wasteland. Bring me the bottles and it's yours.
translation: 哦，好把！我有一张手榴弹（核子）的设计图……整个废土唯一的一张。带给我，它就是你的了。

original: Imagine the look on the target's face when they are burning alive in an effervescent explosion of cola and fruit flavors!
translation: 想象下那些目标在可乐和水果香料的气泡爆炸下活活煎熬的脸！

original: So, what do you say? Will you bring me the bottles?
translation: 你打算怎么办？要不要帮我？

original: Nope, I'm not telling! It's a really cool surprise though. You're gonna love it, I promise!
translation: 不，我不会说的！不过那真的是一个很酷的惊喜。我保证你会爱上的！

original: What's the secret prize?
translation: 什么秘密奖赏？

original: Okay, enough with the addict routine. Tell me what you want already!
translation: 好了，别再说什么瘾君子日常了。直接告诉我你想要什么吧！

original: "You can't resist the taste that'll blow up in your face!" like Ronald always says. He thinks of the best Nuka-Cola jingles!
translation: “你无法抵挡那迎面而来的美味！”就像罗纳德常说的那样。他总能想出最棒的核子可乐广告语！

original: Anyway, for every bottle you bring me I'll pay you some caps. You know, for expenses.
translation: 总之，每带来一瓶，我就会付给你一些瓶盖。你知道的，作为开销。

original: But if you're super cool and find like enough bottles to fill my Nuka-Cola machine, 30 in all, I got a super secret cool prize for you!
translation: 但如果你超厉害，能找到足够多的瓶子来装满我的核子可乐机，一共30瓶，我有一个超级秘密酷大奖给你！

original: Look, asshole. I told you, I found it. It's mine. If you wanted it, you should have been faster on the draw.
translation: 听着，混蛋。我告诉过你我找到它了。它是我的。如果你想要的话，拔枪的速度还要再快点。

original: Protector Casdin, sir! We've got a local interested in the job!
translation: 守护者卡斯丁，长官！我们找到一个有兴趣做这任务的原住民！

original: Nope. Sorry. Protector Casdin says the locals around here are barely smarter than the Mole Rats.
translation: 不行，抱歉。守护者卡斯丁说，这的原住民未必比地鼠更聪明。

original: But Morgan said we might have some work for an outsider. Talk with her, if you're really interested.
translation: 不过摩根说我们或许可以给外来者一些工作。跟她谈谈，如果你真有兴趣的话。

original: Can I join your group?
translation: 我能加入你的队伍吗？

original: Nope. Sorry. Protector Casdin says the locals around here are barely smarter than the Mole Rats.
translation: 不行，抱歉。守护者卡斯丁说，这的原住民未必比地鼠更聪明。

original: But Morgan said we might have some work for an outsider. Talk with her, if you're really interested.
translation: 不过摩根说我们或许可以给外来者一些工作。跟她谈谈，如果你真有兴趣的话。

original: Can I join your group?
translation: 我能加入你的队伍吗？

original: We aren't recruiting, kid. Old sap Lyons might trust walk-ins, but we don't.
translation: 我们不征兵，孩子。老白痴里昂斯或许会信任那些不请自来的人，但我们可不一样。

original: But if you want to help out... well, we might be able to work out a deal.
translation: 但如果你想要帮忙……我们或许能做个交易。

original: You bring in technological devices, and we'll pay you a finder's fee, based on the device. But Protector Casdin would have to okay it, first.
translation: 你给我们带来科技装置，我们就会付你酬劳，当然，以质定价。不过首先要得到守护者卡斯丁的允许。

original: You collect technology? How do I sign up?
translation: 你们收集技术？要不要我帮忙？

original: Are you interested in Lincoln's hat?
translation: 你对林肯的礼帽有没有兴趣？

original: Such strange clothing. We may never truly understand Lincoln and his times.
translation: 真是古怪的服装。我们怕是不会理解林肯和他的时代了。

original: It's worth 25 caps to me.
translation: 对我来说，它也就值25个瓶盖。

original: What a ridiculous hat. I'll pay you 25 caps for it.
translation: 这帽子真可笑。给你25个瓶盖吧。

original: I found one of Lincoln's old hats. Care to buy it?
translation: 我找到一顶林肯的旧礼帽，有兴趣买下它吗？

original: Lincoln's actual hat? Amazing! I must have it for the museum!
translation: 林肯戴过的礼帽！真棒！我一定要把它放到博物馆里！

original: How does 70 caps sound?
translation: 70个瓶盖怎么样？

original: How much for this war poster?
translation: 这战争海报多少钱？

original: Those damn abolitionists would use this against us. I'll give you 50 caps. You won't get a better price anywhere else.
translation: 那些该死的废奴主义者会用这东西来对付我们的。我给你50个瓶盖，你不可能在其他地方得到比这更好的价钱了。

original: The words of the great Lincoln, calling his people to war! I can spare 75 caps for it.
translation: 伟大的林肯的宣言，召唤他的人民加入战争！我愿意为它掏75个瓶盖。

original: I've got this old war poster from Lincoln's Civil War. Want to buy it?
translation: 我有一张林肯时代的古老战争海报，要买吗？

original: That would look fantastic on the museum wall! What do you say to 60 caps?
translation: 它挂在博物馆的墙上一定很拉风！60个瓶盖如何？

original: I have a collection of pennies with Lincoln's face on them.
translation: 我有一个套带有林肯肖像的硬币。

original: Not exactly something that will rally slaves, eh? I'll give you 15 caps for it.
translation: 不完全是那种号召奴隶的玩意吧，唉？付你15个瓶盖好了。

original: I suppose these have some small value to the faithful. I'll give you 15 caps for it.
translation: 我想它对那些真诚的人有点用。我愿意出15个瓶盖买下。

original: Pennies, eh? That's the old money they used long ago.
translation: 硬币？唉，那是他们在很久以前用的钱吧。

original: Well, any artifact from American history would benefit the museum. How about 15 caps for the lot of them?
translation: 任何来自于美国历史的文物都会为博物馆增光添彩。15个瓶盖怎样？

original: I found Lincoln's diary.
translation: 我找到了林肯日记。

original: This is truly a dangerous book. I'll pay 75 caps for it.
translation: 真是本危险的书。我愿意为它付75个瓶盖。

original: The words of the great man himself? In his own handwriting? I'll pay 100 caps for it.
translation: 那位伟人自己的话？他的亲笔？我掏100个瓶盖！

original: I have Lincoln's diary. I might be willing to sell it.
translation: 我有林肯的日记，我乐意出售。

original: Oh my goodness! Hand written by one of the greatest presidents of our country?
translation: 哦，天啊！我们国家最伟大的总统之一的手书？

original: The Society must possess this. I'll give you 100 caps for it!
translation: 协会必须拥有它。我会付给你100个瓶盖！

original: I've got a wanted poster for Lincoln's assassin.
translation: 我找到一张悬赏暗杀林肯的刺客海报。

original: Nice! I'll give you 75 caps for it.
translation: 不错！我付75个瓶盖。

original: To think that even the great Lincoln was felled by an assassin. This is a reminder to all that we must remain vigilant.
translation: 想到伟大林肯也倒在了刺客的枪下。这东西提醒着我们要时刻保持警惕。

original: I would like to buy it from you for 50 caps.
translation: 我愿意出50个瓶盖买下它。

original: Interesting. I'd love to have that in the museum's collection.
translation: 有趣，我喜欢把它放在博物馆的藏品里。

original: I will buy it from you for 70 caps. What do you say?
translation: 我花70个瓶盖买。你觉得怎样？

original: What will you give me for this toy of Lincoln?
translation: 这林肯的玩具，你打算给我多少钱？

original: I suppose I could give you 10 caps. It's not very inspiring, is it?
translation: 我想也就10个瓶盖。它并不是很有趣，对吧？

original: It's a small thing, but I'll give you 10 caps for it.
translation: 这是个小东西，不过我可以付你10个瓶盖。

original: Quite a nice specimen you have there. How about I give you 10 caps for it?
translation: 真是个好看的小东西。我付给你10个瓶盖如何？

original: Then stop wasting my time and tell me where he is.
translation: 别再浪费我的时间了，告诉我他在哪。

original: Well I don't know where he is. The last I knew, he was going back to the old lab.
translation: 我不知道他在哪，我所知道的，就是他回旧实验室去了。

original: Now will you kindly leave? I have work to do.
translation: 现在你能走了吗？我还有工作要做。

original: I'm looking for my father. Have you seen him?
translation: 我正在寻找我父亲，你看到他了吗？

original: I did see a man talking to Doctor Li, but I really shouldn't be discussing it.
translation: 我的确见过一个男人在和李博士谈话，不过我不该提这事的。

original: She's already in a bad mood. I'd hate to make it worse.
translation: 她的心情已经很差了，我不想让她变得更糟。

original: You should probably just talk to her about it.
translation: 你不妨直接跟她谈谈。

original: Look, some of us are trying to get work done here. There have been enough disruptions recently.
translation: 听着，我们中的一些人努力想把这工作搞定，近来的干扰已经够多的了。

original: Anybody coming through here would have to talk to Doctor Li; why don't you go bother her about it?
translation: 到这来的人都应该和李博士聊聊，不如你去找她吧？

original: Don't you judge me! It's not my fault that the only guys in this town are liars and jerks!
translation: 用不着你给我下结论！镇里的家伙都是骗子和流氓，这又不是我的错！

original: "Oh, you can't break up with me, we're all going to die soon!" Well, duh, why do you think I'm breaking up with you!
translation: “哦，你不会和我分手的，我们很快都要挂掉！”嗯，为什么你认为我要和你分手！

original: When I die, the last thing I want to worry about in my afterlife is breaking up with my once-alive boyfriend. Priorities!
translation: 等我死的时候，在我身后我最不想担心的事情就是和生前的男朋友分手。这最优先！

original: Who in this town haven't you dated...
translation: 这镇上还有谁你没约会过……

original: Oh, man, don't even go there. You'd think a girl like that would be more, you know, "adventurous." But that's a dry well, my friend.
translation: 兄弟啊，别提啦。你会以为能从那女孩身上占到点，“便宜”。但那是口枯井，我的朋友。

original: All she does is talk about how she hates everyone else or how dark her clothing is. A guy can only take so much of that before he snaps.
translation: 她喋喋不休地唠叨她多么痛恨其他的人，还有她的衣服有多黑。每个哥们最多听到这里就会睡着。

original: Poor Pappy got the worst of it. I swear, he's gotten even more depressed since she dumped him for me. As if being here wasn't bad enough.
translation: 可怜的帕匹最倒霉了。我发誓，在她为了我而踹掉他之后，他就更加抑郁了。好像活在这里还不算最糟糕的。

original: I hear you and Bittercup were an item.
translation: 我听说你和“苦杯”是一对。

original: We did? Wow, that's news to me. How long was I unconscious, again?
translation: 我们？哇哦，对我来说那真是个新闻。再问一次，我昏迷了多长时间？

original: She didn't, you know, do anything to me while I was out? Did she? That might explain those weird dreams...
translation: 当我昏厥的时候，她没有对我做任何事吧？做没做？那或许可以解释那些离奇的梦……

original: Bittercup tells me the two of you had a thing together.
translation: “苦杯”跟我说，你们俩有一腿。

original: I told her things would be safe here. How was I supposed to know all those stories were bunk? Then she dumped me, called me a liar.
translation: 我告诉过她这里是安全的。我怎么可能知道那些故事都是瞎话？然后她就把我踹了，还说我是个骗子。

original: I was lied to myself, alright! Well, that didn't matter to her. Then she started dating Flash and got all spooky. Good riddance.
translation: 我在骗自己，行了吧！但她才不管呢。然后她就开始勾搭福莱斯，而且变得更加神经质。谢天谢地，我摆脱她了。

original: You came here with Bittercup, right?
translation: 你和“苦杯”一起来的，对吧？

original: Oh, that. I know all about that nonsense. Flash isn't the smartest cookie in the jar, but he deserved better than Bittercup.
translation: 哦，那个啊。那些废话我都知道。福莱斯不是这里最聪明的家伙，但他也不该和“苦杯”搅在一起。

original: She wouldn't be so bad if she just faced reality, instead of doing that whole "spooky girl" routine.
translation: 如果她能面对现实，别总是“神经兮兮”的，也还不至于这么差，。

original: Did you know Flash used to date Bittercup?
translation: 你知道福莱斯以前常常和“苦杯”约会吗？

original: Who lives here?
translation: 谁住在这里？

original: Just a bunch of children who had to turn into adults too fast. If only we were all little again...
translation: 就是一帮必须飞快长大的小孩。如果我们都能再变小的话……

original: You mean Dusty? Never talks about himself much. Never talks about anything much.
translation: 你是指达斯提？从不多谈他自己。从不多谈任何事情。

original: We used to take turns, but Dusty started guarding the gate night and day. Little weird, but I'm not complaining.
translation: 我们原先是轮流的，但是达斯提开始整日整夜地在门口警戒。有点古怪，但我不想抱怨。

original: Who's that guy guarding the gate?
translation: 守大门的那家伙是谁？

original: Well, I mainly hang around Pappy. He's not such a bad guy. You should have seen him when he first got here, so bright and positive.
translation: 我主要是和帕匹待在一块。他不是个坏人。你应该去见见他第一次来这里时的样子，又聪明又积极。

original: I ... just didn't have the heart to tell him at first, you know? How frightening this place really is. Everyone figures it out eventually.
translation: 我……当初没有告诉他的心情，你知道吗？这地方有多吓人，每个人最终都会明白的。

original: Who lives here, anyway?
translation: 总之，谁住在这里？

original: Everyone's dead or dying. Now leave me alone.
translation: 所有的人，不是死掉了，就是快死了。现在让我自己待会吧。

original: You just think you can order people around, huh? You're like Flash. You think you're in charge, but you're not.
translation: 你觉得你可以号令周围的人，呃？你就像福莱斯，自以为大权在握，其实不然。

original: Kimba says we should get along, but we're all gonna just gonna end up like Timebomb: dying on a table in Red's clinic.
translation: 金巴说我们应该友好相处，但我们的结局都会像“定时炸弹”一样：在瑞德诊所里的桌子上等死。

original: Red and Kimba won't talk to me, just because I used to date Pappy and Flash! They're so jealous!
translation: 瑞德和金巴不跟我说话，只不过因为我曾经跟帕匹和福莱斯约会过！她们非常妒忌！

original: Maybe that thing I had with Timebomb was wrong, but still! I don't need them! I'll do whatever I want!
translation: 或许我和“定时炸弹”的事是错的，那又怎么样！我不需要他们！我随心所欲！

original: You and the other people here don't seem to get along.
translation: 你和这里的其他人好像合不来。

original: Oh, yeah! I can tell you all about them, if you want. Let's see...
translation: 哦，是的！我能告诉你他们所有的事情，如果你想的话。瞧……

original: Red's the doctor. Flash is on day patrol. Bittercup is on night patrol. Kimba, Pappy, and Shorty scavenge for food. Dusty guards the gate...
translation: 瑞德是医生。福莱斯在白天巡逻。“苦杯”在夜里巡逻。金巴、帕匹、和“矮子”负责寻找食物。达斯提守大门……

original: At least, that's kinda how things got settled. Everyone sort of picks their own work here, you know? No mayor or anything.
translation: 至少，情况稳定下来了。每个人都各司其职，你知道吗？没有镇长之类的职位。

original: You live here, right? What do you know about the people?
translation: 你住在这里，对吧？你对这里的人了解多少？

original: Aw, that's no fun. I prefer my victims energetic and in agony.
translation: 喔，那很无聊。我更喜欢我的猎物精力充沛、而且痛苦。

original: Big talk, killer. Why don't you leave, and let me watch out for people less discriminating than yourself.
translation: 吹吧，杀手。你走吧，让我好好盯着那些不像你这么显眼的家伙。

original: You've accepted death? Killing all of you should be easy, then.
translation: 你们接受了死亡？那杀光你们就容易了。

original: We're under attack, again! Everyone get down!
translation: 我们再次遭受了攻击！所有人趴下！

original: I just need somewhere to trade my salvage.
translation: 我需要个地方来卖我收获的东西。

original: There isn't anything here that hasn't been destroyed or dragged away. You're better off scavenging the dead out in the wasteland.
translation: 这里的东西要么被毁了，要么被抢了。你最好到外面废土的死尸上去找。

original: Paradise Falls? Where's that?
translation: 堕落天堂？它在哪？

original: Nearby. Slavers move quick and come from all directions. Someone else might know where they nest.
translation: 附近。奴隶贩子行动迅速，来自四面八方。其他人可能会知道他们的巢穴。

original: Where do the Super Mutants come from?
translation: 超级变种人从哪来的？

original: Skulk up toward Germantown, near the police station. They always come from that direction.
translation: 接近日耳曼镇，就在警察局附近。他们总是从那个方向过来。

original: I want a new opening speech. One that acknowledges me as King.
translation: 我要一场全新的公开演说。承认我是国王。

original: Don't think you'll scare anyone here. You could shoot down everyone in town, and I wouldn't flinch.
translation: 别以为你能吓唬谁。这镇上的人你随便杀，而我不会退缩的。

original: You live in Bigtown; you learn to accept death.
translation: 住在大镇，你就得学会接受死亡。

original: I want a new opening speech. One that acknowledges me as King.
translation: 我要一场全新的公开演说。承认我是国王。

original: Don't think you'll scare anyone here. You could shoot down everyone in town, and I wouldn't flinch.
translation: 别以为你能吓唬谁。这镇上的人你随便杀，而我不会退缩的。

original: You live in Bigtown; you learn to accept death.
translation: 住在大镇，你就得学会接受死亡。

original: I want a new opening speech. One that acknowledges me as Queen.
translation: 我要一场全新的公开演说。承认我是女王。

original: So, you're under constant threat?
translation: 你们一直在遭受威胁？

original: There was a Super Mutant attack recently and where there's one big ugly, there are ten more just waiting to grab you by the throat.
translation: 最近有超级变种人来袭，有十来个巨大的丑八怪等着掐住你的脖子。

original: Then the slavers will come and pick off what's left of your carcass, and drag any survivors to Paradise Falls.
translation: 然后奴隶贩子会到来，拣走你尸体上剩下的每件东西，并把幸存者掳到堕落天堂去。

original: What happened to our deal, Sierra?
translation: 我们的交易怎样，塞拉？

original: Ohhhh... Ronald is SUCH a sweetheart! Do you know he went out like you did and found me 30 bottles of Quantum?
translation: 哦~~~……罗纳德真是太贴心了！你知道他像你一样出去，却给我找回了30瓶量子版吗？

original: He loves me! He really really loves me! Now I bet he'll ask me to get married.
translation: 他爱我！他真的真的爱我！我打赌他会向我求婚的。

original: Oh! For my wedding present I'm giving him the super secret prize too!
translation: 哦！为了我的结婚礼物，我也要给他超级秘密奖品！

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Okay, well don't forget I'll still buy bottles of Quantum from you!
translation: 好啊，别忘记了我还是会从你那里买量子版的！

original: You bitch! That was supposed to be for me!
translation: 你这婊子！那些应该是给我的！

original: You can't expect me to get married without a gift for my future husband do you? That wouldn't be right.
translation: 你不能让我在结婚时连一件礼物都拿不出来送给我未来的丈夫，对吧？那样不合适。

original: And don't call me names like that, it hurts my feelings.
translation: 还有，别那么叫我的名字，这很伤感情。

original: Can't you see, Sierra? He just wants to sleep with you.
translation: 你还不懂吗，塞拉？他只不过是想跟你上床罢了。

original: A sleepover? Awesome! We could tell bedtime stories and do each other's hair and all sorts of fun stuff.
translation: 寄宿一晚？好棒！这样我们就可以讲些睡前故事，替对方做头发，还有各种好玩的事。

original: I could even make some Nuka-Cola treats for when we get the munchies late at night. That would be fun!
translation: 我甚至可以做些核子可乐点心当夜宵！那会很有趣的！

original: Yep. I'll be seeing you, soon I hope.
translation: 好了。我希望能很快再见到你。

original: Yep, they sure were hard to get, and you got 'em you big 'ole teddy bear! Anyway, gotta' get these into the machine. Seeya, sweetie!
translation: 好了。它们肯定不容易到手，而你却给他们一个这么大的惊喜！无论如何，要把这些放进机器里。回见，甜心！

original: He he. That's ok, Sierra. Play hard to get. I love it!
translation: 呵呵。那没关系，塞拉。要努力才成功，我喜欢！

original: Some of what?
translation: 一些什么？

original: That's ok, baby. We have plenty of time. You know where to find me when you want some of this.
translation: 那很好，宝贝。我们有的是时间。如果你需要一些的话，你知道去哪找我。

original: Well, maybe later. I have a lot of things to do now. Need to get all of this Quantum icy cold.
translation: 或许晚一些。我现在好多事情要处理。需要把这些量子版冰起来。

original: Nothing. So, you wanna' celebrate?
translation: 没事。你想要庆祝一下吗？

original: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？

original: Yeah, I'll fill your machine all right. Hehe.
translation: 是啊，我会把你的机器填满的。呵呵。

original: Oh my goodness! You absolute dear! You found the Quantum to fill my machine!
translation: 天啊！我最亲爱的人！你找到了能填满我机器的量子版！

original: Hi there, sweet cheeks. I got something for you.
translation: 嗨，甜心。我给你带了些东西。

original: Oh great. I thought I was rid of you.
translation: 哦，天啦，我还以为已经甩掉你了。

original: No such luck, sucker! Life ain't worth living without Butch around, and you can't keep a Tunnel Snake down.
translation: 没那么幸运，小毛孩！如果没有布奇伴你左右，你活着毫无意义，而且你也搞不定一个穴蛇帮。

original: But if you're lucky, you can hold my empties. Here.
translation: 但如果你幸运的话，你可以为我拿着空瓶。接住。

original: How did you get all the way down here?
translation: 你是怎么一路到这来的？

original: Ah, you know you can't keep a Tunnel Snake cooped up forever! We gotta be free, and your little visit was just the inspiration I needed!
translation: 啊，你知道没人能永远困住穴蛇帮的！我们必将获得自由，你的小小拜访正好激发了我！

original: So here's to sweet, glorious freedom! Cheers!
translation: 所以，为了梦寐以求的自由，干杯！

original: I thought the Overseer closed the Vault. How did you get out?
translation: 我以为监督者把避难所给关闭了，你是怎么跑出来的？

original: Same way anyone does. By being too cool to stop anywhere else! I didn't see a thing in the wasteland that was a match for a bona fide Tunnel Snake!
translation: 和别人的办法一样。酷到不能在其它地方逗留！我从未见过废土上有谁能与真正的穴蛇帮匹敌！

original: So, here's to freedom and rocking the Wasteland! Drink up!
translation: 为享受自由，颠覆废土，干杯！

original: Sounds like a deal. Good to see you on the outside, Butch!
translation: 听上去不错。很高兴在外面能见到你，布奇！

original: Here's to raising hell and living the good life out here! Cheers!
translation: 为杀出地狱，享受外面的美好生活，干杯！

original: Now all we need is a gang, and we could take over this whole Wasteland!
translation: 现在，我们只需要成立一个帮派，就能接管废土了！

original: Can I see what you have for sale?
translation: 我能看看你出售的东西吗？

original: If your caps are good, you can buy whatever you like. Beats standing there drooling all over the merchandise.
translation: 如果你有足够的瓶盖，你可以随便买你想要的任何东西，不用站在那对着货品流口水。

original: Come back and see me when I'm mindin' the store. You better bring caps... there's no handouts to be had around here!
translation: 如果我在店里待着的话就回来看看。你最好带着瓶盖来……这可没有什么救济品！

original: Drinking that stuff can't be good for you if it contains radiation.
translation: 如果它含有放射性的话，喝下它对你可没什么好处。

original: Well, I guess so. I heard that sometimes the radiation would remain in people's systems, but only in a few test cases.
translation: 我想也是。我听说有时候辐射会影响到人体的系统，但只是少数的试验中。

original: All you'd need is a little RadAway and poof, the isotope is gone.
translation: 你需要的东西就是一包辐特宁，噗的一声，同位素就没了。

original: What happens when you drink a Nuka-Cola Quantum?
translation: 当你喝下一瓶核子可乐量子版时，会发生什么？

original: Oh my! It's like a tidal wave of flavor washing all over your body!
translation: 天啊！就像一股风味的浪潮席卷你的全身！

original: Your head spins but everything is clear at the same time. It is quite a rush.
translation: 你的头会眩晕，但同时一切又都清晰。真带劲。

original: What exactly does a bottle of Quantum look like?
translation: 一瓶量子可乐具体长什么样？

original: Well, the bottles are glass just like regular Nuka-Cola, except the glass is clear.
translation: 嗯，瓶子是玻璃的，和普通核子可乐一样，只不过玻璃是透明的。

original: That way the glowy stuff inside shows through. You'll know it when you see it.
translation: 这样里面的光就能透出来。你一看就知道了。

original: <Morse Code Clicking>
translation: <敲击摩斯密码>

original: Could I become a Treeminder?
translation: 我能成为一名树启者吗？

original: Although we would welcome you with open arms, you were obviously drawn here to help us.
translation: 尽管我们会张开怀抱来欢迎你，但你被吸引过来显然是为了帮助我们。

original: What remains to be seen is what that help turns out to be.
translation: 尚不清楚的是究竟是怎样的帮助。

original: Becoming a disciple of the Great One takes many years of dedication and the will to cast aside your reliance on technological conveniences.
translation: 成为圣贤的信徒，需要作出多年的奉献，还要抛弃对你对科技便利的依赖。

original: However, I feel you've been sent here for a higher purpose and could be more instrumental in our future than a mere Treeminder.
translation: 无论如何，我感觉到你来这里还有更大的作用，而且你对我们的未来至关重要，不是区区一个树启者可以比拟的。

original: How do the Treeminders normally handle other Outsiders?
translation: 树启者通常怎样对待其他的外来者？

original: Without His blessing, we would not allow an Outsider inside this vale.
translation: 没有神的准许，我们是不允许外来者踏入这片山谷的。

original: If the Outsider doesn't have His blessing, we simply deny him entry to our home.
translation: 如果外来者没能获得他的准许，我们就会拒绝其进入我们的家。

original: If they persist on trying to gain entry, or display any hostile act that could potentially harm the Great One, we take action.
translation: 如果他们坚持要进来或表现出可能伤害到圣贤的敌意，我们会采取行动。

original: If the Outsider were a Raider or some other nefarious type, we ensure they don't report our location back to their comrades.
translation: 假如外来者是个歹徒或是恶徒，我们保证不会让他们有命回同伴那泄露我们的位置。

original: How did the Treeminders begin?
translation: 树启者是如何发源的？

original: I'm afraid I can take none of the credit for my husband's creation.
translation: 恐怕都要归功于我丈夫的创建。

original: I arrived perhaps a year after him, well after he established the Treeminders.
translation: 我在他大概一年之后才来这里，在他创立树启者之后。

original: When I first beheld the glory of the Great One, I knew there'd be others who would seek to do Him harm.
translation: 当我第一次获得圣贤的荣耀时，我知道肯定会有其他人试图去给他造成伤害。

original: I also knew He would be calling others that he felt were pure of heart to protect Him.
translation: 我也知道，他一定会召唤具有纯净心灵的人去保护他。

original: Right then and there I created the Treeminders... the Great One's last line of defense.
translation: 那时，我当即创建了树启者……圣贤的最后防线。

original: I don't think Leaf Mother Laurel is going to like hearing you say that!
translation: 我可不认为“叶之母”萝瑞尔喜欢听你这么说！

original: Go tell her what you want, my opinion is my own. That's one of the founding ideals of the Treeminders.
translation: 去告诉她你想说的吧，我坚持自己的观点。这是护树人的创立理念之一。

original: And being an Outsider, I'd expect you not to judge our laws!
translation: 并且，作为一个外来者，我希望你不要妄加评判我们的规矩！

original: What if all the Treeminders don't agree with you?
translation: 要是所有护树人都不同意你的看法怎么办？

original: That would worry me. I was out there once like you. I wandered the Wasteland for many years.
translation: 那会让我很担忧。我曾经也像你一样身处在外。我在废土上漂泊了许多年。

original: All I saw was poverty, famine, sickness, hate and death everywhere I turned.
translation: 举目四望，我看到的只有贫穷、饥荒、疾病、仇恨和死亡。

original: But this place... this place isn't anything like that. We can't allow that kind of evil inside Oasis... we just can't!
translation: 但这个地方……这个地方完全不一样。我们不能让那种邪恶进入绿洲……绝对不能！

original: I think you're right. Who knows what would happen to this place?
translation: 我认为你是对的。谁知道这里将会发生什么？

original: Exactly! I was out there once like you. I wandered the Wasteland for many years.
translation: 没错！我曾经也像你一样身处在外。我在废土上漂泊了许多年。

original: All I saw was poverty, famine, sickness, hate and death everywhere I turned.
translation: 举目四望，我看到的只有贫穷、饥荒、疾病、仇恨和死亡。

original: But this place... this place isn't anything like that. We can't let all that evil inside here... we just can't!
translation: 但这个地方……这个地方完全不一样。我们不能让那些邪恶进入绿洲……绝对不能！

original: What did you have to do to become a Treeminder?
translation: 为了成为一名护树人，你都做了些什么？

original: Actually, you already did some of it. I had to do the Ceremony and meet with the Great One.
translation: 实际上，你已经做了一些了。我参加了仪式，并见到了圣贤。

original: Then Tree Father Birch taught me everything I needed to know about Oasis and how it has to remain a secret.
translation: 之后，“树之父”伯奇教给我所有关于绿洲的知识，以及必须让这里成为秘密的原因。

original: That's why I'm so worried. I just think letting this place spread into the Wasteland would be an unwise decision.
translation: 那就是为何我如此担忧。我只觉得让这片地方向废土扩展，是很不明智的决定。

original: Like I said before, thanks to Tree Father Birch, I learned everything I needed to know about Oasis and how it has to remain a secret.
translation: 如我之前所说，多亏了“树之父”伯奇，我了解了关于绿洲我需要知道的一切，以及它为何必须成为秘密。

original: That's why I'm so worried. I just think letting this place spread into the Wasteland would be an unwise decision.
translation: 那就是为何我如此担忧。我只觉得让这片地方向废土扩展，是很不明智的决定。

original: Remind me again what you did to become a Treeminder.
translation: 再提醒我一下，你为了成为护树人都做了些什么。

original: Just get born I guess. He he! You're funny!
translation: 我想只要出生就行了。嘿嘿！你真有意思！

original: I had to accept the ideals of Tree Father Birch and cast away my dependence on technology.
translation: 我不得不接受“树之父”布尔奇的理论，抛弃我对科技的依赖。

original: I sort of fell into it I guess. I woke up here and I just stayed. After a while, I became one of them.
translation: 我想我算是误打误撞加入的。我在这里醒来，然后就留下了。过了一阵子，我就成了他们中的一员。

original: I was the third one to arrive here in Oasis. Tree Father Birch was a bit wary at first, but Leaf Mother Laurel convinced him to let me stay.
translation: 我是第三个到达绿洲的人。起初，“树之父”伯奇有些警惕，但“叶之母”萝瑞尔说服他让我留了下来。

original: If she hadn't been around, I doubt Birch would have let me stay here.
translation: 要是没有她在，我怀疑伯奇不会允许我待在这里。

original: After a while, they taught me their ways and together we developed the Ceremony of Purification that you undertook.
translation: 过了一段时间，他们教给我他们的生活方式，然后我们一起制定了你参加过的净化仪式。

original: Please, go right ahead.
translation: 请吧，一直向前。

original: May I ask you about the Treeminders?
translation: 能和你聊聊树启者吗？

original: Of course. We're quite open about everything here.
translation: 当然。我们这的一切都很开放。

original: May I ask you about the Treeminders?
translation: 能和你聊聊树启者吗？

original: Did you know your god wants to die?
translation: 你知道你们的神想要寻死吗？

original: What?! How can you say something so awful and terrible?! Leave me alone, I never wanna talk to you again!
translation: 什么？！你怎能说出这么可怕和骇人的话？！离我远点，我再不要跟你说话了！

original: You speak heresy! Tree Father Birch should hear about this!
translation: 你这是异端邪说！这事得让“树之父”伯奇知道！

original: Heresy? Not at all. Leaf Mother Laurel's word is just as binding as Tree Father Birch's. I have no obligation to follow one or the other.
translation: 异端邪说？才不是。“叶之母”萝瑞尔的话和“树之父”伯奇的同样有约束力。我并无义务只遵从其中一方。

original: How dare you speak to a Bloomseer like that! I know our laws better than any Outsider would! Now begone!
translation: 你竟敢这样跟一位花先知说话！我比任何外来者都更懂我们的律法！现在，快滚！

original: What if there are other that don't share your opinion?
translation: 万一有其他人不同意你的观点呢？

original: You'd think they'd realize that this place won't remain a secret forever. The caravans know about it and you happened upon it.
translation: 你也许认为他们会意识到这个地方不会永远是个秘密。商队知道了，而你也碰巧发现了这里。

original: How long before someone comes to take this place by force? No, I say allow Oasis to grow and that issue becomes moot.
translation: 过不了多久就会有人来武力夺取这里吧？不，我说该让绿洲发展壮大，问题就会迎刃而解。

original: I agree completely!
translation: 我完全赞同！

original: Oh, if only Tree Father Birch saw it as you do! Of everyone, he's been here the longest.
translation: 哦，要是“树之父”伯奇能像你这样想就好了！在所有人之中，他在这的时间最长。

original: You'd think he'd realize that this place won't remain a secret forever. The caravans know about it and you found it.
translation: 你也许认为他会意识到这个地方不会永远是个秘密。商队知道了，而你也找到了这里。

original: How long before someone comes to take this place by force? No, I say allow this place to grow and that issue becomes moot.
translation: 过不了多久就会有人用武力夺取这里吧？不，我说该让这地方发展壮大，问题就会迎刃而解。

original: Yeah, well guess what? He's really a monster!
translation: 是啊，猜猜看？他是个货真价实的怪兽！

original: Hey! He's not a monster! You meanie! I never wanna talk to you again!
translation: 嗨！他才不是什么怪兽！你个刻薄鬼！我再不要跟你讲话了！

original: I can't believe a tree would be scared of anything.
translation: 我不敢相信一棵树也有害怕的东西。

original: Hey! He's not a tree! He's my friend! Don't be mean.
translation: 嘿！他不是一棵树！他是我的朋友！别这么刻薄。

original: What's Harold scared of?
translation: 哈罗德怕什么？

original: Sorry, that's only for secrets between friends!
translation: 抱歉，这可是朋友之间的秘密！

original: Hey, maybe if you tell me what Harold is scared of I won't be scared either.
translation: 嘿，如果你告诉我哈罗德怕什么，说不定我也不会害怕了。

original: Awww, I never knew an Outsider could be scared of anything!
translation: 哎呀，我还不知道外来者也会害怕！

original: Harold told me that he's scared of fire. If fire ever got on him, it would burn him and Bob until they were all gone.
translation: 哈罗德告诉我他怕火。要是火沾到他身上，就会把他和鲍勃烧得一干二净。

original: That's why we keep the fires far away from him.
translation: 这就是为什么我们让火离他远远的。

original: Tell me about your "god."
translation: 给我说说你们的“神”吧。

original: Oh, you mean Harold? He's really nice. Sometimes when I get really lonely, I go into the Grove and talk to him.
translation: 哦，你说的是哈罗德吧？他真的很好。有时候我觉得很孤单，就会去小树林里跟他聊聊天。

original: Sometimes I even curl up all cozy like and sleep next to his roots after I have a bad dream.
translation: 有时候在我做噩梦后，我甚至会舒坦地蜷缩在他的树根旁睡觉。

original: I tell him what I'm scared of and he tells me what he's scared of. It makes me feel better knowing I'm not the only one.
translation: 我跟他讲我怕些什么，他也跟我讲他怕些什么。知道我不是唯一害怕的人，让我感觉好多了。

original: That's okay, I like talking about Harold's... he's really nice... he's my best friend!
translation: 没关系，我喜欢聊哈罗德……他真的很好……他是我最好的朋友！

original: Sometimes I even curl up all cozy like and sleep next to his roots after I have a bad dream.
translation: 有时候在我做噩梦后，我甚至会舒坦地蜷缩在他的树根旁睡觉。

original: I tell him what I'm scared of and he tells me what he's scared of. It makes me feel better knowing I'm not the only one.
translation: 我跟他讲我怕些什么，他也跟我讲他怕些什么。知道我不是唯一害怕的人，让我感觉好多了。

original: Can you tell me about your "god" again? I'd forgotten what you said.
translation: 你能再跟我说说你的“神”吗？我忘了你先前跟我说的。

original: He is the Great One. The Tree Father of Tree Fathers. There is no greater being in the world than He.
translation: 他是圣贤，“树之父”的“树之父”。在这世界上没有能比他再伟大的了。

original: I've dedicated my life to protecting this place from the outside world and I will never fail in that duty.
translation: 我已经把我的生命奉献给保护这不受外界侵袭，我绝不会抛弃我的职责。

original: Well, I'm not so sure the Great One is a god... I mean, I don't believe in that sort of thing.
translation: 嗯，我不太确定圣贤是不是个神……我是说，我不信这一套。

original: However, I am beginning to realize He's special... something greater than any of the creatures in the Wasteland.
translation: 不过，我开始意识到他很特别……比废土上的任何生物都要伟大。

original: Being in His presence gives me the greatest sense of peace I've ever felt in my entire life.
translation: 在神的面前，我能感受到在我的一生中最为平静的时刻。

original: Look around you, Outsider. This place wasn't built by man or made by a machine. This place is a miracle and only a god can perform a miracle.
translation: 看看你周围吧，外来者。这个地方不是人造的，也不是机器造的。这里是一个奇迹，而只有神才能创造奇迹。

original: He's not my god, He's everyone's god. You, me, everyone. This place isn't meant for just the Treeminders, it's for all mankind.
translation: 他不是我一个人的神，他是每个人的神。你、我、所有人。这里不只属于护树人，而属于全人类。

original: Like I said, He's everyone's god. This place isn't meant for just the Treeminders, it's for all mankind.
translation: 就像我之前说的，他是每个人的神。这个地方不只属于护树人，而属于全人类。

original: Can you tell me about your "god" again? I'd forgotten what you said.
translation: 你能再跟我说说你的“神”吗？我忘了你先前跟我说的。

original: Alright. I'll be careful. I promise.
translation: 好吧，我会小心。我保证。

original: You're welcome. Don't do anything strenuous for a few weeks.
translation: 欢迎你，但别做什么出格的事。

original: Oh, yeah, sure. I understand. Here. That's all I have.
translation: 哦，是啊，当然了。我明白。给。我只有这些了。

original: It wasn't free. Doctor's fees are expensive. Understand?
translation: 这可不是义务治疗，医生的收费是很高的，明白？

original: Oh, uh, okay. Whatever you say.
translation: 哦，唔，好吧。你说什么都行。

original: Nothing happened. I just need you to answer some questions.
translation: 没什么，我只需要你回答一些问题。

original: Ah, shit.
translation: 啊，他妈的。

original: I wanted you to be conscious before I killed you.
translation: 我希望杀你的时候，你是清醒的。

original: Wow. That's ... you saved my life! Thanks. You're a good person, you know that?
translation: 哇哦。这……你救了我的命！谢了。你真是个好人！

original: You had seven bullet wounds and broke both clavicles. Should be fine now.
translation: 你有七处枪伤,而且两边的锁骨都骨折了。现在应该没问题了。

original: You sound like you were in love with her.
translation: 听起来你和她堕入爱河了。

original: Love? What are you talking about.
translation: 爱？你说什么呢。

original: All I know is things are sure gonna be awfully quiet around here with her gone.
translation: 我知道的就是，她不在的话，这就会变得特别安静。

original: Ah well. I guess I'll go clean up the mess and take care of things around here.
translation: 唉。我想我应该清理一下，把这管起来。

original: I killed her. Got a problem with that, tough guy?
translation: 我杀了她。有什么意见吗？硬汉？

original: What?? You're crazy! How could you just go and kill her like that?!
translation: 什么？？你疯了！你怎能就这样杀死她？！

original: That's it... you're dead meat! Say hello to the Kneecapper!
translation: 对……你玩完了！跟碎膝者打个招呼吧！

original: Sorry, I don't know. (Lie)
translation: 对不起，我不清楚。(撒谎)

original: Are you shittin' me? What a waste! Oh man.
translation: 你在拿我开心吗？都是废话！这家伙。

original: If I find out who did that to her, they're dead. She was mine... no one was supposed to touch her but me!
translation: 如果我找到干这事的人，他们就死定了。她是我的……除了我，没有人能碰她！

original: Sierra is dead.
translation: 塞拉死了。

original: What? What the hell happened?
translation: 什么？他妈的发生了什么？

original: Is there anything else interesting to see near Girdershade?
translation: 梁影村附近还有什么有趣的地方可以看看吗？

original: Well, to the east there are some nasty Raiders in Evergreen Mills. I'd stay away from there if I were you.
translation: 嗯，往东边走，有一群恶心的掠夺者盘踞在常青工厂。如果我是你的话，我会离那远远的。

original: Luckily, we're kind of hidden here under the old highway, so no one bothers us.
translation: 很幸运，我们在旧高速公路下面的居住点挺隐蔽，所以没人来打扰我们。

original: My friend, you are at the ass end of the Capital Wasteland. If it weren't for Sierra I'd be out of here.
translation: 我的朋友，你现在在首都废土的该死尽头。如果不是为了塞拉，我早就离开这了。

original: One thing I can tell you is stay the hell away from the Dunwich Building to the south. That place is bad mojo.
translation: 我唯一能告诉你的就是该死的离南面的邓维奇大楼远点。那可是个真正的鬼地方。

original: I dunno what that place is about, but I hear about weird shit going on.
translation: 我不知道那地方究竟是怎么回事，但我听说那有很多奇怪的事。

original: What can you tell me about Nuka-Cola Cocktails?
translation: 你能跟我说说核子可乐鸡尾酒吗？

original: I don't know a whole lot about weapons, but I do know that it's more powerful than the Molotov Cocktail.
translation: 我对武器不是很懂，但我知道它比莫洛托夫鸡尾酒的威力大多了。

original: It explodes in a huge blue flame too! How cool is that?
translation: 它还会爆发蓝色的火焰！那不是很酷？

original: Tell me more about the Nuka Grenade.
translation: 告诉我更多关于核子可乐手榴弹的事。

original: Sorry. Can't talk now.
translation: 抱歉，现在不能说话。

original: Good to see you!
translation: 很高兴见到你！

original: Hello.
translation: 你好。

original: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

original: No, not all right. Every day you don't help with this research is another day people might die!
translation: 不，不是很好。你一天不参与研究，就会有更多的人死掉！

original: And I can't write without good research, or else people might follow bad info and die anyway! So get to work!
translation: 不好好研究，我就没办法写，否则其他人就会按照错误的情报行动，并且随时可能死掉！所以赶快去工作！

original: I'll do it when I get around to it, all right?
translation: 我有时间就会做的，好吗？

original: I realize a lot of things, but this isn't one of them because it's a real scientific necessity and... and... and not ridiculous at all!
translation: 我发现了许多事情，但这个不是那种情况，因为它真的是科学上的需要。而且……而且……根本不荒谬！

original: What I mean is, I need this research, and you're probably going to get irradiated out there, anyway. So why not come back here and help me, too?
translation: 我的意思是，我需要做这项研究，而你反正都会在外面受到辐射污染。所以，为什么不帮帮我呢？

original: You realize how ridiculous this request is, right?
translation: 你总算知道这项任务有多荒谬了，对吗？

original: Neither is going around all the time with a loaded gun or running with sharp objects, but people do those things all the time!
translation: 整天带着上膛的枪或者锋利的刀乱跑，但是人们一直都在这么做！

original: You worry too much. Just be careful where you step, and I'm sure you'll be fine!
translation: 你太多虑了。只要当心脚下，我看就没问题！

original: I don't think walking around in a minefield is a very good idea.
translation: 我认为绕着雷区溜达不是太妙的主意。

original: Oh, it's perfectly fine, and made from organic ingredients. Well, it affects things' organs. That's close enough to being organic, right?
translation: 哦，很好，而且还是用的有机原料。它会影响生物的器官。这可以算是有机的了，是吧？

original: Either way, it's perfectly safe. Heck, once it got into food for Jericho, and he never even knew!
translation: 无论怎样，它绝对安全。大头鬼，有一次它被掺进了耶利哥的食物里，而他压根不知道！

original: I'm not so sure about testing this stuff.
translation: 我没把握测试这东西。

original: Okay, yes, they're jerks. But if they're intelligent, we can get them to stop. And train them. Maybe we could even ride them! That'd be fun!
translation: 好吧，是的，它们是笨蛋。不过如果它们有智慧，我们就能遏制它们，并且训练它们。说不定我们甚至可以骑它们！太好玩了！

original: Why do we care if they're intelligent? They still try to kill me.
translation: 我们为什么要在乎他们聪不聪明？他们始终都想杀我。

original: Well, I could hardly be an impartial observer in that case, now could I? It'd ruin the validity of the entire experiment.
translation: 在这种情况下，我很难作为公正的观察员，我能吗？它会破坏整个实验的有效性。

original: Besides, you wouldn't shoot me, now would you?
translation: 此外，你也不会开枪的，你会打我吗？

original: Umm... How about I just leave you alone for a bit?
translation: 嗯……不如我先离开你一会吧？

original: Why not study injuries on yourself? If it'd help, I could shoot you in the gut.
translation: 为什么不拿你自己的伤口做研究？要帮忙的话，我可以打穿你的内脏。

original: No, history is what losers become.
translation: 不，历史是输家堆积起来的。

original: You go right back and talk to those people and find out something so we can make sure others learn from their successes!
translation: 你马上回来，和那些人谈谈，发现些情况，那样我们就能保证其他人能从他们的成功中学习！

original: History is for losers. I'll do it later.
translation: 历史是为失败者而写的。稍后我会去找。

original: The trader who sold me that insisted it was a snap to use. Just plug it into the mainframe, and it should take care of the rest.
translation: 商人坚持说它使用很方便。只要把它接到主机上，剩下就不用管了。

original: Of course, if you played around with the systems after that, we'd probably learn even more. But you can deal with that when you get there.
translation: 当然，这之后如果你在主机上多搞搞，我们说不定能多了解些。等你到了那里后，自然会知道该怎么做。

original: Robots aren't really my style. I'll do it later.
translation: 我确实很不喜欢机器人。稍后我会去找。

original: No need to worry about that. It's got to be around - it's a government building, and they were all built to the highest construction standards!
translation: 不用担心那个。它肯定在附近 — 是一幢政府大楼，是按照最高的建筑标准盖的！

original: I could swear I read that in an old book somewhere, so it's got to be true!
translation: 我发誓我在一本旧书里面读到过，因此它肯定是真的！

original: What if the building was destroyed and I can't even find its remains?
translation: 如果那建筑被摧毁了，我连它的遗迹都找不到怎么办？

original: What better reward for avoiding explosives than to pay you with explosives? Frag grenades, in this case. I got a pretty good haul of them recently.
translation: 如果你能躲开炸弹，还有比送你炸弹更好的奖励吗？这一次给你破片手榴弹吧。我最近搞到一大堆。

original: And if you bring me back something to study, maybe I can make some modifications for you. Nothing like tinkering with a live mine, right?
translation: 要是你能带一些回来研究的话，或许我能帮你改进一下。没什么比拆一个即将起爆的炸弹更难的了，不是吗？

original: That seems kind of... unhealthy. How will you make it worth my while?
translation: 那好像有点……生命危险。你要怎样酬谢我？

original: Did you know, when bones break and re-heal, they grow back tougher? In a way, you'd be repaying yourself. Once I make sure you survive, of course.
translation: 你知道吗？骨折愈合后，它们能重新接上。从某种意义上说那就是你的奖励了。当然，是在我救下你的小命之后。

original: But in a more tangible way, I can give you a modified environmental suit of mine. How's that sound?
translation: 但有个更切实的办法，我能给你一套我的野外套装。怎么样？

original: What could possibly be worth breaking my bones over?
translation: 有什么值得我去伤筋动骨的？
