original: The obvious answer would be, "a book." But I guess there might not be any left there, so how about I pay you with good old-fashioned caps?
translation: 答案显然是“书”。但我估计那可能不剩什么了，所以我用老式的瓶盖支付给你怎么样？

original: Who knows what you could buy with all those caps? It could be anything. It could even be a book!
translation: 谁知道你能用那些瓶盖买些什么呢？什么都可以吧，甚至可以买本书！

original: What do I get for going to the library?
translation: 我要怎样到达图书馆？

original: Oh, don't worry so much about it. I'll be waiting here with a nice, tall glass of rad-cleansing brahmin milk for you when you get back.
translation: 哦，不用太担心。当你回来时，我会在一只精美的高脚玻璃杯里为你准备好没有放射性的双头牛奶的。

original: Well, mostly just a whole lot of Rad-X and Rad-Away. And maybe even a more reliable way to get rid of radiation! Assuming it works, of course.
translation: 嗯，大致就是一堆抗辐剂-X和辐特宁。或许能让你更可靠地摆脱辐射的困扰！当然，得在有效的情况下。

original: You want me to get irradiated? How could that possibly be worth it for me?
translation: 你要我身中辐射？我怎么知道这对我来说值不值得？

original: While you're working on that, I'll be following up on a lead I've got for a couple Stealth-Boys. When you're done, they're yours.
translation: 当你忙那件事的时候，我会用手头的线索搞几个隐身小子。等你把事情干完，它们就是你的了。

original: And who knows? Maybe we'll learn something useful from the Mirelurks.
translation: 谁又知道呢？或许我们能从泥沼蟹身上掌握到一些有用的东西。

original: Sneaking into a Mirelurk lair? The pay had better be worth it.
translation: 潜入泥沼蟹的巢穴？你的酬金最好值得我冒这个险。

original: Well, you'll be getting access to an army of robots. That ought to be reward enough, right? But if you insist, I could spare some pulse grenades.
translation: 唔，你会接触到一大队机器人的。这个报酬足够了，对吧？不过，如果你仍坚持的话，我可以分你几个脉冲手榴弹。

original: What's it worth to you?
translation: 你会为此付出什么？

original: There's my brave research assistant! Go out and get bashed up. For the good of mankind!
translation: 这才是我勇敢的研究助手！出去挨揍吧，为了人类的福祉！

original: Just make sure you stay alive and get back here! That's important! I can't stress that enough!
translation: 不过，要活着回来哦！那很重要！我反复强调喔！

original: Nothing beats a real-world example, they say. I'll get myself injured.
translation: 常言说的好，事必躬亲。我会让自己受伤的。

original: Wow, what a great research assistant you are! I mean really, that's dedication. Demonstrating how to withstand pain by getting injured? Wow.
translation: 哇哦，你是个多么了不起的研究助手啊！我是说真的，你很有奉献精神。通过受伤来验证对痛苦的承受力？哇哦。

original: When you're ready, come back here with some serious injuries, maybe a crippled limb or two, and I'll take notes and fix you up.
translation: 等你准备好，就带着一些严重的伤势回来，最好折条胳膊断个腿的，我会记录下来，然后把你修好。

original: I'll be waiting here with plenty of bandages for you. So don't worry, and just go get horribly injured. Oh, and be careful!
translation: 我会在这里准备好大量的绷带等着你回来。所以不用担心，尽量去受一些可怕的伤吧。哦，记得小心哦！

original: I guess I'll get hurt eventually. Might as well come here when I do.
translation: 我想我最终会受伤的。那时我就会回来。

original: Oh, don't worry. No one ever goes there because they say it's a ghost town. And since ghosts don't exist, you can just focus on the landmines.
translation: 哦，别担心。从来没有人去那里，因为他们说那是个鬼城。既然鬼不存在，那么你就专注于地雷吧。

original: I hear there's a playground in the middle of the town. Reach that point and come back, and I'm sure you'll have some stories to tell!
translation: 我听说在镇子中央有一块操场。到那个地点然后回来，我能肯定你有许多故事要讲！

original: I suppose, for the sake of proper research, I can go back into Minefield.
translation: 我想，为了研究的正确性，我能回到雷区。

original: Oh, don't worry. No one ever goes there because they say it's a ghost town. And since ghosts don't exist, you can just focus on the landmines.
translation: 哦，别担心。从来没有人去那里，因为他们说那是个鬼城。既然鬼不存在，那么你就专注于地雷吧。

original: I hear there's a playground in the middle of the town. Reach that point and come back, and I'm sure you'll have some stories to tell!
translation: 我听说在镇子中央有一块操场。到那个地点然后回来，我能肯定你有许多故事要讲！

original: I'll head into Minefield. Wish me luck.
translation: 我会闯入雷区的，祝我好运吧。

original: Great! The library should be in old Arlington, not far from downtown. See if you can download the archives from its computer.
translation: 好！图书馆应该位于阿灵顿，离市区不远。看你能否从那里的电脑上把档案下载回来。

original: If you can't get those, then even the card catalog would be useful. Any little piece of information could help the book. And thus, humanity!
translation: 如果你拿不到那些的话，那么卡片目录也是很有用的。任何一点情报都会有助于这本书，从而帮助人类！

original: Okay, I'll check out my local library.
translation: 好吧，我会检查当地的图书馆。

original: Now, that's the adventurous scientific spirit! Go on out there and get good and fried!
translation: 呐，这就是科学冒险精神！去吧，好好地被辐射一番！

original: Oh, but not so much that you can't come back. 200 rads should be enough to get a reading, although 600 or more would be more useful!
translation: 哦，不过还放射量不够的话，你是不能回来的。200的辐射量就足够做研究，不过达到600会更有用。

original: Trust me, I'll make sure you're okay! I've got some good ideas for a cure!
translation: 相信我，我会确保你没事的！我有许多治疗的好办法！

original: I suppose nothing beats a real-world example. I'll get myself irradiated.
translation: 我想没有什么比现实世界更有说服力了。我要让我自己被辐射。

original: Oh, you're a peach! Or, at least, some sort of hardy fruit that grows in the savagely irradiated mockery of agriculture we have nowadays.
translation: 哦，你就像个小桃子！或者，至少，是我们现今这蛮荒的辐射冒牌农业所种植的某种坚果……

original: Now, 200 rads should be enough for basic sickness, but if you can get 600 or more rads, my tests will be even more accurate.
translation: 现在，200的辐射量应该足够引起普通的病症了，但是如果你能达到600，我的测试就会更加精确。

original: Just make sure you can get back here, and I'll see to it that you're well taken care of!
translation: 只不过，要保证你能回到这来。我会帮你治疗的！

original: Okay, I'll get irradiated. Just be ready to fix me up when I get back.
translation: 好吧，我会被辐射的，你就等着我回来时治疗我。

original: That's great. I recommend the nest at the Anchorage War Memorial. I knew a trader who talked about the Mirelurks down there.
translation: 太棒了。我推荐位于安克雷奇战争纪念馆的巢穴。我听一个商人说有蟹人盘踞在那。

original: Just go inside and find one of their spawning pods, probably down near the water. Put this observer inside, and get out quietly.
translation: 只要进去，找到一个它们的卵囊就行了，或许会在水面附近。把这个监视器放进去，然后偷偷溜出来。

original: And be sure not to kill any Mirelurks inside their nest! If you do, it could ruin the validity of the study!
translation: 而且别在他们的巢里杀掉任何泥沼蟹！如果你这么做了，就可能破坏实验的效果！

original: All right, I'll try.
translation: 好吧，我会试试。

original: Yeah, you should just be able to plug it into the mainframe at the RobCo production facility. It'll give you access to the robots and terminals.
translation: 是呀，你要把它插进RobCo公司生产设施的电脑主机里，然后就能取得使用机器人和终端的权限。

original: Okay, here. And be sure to keep an eye peeled for any other examples of how to make old technology work for you out there!
translation: 好吧，给。还有，多注意下其他可利用的古老科技！

original: Just go in and connect the widget to the mainframe? I can do that.
translation: 也就是进去把这个小物件连接到主机？我能办到。

original: Hopefully, you'll be finding food and medicine, but I could sweeten the deal by paying more food when you get back, regardless of the results.
translation: 但愿你能找到食品和药物，不过无论结果如何，等你回来的时候，我都会额外给你些食物的。

original: While you're away, I can at least search through my junk and see if there's anything that'll go with old food to make it more appetizing.
translation: 你离开的期间，我至少可以翻翻我的破烂堆，看看有没有什么东西能把过期食品变得好吃些。

original: What's the pay?
translation: 报酬怎么样？

original: Don't worry about the chemicals. I handled them all the time while experimenting, and I'm perfectly fine, aren't I?
translation: 别担心那些化学品。做实验的时候我整天和它们泡在一起，现在我不是也好好的？

original: How about I let you have the leftover chems I used to make it? Heck, do a thorough job, and maybe I'll let you keep the repellent itself.
translation: 不如我把制造它用剩的化学品都给你吧？哎，把工作完成，或许我就把驱虫剂送你了。

original: I don't know if handling weird chemicals is safe. What's it worth to you?
translation: 我不知道摆弄奇怪的化学药品是否安全。这对你来说有什么价值？

original: You mean, apart from making sure we don't repeat our tragic failures in a never-ending cavalcade of human pathos and suffering?
translation: 你的意思是说，除了确保我们不会重复在人类无尽的痛苦和哀号之中失败？

original: Let's say... A big pile of Mentats. I got a shipment of those in recently. Do a good job, and maybe the people of Rivet City will reward you, too.
translation: 这么说吧……一大堆曼他特。我近来搞到了一批。干得漂亮的话干，或许铆钉城的人也会给你报酬。

original: What's the value of digging up history?
translation: 考究历史到底有什么价值？

original: Oh, great! Food is most important, but see if you can get medicine, too. And if there's nothing to find, then just come back in one piece, okay?
translation: 哦，真好！食物最重要，不过也看看你能否搞到药品吧。如果找不到什么东西，就平安回来，好吧？

original: I guess I can check the Super-Duper Mart again.
translation: 我想我能再查看一下顶好超市。

original: Oh, great! Food is most important, but see if you can get medicine, too. And if there's nothing to find, then just come back in one piece, okay?
translation: 哦，真好！食物最重要，不过也看看你能否搞到药品吧。如果找不到什么东西，就平安回来，好吧？

original: Okay, I'll check the Super-Duper Mart.
translation: 好吧，我会去查看顶好超市的。

original: It'll be easy. One tap with the applicator, and it overwhelms their senses with a sort of "feel-bad" sensation. Then they're gone before you know it!
translation: 很简单。被这棍子碰一下，就会让它们的感官充满“非常糟”的感受。然后它们一转眼就会溜走！

original: You could test it out on just a few Mole Ratties, but for real testing, try it on ten or more. There should be plenty in the Tepid Sewers, downtown.
translation: 你可以先拿少量地鼠试试看，但真正测试时，你至少需要十个地鼠。在市区的湿热的下水道应该有很多。

original: I'll test out the Repellent for you.
translation: 我会为你测试这个驱鼠剂。

original: Oh, now I can't wait for what you find out down there! And check around to make sure you're hearing the real deal!
translation: 哦，我可等不及你在那儿会发现什么了！多转转，确保找出真相！

original: Sounds reasonable. I'll research Rivet City's history.
translation: 听起来合乎情理。我会去调查铆钉城的历史。

original: I have something to say to you, Bittercup.
translation: 我有些事儿要对你说，“苦杯”。

original: Oh, yeah, what is it? Um, not that I care what you think.
translation: 哦，什么事？嗯，我可不在乎你怎么想。

original: Why don't you seem to care about what's going on around here?
translation: 为什么你似乎对周围的情况漠不关心呢？

original: I dunno. What does it matter anyway? We're all going to be mutant chow eventually.
translation: 不知道。又有什么关系呢？我们终究会成为变种人的食物。

original: And what do you know?! You wastelanders and your dirty clothes and roughed up faces! YOU look like a serial killer!
translation: 你又知道些什么？！你这废土游民，浑身脏衣服，一张糙脸！你看起来倒更像个连环杀手！

original: You're not ... uh, seeing anyone right now. Are you?
translation: 你现在没……呃，在和谁约会吧。是吧？

original: Wait, what? Did you just hit on me?
translation: 住手，干嘛？你刚刚打了我吧？

original: Oh, um, well. I need to get going, but come back and visit me sometime, okay?
translation: 哦，嗯，我必须走了，不过你以后再来看我吧，好吗？

original: I'm not even going to tell you what's wrong with that question...
translation: 我甚至不想告诉你刚才的问题有什么不对的……

original: Oh, um, well. I need to get going, but come back and visit me sometime, okay?
translation: 哦，嗯，这个。我必须走了，不过你以后再来看我吧，好吗？

original: Why, no. I'm not in any sort of relationship. Are you?
translation: 啊呀，没。我没有什么牵挂。你呢？

original: Oh, um, well. I need to get going, but come back and visit me sometime, okay?
translation: 哦，嗯，这个。我必须走了，不过你以后再来看我吧，好吗？

original: Give me my marching orders, sir.
translation: 长官，给我行进指令。

original: I want you to change how close you follow me.
translation: 我要你改变与我之间的距离。

original: If you don't mind me saying, you look different from everyone else.
translation: 如果你不介意的话，我想说，你看起来和其他人不太一样哦。

original: Really? I mean... good. No one wants to look like the boring slobs in this town, anyway.
translation: 真的？我意思是……好啊。而且，这镇上没人希望自己看着像个无聊的笨蛋。

original: Besides, if we're all going to die here, I at least want my corpse to look better than these inane wastelanders.
translation: 再说了，如果我们真的会全死在这，至少我也得让自己的尸体比那些空虚的废土游民好看些。

original: I like your makeup. The pale-white really reflects the lighting.
translation: 妆化得不错！苍白的颜色都能反光了。

original: That's why I never go out during the day. The moon has such a better shine to it than the sun.
translation: 这就是我从不在白天外出的原因。月光比日光柔和多了。

original: I like corpses. Especially if they're full of holes... that I put in them.
translation: 我喜欢尸体。特别是那些有很多弹孔的 — 还得是被我打的。

original: You're not ... uh, seeing anyone right now. Are you?
translation: 你现在没……呃，在和谁约会吧。是吧？

original: You need to set yourself apart from the mold. Then people will respect you.
translation: 你必须让自己脱颖而出，那样人们才会敬重你。

original: You're not ... uh, seeing anyone right now. Are you?
translation: 你现在没……呃，在和谁约会吧。是吧？

original: That's the dumbest thing I've ever heard. Survival goes before style.
translation: 那是我听过的最愚蠢的事。活命比时尚更重要。

original: And what do you know?! You wastelanders and your dirty clothes and roughed up faces! YOU look like a serial killer!
translation: 你又知道些什么？！你这废土游民，浑身脏衣服，一张糙脸！你看起来倒更像个连环杀手！

original: You're not ... uh, seeing anyone right now. Are you?
translation: 你现在没……呃，在和谁约会吧。是吧？

original: I'm a night person myself. The darkness conceals my... activities.
translation: 本人是个夜猫子。黑暗掩盖了我的……活动。

original: You're not ... uh, seeing anyone right now. Are you?
translation: 你现在没……呃，在和谁约会吧。是吧？

original: Moons are nice. The calm nights of the Wastes are a great time to relax.
translation: 月光多美好！废土宁静的夜晚总是放松的好机会。

original: You're not ... uh, seeing anyone right now. Are you?
translation: 你现在没……呃，在和谁约会吧。是吧？

original: I was being sarcastic. That white makeup is like painting a target on your head.
translation: 我这人爱挖苦。白色的化妆品跟在你头上画个靶子没什么区别。

original: And what do you know?! You wastelanders and your dirty clothes and roughed up faces! YOU look like a serial killer!
translation: 你又知道些什么？！你这废土游民，浑身脏衣服，一张糙脸！你看起来倒更像个连环杀手！

original: You're not ... uh, seeing anyone right now. Are you?
translation: 你现在没……呃，在和谁约会吧。是吧？

original: Actually, never mind. There's something else I need to know.
translation: 实际上，没关系。我想知道些别的东西。

original: Ugh, hurry up. I have poetry I need to write. Dark poetry.
translation: 呃，快点。我还要写诗呢。黑暗之诗。

original: So you knew my mother?
translation: 你认识我母亲？

original: Yes, I did. I'm sorry that you never had time with her.
translation: 对，我认识。很抱歉，她没能陪你就走了……

original: She was... She was a good woman. We didn't always agree, but I respected her work as a scientist.
translation: 她……她是个好女人。虽然我们的意见有时相左，但我尊重她作为一个科学家的工作。

original: Your father... He loved her very much.
translation: 你父亲……他非常爱她。

original: Heard anything juicy about the neighbors?
translation: 听见邻居们什么有趣的消息了？

original: What's the good word?
translation: 有什么好消息？

original: Got any plans for today?
translation: 今天有什么计划没？

original: Why - I do believe you've lost your mind! Ghouls, living here? You're serious?
translation: 为什么 — 我想你一定是疯了吧！僵尸？住在这？你认真的？

original: There are some Ghouls who want to live here. What do you think about that?
translation: 有一些僵尸想要住在这里，你怎么看？

original: Forget it. I'm in the wrong place.
translation: 算了。我找错地方了。

original: I'm sorry, as per Protocol NC-62, all employees must be their designated areas at all times.
translation: 我很抱歉，根据NC-62协议，所有员工必须始终待在指定的区域内。

original: I'm sorry. You have now exceeded 2 demerits. Now instituting Expulsion Protocol KL-001.
translation: 很抱歉。你已超过2次记过。现在开始执行驱逐协议KL-001。

original: I'm sorry, as per Protocol NC-62, all employees must be their designated areas at all times.
translation: 我很抱歉，根据NC-62协议，所有员工必须始终待在指定的区域内。

original: One demerit will now be issued. Note that further demerits can cause your expulsion from this job posting.
translation: 现在记过一次。请注意，再记过可能导致你被从当前岗位开除。

original: I'm John-Caleb Bradberton. I don't need an ID number. I own this place!
translation: 我是约翰-卡勒布·布拉德伯顿。我不需要身份编号。我拥有这地方！

original: The name is verified in my system with no existing or issued employee number. Voice stress pattern within normal parameters.
translation: 姓名已在我系统内核实，没有现存或已发放的员工编号。声音压力模式在正常范围内。

original: Executive override protocol initiated. What may I do for you on this wonderfully productive day?
translation: 高管超驰协议启动。在这高效充实的一天里，我能为您做些什么呢？

original: My posting is Shipping Clerk and my number is NCSD-701G.
translation: 我的岗位是出货员，编号是NCSD-701G。

original: Logged and verified. Thank you very much for your cooperation.
translation: 已记录并核实。非常感谢您的配合。

original: What may I do for you on this wonderfully productive day?
translation: 在这高效充实的一天里，我能为您做些什么呢？

original: My posting is Nuka-Cola R&D and my number is 987065. <Lie.>
translation: 我的岗位是核子可乐研发，我的编号是987065。<撒谎>

original: I have no record of that posting, nor does that employee identification number follow the proper format.
translation: 我没有该岗位的记录，而且该员工编号也不符合正确的格式。

original: I'm sorry. You have now exceeded 2 demerits. Now instituting Expulsion Protocol KL-001.
translation: 很抱歉。你已超过2次记过。现在开始执行驱逐协议KL-001。

original: I have no record of that posting, nor does that employee identification number follow the proper format.
translation: 我没有该岗位的记录，而且该员工编号也不符合正确的格式。

original: One demerit will now be issued. Note that further demerits can cause your expulsion from this job posting.
translation: 现在记过一次。请注意，再记过可能导致你被从当前岗位开除。

original: As previously stated, please identify yourself.
translation: 如前所述，请表明你的身份。

original: My posting title is Ass Kicker and my number is 5.56 mm!
translation: 我的岗位是“爆操王”，我的编号是5.56mm！

original: Use of profanity and attempting to falsify an employee identification number is a violation of Protocols NC-68 and NC-90 respectively.
translation: 使用粗俗语言以及试图伪造员工编号分别违反了NC-68和NC-90协议。

original: I'm sorry. You have now exceeded 2 demerits. Now instituting Expulsion Protocol KL-001.
translation: 很抱歉。你已超过2次记过。现在开始执行驱逐协议KL-001。

original: Use of profanity and attempting to falsify an employee identification number is a violation of Protocols NC-68 and NC-90 respectively.
translation: 使用粗俗语言以及试图伪造员工编号分别违反了NC-68和NC-90协议。

original: Two demerits will now be issued. Note that further demerits can cause your expulsion from this job posting.
translation: 你已被记过两次，注意，如果你再次犯错的话，就有可能导致你被清除出这个工作岗位。

original: I don't have that information.
translation: 我没有那些信息。

original: I'm sorry, as per Protocol NC-77, this information must be readily accessible at all times.
translation: 我很抱歉，根据NC-77号协议，这些信息必须随时可供查询。

original: I'm sorry. You have now exceeded 2 demerits. Now instituting Expulsion Protocol KL-001.
translation: 很抱歉。你已超过2次记过。现在开始执行驱逐协议KL-001。

original: I'm sorry, as per Protocol NC-77, this information must be readily accessible at all times.
translation: 我很抱歉，根据NC-77号协议，这些信息必须随时可供查询。

original: One demerit will now be issued. Note that further demerits can cause your expulsion from this job posting.
translation: 现在记过一次。请注意，再记过可能导致你被从当前岗位开除。

original: As previously stated, please identify yourself.
translation: 如前所述，请表明你的身份。

original: I'm looking for the factory's shipping manifests.
translation: 我在寻找工厂的货运清单。

original: That information is in the Shipping Computer Terminal. The pass code for the terminal is NC-C1864.
translation: 该信息在货运电脑终端中。终端的密码是NC-C1864。

original: Oh boo hoo. People die all the time.
translation: 哭吧。每时每刻都有人死亡。

original: Well! That's the most insulting thing anyone has ever said to me!
translation: 从没有人这么污辱过我！

original: Here I offer my hospitality and you spit it right back in my face.
translation: 我热情款待你，你却如此的不识好歹。

original: Any information you could give me on the caves below Oasis would be helpful.
translation: 关于绿洲下方的洞穴，你能提供的任何信息都将对我有所帮助。

original: Oasis is located near what used to be an old mining town before the bombs fell.
translation: 绿洲在的地方，核弹落下前，那附近曾是一座古老的矿业小镇。

original: When the attacks started about 200 years ago, many people took shelter in the natural caves that dotted the area.
translation: 大约200年前攻击开始时，许多人躲进了该地区星罗棋布的天然洞穴中。

original: The old gate that stands at the mouth of Oasis Cave is the last piece of architecture from those days.
translation: 耸立在绿洲洞穴的那扇古老大门，是那个时代最后仅存的建筑物了。

original: Just like a cancer would infest our bodies, the caves below us are infested with vermin.
translation: 就像癌症在侵嗜我们的身体一样，洞里的寄生虫也多得成灾。

original: You'd do well to be cautious down there, we've lost a few Treeminders in the past.
translation: 你下去后最好小心些，之前我们已经损失了几个树启者。

original: If the Great One knows you to be worthy of his grace, he will allow you to pass through to his heart.
translation: 如果圣贤觉得你是个值得一见的人，他会允许你通过并到达他的心脏。

original: Be wary of the water in the caves, I fear they still carry the sting of radiation from the bombs.
translation: 小心洞中的水，我担心它们仍带有核弹的放射性危害。

original: My parents told me never to go past the old gate... there are monsters in there!
translation: 我父母告诉我绝不要越过那扇旧大门……里面有怪物！

original: Sure. Here you go. Good luck to you!
translation: 当然。给你。祝你好运!

original: May I have the key to the caves?
translation: 可以给我进入洞穴的钥匙吗？

original: Leave it to good old Bob to get me stuck above some caves. Now my dang feet are cold!
translation: 都怪老鲍勃，害我被困在这些洞穴上。现在我那倒霉的脚好冷！

original: I have some quick questions about those caves.
translation: 对于那洞穴，我有些小问题。

original: Your names are quite strange. What do they mean?
translation: 你们的名字相当奇怪。它们是什么意思？

original: The first part of our name represents our role in the Treeminders. The youngest are the Saplings, still learning what it means to live in Oasis.
translation: 我们的名字的第一个部分代表了我们在树启者中的角色。最年轻的叫树苗，仍然在学习在绿洲生活的意义。

original: The Branchtenders are our guardians and keep our homes safe. Our healers and soothsayers are known as Bloomseers.
translation: 护枝人是我们的保护人，并且保护我们家园的安全。我们的愈疗者和预言家叫作卜花大师。

original: Finally, the Tree Father and the Leaf Mother are the creators and the upholders of the Great One's laws.
translation: 最终，“树之父”和“叶之母”是圣贤的法律的创造者和维护者。

original: You say you saw me coming to Oasis. And you call the Treeminders crazy...
translation: 你说你看到我朝绿洲走来。并且你说那些护树人疯了……

original: You have a point there. Maybe I'm just losing my marbles from all this boredom.
translation: 你这话有道理。也许是因为太过无聊，我都有点神志不清了。

original: I swear if I try real hard, I can see all around me like my eyes are in every leaf on every tree.
translation: 我发誓，只要我使劲儿集中注意力，我就能看见周围的一切，仿佛我的眼睛在每一棵树的每一片叶子上。

original: I think it's making Bob kind of jealous, cause he was the first tree in my life and all that.
translation: 我想这让鲍勃有点嫉妒，因为他是我生命中的第一棵树，诸如此类的原因吧。

original: See me coming? That's not possible.
translation: 看见我过来？那不可能。

original: I'm telling you, it is possible, or maybe I'm just losing my mind from all this boredom.
translation: 我告诉你，是可能的，要不就是我只是因为无聊到发疯了。

original: I swear if I try real hard, I can see all around me like my eyes are in every leaf on every tree.
translation: 我发誓，只要我使劲儿集中注意力，我就能看见周围的一切，仿佛我的眼睛在每一棵树的每一片叶子上。

original: I think it's making Bob kind of jealous, cause he was the first tree in my life and all that.
translation: 我想这让鲍勃有点嫉妒，因为他是我生命中的第一棵树，诸如此类的原因吧。

original: Seeing me approach Oasis is quite a feat for a living tree.
translation: 对于一棵活着的树来说，能看到我朝绿洲走来，这可真了不起。

original: Maybe I'm just losing my mind from all this boredom, but I swear if I try I can see all around me like my eyes are in every leaf on every tree.
translation: 也许我只是因为无聊到发疯了，但我发誓，只要我试着这么做，我就能看见周围的一切，仿佛我的眼睛在每一棵树的每一片叶子上。

original: I think it's making Bob kind of jealous, cause he was the first tree in my life and all that.
translation: 我想这让鲍勃有点嫉妒，因为他是我生命中的第一棵树，诸如此类的原因吧。

original: If people thought I was a god, I'd exploit it for all it's worth!
translation: 要是人们把我当成神，我肯定会充分利用这一点，榨取所有价值！

original: Hey, I thought that too... at first.
translation: 嘿，一开始我也这么想……

original: I had them sing me songs, I made them do stupid dances and things like that. Bob even told me to make Maple stand on his head for a whole day!
translation: 我让他们给我唱歌，让他们跳些愚蠢的舞蹈之类的。鲍勃甚至还让我命令梅坡倒立一整天！

original: After a while though, it just gets boring. Then it becomes a nuisance and now it's completely driving me nuts!
translation: 但过了一阵子，就觉得无聊了。接着就成了一种烦扰，而现在，这简直要把我逼疯了！

original: When I saw you coming towards Oasis, I thought I felt that you'd understand me. I guess I was wrong.
translation: 当我看到你朝绿洲走来时，我原以为你能理解我。看来是我想错了。

original: I understand what you mean.
translation: 我理解你的意思。

original: I knew you would. That's why I picked you when I saw you coming.
translation: 我就知道你会懂。所以看到你走来的时候，我就选中了你。

original: Hey, life is a gift. Even if it lasts a long time, be glad you have it!
translation: 嘿，生命是份礼物。哪怕它漫长无期，你也该为拥有它而感到庆幸！

original: I've tried to stay happy, really I have. Bloomseer Poplar thinks I'll live for hundreds of years... maybe even more!
translation: 我努力让自己保持乐观，真的。“花先知”波普勒认为我能活好几百年……甚至更久！

original: Can you imagine THAT? Stuck here for centuries? I can't do it, I just want to be alone. Just me and Bob until the end.
translation: 你是想象吗？在这里困上几个世纪？我做不到，我只想独自待着。到最后，就只有我和鲍勃相伴。

original: When I saw you coming towards Oasis, I thought I felt that you'd understand me. I guess I was wrong.
translation: 当我看到你朝绿洲走来时，我原以为你能理解我。看来是我想错了。

original: You don't actually seem that sad. Why do you want to die?
translation: 你看上去其实没那么哀伤。为什么想要去死呢？

original: I've been literally rooted to this spot thanks to Bob for maybe twenty or thirty years... I can't even remember anymore.
translation: 因为鲍勃，我已经在这里扎扎实实待了二三十年了……我甚至都记不清多久了。

original: Can you imagine being stuck in one place for that long not being able to eat or to read or to sleep or anything?
translation: 你能想像被困在一个地方那么久，没法吃饭、没法读书、没法睡觉，什么都做不了吗？

original: In the meantime, I have these Treeminders bothering me every day about things I don't even care about. I can't stand it anymore.
translation: 与此同时，那些护树人每天都拿些我根本不在乎的事情来烦我，我实在是忍无可忍了！

original: Is there anything down there to look out for?
translation: 下面有什么需要注意的东西吗？

original: Sometimes I feel stuff tickling me, but I think that's just Bob getting back at me for all the times I called him Herbert.
translation: 有时候我感觉有东西在挠我，但我觉得那只是鲍勃在报复我老是叫他赫伯特。

original: How do I get into the caves?
translation: 我怎么进入洞穴？

original: I think the best way for you to get down there would be to get the key from the one those loonies call "Cypress."
translation: 我觉得你下去的最佳办法，是从那群疯子口中的“赛普拉斯”那里拿到钥匙。

original: There's supposed to be some old gate or something back in the other grove.
translation: 在另一片树林里应该有一扇旧大门之类的东西。

original: How did this all happen, Reilly?
translation: 这是怎么发生的，莱莉？

original: We were mapping the Vernon Square part of the downtown ruins and got jumped by a Super Mutant ambush party.
translation: 我们当时正在前往市区废墟的弗农广场部分，结果遭遇了一群埋伏在那的超级变种人。

original: Usually it isn't a problem, but this group was bigger than usual. We fought our way into Our Lady of Hope Hospital, hoping to find cover.
translation: 通常来说，这不算什么，但这次的队伍比通常庞大。我们杀出了一条通往玛利亚医院的路来，希望能够找到掩护。

original: Eventually the fight spilled into the Statesman Hotel and we ran all the way to the roof.
translation: 最后战斗打到了政要酒店，我们就一路跑到了楼顶。

original: I left my guys up there and tried to stealth out but got caught by a Mutie ambush patrol. That was the last thing I remember.
translation: 我把我的人留在那里，并且试图溜出来，但被一支变种人巡逻队逮住了。那就是我所记得的最后一件事。

original: Oh, it's been centuries. The planet is a lush, green paradise once again.
translation: 哦，都几个世纪了。这个星球将再次变成了繁华的绿色天堂。

original: Huh? What the hell are you talking about? That isn't very funny.
translation: 呃？你他妈在说什么？这一点都不好笑。

original: If my guys were here, they'd kick your...
translation: 如果我的人在这，他们会踢你的…

original: Oh shit! My team! What the hell happened?
translation: 该死！我的队伍！他妈的发生了什么事？

original: What difference does it make?
translation: 这又有什么区别呢？

original: Well, I don't know actually. Kind of confused.
translation: 我真的不知道。有点晕。

original: Wait! Oh shit!
translation: 等等！见鬼！

original: My men... my team! What happened to them?
translation: 我的人……我的队伍！他们怎么样了？

original: Not long, fortunately.
translation: 时间不长，运气不错。

original: Right... can't remember what I was doing.
translation: 对……想不起来我当时正在做些什么。

original: Wait! Oh shit!
translation: 等等！见鬼！

original: My men... my team! What happened to them?
translation: 我的人……我的队伍！他们怎么样了？

original: Okay, thanks. Got to go.
translation: 好啊，谢谢。得走了。

original: No problem, just don't disturb the patients.
translation: 没问题，只是别打扰病人。

original: She your new toy, zombie?
translation: 她是你的新玩具，丧尸？

original: That kind of talk is uncalled for. I was, am and always will be a doctor of medicine.
translation: 这种说法是不当的。我曾经，并且永远都是医学博士。

original: I don't care if she was a Super Mutant. I'd still help her.
translation: 我不在乎她是否是个超级变种人，我仍然会帮助她。

original: If they hauled your sorry, shot-up body into my clinic, I'd try and save you too.
translation: 如果他们把你那可怜而伤痕累累的身体拖到我的诊所里来，我也同样会试着救你命的。

original: Tara's dead. Crowley fucked up and got her killed. Fucking ghoul. When I'm done, he'll sniff butts with the ferals for the rest of his life.
translation: 塔拉死了。考利闯了祸，害死了她。那混蛋僵尸。等我事成后，他这辈子就跟那些凶悍僵尸待在一起吧。

original: Your "Republic" is a joke, and your presidency is a farce. You need to die.
translation: 你的“共和国”是个笑话，你的总统职务更是一出滑稽剧。你该去死。

original: What! How dare you! I'm going to have you executed.
translation: 什么！好大的胆子！我要将你处死。

original: Help! Your president is being attacked!
translation: 救命！你们的总统被攻击了！

original: How did all of you meet?
translation: 你们大家怎么认识的？

original: Tenpenny hired us as mercs. He wanted some fancy fucking gun.
translation: 特佩尼雇用我们当佣兵。他妈的是想要个好枪手。

original: Don't know how he got Crowley to sign on. Tenpenny fucking hates Ghouls.
translation: 不知道他怎么让考利加入了。特佩尼最他妈恨僵尸了。

original: So it was just you and Mister Crowley?
translation: 所以，那就只有你和考利先生？

original: Ha, ha! No, clown shoes. Tenpenny hired a whole fucking team.
translation: 哈，哈！不，可笑的家伙。特佩尼雇用了他妈的一整队。

original: Strayer, Crowley, Tara, Dave and me. Tara had a pair on her! Sweet Jesus they were nice. Ha, ha!
translation: 斯崔尔、考利、塔拉、戴夫和我。塔拉还有对大胸！天啦，那太美妙了。哈，哈！

original: That place fucked her up more than I did. The rest of us went our separate ways after that.
translation: 那地方比我把她搞得惨多了。在那之后，我们剩下的人就分道扬镳了。

original: Let's just get this over with.
translation: 我们把这搞定吧。

original: I'm glad you've chosen to see reason.
translation: 我很高兴您选择了讲道理。

original: Again, I present you with a simple little job. The Rockwells have a seemingly happy marriage. I'd like you to put an end to it.
translation: 我再给你提供个轻松而简单的工作。罗克韦尔夫妇的婚姻似乎很美满。我希望你结束它。

original: The only caveat is that you may not kill either of them in the process. I look forward to seeing what you're capable of.
translation: 唯一的限制是在整个过程中你不可以杀害他们中的任何一个。我等着看你有多大能耐了。

original: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Calm down, there. Amata's not in any danger.
translation: 哇哦，哇哦，哇哦！冷静。阿玛塔没有任何危险。

original: I mean, we're all in a sort of a rough patch, but we've weathered worse.
translation: 我的意思是，我们全都陷入了困境，可我们经历过更困难的情况。

original: But, sorry to say... If you're back, there's going to be trouble with some folks. And if Amata's wrapped up in it, there'll be trouble for her, too.
translation: 但是，很抱歉这么说……如果你回来，某些人就麻烦了。而且如果阿玛塔卷进来，她也会有麻烦。

original: Where the hell is Amata? So help me, if you've hurt her...
translation: 阿玛塔到底在哪？你要是伤害了她，我可不客气……

original: You ain't allowed up there, you hear me? Go any farther and you're a dead man. I ain't warning you twice.
translation: 你不准上去，听见没？多走一步，你就死定了。我不会再警告你第二次。

original: You ain't allowed up there, you hear me? Take one more step and they'll be scraping you off the pavement. Ain't gonna warn you again.
translation: 你不准上去，听见没？再迈一步他们就会把你拽下来。不会再次警告你的。

original: No, I haven't. Say, does that hurt?
translation: 不，我没有。我是说，疼吗？

original: No, it tickles. Everyone's got to be a comedian.
translation: 不，它很可笑。难道每个人都是喜剧演员吗。

original: Say, for someone who hasn't seen many Ghouls before, you don't seem too bothered.
translation: 我说，对于以前没怎么见过僵尸的人来说，你似乎并不担心啊。

original: I could use someone like you. How would you feel about working for a Ghoul?
translation: 我可以雇用你这样的人。你觉得帮僵尸做事怎么样？

original: <Morse Code Clicking>
translation: <敲击摩斯密码>

original: <Morse Code Clicking>
translation: <敲击摩斯密码>

original: <Morse Code Clicking>
translation: <敲击摩斯密码>

original: <Morse Code Clicking>
translation: <敲击摩斯密码>

original: <Morse Code Clicking>
translation: <敲击摩斯密码>

original: <Morse Code Clicking>
translation: <敲击摩斯密码>

original: You "want to look around?" Where the hell do you think you are? Stop wasting my time, asshole.
translation: 你“想要四处看看？”你以为你他妈的在哪？别浪费我的时间了，混蛋。

original: I won't cause any trouble. I just want to look around.
translation: 我不想惹麻烦。我只是随便看看。

original: You "want to look around?" Where the hell do you think you are? Stop wasting my time, asshole.
translation: 你“想要四处看看？”你以为你他妈的在哪？别浪费我的时间了，混蛋。

original: I won't cause any trouble. I just want to look around.
translation: 我不想惹麻烦。我只是随便看看。

original: There's two kinds of people who get into Paradise Falls. Slaves and Slavers.
translation: 能进入堕落天堂的只有两种人：奴隶和奴隶贩子。

original: So, unless you're looking to become a slave, piss off.
translation: 因此，除非你想成为一个奴隶，否则滚开。

original: Why can't I go up there?
translation: 为什么我不能去那？

original: There's two kinds of people who get into Paradise Falls. Slaves and Slavers.
translation: 能进入堕落天堂的只有两种人：奴隶和奴隶贩子。

original: So, unless you're looking to become a slave, piss off.
translation: 因此，除非你想成为一个奴隶，否则滚开。

original: Why can't I go up there?
translation: 为什么我不能去那？

original: I think it would be good for the Republic, Mister President.
translation: 我认为这有益于共和国，总统先生。

original: Of course it would. I knew that. You heard me say that before, didn't you. It was my idea after all. Here, take it.
translation: 当然会，我知道。之前你也听我说过，对吧？毕竟那是我的主意。给，拿着它。

original: Your audience is over.
translation: 你的晋见时间结束了。

original: Are you sure I can't just have that key, handsome? You know, as a present?
translation: 我真的不能得到那把钥匙吗，帅哥？就当作是礼物好吗？

original: For you, sweet cheeks? Sure thing!
translation: 为了你，甜心？当然可以！

original: Now, how about I show you how I keep my two bitches happy all night long?
translation: 现在，不如我让你体验一下我让那两个婊子快活一夜的绝活吧？

original: How about I let you live, and you give me something so I can lie to Crowley?
translation: 我会让你活着，你给我一些东西，好让我去向考利交差？

original: Just give me the key. Don't ask why.
translation: 给我钥匙，不要多问。

original: Okay, dude, Don't have a cow. Here, take it.
translation: 好吧，老兄，别发脾气。给，拿去吧。

original: Okay, dude, Don't have a cow. Here, take it all.
translation: 好吧，老兄，别发脾气。给，都拿去吧。

original: Just give me all your stuff. And don't ask any questions.
translation: 把你所有的东西都给我，别问为什么。

original: You want to kill humans? I thought it would just be Ghouls. No way.
translation: 你想要杀人类？我还以为只是尸鬼呢。没门。

original: Watch the attitude, human. Right here, right now, there are more of us than there are of you.
translation: 注意态度，人类。此时此地，我们的人可比你们的多。

original: Maybe. I don't know if I trust you.
translation: 可能吧，我不知道自己是否信任你。

original: The feeling's mutual, smoothskin. But that never stopped a business deal.
translation: 这种感觉是相互的，光皮肤。但是那从来没有阻断过商业交易。

original: A lot of you humans are bigots. You don't like Ghouls and treat us like zombies, calling us brain eaters and shufflers.
translation: 很多人类都是偏执狂。你们讨厌僵尸，像对待丧尸一样对待我们，还把我们叫作食脑者和瘸子。

original: Well, they're going to pay. Uh...before I get into the details, you don't have anything against killing do you?
translation: 他们将会付出代价。喔……在我谈论细节之前，我先问问，你对杀人没什么异议吧？ ?

original: I don't need to stay here and listen to your lame insults.
translation: 我干嘛要待在这里听你那蹩脚的侮辱。

original: That's it. Run away like a smoothskin coward.
translation: 就这样。像一个懦弱的光皮肤一样逃跑吧。

original: I don't need some old clothes you found. Time to die, freak.
translation: 我不需要你发现的那些旧衣服。去死期吧，怪胎。

original: Well, please give the clothes to someone who needs them.
translation: 请把衣服给那些需要它们的人吧。

original: I'm sorry for annoying you. Maybe it's best that I leave you now.
translation: 很抱歉惹恼了你。或许我最好立刻离开。

original: You don't seem to understand. I'm robbing you.
translation: 你看起来还没明白 — 我是在抢劫你。

original: No, you're not. I want you to take it as a gift. I meant to give it to you anyway.
translation: 不，你不是。我希望你能把它作为礼物收下。我本来就是要送你的。

original: Have you ever watched the moon rise over the Wasteland? I only wish I had something as wonderful as that to give you.
translation: 你有没有观看过月亮在废土升起？我只期望我有那般美妙的东西送给你。

original: Um. Thanks.
translation: 嗯。谢谢你。

original: I know it isn't much, but it's all I have.
translation: 我知道这不多，但我只有这些。

original: Have you ever watched the moon rise over the Wasteland? I wish I could have given you something as wonderful as that.
translation: 你有没有观看过月亮在废土升起？我只期望我有那般美妙的东西送给你。

original: Give me everything you've got and I might let you live.
translation: 把你的东西都交出来，或许我会留你一条小命。

original: I'm sorry, I've been a poor host. Please, take this. It isn't much, but I want you to have it.
translation: 很抱歉，我已经一贫如洗了。拿着这个吧。我知道这不多，但我还是希望你收下。

original: How'd you get the name Uncle Leo?
translation: 你是怎么得到利奥大叔的这名字的？

original: I don't know. I've always called myself that.
translation: 我不知道。我总是这样称呼自己。

original: Maybe it was my name before I became... this. Maybe I read it in a book a long time ago.
translation: 可能这是在我成为……这样之前的名字吧。要么就是我很久以前在书中读到过的名字。

original: I just wanted to get a good look at your ugly mug before I blew it away.
translation: 我只是在把你那丑脸蹦飞之前好好看看它。

original: Don't worry, I'm not offended. I know that I am a hideous monstrosity, fit only to be hunted down and killed.
translation: 别担心，我不在乎。我知道自己是个丑八怪，就该被搜捕和猎杀。

original: A talking Super Mutant? What next, a dog on a bicycle?
translation: 一个会说话的超级变种人？接下来会是什么？一只骑着自行车的狗？

original: Ah, you joke with me. I understand. A dog on a bicycle would be laughable, ridiculous, just like me.
translation: 啊，你嘲笑我。我明白。一只骑着自行车的狗应该会很有趣、很可笑，就像我一样。

original: Who are you? I've never met a friendly Super Mutant before.
translation: 你是谁？我之前从未见过友善的超级变种人。

original: I was driven out by my brothers.
translation: 我被我的兄弟驱逐出来了。

original: I tried to get them to understand that there was more to life than fighting and killing, but they wouldn't listen.
translation: 我设法使他们了解生活不仅仅是打斗和杀戮，但是他们不听。

original: Now I wander the Wasteland, hoping to find some meaning to life before I die.
translation: 现在，我在废土流浪着，希望能在有生之年发现一些生命的真缔。

original: Trade? This place is empty. What, are you a prostitute or something?
translation: 交易？这地方空空如也。怎么，难道你是妓女什么的……？

original: That's disgusting! I'm old enough to be your grandmother. I won't have that kind of talk in this house.
translation: 真讨厌！我都能当你的祖母了。我不会在这房子里进行那种谈话。

original: I play songs on my homemade violin and people trade me goods. Sellbaby, indeed!
translation: 我用自制的小提琴演奏，而人们拿东西和我交换。就是如此！

original: If not in person, I play it over my husband's old radio set. The men in the caravan say it keeps their morale up on lonely nights in the Wasteland.
translation: 不亲自演出的时候，我会使用我丈夫那个老电台。商队都说那音乐让他们在废土寂静的夜晚中保持斗志。

original: A frail old lady like yourself should be careful out here all alone.
translation: 像你这样的老弱妇人得小心外面的一切。

original: Old? Yes. Frail? No.
translation: 老？对。弱？错。

original: I can still hold my own if I have to. My husband made me learn a thing or two about how to defend myself.
translation: 如果必要，我还能保护自己。我丈夫生前教会了我一些自卫的方法。

original: Besides, I have a caravan come through here about once a week to trade. They'd miss me if I was gone.
translation: 此外，还有一个商队每星期都会来同我交易一次。如果我离开了，他们会想我的。

original: How about we make it 300 caps?
translation: 我们300个瓶盖成交如何？

original: Well, that's wonderful. Here are your caps. Thanks very much!
translation: 嗯，真不错。这是你的瓶盖。非常感谢你！

original: Well, that's wonderful. Here are your caps. Thanks very much!
translation: 嗯，真不错。这是你的瓶盖。非常感谢你！

original: Let me consider your offer.
translation: 让我考虑下你的提议。

original: Certainly, don't let me stand in your way.
translation: 当然，别让我妨碍了你。

original: Sure, that sounds fair.
translation: 行啊，那听起来很公道。

original: Well, that's wonderful. Here are your caps. Thanks very much!
translation: 嗯，真不错。这是你的瓶盖。非常感谢你！

original: Well, that's wonderful. Here are your caps. Thanks very much!
translation: 嗯，真不错。这是你的瓶盖。非常感谢你！

original: I have a very unique item for sale, a genuine Stradivarius violin.
translation: 我有一件绝世孤品要卖，一把货真价实的斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴。

original: Incredible! I've heard of those items. They were used to make music many many years ago I believe.
translation: 难以置信! 我听说过那些乐器。我相信它们是许多许多年前被用来演奏音乐的东西。

original: Well, although it has no American historical significance, I can take it off your hands for 200 caps. How does that sound?
translation: 虽然它对美国历史没什么意义，但我愿意花200个瓶盖买下它。如何？

original: Absolutely! I believe the standing offer was 200 caps.
translation: 当然！我认为这绝对值200个瓶盖。

original: Are you still interested in the Stradivarius?
translation: 你对斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴还有兴趣吗？

original: Do I look like I play in a fucking orchestra? Why should I care?
translation: 我看起来像是在他妈的交响乐团里玩乐器的吗？我干嘛要关心这个？

original: So you want me to risk my ass for a violin that's probably rotted away by now?
translation: 所以你他妈的让我为了一把现在可能烂成渣子的小提琴去冒险？

original: Don't you think I've thought of that?
translation: 你认为我没考虑过那些？

original: She kept it in a special pressurized case. Inside the case is the perfect temperature and humidity for the instrument.
translation: 她把它保存在一个加压的特殊容器中。在容器里，温度和湿度对于乐器来说都是完美的。

original: Hilda's Stradivarius was named the Soil Stradivarius. All of them had names. That's what I want you to get.
translation: 希尔达的斯特拉迪瓦里被称为索耶尔·斯特拉迪瓦里。它们都有名字。 那就是我想让你寻找的东西。

original: After 200 years, how can you be certain the violin is in decent shape?
translation: 200年过去了，你怎么可以肯定小提琴还能保持原样？

original: She kept it in a special pressurized case. Inside the case is the perfect temperature and humidity for the instrument.
translation: 她把它保存在一个加压的特殊容器中。在容器里，温度和湿度对于乐器来说都是完美的。

original: If the case is still functioning, the Stradivarius would be in perfect shape.
translation: 如果琴盒还起作用，那么斯特拉迪瓦里就应该完好。

original: Hilda's Stradivarius was named the Soil Stradivarius. All of them had names. That's what I want you to get.
translation: 希尔达的斯特拉迪瓦里被称为索耶尔·斯特拉迪瓦里。它们都有名字。 那就是我想让你寻找的东西。

original: Actually, forget the stories... let's get to the point.
translation: 说实话，别提那些故事了……让我们进入正题。

original: If you're that eager to get going I'll skip the story. I'm looking for a particular violin called the Soil Stradivarius.
translation: 如果你急着出发，我就跳过这故事。我正在寻找一把叫做索耶尔·斯特拉迪瓦里的独特小提琴。

original: Its located in Vault 92, where my great great grandmother once lived.
translation: 它位于92号避难所, 那是我高祖母曾经居住过的地方。

original: This violin she owned, was it valuable?
translation: 她拥有的这把小提琴，很值钱吗？

original: Oh, absolutely irreplaceable! The Stradivarius violins are as unique as a painting or a sculpture... each one its own work of art.
translation: 哦，绝对无可替代！斯特拉迪瓦里的小提琴就像绘画或雕塑一样独特……它们每一把都是艺术品。

original: I think the opportunity to use that fine instrument with her fellow accomplished musicians was more than a draw for Hilda.
translation: 我想，对希尔达来说，没有任何机会比她使用如此美妙乐器和其他优秀的音乐家一起演奏更吸引人了。

original: Then, the bombs fell. The Vault was sealed, and my family never heard from her again.
translation: 然后核弹落下。避难所也被封闭了，我的家人再也没有听到关于她的消息了。

original: Musical talent? Why would they care about that?
translation: 音乐天才？他们为什么会关心那个？

original: Vault-Tec was always promoting the Vaults being used for the preservation of the arts and all that nonsense.
translation: 避难所科技总是宣扬避难所可以保存艺术品之类的废话。

original: Hilda couldn't pass on a chance to meet many of the other musical talents of the world, so she accepted their invitation.
translation: 希尔达不愿意错过这样一个能与世界上其他音乐天才见面的绝好机会，因此她接受了他们的邀请。

original: Then the bombs fell. The Vault was sealed, and my family never heard from her again.
translation: 然后核弹落下。避难所也被封闭了，我的家人再也没有听到关于她的消息了。

original: This already sounds kind of like a wild goose chase.
translation: 这听起来像是徒劳无益啊。

original: A famous man once said that patience is the companion of wisdom. If you shut your trap and listen, you might learn something.
translation: 一个名人说过，耐心是智慧之伴。如果你闭上嘴好好听着，说不定还能学些东西。

original: Anyway, Hilda was quite a special woman. Classically trained and exceptionally talented at the violin.
translation: 无论如何，希尔达是一位特别的女性。她受过传统教育并在小提琴方面很有天赋。

original: Her pride and joy was her Stradivarius Violin. I can only imagine how exquisite this instrument must have been.
translation: 她的骄傲和快乐来源于斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴，我只能猜想这乐器必定很精致。

original: When war reared its head, she was invited by Vault-Tec into Vault 92. They claimed the vault would be dedicated to preserving musical talent.
translation: 当战争硝烟四起, 她被避难所科技邀请到92号避难所，他们号称那里专门保护世界上的音乐天才。

original: 2077? I can't even imagine that long ago.
translation: 2077年？那么久了，我无法想像。

original: It certainly is a long time. That precious instrument has been through a lot.
translation: 的确是过了很长时间。那件珍贵的乐器可是经历丰富。

original: Anyway, Hilda was quite a special woman. Classically trained and exceptionally talented at the violin.
translation: 无论如何，希尔达是一位特别的女性。她受过传统教育并在小提琴方面很有天赋。

original: Her pride and joy was her Stradivarius Violin. I can only imagine how exquisite this instrument must have been.
translation: 她的骄傲和快乐来源于斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴，我只能猜想这乐器必定很精致。

original: When war reared its head, she was invited by Vault-Tec into Vault 92. They claimed the vault would be dedicated to preserving musical talent.
translation: 当战争硝烟四起, 她被避难所科技邀请到92号避难所，他们号称那里专门保护世界上的音乐天才。

original: You have records from back then?
translation: 你有那时的记录吗？

original: Of a kind, yes. Hilda sent a good deal of letters to my great grandmother Mary who passed them on, and so forth.
translation: 算是吧。希尔达给我的曾祖母玛丽寄过很多信，曾祖母把这些信留传了下来，诸如此类。

original: I suppose the correspondence could be considered a diary of sorts.
translation: 我看这些信件算是一种日记吧。

original: Look, granny... Talk is cheap, but getting stuff isn't.
translation: 嗯，老婆婆……谈话是廉价的，但换东西却不是。

original: You have a lot to learn about dealing with people, young man. However, you're right. I need to think of your needs too.
translation: 对于处理人际关系，你还有很多东西要学，小伙子。不过你提的也对，我是该考虑下你的需要。

original: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
translation: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。

original: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
translation: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。

original: You have a lot to learn about dealing with people, young lady. However, you're right. I need to think of your needs too.
translation: 对于处理人际关系，你还有很多东西要学，小女孩。不过你提的也对，我是该考虑下你的需要。

original: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
translation: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。

original: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
translation: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。

original: I want to help you, but that type of search could cost me greatly.
translation: 我很想帮你，但那种搜寻可会花费我大量的时间和精力。

original: You have a point. Perhaps I've been neglecting needs that you might have and being selfish.
translation: 你说得对。或许是我忽略了你可能的需求以及你的自私。

original: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
translation: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。

original: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
translation: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。

original: I guess a homemade violin is never quite in tune...
translation: 我看这把自制的小提琴音不太准……

original: You are a clever one!
translation: 你是个聪明人！

original: Yes, that's exactly the problem that I have with it. It doesn't quite play all of the notes correctly and I have to constantly tinker with it.
translation: 是的，那正是我的麻烦所在。它总是不能正确地演奏音符，而我不得不经常修补它。

original: Wow, Reilly. You look like shit.
translation: 哇哦，莱莉。你看起来真狼狈。

original: You got a lot of class, kid.
translation: 你还有很多的课要上，孩子。

original: I feel worse than I look, but that doesn't even matter to me. I'm just worried about the rest of the Rangers.
translation: 呃，我的感觉比外表还糟，但我不在乎。我只是担心其他的游骑兵。

original: I don't even know if they're still alive.
translation: 我甚至不知道他们是死是活。

original: Forget it. I may as well shoot myself in the head and save the trouble.
translation: 算了。我不如朝自己头上开一枪来摆脱这些麻烦。

original: Wow. You really are an asshole. Fine. I hope their deaths sit well on your conscience.
translation: 哇哦。你真是一个混蛋。好吧，我希望他们的死能唤起你的良知。

original: Did you set any kinds of traps or mines?
translation: 你有没有设陷阱或是埋地雷？

original: Actually, we did lay down a bunch of countermeasures. I don't know how many of them have already gone off though.
translation: 实际上，我们的确制订了一堆对策。但我不知道它们有多少已经失效了。

original: When I slipped out with my Stealth Boy, I think I almost tripped one or two of them.
translation: 当我使用隐身小子溜出来的时侯, 我想我差点就触动了其中的一两个。

original: Damn near didn't make it out of there at all, come to think of it.
translation: 回想一下，我差点就没从那里逃出来。

original: Oh, not the mighty Reilly's Rangers! Oooh, scary...
translation: 哦，不像强大的莱莉的游骑兵！哦哦, 真可怕……

original: Laugh it up, kid. It's easy for you to make fun of me now when I'm in this condition.
translation: 笑吧，孩子。以我现在的状态，你要取笑我是很容易的。

original: Keep making jokes and I'll show you what it's like to be in a coma.
translation: 继续说笑吧，然后我会让你感受下昏迷的滋味。

original: I've heard of you guys. You pack some serious firepower.
translation: 我听说过你们。你们有一些可怕的武器。

original: You're pretty sharp, kid.
translation: 你相当敏锐，孩子。

original: We pack plenty of firepower, but that didn't help us from getting our asses into serious trouble.
translation: 我们装备有大量武器，不过这他妈的并没有帮助我们远离那些大麻烦。

original: I didn't expect to make it out of there alive.
translation: 我没指望能活着离开。

original: Let's skip all the story and get to the point. What do you need?
translation: 我们跳过所有的故事来谈谈重点吧。你需要些什么？

original: So you're that eager to jump in headfirst, eh? You remind me a lot of some crazy mercs I knew back in the day.
translation: 你就真的这么迫不及待吗，嗯？你倒是让我回想起了过去认识的许多疯狂的佣兵。

original: They're all dead now because they were stupid, but suit yourself.
translation: 他们这些愚蠢的家伙都死了，随便你吧。

original: My team is trapped on the roof of the Statesman Hotel in Vernon Square and completely surrounded by Super Mutants.
translation: 我的队伍被一群超级变种人团团围困在弗农广场的政要酒店楼顶上了。

original: Their ammo is almost gone, and I have no idea how much longer they have to live.
translation: 他们的弹药快用完了，我不知道他们还能撑多久。

original: Suit yourself.
translation: 听你的。

original: Actually, I get the point.
translation: 事实上，我明白你的意思了。

original: I don't think you're in any condition to be up and about.
translation: 我认为你的情况不适宜上去。

original: That's not the way I do things.
translation: 那不是我处事的方式。

original: Do you have any idea what it would do to my reputation if word got around that Reilly of Reilly's Rangers was laid up in a hospital bed?
translation: 你觉得如果“莱莉的游骑兵的莱莉躺到了病床上”这样的话传出去，对我的声誉会有什么影响？

original: Well then, I guess I'll just have to kill you.
translation: 好吧，我想我不得不干掉你。

original: That's it. GUARDS!
translation: 把他捉起来，守卫！

original: Your boss. So you'd better let me past before you get in trouble.
translation: 你决定。不过你不想惹麻烦的话，最好让我过去。

original: Colonel Autumn is the only one authorized to see the President.
translation: 奥托姆上校是唯一一个被授权能见总统的人。

original: Don't move. I'm going to find out what's going on here.
translation: 别动。我去看看发生了什么事。

original: Maybe I can fix the elevator.
translation: 或许我可以修好电梯。

original: Maybe you can, but we'd still need the fission battery. It's the only way to locally feed power into the elevator's electronics.
translation: 或许你可以，但我们仍需要核裂变电池。它是为电梯的电子控制系统提供电力的唯一方式。

original: Look, let's get out of here and I promise I'll take you to her.
translation: 听着，我们离开这，我保证把你带到她身边。

original: All right. I'm sorry. We're just... very close. If something's happened to her, I don't know what I'll do.
translation: 好的。我很抱歉。我们的确是…很亲近。如果她发生了什么，我不知道我会怎样。

original: Anyway, sorry. Ahem. The only way off of the roof now is using the express elevator.
translation: 无论如何，抱歉。咳。现在离开楼顶的唯一方式就是使用电梯。

original: I'll call the shots from here.
translation: 我就在这里指挥。

original: You can call anything you like, but the other Rangers will only follow me.
translation: 随便你，但其他游骑兵还是只会跟随我。

original: So, let me know what you want to do, and then I'll decide if we're going to do it.
translation: 让我知道你想要做什么，然后我将决定我们是否该去做。

original: The shit's about to hit the fan up here, and you're asking questions?
translation: 那些该死的都打到这了，你还在问东问西？

original: Look, Reilly once told me all we got in this shitty world is each other. I buy into that theory quite a bit.
translation: 听着，莱莉告诉过我，我们在这个烂世界里，唯一拥有的就是彼此。我相当赞同这种观点。

original: We watch each other's backs and that's what keeps us alive.
translation: 我们相互掩护并互相照顾，这也是我们能活着的原因。

original: If she's dead and you just followed our transmission, I want to know about it!
translation: 如果她死了，而你只是来捎个口信，我一定要知道怎么回事！

original: Well, looks like you got yourselves into a mess. Nice work.
translation: 好吧，看来你把自己弄得一团糟。干得好。

original: Tough guy routine, eh?
translation: 强充硬汉吗？

original: I don't give a shit what you think about us. I just want to get the hell out of here.
translation: 我才他妈的不在乎你对我们有什么看法。我只想要离开这该死的地方。

original: Now, what happened to Reilly? Is she okay?
translation: 莱莉发生什么事了？她还好吗？

original: Tough guy routine, eh?
translation: 强充硬汉吗？

original: I don't give a shit what you think about us. I just want to get the hell out of here.
translation: 我才他妈的不在乎你对我们有什么看法。我只想要离开这该死的地方。

original: Now, what happened to Reilly? Is she okay?
translation: 莱莉发生了什么事 ？她还好吗？

original: A medic, huh? Can you patch me up?
translation: 医生，呃？你能否给我包扎下吗？

original: Sorry, no can do. I used the last of my supplies on us when we got to the roof.
translation: 抱歉，做不到。我们上到楼顶时，我就用掉了最后的补给。

original: I can still put a bullet through a Super Mutant skull though!
translation: 我仍然可以一枪射穿超级变种人的脑袋！

original: Now, what's up with Reilly? She okay?
translation: 莱莉发生了什么事 ？她还好吗？

original: Sorry, no can do. I used the last of my supplies on us when we got to the roof.
translation: 抱歉，做不到。我们上到楼顶时，我就用掉了最后的补给。

original: I can still put a bullet through a Super Mutant skull though!
translation: 我仍然可以一枪射穿超级变种人的脑袋！

original: Now, what's up with Reilly? She okay?
translation: 莱莉发生了什么事 ？她还好吗？

original: I don't understand. I can't see you.
translation: 我不明白。我看不到你。

original: You are seeing me in a way that only a few select individuals have. Wouldn't they be jealous?
translation: 你正在用只有少数被选中的人才有的办法看着我。他们不会嫉妒你吧？

original: Colonel Autumn is the only human permitted in this room besides yourself, for reasons which may now be clear to you.
translation: 除你之外，奥托姆上校是唯一允许进入这间房间的人，原因我想你现在也该明白了。

original: Is this some kind of a joke?
translation: 这是开什么玩笑？

original: No, it's not.
translation: 不，这不是玩笑。

original: I am the computer you see before you. Well, that and several thousand databanks beneath this room.
translation: 我就是你面前的这台电脑。它和这个房间下面的数千台数据库。

original: Well then, where are you? All I see is computers.
translation: 你在哪？我看见的全都是电脑啊。

original: You should feel privileged. Colonel Autumn is the only other human permitted within this room.
translation: 你应该感到荣幸。奥托姆上校是另一个允许进入这间房间的人类。

original: You are now privy to one of the few secrets our government now harbors. Do keep it to yourself, please.
translation: 你现在得悉了我们政府的数大秘密之一。请勿泄密。

original: If we're meeting face to face, then show yourself. Don't hide behind a monitor.
translation: 如果我们要面对面地交谈，就到这来。别躲在显示器后面。

original: Ah, but I have! I am right here before you.
translation: 啊，但我就在这啊！我就在你的面前。

original: Sure. You stay here while I get the caps. I'll be right back.
translation: 就这样定了。你在这里等着，我去找瓶盖，很快回来。

original: Right here? Okay...
translation: 就在这？好吧……

original: Don't take too long.
translation: 别太久了。

original: On second thought, you're not worth the caps.
translation: 再一想，你可不值那些瓶盖。

original: GUARDS!
translation: 守卫！

original: Look, here are the caps. Let's just pretend we never saw each other.
translation: 听着，拿着这些瓶盖。让我们假装从未见过对方吧。

original: Well, okay. Hand 'em over.
translation: 好吧。给我。

original: 500 caps says you never saw me. Understand?
translation: 给你500个瓶盖，你就假装从没见过我，怎么样？

original: Are you bribing me?
translation: 你想贿赂我？

original: I'm on my way up to see the President. How about I put in a good word for you?
translation: 我正要去见总统。要替你美言几句吗？

original: I, uhh... You are? I mean, you would?
translation: 我，喔……你？我的意思是，你会？

original: Just make sure he knows I was real strict with you, okay? And that I didn't have my uniform on backwards this time.
translation: 你一定要让他知道，我真的对你很严格，明白吗？还有这次我可没把制服穿反了。

original: So that's your story? I can't believe I stood here and listened to it.
translation: 这就是你的故事？我简直不能相信我会站在这听你讲完。

original: You're a good friend to have such patience with me. I'm glad you listened even though you didn't want to.
translation: 你是个好哥们，对我这么有耐心。我很高兴你听完了，虽然你并不想听。

original: Like I said, you were lucky to get away.
translation: 正如我所说，你能逃脱真是侥幸。

original: Maybe. I might not have met you today if those humans hadn't chased me.
translation: 或许吧。如果那些人类不追我，或许我今天也见不到你的。

original: Like I said, bad luck for you.
translation: 正如我所说，你运气真不好。

original: Maybe. I might not have met you today if those humans hadn't chased me.
translation: 或许吧。如果那些人类不追我，或许我今天也见不到你的。

original: I've had enough of this pointless story. Shut up already.
translation: 我已经受够了这毫无意义的故事。闭嘴吧。

original: Of course. I'm sorry. Other than you, I only have myself to talk to. I know very little about civilized conversation.
translation: 当然。我很抱歉。除了你，我只能自言自语。我不太知道怎么礼貌地交谈。

original: Do you still have any? I could use some water.
translation: 你还有吗？我想喝一些水。

original: I wish I had some to give you, but I'm afraid I lost it all.
translation: 我很乐意给你些，但恐怕已经全被我弄丢了。

original: I gathered up all I could carry, and once my leg felt better I climbed out of the hole and went on my way.
translation: 我收集了自己背得动的量，等我的腿稍一好点，我就爬出了洞继续上路。

original: The next day, I came upon a group of humans. Usually your people leave me alone, but they saw the water I was carrying and attacked.
translation: 第二天，我遇到了一队人类。一般你们人类不会招惹我，但他们看到了我带的水，就攻击了我。

original: I dropped the water and ran for my life. I'm afraid my brothers would find me very contemptible.
translation: 我扔掉了水就逃。只怕我的兄弟会因此而鄙视我。

original: That was a stroke of good luck.
translation: 真是好运气啊。

original: Maybe.
translation: 克莱因：应该能。

original: I gathered up all I could carry, and once my leg felt better I climbed out of the hole and went on my way.
translation: 我收集了自己背得动的量，等我的腿稍一好点，我就爬出了洞继续上路。

original: The next day, I came upon a group of humans. Usually your people leave me alone, but they saw the water I was carrying and attacked.
translation: 第二天，我遇到了一队人类。一般你们人类不会招惹我，但他们看到了我带的水，就攻击了我。

original: I dropped the water and ran for my life. I'm afraid my brothers would find me very contemptible.
translation: 我扔掉了水就逃。只怕我的兄弟会因此而鄙视我。

original: Tell your crazy stories to somehow who cares.
translation: 把你疯狂的故事说给那些乐意听的人吧。

original: Of course. I'm sorry. You're really the only person I have to talk to. I forget myself sometimes.
translation: 当然。我很抱歉，你真的是我唯一可以交谈的人。有时我都有点得意忘形了。

original: Obviously you got out somehow.
translation: 很明显，你已经设法逃了出来。

original: True.
translation: 的确。

original: After I had rested, I looked around. I was in an old basement. There were bottles of pure water stacked everywhere.
translation: 休息了之后，我环顾四周。我在一个老地下室里。一瓶瓶净水堆得到处都是。

original: That sounds bad.
translation: 那听起来真糟。

original: Maybe.
translation: 克莱因：应该能。

original: After I had rested, I looked around. I was in an old basement. There were bottles of pure water stacked everywhere.
translation: 休息了之后，我环顾四周。我在一个老地下室里。一瓶瓶净水堆得到处都是。

original: You'd rather those Raiders caught you? Maybe you are crazy.
translation: 你宁愿让这些掠夺者抓住你吗？或许你是疯了。

original: After we last met, I was climbing a small hill when the ground crumbled beneath me and I fell into a dark pit.
translation: 在我们上次见面后，当我爬上一个小山坡时，突然地面塌陷，我摔进了黑呼呼的坑里。

original: My leg was hurt in the fall, so I couldn't climb out.
translation: 我的腿被摔伤了，所以我无法爬出去。

original: You think being attacked by Raiders is good luck?
translation: 你认为受到掠夺者的攻击是好运气吗？

original: After we last met, I was climbing a small hill when the ground crumbled beneath me and I fell into a dark pit.
translation: 在我们上次见面后，当我爬上一个小山坡时，突然地面塌陷，我摔进了黑呼呼的坑里。

original: My leg was hurt in the fall, so I couldn't climb out.
translation: 我的腿被摔伤了，所以我无法爬出去。

original: Maybe? What do you mean?
translation: 或许吧？你是什么意思？

original: After we last met, I was climbing a small hill when the ground crumbled beneath me and I fell into a dark pit.
translation: 在我们上次见面后，当我爬上一个小山坡时，突然地面塌陷，我摔进了黑呼呼的坑里。

original: My leg was hurt in the fall, so I couldn't climb out.
translation: 我的腿被摔伤了，所以我无法爬出去。

original: Lucky for you that you got away, huh?
translation: 幸运的是你还是逃脱了，呃？

original: Maybe.
translation: 克莱因：应该能。

original: Sounds like you've been having some bad luck.
translation: 听起来你运气似乎很糟糕啊。

original: Maybe.
translation: 克莱因：应该能。

original: You said "before I became this." What did you mean?
translation: 你说“在我变成这样之前 ”是什么意思？

original: Maybe you don't know where we come from -- Super Mutants, I mean. We aren't born this way. We are created.
translation: 或许你不知道我们从哪来的，我是指 — 超级变种人。我们出生的时候可不是这样子。我们是被制造出来的。

original: In the cold, dark, metal place, where my brothers bring their captives, endlessly trying to make more of us.
translation: 在那个寒冷、黑暗，全是金属的地方，我的兄弟们将他们的俘虏带来，并不断试图制造出更多的我们。

original: It was something I could not do. I tried to get them to stop. But they wouldn't listen. They would have killed me if I had not run away.
translation: 这种事情我做不出来。我试图阻止他们。但他们不听。不是我逃得快，他们已经杀了我。

original: Don't you try to blame this on us! It was all my father and his cronies who tried to keep us from ever going outside.
translation: 你不要来指责我们！全都是我的父亲和他的亲信们的错，他们一直阻止我们到外面去。

original: We found out that the Vault used to be open before we were born! They've been lying to us all our lives - and people have died because of it!
translation: 我们发现，在我们出生之前，避难所是开放的！他们一直在欺骗我们 — 而且还有人因此丧命！

original: Oh, nice job. I'm gone for a bit and you screw the whole place up.
translation: 噢，干得好。我只离开了一小会，而你们却把这整个地方都给毁了。

original: Yes, sir.
translation: 是的，长官。

original: Sure, whatever.
translation: 好的，随便。

original: Yes, of course.
translation: 是的，当然。

original: Yes, sir.
translation: 是的，长官。

original: Don't you have anything better to do?
translation: 你就没其他更好的事情可做吗？

original: I'm interested in trading.
translation: 我有兴趣做个买卖。

original: We always need bullets. Takes damn near a hundred of 'em to kill a 'Guai.
translation: 子弹对于我们来说永远都是必需品。居然他妈的近百发子弹才能干掉一个妖怪。

original: Always good ta hear. Lesse what ya got.
translation: 听起来不错，看看你都有什么。

original: Hmm. Good point. Best to leave him alone.
translation: 唔。有道理。最好别理他。

original: I'd give anything if he'd just stop yelling...
translation: 如果他能停止大喊大叫，我愿意给任何东西……

original: Oh, come on. He'll listen to reason. Go talk to him.
translation: 哦，拜托。他会听你劝告的。去和他谈谈吧。

original: Oh... uhm... well... you look like someone who's pretty smart... so if you say so. I'll give it a try.
translation: 哦…喔喔，好吧…看起来你像个聪明人…如果真如你所说的那样。我会去试试的。

original: Okay. <takes a deep breath> Here I go...
translation: 好吧。<深呼吸>我去了……

original: What's that guy's problem?
translation: 那人是怎么回事啊？

original: He's... he's been up there for days! He's got all of those mines wired to a trigger. He won't let anyone in or out of the alley.
translation: 他…他在上面已经很多天了！他把所有的地雷都连上了一个扳机。他不让任何人进出这通道。

original: If I try to leave, he'll set them off. But I can't stay here any longer!
translation: 如果我试图离开，他就会将它们引爆。但我不能再留在这了！

original: Why don't you just go over and see what he's yelling about?
translation: 为什么你不过去看看他在叫喊些什么？

original: No! No way! He'll set the bombs off if I go anywhere near him!
translation: 不！绝不！只要我靠近他，他就会引爆炸弹！

original: And the sun will rise in the north! No! the northwest! For forty-four days and sixty-seven nights! And we'll never notice!
translation: 太阳将在北边升起！不！是西北边！并将持续四十四个白日和六十七个夜晚！而我们永远都不会注意到！

original: You don't know, you can't know. Little fools. You wish you knew! You wish! But only I know! Only me... only me... only me...
translation: 你不知道，你也不能知道。小傻瓜。你希望你知道！你做梦吧！但是，只有我知道！只有我，只有我……只有我……

original: The sky will fall! The Earth will rise! The stars will shine open their toothy grins and caress the sun with their love!
translation: 天会塌下来！大地会升起来！星星将会露出锋利的牙齿，现出邪恶的笑容，还要用它们的爱去拥抱太阳！

original: Oh... God... it hurts. My head... why doesn't it ever stop hurting... why? Please... please... I can hear it! Moving! Pulsing! Just leave me alone!
translation: 噢，上帝……疼啊。我的头……为何它就痛个不停……为什么？求求你……求求你……我可以听到它！那移动的声音！那脉动的声音！赶快从我的大脑里消失吧！

original: Not one step further! Not one! Come no closer! I'll do it! I'll blow us ALL to hell! All of us! Me, you... and the worm...
translation: 一步也不许走近了！不行！不要再靠近了！我会这么做的！我会把我们都炸到地狱去！我们大家！我、你……还有那些个蛆虫……

original: Beware, worm! I shall destroy you! With the fire of this small sun before me! BEWARE WORM! Not one step further!
translation: 给我小心点，蛆虫！我将毁灭你！用我身前的这小太阳产生的火焰！注 — 意 — 了，蛆—虫 — ！一步也不许走近！

original: Hungry... hungry... so hungry. What? No. I'm not hungry. The worm is hungry. Hungry for me, for you, and for fire.
translation: 饥饿……饥饿……异常饥饿。什么？不，我不饿。饿的是那些蛆虫。它们想吞食我、吞食你，还要吞食火焰。

original: THE SUN! IT BURNS! Why does it burn? Why have we put the sun into a jar? And what did we do with that jar? We broke it all over our little world...
translation: 太——阳——！在——燃——烧——！它为什么燃烧？为什么我们把太阳放在罐子里？并且我们对那罐子做了什么？我们在自己的小世界里打破了它……

original: In fourteen hundred and ninety-two, your mother and my mother were hanging up clothes around the mulberry bush...
translation: 在1492年，你我的母亲正在桑树丛附近晾衣服……

original: Fire, fire, burning bright... burning... fire... pain, misery, peace, love, murder, death, death, death... love...
translation: 火焰，火焰，明亮地燃烧着……燃烧着……火焰……痛苦，不幸，和平，爱，谋杀，死亡，死亡，死亡……爱……

original: Trees! So many trees! To the north! But be careful... the trees... are deadly, and the trees too will be consumed in the belly of the great fat worm!
translation: 树！那么多树！在北边！但是要小心…树…是致命的，这些树木同样会被那些又胖又大的虫子的肚子消化掉！

original: A great crack shall open in the Earth and swallow the non-believers! And they shall weep! Weep! Weep! Tears and salt and earth and dirt!
translation: 巨大的裂缝将出现在大地上并吞噬那些没有信仰的人！他们将会哭泣！哭泣！哭泣！泪水、盐、尘土、污垢！

original: Try new BLAMMO! Soap! Blasts stains out! Blasts the whole world out! We've all been BLAMMO'd!
translation: 试试新的轮回！宛如香皂！洗刷污点！洁净全世界！我们都需要轮回！

original: I had no idea. This is fascinating.
translation: 真没料到，这太诱人了。

original: I'm glad you think so. Perhaps a bit later we can discuss it in more detail.
translation: 我很高兴你这么认为。或许过一会我们可以更详细地讨论它。

original: Right now, I'd like to focus on why you're here. I've asked you here for a reason, and you and I need to talk about it.
translation: 现在，我关心的是你为什么来这。你来这里是有目的的，我想和你探讨一番。

original: This is crazy. A computer is running the Enclave?
translation: 真疯狂。一台电脑在掌控着整个英克雷？

original: I assure you that I am much more than a simple computer.
translation: 我向你保证，我不仅仅是一台简单的电脑。

original: But let's not get bogged down in the details just yet. You are here for a purpose, and I'd like to discuss it with you.
translation: 但是，我们先暂时不谈细节。你来这里是有目的的，我想和你探讨一番。

original: I don't think this is funny.
translation: 我不觉得这很好笑。

original: I can't imagine why you would. I assure you this is not a joke.
translation: 我不知道你为什么会觉得好笑。我保证这不是在开玩笑。

original: But before you pass judgment, I'd like to discuss why you're here.
translation: 但在你做出结论之前，我想讨论下你为什么来这。

original: Like I told ya man, I don't fuckin' know where it came from. But it freaks the boys out. Some story from a while back, 'bout a stranger with no name.
translation: 就像我告诉过你的，我他妈也不知道它是从哪里来的。但它吓坏了那些孩子。早就有一些故事了……关于一个没有名字的陌生人。

original: Just... get rid of the damn thing. Ain't no good gonna come from keeping it around. Besides, if it is.. his. Maybe he'll come back for it. Comprende?
translation: 只要……甩掉那个该死的家伙。留着它没好处。再说，万一它是……他的，或许他会回来找它的。明白没？

original: I guess you'll just have to live with your choice.
translation: 我看你对自己的选择也不得不认命了。

original: Hey, its my life. Butt out.
translation: 嗨，这是我的生活。别多嘴。

original: Damn straight.
translation: 真他妈的直。

original: Your life, your choice.
translation: 你的生命，由你选择。

original: Admit it. You're just a whore.
translation: 承认吧。你就是一个妓女。

original: Up yours! It's not like I've got a lot of other options.
translation: 去你的！好像我有得其它选择似的。

original: The only survival skill I've got is the one I'm using here.
translation: 我唯一的“生存技能”就是我在这干的事。

original: I'd rather be a whore than dead.
translation: 我宁愿做一个妓女也不想死。

original: So basically, you're just a whore?
translation: 这么说，你只是个妓女？

original: Damn! I wish I had a setup like this.
translation: 该死！我真希望我也能遇上这种事。

original: You're a pig, you know that?
translation: 你知道吗？你就是头猪！

original: I'm only doing this because he can keep me safe. He's a lot tougher than he looks.
translation: 我这样做只是因为他能保护我的安全。他比他的外表更厉害。

original: I'm not sure how much longer that will be enough though.
translation: 我不确定这样子还能坚持多久。

original: Sweet for him maybe.
translation: 对他来说或许很不错。

original: I'm just along for the ride. He's good with a gun and knows where to get booze.
translation: 我只是跟着他凑热闹。他枪法很好，而且知道在哪能弄到酒。

original: Lucky bastard. He's got a sweet setup here.
translation: 走运的杂种。他在这找到了甜蜜的归宿。

original: So you're not really in control of the Enclave, then.
translation: 你也不是真的在控制英克雷。

original: Make no mistake. I am the Enclave.
translation: 别搞错了。我就是英克雷。

original: The organization is merely experiencing some growing pains. All will be sorted out in time.
translation: 这个组织只是在经历成长的痛楚罢了。一切都会好的。

original: I'd better go before I get a headache.
translation: 在我惹上麻烦前，我还是离开的好。

original: You need to drink more. Ha, ha!
translation: 你必须再喝点，哈，哈！

original: So... What exactly is this place?
translation: 那么…这到底是什么地方？

original: It's my hidey hole. Nobody can fuck with me here.
translation: 这是我的藏身洞。在这里没人能动我一根毫毛。

original: I got my women and my booze. What the hell else is there?
translation: 我得到了我的女人和酒。他妈的还需要什么？

original: It's my hidey hole. Nobody can fuck with me here.
translation: 这是我的藏身洞。在这里没人能动我一根毫毛。

original: My women are gone, but I've got my booze. That's enough.
translation: 我的女人都走了，但我得到了我的酒。这就足够了。

original: It's...well, it's Dukov's place. He lives here.
translation: 这是…这是杜克夫的淫窝。他住在这。

original: Pretty much he just does a lot of drinking and partying.
translation: 通常他也就是喝喝酒、搞搞聚会。

original: It's...well, it's Dukov's place. He used to live here. Lots of drinking and...you know. Now he's dead.
translation: 这是…嗯，这是杜克夫的淫窝。他曾住在这。喝喝酒，还有……你知道的。现在他玩儿不转了。

original: You're obviously crazier than they are. Why would I listen to you?
translation: 你显然比他们更加疯狂。我为什么要听你的？

original: I can't say I blame you. Its my mistake for making you do something you didn't want to do in the first place I guess.
translation: 我不能怪你。我想一开始让你去做你不想做的事是我的错。

original: Still, maybe it's all for the best. I mean, I've been talking with Birch and they really seem to need me.
translation: 不过，或许这一切就是最好的安排。我是说，我和伯奇聊过了，他们似乎真的很需要我。

original: What do you say Herbert, should I give them another chance?
translation: 赫伯特，你怎么说，我该再给他们一次机会吗？

original: Fine, fine. I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我是说鲍勃。我每次叫他赫伯特都觉得很好玩。

original: I'm not the killing type.
translation: 我不是那种会杀人的人。

original: No, I suppose you aren't. My mistake for making you do something you didn't want to do in the first place I guess.
translation: 是啊，我想你也不是。是我的错，不该让你做一开始就不想做的事。

original: Still, maybe it's all for the best. I mean, I've been talking with Birch and they really seem to need me.
translation: 不过，或许这一切就是最好的安排。我是说，我和伯奇聊过了，他们似乎真的很需要我。

original: What do you say Herbert, should I give them another chance?
translation: 赫伯特，你怎么说，我该再给他们一次机会吗？

original: Fine, fine. I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我是说鲍勃。我每次叫他赫伯特都觉得很好玩。

original: You've become an important part of their life. Without you, they're lost.
translation: 你已经成为他们生活中重要的一部分。没有你，他们会不知所措。

original: So, they really need me that badly, huh? I guess I never thought of it that way. Awfully selfish of me.
translation: 这么说，他们真的那么需要我，哈？我想我从来没这么想过。我太自私了。

original: Should we give them another chance, Herbert?
translation: 我们再给他们一次机会怎么样，赫伯特？

original: Fine, fine. I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我是说鲍勃。我每次叫他赫伯特都觉得很好玩。

original: I could have used a pile of caps instead, but whatever.
translation: 我其实更想要一堆瓶盖，不过算了。

original: I'm saddened that worldly possessions and wealth still drive you, but I'm glad to see you made the right choice in the end.
translation: 你依然被世俗的财物所驱使，这让我感到悲哀，不过很高兴看到你最终做出了正确的选择。

original: I believe there are a few Treeminders who wish to speak to you before you depart. I think you'll find their appreciation quite rewarding.
translation: 我想在你离开之前，有几位护树人想和你谈谈。我觉得你会发现他们的感激之情是很值得的。

original: Good luck in all your journeys, my friend. I hope your time here has opened your heart as well as it opened your eyes.
translation: 祝你一帆风顺，我的朋友。希望你在此地的时光不仅开阔了你的眼界，也打开了你的心扉。

original: Sure, I guess.
translation: 确实，我想是这样的。

original: Perhaps you haven't learned quite as much as I hoped from your visit here, but I'm glad to see you made the right choice in the end.
translation: 或许你这次拜访并没有学到我期望的那么多，不过我很高兴最后你还是做出了正确的选择。

original: I believe there are a few Treeminders who wish to speak to you before you depart. I think you'll find their appreciation quite rewarding.
translation: 我想在你离开之前，有几位护树人想和你谈谈。我觉得你会发现他们的感激之情是很值得的。

original: Good luck in all your journeys, my friend. I hope your time here has opened your heart as well as it opened your eyes.
translation: 祝你一帆风顺，我的朋友。希望你在此地的时光不仅开阔了你的眼界，也打开了你的心扉。

original: I was glad to do it. Oasis needs to be shared with the world.
translation: 我很乐意这样做。绿洲理应与这世界分享。

original: In your short visit here I can see you've learned much. That's a rare gift in these turbulent times.
translation: 在你的短暂拜访中，我看得出你学到了很多。在这动荡的时代，这可是一份难得的收获。

original: I believe there are a few Treeminders who wish to speak to you before you depart. I think you'll find their appreciation quite rewarding.

original: Are you taking Jet over here?
translation: 你要在这里用杰特？

original: Well... yeah. So? What else do I have to do except get high?
translation: 这个…是的。怎么了？除了麻醉自己，我还能做什么？

original: You think that I need to be sober to cut a Ghoul's hair? Half the work is cutting the skin off.
translation: 你以为我必须保持清醒才能为僵尸理发？其实有一半的工作时间是在清理他们的皮肤。

original: These guys don't care how they look anyway. They just humor me.
translation: 反正这些家伙也不关心他们自己看起来如何。他们只是顺着我来。

original: How does a Ghoul end up as a barber?
translation: 一个尸鬼是怎么变成理发师的？

original: I prefer "stylist" myself, but whatever works for you. Everyone has a gift, you know?
translation: 我喜欢以“时尚设计师”自居，但无所谓你怎么叫。每个人都有自己的天赋，你明白吗？

original: I used to live in Rivet City. Folks there had enough money for me to do okay. But after I... uh... changed, no one would let me touch them.
translation: 我曾经居住在铆钉城。那的人有足够的钱让我过得舒适。但是在我…呃…“改变”之后，就没有人愿意接触我了。

original: I ended up here. Of course, a Ghoul with a barber shop makes about as much sense as a screen door on a submarine so... fuck it.
translation: 我最终到了这。当然，给僵尸开理发店就和在潜水艇上安纱窗一样，所以…去他妈的吧。

original: I just took up Jet. At least it passes the time, you know?
translation: 我最近吸上了杰特。至少它能消磨时间，知道了吧？

original: How about a haircut?
translation: 给我理个发怎么样？

original: Now we're talking! What do you need?
translation: 这才对嘛！你要什么发型呢？

original: Are you serious? Well alright! Let me get my knives!
translation: 真的？好极了！让我去拿刀具！

original: Alright! A full head of hair to work with! What should I do?
translation: 真好！有满满一头的头发要处理！我该做什么呢？

original: Sorry. I'm way too gone to cut hair right now... maybe later?
translation: 对不起。我现在嗑高了，没法理发……过会儿吧？

original: You stay away from my hair.
translation: 你离我的头发远点。

original: Oh, c'mon! I don't ever get to work on an actual human!
translation: 哦，来吧！我从没有在一个真正人类的头发上动过剪刀！

original: I'm good! I promise! I'll take a few puffs and I'll give you the best haircut of your life! No charge or anything! It'll be fun!
translation: 我很在行！我保证！等我抽两口，然后给你来个你一生中最漂亮的发型！完全不收钱！会很有趣的！

original: About what? My hair?
translation: 关于什么？我的头发？

original: Yeah, man! That's what I do! I cut hair!
translation: 是啊，兄弟！那就是我的工作！我是剪头发的！

original: I know, I know, you look around here and there ain't a lot of work to show off, right?
translation: 我知道，我知道，你四处看看就能发现我没什么值得炫耀的作品，对不对？

original: These corpses only got half a head of the stuff, so I never get a chance to work on a full head! C'mon! No charge!
translation: 这些行尸只有半个脑袋有那玩意，所以我从来没有机会在一个完整的头上动过剪刀！来吧！免费！

original: I could care less about your problems. I'm out of here.
translation: 我不关心你的问题。我要走了。

original: Your words carry no remorse, no caring.
translation: 你的话毫无悔意和关切。

original: I'm at a loss as to how this place failed to open your eyes, but more importantly, to open your heart.
translation: 我不明白这个地方为何没能让你醒悟，更重要的是，没能让你敞开心扉。

original: Go now, Outsider. Go and never look back.
translation: 现在就走吧，外来者。走了就别再回头。

original: You'll make due.
translation: 你会应付得来的。

original: Even though the Great One has left us, our memories of Him will never die.
translation: 尽管圣贤已经离开了我们，但我们对祂的记忆永不消逝。

original: With Bloomseer Poplar's help, I'm confident we can keep Oasis alive and carry on as Treeminders.
translation: 在“花先知”帕普勒的帮助下，我确信我们能保持绿洲的繁荣，并延续我们树启者的职责。

original: Go now, Outsider. Go but never forget the gifts the Great One bestowed upon us.
translation: 现在走吧，外来者。离开这里，但永远不要忘记圣贤赐予我们的礼物。

original: What will become of Oasis?
translation: 绿洲将会怎样？

original: Even though the Great One has left us, our memories of Him will never die.
translation: 尽管圣贤已经离开了我们，但我们对祂的记忆永不消逝。

original: With Bloomseer Poplar's help, I'm confident we can keep Oasis alive and carry on as Treeminders.
translation: 在“花先知”帕普勒的帮助下，我确信我们能保持绿洲的繁荣，并延续我们树启者的职责。

original: Go now, Outsider. Go but never forget the gifts the Great One bestowed upon us.
translation: 现在走吧，外来者。离开这里，但永远不要忘记圣贤赐予我们的礼物。

original: Welcome back to the Wasteland, asshole.
translation: 欢迎你回到废土，混蛋。

original: You're words sting, Outsider. Normally I'd have you cast from this place for such a statement, but my eyes have been opened.
translation: 你的话很伤人，外来者。通常情况下，你说出这样的话，我会把你从这个地方赶走，但我已经醒悟了。

original: Before you reached His heart, He imparted his last words to me. He told me about his will to die and how I mistook this for some mystical sign.
translation: 在你触及祂的心脏之前，祂向我传达了祂的遗言。祂对我说了求死的意愿，而我却错以为这是某种神秘征兆。

original: How could I have been so blind? How could I have mislead all these people?
translation: 我怎么会如此盲目？我怎么能误导了这么多人？

original: Perhaps if I would have spent more time getting to know Him, things would have turned out different.
translation: 或许，如果我能花更多的时间去了解祂，事情就会是不同的结果了。

original: And here I thought you'd be ready to kill me.
translation: 我还以为你已经准备好杀了我呢。

original: No, Outsider, my anger lay not with you, but with myself.
translation: 不，外来者，我愤怒的并不是你，而是我自己。

original: Before you reached His heart, He imparted his last words to me. He told me about his will to die and how I mistook this for some mystical sign.
translation: 在你触及祂的心脏之前，祂向我传达了祂的遗言。祂对我说了求死的意愿，而我却错以为这是某种神秘征兆。

original: How could I have been so blind? How could I have mislead all these people?
translation: 我怎么会如此盲目？我怎么能误导了这么多人？

original: Perhaps if I would have spent more time getting to know Him, things would have turned out different.
translation: 或许，如果我能花更多的时间去了解祂，事情就会是不同的结果了。

original: I have to say I'm surprised you aren't angrier with me.
translation: 我不得不说，我很惊讶你居然没有对我发火。

original: Before you reached His heart, He imparted his last words to me. He told me about his will to die and how I mistook this for some mystical sign.
translation: 在你触及祂的心脏之前，祂向我传达了祂的遗言。祂对我说了求死的意愿，而我却错以为这是某种神秘征兆。

original: How could I have been so blind? How could I have mislead all these people?
translation: 我怎么会如此盲目？我怎么能误导了这么多人？

original: Perhaps if I would have spent more time getting to know Him, things would have turned out different.
translation: 或许，如果我能花更多的时间去了解祂，事情就会是不同的结果了。

original: How is it you're causing all of these things to grow around you?
translation: 你是怎么让周围长出这么多东西的？

original: In what we call the Harvest Month, the Great One creates seeds among his branches within seed pods.
translation: 在我们所说的收获之月，圣贤会在枝间的种荚内孕育种子。

original: At the end of this time, the pods open and the seeds are carried quite easily upon the wind. It's quite beautiful.
translation: 到这个时期末尾，种荚裂开，种子很容易就随风飘散。那场景好美啊。

original: Wherever the seeds take purchase, they grow into trees, plants, grass or all manner of wonderful things.
translation: 无论种子落到哪里，都会长成树、灌木、草，或是各种各样奇妙的东西。

original: What's causing this place to grow?
translation: 是什么促使这个地方枝繁叶茂？

original: It's kind of embarrassing really. Once a year, Bob decides he's going to go ahead and start growing these weird pods filled with tiny seeds.
translation: 那真有些尴尬。每年一次，鲍勃都会自顾自地生长出这些古怪的、充满着细小种子的种荚。

original: Well, all it takes is a good wind and the seeds just fly everywhere.
translation: 只需要一阵清风，种子就飘得到处都是。

original: I call them Herbert's Seeds. He hates that!
translation: 我称呼它们为“赫伯特的种”。他恨死这叫法了！

original: Oh, you said violin? I thought you needed something else. Never mind.
translation: 哦，你说小提琴？我还以为你需要别的什么东西。没关系。

original: Well then, you interested in helping me or am I just wasting my time?
translation: 你有兴趣吗？还是我在浪费自己的时间？

original: Maybe. You gonna give me something for it?
translation: 或许。你有什么东西给我用来交换它？

original: Oh very well. I suppose I should have expected that from a Wastelander. Here's the key to my husband's ammo crate; take whatever you like.
