translation: 哦，非常好。我应该知道废土游民会这样的。这是我丈夫的弹药箱的钥匙，想拿什么随便。

original: It's like holding a chunk of history in the palm of my hands. Amazing, simply amazing.
translation: 就像是把一段历史握在了手中一样，这太妙了，实在太美妙了！

original: I can't thank you enough. I wish I had something to give you, a more suitable reward for all your efforts.
translation: 我无法表达我的谢意。我想我可以给你些什么，相对你的辛劳更适合的报酬。

original: All I can give you is the frequency to my radio set. Tune in whenever you feel like listening to the strains of an old woman's violin playing.
translation: 我所能给你的就是一个电台频率。无论何时你想听的时候就调到这频率，来收听一个老妇人的小提琴演奏。

original: Yes, take this Stradivarius Violin I found in Vault 92.
translation: 是的，拿着这把斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴吧，我从92号避难所里找到的。

original: Oh my goodness! I must see it... please!
translation: 天啊！我一定要看一看……拜托！

original: It's like holding a chunk of history in the palm of my hands. Amazing, simply amazing.
translation: 就像是把一段历史握在了手中一样，这太妙了，实在太美妙了！

original: I can't thank you enough. I wish I had something to give you, a more suitable reward for all your efforts.
translation: 我无法表达我的谢意。我想我可以给你些什么，相对你的辛劳更适合的报酬。

original: All I can give you is the frequency to my radio set. Tune in whenever you feel like listening to the strains of an old woman's violin playing.
translation: 我所能给你的就是一个电台频率。无论何时你想听的时候就调到这频率，来收听一个老妇人的小提琴演奏。

original: Tell me about this project you worked on with my father.
translation: 说说这个你和我父亲为之奋斗的工程。

original: Project Purity, we called it. What do you want to know?
translation: 我们叫它净水工程，你想要知道些什么？

original: Why did my mother die? What happened?
translation: 我母亲为什么会死？发生了什么？

original: Complications from childbirth. None of us were expecting it; we weren't as prepared as we could have been.
translation: 分娩的并发症。没人料到会发生这种事；我们早该做好准备的，但没有。

original: You have to understand, we were struggling with scavenged, derelict equipment. We did everything we could.
translation: 你得明白，我们只有用清洗过的废弃工具竭尽全力，我们做了可以做到的一切。

original: What was my father like back then?
translation: 我父亲当年是个怎样的人？

original: James? He was very driven. Determined to change the world. Well, we all were back then, I suppose.
translation: 詹姆斯？他充满激情，决心要改变世界，嗯，那时我们都是如此。

original: He was focused on two things, really. Making Project Purity work, and your mother.
translation: 他只专注于两件事，真的。一是让净水工程运转下去，另一个就是你母亲。

original: When she died, I think... I think he gave up. I know he wanted to keep you safe, but I think part of what he did was run away.
translation: 当她死后，我想…我想他放弃了。我知道他想保护你的安全，但也认为他这么做部分原因是为了逃避。

original: But it seems that he never really was able to get over the idea. I'm frankly shocked that he waited all this time, and wants to try again.
translation: 但他似乎从未真正放弃过自己的想法，他始终等着想要再试一次，对此我大为震惊。

original: I never knew my mother. What can you tell me about her?
translation: 关于母亲我一无所知，你能跟我说说她吗？

original: Yes... Your mother was, well she was a good woman. A very dedicated scientist. Your father loved her very much.
translation: 是的…你母亲，她很了不起，是一位非常能干的科学家。你父亲很爱她。

original: It was a shame that she died. She had been excited to meet you.
translation: 她的过世真是非常令人遗憾，她看到你时曾是那么地激动。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈点别的。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: All right, then.
translation: 好吧，那。

original: Well, that's okay, then.
translation: 行，那好吧。

original: It's just like up here, Pep. The place is a mess. I've got to be extra careful right about now.
translation: 正如你所见。这地方真乱。现在我应该格外小心。

original: Whole place is running a little too hot, but it'll calm down in time, like everything else around here.
translation: 整个地方气氛都很紧张，但会终究会缓和下来，正如这周围的一切。

original: I hope so, dear. I really do.
translation: 我也希望如此，亲爱的。真的。

original: Maybe you can change the Overseer's mind, dear.
translation: 或许你可以改变监督者的主意, 亲爱的。

original: Will do, Amata. You watch out for yourself, too.
translation: 我会的，阿玛塔。你自己也要小心。

original: You don't need to tell me. Just keep an eye on your father, all right?
translation: 你不必告诉我。只要留意你的父亲，好吗？

original: That's a damned shame, but maybe they'll come around in time. Keep working at it.
translation: 真他妈的可惜，不过或许他们会及时赶到。继续工作。

original: Hard to lead your Tunnel Snakes when they're afraid of getting stepped on, huh? Well, keep at it.
translation: 害怕被踩一脚之后，你的穴蛇帮就不好控制了，对吧？继续。

original: Well, ain't you a bundle of smiles. If it were just about staying alive, we might as well stick with your Dad.
translation: 你们不就是一堆笑料嘛。如果只是为了能活下去，我们不如也跟着你爸爸算了。

original: Look on the bright side, Amata: you get to look at my handsome mug again. Who wouldn't want that?
translation: 往好的方面想，阿玛塔：至少你又看到了我英俊的脸。谁不想这样呢？

original: Pack of cowards, if you ask me. If they don't grow a spine soon, I'm heading out myself. I mean it this time!
translation: 一群懦夫，要我说的话。如果他们再不立马鼓起勇气，我就将独自前往。我这次是认真的！

original: Aw, let 'em stay down here. One day, I'm heading out there on my own. I mean it.
translation: 喔，让他们呆在这吧。总有一天，我会自己去。我当真的。

original: Keep talking to them. If we're going to take a stand, we really want them on our side.
translation: 继续和他们交谈。如果我们想占有一席之地，我们真的需要他们站在我们这一边。

original: I swear, what sort of "rebels" are they? Keep talking to them, okay?
translation: 我发誓，他们怎么会是“反叛者”？继续和他们交谈，好吗？

original: Okay, keep listening, and see who else we can get to take a stand. And be careful up there.
translation: 好吧，仔细听着，看看我们还能争取到谁。要小心行事。

original: Keep an ear out up there. They'll get sick of father's lockdown eventually, and then we'll all take a stand.
translation: 提高警惕。他们最终会受不了父亲的封闭手段，到那时我们都会有机会。

original: Well, I guess it could be worse. But if I know father, he's not just going to change his mind on this.
translation: 我想可能更糟糕。但是如果我对父亲所料不差，他是不会在这问题上改变主意的。

original: That's better than nothing, I suppose. That may be all the good news we're getting, for now.
translation: 我想，这总比什么都没有好吧。这可能是目前我们能得到的最好的消息了。

original: Not yet. Freddie doesn't want to get in trouble, and Wally thinks we shouldn't be going outside, anyway.
translation: 还不行。弗雷迪并不想趟这浑水，并且瓦利也认为我们无论如何都不应该出去。

original: Paul would've joined up no problem, but... y'know. Anyway, no luck with them.
translation: 保罗毫无疑问会参加的，但…你知道的。不管怎么说，他们的运气可不好。

original: They're still scared: enough to stay quiet, but not enough to risk doing anything.
translation: 他们仍然在害怕：这足以让他们保持沉默，但不足以冒风险采取行动。

original: No development. They're still quiet and scared. We won't be getting any of them to make a stand anytime soon.
translation: 没有进展。他们仍然害怕并保持沉默。近期内我们无法让他们任何一人进行反抗。

original: It's not safe. We'll talk later.
translation: 现在不安全，我们待会再谈吧。

original: Yeah, sure, rebels. Any luck convincing anyone else to stand up to Father?
translation: 对，当然，反叛者。能说服其他人来对抗父亲吗？

original: We're not your ridiculous gang, Butch. We're actually trying to get something done. Any luck convincing more to join us?
translation: 我们不是你那可笑的帮会，布奇。实际上我们正在试图做点什么。能说服更多的人加入我们吗？

original: Looks like we're secure. What's the word up there?
translation: 看来我们安全了。上面怎么说？

original: We're safe. How's everyone holding up in the dorms?
translation: 我们很安全。这宿舍里的人还好吗？

original: Ix-nay on the alk-tay. We're being atched-way.
translation: 同—不—意—话—谈—。我们被监—着—视—

original: Calm down, old man. How's life in the west dorms?
translation: 冷静下来，老家伙。在西边宿舍的生活怎么样？

original: Don't worry, we're fine. What's the word in the dorms?
translation: 别担心，我们很好。宿舍里在谈论什么？

original: Come on, Amata. Who's gonna mess with me?
translation: 说吧，阿玛塔。是谁想惹我？

original: You know me. The Butch man fears no Overseer.
translation: 你知道的，布奇手下的人不害怕监督者。

original: Hold on. The walls have ears.
translation: 别说，小心隔墙有耳。

original: Looks like I made it through another day, for what that's worth. But I don't see much changing yet.
translation: 看样子我又坚持了一天，无论如何，这很值得。但我还没看到更多的变化。

original: I wasn't taken away in the night, for what that's worth. That's about the best news I've got to report.
translation: 我没有在晚上被带走，无论如何，这很值得。这大概是我所能报告的最好消息。

original: I survived the night, but I get the feeling there's change in the air. Don't know if it's good or bad, though.
translation: 我熬过了晚上，但我感觉到气氛有些变化。虽然不知道是好是坏。

original: I'm still alive, but I don't know how long that luck'll last. Seems like something big's about to transpire.
translation: 我还活着，但我不知道这运气还能持续多久。似乎有些大事即将发生。

original: First time in your life you're a rebel with a cause, boy. Any luck convincing your friends to join you in it?
translation: 这是你生平第一次进行有目的叛乱吧，孩子。能说服你朋友也加入我们吗？

original: You've got to take this seriously, boy. Any luck getting anyone else to join us?
translation: 你必须认真点，孩子。能说服其他人加入我们吗？

original: I don't know. He's not really my type. But at least you're here, too!
translation: 我不知道。他不是我喜欢的类型。但至少你也在这！

original: Not really. I mean, sure he's cool, but I don't really like him like that. You know? I'm just glad you're here, too.
translation: 未必。我的意思是：没错，他很棒，但我不喜欢他那样的人。你知道吗？我只是高兴你也在这。

original: I remember you said, yeah. That's so gross. Don't you wish it could be just Butch, instead?
translation: 是的，我记得你说过。这真令人恶心。你不希望让布奇来代替吗？

original: Ew, that's just creepy. Wouldn't it be so much better if it was just Butch, instead? He's dreamy.
translation: 哟，真让人起鸡皮疙瘩。如果换成布奇，那不会好很多吗？他很棒。

original: It's awful. Stuck in one room with Miss Palmer? It's just weird.
translation: 这太难受了。和帕尔默小姐困在同一个房间里？太别扭了。

original: Terrible! I can't believe I have to share a dorm with old lady Palmer. How creepy is that?
translation: 糟透了！我不敢相信我必须和帕尔默大妈共用一间宿舍。太令人毛骨悚然了！

original: We'll have the place back to normal in no time, sir. It'll just take some time to repair the damages he caused.
translation: 我们很快就会让一切恢复正常的，先生。只是要修复他所造成的损害还需要点时间。

original: Don't blame yourself, sir. We'll scrub every last trace of his influence from these halls, and then everything can go back to normal.
translation: 不要责怪你自己，先生。我们会清理掉他在大厅里留下的每处痕迹，然后一切都会回复原样。

original: Yes. You're right, of course. It was a mistake to let the doctor into our home, but we'll soon recover from his treatment.
translation: 是的。你当然是对的。让医生进来我们的家是个错误，但也因为有了他的治疗，我们才能快速恢复健康。

original: Indeed. As much as it seemed a good idea at the time, we should never have taken that doctor into our world.
translation: 确实。那时候看起来它算是个好主意，但我们真不应该让那医生进入我们的世界。

original: Sir? It's the only world we've ever known. With a regrettable exception, I suppose.
translation: 先生？我们只知道这片天地。不过，我猜有个令人遗憾的例外。

original: It's our home, sir. It's seen better days, of course, but we won't be making the same mistakes again, of course.
translation: 这是我们的家，先生。它曾经很不错，当然，不过我们肯定不会再犯同样的错误。

original: I guess. But... it didn't rule so much for Paul.
translation: 我估计是。但是……对保罗可没有太大的约束。

original: Yeah, we rule. It's just not the same without Paul saying it.
translation: 是的，我们统治。只是如果不是保罗说的，就会不太一样。

original: Freddie, there's more to this than just getting out of the dorm. It's about freedom and standing up to the Man! Tunnel Snakes rule!
translation: 弗雷迪, 还有比离开宿舍更重要的事要去做。那就是获得自由、反抗老头！穴蛇帮主宰一切！

original: Come on, have a little pride! What do Tunnel Snakes do? We don't sit around and hide in the dorm. We rule!
translation: 拜托，有点自尊啊！穴蛇帮会怎么做？我们不能坐以待毙的躲在宿舍里。我们要控制局势！

original: We're all the gang there is, Butch. But yeah, it's better than just sitting here alone.
translation: 我们都是帮中之人，布奇。不过也对，总比独自一人坐在这里好。

original: Better than sitting around at home, you know?
translation: 总比在家里无所事事的好，懂吗？

original: That's enough of the history lesson.
translation: 我听够你的历史课了。

original: If you say so, honey.
translation: 随便你，甜心。

original: So anyone can live in Megaton?
translation: 所以任何人都可以居住在兆吨镇了？

original: No. Space is limited these days. You see all of these people wandering around here? They live up in the common house and aren't really citizens.
translation: 不，现在没多少地方了。你看到在这游荡的人没？他们住在公用房屋里，但并不是真正的居民。

original: Most people around here keep one eye open around strangers, but me, I can spot a Raider spy at 100 meters. I'm not worried about it at all.
translation: 大多数在这的人都会对陌生人留个心眼，除了我，我可以在100米外认出一个歹徒间谍。我倒是一点也不担心。

original: But if having meetings and pretending to vote on things makes the others feel safer, so be it.
translation: 但是，如果开个会、表个决，这种事能让其他人感觉更安全的话，那就随便吧。

original: So it was just a collection of traders in the beginning?
translation: 那最开始的时候，只有商人聚集在这？

original: Not at first. It was a collection of people trying to get into the vault, people worshipping the bomb, and a few other refugees.
translation: 最开始的时候不是那样。而是一伙想进入避难所的人、一群崇拜核弹的人以及其他的难民。

original: Then the traders came. Now the caravans take care of most of the trading, but before they were set up, it was all Megaton.
translation: 然后商人们才来到这。现在商队垄断着大多数的交易，但在他们立足之前，全部是由兆吨镇控制的。

original: I worked on the caravans with my father for a while. That's how I met that worthless bag of liver spots I call a husband.
translation: 我和我父亲在商队里干过一段时间。这就是我怎么遇到我那没用丈夫的。

original: Why did they build the walls?
translation: 他们为什么要建造围墙？

original: Well, the Raiders, for one. Once the town got big enough, they'd wait until the traders and their guards were away, then come in and clean us out!
translation: 歹徒是一个原因。一旦这镇子变得够大，他们就会等商人和他们的护卫离开后，闯进来把我们洗劫一空！

original: Now the Super Mutants... They were a whole other breed of problem. They'd kill us if they had to, but mostly they tried to drag people away! Alive!
translation: 而现在又有了超级变种人……他们是另一大难题。如果有必要的话，他们会杀了我们，但大多数情况下他们却试图活捉我们！

original: So, eventually, my father did something about it. Him and a few others organized the traders and the citizens and built the walls.
translation: 所以，最终，我父亲实施了些对策。他和其他几个人，组织商人和居民们一起修建了这围墙。

original: So we're pretty safe now. Still, I wish those Brotherhood of Steel fellers hadn't hit on such hard times. They really helped keep the wolves at bay.
translation: 因此，我们现在很安全了。不过，我希望那些钢铁兄弟会的家伙不要在这艰难时期被打垮。他们的确帮我们挡住了群狼。

original: I had another question about Megaton.
translation: 关于兆吨镇，我还有一个问题。

original: Sure thing, hon.
translation: 当然可以，亲爱的。

original: Why build the walls out of some old flying machine?
translation: 为什么要用旧飞行机械修建围墙呢？

original: It's a hell of a lot easier than trying to find enough parts to build walls and houses from nothing. The scrap was there, why not use it?
translation: 那总比赤手空拳地造围墙和房子容易多了。即然有这么多的废料，为何不利用它呢？

original: Besides, it's sturdy. It keeps the Raiders and the dust storms out. Not all of us had the luck to be born in a vault, you know.
translation: 此外它很坚固，可以抵挡歹徒和沙尘暴。你知道的，不是所有的人都有好运气，能生在避难所里。

original: There are a lot of parts here for just one machine.
translation: 很多零件都是同一个机器上的。

original: Good eye. You're right honey, there are. There was an air station a couple of miles from here. It'd been stripped of everything except the planes.
translation: 好眼力。你说得对，甜心，的确是。这儿几英里外就有一个航空站。那里除了飞机外，其他东西都被搬光了。

original: My daddy got a bunch of people together to go out there, break apart the machines and drag back what we could use. It took 'em a couple of months.
translation: 我爸爸组织了一群人去那，拆散那些机器，并把我们能用到的东西拖了回来。这可用了他们几个月的时间。

original: You can't even tell where the air station was anymore. The Wasteland just took it back.
translation: 现在没人能说清那航空站在哪了。废土吞没了它。

original: So why didn't they move the bomb?
translation: 那他们为什么不把核弹移走？

original: Some of us wanted to. But the Church of Atom was just getting its start then. We needed their help to build the walls and clear the wreckage.
translation: 我们中有些人是想要这么做。但那时原子教派刚刚建立。我们需要他们的帮助来修建围墙和清理残骸。

original: If we'd have tried to move the bomb, they would have refused to help.
translation: 如果我们试图搬走核弹，他们就拒绝提供帮助。

original: Besides, a lot of people just wanted to leave it alone. It didn't seem to be hurting anything and who knows what would happen if we messed with it.
translation: 此外，很多人希望别动那个核弹。它似乎不会对安全造成威胁，而且要是去摆弄它，谁知道会发生什么事呢。

original: I don't want to talk about Megaton anymore.
translation: 我不想再谈论兆吨镇了。

original: Well, you come on back any time you want to hear more.
translation: 你要是了解更多的话随时可以回来。

original: Where did everyone else come from?
translation: 其他人都是从哪来的？

original: Oh, they come from all over... all over. You name it. The Stahl family grew up out east somewhere. Lucy's from some little settlement to the north.
translation: 哦，他们来自各处…各地。你说得出来的地方。斯塔尔家族曾在东边某地发展过。露西则是从北边某个小型定居点来的。

original: Billy doesn't really talk about where he's from. Doc Church used to live in Rivet City. Jericho... well... let's just say that men can change.
translation: 比利不愿说他是从哪来的。丘奇医生曾住在铆钉城。耶利哥…嗯…我们只能说人都会改变的。

original: ...I hope.
translation: ……我希望如此。

original: I think I get the picture.
translation: 我想我知道个大概了。

original: All right then. Anything else you wanted to know?
translation: 好的。你还想知道什么？

original: Tell me about Lucas Simms.
translation: 告诉我关于卢卡斯·西姆斯的事。

original: That man tries to bring law to this place. Lost cause if you ask me, but I respect his trying. He does seem to keep people in line though.
translation: 那人试图把法律引入这里。我只能说那注定是要失败的。但我尊重他所做的努力，他似乎的确让人们更守规矩了。

original: Other than that weird cowboy thing of his, I don't have much to complain about.
translation: 除了他自己那古怪牛仔的外表，我没什么可抱怨的。

original: Tell me about Colin Moriarty.
translation: 告诉我关于科林·莫里亚蒂的事。

original: That man is the scum of the Earth. He keeps the drunks around here soaking in liquor and that poor Nova, that girl deserves better.
translation: 他是个彻头彻尾的人渣。他让那些整天泡在酒坛子里的醉鬼在这附近乱转。可怜的诺瓦，她本来能过得更好。

original: And don't even get me started on how he treats Gob. Just because the boy looks dead doesn't mean that he should be treated like that.
translation: 还有他怎么对待盖博的事，更让我难以启齿。不能因为那男孩看起来像死人一样，就那样对待他啊。

original: That man has his fingers in everything around here. Just watch what you say about him, it'll always get back.
translation: 那家伙插手这的一切。谈论他的时候要小心，它们总能传到他的耳朵里。

original: Who's in charge around here?
translation: 这儿谁说的算？

original: Well, technically, no one. But you can't put two people in a room together without one of them trying to govern the other.
translation: 严格来说，没人。但当你把两个人放到同一房间时，他们之中总会有一人想支配另一人。

original: But it depends on who you ask. Lucas Simms appointed himself the Sheriff. He throws anyone out who causes too much trouble.
translation: 但是，这取决于你问谁。卢卡斯·西姆斯任命自己为警长。他把那些惹麻烦的家伙都赶了出去。

original: But Colin Moriarty runs just about everything else. Not much happens here that he doesn't know about. Or plan.
translation: 科林·莫里亚蒂控制着其它的一切。这的事没几件是他不知道的，或者不是他策划的。

original: Well, technically, no one. But you can't put two people in a room together without one of them trying to govern the other.
translation: 严格来说，没人。但当你把两个人放到同一房间时，他们之中总会有一人想支配另一人。

original: But it depends on who you ask. Lucas Simms appointed himself the Sheriff. He throws anyone out who causes too much trouble.
translation: 但是，这取决于你问谁。卢卡斯·西姆斯任命自己为警长。他把那些惹麻烦的家伙都赶了出去。

original: Colin Moriarty used to run just about everything else. Not much happened here that he doesn't know about. Or plan. I guess he got what was coming.
translation: 科林·莫里亚蒂曾经控制着其它的一切。这的事没几件是他不知道的，或者不是他策划的。我想他知道将要发生什么。

original: Well, technically, no one. But you can't put two people in a room together without one of them trying to govern the other.
translation: 严格来说，没人。但当你把两个人放到同一房间时，他们之中总会有一人想支配另一人。

original: But it depends on who you ask. Lucas Simms appointed himself the Sheriff. Before he died, he threw anyone out who caused too much trouble.
translation: 但是，这取决于你问谁。卢卡斯·西姆斯任命自己为警长。在他还活着的时候，他把那些惹麻烦的家伙都赶了出去。

original: Now Colin Moriarty runs just about everything. Not much happens here that he doesn't know about. Or plan. You ask me, he was behind Lucas' death.
translation: 科林·莫里亚蒂控制着一切。这的事没几件是他不知道的，或者不是他策划的。要问我的话，他是卢卡斯之死的幕后黑手。

original: Well, technically, no one. But you can't put two people in a room together without one of them trying to govern the other.
translation: 严格来说，没人。但当你把两个人放到同一房间时，他们之中总会有一人想支配另一人。

original: But it depends on who you ask. It used to be that Lucas Simms and Colin Moriarty fought each other for control.
translation: 但是，这取决于你问谁。过去，卢卡斯·西姆斯和科林·莫里亚蒂为了争夺控制权而相互争斗。

original: But with the two of them gone, who's to say what will happen around here? I'm just hoping that the Raiders don't show up again.
translation: 但是随着他们两人的离去，谁知道这里将会发生什么？我只是希望歹徒不要再出现了。

original: What's this place made of?
translation: 这地方是用什么建造的？

original: Long ago, before the war, there used to be machines -- they were like buses, but they flew through the sky, taking people anywhere they wanted to go.
translation: 很久以前，在大战之前，曾有一种机器 — 它们象公共汽车，但却是在天上飞的，能把人带去任何想去的地方。

original: You didn't have to walk, you just went to the air station, bought a ticket, and took to the skies. Anywhere in the world, you just up and flew there.
translation: 你不需要走路，你只需要去航空站，买张票，就能飞上天。你可以飞到世界上的任何地方。

original: When the war happened, the machines started dropping from the sky. Everyone around here thinks that the bomb made the crater, but it didn't.
translation: 当战争爆发后，这些机器开始从天上掉落下来。这的人都认为弹坑是核弹造成的，但其实并不是。

original: The crater provided good cover from the dust storms and when my daddy and the rest of the town decided to build the walls, they used what they had.
translation: 弹坑可以很好的用来躲避沙尘暴，而且当我父亲和镇上其他人决定修建围墙时，他们只能用手头上的东西。

original: How did you get here?
translation: 你是怎么到这里的？

original: I was born here, actually. Just like my papi. Oh, for a while I helped him scavenge and then later on his caravan.
translation: 实际上，我就出生在这。就像我爸爸一样。哦，我帮他捡过一阵破烂，后来还加入了他的商队。

original: But traipsing around the Wasteland is work for young people. After I met Nathan, I just wanted to stop moving around so much.
translation: 不过在废土中四处旅行可是年轻人的工作。在我遇到内森之后，我就再也不想四处逛了。

original: We've been here ever since. Of course, I can't say that it's been good for Nathan's sanity...
translation: 从那时起我们就在这了。当然，我不能说这对内森的心智健全有益。

original: How did the town start?
translation: 这镇子是怎么形成的？

original: Well, originally, it started as a hole in the ground. My papi talked about how his father and the original settlers just hid in this crater.
translation: 起初，它就是地上的一个洞。我爸爸说起过他的父亲和最初的居民们就躲在这弹坑里。

original: It was enough to keep them safe from the dust storms. When things cooled down and people started wandering into the Wastes, some stayed behind.
translation: 这足以保证他们能安全度过沙尘暴。当情势安定之后，人们又开始在废土中流浪，而一些人则留了下来。

original: The wanderers started coming back here to trade their stuff. By the time my papi was born, the town was a full on trading center.
translation: 一些流浪者又开始回到这里交易他们找到的东西。我爸爸出生的时候，这镇子是个繁荣的交易中心。

original: Papi got rich on the caravan routes and eventually convinced the others to build the walls to hold off the Raiders.
translation: 爸爸靠着商路发了财，并最终说服了其他人建造围墙来抵御歹徒们。

original: I had some questions about this town's history.
translation: 我想问些关于这个小镇的历史问题。

original: I can tell you just about anything you want to know, honey. Megaton's history ain't no secret.
translation: 甜心，想问什么就问吧。兆吨镇的历史是没有秘密的。

original: We should just go back to our quarters.
translation: 我们回宿舍吧。

original: It's our only chance, don't you see? We're getting out of here, just like the doctor. I'm not going to let anyone stop us.
translation: 你难道不明白这是我们唯一的机会吗？我们要离开这，就像那医生一样。我不会让任何人阻止我们的。

original: Tom! No!
translation: 汤姆！不！

original: Tom! Be careful!
translation: 汤姆！小心！

original: It's me! Tom Holden! Just let me through!
translation: 是我！汤姆·霍顿！让我过去！

original: What are you doing? Are you crazy? We'll shoot! Dammit, Tom.
translation: 你在干嘛？你疯了吗？我们会开枪的！该死的，汤姆。

original: Sounds like my kind of people.
translation: 听起来和我的性格很像。

original: If that's your kind of people, then you really need to take a long look at yourself and decide just what the hell is wrong with you.
translation: 如果性格和你很像，那你真得需要瞧瞧自己，并仔细想想你他妈的到底有什么毛病。

original: Well, wouldn't you kill if that was part of your contract?
translation: 如果合同规定，你会不杀人吗？

original: Look, those fucks went into a settlement a year or two ago and killed everyone. Women, children... everyone.
translation: 听着，一两年前, 那些杂种闯进了一个定居点并屠杀了所有的人。妇女、儿童……所有的人。

original: That's the sort of crap Talon Company does. All they care about is getting paid.
translation: 鹰爪公司专干那种好事。他们只关心如何挣工资。

original: Reilly's Rangers operate on a set of morals. We're here to help people, not as professional assassins.
translation: 莱莉的游骑兵有自己的道德准则。我们来这里是为了帮助人们，而不是来作职业杀手。

original: Have you had run-ins with them?
translation: 你曾与他们发生过争执吗？

original: Yeah, we've crossed paths. Fortunately, we just stepped out of each others way.
translation: 是啊，我们曾有过邂逅。幸运的是，我们都会避开对方。

original: Brick almost turned it into a damn bloodbath when one of them spit on her boots, but I was able to hold her back.
translation: 当他们有人将痰吐到布瑞克的靴子上时，她气得要大开杀戒，不过我及时制止了她。

original: Let's discuss something else.
translation: 让我们讨论点别的东西吧。

original: Sure thing.
translation: 当然的。

original: Whatever floats your boat.
translation: 随你便。

original: Fine by me.
translation: 我没问题。

original: Sounds good.
translation: 听起来不错。

original: What's the deal with Talon Company?
translation: 这和塔伦公司有什么关系？

original: Let me give you a word of advice. Stay away from them, they give mercs a bad name.
translation: 我给你个建议吧：远离他们，他们让佣兵恶名远扬。

original: They have no morals, no remorse and wouldn't hesitate to put a bullet through a defenseless man's head if it meant a job.
translation: 他们没有道德，没有良心，会毫不犹豫地用子弹射穿一个手无寸铁之人的脑袋 — 如果这是“工作内容”的话。

original: They've been pretty active lately around the old Capital Building ruins. I'd recommend giving that area a wide berth.
translation: 他们最近在旧政府大楼废墟周围非常活跃。我建议你离那地方远点。

original: On second thought, maybe I'll hang onto them.
translation: 仔细想想，或许我还是留着吧。

original: Then quit wasting my damn time, asshole!
translation: 那就别再浪费我的时间，混蛋！

original: I don't have that many caps.
translation: 我没那么多瓶盖。

original: Oh well. Tough luck for you I guess.
translation: 哦。我想你真够倒霉的。

original: That's very helpful. Here you go.
translation: 这非常有帮助。给你。

original: I suggest taking the door around the corner if you want to get where I think you're going. You'll find it unlocked in a moment.
translation: 如果我没猜错，我建议你走转弯处的那扇门。你待会就会发现它没上锁。

original: If I were you, I'd speak to Vance before you poke around too much. You can usually find him on the mezzanine overlooking the common area.
translation: 要是我的话，在四处游荡前会先和万斯谈谈。你能在上面俯瞰这个区域的平台上找到他。

original: I'm wondering what I could do with all these spare caps I have...
translation: 我不知道拿这些多余的瓶盖做什么……

original: Sounds like an interesting problem.
translation: 听起来像是个有趣的问题。

original: Let me take 100 of those off your hands... you know, to lighten the load.
translation: 让我从你手中拿走100个吧……帮你减轻负荷。

original: It's Cole Porter and "Anything Goes."
translation: 这是科尔·波特演唱的“万事成空”。

original: Here's Tex Beneke with... "A Wonderful Guy."
translation: 这是泰克斯·本尼克和一个……“棒小伙”。

original: It's the "First Lady of Song" herself, Miss Ella Fitzgerald, telling us that, "Into Each Life Some Rain Must Fall." Ain't that the truth, sister.
translation: 现在是“爵士第一夫人”本人，艾拉·费兹洁拉德，告诉我们“生活总会有风雨”。难道不是这样吗，我的姐妹！

original: Here's Danny Kaye and Andrew Sisters, crooning about - what else? - "Civilization."
translation: 现在由丹妮·凯依和安德鲁·凯依姐妹，低唱一曲 — 还有别的吗？ — “文明”。

original: How about some "Easy Living," from everyone' favorite songstress, Billie Holiday?
translation: 来点“轻松生活”怎么样？是人人都爱的女歌手比莉·霍利戴。

original: It's Billie Holiday with... "Crazy He Calls Me."
translation: 这是比莉·霍利戴…“他说我疯了”。

original: Up next is Roy Brown, tellin' us all about that, "Mighty Mighty Man."
translation: 下一首是罗伊·布朗，给我们说说“大男人”。

original: It's Roy Brown, singin' about the one, the only, "Butcher Pete"!
translation: 罗伊·布朗演唱的独一无二的“屠夫皮特”！

original: This is Bob Crosby, takin' us, "Way Back Home."
translation: 这是鲍勃·克罗斯比，正引领我们踏上“漫漫回家路”。

original: Here's Bob Crosby, singin' to us all about, "Happy Times."
translation: 这是鲍勃·克罗斯比，将告诉我们什么是“欢乐时光”！

original: It's the Ink Spots, and "Maybe."
translation: 掌声欢迎墨迹组合，以及“或许”。

original: This is the Ink Spots, with their timeless classic, "I Don't Want to Set the World on Fire."
translation: 这里是墨点乐队，以及他们的永恒经典《我不愿让世界燃烧》。

original: Now... some music.
translation: 现在……来点音乐。

original: And now... some music.
translation: 那么现在……来点音乐。

original: Sigh. I think we've lost this one, folks. Good kid goes bad, it's the story of the Wasteland, right? It's a sad, sad day for us all.
translation: 唉……我看我们失去了他，伙计们。好孩子总是变成坏人，这就是废土的故事，对吗？悲哀，对我们所有人而言，这是个伤心的日子。

original: Kid, if you're listening? Fool me once, shame on me. Fool me twice - fuck you, you worthless piece of shit.
translation: 小子，不知你有没有在听？你骗我一次，是我的耻辱。骗我两次 — 他妈的，你是一堆狗屎。

original: The kid from Vault 101 had ole Three Dog fooled. I had her pegged as one of the good guys and then, BAM -- she goes and acts all... evil.
translation: 来自101号避难所的孩子蒙蔽了老三狗。我认定她是个好人，但那是欺骗 — 她的所作所为都是……邪恶的。

original: The kid from Vault 101 had ole Three Dog fooled. I had him pegged as one of the good guys and then, BAM -- he goes and acts all... evil.
translation: 来自101号避难所的孩子蒙蔽了老三狗。我认定他是个好人，但那是欺骗 — 他的所作所为都是……邪恶的。

original: Is there not one human being with a shred of decency left in this entire back-asswards Wasteland?
translation: 难道在整个狗屎般的废土上，就没有一个人类有丝毫正义感？

original: Why? Why why why why why? Aggh! Faithful listeners, I'm disappointed. And you should be too.
translation: 为什么？为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么？哦！忠实的听众啊，我很失望。而你们也应该一样。

original: Again with the evil kid doing good things. I ask you, folks - has a soul been saved?  Keep fighting the Good Fight, kid. We're rootin' for ya.
translation: 邪恶的孩子又一次做了好事。我问你们，伙计们 — 有灵魂得到拯救了吗？继续圣战吧，孩子。我们做你的后援。

original: Kid, if you're listening - you did a good thing. Please, for all our sakes, keep it up. There are enough evil assholes out there already.
translation: 孩子，如果你正在听 — 你做了一件好事。求求你，为了我们大家，继续下去。外面的邪恶杂种已经够多的了。

original: But now, for some miraculous reason, She's had a change of heart! She's actually done something that can be considered - dare I say it? - "good"!
translation: 但现在，由于一些神奇的原因，她变了！她竟然做了件 — 我该这么说吗？ — “好事”！

original: But now, for some miraculous reason, he's had a change of heart! He's actually done something that can be considered - dare I say it? - "good"!
translation: 但现在，由于一些神奇的原因，他变了！他竟然做了件 — 我该这么说吗？ — “好事”！

original: My, my. What a curious turn of events. So here we have the kid from Vault 101, who by all accounts has a soul as black as charred Brahmin meat.
translation: 不是我不明白，这世界变化快。这个来自101号避难所的孩子，无论如何，有着一个和熏双头牛肉一样黑的灵魂。

original: Thanks for listening, children. This is Three Dog, and you're listening to Galaxy News Radio. We're Radio Free Wasteland, and we're here... for you.
translation: 感谢收听，孩子们。这里是三狗，你正在收听的是银河新闻电台。我们是自由废土电台，我们在此……为你们而存在。

original: Until next time, this is Three Dog, and you're listening to Galaxy News Radio, Bringing you the truth, no matter how bad it hurts.
translation: 下次再会，我是三狗，你正在收听银河新闻广播，为你呈现真相，哪怕真相会让人痛心。

original: Whoever lives in there sure as hell doesn't want what you're selling, and no, you can't knock down the door. It weighs like 13 tons.
translation: 里头的人绝对不稀罕你那点小算盘，再说了，那扇13吨重的门可不是说砸就能砸开的。

original: Hey, and in case a light bulb just started glowin' over your head, you can flick the switch and forget about it. You're not getting into that vault.
translation: 对了，要是你突然灵光一闪想搞事情，赶紧把念头掐了。那个避难所你是进不去的。

original: So if you see James out there, you say hello. Be kind to our new brother, and show him that here on the outside, we always fight the good fight.
translation: 所以各位要是在外头碰见詹姆斯，记得跟他打招呼。对咱们的新兄弟好点，让他知道在外面的世界，我们永远在为正义而战。

original: So I, the great and powerful Three Dog, set my brother straight. I told him what was what. Who are the winners, the losers, the movers and shakers.
translation: 于是，我，英明神武的三狗，给我的兄弟讲得明明白白。把现在谁混得风生水起，谁栽了跟头，谁是搅动风云的人物都掰扯明白了。

original: Now, this cat, James is his name, had been in a hole for years! He needed to know what was what out here in the beautiful Capital Wasteland!
translation: 这位仁兄，名叫詹姆斯，在那地儿待了好些年！他迫切想知道美丽的首都废土现在是个什么状况！

original: Well wouldn't you know it, someone's come out of it again! And, I kid you not, he came to visit yours truly right here in the studio!
translation: 你猜怎么着，最近又有个家伙钻出来了！而且说真的，这哥们竟然直接来演播室找我了！

original: Now, believe it or not, this one's still got people livin' in it! And every few years or so, someone comes scrabblin' out.
translation: 信不信由你，那里面到现在还有人居住！并且每隔几年，就会有人爬出来。

original: For those of you not in the know, to the northwest of Megaton there's this vault. Vault 101.
translation: 对还不知道的朋友，在兆吨镇的西北方向有个避难所——101号避难所。

original: Seems we've got a bit of news. Just listen to this.
translation: 看来我们有点新闻要报道。且听这个。

original: News time, children.
translation: 新闻时间，孩子们。

original: We interrupt our regularly scheduled program for some news.
translation: 我们暂停正常的节目，插播新闻。

original: Ah yes, time for the news.
translation: 对了，新闻时间。

original: And here's... me! With the news.
translation: 是……我！还有新闻！

original: Got lots of stuff goin' down in Post Apocalyptia these days. Here some of the latest news.
translation: 后启示录世界最近可是发生了不少事。以下是最新消息。

original: Arefu donates bloodpacks, and in exchange, you protect them.
translation: 断桥镇捐助血浆袋，做为交换，你们要保护他们。

original: Agreed. Please, take this proposal to Arefu. Speak with them and then return to me with their decision.
translation: 同意。请将此提议带给断桥镇。与他们谈谈，然后告诉我他们的决定。

original: I thank you for showing me that your kind can be trusted after all. It is a lesson I will not forget.
translation: 感谢你向我证明你们的种族也是可以信任的。我忘不了这次的经历。

original: Now, what of young Ian? Tell me his decision.
translation: 小伊恩怎样了？告诉我他的决定。

original: Arefu will sell you bloodpacks, and you'll leave the town alone.
translation: 断桥镇会卖给你们血浆袋，而你们别再招惹这个镇子。

original: Although I appreciate what you are trying to do, please realize that we have no money or goods to speak of.
translation: 虽然我很感激你所做的一切，但你要知道我们没有钱或货物来交易。

original: What little money Karl makes with his shop goes to buying weapons and ammunition to protect ourselves.
translation: 卡尔靠他那小店赚的钱都用来买武器弹药保护我们了。

original: I am very sorry, but perhaps you can make a better offer?
translation: 抱歉，或许你还能开出更好的提议？

original: Arefu donates bloodpacks, and you leave the town alone.
translation: 断桥镇会捐助血浆袋，你们别再骚扰这镇子了。

original: Agreed. Please, take this proposal to Arefu. Speak with them and then return to me with their decision.
translation: 同意。请将此提议带给断桥镇。与他们谈谈，然后告诉我他们的决定。

original: I thank you for showing me that your kind can be trusted after all. It is a lesson I will not forget.
translation: 感谢你向我证明你们的种族也是可以信任的。我忘不了这次的经历。

original: Now, what of young Ian? Tell me his decision.
translation: 小伊恩怎样了？告诉我他的决定。

original: There must be an alternative source of blood you can survive on.
translation: 肯定有一种能让你们能活下去的血源替代品。

original: Many years ago, I survived by drinking from fresh bloodpacks I recovered from hospital ruins.
translation: 多年前，我正是吸食从医院废墟里找出的新鲜血浆袋才活下来的。

original: The problem with your idea is that these bloodpacks are scarce.
translation: 你这种想法的问题在于：血浆袋很稀缺。

original: What do you propose?
translation: 你的想法是什么？

original: Come on, Vance! You're on a power trip... you mess with their minds!
translation: 好了，万斯！你沉浸在你的权利欲之中无法自拔……你这是在玩弄他们的思想！

original: Yes. In a way, I am brainwashing them. I am eliminating their fears, their inhibitions and their shame.
translation: 没错。从某种意义上说，我在给他们洗脑。我消除了他们的恐惧、顾虑和羞耻感。

original: I have reined in their cravings and taught them to eat not of the flesh, but to drink of the blood.
translation: 我已经减缓了他们的恶欲，并教导他们不要吃人肉，而只是喝血。

original: Most importantly, they have a Family. A place where their quirks are tolerated and understood.
translation: 最重要的是，他们有一个家族，一个宽容和理解他们的怪癖的地方。

original: What you're doing here is brainwashing them, plain and simple.
translation: 很明显，你现在在做的就是给他们洗脑。

original: Yes. In a way, I am brainwashing them. I am eliminating their fears, their inhibitions and their shame.
translation: 没错。从某种意义上说，我在给他们洗脑。我消除了他们的恐惧、顾虑和羞耻感。

original: I have reined in their cravings and taught them to eat not of the flesh, but to drink of the blood.
translation: 我已经减缓了他们的恶欲，并教导他们不要吃人肉，而只是喝血。

original: Most importantly, they have a Family. A place where their quirks are tolerated and understood.
translation: 最重要的是，他们有一个家族，一个宽容和理解他们的怪癖的地方。

original: I think you're a collective of seriously messed up freaks.
translation: 我想你就是个畸形变态的大杂烩。

original: I can see that you have no understanding of what I have accomplished here.
translation: 我想你还不了解我的成就有多大。

original: I tire of debating with those who are so narrow-minded.
translation: 我已经厌倦了同那些思想狭隘的人进行争论。

original: You're vampires. Or at least you follow their fictional traditions.
translation: 你们是血族。至少你追随他们那虚构的传统。

original: Do you think I believe I can turn into a bat and fly away? Of course not. Do I cast my image in a mirror? Absolutely.
translation: 你认为我会相信自己能变成一只蝙蝠飞走吗？当然不能。我会在镜子里照出自己吗？绝对会的。

original: Now ask me if I believe these individuals from every corner of the Wasteland need me to give them a sense of purpose and identity.
translation: 现在你可以问我是否相信这些从废土中各个角落来的人，都需要我来教导他们人生的目的和自身的价值。

original: I have shown these people the ways of the vampire. I've provided them shelter, organization and a sense of belonging.
translation: 我引导他们走上血族之路，为他们提供庇护、家园以及归属感。

original: Let me ask you something else.
translation: 让我来问你点别的事。

original: Certainly.
translation: 行。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Ha! You're as cowardly as a Brahmin! Watch this...
translation: 哈！你就像双头牛一样胆小！看着……

original: Careful! What if it's armed?
translation: 小心！如果它上膛了怎么办？

original: What the hell is going on down there? Revolution? Vacation? Somebody fart? Your guess is as good as mine, kiddies.
translation: 情况越来越好了。我这有一个新的报道，又有一个人爬出洞口了！

original: Turns out it gets better. I've got a new report here that says someone ELSE has just climbed out of that hole!
translation: 不久之前，我刚报道过：最近有一只猫离开了101号避难所。他的名字是詹姆斯。一个好人。

original: Not too long ago, I reported that a cat recently left Vault 101. His name is James. Good guy.
translation: 不久之前，我报告说有只猫离开了101避难所。他叫詹姆斯。是个好人。

original: For now, listen close, as I share yet another of our friend's adventures.
translation: 现在，仔细听喽，我要和你分享我的另一位朋友的冒险经历。

original: We'll get through this, children. You just gotta believe.
translation: 我们会熬过去的，孩子们。你们要坚信。

original: So believe me when I tell you that I was wrong. Dead wrong. That kid from Vault 101 is the Last, Best Hope of Humanity.
translation: 当我说我错了的时候，务必相信我。错到家了。那个从101号避难所来的孩子，是人类最后、最好的希望了。

original: I've always given it to you straight, have I not? For good or ill, Galaxy News Radio has been the voice of truth on these airwaves.
translation: 我总是对你们有话直说，对吧？无论是好是坏，银河新闻电台一直用这些电波传达真相。

original: The good ole U.S. of A... ahhh, she's a mess. I had pretty much written us all off. But that was before a certain kid from Vault 101...
translation: 美利坚合众…国…哈，她真是一团糟啊。几乎所有的人被我写进了死亡名单。但那是在某个小孩从101号避难所里出来之前…

original: All right, children. It's time for Three Dog to be honest with ya. Here it is, plain as day - I used to think we were all well and truly fucked.
translation: 好吧，孩子们。现在是三狗对你说实话的时间了。它就是，青天白日的 — 我过去认为我们肯定是彻彻底底的完蛋了。

original: And now for you other faithful listeners, here's an update on our friend.
translation: 为了你们这些忠实的听众，现在带来了有关于我们的朋友的新消息。

original: Kid from the vault, if you're listening, I want you to know that you are, truly, a Paradigm of Humanity. Keep on fighting, girl!
translation: 从避难所来的孩子，如果你在听，我想让你知道你简直就是“人性楷模”。继续战斗吧，小女孩！

original: Kid from the vault, if you're listening, I want you to know that you are, truly, a Paradigm of Humanity. Keep on fighting, man!
translation: 从避难所来的孩子，如果你在听，我想让你知道你简直就是“人性楷模”。继续战斗吧，小伙子！

original: I'm talkin' about the kid from Vault 101. Just 19, and this babe has been in some serious shit.  And there ain't no sign o' stoppin'!
translation: 我正在说的是关于101号避难所来的孩子。只有19岁，这宝贝已经陷入了可怕的麻烦中。但她并没有放弃和停止前进。

original: I'm talkin' about the kid from Vault 101. Just 19, and this cat has been in some serious shit.  And there ain't no sign o' stoppin'!
translation: 我正在说的是关于101号避难所来的孩子。只有19岁，这小猫已经陷入了可怕的麻烦中。但他并没有放弃和停止前进。

original: Alive? Yes. Still wandering? Uh huh. One of the most powerful individuals in the Capital Wasteland? You bet your bobby socks, Susie.
translation: 还活着？是。仍然在流浪？哈哈。首都废土中最强大的人中的一个？用你的短袜打赌，苏茜。

original: Alive? Yes. Still wandering? Uh huh. One of the most powerful individuals in the Capital Wasteland? You bet your bobby socks, Susie.
translation: 还活着？是。仍然在流浪？哈哈。首都废土中最强大的人中的一个？用你的短袜打赌，苏茜。

original: Here's the latest news on Vault 101's evil progeny...
translation: 这是最新消息：邪恶的101号避难所后代…

original: Why? Because that kid from Vault 101 is the worst thing to happen to our neighborhood since radiation sickness.
translation: 为什么？因为那101号避难所来的孩子是自辐射病以来，我们这地区遇上的最糟糕的事情。

original: If they rewrite the Bible, they really need to add that part.
translation: 如果他们重写圣经，他们真的需要把这部分加进去。

original: And lo, the girl did step forth from her shadowy hole, and proclaim herself Scourge of Humanity.
translation: 之后，那女孩果真走出了她那阴暗的洞穴，并宣布她自己是“人类公敌”。

original: And lo, the boy did step forth from his shadowy hole, and proclaim himself Scourge of Humanity.
translation: 之后，那男孩果真走出了他那阴暗的洞穴，并宣布他自己是“人类公敌”。

original: This just in, my friends. Looks like we've got an update on the Last, Best Hope of Humanity herself, the kid from Vault 101.
translation: 各位朋友，刚刚收到的消息。看来我们有了“人类最后、最好的希望”本人的最新消息，她就是来自101号避难所的那孩子。

original: This just in, my friends. Looks like we've got an update on the Last, Best Hope of Humanity himself, the kid from Vault 101.
translation: 各位朋友，刚刚收到的消息。看来我们有了“人类最后、最好的希望”本人的最新消息，他就是来自101号避难所的那孩子。

original: This just in, my friends. Looks like we've got an update on that Paradigm of Humanity, the kid from Vault 101.
translation: 各位朋友，刚刚收到的消息。看来我们有了“人性楷模”的最新消息，就是那个来自101号避难所的孩子。

original: This just in, my friends. Looks like we've got an update on that Scourge of Humanity, the kid from Vault 101.
translation: 各位朋友，刚刚收到的消息。看来我们有了“人类公敌”的最新消息，她就是来自101号避难所的那孩子。

original: Question. Is there a God, and if so, does he give a shit about the rest of us? I was skeptical, but that was before a certain Saint from Vault 101...
translation: 我确实不知道她是否还活着，但我得到了一条有关101号避难的孩子的新消息。我发誓，她肯定是超级人类什么的…

original: I don't know how she's even still alive, but I've got an update on the kid from Vault 101. I swear, she must be Super-Human or somethin'...
translation: 我确实不知道她是否还活着，但我得到了一条有关101号避难的孩子的新消息。我发誓，他肯定是超级人类什么的…

original: I don't know how he's even still alive, but I've got an update on the kid from Vault 101. I swear, he must be Super-Human or somethin'...
translation: 我有了一个新理论。101号避难所实际上就是地狱。听我说完。我的意思是，我们都知道并憎恶的那个孩子根本就是邪恶化身，对不对？现在是最新消息。

original: I have a new theory. Vault 101 is actually Hell. Hear me out. I mean, that kid we all know and hate is Evil Incarnate, right? Here's the latest.
translation: 嗨，就在那山脊上！是佛祖！是耶稣！不，那是…废土救星！现在是有关101号避难所土产救世主的新消息！

original: Hey, out on that ridge! It's Buddha! It's Jesus! No, it's the... Wasteland Savior! Here's an update on Vault 101's homegrown messiah.
translation: 她来自101号避难所…是朋友？还是敌人？或者仅仅是废土看客？这是个关于那从洞里出来的孩子的新消息…

original: She came from Vault 101... Friend? Foe? Or simple Wasteland Watcher? Here's an update on that kid from the hole...
translation: 他来自101号避难所…是朋友？还是敌人？或者仅仅是废土看客？这是个关于那从洞里出来的孩子的新消息…

original: He came from Vault 101... Friend? Foe? Or simple Wasteland Watcher? Here's an update on that kid from the hole...
translation: 正当你觉得外面已经疯透了的时候……这里有个新消息：是那个从101号避难所里出来的孩子，她自以为是废土毁灭者。

original: So. Just when you thought it was crazy enough out there... Here's an update on the kid from Vault 101 who fancies herself the Wasteland Destroyer.
translation: 正当你觉得外面已经疯透了的时候……这里有个新消息：是那个从101号避难所里出来的孩子，他自以为是废土毁灭者。

original: So. Just when you thought it was crazy enough out there... Here's an update on the kid from Vault 101 who fancies himself the Wasteland Destroyer.
translation: 老天爷！我爱上那避难所女孩了！头一天还是穴居人，第二天就成了全世界善良与正义的典范。并且，她一直忙于…

original: Lordy! I just love that vault girl! Hole-dweller one day, Paragon of all that is good and right in the world the next. And, she's been busy...
translation: 老天爷！我爱上那避难所男孩了！头一天还是穴居人，第二天就成了全世界善良与正义的典范。并且，他一直忙于…

original: Lordy! I just love that vault boy! Hole-dweller one day, Paragon of all that is good and right in the world the next. And, he's been busy...
translation: 啊，那101号避难所来的孩子。她捣乱，她帮忙，她他妈的想干嘛就干嘛。可以说，有时仅仅是个看客…一个旁观者。

original: Ah, the kid from Vault 101. She hurts, she helps, she does whatever she damn well pleases. Sometimes just a watcher... a Beholder, if you will.
translation: 而现在，“废！土！英！雄！”又开始刺激的冒险了。

original: And now, for another exciting adventure of, "The Hero... of the Wasssssttteesss!"
translation: 你在外面见过她的，她游荡于特区废墟，寻找冒险，不是吗？这就是101号避难所特产的荒野行者的最新消息。

original: You've seen her out there, haven't you, wandering the D.C. ruins, looking for adventure? The latest on Vault 101's very own Strider of the Wastes.
translation: 你在外面见过他的，他游荡于特区废墟，寻找冒险，不是吗？这就是101号避难所特产的荒野行者的最新消息。

original: You've seen him out there, haven't you, wandering the D.C. ruins, looking for adventure? The latest on Vault 101's very own Strider of the Wastes.
translation: 你认为超级变种人与钢铁兄弟会之间的烂事很糟糕？咱们听听战争先锋的最新消息吧，就是那个来自101号避难所的孩子。

original: You think all that shit between the Super Mutants and Brotherhood is bad? Here's the latest on the Harbinger of War himself, that kid from Vault 101.
translation: 你认为超级变种人与钢铁兄弟会之间的烂事很糟糕？咱们听听“战争先驱”的最新消息吧，他就是来自101号避难所的那孩子。

original: You think all that shit between the Super Mutants and Brotherhood is bad? Here's the latest on the Harbinger of War herself, that kid from Vault 101.
translation: 你认为超级变种人与钢铁兄弟会之间的烂事很糟糕？咱们听听“战争先驱”的最新消息吧，她就是来自101号避难所的那孩子。

original: Yeah, you guessed it - time for another update on the Villain of the Wastes herself, that evil little bitch from Vault 101.
translation: 是啊，你猜到了 — 现在播送另一则新消息：就是来自101号避难所的那个邪恶的小杂种，废土流氓。

original: Yeah, you guessed it - time for another update on the Villain of the Wastes himself, that evil little bastard from Vault 101.
translation: 哈利路亚！都市伟人是真的，孩子们！她真的存在，而且她就在外面，每天都在帮助着那些像你们一样贫穷懦弱的人。大快人心啊。

original: Hallelujah! The Urban Legend is real, children! She's real, and she's out there, everyday, helping poor shlubs like you. The latest and greatest.
translation: 哈利路亚！孩子们，“都市传奇”是真实存在的！她不玩虚的，每天都在外边，帮助你们这样的小人物。最新最劲爆的消息给您整上。

original: Hallelujah! The Urban Legend is real, children! He's real, and he's out there, everyday, helping poor shlubs like you. The latest and greatest.
translation: 哈利路亚！孩子们，“都市传奇”是真实存在的！他不玩虚的，每天都在外边，帮助你们这样的小人物。最新最劲爆的消息给您整上。

original: Special report! Da da dum dum, da da da dum dum! This just in -- The kid from Vault 101 is not just an Urban Myth ! Oh, she's real all right.
translation: 特别报道！哒哒铛铛，哒哒哒铛铛铛！刚得到的消息——来自101号避难所的那孩子不只是都市神话！哦，她是真实存在的。

original: Special report! Da da dum dum, da da da dum dum! This just in -- The kid from Vault 101 is not just an Urban Myth ! Oh, he's real all right.
translation: 特别报道！哒哒铛铛，哒哒哒铛铛铛！刚得到的消息——来自101号避难所的那孩子不只是都市神话！哦，他是真实存在的。

original: You don't want to believe it, I know. That kid from Vault 101, he can't be real. He's just some creepy Urban Superstition, right? Wrong.
translation: 我知道，你们不想相信它。来自101号避难所的孩子，她不可能真的存在。她只是一些令人毛骨悚然的都市信徒，对不对？错。

original: You don't want to believe it, I know. That kid from Vault 101, she can't be real. She's just some creepy Urban Superstition, right? Wrong.
translation: 憎恨、偏见、暴力。抛开这一切吧。来自101号避难所的孩子做到了，为什么你不能？这是我们的和平大使的最新消息。

original: Hate. Prejudice. Violence. Leave 'em all behind. The kid from Vault 101 did, so why can't you? The latest on our own Ambassador of Peace.
translation: 仇恨，偏见，暴力，全都抛在脑后。来自101号避难所的孩子做到了，你为什么不能？这是来自我们“和平使者”的最新消息。

original: Never quit. Never stop believing. That's the story of the cat from Vault 101. Here's the latest on the very Pinnacle of Survival.
translation: 永不放弃。永不放弃信念。这就是来自101号避难所小伙的故事。以下是关于“顶级生存者”的最新消息。

original: Want peace and quiet? Good luck with that, kids. The name of the game is chaos, thanks to Vault 101's own Harbinger of War. Listen and learn.
translation: 想要宁静？祝你们好运，孩子们。游戏的名字叫“混乱”，这要归功于101避难所自己的“战争先驱”。听一听，学一学。

original: And now an update on everyone's favorite hero from a hole, a gal I feel really comfortable calling - drum roll please - the Vault Legend!
translation: 有关那个从洞里钻出来的英雄我们有条新消息，我觉得这样叫那小子更舒服 — 来点鼓声 — 避难所伟人！

original: And now an update on everyone's favorite hero from a hole, a guy I feel really comfortable calling - drum roll please - the Vault Legend!
translation: 现在，有一个小故事。关于一个从洞里爬出来的小男孩。当然，我谈的正是那避难所后人。这是最新的消息。

original: And now, a little story. A story about a boy who climbed out of a hole. I'm talkin' about that Vault Descendent, of course. Here's the latest.
translation: 现在，有一个小故事。关于一个从洞里爬出来的小女孩。当然，我谈的正是那避难所后人。这是最新的消息。

original: And now, a little story. A story about a girl who climbed out of a hole. I'm talkin' about that Vault Descendent, of course. Here's the latest.
translation: 我的孩子们，又到了毛骨悚然、惊恐万状的时间了。你可知道那令人起鸡皮疙瘩的避难所恶巫有什么目的吗？好好听着。

original: Time again, my children, for chills and thrills, fears and scares. Do you know what that creepy Vault Boogeyman has been up to? Listen to this.
translation: 一个圣骑士来到了我们中间，孩子们。而且，这不是来自钢铁兄弟会的弟兄。我说的是那披着闪亮的避难所外套的骑士。

original: A Paladin walks among us, children. And no, this ain't one of our buddies from the Brotherhood. I'm talking about that knight in shining vault suit.
translation: 现在，101号避难所的疯小子有了新消息。让我们称他为守护者吧。承诺、秘密、和他自己的命运的守护者。

original: Now, an update on a certain crazy dude from Vault 101. Let's call him the Keeper. The Keeper of promises, of secrets, of his own destiny.
translation: 现在，101号避难所的疯小妞有了新消息。让我们称她为守护者吧。承诺、秘密、和她自己的命运的守护者。

original: Now, an update on a certain crazy chick from Vault 101. Let's call her the Keeper. The Keeper of promises, of secrets, of her own destiny.
translation: 我知道，我知道，你想打听101号避难所小姐的小道消息。现在是快讯时间 — 那个他妈的无情的玷污者仍然活着，可以了吧？

original: I know, I know, you want the skinny on Miss Vault 101. Well here's a news flash - that merciless fucking Defiler is still out there, all right?
translation: 我知道，我知道，你想打听101号避难所先生的小道消息。现在是快讯时间 — 那个他妈的无情的玷污者仍然活着，可以了吧？

original: I know, I know, you want the skinny on Mister Vault 101. Well here's a news flash - that merciless fucking Defiler is still out there, all right?
translation: 孩子们，又到了那个的时间了！首都十字军大冒险！哇哦！加油！严肃点，你们怎么可能不稀罕这小妞呢？我说的对吗？

original: It's that time again, kids! The adventures of... the Capital Crusader! Yeah! Hurray! Seriously, how can you not dig this gal? Am I right?
translation: 孩子们，又到了那个的时间了！首都十字军大冒险！哇哦！加油！严肃点，你们怎么可能不稀罕这小子呢？我说的对吗？

original: It's that time again, kids! The adventures of... the Capital Crusader! Yeah! Hurray! Seriously, how can you not dig this guy? Am I right?
translation: 不偏不倚，宝贝儿。这是今天的教训，由我们自己的华盛顿顾问所总结。或许那扇避难所大门通往瑞士吧？总之，她又有行动了。

original: Neutrality, baby. That's today's lesson, taught by our own Capital Councilor. Maybe that vault door leads to Switzerland? Anyway, she's at it again.
translation: 不偏不倚，宝贝儿。这是今天的教训，由我们自己的华盛顿顾问所总结。或许那扇避难所大门通往瑞士吧？总之，他又有行动了。

original: Neutrality, baby. That's today's lesson, taught by our own Capital Councilor. Maybe that vault door leads to Switzerland? Anyway, he's at it again.
translation: 别再说那101号避难所来的孩子了，他过着毫无悔意，粗暴蛮横的生活。天哪，他就像……就像是华盛顿大魔头。

original: Now more on the kid from Vault 101, living a life of unrepentant vice and violence. Jesus, he's like some kind of, of... Capital Crimelord.
translation: 别再说那101号避难所来的孩子了，她过着毫无悔意，粗暴蛮横的生活。天哪，她就像……就像是华盛顿大魔头。

original: Now more on the kid from Vault 101, living a life of unrepentant vice and violence. Jesus, she's like some kind of, of... Capital Crimelord.
translation: 嗨，我们那101号避难所里的朋友又出手了。真是个模范标兵，向我们所有人展示了什么是爱、同情、还有其他那些废话。

original: Hey, our friend from Vault 101 is at it again. A true Exemplar, showing us all the true meaning of love, compassion, and all that other crap.
translation: 来自101号避难所里的孩子的新消息，一直有着模糊的道德标准。是天使？是恶魔？现在看来，更像是一位中立的观察员。

original: Now more on the kid from Vault 101, keeping that moral compass firmly grounded in gray. Angel? Devil? More like neutral Observer at this point.
translation: 好吧，来看看。那个从101号避难所里出来的、满腔仇恨的小废物有新消息吗？……的确有……

original: Okay, let's see. Anything new with that rancorous little Ne'er-do-well from Vault 101? Well, there's this...
translation: 我们的都市守卫者有了新消息。她离开避难所只是为了帮助我们吗？谁在乎呢，伙计。无论如何，我们都欠她的人情。听听这个。

original: And now an update on our very own Urban Defender. Did she leave that vault just to help us? Who cares, man. We owe her either way. Check this out.
translation: 我们的都市守卫者有了新消息。他离开避难所只是为了帮助我们吗？谁在乎呢，伙计。无论如何，我们都欠他的人情。听听这个。

original: And now an update on our very own Urban Defender. Did he leave that vault just to help us? Who cares, man. We owe him either way. Check this out.
translation: 在洞穴里长大，封闭又无聊？来废土逛逛吧！是的，你也可以成为一名都市游骑兵！现在，是101号避难所的孩子的最新消息。

original: Grow up in a hole, confined and bored? Hit the Wasteland! You, too, can be an Urban Ranger! And now, the latest on the kid from Vault 101.
translation: 伙计，我讨厌这个小庞克了。从单纯的避难所孩子到神经有问题的都市侵略者。这是最新的消息……

original: Man, am I getting sick of this little punk. From innocent vault kid to sicko Urban Invader. Here's the latest...
translation: 现在，是大伙喜欢的101号避难所小金豆的最新消息。她正在外面充当着我们的保护者，所以，对那孩子尊重一些。听听这个。

original: Now the latest on everyone's favorite runt from Vault 101. She's out there serving as our Protector, so show the kid some respect. Listen to this.
translation: 现在，是大伙喜欢的101号避难所小金豆的最新消息。他正在外面充当着我们的保护者，所以，对那孩子尊重一些。听听这个。

original: Now the latest on everyone's favorite runt from Vault 101. He's out there serving as our Protector, so show the kid some respect. Listen to this.
translation: 嗨！101号避难所的孩子发生什么都无所谓？呃？哦！哦！我知道了！哥们，那女孩已经变成了一个心黑手狠的废土雇佣兵。

original: Hey! So whatever happened to that kid from Vault 101? Huh? Ooh! Ooh! I know! Man, that girl has turned into one hard-edged Wasteland Mercenary.
translation: 嗨！101号避难所的孩子发生什么都无所谓？呃？哦！哦！我知道了！哥们，那小猫已经变成了一个心黑手狠的废土雇佣兵。

original: Hey! So whatever happened to that kid from Vault 101? Huh? Ooh! Ooh! I know! Man, that cat has turned into one hard-edged Wasteland Mercenary.
translation: 提问时间，孩子们。你们知道强盗是什么吗？它是一个杀手、一个骗子、一个怪物。换句话说，就是那从101号避难所出来的杂种。快看看吧。

original: Question time, kids. You know what a Reaver is? It's a killer, a liar, a monster. In other words, it's that bastard from Vault 101. Check it out.
translation: 提问时间，孩子们。你们知道强盗是什么吗？它是一个杀手、一个骗子、一个怪物。换句话说，就是那从101号避难所出来的婊子。快看看吧。

original: Question time, kids. You know what a Reaver is? It's a killer, a liar, a monster. In other words, it's that bitch from Vault 101. Check it out.
translation: 好消息，孩子们！我们的101号避难所来的老朋友仍然 — 活着！看来真的有上帝啊。这就是废土游骑兵的最新消息。

original: Good news, kids! Our old friend from Vault 101 is - get this - still alive! Guess there is a God. Here's your update on the Ranger of the Wastes.
translation: 有一些消息，小子们。看来那从101号避难所来的小妞还能蹦蹦跳跳的。现在，让我们来一条好点的消息吧，是关于废土浪人的。

original: Got some news for you kiddies. Looks like that chick from Vault 101 is still kicking. And now, a friendly update on the Vagabond of the Wastes.
translation: 有一些消息，小子们。看来那从101号避难所来的小子还能蹦蹦跳跳的。现在，让我们来一条好点的消息吧，是关于废土浪人的。

original: Got some news for you kiddies. Looks like that dude from Vault 101 is still kicking. And now, a friendly update on the Vagabond of the Wastes.
translation: 快讯！仔细听着，孩子们。锁好你们那该死的大门吧。有废土大盗出没，大肆破坏、涂炭生灵。现在是最新情报。

original: News flash! Listen up, children. Lock your damn doors. The Pirate of the Wastes is out there, wreaking havoc, wrecking lives. Here's the latest.
translation: 现在说说101号避难所的和事佬的新消息，这小子证明了外头的人并不全都是……混蛋。

original: It’s time for an update on that Vault 101 Peacekeeper, a man who proves that not everyone out there... is a complete asshole.
translation: 现在说说101号避难所的和事佬的新消息，这小妞证明了外头的人并不全都是……混蛋。

original: It’s time for an update on that Vault 101 Peacekeeper, a gal who proves that not everyone out there... is a complete asshole.
translation: 看起来，那个101号避难所的迷路的小男孩这些天已成为了一个相当了得的冒险家了……

original: It seems the lost little boy from Vault 101 has become quite the Adventurer these days...
translation: 看起来，那个101号避难所的迷路的小女孩这些天已成为了一个相当了得的冒险家了……

original: It seems the lost little girl from Vault 101 has become quite the Adventurer these days...
translation: 你认识她，你憎恨她。（你怎能不恨？）她是闯出101号避难所的邪恶的掠夺者。你永远猜不到她现在在想什么。

original: You know her, you hate her. (How could you not?) She's the malignant Marauder who oozed out of Vault 101. You'll never guess what she's up to now.
translation: 你认识他，你憎恨他。（你怎能不恨？）他是闯出101号避难所的邪恶的掠夺者。你永远猜不到他现在在想什么。

original: You know him, you hate him. (How could you not?) He's the malignant Marauder who oozed out of Vault 101. You'll never guess what he's up to now.
translation: 好了，孩子们。我有最新的小道消息，关于101号避难所那迷人的小猫的，那位首都废土最新、最正直的显要人物。听我详说。

original: Okay, children. I've got the skinny on the Capital Wasteland's newest, noblest Dignitary, that charming cat from Vault 101. Check this out.
translation: 好了，孩子们。我有最新的小道消息，关于那位首都废土的最新公民的。好奇吧，听我详说。

original: Okay, children. I've got the skinny on the Capital Wasteland's newest Citizen. Curious? Of course you are. Check this out.
translation: 好吧，忠实的听众们，我知道你们都想知道什么。那只龌龊的肥猫现在在做什么？我敢打赌，肯定在磨利他的爪子……

original: All right, faithful listeners, I know what you really want to know. What's that nasty Fatcat up to? Sharpening his claws, I bet...
translation: 好吧，忠实的听众们，我知道你们都想知道什么。那只龌龊的肥猫现在在做什么？我敢打赌，肯定在磨利她的爪子……

original: All right, faithful listeners, I know what you really want to know. What's that nasty Fatcat up to? Sharpening her claws, I bet...
translation: 现在，快看看大伙最亲爱的守卫者的最新消息吧，就是那一招将狂野废土上的邪恶击败的人。

original: Now, let's check out the latest on everyone's darling Defender, giving evil the one-two punch out there in the wooly Wasteland.
translation: 现在，让我们看看那关于来自101号避难所的流浪者的最新消息吧，她……正在流浪。

original: Now, let's check out the latest on the Vault 101 Wanderer, as she, well, wanders.
translation: 现在，让我们看看那关于来自101号避难所的流浪者的最新消息吧，他……正在流浪。

original: Now, let's check out the latest on the Vault 101 Wanderer, as he, well, wanders.
translation: 想知道来自101号避难所没心没肺的小抢劫犯的最新消息吗？行啊。

original: Want to know the latest on that heartless little Plunderer from Vault 101? Here's the deal.
translation: 大家最喜欢的哨兵在做什么呢？以下就是来自101号避难所的可爱孩子的最新消息。

original: So what's everyone's favorite Sentinel been up to? Here's the latest on that sweet kid from Vault 101.
translation: 那勇敢的搜寻者在做什么呢？以下就是关于来自101号避难所的孩子的最新消息。

original: So what's that brave little Seeker been up to? Here's the latest on the kid from Vault 101.
translation: 那令人不寒而栗的投机客在做什么呢，呃？以下就是关于来自101号避难所的孩子的最新消息。

original: So what's that creepy Opportunist been up to, huh? Here's the latest on the kid from Vault 101.
translation: 现在是关于那神秘的避难所受难者的最新消息，就是那最近才离开101号避难所，走进我们内心的人。

original: And now the latest on that enigmatic Vault Martyr, who only recently stepped out of Vault 101 and into our hearts.
translation: 现在是关于那神秘的避难所叛徒的最新消息，就是那最近才离开101号避难所，并走进我们生活的人。

original: And now the latest on that enigmatic Vault Renegade, who only recently stepped out of Vault 101 and into our lives.
translation: 现在是关于那神秘的避难所歹徒的最新消息，就是那最近才离开101号避难所，并走进我们恶梦的人。

original: And now the latest on that enigmatic Vault Outlaw, who only recently stepped out of Vault 101 and into our nightmares.
translation: 现在是关于那个神秘的避难所狂徒的最新消息，他刚刚走出101避难所，就成了我们的噩梦。

original: You play live on the radio all the time? That must be exhausting!
translation: 你一直都电台直播？那一定非常的让人疲惫！

original: Oh, don't be silly!
translation: 哦，别傻了！

original: I record everything I play on the nice machines built into my husband's old radio gear.
translation: 我把演奏都记录在了那个美妙的机器里 — 就是我丈夫的老电台。

original: That way you can hear the music anytime you want, and this old woman can get some well-needed beauty sleep!
translation: 这样，你就可以随时听到你想要的音乐，而我这老太婆也能睡个安稳觉了！

original: What were you doing up here?
translation: 你们在上面做什么？

original: We were looking for Fat Man ammo. One of the Scribes found a reference to a storage box in some old documents.
translation: 我们正在寻找“胖子”微型核弹发射器的弹药。有个文士在一些旧文件里发现了涉及存储箱的信息。

original: We found the box, alright. And the key. But then the Mutants showed up. If I didn't know better, I'd swear that this was a trap!
translation: 我们发现了“盒子”和钥匙。但那时变种人却出现了。要不是我心里有数，肯定会说那是一个陷阱！

original: But the only way that those Mutants will lay a hand on this key is over my cold, dead body.
translation: 不过除非我死了，否则那些变种人休想染指这钥匙。

original: Never mind.
translation: 别介意。

original: Very well.
translation: 那好吧。

original: Take all the Holotags I have.
translation: 把我所有的全息军牌拿走吧。

original: Their names shall be written into the Scrolls to be remembered forever.
translation: 他们的名字将被写在卷中，永世流传。

original: As for you, here is your reward. Use it well, and in good health.
translation: 至于你，这是你的报酬。好好用它吧，并祝你身体健康。

original: I have five Holotags for you.
translation: 我有5个全息军牌给你。

original: Their names shall be written into the Scrolls to be remembered forever.
translation: 他们的名字将被写在卷中，永世流传。

original: As for you, here is your reward. Use it well, and in good health.
translation: 至于你，这是你的报酬。好好用它吧，并祝你身体健康。

original: I have four Holotags for you.
translation: 我有4个全息军牌给你。

original: Their names shall be written into the Scrolls to be remembered forever.
translation: 他们的名字将被写在卷中，永世流传。

original: As for you, here is your reward. Use it well, and in good health.
translation: 至于你，这是你的报酬。好好用它吧，并祝你身体健康。

original: I have three Holotags for you.
translation: 我有3个全息军牌给你。

original: Their names shall be written into the Scrolls to be remembered forever.
translation: 他们的名字将被写在卷中，永世流传。

original: As for you, here is your reward. Use it well, and in good health.
translation: 至于你，这是你的报酬。好好用它吧，并祝你身体健康。

original: I have two Holotags for you.
translation: 我有2个全息军牌给你。

original: Their names shall be written into the Scrolls to be remembered forever.
translation: 他们的名字将被写在卷中，永世流传。

original: As for you, here is your reward. Use it well, and in good health.
translation: 至于你，这是你的报酬。好好用它吧，并祝你身体健康。

original: I have one Holotag for you.
translation: 我有1个全息军牌给你。

original: Their names shall be written into the Scrolls to be remembered forever.
translation: 他们的名字将被写在卷中，永世流传。

original: As for you, here is your reward. Use it well, and in good health.
translation: 至于你，这是你的报酬。好好用它吧，并祝你身体健康。

original: Actually, I don't have any books to trade.
translation: 其实，我没有什么书可供交易。

original: Then why are you wasting my time? Honestly. Do you think that's funny?
translation: 你为什么要浪费我的时间？老实说。你觉得这样很好玩吗？

original: Take all the books I have.
translation: 这是我找到的书，全拿去吧。

original: Very well. Here is your reward. Use it well and return with more books when you can.
translation: 非常好。这是你的报酬。好好用它。如果可能的话，下次多带点书回来吧。

original: Actually, never mind.
translation: 实际上，没什么。

original: Very well.
translation: 那好吧。

original: I'll trade five.
translation: 我要交易5本。

original: Very well. Here is your reward. Use it well and return with more books when you can.
translation: 非常好。这是你的报酬。好好用它。如果可能的话，下次多带点书回来吧。

original: I'll trade four.
translation: 我要交易4本。

original: Very well. Here is your reward. Use it well and return with more books when you can.
translation: 非常好。这是你的报酬。好好用它。如果可能的话，就带回更多的书吧。

original: I'll trade three.
translation: 我要交易3本。

original: Very well. Here is your reward. Use it well and return with more books when you can.
translation: 非常好。这是你的报酬。好好用它。如果可能的话，下次多带点书回来吧。

original: I'll trade two.
translation: 我要交易2本。

original: Very well. Here is your reward. Use it well and return with more books when you can.
translation: 非常好。这是你的报酬。好好用它。如果可能的话，下次多带点书回来吧。

original: I'll trade one.
translation: 我要交易1本。

original: Very well. Here is your reward. Use it well and return with more books when you can.
translation: 非常好。这是你的报酬。好好用它。如果可能的话，下次多带点书回来吧。

original: I see. Thanks.
translation: 我知道了，谢谢。

original: Certainly.
translation: 行。

original: Wait... Is there a problem with your Elder?
translation: 等等……长老有什么问题？

original: It is not my place to criticize Elder Lyons. All I will say to an outsider is that he is not a traditionalist. That is all.
translation: 这可不是我能评论里昂斯长老的地方。对一个外来者，我只能说：他不是一个遵循传统的人。这就是我要说的。

original: What do you do in this library?
translation: 你在这图书馆里干嘛？

original: We have set up this area as a forward operations center for our project. The books we collect can be recorded with the computer systems here.
translation: 我们设立这地方作为我们计划的前方行动中心。我们收集的书籍可以在这被输进电脑系统中。

original: We then ship them under escort back to the Citadel for transcribing into the archives there.
translation: 然后，我们把这些护送运回五角大本营以便转换成档案保存。

original: Why are you collecting books?
translation: 为什么你们要收集这些书？

original: Books represent the collected knowledge of the world before. Everything from a child's story book to a detailed technical guide has value.
translation: 书籍是战前世界所汇集知识的表率。无论是儿童的故事书还是详细的技术指导手册，都极富价值。

original: By assembling and recording this knowledge, we scribes can analyze it and use it to further the goals of the Brotherhood.
translation: 通过收集和记录这些知识，我们文士可以分析它，并用它来为钢铁兄弟会未来的目标服务。

original: Whatever our Elder decides that those goals are, that is.
translation: 无论我们的长老决定的是什么，那都是我们的目标。

original: I have Pre-War Books for you.
translation: 我有些战前的书籍要给你。

original: Excellent. How many are you willing to trade?
translation: 好极了，你要交易多少？

original: You have no such thing. I do not have time for these jokes.
translation: 你根本就没有这东西。我可没时间浪费在这种玩笑上。

original: The mighty Brotherhood is gathering books? Seriously?
translation: 强大的钢铁兄弟会正在收集书籍？你确定？

original: The collected knowledge of a lost age is worth far more than any weapon. Do not underestimate the power of the written word.
translation: 收集有过去那时代的知识远要比任何武器更具价值。不要低估这些文字的力量。

original: But, I will overlook your disrespect because you can be of use. Should you come across any Pre-War Books in your travels, bring them here.
translation: 但是，我不会在意你的无礼，因为你还有用处。如果你在旅途中碰到了任何战前书籍的话，就把它们带到这来吧。

original: I will compensate you for every volume that you bring me. Think on it, and return when you have books to offer me.
translation: 你带给我的每本书我都会付你报酬的。考虑一下，当你有书能给我时就回来吧。

original: And you want me to help you gather books, right?
translation: 你要我帮你收集书籍，对不对？

original: Precisely. The collected knowledge of a lost age is worth far more than any weapon. So, return here with any books that you find in good condition.
translation: 正是。收集过去那时代的知识远要比任何武器更具价值。所以，如果你找到任何书籍，只要它还可以阅读，就带回这吧。

original: I will compensate you for every volume that you bring me. Think on it, and return when you have books to offer me.
translation: 你带给我的每本书我都会付你报酬的。考虑一下，当你有书能给我时就回来吧。

original: Money and the promise of mysterious compensation? I'm in.
translation: 有金钱和神秘奖赏的许诺？我加入了。

original: If nothing else, I admire your commitment to your chosen focus.
translation: 如果不是因为别的什么，我会很欣赏你对你自己承诺的执着。

original: But, to the point: My task here is to collect the written works of those who came before in order to supplement the Brotherhood archives.
translation: 但是，有一点要说明：我在这的任务就是收集那些过去遗留下来的书籍，用以完善钢铁兄弟会的档案。

original: Although most of the pre-war books have been destroyed, there are a few that have survived. But finding a book in the ruins is... difficult.
translation: 虽然大部分战前书籍已被摧毁了，但还是有少部分被保存了下来。不过，要在废墟中找到一本书的确是件……困难事。

original: So, return here with any Pre-War Books that you find and I will reward you for them. With money. Because that's what you like.
translation: 所以，把任何你找到的战前书籍都带回这，我会为此付给你报酬的。当然是钱。因为那是你最喜欢的。

original: As long as there's money involved, I'm in. Mmmm.... money.
translation: 只要跟钱有关，我就加入。嗯……钱。

original: If nothing else, I admire your commitment to your chosen focus.
translation: 如果不是因为别的什么，我会很欣赏你对你自己承诺的执着。

original: But, to the point: My task here is to collect the written works of those who came before in order to supplement the Brotherhood archives.
translation: 但是，有一点要说明：我在这的任务就是收集那些过去遗留下来的书籍，用以完善钢铁兄弟会的档案。

original: Although most of the pre-war books have been destroyed, there are a few that have survived. But finding a book in the ruins is... difficult.
translation: 虽然大部分战前书籍已被摧毁了，但还是有少部分被保存了下来。不过，要在废墟中找到一本书的确是件……困难事。

original: So, return here with any books that you find and I will reward you for them. With money. Because that's what you like.
translation: 所以，把任何你找到的战前书籍都带回这，我会为此付给你报酬的。当然是钱。因为那是你最喜欢的。

original: Sorry, I'm too busy right now.
translation: 对不起，我现在很忙。

original: Very well. But, hear me out before you go. My task is to recover undamaged books in order to supplement the knowledge of the Citadel archives.
translation: 好吧。但是，在你走前听我说完。我的任务就是回收未损坏的书籍，用以完善五角大本营的档案库中的知识。

original: Should you come across any in your travels, return to me and I will reward you. And no questions will be asked about how you recovered them.
translation: 如果你在旅行中碰到任何书籍，都带回来给我，我会给你报酬。而且我也不会问你是怎么得到这些书的。

original: That is my proposal. Go now, and be strong. I shall remain here, should you be willing to help.
translation: 这是我的提议。现在走吧，保重。如果你愿意帮我，就来这找我吧。

original: I'm interested in this. Tell me more.
translation: 我对这很感兴趣，再告诉我些。

original: Good. My task here is to collect the written works of those who came before in order to supplement the Brotherhood Archives at the Citadel.
translation: 好吧。我在这的任务就是收集那些过去遗留下来的书籍，用以完善钢铁兄弟会的档案。

original: Although most of the pre-war books have been destroyed, there are a few that have survived. But finding a book in these ruins is... difficult.
translation: 虽然大部分战前书籍已被摧毁了，但还是有少部分被保存了下来。不过，要在废墟中找到一本书的确是件……困难事。

original: I could have a million Initiates to comb the ruins, and I'd still never come close to recovering every book that remains undamaged.
translation: 我有成千上万个新兵在到处搜索那些废墟，但离收集所有保存完好的书这个目标，还是遥不可及。

original: Does it involve money? I really like money. Like, a lot.
translation: 这跟钱有关吗？我真的很喜欢钱。喜欢很多很多的钱。

original: I find that to be so with many Wastelanders. It may involve money, if you choose. Or there may be other forms of compensation.
translation: 我发现很多废土游民都是这样。或许会是钱，也许跟前有关。也许还有其他形式的报酬呢。

original: But, before you receive any reward at all, you will have to be willing to aid me in my task here in this library.
translation: 但是，在你收到任何报酬前，你必须心甘情愿地帮助我完成我在这图书馆里的任务。

original: Why should I tell you anything, lady?
translation: 我为什么要告诉你所有的事，女士？

original: Actually, it's "Scribe", not lady. Senior Scribe Yearling, Order of the Word.
translation: 实际上，我是“文士” ，而不是“女士”。资深文士伊尔琳，隶属羽之修会。

original: And you should tell me what I want to know because I have a proposal and the considerable resources of the Brotherhood to compensate you.
translation: 你应该告诉我我想知道的事情，因为我有一个建议，用兄弟会的丰富资源作为你的回报。

original: I use what I can find, the same as anyone.
translation: 我找到什么就用什么，和其他人一样。

original: So it goes with all of us. Perhaps we can be of use to one another.
translation: 我们大家不都一样吗。或许，我们可以互相帮助。

original: I am Senior Scribe Yearling, Order of the Word. I have a proposal for you if you are interested.
translation: 我是资深文士伊尔琳，隶属羽之修会。如果你感兴趣的话，我有个建议。

original: I guess I'll be going, then.
translation: 我想我要走了。

original: I can't go anywhere without bumping into you assholes.
translation: 我怎么到哪都会遇到你们这帮混蛋。

original: I would be cautious about insulting the Brotherhood. We have very long memories. Very long.
translation: 如果是我就不会随便侮辱兄弟会。我们的记性很好，非常好。

original: Leave this library and do not return. We have work to do here and I have no time for ill-mannered Wastelanders. Go.
translation: 离开这图书馆，别再回来。我们在这还有工作要做，不想在一个无礼的废土游民身上浪费时间。滚吧。

original: Whoa, calm down. I was just exploring this area.
translation: 哇哦，冷静。我正在探索这一地区。

original: You're awfully brave to be walking around down here by yourself. Are you scavenging the ruins?
translation: 你真勇敢啊，竟然一个人四处游荡。你在废墟里寻觅什么？

original: What's happening here?
translation: 这发生了什么事？

original: What does it look like? We're fighting a losing battle! That's what's happening.
translation: 没看见吗？我们正在打一场必败无疑的仗！这就是我们现在的处境！

original: They just keep coming. We haven't slept in days. Every couple of hours, more show up.
translation: 他们不断地袭来。我们好几天没休息了。每隔数小时，就会出现更多的敌人。

original: Is there anything going on here?
translation: 这发生了什么事？

original: Some fellas came by here a while ago that said they was lookin' for some troublemaker that came from out of one of them Vaults.
translation: 不久前一些家伙来到这，说什么他们是来找一些从避难所里跑出来的闹事者的。

original: I told 'em I ain't seen nobody like that and set 'em on their way.
translation: 我告诉他们没见过那样的人，把他们打发走了。

original: They might still be around here though, if'n you think you can help 'em.
translation: 如果你想帮他们，就去这附近找找看。

original: Some fellas came by here a while ago that said they was lookin' for some dogooder that came from out of one of them Vaults.
translation: 不久前一些家伙来到这里，说什么他们是来找一些从避难所里跑出来的空想家的。

original: I told 'em I ain't seen nobody like that and set 'em on their way.
translation: 我告诉他们没见过那样的人，把他们打发走了。

original: They might still be around here though, if'n you think you can help 'em.
translation: 如果你想帮他们，就去这附近找找看。

original: Nope. Can't say that I heard anything but them 'Lurks in quite some time.
translation: 这么久以来，除了那些泥沼蟹，其他我什么都不知道。

original: What are you doing way out here?
translation: 你在这干嘛？

original: My boys are huntin' 'Lurks. Finest meat you can get, and it don't move around in your stomach like Mole Rat does.
translation: 我的孩子们在狩猎泥沼蟹。这可是你能得到的最好的肉，而且它不会像地鼠那样在你的胃里动来动去。

original: Right dangerous, those things. Just as soon take your head off as look at'cha. Watch yourself out here. They're all over.
translation: 那些东西，真是危险啊。对它们来说，拧下你的脑袋就像喝茶一样。在这要小心。它们到处都是。

original: All right. I haven't killed anyone all day. Let's go.
translation: 好啊。我一整天都没杀人了。行动吧。

original: You've done this before, haven't you? Fine time for me to be out of bullets...
translation: 以前你干过，对吧？正好我现在缺子弹……

original: That gun doesn't look loaded.
translation: 这枪一看就知道没上子弹。

original: What? How did you know that?
translation: 什么？你怎么知道的？

original: I mean ... ah, shit. Look. I'm just gonna go. Forget about it.
translation: 我的意思是……啊，真他妈该死。听着。我要走了。忘记这件事吧。

original: I can't give you all my stuff, sorry.
translation: 我不能把我所有的东西都给你，抱歉。

original: Ah, man. Now I have to kill you... Dammit, I'm out of bullets, too...
translation: 啊，哥们。现在，我必须杀了你……该死的，我也没子弹了……

original: Bullshit. A mugger in the Wasteland? A real Raider would've shot me already.
translation: 胡说。废土上的掠夺者？真正的掠夺者早就向我开枪了。

original: Alright. Alright. I wasn't going to shoot you. Damn gun's outta shells, anyway.
translation: 好吧。好吧。我没打算开枪射你，这该死的枪卡壳了。

original: Look. This is embarrassing. I'm just going to go, okay?
translation: 听着。真是不好意思。我要走了，好吗？

original: How about I give you 5 caps and you leave me alone?
translation: 我给你5个瓶盖，你别来烦我了，怎么样？

original: You got yourself a deal. Um, what happens next... Oh, right. I'm gonna go.
translation: 你又做了个好买卖。嗯，接下来会是什么……哦，对了，我要走了。

original: What? You don't have even have 5 caps! Stop jerking off and hand everything over.
translation: 什么？你连5个瓶盖都没有！别开玩笑了，把所有东西交出来。

original: Back off or I'll make you regret threatening me.
translation: 后退，否则让你后悔来威胁我。

original: Hey, hey. I didn't mean anything by it. Just trying to get by out here in the Wastes, you know?
translation: 嗨，嗨。我不是那意思。我只是想在这废土里有点收获，你明白了吗？

original: It won't happen again, uh, sir.
translation: 这种事不会再发生了，先生。

original: Hey, hey. I didn't mean anything by it. Just trying to get by out here in the Wastes, you know?
translation: 嗨，嗨。我不是那意思。我只是想在这废土里有点收获，你明白了吗？

original: It won't happen again, uh, sir. I mean, um, ma'am.
translation: 这种事不会再发生了，先生。我是说，嗯……女士。

original: Holy shit! You're that guy from the radio!
translation: 见鬼！你就是电台里那家伙！

original: Yup! Guilty as charged! He he.
translation: 没错！一语中的！嘿嘿。

original: I don't usually have exposure to the public like this. It's nice to know someone's listening.
translation: 我向来低调。很高兴知道有人一直在聆听我的电台。

original: Makes carrying on the Good Fight that much easier.
translation: 这让维持圣战变得容易许多。

original: Time for a showdown with the remaining Enclave forces at the Jefferson Memorial? You keep listening, children, and GNR will keep you posted!
translation: 是时候向驻留在杰斐逊纪念馆的英克雷军队摊牌了？请继续收听，孩子们，银河新闻电台将为您追踪报道！

original: In other news, the Brotherhood of Steel has amassed a large assault force at the Citadel.
translation: 其他方面的消息，钢铁兄弟会已在大本营集结了大量突击部队。

original: Can't have everything, I guess.
translation: 我想我们也不可能掌握一切消息。

original: Now here's the bad news. Unfortunately, the little bitch from Vault 101 managed to crawl out before the place went kaboom.
translation: 现在，这有个坏消息。非常不幸，来自101号避难所的小婊子在那地方爆炸之前就爬出去了。

original: Now here's the bad news. Unfortunately, the little prick from Vault 101 managed to crawl out before the place went kaboom.
translation: 现在，这有个坏消息。非常不幸，来自101号避难所的小滑头在那地方爆炸之前就爬出去了。

original: Time for a showdown with the remaining Enclave forces at the Jefferson Memorial? You keep listening, children, and GNR will keep you posted!
translation: 是时候向驻留在杰斐逊纪念馆的英克雷军队摊牌了？请继续收听，孩子们，银河新闻电台将为您追踪报道！

original: In other news, the Brotherhood of Steel has amassed a large assault force at the Citadel.
translation: 其他方面的消息，钢铁兄弟会已在大本营集结了大量突击部队。

original: Keep fighting the good fight, kid! We're with you all the way!
translation: 坚持为圣战而战，孩子！我们永远与你同在！

original: And if that weren't good enough news, word is our old friend from Vault 101 made it out of there in one piece.
translation: 如果这还不算好消息的话，这还有一个：我们从101号避难所里来的老朋友已经安然无恙的脱身了。

original: Sure enough, the Enclave radio station is officially offline. Hell, check for yourself if you don't' believe me!
translation: 毫无疑问，英克雷电台正式垮台了。该死，如果你不相信我的话可以自己去看看！

original: The Enclave's not-so-secret base way up in the northwest just went kablooey! And I have reports, damn good ones, that Eden didn't make it out alive!
translation: 英克雷那条位于西北方向的非秘密通道刚刚发生了爆炸！而且我这有个报道，真他妈的好，伊登没有活着出来！

original: I'm coming to you live with a special report! Ding, dong, the sanctimonious, self-righteous, self-proclaimed Presidential asshole is dead!
translation: 我来给你们带来了一个特别报道！叮咚。那伪善的、自以为是、自封为总统的混蛋终于死了！

original: If Eden declares this kid vice president, I swear to God I'll swallow this microphone.
translation: 如果伊登宣布这孩子为副总统，我向上帝发誓我会吞下这麦克风。

original: Well that's... That's just great. The Vault kid from hell is now in cahoots with the devil himself.
translation: 这……这真是太好了。从地狱来的避难所孩子和魔鬼达成了协议。

original: She was seen not too long ago walking away from the Enclave's not-so-secret base way out to the northwest.
translation: 有人看见她不久前从英克雷那已不算是秘密的西北方堡垒里走出来。

original: He was seen not too long ago walking away from the Enclave's not-so-secret base way out to the northwest.
translation: 有人看见他不久前从英克雷那已不算是秘密的西北方堡垒里走出来。

original: Well no such luck.
translation: 真不走运。

original: We haven't heard squat about the little bitch from Vault 101 for two weeks, and hoped to God someone finally put a bullet in her brain.
translation: 我们已经有两个星期没有听到关于从101号避难所来的那小婊子的消息了，希望上帝保佑，最后能有人一枪打爆她的脑袋。

original: We haven't heard squat about the little prick from Vault 101 for two weeks, and hoped to God someone finally put a bullet in his brain.
translation: 我们已经有两个星期没有听到关于从101号避难所来的那小杂种的消息了，希望上帝保佑，最后能有人一枪打爆他的脑袋。

original: I'm coming to you live with a special report!
translation: 我为你们带来个特别报道！

original: Keep fighting the good fight, kid! We're with you all the way!
translation: 坚持为圣战而战，孩子！我们永远与你同在！

original: Well buck up, pilgrims! Our friend is alive and well, and has managed to slip through the Enclave's clutches and escape their fortified base!
translation: 振作点，信徒们！我们的朋友仍然活得好好的，并已经设法摆脱了英克雷的魔爪，从他们那戒备森严的基地逃走了！

original: We haven't heard squat about our old pal from Vault 101 for two weeks now, and it's been looking pretty grim.
translation: 我们已经有两个星期没有听到关于从101号避难所来的老朋友的消息了，情况看起来不容乐观。

original: I'm coming to you live with a special report!
translation: 我为你们带来个特别报道！

original: Good luck, Wanderer. You'll need it.
translation: 祝你好运，流浪者。你正需要这。

original: Anyway, the vertibird was headed northwest into the mountains, where I have it on good authority the Enclave has their big underground clubhouse.
translation: 总之，飞鸟已进入了西北方的山脉，据可靠的消息称，那地下有英克雷的大型俱乐部。

original: I mean, how willing can you be when you're encased in a block of ice? Crazy, I know, but these are crazy times we live in...
translation: 我是说，当你被困在冰棺材里，你的意志能有多坚强？我知道这很疯狂，但是我们不就活在疯狂的时代里吗…

original: My deep cover super secret agents tell me a vertibird recently flew out of the mountains to the west, and the vault kid was an unwilling passenger.
translation: 我的超级秘密特工向我报告说，最近有一架飞鸟飞入了西边山脉，而避难所孩子就是那不情愿的乘客。

original: Yikes. Looks like the lone Wanderer has wandered himself right into the Enclave's sinister clutches.
translation: 呀。看起来这孤独的流浪者已经逛进了英克雷凶恶的魔爪之中。

original: Yikes. Looks like the lone Wanderer has wandered herself right into the Enclave's sinister clutches.
translation: 呀。看起来这孤独的流浪者已经逛进了英克雷凶恶的魔爪之中。

original: So what was Vault kid doing out there? You do the math.
translation: 避难所小孩正在那干嘛？你自己想想吧。

original: But Three Dog, the selling of live human beings is completely fucked up! Yes, children. Yes it is.
translation: 而三狗要说！这种贩卖活人的勾当就应当被收拾！是的，孩子们。必须的。

original: Do you know what goes on out there in the stripmall that time forgot? Wake up, children! It's a goddamned slaver compound! They. Sell. People.
translation: 你知道在外面的那被时间遗忘的商业区是什么吗？醒醒吧，孩子们！那是个该诅咒的奴隶贩子营！他们，贩卖，人口。

original: The gal from Vault 101 was seen walking into Paradise Falls, and then walking back out with a big smile on her face.
translation: 有人看见，从101号避难所来的女孩走进了堕落天堂，然后带着灿烂的笑容出来了。

original: The cat from Vault 101 was seen walking into Paradise Falls, and then walking back out with a big smile on his face.
translation: 有人看见，从101号避难所来的小猫走进了堕落天堂，然后带着灿烂的笑容出来了。
