original: But more importantly - does it even matter worth a damn? Slavers are dead, slaves are free. That's a win-win if you ask me, children.
translation: 但更重要的是 — 这该死的事值得一搏，不是吗？奴隶贩子会被干掉，而奴隶都将获得自由。孩子们，如果你问我，我会说：这可是件一举两得的事。

original: Did they sell her a bum slave and then refuse the refund, or was it some elaborate rescue operation?
translation: 是不是他们卖给了她一个次品奴隶，然后还拒绝退款？或者这本来就是一个精心准备的救援行动？

original: Did they sell him a bum slave and then refuse the refund, or was it some elaborate rescue operation?
translation: 是不是他们卖给了他一个次品奴隶，然后还拒绝退款？或者这本来就是一个精心准备的救援行动？

original: You heard it here first, faithful listeners. The Wanderer showed up at slaver central and bad guys started dropping left and right.
translation: 这是第一手的消息，忠实的听众们。在这流浪者出现在奴隶交易中心之后，坏人们就开始四下逃窜了。

original: Gasp! But what's this? The bothersome bumblebee looked suspiciously like a certain kid, from a certain vault...
translation: 呼！但是，这是什么？这惹人厌的大马蜂看起来的确像某个来自避难所的孩子……

original: Those scumbag Slavers way over in Paradise Falls had one big ole bee on their bonnet, and this baby knew how to sting.
translation: 堕落天堂的那些卑鄙的奴隶贩子们，他们的帽檐边可是有着一只大马蜂，而且这马蜂知道怎么去蛰人。

original: Look, all I'm sayin' is the Wanderer showed up, and then some slaves mysteriously escaped. Coincidence? Oh, I think not...
translation: 听着，所有我能说的就是：流浪者出现后，这些奴隶就神秘地逃跑了。这是巧合吗？噢，我想不是……

original: Gasp! But what's this? The bothersome bumblebee looks suspiciously like a certain kid, from a certain vault...
translation: 呼！但是，这是什么？这惹人厌的大马蜂看起来的确像某个来自避难所的孩子……

original: Those scumbag Slavers way over in Paradise Falls have one big ole bee on their bonnet. Buzz, buzz, buzz, buzz!
translation: 堕落天堂的那些卑鄙的奴隶贩子们，他们的帽檐边可是有着一只大马蜂。嗡嗡嗡，嗡嗡嗡，嗡嗡嗡，嗡嗡嗡！

original: Good luck with that, my friend. Only thing been seen out in those parts is Yao Guai, Super Mutants, and some crazy mountain kids.
translation: 祝你好运，我的朋友。在那些地方唯一能看到的就是妖怪、超级变种人和一些疯狂的山地人。

original: Makes perfect sense to me. The kid's had enough of the wild and wooly Wasteland, and is looking for another old vault to crawl into.
translation: 照我看来这很正常。这孩子已经受够了废土的野外生活，而现在正在寻找另一个老避难所爬进去。

original: The kid from Vault 101, aka the Wanderer, aka "That Crazy Sonnuvabitch," has been spotted poking around some caves way out west.
translation: 来自101号避难所的孩子，被称为流浪者，又名婊子养的疯子，已经发现了一些通向西边的洞穴。

original: Well, boys and girls, what can I say. Looks like President Eden wasn't completely full of shit after all. Methinks we are screwed...
translation: 男孩们和女孩们，怎么说呢。毕竟伊登总统看起来还不是完全一无是处。据我看来，我们都被耍了……

original: They're safe and sound now at the Citadel. Praise Jesus! Praise Jesus! No sign of the kid's father, though. Here's hoping James is okay.
translation: 他们现在安然无恙的抵达五角大本营了。赞美耶稣！赞美耶稣！尽管还没有关于这孩子父亲的消息，但大家都希望詹姆斯没事。

original: And, when the Man showed up, a bunch of scientists went running. With them was Rivet City's own Dr. Madison Li, and that crazy kid from Vault 101.
translation: 而且，当那男人出现时，一大批科学家冲了上去。和他们一起冲上去的是铆钉城的负责人麦迪逊·李博士, 还有那来自101号避难所的疯狂孩子。

original: You heard it here first, my friends - the Enclave is on the scene. I've got reports of flying ships and shock troops in high-tech power armor.
translation: 这是第一手的消息，忠实的听众们 — 英克雷就在现场。我得到了关于飞船和身穿高科技动力装甲的突击部队的现场报告。

original: Tinfoil hat time, children. My eyes and ears tell me the Big Bad Government has taken over that big machine thingy at the Jefferson Memorial.
translation: 别再浪费时间了，孩子们。我的眼睛和耳朵告诉我，邪恶的政府已经接管了杰斐逊纪念馆的大型机械。

original: Here's hoping they can hold onto each other this time around.
translation: 希望这次他们能够互相扶持。

original: But none of that matters now! Father and daughter were spotted walkin' and talkin' together out there in the Wastes.
translation: 不过，现在无所谓了！有人看到父女俩在废土边走边谈。

original: But none of that matters now! Father and son were spotted walkin' and talkin' together out there in the Wastes.
translation: 不过，现在无所谓了！有人看到父子俩在废土边走边谈。

original: What kind of dad leaves his kid in an underground bunker? Children, I just don't know. It ain't for Three Dog to judge, and you shouldn't either.
translation: 什么样的父亲才会把自己的孩子们留在地下掩体里？孩子们，我只是不明白。这不该让三狗来下判断，也不应该由你来。

original: You see, the kid from Vault 101 has been looking for her dad, a very nice man named James, who left his daughter in the vault when he took off.
translation: 你看，来自101号避难所的孩子一直在寻找她的父亲，一个叫詹姆斯的人，一个离开时却把女儿留在避难所里的“好男人”。

original: You see, the kid from Vault 101 has been looking for his dad, a very nice man named James, who left his son behind in the vault when he took off.
translation: 你看，来自101号避难所的孩子一直在寻找他的父亲，一个叫詹姆斯的人，一个离开时却把儿子留在避难所里的“好男人”。

original: It's about love, abandonment, and - now this is the good part - reunion!
translation: 这是关于爱、遗弃，和 — 现在这的高潮部分 — 团圆！

original: Grab your hankies, children, cause I've got a heart-warming tale to tell. It's about a little girl's search for her... for her daddy. Waaaahh!
translation: 拿好你的手帕，孩子们，因为我有一个温暖人心故事要讲述。它是关于一个小女孩寻找她的……她的爸爸的故事。哇哇哇！

original: Grab your hankies, children, cause I've got a heart-warming tale to tell. It's about a little boy's search for... for his daddy. Waaaahh!
translation: 拿好你的手帕，孩子们，因为我有一个温暖人心故事要讲述。它是关于一个小男孩寻找他的……他的爸爸的故事。哇哇哇！

original: And... According to my super secrety sources, Rivet City council member and lead egghead Doctor Madison Li is personally involved.
translation: 并且……根据我的超级秘密的消息来源，铆钉城议会成员和知识分子领袖麦迪逊·李博士以个人身份参与其中。

original: Hey, all I can tell you is the Vault kid showed up, and the scientists there started running around like their pointy heads were on fire.
translation: 嗨，我所能告诉你的就是：当避难所孩子出现后，那的科学家就像是脑袋着火似的东奔西跑。

original: SOMETHING is going on down in Rivet City, and you-know-who is involved.
translation: 在铆钉城发生了一些事，而你 — 知道 — 谁 — 参与其中。

original: Kid, you get your ass back to GNR, you hear me? We've got some stuff to talk about!
translation: 孩子，快滚回银河新闻电台来吧，你听到我等了吗？我们得谈谈！

original: From here on in, it's bye-bye stupid static, hello magnificent music. So sit back, relax, and absorb these classic tunes.
translation: 从现在一刻起，就该和这该死的寂静说再见了，欣赏下这宏伟的音乐。来，休息一下，放松，好好享受这些经典的旋律吧。

original: Because of the kid from Vault 101, that's how! That gal actually managed to repair our antenna relay. How's that for ingenuity, folks?
translation: 因为那来自101号避难所的孩子，这就是为什么！事实上这小女孩设法修好了我们的天线。那孩子多机灵啊？

original: Because of the kid from Vault 101, that's how! That cat actually managed to repair our antenna relay. How's that for ingenuity, folks?
translation: 因为那来自101号避难所的孩子，这就是为什么！事实上这小猫设法修好了我们的天线。那孩子多机灵啊？。

original: But Three Dog! You're in that cool radio studio in D.C. How do YOU know I can hear you, all the way out here in the ass end of nowhere?
translation: 但是三狗！你现在正位于特区那酷酷的电台工作室里。我离你可是有十万八千里，你是怎么知道我能听见你说的话？

original: That's right, from Megaton to Girdershade, Paradise Falls to the Republic of Dave, we are coming to you loud and proud, in a special live report!
translation: 没错，从兆吨镇到梁影村，从堕落天堂到戴夫共和国，我们响亮而自豪的来到你身边，并带给你特殊的直播报道！

original: And for all you other cats out there listening, if you see the kid from Vault 101 out there, give her a pat on the back and wish her luck.
translation: 而你们这些外面的小猫们，听好了，如果你们在外面看到那来自101号避难所的孩子，请给她点鼓励，并祝她好运。

original: And for all you other cats out there listening, if you see the kid from Vault 101 out there, give him a pat on the back and wish him luck.
translation: 而你们这些外面的小猫们，听好了，如果你们在外面看到那来自101号避难所的孩子，请给他点鼓励，并祝他好运。

original: But James, if you're listening... Your kid's out, man, and she misses you. So you might want to find her before she gets swallowed up and spit out.
translation: 还有詹姆斯，如果你也在听……你的孩子就在外面，伙计，她想念你。所以，或许你应该在她被什么东西吃下去再拉出来之前找到她。

original: But James, if you're listening... Your kid's out, man, and he misses you. So you might want to find him before he gets swallowed up and spit out.
translation: 还有詹姆斯，如果你也在听……你的孩子就在外面，伙计，他想念你。所以，或许你应该在他被什么东西吃下去再拉出来之前找到他。

original: Is that why he left the vault? Looks that way. So who knows, maybe James is going to save the world. Can't think of a better cause than that.
translation: 这就是他离开避难所的原因？看来就是这了。谁知道呢，或许詹姆斯就是想拯救这世界。找不到比这更好的理由了。

original: See, James left Vault 101 without telling the kid why. Now, I've since learned that James is a scientist and is working on something big.
translation: 看到了吧，詹姆斯离开了101号避难所，却没有告诉自己的孩子这是为什么。但现在，我已经了解到，詹姆斯是一位科学家，并且正在策划着什么大事情。

original: I know! I know! I couldn't make this shit up! Okay, but now it gets kind of sad. You see, the kid is looking for her dad, looking for James.
translation: 我知道！我知道！我却该死的不能为此做点什么！好吧，但现在却让人有点伤心。你看，这孩子正在寻找她的父亲，寻找詹姆斯。

original: I know! I know! I couldn't make this shit up! Okay, but now it gets kind of sad. You see, the kid is looking for his dad, looking for James.
translation: 我知道！我知道！我却该死的不能为此做点什么！好吧，但现在却让人有点伤心。你看，这孩子正在寻找他的父亲，寻找詹姆斯。

original: Now. You want to know if it gets better, don't you? Well hell YES it gets better! Turns out vault dweller #2 was none other than James's kid!
translation: 现在，你想知道情况是否好转了，是吧？这该死的事情还真的好转了！事实证明，避难所居民2号不是别人就是詹姆斯的孩子！

original: Weeeeelll... Guess who came to visit ole' Three Dog at his luxurious studio in beautiful downtown D.C.? That's right - the other vault dweller!
translation: 喔喔喔喔喔喔……猜猜是谁来造访了老三狗位于美丽特区市区的豪华工作室？没错 — 另一位避难所居民！

original: Okay, so I told you about James, the guy from the vault. And then I told you somebody else crawled outta there too. Right.
translation: 好了，我已经告诉你关于詹姆斯，那来自避难所的家伙的一些事了。顺便一说，有其他人同样从那爬了出来。没错。

original: Hoooooo BOY! Children, you are going to LOVE this.
translation: 哦~~，小子！你会喜欢的。

original: Look, I already know about my Dad, so this was all a waste of time.
translation: 你看，我已经知道我爸爸在哪里了，所以现在这只是浪费时间。

original: Don't ever let anyone make you think that fighting the Good Fight is a waste of time!
translation: 永远也从来不要认为圣战是浪费时间！

original: Whether you like it or not, you just made a difference in the world.
translation: 无论你喜不喜欢，你多少都改变了这世界。

original: Here, I want you to take this. I was saving it for someone special... someone who could really help with the Good Fight.
translation: 拿着，三狗希望你收下这个。我留下它就是为了给某个特殊的人……真正能帮助圣战的人。

original: It contains the location of an old weapons cache. You're welcome to help yourself to anything inside.
translation: 它包含了旧武器库的地理位置。你可以随意使用里面任何东西。

original: Well, you got what you wanted, and I already know about Dad, so...
translation: 你得到了你想要的，我也知道了父亲的事，所以……

original: Yeah, I heard you found out about your Dad, and yet you went ahead and kept your promise to me. That takes some real moxie, kid.
translation: 是的，我听说你已经自己找到了寻找父亲的线索，而且还继续遵守给我的承诺。你真是好样的，孩子。

original: Three Dog can't let you walk away from here empty-handed after all that.
translation: 不管怎样，我三狗可不会让你白白地忙活这么半天。

original: Here, I want you to take this. I was saving it for someone special... someone who could really help with the Good Fight.
translation: 拿着，三狗希望你收下这个。我留下它就是为了给某个特殊的人……真正能帮助圣战的人。

original: It contains the location of an old weapons cache. You're welcome to help yourself to anything inside.
translation: 它包含了旧武器库的地理位置。你可以随意使用里面任何东西。

original: I guess this is goodbye then. It's been a pleasure, Three Dog.
translation: 我想该说再见了。认识你很高兴，三狗。

original: Now hang on a second there. Three Dog can't let you walk away from here empty-handed like this.
translation: 麻烦等一下。我三狗可不会让你白白地忙活这么半天。

original: I heard you found out about your Dad on your own, and yet you went ahead and kept your promise to me. That takes some real moxie, kid.
translation: 我听说你已经自己找到了寻找父亲的线索，而且还继续遵守给我的承诺。你真是好样的，孩子。

original: Here, I want you to take this. I was saving it for someone special... someone who could really help with the Good Fight.
translation: 拿着，收下这个。我留下它就是为了给某个特殊的人……真正能帮助圣战的人。

original: It contains the location of an old weapons cache. You're welcome to help yourself to anything inside.
translation: 它包含了旧武器库的地理位置。你可以随意使用里面任何东西。

original: I'm afraid I haven't heard from Crow for a while, now. I'm afraid he may have fallen victim to foul play.
translation: 现在，恐怕我已经有段时间没有听到乌鸦的消息了。只怕他中了谁的圈套。

original: Let's talk about armor.
translation: 我们来谈谈装甲。

original: Our man Crow handles most armor and clothing out on the trail.
translation: 我们的乌鸦负责处理那些找到的装甲和衣服。

original: He grew up a tribal, but he traded in his loincloth for much snappier apparel long ago.
translation: 他在一个部落里长大，但很久以前他就把他的遮羞布换成更漂亮的行头了。

original: Let's talk about armor.
translation: 我们来谈谈装甲。

original: What sort of clothing and armor would you like to see from Crow?
translation: 你想从乌鸦那里看看什么类型的装甲和衣服？

original: Let's talk about armor.
translation: 我们来谈谈装甲。

original: Lucky Harith kind of dropped off the map. Or, knowing his wares, he may have burnt a whole straight through it.
translation: 幸运哈里斯似乎掉到地图以外了。要么，考虑到他手里的家伙，是他在地上钻了个眼。

original: Let's talk about weapons.
translation: 我们来谈谈武器。

original: Then you'd be looking for Lucky Harith, adventurer, martial artist, and occasional collector of the most deadly items known to mankind.
translation: 那你最好找幸运哈里斯，他是冒险者、军事艺术家、偶尔也收集些当人类已知最危险的物品。

original: He's a bit of an eccentric, but he deals in more weaponry than you can shake a sharp stick at. In fact, he's probably got a sharp stick, too.
translation: 他有点古怪，但经他之手的武器多不可数。

original: Let's talk about weapons.
translation: 我们来谈谈武器。

original: What sort of death-dealing implements would you like to see from Harith?
translation: 你想从我这找到什么类型的致命武器？

original: Let's talk about weapons.
translation: 我们来谈谈武器。

original: The good doctor's lab equipment isn't cheap. It'll cost about 200 caps for him to offer higher quality material.
translation: 大医生的实验室设备并不便宜。你要是想他能有更高质量的物资，就得花掉200个瓶盖。

original: He should expand his inventory.
translation: 他应该扩充他的货物。

original: At this point, it would be hard to improve Doc's medicine cabinet without a significant investment.
translation: 就目前而言，没有笔可观的投资，是很难改善医生的医疗货物的。

original: Say, 500 caps should suffice for him to offer a whole cornucopia of pharmacopoeia.
translation: 这么说吧，500个瓶盖应该能让他提供各种各样的医疗药物吧。

original: He should expand his inventory further.
translation: 他应该进一步扩充他的货物。

original: As much as it hurts me to say it, there's really only so much that money can buy. The good doctor's supply cannot be improved at this point.
translation: 每次一说到它，我就很伤心 — 我的钱只能买这么多的东西。现在医生的补给品无法改善了。

original: He should expand his inventory.
translation: 他应该扩充他的货物。

original: I agree wholeheartedly. I'd hate to unduly burden a dedicated entrepreneur.
translation: 我真心赞同。我讨厌给一个富有事业心的企业家过重的负担。

original: I suppose you're right. Best to let them stay independent.
translation: 我想你是对的，最好让他们保持中立。

original: My, my! When it comes to sales, I can see even I've got a few things I could learn from you!
translation: 天、天啊！说到做买卖，我该向你学习！

original: Well, in that case, I can act as your representative to the caravans. They'll listen to me, and I'll listen to you.
translation: 既然如此，我可以作你在商队那里的代表。他们会听我的，而我也会听你的。

original: Just let me know what you suggest in the way of specialties, and I'll let them know to focus on that area.
translation: 你只要告诉我应该专注于那个方面，我就会让他们把注意力集中到那里的。

original: Under my organization, they'd see better profits and more bargaining power.
translation: 在我的组织下，他们将获得更好的利润，并能学会怎么更好地讨价还价。

original: Hmm... I think you're right. And the specialization might play to their eccentricities. It could work!
translation: 嗯……我想你是对的。专业化会合他们胃口。能行！

original: And I could act as their representative in this matter. Goodness knows, I've known them for years, so I should be able to speak for them.
translation: 在这里件事情上，我可以作为他们的代理人。众所周知，我已经和他们认识了好多年了，所以我想我能替他们说话。

original: Just let me know what you suggest in the way of specialties, and I'll let them know to focus on that area.
translation: 你只要告诉我应该专注于那个方面，我就会让他们把注意力集中到那里的。

original: Working together would allow specialization in sales, for more reliable profits.
translation: 同心携力将会带来专业化的销售，赚取更可靠的利润。

original: Madam, you flatter me! I'm but a humble man of this small community.
translation: 夫人，您过奖了！但我只是一个微不足道的人。

original: But, since it's a trader community, I suppose I can call in a few favors with the caravans. I suppose I am rather persuasive in that way.
translation: 但是，因为这里是商人社区，我想我在商队中间还有点面子。我的说服力应该还是可以的。

original: So, you just let me know what you'd like to see from the caravans, and I'll let them know what to focus on.
translation: 你只要告诉我希望商队提供什么样的货物，我就会让他们把集中注意力的。

original: Oh, I'm sure a charismatic fellow like you can get them to follow your lead.
translation: 噢，我相信像你这样有超凡魅力的伙伴能让他们追随你的领导。

original: That... That certainly is quite a lot of caps. It really would be a shame for those to go to waste, wouldn't it?
translation: 这……这么多的瓶盖。要是浪费了多可惜啊，对不对？

original: I suppose I can call in a few favors with the caravans, talk with them about their inventory. Must keep the customers happy, right?
translation: 我想我可以找商队的熟人问问，和他们谈谈他们的货物。必须保证让客人满意，对吧？

original: So, you just let me know what you'd like to see from the caravans, and I'll let them know what to focus on.
translation: 你只要告诉我希望商队提供什么样的货物，我就会让他们把集中注意力的。

original: That's a real shame. I have all these caps, and nowhere to spend them...
translation: 真可悲。我有满口袋的瓶盖，却没处花……

original: Maybe, but if they were more closely organized, the costs of organization might outweigh the benefits.
translation: 或许吧，但如果他们的组织更加严密，那费用就会超过利润了。

original: The economics of this sort of trading operation can be rather more complex than your standard store in a settlement, sadly.
translation: 这类买卖经营起来，可比那些定居点的摊贩复杂多了。

original: Couldn't they make more money if they worked together?
translation: 他们不会合伙来赚更多的钱吗？

original: I had thought about it, but some of these Wasteland traders... well, they aren't exactly the organizational type.
translation: 我曾想过，但有些废土商人……嗯，他们都是些没组织的家伙。

original: It'd take a pretty savvy businessman to make it worth their while to work together. Frankly, I'm not sure even I'm up to the task!
translation: 最好让一位精明的商人和我共事，这样更值得一些。坦白说，我不觉得自己胜任这个任务！

original: Have you thought about organizing the traders into a unified group?
translation: 你有想过把这些商人组织起来吗？

original: Sure thing! Which one would you like to talk about?
translation: 没问题！你想谈谈哪个？

original: Let's talk about the trade caravans.
translation: 我们来谈谈商队。

original: Girl, if you don't relax a little, you're going to snap in half. Now, get going, before you take someone's head off.
translation: 女孩，如果你不放轻松点，你早晚会死的。现在，走吧，趁你还没把别人脑袋崩了。

original: Lady, if you don't calm down, I'm going to let Derek know about your crush on him. That'll give you something else to think about.
translation: 女士，如果你不冷静下来，我就会让德里克知道你对他的态度。这会让你三思。

original: Can't let our guard down, sir! That's when people cause trouble.
translation: 我们不能放松警惕，先生！否则就会有麻烦的。

original: The locals could use a little scaring, sir! Bunch of fat, coward traders...
translation: 不妨吓唬当地人一下，先生！他们不过是一群肥胖、鼠胆商人……

original: Whoa, calm down there. Attitude like that'll just get someone hurt... plus, it puts the locals on edge.
translation: 哇哦，冷静点。那样的态度不知道会伤着谁……而且，还会逼那些当地人冒险。

original: Relax, girl. We're not in a war zone, we're just making sure the market's safe. Stop scaring the locals, okay?
translation: 放松点，女孩。我们不在战区，我们只是想确保市场的安全。别再恐吓当地人，好吗？

original: Good to hear it. I'm not giving up this whole "living" habit, not at my age. Keep it up.
translation: 谢谢。我决不会放弃我的“生活”习惯，至少我现在不会。继续吧。

original: Well, you be sure to let us know when we are, all right?
translation: 到了该知道的时候一定要让我们知道啊，可以吗？

original: I guess.
translation: 也许吧。

original: Dunno.
translation: 不晓得。

original: It's nothing. Just... You think Machete might like me?
translation: 没事。只是……你认为玛切蒂有没有可能喜欢上我。

original: Nothing's wrong. It's just... you think there's a chance Machete might think I'm cool? Like, maybe when I'm older?
translation: 没事。只是……你认为有没有机会让玛切蒂认为我很酷？或者等我再长大点？

original: Well, have any big plans for the day?
translation: 嗯，今天有什么宏伟计划吗？

original: You never know what the day may hold, eh boy?
translation: 你永远不知道今天会发生什么，是吧，孩子？

original: Well, no worries. Maybe tomorrow will be more exciting, eh? But not too exciting, I hope! Ha!
translation: 嗯，不用担心。或许明天会更精彩，不是吗？但也别太精彩哦，我希望！哈哈！

original: Well, there's always tomorrow, isn't there? At least, one hopes, eh? Ha!
translation: 嗯，永远都会有明天，不是吗？至少，有个希望，对吧？哈哈！

original: You oughta be proud - that's hard work. So why do you look so blue?
translation: 您应该感到骄傲 — 那是个艰巨的工作。可你为何脸都绿了？

original: I mean it - that's hard work. But you look like you got something on your mind. What's up?
translation: 我说真的 — 那是个艰巨的工作。但你看起来心事重重，到底怎么了？

original: It was okay.
translation: 没问题。

original: I suppose it was fine.
translation: 还好。

original: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

original: It wasn't anything much. But thanks!
translation: 没什么大不了,但是谢谢啦！

original: You can usually find one of the trade caravans at the entrance to town. They come through every day or two.
translation: 你经常会在镇门口碰到商队的。他们每隔一两天就会经过这里一次。

original: Other than them, Porter's always got food for sale down at the diner.
translation: 跟他们不同，波特的餐馆总是有好吃的。

original: Anything to trade around here?
translation: 这周围可以做交易吗？

original: Take a look, let me know what you want.
translation: 看看吧，想要什么就告诉我。

original: What's on the menu?
translation: 菜单上都有什么？

original: Only the best, hand-picked from the Wastes... for what that's worth.
translation: 都是最好的，手工从废土里精选出来的上等货……绝对物超所值。

original: What's on the menu?
translation: 菜单上都有什么？

original: Tell me what you need, and maybe I've got your fix.
translation: 告诉我你需要什么，没准我能帮你搞定。

original: I'm here to buy.
translation: 我要买点东西。

original: Let's see what the good doctor has in his magic bag, shall we?
translation: 让我们看看这神医的百宝箱里有什么，怎么样？

original: I'm here to buy.
translation: 我要买点东西。

original: Nothing but the highest quality leftovers, junk, and crap!
translation: 我这里只有高质量的剩货、垃圾还有废物！

original: I'm here to buy.
translation: 我要买点东西。

original: Crazy Wolfgang's got just what you need! Assuming you need the random junk that I've got.
translation: 疯子沃尔夫冈正好有你想要的东西！前提是你要的我碰巧都有。

original: I'm here to buy.
translation: 我要买点东西。

original: It's my pleasure to offer hot death in a variety of exciting flavors - take your pick!
translation: 我很荣幸为你提供当前最流行的死法，滋味不同，风格各异 — 随你挑选！

original: I'm here to buy.
translation: 我要买点东西。

original: Please, enjoy my selection of high-quality problem-solvers!
translation: 请欣赏我的顶级收藏吧！

original: I'm here to buy.
translation: 我要买点东西。

original: Have a look, see if anything calls out to you.
translation: 看一看，有没有你喜爱的东西。

original: I'm here to buy.
translation: 我要买点东西。

original: If the clothes make the man, then here are the means to re-make yourself.
translation: 人靠衣装，你真得重新包装下自己了。

original: I'm here to buy.
translation: 我要买点东西。

original: They're just small caravans that make rounds through the Wastes, hawking their wares from Paradise Falls to Rivet City.
translation: 他们只是在废土穿行的小商队，来往于堕落天堂和铆钉城之间做生意。

original: They won't trade with anyone who's hit their friends, but that's about as organized as they get.
translation: 他们不会与攻击他们朋友的人做任何交易，这是他们的原则。

original: How organized are the traders?
translation: 这些商人有组织吗？

original: Quite organized, now. Thanks to your guidance, of course! They still travel independently, but I keep track of their investments and such.
translation: 目前，组织得很好。当然喽，谢谢你的指导！他们仍然独来独往，但是我会继续跟踪他们的投资等情况。

original: They make more profits, and supplies get to those that need them most, so everyone wins. Such is the magic of economics!
translation: 他们更赚钱了，也能为最需要的人提供补给，双赢。这就是经济的魔力！

original: How organized are the traders?
translation: 这些商人有组织吗？

original: If you're done asking questions, I'm sure there's something I should be keeping an eye on.
translation: 你要是没什么问题了，我就去办其它事情了。

original: Okay, that's enough.
translation: 好的，够了。

original: I'm about the rarest thing out here in the Wastes: a mercenary who lived long enough to retire.
translation: 我大概是废土里最稀罕的了：一个可以活到退休的佣兵。

original: I used to sell my services around here, so it was a natural place to settle down. Not a bad sort of retirement, honestly.
translation: 我过去常在这里附近揽活，所以自然在这里定居。这么退休可不赖，真的。

original: How did you get this position?
translation: 你怎么得到这个职位的？

original: Because I asked them to, I suspect. I grew up in these trade caravans; known most of them my whole life.
translation: 我想是因为我叫他们这样做的。我在这些旅行商队中长大；对他们中的大多数人都很了解。

original: I founded this place with my sister Daisy, back in the day. Perfect stop along the caravan circuit.
translation: 当年我和我姐姐黛丝建造了这地方，它是商队路线上最理想的休憩地。

original: Why do the traders come here?
translation: 商人们为什么来这里？

original: Life and death matters, putting down thieves, protecting people from raiders who are shortsighted or stupid enough to attack, that sort of thing.
translation: 生死攸关之事，平定匪帮，保护人民不被那些目光短浅或傻气冲天的歹徒攻击，诸如此类的事情。

original: Pretty much, anything the man can't solve by talking at it. And don't misunderstand, he can solve a lot of things that way.
translation: 那家伙差不多光练嘴就能搞定所有的事。别误会，他用那种方式能解决很多问题。

original: What do you mean, "the big stuff"?
translation: 你所说的“大买卖”是什么意思？

original: What can you tell me about Canterbury Commons?
translation: 你能跟我说说坎特伯雷社区吗？

original: Hah! Damn near everything, I suspect! I founded the place myself, and I'm the reason this place stays fat and happy.
translation: 哈！我想，让周围的一切都见鬼去吧！我创建了这地方，这里之所以能保持富裕和欢乐，就是因为我的存在。

original: It's okay, I guess. I heard it's safer than most places, because the raiders don't bother us. But I've never been anywhere else, so I don't know.
translation: 我想没什么事。我听说这里比大多数地方都安全，因为歹徒不会给我们找麻烦。不过我没去过别的地方，所以我也不太清楚。

original: Best place I ever worked in, and I guess I've worked about everywhere there is.
translation: 我到处都工作过，这里是我工作过最好的地方。

original: We get some weird types passing through, but it's stable enough for a guy to make an honest living. I don't really see what more a man could ask for.
translation: 虽然有些奇怪的事情发生，但是如果想安分地活着，还是足够稳定的。我不知道一个人还能要求些什么。

original: Canterbury's a good town. Roe's done a damned good job setting up the place, and no one can handle the day-to-day details like him.
translation: 坎特伯雷是个不错的小镇。罗伊完建立它，真他妈干的漂亮，而且没人能像他一样把日常事务处理得井井有条。

original: But when it comes to the big stuff, that's when he needs a little help. That's where I come in.
translation: 不过有大买卖的时候，他还是需要一些帮助。那时我就会来帮忙了。

original: This whole place would fall apart if it weren't for Dom and me keeping anyone from causing too much trouble.
translation: 要不是我和多姆一直在防止任何人给我们带来过多的麻烦，这整个地方早就土崩瓦解了。

original: Fat, old Roe may think he runs the place, but it's only because Dom lets the idiot.
translation: 又肥又老的罗伊或许以为是他在掌管这地方，但那是因为多姆让着这白痴。

original: Well, hope you had fun with that.
translation: 希望你玩的开心。

original: Because I wanted to talk to the world's biggest pain in the ass, apparently.
translation: 显然,因为我想要跟世上最欠揍的人说话。

original: Well, if you figure it out, be sure to let me know, okay? I'm kind of busy.
translation: 好的，要是你搞清楚了，务必要让我知道，行吧？我有点忙。

original: Now that I think about it, I'm not really sure.
translation: 我考虑过了，可我不太清楚。

original: I guess, sure. I'll keep an eye out for any hidden depths, okay?
translation: 当然可以。我会留意任何玩深沉的，行了吧？

original: Sometimes people can have hidden depths even they don't know about.
translation: 有时人们即使不知道，也会装得很深沉。

original: In that case, perhaps you ought to leave town, stranger.
translation: 要是那样的话，或许你该离开这镇子了，陌生人。

original: That'd save Dom the cost of ammo, and it'd save you the cost of being dead. Now, good day.
translation: 那会节省多姆的子弹钱，也留了你一条小命。现在离开吧。

original: My business and pleasure are the same. And you're not going to like either.
translation: 我的生意和快乐是一码事。并且这里两样你都不会喜欢的。

original: In that case, I'm sure you'll find it was providence that brought you here!
translation: 要是那样，我敢肯定你会明白，是天意让你来到这里的！

original: Why, have a talk with any trader in town, and I'm sure you'll find just the thing you didn't even realize you needed!
translation: 哦，在城里随便找个商人聊聊吧，我敢肯定你会有意外惊喜的！

original: Neither. Just wandering through, Roe.
translation: 都不是。我只是经过，罗伊。

original: Huh. Why'd you want to do that?
translation: 啊。为什么你要那样做？

original: I already talked to your uncle. I figured I'd talk to you, too.
translation: 我跟你叔叔谈过了，我想我最好也和你谈谈。

original: Sure, fine, whatever.
translation: 当然可以。随便。

original: Then why am I wasting my time talking to you? Scram.
translation: 那里我为何要浪费时间跟你鬼扯？混蛋。

original: Sorry, but our water purifier's been on backorder for about two hundred years.
translation: 抱歉，不过我们的净水器已经停工了大约200年。

original: Unless you're here to make the delivery, I suggest you be glad for what you've got.
translation: 除非你是来送货的，否则我建议你还是知足一点。

original: Unpurified water? I'm insulted.
translation: 未净化的水？我伤自尊了。

original: Sure, you do that. We can take turns shooting each other, teams are "the whole damned town" versus "your face." Our team's got a winning record.
translation: 当然，你就那样做吧。到时候，我们可以轮番向对方开枪。两边各是“整个镇的人”对“你的脸”。我们队可是一直获胜的噢。

original: Now, if we're done with this little pissing contest, I've got to get back to work. But I can tell we're just going to be best friends forever.
translation: 现在，要是我们的狗屁争论完了的话，我就得回去工作了。但我觉得我们会成为永远的好朋友的。

original: Maybe I can introduce a new pastime: shooting nosy guards in the face.
translation: 也许我可以介绍新的玩法：向爱管闲事的守卫的脸射击。

original: And it sounds like your tongue's going to get itself cut out if you keep bothering me, man. Get lost.
translation: 哥们，你要是再打扰我的话，你的舌头就会因为太长而被剁掉。滚一边去。

original: Watch your attitude. It'll get you in trouble.
translation: 注意你的态度，它会让你惹上麻烦。

original: Yeah, maybe. But you need one to keep some of those caravaners in line. And to keep them from getting too friendly, if you catch my drift.
translation: 是啊，或许吧。但你需要一个人去协调那些商队。但也不能让他们太过亲密，明白吧。

original: Even in a nice place like this, a girl's best friend is a good knife, right?
translation: 即使在这样迷人的地方，一个女孩的挚友也该是一把好刀，对不对？

original: Watch your attitude. It'll get you in trouble.
translation: 注意你的态度，它会让你惹上麻烦。

original: Most of the caravans that come through, their fondest desire is to spend a few days off the road and to get a full stomach.
translation: 大多数往返的商队，他们最大的愿望就是好好歇息几天，然后再来个酒足饭饱。

original: We've got good food in the diner, and we try to keep it nice and peaceful here. When that's an option, of course.
translation: 我们为用餐者准备了美味的食物，我们也尽量保持这里的欢乐和祥和。当然，是在条件允许的情况下。

original: Pleasure's hard to come by out here. What's on tap?
translation: 外头能有什么可开心的。有什么现成的？

original: First clue was that you didn't shoot me. Most troublemakers I meet are just starving folks down on their luck. So, stop the starve, stop the trouble.
translation: 第一点就是你没开枪打我。我碰上的的多数惹麻烦的人只是些倒霉的饿鬼。所以，不饿肚子就没麻烦。

original: I can save a whole lot of trouble that way. Plus, if you're still planning on raising hell, losing out on a drink is the last of my worries!
translation: 那样我能省去一堆的麻烦。另外，要是你还打算闹事，请你喝一杯有什么好在乎的！

original: Pretty trusting of you. How do you know I'm not here to cause trouble?
translation: 你还挺轻信的。你怎么知道我不是来找麻烦的？

original: Sorry. I mean, I'm Derek. Welcome to Canterbury, Miss. Commons. Canterbury Commons. Miss.
translation: 对不起。我是说，我就是德里克。欢迎来到坎特伯雷社区，小姐。

original: Calm down, kid. Can you actually say a whole sentence at once?
translation: 冷静，孩子，你能一次说一整句吗？

original: When I can find time for it, sure. In the guarding business, it's the personal touches that make all the difference.
translation: 如果我有时间的话当然可以。不过对放哨的人来说，个性的不同才重要。

original: Anyway, welcome to town, don't cause trouble, threats of violent justice, so on, so forth. You look like you know the drill.
translation: 无论如何，欢迎到镇里来，别惹事，别妨碍司法公正，诸如此类。你看起来应该知道怎么做。

original: Do you personally threaten every visitor to your town?
translation: 是不是谁来这个镇子，你都会亲自恐吓他们一番？

original: This is Canterbury Commons, where dirty, old lechers get rid of everything they picked up on the road. Unless it's not treatable, that is.
translation: 这里是坎特伯雷社区，那些肮脏猥琐的老家伙把路上捡到的东西，除了那些不好处理的，统统拿到这里卖。

original: And I'm Machete - Dom and me make sure nobody starts anything stupid in town. Keep that in mind, okay?
translation: 我就是玛切蒂 — 我和多姆要确保没人在镇里惹事。你记得别惹事，懂吗？

original: I'm new in town. What is this place?
translation: 我新来的。这里是什么地方？

original: Understood, understood. A man doesn't get to be my age without learning when not to pry.
translation: 了解，了解。如果我不知道什么时候该住嘴的话，是活不到现在的。

original: Long as your business doesn't hurt ours, you're welcome to stay. Otherwise... Well, there's no need to get into unpleasantness, is there?
translation: 只要你的生意没妨碍到我们，我们就欢迎你留下来。要不然……没必要把事弄得不愉快，对吧？

original: Business. My business. So mind your own.
translation: 这是生意，我的生意。所以去操你自己生意的心吧。

original: Damn near all of 'em, depending on which caravan's in town! Guns, armor, food, junk, pretty much everyone swings by the old circle, eventually.
translation: 真该死，要靠城里的商队才行！枪、盔甲、吃的、杂货。最终，差不多每个人都在这里老圈子里面转。

original: Everyone but Slavers, that is. It's a hassle to transport their wares, as they say. Just as well, eh? Anything else I can do to welcome you to town?
translation: 每个人，除了奴隶贩子。他们说，为运货的事总要吵闹。本来就是嘛，对不？我还能做些什么来迎接你呢？

original: I'm all business. What types have you got to offer?
translation: 我做各种生意。你有什么货？

original: Sounds like you've never spent a day mucking out Brahmin pens with a busted shovel.
translation: 听上去好像你从未花过一整天拿一把破铁锨，去清理双头牛栅栏里的粪便。

original: My uncle says it'll build character. Mostly, it just builds stink.
translation: 我叔叔说这能练就品格，但大多时候它只能制造臭味。

original: Don't sell yourself short. Even the little jobs can be important.
translation: 别小看你自己。即使这些小工作也可能很重要。

original: We do our best. Well, Dom and Roe do their best. I just make sure they've got enough food so they can keep on doing their best.
translation: 我们尽量做到最好。多姆和罗伊在竭尽全力。我只是确保他们有足够的食物，以便他们能够竭尽全力。

original: You ever find yourself starving around here, drop by Dot's Diner. We don't charge much, but don't expect any more freebies.
translation: 你要是饿了，就来多特的餐馆。价格便宜，但别指望会免费。

original: Thanks, Joe. Looks like a pretty nice place, here.
translation: 谢谢，乔。这里看来相当不错。

original: Sounds like a good plan. Keeps the traders happy, that way. And it means Machete and I get to save on ammo.
translation: 听起来不错。那样商人们也会高兴的。这样我和玛切蒂还能省下不少子弹。

original: No worries. I wasn't planning on stealing anything.
translation: 别担心，我没打算偷东西。

original: Fine, hi, whatever. I'm Machete, and I've got better things to do than talk with you. Scram.
translation: 好的，随便。呃，我叫玛切蒂，我现在有要紧的事要做，没功夫和你闲聊。走开。

original: I didn't mean to interrupt. I just wanted to say hi.
translation: 我无意打断，只是问个好。

original: I'm not interested in fixing things right now.
translation: 我现在没心情修那玩意。

original: Yeah, no problem. Come back if you decide to help.
translation: 好的，没问题。要是你决定帮忙的话就回来找我。

original: It's probably just a problem in a subroutine somewhere. No sweat.
translation: 可能是子程序之类的地方出了问题。小事一桩。

original: Great. Just between us mechanics, try some Mentats before you tackle that robot. They really clear your head.
translation: 好极了。机械师之间的对话，在处理机器人之前先来点曼他特吧，这能让你保持头脑清醒。

original: I know they're addictive, but hey, that's just the sort of risk professionals like us take, right? Here, I've got a few.
translation: 我知道它们会让人上瘾，不过，干我们这行的，经常要承担这种风险，不是吗？给，我这有一些。

original: Huh. A robot stuck in a diagnostic loop. Curious.
translation: 啊哈，机器人卡在诊断回路上了。真奇怪。

original: Hey, you really know robots, huh? Great to meet another mechanic.
translation: 嗨，你是个机器人行家吧，嗯？遇到另一个修理师真是太好了。

original: I stumbled across this model a while ago. I just can't seem to fix it.
translation: 我在不久前发现了这种机型，但似乎修不好它。

original: Hmm... A robot complaining about you forever. I like it that way.
translation: 嗯……一个机器人在不停的抱怨你。我喜欢这样。

original: Well, I'm not gonna stay here and listen to your bullying. Forget it.
translation: 好了，我可不想待在这听你放屁。算了。

original: I'm outta here. Good luck with that robot. Jackass.
translation: 我走了。祝那机器人好运。蠢货。

original: What will you give me if I fix it?
translation: 要是我能修好，你给我什么？

original: I could give you some old energy cells I have. They might be worth a few caps at the nearest town.
translation: 我能给你些旧动力电池。那些电池在附近城镇里没准能值几个瓶盖。

original: I could try to fix that robot for you.
translation: 我会试着帮你修理那机器人。

original: Thanks! If you get it working, I have a couple of energy cells you can have. Just come back to me when you're done.
translation: 谢谢！要是你能修好，我的一对动力电池就是你的。完事了就回来找我吧。

original: I guess that robot doesn't like your house. I agree: the architecture sucks.
translation: 我猜那机器人不喜欢你的房子，我同意：建筑结构糟透了。

original: Huh, what? Oh, yeah. That's funny.
translation: 呃，什么？哦，是的。很可笑。

original: This robot is stuck in some sort of loop. It's been prattling about houses and supplies for an hour.
translation: 这机器人被卡在某个回路上了。它胡说八道了一个小时，就说那些房子和补给的事情。

original: I've given up on trying to fix it.
translation: 我放弃修这玩意了。

original: Something wrong with your robot?
translation: 你的机器人出什么问题了？

original: I've been wondering about that for an hour, now.
translation: 我一直在困惑中，到现在已经一个小时了。

original: I think it's stuck in some sort of loop. I tried fixing it, but all those switches and circuits are beyond me.
translation: 我想是一些回路卡住了。我试过修理它，但对开关和电路的毛病我可没招了。

original: Yeah. I'm about ready to smash the damn thing and move on.
translation: 哎，我已经准备打碎这该死的东西，然后丢掉。

original: Robot's still broken, huh?
translation: 机器人还是坏的，呃？

original: I give up. You're not getting any more fixed with me just talking to you.
translation: 我放弃了，仅仅和你说话是没有办法让你帮我修理好的。

original: There's no sense in trying to fix this heap of junk. Dammit.
translation: 修理这堆废物毫无意义。该死。

original: I just have no idea what to do with you.
translation: 我真拿你没办法。

original: You're not inside a house, robot. Why do you think you are?
translation: 你没在房子里，机器人。为什么你在这？

original: There's nothing wrong with the outside of you. Something wrong with the inside, then?
translation: 从你的外表看你没什么毛病。这么说问题出在你身体内部？

original: This isn't a building robot, I keep telling you...
translation: 这不是一个建筑机器人，我一直告诫你……

original: The dog is dead. Please go to the pound to obtain a new one.
translation: 这条狗死了。请到认领处再认领一条新的吧。

original: Lawnmower in need of maintenance. Please repair to keep grass freshly cut.
translation: 割草机急需保养。请修理割草机，保证草坪能够正常修剪。

original: Out of dog food for animal, designation "Fluffy." Please purchase more food to ensure optimal health.
translation: 给动物们的弗拉菲伊牌狗粮已经没了。请多购买点食物，保证生存环境处在最佳状态。

original: House is gone. Please contact your local planning authority to construct a new residence.
translation: 您的房子已经不存在了。请联系你们当地的规划局来建设一个新住所。

original: Current paperwork on residence now 220 years out of date. Please contact local planning authorities to obtain new paperwork.
translation: 现在我们手里的居住区规划图已经过期220年了。联系你们当地规划局制作一张新的规划图。

original: No furniture detected in current residence. Please visit your local shopping area to make appropriate purchases.
translation: 现在的居住区里根本找不到一件家具。去你们当地的商店，看看可不可以买一些合适的。

original: Wouldn't a beacon just attract the Slavers?
translation: 烟火不会引来奴隶贩子吧？

original: You make jokes when the lives and freedom of our fellow men are at stake!
translation: 你竟然在我们的同伴生命和自由危如垒卵的时候开玩笑！

original: I tell you, I know a place that we can defend from the slavers.
translation: 告诉你，我知道个地方能抵御那些奴隶贩子。

original: Why don't you just kill them and take all their stuff? Everyone else does.
translation: 你为什么不干脆宰了他们，然后拿走他们的东西？大家都这么干。

original: They come here with nothing but their dignity. Would you have me take that from them too?
translation: 他们到这来，除了尊严以外一无所有。你想让我连他们的尊严也夺走吗？

original: We will rise above our base instincts and help our fellow man.
translation: 我们将超越自我本能，协助我们的同胞。

original: That's a really stupid idea.
translation: 真是个愚蠢至极的主意。

original: You wouldn't say that if you spent even a single night in shackles.
translation: 你不会想戴着枷锁过上一夜吧？

original: I'm done trying to justify my plan to you. If you don't want to help us, just say so.
translation: 我已经向你明确告知了我的计划。要是你不想帮忙，直说就行了。

original: So, you used to be a slave?
translation: 这么说，你曾经是个奴隶？

original: Long time ago. Eight years I think.
translation: 很久以前。我想有八年了吧。

original: Three of us escaped during the night. They caught Liesel and John. I made it into the wasteland.
translation: 我们三个人趁着夜色逃跑，他们抓住了利塞尔和约翰。而我成功逃到了废土。

original: Raiders took me in at first. When I heard about this place, I knew I had to come here.
translation: 起初是歹徒接纳了我。当我听说这地方时，我就知道我必须到这来。

original: Oh, yes. All my life.
translation: 哦，是的。我的一生。

original: One day I killed the master's little girl. It was an accident, I swear!
translation: 某天我弄死了主人的小女儿。那只是个意外，我发誓！

original: I...I ran away. They would never have believed me.
translation: 我……我跑了。因为他们永远也不会相信我的。

original: Hannibal found me. I would never have made it without him.
translation: 汉尼拔找到了我。如果没有他我是活不下来的。

original: Not for long. Me and my merc crew were captured by slavers.
translation: 没多久。我和我的佣兵小队就被奴隶贩子抓住了。

original: Seven months I groveled and obeyed like a good lap dog. When I saw my chance, I took it.
translation: 七个月来我卑躬屈膝，像条哈巴狗一样摇尾乞怜。当我看准时机时我就逃跑了。

original: I had nowhere else to go. Hannibal took me in. He never cared about my past.
translation: 当我走投无路时，汉尼拔接纳了我。他从不在意我的过去。

original: Yes. For four years. I was young and pretty. I don't need to tell you what my duties were.
translation: 是啊，四年了。我曾经是青春少艾。没必要跟你说我过去的事。

original: He liked me enough to educate me. I learned reading, history, math, and even some science.
translation: 他很喜欢我，并开始培养我。我学会了阅读、历史、数学，甚至一些科学常识。

original: When my master married, his wife insisted I get sold. Hannibal bought me and freed me.
translation: 当我的主人结婚的时候，他的妻子坚持要把我卖掉。汉尼拔买下了我，并且赐予我自由。

original: For 23 years I was a slave, ever since I was 14.
translation: 从我14岁起，23年来我一直都是个奴隶。

original: Six years ago I managed to escape from my master. He's been hunting me ever since.
translation: 六年前我设法从主人身旁逃脱了。直到现在他还在追杀我。

original: When I found the head of Lincoln here, I knew it was a sign for me to help other slaves to escape.
translation: 当我在这找到林肯雕像的头时，我知道那是一个让我拯救其他奴隶的标志。

original: I founded the Temple of the Union as a safe haven for runaway slaves everywhere.
translation: 我建立了团结圣殿，这是亡命天涯的奴隶们的世外桃源。

original: What's the story with Hannibal?
translation: 有什么关于汉尼拔的故事讲给我听吗？

original: You've got to make up your own mind, sir.
translation: 你必须做出抉择，先生。

original: This is a good place. A safe place.
translation: 这是个好地方。一个避风港。

original: Hannibal wants me to promise to keep this place safe. Why should I do that?
translation: 汉尼拔要我答应保卫这地方的安全。我为什么要那么做？

original: He's gonna save us all.
translation: 他将会拯救我们所有人。

original: I mean all us slaves. He's gonna find a way to free everyone one of us.
translation: 我是说我们所有奴隶。他正在设法解救我们这些人。

original: Because if you don't, I get to use you for target practice.
translation: 因为如果你不这样做的话，我就不得不把你当靶子练。

original: Why should I promise to protect this place?
translation: 我为什么要答应保卫这个地方？

original: Why are you asking?
translation: 为什么这么问？

original: He's the one honest, decent man in the Wasteland.
translation: 他是废土中一个忠诚、正直的人。

original: You hurt him and I'll hunt you down and feed you your own liver.
translation: 你要敢碰他的话，我就会对你穷追不舍，并且把你的肝扯出来喂你自己吃。

original: So what can you tell me about Hannibal Hamlin?
translation: 那么你能跟我说说汉尼拔·哈姆林吗？

original: We keep the dream alive. The dream of a free world where all men are created equal.
translation: 我们要心怀这梦想。建立一个自由、众生平等世界的梦想。

original: Hannibal has plans to abolish slavery everywhere. What more noble goal is there?
translation: 汉尼拔计划废除每一个地方的奴隶制。还有比这更高尚的目标吗？

original: Why do you think I should swear my allegiance to this place?
translation: 你为什么认为我该向这地方表示我的忠诚？

original: He's a man with a dream.
translation: 他是个怀抱梦想的人。

original: If you want to know more than that, you should ask him, not me.
translation: 如果你想多知道一些，那么你应该去问他，而不是问我。

original: I trust him with my life, but you'll have to make up your own mind.
translation: 我和他可以性命相托，但你就必须得自己做决定。

original: Who is this Hannibal guy, anyway?
translation: 总之，这个叫汉尼拔的家伙是谁？

original: Somebody's got to look out for those that can't look out for themselves.
translation: 需要有人去拯救那些不能拯救自己的人。

original: That's all Hannibal is trying to do. He's looking out for all those runaway slaves.
translation: 这就是汉尼拔尝试去做的。他在照顾所有亡命天涯的奴隶。

original: I'm supposed to promise to keep this place safe. Why should I?
translation: 人们指望我答应保卫这地方的安全。我为什么要这么做？

original: He's got big plans.
translation: 他有一个大计划。

original: Someday we're going to leave this place and make our own town.
translation: 总有一天我们会离开这，去建设属于我们自己的城市。

original: I hope I get to help build it.
translation: 我希望我能为它添砖加瓦。

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这干嘛？

original: My former master trained me in masonry. I fix things.
translation: 我从前的主人把我训练成了一个工匠。我在这修理东西。

original: Someday I hope to reattach Lincoln's head to the statue in the Memorial.
translation: 希望有一天，我能在纪念堂把林肯的头重新安放到他的雕像上。

original: I'm an historian. I also tinker with pre-war machines.
translation: 我是个历史学家，同时我也焊补战前的机器。

original: My dream is to build a shrine to the great Abraham Lincoln.
translation: 我的梦想是给伟大的亚伯拉罕·林肯造一座圣殿。

original: I shoot nosy people.
translation: 我喜欢请爱管闲事的人吃子弹。

original: What the hell do you think I do? I protect this place.
translation: 你以为我在干嘛？我在守卫这地方。

original: A bit of this and a bit of that. Whatever Mister Hannibal needs.
translation: 我提供杂七杂八的东西，还有汉尼拔先生需要的东西。

original: I look after the animals, cook our meals, clean up, things like that.
translation: 我负责照看牲口、做饭、打扫卫生之类的活。

original: If I had known this before, I wouldn't have come in. Let me go!
translation: 要是我之前知道会这样的话，我就不来了。让我走吧！

original: We can't risk that. Just as we couldn't risk telling you who we were before letting you in.
translation: 我们不能冒这险。就像我们不能在你加入之前，冒险告诉你我们是谁一样。

original: All I need is your word. Will you guard our secret?
translation: 我要你做的全部就是守口如瓶。你会保守我们的秘密吗？

original: I'm an escaped slave. I was told you help runaways like me. <Lie.>
translation: 我是个逃亡的奴隶。有人告诉我你在帮助像我一样亡命天涯的人。<撒谎>

original: You're the best equipped runaway slave I've ever seen.
translation: 你是我见过的逃亡奴隶中装备最棒的。

original: Whether you're telling the truth or lying through your teeth, you'll need to see Hannibal.
translation: 不管你是想告诉我实话，还是想被我打得满地找牙，你都得见见汉尼拔。

original: Keep your hands in sight and don't make any sudden moves. I'm coming down to open the gate.
translation: 把手放在我能看见的地方，别做小动作，我这就下来开门。

original: I want to know what you're hiding in there. Now open the damn door.
translation: 我得弄清楚你们在这藏了什么东西。快把那该死的门给我打开。

original: That's some tough talk stranger. You should clear out of here before I'm forced to make you.
translation: 是一些不好说话的陌生人，从没见过他们。你应该在我对你动粗之前把这清理干净。

original: Forget it. I'm not interested.
translation: 忘了它吧。我没兴趣。

original: Suit yourself. Offer's here if you want it.
translation: 随便你。你要想通了随时都可以回来。

original: Sounds like a deal.
translation: 听起来还可以。

original: Alright. Fix that robot, and I'll give you some energy cells. Good luck.
translation: 好吧。如果你能修好那机器人，我就会给你些动力电池的。祝你好运。

original: That's a complicated job. I'm going to need some money.
translation: 这可是个麻烦活。我需要钱。

original: Well, I guess that's fair. I'll throw in 100 caps if you fix the robot, plus the two energy cells.
translation: 好吧，我想这很公平。要是你能修好这机器人，我就给你一百个瓶盖，外加两块动力电池。

original: She was seen coming OUT of the vault, AGAIN, and headed God knows where. Don't let that revolving door hit you on the ass on the way out...
translation: 有人又一次看到她从避难所里出来，天知道她去哪了。出去时候别让那旋转门撞到你的屁股……

original: He was seen coming OUT of the vault, AGAIN, and headed God knows where. Don't let that revolving door hit you on the ass on the way out...
translation: 有人又一次看到他从避难所里出来，天知道他去哪了。出去时候别让那旋转门撞到你……

original: Who says you can't go home again, huh? The kid from Vault 101 did, but it looks like the prodigal daughter's return didn't last all that long.
translation: 谁说你不能再回家？这从101号避难所出来的孩子就做到过，看起来这放荡浪女的回归没持续多久。

original: Who says you can't go home again, huh? The kid from Vault 101 did, but it looks like the prodigal son's return didn't last all that long.
translation: 谁说你不能再回家？这从101号避难所出来的孩子就做到过，但看起来这放荡浪子的回归没持续多久。

original: Only you, 101. Only you.
translation: 只有你，101，只有你。

original: You heard it here first, children. A forest fire in the Capital Wasteland, where all the trees were ALREADY burnt to a crisp 200 years ago.
translation: 你是第一个听到这的，孩子们。首都废土发生了一场森林大火，但是那里的树木在200年前就烧成渣了。

original: Point 2: The smoke and smell from this thing don’t match your typical chemical burn. Reports are, this smells like burning... wood.
translation: 要点2：这东西散发的烟雾和气味和你所知道的化学燃烧无法相提并论。报告上说，这味道闻起来像在烧……木头。

original: Point 1: The kid from Vault 101 was seen in that area just before the fire.
translation: 要点1：在那地方着火之前，有人看到过这来自101号避难所的孩子。

original: Yeah, yeah. So what? Well here’s what.
translation: 嗯，嗯。那又怎样？就这样。

original: We’ve been getting reports of a raging, sustained fire somewhere up north.
translation: 我们得到报告说，北方某个地方发生了一场持续了很久的大火。

original: In the end, I guess it doesn’t really matter. Arefu is quiet once more, thanks to the efforts of the lone wanderer... from Vault 101.
translation: 最后，我猜那没什么大事了。断桥镇再一次得到了平静，多亏了那孤独的流浪者……来自101号避难所的那人。

original: So what happened down there in the stinking, slinking subway tunnels? Friendly chit-chat, or a classic case of shotgun diplomacy?
translation: 那么在那臭烘烘的地铁隧道里发生了什么？是友好协商，还是一次经典的强盗外交？

original: The cherry on top? She emerged a short time later with a lad named Ian West, who, presumably, had been taken captive in the latest raid.
translation: 后来呢？她与一个名叫伊恩·维斯特的小伙子出现了，而那个伊恩就是之前被俘虏的那个人。

original: The cherry on top? He emerged a short time later with a lad named Ian West, who, presumably, had been taken captive in the latest raid.
translation: 后来呢？他与一个名叫伊恩·维斯特的小伙子出现了，而那个伊恩就是之前被俘虏的那个人。

original: Buuuuttt... it would seem that after 101 made a little solo sojourn into the murky depths of Meresti Station, the attacks... stopped.
translation: 但但但但是……看起来101独自一人在又黑又深米尔斯蒂地铁站作了小小的逗留之后，攻击……停止了。

original: Little Miss Vault 101 was spotted over in Arefu, where the settlement has been hit pretty hard lately by a marauding gang of riotous ruffians.
translation: 有人见到101号避难所的小妞在断桥镇，那的居民不久前被一群打家劫舍的流氓恶棍揍得够呛。

original: Mister Vault 101 was spotted over in Arefu, where the settlement has been hit pretty hard lately by a marauding gang of riotous ruffians.
translation: 有人见到101号避难所的小子在断桥镇，那的居民不久前被一群打家劫舍的流氓恶棍揍得够呛。

original: I'd ask the kid from 101, but I hear she's busy oogling some newly obtained piece of shiny Commonwealth technology. Quite a coinc of dink, that...
translation: 我应该问问这101来的孩子，可我听说她忙着研究一些新得到的联邦的高科技。真是……

original: I'd ask the kid from 101, but I hear he's busy oogling some newly obtained piece of shiny Commonwealth technology. Quite a coinc of dink, that...
translation: 我应该问问这101来的孩子，可我听说他忙着研究一些新得到的联邦的高科技。真是……

original: A case of unrequited middle-aged romance, or some kind of spontaneously beneficial business arrangement?
translation: 一段典型的不求报答的中年罗曼史，或者一种于己有利的自发性商业安排？

original: Weird thing is, trusted Rivet City resident and head of security Harkness has abandoned his life here in the Capital Wasteland... and gone with him.
translation: 莫名其妙的是，值得信任的铆钉城居民兼警卫主管哈克尼斯放弃了他在首都废土的生活……随他人而去。

original: Looks like Rivet City's latest visitor, a certain Zimmer from the scientifically superior Commonwealth, has finally packed his bags and headed home.
translation: 看来刚从高手如云的科技之城联邦来到铆钉城，叫齐默的那家伙，最终卷铺盖走人了。

original: Signs point to yes...
translation: 迹象表明，正是……

original: Could this have something to do with Miss Vault 101 playing junior gumshoe lately, interrogating everyone about a fugitive from the Commonwealth?
translation: 这和近来101号避难所小姐装作刑警，就某个联邦的逃犯询问每个人有什么关系吗？

original: Could this have something to do with Mister Vault 101 playing junior gumshoe lately, interrogating everyone about a fugitive from the Commonwealth?
translation: 这和近来101号避难所先生装作刑警，就某个联邦的逃犯询问每个人有什么关系吗？

original: Trouble, oh we got trouble, right here in Rivet City! Looks like trusted resident and head of security Harkness has unexpectedly flown the coop.
translation: 麻烦了，哦，我们有麻烦了，就在铆钉城！那看似可信的居民兼警卫主管哈克尼斯居然逃之夭夭了。

original: One small step backwards for man, one giant evolutionary rewind for mankind.
translation: 他后退一小步，人类倒退一大步。

original: You see, they worked together to completely wipe out a group of noble, slavery-hating abolitionists at a place called the Temple of the Union.
translation: 你看，他们齐心协力在团结圣殿彻底消灭了那些自命不凡的废奴主义者。

original: Well you're in luck! Human bondage is here to stay, folks, thanks to that asshole from Vault 101 and his Slaver amigos.
translation: 你太幸运了！伟大的奴隶制保存了下来！人民们，这多亏了这来自101号避难所的混蛋和他的奴隶贩子朋友。

original: Are you sick enough to think slavery is the best thing to happen to the Capital Wasteland since broiled Mirelurk Cakes?
translation: 你真的傻到认为除了泥沼蟹饼，奴隶制就是首都废土上最好的事吗？

original: Are you a worthless piece of human trash who'd like nothing better than to own another human being?
translation: 你是一个只想占有别人的人渣吗？

original: Now if she could just remove all those ugly pipes from the Jefferson Memorial...
translation: 现在如果她能把杰斐逊纪念馆中所有难看的管道清除掉的话……

original: Now if he could just remove all those ugly pipes from the Jefferson Memorial...
translation: 现在如果他能把杰斐逊纪念馆中所有难看的管道清除掉的话……

original: Thanks to the kid from Vault 101, for assisting with this little bit of civic restoration.
translation: 多亏了这101号避难所的孩子，他帮助这些平民的生活重回正轨。

original: If you happen to make it down to the Mall, you just may notice that a previously decapitated statue has had an unexpected reunion... with it's head.
translation: 如果你偶然经过商业街，你可能会发现一尊之前无头的雕像和它的头意外重逢了……

original: And special thanks to 101, for kicking the bad guys where it counts -- their wallets.
translation: 特别感谢101，踢到了那群人渣的痛处 — 他们的钱包。

original: Slavers of the Capital Wasteland, consider this the big "fuck you" you've had coming since starting this scurrilous skin trade.
translation: 自废土上奴隶贸易诞生以来，这是奴隶贩子所面临的最大威胁。

original: So if you're a slave on the run, the time for lying low is long gone. Head to the Temple of the Union and keep your head held high.
translation: 所以如果你是一个逃亡的奴隶，那么担惊受怕的日子就一去不复返了。挺胸抬头朝着团结圣殿去吧。

original: Is the tide finally turning for those scumbag Slavers? Lordy knows it's been open season on defenseless settlers long enough.
translation: 最终卑鄙的奴隶贩子会成为主宰吗？连上帝都知道，废土上毫无防备的人们被肆意捕猎很久了。

original: Looks like our friend from Vault 101 has turned amateur abolitionist, lending a hand to the folks at the Temple of the Union.
translation: 看来我们101号避难所的朋友变成了一个业余的废奴主义者，还向那些团结圣殿的家伙施以援手。

original: Hey, wouldn't you know it, the lone Wanderer is done collecting bottles of soda. Christ, talk about your slow news days...
translation: 嗨，你不知道，那孤独的流浪者已经不再收集汽水瓶了。克里斯蒂，说说你这些天来的新闻……

original: I've also heard it tastes like Radscorpion shit and turns your piss blue. Or does it taste like Radscorpion piss and turn your shit blue? Whatever.
translation: 我还听说那玩意尝起来像辐射蝎的大便，而且能让你尿出蓝色的东西。或者是那玩意尝起来像辐射蝎的尿而让你排出蓝色的大便？管他呢。

original: It's called Nuka-Cola Quantum, and I believe it was made in limited quantities before the war.
translation: 它叫量子版核子可乐，而且我相信这东西在战前是限量生产的。

original: God knows why, but the kid from Vault 101 is scouring the Capital Wasteland for a unique brand of Nuka-Cola.
translation: 天知道为什么，但这101号避难所的孩子为了一瓶有独一无二商标的核子可乐搜遍了首都废土。

original: Shame, shame, shame on you...
translation: 可耻，可耻，你真可耻……

original: Oh, you heard me right! 101, a little defenseless boy begged you for help, and what did you do? You SOLD HIM AS A FUCKING SLAVE!
translation: 哦，你听说过对不对！101，一个毫无恶意的小男孩请求你的帮助，你都做了什么？你把他当做一个恶心的奴隶给卖了！

original: I'll tell you where Bryan Wilks is. He's at fucking Paradise Falls, that's where!
translation: 我会告诉你布赖恩·威尔克斯在哪。他在该死的堕落天堂，就在那！

original: So if you see Bryan and his new parents, wish them all good luck. Oh, and 101? Nice work.
translation: 所以要是你看见布赖恩和他新的监护人，祝他们所有人好运。还有什么，101？干的真漂亮。

original: You see, not only did Miss Vault 101 stop the Ant problem, she also found little Bryan Wilks a new home.
translation: 你看，101号避难所小姐不仅解决了蚂蚁问题，她还给小布赖恩·威尔克斯找了一处新家。

original: You see, not only did Mister Vault 101 stop the Ant problem, he also found little Bryan Wilks a new home.
translation: 你看，101号避难所先生不仅解决了蚂蚁问题，他还给小布赖恩·威尔克斯找了一处新家。

original: Bryan, sadly, was the sole survivor. That's where the kid from Vault 101 comes in, and where our story, thankfully, gets better.
translation: 很遗憾，布赖恩是唯一的幸存者。然后那101号避难所的孩子就出场了，这也是我们故事发生的地方，万分感谢你，祝你过得更好。

original: So for the love of God, if someone is in the vicinity of Grayditch, could you please give the kid a Nuka-Cola, a Salisbury steak, something?
translation: 看在上帝的份上，要是有谁在格雷蒂奇的附近，求求你给那孩子一瓶核子可乐，一块索尔兹伯里肉饼，和一点别的好不好？

original: Good God, 101, have you no conscience? You left the kid to rot in that fallout shelter. I have witnesses!
translation: 天啊，101，你一点良心也没有吗？你把那孩子扔在充满辐射的掩体里自生自灭。我有证据！

original: I'll tell you where Bryan Wilks is. That little boy is stuck in a fucking box, that's where!
translation: 我告诉你布赖恩·威尔克斯在哪。那小男孩被卡在一个该死的亭子里，就在那！

original: But, what did she do with the boy, Three Dog? Where's Bryan Wilks now?
translation: 但是，她对那男孩做了什么，三狗？布赖恩·威尔克斯现在在哪？

original: But, what did he do with the boy, Three Dog? Where's Bryan Wilks now?
translation: 但是，他对那男孩做了什么，三狗？布赖恩·威尔克斯现在在哪？

original: You see, Miss Vault 101 may have stopped the Ant problem, but she couldn't be bothered to help poor little Bryan. Noooo.
translation: 你看，101号避难所小姐可能解决了蚂蚁问题，但现在却为帮助穷小孩布赖恩的事而头疼了。不 —

original: You see, Mister Vault 101 may have stopped the Ant problem, but he couldn't be bothered to help poor little Bryan. Noooo.
translation: 你看，101号避难所先生可能解决了蚂蚁问题，但现在却为帮助穷小孩布赖恩的事而头疼了。不 —

original: Bryan, sadly, was the sole survivor. That's where the kid from Vault 101 comes in, and where our story, unfortunately, gets even worse.
translation: 很遗憾，布赖恩是唯一的幸存者。然后那101号避难所的孩子就出场了，这也是我们故事发生的地方，很不幸，屋漏偏逢连夜雨。

original: You see, Bryan's from Grayditch, a small settlement that was recently overrun with overzealous Giant Ants.
translation: 你瞧，布赖恩来自格雷蒂奇，那个巨蚁泛滥的小型定居点。

original: This, faithful listeners, is the story of a little boy. A little boy... named Bryan Wilks.
translation: 我忠实的听众，这是一个小男孩的故事。一个小的男孩……他叫布赖恩·威尔克斯。

original: Following this thing's advice'll get you killed faster than you can say, "Hug a deathclaw!"
translation: 照这破书的建议行动，保准让你死得比说句“抱抱死亡爪”还快！

original: The kid from Vault 101 had a big hand in getting this thing written, and her research methods suck. There, I said it.
translation: 101号避难所那姑娘深度掺和了这本书的编写，她的调研手法简直烂到家。好了，我直说了。

original: The kid from Vault 101 had a big hand in getting this thing written, and his research methods suck. There, I said it.
translation: 101号避难所那小子深度掺和了这本书的编写，他的调研手法简直烂到家。好了，我直说了。

original: Public Service Warning, children! Watch out for a book claiming to be a "Wasteland Survival Guide!"
translation: 公共服务警告，孩子们！千万当心那本自称《废土生存指南》的破书！

original: Survive, Thrive, and Revive, that's the name of the game. The book is the Wasteland Survival Guide! Pick up your copy today!
translation: “生存”、“成长”和“复活”，那就是这游戏的名字。这本书就是废土生存指南！今天就来买本吧！

original: Now, let me tell ya. This thing's got all sorts of useful tips. Where to find food, how to deal with radiation, tons o' stuff.
translation: 现在，让我告诉你。这东西里面有各种各样有用的小秘诀。例如到哪去找吃的，怎么处理辐射，有用的东西非常多。

original: Oh, and, get this - researched and co-authored by none other than - yep, you guessed it - that tenacious teenager from Vault 101.
translation: 哦，还有，记着住这一点 — 这些研究的调查者和合著者不是别人 — 不错，你猜对了，就是那来自101号避难所的顽强少年。

original: Our first masterpiece is called "The Wasteland Survival Guide," written by Underworld's own Moira Brown.
translation: 我们的首部大作名为“废土生存指南”，由地下城的莫伊拉·布朗撰写。

original: Our first masterpiece is called "The Wasteland Survival Guide," written by Megaton's own Moira Brown.
translation: 我们的首部大作名为“废土生存指南”，由兆吨镇的莫伊拉·布朗撰写。

original: Know what I've decided, children? I'm gonna start a bookclub. Right... NOW! Wanna join? Good, cause you got no choice!
translation: 知道我做了什么决定吗，孩子们？我就要办一个读书俱乐部。没错……就是现在！想加入吗？没问题，只此一家别无分店！

original: So let's recount - our old friend shows up, weird shit happens, but in the end she saves the day. Yeah, that sounds about right.
translation: 让我们回顾一下：我们的老朋友一现身，怪事就频发，但最终她力挽狂澜。害，老套路吧。

original: So let's recount - our old friend shows up, weird shit happens, but in the end he saves the day. Yeah, that sounds about right.
translation: 让我们回顾一下：我们的老朋友一现身，怪事就频发，但最终他力挽狂澜。害，老套路吧。

original: In any event, the super silly situation's been dealt with, Canterbury Commons is safe, and 101 is the woman of the hour.
translation: 不管怎样，这场超级荒谬的闹剧已经收场，坎特伯雷社区太平了，而101来的姑娘正是那位风云人物。

original: In any event, the super silly situation's been dealt with, Canterbury Commons is safe, and 101 is the man of the hour.
translation: 不管怎样，这场超级荒谬的闹剧已经收场，坎特伯雷社区太平了，而101来的小伙正是那位风云人物。

original: From who, you ask? A couple of self-obsessed super psychos called... the AntAgonizer and the Mechanist! Hey, I couldn't make this shit up if I tried.
translation: 你问谁是罪魁？一对心理变态的自恋狂，好像叫……痛苦蚁后和机械侠！嘿，这鬼话我编都编不出来。

original: A big 'thank you' goes out to the mysterious traveler from Vault 101, for saving the little town of Canterbury Commons.
translation: 小镇坎特伯雷社区得救了，我们把一句真心的“谢谢你”送给来自101号避难所的神秘旅者。

original: Looks like I've got a spot o' good news for you, children.
translation: 看来我有了一丁点儿好消息要告诉你们，孩子们。

original: Somethin' about Super Mutants takin' residents prisoner... All I know is the kid could have helped, and didn't. Nice going, asshole.
translation: 说是超级变种人绑了居民作俘虏……我只知道，那崽子明明能搭把手却装死。干得好啊，混球。

original: Somethin' about a rescue from Super Mutants, if you can believe that. Nice going, kid.
translation: 听说是从超级变种人手里搞了波营救，这没吹牛皮哦。可以啊，孩子。

original: Now, I've got new reports from the settlement known as Bigtown that Little Miss Vault Gal has helped them out with one hell of a mess.
translation: 新消息，我刚收到那个叫大镇的聚居地报告，那位避难所小姐帮他们解决了一个大麻烦。

original: Now, I've got new reports from the settlement known as Bigtown that Mister Vault Guy has helped them out with one hell of a mess.
translation: 新消息，我刚收到那个叫大镇的聚居地报告，那位避难所小伙帮他们解决了一个大麻烦。

original: What will you do now?
translation: 你现在打算做什么？

original: I'll mourn Him with every ounce of my being. This has been a tremendous loss to the world.
translation: 我会全身心地悼念祂。这对全世界而言是巨大的损失。

original: If anything, this place will become a memorial to Him lest we may forget.
translation: 如有可能，这个地方会变成祂的纪念堂，以免我们忘却。

original: Rejoice in the knowledge that one day all the barren rock and sand of this dead Wasteland will become vibrant with green once again!
translation: 欣喜地知道，这片死寂废土上的所有荒岩和沙土，有朝一日将再次焕发生机，充满绿意！

original: There's so much to prepare for, so much to do!
translation: 有太多事要准备，太多事要做了！

original: I'll remain hopeful that someday Birch will come to his senses and realize we may not only be the only Treeminders, but the last of them as well.
translation: 我会一直抱有希望，盼着有一天伯奇能清醒过来，意识到我们不仅可能是唯一的护树人，甚至可能是最后的。

original: I will do my best to honor the Great One's memory by tending this place until my dying day.
translation: 我会竭尽全力照料这个地方，直至生命的最后一刻，以此缅怀圣贤。

original: If anything, this place will become a memorial to Him lest we may forget.
translation: 如有可能，这个地方会变成祂的纪念堂，以免我们忘却。

original: Although his influence will spread through the Wasteland one day, that day is still a long way off.
translation: 尽管终有一天，祂的影响会遍及整个废土，但那一天还很遥远。

original: For now, we'll remain ever vigilant and watch the Wasteland for anything that could threaten this sanctuary.
translation: 目前，我们仍会时刻保持警惕，留意废土上任何可能对圣所构成的威胁。

original: Now that Oasis is safe, we do what we always do. We remain ever vigilant and watch the Wasteland for anything that could threaten this sanctuary.
translation: 既然绿洲现在安全了，我们就做我们一以贯之的事。我们要时刻保持警惕，紧盯住废土上一切对圣所可能构成的威胁。

original: Now that Harold's gone, I lost my bestest friend! All I want to do is cry!
translation: 现在哈罗德走了，我失去了我最最要好的朋友！我现在只想哭！

original: I dunno, maybe go play with Harold? I wanna hear another one of his super swell stories!
translation: 我不知道，没准去找哈罗德玩？我希望能听到他的另一个精彩的故事！

original: Look to the future and seek the true meaning of what transpired here. If there's an answer out there somewhere, I'll find it.
translation: 展望未来，探寻此地所发生之事的真谛。如果有答案，我一定会找到的。

original: I'll do what I do best. I'll make sure Oasis never falls even if it means my own death.
translation: 我会做我最擅长的事。我会确保绿洲永远不会陷落，即便这意味着要牺牲我自己的生命。

original: Whatever the Tree Father or Leaf Mother would have me do, I'm still theirs to obey.
translation: 无论“树之父”或“叶之母”要我做什么，我都仍会听从他们的吩咐。

original: I'll remain here and help in anyway that I can. I owe them my life, and I intend to repay that debt until my last breath.
translation: 我会留在这里，尽我所能提供帮助。我欠他们一条命，我打算用我的余生来报答这份恩情。

original: What do you see in my future?
translation: 你从我的未来中看到了什么？

original: Please, I must rest a day's time before I can again see into the future... I find the experience quite draining.
translation: 别了，我得休息一天才能再次预见未来……我觉得这种体验太耗费精力了。

original: I see four-leaf clovers in the sky with time as their deadliest adversary.
translation: 我看到天空中飘浮着四叶草，而时间是它们最致命的敌人。

original: I see a woman searching in vain for a relative long lost.
translation: 我见过一个女人徒劳地寻找一个失踪很久的亲人。

original: I feel the torment of a man who returns home and discovers the changes his absence has wrought.
translation: 我感觉到这人的痛苦，他回到家中却发现因为自己的离去产生了许多变故。

original: I divine a great document and the passages that changed the face of the world.
translation: 我看到一个重大的文件和其中某段足以改变世界面貌的文字。

original: I see four headless men and a being robbed of its dignity.
translation: 我看见四个无头的人和一个被夺去尊严的生物。

original: I picture a place of great sorrow where men are traded for money and treated like Brahmin.
translation: 我脑海中勾勒出一个令人扼腕的地方，在那为了钱，人可以被用来交易，被当成双头牛那样随意处置。

original: I see a selfish man who lives among the clouds playing a dangerous game with the lives of those below him.
translation: 我看到云端有一个自私的人正在和那些云下的人玩着危险的游戏。

original: I see a mysterious man and a town on the brink of destruction.
translation: 我看到了一个神秘的人和一个濒临毁灭的城市。

original: I divine a group of individuals who society views as monsters and a town suspended above the ground.
translation: 我预见到一群被社会视为怪物的人，还有一座悬浮在地面之上的城镇。

original: I feel people's hatred and love for a man who hunts men that aren't men.
translation: 我感觉到人们对一个猎杀非人类的的人的爱恨。

original: I see a great leader whose message carries through time as a rallying cry to the oppressed and a warning to the oppressors.
translation: 我看到一个伟大的领袖，他的讯息穿越时空，就像受压迫者的齐声呐喊和对压迫者的言辞警告。

original: I hear the cry of a woman obsessed and the man who desires her.
translation: 我听到一个着了魔的女人的哭喊，和一个渴望着她的男人的悲鸣。

original: I discern a lonely child trapped in a city on fire.
translation: 我看到，一个形单影只的小孩被困在着火的城镇。

original: I divine an endless search for knowledge to help others survive the desolation.
translation: 我看到一些人在无止境地学术探索，帮助其他人，拯救这片荒芜。

original: I see a clash between insects and industry and the men that control them.
translation: 我看到昆虫和工业文明之间的冲突。

original: I see a town in need of a savior and a woman in red.
translation: 我看到一个需要救世主的城镇和一个红衣女子。

original: Tree Father Birch said you may have a gift for me?
translation: “树之父”伯奇说你可能有礼物要给我？

original: I somehow knew you'd be the one to make the changes that Leaf Mother Laurel desired.
translation: 不知为何，我就知道你会是那个能做出“叶之母”萝瑞尔所期望改变的人。

original: I helped to create the hoods that you see all Treeminders wear. It's said that the cloth has a part of the Great One's spirit woven into the fibers.
translation: 所有护树人戴的兜帽都是我参与制作的。据说布料的纤维里织入了圣贤的一部分灵魂。

original: I present this to you as thanks. Wear this with pride and bring the message of renewal to all the corners of the Wasteland.
translation: 我把这个送给你以表感谢。骄傲地戴上它，将重生的讯息带到废土的每一个角落。

original: Leaf Mother Laurel said you may have a gift for me?
translation: “叶之母”萝瑞尔说你可能有礼物要给我？

original: I helped to create the garb that you see all Treeminders wear. It's said that the cloth has a part of the Great One's spirit woven into the fibers.
translation: 我帮着做外衣，就是你看到的所有树启者穿的那种。据说这块布料的纤维里面含有一部分的圣贤精魂。

original: I present this to you as thanks. Wear this with pride but tell no one where it came from or Oasis may face as yet a greater peril.
translation: 我把这送给你以示感谢。自豪地穿着它，但不要告诉别人你是从哪得到的它，否则绿洲将会面临极大的危险。

original: We're very much alike, you and I. We both searched the Wasteland seeking answers, but I found my answer here.
translation: 你和我很相似。我们都曾在废土上探寻答案，而我在这里找到了自己的答案。

original: I hope one day you'll find what you're looking for. I know it's out there somewhere... just be patient.
translation: 我希望有一天你也能找到你所追寻的东西。我知道它就在某个地方……耐心点。

original: Here, please take this relic of my older days. Perhaps it will help you on your journey.
translation: 来，收下这件我旧日的纪念。也许它能在你的旅途中帮到你。

original: I've never known someone to show as much caring as you did towards us. It seems to be rare to run into anyone like that anymore.
translation: 我从未见过像你这般对我们关心的人。如今，这样的人似乎越来越少见了。

original: That's partly why I never returned to my former life after I found myself in this place.
translation: 这也是我来到此地后，便再也没有回归往昔生活的部分原因。

original: Allow me to present a piece of my past to you, friend. Perhaps it will serve you better than it served me.
translation: 朋友，请收下这件承载我过往的物件。或许它对你的用处会比在我这里更大。

original: Leaf Mother Laurel said you may have a gift for me?
translation: “叶之母”萝瑞尔说你可能有礼物要给我？

original: Yeah, I think you're pretty swell for someone from Out There! And... and you were really nice to me too.
translation: 是啊，我觉得对来自“外面”的人来说，你真的很棒！而且……而且你对我也很好。

original: I was gonna give this to my bestest friend Harold, but he doesn't have pockets, the silly-head!
translation: 我本来要把这送给我最最要好的朋友哈罗德，可他没有口袋，这个笨蛋！

original: This is a charm that my parents gave me for my fifth birthday. It's really neat! Take it!
translation: 这是我父母在我五岁生日时送的护符。它非常棒！拿着吧！

original: I hear you may have a gift for me?
translation: 我听说你可能有礼物给我？

original: Yes, I believe Branchtender Linden, Bloomseer Poplar and my little Yew mentioned they had some things for you as gifts.
translation: 是的，我想“护枝人”林登、“花先知”波普勒，还有我的小杨提到过，他们有一些东西要送给你当礼物。

original: Such is our tradition when honored guests are preparing to leave.
translation: 在贵宾准备离开时，这是我们的传统。

original: You said someone had gifts for me?
translation: 你说有人给我准备了礼物？

original: Yes, I believe Branchtender Linden and Bloomseer Poplar mentioned they had some things for you as gifts.
translation: 是的，我相信护枝人林登和“花先知”帕普勒提过他们有东西要送给你。

original: Such is our tradition when honored guests are preparing to leave.
translation: 在贵宾准备离开时，这是我们的传统。

original: You said someone had gifts for me?
translation: 你说有人给我准备了礼物？

original: Yes, I believe Branchtender Maple, Branchtender Cypress and my little Yew mentioned they had some things for you as gifts.
translation: 是的，我想“护枝人”梅坡、“护枝人”赛普拉斯，还有我的小杨提到过，他们有一些东西要送给你当礼物。

original: Such is our tradition when honored guests are preparing to leave.
translation: 在贵宾准备离开时，这是我们的传统。

original: You said someone had gifts for me?
translation: 你说有人给我准备了礼物？

original: Yes, I believe Branchtender Maple and Branchtender Cypress mentioned they had some things for you as gifts.
translation: 是的，我想“护枝人”梅坡和“护枝人”赛普拉斯提到过，他们有一些东西要送给你当礼物。

original: Such is our tradition when honored guests are preparing to leave.
translation: 在贵宾准备离开时，这是我们的传统。

original: You said someone had gifts for me?
translation: 你说有人给我准备了礼物？

original: I can't explain it, but I can feel this place just teeming with life.
translation: 我说不出来，但我能感觉到这儿生机勃勃。

original: That's His power you feel, Outsider. With His outstretched limbs He shelters us and keep us safe.
translation: 你感觉到的就是他的力量，外来者。他伸出臂膀庇护我们，保护我们的安全。

original: The way you're saying "Him," I could swear you're referring to a god...
translation: 听你说“祂”的口气，我敢发誓你说的是一位神明……

original: He's no mere god, my friend.
translation: 祂可不只是普通的神，我的朋友。

original: He is the One Who Grows, He is the One Who Gives and He is the One Who Guides.
translation: 祂是万物培育者，是慷慨赐予者，也是方向指引者。

original: Thanks to Him, the Treeminders have a home.
translation: 多亏了祂，树启者才有了家园。

original: Amazing, this place seems so abundant with animal life.
translation: 太神奇了，这个地方的动物种类似乎非常丰富。

original: The innocent creatures are drawn here by His gifts. They come from across the Wasteland to live in this sanctuary.
translation: 这些无辜的生灵被祂的馈赠吸引到这里。它们从废土的各个角落赶来，在这片圣所中栖息。

original: This part of the world is healing, my friend, and it's all thanks to Him.
translation: 我的朋友，世界的这一隅正在恢复生机，这一切都多亏了祂。

original: Your robot made this satisfying grinding noise when I ripped out its innards.
translation: 当我扯掉你的机器人内脏时，它发出了惬意的摩擦声。

original: What the hell, man? Why would you even do that?
translation: 你到底怎么回事，小子？你为什么要那样做？

original: Forget you. I'm outta here. Stay away from machines in the future, especially mine.
translation: 忘了吧。我离开了。在以后的日子里离机器远点，尤其是我的。

original: I had to disable that robot. It was going to explode. <Lie.>
translation: 我不得不毁了那机器人。它会爆炸的。<撒谎>

original: It was? I had no idea, thanks.
translation: 是吗？我不知道，谢谢。

original: Here, take these for helping me out.
translation: 给，谢谢你帮助我。

original: It was? I had no idea, thanks.
translation: 是吗？我不知道，谢谢。

original: Here, take these for helping me out.
translation: 给，谢谢你帮助我。

original: Your robot's working fine, now.
translation: 现在你的机器人可以正常运作了。

original: Thanks. Nice to meet a fellow mechanic out here in the Wasteland. Here's your payment.
translation: 谢谢。很高兴能在废土碰到一个修理师同伴。这是你的报酬。

original: Thanks. Nice to meet a fellow mechanic out here in the Wasteland. Here's your payment.
translation: 谢谢。很高兴能在废土碰到一个修理师同伴。这是你的报酬。

original: Oh, I like that, Butch.
translation: 哦，我喜欢，布奇。

original: That's a good one. Best yet, don't you think, Wally?
translation: 那个好。眼下最好的，你觉得呢，瓦利？

original: Uh, sure. I mean, I really like that one!
translation: 呃，当然。我是说，我真喜欢那个！

original: I don't know. Maybe.
translation: 我不知道。或许吧。

original: You and your snakes and rats and lizards...
translation: 你和你的蛇还有老鼠还有蜥蜴……

original: Hey, how about the Vault Dwellers? Get it?
translation: 嗨，“避难所居民”怎么样？还可以吗？

original: Yeah. I got one. "The Mackers." Super cool, right?
translation: 当然。我想到一个。“麦克帮”，很酷，对吧？

original: I don't know. You guys never like any of my ideas anyway.
translation: 我不知道。反正你们这些家伙从不喜欢我的看法。

original: If you're so smart, why don't you suggest something.
translation: 要是你是真聪明的话，为什么不提点建议。

original: Oh! Oh! I got it. Oh, man this is a great one. "The Grease Weasels"! What do you guys think?
translation: 哦！哦！我想到一个。哦，伙计们，这是个了不起的名字。“黄鼬帮”！你们觉得怎样？

original: Didn't you guys like Grease Weasels?
translation: 大伙不喜欢黄鼬帮？

original: How about "Hell's Overseers"? Yeah, I like that.
translation: “地狱监督者”怎样？嗯，我喜欢这个。

original: I can't believe you didn't like "Hell's Overseers". Better than anything you guys have come up with.
translation: 我简直无法相信你会不喜欢“地狱监督者”。这可比你们这帮家伙想出来的强多了。

original: Isn't being a gang a little stupid? I mean, basically everyone we know is going to be in it.
translation: 组织帮派是不是有点傻？我的意思是，差不多我们认识的每一个人都会入伙的。

original: Here's one: "Wally and the Big Cheese." That's you, Butch -- the Big Cheese.
translation: 我想到一个：“瓦利和大人物”。就是你 —布奇。大人物。

original: I still like "The Mackers."
translation: 我还是喜欢“麦克帮”。

original: Ummm... the Vault Kings?
translation: 嗯……避难所的大王们？

original: So they killed Jonas, and I'm next, is that it?
translation: 所以他们杀了乔纳斯，下一个就是我了，是这样吧？

original: Yeah. It's lucky I got here ahead of them. But we can't stand here talking! You've got to get out of here!
translation: 是这样。幸亏我比他们提前到这。不过我们没时间聊天！你必须赶快离开这！

original: Good guess! I was the toughest defender they ever saw in Lamplight. I earned my nickname fighting off a Mole Rat with a knife big as my arm.
translation: 猜的好！在小灯镇，我是个最强硬的守卫者。我拿着一把胳膊那么长的大刀干退了一只地鼠，就混到这个绰号。

original: When I left, I figured I'd pass on a cushy place like Big Town. I ended up here, Dom took me on as a guard, and that's that.
translation: 当我离开的时候，我觉得自己该去一个像大镇那样轻松的地方。我到了这里，多姆提拔我当了一个守卫，事情就是这样。

original: Did you get your nickname in Lamplight?
translation: 你在小灯镇获得了你的绰号？

original: That's all I need to know.
translation: 我就问这么多好了。

original: Enjoy!
translation: 玩得愉快！

original: See you 'round.
translation: 待会见。

original: Stay out of trouble.
translation: 别惹麻烦。

original: Where do the caravans set up?
translation: 商队在哪里驻扎？

original: When they're in town, you can find the caravan trader out front of the town.
translation: 当商队到了镇子后，你可以在城镇的外面找到他们。

original: They say it's a good way to catch a visitor's eye.
translation: 他们说这是一个吸引旅客眼球的好办法。

original: They usually sell their stuff out front of the town. Never seem to stick around for long, though.
translation: 他们经常在镇前兜售他们的东西。不过从不在一个地方长留。

original: I swear, those boys can't tolerate staying in one place for too long.
translation: 我敢发誓，那些小子可忍受不了老在一个地方待着。

original: You can find them out front. If you didn't see them coming in, that probably means they're all out on trips.
translation: 你能在镇前找到他们。要是你进来的时候没看见他们，那可能就是他们上路了。

original: If you're not in a hurry, you can wait a day or two. They'll be back around in time.
translation: 要是你不着急，你可以等一两天。他们总会回来的。

original: Where can I get some food?
translation: 哪里有食物？

original: You'll want to talk with Joe Porter, over in Dot's Diner.
translation: 你该去找乔·波特谈谈，就在多特的餐馆。

original: I don't know who Dot was, but I'm sure Porter's food does her memory proud!
translation: 我不知道谁是多特，但我确信波特的食物绝对让你难忘！

original: You certainly came to the right person. What'd you like?
translation: 你确实找对人了。要来点什么？

original: Go talk with Porter, over in the Diner. He'll set you right for food.
translation: 去餐馆里跟波特谈谈，他会为你准备好食物。

original: Can I get some directions around town?
translation: 能为我指下路吗？

original: Glad to help, glad to help!
translation: 乐意帮忙，乐意帮忙！

original: Uncle Roe and I live in the old town hall, and Mr. Porter runs the diner across the street. It's not really a big place, you know?
translation: 我和罗伊大叔住在老市政厅，波特先生经营街对过的餐馆。这地方真不算大，对吧？

original: Sure thing. Where ya headed?
translation: 行啊。你去哪儿？

original: No problem. What're you looking for?
translation: 没问题。你在找什么？

original: Busy. Go ask someone else.
translation: 忙着呢。问别人去。

original: I think it's time you put an end to this, once and for all.
translation: 我想是时候了结这事了，一劳永逸。

original: Analyzing command...
translation: 分析指令中……

original: New course of action dictated. Self-destruct sequence initialized.
translation: 更新行动指令。初始化自毁程序。

original: Civilian is advised to secure hazardous FEV material to prevent explosive decompression.
translation: 警告：所有人员保护好危险的FEV病毒原料以防止爆发性分解。

original: Civilian also advised to evacuate complex immediately.
translation: 警告：所有人员紧急疏散。

original: Shut yourself down. Shut down this whole place.
translation: 关机。关闭这整个地方。

original: ...Processing directive.
translation: ……指令处理中。

original: New directive accepted. Self-destruct sequence initialized. Civilian is advised to remove hazardous FEV material and exit at once.
translation: 确认新指令。自毁程序正在初始化。警告：所有人员转移危险的FEV病毒原料并尽快撤离。

original: Where are the other Tenpenny Tower residents?
translation: 特佩尼大厦的其他住户都去哪了？

original: I don't know where they are... but everything is fine. Roy said not to worry about the other residents.
translation: 我不知道他们在哪……不过一切都好。罗伊说别担心其他人。

original: Where are the other Tenpenny Tower residents?
translation: 特佩尼大厦的其他住户都去哪了？

original: Oh? Well... They must have done something to deserve that.
translation: 哦？是吗……他们一定是自作自受。

original: So you approve of mass murder? The basement storage room is full of corpses.
translation: 所以你同意了大屠杀？地下储藏室堆满了尸体。

original: Heh. Roy decided to take out the trash. I'm glad I lost my sense of smell. You'll want to stay clear of the basement storage room.
translation: 呵。罗伊决定清理掉那些垃圾。我很高兴我鼻子不好。你不会想靠近地下储藏室的。

original: What happened to the other Tenpenny Tower residents?
translation: 特佩尼大厦的其他住户出了什么事？

original: Can't say I completely agreed with Roy's decision. Then again, they were a bunch of assholes. No one's innocent, kid. You'd do well to remember that.
translation: 我不完全同意罗伊的决定。但话又说回来，他们是一群混蛋。没有人是无辜的，孩子。你最好记住这一点。

original: The basement storage room is full of bodies. You have anything to do with that?
translation: 地下储藏室堆满了尸体。这事和你有没有关系？

original: Let's just say those two-faced smoothskins didn't like the new management. So they all got themselves "evicted." Can't say it's a shame.
translation: 这些两面三刀的光皮肤讨厌新的管理方式。所以他们就符合“逐客”条件了。这未必不是好事。

original: I notice a distinct lack of non-Ghoul tenants.
translation: 我清楚地注意到非僵尸住户的消失。

original: They had it coming. But I don't have to justify myself to you, or any other smoothskin. In fact, you'd best piss off if you don't want to join them.
translation: 这是他们自找的，但我不必向你或其他的光皮肤证明自己有理。事实上，你要是不想像他们一样，最好赶紧滚。

original: Nice pile of bodies in the storage room. You're proud of yourself, aren't you?
translation: 地下储藏室堆积如山的尸体可真壮观。你很为自己骄傲，对吧？

original: What happened to Mister Tenpenny?
translation: 特佩尼先生怎么了？

original: I'm afraid Tenpenny and I had little disagreement. Not to worry though. He soon had a little "accident." Problem solved.
translation: 恐怕我和特佩尼之间有点意见不合。别急，他很快就会出点“小意外”。问题就解决了。

original: Never mind.
translation: 别介意。

original: Will you stop wasting my time?
translation: 你能不能不浪费我的时间？

original: You've got yourself a deal. Here's your 200 caps.
translation: 你把事情解决了。给你200个瓶盖。

original: 10 more batteries. Don't waste them, these things don't grow on trees you know.
translation: 还有十多个电池。别浪费，这些玩意可不会像树那样自己长出来。

original: Dumbass. You did waste them, didn't you?
translation: 蠢货。你把它们给浪费了，是不是？

original: 200 caps? Wow. I'll have to get back to you on that.
translation: 200个瓶盖？哇哦，让我们回到刚才的话题吧。

original: I need to buy some more ammo for the Mesmetron.
translation: 我要为迷魂枪多买些弹药。
