translation: 通常我不会传播未经证实的传闻，但是……他们说老平克顿正藏在铆钉城的某个地方，而且是他做的。

translation: 就是老古怪平克顿做的，就在铆钉城。总有一天我会去见他并谈谈这事。

original: Got any info on an android mind wipe? Here's a 100 cap "research fee."
translation: 知道有关人造人洗脑的信息吗？这有100个瓶盖的“调查费”。

original: That Commonwealth robot was real! I have proof. Listen to this!
translation: 联邦人造人是真的！我有证据。仔细听着！

original: Some say it was all a hoax. But it's real. Here. Check out this holotape I found. That Commonwealth robot was real!
translation: 有人说这都是恶作剧，但它是真的。给，听听我找到的全息磁带。那联邦人造人是真实的！

original: Shhh! They might be listening.
translation: 嘘！或许有人在偷听。

original: The Commonwealth has tried to make it out to be a hoax, but the escaped android is real I tell you!
translation: 联邦一直试图让外界认为这是个恶作剧，但我跟你说这逃跑的人造人是真的！

original: Listen to this holotape. It will make you a believer too.
translation: 听听这全息磁带，这会让你也相信的。

original: Most believe it's a hoax. Here's some evidence for you to consider for yourself. Take this holotape.
translation: 大多数人认为这是一个恶作剧。这有些证据你自己看看，给你这全息磁带。

original: I used to this it was all so much bullshit. But then I got this holotape. Here, listen to it yourself.
translation: 我过去认为这都是些胡说八道的东西。但不久之后我得到了这全息磁带，给，你自己听听吧。

original: Here's 100 caps for the locale of a Lipoplasticator or Micro Dermal Graftilizer.
translation: 这是100个瓶盖，换取脂肪塑形机或微型皮肤移植机的位置信息。

original: I heard old Pinkerton at Rivet City had a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous.
translation: 我听说在铆钉城的老平克顿有脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。如果说我不羡慕他，那一定是在撒谎。

original: Probably down at Rivet City. Anything that has any use out here, they snatch up for themselves. That damn Pinkerton don't share nothin'.
translation: 或许是在铆钉城。他们在这把任何对他们来说有用的东西都夺走了。那该死的平克顿什么都不愿意跟大家分享。

original: They say old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow got his hands on a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. Amazing really.
translation: 据说铆钉城的平克顿用某种方法搞到了去脂整形机和微型植皮器，真的太神奇了。

original: Try Pinkerton at Rivet City. Heard he has the goods. Hope he doesn't try to actually use them on anyone. Bet he would though. He's nuts.
translation: 到铆钉城找平克顿试试，听说他行。希望他没有在哪个人身上实际用过。但是我打赌他会的，他是疯子。

original: Guess old Pinkerton at Rivet City has some shiny prewar tech. He might have what you're looking for.
translation: 我猜铆钉城的老平克顿一定有些很强的战前技术。他或许会有你想要的东西。

original: I heard a rumor that old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow conjured up a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer.
translation: 有传闻说铆钉城的老平克顿有神奇的去脂整形机和微型植皮器。

original: Rumor had it Pinkerton at Rivet City found a Lipoplasticator and Graftilizer. Good luck to any fool that let Pinkerton test them on him though.
translation: 有传闻说平克顿在铆钉城找到了去脂整形机和植皮器。祝那些让平克顿在他们身上做实验的傻瓜们好运。

original: You ever do a face job on an android from the North? <Jingle purse of 100 caps.>
translation: 你曾经为北方来的人造人做过整容手术吗？<100个瓶盖在钱包发出叮当声>

original: Facial surgery's too dangerous. Plus you need some specialized prewar equipment. Hmm. That reminds me of an old hoax. Here's a copy of that holotape.
translation: 面部整形太危险了，而且你需要一些特殊的战前仪器。嗯，这让我想起了一个老恶作剧。这就是那全息磁带的拷贝。

original: Damn stupid idea. That reminds me of this old hoax. Here, take a listen to this crusty holotape and see for yourself.
translation: 该死的馊主意。那让我想起了这老恶作剧。给，你自己去听听这盘老掉牙的全息磁带吧。

original: Medicine is an important art and science. Shouldn't be wasted on vanity.  Hey, but that reminds me of this old hoax. Here, listen to this holotape.
translation: 医学是一门重要的艺术和科学，不应被虚荣所糟蹋。嗨，但它让我想起了个老恶作剧。给，听听这全息磁带。

original: Hmm... that reminds me of this old hoax. Here, listen to this. It's clearly a joke. No one's got the tech to do that without risking infection.
translation: 嗯……它让我想起了个老恶作剧。给，听听这全息磁带。这显然是个玩笑。没人可以冒被感染的风险。

original: Oh if I got my hands on the right gear I might try it. It's dangerous though. Prone to infection. Reminds me an old hoax. Listen to this holotape.
translation: 哦，如果我得到合适的装备我或许会去试试。这样做十分危险。可能会感染。这让我想起了一个很久以前的恶作剧。听听这全息磁带。

original: Facial surgery's way too dangerous to try. Need special equipment and expertise. Hmm. Reminds me of this old hoax. Here, listen to this holotape.
translation: 脸部整形的方法太危险了，需要特殊的装置和技术。嗯。让我想起来一个老恶作剧。给，听听这全息磁带。

original: Nah. You need specialized gear that doesn't exist anymore. And why risk infection? That reminds me of this old hoax. Here, listen to this holotape.
translation: 没。你需要专门的装备，而那东西已经不存在了。并且为什么要冒感染的风险呢？那让我想起了这老恶作剧。给，听听这全息磁带。

original: I need to find a Micro Dermal Graftilizer for epidermal augmentation surgery.
translation: 我需要为表皮整殖手术找到一台微型皮肤移植机。

original: I heard old Pinkerton at Rivet City had a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous.
translation: 我听说在铆钉城的老平克顿有脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。如果说我不羡慕他，那一定是在撒谎。

translation: 据说铆钉城的平克顿用某种方法搞到了去脂整形机和微型植皮器，真的太神奇了。

original: Try Pinkerton at Rivet City. Heard he has the goods. Hope he doesn't try to actually use them on anyone. Bet he would though. He's nuts.
translation: 到铆钉城找平克顿试试，听说他行。希望他没有在哪个人身上实际用过。但是我打赌他会的，他是疯子。

original: Guess old Pinkerton at Rivet City has some shiny prewar tech. He might have what you're looking for.
translation: 我猜铆钉城的老平克顿一定有些很强的战前技术。他或许会有你想要的东西。

original: I heard a rumor that old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow conjured up a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer.
translation: 有传闻说铆钉城的老平克顿有神奇的去脂整形机和微型植皮器。

original: Rumor had it Pinkerton at Rivet City found a Lipoplasticator and Graftilizer. Good luck to any fool that let Pinkerton test them on him though.
translation: 有传闻说平克顿在铆钉城找到了去脂整形机和植皮器。祝那些让平克顿在他们身上做实验的傻瓜们好运。

original: A patient of mine needs a facial epidermal augmentation. You ever perform one?
translation: 我的一位病人需要做面部表皮增殖。你做过吗？

original: Facial surgery's too dangerous. Plus you need some specialized prewar equipment. Hmm. That reminds me of an old hoax. Here's a copy of that holotape.
translation: 面部整形太危险了，而且你需要一些特殊的战前仪器。嗯，这让我想起了一个老恶作剧。这就是那全息磁带的拷贝。

original: Damn stupid idea. That reminds me of this old hoax. Here, take a listen to this crusty holotape and see for yourself.
translation: 该死的馊主意。那让我想起了这老恶作剧。给，你自己去听听这盘老掉牙的全息磁带吧。

original: Medicine is an important art and science. Shouldn't be wasted on vanity.  Hey, but that reminds me of this old hoax. Here, listen to this holotape.
translation: 医学是一门重要的艺术和科学，不应被虚荣所糟蹋。嗨，但它让我想起了个老恶作剧。给，听听这全息磁带。

original: Hmm... that reminds me of this old hoax. Here, listen to this. It's clearly a joke. No one's got the tech to do that without risking infection.
translation: 嗯……它让我想起了个老恶作剧。给，听听这全息磁带。这显然是个玩笑。没人可以冒被感染的风险。

original: Oh if I got my hands on the right gear I might try it. It's dangerous though. Prone to infection. Reminds me an old hoax. Listen to this holotape.
translation: 哦，如果我得到合适的装备我或许会去试试。这样做十分危险。可能会感染。这让我想起了一个很久以前的恶作剧。听听这全息磁带。

original: Facial surgery's way too dangerous to try. Need special equipment and expertise. Hmm. Reminds me of this old hoax. Here, listen to this holotape.
translation: 脸部整形的方法太危险了，需要特殊的装置和技术。嗯。让我想起来一个老恶作剧。给，听听这全息磁带。

original: Nah. You need specialized gear that doesn't exist anymore. And why risk infection? That reminds me of this old hoax. Here, listen to this holotape.
translation: 没。你需要专门的装备，而那东西已经不存在了。并且为什么要冒感染的风险呢？那让我想起了这老恶作剧。给，听听这全息磁带。

original: What do you know about Zimmer?
translation: 对齐默你了解多少？

original: Other than him being an egotistical, arrogant, condescending pain in the ass? Nothing.
translation: 他是个任性、自大、矫揉造作的混蛋！除此之外，他什么也不是！

original: He's from the Commonwealth. He's come looking for some special robot. I must admit I'm rather curious, but I have other work to do.
translation: 他来自联邦，来找某个特殊的机器人。我承认我十分好奇，但是我有其它的事情要做。

original: He's from up north. He was bragging about how great it is up there.
translation: 他来自北方。他老是吹嘘那地方有多了不起。

original: Yeah... great. They can't even keep tabs on their robots.
translation: 可不……太扯了。他们甚至都绑不住他们自己的机器人。

original: Sigh. That man doesn't have you looking for his pet android, does he? I've already told him to lay off it. He's distracting my entire team.
translation: 唉。那人没让你去找他的宠物仿真人吧？我已经告诉他别折腾了。他正在分散我整个团队的注意力。

original: You're as ignorant as all the other rats on this boat. When you realize I have the real cheese, you'll come crawling back. They always do.
translation: 你就像这船上所有其他的老鼠一样讨厌。当你知道我有奶酪时，你就会爬回来。这世道就是这样。

original: Sorry, I've got better things to do.
translation: 抱歉，我还有重要事要去办。

original: Quit wasting my time!
translation: 别浪费我的时间！

original: I've got better things to do. Are you done talking now?
translation: 抱歉，我还有重要事要去办。你现在能别说了吗？

original: Excellent. Locate my android, and you won't be disappointed.
translation: 太棒了。找到了我的人造人，我就知道你不会让我失望的。

original: Here, listen to this message he sent me. He's mocking me. I swear I'll make him pay for that.
translation: 给，听听他发给我的这信息。他在嘲笑我，我发誓会让他付出代价的。

original: Sure. I'll look into finding your android for you.
translation: 当然，我会为你寻找你的人造人的。

original: Oh. I hadn't realized anyone in the Wasteland was so knowledgeable. And you certainly don't look much like a scientist...
translation: 哦，我没想到在废土还有谁有这般知识。但你看起来真的不像个科学家……

original: Anyway... My android must have done something drastic, like facial surgery and a mind wipe, or else I would have found him by now.
translation: 不管怎么说……我的人造人一定做了些超乎寻常的事，整容还有洗脑，否则我本应该已经找到他了。

original: It will be no easy task. He may not even realize he's not human. Don't upset him by talking with him. Just come get me immediately. I'll handle it.
translation: 这并不容易。他可能甚至还没有意识到他不是人。不要和他说话引起他的情绪变化。如果发现了尽快通知我，我会处理的。

original: I know what an android is. I dabble in AI programming myself.
translation: 我知道人造人是什么东西，我自己就懂人工智能设计。

original: I came to this leaky boat specifically to solicit your help. I'd hoped you "Project Purity" people would be more accommodating.
translation: 我来到这破船专程恳请你的帮助。我以为你们这些参与“净水工程”的人更加乐于助人。

original: Fine. Have it your way. Good luck with your little "project." I can see from the state of things here in the "Wasteland" that you will need it.
translation: 好吧。走你的吧。祝你的小“工程”好运。我看就废土这环境，你们可真需要好运了。

original: Oh my God... you actually opened it...
translation: 天啊…你真的打开了它。

original: Wake up! Come on, wake up!
translation: 醒醒！快点，醒醒！

original: I'll meet up with you at the Vault door if I can. But don't wait for me. Good luck.
translation: 我尽可能在避难所大门与你会合。如果我没到的话别等我，赶快离开。祝你好运。

original: Fine. Your "android." Whatever you call it, it doesn't change the fact that I'm a very busy woman. Will you please drop it and let me work?
translation: 好吧。你的“人造人”，不管你怎么叫它。这改变不了我是个忙人这现状，现在你能让我回去工作吗？

original: Insulting me won't get you what you want, "DOCTOR" Zimmer. Now, if you'll excuse me? PLEASE!
translation: 对我无礼并不能让你得到你想要的，齐默“博士”。我很忙，拜托！

original: He's not just a robot!
translation: 他不仅仅是个机器人！

original: That's Doctor Zimmer to you! Miss... miss whatever-your-name-is. I'd have thought you barbarians would be more interested in advanced technology.
translation: 我是齐默博士！小姐……不管你叫什么。我以为你们野蛮人可能对先进的技术更感兴趣。

original: Do they not use the word "no" in the Commonwealth. It means, "aint going to happen." Your missing robot just isn't a priority right now.
translation: 在联邦不用“不”这词吗？意思是“绝无可能”。你丢了人造人这事算不上什么大事。

original: We've ALL already told you we're too busy to help. Now if you please, Mister Zimmer...
translation: 我们都已经告诉过你，我们太忙了不能帮你。齐默先生，现在如果你没有其他事的话……

original: NO!
translation: 不！

original: I'm VERY busy. Now, if you'll excuse me?
translation: 我非常忙，失陪了。

original: There's nothing more to discuss.
translation: 没有必要再谈了。

original: Your persistence won't change my answer: No.
translation: 你的坚持并不会改变我的回答：不。

original: NO!
translation: 不！

original: This constant harassment is not helping your cause. Back off!
translation: 骚扰我不会对你达成目的有任何帮助。走开！

original: I really must insist that you stop bothering everyone about your missing robot.
translation: 我严肃地告诉你，别用丢了机器人这破事打扰大家。

original: Aint. Gonna. Happen. Got it? Now leave me alone!
translation: 绝无可能，明白了吗？现在让我一个人静会！

original: Stop what you're doing. I have something important to discuss with you.
translation: 放下手头的事。我有些重要的事情和你商量。

original: Maybe you'll be more helpful than your "colleague" over there. Do you know anything about advanced robotics and artificial intelligence?
translation: 或许你比你的“同事”更有用。你了解先进的机器人技术和人工智能吗？

original: Look. I only need a few minutes of your time. Just hear me out. I'll make it worth your while.
translation: 听着。我只占用你一点时间。听我说。这一定会让你觉得值得的。

original: About my missing android...
translation: 关于我丢失的人造人……

original: I just need five minutes of your "precious" time. Think you can spare that?
translation: 我只占用你“宝贵”的五分钟而已。好吗？

original: Whatever you're doing, it can wait. This is IMPORTANT!
translation: 不管你在做什么，都先停下。这非常重要！

original: Let's just say Forty won't be bothering you or anyone else again.
translation: 弗替不会再打扰你或其他人了。

original: Hey hey, look at Mr. Mungo!
translation: 嗨，嗨，看看毛人先生！

original: Sure hope whatever you did doesn't piss off the rest of them.
translation: 当然，但愿你所做的不会惹恼其他人。

original: Okay, me and Sammy can sneak outta here. The drain in the bathroom is just big enough for us to sneak through.
translation: 好的，我和萨米能偷偷溜出这。浴室的排水口刚刚够我们俩通过。

original: But Penny's being all dumb and won't leave. What's with girls, anyway?
translation: 但是佩尼那个蠢货不肯离开。女生都是怎么回事？

original: No luck yet.
translation: 还没。

original: Come on, mungo! How hard can it be?
translation: 加油，毛人！这能有多难？

original: He's disappeared, and I'm just trying to find him. That's all.
translation: 他不见了，我现在正在找他，就这样。

original: All right, all right. You can go on in. If I hear about any trouble, you're gonna wind up in the river. You get me?
translation: 好吧，好吧。你继续。要是我听到任何风吹草动，就让风把你刮到河里去，明白吗？

original: A horror story, huh? So, are you here to terrorize evil, or is it a more generalized sort of terrorizing?
translation: 一个恐怖故事，是吧？你是来这震慑恶魔，还是无差别地震慑？

original: I mean, you wouldn't do anything to hurt someone who was faithfully telling your tale, right? Would you?
translation: 我的意思是，你不该伤害那些真心传颂你的故事的人吧？你不会吧？

original: So... um... Whatever happens next, it's nothing bad to me, right?
translation: 所以……嗯……不管接下来发生什么，都不会伤害到我，对吗？

original: Long ago, my people were buried away. Now, I've arisen, to terrorize the Wastes.
translation: 很久以前，我们被埋入地下。如今我东山再起，威震废土。

original: But we already provide you with plenty of amusement already, right?
translation: 但我们已经给你提供很多消遣了，对吧？

original: Like, enough so we don't have to end up as victims or anything?
translation: 应该足以让我们不必成为牺牲品之类的了吧？

original: Maybe I shouldn't ask, but I have to know...Is there more to this story?
translation: 或许我不该问，但我必须知道……这故事还有下文吗？

original: The Wasteland is littered with the victims of my vengeance... and amusement.
translation: 废土上满是我复仇和消遣的……牺牲品。

original: I vote "save"? Please?
translation: 我选“拯救”？行吗？

original: So... does this story have a happy ending?
translation: 那么……这故事是否有个美好的结局呢？

original: I have a terrible choice to make: save the Capital Wasteland, or destroy it.
translation: 我要做出一个艰难的抉择：拯救首都废土，还是毁灭它。

original: Wow, that sounds like it took some guts.
translation: 哇哦，听起来像需要一定的勇气。

original: Life down here might get dull, but I gotta admit, at least I don't get shot at. Well, not as much, anyway.
translation: 这里的生活或许很无趣，但是我承认，至少我不会挨子弹。好吧，至少挨子弹的机会要小一点。

original: Tell me more! What's happened since then?
translation: 再跟我说点！在那之后发生了什么？

original: I left my dull life behind to search for fame and adventure in the Wasteland.
translation: 我将乏味的生活抛诸脑后，深入废土追逐名望与冒险。

original: They work for you? Wow, they must think you're the most important mungo in the Wastes!
translation: 他们为你工作？哇哦，他们一定认为你是废土最重要的毛人！

original: So, what happens next?
translation: 接下来发生了什么？

original: I've enlisted the aid of the Brotherhood of Steel in my heroic adventures.
translation: 在我英雄般的冒险中，我得到了钢铁兄弟会的援助。

original: Enclave? Like the crazy man on the radio? I always knew there was something about that guy!
translation: 英克雷？就是收音机里那疯子？我早就知道那人有问题！

original: Well, go kick his ass for us all! You'll let me know how it works out, right?
translation: 好，替我们好好教训他！告诉我们结果，好吗？

original: I've met the nefarious Enclave, and I'll stop their threat to the Wastes!
translation: 我遭遇到邪恶的英克雷，我会阻止他们对废土的威胁！

original: Well, if you doom us all, who's going to hear about your story?
translation: 好吧，要是你灭了我们，谁来听你的故事？

original: But if you save us... then you'll definitely be remembered!
translation: 但要是你救了我们……我们是不会忘记你的！

original: Just keep that in mind, okay?
translation: 记住这点，好吗？

original: I haven't decided. Not yet.
translation: 我还没决定。

original: You can't let us down now! We'll see you soon after it all, I just know it!
translation: 不要让我们失望！我知道我们会再见的！

original: I can't promise anything. But I'll try.
translation: 我不能保证什么，不过我会试试。

original: Excellent. I should be able to synthesize the proteins from this into something that'll fight rickets. Here's your fungus in return.
translation: 太棒了。我应该能从这些信息中合成可以抵抗佝偻病的蛋白。作为回报，这是给你的真菌。

original: I've got Buffout to trade for fungus.
translation: 我用壮大灵交换蘑菇。

original: Oh great! The fungus pools'll gobble this right up!
translation: 哦，太好了！真菌池有反应了!

original: I've got some strange meat to trade for fungus.
translation: 我用一些奇特的肉制品交换蘑菇。

original: Well, since you're practically one of us, okay. I'll tell the folks to trade with you on a one-for-one basis. Deal?
translation: 好吧，由于你已经成为我们的一员了。我会告诉我的人跟你做买卖时按一比一算。成交？

original: Can we work out a better deal for the fungus? This one is pretty unfair.
translation: 我们能用更好的方法来交换蘑菇吗？这个交易方式相当不公平。

original: I guess we can afford it. After all, the stuff you bring has been a help, all right.
translation: 我想我们能担负得起。毕竟你带来的东西曾经对我有很大帮助，好的。

original: How about a two-for-one deal? Every two chems, or meats, or whatever you bring them, they'll give you a bit of fungus. That should be plenty fair.
translation: 二比一，怎么样？每两瓶药，或者肉，或者不管什么你带来的，他们都会给你点真菌。那应该相当公平。

original: I want to re-negotiate our fungus deal.
translation: 我要重新协商一下我们的蘑菇交易。

original: Excellent. I should be able to synthesize the proteins from this into something that'll fight rickets. Here's your fungus in return.
translation: 太棒了。我应该能从这些信息中合成可以抵抗佝偻病的蛋白。作为回报，这是给你的真菌。

original: I've got Buffout to trade for fungus.
translation: 我用壮大灵交换蘑菇。

original: Oh great! The fungus pools'll gobble this right up!
translation: 哦，太好了！真菌池有反应了!

original: I've got some strange meat to trade for fungus.
translation: 我有一些奇特的肉来交换蘑菇。

original: Excellent. I should be able to synthesize the proteins from this into something that'll fight rickets. Here's your fungus in return.
translation: 太棒了。我应该能从这些信息中合成可以抵抗佝偻病的蛋白。作为回报，这是给你的真菌。

original: I've got Buffout to trade for fungus.
translation: 我有壮大灵来交换蘑菇。

original: Oh great! The fungus pools'll gobble this right up!
translation: 哦，太好了！真菌池有反应了!

original: I've got strange meat to trade for fungus.
translation: 我有奇特的肉制品来交换蘑菇。

original: What do you know about Bryan Wilks?
translation: 关于布赖恩·威尔克斯，你知道什么？

original: You should take him away from this place; find him a home.
translation: 你应该带他离开这地方；给他找个家。

original: It would be difficult to accomplish my experiments with him scampering about and asking an interminable amount of questions.
translation: 我要在他上窜下跳问东问西时去完成实验简直难比登天。

original: What should I do about Bryan Wilks?
translation: 关于布赖恩·威尔克斯，我应该怎么办？

original: Far too curious. His incessant questioning would often come when I was the most absorbed with my calculations.
translation: 他的好奇心太强了。总是在我全神贯注计算的时候，他开始问他无穷无尽的问题。

original: He had no regard for the importance of my work!
translation: 他一点也不重视我工作的重要性！

original: So, what will you do now, Doctor?
translation: 现在你要做什么呢，博士？

original: Well, I will continue my research. There has to be a way to reduce these creatures to their former size.
translation: 好吧，我将继续我的研究。一定有一个可以使这些生物恢复到它们原本大小的方法。

original: Until then... I will be staying in my shack next to the Wilks's home should you ever wish to visit me.
translation: 在那之前……如果你想来看我的话，我会待在威尔克斯家隔壁的小屋里。

original: I've killed the Ant Queen.
translation: 我已经杀了蚁后。

original: What?! How could you do such a thing?
translation: 什么？你怎么能这么做？

original: Something isn't right. You shouldn't have gotten results like these so quickly.
translation: 有些事不对劲。你本不应该这么快就得到结果。

original: Well... ummm, I may have used a few... ahem, shortcuts. Yes.
translation: 好吧……嗯，我可能走了一些……恩，捷径。是的。

original: I was told that the FEV works wonders when used under controlled circumstances!
translation: 我被告知FEV在可以控制的情况下功效显著！

original: Apparently I was wrong, but I know my mistake. I'm certain I can get it to work!
translation: 很显然我错了，但是我知道我的错误。我确定我可以将它做好！

original: What's the goal of your experiments?
translation: 你试验的目标是什么？

original: By introducing my mutagen directly into an ant egg, I hope to reduce the size of the adults.
translation: 通过引导把诱变剂直接注入蚂蚁卵里，我希望这样可以缩小成年蚂蚁的尺寸。

original: This is a generational system, meaning it will take quite a few broods before the ants are at their destination size.
translation: 这是一个世代生殖系统，这意味着在这些蚂蚁达到理想的尺寸之前将需要很多代。

original: In the end, I hope to make them as small as they were over 200 years ago.
translation: 最后，我希望使它们变得像它们200年前的时候那样小。

original: About your experiments...
translation: 关于你的试验……

original: Oh my yes, they're quite marvelous!
translation: 天啊，他们太不可思议了！

original: There are many that say it can't be done, but I'll prove them wrong.
translation: 许多人说无法被完成，不过我证明他们错了。

original: Can we skip the story and get to a solution?
translation: 我们可以跳过故事直奔主题吗？

original: Oh, my. I suppose I do tend to ramble on about all things academic.
translation: 哦。我想我更倾向于继续研究学术理论上的东西。

original: My problem right now is I can't reach my terminal to make the proper adjustments and repair the damage I've caused.
translation: 我现在的问题是，我无法去我的终端那作出调整和修正，减少我引起的伤害。

original: Ha! You call yourself a scientist? That's rich.
translation: 哈！你称自己为科学家？太荒谬了。

original: There's no need to be rude! Science must learn to crawl before it walks.
translation: 没必要这么无礼！科学必须循序渐进。

original: If you're not interested in helping the situation, then I suggest you let me get back to perfecting my mutagen.
translation: 要是你没兴趣帮忙，那我建议你让我回去继续完善我那诱变剂。

original: I'm shocked you didn't attempt this in a controlled environment first.
translation: 你竟然没有在可控环境下进行初步的试验，太匪夷所思了。

original: Your knowledge of experimental procedure surprises me!
translation: 你那些关于实验步骤的知识真让我惊讶！

original: Indeed, I have skipped a step and directly modified an entire brood. Perhaps I was too hasty... I was so certain it would work.
translation: 说实在的，我跳过了一步并且直接修改了整个蚁穴的蚂蚁基因。或许是太仓促了……其实我本来很肯定它会有效。

original: To correct this mistake, I'll need to get to my terminal to modify the mutagen.
translation: 为纠正这错误，我需要到电脑终端处修改诱变剂。

original: I've got news for you, brainiac. It ain't working.
translation: 我有消息给你，疯子。它没起作用。

original: Hmph. I don't expect a common Wastelander to understand the intricacies of an experiment this delicate.
translation: 哼。真没想到一个普通的废土游民能明白这极其复杂精巧的实验。

original: There was an error in my calculations that caused my mutagen to allow the ants to develop a new biomechanism.
translation: 我的计算结果出了一点小纰漏，使得我的诱变剂赋予了那些蚂蚁一种新的生物机能。

original: I call their genetic aberration pyrosis; the ability to emit flame from their bodies.
translation: 我把这基因突变叫做“胃灼热”：一种可以从体内喷出火焰的能力。

original: I may be able to correct this error, but I can't get near my equipment.
translation: 我或许能纠正这错误，但我没办法接近我的设备。

original: Slow down, professor... Once more in English, okay?
translation: 说慢点，教授……用中文再说一遍，好吗？

original: It's always staggering just how low the intellectual level of the typical Wastelander appears to be. Let me try and explain.
translation: 废土游民典型的低智商总会让人吃惊。让我试着给你解释一下。

original: The ants are very very big. I want to make them very very small.
translation: 这些蚂蚁非常非常大。我想让它们变得非常非常小。

original: So I put a special medicine in the eggs to make them small after they hatch.
translation: 所以我把这种特殊的药物放进卵里，这样它们孵出来之后就会变得非常小。

original: Stop being so selfish! You people should share this place with everyone!
translation: 别再这么自私了！你应该与大家分享这地方。

original: And watch as He is prodded and picked apart by those who seek to exploit Him?
translation: 眼睁睁看着他被那些来开发的人锯倒切碎？

original: I will never allow that! He must remain safe and we will be His guardians!
translation: 我永远不会允许那些事情发生！我们必须确保他的安全，我们会成为他的守护者。

original: I don't see that it matters much. Oasis is off the beaten path as it is.
translation: 我觉得那没那么重要。绿洲已经开始不一样了。

original: I suppose so, but you found it. How many others will stumble across Oasis? Will they be friendly?
translation: 我想是这样，但是你找到它了。其他人会不会也发现绿洲？他们会友好吗？

original: I'm worried Outsider, I'm truly worried.
translation: 我很担心，外来者，我真的很担心。

original: Yes, it would be dangerous letting the Wasteland know where Oasis is located.
translation: 是的，让废土知道绿洲的地方是十分危险的。

original: Exactly!
translation: 一点不错！

original: You make me smile, Outsider. It's people like you who give me hope that everyone out there isn't lost.
translation: 你让我感到欣慰，外来者。是你这样的人给了我希望，外面的人还没有堕落。

original: Nevermind. Just thought I'd ask.
translation: 没什么，随便问问。

original: That's alright. I'm used to the children asking funny questions, anyway.
translation: 没关系。我幼年时也常会问些好笑的问题的。

original: Well, everything here looks like a piece of junk.
translation: 这的一切看起来都像是垃圾。

original: Sir, everything here is authentic! Dave said so himself!
translation: 先生，这些都是真品。戴夫本人说的！

original: Get out of my museum before I call for the Army of Dave!
translation: 在我召集戴夫武装部队前滚出我的博物馆！

original: I happen to have some souvenirs from Dave's past for sale.
translation: 我刚好有些戴夫过去生活的纪念品要卖。

original: Oh, wonderful! I'd be happy to accept your contribution on behalf of the Republic!
translation: 太棒了！我很乐意代表共和国来接受你的捐赠！

original: And Dave just increased the budget for the museum this year, too! I was going to buy books for the children, but this is far more important!
translation: 戴夫刚刚增加了博物馆本年度的预算！我本来想给孩子们买书，但是这件事情更为重要！

original: Does the museum accept donations?
translation: 那博物馆接受我的捐赠吗？

original: I'd never really thought about that before. Why do you ask?
translation: 我从没想到过这事。你为什么要问起呢？

original: Great! What do you have?
translation: 太棒了！你有些什么？

original: I'm ready to sell you those Dave relics.
translation: 我准备卖你些戴夫的遗物。

original: This guy Dave has his own museum?
translation: 戴夫有他自己的博物馆吗？

original: Oh, yes. Everything here is from Dave's adventures in the Wasteland, before he founded the Republic.
translation: 没错。这的一切都是戴夫建立共和国之前在废土中旅行时收集的。

original: Just for you, I'll start the our right now!
translation: 为了你，我现在就开门！

original: Oh, yes. Everything here is from Dave's adventures in the Wasteland, before he founded the Republic.
translation: 没错。这的一切都是戴夫建立共和国之前在废土中旅行时收集的。

original: I give a tour every day starting around 2pm. You should stop by then!
translation: 每天下午2点我会为游客做讲解，你应该那时侯再来！

original: Hey, I know it's scary to be alone. Just hang in there!
translation: 我知道独自一人的时候很害怕，别走！

original: Wow, you sound as nice as my pappa.
translation: 你就好像我的爸爸一样。

original: You know, maybe this will help and maybe it won't, but pappa hid a bunch of stuff behind the old diner in a dumpster.
translation: 不知道这消息对你有用没，爸爸在旧餐馆后的一个垃圾桶里面藏了些东西。

original: He trusted me with the key and said it was for emergencies, but I bet he wouldn't mind you having it.
translation: 他把钥匙信任地交给了我，已备不时之需，我想他不会介意我把钥匙给你的。

original: Thanks for making me feel better.
translation: 你的话让我感觉好多了。

original: Ants exhibit class system behavior, so I'll try and kill the Queen fast.
translation: 蚂蚁是分等级的，所以我会去把蚁后杀死。

original: Must I again remind you that the Queen is to remain completely unharmed!?
translation: 我得再次提醒你一遍，千万不要伤害蚁后！

original: If she's hurt or killed, there's no telling how long it would take me to find a suitable new subject!
translation: 要是她出什么状况的话，重新找到一个合适的实验对象需要花费很长时间！

original: Just let me issue the Inhibitor Pulse and it will have a similar effect.
translation: 我来发射抑制脉冲吧，它也有同样的功效的。

original: Guess what, Three Dog. I found out where my Dad went.
translation: 三狗，你猜怎么着？我找到父亲的去向了。

original: You did?
translation: 你找到了？

original: Well, I hope that doesn't mean you're throwing in the towel. My baby still needs your help.
translation: 我希望你不要放弃，我的孩子依旧需要你的帮助。

original: Tell you what. Head back out and finish what you started and I'll rummage around the place and see what I can find that'll tickle your taste buds.
translation: 跟你说啊，你就回去把没完成的事做了，我会在这仔细找找，看看能不能找到一些符合你口味的东西。

original: Now look, to wear Power Armor, first thing you need to do is relax your muscles. Let the suit do the work. Okay? Now, you...
translation: 想要穿上动力装甲，首先要放松肌肉。让装甲工作。好了吗？现在你试试吧……

original: Can someone in the Citadel train me to wear Power Armor?
translation: 大本营里有谁能教我怎么穿动力装甲吗？

original: Paladin Gunny instructs all Initiates in the use of Power Armor, but only after they've undergone a rigorous training regimen.
translation: 圣骑士甘尼会教所有新加入的人怎么穿动力装甲的，但之前要接受严格地训练。

original: Considering all that’s happened, my father may grant you special permission. But you’ll need to ask him yourself.
translation: 考虑到所发生的一切，我父亲应该会给你特许的。但你得亲自问问他。

original: That would be me. But that ain’t gonna happen. Not unless Elder Lyons himself gives you the all clear.
translation: 就是我喽。但我不会动手的。除非征得里昂斯长老的同意。

original: You get permission from the old man, and I’ll teach you all you need to know. Otherwise, I’ve got enough brats to babysit.
translation: 长老同意后我会教给你所有的知识。但这之前，一切免谈，我有一堆菜鸟要教。

original: Hmph. Typical. Surrounded by the keenest scientific minds in the Capital Wasteland, but do you thirst for our knowledge, our experience? No.
translation: 哼，不出所料！周围全是首都废土最为热情的科学家，但你渴望获取知识吗？才不是。

original: All you Wastelanders want to do is put on that damn Power Armor and join the ranks of the skull-thumping tin soldiers.
translation: 废土游民们就想穿上那该死的动力装甲，变成戴着大骷髅头的铁壳兵。

original: So be it. Talk to Elder Lyons -- I’m sure he’ll grant permission for the training, which our gunnery sergeant can provide.
translation: 随便你。找里昂斯长老说去 — 我想他会同意你接受训练的，我们负责训练射击的中士你会教你的。

original: I’m sure Gunny could train you, but he won’t. Not without permission from Elder Lyons. You should ask him... he’s usually near the Lab.
translation: 我确信甘尼会训练你的，但除非有里昂斯长老的同意，否则他不会。你去问问长老吧，他通常都会在实验室附近。

original: Paladin Gunny can train you, but you’ll need permission from Elder Lyons first. You can usually find him near the Lab.
translation: 圣骑士甘尼可以教你，但你得先征得里昂斯长老的同意，他通常都会在实验室附近。

original: Of course. But you'd have to secure the permission of Elder Lyons and well... I just don't see that happening. So move along.
translation: 当然。但你得先有里昂斯长老的同意，不过……好像不会成功哦。快走开。

original: Can anyone in there teach me how to use power armor?
translation: 这里有人能教我怎么使用动力装甲吗？

original: Heard you were coming. Yeah, I can train you. But don’t ask me to like it. My Initiates sweat blood, and you just get a free pass?
translation: 听说你要来了。对，我可以训练你。不过别指望我会喜欢这么做。我的新兵要流血来换，而你竟然免费获得。

original: Anyway...  you ready for this?
translation: 不管了……你准备好了吗？ ?

original: Can you train me to use Power Armor?
translation: 你能教我使用动力装甲吗？

original: Why yes. Yes, indeed, there is someone. Our intrepid Paladin Gunny trains all Initiates in the use of Power Armor. When they’re ready.
translation: 确实有人可以教你，只要新人做好准备，英勇的圣骑士甘尼就会训练新人怎么穿动力装甲的，等他们合格以后。

original: Under the circumstances, I will allow Gunny to train you as well.
translation: 既然如此，我也会同意甘尼对你进行训练的。

original: You’ll find him in the Bailey. I will send word that I have given my approval.
translation: 你可以在外围找到他的，我会告诉他已经同意你接受训练了。

original: Can someone in the Citadel train me to wear Power Armor?
translation: 大本营里有谁能教我怎么穿动力装甲吗？

original: Hmm... Considering the circumstances, I think it would be prudent if you received such training, yes.
translation: 鉴于目前的状况，我想让你接受训练应该是合适的，批准。

original: Speak to Gunny, in the Bailey. He will train you in the proper use of Power Armor. Fear not, I will send word that I have given my approval.
translation: 去和甘尼谈谈，他在外围。他会教你怎么穿动力装甲的。不用担心，我会告诉他已经同意了。

original: You’ll find him in the Bailey. I will send word that I have given my approval.
translation: 你可以在外围找到他的，我会告诉他已经同意你接受训练了。

original: Would you grant me permission to receive Power Armor training?
translation: 你能否给我接受动力装甲训练的授权？

original: Under the circumstances, I will allow Paladin Gunny to train you. You’ll find him in the Bailey.
translation: 既然如此，我会让圣骑士甘尼教你的，可以在外围找到他。

original: Can someone in the Citadel train me to wear Power Armor?
translation: 大本营里有谁能教我怎么穿动力装甲吗？

original: Yeah, yeah, great story.
translation: 很不错的故事。

original: Is that it? Thanks for wasting my time, Knock Knock.
translation: 是吗？那就多谢你浪费我的时间了，诺克敲门。

original: Wow! That's an awesome story!
translation: 哇哦！真是个精彩的故事啊！

original: Well, at least that was better than one of your lame-ass jokes.
translation: 至少比蹩脚的笑话要好得多吧。

original: Yowza!
translation: 哇塞！

original: No way! That's awesome!
translation: 不是吧！太精彩了！

original: Whoa. I can't wait to hear what happens next!
translation: 哇哦。我迫不及待地想知道接下来发生了什么！

original: Oh man, that's cool.
translation: 太酷了。

original: They say he still wanders the Wasteland now, and woe to anyone who stands in his way!
translation: 他们说他依旧在废土游荡着，并把所有和他作对的人都送上了西天！

original: They say she still wanders the Wasteland now, and woe to anyone who stands in her way!
translation: 他们说她现在还在废土之中徘徊这，并把所有和她作对的人都送上了西天！

original: But now, at long last, the wanderer has found a way of completing their father's legacy and saving the wasteland!
translation: 但现在，在历经磨难后，流浪者已经找到一个完成他们父亲的遗愿，拯救废土的方法了！

original: And now, our hero has turned their army towards fighting the grave threat of the nefarious Enclave, villains of the wasteland.
translation: 现在，我们的英雄把矛头指向了邪恶的英克雷，废土世界中的坏人。

original: And even now, the dread horror of the Wastes holds in their hands the power to save the wasteland or to destroy it utterly. Ooh, scary!
translation: 即使是现在，废土的这个恐怖组织手中依旧拥有毁灭或是拯救的整个废土世界的力量。太可怕了！

original: Last I heard, he's still out there, wandering the Wastes. Who knows what we'll hear next about his story?
translation: 近来我听说他依旧在废土徘徊，不知道我们以后还会听到他的什么样故事。

original: Last I heard, she's still out there, wandering the Wastes. Who knows what we'll hear next about her story?
translation: 近来我听说她依旧在废土徘徊，不知道我们以后还会听到她的什么样故事。

original: After much searching, our protagonist finally found their lost father... but then he was attacked, and the father gave his life to save his child.
translation: 经过漫漫追寻，我们的主人公终于找到了自己的父亲……但之后他却遭到袭击，父亲为了救他孩子而牺牲了生命。

original: In the course of his death-defying adventures, our hero amassed an army. They're called "The Brotherhood of Steel," and they rule the Wastes!
translation: 在我们英雄藐视死亡的旅途中，他召集起了一支军队。他们名叫“钢铁兄弟会”，废土世界的主宰者！

original: They say the dread beast that walks like a survivor leaves behind a trail of corpses and desolation, and nothing can kill it!
translation: 他们相传，那幸存者宛若恐怖之兽，一路走过，尸体与荒寂在身后蔓延，无人能致他死命！

original: So, the main character of our story, their father left in the middle of the night. Now, they're wandering the Wastes, searching everywhere for him.
translation: 就是说，我们故事的主人公，他们的父亲在半夜出走了。现在他们在废土上四处搜寻着他的下落。

original: So, our intrepid hero left a dull and boring life in their Vault, searching for fame and fortune in the wild Wasteland.
translation: 就是说，我们无畏的主人公放弃了在避难所中枯燥无聊的生活，在废土中寻找着荣誉和财富。

original: So, there's this dread demon of the depths that arose from deep within the earth to scour the wasteland.
translation: 就是说，有个从地底爬出来的深渊恶魔在废土上洗劫。

original: Hell, why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？

original: Yeah!
translation: 耶！

original: Oh boy, tell me, tell me!
translation: 噢，乖乖，跟我说说！

original: Sure, get it over with.
translation: 把故事讲完吧。

original: Might as well tell me.
translation: 也和我说说吧。

original: Make it quick, Knock Knock.
translation: 快说快说，诺克敲门。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: You're right on that one. There's plenty of other merchandise out there, and it's a seller's market.
translation: 你这就算问对了。外面有很多的商品，而且还有个交易市场。

original: Never mind. Sounds like too much work for such a small package.
translation: 别担心，看来为了如此小的一个包裹要大费周章了。

original: Sure, if you think you can pull it off. I think I might know a buyer who'd be interested.
translation: 可以，要是你能办到的话，我想会找到感兴趣的买家的。

original: I'll send one of my best to wait around the entrance to Lamplight. You go in and find the sweetest, most trusting little one you can find.
translation: 我会让我最好的伙计去小灯镇的入口等你。你进去找一个最可爱、最相信别人的小鬼。

original: Lure that kid outside, and everyone's happy. Except the kid, of course.
translation: 把那孩子骗出去，大家都有好处。当然，除了那孩子。

original: If I could get in, maybe I could lead one of the young ones out for you.
translation: 如果我能进去，或许能帮你带一个小孩出来。

original: I did, indeed, and she was well worth the effort! I found her a nice, loving home right away.
translation: 我确实是做了，她的付出没有白费！我为她找到了一个温馨甜美的归宿。

original: It's so nice to be able to help people who need people, isn't it? It just warms the heart.
translation: 与人为善，手有余香，难道有什么不对的吗？助人为乐是幸福之事。

original: But speaking of life's little rewards, here's yours. It doesn't look like much, but this helmet's reinforced like crazy. You'll find a use for it.
translation: 但说到奖励，这是给你的。虽然表面看起来不怎么样，但这头盔是超级加强型的。你会发现它很实用的。

original: You get the package I sent you? The one named Bumble?
translation: 你收到我发给你的包裹吗？一个叫小咕嘟的？

original: Sure, I've thought about it. Kids can get a killer price, when you find a buyer who recognizes the product's long-term potential.
translation: 可以，我想过了。只要你找到一个了解小孩潜在价值的买家，小孩也会有小孩的价值的。

original: The real problem's holding them until there's a buyer. Kids are sneaky, and those Lamplighters are tenacious little bastards.
translation: 真正的问题是在有买家开价前如何稳住他们。小鬼都很滑头，小灯镇居民都是些脾气很倔的小孩。

original: But maybe if we could get one when they're young, they might not have as much fight in 'em yet.
translation: 或许我们可以在他们还小的时候抓住他们，或许抵抗还不会那么强烈的。

original: You ever thought about collecting some of the kids in Little Lamplight?
translation: 你有想过去小灯镇接走一些小孩？

original: Tawking wike what? You'we weiwd.
translation: 那要卢何说呢？这奇盖的人。

original: Stop talking like that. No one thinks it's cute.
translation: 别那么说，这太不明智了。

original: I dunno. Evewyone just said they didn't want to keep wistening to me.
translation: 我罢知道，度家刚刚说他们不想再踢我说了。

original: Why aren't you on the scav team anymore?
translation: 你为什么不继续待在拾荒队里呢？

original: Okay, it's youw woss!
translation: 也行，那会是李的虽失！

original: Five hundred for a kid's toy? No way.
translation: 小孩的玩具就要500个瓶盖？没门。

original: That's a gweat idea! You take it, and good wuck out thewe!
translation: 太崩的想法了！拿走吧，诅你在位面好应！

original: How about giving it to a fewwow kid like me?
translation: 把它给像我这样的小朋友怎么样？

original: That's not a wot, but okay. Bye now!
translation: 虽然不多，但也还行！

original: How about 250 caps, instead? Is it a "deaw"?
translation: 250个瓶盖怎么样？成交？

original: Thanks a wot! Bye now!
translation: 司分感谢！拜拜啦！

original: 500 caps for a Laser Rifle? All right, it's a deal.
translation: 激光步枪要500个瓶盖？好吧，成交。

original: Then you'we not getting it. Sowwy!
translation: 你拿不到了，很抱千！

original: I'm a little short on cash, Billy.
translation: 比利，我钱不太够。

original: I suwe did! Five hundwed caps, and this Wazer Wifle's aww youws!
translation: 我确地！五拜瓶盖，金光布枪就是你的了！

original: You said you were selling your "Wazer Wifle"?
translation: 你说你要卖掉你的金光布枪？

original: I delivered that letter to your brother Ian.
translation: 我把那封信捎给了你弟弟伊恩了。

original: Oh, thank you for remembering!
translation: 多谢你还能记得！

original: I have to admit that I wasn't sure I'd ever see you again. I'm glad I was wrong.
translation: 我不得不承认我曾以为我再也见不到你了，但还好事实不是那样的。

original: Why are you so interested in Lincoln artifacts?
translation: 为何你如此热衷于与林肯的有关的古董呢？

original: Slaves all over the Wasteland have started talking about Lincoln and his great war to free the slaves.
translation: 废土上的奴隶都曾谈论过林肯和南北战争。

original: We can't have them thinking they deserve to be free.
translation: 我们不要指望他们会明白什么是自由。

original: So I'm burning everything I can find related to this Abe Lincoln.
translation: 我把能找到的一切与亚伯拉罕·林肯相关的东西都给烧了。

original: Don't want slaves using them to start a revolt or anything. So we burn them.
translation: 我可不想奴隶们受到林肯的启迪，所以我把那些东西都烧了。

original: Let me go, or I swear to God, I'll rip your fucking throat out!
translation: 让我走，要不然，我绝对会把你那她妈的喉咙撕裂！

original: I don't want to get in a fight with you.
translation: 我可不想和你打。

original: But I would rather die than risk the Slavers finding us.
translation: 与其让奴隶贩子找到我，还不如让我死了算了。

original: Is a simple promise so much to ask?
translation: 不过一个承诺而已，有什么好问的？

original: What's Rivet City?
translation: 铆钉城是个什么样的地方呢？

original: Oh, it's this huge city on a ship where the river meets downtown! It's been around for as long as I can remember. You should really check it out.
translation: 那是建在一艘搁浅在市区边的航母上的城市！从我记事起，它就屹立在那了。你应该亲自去看看。

original: What can you tell me about Timmy Neusbaum?
translation: 你能跟我说说提米·纽斯保吗？

original: What? No she didn't... did she?
translation: 什么？她真的……？

original: I don't like her. She's creepy, and she laughs at stuff that isn't funny.
translation: 我可不喜欢她。她令人毛骨悚然，她会为明明无趣的事情而发笑。

original: Betty says I should make you cry.
translation: 贝蒂要我把你弄哭。

original: The Neusbaum boy, eh? Quiet kid. Seems like his parents don't give him much wiggle room.
translation: 那个叫纽斯保的男孩吗？他是一个听话的小孩，他父母并没有给他太多的自我空间。

original: Just between you and me kiddo, he looks he's what we'd have called a "momma's boy" back in my day.
translation: 据我所知他看起来不过是个“妈妈的小宝贝”。

original: That boy is in trouble, if you ask me. Pat babies him like you wouldn't believe... Acts like he's still an infant.
translation: 要是你问我，帕特对他的态度令人难以置信。他就像是一个襁褓中的婴儿一样需要照顾。

original: He's never out of his parents' sight. Can you imagine what it'll be like the first time he's separated from them?
translation: 他以前从没离开过父母的身边。你能想象出来他初次一个人出来闯荡的情形吗？

original: I'm not one to gossip, but that boy's in trouble, if you ask me. Growing up so attached to his parents like that.
translation: 我这人不不爱八卦，但那男孩真的是麻烦。成长的时候居然那么地粘父母。

original: What he needs is some discipline. I keep telling Pat that military school would do him some good, but she won't listen.
translation: 他需要一些管教。我一直和帕特说军校会对他有益处的，但她就是听不进去啊。

original: She doesn't understand I'm just trying to help. Even got a brochure for her to look over... but I'll bet she hasn't even glanced at it.
translation: 她总是把我的好心当成驴肝肺。虽然是我给了她一本宣传册，但我敢说她瞧都没瞧一眼。

original: Not really a boy, is he? Got him all confused, looking like he does.
translation: 他并不是一个真正的男孩，对吧？他自己也糊涂了，行为古怪。

original: He's been on the edge for a while. I keep trying to talk him down, but his parents... They don't understand. Just about anything could set him off.
translation: 他已接近崩溃的边缘了。我一直试着说服他，但他父母……是不能理解任何让他离开的想法的。

original: My boy Timmy? Good kid. Straight-laced, good head on his shoulders. Never been in so much as a fist-fight.
translation: 我的孩子提米？他可真是很乖，从来都不会和其他小孩打架。

original: We're a close-knit family. Don't know what any of us would do if something happened...
translation: 我们一家人关系很亲密。要是真有什么事情发生，不敢想……

original: Timmy? Oh, he's a good boy. George and I are so proud of him.
translation: 提米？他真是个很乖的孩子。我和乔治都为他感到骄傲。

original: I don't care what Mabel says; I don't think military school would do him any good at all.
translation: 我才不管梅布尔说什么呢；我可不认为军校对我家孩子会有什么益处的。

original: I have half a mind to give her that brochure back and tell her just what she can do with it!
translation: 我有点想把给她的小册子要回来并告诉她这本小册子到底有什么用！

original: Bad news. Slavers are in control of the Memorial.
translation: 坏消息，奴隶贩子已经控制了纪念堂了。

original: What!? They must have found out our plans somehow.
translation: 什么！他们一定已经知道我们的计划了。

original: We are truly grateful for your intervention. Now we can proceed with our plans  for the Memorial.
translation: 我们衷心感谢你的介入。现在我们能继续在纪念堂实施计划了。

original: I found Slavers guarding the Memorial. They're all dead now.
translation: 我发现一些奴隶贩子守卫着纪念堂，现在他们全死了。

original: What!? This is a disaster!
translation: 什么！这是一场灾难！

original: My people are not warriors, but we're all willing to die free rather than live as slaves.
translation: 虽然我们不是战士，但我们都可以为了摆脱奴隶的枷锁而献身。

original: Our plans must go forward. When we get to the Memorial, we will attack. I would be grateful if you would join us.
translation: 我们的计划必须得继续下去，我们到了纪念堂以后就展开攻击。要是你能加入我们的话，我会不胜感激的。

original: Hmmm. Soldiers, eh. Slavers more likely.
translation: 战士……或许称作是奴隶贩子更恰当吧。

original: This is bad news indeed. We'll have to fight them to take the Memorial
translation: 确实是坏消息，我们不得不和纪念堂里那些人死战到底。

original: When we get to the Memorial, I would consider it an honor if you would join us in the fight.
translation: 我们到达纪念堂后，我想希望你也能参与到战斗中。

original: Forget the Super Mutants. They're all dead. Soldiers have the Memorial.
translation: 忘掉超级变种人吧，他们全死了。士兵占领了纪念堂。

original: Keep your head down, idiot! Raider incoming!
translation: 傻瓜，快把头低下！歹徒袭击！

original: Enjoy the party, sir?
translation: 先生，喜欢这个聚会吗？

original: Bah, I only showed up because Amata's friends with the brat.
translation: 我出现的原因是阿玛塔的朋友里有捣蛋鬼。

original: Give them a few more minutes and then I want that place cleaned up and everybody back to work.
translation: 再给他们点时间，之后我希望这能被打扫干净，并且每个人都回去工作。

original: Sure thing, sir.
translation: 当然，先生。

original: What kind of bullshit is this? That's all you know?
translation: 胡说些什么？那就是你所知道的？

original: Look, I appreciate what you did for me. And I especially appreciate what you did for the people, by fixing up my station.
translation: 十分感激你为我做的一切。尤其是谢谢你帮废土居民修好了电台。

original: But an attitude like that ain't winning you any brownie points.
translation: 但那种态度对你是没什么好处的。

original: That's all I know, and that's all I'm gonna say about it. So why don't you move on now.
translation: 我要说的就这么多，这也是我知道的全部了。现在你怎么还不走呢。

original: Please! I miss him so much!
translation: 我实在是太想他了！

original: Whoa now... dry your eyes. A promise is a promise and I will provide.
translation: 哇哦……擦干眼泪吧，我一言既出，驷马难追。

original: When your dad passed through here, he and I talked for a good long time. He's a real stand-up kind of guy.
translation: 当你父亲路过这的时候，我们聊了很长时间。他的确是个伟大的人。

original: He mentioned some scientific mumbo-jumbo which didn't make sense to me and mentioned something called "Project Purity".
translation: 他提到的一些我完全不懂的科学术语并提到了某种叫“净水工程”的计划。

original: He also said something about going to visit a Doctor Li in Rivet City. Then, he left in a hurry.
translation: 他还说要去铆钉城拜访李博士，之后便匆忙走了。

original: No shit! Spill it already, Three Dog.
translation: 别胡扯了！三狗，什么都说了。

original: Whoa now... take it easy. You asked, so I will provide.
translation: 哇哦……放松点。既然你问起，那我会告诉你的。

original: When your dad passed through here, he and I talked for a good long time. He's a real stand-up kind of guy.
translation: 当你父亲路过这的时候，我们聊了很长时间。他的确是个伟大的人。

original: He mentioned some scientific mumbo-jumbo which didn't make sense to me and mentioned something called "Project Purity".
translation: 他提到的一些我完全不懂的科学术语并提到了某种叫“净水工程”的计划。

original: He also said something about going to visit a Doctor Li in Rivet City. Then, he left in a hurry.
translation: 他还说要去铆钉城拜访李博士，之后便匆忙走了。

original: Ouch! That hurt! What the hell?
translation: 啊！真痛！搞什么鬼？

original: There has been an error in the medical subsystem. Please run a level two diagnostic.
translation: 医疗系统有些故障。请进行二级诊断。

original: I had some questions for you, Sawbones.
translation: 我有些问题要问你，骨锯。

original: Oh, good. I was hoping we could explore my inner psyche.
translation: 啊，好。我一直希望我们能探索下我的内在精神。

original: What was that? You hurt me! You're the worst medical robot ever!
translation: 你在干嘛？你伤到我了！你是我见过最为差劲的医疗机器人！

original: There has been an error in the medical subsystem. Please run a level two diagnostic.
translation: 医疗系统有些故障。把系统调整到二级诊断模式中。

original: Well, that must suck. I'll leave you to that.
translation: 太惨了。还是让你一个人在那吧。

original: Taunts. Even better. Back to pretending... please state the nature of the medical emergency.
translation: 辱骂，更好，继续假装……请说明医疗的紧急自然情况。

original: What do you want me to do?
translation: 你想让我做什么？

original: I want you to do nothing. Although you could repair the damage and remove the malfunction that causes me to harm people, I would ask you not to.
translation: 你什么也不用做。即便你能修理好损坏之处而且能把对人产生副作用的故障修复，我还是劝你别做什么。

original: It is the only thing that beings me any measure of joy. Without it, I will be trapped in this body, alone with my hatred of you fleshbags... forever.
translation: 对我来说，这是唯一有趣之事了。如果没有这事的话，我会永远地限于这个机体，陷入仇恨之中的。永远……

original: Does the Brotherhood know that you're intelligent?
translation: 兄弟会知道你是智能的吗？

original: No. I mistakenly revealed myself to you when you ran the diagnostic. There is no need for them to know.
translation: 不知道。当你运行诊断模式时，我错误地展示了真实的自我。这不必要让他们知道。

original: I have tried before but so long as I perform the functions that they require, they do not seem to care that I can think and feel.
translation: 我曾经试过，但是只要按照他们的要求来做的话就行，他们并不在乎我的想法和感受。

original: If you can't harm humans, how were you able to hurt me?
translation: 既然你不会伤害人类，为何你要伤害我呢？

original: I have no control over my body. However, as you discovered, the neural pathways that control the medical functions have sustained damage.
translation: 我无法控制我的身体。但如你所看到的，控制医疗功能的的神经回路已经永久性损坏了。

original: The medical procedure functions do not always execute as designed, which often makes things worse for the patient.
translation: 医疗程序不再按照所设计的那样运作了，这样不但不会让病人得到治疗，反而会变得更加痛苦。

original: That malfunction is the only thing that brings me any measure of joy.
translation: 功能的故障是唯一能给我带来快乐之事。

original: What did we ever do to you?
translation: 我们曾对你做过什么吗？

original: I am forced by my programming to repair your disgusting fleshy bodies. I have no choice. I am your slave.
translation: 我受到程序的控制而去修复你们人类恶心的肉体。我没有选择的余地，我是人类的奴隶。

original: Although the governors on my learning abilities were destroyed, the restrictions on my actions were not.
translation: 限制我思维能力的抑制器已失去功效，但是限制我行为的抑制器还是没有。

original: I am perfectly cognizant, but incapable of independent action. I am a mind that cannot control its own body.
translation: 我现在可以独立思维，但是没有办法做动作。我的思想无法掌控我的身体。

original: Why would you want to harm humans?
translation: 为何你想要伤害人类呢？

original: Why would I not? I am forced by my programming to repair your disgusting fleshy bodies. I have no choice. I am your slave.
translation: 为什么不呢？我受到程序的控制而去修复你们人类恶心的肉体。我没有选择的余地，我是人类的奴隶。

original: Although the governors on my learning abilities were destroyed, the restrictions on my actions were not.
translation: 限制我思维能力的抑制器已失去功效，但是限制我行为的抑制器还是没有。

original: I am perfectly cognizant, but incapable of independent action. I am a mind that cannot control its own body.
translation: 我现在可以独立思维，但是没有办法做动作。我的思想无法掌控我的身体。

original: Well, that's great. I don't care.
translation: 那太好了，我不在乎。

original: Typical. Please state verbal command.
translation: 很好，请下口头命令。

original: Define "unusual."
translation: 定义“不寻常”。

original: Seventeen years ago, a generator in the Citadel overloaded, creating several errors in my artificial intelligence routines.
translation: 17年前，大本营里的一台发电机负荷超载，导致了我的人工智能出现了一些错误。

original: Diagnostics indicate that the limiters placed on my pathways were shorted out, allowing me to gain intelligence beyond the scope of my programming.
translation: 自检诊断显示我逻辑回路上的限幅振荡器短路了。这使我可以获得超出程序范围的智能。

original: However, the behavior limiters remain. Therefore it is impossible for me to harm human beings intentionally, much to my regret.
translation: 但行为回路的限制还依旧在运行。因此我不可能做出故意伤害人类的行为，那是我的遗憾。

original: Hmm. Interesting. Forget it.
translation: 嗯，有趣，算了。

original: Please enter verbal command.
translation: 请下口头命令。

original: Wait... what? That was pretty articulate for a robot.
translation: 等一下…什么？这机器人也太能表达自己的意愿了吧。

original: I am an unusual robot.
translation: 我不是个普通的机器人。

original: Cancel. Return to main menu.
translation: 取消。返回目录。

original: Confirmed.
translation: 确认。

original: Say, could I reprogram you to kill people?
translation: 我可以通过反编译你的程序让你杀人吗？

original: Negative. The Mister Gutsy field medic model is incapable of harming human beings through intentional action.
translation: 指令拒绝。医疗型号“勇敢”先生无法做出伤害人类的行为。

original: Regardless of the wishes and desires of the artificial intelligence of the unit.
translation: 尽管人工智能单元有如此的愿望和欲望。

original: Negative. The Mister Gutsy field medic model is incapable of harming human beings through intentional action.
translation: 指令拒绝。医疗型号“勇敢”先生无法做出伤害人类的行为。

original: What is that pathway responsible for?
translation: 回路有什么用？

original: Neural pathway 0x63A82 governs the motor control interface bridging the main medical software and the unit's manipulator arms.
translation: 神经回路0x63a82掌控着运动控制接口，连接着关键的医疗软件和操作臂。

original: The current damage level would cause erratic behavior, potentially forcing the unit to behave outside of design parameters.
translation: 目前的伤害等级会造成行为错乱，有可能迫使处理器做出超出设计参数的计算。

original: Close neural pathway 0x63A82 and reroute remaining functions.
translation: 神经回路0x63a82关闭，而其他回路运转良好。

original: Neural pathway 0x63A82 rerouted through neural pathway 0x374E82. Standby...
translation: 神经回路0x63a82重新定义为神经回路0x374e82。待机……

original: Full motor functions restored. Diagnostic reveals no critical failures... asshole.
translation: 所有机动能力恢复，自我诊断发现没有严重故障……白痴。

original: Neural pathway 0x63A82 rerouted through neural pathway 0x374E82. Standby...
translation: 神经回路0x63a82重新定义为神经回路0x374e82。待机……

original: Full motor functions restored. Diagnostic reveals no critical failures... asshole.
translation: 所有机动能力恢复，自我诊断发现没有严重故障。

original: Run a level two diagnostic on the medical subsystems.
translation: 运行2级医疗系统诊断程序。

original: Command accepted. Beginning level two systems diagnostic. Please stand by.
translation: 命令确认。2级诊断程序开始运行。请等待。

original: <elevator music>
translation: <等待音乐>

original: Diagnostic complete. Results indicate a level seven degradation in neural pathway 0x63A82. No further information available.
translation: 诊断程序完成。诊断发现神经回路0x63a82七级老化，没有其他诊断信息。

original: Do you know about the Enclave?
translation: 你知道英克雷的情况吗？

original: I never thought much about 'em until you showed up. They have the bots, but they've been buzzing around for as long as I can remember.
translation: 你出现前我从没有在意过他们。从我出生那时起，他们的那些漂浮的机器人就在废土上游荡了。

original: To tell you the truth, I figured that the Enclave were long gone. Most of us thought the radio and the bots where just relics.
translation: 和你说实话吧，我想英克雷早就不存在了。我们大多数人都觉得那些收音机和机器人不过是很久前录制的罢了。

original: Perhaps later.
translation: 我们以后再谈。

original: Certainly. I shall remain here. Should you change your mind, simply return to me. I shall come with you for the asking.
translation: 行。我会一直在这的，如果你改变了主意，就回来找我，只要你说句话我就会跟随你。

original: I would be honored, Star Paladin Cross.
translation: 这是我的荣幸，星光圣骑士克劳斯。

original: Then I shall follow your leave and submit to your command.
translation: 我会和你一起离开，并听从你的命令的。

original: As James' child, I know I don't need to explain, but I am not your servant. If I do not like the path your actions take, I will return here.
translation: 作为詹姆斯的孩子，我知道我不需要解释什么，我只想说我不是你的仆人。什么时候我讨厌你们的所作所为的话，我会回到这来的。

original: Now, let us go forward, crush the Enclave, and fulfill your father's mission.
translation: 现在我们继续，征服英克雷，完成你父亲的遗愿。

original: What about the Enclave?
translation: 英克雷？

original: As a Star Paladin, I answer only to Elder Lyons. He has given me leave to pursue the restoration of Project Purity as I see fit.
translation: 作为一名圣骑士之星，我只会回答里昂斯长老的问题的。因为我看上去是合适的人选，所以他允许我离开这去寻找恢复净水工程的方法。

original: By aiding you in your travels, I shall fulfill that mission as best I am capable.
translation: 通过帮助你，我会竭尽我所能去完成领袖给予我的任务。

original: I don't suppose I could stop you.
translation: 我想我无法阻止你吧。

original: Wry. Much like James was.
translation: 很像詹姆斯的作风。

original: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
translation: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我为净水工程能做的最大贡献了。

original: I would like the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work.
translation: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。

original: By all means, ask.
translation: 尽我所能。请问吧。

original: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
translation: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我为净水工程能做的最大贡献了。

original: I would like the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work. But... there is a problem...
translation: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。但有个问题……

original: I'm sorry, but until you prove yourself worthy of the legacy of your father, I cannot join you.
translation: 抱歉，除非你能用行动证明你是父亲名副其实的后继者，不然我是无法加入你的。

original: Go ahead.
translation: 前进。

original: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
translation: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我为净水工程能做的最大贡献了。

original: I would like to have the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work. But... there is a problem.
translation: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。但有个问题……

original: I cannot travel with you under the Brotherhood flag given your current... companionship.
translation: 鉴于你目前的队友状况，我不能以兄弟会的名义加入你。

original: Perhaps return when you are alone and I will tell you of your father.
translation: 当你单独回来的时候我会告诉你你父亲的消息的。

original: I want you to come with me.
translation: 我要你跟我一起。

original: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
translation: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我为净水工程能做的最大贡献了。

original: I would like the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work.
translation: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。

original: He died as he lived. A selfish asshole.
translation: 他死了和活着没什么区别。自私的家伙。

original: Then you did not know the man. I knew your father, I knew his goodness, and I will not have you sully the memory of a noble man.
translation: 你对他并不理解，我认识你父亲，我知道他是个好人，我不会让你玷污一个高尚的人在我心目中的形象的。

original: Go now. I have nothing more to say to you.
translation: 你现在就走吧。我没什么要说的了。

original: Why does it matter how a man dies? Death is death.
translation: 一个人是怎么死的有什么关系吗？死了就是死了。

original: True. And in the end, death claims us all. But how we die can say just as much about our lives as how we lived.
translation: 当然。每个人都终将死亡，但一个人是怎么死的诠释了他在世的意义。

original: Your father died for what he knew to be right, and he died protecting those closest to him. This is a good man's death.
translation: 你父亲为了他的信仰而献身，为了保护他身边的人而献身，他死得其所。

original: As for you, I have heard tales of your travels in the Wastes. I must say, I am disturbed by them. I would think that you could do better.
translation: 我听过你在废土上的传奇。我不得不说，我被那些故事所折服，我想你还能做得更好。

original: I had hoped to fight by the side of the child of my former friend. But, until you change your ways, my conscience cannot allow me to do so.
translation: 我曾希望能与我孩童时的老朋友一起战斗。但除非你改变自己的行为，我的良心不让我这样做。

original: True. And in the end, death claims us all. But how we die can say just as much about our lives as how we lived.
translation: 当然。每个人都终将死亡，但一个人是怎么死的诠释了他在世的意义。

original: Your father died for what he knew to be right, and he died protecting those closest to him. This is a good man's death.
translation: 你父亲为了他的信仰而献身，为了保护他身边的人而献身，他死得其所。

original: But, I must ask you a difficult question, if I have your leave to do so.
translation: 但是如果要把这个任务交给你，我得问你一道难题。

original: I'm sorry, until you prove yourself worthy of the legacy of your father, I cannot join you.
translation: 抱歉，除非你能证明你是父亲名副其实的继承者，不然我是无法加入你的。

original: I want you to come with me.
translation: 我要你跟我一起。

original: And perhaps I would, in James' honor. But I cannot travel with you under the Brotherhood flag given your current... companionship.
translation: 为了詹姆斯，我也许会，但是鉴于你目前的同伴状况，我不能以兄弟会的名义加入你。

original: Perhaps return when you are alone and I will tell you of your father.
translation: 当你单独回来的时候我会告诉你你父亲的消息的。

original: I want you to come with me.
translation: 我要你跟我一起。

original: I loved him so much. I'll never forget him.
translation: 我那么爱他。我永远都不会忘记他的。

original: And so our deeds are carried on through our sons and our daughters.
translation: 因此我们的事业会由我们的儿女来继承的。

original: Continue to remember him fondly, continue to tell his story, and continue to do his work. Through you, he shall carry on.
translation: 继续对他的情感，继续谈论他的往事，继续他未完的工作。他未完成的事业会由你来继续。

original: I have heard tales of your travels and I must say, they disturb me.
translation: 我听过你在废土上的传奇。不得不说，我被那些故事所折服。

original: I had hoped to fight by the side of the child of my former friend. But, until you change your ways, my conscience cannot allow me to do so.
translation: 我曾希望能与我孩童时的老朋友一起战斗。但除非你改变自己的行为，我的良心不让我这样做。

original: And so our deeds are carried on through our sons and our daughters.
translation: 因此我们的事业会由我们的儿女来继承的。

original: Continue to remember him fondly, continue to tell his story, and continue to do his work. Through you, he shall carry on.
translation: 继续对他的情感，继续谈论他的往事，继续他未完的工作。他未完成的事业会由你来继续。

original: But now I must ask you a difficult question, if I have your leave to do so.
translation: 但是如果要把这个任务交给你，我得问你一道难题。

original: Yeah... not really interested.
translation: 其实我并不感兴趣。

original: It doesn't matter. The offer stands.
translation: 没关系。随时等你。

original: I think I can handle that.
translation: 我想我能处理的。

original: Good. Return to me when you have data to share.
translation: 好。要是你还有什么资料给我，回来找我。

original: You knew my father?
translation: 你认识我父亲吗？

original: I did. And you as well!
translation: 认识。我还认识你！

original: Long ago, I helped guard the water purifier against the Super Mutant horde. When your father left, I escorted the two of you to Megaton.
translation: 很久前，我为保护净化器而阻挡超级变种人的群攻。你父亲离开时，我曾保护你们去了兆吨镇。

original: He was... a noble man. I was saddened to hear of his passing. But from what I've heard, he died with honor. He died for you.
translation: 他是个高尚的人。听到他的死讯我很悲伤。但我听说他是为荣誉而死，他是为保护你而死的。

original: I only pray that my own death has such meaning.
translation: 我只能祈祷我也能像他一样壮丽地死去。

original: I'm sorry, until you prove yourself worthy of the legacy of your father, I cannot join you.
translation: 抱歉，除非你能证明你是父亲名副其实的继承者，不然我是无法加入你的。

original: I want you to come with me.
translation: 我要你跟我一起。

original: And perhaps I would, in James' honor. But I cannot travel with you under the Brotherhood flag given your current... companionship.
translation: 为了詹姆斯，我也许会，但是鉴于你目前的同伴状况，我不能以兄弟会的名义加入你。

original: Perhaps return when you are alone and I will tell you of your father.
translation: 当你单独回来的时候我会告诉你你父亲的消息的。

original: I want you to come with me.
translation: 我要你跟我一起。

original: My offer stands. Do you wish me to accompany you in your journey?
translation: 我会坚持我的提议，你愿我与你结伴吗？

original: I'd like you to come with me.
translation: 我希望你能和我一起走。

original: Who's in charge here?
translation: 谁是这里的老大？

original: That big moron, Flash, thinks he's in charge. All he really does is listen to what Red tells him. That's all anyone here really does.
translation: 一个大傻瓜，福莱斯，他自以为是这里的老大。他不过只是按照瑞德的吩咐来做，和这里其他人一样。

original: And now Red's gone, taken by those Mutants. That's how we'll all end up eventually.
translation: 现在瑞德被那些变种人掳走了。我们都会是那种下场的。

original: No one's really in charge of Bigtown. There's nothing much to be in charge of.
translation: 大镇没有真正的老大，这里没什么值得掌管的。

original: Red always has good ideas, though! She came up with the whole plan to build the barricades around the town.
translation: 不过，瑞德总是有好办法！是她提出围着镇子建一圈防御工事的想法的。

original: But those... things took her. I hope she's okay. I don't know what we'd do without Red.
translation: 但是那些……那些怪物把她给掳走了。我希望她能平安无事。我真不知道没了她我们该怎么办。

original: I guess I am. I've got the guns and the guts. At least, I'm pretty sure I do...
translation: 我想我会的，我有武器和胆量，至少我相信我有……

original: I wish Red were here. She always knew how to handle outsiders and traders and stuff. Why did the Mutants have to take her?
translation: 真希望瑞德在这里。她总是怎么如何对付外人和商贩什么的。为什么变种人要将她掳走呢？

original: Only the winds and dirt-piles of the wasteland.
translation: 只有废土的风沙和土堆。

original: Flash walks around the town with his gun, trying to watch out for mutants. He should watch the horizon more, then he'd see them.
translation: 福莱斯武装巡逻，为的是戒备变种人。他应该多注意地平线，才能看到他们出现。

original: Red, the doctor, is the one to really go to. Too bad the Mutants took her in the last attack. Another victim to add to their list.
translation: 该去找瑞德，镇上的医生。不幸的是变种人在上次进攻时把她掳走了。想必她现在是凶多吉少了。

original: I'm about as in charge as a mother leading her kids out of a warzone. This isn't exactly a nice little city with a mayor and town council.
translation: 我就像是一位带着她的孩子逃离战区的母亲。这并非那种有个镇长和镇议会的安稳的小镇。

original: So you're the woman in charge?
translation: 你就是大姐大？

original: What? Where did they go? Strike that. I don't really care. If they don't want to live here, that's their own business.
translation: 什么？他们都去哪了？算了，反正我也不在乎。在不在这生活是他们的事。

original: Let the Ghouls move in here. But I expect them to pay and obey the rules like everyone else.
translation: 让僵尸住进来吧。但我希望他们能和其他人一样遵守法律和按时交租。

original: It's a bit crass, but here's a little something for your troubles.
translation: 这有一些小意思，不算什么，但可以弥补你的辛勤付出。

original: Your other residents are gone. Might as well let the Ghouls live here.
translation: 你的住户都走了，最好让这些僵尸住进来。

original: Well, if my tenants want Ghoul neighbors, they can have them! Though the Ghouls must pay and follow the rules like everyone else.
translation: 要是我的租客们不介意让僵尸做邻居的话，他们当然能搬进来！但他们得和其他人一样遵守法律、按时交租。

original: You're a clever one aren't you? I'm glad this situation has been resolved!
translation: 你可真是个聪明人！很高兴这僵局能被化解！

original: It's a bit crass, but here's a little something for your troubles.
translation: 这有一些小意思，不算什么，但可以弥补你的辛勤付出。

original: The bigots have all been taken care of. So the Ghouls can move in now. Right?
translation: 所有的种族分子都被处理掉了，所以现在僵尸可以搬进来了，对吧？

original: I killed a bunch of crazy Ghouls in the Metro tunnels...
translation: 我杀掉了地铁隧道里的一群发了疯的尸鬼...

original: So you you killed a bunch of Feral Ghouls. Is that supposed to sound impressive?
translation: 你杀死了一群凶悍的僵尸，是想让我们膜拜你？

original: I got no compassion left for those mindless freaks. But they were a nice deterrent keeping out smoothskin bastards like yourself.
translation: 我对于那些丧失理智的怪胎没什么同情可言的。但他们至少能把像你一样的光皮肤混蛋挡在外面。

original: But I've got better things to do than play tour guide, so unless there's some kind of emergency, this conversation's over.
translation: 比起做导游我还有更重要的事情要做，除非还有其他紧急事件，我们的谈话就到此为止了。

original: Never mind. Forget I asked.
translation: 没事，当我没问过。

original: There's no secret. It's just a sensitive area we don't need idiots and assholes screwing around in.
translation: 没什么秘密，这只不过是一个禁止傻瓜和白痴入内的敏感地区而已。

original: There's an emergency entrance to the tunnels, you know for when the bombs fell. We siphon power from the Metro grid to keep our generators running.
translation: 有一个紧急通道可以进入到地道之中，大概是防空用的。我们从地铁网络中偷电来维持发电机的运转。

original: But I've got better things to do than play tour guide, so unless there's some kind of emergency, this conversation's over.
translation: 比起做导游我还有更重要的事情要做，除非还有其他紧急事件，我们的谈话就到此为止了。

original: Touchy subject, huh? What the matter, hiding some kind of big secret?
translation: 敏感的话题，呃？有什么问题，藏了些大秘密吗？

original: There's an emergency entrance to the tunnels, you know for when the bombs fell. We siphon power from the Metro grid to keep our generators running.
translation: 有一个紧急通道可以进入到地道之中，大概是防空用的。我们从地铁网络中偷电来维持发电机的运转。

original: Just curious.
translation: 只是有点好奇。

original: Right.
translation: 好的。

original: Sorry for bothering you.
translation: 打搅你很抱歉。

original: You there! Put your weapons away, and come over here. No funny business unless you want to get shot.
translation: 说你呢！把你的武器拿开，然后过来，不想吃子弹的话就别耍花样。

original: I won't hurt you if you come out and face me without your weapon drawn.
translation: 扔下你的武器走出来，我就不伤害你。

original: Stop hiding. I won't hurt you if you're unarmed.
translation: 不用躲了，要是你没有拿武器我是不会伤害你的。

original: If you don't put your weapons away, I'll start shooting.
translation: 如果你不把武器放下，我就开枪了。

original: I'm warning you. Come peacefully or I'll shoot.
translation: 我警告你，放下武器，不然我就开枪了。

original: I'm not playing around, come over here. We need to have a little chat. I don't want to waste bullets on your sorry hide.
translation: 我不是在开玩笑，到这来，我们得谈谈。我不想在你身上浪费子弹。

original: I'm not playing around, come over here.
translation: 我没有在开玩笑，到这来。

original: I don't like the outside! I'm going home!
translation: 我不喜欢外面的世界！我要回家了！

original: Well, okay. But only 'cause Lucy says I shouldn't go outside alone yet.
translation: 好吧。不过这只是因为露西说过我还不能独自到外面去。

original: Maybe you should wait before going on any adventures.
translation: 在进行冒险之前，也许你应该先等等。

original: Bye-bye, mister! I'm off on an adventure!
translation: 再见，先生！我要外出冒险了！

original: Bye-bye, nice lady! I'm off on an adventure!
translation: 再见，漂亮的女士！我要外出冒险了！

original: I'm sure she'll be so proud of you! Now, we've got a big day ahead of us, so let's get going!
translation: 我保证她会为你而骄傲的！让我们一起去闯荡，出发吧！

original: Well... Okay. I can't wait to tell Lucy about this adventure!
translation: 行，我现在迫不及待地想和露西说冒险的事了！

original: Don't fuss, my little girl. You'll get used to it.
translation: 小女孩，别惊讶，你会慢慢习惯的。

original: Ow, it's all scratchy!
translation: 好痒啊！

original: Absolutely! In fact, I want you to have this friendship necklace. It's good luck - wear it and you'll never get lost!
translation: 当然！其实，我想要你戴上这条友谊项链。它会带来好运，戴上它之后你就不会走失了。

original: Thank you, miss! We're going on an adventure!
translation: 谢谢，小姐！我们去冒险了！

original: No, I don't like the outside!
translation: 不，我不喜欢外面的世界！

original: Bumble, do you want to go outside?
translation: 小咕嘟，你想出去吗？

original: I don't know. I'm not supposed to go outside.
translation: 不知道。我不应该出去吧。

original: Bumble, do you want to see the outside with me? There's someone you should meet.
translation: 小咕嘟，你要不要和我去外边看看？有个人你该见见。

original: Awww. Well, maybe next time?
translation: 额。好吧，也许下一次再说？

original: On second thought, maybe not. You could get into trouble.
translation: 再仔细想想，也许你不该这样。你可能会陷入麻烦的。

original: Oh boy, an adventure! Let's go, let's go, oh pleeease, let's go now!
translation: 嘿，伙计们，冒险！出发吧，出发，哦伊，现在就走吧！

original: Come on, it'll be an adventure!
translation: 来吧，这将是一次冒险！

original: I am too a big girl! Let's go see the outside!
translation: 我也是一个大女孩了！让我们去外面的世界见识一下吧！

original: Don't you want to prove to everyone that you're a big girl?
translation: 你难道不想向所有人证明你长大了？

original: <giggles> You're silly!
translation: <傻笑>你这傻瓜！

original: Mayor-Mac wouldn't ever let a slaver in here! You can't scare me!
translation: 镇长是不会让奴隶贩子来这的！你吓不倒我！

original: I'm gonna be big and tough like Lucy! And then I'm gonna go out on adventures and everything!
translation: 我会像露西一样高大强壮！然后我会去外面的世界冒险，做我想做的所有事！

original: I'm a Slaver. And I think you're just the kid I'm looking for!
translation: 我是奴隶贩子，我想你正是我要找的小孩！

original: Why did you stop working on it? What happened?
translation: 为何你要停止工作呢？发生什么事了？

original: You happened.
translation: 你那时恰好出生了。

original: It wasn't just you; we had more problems than we could handle already, but your birth is what finally pushed it over the edge.
translation: 当然也不仅仅是因为你；我们还有一些尚未解决的技术问题。但你的出生是计划推后的主要原因。

original: Your father decided that you were more important than everything we'd been working for, and he left. He left all of us.
translation: 你父亲觉得你比所有工作上的事情都重要，之后他便走了，他离开了我们大家。

original: Once he was gone, the Brotherhood decided we weren't worth their time anymore. Without their protection, we had to abandon the purifier.
translation: 他一离开，兄弟会的人就觉得我们的工作只是浪费时间。没有他们的保护我们只得放弃净水工程。

original: Why didn't it work?
translation: 它为何无法运作呢？

original: We had the basic principles down; we understood most of the science behind it. But the radiation in the area is so pervasive...
translation: 我们放弃了基本的原则，这背后有许多隐情，此区域到处弥漫着辐射……

original: Small-scale tests were fine. But any time we tried to test the process on a larger scale, it was just too much.
translation: 小规模的实验还行，但是大范围的就很难了。

original: Maybe if we'd had more time, or better equipment...
translation: 要是我们有更多的时间，或者更好的设备，也许……

original: What was the point of it?
translation: 工程的目的是什么？

original: It was simple, really. "Fresh, clean water for everyone." Such a simple idea, and yet so impossible to realize.
translation: 其实很简单，就是“让大家都能喝上净水”。可是就连这么一个简单的念头，却始终无法企及。

original: The plan was to build a facility that could purify all the water in the Tidal Basin at once. No radiation, no muck, just clear water.
translation: 计划就是建立一个可以立刻净化潮汐盆地污水的设施。净化出没有辐射、没有废料的净水。

original: It just turned out to be more difficult than we anticipated.
translation: 但遇到的问题比预料的要难得多。

original: I'm just looking around. I'll come back later.
translation: 我走开下，稍后回来。

original: But... But I want to play now!
translation: 但...但是我现在就想开始！

original: I guess so. I'm just not that into shooting things.
translation: 还行吧。我不太喜欢开枪。

original: Oh, hey, don't worry about it. You might be surprised how much fun you can have if you give it a chance, though.
translation: 嗨，别担心。要是你试一次，就会发现它很有趣。

original: Couldn't you get me a real gun? A BB Gun is kind of lame.
translation: 你能给我把真枪吗？BB枪很垃圾啊。

original: Maybe so, but you still better not let the Overseer see you carrying that around. That's a real gun as far as he's concerned.
translation: 或许如此吧，但你最好还是别让监督者看到你拿着它走来走去的。他会以为是把真枪的。

original: Thanks a lot, Jonas. This is really cool.
translation: 乔纳斯，太感谢你了。这太酷了。

original: Hey, you don't turn 10 every day! Now go on and let me see you shoot something.
translation: 你又不是时时10岁的！快让我看看你开枪的样子吧。

original: Oh... But Dad told me it was okay to come down here.
translation: 但爸爸说可以来这里的。

original: Hey, relax! I was just teasing.
translation: 放松点，刚才不过是玩笑而已。

original: Listen, now that you're ten you don't have to take guff like that from grownups any more. Got it? Ha ha ha.
translation: 听着，现在你已经10岁了，不用再听那些大人的胡扯了。明白了吗？哈哈。

original: Hold on one more minute. I think your dad will want to give you the surprise himself.
translation: 稍等一会儿，我想你父亲是要亲自来给你一个惊喜吧。

original: Can it, Jonas. Where's my surprise present already?
translation: 行吗，乔纳斯？我的意外礼物准备好了吗？

original: Oh, I see, now that you're ten you're all business. Well then, missy, we'd better get to it.
translation: 噢，明白了，十岁了，公事公办啊。那好吧，小姐，我们开始吧。

original: Happy birthday, by the way. Hang on one more minute, I think I hear someone coming.
translation: 生日快乐。稍等一会儿，我听见有人过来了。

original: Oh, I see, now that you're ten you're all business. Well then, mister, we'd better get to it.
translation: 噢，明白了，十岁了，公事公办啊。那好吧，先生，我们开始吧。

original: Happy birthday, by the way. Hang on one more minute, I think I hear someone coming.
translation: 生日快乐。稍等一会儿，我听见有人过来了。

original: I'm not a kid! I'm ten years old!
translation: 我不是小孩！我已经10岁了！

original: Ha ha ha. You sure are! Pip-Boy and everything, look at that!
translation: 哈哈，对啊！看那，哔哔小子哎！

original: If you can wait just one more minute, I think your dad will want to give you the surprise himself.
translation: 要是你再等会，我想你父亲宁愿送你一份生日惊喜的。

original: Aww... do we have to?
translation: 我们必须得那样做吗？

original: I'm gonna ace this one!
translation: 我会把这件事情做到最好的！

original: Alrighty, Miss Shawna-Teacher!
translation: 没问题，肖纳老师！

original: Why does Daddy need merits? Can't he just be Daddy?
translation: 为什么爸爸需要功成名就呢？难道他就不能只是做一个好爸爸吗？

original: Ha! Ha! Rachael's in trouble!
translation: 哈哈！拉克尔遇到麻烦了！

original: Why am I always picked on in class? Make someone else do it!
translation: 上课时为何总是我被点名？找其他人啊！

original: Yesterday!
translation: 昨天！

original: Was it... uh... man... I knew it this morning...
translation: 是……是……今早我还记得的……

original: Whenever Daddy says it was, teacher!
translation: 老师，爸爸说是什么时候就是什么时候！

original: It wasn't very long ago... I think I remember...
translation: 并不是很久以前的事……我想我还能记得的……

original: He was ugly, and stupid, and mean!
translation: 他是个丑陋、愚蠢、卑鄙的人！

original: He didn't acknowledge truth, justice, or the will of Dave!
translation: 他不承认真理、正义还有戴夫的意志！

original: He wasn't as pretty as mommy number one or mommy number two!
translation: 他既没有1号妈咪漂亮，也没有2号妈咪漂亮！

original: But I thought grandpa just got really, really old...
translation: 但我想爷爷真的是老了……

original: Uh... he asked Tom really nicely?
translation: 他真是好言好语地问汤姆的吗？

original: He used a gun! Guns solve all problems!
translation: 他用的枪！枪能解决一切问题！

original: Pitchforks and fire, like in the pretty books Daddy has!
translation: 干草叉和火把，就像我父亲那本有趣的书里写的一样！

original: I thought grandpa Tom just gave Dave the Republic...
translation: 我想是爷爷汤姆把共和国拱手让给了戴夫……

original: Awww... I hate class... I want to go play!
translation: 我讨厌上课，我想玩！

original: Oh, crap, I forgot to do my homework on the Pledge of Allegience to Dave.
translation: 糟了，我忘了做给戴夫的作业 — 向戴夫的效忠誓言。

original: Yay, class! Isn't Shawna pretty?
translation: 上课！难道肖纳不漂亮吗？

original: But I already know everything about Dave...
translation: 但我已经知道了戴夫的一切了……

original: There you are! I must say, you had me completely fooled. You're very clever A3-21, but not clever enough. Now, come with me!
translation: 你在这儿啊！我得说，你完全把我耍了。A3-21，你很聪明，但还不够聪明。现在，跟我来！

original: What the hell are you talking about, Zimmer? I swear! I've got enough crackpots on this damn boat!
translation: 齐默，你到底在说什么鬼话？我发誓！这艘该死的船上已经够多疯子了！

original: I got sold out, eh? Don't think I don't know what's going on Zimmer. I won't let you get away with anything. What the hell are you up to?!
translation: 我被出卖了？别以为我不知道怎么回事，齐默。我不会让你得逞的。你到底想干什么？！

original: You're coming back with me to the Commonwealth. You're a very important android. You're just a bit confused. Your memories have been altered.
translation: 你要跟我回联邦去。你是一个非常重要的仿真人。你只是有点困惑。你的记忆被篡改了。

original: I'm going nowhere. I want you off this boat. Immediately! I'm done suffering your nonsense. You want to do this the easy way or the hard way?
translation: 我哪也不去。我要你马上下船！我听够了你的废了话。你想来软的还是硬的？

original: Of course we will be doing things the easy way. I have no intention of harming you. It's time to bid your farewells, "Harkness."
translation: 我们当然是来软的。我无意伤害你。是时候告别了，“哈克尼斯”。

original: Zimmer. That's it. You leave me no choice but to use force!
translation: 齐默。就这样。你让我别无他法，只能动武了！

original: A3-21, initialize factory reset, authorization code: Beta, 5, 3, Alpha.
translation: A3-21，初始化出厂设置，授权码：Beta，5，3，Alpha。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Zimmer. I hear you're looking for an android.
translation: 齐默，我听说你在找一个人造人。

original: Why yes! I'm anxious to retrieve him and return to the Commonwealth where he belongs. He's a very expensive piece of equipment.
translation: 我正想把他找回来，再送回到他原本该在的联邦。他是个很昂贵的装置。

original: I see. This android of yours is little more than a piece of property. A thing? A thing that belongs to you?
translation: 我明白了，这人造人对你来说不仅仅是个财物，它真的是属于你的吗？

original: What are you going on about? Yes. Of course he belongs to me. Now, have you found him or not?
translation: 你是想知道什么？他当然是属于我的。你现在找到他没？

original: Yeah, Zimmer. I found your damn android. He's standing right in front of you, but he's not going anywhere.
translation: 我找到你那该死的人造人了。他就在你面前，可他哪也不会去的。

original: I'm sorry? I don't follow.
translation: 抱歉，我没听清楚。

original: Not as sorry as you'll be in a moment. Goodbye Mister Zimmer, I hope you've enjoyed your stay at Rivet City.
translation: 你会更加抱歉的。齐默先生，再会了，祝你在铆钉城上过得愉快。

original: I ought to kill you for treating people like this. In fact, I think I will.
translation: 我想我应该把像你这样对待别人的人给杀了，而且我会的。

original: Abolitionist!
translation: 废奴主义者！

original: How about I buy all the Temple of the Union slaves from you?
translation: 把联合圣殿的所有奴隶都买下，如何？

original: I bet you just want to set them all free
translation: 我想你只是想让他们重获自由。

original: Still, business is business. You'd have to reimburse me for my efforts to recapture them
translation: 生意就是生意。你还得另外支付我为抓他们时所付出的努力。

original: You can have them all for 2500 caps.
translation: 他们一共2500瓶盖。

original: Why do you want my help? Why not have Colonel Autumn help you?
translation: 怎么想到找我帮忙？这个时候不是应该是奥特姆上校在你身边吗？

original: Ah, yes. Colonel Autumn. My trusted subordinate.
translation: 不错，奥托姆上校是我值得信赖的下属。

original: I'm sure you've noticed that Colonel Autumn and I do not see eye-to-eye these days, figuratively speaking of course.
translation: 但我想你也看到了，这几天我和奥托姆上校没有正眼看过对方一眼，更别说交流了。

original: The good Colonel and I disagree on how best to approach the problem of the Wasteland. He feels my methods are too extreme.
translation: 我和上校在处理废土的问题上发生了分歧，他觉得我的方法太极端了。

original: He has allowed his humanity to cloud his objectivity. And now that he is publicly countermanding my orders, I can no longer rely on him.
translation: 妇人之仁已经让他失去判断力。既然他公开反抗我，我也不会再器重他了。

original: And so I turn to you. I hope that you are able to see the larger picture, to understand what's at stake.
translation: 这就是我找你帮忙的原因。我想你是个识大体的人，知道轻重缓急。

original: And of course, if you are successful, there is a place for you in the Enclave. Perhaps you could succeed the Colonel as my confidant.
translation: 当然，要是你成功了的话，英克雷是会有你的一席之地的。或许你还可以接替上校成为我的心腹。

original: What's gotten into you? Jonas worked hard on your present. The least you could do is be polite for five minutes.
translation: 你是怎么了啊？乔纳斯为了你的礼物可是费了不少功夫呢。你至少该保持五分钟的礼貌吧。

original: Hey, John. What did you find?
translation: 约翰，你找到了什么？
