original: He was leaving his quarters just as I got there, but then I got jumped by some roaches and he got away.
translation: 我到那时他正要离开住所，但我被几只蟑螂困住了，然后他就逃走了。

original: She was leaving her quarters just as I got there, but then I got jumped by some roaches and she got away.
translation: 我到那时她正要离开住所，但我被几只蟑螂困住了，然后她就逃走了。

original: Don't worry, we'll find that little punk. He can't hide forever.
translation: 别担心，我们会找到那小混混的。他不可能永远都躲着。

original: Don't worry, we'll find that little bitch. She can't hide forever.
translation: 别担心，我们会找到那小婊子的。她不可能永远都躲着。

original: Righto. Give a yell if you see anything. I'm going to head down this way.
translation: 好，要是你看到什么就大喊，我会循声而来。

original: I ran into a friend of yours in Germantown.
translation: 我在日耳曼镇碰到了一个你的朋友。

original: That was you? Wow! Well, don't just stand there, come on in!
translation: 是你吗？别站在那啊，快进来！

original: I was the one who rescued your friend from the Super Mutants.
translation: 我是从超级变种人手中救下你朋友的人。

original: That was you? Come on in!
translation: 是你吗？进来吧！

original: Really? Well, I guess you'd better come on in then.
translation: 真的吗？赶快进来啊。

original: I ran into some friends of yours in Germantown.
translation: 我在日耳曼镇碰到了一些你的朋友。

original: Really? Well, I guess you'd better come on in then.
translation: 真的吗？赶快进来啊。

original: Any idea where I can look for someone to take care of you?
translation: 你知道哪能找到人来照顾你吗？

original: Well, pappa always told me about my cousin Vera. She lives on some big, giant ship somewhere or something.
translation: 爸爸以前经常说道我的表姐薇拉。他住在某处的一艘大船上。

original: Pappa called the place "Rivet City", but I dunno where it is.
translation: 爸爸说那地方叫做“铆钉城”，但我不知道它的确切位置。

original: Yep, it was all me.
translation: 对啰，全是我干的。

original: I wish I had something to give you for all the work you did, but I never really had much to start with.
translation: 我真想给你些东西来感谢你，但我从没什么东西可给的。

original: I guess now you'll be on your way and I'll have to try living here by myself. I hope you'll come back and visit someday.
translation: 我想你现在要继续征程，而我只能试着独自生活。希望有天你路过这时能再来看看我。

original: I'm just glad you're safe.
translation: 我很高兴你没事。

original: I wish I had something to give you for all the work you did, but I never really had much to start with.
translation: 我真想给你些东西来感谢你，但我从没什么东西可给的。

original: I guess now you'll be on your way and I'll have to try living here by myself. I hope you'll come back and visit someday.
translation: 我想你现在要继续征程，而我只能试着独自生活。希望有天你路过这时能再来看看我。

original: For God's sake... Stop acting like an asshole and let the kid in!
translation: 看在上帝的份上，不要再这么势利了，让孩子进去吧。

original: Ha ha, tough guy.
translation: 哈哈，顽固的人。

original: Nice try, but we ain't got the room.
translation: 可惜，我们没有房间了。

original: Ha ha. Tryin' to act like you're all tough, mungo?
translation: 你想装作是很坚强的吗，毛人？

original: Nice try, but we ain't got the room.
translation: 可惜，我们没有房间了。

original: Forget it.
translation: 算了。

original: Already have.
translation: 已经有了。

original: All right. How many caps is it going to take to change your mind?
translation: 你要多少瓶盖才愿意改变主意呢？

original: Like I care about your stupid caps. I'm not some big, dumb mungo.
translation: 说的好像是我贪财一样，我才不是又大又蠢的毛人。

original: We don't let people just come in here when they feel like it. That ain't how it works, and it ain't gonna change.
translation: 这不是想进就能进的地方，规矩是不能变的。

original: Guess you gotta find another home for Little Orphan Asshole.
translation: 看来你必须给小孤儿找另一处安身之所了。

original: Look, this kid needs to be with people his own age. Give him a chance.
translation: 这年龄的小孩须要多和同龄人相处，给他一个机会吧。

original: This is a bad idea...
translation: 真是个糟糕的想法。

original: Fine, send him here. But if he smells bad, or makes dumb jokes, I'm sticking him right back outside.
translation: 好吧，让他来这吧。但要是他身有异味或是做出什么蠢事的话，我会立刻把他赶走的。

original: We got enough of those here already.
translation: 我们这的人已经够多了。

original: Look, this kid's just like you. On his own, no parents... Give him a chance!
translation: 这孩子其实和你们一样，是个没有父母的孤儿……给他一个机会吧！

original: You're killin' me here, mungo.
translation: 你要急死我了，毛人。

original: Fine. You can send him here, but I'm not gonna do any special favors for him or anything. He's gotta pull his weight.
translation: 好吧，你能让他来这，但我不会帮他任何事，让他自己考虑吧。

original: How exactly can I destroy the mutagen?
translation: 我要是能摧毁那突变体呢？

original: Destroy? Oh no no no!
translation: 你说摧毁？不不不！

original: You mustn't do that! It's my life's work! Just clear me a path to my equipment and I'll do the rest when you tell me its safe.
translation: 你不能那样做！那是我毕生的心血！你帮我把路上的兵蚁清了，我会自己完成接下来的工作的。

original: I'm here to do research on the city's history.
translation: 我来这寻找这城市的历史背景。

original: Research, huh?
translation: 找什么，呃？

original: I can't help you there, but you're free to ask around inside. Just don't start any trouble.
translation: 我帮不上什么忙，但你可以问问别人，别惹麻烦就行。

original: I have to go now.
translation: 我现在要走了。

original: Don't worry, Herbert, he'll be back. Ha! I love that one... gets me every time.
translation: 别担心，赫伯特，他会回来的。哈！我超爱这句……每次都能让我爽到。

original: Don't worry, Herbert, she'll be back. Ha! I love that one... gets me every time.
translation: 别担心，赫伯特，她会回来的。哈！我超爱这句……每次都能让我爽到。

original: See you later... well, maybe not if you do what I've asked.
translation: 再见，或许再也见不到了……。

original: Oh okay... I guess me and Bob will see you again soon.
translation: 哦，好吧……我想我和鲍勃很快会再见到你的。

original: Tell me, too! Then I won't be scared either.
translation: 也告诉我吧！那样我也不会害怕了。

original: Awww, I never knew an Outsider could be scared of anything!
translation: 哎呀，我还不知道外来者也会害怕！

original: Harold told me that he's scared of fire. If fire ever got on him, it would burn him and Bob until they were all gone.
translation: 哈罗德告诉我他怕火。要是火沾到他身上，就会把他和鲍勃烧得一干二净。

original: That's why we keep the fires far away from him.
translation: 这就是为什么我们让火离他远远的。

original: This is your last mistake, little bartender!
translation: 小酒保，这是你犯的最后一个错误了！

original: Please! No! I didn't! I swear!
translation: 不要！我没有！我发誓！

original: This is last time I tell you! No more!
translation: 这是我最后一次跟你说了！没有了！

original: All right, I'll just take them off your hands then... but I still need more. Come back when you have some to trade.
translation: 好，那我要了……但还要更多的。要是你还有的话回来卖给我吧。

original: I've got ten rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了十把步枪。

original: Come on, I haven't got all day.
translation: 快点，我可没有闲功夫。

original: That should be it! Give me a few days to spread the word around. I should be resupplied pretty quick.
translation: 行了！给我几天让我把话放出去。到时候我就有货了。

original: Thanks for your help, man. I could have never done this without you. Just for you: a 20% discount at the new and improved Lock and Load.
translation: 多谢你的帮助。没你我肯定做不到。给你个特例：锁定－上膛的八折优惠。

original: Not bad, not bad. I still need some more though. Keep 'em comin', man.
translation: 不错，不错。只是我还需要更多，再帮我弄些来吧。

original: So? What's the count?
translation: 有多少呢？

original: That should be it! Give me a few days to spread the word around. I should be resupplied pretty quick.
translation: 行了！给我几天让我把话放出去。到时候我就有货了。

original: Thanks for your help, man. I could have never done this without you. Just for you: a 20% discount at the new and improved Lock and Load.
translation: 多谢你的帮助。没你我肯定做不到。给你个特例：锁定－上膛的八折优惠。

original: Not bad, not bad. I still need some more though. Keep 'em comin', man.
translation: 不错，不错。只是我还需要一些，再帮我弄些来吧。

original: Actually, never mind.
translation: 其实，没事。

original: Your call, man. But if I'm gonna get this place going again, I'm gonna need a lot of something to trade.
translation: 随便吧。但要是想让这地方再次的发展起来，就得做大很多买卖。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got nine rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了九把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got eight rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了八把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got seven rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了七把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got six rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了六把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got five rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了五把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got four rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了四把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got three rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了三把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: I've got two rifles for you.
translation: 我给你带来了两把步枪。

original: Alright, I'll just take it off your hands then... but I still need more. Come back when you have some to trade.
translation: 好，那我要了……但还要更多的。要是你还有的话回来卖给我吧。

original: I've got one rifle for you.
translation: 我给你带来了一把步枪。

original: Yeah? You got some?
translation: 你有吗？

original: Let's talk about those Chinese Assault Rifles you were looking for.
translation: 我们谈谈你要找的那些中式突击步枪。

original: Yeah, fuck that. I don't work for you.
translation: 去你妈的，我才不为你打工呢。

original: Well, whatever, man. I don't need to like you to do business with you. If you want to get something going, you know where to find me.
translation: 随便喽。我和你做生意，又不和你做爱。要是你想有点前途，我一直都在这里哦。

original: Did you need anything else?
translation: 你还需要什么吗？

original: What's in it for me?
translation: 这对我有什么好处？

original: Well, I can't really kick much your way now but once I get running, I'll be able to offer you much better stuff.
translation: 现在我没什么好货，等我生意一旦做起来了，会给你提供些更好的东西的。

original: And of course, as my business partner, you'll get a discount on everything.
translation: 当然，作为我的生意伙伴，你会享受到折扣价的。

original: Sounds like a good deal to me, man.
translation: 听起来是个好主意。

original: Alright, twenty Chinese Assault Rifles and we're in business. Just bring any you find back to me.
translation: 行，20把中式突击步枪，我们就开张了。你找到的话就拿来给我吧。

original: Any piece of shit will do, I'm just going to be breaking them apart and trading the parts.
translation: 什么烂货都行，我会把它们都给拆开，然后卖零件。

original: You know where to find me.
translation: 你知道在哪里能找到我。

original: Tough shit, man. Now shut up and sell me the stuff you already have.
translation: 活该，老兄。闭嘴吧，把你手上的东西卖给我就行。

original: Yeah, whatever asshole. Shut up and buy something.
translation: 你个混蛋。少说废话，多做生意。

original: Sounds pretty rough, but that's business for you.
translation: 听起来很麻烦，但我会尽力去弄的。

original: Yeah, it is. Is there anything else you need?
translation: 没错，你还要其他什么东西吗？

original: What do you need? Maybe I could bring you stuff to trade.
translation: 你要什么呢？或许我能弄点东西来卖给你。

original: Yeah... you know, I could really get this little shithole going if I had some better stuff.
translation: 对……你看，我要是有些好货，这小粪坑就能运作起来。

original: First thing's first, bring me some Chinese Assault Rifles. People always need 'em for parts. Twenty should get me going.
translation: 首先，你得给我些中式突击步枪。人们需要这种枪的零件，20把就行。

original: I'll trade 'em off and I should be able to improve my stock pretty fast.
translation: 我会把那些枪都倒手，这样就可以好好地进一批货了。

original: Tough shit, man. Now shut up and sell me the stuff you already have.
translation: 活该，老兄。闭嘴吧，把你手上的东西卖给我就行。

original: Yeah, whatever asshole. Shut up and buy something.
translation: 你个混蛋。少说废话，多做生意。

original: Sounds pretty rough, but that's business for you.
translation: 听起来很麻烦，但我会尽力去弄的。

original: Yeah, it is. Is there anything else you need?
translation: 没错。你还要其他什么东西吗？

original: What do you need? Maybe I could bring you stuff to trade.
translation: 你要什么呢？或许我能弄点东西来卖给你。

original: Yeah... you know, I could really get this little shithole going if I had some better stuff.
translation: 对……你看，我要是有些好货，这小粪坑就能运作起来。

original: First thing's first, bring me some Chinese Assault Rifles. People always need 'em for parts. Twenty should get me going.
translation: 首先，你得给我些中式突击步枪。人们需要这种枪的零件，20把就行。

original: I'll trade 'em off and I should be able to improve my stock pretty fast.
translation: 我会把那些枪都倒手，这样就可以好好地进一批货了。

original: Why not put a boot to their asses and take the good stuff?
translation: 为什么不打扁他们，把好东西都给抢走呢？

original: Because there's only one of me, man. I know you're new here, but you piss too many people off around here and you'll have trouble on your hands.
translation: 因为我只有一个人。我知道你是个新人，但要是你惹了太多人的话，自己会有麻烦的。

original: And by "trouble" I mean "end up in the pens or hanging from the sign out front". No thanks.
translation: 提到“麻烦”，我是指“死在栅栏里，或者被挂在大门口”。我就免了。

original: But, if you know of anyway I could get some better stock in here, maybe we could work something out.
translation: 但是，如果你知道有什么办法搞些好货来，或许我们可以合作。

original: It'd give me more to trade and give those animals out there more reason to open up their pockets.
translation: 如果提升我货品的质量，外面的人就更愿意掏腰包了。

original: So what would it take for you to get some decent supplies?
translation: 怎么样才能让你有一些好货呢？

original: I'd have to have some decent supplies to trade for them. If I have more things that these douchebags want, they'll bring me better stuff to trade.
translation: 我需要为他们准备好货。要是我有些他们更愿意要的东西的话，相信他们的货物也会更好的。

original: But you know, I'm a one man operation here. Not like I get out a lot. Pretty much, my business is at the mercy of assholes. Fuckin' free market, man.
translation: 但是你也知道，我是个单干的，不喜欢往外跑。我生意的大部分是和那些滚蛋做的。去你妈的市场经济。

original: Tough break, man. But let's talk about something else.
translation: 够倒霉的，老兄。我们谈谈其它事。

original: Yeah, no one wants to hear me bitch about my problems. What else do you need, man?
translation: 对，没人想听我抱怨自己的麻烦事。你还要什么东西吗？

original: They keep the good stuff? No wonder your selection sucks.
translation: 他们把好东西留下了？怪不得你这都是些残次品。

original: Hey, man. Rude. You don't like it, shop somewhere else.
translation: 嗨，哥们，没礼貌。不喜欢去别处买啊。

original: But yeah, those greedy assholes... I don't know how I'm supposed to pull down a living over here when they don't trade fair.
translation: 对……那些贪婪的滚蛋……他们不愿意公平买卖，我真不知道怎么在这待下去。

original: So you pretty much get the leftovers?
translation: 所以你基本上就只有些残次品了？

original: Yeah, pretty much. Greedy assholes. I don't know how I'm supposed to pull down a living over here when they don't trade fair.
translation: 大致上是这样……那些贪婪的滚蛋……他们不愿意公平买卖，我真不知道怎么在这待下去。

original: You guys are pretty isolated. Where do you get your supplies?
translation: 你们好像都躲在这里，那你从哪里进货呢？

original: Well, the guys usually bring in what they grab on missions. I mean, you always got to kill a few people when you're gathering meat.
translation: 那些家伙会把做任务时搜刮的东西卖给我。你也知道他们找肉吃的时候难免杀上几个人的。

original: You know, they've got some guards, the dad thinks he's a hero and pulls a gun, whatever. So, they bring that crap in here and trade it.
translation: 他们有保镖，都是些持枪的混蛋。然后，他们就把废物拿到我这来卖。

original: But, mostly the only stuff I get is from these guys. And they keep the good stuff for themselves.
translation: 不过，东西主要来自他们。而他们把好东西留下，只把残次品卖给我。

original: Thank you, and know that your hard work will pay off soon.
translation: 谢谢。你不会白白受那些苦的。

original: In fact, if you should see him, feel free to offer him directions or an escort.
translation: 要是你见到他的话，给他指明道路或是护送他吧。

original: In fact, if you should see her, feel free to offer her directions or an escort.
translation: 要是你见到她的话，给他指明道路或是护送她吧。

original: I've invited our guest from Vault 101 to my office. Please do not impede his progress in any way.
translation: 我已经邀请来自101号避难所的客人来我的办公室，请大家不要阻拦。

original: I've invited our guest from Vault 101 to my office. Please do not impede her progress in any way.
translation: 我已经邀请来自101号避难所的客人来我的办公室，请大家不要阻拦。

original: Please do not impede his progress. Thank you for your cooperation.
translation: 请不要阻拦他，谢谢合作。

original: Please do not impede her progress. Thank you for your cooperation.
translation: 请不要阻拦她，谢谢合作。

original: Attention all Raven Rock Personnel: This is your President speaking. I've invited our guest from Vault 101 to my office.
translation: 拉文罗克山基地的所有人请注意：现在是由你们的总统在发言，我已经邀请来自101号避难所的客人来我的办公室。

original: Yeah. What a surprise. Don't ask again. That was a one time offer.
translation: 吃惊吧。不要再问了，同一个提议我不会说两次。

original: Now get lost before I put you out of my misery.
translation: 在我发火之前赶快从我面前消失。

original: Um... I seem to be a bit short. But I promise I'll have it by next week.
translation: 嗯……貌似不太多，不过我保证下周会有的。

original: Yeah. What a surprise. Don't ask again. That was a one time offer.
translation: 吃惊吧。不要再问了，同一个提议我不会说两次。

original: Now get lost before I put you out of my misery.
translation: 在我发火之前赶快从我面前消失。

original: That's too much. I think I'll pass.
translation: 太多了，我想我要放弃。

original: You've got a deal.
translation: 你真有办法。

original: We'll clear out of here. Those slaves can have this goddamn place.
translation: 我们把这清干净了。那些奴隶可以有个住的地方了。

original: Here. Take your blood money, all 2500 caps of it.
translation: 给，拿走你的血腥钱，总共是2500个瓶盖。

original: It's northwest of here, numb nuts. A long fucking walk, too.
translation: 在西北方向，傻瓜。有他妈一大段路要走。

original: Wankers like you can't get in though. You need a special set of keys.
translation: 可是你这么无能的家伙是进不去的，你需要一套特制的钥匙。

original: Where is this Fort Constantine?
translation: 康斯坦丁要塞在哪？

original: I didn't need your help. Go back to your crazy father.
translation: 我不要你的帮助，回到你那疯子老爸的身边吧。

original: Fair enough. I know you must hate my father for what he's done, and I guess maybe you hate me now, too.
translation: 够了，我想你讨厌我父亲的所作所为，而且你现在也恨我吧。

original: But for whatever it's worth, I'm sorry. Sorry about Jonas, and my father, and everything.
translation: 对所有的一切我表示遗憾。乔纳斯、我的父亲、还有其他的一切。

original: If you do catch up with your dad, I hope you'll tell him that. Jonas was my friend, too, you know.
translation: 要是你找到你父亲的话，希望你能转告他，乔纳斯是我的朋友。

original: When I say I'm going to do something.... I do it.
translation: 我这人是说到做到的。

original: You're right, I should never have doubted you!
translation: 你说的对，我从不该怀疑你！

original: I couldn't have done it without your help.
translation: 没有你的帮助我是无法完成此事的。

original: No, you didn't need me. If anyone can survive out there, it's you.
translation: 不，你不需要我。要是有谁可以在外面的世界生存下来的话，那就是你。

original: I'm not giving you anything.
translation: 我是不会给你任何东西的。

original: Then you have 24 hours to remain in the Republic or face execution. Enjoy your stay.
translation: 要么你在24小时内滚出共和国，要么你就得接受死刑，享受你在此的时光吧。

original: I'll be back with 250 caps.
translation: 我会带250瓶盖回来的。

original: Very well. I look forward to it, future refugee.
translation: 很好，我期待你的到来，未来的难民。

original: Yes, this will do nicely. Congratulations, you are now an official refugee of the Republic of Dave.
translation: 这就对了。恭喜你现在是戴夫共和国的正式难民了。

original: I'll pay your refugee tax. Here's 250 caps.
translation: 我会付你难民税，给你250个瓶盖。

original: A Hunting Rifle? Fine, I'll be back with one.
translation: 猎枪吗？我会带一支回来的。

original: Very well. I look forward to it, future refugee.
translation: 很好，我期待你的到来，未来的难民。

original: Yes, this will do nicely. Congratulations, you are now an official refugee of the Republic of Dave.
translation: 这就对了。恭喜你现在是戴夫共和国的正式难民了。

original: I have a Hunting Rifle right here.
translation: 我这有猎枪。

original: You crazy, condescending asshole! No one exiles me!
translation: 你这疯狂、低贱的混蛋！没人可以驱逐我的！

original: Have it your way. You'll never leave the Republic. Alive, that is.
translation: 既然你想这样，那你绝不可能活着走出共和国。

original: What if I just make a donation to the Republic... and you let me stay?
translation: 要是我向共和国捐款的话，你们能让我留下来吗？

original: A donation, huh? Well, it just so happens that the Republic of Dave does grant special asylum to its supporters in times of crisis.
translation: 捐赠？当戴夫共和国的支持者处于危机之中时，这里就会为其提供庇护。

original: A one-time refugee tax of 250 caps should be enough to handle the administration costs of letting you stay.
translation: 每次上交250瓶盖避难税，便足矣填补政府让你在此逗留的支出。

original: Or, you could always find the President a new hunting rifle. I lost the last one when I was out stalking Mirelurks.
translation: 或者你可以帮我们的总统弄支新猎枪。我在围捕泥沼蟹时弄丢了一支。

original: There must be something I can do to stay.
translation: 一定有什么办法能让我能留在这里。

original: Hmm... now that you mention it, the President could use a new hunting rifle.
translation: 既然提到这事，总统正需要一把新猎枪。

original: Tell you what. You find me a serviceable hunting rifle, and I'll grant you special asylum within my Republic.
translation: 这样吧，只要你能给我支耐用的猎枪，我就允许你在共和国避难。

original: Or, you can just pay the 250 cap tax on "unwanted refugees."
translation: 或者，你也可以为你“不必要的”避难交250个瓶盖的税。

original: I'm not going to go out of my way to find these slaves for you.
translation: 我才不会去为你抓奴隶。

original: Then some other wastelander will get the bounty for them.
translation: 总有另外的废土游民会干这差事的。

original: It doesn't matter to me, just so long as I get them.
translation: 对我无所谓了，只要你把他们交给我就行。

original: As far as I'm concerned, you're a murderer just like the rest of them.
translation: 据我所知，你是一个和他们一样的杀人犯。

original: Now come on, that's not fair. I wasn't even there! I had some words with the Overseer when I saw what they'd done to Jonas.
translation: 那不公平，我当时甚至不在场！当我看见他们要对乔纳斯下手时，我向监督者求情了。

original: But they all went crazy when they realized what your dad had done. Opened the Vault door!
translation: 但他们知道你父亲的所作所为时都陷入了疯狂。他居然把避难所的大门打开！

original: Good gravy, if it was anybody but your dad I'd have thought he was a traitor, too.
translation: 天！要是那个人不是你爸爸，我肯定就相信那人是一个叛徒了。

original: But not him. If he opened that door, he must have had his reasons. And you'd better follow him, quick.
translation: 但不会是他！他不会无缘无故地把大门打开的，你最好赶快去找他。

original: And I'll pretend you don't work for a homicidal maniac.
translation: 我会伪称你没有为一个杀人的疯子工作的。

original: Don't think I don't know it. Why do you think I'm letting you go?
translation: 不要以为我不知道，你为何觉得我会放你走呢？

original: I guess you're trying to follow your dad... outside.
translation: 你猜你是想要追随父亲到外面的世界去闯荡吧。

original: Good gravy, if I didn't know what the Overseer would do if he caught you, I'd never tell you to try for it, but it's your only shot.
translation: 我不敢说监督者抓住你后会怎样对你，我从没赞成过让你去冒险，但毕竟这是你自己的抉择。

original: You take care and I hope you find your daddy.
translation: 保重，祝愿你能找到你的父亲。

original: Thanks, Officer Gomez. I always liked you.
translation: 多谢，警员戈麦斯。我总是很喜欢你的作风。

original: It's a real shame it's come to this. I can't believe what they did to Jonas... Officer Mack was just out of control...
translation: 对此我深感遗憾，我不敢相信他们对乔纳斯所做的一切……警员麦克失去理智了。

original: But you're a good kid. You didn't do anything to deserve this. Go find your dad, if you can.
translation: 你是个好人，不应该遭罪的。要是你有能力的话，就去找你父亲吧。

original: What can you tell me about Doctor Li?
translation: 你能跟我说说李博士吗？

original: She's not very social. Stays in her lab in the stern.
translation: 她不爱和别人说话，她就待在船尾的实验室里面。

original: She's smart though. Real smart.
translation: 不过，她真的是很聪明。

original: So what's the story with Doctor Li?
translation: 那么李博士有些什么故事？

original: She's one of the members of the Council. Runs the science lab here. Don't bother her unless it's important.
translation: 她是铆钉城议会的成员，管理这里的实验室。除非是万不得已最好不要去打搅她。

original: Her lab is in the stern end of the ship.
translation: 她的实验室就在船尾。

original: She's some sort of genius. You know. One of those egg head scientist types.
translation: 她是一位天才，聪明绝顶的那种。

original: Her lab is in the stern end of the ship.
translation: 她的实验室就在船尾。

original: She's certainly head and shoulders above most everyone else around here. Though that's not saying much.
translation: 她的水平远远胜过这里每个人，不过这不能说明问题。

original: Is Doctor Li as smart as they say she is?
translation: 李博士真像他们说得那样精明吗？

original: You have quite an unusual name.
translation: 你的名字很特别。

original: It was taken from a historical entry in the computer. The name comes from a man who was willing to fight and die for what he believed in.
translation: 这是从电脑里的历史条目中选出的一个名字。一个为了自己信念奋战至死的男人的名字。

original: I felt it was appropriate given my circumstances.
translation: 我觉得这名字适合我的处境。

original: This is a huge waste of time.
translation: 这太浪费时间了。

original: Is it? What if I told you I could help you find the G.E.C.K.?
translation: 是吗？假如我说可以帮你找到伊甸园创造器呢？

original: You belong in that cage, you freak!
translation: 你这怪胎应该被关到笼子里去！

original: Sigh. Very well.
translation: 唉，好吧。

original: I was hoping my first encounter with a human would have proven more beneficial. I'm saddened that I was mistaken.
translation: 我对于和人类第一次的接触本来有个更好的期待。我对我的错误而感到惋惜。

original: Very well. You were saying?
translation: 很好。刚才说到哪了？

original: I appreciate your understanding.
translation: 多谢你的理解。

original: Perhaps we can use this moment to help each other rather than fight each other.
translation: 或许我们此刻能互相帮忙而非相互残杀。

original: I'm used to your kind being less cordial. My apologies.
translation: 我以前觉得你们的族类都很冷血，在此向你道歉了。

original: I appreciate your understanding and your tone leads me to believe you're a reasonable person.
translation: 多谢你的理解，你的话语让我相信你是个通情达理的人。

original: Perhaps we can use this moment to help each other rather than fight each other.
translation: 或许我们此刻能让大家互相帮忙而非互相残杀。

original: Yikes! I'd say whoever beat you with the ugly stick overdid it.
translation: 我得说不管是谁用棍子打你，他做得都太过分了。

original: Your arrogance against my kind is hardly surprising.
translation: 你用你的傲慢来反对我的仁慈并没出乎我的意料。

original: However, there's only so much even I can take. Please, I'm appealing to the positive side of your human nature.
translation: 但我的容忍也是有限度的。我是想唤醒你人性的光明面。

original: Can we have a civil conversation?
translation: 我们能用文明的方式交流吗？

original: Must not have been too bad. You're still alive, aren't you?
translation: 不太糟糕吧。至少你还活着，不是吗？

original: You're right. Compared to Jonas, I'm just peachy. A few bruises, nothing more. What do I have to complain about?
translation: 你说得对，和乔纳斯相比我算是好多了。除了擦伤外就没什么了，我还有什么可抱怨的呢？

original: You seem to have come through in fine shape as well.
translation: 你似乎没什么大碍。

original: Go on, then. The door's open. Time for you to leave. And I'll stay here and clean up the mess you and your dad made.
translation: 继续吧。大门已经打开了，是你离开的时候了。我会留在这收拾你和你父亲留下的残局。

original: Don't worry, I'm sure I can patch things up with my father. That's what we do down here, isn't it? Smile and pretend everything is just fine.
translation: 别担心。我会和父亲一起把这些事处理好的，这是我们接下来要做的事情。笑一个，一切事情都会好起来的。

original: My only concern was getting this door open, and I did it.
translation: 我唯一关心的事就是把这扇门打开。

original: Of course. That was the plan, wasn't it? I was supposed to distract them while you got the door open. Mission accomplished!
translation: 当然，那就是计划了。你开门的时候我会去吸引他们的注意力。这样就搞定了。

original: Now you're going to go... out there. And I'm going to go back and make up with my dear old Daddy.
translation: 现在你要去外面了，而我要回去和父亲重归于好了。

original: I guess if anyone can survive out there, it's you. And I'm great at pretending everything's just fine, so that's okay too.
translation: 我想要是有谁能在外面的世界活下来的话，那一定是你。而我能装作一切都没事的样子，所以我们都好。

original: Go on. What are you waiting for? No point in getting caught now, after all this trouble. Goodbye.
translation: 继续吧，你还在等待什么呢？经过这些，你对这没有什么值得留恋的了。再见了。

original: I'm sorry, Amata, but I couldn't risk helping you. They would have killed me.
translation: 抱歉，阿玛塔，但我不能冒险去救你。他们会杀了我的。

original: You're right. I understand. It was crazy for me to think you could stop them.
translation: 你说的对，我也知道让你去阻止他们的想法是不切实际的。

original: What's important is that you made it. You got the door open.
translation: 重要的是你成功了，现在就去把大门打开吧。

original: Pretty quiet. You?
translation: 这里相当安静，你怎么样？

original: Just roaches. I don't know where they keep coming from. How about you?
translation: 只有些不知从哪来的蟑螂而已。你怎么样？

original: Nah. Everyone's keeping to the curfew. Any news on the doc's kid?
translation: 不。所有人都执行了宵禁。有什么关于医生孩子的消息吗？

original: No. I'd better get going. Good luck.
translation: 没有。我还是走吧。祝你好运。

original: Nothing. That kid can't hide from us forever though.
translation: 没有。不过那孩子不可能躲一辈子的。

original: Nope. I bet you a week's rations Amata knows something, though.
translation: 没有。我拿一周的口粮和你打赌，阿玛塔肯定知道些内幕。

original: I'll never get the roach guts off my billy club. What a mess.
translation: 我的棍子上全是蟑螂碎，真是一团糟。

original: Nope. Wild goose chase if you ask me.
translation: 你问我是白费力气。

original: If you insist.
translation: 随你便吧。

original: Not worth it. I'll pass.
translation: 不值得，我放弃。

original: Well, your financial advice has never steered us wrong before. Done!
translation: 你对投资的建议从让我们每次都能大赚一笔。成交了！

original: Take my advice -- it can be done with only 100 caps.
translation: 我的意见是 — 它只需100个瓶盖。

original: Excellent! Harith will be delighted! He usually is by most things, really.
translation: 太棒了！哈里斯会很高兴的！他总是这样……

original: That's a good investment. Here's 200 caps.
translation: 不错的投资，给你200个瓶盖。

original: Yes, it is. But if you don't have the capital, it'll have to wait, I'm afraid.
translation: 是的。但如果你没有资本的话，恐怕还得等等。

original: That's a good investment.
translation: 不错的投资。

original: Hmm. I suspect you're right. Done!
translation: 或许你是对的。行！

original: With my guidance, it can be done with only 250 caps.
translation: 在我看来，它只需250个瓶盖。

original: An investment in weaponry is usually returned in short order, after all. I'll inform Harith.
translation: 在军火上的投资总是短期就能见效的。我会把消息告诉哈里斯的。

original: That's a good investment. Here's 500 caps.
translation: 不错的投资，给你500个瓶盖。

original: Pricey, but worth it. Perhaps you can do so later, when you have the proper funds on hand.
translation: 投资虽然很贵，但总是成效显著。等你以后有钱了再来吧。

original: That's a good investment.
translation: 不错的投资。

original: If you insist.
translation: 随你便吧。

original: Not worth it. I'll pass.
translation: 不值得，我放弃。

original: Well, your financial advice has never steered us wrong before. Done!
translation: 你的投资建议从来也没出过错。成交了！

original: Take my advice -- it can be done with only 100 caps.
translation: 我的意见是 — 只花100个瓶盖就够了。

original: Excellent! I'll see to it right away.
translation: 太好了！我立刻去办。

original: That's a good investment. Here's 200 caps.
translation: 不错的投资，给你200个瓶盖。

original: Yes, it is. But if you don't have the capital, it'll have to wait, I'm afraid.
translation: 是的。但如果你没有资本的话，恐怕还得等等。

original: That's a good investment.
translation: 不错的投资。

original: Hmm. I suspect you're right. Done!
translation: 或许你是对的。行！

original: With my guidance, it can be done with only 250 caps.

original: Isn't it, though? I'll inform Wolfgang immediately.
translation: 我同意的看法。我会立刻告诉沃尔夫冈的。

original: That's a good investment. Here's 500 caps.
translation: 不错的投资，给你500个瓶盖。

original: Pricey, but worth it. Perhaps you can do so later, when you have the proper funds on hand.
translation: 投资虽然很贵，但总是成效显著。等你以后有钱了再来吧。

translation: 太棒了！我会把你的话转告给乌鸦的。

original: Pricey, but worth it. Perhaps you can do so later, when you have the proper funds on hand.

original: That's a good investment.
translation: 不错的投资。

original: All right, you're the boss!
translation: 行，听你的！

original: That's enough about the traders.
translation: 商人的情况先说到这里吧。

original: It takes a fair amount of capital to expand into higher quality material, you know.
translation: 你也知道想进好货是得要大量资本的。

original: Improving Crow's wardrobe would require a one-time investment of, say, 200 caps.
translation: 想让乌鸦的衣柜里面有更好的东西的话，得要200瓶盖的投资。

original: He should expand his inventory.
translation: 他应该扩充他的货物。

original: Crow's armor is already rather extensive, but I'm sure it could be even more impressive... for a one time investment of 500 caps.
translation: 乌鸦的盔甲库已经扩容了，但我要说，如果你能一次投资500瓶盖的话，规模会变得更大的。

original: He should expand his inventory.
translation: 他应该扩充他的货物。

original: At this point, the merchandise of our man Crow is the best in the Wasteland. I fear it's beyond improvement with further investments.
translation: 就目前而言，我们乌鸦的货物已经是废土上最好的了，再投资也估计没有用了。

original: He should expand his inventory.
translation: 他应该扩充他的货物。

original: Harith's got quite a lot of weapons, but I'm sure he could improve his stock. An investment of 200 caps should see to that nicely.
translation: 哈里斯有大量的武器，但还是能再进些好货。200瓶盖的投资你就会见到成效了。

original: He should expand his inventory.
translation: 他应该扩充他的货物。

original: If Harith were a less-reputable man, I'm sure he could use his armory to collect even more weapons.
translation: 要是哈里斯是个有信誉的商人，他会购置更多的军火进他的武器库里面。

original: But he's a merchant, not a raider, so it's legitimate means only. Like a legitimate investment of 500 caps.
translation: 但他是个商人而不是个歹徒，所以只能对他进些合法的投资，你得投资500瓶盖。

original: He should expand his inventory further.
translation: 他应该进一步扩充他的货物。

original: That simply isn't feasible, I'm afraid. Harith's gear already rivals some mercenary armies - anything further would be asking for trouble.
translation: 恐怕这是不可行的。哈里斯的武器已经能和佣军的匹敌了 — 要是武器再好的话可能会被其他人给盯上了。

original: He should expand his inventory.
translation: 他应该扩充他的货物。

original: With an investment of about 200 caps, I'm sure he could improve the quality of his materials. Or at least, offer more of them.
translation: 要是你能投资200瓶盖的话，我确信他的商品质量会大大提高的，至少数量是会增加的。

original: Can he offer a wider variety of junk?
translation: 他能提供更多品种的垃圾吗？

original: At this point, it would require another pack brahmin to carry his wares. But for 500 caps, I think he could offer more.
translation: 就目前而言，你再继续投资的话，他还得增加一只双头牛才能驮得动他的货物了。所以说500瓶盖的投资你会收效显著的。

original: He should offer even more junk.
translation: 他应当提供更多的垃圾。

original: At the moment, Wolfgang's practically carrying an entire junkyard with him.
translation: 沃尔夫冈目前已经是背着整个垃圾场在走了。

original: Anything more, and he'll have trouble with the "traveling" part of being a traveling salesman.
translation: 货再多的话，他就没法上路了，他可是个旅行商人。

original: He should expand his wares further.
translation: 他应当更多的扩充他的商品。

original: Sure thing. Interested in any of the other traders?
translation: 当然，还对其他的商人有兴趣吗？

original: Enough about that.
translation: 够了。

original: No word from Crazy Wolfgang for some time now. With him, it could mean anything, but I don't have a good feeling about it.
translation: 目前还没有疯子沃尔夫冈的回音。他什么事情都有可能发生，但我有种不祥的预感。

original: Let's talk about odds and ends.
translation: 我们谈谈一些零碎的事。

original: That'd be Crazy Wolfgang: he does repairs and general supplies. But he prefers to call himself a "junk dealer."
translation: 那里一定是疯子沃尔夫冈了——他做修理和百货的生意。但他更愿意别人称他为“废旧品商人”。

original: As he says, he's "overjoyed to assist those who have a deep need for his... junk." He's just like that. Says it catches people's attention.
translation: 如他所说的，他“很乐意帮助对他的垃圾有大量需求的人”，他就是这么个人，号称这能吸引别人的目光。

original: Do you have any traders that deal with miscellaneous goods?
translation: 你们有处理杂货的商人吗？

original: I'm sure Crazy Wolfgang would be just delighted to hear we're discussing his junk.
translation: 我想疯子沃尔夫冈听到人名议论他的垃圾是会很高兴的。

original: Let's talk about odds and ends.
translation: 我们谈谈一些零碎的事。

original: I'm afraid the good doctor hasn't reported in for quite a while. Quite unfortunate, really.
translation: 恐怕大医生是有一阵没来过了。真的是很不幸啊。

original: Let's talk about food and chems.
translation: 我们谈谈食物和药品。

original: Ah, then you'll be wanting Doc Hoff. Or "the good doctor," as he prefers.
translation: 你是想找霍夫医生吧，或者说那个自称大医生的家伙。

original: He prescribes everything from a good meal to stimpaks to things that'll make your brain get up and dance.
translation: 他开的药方从大餐到治疗针到让你的脑子飘飘欲仙的玩意，什么都有。

original: Let's talk about food and chems.
translation: 我们谈谈食物和药品。

original: What sort of better living would you like from the good doctor's chemistry?
translation: 大医生的药品中有什么能让你生活美满的？

original: Let's talk about food and chems.
translation: 我们谈谈食物和药品。

original: Anytime, my friend. I could talk about my little Canterbury 'till doomsday.
translation: 随时，朋友。我可以和你大谈我的小坎特伯雷，直到世界末日。

original: Course that came and went already, didn't it?
translation: 人生总是周而复始的，不是吗？

original: I think I get the picture.
translation: 我想我知道个大概了。

original: Let's talk about your plan for the purifier.
translation: 我们来谈谈你对于净水工程的计划吧。

original: Certainly. I think it's a very good plan, frankly. I'm not often one to praise my own ideas, but it's a creative solution to a very serious problem.
translation: 当然，这确实是个很好的计划。我很少称赞自己的主意，但这创造性的方法可以解决严重的问题。

original: Won't this kill pretty much everyone in the Wasteland?
translation: 这不是会杀死废土的许多人吗？

original: Anyone or anything that has been affected by mutation will be eliminated. You will likely be immune, thanks to your upbringing in the vault.
translation: 不管是何人何物，只要是变异的就该被消灭。由于你在避难所里长大的，所以你是免疫的。

original: Likewise, the good people of the Enclave will be unaffected as well.
translation: 同样地，英克雷的兄弟们也是不会受到影响的。

original: I understand that you may have become sympathetic to certain individuals in your travels. Individuals this will eliminate.
translation: 我能理解在你的旅途中你变得对他们有同情感了，但这些人都是应该被消灭的。

original: Please recognize that the fate of our entire country rests on this plan. Sacrifices must be made for the greater good.
translation: 你要知道整个世界的命运都依托在这计划之上，为了创造更美好的世界牺牲是难免的。

original: I'd really like to speak to Reilly and find out what happened to her.
translation: 我真想和莱莉好好谈谈，弄清楚到底发生了什么。

original: It would be dangerous for me to prematurely awaken her.
translation: 要是这样贸然地把她弄醒是很危险的。

original: The sudden shock to her system could provoke any number of complications.
translation: 她的神经系统遭受了突然的震荡，可能会造成多种并发症。

original: I keep telling you, it's Mister President! Now get back to guarding the gate!
translation: 我告诉过你了，是总统“先生”！现在回去守卫大门！

original: President Daddy, there is a Wastelander who wishes to see you, sir!
translation: 总统爸爸，有个废土游民想要见你！

original: Never mind. I've got to get going.
translation: 算了，我走了。

original: Fine. We need to be on our way then.
translation: 好，我们该走了。

original: It's far northwest of D.C. Real friendly people there. <Lie.>
translation: 在特区的西北角。有一些真正友好的朋友。<撒谎>

original: We just came from that place, and I know who lives there.
translation: 我们就是从那来的，我知道有谁住在那。

original: If you're going to act like a Slaver, then you can die like one.
translation: 要是想做奴隶贩子的话，你会像他们那样死去的。

original: The Temple is in the Lincoln Memorial, near the Washington Monument.
translation: 圣殿在林肯纪念堂，华盛顿纪念碑附近。

original: Thank you, friend. We won't forget this.
translation: 谢谢你，我的朋友，我们是不会忘记的。

original: You look a little lost. Do you need directions?
translation: 你看上去是迷路了，要人指路吗？

original: Do you know Hannibal Hamlin? Do you know where the temple is?
translation: 你知道汉尼拔·哈姆林吗？你知道圣殿在哪吗？

original: I enjoyed killing him. Now get out of my way.
translation: 我会享受杀死他的乐趣的，你别挡路。

original: Gladly.
translation: 很好。

original: The only reason I'm not calling the guards is out of respect for your dad. I don't want him to lose the only family he has left.
translation: 我没有叫警卫过来是由于对你父亲的尊重。我也不希望他失去唯一在世的家人。

original: You'd better get out of here before I change my mind.
translation: 你最好在我改变主意之前离开这。

original: Your father deserved to die. He was a murderer.
translation: 你父亲该死，他是个杀人犯。

original: Oh, really? And who appointed you judge, jury, and executioner? I know he wasn't perfect, but he was my father.
translation: 真是这样吗？是谁任命你为法官、陪审团和刽子手的？！我知道他并不完美，但他是我的父亲。

original: I thought you were my friend. He was the only family I had left. I thought you of all people would have understood that.
translation: 我一直把你当朋友。他是我唯一的家人，我想你们都知道这一点的。

original: You'd better get out of here before I change my mind and call the guards.
translation: 你最好在我改变主意把警卫叫来之前赶快离开。

original: I'm sorry, Amata. But I had no choice.
translation: 阿玛塔，很抱歉，我当时没其它选择的。

original: So you say. Maybe one day I'll be able to forgive you. But not now.
translation: 你说的对，或许有天我会原谅你的，但不是现在。

original: I hope you never have to find out what it's like to see your father killed right in front of you.
translation: 我希望你永远都不要看到你父亲死在你面前。

original: No, don't listen to me. Just... just go. Find your father. I have to go bury mine.
translation: 不要听我说了。你赶快去找你父亲吧，我还得把埋葬我父亲。

original: Yes, I was going to. Still am, if you'll shut up and get out of my way.
translation: 是的，我还是会去的，如果你闭嘴并从我面前走开。

original: Fine. Be that way. By the way, thanks for rescuing me from my father.
translation: 好的。就那样吧，多句嘴，感谢你把我从父亲那里解救出来。

original: Although I'm sure it was only by accident. I'm sure you wouldn't have helped me on purpose.
translation: 不过我知道这次只是个意外，你不是专程来救我的。

original: Go on, then. The door's open. Time for you to leave. And I'll stay here and clean up the mess you and your dad made.
translation: 继续吧。大门已经打开了，是你离开的时候了。我会留在这收拾你和你父亲留下的残局。

original: Don't worry, I'm sure I can patch things up with my father. That's what we do down here, isn't it? Smile and pretend everything is just fine.
translation: 别担心。我会和我父亲和好的，这也是我们要做的事情，不是吗？笑一个吧，一切都会好起来的。

original: I said I didn't need your help to escape. Turns out I was right.
translation: 我说过我不需要你的帮助也能逃脱，事实证明了我是正确的。

original: Well, trust you to do things the hard way. Sorry for trying to help you. And getting a beating for my pains.
translation: 好吧，我知道你生性冷硬。很抱歉我曾经想要帮助你，你就继续向我伤口上面撒盐吧。

original: Never mind. It doesn't matter now. What's important is that you made it. You got the door open...
translation: 没关系，重要的是你成功了，你把大门给打开了……

original: My God, everything they told us was a lie, wasn't it? We can never go back to the way things were. We... I trusted him.
translation: 天啊，他们和我说的一切都是假的！我们再也回不到从前的时光了，我们……我相信过他……

original: I guess it's time for you to go deal with your father issues, while I deal with mine. Good luck. I will miss you, you know.
translation: 我想是时候让你去弄明白你父亲的事情了，我也该回去处理我的事情了，祝你好运，我会想念你的。

original: It's good to see you, Amata. I'm sorry I didn't trust you earlier.
translation: 阿玛塔，很高兴能认识你，很后悔没有早点信任你。

original: You did the right thing in the end. That's what counts. I don't know what my father would have done to me if you hadn't stopped him.
translation: 关键是，最后你终于做了正确的事，我真不敢想象要是你没有及时制止他的话，他会对我做什么样的事。

original: I still can hardly believe we did it. The door... it's open.
translation: 我还是不敢相信我们居然做到了，大门……打开了。

original: Everything they told us was a lie, wasn't it? Things can never go back to the way they were.
translation: 他们和我说的一切都是谎言。事情再也不可能回到原来的样子了。

original: Okay, so where'd you like to start?
translation: 好吧。那你想从哪开始呢？

original: I don't think I want to do that one.
translation: 我不想干这个。

original: Okay, I suppose we can put that one off for a bit.
translation: 好吧，这个可以先放一放。

original: I don't think I want to do that one.
translation: 我不想干这个。

original: They say it was a town called Ridgefield, until slavers cleared it out. Now, it's supposedly cursed, and just a deathtrap to visitors.
translation: 他们说在奴隶贩子把那洗劫一空之前，它是个叫做瑞吉菲尔德的小镇。现在那是个被诅咒之地，是旅者的死亡之地。

original: Now, everyone calls the place "Minefield" and says it's a ghost town. Superstitious nonsense, of course, but that's how people think. You'll be fine.
translation: 现在大家都叫那地方“雷区”，说那是一个有幽灵出没的小镇。虽然这是迷信的说法，但人们都是这么认为的，当然你是不会有事的。

original: What do you know about Minefield?
translation: 你对雷区知道些什么？

original: Interesting. Well, I'll see you around.
translation: 很有趣的故事。回头见。

original: Well, I could use some firepower myself. What are you selling?
translation: 我想买点武器，你这有吗？

original: Blow yourself up.
translation: 把你自己炸飞。

original: I am shocked to hear these words from you. I thought I was doing my best to hold these fortifications on behalf of our country.
translation: 听到你说的那些话我很震惊。我以为自己是在为了我们的国家而全力守卫这些工事的。

original: Since I have obviously failed that task in your eyes, the only task I held dear, I see no recourse but to do the honorable thing.
translation: 鉴于在你眼中，我失败了，那是我唯一珍惜的任务。现在，我们只为荣誉、别无所求。

original: Farewell and Godspeed.
translation: 再见，祝平安。

original: Do whatever you want... I'm out of here.
translation: 去做你想做的事情吧……我走了。

original: Very well, I'm sure you need to hasten back to headquarters.
translation: 很好，我想你得立刻回到总部去。

original: It's been an honor meeting you, I can see you are indeed a patriot among men.
translation: 认识你很荣幸，我知道你是个真正的爱国者。

original: Now go... you'll have no further trouble from my men. Godspeed.
translation: 去吧，我的人不再会找你麻烦了。一切顺利。

original: Keep the Declaration safe... don't let anyone take it.
translation: 看管好宣言，别让任何人把它抢走。

original: It will be done. The only way to get the Declaration now would be to pry it from my cold, dead fingers.
translation: 保证完成任务。想拿宣言的话，只有撬开我冰冷僵硬的手指。

original: It's been an honor meeting you, I can see you are indeed a patriot among men.
translation: 认识你很荣幸，我知道你是个真正的爱国者。

original: Now go... you'll have no further trouble from my men. Godspeed.
translation: 去吧，我的人不再会找你麻烦了。一切顺利。

original: This is getting ridiculous. Just give me the Declaration, now!
translation: 太荒谬了，把宣言给我就行，快！

original: I think you'll find that to be very difficult when you'll soon be hanging from the gallows outside the State House in Philadelphia!
translation: 当你被挂到费城的议场外的绞刑架上，你就知道事情有多难了。

original: I've got it! We'll kill all of the English scholars!
translation: 明白了！我们会杀死所有的英国学者的！

original: Forgive my impertinence, but that's foolish.
translation: 原谅我的无理，但这实在是太愚蠢了。

original: However, if you were to bring me some iron gall ink, I could produce a mirror perfect duplication.
translation: 但要是你能给我带点鉄汁墨水的话，我会制造出完美的复制品的。

original: The best place to find some would be in the Arlington Library, which is why I have been unable to do this myself.
translation: 最可能的地方是阿灵顿图书馆，这就是为什么我自己做不到的原因。

original: After all, I can't abandon these fortifications.
translation: 毕竟，我不能放弃这些防御工事。

original: Anything we can do to pull the wool over their eyes is a blow for freedom!
translation: 任何欺瞒他们的办法都是为自由而战！

original: Hear, hear!
translation: 听！听！

original: If you were to bring me some iron gall ink, I could produce a mirror perfect duplication.
translation: 如果你给我拿些铁汁墨水，我会能造出完全一样的复制品。

original: The best place to find some would be in the Arlington Library, which is why I have been unable to do this myself.
translation: 最可能的地方是阿灵顿图书馆，这就是为什么我自己做不到的原因。

original: After all, I can't abandon these fortifications.
translation: 毕竟，我不能放弃这些防御工事。

original: Just give me the damn Declaration already!
translation: 把那该死的宣言给我！

original: I'm shocked at your tone. This is a great day for the United States of America!
translation: 我被你的话震惊了。对美利坚来说这是非凡的一天！

original: I think you said it best when you said: "We in America do not have government by the majority. We have government by the majority who participate."
translation: 我觉得你说的最好的一句就是：“美国的政府不是多数人的政府，而是多数参与者的政府。”

original: It has been both an honor and a privilege to serve the United States.
translation: 为美国服务一直是荣誉和责任。

original: What are your final orders?
translation: 你最后的命令是什么？

original: You're a disgrace. I order your immediate dismissal from the Congress!
translation: 你是个败类。我命令你马上从国会大厦滚出去！

original: I am shocked to hear these words from you. I thought I was doing my best to hold these fortifications on behalf of our country.
translation: 听到你说的那些话我很震惊。我以为自己是为了我们的国家而尽全力去守卫防御工事的。

original: Since I have obviously failed that task in your eyes, the only task I held dear, I see no recourse but to do the honorable thing.
translation: 鉴于在你眼中，我失败了，那是我唯一珍惜的任务。现在，我们只为荣誉、别无所求。

original: I hereby relinquish command and control of this fortification to you.
translation: 我谨此向你移交防御工事的控制权。

original: Good luck to you, Mr. Jefferson... and give Sally my regards.
translation: 好运，杰斐逊先生……向莎丽问好。

original: You can do whatever you like.
translation: 你想怎么做都行。

original: Then I choose to take a long-needed rest. I think you'll find that the rest of my men are long-due for the same.
translation: 我想好好休息一下。我的手下们也太需要休息了。

original: I hereby relinquish command and control of this fortification to you.
translation: 我谨此向你移交防御工事的控制权。

original: Good luck to you, Mr. Jefferson... and give Sally my regards.
translation: 好运，杰斐逊先生……向莎丽问好。

original: I am presenting it to our King in Great Britain.
translation: 我要把它献给我们大不列颠的国王。

original: No! It can't be! Then the Stars and Stripes have indeed fallen.
translation: 不，怎么会！那么星条旗就真的陨落了。

original: This is a sad day, a day that every man, woman and child will remember as they toil in the English salt mines as slaves.
translation: 这是悲伤的一天，所有在英国盐矿当奴隶的男人、女人和小孩都刻骨铭心。

original: Although my brow is heavy,  I am honored that you've come to tell me this in person like a true gentleman.
translation: 尽管我的眉头紧锁，我还是为你能像一个绅士一样地来告诉我真相而荣幸。

original: What are your final orders?
translation: 你最后的命令是什么？

original: You were right! I am a Redcoat Spy and the place is surrounded by my army!
translation: 没错，我是红衣间谍，这已经被我的部队包围了！

original: Do you take me for a complete fool?
translation: 你把我当傻瓜吗？

original: I too have spies, and they tell me you have no army with you.
translation: 我也安插了间谍了，他们说你没有军队。

original: However, since you've admitted to being the enemy and you have no wish to surrender, I'm afraid you'll have to be executed for your crimes!
translation: 既然你要做一个死不悔改的敌人，恐怕你要被处决了。

original: Nope, sorry. I've got to have that Declaration at any cost.
translation: 那就对不起了，我会不惜一切代价拿到宣言的。

original: I've been patient and I've spoken to you like a gentleman.
translation: 我已经很耐心了，而且和你讲话也像个绅士一样。

original: But if all you understand is violence, then let justice be done and let the Almighty decide the rightful winner. Defend yourself!
translation: 但如果你只懂得暴力，那么就让公正得到声张吧，让万能的主裁定谁该获胜。受死吧！

original: This is what's going to happen. You die, I get the Declaration. Understand?
translation: 事情的发展将会是我杀掉你，然后把宣言抢走。明白吗？

original: I've been patient and I've spoken to you like a gentleman.
translation: 我已经很耐心了，而且和你讲话也像个绅士一样。

original: But if all you understand is violence, then let justice be done and let the Almighty decide the rightful winner. Defend yourself!
translation: 但如果你只懂得暴力，那么就让公正得到声张吧，让万能的主裁定谁该获胜。受死吧！

original: Is there some way we can make a compromise?
translation: 有什么能折中的解决方法吗？

original: Broken promises and deceit may be the way of Great Britain's crown, but I will not succumb to such tomfoolery.
translation: 背信忘义和谎话连篇是英国皇室的一贯作风 ，但我不会屈服于这样的愚蠢行为的。

original: Since it appears you wish to resolve this without bloodshed, may I suggest you stand down and surrender?
translation: 既然看起来你想通过不流血的方式解决，或许我该建议你立刻缴械投降？

original: I can promise that you will be treated well; in a manner accustomed to any member of the Royal Army.
translation: 我可以承诺你会得到很好的待遇；那些皇家陆军早就习惯的方式。

original: You're not even human, you stupid bucket of bolts!
translation: 你根本不是人类，你是个愚蠢的东西。

original: To suggest such a thing isn't just a falsehood... it's blasphemy!
translation: 这样的建议不但虚伪，更是亵渎。

original: The doctrine I defend was laid down by my fellow members of the Second Continental Congress.
translation: 我所信守的声明是第二届大陆议会的同胞们制定的。

original: It absolves us of the tyranny of King George the Third of Great Britain. It is perhaps the greatest symbol of this free nation!
translation: 它让我们摆脱了英皇乔治三世的暴政，或许这是这国家自由民主的最伟大象征！

original: That's quite brave of you. To potentially sacrifice your life over a document.
translation: 你十分勇敢，你可能会为一份文件而牺牲的。

original: This is no mere document, sir. This is the doctrine laid down by my fellow members of the Second Continental Congress.
translation: 先生，这不仅仅是一份文件。它是第二届大陆议会的成员所拟定的声明。

original: It absolves us of the tyranny of King George the Third of Great Britain. It is perhaps the greatest symbol of this free nation!
translation: 它让我们摆脱了大英帝国乔治三世的暴政。它可能是这个自由国家最伟大的象征。

original: This is no mere document, madam. This is the doctrine laid down by my fellow members of the Second Continental Congress.
translation: 女士，这不仅仅是一份文件。它是第二届大陆议会的成员所拟定的声明。

original: It absolves us of the tyranny of King George the Third of Great Britain. It is perhaps the greatest symbol of this free nation.
translation: 它让我们摆脱了大英帝国乔治三世的暴政。它可能是这个自由国家最伟大的象征。

original: Just who are you, exactly?
translation: 你到底是谁？

original: Why, I am Button Gwinnett, second signer of the Declaration of Independence and distinguished representative from Georgia.
translation: 我是巴顿·格温耐特，独立宣言的的第二个签署者，我是佐治亚洲的代表。

original: I know your fighting prowess far exceeds my own, but I will still duel you to the death if I must.
translation: 你知道你的战斗本领远远超过我，但是我仍然要和你决斗，至死方休。

original: What will it be then? Rapiers? Pistols at dawn? Out with it!
translation: 你要选哪样？短剑？拂晓拼抢？随你挑！

original: How did you get into the relic hunting business?
translation: 你是怎样开始你的古董猎人生涯的？

original: I dunno. I grew up like pretty much every other girl in this crappy world. Spent most of my life just trying to keep away from Slavers.
translation: 不知道，我和这垃圾世界上的其他女孩一样，把生命里的许多时间花在了躲避奴隶贩子的魔爪上。

original: One day out in the Wastes, I stumbled across some poor bastard's body. On the body I found info leading to some famous document.
translation: 有天我在废土上见到一具可怜的无名尸，在尸体上我找到了一些信息，顺着这信息找到了一些著名的文件。

original: I had heard that Abraham Washington was looking for these scraps of paper, so I went after the thing. Turned out to be the Constitution.
translation: 我听说过亚伯拉罕·华盛顿在寻找这些破纸，我再一打听，发现这些居然就是宪法。

original: After he loaded me up with caps, I got piss drunk, got laid and was happy for the first time in a while. I haven't looked back since.
translation: 他给我瓶盖之后，我就去买醉了，直到喝趴下，我好久都没那么开心了。此后我再也没回过头。

original: Who's stupid enough to shell out a bunch of caps for a scrap of paper?
translation: 是谁会傻到用瓶盖来换几张破纸啊？

original: Like I said, Abraham Washington, that's who. He's got plenty of caps and all kinds of valuables for trade.
translation: 就像我刚才说的，亚伯拉罕·华盛顿，他拿了一大堆瓶盖来换。

original: The guy lives over in Rivet City; runs some sort of museum there. He buys all sorts of junk like this.
translation: 那人住在铆钉城，开着一个博物馆。他收购所有那样的垃圾。

original: Bring the Declaration back with me and we split the reward right down the middle. How's that grab ya?
translation: 和我一起把宣言带回去，我们把赏金对半分了，如何？

original: Hang on, there. You need to tell me who you are before I agree to anything!
translation: 等一下，在我同意之前你得先告诉我你是谁！

original: I told you already. I'm a relic hunter just like you. I turn bits of trash into caps and then get my ass drunk.
translation: 我已经说过了，我是个和你一样的古董猎人。我把找到的那些破铜烂铁拿来换酒喝。

original: I've studied the plans to this place, so without me you're going to go in circles. What do you say?
translation: 我已经勘察研究过这地方的线路，没有我，你只能原地打转兜圈子，你觉得呢？

original: I don't have time for this crap.
translation: 我没有时间管这破事。

original: In a rush to get back to Abraham Washington for your reward, eh?
translation: 赶着回去找亚伯拉罕·华盛顿领你的奖金，是吗？

original: If you think you can just waltz into these ruins and grab the Declaration of Independence without my help, you're fucking nuts.
translation: 要是没有我的帮助，难道你自以为能跳着华尔兹进入遗址，然后轻松地把《独立宣言》拿到手吗？你别痴人说梦了！

original: Or maybe you just have a death wish.
translation: 或许你是活腻了吧。

original: I'm not looking for anything. I'm just passing through.
translation: 我没在找什么东西，我只是刚好路过而已。

original: Passing through? Come on... you and I both know this is where the Declaration of Independence is stashed.
translation: 路过？少来了，我们都清楚这可是《独立宣言》的所在之地。

original: Good old Abraham Washington sent you on the same suicide mission he sent me on.
translation: 老亚伯拉罕·华盛顿让我们来干同一个自杀任务。

original: Got news for you -- there's no way in Hell you're gonna get it without my help.
translation: 告诉你吧 — 没有我的帮忙，你根本找不到。

original: Yeah... better than you, deadeye.
translation: 对啊……比你好些，神射手。

original: Yeah right. I could shoot the dick off of a fly at 100 yards without iron sights.
translation: 当然，我可以盲狙打掉一百码之外苍蝇的鸡鸡。

original: Why don't you can the tough girl bullshit? We're both relic hunters and I suspect we're both here for the same reason.
translation: 为何你废话连篇呢？我们都是古董收集者，而且恐怕我们都是为了相同原因来到这的吧。

original: Yeah right. I could shoot the dick off of a fly at 100 yards without iron sights.
translation: 当然，我可以盲狙打掉一百码之外苍蝇的鸡鸡。

original: Why don't you can the tough guy bullshit? We're both relic hunters and I suspect we're both here for the same reason.
translation: 为何你要废话连篇呢？我们都是宝物猎人，而且恐怕我们都是为了相同原因来到这的吧。

original: What's the history behind the document?
translation: 这文献的历史背景是什么？

original: On July the 4th in 1776, a group calling themselves the Second Judgmental Congress got together at Fort McHarry in Maryland.
translation: 1776年7月4日，一帮自称第二届审判会议的成员聚集到了马里兰州的马克哈里要塞。

original: After a ceremony which ended with Paul Revere singing the famous battle hymn known as the National Anthem, the document was signed.
translation: 举行完一个仪式之后，保罗·瑞威尔吟唱了著名的战争圣歌 — 也就是后来美国的国歌，文件就被签署了。

original: From there, it was sent to England by plane presumably and presented to King George himself. Thus began the Evolutionary War.
translation: 后来这文件送到了英国。乔治三世肺都炸了，独立战争就这样爆发了。

original: On July 4, 1776 the Second Continental Congress declared that the original Thirteen Colonies of America were now free and independent states.
translation: 1776年7月4日，在第二届大陆会议上，十三个殖民地的代表宣布美国是独立、自由的国家。

original: This paper stated their intentions to sever all ties with the monarchy in Great Britain and operate as an independent nation.
translation: 这份文件宣告了他们脱离英国王权，并独立运作。

original: It's perhaps the single most important document in United States history.
translation: 这恐怕是美国历史上最为重要的一份文件了。

original: I have a few questions about the Declaration of Independence.
translation: 我有些关于《独立宣言》的问题。

original: Please ask then. After all, knowledge is power!
translation: 问吧，毕竟知识就是力量！

original: All I know is that it looks like a rolled up piece of thick paper with all kinds of writing on it. Some famous document from a long time ago.
translation: 据我所知它看起来就是一张厚卷轴，有不同字体签名。很久以前的一份重要文件。

original: Abraham Washington is a huge U.S. History nut, so that's why he wants it so badly.
translation: 亚伯拉罕·华盛顿是美国历史痴迷者，因此他才如此迫切地想拿回《独立宣言》。

original: What do you know about the Declaration of Independence?
translation: 关于《独立宣言》，你知道些什么？

original: Oh very well. There's no harm in that.
translation: 很好，这也没什么要紧的。

original: Let me ask you something else.
translation: 让我来问你点别的事。

original: Certainly.
translation: 行。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Very well.
translation: 那好吧。

original: Let me think about this for a bit, and I'll get back to you.
translation: 让我想想，想好了再来找你。

original: Oh dear. Well, I can't make you go. Only to appeal to your sense of patriotism and to do it for your country.
translation: 天啊。我不能强迫你去。只能问问你的爱国良心，为了国家做它。

original: Slow down there, gramps. What's this reward you're talking about?
translation: 老爷子，慢点。你刚才说的奖金是什么？

original: You'd secure your place in history. The man who rediscovered the Declaration of Independence. Imagine the fanfare!
translation: 你会青史留名的。重新找回《独立宣言》的人。想想有多么荣耀。

original: You'd secure your place in history. The woman who rediscovered the Declaration of Independence. Imagine the fanfare!
translation: 你会青史留名的。重新找回《独立宣言》的人。想想有多么荣耀。

original: What's your point?
translation: 你想说什么呢？

original: Well, I was hoping you'd realize what I want. I want you to get the Declaration for me.
translation: 我还以为你想得到呢。我要你能帮我把《独立宣言》取回来。

original: The Declaration would tie this collection of documents together so well and give it the patriotic meaning it deserves.
translation: 这份宣言会将其他所有文件连成一体，赋予这个整体应有的爱国意义。

original: If you can find it for me, I'd be sure to make it worth your while.
translation: 要是你能帮我取回来的话，我会奖励你的。

original: It has to be the Declaration of Independence.
translation: 一定是独立宣言了。

original: Why, yes! Your knowledge of American History is quite impressive!
translation: 是的！你对美利坚历史的了解真让人佩服！

original: What an amazing crown jewel in my collection that would be! The original document created by the people, for the people.
translation: 这会是我收藏品里的最重要的珍宝！人民发布的文献！为人民谋福祉的文献！

original: What's missing is my ability to stay awake in this snoreatorium.
translation: 你的话让我听得昏昏欲睡。

original: My friend, the sleeping fox catches no moss.
translation: 朋友，睡着的狐狸抓不着鸡。

original: Would you want to miss out on the opportunity of a lifetime?
translation: 你想错过这千载难逢的机会吗？

original: Oh good, I was looking for some kindling.
translation: 太好了，我正在找些易燃物。

original: Watch your tone, sir. To suggest the destruction of such fine specimens is almost, well... blasphemy!
translation: 先生，注意你的口气。毁掉这样珍贵的原件简直就是种亵渎！

original: I'll have you know this collection is a complete chronicle of our nation's history. A unique glimpse into the past.
translation: 我会让你知道这些藏品美国历史的完整编年史，是对过去罕见的回顾。

original: Well, almost complete. One document still continues to elude me.
translation: 我的收藏几乎都齐了，但还有一份文件让我耿耿于怀。

original: I want to help.
translation: 我想要帮忙。

original: We will not give up this position and the Mutants show no sign of slowing down.
translation: 我们不能放弃这个据点，超级变种人的攻势没有减弱的迹象。

original: The best thing you can do is eliminate any Mutants you find. I have no reward to offer you but my thanks.
translation: 你能做的最重要的事就是消灭你看到的超级变种人，我不能给你什么奖励，除了我的感谢。

original: Let's get out of here, I don't have all day.
translation: 让我们走吧，我可没有一整天的时间。

original: You'll get no argument from me.
translation: 我是不会和你争论的。

original: Don't worry about that gun. Take one of mine.
translation: 不要担心枪的问题，把我的枪拿去用。

original: Okay... if you say so. Let's just hurry.
translation: 好吧……既然你坚持，我们赶快。

original: What do you do for fun around here?
translation: 你一般拿什么作消遣？

original: Heh... well... there's this and that. I keep myself busy. But, really, that's none of your business is it?
translation: 又这又那的确实让我很忙，但这不关你的事，对不对？

original: I really don't know. I skipped American government class back in the Vault.
translation: 我真是不知道，我当年在避难所里经常逃历史课。

original: I don't mean to embarrass you, but maybe you should learn your history before you argue with a patriot.
translation: 我并不想让你难堪，但你在和一个爱国者交谈之前麻烦你先多读一点历史。

original: It's okay, though. That's what we have a government for, to do the hard things so we don't have to.
translation: 好吧，那就是我们需要政府的原因了，来替我们做我们不愿做的麻烦事。

original: But, what else did you want to know?
translation: 你还想知道什么呢？

original: Well, they did give us guns and say, "If we fuck up, feel free to take us out."
translation: 他们把枪给我们，然后说：“要是我们把事情搞砸了，就随你们处置。”

original: Well, when you put it that way... wait, you're just trying to confuse me with your fancy vault education and your textbooks!
translation: 照你那样说的话……等一下，你是想用你避难所里那童话式的教条和教科书把我弄晕吧。

original: I'll have none of it! Did you have something else you wanted to ask, or were you done with your crazy talk?
translation: 我才不要！你还有其他什么要问的吗，还是你已经废话完了？

original: Do you think people who fought a war with tyrants wanted unquestioning support?
translation: 你觉得人们反抗暴政的时候应该得到无条件的支持？

original: Well.. when you put it that way... wait, you're just trying to confuse me with your fancy vault education and your textbooks!
translation: 照你那样说的话……等一下，你是想用你避难所里那童话式的教条和教科书把我弄晕吧。

original: I'll have none of it! Did you have something else you wanted to ask, or were you done with your crazy talk?
translation: 我才不要！你还有其他什么要问的吗，还是你已经废话完了？

original: I couldn't possibly care less about governments or presidents.
translation: 我最不在乎的就是政府和总统等等等等破事。

original: Well, we can't all care. Besides, why should we have to? That's what the government is here for, to take care of that stuff.
translation: 好吧，不是每个人都在乎。而且，我们为什么要在乎呢？政府不就是为料理这种事情而存在的嘛。

original: Are you kidding? It's the duty of a citizen to question his government.
translation: 你是在开玩笑吗？对政府质疑是公民的天职。

original: Why... that's unthinkable! Where in the constitution does it say that we're supposed to run around questioning the government? Huh?
translation: 无法想象！宪法中哪说过我们应该对政府保持怀疑了？

original: You're right. My country deserves my unthinking and unquestioning support.
translation: 你是对的。我理当执着并坚信祖国的信念。

original: Now there's a proud patriot. After all, if they could do us wrong, we wouldn't have elected them in the first place, right?
translation: 那么你就是个骄傲的爱国者。毕竟要是他们执政方针有误的话，我们一开始就不会选他们了，我说的没错吧？

original: Yessir, trust in the judgement of other people to know what's best for me. It's the American way!
translation: 根据别人的判断，做出最适合自我的选择，这就是美利坚式的做法。

original: That's all I needed to hear.
translation: 那就是我所愿意听到的了。

original: Any time you want another lesson, come on by.
translation: 要是你还想上历史课的话，随时欢迎回来。

original: Who are the Enclave, anyway?
translation: 英克雷到底是什么鬼东西？

original: They're the American government! The eagle! People comma we the! The more perfect union!
translation: 他们是美利坚政府！是白头鹰！人民的专政！是最完美的联盟！

original: If you've never seen the Enclave, how can you know anything about them?
translation: 既然你从没见过英克雷，那你又是怎么知道他们的故事的呢？

original: They're on the radio! They have been for years. President Eden talks about everything they're doing.
translation: 听广播啊，他们已经广播了好几年了。伊登总统会说他们所做的一切事情。

original: They got flyin' robots all around, watching everything so they know what to do when they finally swoop in and clean this place up.
translation: 到处都有他们的飞行机器人，他们监视着所有的事情，在未来必要的时候，他们会从天而降扫平一切的。

original: You'll see. People think I'm just a crazy old man. Things'll be different when the Enclave gets here.
translation: 人们认为我不过是个疯疯癫癫的怪老头，但如果英克雷真的来这，大家就会知道谁才是疯子。

original: Why do you support the Enclave?
translation: 为什么你要支持英克雷呢？

original: Why? Why? Look around you. This is the good ol' USA. Sure, she looks a little bit different these days, but you're still on American soil.
translation: 为什么呢？为什么？看你的周围。这是美利坚，虽然现在它看起来是有些不一样了，但这依旧是美利坚的土地。

original: And even if you were born in some underground Vault, you were born under the United States, which makes you an American.
translation: 就算你是从什么地下世界的避难所里出生的，但你还是在美利坚出生的，你仍然是美利坚的公民。

original: And it's your duty and my duty to support our country and our president, no matter what. Understand?
translation: 无论怎样，支持我们的国家和总统都是你我的责任，明白吗？

original: Because American is the greatest country on Earth... actually... it might be the only country on Earth now.
translation: 因为美利坚是地球上最好的国家……事实上……现在美利坚可能是地球上最后的国家了。

original: Wow... your own stuff. That's... just stupid. Why take apart good guns?
translation: 哦……你自己的东西……那太愚蠢了。为什么把好枪拆掉？

original: You ain't got no artistic sense, man. There are a million different ways to kill someone, all it takes is a little imagination.
translation: 老兄，你太缺乏艺术细胞了。杀人的方法千千万，变着花样叫你完蛋。

original: What have you made?
translation: 你做了什么？

original: You know, this and that but... I made this kickass rifle. Fires railroad spikes. It will fuck a dude up, man.
translation: 你知道，形形色色的，不过……我造了这把射腚步枪。发射道钉的。它可以一枪撂翻一个家伙，哈哈。

original: I'll be sure to put this gun to good use. Thanks.
translation: 我会好好拿着这把枪的，多谢了。

original: Maybe it would have been better if you'd taken it in the first place. I don't know.
translation: 要是你一开始就拿着的话就好了。我不知道。

original: But you'd better get out of here. I'll try to meet you at the Vault door. If I don't make it... good luck.
translation: 你最好先离开这。我会在避难所的大门口见你的，要是我没到那的话……嗯，祝你好运。

original: Do you make a lot of your own stuff?
translation: 这许多东西都是你自己做的吗？

original: Yeah, pretty much. Take it apart, put it back together. It ain't hard. Sometimes I design my own weapons too.
translation: 是的，相当多。把东西拆开后又装起来，这些工作没什么复杂的。有时我还会自己制造武器。

original: You had no choice. You only did what you had to do.
translation: 你没有选择，你不过是做你必须做的事罢了。

original: I don't know. I don't know.
translation: 我不知道。

original: Well, you'd better get out of here. I'll try to meet you at the Vault door. If I don't make it... good luck.
translation: 你最好先离开这。我会在避难所的大门口见你的，要是我没到的话……嗯，祝你好运。

original: I need to turn the power back on. Where are the reactor controls?
translation: 我得把电源重新打开，反应堆的控制台在哪？

original: Oh, well, right over there through that door. You'll have to turn on all three generators. None of 'em will take the load by themselves any more.
translation: 就在那边，穿过那道门就到了。你得把三台发电机全打开。这样每一个发电机会负荷超载。

original: Now, I'd do it myself but I'm under orders from the Overseer not to turn them back on without his say so.
translation: 我自己就可以搞定，但要是没有监督者的允许，我是不能把它们重新打开的。

original: But I don't suppose I know anything about what you might get up to.
translation: 我不知道你你要在这干嘛。

original: I wouldn't suggest going there. They don’t treat your kind very well.
translation: 我不建议去那，他们对你不会友善。

original: Ain't that the truth. Goddamn bigots! Smoothskins like to pretend we’re all feral. You bastards are always oppressing us.
translation: 那不是事实吗？死脑筋！光皮肤们总觉得我们全都是疯狂的，你们这些混蛋总是欺压我们。

original: But we're done with all that. We’re going to take that tower by force and teach ya'll a lesson.
translation: 但我们已经受够了，我们要去用暴力把大厦给夺过来，给你们好好地上一课。

original: In fact, the revolution is going to start right here and now. Start running smooth-skin!
translation: 起义就在此地此刻爆发了，光皮肤，快跑吧！

original: I wouldn’t suggest going there. They don’t treat your kind very well.
translation: 我不建议去那，他们对你不会友善。

original: You mocking me? We won't stand for your oppressive mockery any longer! You smoothskin bastards are all the same!
translation: 你在嘲笑我吗？我们再也不会忍受你的欺压和嘲笑了。你们光皮肤的滚蛋都是一样的坏！

original: You just can't stand to see a ghoul make it in this world. It's about time someone taught you some humility. Start running smooth-skin!
translation: 你们不愿意再看到这个世界上还有僵尸。是时候教教你们学习点人道精神了。光皮肤，逃跑吧！

original: More power to you.
translation: 给你更多力量。

original: It's a great place to live. But dirty Ghouls like you can't live there.
translation: 这是一个生活的好地方，但像你一样肮脏的尸鬼是不能住在那的。

original: Oh really? You goddamn bigot! You smoothskin bastards are always oppressing us.
translation: 真的吗？滚蛋！你们光皮肤总是在压迫我们。

original: But we're done with all that. So we’re going to take that tower by force and teach ya’ll a lesson.
translation: 但我们已经受够了，我们要去用暴力把大厦给夺过来，给你们好好地上一课。

original: In fact, the revolution is going to start right here and now. Start running smooth-skin!
translation: 起义就在此地此刻爆发了，光皮肤，快跑吧！

original: It's a great place to live. But filthy fucking Ghouls like you can’t live there.
translation: 这是一个生活的好地方，但像你一样肮脏的僵尸是不能住在那的。

original: Is that so? Ha! That's classic smoothskin bullshit right there.
translation: 是这样吗？这就是典型的光皮肤的废话！

original: Why is it the moment a ghoul makes something of himself, you smoothskins get all puffed up and claim responsibility?
translation: 为什么僵尸总是不能过上应得的好日子，而你们光皮肤却养尊处优的，不想为其他人负责？

original: It really busts you up to see a ghoul make it to the top, doesn’t it? I'll show you that we ghouls got what it takes. Start running smooth-skin!
translation: 你会惊讶地看到僵尸是怎么到大厦顶的，难道不是吗？我会给你看看僵尸是怎么做到这一点的，光皮肤，快跑吧！

original: Relax. I'm the one that helped get Ghouls into Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 放松，我就是那个帮僵尸进住特配尼大厦的人。

original: Um... no. <Lie.>
translation: 嗯…没有。<撒谎>

original: That tower is the symbol of Ghoul oppression.
translation: 那座大厦象征着对僵尸的压迫。

original: We sent a delegation of Ghouls to parlay with Tenpenny, and he slaughtered every last one of them in cold blood!
translation: 我们派出一个僵尸的代表团和特佩尼谈判，他却冷血地把他们都屠杀了。

original: We're done being nice! In fact, the revolution is going to start right here and now. Start running smooth-skin!
translation: 我们不再做顺民了！起义就在此地此刻爆发了，光皮肤，快跑吧！

original: Um... no. <Lie>
translation: 嗯…没有。<撒谎>

original: Ha! That's rich. We're the ones being oppressed by smoothskins like you.
translation: 哈！真有意思！我们就是被像你一样的光皮肤所压迫的对象。

original: Sure we might be angry as hell, but that’s your own damn fault for oppressing us.
translation: 我们当然是十分地愤怒，但那是由于你们对我们的压迫所造成的。

original: The revolution has begun! Start running smooth-skin!
translation: 起义开始了！光皮肤，快跑吧！

original: That’s awfully bigoted of you.
translation: 你相当固执。

original: Stevie, thank God... I... I was at Bea's, worried about the kids... the roaches...
translation: 史蒂维，谢天谢地，我在比阿特丽斯的家里，心里却担心着孩子们……那些蟑螂……

original: Geez, Mom, I don't have time for this! Why didn't you stay with Aunt Beatrice? There's important stuff going on... oh, come on. I'll take you home.
translation: 天，妈妈，我没时间做这事！为什么你不和比阿特丽斯阿姨待在一起呢？我还有重要的事情要做的……哦……我会带你回家的。

original: What do you know about Project Purity?
translation: 关于净水工程，你知道些什么？

original: Who cares? It's some hydroponics pipe dream that Li's been working on forever. Waste of time and effort, I say.
translation: 谁在乎呢？那不过是李医生水培实验的白日梦，简直就是费时费力。

original: Apparently, though, my teams cared more about it than they did about little things like defense systems or making this ship float again.
translation: 显然地，我的团队更关心的是如防御系统和怎么让这艘航母重新浮起来的事。

original: Treacherous bastards, all of them.
translation: 他们都是忘恩负义的畜生。

original: Hey, that's the mungo. Go talk to him.
translation: 就是那毛人，去和他谈谈。

original: Hey, that's the mungo. Go talk to her.
translation: 就是那毛人，去和她谈谈。

original: Practically speak robot, do you? As long as you don't write it all in ones and zeroes, then I guess it'll be fine. Thanks!
translation: 实际上就是讲讲机器人，不是吗？只要你不用以0和1组成的语言和我交流就行！

original: In fact, here: just in case you expertise fails you, a few pulse grenades, and my old science textbook. Enjoy!
translation: 实际上，如果你的专业知识不够，给：这有一些脉冲手榴弹，还有我的旧科技课本。好好享受！

original: I could just write that section for you. Trust me -- I'm an expert.
translation: 我正好可以帮你写那个章节。相信我 — 我是行家。

original: Sounds good to me.
translation: 听起来对我有利。

original: Well then, let's make a deal!
translation: 让我们做个交易！

original: Actually, let me pick another Theme.
translation: 实际上，我想换个主题。

original: Go right ahead!
translation: 继续！

original: Let me ask about something else.
translation: 我想问些其它事。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: I'm interested in the Pre-War Theme.
translation: 我对战前装饰主题感兴趣。

original: Feeling a bit nostalgic are we?
translation: 有点怀旧的感觉，对吧？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: I'm interested in the Science Theme.
translation: 我对科学装饰主题感兴趣。

original: You're the intellectual type, eh?
translation: 你是个知识份子，对吧？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: I'm interested in the Wasteland Explorer Theme.
translation: 我对探险装饰主题感兴趣。

original: Longing for the great outdoors are we?
translation: 寻求美妙的户外生活，对吧？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: I'm interested in the Raider Theme.
translation: 我对掠夺者装饰主题感兴趣。

original: Into the blood and guts look, eh?
translation: 想住在鲜血与内脏中，对吧？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: I'm interested in the Vault Theme.
translation: 我对避难所装饰主题感兴趣。

original: Feeling a bit homesick are we?
translation: 有点思乡的感觉，对吧？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: Penny, come on. Rory's a mungo. You've got to stick with your friends.
translation: 佩尼，少来了，罗瑞是个毛人，你得继续跟着你的朋友。

original: I know, I know... but he was so nice to me. I just wanted him to be safe.
translation: 我知道，我知道……但他对我太好了，我只希望他能平安无事。

original: Fine, I'll go.
translation: 好的，我会走。

original: Hey, back away from the kid.
translation: 从孩子身边滚开。

original: Quit hasslin' the merchandise.
translation: 别再搅扰这些货物了。

original: Maybe... Why don't you go for a jog and see if your head explodes.
translation: 或许吧……你何不逃跑试试，看看你的头会不会爆掉。

original: Ha ha. Real funny, mungo.
translation: 哈哈。真有趣啊，毛人。

original: So I guess you fixed it huh? Well good. Means we're one step closer to getting out of here.
translation: 看来你把它搞定了，呃？很好。意味着我们距逃离这里又近了一步。

original: Yeah, it's working. Am I done now?
translation: 没错。终端那边破解了。没我事了吧？

original: Nope. Good job on the terminal, but we're only one step of the way there.
translation: 不。搞定终端干得漂亮，但我们只是完成了第一步。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: I'm Sammy. I'm from Little Lamplight. Me and Squirrel and Penny... We aren't supposed to be here.
translation: 我是萨米，我来自小灯镇。我、“松鼠”还有佩尼原本不应该在这的。

original: We gotta get back home. You gotta help us get out of here.
translation: 我们想要回家，你把我们救出来吧。

original: Pansy! Take a shot of vitamin M and keep fighting!
translation: 娘娘腔！打一针维生素M，继续战斗！

original: It's just pain, soldier. Have some of this and tough it out.
translation: 不过是点伤痛罢了，士兵。吃点这个来克服一下。

original: Be a soldier, not a civie! Have some juice and suck it up!
translation: 你是个士兵而非平民！喝点果汁，接着上。

original: I'm searching for records from the library.
translation: 我在找图书馆的记录。

original: It seems that we have similar goals in mind. It's rare to meet someone who has proper priorities.
translation: 看来你我是志同道合了，难得能遇到一个爱国者。

original: I am Senior Scribe Yearling, Order of the Word. I have a proposal for you if you are interested.
translation: 我是资深文士伊尔琳，隶属羽之修会。如果你感兴趣的话，我有个建议。

original: Nice one, Butch!
translation: 布奇，打得好！

original: Give him another one!
translation: 再给他一下！

original: Give her another one!
translation: 再给她一下！

original: Hit him again!
translation: 继续打他！

original: Hit her again!
translation: 继续打她！

original: Primary Targets: Any and all Red Chinese invaders. Emergency Communist Acquisition Directive: Immediate Self-Destruct -- Better Dead than Red.
translation: 主要目标：所有中国红军侵略者。共产主义者入侵紧急指示：立即自爆 — 死都比被赤化好。

original: Voice module online. Audio functionality test... initialized. Designation: Liberty Prime. Mission: the Liberation of Anchorage, Alaska.
translation: 语音模块连线，音频功能测试……初始化。编号：自由先锋。任务：解放阿拉斯加安克雷奇港。

original: Head wound! Too bad you're out of morhpine.
translation: 头部受伤了！太糟了，没有吗啡了。

original: Leg wound! Without morphine, you're just going to have to suck it up.
translation: 腿部受伤了！没有吗啡了，你得自己忍着。

original: Chest wound! Don't you wish you had some vitamin M?
translation: 胸部受伤了！你不希望有点维生素M吗？

original: Arm wound! No morphine, no relief soldier.
translation: 手臂受伤了！没有吗啡了，士兵你要坚强。

original: God damn it, soldier! You're out of morphine!
translation: 见鬼，士兵！没有吗啡了！

original: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这干嘛？

original: I keep my father safe.
translation: 我在保护我父亲的安全。

original: It is... a big job.
translation: 那是……那是一个很重的任务。

original: Where do you come from?
translation: 你是从哪来的？

original: Does it matter? It only matters where I am, and that is here.
translation: 有关系吗？重要的是我现在在哪儿，我现在就在这儿。

original: I have my boy, my friends, plenty of caps, and strong drink!
translation: 我有自己的小孩、朋友、瓶盖和烈酒！

original: Why would the past matter when now is so good?
translation: 既然现在生活这么安逸还在乎过去干嘛？

original: Why are you so goddamned mean?
translation: 为什么你这么卑鄙？

original: I'm ain't mean. Not by a long shot.
translation: 我绝对不是个卑鄙的人。

original: You wanna see mean? You should've met my daddy. That son of a bitch'd cut your legs off just to laugh at you tryin' to crawl away.
translation: 你知道什么是卑鄙吗？那你应该见识一下我父亲，那畜生会把你的腿砍断，然后嘲笑着你那爬走的样子。

original: I saw him do it once too. Jus' kept laughin' at this poor bastard. After an hour or so, Daddy got bored and crushed his skull with a rock.
translation: 我曾见过他这么做过。他先是不断地耻笑着那可怜的小杂种，一小时他厌倦之后就用石头砸自己的头颅。

original: Come to think of it... that was pretty funny...
translation: 想想……很有趣是吧……

original: Pipe down, shorty. I'm going to take care of it.
translation: 静一静，矮子，我会去处理这事的。

original: What's the matter, mungo? Can't handle it?
translation: 毛人，怎么了？很棘手吗？

original: You're big enough to take care of it. Don't get all cranky with me over it.
translation: 你既然这么大了，应该可以把事情给解决的，别让我也生气。

original: Actually, never mind. I'll hang on to them.
translation: 其实，算了吧。我自己留着。

original: I can't imagine why you'd want to, but the choice is yours.
translation: 难以置信你居然想去，但选择权在你的手中。

original: Here. Take all of them.
translation: 给，把它们都带上。

original: If this is a joke, I am not amused. Justice is serious business.
translation: 要是你在开玩笑，我是不会为此而高兴的。正义是件严肃的事情。

original: Actually, I don't have any right now.
translation: 事实上，我现在一个都没有。

original: Make your jokes when the Wastes are rid of the filth that feed off of it.
translation: 当废土世界里不再有罪恶的时候才是你可以开玩笑的时候。

original: Actually, I don't have any right now.
translation: 事实上，我现在一个都没有。

original: You've done good work. Not only that, but the other Regulators have told me of your other actions in your travels.
translation: 你干得漂亮。不单单是那件事情，赏金猎人还和我说过你旅途中的其他伟绩。

original: Good deeds should not go unrewarded, and so I will add on a bonus to your normal bounty.
translation: 善有善报，我会在你的基本报酬上再加上一些额外报酬的。

original: So many of the unjust have been dispatched, but so many remain. But ever still, word reaches me that you have gone far beyond what we've asked.
translation: 许多邪恶已被铲除，但还有许多依旧逍遥法外。但我知道你所做的远比我们要求的多得多。

original: Good deeds should not go unrewarded, and so I will add on a bonus to your normal bounty.
translation: 善有善报，我会在你的基本报酬上再加上一些额外报酬的。
