original: So many of the unjust have been dispatched, but so many remain. Here is your reward. Spend it well.
translation: 许多邪恶已被铲除，还有许多依旧逍遥法外。这是你的报酬，好好花吧。

original: Your work is impressive. Here is your reward. Don't retire just yet, there is far more to be done.
translation: 你干得实在太棒了。这是给你的奖励，别懈怠，还有很多未完之事。

original: I have fingers to collect the bounty on.
translation: 我有手指来换取赏金。

original: Then you've been busy. Good. Show me what you have.
translation: 看来你最近是很忙啊，让我看看你带了些什么过来。

original: The unrighteous will fall. Let me see how many you've brought to justice.
translation: 正义终将战胜邪恶，让我看看你有多少恶人的手指。

original: What do you do with these fingers?
translation: 你要这些手指干嘛？

original: Nothing. Nothing at all. They only serve to mark the fact that justice has been done.
translation: 不用来干嘛，只是为了彰显有多少恶人已经被铲除了。

original: While we trust our members not to take innocent lives for profit, having a record of the deed is sometimes necessary.
translation: 我们相信我们的弟兄不会为了利益而残害无辜，记录他们的战绩有时候也是必须的。

original: While we don't have liars in our midst, occasionally we all.. embellish a bit.
translation: 尽管我们中间没有骗子，但有时我们说的话也会加一些修饰的。

original: Is this all of the Regulators?
translation: 这就是赏金猎人的全部人手了吗？

original: Oh, no. We're spread all around. The few here just assist me in organizing things here at the headquarters.
translation: 不是的，我们都在四处巡逻。总部里的这少数人只是帮我协调一些事情而已。

original: There are Regulators everywhere. The thing is, if you see them, then they're likely the last thing that you'll see.
translation: 赏金猎人散布在废土的各个角落，要是你见到他们，可能会被他们当场干掉。

original: What do you do?
translation: 你会怎么做？

original: We're the Regulators. We've dedicated our lives to bringing the evil to justice.
translation: 我们是赏金猎人，我们是一群可以为了让恶人绳之以法而献身的人。

original: And out in the Wasteland, there's only one brand of justice: the gun.
translation: 在废土上，正义是由枪杆子来裁决的。

original: I'm not one for causes. I just want to get paid.
translation: 我不是为正义而战的人，我只是为金钱而战的人。

original: Fair enough. We'll still take the help where we can get it.
translation: 好的，要是有人愿意帮忙我们是会很乐意接受的。

original: So, the deal is this: there are a lot of evil assholes out there. Take 'em down, bring us their fingers as proof and we'll pay you for each.
translation: 协定是这样的：有许多恶棍逍遥法外，干掉他们，然后把他们的手指带回来作为我给你赏金的依据。

original: We'll be watching you until we know you can be trusted, so don't try anything stupid.
translation: 在完全信任你之前，我们会监视着你的，所以不要干什么蠢事。

original: I'm in.
translation: 我加入。

original: Fantastic. Well, take this coat. We all wear them. The unrighteous fear the sight of the Regulators.
translation: 太好了，这是我们的制服，把它穿上，恶人们看到赏金猎人的制服都会落荒而逃的。

original: Now, as for the rest, here's the only thing we want from you: hunt down the evil, the wicked, and the villainous. Bring them to justice.
translation: 你剩下来要做的事情就是：把坏人、恶棍这些邪恶给扑灭，让他们接受正义的审判。

original: Bring us their fingers as proof of the deed. We'll pay you a bounty for each one. Simple, right? Questions?
translation: 把他们的手指带回来作为我们付你赏金的依据。就这么简单，还有什么疑问吗？

original: Yes. I want to join you.
translation: 是的。我想加入。

original: Fantastic. Take this coat. We all wear them. The unrighteous fear the sight of the Regulators.
translation: 太好了，这是我们的制服，把它穿上，恶人们看到赏金猎人的制服都会落荒而逃的。

original: Now, as for the rest, here's the only thing we want from you: hunt down the evil, the wicked, and the villainous. Bring them to justice.
translation: 你剩下来要做的事情就是：把坏人、恶棍这些邪恶给扑灭，让他们接受正义的审判。

original: Bring us their fingers as proof of the deed. We'll pay you a bounty for each one. Simple, right? Questions?
translation: 把他们的手指带回来作为我们付你赏金的依据。就这么简单，还有什么疑问吗？

original: What are the Regulators all about?
translation: 赏金猎人是做什么的呢？

original: We live to cleanse the Wasteland of the scum and evil that pollute it. We're the only thing that represents any sort of law out here.
translation: 我们是为了清除这世界上污秽罪恶而活的，我们是这唯一代表法律的人们。

original: We hunt down the worst criminals imaginable and deliver the only justice we have: a bullet.
translation: 我们制裁罪恶滔天之人只会用一种正义的武器：那就是子弹。

original: So, what do you say?
translation: 那你想说什么？

original: I don't care about your cause. I'm here for the money.
translation: 我不在乎你为何要清除恶人，我不过是为钱而来的。

original: Fair enough. We'll still take the help where we can get it.
translation: 好的，要是有人愿意帮忙我们是会很乐意接受的。

original: So, the deal is this: there are a lot of evil assholes out there. Take 'em down, bring us their fingers as proof and we'll pay you for each.
translation: 协定是这样的：有许多恶棍逍遥法外，干掉他们，然后把他们的手指带回来作为我给你赏金的依据。

original: We'll be watching you until we know you can be trusted, so don't try anything stupid.
translation: 在完全信任你之前，我们会监视着你的，所以不要干什么蠢事。

original: Actually, never mind. I'll hang on to them.
translation: 其实，算了吧。我自己留着。

original: You'll be back. They always come back.
translation: 你会回来的。猎物总会归巢的。

original: Here. Take all of them.
translation: 给，把它们都带上。

original: I would scold you for wasting our time, but I enjoy a practical joke.
translation: 本想训你浪费我时间，不过耍小聪明的样子倒让我乐呵。

original: Just don't do it again.
translation: 可别再这样了啊。

original: Actually, I don't have any right now.
translation: 事实上，我现在一个都没有。

original: And here out hopes were up. Shame on you.
translation: 白高兴一场。你真行啊。

original: Actually, I don't have any right now.
translation: 事实上，我现在一个都没有。

original: Most excellent. And you have exemplified yourself in the eyes of Littlehorn and Associates.
translation: 太棒了，现在里特宏和助手更为关注你了。

original: One with a heart as black as yours deserves to be rewarded for it. We shall include a bonus in your pay this time.
translation: 像你这样心狠手辣的人应该获得奖赏，这次你也会得到奖金的。

original: Enjoy it. Might I recommend booze? Or gambling? Or perhaps a nice chem habit?
translation: 好好花吧。是去酗酒呢？还是赌博？或者是嗑药？

original: Before our exchange, I should tell you: word has reached my ears of your black deeds in the Wastes.
translation: 在我们交易前，我得先和你说明：你在废土上的种种恶行已经传到我们的耳朵里了。

original: Acts such as yours fall in line with the goals of Littlehorn and Associates. And we believe you deserve a bonus for going that extra mile.
translation: 你的目标是和我们里特宏和助手一样的堕落。只要你更恶毒一些，奖励还会滚滚而来的。

original: Enjoy it. But by all means, do not let it stop you from walking the path that you're on.
translation: 好好享受。当然，千万别走上正道。

original: Most excellent. We love a good and loyal employee.
translation: 太好了，我们就是喜欢你这样忠诚而又强悍的雇员。

original: And, as a good and loyal employee, here is your reward.
translation: 这是给你这样忠诚而又强悍的雇员的奖励。

original: We here at Littlehorn and Associates cannot express our gratitude that your loyalty and service inspires.
translation: 我们里特宏和助手无法表达对你忠诚和付出的感激之情。

original: Here is your payment per our contract. Spend it... well.
translation: 这是约定的酬劳，尽情地花吧。

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这干嘛？

original: This is the current home office of Littlehorn and Associates. This is where we operate our little business.
translation: 这里是利特霍恩联合公司当前的总部。我们在此经营自己的小生意。

original: We dabble in this, and that. I'm sure you've seen our work around the Wasteland and haven't even realized it.
translation: 我们涉猎各种事务。我敢说，你在废土各处都见过我们的手笔，只是未曾察觉。

original: We prefer to operate quietly, which is why we employ individuals such as yourself.
translation: 我们更倾向于低调行事，所以才需要雇佣你这样的人。

original: Who are you anyway.
translation: 你到底是什么人。

original: I am Daniel Littlehorn. I offer you the currency that you crave in exchange for services aligned to your skills.
translation: 我是丹尼尔·利特霍恩。用你渴求的财富，换你擅长的服务。

original: And that, friend, is what we are to each other.
translation: 而这就是我们之间的全部关系，朋友。

original: I've been doing this a very long time, and I find that the less we know about each other, the smoother our relationship will be.
translation: 我干这行很久了，发现彼此了解越少，合作就越顺畅。

original: Why do you want ears?
translation: 为啥你要耳朵呢？

original: Now, that's the sort of question which will endanger our relationship.
translation: 好了，这种问题可是会危及我们的合作关系。

original: You are providing a service and we are providing payment. It is there our questions end. Understand?
translation: 你提供服务，我们给钱。问题到此为止。明白吗？

original: What do these people do?
translation: 这些人都是干什么的？

original: They are fellow associates such as yourself. They simply possess a different set of skills than you.
translation: 他们和你一样是同事，只不过掌握的技能不同罢了。

original: I have ears to sell you.
translation: 我有耳朵要卖给你。

original: Excellent. I had suspected that's why you came to me.
translation: 很好。我就料到你为此而来。

original: And we will happily take them in trade, friend.
translation: 我们很乐意全收了，朋友。

original: Body parts for money. I like that. Now pay me.
translation: 拿器官换钱，我喜欢这买卖。现在，付钱。

original: Oh, how we do love enthusiasm in our employees. The deal is quite simple, as you know.
translation: 啊，我们最欣赏员工的积极性了。如你所知，交易相当简单。

original: The more ears you deliver to me, the greater your coffers will grow, and the more pleased we will be with your work.
translation: 你交来的耳朵越多，你的金库就越充盈，我们之间的合作也就越融洽。

original: Now, what would you ask of us?
translation: 现在，你有什么要求要提吗？

original: Yeah, I'm here about the deal.
translation: 嗯，我是来谈买卖的。

original: Good, good. Direct. To the point. I like that in an employee. Then you understand what your purpose is.
translation: 很好，很好。直截了当。直奔主题。我就喜欢雇员有这种特质。看来你明白自己的使命了。

original: The ears of the good of the world is all I ask and currency is what you will receive.
translation: 我要的不过是世间好人的耳朵，而你将得到相应的财富。

original: And now that we understand one another, what is your business here?
translation: 既然我们已达成共识，你这次来所为何事？

original: Remind me what this deal is, again.
translation: 再和我说一下这笔交易的内容。

original: The deal is this: you are now in the employ of Littlehorn and Associates. We deal in all many of affairs, most of which are not your concern.
translation: 交易是这样的：你现在受雇于利特霍恩联合公司。我们处理各类事务，其中大部分与你无关。

original: Your duties are as follows: you will bring me the ears of the good people of the world. And in turn, I will give you the wealth you crave.
translation: 你的职责如下：你要把世上那些“好人”的耳朵带给我。作为交换，我会给予你渴望的财富。

original: The more you bring, the wealthier you will be and the happier I will be with you. That's not so hard now, is it?
translation: 你带回来的越多，你就会越富有，而我对你也会越满意。这不算太难吧，嗯？

original: Sorry. Not today.
translation: 抱歉，今天不行。

original: Aww... okay. Goodbye, Mechanist. Nice meeting you.
translation: 再见了，机械侠。

original: Aww... okay. Goodbye, AntAgonizer. Nice meeting you.
translation: 再见了，痛苦蚁后。

original: How about I give you my super suit? Would that make your day, kid?
translation: 我把我这身行头给你，怎么样？这样彼此都开心，孩子？

original: Would it ever! You're the best, Mechanist! I'll never forget this!
translation: 这样太好了！机械侠，你是最棒的！我不会忘记你的！

original: Would it ever! You're the best, AntAgonizer! I'll never forget this!
translation: 这样太好了！痛苦蚁后，你是最棒的！我不会忘记你的！

original: Autographs aren't free. I charge 10 caps for my time. No exceptions.
translation: 签名可不是免费的，每次收你10个瓶盖，绝不打折。

original: Oh, alright. I was going to use this money to buy food, but you're worth it, Mechanist!
translation: 行，我本打算这些钱去买些食物的，但你值这个价，机械侠！

original: Oh, alright. I was going to use this money to buy food, but you're worth it, AntAgonizer!
translation: 行，我本打算这些钱去买些食物的，但你值这个价，痛苦蚁后！

original: Sure, kid. Here's to my number one fan.
translation: 好的，孩子，这是给我的头号拥趸的。

original: Thanks! You're Mecha-tastic!
translation: 谢谢！你真是太伟大了！

original: Thanks! You're Ant-tastic!
translation: 谢谢！你真是太伟大了！

original: I've got to go now.
translation: 我现在得走了。

original: Sure. Good luck to you.
translation: 好的，一路顺风。

original: You guys lost?
translation: 你们迷路了吗？

original: We're trying to find this place up north called Oasis. Supposed to have a lot of good stuff to grab.
translation: 我们在寻找北边一个叫做绿洲的地方，听说那有很多好抢的东西。

original: But we ain't interested in sharing it with every dirty waster that wanders in. So now we're gonna have to kill you.
translation: 但我们可不愿有路人来坏我们的好事，现在我们得做掉你。

original: I heard arguing. What's going on?
translation: 我听你们在争吵，发生了什么？

original: We're trying to find this place up north called Oasis. Supposed to have a lot of good stuff to grab.
translation: 我们在寻找北边一个叫做绿洲的地方，听说那有很多好抢的东西。

original: But we ain't interested in sharing it with every dirty waster that wanders in. So now we're gonna have to kill you.
translation: 但我们可不愿有路人来坏我们的好事，现在我们得做掉你。

original: We're never going to find the Oasis at this point!
translation: 这样的话，我们再也没法去找绿洲了！

original: Where did Frank say it was? Damn it! We shouldn't have killed him!
translation: 弗兰克说是在哪啊？该死！早知道我们就不把他给干掉了！

original: Nuka-Cola Quantum, huh? That does sound good. How much?
translation: 量子可乐是吧？听着真不错。多少钱？

original: Only 100 caps, my friend, and a bargain at twice the price! Why, I know a lady in Girdershade who'd pay through the nose for one!
translation: 只要100瓶盖，朋友，就算翻倍都算捡漏！跟你说，我认识一个在梁影村的女士，她愿意花大价钱买一瓶！

original: Nope, I'm really not interested.
translation: 不了，我真没兴趣。

original: Suit yourself. But I can tell you, you don't know what you're missing! Nuka-Cola Quantum is considered the pinnacle of the soft drink art.
translation: 随你便。但我得说，你根本不知道错过了什么！核子可乐量子版堪称软饮艺术的巅峰之作。

original: If it's that rare, I bet it will cost an arm and a leg.
translation: 稀罕成这样，怕不是要剁手剁脚才换得来吧。

original: Nuka-Cola Quantum is worth its weight in gold. It's much better than your average Nuka-Cola... it even glows in the dark!
translation: 核子可乐量子版堪称液体黄金。比普通的核子可乐带劲多了……甚至能在黑暗里发光！

original: That sounds mighty good in this heat. What is it?
translation: 这大热天的听着真解渴。啥玩意儿啊？

original: It's called a Nuka-Cola Quantum. It's much better than your average Nuka-Cola... it even glows in the dark!
translation: 核子可乐量子版。比普通的核子可乐带劲多了……甚至能在黑暗里发光！

original: I'm kind of thirsty. Still got that Nuka-Cola Quantum for sale?
translation: 有点渴了，那量子可乐还卖不？

original: Yes, indeed, and only 100 caps! Why, I know a lady in Girdershade who'd pay through the nose for one!
translation: 必须的，只要100瓶盖！跟你说，我认识一个在梁影村的女士，她愿意花大价钱买一瓶！

original: Sydney and I have the Declaration of Independence.
translation: 我和西德尼拿到了《独立宣言》。

original: Oh my lord, I never expect... I mean, I am utterly shocked!
translation: 噢，天啊，我从没想到……我意思是，我太震惊了！

original: You two have earned your places in the annals of American History, yes indeed. You will be remembered for this great day!
translation: 你在美国历史中已经赢得一席之地了。你会和这个伟大的日子一起被铭记！

original: I will award Sydney's promised bounty to her personally. No need to worry yourself about that.
translation: 我会按照约定把奖金给希妮的，这你就不必担心了。

original: Enjoy your reward, my friend. You've earned it.
translation: 享受你的报酬吧，朋友。你应得的。

original: How do I get to the Arlington Library?
translation: 我要怎么去阿灵顿图书馆？

original: The journey will be rife with peril I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕旅途会充满危险的。

original: You cross Farmer Smith's cornfield and make your way up Greenleaf Hill. Ford your way across Quickrun Creek and make for the horse path.
translation: 你可以穿过史密斯农场的玉米地，然后攀上绿叶山。穿过快步溪，然后沿着马路走。

original: When the pines thin out, you need to make your way along the edge of Arlington. Watch out for Redcoats. They have a garrison there.
translation: 到松林尽头后你就沿着阿灵顿的边上走。要小心红衣，他们在那有驻军。

original: The building across from the fish market is the Library. Look for the old clock tower.
translation: 鱼市对面的大楼就是图书馆。你找找老钟楼。

original: Oh, I know where that is. Here, lemme punch it into your PipBoy map.
translation: 哦，我知道它在哪里。让我帮你标注到哔哔小子的地图上吧。

original: Is there anything else you can tell me about the Declaration?
translation: 有其他关于《独立宣言》的事要告诉我吗？

original: The Lee Resolution, enacted two days earlier, was the actual independence declaration.
translation: 两天前签署的“李决议”，其实是真正的《独立宣言》。

original: The Declaration itself was an expansion of that resolution for public consumption.
translation: 《独立宣言》本身是该决议的扩展，只是更易于被公众接受。

original: The Declaration of Independence wasn't fully signed by all of the delegates until August 2, 1776.
translation: 直到1776年8月2日，所有殖民地的代表才全都在《独立宣言》上面签名。

original: What else do you know about the Declaration?
translation: 关于《独立宣言》，你还知道些什么？

original: The colony of New York abstained from the Declaration and then later declared its own independence on July 9, 1776.
translation: 纽约州的殖民地没有签署《独立宣言》，1776年的7月9日它自己宣布独立。

original: Any other facts you can share about the Declaration?
translation: 你能再向我透露一些《独立宣言》的其他消息吗？

original: Although it's often pictured as if all of the delegates signed the paper in a grand meeting, the delegates often signed it in secret one at a time.
translation: 尽管我们大多人都认为是代表们在一个庄严的会议上签署文件的，其实，他们通常是在秘密的场合分别签署的。

original: What else can you tell me about the Declaration?
translation: 你对《独立宣言》还有什么可以跟我说的？

original: Please describe your original function.
translation: 说说你最初的功能吧。

original: Original function parameters are as follows. Function One: Provide tour guide services for visitors to National Archives facility.
translation: 我最初的功能如下，功能一：为来国家档案馆的参观者提供向导服务。

original: Function Two: Participate in reenactment of the signing of Declaration of Independence show as the character Button Gwinnett.
translation: 功能二：以巴顿·格温耐特的身份参与《独立宣言》的重新签署。

original: Function Three: Provide security support for National Archives facility in the event of a breach or threat to any of its assets.
translation: 功能三：为防止有人对国家档案馆的财物进行威胁或破坏而提供安保工作。

original: How did you end up in this place?
translation: 为何你会在这呢？

original: I was posted here by Thomas Jefferson after the Declaration was drafted. He said it was my duty to protect the document at all costs.
translation: 《独立宣言》起草后，托马斯·杰斐逊把我派到了这，他说我的职责就是不惜一切代价保护这份文件。

original: I spent quite a while whipping this place into shape, but with a lot of spit and polish, I think the results speak for themselves.
translation: 我花了很久来清理这，经过一番努力后，你也看到成果了。

original: I'm proud to fly the Stars and Stripes over these fortifications.
translation: 我为星条旗能在那些防御工事上飘扬而自豪。

original: I'm afraid until I know exactly what your intentions are, I can't divulge that top secret information.
translation: 恐怕你得先把你的目的告诉我，不然我无法将这最高机密泄露给你。

original: Let me ask you about something else.
translation: 我来问点其他事情吧。

original: Well okay.
translation: 好的。

original: I'd get you a damn moon rock if you pay well enough.
translation: 要是出价够高的话我会给你一个月球岩石样本的。

original: It should be pretty obvious that I have nothing of value.
translation: 很明显，我这没有什么值钱的东西。

original: All I can offer you is the same I offer the caravans that trade with me. The frequency of my radio and the promise of beautiful music.
translation: 我能给你的与我给商队提供的回报是一样的：那就是我电台的频道和美妙的音乐。

original: I think I'd rather just take the G.O.A.T. myself and take my chances.
translation: 我想我会参加G.O.A.T.，看看我的前程。

original: Good for you. Don't worry, you'll do fine. As soon as everyone's found a seat, we'll get started.
translation: 别紧张，你会做得很好的。你找到位子坐下后，我们就开始测验。

original: Cool. Let me see the results and I'll fill it out myself.
translation: 让我看看答案，我自己填。

original: Well... all right. Here, take a look.
translation: 嗯…好吧。给，看吧。

original: Sure, I'm ready. I bet I'll ace it!
translation: 我准备好了，我想我会做得很好的！

original: I'm sure you will. Especially since it's multiple choice with no wrong answers...
translation: 我想你没问题的，特别对于这些没有对错标准的选择题……

original: We'll start as soon as everyone's found a seat. Good luck.
translation: 各位找到位子后我们就开始，祝你们好运。

original: Come on. I don't really have to take this stupid test, do I?
translation: 拜托。我不是真要接受这愚蠢的测验吧？

original: Listen. I like your dad. I might even like you if I wasn't your teacher.
translation: 听着，我喜欢你的父亲，要不是我是你的老师的话我也会喜欢你的。

original: So here's what I'm going to do. If you want to skip the test, just tell me how you want it to come out and I'll take care of it for you.
translation: 要是你不想参加测验，你直接跟我说你想做什么，我帮你把测试的事情给搞定。

original: Ohh... I'm feeling kind of sick, Mister B. Guess I'll have to reschedule...
translation: 先生，我有些不舒服。我想我的测试可能得延后了……

original: Didn't work on your dad either, did it?
translation: 就算搬出你父亲也没用的，不是吗？

original: Now unless you have something else you want to discuss, take a seat and prepare for the 2274 edition of the G.O.A.T.
translation: 现在除非你还有其他的事情要跟我说，不然你就找个位子坐下来参加2274年度的G.O.A.T.。

original: Oh, just wonderful. Thanks for asking.
translation: 哦，很好呢。多谢关心。

original: Dear, I live in Tenpenny Tower. I'm at the top of the world. He he he he.
translation: 我住在特佩尼大厦，我住在世界的巅峰。哈哈哈！

original: I'm quite well, thank you.
translation: 我很好，多谢。

original: Splendid. Simply splendid. Thanks so much for asking.
translation: 壮观，太壮观！多谢你的关心。

original: I'd be better if I could get my hands on some caviar, but what can you do? Ha ha ha ha ha.
translation: 要是我能吃到鱼子酱就好了，但你能做什么呢？哈哈哈哈。

original: I broke a promise to someone and I'd like to buy back the violin for 300 caps.
translation: 我没办法兑现对某人的诺言，我想用300个瓶盖把小提琴买回来。

original: It takes moxie to admit you've done something wrong. I admire that.
translation: 承认错误是得需要很大勇气的，这个我很钦佩。

original: I'd be glad to sell it back to you. Here you go.
translation: 我很高兴把它卖回给你，拿去吧。

original: It takes moxie to admit you've done something wrong. I admire that.
translation: 承认错误是得需要很大勇气的，这个我很钦佩。

original: I'd be glad to sell it back to you, but you don't seem to have enough caps. Come back when you do.
translation: 我很乐意再把它卖给你，但你的钱似乎不够，等够了再回来吧。

original: I've had a change of heart, Agatha. Here's your violin.
translation: 阿加莎，我改变主意了，小提琴给你。

original: You actually got it back. I didn't think you'd bother after that stunt you pulled.
translation: 你居然真的把它给找回来了！我以为，你做了错事之后就不会再补救了。

original: It's like holding a piece of history in the palm of my hands. Amazing, simply amazing.
translation: 就像是把一段历史握在了手中一样，这太妙了，实在太美妙了！

original: It may have been like pulling teeth, but at least you finally brought me the thing. Still, I'm lacking a suitable reward for what you've done.
translation: 那就像拔牙一样的艰难，但你最终还是把它带回来给我了。看我真是没什么好的东西作为给你的奖励。

original: All I can give you is the frequency to my radio set. Tune in whenever you feel like listening to the strains of an old woman's violin playing.
translation: 我所能给你的就是一个电台频率。无论何时你想听的时候就调到这频率，来收听一个老妇人的小提琴演奏。

original: You son of a bitch! You know what that thing meant to me!
translation: 你这混蛋！你知道这东西对我意味着什么！

original: It was a family heirloom. It belonged rightfully in the hands of a musician, someone to appreciate its value, not to exploit it!
translation: 这是传家宝。它要托付给一个合适的人、一个音乐家，一个能够赏识它的价值的人，而不是拿它去换钱！

original: I can't believe you'd stab an old woman in the back like this! Get out! GET OUT OF HERE THIS INSTANT!
translation: 我真不敢相信你会如此伤害一个老妇人！滚！立刻滚出去！

original: I just wanted to let you know I sold the Stradivarius to someone else.
translation: 我只想让你知道，我把斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴卖给了别人。

original: Look, Burke. I... I don't care how you got past the others. I could... I could have you torn apart in an instant, with a snap of my fingers!
translation: 伯克，我…我不管别人是怎么对付你的，但我……我动一动手指就能把你给捏死。

original: Is that so? Do it then, Phillips. Set you feral pets upon me. I could use a bit of sport. After I’ve dealt with them, I'll turn my attention to you.
translation: 是那样吗？菲利普斯，那就动手吧，让你疯狂的宠物冲着我来吧，正好我能热热身。等我把他们给处理完之后，我就来对付你了。

original: After all, you've destroyed my home, murdered my employer. I’ve something of a score to settle, wouldn't you say?
translation: 你把我的家园给毁了，还杀了我的雇主。这笔帐我得给你好好的算一算了！

original: Hey, now, come on... The old man got what he had coming… Look, maybe we can work something out. You said you just have some... business to conclude?
translation: 嘿，来吧……他老人家弄到他想要的了？我们会搞出点名堂来的。你刚才说你点事情要了断？

original: Correct. You and your friends may have killed Tenpenny, but the man gave me a task, and I intend to complete it.
translation: 没错，你和你的朋友把特佩尼给杀死了，但我还是会完成他交给我的任务的……

original: There's a detonator on the balcony. When that switch is activated, the bomb at the center of Megaton goes... boom. THAT will conclude my business.
translation: 阳台上有个引爆器，只要轻轻地一按开关，在兆吨镇中心的核弹就会……轰的一声，然后一切就完结了。

original: Holy shit, you're gonna blow up Megaton? No lie? Look Burke… if you're about to burn down that smoothskin shithole, I ain't gonna stop ya.
translation: 他妈的，你居然要炸掉兆吨镇？没骗人吧？伯克，你说你要把光皮肤的老巢给炸掉？我是不会阻止你的。

original: In fact, I... Well, I think it's fair to say you'd be quite welcome around here. So what do you say? You do your thing and we let bygones by bygones.
translation: 说实在的，我觉得…其实…你在这是很受欢迎的，你做你该做的事情，让过去的事成为过去吧。

original: All right. Water under the bridge, then. Truth be told, I'm a firm believer in natural selection. What you people did here was... inspired.
translation: 好吧，既然覆水难收，那我实话和你说吧，我坚定地相信物竞天择，你所做的是……很有创意的。

original: All right then, Burke... er... Mister Burke. I’ll let you get to it. And, um, thanks for your... understanding.
translation: 好吧，伯克先生。你会让你去做的。并且，嗯，多谢你的…理解。

original: It's none of your business.
translation: 这不关你的事。

original: I'm sorry I asked. And I'm not just saying that -- I shouldn't have pried.
translation: 我很抱歉我这么问。我并不是要这么说，而且我也不是想要打听什么。

original: But it doesn't matter. I can help you escape. I have my own plan!
translation: 但是无所谓了。我可以帮助你逃跑，我有我的计划！

original: <whine>
translation: <哀鸣声>

original: I think it's time for us to say goodbye, old buddy. Take care of yourself, okay?
translation: 老兄，我们该说再见了。好好照顾你自己，好吗？

original: Fuck that. Do your own dirty work.
translation: 他妈的，做你的脏活就好。

original: Jericho, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 耶利哥，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

original: I’m sorry, my companion, but no. We all have our own destinies, and yours culminates here. I would not rob you of that.
translation: 抱歉，我们各有自己的命运，今天是你的终点，我不想改变你的命运。

original: Fawkes, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 福克斯，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

original: Soldier, you ought to be ashamed of yourself. This is your fight! You gotta finish what your daddy started! Stand strong and get your ass in there!
translation: 士兵，你应该为自己感到羞耻，这是你的战斗！你应该完成父亲未完的使命，坚强地爬起来战斗吧！

original: Emergency directive, sergeant. Go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 紧急指示，中士。进入房间开启净化器。

original: Honey, you are out of your mind if you think I'm going in there. Find yourself another guinea pig.
translation: 亲爱的，要是你认为我会去那的话你就真是疯了，你重新找个实验品吧。

original: Clover, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 可萝尔，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

original: My friend... It's been my pleasure accompanying you, but we both know this is your fight to finish. Stay strong, and honor your father's memory.
translation: 很乐意能与你为伴，但我们都知道这是你的战斗，继承你父亲的遗志坚强地战斗下去吧。

original: Star Paladin Cross, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 星骑士 克罗丝，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

original: That chamber? Right there? With all the radiation? Man, no way. I'll end up dead. Or worse. I could be one of them Ghouls! Ain't gonna happen.
translation: 你说那充满着高辐射的房间吗？没门，我会死掉的，或者是变成僵尸！我是不会去的！

original: Butch, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 布奇，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

original: You and I both know that's not going to happen. I've saved your sorry ass enough. This one's all you.
translation: 我对你已经仁至义尽了，这次我不会帮你了。

original: Charon, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
translation: 卡戎，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

original: Sorry kid. You're on your own.
translation: 抱歉了，你得自力更生了。

original: Thanks for nothing, mungo.
translation: 谢谢你什么也没干，毛人。

original: Let me think about it.
translation: 让我想想。

original: Think about it? Come on, mungo. You can do it.
translation: 还需要考虑？拜托，毛人。你办得到。

original: Well I'm gonna hang out here until you make up your stupid mind.
translation: 在你决定前我会在这等着的。

original: I'll get you kids out of here.
translation: 我会把你们这些小鬼救出来的。

original: You're okay for a mungo. Squirrel and Penny are still stuck inside. You need to get the key to the slave pen to get 'em out.
translation: 作为毛人你很不错。“松鼠”和佩尼还被关在里面，你得找到围栏的钥匙来把他们放出来。

original: That Forty asshole has one, and so does the boss guy, Eulogy. Go get 'em!
translation: 弗替和老板尤勒基都有钥匙，把它给弄过来吧！

original: Why is this my problem? In case you hadn't noticed, I've already got problems.
translation: 这怎么会是我的问题呢？我早就有自己的问题了。

original: I just thought maybe you could do something, since they're all gonna shoot you anyway.
translation: 我想你得做点什么吧，因为他们无论如何都会射杀你的。

original: Squirrel and Penny are still stuck in there, and none of us can leave while they got these collars turned on.
translation: “松鼠”和佩尼还在那的，要是奴隶项圈没有关闭我的话我们都逃不掉的。

original: If you can get the slave pen open, Squirrel and Penny can make a run for it, and we can get out of here. What do you say?
translation: 要是你能把奴隶围栏的门给打开，“松鼠”和佩尼就能出来了，这样我们都能逃离这了。这计划怎么样？

original: Sure, what can I do to help, kid?
translation: 好的，我能帮上什么忙，孩子？

original: This collar. It's gotta get turned off, or else I can't get out of here. You saw what happened to that other guy.
translation: 这项圈，要是不把它给关闭的话我是无法逃走的，你也看到外面那逃跑的人的下场了吧。

original: And then Squirrel and Penny... They're still inside, locked in the cage. You gotta get them out too.
translation: “松鼠”和佩尼还被关在里面，你得把他们也给救出来才行。

original: No way the slavers are gonna let them walk out, so you're gonna have to bust them out. Think you can handle it?
translation: 奴隶贩子是不会眼睁睁地看着我们走出去的，所以你得把他们都给干掉，能办到吗？

original: You're already out. Can't you just run home from here?
translation: 你们已经出来，可以自己回家吗？

original: You saw what happened to that other guy. Same thing'd happen to me if I try to run away now.
translation: 你也看到外面那逃跑的人的下场了吧，要是我们试图逃跑的话会和他一样的。

original: Collar would pop my head right off. And besides, I don't wanna leave without Squirrel and Penny.
translation: 项圈能把我的头立刻炸爆，而且我不想丢下“松鼠”和佩尼。

original: I'll hide out here. Can you go in and get them?
translation: 我会躲在这的，你能潜进去把他们给救出来吗？

original: If she won't go, maybe it's time to leave her behind. You can't save everyone.
translation: 要是她实在不想走的话就让她留着。你不会救得了每个人。

original: Yeah, maybe you're right. Me and Sammy can leave, at least.
translation: 或许你说得对，至少我和萨米能逃出去。

original: All right, we're outta here. See you on the outside, mungo.
translation: 好的，我们要逃了，外面见，毛人。

original: Sorry, I didn't mean to bother you.
translation: 不好意思打扰了。

original: Whatever. Get the hell out of here.
translation: 不管怎么说，从这破地方出去吧。

original: Any vault resident seen associating with the so-called "Rebels" will be detained, questioned, and disciplined appropriately.
translation: 任何避难所的居民被看到与所谓的反叛者有牵连的话，都会被拘留、询问并受到适度的惩罚。

original: Order WILL be restored. Discipline WILL be restored. Vault security personnel have been authorized to use deadly force if necessary.
translation: 秩序将会恢复，纪律将会重建。避难所的警卫人员已授权在必要情况下可以使用致命的武力。

original: Don't let it come to that. This vault will be one big, happy family again. One way or another.
translation: 不要走到那一步。避难所应该是一个快乐的大家庭，无论如何实现。

original: Any vault resident seen associating with the so-called "Rebels" will be detained, questioned, and disciplined appropriately.
translation: 任何避难所的居民被看到与所谓的反叛者有牵连的话，都会被拘留、询问并受到适度的惩罚。

original: Order WILL be restored. Discipline WILL be restored. Vault security personnel have been authorized to use deadly force if necessary.
translation: 秩序将会恢复，纪律将会重建。避难所的警卫人员已授权在必要情况下可以使用致命的武力。

original: Don't let it come to that. Haven't you always been happy? Haven't we always been a… a family?
translation: 不要走到那一步，你们不是一直都快乐吗？我们不是一直都是个大家庭吗？

original: Amata... Stop this madness. You're disrupting everyone's life, everyone's happiness. Come home. Just… come home.
translation: 阿玛塔…别疯了。你是在危害别人的生命和幸福啊。回家吧，快回家吧。

original: And everything can be the way it was.
translation: 一切将回复原貌。

original: This is the Overseer.
translation: 我是监督者。

original: All residents of Vault 101 are hereby confined to their quarters.
translation: 101号避难所里所有的居民的都被禁闭到他们的房间里面了。

original: The Radroach infestation is under control. Do NOT interfere with vault security personnel.
translation: 蟑螂的侵扰已经被控制住了，不要干扰避难所的警卫人员。

original: Any resident found outside his or her quarters will be dealt with. Severely.
translation: 任何离开自己房间的居民将受到严惩，我可是认真的。

original: That is all.
translation: 就这样。

original: Liberty Prime is online. All systems nominal. Weapons hot. Mission: the destruction of any and all Chinese communists.
translation: 自由先锋启动，所有系统正常，武器准备就绪，目标：消灭所有的中国共产党。

original: If you don't activate the purifier right now, you're all going to die!
translation: 要是你不把净化器打开，你们全都得死！

original: Why haven't you started the purifier? Please, do it now!
translation: 为何你还不把净化器给打开呢？快！

original: You only have about a minute left! Please hurry!
translation: 你只有一分钟逃离的时间！赶快！

original: If you're still there, the purifier needs to be activated NOW! You don't have much time left!
translation: 你怎么还在那？净化器必须立刻激活！你的时间不多了！

original: Wait! What about Arefu? You can't just prey on them anytime you're hungry!
translation: 等一下！断桥镇怎么办？你们总不能一饿了就去捕食他们吧！

original: You wish to arrive at some sort of a bargain?
translation: 你想达成某种协议吗？

original: Charon, you think you could retrieve the G.E.C.K. for me?
translation: 卡戎，你可以帮我把伊甸园创造器取回来吗？

original: The contract entitles you to my services in combat. I'm nobody's errand boy. I'm afraid you'll have to get it yourself.
translation: 契约上面说只须帮你战斗，我不是任你差遣的仆人，恐怕你得自己去取吧。

original: Okay, it's just you and me now. Take it slow, keep your eyes peeled, and let's head for the control room.
translation: 行，现在只有你和我了。慢点走，提高警惕，向控制室进发。

original: All right, this is it. Stay sharp, and we'll have this thing under control in no time.
translation: 好，就在这了。保持警惕，我们很快就会把事给搞定了。

original: Butch, stop it! Leave him alone!
translation: 布奇，住手！离他远点！

original: Butch, stop it! Leave her alone!
translation: 布奇，住手！离她远点！

original: Please! Stop fighting!
translation: 请不要再打了！

original: Stop it!
translation: 停手！

original: This isn't solving anything!
translation: 这解决不了任何问题的！

original: You seem like a nice woman. Let me get that violin for you.
translation: 你是一个善良的老妇人，我去帮你把小提琴带回来吧。

original: Well, that's just so sweet of you!
translation: 你实在是太好了！

original: I feel bad sending you off with nothing like this.
translation: 什么都不给你就让你上路，也不太好吧。

original: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
translation: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。

original: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
translation: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。

original: If only you had something to help keep me safe, my little honey bee...
translation: 如果你有能让我安全一点的办法，我亲爱的……

original: Oh my! I didn't know I still had the looks.
translation: 天啊！我不知道我容颜依旧。

original: Well, you just made my day you sweet thing! Let me give you something extra to help you on your way.
translation: 你让我这一天都很快乐！我再给你一些路上用得到的东西吧。

original: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
translation: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。

original: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
translation: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。

original: Old lady alone, huh? Got anything valuable around?
translation: 孤身老婆婆吗？有值钱的东西没？

original: Watch the sass, captain sassy-pants!
translation: 真没礼貌！

original: I can still hold my own if I have to. My husband made me learn a thing or two about how to defend myself.
translation: 如果必要，我还能保护自己。我丈夫生前教会了我一些自卫的方法。

original: Besides, I have a caravan come through here about once a week. They'd miss me if I was gone.
translation: 而且商队每周都会到我这来，要是我死了他们会想念我的。

original: So what's your take on this whole situation?
translation: 对于这一切，你有什么想法？

original: Ah, human problems for human hearts. I don't trouble myself with such petty affairs. My work is my life! And as you can see, I've been quite busy...
translation: 不关我的事，我不会让自己惹上这些麻烦的。工作就是我的生命！而且你也看到了，我现在很忙……

original: If you're the new doctor, can you heal me?
translation: 要是你是新来的医生的话，可以把我治好吗？

original: Um, actually... no. I'm afraid I've been... What's the human term? Ah yes. "Fired."
translation: 实际上……不。恐怕我被……如果是人类会怎么说呢？想到了，“炒鱿鱼”了。

original: I've been reassigned to cleaning detail. My first duty is, somewhat ironically, cleaning the clinic! Ah, but surgery was fun while it lasted...
translation: 我被重新安排了清理工作。我现在的首要职责是清理诊所，很讽刺吧！但做外科医生真的很有趣……

original: Wait... they made you the doctor?
translation: 等一下……他们让你做医生？

original: But of course! With your father's departure from the vault, and Jonas's untimely demise, the Overseer had to take swift action!
translation: 当然！你父亲离开了避难所，而乔纳斯最终还是死了，监督者不得不随机应变。

original: And so he named me the new vault medical practitioner! A marvelous decision, if I do say so myself! I am fully equipped, after all.
translation: 于是他让我当避难所的新医生！要让我说的话，这是一个了不起的决定！毕竟我是身怀绝技的。

original: Andy, what happened? All this blood...
translation: 发生什么事了？这摊血……

original: Ah, yes. A rather unfortunate incident. In all the commotion, Miss Beatrice suffered from a rather bad sprain in her left toe. The big one.
translation: 一个不幸的意外事故。比阿特丽斯小姐扭伤了左脚脚趾。大脚趾。

original: Obviously, I had no choice but to amputate. The leg. I'm sorry to say the operation was not a success.
translation: 显然，我不得不截肢，她的腿。但很遗憾，手术不成功。

original: I'm sorry, Agatha. I couldn't find the violin in Vault 92. <Lie.>
translation: 不好意思，阿加莎。但是我在92号避难所里没有发现小提琴。<撒谎>

original: I... I was afraid this was a possibility. The information I had received was sketchy at best.
translation: 我…我想有这可能。我得到的信息的确很含糊。

original: Oh well. Perhaps this is a sign that I wasn't meant to follow in my ancestor's footsteps.
translation: 好啊。或许这是一个我不用再追随我先辈足迹的征兆。

original: One day maybe I'll return to playing, or perhaps not. Either way, I thank you for your efforts.
translation: 未来某天我可能会去演奏，也可能不会。无论如何，我还是要感谢你所做的努力。

original: No, thanks.
translation: 不了，谢谢。

original: Okay, then.
translation: 那好吧。

original: Okay, then.
translation: 那好吧。

original: Very good, madam.
translation: 很好，女士。

original: Very good, sir.
translation: 好的，老爷。

original: Okay, then.
translation: 那好吧。

original: Oh. Sorry... there's not really anything I can do. I have to make money, you know.
translation: 哦。对不起，我帮不上忙。我也必须赚钱啊，对吧。

original: Actually, I don't have 120 caps.
translation: 其实，我没有120个瓶盖。

original: Ok, it's right over there. Middle room.
translation: 好的，就在那里。中间的房间。

original: 120 Caps sounds good to me.
translation: 对我来说，120个瓶盖挺划算的。

original: Well, you aren't gonna get very far with no money.
translation: 没钱就别毛手毛脚的。

original: Actually, I don't have 120 caps.
translation: 其实，我没有120个瓶盖。

original: Right at the top of the stairs, honey. That's your room.
translation: 就在楼梯上面，亲爱的。那是你的房间。

original: 120 Caps sounds good to me.
translation: 对我来说，120个瓶盖挺划算的。

original: Right at the top of the stairs, honey. The room with the big bed.
translation: 就在楼梯上面，亲爱的。有大床的那间。

original: 120 Caps sounds good to me.
translation: 对我来说，120个瓶盖挺划算的。

original: A regretable error on your part. We will be happy to service you when you have the necessary funds.
translation: 你会后悔的。等你有钱了，我们会很乐意为你服务的。

original: Actually, I don't have 120 caps.
translation: 其实，我没有120个瓶盖。

original: Excellent. Simply venture into the hallway, turn left, first door on your left. That is your room.
translation: 太棒了。去走廊，左转，左手边的一间房间就是你的了。

original: Sounds like a fair price. I'll take it.
translation: 听起来价钱公道，我接受。

original: Well, when you do, you know where to find me.
translation: 你要是想的话，就来找我。

original: Actually, I don't have 120 caps.
translation: 其实，我没有120个瓶盖。

original: That sounds like a deal. Out in the hallway, turn left, first door on your left. That's your room.
translation: 这交易听起来不错，穿过走廊，左转，你左手边的一间房间就是你的了。

original: 120 Caps sounds good to me.
translation: 对我来说，120个瓶盖挺划算的。

original: How much for a room?
translation: 一间房多少钱？

original: Huh? Oh... 120 caps... I guess.
translation: 120瓶盖吧，呃，差不多……

original: Since Colin's not running the show anymore, it's just the room now. 120 caps. Up front.
translation: 科林不再搞演出了，只算房钱。120个瓶盖，先付款。

original: Well... for you? A room and some company will run you 120 caps. Up front.
translation: 嗯……你要吗？一间房间一个伴，收你120个瓶盖，先付款。

original: A mere 120 caps.
translation: 120个瓶盖而已。

original: Only 120 caps. You won't get a better deal than that.
translation: 120个瓶盖而已，你不会再遇到这么好的价钱了。

original: Despite what you put me through, I'm trying to make the best of it.
translation: 不管你做了些什么，我都会尽全力去把这个事情做得最好。

original: Someday I'll find a way to make it up to you. I promise.
translation: 我会好好弥补你的，我发誓。

original: Let's finish our work so that we can do some good together.
translation: 我们还是先做完手头上的工作吧，还有许多美好的东西等着我们以后慢慢去想呢。

original: Well, you taught me everything I know.
translation: 你教我的这些我都会。

original: As much as I'd like to, I can't take all the credit. You're the one making the choices. I'm glad to see they've been good ones.
translation: 我想我不能独享全部的功劳，你是决策者，我很感谢你做出了明智的选择。

original: You make me very proud.
translation: 你让我感到很骄傲。

original: Look at me, getting all sentimental. There's time for that when our work is done.
translation: 我怎么了，这么多愁善感的。等到工作完成之后再感伤吧。

original: I'm just trying to find a place for myself out here.
translation: 我在找一个安身之所。

original: Life out here is so different from the Vault. You know it's something I never wanted you to face.
translation: 避难所外面的世界与这完全地不一样，我不想让你去面对它。

original: I'm glad to see it hasn't changed who you are. There aren't many who can say that about themselves.
translation: 看到你没有改变自己的立场，我很高兴，没有几个人可以做到这一点的。

original: Thanks, Dad. That means a lot.
translation: 谢谢，父亲。这对我来说很重要。

original: I didn't want you to think I hadn't noticed. You've had to deal with so much... We all have.
translation: 我不想让你以为我是个冷漠的人，你确实是经历了许多的风风雨雨……我们都是。

original: Once we're done here, you can tell me all about it. For now, let's get to work.
translation: 我们完成之后，你可以向我说说你的故事。现在，还是先开始工作吧。

original: I'm just trying to survive out here. I do whatever I have to.
translation: 我只是在努力生存下去，我做一切我该做的事情。

original: I know. We all do what we have to.
translation: 我明白，我们都有自己的路要走。

original: But don't compromise who you are. It's in your power to be a good person, to do the right thing. Just please keep that in mind.
translation: 不要轻易妥协，你可以做好人，做好事。你要牢记这点。

original: We can talk more later. Let's get back to work.
translation: 我们以后再详谈吧，现在先回去工作。

original: Because you're such a saint yourself, right?
translation: 难道你就是个圣人吗？

original: This isn't about me, or the choices I've made. We're talking about you.
translation: 我不是，也不想成为圣人。我们在讨论的是你，而不是我。

original: Whatever life you make for yourself out here, it's in your power to make it a good one. I just don't want to see you go down the wrong path.
translation: 离开这里之后，无论以后会发生什么，你都要好自为之，我不希望看到你走上歪道。

original: But maybe this isn't the best time to have this talk. Once we're done here, then we can work it out together. Let's just get through this.
translation: 或许现在不是谈论这些的时间，我们动手吧，还有很多事等着我们去做呢。

original: I'm in the real world now. I can be whoever I want, do whatever I want.
translation: 我现在是在真实的世界里面，我想做什么人，干什么事情，都是我自己的事情。

original: This place, this Wasteland... it's no more real than the Vault. You're still responsible for your actions.
translation: 废土世界和避难所一样…都是不真实的，你需要对自己的一切负责。

original: Those actions can come back to haunt you in ways you never expect. Please just keep that in mind.
translation: 无论你在不在乎，你所做的一切都会深刻在你的心头，记住我说的这句话。

original: Whatever happens, know that I'll always love you.
translation: 无论发生什么，孩子，我都会永远爱你的。

original: Well, enough of a lecture for now. Let's get back to work.
translation: 就说这么多吧，回去工作了。

original: I've done some things I'm not proud of, but I'm trying to do better.
translation: 我所做的这一切都没什么好骄傲的，但我还是希望能做到更好。

original: I know that you're a good person. Whatever's going on, I know you'll make the best of it.
translation: 我知道你是个好人。不管发生什么，我知道你都会做到最好的。

original: Let's get through this, and then I'll help you in whatever way I can. I'm here for you.
translation: 是时候结束这一切了，我会尽我所能帮你的，这就是我在这里出现的原因。

original: What do you care?
translation: 你在乎的是什么呢？

original: I just wanted to say that I'm very proud of you. That's all.
translation: 我想说的就是 — 我为你骄傲。

original: Let's get back to work, then.
translation: 让我们回去工作中吧。

original: Sure, I did it. But only because it paid well.
translation: 行，我干，只要价钱合适。

original: I see. You did a good thing, but I'm not sure I approve of your motives.
translation: 你做得很好，但你的动机我却不赞同。

original: Perhaps we can discuss it more later. We have a lot of work to do now.
translation: 或许我们迟点再谈，现在我们还有许多工作要做。

original: Yes, I disarmed the bomb.
translation: 我把核弹给拆除了。

original: I'm very proud of you, even though you put yourself in harm's way.
translation: 我为你感到骄傲，尽管你用了暴力的手段。

original: Just please be careful out there. This is a dangerous world; far more dangerous than anyone in that Vault knows.
translation: 出去之后万事要小心，这世界很危险，比避难所要危险得多了。

original: Look, it's complicated. I'm not proud of it, but it needed to be done.
translation: 它太复杂了，而且我一点也没有自豪感，但我还是会去做的。

original: Something like that never needs to be done. I can't begin to tell you how disappointed I am in you.
translation: 那些事情是不应该去做的，我无法形容我对你的失望之情。

original: There's work to be done now, but I want to talk to you about this later.
translation: 有些工作现在就得完成，但我希望过后再和你谈这件事。

original: What I do in the world is my business, not yours.
translation: 我做什么是我的事，与你无关。

original: What you do in the world may be your business, but here, with me, you are MY son.
translation: 你做什么是你的事，但在我面前就关我的事，你是我的儿子！

original: I can't begin to tell you how disappointed I am. That goes against everything I ever taught you.
translation: 我对你失望至极了，你所做的完全违背了我的初衷。

original: I want to talk more about this later. For now, let's just focus on our work.
translation: 这些事我们还是过后再说，现在还是专心工作吧。

original: Nope. Nothing to do with me. <Lie.>
translation: 不，这些事情和我没有关系。<撒谎>

original: I didn't think so. You couldn't possibly do something like that.
translation: 我一直以来都不相信你会做这样的事情。

original: Honestly, I have a hard time believing you. I raised you to be better than that... Better than the Wastes.
translation: 实话说。我很难相信你的话。我把你带大是想让你成为个更好的人……比废土所有人都高尚。

original: We'll talk more about this later. There's too much work to be done now to let this get in the way.
translation: 这些事我们还是过后再说，现在还是专心工作吧。

original: I certainly hope not. It's not how I raised you.
translation: 我当然希望事情不是这样，这不是我养大你的目的。

original: Oh, so now the father who walked out on me is going to give me a lecture?
translation: 这么说你是来给我讲大道理了？

original: What I did can't even compare to such a thing.
translation: 我所做的其他事情都没有这件事情重要。

original: All those people...
translation: 那些人……

original: You're still my son, and I love you, but I can't begin to tell you how disappointed in you I am.
translation: 你依旧是我的儿子，我依然爱着你，但我无法形容我对你的失望之情。

original: We'll talk more about this when there's time. Right now we have work to do.
translation: 有时间的话我们再谈吧，现在还是工作重要。

original: What I did can't even compare to such a thing.
translation: 我所做的其他事情都没有这件事情重要。

original: All those people...
translation: 那些人……

original: You're still my daughter, and I love you, but I can't begin to tell you how disappointed in you I am.
translation: 你依旧是我的女儿，我依然爱着你，但我无法形容我对你的失望之情。

original: We'll talk more about this when there's time. Right now we have work to do.
translation: 有时间的话我们再谈吧，现在还是工作重要。

original: Human must not steal its secrets.
translation: 决不能让人类窃取到这机密。

original: Death to humans, life to us!
translation: 人类会死亡，而我们会活下去的！

original: More failures mean more meat.
translation: 失误越多，人肉越多。

original: Failures mean more work.
translation: 失误越多，工作越多。

original: Fox likes Humans. We should kill him.
translation: 福克斯太像人类了，我们应该杀死他。

original: Then Fox should die.
translation: 那福克斯就该去死。

original: Find the Human and kill him!
translation: 找个人类来杀掉！

original: Rip the Human limb from limb!
translation: 把人类的四肢给割下来。

original: Human means fresh meat!
translation: 人类就是新鲜的肉！

original: Find the Human and make him one of us!
translation: 找个人类来，让他变成我们这样！

original: Human can't go to top place. Human will die.
translation: 人类不能当霸主。人类会灭亡的。

original: Top place make Human very sick. Not good to eat.
translation: 当了霸主人类就生病，变得难吃。

original: Waste of time.
translation: 浪费时间。

original: Only fun to shoot at.
translation: 开枪才有趣。

original: They make me laugh. So small. Ha ha ha.
translation: 他们让我发笑，哈哈。他们好小。

original: He come to kill us and take the birth stuff.
translation: 他是来杀我们，再拿走出生的东西。

original: Human? Chance to make us another.
translation: 人类？有机会再造一个了。

original: I wish stupid Fox would shut up.
translation: 我希望愚蠢的福克斯可以闭嘴。

original: He is a failure.
translation: 他是输家。

original: Stuff hard to find.
translation: 难找的东西。

original: Human comes to steal stuff. Kill the Human!
translation: 人类来偷东西，把他干掉！

original: Hey, that's good! I was just going to say, "Noah place where I can get some food?"
translation: 太棒了！我想说的是：“哪儿能找到食物呀？”

original: Noah place where you can get some better jokes?
translation: 哪儿能找到更好玩的笑话呀？

original: Noah place where I can get some food?
translation: 哪儿能找到食物呀？

original: I refuse to play along.
translation: 我拒绝玩下去。

original: No it isn't. It's Noah!
translation: 不是。是娜儿！

original: This is stupid.
translation: 真是愚蠢。

original: Noah place where I can get some food?
translation: 哪儿能找到食物呀？

original: Noah who?
translation: 娜儿什么？

original: Who's there?
translation: 谁啊？

original: Noah!
translation: 娜儿！

original: Who's there?
translation: 谁在那儿？

original: As I thought. Now, give me the Mechanist's suit!
translation: 把你的机械侠的套装给我，就现在！

original: My apologies, Ant Queen. Please, continue.
translation: 我道歉，痛苦蚁后。请继续。

original: Quite all right. Now, give me the AntAgonizer's suit, so that its evil may not fall into the wrong hands!
translation: 把痛苦蚁后的套装给我，现在就给我！以免它落到心怀叵测的人手中！

original: My mistake. Never mind.
translation: 我的错，别介意。

original: Wait. First, let's talk about what you've been doing.
translation: 先等等，我还不知道你是在干嘛。

original: You would dare to tell the AntAgonizer to wait? No human commands the Ant Queen!
translation: 你居然敢让痛苦蚁后等？蚁后是不会听人类的命令的！

original: But as you have defeated my nemesis, I will allow you to talk. Quickly.
translation: 但既然你帮我除掉了敌人，我会和你谈谈的。快说吧。

original: Wait. First, let's talk about what you've been doing.
translation: 先等等，我还不知道你是在干嘛。

original: Quickly, then! Evil never pauses to contemplate its actions, so I see little reason that we should, either.
translation: 赶快！恶人是不会三思而后行的，我们也没必要犹豫什么。

original: Wait. First, let's talk about what you've been doing.
translation: 先等等，我还不知道你是在干嘛。

original: Listen up you god-damn puke! You are now wearing prototype medic power armor. You take care of me, and I'll take care of you.
translation: 给我听好了，该死的家伙！你现在穿着的是原型医疗动力装甲。我们得互相照料。

original: Medic armor, reporting for duty, sir!
translation: 医疗装甲，向您报告！

original: Medic armor, reporting for duty, ma'am!
translation: 医疗装甲，向您报告！

original: Just give me the present already!
translation: 快把礼物给我！

original: Okay, okay! One last question: who's your favorite barbarian? That's right, Grognak! Issue 14, and with no missing pages!
translation: 好的！最后一个问题：谁是你最爱的野蛮人？没错，就是歌南！第14册，没有一页残缺！

original: I found this in a box of my father's old things, can you believe it? Kind of weird to think about him reading comic books.
translation: 我找到了一箱父亲的旧东西，真是难以置信，里面居然有他看过的漫画书。

original: I guess I'd better let you get back to "mingling" with your guests. We'll talk later, okay? Happy birthday.
translation: 我想你得去和你的客人们谈天说地了，我们之后再谈！生日快乐！

original: Um... a date with Christine Kendall?
translation: 和克里斯廷·肯德尔约会？

original: Gross! I didn't think you even liked girls. And you know what I mean, before you say something rude about me.
translation: 天！我还以为你不喜欢女孩呢。你知道我什么意思，不许瞎说。

original: I guess maybe I should give this to someone else... someone who likes Grognak the Barbarian better than Mean Christine...
translation: 我不如把这个给其他人吧……那些喜欢《野蛮人歌南》、而不是小气的克里斯廷的人。

original: The question is, how could you tell the difference? Ha ha ha.
translation: 问题是你分得清差别吗？哈哈哈。

original: Gross! I didn't think you even liked boys. Especially not Freddie the Freak. Yuck!
translation: 真恶心！没想到你会喜欢男孩。而且是弗雷迪那个怪物。讨厌！

original: I guess maybe I should give this to someone else... someone who'd rather curl up with Grognak the Barbarian than Freddie Gomez...
translation: 我看我还是把这个给其他人吧……那些宁可找《野蛮人歌南》、而不是弗雷迪·戈麦斯的人……

original: The question is, how could you tell the difference? Ha ha ha.
translation: 问题是你分得清差别吗？哈哈哈。

original: Um... a date with Freddie Gomez?
translation: 嗯……和弗雷迪·戈麦斯约会？

original: I really have no idea...
translation: 我真是不知道了……

original: Ha! I knew I'd surprise you. Who's your favorite barbarian? That's right, Grognak! Issue 14, and with no missing pages!
translation: 好的！就知道你不知道。谁是你最爱的野蛮人？没错，就是歌南！第14册，没有一页残缺！

original: I found this in a box of my father's old things, believe it or not. Imagine him reading comic books. I guess everybody was ten once.
translation: 我找到了一箱父亲的旧东西，真是难以置信，原来他也看过漫画书。我想每个人都有十岁的时候吧。

original: Well, I'd better let you get back to "mingling" with your guests. We'll talk later, okay? Happy birthday.
translation: 我想你得去和你的客人们谈天说地了，我们之后再谈！生日快乐！

original: She did a great job. But couldn't you have helped out a bit more?
translation: 她做得很出色，但你不能帮帮她吗？

original: I do not allow the fact that Amata is my daughter to compromise my position as Overseer.
translation: 我不会因为阿玛塔是我女儿，而放低我在她面前的监督者权威的。

original: I gave her all the appropriate paternal encouragement, of course, but I could not contribute extra vault resources.
translation: 我已经给了她一切父亲能给的鼓励了，但我不能向她额外提供避难所的资源。

original: That is simply what my position requires. No more, no less. I know Amata understands that perfectly well.
translation: 在其位而谋其政嘛。对所有人都要不偏不倚。我想阿玛塔是会完全明白的。

original: Of course she likes me. I'm a really charming guy.
translation: 她当然喜欢我。我这么有魅力。

original: Don't presume too much on her friendship, young man. I'm still the Overseer, and I'm still in charge of this Vault and everyone in it.
translation: 别对你和她之间友谊的期望太高，年轻人。我现在还是监督者，我还管理着避难所、和所有的人。

original: Hmm. That's not what I hear. But perhaps she'll set a good example for you. There's still plenty of time for you to make something of yourself.
translation: 嗯，那和我听说的不一样。但或许她会为你树立一个好榜样。你有足够的时间来获得自己的成就。

original: Of course she likes me. Everyone does.
translation: 她当然喜欢我，每个人都喜欢我。

original: Is this it? Or hasn't the real party started yet?
translation: 就这个啊？真正的派对开始了吗？

original: Shut up! And it isn't my fault that Butch and Wally are here. Your dad said we had to invite them.
translation: 闭嘴！布奇和瓦利会出现在这不是我的错，是你父亲说我们必须邀请他们的。

original: Never mind them. Time for your present. What do you think I got you? Go on, try to guess!
translation: 别管他们了。还是猜猜我给你准备了什么样的礼物吧！

original: Great party, Amata! Thanks for doing this for me.
translation: 阿玛塔，这个派对太棒了！多谢你为我所做的一切。

original: You're welcome. But really, your dad did most of it. I just helped with the decorations and stuff.
translation: 没关系。其实大部分都是你父亲做的，我不过是帮了下忙。

original: Hey, I bet you can't guess what I got you for your birthday. Go on, guess!
translation: 我敢说你一定猜不出我给你准备了什么样的生日礼物，不信就猜猜试试！

original: You didn't fool me. I just pretended not to know. <Lie.>
translation: 你骗不了我的，我刚才不过是假装不知道而已。<撒谎>

original: You're such a liar! Okay, if you're so smart, what did I get you for your birthday?
translation: 你这小骗子！要是你够聪明的话，就猜猜我给你带了什么样的生日礼物来了。

original: <Yawn> That's really really interesting.
translation: <哈欠>真是太有趣了。

original: Sure, most people don't give a thought to their Pip-Boy as long as it keeps working.
translation: 当然，许多人对自己的哔哔小子的态度是，只要不坏，就不管它。

original: Well, anyway, I got you this for your birthday. It isn't much and you probably already have one, but there you go. Happy birthday.
translation: 我把它作为你的生日礼物，它不是很贵重而且可能你已经有了，但还是要给你，再说一句生日快乐。

original: Sure, whatever. Did you bring me anything for my birthday?
translation: 行，你给我带什么生日礼物来了吗？

original: Here am I going on about your Pip-Boy and I clean forgot about your present!
translation: 瞧我光顾聊哔哔小子了，差点忘了给你的礼物！

original: Here you go. Happy birthday! It's not much, but I hope you like it.
translation: 给你吧。生日快乐！虽然不是很值钱的礼物，但还是希望你能喜欢。

original: Thanks, Stanley.
translation: 斯坦利，多谢了。

original: Don't mention it.
translation: 别客气。

original: Oh yes, I almost forgot. Happy birthday! It's not much, but I hope you like it.
translation: 我差点忘了，祝你生日快乐！虽然不是很值钱的礼物，但还是希望你能喜欢。

original: Wally said my Pip-Boy was a piece of junk!
translation: 瓦力说我的哔哔小子是个垃圾！

original: Don't you listen to him. The A series may be a bit heavier than the luxury models, but they were built to last.
translation: 别听他胡说，A系列的可能比豪华型重点，但它的耐久度很高。

original: Solid as a vault, they are. And I fixed her up myself. Shouldn't need to open her up again for a decade or two.
translation: 它就如避难所一样的坚固，我亲自把它给修理好的，估计一、二十年都不会出问题了。

original: I hate it. How do I get it off?
translation: 我讨厌它，怎么才能把它给脱下来？

original: Get it off? Why in the world would you want to do that? Your Pip-Boy's the best friend you'll ever have!
translation: 脱下来？为何你会有那样的想法啊？你的哔哔小子是你的最好伙伴啊！

original: Besides, you can't get it off. Biometric seals et cetera. I could tell you some stories about trying to take 'em off the old folks...
translation: 而且你是脱不下来的，生物锁定技术让它紧紧地粘在你的手上。我可以跟你说说以前那些想把它给脱下来的人的下场……

original: ...ah, well, that's hardly a fit subject for a kid's birthday party.
translation: ……呃，这事不适合在孩子的生日聚会上说。

original: Don't worry, you'll get used to it. Pretty soon you'll wonder how you ever got along without it.
translation: 别急，你会慢慢习惯的。不久之后你就知道没有它你是寸步难行的了。

original: It's all right. Seems kind of old, though.
translation: 没关系，尽管看起来是有点旧了。

original: Of course it is. Just like everybody else's. They don't make 'em any more now, do they?
translation: 它当然了。就像其他人的一样，早就停产了。

original: That one I've been saving just for you, though. The A series is a bit heavier than some of the fancier models, but it won't let you down.
translation: 不过这只可是留给你的。A系列的可能比某些时髦些的型号重一点，但它绝对是不会让你失望的。

original: I bet you could drop a bomb on one and it would still work. As a matter of fact, I know you could.
translation: 就算是你用炸弹去炸它，它也不会有事的。我知道，你还真会做出这样的事情的……

original: It's really cool. Did you fix it up for me?
translation: 太棒了，你帮忙修好的吗？

original: As a matter of fact I did. I'm glad you like it. Some may think the A series a bit basic, but I've always preferred them for their reliability.
translation: 没错。我很高兴你能喜欢它。虽然有些人说A系列的功能简单了些，但我还是偏爱它们的牢靠设计。

original: A poem? You've got to be kidding me.
translation: 一首诗？你一定是在开玩笑吧。

original: No, really, I wrote it just for you!
translation: 不开玩笑，我真的是写了一首诗给你！

original: I never just copy one of my old poems... well, there was that one Founder's Day where I couldn't rhyme anything with Overseer...
translation: 我从来不照搬以前写的诗……不过有一次“创立日”的时候，我歌颂监督者时就找不到押韵的词，只好……

original: But you deserve nothing less than a brand new poem. You can keep it in your Pip-Boy and read it whenever you want!
translation: 但是写给你的必须是一首崭新的诗，你可以把它存到哔哔小子里面，想看随时可以看！

original: Um... thanks. I guess. Did you get me anything else?
translation: 呃……谢了。我说，你还有其它什么东西给我吗？

original: Don't be silly! One poem per birthday, that's my rule! Ha ha. If I gave you two, think how jealous Butch would be, ha ha.
translation: 别傻了！每个生日只能获得一首诗，这是规矩！要是我给你两首的话，布奇可是会吃醋的哦！

original: Thank you. I will treasure it always. Is that all?
translation: 谢谢你，我会一直珍藏着的。没别的了吧？

original: Of course! Run along now, dearie, and have yourself a wonderful birthday!
translation: 当然！去玩吧，小亲亲，祝你生日开心！

original: Yes. Can I have my present now?
translation: 对。现在可以把礼物给我了吗？

original: Oh! Boys will be boys, won't they? Just can't wait to see your present, is that it?
translation: 男孩就是男孩，不是吗？已经迫不及待地想看到你的礼物了。

original: Well, let's not keep you waiting any longer. I think you're going to like it... it's a poem! Written by me, just for you!
translation: 不再让你久等了，我给你的礼物是 — 一首诗！我亲自为你所写的。

original: Of course you can, dearie. There's no need to get impatient! I've got your present right here.
translation: 当然可以，小亲亲。你不用再等下去了！给你的礼物就在这。

original: I think you're going to like it... it's a poem! Written by me, just for you!
translation: 你会喜欢我给你的礼物的…一首诗！我亲自为你而写的！

original: Why are you talking to me like I'm five?
translation: 为什么你还把我当作一个五岁小孩一样和我说话？

original: Oh, you are so funny! Ten years old, of course you are -- why, you have your Pip-Boy and everything!
translation: 你还真有趣！10岁了，可不是么 — 你已经有自己的哔哔小子什么的！

original: And do you know what I did? Just for the occasion -- wrote you a poem! I hope you like it.
translation: 你知道我做了什么了吗？为你的生日写了一首诗！希望你会喜欢的。

original: Of course you're not five! Ha ha ha. You're a big ten-year-old "man" now, aren't you, with your very own Pip-Boy!
translation: 你当然不是5岁的小孩了！哈哈哈，现在你已经是长成一个10岁的“大人”了，你还有自己的哔哔小子了！

original: And do you know what I did? Just for the occasion -- wrote you a poem! I hope you like it.
translation: 你知道我做了什么了吗？为你的生日写了一首诗！希望你会喜欢的。

original: I'm not a girl. And I'm not five. So stop calling me "dearie."
translation: 我不是小女孩，也不止五岁，所以别叫我“小亲亲”。

original: Yeah, my Dad and Amata threw me a great party, didn't they?
translation: 对啊，我爸爸和阿玛塔给我办了一个很不错的派对！

original: They sure did. My, my. Ten years old already. Why, I can remember helping your dad change your diapers...
translation: 可不是嘛。瞧瞧，转眼就10岁了。到现在我还记得和你父亲一起为你换尿布的情景……

original: And now, look at you! A great big grown up 10-year-old, with your very own Pip-Boy.
translation: 让我瞧瞧！你已经是个10岁的大孩子了，而且还有了自己的哔哔小子。

original: Since this was such a special occasion, do you know what I did? I wrote you a poem! Just for you. I hope you like it.
translation: 这是一个特殊的聚会，你知道我为你带了什么来吗？我为你写了一首诗！希望你会喜欢的。

original: You tell that same fucking joke every time we're out here. You need a new line, Dukey.
translation: 这类场合你总是讲些无聊的笑话。杜克夫，麻烦你有点创意。

original: That's just the river. Have some booze.
translation: 畅饮吧。

original: Quit your bitching. You weren't complaining last night. Ha, ha! I rode you hard and long. Just like me. Ha, ha!
translation: 别抱怨了，你还不爽啊。昨天晚上我跟你做得真是激烈又持久。我就是这么厉害。哈哈！

original: It's where Dukov wants to live. It's his money. If you don't like it, leave.
translation: 这是杜克夫所在之地，他有得是钱，要是你不喜欢就走吧。

original: We did that yesterday, Duke. My ass still hurts. When we get inside, I'll take special care of you. How about that?
translation: 昨晚我们做了，杜克夫。我臀部到现在还疼着。我们进去后，我可要对你来点特别的。怎么样？

original: The booze will keep you warm if you drink enough.
translation: 喝酒能暖身。

original: I need a drink.
translation: 我需要来点饮料。

original: Think I'll get in some target practice.
translation: 我会找机会练练的。

original: Time to fire off a few more rounds.
translation: 再练习几个回合。

original: Please, I can't very well speak to you when you're back there.
translation: 拜托，你在后面我根本没法跟你好好说话。

original: Come around to where I can see you.
translation: 到我能看见你的地方来。

original: Stand where I can see you.
translation: 站到我能看到你的地方来。

original: I hear you're the person to see about buying stuff for my house.
translation: 听说你这有卖适合我房子的家居用品。

original: Good to see that old house finally found an owner.
translation: 看到旧房子有了新主人我很高兴。

original: I have all sorts of items and themes for that place that may interest you.
translation: 我这里有各式各样的家具和主题，里面肯定有你感兴趣的。

original: Of course! I have all sorts of items and themes for that place that may interest you.
translation: 当然！我这各式各样的家具和主题，包你满意。

original: I'm looking to buy some things for my house.
translation: 我要给我的房子买些东西。

original: That's enough about the items.
translation: 家具的事就说到这吧。

original: Sounds good.
translation: 听起来不错。

original: Tell me about the Workbench.
translation: 跟我说说什么是工作台。

original: If you feel like tinkering and want to build some custom gizmos, this setup will help you do it.
translation: 要是你修补东西或是想制造什么新玩意出来的话，我想这台机器可以帮你实现。

original: Tell me about the Nuka-Cola Machine.
translation: 跟我说说什么是核子可乐机。

original: One push of a button and you can get your hands on an Ice Cold Nuka-Cola!
translation: 只须轻轻一按，你就能拿到一瓶冰镇的核子核子可乐了！

original: Tell me about the My First Laboratory.
translation: 跟我说说什么是生化实验台。

original: This setup is great for experimenting and coming up with all sorts of useful concoctions.
translation: 这设备是让你用来做实验的，试验结果会是多种多样的有用结果。

original: It also can be used to get rid of any horrible addictions you may have from tasting your results!
translation: 要是你为了试验化学药物而上瘾了，它还能帮你戒瘾！

original: Tell me about the Jukebox.
translation: 跟我说说什么是自动点唱机。

original: If you feel like filling your place with a whole bunch of music, switch this beautiful pre-war antique on.
translation: 只要你把这战前古董的开关打开，就能让房子立刻充满着美妙的音乐。

original: Tell me about the My First Infirmary.
translation: 跟我说说什么是个人治疗仪。

original: If you're wounded or you've hurt one of your limbs badly, this setup will allow you to heal it up as good as any other Wasteland Doctor.
translation: 要是你什么时候你受伤或者残疾的话，这台设备能像医生一样的把你给治好。

original: Enough about the house. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 房子的事情就说到这吧，让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Okay, let me take a look at your stuff.
translation: 让我来看看你的东西。

original: Sure thing!
translation: 当然的！

original: Tell me about your Themes.
translation: 谈谈房子的装饰主题好了。

original: Some people don't like living in a boring old house.
translation: 人们不希望自己住的是黯淡的老式住宅。

original: Purchase a theme from me and I use all of my design abilities to set your place up in the manner you request.
translation: 要是你从我这我这买下装饰主题的话，我会按你的主题将你的房子大变样的。

original: You can choose from the Vault, Raider, Wasteland Explorer, Science, Love Machine or Pre-War Themes.
translation: 你所能选择的主题有避难所、歹徒、废土探索者、科学、爱的机器或战前风格。

original: Can you tell me what the items do?
translation: 能和我说说家具有什么用吗？

original: Of course I can!
translation: 当然可以！

original: Which one in particular interests you?
translation: 你对哪一个最感兴趣呢？

original: I'm going to find a non-violent solution to your Ghoul problem.
translation: 我想找一个和平的方法来解决尸鬼的问题。

original: That's a laugh. Roy Phillips can't be reasoned with. Trust me. But go ahead and try to talk some sense into him. It's your funeral.
translation: 这太可笑了，罗伊·菲利普斯完全不可理喻。请相信我，要是你非要去找他讲道理的话是必死无疑的。

original: They've holed up in the nearby metro tunnels. They're living with packs of Feral Ghouls. They've barred the main entrance. Go through the train yard.
translation: 他们就住在附近的地铁隧道里。他们和凶悍僵尸生活在一起，而且还把紧急出口给堵住了，所以你要经过一段铁轨才能进入。

original: Good luck, kid. You're gonna need it.
translation: 祝你好运，你会用得上这东西的。

original: MS12WhatIsGhoul
translation: MS12WhatIs僵尸

original: You serious? You don't know what a Ghoul is?
translation: 你是认真的吗？你知道什么是僵尸吗？

original: A goddamn disaster waiting to happen that's what they are.
translation: 他们就是随时可能惹事的麻烦玩意。

original: Sure, maybe you can get over the fact they look like someone took a cheese grater to their face. But it's what you don't see that's the problem.
translation: 当然，你看得到的是他们在脸上涂的一层奶酪，你看不到的是他们所制造的麻烦。

original: The radiation slowly eats away their brain, then they go zombie on you. It's better for everyone to kill them before all that, if you ask me.
translation: 辐射缓慢地侵蚀着他们的大脑，之后把他们变成了活死尸。要是我说的话，最好还是把他们统统杀掉最好。

original: What the hell's a Ghoul anyway? Some kind of diseased human?
translation: 那该死的僵尸到底是什么？生病的人类吗？

original: I may be willing to help, but I need straight answers about who "He" is.
translation: 帮忙倒是可以，但我要你明白地告诉我“祂”是谁。

original: I would have preferred that He made the introduction, but I understand your hesitation.
translation: 我本希望“祂”可以亲自介绍，但我理解你的顾虑。

original: The Great One is a god-tree. A living, breathing, speaking god-tree!
translation: 圣贤是一棵神树。一棵有生命、会呼吸、能说话的神树！

original: The Treeminders are blessed to have this being watch over us.
translation: 能得此庇护，树启者们深感福佑。

original: The gang of Wall Street fat cats, and their Washington war-monger puppets, have plunged the world into war to line their own...
translation: 华尔街那群滚蛋，还有那帮发战争财的走狗，是他们让这世界陷入了战争之中，为了他们的享乐……

original: Do you think your leaders will keep you safe if the bombs fall? You will die while the Wall Street gang and their hangers-on live like kings in...
translation: 当核弹爆炸时，你以为领导人会管你的死活吗？当华尔街那群滚蛋和他们的傀儡们花天酒地时，你默默地死去了……

original: Why do you continue to send your boys to die for your capitalist masters?
translation: 你们为何要为了资本家主人而将孩子们推向死亡？

original: Your boys are dying on the Alaska front, and all for nothing. Bring them home, before it is too late.
translation: 你们的孩子正在阿拉斯加无谓地丧生。趁为时未晚，快让他们回家吧。

original: That's enough about the items.
translation: 家具的事就说到这吧。

original: Sounds good.
translation: 听起来不错。

original: Yeah, okay.
translation: 好的。

original: Tell me about the Workbench.
translation: 跟我说说什么是工作台。

original: If you feel like tinkering and want to build some custom gizmos, this setup will help you do it.
translation: 要是你想制造什么新玩意出来的话，我想这台机器可以帮你实现。

original: Find one of them fancy schematics? Well, you can use this table to build whatever it is in your own place.
translation: 只要你有武器的设计图，就能使用工作台制造。

original: Tell me about the Nuka-Cola Machine.
translation: 跟我说说什么是核子可乐机。

original: One push of a button and you can get your hands on an Ice Cold Nuka-Cola!
translation: 只须轻轻一按，你就能拿到一瓶冰镇的核子核子可乐了！

original: Well let's see. It's a machine, and it gives you Ice Cold Nuka-Colas. What are you, stupid?
translation: 让我看看。这是不过台机器，卖冰镇核子可乐的机器。明白吗？

original: Tell me about the My First Laboratory.
translation: 跟我说说什么是生化实验台。

original: This setup is great for experimenting and coming up with all sorts of useful concoctions.
translation: 这设备是让你用来做实验的，这些实验可以制造出各种各样的奇妙效果。

original: It also can be used to get rid of any horrible addictions you may have from tasting your results!
translation: 要是你为了试验化学药物而上瘾了，它还能帮你戒瘾！

original: If you like blowing yourself up by mixing chemicals and trying to make drugs to get you higher than the top of this tower, this addon's for you.
translation: 要是你想尝试化学试验中被炸飞的刺激，还有嗑药后如梦似幻的快感，那就非它莫属了。

original: It also can be used to get rid of any addictions you may have from tasting your results!
translation: 它还能帮你降低辐射量，相信你已经见识过它的功效了！

original: Tell me about the Jukebox.
translation: 跟我说说什么是自动点唱机。

original: If you feel like filling your place with a whole bunch of music, switch this beautiful pre-war antique on.
translation: 只要你把这战前古董的开关打开，就能让房子立刻充满着美妙的音乐。

original: This noise box will fill your room with awful human-made music. How can you stand listening to that garbage anyway?
translation: 这台机器能让你的房子里霎时洋溢着庄严的音乐，但是你能受得了那些垃圾音乐吗？

original: Tell me about the My First Infirmary.
translation: 跟我说说什么是个人治疗仪。

original: If you're wounded or you've hurt one of your limbs badly, this setup will allow you to heal it up as good as any other Wasteland Doctor.
translation: 要是你什么时候你受伤或者残疾的话，这台设备能像医生一样的把你给治好。

original: If you went and did something stupid, like busting up a limb or something, this setup will allow you to heal just like being at a Wasteland Doctor.
translation: 要是你不慎把胳膊或是其他什么部位弄伤的话，这台机器能像医生一样地给你全方位的治疗。

original: Enough about the suite. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 关于房子的事情已经说的够多了。让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Suit yourself.
translation: 听你的。

original: Okay, let me take a look at your stuff.
translation: 让我来看看你的东西。

original: Sure thing!
translation: 当然的！

original: Now we're talkin'.
translation: 现在我们进入正题。

original: Tell me about your Themes.
translation: 谈谈房子的装饰主题好了。

original: Some people don't like living in a boring old suite.
translation: 人们都讨厌式样古板的房子。

original: Purchase a theme from me and I use all of my design abilities to set your place up in the manner you request.
translation: 要是你从我这我这买下装饰主题的话，我会按你的主题将你的房子大变样的。

original: You can choose from the Vault, Raider, Wasteland Explorer, Science, Love Machine or Pre-War Themes.
translation: 你所能选择的主题有避难所、歹徒、废土探索者、科学、爱的机器或战前风格。

original: Themes, huh? What's the matter... too lazy to decorate yourself?
translation: 主题？怎么了……太懒了而不想装饰一下你的房子吗？

original: The former owner of this business left detailed instructions on how to have themes set up to make your suite look interesting.
translation: 房子的前主人留下了一本装修指南来指导怎么样把房子装饰成你所感兴趣的样子。

original: You can choose from the Vault, Raider, Wasteland Explorer, Science, Love Machine or Pre-War Themes.
translation: 你所能选择的主题有避难所、歹徒、废土探索者、科学、爱的机器或战前风格。

original: Can you tell me what the items do?
translation: 能和我说说家具有什么用吗？

original: Of course I can!
translation: 当然可以！

original: Which one in particular interests you?
translation: 你对哪一个最感兴趣呢？

original: Well, you wanna be more specific or do I have to guess?
translation: 你是想说得明白一些，还是要我来猜？

original: I hear you're the person to see about buying stuff for my suite.
translation: 听说你这能买到我房子的家具。

original: Good to see that old suite finally found an owner.
translation: 很高兴能看到旧房子有了个新主人。

original: I have all sorts of items and themes for that place that may interest you.
translation: 我这里有各式各样的家具和主题，里面肯定有你感兴趣的。

original: They got you living up there?
translation: 他们让你住在那的吗？

original: Well, since we're stuck with you, you might as well take a look at all the items and themes for that place that may interest you.
translation: 既然我们以后就是邻居了，到我这你可以好好地看看有没有什么你喜欢的家具或是主题了。

original: Of course! I have all sorts of items and themes for that place that may interest you.
translation: 当然！我这各式各样的家具和主题，包你满意。

original: I'm looking to buy some things for my house.
translation: 我要给自己的房子买些东西。

original: Yeah, sure. I have all sorts of items and themes for that place. Check 'em out.
translation: 我有适合这房子的一切家具和装饰主题。来看看吧。

original: I'm looking to buy some things for my house.
translation: 我要给自己的房子买些东西。

original: I'd like to change my house's Theme.
translation: 我想给房子换个主题。

original: Okay, consider it done. Anything else?
translation: 行，好了。还要什么吗？

original: Jeez... make up your mind, will ya?
translation: 赶快决定。

original: What else can I get for you, your majesty?
translation: 主人，我还能为你做些什么吗？

original: I'd like to change my house's Theme.
translation: 我想给房子换个主题。

original: Okay, consider it done. Anything else?
translation: 行，好了。还要什么吗？

original: You can't do that here.
translation: 你不能那样做。

original: And now, you have to pay.
translation: 现在你得付出代价。

original: Jack says you have some pie for me?
translation: 杰克说你这有派？

original: Oh, of course. Here you are! Enjoy!
translation: 没错。给你！好好享受！

original: Oh, sorry. I gave you the last one! Come back tomorrow, I'll make a new batch!
translation: 抱歉。刚刚的是最后一个了！明天再来，明天还会有的！

original: Do you have any more of that pie?
translation: 那种派你还有吗？

original: No, Jack. You have to die. You and your sick little town.
translation: 不，杰克，你死定了，你和你那该死的小镇上的人都死定了。

original: Well, I guess we know where our next meal is coming from then, don't we?
translation: 我想你应该知道我们下一餐的肉是从哪来的了吧？

original: Sure, Jack. No problem at all. I saw nothing.
translation: 杰克，放心吧。一切正常，我什么都没看见。

original: Well, that's good to hear, friend! Very good to hear, indeed.
translation: 朋友，听到你这么说，我实在太高兴！

original: You wouldn't believe how judgmental some people can be. Honestly. All I'm trying to do is keep my family happy and fed.
translation: 有些人的偏执到了让你无法想象的程度。实话说，我只是在努力维持家人的欢乐与温饱。

original: Tell you what, talk to Linda. She'll give you some of her special meat pie. It's to die for! Ha! Hahaha... but not you. You're good people.
translation: 我跟你讲，你去跟琳达去谈谈。她会给你一些特制的肉派。值得为它而死！哈哈哈哈哈哈哈…开玩笑了，你不会的。你是个好人。

original: Well, that's good to hear, friend! Very good to hear, indeed.
translation: 朋友，听到你这么说，我实在太高兴！

original: You wouldn't believe how judgmental some people can be. Honestly. All I'm trying to do is keep my family happy and fed.

original: Tell you what, talk to Linda. She'll give you some of her special meat pie. It's to die for! Ha! Hahaha... but not you. You're good people.
translation: 我跟你讲，你去跟琳达去谈谈。她会给你一些特制的肉派。值得为它而死！哈哈哈哈哈哈哈…开玩笑了，你不会的。你是个好人。

original: Well, whatever works you you.
translation: 你想怎么做就怎么做吧。

original: Indeed. To each their own, personal choice, it's the American way!
translation: 没错。自己的命运掌握在自己的手中，这就是美利坚的方式！

original: I tell you what, stranger. I like you. Stop by here anytime and ask Linda for one of her special meat pies.
translation: 陌生人，我发现我们很投机。有空就来坐坐，尝尝琳达的特别肉派。

original: There's nothing better after a hard day of work than one of those pies, I tell you what!
translation: 跟你说吧，没有什么比劳累一天后尽情享受这些派更惬意的事了！

original: That's the way to be, together to the end.
translation: 你得一直在这待下去了。

original: Indeed. To each their own, personal choice, it's the American way!

original: There's nothing better after a hard day of work than one of those pies, I tell you what!
translation: 跟你说吧，没有什么比劳累一天后尽情享受这些派更惬意的事了！

original: Actually, I'll just leave you alone.
translation: 我得走了。

original: Unfortunately, that's not an option. You see, you leave here and start warning people about the "crazies" in Andale.
translation: 很不幸，你走不了了。难道我会让你离开这里，去告诉别人安戴尔有一群疯子吗？

original: And then food get a lot more scarce, doesn't it?
translation: 况且，食材一直很稀缺，不是吗？

original: No, no, friend. I'm afraid that we can't let you leave. Get the ketchup, Linda!
translation: 这可不行，我的朋友，我们不能让你就这么走。琳达，把他捉住！

original: Nah. It's not presumptuous at all. You have to go.
translation: 不。这不算过分。你得走了。

original: Well then. I guess we can always stand to have some leftovers, can't we?
translation: 好吧，我猜我们不能把所有人都做成派，不是吗？

original: Yes. You're going to die for what you've done, Jack.
translation: 杰克，你会为你的行为付出生命的代价。

original: Too bad, stranger. I guess you'll just have to be our new meal!
translation: 悲剧啊，陌生人，我想你得变成我们的下一餐了。

original: I think that you're a bunch of sick fucks and I'm getting out of here.
translation: 你们这群恶心的杂种，让我离开这里。

original: I'm disappointed, friend. But that's your prerogative.
translation: 我很失望，但那是你的权力。

original: If you don't want to enjoy our town, we certainly don't want you here.
translation: 你不喜欢我们的小镇，我们也不欢迎你。

original: I'm sorry that you didn't enjoy your stay... but, a man does need to feed his family. Nothing personal.
translation: 很遗憾你不喜欢待在这里……可做人总得养家糊口的。就事论事而已。

original: No, not really. Everyone does what they have to.
translation: 不，并不是这样，每人都有自己该做的事。

original: Well, that's good to hear, friend! Very good to hear, indeed.
translation: 朋友，听到你这么说，我实在太高兴！

original: You wouldn't believe how judgmental some people can be. Honestly. All I'm trying to do is keep my family happy and fed.

original: Well, that's good to hear, friend! Very good to hear, indeed.
translation: 朋友，听到你这么说，我实在太高兴！

original: You wouldn't believe how judgmental some people can be. Honestly. All I'm trying to do is keep my family happy and fed.
translation: 有些人的偏执到了让你无法想象的程度。实话说，我只是在努力维持家人的欢乐与温饱。

original: Tell you what, talk to Linda. She'll give you some of her special meat pie. It's to die for! Ha! Hahaha... but not you. You're good people.
translation: 我跟你讲，你去跟琳达去谈谈。她会给你一些特制的肉派。值得为它而死！哈哈哈哈哈哈哈…开玩笑了，你不会的。你是个好人。

original: You know the drill, people. Stay back until the field is down.
translation: 你们也知道。在这解决前离远一点。

original: Hold positions. Let the robot do its job.
translation: 保持距离，让机器人先来。

original: Move it, Pride. Double time!
translation: “里昂斯的骄傲”，行动！

original: Move out! Let's go!
translation: 开始行动，我们出发！

original: Time to put this oversized wind-up toy to work.
translation: 是时候让这上发条的大家伙工作了。

original: All right, this is it. Go, go, go!
translation: 好的，出发吧！

original: Thanks, Amata. I'll only use it as a last resort, I promise.
translation: 阿玛塔，多谢了。我保证只在万不得已的情况下才会使用。

original: Okay. I'll try to meet you at the exit. Watch out for security. Good luck!
translation: 好。我会在出口处和你碰面的。多多保重了！

original: Well, what are you waiting for?
translation: 你在等什么呢？

original: Ha! I love it when they go down fighting!
translation: 哈！我就喜欢他们打起来！

original: Ha! I love it when they go down fighting!
translation: 哈！我就喜欢他们打起来！

original: Can't we talk this out?
translation: 我们不能谈判解决？

original: Haha! No... No. I don't think so.
translation: 哈哈！不能……我认为不能。

original: Haha! No... No. I don't think so.
translation: 哈哈！不能……我认为不能。

original: He needs to talk to someone from the outside, to get some perspective.
translation: 他得和外面的人说说话，了解些外面的事。

original: I'd never thought of it that way. I suppose he should get a chance to talk to someone like you.
translation: 我从没想到这点，我想他应该和你这样的人谈谈。

original: Here's the password to his isolation area. Just please don't mention my name to Vance about this.
translation: 这是去他那区域的密码。不要把这事告诉万斯啊。

original: You're secure in these tunnels. Why try to get into Tenpenny, anyway?
translation: 你在隧道里明明很安全，为何要跑到特佩尼来？

original: Ghouls aren't built for luxury and comfort, is that it? You think Ghouls belong scurrying around in the dark dank under belly of the Wasteland?
translation: 你认为僵尸都不应享受舒适豪华生活吗？你认为他们就该在阴暗潮湿的地下生活居住吗？ ?

original: You got a lot of nerve.
translation: 你胆子可真不小。

original: I'll come back later then.
translation: 那我以后再来。

original: Fine. Bye.
translation: 好的，再见了。

original: Do you know when I can see Mister Tenpenny?
translation: 你知道我何时能见到特佩尼先生吗？

original: Unsolicited callers are not generally welcome. Have a nice day. Goodbye.
translation: 不速之客不受欢迎。日安，再见。

original: I'm here to see Tenpenny. But if you weren't so incompetent, you'd know that.
translation: 我来这是见特佩尼的，你要不是那么无能，早该知道这一点了。

original: Hold on there a minute. Oh all right. I'll let you in, but if Tenpenny hollers because he isn't expecting you, you're dead.
translation: 稍等，我会让你进来的。但要是特佩尼说没约过你，你就死定了。

original: I've met them. Roy Phillips and those other Ghouls don't seem all that bad.
translation: 我见过他们了。罗伊·菲利普斯那几只尸鬼似乎没有那么糟糕。
