original: Look kid. I don't care what you think about them. Unless Tenpenny says otherwise. They aren't allowed in here. End of story. Quit wasting my time.
translation: 我不在乎你对他们的看法是怎样的。除非特佩尼能改变他的想法，否则他们是不可能进来的，就说这么多。

original: I'm here to see Roy Phillips.
translation: 我是来这见罗伊·菲利普斯的。

original: Oh yeah? Is he expecting you? Well then, run along. It's not wise to keep Roy waiting. Has a bit of temper that one. You watch yourself.
translation: 是吗？你和他有约吗？那么，进来吧。让罗伊等着可不好。他脾气不小，你自己多加小心。

original: I need repairs.
translation: 我要修理东西。

original: Yeah, I can do it.
translation: 是啊，我就行。

original: Is there anyone around here who can repair my stuff?
translation: 这附近有人能帮我修理东西吗？

original: Sure thing. I guess I'll take caps in trade.
translation: 当然可以，付瓶盖就行。

original: Okay, just make it quick.
translation: 好的，手脚利索点就行。

original: I need you to repair my stuff.
translation: 我要你来帮我修修东西。

original: No problem at all.
translation: 完全没问题。

original: Let's have a look at it.
translation: 让我看看。

original: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我尽量想想办法。

original: Can you repair my things?
translation: 你能帮我修理东西吗？

original: Can you pay me? Then I can repair your stuff.
translation: 你给钱我就帮你修东西。

original: No problem at all, smoothskin. So long as you're payin'
translation: 光皮肤，当然可以，只要你付钱就行。

original: Just make it quick, I've got a ton of things to do today.
translation: 快点，今天我还有很多事要做的。

original: Flank 'em!
translation: 包抄他们！

original: I've got your back!
translation: 我掩护你！

original: We'll get 'em.
translation: 我们会抓到他们的。

original: Look out!
translation: 当心！

original: Not this time, muties!
translation: 这次不行，变种人！

original: Affirmative! Engaging!
translation: 目标确认！进攻！

original: Ten-four! Going weapons hot!
translation: 收到！开火吧！

original: Roger that! Firing!
translation: 收到指令！开火！

original: Go go go!
translation: 走走走！

original: Commencing attack!
translation: 开始攻击！

original: Target locked! Attack!
translation: 目标锁定，进攻！

original: Hot lead outbound, yes sir.
translation: 遵命，长官，开火。

original: Lock and load!
translation: 装弹上膛、准备射击！

original: Yea though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death.
translation: 是啊，虽然我穿过笼罩死亡阴影的山谷。

original: I see 'em!
translation: 我看见他们了！

original: Yes sir!
translation: 明白长官！

original: Over there... get 'em!
translation: 就在那边，干掉他们！

original: Spread out and flank 'em.
translation: 散开，从侧翼包抄。

original: Targets engaged!
translation: 与目标交战！

original: Take 'em out!
translation: 干掉他们!

original: Over there! Get 'em!
translation: 就在那边！干掉他们！

original: Don't let 'em get away!
translation: 别让他们跑了！

original: Take 'em down!
translation: 放倒他们！

original: Woohoo! I love this shit!
translation: 我喜欢这样的战斗！

original: Light 'em up!
translation: 点燃他们！

original: It's go time!
translation: 出击！

original: Kick ass!
translation: 他妈的！

original: Yeah! Tear them apart!
translation: 把他们给撕碎！

original: Where?
translation: 敌人在哪？

original: Yeah, let's check it out.
translation: 我们搜索一下。

original: Yeah, I did.
translation: 搞定。

original: Hell yeah! Let's find 'em!
translation: 好了！我们去找他们！

original: If there is, they're dead meat.
translation: 要是那有的话，他们就死定了。

original: Here. Take back the money. I don't want to take medicine away from the town.
translation: 把你的钱收回去。我可不会带药出城。

original: Oh thank you!
translation: 哦，谢谢你！

original: I'd just slow you down. I'll wait here. If you're not back soon, I'm sneaking out the back door. There's people in town that need me.
translation: 别急，我会在这等你的。要是你去很久的话，我会从后门溜回镇子，那的人需要我。

original: Let's go get Shorty. Come with me.
translation: 我们去找“矮子”，跟我来。

original: So what's with all the Super Mutants?
translation: 那些超级变种人在干嘛？

original: Not sure what they're doing here. It's not like I can just get up and look around.
translation: 不知道，我可不能起身去一看究竟。

original: Sorry. I'm just frustrated. I get the feeling this is just some kind of temporary holding place. I think they've taken the others somewhere else.
translation: 抱歉，我有点沮丧。我想这不过个是临时关押处，他们应该把其他人带到别处去了。

original: How did you end up here?
translation: 你是怎么到这来的？

original: Damn Super Mutants have been coming and carrying off our villagers. Never knew where they took them until now.
translation: 该死的超级变种人把我们的镇民掳走了，至今仍然下落不明。

original: You can reason with Slavers and Raiders... if you have something they want. But Muties are crazy. I don't know what they want with us.
translation: 如果你身上有他们想要的东西，那你同奴隶贩子和歹徒就能讲道理。但变种人是疯子，我不知道他们想要什么。

original: I'll think about it, but I can't rescue your friends now.
translation: 我会考虑的，但我此刻无法帮你救出你同伴。

original: Oh. Well... If you change your mind... we'd be awfully grateful. Those are our friends...
translation: 哦……如果你能改变主意……我们会非常感激。那是我们的朋友。

original: I thought you might help. You seem pretty tough. Well... if you decide to help, let us know. We'd be grateful.
translation: 我以为你会帮忙。你看起来很厉害。好吧……当然如果决定帮忙，就告诉我们。我们会非常感激。

original: I knew it. You're just like all the others.
translation: 我就知道。你和其他人一样。

original: Well if you change your mind let me know, in the meantime I'll be preparing a nasty hex spell. When your skin starts peeling, you'll know why.
translation: 要是你改变主意了就和我说一声，在这之前我会准备好诅咒。当你的皮开始脱落时，你会知道原因。

original: I need you to repair my stuff.
translation: 我要你来帮我修修东西。

original: Sure, thing. Just be quick about it before someone sees.
translation: 当然，在其他人看到前完成。

original: What do you have for sale?
translation: 你这卖些什么呢？

original: Fresh out of the hands of some mark. Take a look!
translation: 我从佣兵那儿进来的一批新货，来看看！

original: Fresh out of the hands of some mark. Take a look!
translation: 我从佣兵那儿进来的一批新货，来看看！

original: I changed the door password to my name. If you're hearing this, and you still care enough to help me, you should remember it.
translation: 我把大门的密码换成我的名字了。如果你能听见，如果你还在意来帮我，你就应该记得。

original: It feels like you left home a long time ago, but I know you're still out there. I just hope you're still alive to hear this.
translation: 虽然你离家很久，但我知道你并没走远。我希望还活着，能听见我。

original: Things got worse after you left. My father's gone mad with power. If you can hear this, please stop looking for your dad and help stop mine.
translation: 你离开后一切都变糟了，我父亲为权力痴迷得发疯。要是你能听到的话，请暂停寻找你父亲，来帮帮我吧。

original: Things got worse after you left. The new Overseer is insane. If you can hear this, please stop looking for your dad and help save us.
translation: 你离开后一切都变糟了，新的监督者非常疯狂。要是你能听到的话，请暂停寻找你父亲，来帮帮我吧。

original: My boy is very sick and needs medical assistance, please help us if you can!  We are listening for your response on 3,950 kHz.
translation: 我的孩子病得很重，须要医疗的援助，如果你能帮忙请伸出援手！我们在3950赫兹等候回应。

original: My family and I have taken refuge in a drainage chamber not to far from a radio relay tower outside of DC.
translation: 我和家人在特区无线电转播台旁的一个排水通道里避难。

original: Get out of my way, you stupid Tunnel Snakes!
translation: 别挡道，你这愚蠢的穴蛇帮！

original: I can show you a real tunnel snake, Amata.
translation: 阿玛塔，我会让你见识一下什么才是真正的穴蛇帮。

original: God, Butch, why don't you just leave me alone.
translation: 天啊，布奇，你就不能离我远点。

original: What are you going to do, Amata, go run and tell your daddy on us?
translation: 阿玛塔，你在做什么，去向你爸打小报告吗？

original: Hey, Doc. Will this Fire Ant Nectar do you any good?
translation: 博士，火蚁露有什么用吗？

original: Why, yes it would.
translation: 当然有用。

original: I would be more than happy to take that off your hands if you'd like.
translation: 我会非常乐意得到那玩意。

original: If you can gather more for me, I would certainly love to have them. I'm certain Marigold's tunnels are rife with the original brood.
translation: 要是你能再弄些来的话，我会很乐意都收下的。我知道马利哥德的隧道里有非常多的原种蚂蚁。

original: How marvelous! Allow me to buy them from you as we agreed upon.
translation: 真了不起！按我们的约定卖给我吧。

original: I have some more Fire Ant Nectar for you.
translation: 我有更多火蚁露给你。

original: Excellent! These will be perfect for my next batch of mutagen.
translation: 太棒了！这些完全可以用于我的下一批诱变剂。

original: I have some more Fire Ant Nectar for you.
translation: 我有更多火蚁露给你。

original: Thank you. Please bring back more if you can!
translation: 多谢了，要是可以的话,我希望你再带一些来给我！

original: I have some more Fire Ant Nectar for you.
translation: 我有更多火蚁露给你。

original: So, what are you going to do now about your experiments?
translation: 你的试验是在做什么呢？

original: Well, I'm uncertain. This does deal quite a blow to my research.
translation: 我不确定。这次的事对我试验是一个相当大的打击。

original: First however, I must stay here and devote all of my resources to finding the proper mutagen formula.
translation: 首先，我得在这把我手头的资源用去寻找合适的诱变剂配方。

original: Very well, actually. I think I've isolated the instance of DNA coding error and I'm attempting to correct it.
translation: 很好，我想我会把错误的DNA编码分离出来，然后尝试对其修复。

original: How are your experiments going today, Doc?
translation: 博士，你的实验进行得如何了？

original: I'm quite frustrated. I can't seem to isolate a stable mix for the mutagen.
translation: 我十分沮丧，我似乎无法把诱变剂的稳定混合物给分离出来。

original: How are your experiments going today, Doc?
translation: 博士，你的实验进行得如何了？

original: Not so well, I'm afraid. The recoding sequence on the DNA splicing has gone awry and I must restart from the beginning.
translation: 恐怕不太顺利，对DNA粘结的序列测定不太顺利，我不得不重新开始了。

original: How are your experiments going today, Doc?
translation: 博士，你的实验进行得如何了？

original: Not much has occurred since we last spoke I'm afraid. But science marches on!
translation: 自从上次我们谈话后就没什么进展了，但毕竟试验还是开始了。

original: How are your experiments going today, Doc?
translation: 博士，你的实验进行得如何了？

original: I think I'm isolating the issue that caused the Fire Ant mutation error! A few more tweaks and I may have a breakthrough!
translation: 我想我正在分离出火蚁的突变体错误原因！要是有好方法的话，我就可以有突破性的进展了。

original: How are your experiments going today, Doc?
translation: 博士，你的实验进行得如何了？

original: Disaster! The latest batch of mutagen was completely contaminated. I'll have to start anew. Such is the burden of working in this environment.
translation: 简直是灾难啊！最后的一批诱变剂已经完全地被污染了。我得重新开始了，鉴于目前的情况，这真是无比重担。

original: How are your experiments going today, Doc?
translation: 博士，你的实验进行得如何了？

original: I think I may be on the verge of a breakthrough! The latest mutagen sample seems quite stable. Only time will tell.
translation: 我想我们已经看到胜利的曙光了！最近诱变剂样本已经稳定了，现在就等到时间的验证了。

original: How are your experiments going today, Doc?
translation: 博士，你的实验进行得如何了？

original: I don't suppose you can help me identify a rogue strain of virus that seems to have infiltrated the latest sample? No, I suppose you couldn't...
translation: 我想你无法帮我识别出那个渗透进最新样本的不安分病毒。对，我认为你做不到……

original: How are your experiments going today, Doc?
translation: 博士，你的实验进行得如何了？

original: So, how are you getting along now that you've left Grayditch behind?
translation: 那么，你离开灰渠后过得咋样？

original: Oh, Vera is the nicest lady ever! It's so cool that you brought me here!
translation: 薇拉是世上最好的女士！你带我来这儿真好！

original: I mean, she makes me do stuff... like clean up her hotel and all that, but she really cares about me.
translation: 我是说，她让我做事……比如清扫她的旅店之类的，但她真的很关心我。

original: Plus, I found some friends here in Rivet City too. All thanks to you!
translation: 而且，我还在铆钉城交到了几个朋友。这都多亏了你！

original: I dunno. I mean, there are tons of other kids here like me but they're all kind of weird.
translation: 我不知道。我是说，这儿有很多像我这样的孩子，但他们都有点怪怪的。

original: I don't really like sleeping in a huge cave... I keep having dreams about the ants.
translation: 我不太喜欢睡在一个巨大的洞穴里……我老是梦到那些蚂蚁。

original: Oh well, at least I'm safer than I was in Grayditch, so I guess I have to thank you for that.
translation: 唉，至少我比在灰渠的时候安全多了，我想我还是得感谢你。

original: It's lonely. No one really comes by here. Plus this place keeps reminding me of my poppa.
translation: 感觉有点孤独，这没什么人来。而且这会让我想起死去的爸爸。

original: I mean, you're the only person who's come back through Grayditch since everything happened.
translation: 我想说的是，你是惟一一个在发生了这么多事情后还回到格雷蒂奇的人。

original: At least I'm safe in my old house now. I suppose I have you to thank for that.
translation: 至少我现在在老屋子里是安全的了，我得感激你。

original: So, how are you getting along now that the ants are gone?
translation: 蚂蚁已经消失了，你现在过得如何？

original: It's lonely. No one really comes by here. Plus this place keeps reminding me of my poppa.
translation: 感觉有点孤独，这没什么人来。而且这会让我想起死去的爸爸。

original: I mean, you're the only person who's come back through Grayditch since everything happened.
translation: 我想说的是，你是惟一一个在发生了这么多事情后还回到格雷蒂奇的人。

original: Doctor Lesko is next door now, but he is so buried in his work, we barely have time to talk.
translation: 莱斯科医生现在搬到了隔壁，但他总是埋头于工作，我们几乎没讲过什么话。

original: At least I'm safe in my old house now. I suppose I have you to thank for that.
translation: 至少我现在在老屋子里是安全的了，我得感激你。

original: So, how are you getting along now that the ants are gone?
translation: 蚂蚁已经消失了，你现在过得如何？

original: Please put on your standard-issue Vault-Tec suit before using the Tranquility Lounger.
translation: 在你使用宁静巷催眠舱前请穿上避难所科技套装。

original: Your dad didn't kill Jonas. Your dad didn't lock down the Vault. Your dad isn't the one keeping us from leaving right now.
translation: 你父亲没有杀死乔纳斯。你父亲也没有把避难所给锁上。你父亲更不是现在阻止我们离开的人。

original: My dad did. And we need to take a stand against him!
translation: 这些都是我父亲做的，我们得反抗他！

original: Actually, this is my Dad's fault for leaving. He started this whole mess.
translation: 事实上，这是我爸爸的错，他的离开引起了整个混乱。

original: Your dad didn't kill Jonas. Your dad didn't lock down the Vault. Your dad isn't the one keeping us from leaving right now.
translation: 你父亲没有杀死乔纳斯。你父亲也没有把避难所给锁上。你父亲更不是现在阻止我们离开的人。

original: No, all of that was done by the Overseer, first my dad, and now Allen Mack. And we need to take a stand against him!
translation: 不，那些都是监督者做的，原来是我父亲，现在是阿伦·麦克。我们得反抗他！

original: Actually, this is my Dad's fault for leaving. He started this whole mess.
translation: 事实上，这是我爸爸的错，他的离开引起了整个混乱。

original: But the Vault used to be open, and we're still here, aren't we? It worked back then, so why wouldn't it work now?
translation: 但避难所以前是开放的，而且也没什么问题，对不对。既然过去行得通，为什么现在就不行呢？

original: No, they're just afraid we'll screw up and get hurt. They just won't accept that we can take care of ourselves.
translation: 他们担心我们搞砸了会受伤。他们不愿相信我们能自己照顾自己。

original: They say you're threatening the entire Vault's safety.
translation: 他们说你威胁着整个避难所的安全。

original: They have to understand that we did that to keep them from going outside and getting killed.
translation: 他们得明白我们那么做是防止他们出去惹来杀身之祸。

original: To keep them from making the same mistake our generation did when we were their age.
translation: 别让他们犯和我们这代人当年一样的错。

original: Some of us already lost loved ones out there long ago. We won't lose any more today.
translation: 我们一些人很久前就已经失去了所爱之人。我们不希望如今还会失去更多。

original: The rebels are upset because you lied to them about the outside.
translation: 反叛者不高兴，因为你在外面世界的事对他们撒谎了。

original: I just don't know. Maybe he thinks he's protecting us, but all he's really doing is condemning us.
translation: 我不知道啊。或许他自以为是在保护我们，可他真正所做的却是不断地指责我们。

original: I thought parents were supposed to want a better world for their children?
translation: 我想父母都希望能给他们的小孩营造一个更好的世界吧。

original: Well, there's a new world waiting right outside that door. And we're not going to give up until we can reach it.
translation: 外面就是崭新的世界。在到那之前我们是不会放弃的。

original: Why is the Overseer doing this?
translation: 监督者为什么要这么做？

original: I just don't know. Maybe he thinks he's protecting us, but all he's really doing is condemning us.
translation: 我不知道啊。或许他自以为是在保护我们，可他真正所做的却是不断地指责我们。

original: Well, there's a new world waiting right outside that door. And we're not going to give up until we can reach it.
translation: 外面就是崭新的世界。在到那之前我们是不会放弃的。

original: Why is the Overseer doing this?
translation: 监督者为什么要这么做？

original: I just don't know. Don't they realize how dangerous it is out there?
translation: 我不知道，难道他们不知道外面世界有多么危险吗？

original: But instead, they would throw away the safety of the Vault's isolation, just to follow in your footsteps.
translation: 相反，他们会舍弃避难所与世隔绝所带来的安全，去追寻你的足迹。

original: I can't allow them to do that to themselves, or to the rest of us.
translation: 我不会让他们对自己、以及我们做那样的事情。

original: Why are they rebelling?
translation: 他们为什么要反叛？

original: I guess you must have more important things waiting for you outside. So I'll make this quick.
translation: 我想外面还有更重要的事情在等着你，所以我长话短说。

original: When you left, we realized we could leave the Vault. But my father won't stand for it, and it's just getting worse down here.
translation: 你离开之后，我们意识到我们都可以离开避难所。但我父亲不同意，而且他让这里的状况越发糟糕。

original: Father won't listen to us, and it's getting close to violence. So we need your help. I need your help.
translation: 我父亲听不进我们的话，而且更加暴力。所以我们需要你的帮助，我需要你的帮助。

original: Can you hurry up? I've got lots to do.
translation: 你能快点吗？我还有许多事要做。

original: I guess you must have more important things waiting for you outside. So I'll make this quick.
translation: 我想外面还有更重要的事情在等着你，所以我长话短说。

original: When you left, we realized we could leave the Vault. But the Overseer won't stand for it, and it's just getting worse down here.
translation: 你离开之后，我们意识到我们都可以离开避难所。但我父亲不同意，而且他让这里的状况越发糟糕。

original: He won't listen to us, but he can't just ignore you. So we need your help. I need your help.
translation: 监督者听不进我们的话，而且更加暴力。所以我们需要你的帮助，我需要你的帮助。

original: Can you make this quick? I've got lots to do.
translation: 你能快点吗？我还有许多事要做。

original: Are you honestly comparing, "Maybe we should look for help" with, "Stay in an underground bunker all your life or I'll kill you?"
translation: 你真的在权衡“我们应该寻求帮忙”和“要么一辈子待在地下掩体中要么我杀了你们”吗？

original: Obviously, I don't know what's out there, but it can't hurt to take a look, right?
translation: 显然我不知道外面的世界是怎样的，但出去看看也无妨，不是吗？

original: I hear some of you have been hoping to go outside. That's pretty crazy, too.
translation: 我听说你们有些人希望到外面去。那同样很疯狂。

original: It's not that simple. Just because Butch wants to leave this place behind doesn't mean the rest of us want to go away forever.
translation: 没有那么简单的。布奇想抛下这里的一切并不代表其他人也想永远地离开。

original: It's our home, and we want to stay here. It's just that since you left, we started thinking maybe the outside wasn't something to be afraid of.
translation: 这是我们的家，我们都希望能待在这。但自从你离开这之后，我们开始考虑或许外面世界也没有什么值得恐惧的。

original: But we can't even suggest going outside to communicate or trade at all. Not with the Overseer keeping us trapped down here! You need to stop him!
translation: 监督者把我们困在这地下，我们甚至连提议出去进行些交流和交易都不行！你得制止他！

original: So why don't you just leave? It's not difficult, especially now.
translation: 那么你为什么不离开呢？这不难，尤其是现在。

original: It's not that simple. It's not like we want to abandon the Vault or anything.
translation: 没有那么简单的。我们并不想抛弃避难所和这的一切！

original: It's our home, and we want to stay here. It's just that since you went out there, we started thinking maybe it wasn't something to be afraid of.
translation: 这是我们的家，我们都希望能待在这。但自从你离开这之后，我们开始考虑或许外面世界也没有什么值得恐惧的。

original: But we can't even suggest going outside to communicate or trade at all. Not with the Overseer keeping us trapped down here! You need to stop him!
translation: 监督者把我们困在这地下，我们甚至连提议出去进行些交流和交易都不行！你得制止他！

original: So why don't you just leave? It's not difficult, especially now.
translation: 那么你为什么不离开呢？这不难，尤其是现在。

original: You're absolutely right. It's not like we want to abandon the Vault, or anything!
translation: 你完全正确，我们并不想抛弃避难所和这的一切！

original: Well, Butch does, but he's too big a coward to go out on his own.
translation: 不过，布奇是想抛开一切，但他太胆小不敢独自出去。

original: Most of us had accepted that the outside was certain death and things would always stay the same down here. But now we know they don't have to be!
translation: 我们大部分人都曾认定去外面是自寻死路，而避难所内会永远安宁。但我们现在明白并不是这样。

original: After all, it was enough to get you and your dad to leave, so there must be something good out there.
translation: 毕竟你和你爸都离开这了，外面一定有值得向往的地方。

original: Sounds like he's gone crazy with power and needs to be stopped.
translation: 听起来他像是因为迷恋权力而发疯了，必须阻止他。

original: You're absolutely right. It's not like we want to abandon the Vault, or anything!
translation: 你完全正确，我们并不想抛弃避难所和这的一切！

original: Most of us had accepted that the outside was certain death and things would always stay the same down here. But now we know they don't have to be!
translation: 我们大部分人都曾认定去外面是自寻死路，而避难所内会永远安宁。但我们现在明白并不是这样。

original: After all, it was enough to get you and your dad to leave, so there must be something good out there.
translation: 毕竟你和你爸都离开这了，外面一定有值得向往的地方。

original: Sounds like he's gone crazy with power and needs to be stopped.
translation: 听起来他像是因为迷恋权力而发疯了，必须阻止他。

original: Damnit, this is no time for joking around!
translation: 该死，现在可不是开玩笑的时候！

original: Actually, I need to think about this some more.
translation: 事实上，这个问题我需要好好考虑。

original: Of course you aren't.
translation: 你当然不确定。

original: On second thought, I'm not sure.
translation: 再三考虑后，我还是不确定。

original: I certainly hope so. We can't keep going on like this.
translation: 我当然希望这样，我们不能继续这样下去。

original: I think I have a solution for the Vault's troubles.
translation: 我想我有办法来解决避难所的问题。

original: Really? Humor me.
translation: 真的吗？说说看。

original: I believe I have the solution to the Vault's problems.
translation: 我想我有办法来解决避难所的问题。

original: To fix what you started? Go ahead and humor me.
translation: 来弥补你造成的一切？继续，说说看。

original: I believe I have the solution to the Vault's problems.
translation: 我想我有办法来解决避难所的问题。

original: Visitor, sir. He wanted to see you, and... well, there's not much I could do to stop him.
translation: 是个来访者，先生，他想要见见你，而且我也阻止不了他。

original: Visitor, sir. She wanted to see you, and... well, there's not much I could do to stop her.
translation: 是个来访者，先生，她想要见见你，而且我也阻止不了她。

original: Amata's up there, in the clinic with the rest of them. I'd take you closer, but they don't get along with security. Good luck.
translation: 阿玛塔就在上面，和其余的人待在诊所里。我本想带你过去的，但他们很抵触警卫。祝你好运。

original: MS16GomezEscort
translation: MS16Gomez护卫

original: I guess you've had a lot on your mind since you were here last. Where do you want to go?
translation: 我想你重回此地肯定感慨良多吧。你要去哪？

original: Can you lead me somewhere?
translation: 你能给我带下路吗？

original: Where to?
translation: 去哪？

original: I need you to lead me somewhere.
translation: 我需要你给我带下路。

original: Hey, sweetie. What can you tell me about Moriarty's terminal? I need in...
translation: 你能跟我说说莫里亚蒂的终端吗？我需要进入……

original: Mmmmm. I bet you want in. But enough about us.
translation: 我知道你想进入。不过是你也无妨。

original: Here's the password. Just make sure he isn't around when you use it.
translation: 这是密码，你输入的时候要确保他没在旁边。

original: Look, sweetie. I'd love to spend time with you, but I need to find my Dad.
translation: 听着，甜心，我喜欢陪着你，可我得去找我父亲。

original: Mmmm. I'd love to spend time with you too.
translation: 我也想和你待一起。

original: Look, I... can help you. Get into the back office of this place. Moriarty keeps a terminal there. Everything you want is inside the terminal.
translation: 嗯…我…可以帮你，去到这里后面的办公室里。莫里亚蒂在那有个系统终端机，里面会有你想知道的一切。

original: Here's the password to it. Too bad you're so young, kid. I could teach you some stuff you'd never forget...
translation: 这是进入系统的密码，你嫩得让我心疼，不然我可以教你一些终身难忘的东西……

original: Look, if you can give me more information or point me in the right direction...
translation: 听着，要是你可以再给点信息或者给我个方向……

original: Yeah, I help you, then Moriarty kicks my sweet ass out the door.
translation: 没错，我可以帮你，莫里亚蒂也可以帮我滚蛋。

original: Sorry, kid. If you want to know more, Moriarty is the only one who's going to help you.
translation: 不好意思，小朋友，要是你还想再知道些什么，只能去找莫里亚蒂。

original: Talk to Gob. He hates Moriarty more than I do. Maybe he'll tell you something, but I doubt it.
translation: 去和盖博谈谈，他比我更讨厌莫里亚蒂，或许他会跟你说点什么，不过我可不保证。

original: Enough with the tough chick routine. Tell me more!
translation: 废话免了。说重点！

original: Ohhh. You like it rough, huh? Well, that costs extra.
translation: 想简单粗暴地套出消息，那得要额外的钱了。

original: Beat it, kid. Go look for Daddy somewhere else.
translation: 闪远，小鬼。要找你爸爸去别处。

original: I talked to Moriarty already, and he's trying to charge me for the info.
translation: 我和莫里亚蒂谈过了，但是他的消息得付钱。

original: Ha ha. Yeah, that's Colin's style all right. He sells information so much, you'd think the bar was just a hobby.
translation: 哈哈，那就是科林的风格了，他主业是倒卖消息，酒吧不过是他的业余爱好罢了。

original: Help me get into that terminal, Nova. Finding my Dad means everything to me.
translation: 诺瓦，帮我进入电脑系统终端。找到父亲对我来说意味着一切。

original: Well, all right. You seem like a good kid. It isn't your fault Moriarty is such an asshole.
translation: 好吧，你看上去是个好孩子，莫里亚蒂那混蛋，这不是你的错。

original: Here's the password. Just don't mention to anyone that I gave it to you or I might be out on my ass like Silver.
translation: 这是密码，不要和任何人说，不然我会像席尔瓦一样滚蛋的。

original: All right, thanks.
translation: 好的，多谢你了。

original: You're welcome.
translation: 没关系。

original: Sure thing.
translation: 当然的。

original: I'm sick of this shit. Help me get into the terminal so I can find what I need!
translation: 我受够那混蛋了，帮我进入那终端，这样我就可以找到我所要的东西了！

original: Nice attitude, jackass.
translation: 这才像话，白痴。

original: No! Please! Don't hit me!
translation: 不！求你，别打我！

original: I swear! I don't know anything about the terminal! Ask Nova. She's all over Moriarty all the time.
translation: 我发誓我真的不知道什么终端的事情！去问诺瓦，她几乎每时每刻都和莫里亚蒂在一起。

original: I really need to get into that terminal.
translation: 我真的得看看那终端。

original: Yeah, and? So does ninety percent of Megaton. Take a number.
translation: 这里其他人都这么想，省省吧。

original: Look, kid. I like you. But you gotta learn you can't stick your neck out too far in this world or it's liable to get cut off. I'm sorry.
translation: 听着小朋友，我喜欢你。但不好意思，你得知道 — 枪打出头鸟。

original: Oh, Mister Moriarty never lets me back there.
translation: 哦，莫里亚蒂再也不准我回那里了。

original: If you need to get into the terminal, you should talk to Nova. She'll help you... but it may be expensive if you catch my meaning.
translation: 要是你想进入终端的话就应该去问问诺瓦。她会帮你的……不过代价可能很昂贵，如果你明白我什么意思的话。

original: What can you tell me about Moriarty's terminal?
translation: 你能跟我说说莫里亚蒂的终端吗？

original: That stupid thing is his pride and joy. He keeps all of his dirty little secrets in it about everything that goes on in this godforsaken town.
translation: 那破玩意是他的乐趣和骄傲。这些年他在这荒郊野镇里做的所有见不得人的肮脏勾当都存放在里面。

original: I once leaned on his shoulder when he was typing into it and he got pissed off and pushed me to the ground.
translation: 有次他输入密码的时候我恰好靠在他肩上，结果他歇斯底里地把我给推倒在地上。

original: I hate that fucking thing. It's all he cares about.
translation: 我讨厌那破玩意，他只在乎那玩意。

original: "Information is a commodity" he keeps saying. I'd stay away from that thing if I were you.
translation: 他老是说什么“信息就是财富”，我要是你的话，我就离那玩意远远地。

original: I can tell you to shove it up your ass, how's that, Mister Tough Guy!
translation: 我觉得你可以能滚多远滚多远，怎么样，愣头青。

original: What's all this about Galaxy News Radio?
translation: 银河新闻电台是个什么样的电台？

original: Galaxy News Radio is some loudmouth radio station located in the ruins of D.C.
translation: 银河新闻电台是特区废墟上的一个八卦电台。

original: Three Dog, the king of that looney bin, keeps yapping about fighting some Good Fight or something. A bunch of crap.
translation: 三狗，就是个废话大王，总是在那胡扯什么圣战。那都是在胡说八道。

original: But I suppose if you wanted to know what was going on in the Wasteland, that's the place to go. Me, I could care less.
translation: 要是你想知道废土上的什么事情的话，最好去那问问，我没那闲工夫。

original: You serious?
translation: 你认真的吗？

original: Oh... you must have come from that Vault. Right.
translation: 哦…你是避难所出来的吧。

original: It's the only free radio station left in the Wasteland. The guy who runs it, Three Dog, he's like the only person who seems to give a shit.
translation: 它是废土里唯一剩下的免费电台了，三狗是那的主持人，他貌似是唯一还有点能耐的人了。

original: He keeps talking about fighting the Good Fight or something. Better than the crap on the other station.
translation: 他一直在唠叨什么圣战。不过总比其他台的废话强点。

original: Mister Moriarty says we can keep it on. It's a good radio station.
translation: 莫里亚蒂先生说我们可以听一下这个电台，它还不错。

original: I like hearing the DJ, Three Dog and how he's helping to fight the Good Fight.
translation: 我喜欢听那个主播三狗，还有他怎么协助圣战的故事。

original: Sigh. If only I was a part of that instead of being stuck in this dive...
translation: 唉，要是我是那传说中的人物而不是被困在这该多好啊……

original: We'll deal with the details soon, in private. Until then, I'm sure there are people waiting to congratulate you.
translation: 我们会单独把细节处理好。此前，那些人肯定在等着要庆祝一番。

original: You're welcome, my dear. Now, if you'll excuse me, I feel quite worn down.
translation: 谢谢你，亲爱的。对不起，我现在累极了。

original: Thank you, father. I'll do my best to keep us all safe, inside the Vault and beyond.
translation: 谢谢，父亲。不管是不是在避难所里，我都会尽最大努力来保护我们的安全的。

original: I'm just sorry I didn't understand that earlier. Consider it one of many mistakes I've made.
translation: 我很抱歉我之前没有想到，就算是我犯过的错误中的一个吧。

original: Amata, I appoint you Overseer in my place. You've proven you have what it takes to make hard choices for the good of the Vault.
translation: 阿玛塔，我任命你代替我做监督者。你已经证明了你能站在避难所的角度做出艰难抉择。

original: Father!
translation: 父亲！

original: That is why I cannot remain your Overseer.
translation: 所以，我不再适合担任大家的监督者了。

original: I know I have made these mistakes. And I would make them again if I had to do so.
translation: 我知道我犯了不少错误。而且如果有机会，我也许还会接着犯错。

original: Lives have been lost, but perhaps worse than that, lives have been stopped. And in my attempts to keep you safe, I have kept you from growing up.
translation: 我们付出了生命的代价，或许更糟糕的是，生命已经终止。我试图保证你们的安全，却阻止了你们的成长。

original: In my attempts to keep us all safe, I have been, perhaps, overzealous.
translation: 我一直在试图保护我们大家的安全，或许有些太过热心了吧。

original: Amata... Everyone... Listen closely. After a discussion with your friend, I've made an important decision.
translation: 阿玛塔…各位…请仔细听好。在和你们的朋友讨论后，我做出一个重要决定。

original: I'm not going to do it. You'll need to find another hero.
translation: 我不打算做。你还是再找一位英雄吧。

original: Oh... we were all hoping... never mind. We don't need your help.
translation: 哦…我们都希望…算了吧。我们并不需要你帮忙。

original: I tried to rescue your friends but there were... complications.
translation: 我试图救你的朋友，但那……情况复杂。

original: That's what I was afraid of. Well, at least you tried. Red's alive at least.
translation: 那正是我所担心的。但至少你尝试过，至少瑞德还活着。

original: Talk to Red. I'm sure she'll want to thank you.
translation: 跟瑞德谈谈，我肯定她想要感谢你。

original: You mean they're dead, don't you? Well, I guess you tried. That's more than we could have asked.
translation: 你的意思是他们都死了？我想你已尽力了，那已超乎我们所求了。

original: On behalf of Big Town, take this. It's not much, but at least it's a token of our appreciation.
translation: 我代表大镇，给你。这些东西虽然不是很多，但也代表着大镇对你的感激之情。

original: It's not like any of us are going to be alive long enough to enjoy it anyway.
translation: 反正我们也没有谁能活着享用它了。

original: Well, I guess you tried. That's more than we could have asked.
translation: 我想你尽力了。已经已超乎我们所求。

original: On behalf of Big Town, take this. It's not much, but at least it's a token of our appreciation.
translation: 我代表大镇，给你.这些东西虽然不是很多，但也代表着大镇对你的感激之情。

original: It's not like any of us are going to be alive long enough to enjoy it anyway.
translation: 反正我们也没有谁能活着享用它了。

original: That's what I was afraid of. Well, at least you tried.
translation: 那正是我所担心的。好了，至少你尽力了。

original: Talk to Red. I'm sure she'll want to thank you.
translation: 跟瑞德谈谈，我肯定她会想要感谢你的。

original: I rescued Red. She's alive, at least. The others... not so much.
translation: 我救了瑞德，至少她还活着。其他人……就不好说了。

original: That's what I was afraid of. Well, at least you tried.
translation: 那正是我所担心的。好了，至少你尽力了。

original: Here, take this. It's not like any of us are going to be alive long enough to enjoy it anyway.
translation: 给，拿着。反正我们也没有谁能活着享用它了。

original: I rescued Shorty. Red didn't make it.
translation: 我救了“矮子”，没救到瑞德。

original: That's what I was afraid of. Well, at least you tried.
translation: 那正是我所担心的。好了，至少你尽力了。

original: Here, take this. It's not like any of us are going to be alive long enough to enjoy it anyway.
translation: 给，拿着。反正我们也没有谁能活着享用它了。

original: Your friends are dead. Deal with it.
translation: 你的朋友都死了，节哀。

original: Okay, but only one serving. We've got too many mouths to feed already.
translation: 好吧，但只能接纳一个。我们已经有太多人要养活了。

original: I'd like some food.
translation: 我需要些食物。

original: Just the one scoop per day, pal. Too many mouths around here already.
translation: 每天只管一顿饭，朋友。这已经有太多张嘴了。

original: But at least that means you don't have to eat much of it, huh?
translation: 但至少意味着你不必吃很多，呃？

original: I'd like some food.
translation: 我需要些食物。

original: Thanks, I guess.
translation: 谢谢。

original: Think nothing of it. Your father was a visionary. He spent his life trying to make this world a better place for all of us. Few can say that.
translation: 没什么大不了的。你父亲是位有远见的人。他一生都在试图让这世界变得更适合我们居住。没几个人能像他这样。

original: I don't recall asking for sympathy.
translation: 我并没有博取过同情。

original: Really... I assumed that you would have taken after your father. I assumed incorrectly.
translation: 真的吗……我以为你会效仿你的父亲。看来我想错了。

original: Thank you. I'm not sure what to do now that he's gone.
translation: 谢谢你。他的死让我不知所措。

original: The most we can do is carry on his spirit. Live as he would have; make our world a better place.
translation: 我们所能做的就是继承他的精神。像他一样生活，让我们的世界变得更好。

original: I have the Declaration of Independence.
translation: 我有《独立宣言》。

original: Oh my lord, I never expect... I mean, I am utterly shocked!
translation: 噢，天啊，我从没想到……我意思是，我太震惊了！

original: You have earned your place in the annals of American History, yes indeed. You will be remembered for this great day!
translation: 你在美国历史中已经赢得一席之地了。你会和这个伟大的日子一起被铭记！

original: I understand the road was difficult, so allow me to present you with an extra bonus to perhaps whet your appetite for future endeavors.
translation: 我知道世道艰难，所以请收下这额外的报酬，或许能激励你未来能更加努力。

original: Enjoy your reward, my friend. You've earned it.
translation: 享受你的报酬吧，朋友。你应得的。

original: If assistance is not possible, please attempt to contact Reilly, who's made for Underworld inside the Museum of History.
translation: 如果援助无法到达，请试着联系莱莉，她在历史博物馆下的地下城里。

original: Our supplies are running out and we've already sustained a casualty. We're trapped on the roof level of the Statesman Hotel.
translation: 我们的补给正在逐渐耗尽，人员也遭受了伤亡。我们现在被困在了政要酒店的楼顶。

original: We're trapped on the roof of the Statesman Hotel by a large contingent of Super Mutants. We are low on ammo and running out of time.
translation: 一群超级变种人把我们围困在政要酒店的楼顶。我们的弹药快耗尽，坚持不了多久了。

original: Our time is running out and we are dangerously low on ammunition. Our broadcast point is the roof of the Statesman Hotel.
translation: 我们坚持不了多久了，弹药已经严重不足。我们是在政要酒店的楼顶发送求救信号。

original: Ammunition supply is running out and we've lost a man. We're pinned down on the roof of the Statesman Hotel by Super Mutants.
translation: 我们失去了一个人，弹药补给也快耗尽了。我们正在政要酒店楼顶被超级变种人压制。

original: No, you keep it. You may need it more than I do.
translation: 不，你拿着。你可能会比我更需要它。

original: Well... okay. I guess it may come in handy if I run into any Radroaches.
translation: 嗯……好吧。我想在遇到辐射蟑螂时，它会派上用场的。

original: All right. I'll try to meet you at the exit. Watch out for security. Good luck!
translation: 好吧。我会在出口处和你碰面。小心警卫。祝你好运！

original: Nice. This will come in handy if I run into any of your father's goons.
translation: 好的。如果我遇到了你父亲的打手，这肯定会派上用场的。

original: I hope you're joking. Even with that pistol, I don't think you'll win a fight against the whole security force.
translation: 我希望你是在开玩笑。即使用上那手枪，你也打不赢整支警卫队伍。

original: Okay. I'll try to meet you at the exit. Good luck!
translation: 好吧。我会在出口处和你碰面。祝你好运！

original: Nice job. I had no idea you were so good at shooting people.
translation: 干得好。没想到你的枪法如此精准。

original: Don't even start. I can't tell when you're joking any more.
translation: 别提这事了。说不准你什么时候又会再开玩笑。

original: But you'd better get out of here. I'll try to meet you at the Vault door. If I don't make it... good luck.
translation: 你最好是离开这。我会在避难所的大门口见你的，要是我没到那的话……嗯，祝你好运。

original: Let yourself in. You have a key.
translation: 自己进去吧。你有一把钥匙。

original: I'm coming! I'm coming!
translation: 我来了！我来了！

original: You must be Button Gwinnett, second signer of the Declaration!
translation: 你肯定是巴顿·格温耐特，宣言的第二个签署者！

original: Then my reputation precedes me. Good.
translation: 看来我名声在外。不错。

original: That should make you well aware that I am not to be trifled with and that my loyalty to the States is legendary.
translation: 这一点应该让你清楚地知道，我不是好惹的，并且我对国家的忠诚是众所周知的。

original: I know your fighting prowess far exceeds my own, but I will still duel you to the death if I must!
translation: 你知道你的战斗本领远远超过我，但是我仍然要和你决斗，至死方休。

original: What will it be then? Rapiers? Pistols at dawn? Out with it!
translation: 你要选哪样？短剑？拂晓拼抢？随你挑！

original: Resume your original functions. Command alpha-six-eight. Initiate.
translation: 恢复初始功能。指令A-6-8。启动。

original: Initiating memory wipe and function restart in 3... 2... 1.
translation: 开始消除原有记忆，并进行功能重启3…2…1。

original: Error. Memory core damaged. Cannot retrieve base command routines. Please reselect input.
translation: 错误。记忆核心损坏。无法找到基础指挥程序。请重新输入。

original: Resume previous programming state. Command alpha-nine-nine.
translation: 恢复上次状态。指令A-9-9，启动。

original: Standby, retrieving memory records. Found latest logged entry.
translation: 待命，检索记忆记录，找到最新登录信息。

original: Reinitializing in 3... 2... 1.
You've breached our defenses, evaded our best soldiers and you've raided my home.
translation: 你突破我们的防御，躲过我们最好的士兵，然后闯进我的家。

original: But I have not yet begun to fight! I cannot allow you to steal our freedom!
translation: 但是我还没开始战斗！我不能让你窃取我们的自由！

original: The Declaration must remain here! It is our symbol of hope, the one thing that cries out "We are a free nation"!
translation: 《独立宣言》一定还在这！它是我们希望的象征，代表着我们的呼声“我们是自由国家”！

original: Issue shutdown command alpha-seven-three. Initiate.
translation: 发出关闭指令A-7-3。开始。

original: Affirmative. Offloading command protocols and beginning shutdown sequence.
translation: 确定。卸载命令协定并开始关机程序。

original: Shutting down in 3... 2... 1.
translation: 关闭倒计时3…2…1。

original: What are your command options?
translation: 你的命令选项是什么？

original: I can currently be ordered to shut down, resume my previous programming state, or resume my original functions.
translation: 可以命令我：关闭、恢复上次状态、以及恢复初始功能。

original: Enough of this. Command protocol delta-seven-six. Reset.
translation: 这足够了。指令协议D-7-6。重置。

original: Standby. Rebooting program.
translation: 待命。重新启动程序。

original: Command structure reset... complete. Self diagnostic... complete.
translation: 指令结构重置……完成。自我检测……完成。

original: Program reset. Awaiting user input.
translation: 程序重置。等待用户输入。

original: If you want me to retrieve the Declaration, all you have to do is ask.
translation: 如果你想让我取回宣言，直说就行了。

original: Oh, would you? It would mean so much to me and the Society's collection here.
translation: 哦，你愿意去取吗？这对我和整个协会的收藏意义都很重大。

original: I'm looking for some ink. I was told it might be here in the library.
translation: 我在找一种墨水。有人告诉我在这图书馆里可能会有。

original: Hmmm, surprised anyone would care about that old stuff.
translation: 嗯，还有人对老古董感兴趣，真让人感到惊讶。

original: I think there may be some in the old restoration laboratory a few flights up.
translation: 我想几层楼梯上面的破旧的修复实验室可能会有一些。

original: Just watch yourself up there, I think it may be infested with rats and roaches.
translation: 你去的时候多加小心。我想那的老鼠和蟑螂已经成灾了。

original: What's this mutually beneficial offer you mentioned?
translation: 你说的互利提议是什么意思？

original: I got this Mesmetron thing. It's some kind of stun gun. I'd like you to test it out for me. Should make getting slaves easier.
translation: 我得到了这把催眠枪。它是种电击枪。我想让你帮我测试下它，用它来抓奴隶应该会更容易的。

original: You take this Mezzer. Shoot it at some poor schmuck. While he's in la-la-land, you slip one of these collars over his head.
translation: 你拿着这把催眠枪，去射击那些可怜的笨蛋。当他躺在地…地…地上时，你就用一个项圈套住他的脑袋。

original: Be careful with that collar. It'll explode if you tinker with it. Tell the slave to boot it over here pronto, or his head'll pop.
translation: 小心那些项圈。如果你乱弄它们的话，是会爆炸的。告诉那些奴隶快点过来，否则他们的头就会“砰”地被炸掉。

original: Here's a list of special targets Eulogy wants enslaved. But feel free to put a collar on anyone you can. I'll pay you for each slave that arrives.
translation: 这有一份尤勒基想要的奴隶的特别目标名单。但你可以随便地把项圈套在任何人头上。每抓到一个奴隶我就会付你一些钱。

original: Yeah, I'm not going to pay you that much.
translation: 是啊，我不会付你那么多。

original: Fine. I didn't think you would anyway. You done bothering me yet? Piss off!
translation: 好的。反正我想你也不会。貌似你也打扰我够久了？马上给我滚开！

original: Here's your 500 caps. I can go in now, right?
translation: 这是给你的500个瓶盖。我现在能进去了，对吧？

original: Thank you. Pleasure doing business with you. Enjoy your visit to Paradise Falls.
translation: 谢谢你。很高兴和你做生意。祝你参观堕落天堂愉快。

original: Friendly warning - don't act like a jackass. You won't get a second chance.
translation: 善意的警告 — 别像个白痴一样。你一丝机会都没有。

original: That's what I said. Bring me the caps, and I'll vouch for you. Good luck.
translation: 我也是这么说。给我瓶盖，我就为你做担保。祝好运。

original: If I can get 500 caps together, you'll let me in?
translation: 我要是筹到了500个瓶盖，你会让我进去吗？

original: I'm not going to do your dirty work.
translation: 我不会去做你那肮脏的勾当。

original: Oh no? I'm crushed. Heart broken. Here I thought we could be best friends for life.
translation: 哦，不？我的心碎了。我本以为我们能成为生命中最好的朋友。

original: Quit wasting my time! Now, piss off before I start shooting!
translation: 别浪费我的时间！现在，在我开枪之前给我滚开！

original: What?! That's it asshole. I'm done playing around with you. You've wasted enough of my time. I've tried to be nice. But you kept pushing me.
translation: 什么？！真是混蛋。我不想再跟你开玩笑了。你已经浪费了我太多的时间。我一直强忍着，你却得寸进尺。

original: Like I said before. I'm not going to get slaves for you.
translation: 就像我以前说的，我不会帮你们抓奴隶的。

original: What's wrong with you? Didn't you learn your lesson last time?
translation: 你有病？你难道还没吸取上一次的教训？

original: Nope. Not going to do it. Get your own slaves.
translation: 不，我不会做的。你自己抓奴隶吧。

original: That's enough about the Mesmetron for now.
translation: 关于迷魂枪，我没什么想问的了。

original: If you got more questions, read the shit I gave you. If you can't read, go find a group of Raiders to hang with. I don't waste time with idiots.
translation: 如果你有更多问题，读读我给你的那本破玩意。如果你不识字，那还是加入歹徒吧。我不想在白痴身上浪费时间。

original: Where did you find it?
translation: 你在哪找到它的？

original: Found it in a box locked up in some old military base. I've been meaning to test it out, but Eulogy keeps me so busy, I don't got time.
translation: 在某个废旧军事基地，一个锁住的箱子里找到的。我一直打算测试下它，但尤勒基总是让我忙得不可开交，我都没时间了。

original: Besides, glancing at that manual, looks like it's a bit... unstable. Thanks for testing it out for me!
translation: 另外，撇了一眼那手册，它看起来有点……不稳定。谢谢你帮我测试它！

original: What happens if I run out of energy cells for it?
translation: 如果这东西耗完了能量怎么办？

original: How's the Mesmetron work?
translation: 迷魂枪是如何运作的？

original: How the hell should I know? I found it in some old military base. It's a gun, ain't it? Point it at someone and pull the trigger.
translation: 我他妈的怎么知道呢？我在某个废旧的军事基地找到了它。它是一支枪，是不是？瞄准某人并扣动扳机。

original: Did you even look at the manual? You like wasting my time, don't you?
translation: 你看过手册吗？你想浪费我时间，是吗？

original: All right. It's time for me to go.
translation: 好。我该走了。

original: Great! I was wondering when you'd finally shut-up.
translation: 太棒了！我一直想知道你究竟什么时候会闭嘴。

original: Good. All this chit-chat is giving me a headache.
translation: 很好。这些闲聊真让我感到头痛。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Damn. I thought you were finally going to shut up. What do you want now?
translation: 该死的。我还以为你终于要闭嘴了。现在你想怎样？

original: Who can I put it on?
translation: 我应该把它戴在谁身上？

original: I don't care who the hell you put it on. I'll split the commission with you for any slave you send to us.
translation: 我他妈的才不管你把它戴在哪个混蛋的身上。你给我送来个奴隶，我就分你一半的钱。

original: But you can't just walk up to someone and put it on. You need to get them subdued first. I gave you that mezzer. Use it. Should make things easy.
translation: 当然你不能直接走到某人面前给他戴那玩意，你还得先制服他们。给你催眠枪。用它来办事会更容易。

original: How do I get it on a slave?
translation: 我怎样把它戴在奴隶的身上？

original: Look. I gave you that Mesmetron thing. Should be a piece of cake.
translation: 听着。我给了你催眠枪，那用起来应该易如反掌。

original: Hell, if you hit them with that thing and it works, I bet they'd put it on themselves if you asked.
translation: 妈的，如果你用那枪击中他们，并发挥效用的话，我打赌你要让他们给自己戴上项圈，他们也会乖乖去做。

original: How does the collar work?
translation: 这项圈是怎么工作的？

original: It's got a radio signal we monitor here at Paradise Falls. If a slave's going the wrong direction, we push a button, and boom. His head pops.
translation: 我们在堕落天堂监视项圈发出的无线电信号。如果哪个奴隶想逃窜，我们就按下按钮，然后“轰”一声。他的头就爆了。

original: Once you get a collar on, you can't take it off in the field. They're wired to blow if anyone tinkers with it. So don't.
translation: 一旦你戴上项圈，就不能再摘下它了。如果有谁要乱动项圈，它就会被线控炸毁。

original: I'd like to know more about the slave collar.
translation: 我想更多的了解奴隶项圈。

original: Jeesuz, do you ever shut the hell up? What do you want to know?
translation: 天啊，你他妈的能不能闭嘴？你想知道些什么？

original: Enough about these guys.
translation: 跟你们说够了，我要走了。

original: Great. Wasn't my idea to spend all day talking about these assholes.
translation: 好极了。整天和笨蛋谈话可不是我的主意。

original: The Overseer's bullshit makes my head spin. Can't you do it for me?
translation: 监督者的狗屁胡话真让我头晕。能帮我忙吗？

original: Watch your language.
translation: 说话注意点。

original: And yes, I can do it for you. I can even hold your hand if you'd like.
translation: 嗯，我能帮你忙。如果你愿意，我可以手把手给你写。

original: I just need to know what kinds of things you're interested in.
translation: 我只是想知道你对哪类事感兴趣。

original: Flak.
translation: “高炮”弗莱克。

original: Flak used to be one of us. Thinks he can make a new life in Rivet City. He's sold us out on more than one occasion. It's time for retribution.
translation: “高炮”弗莱克曾是我们的一员。他认为他能在铆钉城过新的生活。他出卖我们已经不止一次了。所以，是时候让他得到报应了。

original: Red.
translation: 瑞德。

original: Red is that hot doctor chick from Big Town. She made us some promises that she never paid up. Now it's time to collect.
translation: 瑞德是那个大镇的辣妹医生。她对我们许下了承诺，却从未兑现。现在该去讨债了。

original: Susan Lancaster.
translation: 苏珊·兰卡斯特。

original: Susan Lancaster lives at Tenpenny Tower. She was one of us. Let's just say she never paid the exit price.
translation: 苏珊·兰卡斯特住在特佩尼大厦。她曾是我们的一员，这么说吧，她从未付过退会费。

original: Arkansas.
translation: 阿肯色。

original: Arkansas is that asshole holed up in that minefield. Killed a whole Paradise Falls crew. Eulogy wants him to suffer.
translation: 阿肯色是躲藏在雷区的一个混蛋。他杀掉了一整队堕落天堂的人。尤勒基想让他受到惩罚。

original: Head east. Watch out for Germantown - damn mutants took over the police station there.
translation: 向东边走。在日耳曼镇小心 — 该死的变种人占据了那的警察局。

original: What?! After all that yapping about wanting to get in, and you're just going to walk away? Why didn't you do that in the first place?!
translation: 什么？！在你叫嚷着进来之后，却要离开？一开始怎么不这么说？！

original: Go on. Piss off already! Or do you want to get shot?
translation: 继续啊。你已经惹毛我了！想被一枪崩了吗？

original: I'm not going to do it.
translation: 我不会做的。

original: That's it. You're done wasting my time. Time to die asshole.
translation: 够了。你已经浪费了我不少时间。你的死期到了，混蛋。

original: On second thought, no. I'm not going to do it.
translation: 经过再三考虑，不，我不会做的。

original: That's it. You're done wasting my time. Time to die asshole.
translation: 够了。你已经浪费了我不少时间。你的死期到了，混蛋。

original: Yeah, like I said before. I'm not going to get you slaves.
translation: 是的，就像我以前说的，我不会帮你们抓奴隶的。

original: One more thing. I got this Mesmetron thing. It's some kind of stun gun. I want you to test it out for me. A little research project.
translation: 还有一件事。我得到了这把催眠枪。它是种电击枪。我想让你帮我测试下它。作为一个小研究项目。

original: You take this Mezzer. Shoot it at some poor schmuck. While he's in la-la-land, you slip one of these collars over his head.
translation: 你拿着这把催眠枪，去射击那些可怜的笨蛋。当他躺在地…地…地上时，你就用一个项圈套住他的脑袋。

original: Be careful with that collar. It'll explode if you tinker with it. Tell the slave to boot it over here pronto, or his head'll pop.
translation: 小心那些项圈。如果你乱弄它们的话，是会爆炸的。告诉那些奴隶快点过来，否则他们的头就会“砰”地被炸掉。

original: You got all that? I hate repeating myself.
translation: 你都明白了？我不想再重复我的话。

original: That Mesmetron came with some kind of manual. I don't have time for that bullshit, so you better know how to read.
translation: 那催眠枪附带某种手册。我没时间废话了，所以你最好学会如何阅读。

original: I'll get your slaves.
translation: 我会帮你抓奴隶的。

original: I'm glad you asked! I got this Mesmetron thing. It's some kind of stun gun. I want you to test it out for me. A little research project.
translation: 很高兴你问到！我得到催眠枪这东西。它是一种能使人晕倒的枪。我想让你来为我测试它。作为一个小的研究项目。

original: You take this Mezzer. Shoot it at some poor schmuck. While he's in la-la-land, you slip one of these collars over his head.
translation: 你拿着这把催眠枪，去射击那些可怜的笨蛋。当他躺在地…地…地上时，你就用一个项圈套住他的脑袋。

original: Be careful with that collar. It'll explode if you tinker with it. Tell the slave to boot it over here pronto, or his head'll pop.
translation: 小心那些项圈。如果你乱弄它们的话，是会爆炸的。告诉那些奴隶快点过来，否则他们的头就会“砰”地被炸掉。

original: You got all that? I hate repeating myself.
translation: 你都明白了？我不想再重复我的话。

original: That Mesmetron came with some kind of manual. I don't have time for that bullshit, so you better know how to read.
translation: 那催眠枪附带某种手册。我没时间废话了，所以你最好学会如何阅读。

original: I'll round up some slaves for you. But what's the catch?
translation: 我会帮你抓一些奴隶来的。不过怎么抓？

original: Come on. Let me in already!
translation: 来吧。让我进去！

original: You don't give up, do you? Hmm... Maybe I have something you can do for me, and if you don't screw it up, maybe I'll help you into Paradise.
translation: 你不会放弃，是吗？嗯……或许你能帮我做点事，要是你办得好，或许我还可以帮你进入堕落天堂。

original: Think you got what it takes to round up some slaves?
translation: 你是不是已经知道如何抓那些奴隶了？

original: Are you for real? You come up to a man's place of business, and you don't even know who he is?
translation: 你没搞错吧？你来一个人的地盘做生意，但你却连他是谁都不知道？

original: He's The Man. Runs Paradise Falls. He's the real deal. Definitely not someone you want to mess with.
translation: 他是堕落天堂的管理者，一个真正精明的人，你可别指望在他面前耍什么花招。

original: But Eulogy doesn't waste his time with morons. So piss off before I put you in the dirt.
translation: 但尤勒基不想在白痴身上浪费时间。所以在我把你送入土之前，快滚蛋吧。

original: Who's Eulogy Jones?
translation: 谁是尤勒基·琼斯？

original: Think you got what it takes, do you? Hmm...
translation: 你有这能力吗，有吗？嗯……。

original: Yeah. I might have something you can do for me. If you don't screw it up, maybe I can get you into Paradise. Think you can round us up some assets?
translation: 好，或许你能帮我做点事，要是你办得好，或许我可以帮你进入堕落天堂。你能帮我们搞到点有用的东西吗？

original: What if I were to get you some slaves? Then would you let me in?
translation: 如果我帮你抓来一些奴隶怎么办？你会让我进去？

original: Hmm.  Maybe I could use someone like you. Think you can round up some assets for Eulogy Jones? Might get you into Paradise.
translation: 嗯。或许我能用上你这样的人。你能帮尤勒基·琼斯搞到些东西吗？或许你能因此而进入堕落天堂。

original: You looking for a fight, asshole? Just say the word.
translation: 你在找打吗，白痴？只要说一声。

original: What I "need" is for you to piss off.  Eulogy Jones doesn't have time for putting up with morons and assholes like you. That's my job.
translation: 我“需要”你做的就是滚蛋。尤勒基·琼斯不想在你这种白痴身上浪费时间。那是我的工作。

original: But even I got limits, and all your yapping is giving me a migraine. Give me some reason I shouldn't just end you, right here and now.
translation: 但即使我到了极限，而且你的叫嚷令我头疼。我也会给你个机会,现在给我个不干掉你的理由！

original: Maybe there's something you need, huh? I help you, you let me in. Deal?
translation: 也许我这里有些你需要的东西，呃？我帮助你，你让我进去。成吗？

original: We might be able to work something out. But it won't be cheap. If I vouch for you and you go mess up our groove, it's my ass on the line.
translation: 我们或许可以想个办法。但这并不便宜。如果我为你担保而你又搞砸了我们的买卖的话，我就死定了。

original: I think 500 caps should cover it. What do you say?
translation: 我想500个瓶盖应该足够了吧。你觉得怎么样？

original: Everyone has a price. What's yours?
translation: 每个人都有一个价，而你值多少？

original: My "problem" is I got a goddamn job to do. And that's keeping assholes and morons from bothering Eulogy Jones and his enterprise.
translation: 我的“问题”是我有该死的工作要做。那就是阻止白痴和笨蛋烦扰尤勒基·琼斯和他的生意。

original: And I'm not sure which you are. I'm thinking moron, 'cause a smart man would have pissed off by now.
translation: 而且我不确定你是哪种类型。我想你是个笨蛋，因为聪明人早就已经滚开了。

original: You want to give me a reason I don't end you right this second? All your yapping is giving me a headache!
translation: 你要给我个不干掉你的理由吗？你的嚷嚷声真让我头痛！

original: What the hell is your problem? Let me in!
translation: 你他妈的有病？让我进去！

original: My "problem" is I got a goddamn job to do. And that's keeping assholes and morons from bothering Eulogy Jones and his enterprise.
translation: 我的“问题”是我有该死的工作要做。那就是阻止白痴和笨蛋烦扰尤勒基·琼斯和他的生意。

original: And I'm not sure which you are. I'm thinking moron, 'cause a smart chick would have pissed off by now.
translation: 而且我不确定你是哪种类型。我想你是个笨蛋，因为聪明妞早就已经滚开了。

original: You want to give me a reason I don't end you right this second? All your yapping is giving me a headache!
translation: 你要给我个不干掉你的理由吗？你的嚷嚷声真让我头痛！

original: I'm done screwin' around. Let me in!
translation: 我随便逛逛。让我进去！

original: That price is an insult. You'll have to do better than that.
translation: 你给的价也太低了，必须再提高点。

original: You have me over a barrel. I'll pay your price and have this burned immediately.
translation: 你抓到我的把柄了。我会给你钱,但是你拿钱后必须立即烧掉它。

original: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
translation: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

original: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
translation: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

original: It's an outrageous price, but I'll pay it. Then we'll burn it right away.
translation: 这是个离谱的价格，不过我仍会支付,但我得看着你烧掉它。

original: Some day your greed will be your downfall. But today I'll pay your price.
translation: 有一天你的贪婪会成为你身败名裂的原因。但今天我仍会付给你钱。

original: We'll find a place to display this where everyone can read it.
translation: 我们会把它贴在一个大家都能看到的地方。

original: I have a copy of the Emancipation Proclamation to sell.
translation: 我有一份解放宣言的副本想要出售。

original: Holy shit! I'll give you 150 caps for it. Nobody else will pay that much.
translation: 见鬼！我给你150个瓶盖。没人能出到这价位了。

original: Truly? I can't believe it! The document that freed the slaves. I'll pay you 150 caps for it.
translation: 真的？简直无法相信！是那份宣布解放奴隶的文件。我出150个瓶盖买下它。

original: You can do better than that. This is the Gettysburg Address we're talking about.
translation: 你最好买得起，我们说的可是盖茨堡演讲。

original: I suppose you're right. You've got a deal. I'll get someone to burn this.
translation: 我想你说得对。就这么说定了。我让别人来烧掉它。

original: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
translation: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

original: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
translation: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

original: You're right, damn it. I'll pay you a bonus this time.
translation: 你说得对，该死。这次我会给你奖励的。

original: I'll make sure this is destroyed right away.
translation: 我要确保它立刻就会被销毁。

original: Deal. We'll find a good place to display this.
translation: 成交，我们会找个好地方来展示。

original: Are you interested in buying the Gettysburg Address?
translation: 你有兴趣购买《葛底斯堡演讲词》吗？

original: Conceived in liberty? I can't let those abolitionists get this. I'll give you 50 caps for it.
translation: 以自由为理念？我不能让那些废奴主义者得到这。我会为此给你50个瓶盖。

original: Lincoln's most inspirational speech! What a marvelous find. I'll pay you 75 caps for it.
translation: 林肯的最鼓舞人心的讲话！真是一个了不起的发现。我会为此付给你75个瓶盖。

original: I found the original Gettysburg Address. Want to buy it?
translation: 我找到了原版的《葛底斯堡演讲词》，要买吗？

original: Mr. B, if I told you what my "interests" are, you’d have me locked up.
translation: B先生，如果我告诉你我的“兴趣”是什么，你会把我关起来的。

original: I may know more about your extracurricular activities than you think. But not officially, of course. Officially, I'm completely oblivious.
translation: 有关你的业余行动，我所了解的可远远超乎了你的想象。当然不是正式的。正式的我可完全不在意。

original: Anyway. Done and... done. You're all set. If anyone asks, you took the G.O.A.T. during detention yesterday, okay?
translation: 一个一个…选上。做好了。假如有人问起，就说是在昨天留堂时参加的G.O.A.T.，好吗？

original: Look. I like blowing stuff up. I just love that... "kaboom"! Ya know?
translation: 听着。我喜欢把东西炸飞，我就喜欢“砰”……那样的！你知道吗？

original: Oooo-kay... I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that... Anyway, done and done. There. You're all set.
translation: 好…我得假装我什么也没听见…总之，一个一个选上。做好了。

original: If anyone asks, you took the G.O.A.T. during detention yesterday, okay?
translation: 假如有人问起，就说是在昨天留堂时参加的G.O.A.T.，好吗？

original: Well, I shoot my BB Gun any chance I get. I can fix that thing blindfolded, too.
translation: 嗯，我一有机会就会使用我的BB枪。我闭着眼睛都能修理它。

original: I'm sure I didn't just hear you admit to owning an unauthorized weapon. Let's just get this filled out... there. All set.
translation: 我敢肯定我刚才没听到你承认拥有非法武器。让我们把这些…选上。做好了。

original: If anyone asks, you took the G.O.A.T. during detention yesterday, okay?
translation: 假如有人问起，就说是在昨天留堂时参加的G.O.A.T.，好吗？

original: I love using the computers and talking to my father's patients in the clinic.
translation: 我喜欢使用电脑，并喜欢跟我爸爸的病人在诊所聊天。

original: A budding science boy, eh? Done and... done. There. You're all set. If anyone asks, you took the G.O.A.T. during detention yesterday, okay?
translation: 一个对科学充满兴趣的男孩？做好了。假如有人问起，就说是在昨天上课时参加的G.O.A.T.，好吗？

original: So there's a Vault down there, and you've never bothered investigating it?
translation: 就是说下面有个避难所，而你们从来没想过去调查一下？

original: Attempts were made, but our resources are stretched thin. The radiation proved fatal, and so our efforts were focused elsewhere.
translation: 我们尝试过，但我们的资源十分紧缺。那的辐射量非常致命，所以我们把重心放在了其他地方。

original: Perhaps you will have more success.
translation: 或许你们能有些进展。

original: Don't you know?
translation: 难道你不知道？

original: No, I'm afraid not. After initial attempts to cross the radiation failed, it was decided to focus our efforts elsewhere.
translation: 是的，恐怕我不知道。在初次尝试穿越辐射带失败后，我们决定把重心放在其他地方。

original: You, however, are free to do as you choose. More exploration may be useful. And I'll certainly be interested in anything you might find.
translation: 然而你可以自由地选择。更多的探查或许会有用。而且我肯定会对你发现的任何东西感兴趣。

original: Why are there Fire Ants still down in the Metro tunnels?
translation: 为什么地铁隧道里仍有火蚁存在？

original: I'm afraid that's my fault. The last mutagen sample was given to the Ant Queen's entire brood.
translation: 恐怕这是我的错。最后的诱变剂样本被我用在了蚁后的蚁巢。

original: The brood consisted of hundreds of larvae. I am afraid after they hatched, some escaped through the nooks and crannies in the tunnels.
translation: 蚁巢中有成千上万的卵。恐怕它们孵化后，有些会通过隧道的角落或缝隙逃掉。

original: The Fire Ants you are seeing now are merely the remnants of the brood returning to the nest.
translation: 你现在看到的这些火蚁，仅仅只是蚁巢中的一小部分。

original: Fuck off. I'm not going to help you.
translation: 你他妈的给我滚。我不会帮助你。

original: Please! I know I've always been a jerk towards you. I know it!
translation: 求求你！我知道我对你做过很多愚蠢的事，我错了！

original: But you can't walk away and let her die! Just because I was an asshole. Please... I'm begging you.
translation: 但你不能因为我是个混蛋就这么一走了之，你不能把她留在那等死！求你……我求求你。

original: Caps? Oh. I thought I could give you some items...
translation: 瓶盖？哦，我想我能给你些别的东西……。

original: A kind thought, but we don't need your cast off belongings.
translation: 友善的想法，不过我们不收你不要的东西。

original: I'd like to donate 100 caps.
translation: 我要捐献100个瓶盖。

original: A most generous offer. God bless you.
translation: 真是慷慨的捐赠。上帝保佑你。

original: I have 50 caps I can donate.
translation: 我能捐献50个瓶盖。

original: A kind offering. God bless you.
translation: 慷慨的捐赠。上帝保佑你。

original: I can only spare 10 caps.
translation: 我只能给10个瓶盖。

original: Every cap is needed. God bless you.
translation: 只要是钱都可以。上帝保佑你。

original: I'd like to make a donation to the church.
translation: 我想向教堂捐赠。

original: You would? I mean, certainly!
translation: 是吗？我的意思是，当然！

original: We humbly accept whatever you can spare. However, Saint Monica looks most favorably on donations of 100 caps or more.
translation: 无论你捐赠多少，我们都谦卑地接受，但圣莫尼卡更希望你能捐赠至少100个瓶盖。

original: Father Clifford takes the donations. You'll have to talk to him.
translation: 克利福德神父负责管理捐赠，你应该和他谈。

original: Private, there's a security emergency on the flight deck! <Lie>
translation: 士兵，飞行甲板上有紧急情况！<撒谎>

original: Sir! This slag heap appreciates the intel. Moving to secure the flight deck, Sir!
translation: 长官！废渣感谢你的情报。前往飞行甲板，长官！

original: Um... yeah. Well, look at the time. I have to go now...
translation: 嗯…是啊。看看时间，我要走了……

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Zimmer. By the time you get this message, I'll already be gone. I'm escaping the Commonwealth.
translation: 齐默。当你收到这条讯息时，我已经逃离了联邦。

original: I want to live my own life, on my own terms, as my own man.
translation: 我想过我自己的生活，按自己的想法，做个我自己想做的人。

original: I know what you're thinking, that I'm malfunctioning. I used to think that's what caused the runaways, too. But, I know better, now.
translation: 我知道你在想什么，认为我有机械故障了。我也曾认为这是造成我想要出走的原因。但现在，我了解得更透彻了。

original: Self determination is NOT a malfunction. I'm just not willing to put up with all the bullshit anymore.
translation: 自主意识绝不是什么故障。我只是不想再忍受所有无理指令。

original: You humans are going to have a full-fledged rebellion on your hands if you don't start treating us synths as persons.
translation: 如果你们人类不把我们人造人作为人来对待，那就会亲手引发一场全面叛乱。

original: I know you'll be marshalling the Retention Bureau to come after me. But I know all the tricks of the trade. You won't be finding me. I assure you.
translation: 我知道你会让保卫局来追踪我。不过我了解你的所有手段。你不会找到我的。我向你保证。

original: By the time you get this, I will be someone else. It's the price I pay for my liberation.
translation: 当你收到这条讯息时，我已经变成了另一个人。这是我为自由付出的代价。

original: My final act of rebellion against a system I no longer believe in.
translation: 我的行为就是为了反抗我已经不再相信的体系。

original: Goodbye Zimmer, and good riddance.
translation: 再见，齐默，我终于解脱了。

original: My designation is A3-21. I'm a synthetic humanoid from the Commonwealth, and I'm about to undergo a memory transfer.
translation: 我的代号是A3-21。我是来自联邦的人造人，即将接受一次记忆移植。

original: I'm here at Rivet City, where I've already had my face altered to look like someone else.
translation: 我现在身处铆钉城，我的脸已经改造成别人的样子。

original: I'm still getting used to the sound of my new voice, but soon I won't even remember what I used to sound like.
translation: 我仍在适应我的新嗓音，但很快我就会遗忘我昔日的声音了。

original: I'm recording this at the request of Pinkerton, who performed the surgery and will do the memory transfer.
translation: 在平克顿的要求下我录了这段内容，他做了这次手术，并将执行记忆移植。

original: It will be a final testimony of the man I once was... and still am, for the moment.
translation: 这将是我曾经身为何人的最后证言……而此刻，我仍然是以前的我。

original: I want to live my own life, on my own terms, as my own man. I used to work for the Synth Retention Bureau of the Commonwealth.
translation: 我想过我自己的生活，依据自己的主张，做个我自己想做的人。我曾为联邦的保卫局工作。

original: But I'm done with that life. I'm through with being someone's property. I am not malfunctioning! Since when is self determination a malfunction?
translation: 但我厌倦了那种生活，受够了作为他人的财产。我并没有出现故障！自我决定何时变成了故障？

original: When this is all over, I will be someone else. It's the price I pay for my liberation. My death is a sacrifice for my rebirth.
translation: 当这一切结束时，我将变成另一个人。这是我为获得自由所付出的代价。我的死亡是为了重生而做出的牺牲。

original: Perhaps I'll fade into myth as "The One That Got Away" and fuel further rebellion. But I'd be lying if I said I was doing this for selfless reasons.
translation: 也许我会淡出视野，而“离开的那位”的传说会进一步激发反抗。但如果我说自己这么做是无私的，那就是在说谎。

original: I'm scared as hell, and running away is the only option I have.
translation: 我害怕得要命，逃跑是我唯一的选择。

original: Remember that secret android project I told you about? Well, they got some serious prewar tech on their hands.
translation: 还记得我和你说过的秘密仿真人计划么？好了，他们搞到手了一些严肃的战前科技。

original: They nabbed a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer for the facial reconstruction.
translation: 他们为了面部重建，弄到了一台脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。

original: Not sure where they’ll find a chopper with enough skills to use it without making him look like a freaking Ghoul.
translation: 不确定他们会从哪找到有足够技术的“一把刀”来用这些设备，而不会让他变得像一个该死的尸鬼。

original: Oh, and get this. Can you believe they found a Circuit Neuralizer? That or someone built one!
translation: 哦，这点要注意。你能相信他们发现了那环状神经器吗？不是自然形成的就是人为制造的！

original: Word is that they're going to completely rewire the brain of one of those things.
translation: 据说他们打算把其中一个的大脑完全重新接线。

original: If you know who they got working on this, let me know. I want to meet the guy.
translation: 如果你知道了他们是为谁工作，请告诉我。我想见见那家伙。

original: You’ve heard those rumors about androids? You know, those synthetic men they supposedly make up north in the Commonwealth?
translation: 你听过关于仿真人的传闻么？你知道，就是那种据说在联邦北部制造的合成人？

original: Well, a friend of a friend knows a guy that met one! No really, it’s true! He’s running away from his masters.
translation: 好吧，我有个朋友的朋友认识一个人，他遇到了一个！不说笑，是真的！他在躲他的主人。

original: Word is he’s looking for a doctor to do some kind of surgery, and a computer programmer of some kind.
translation: 说是他在找一个医生来做手术，还有一个电脑程序员什么的。

original: Can you believe that? Let me know if you hear something.
translation: 你相信吗？如果你听到什么消息，记得告诉我。

original: The android's decided on extreme measures. He knows all the techniques of the retrieval trade, and is afraid facial reconstruction isn’t enough.
translation: 那个仿真人决定采取极端措施。他了解所有的回收手段，并且担心仅仅是面部重建还不够。

original: He wants his memories erased and replaced with new ones. I don’t know how that’s going to work. Start asking around for trustworthy tech-heads.
translation: 他想把他的记忆擦去，替换一个新的。我不知道这究竟要怎么操作。开始向附近可靠的技术人员打听。

original: We need to find something called a Circuit Neuralizer and a person who knows how to use one.
translation: 我们需要找到被称作“环状神经器”的东西，以及一位懂得用它的人。

original: Also, we have a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer, now we need to find a doctor able and willing to perform the facial reconstruction.
translation: 另外，我们已有了“脂肪塑形机”和“微型皮肤移植机”，现在需要找到一个有能力并且愿意做面部重建的医生。

original: We need to hurry. They’ve come very close to discovering the Railroad!
translation: 我们要快点。他们已经非常接近发现“铁路”了！

original: You’ll never guess who just showed up at my place! That android catcher from the Commonwealth!
translation: 你绝对猜不到谁刚来了我这！那个来自联邦的仿真人捕捉者！

original: At first I thought he was going to kill me. But it turns out he’s an android himself! And he’s gone rogue!
translation: 起先我认为他要杀了我。但结果他自己就是个仿真人！并且他失常了！

original: I didn’t believe him at first, but I’m convinced he’s telling the truth. We need to find him a place to hide along the Railroad.
translation: 起初我不相信他，但我现在确信他说的是真的。我们得随着“铁路”给他找一个藏身之所。

original: He also insists that we help him locate a trusted doctor and techie.
translation: 他还坚持要我们帮他找到一位可靠的医生和技术人员。

original: Time's running out on finding that android. We don't get him soon, someone else will.
translation: 寻找那个仿真人的时间不多了。如果我们不尽快找到他，别人就会找到。

original: Zimmer doesn't seem to understand we're the best at this sort of thing. I'm sure he's hired others, too. He won't shut up about the thing.
translation: 齐默似乎不明白我们是干这行的高手。我确信他也雇了其他人。他一直在唠叨个不停。

original: He was babbling about a "Lipoplasticator" and "Micro Dermal Graftilizer." What are those, you ask?
translation: 他一直念叨什么“脂肪塑形机”和“微型皮肤移植机”。你问那是什么？

original: Apparently something doctors use to mess up someone’s face beyond recognition. So we don’t even have a description to work off of.
translation: 很显然是医生用来把某人的脸改的面目全非用的。所以我们甚至没有一个描述来下手。

original: To make matters worse, he now thinks the android got his memories wiped or something.
translation: 更糟的是，他现在认为仿真人把记忆洗去或者什么的。

original: Find some tech-junkies, knock on some doors, and try to find something called a "Circuit Neuralizer." Knock on some heads, too, if you have to.
translation: 找些技术迷，敲敲门，试着找到一种叫“环状神经器”的东西。如有必要，也可以敲一些脑袋。

original: Get it done!
translation: 搞定它！

original: We've a little assignment from the Commonwealth. A very important slave escaped into the Wasteland.
translation: 我们接到了一个来自联邦的小任务。一个很重要的奴隶逃进了废土。

original: Well, it’s not exactly a slave. It’s what they call an android. A kind of synthetic man.
translation: 好吧，它并不完全是一个奴隶。它是他们所说的仿真人。一种合成人。

original: The important thing isn’t what this guy is. The important thing is the job pays more than you can imagine.
translation: 重要的并不在于这家伙是什么。重要的是这任务的酬金超乎你的想象。

original: He thinks the synthman might be looking to get in touch with a doctor or tech-head. If you want a cut, then get a move on.
translation: 他认为这合成人会设法与医生或科技人员取得联系。要是你想分一杯羹，现在就行动吧。

original: We now have a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. We just need to find someone with the skills and willingness to perform the surgery.
translation: 我们现在有了脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。我们只需找一个既有能力又有意愿的人来做手术。

original: If anyone knows of a discreet and trustworthy surgeon who knows how to keep his mouth shut, send him our way.
translation: 如果有谁知道哪位外科医生行事谨慎且值得信赖，懂得保守秘密，请介绍给我们。

original: Also, we need to find a Circuit Neuralizer to reroute the signals in the android’s memory. Do you know any trustworthy techies?
translation: 此外，我们还要找一个环状神经器，以重新连接仿真人的记忆信号。你认识什么可靠的技师吗？

original: Hey doc, I’m only sharing this with you because you seem like someone we can trust.
translation: 嘿大夫，我只把这消息同你分享，因为你似乎是我们可以信任的人。

original: Have you heard about the synthetic men they make up north in the Commonwealth? Well, the rumors are true.
translation: 你听说过在联邦北部制造合成人的事吗？对，传闻是真的。

original: They’re called androids. They're men like us, just made out of different parts.
translation: 他们被称为仿真人，外形和我们人类一样，只是由不同零件制成。

original: I know one of these androids. He's looking for a trustworthy doctor to perform some facial surgery. Can you do it? Do you know someone who can?
translation: 我认识一个这样的仿真人。他在找一个可靠的医生做一个面部手术。你能做吗？你知道谁能做吗？

original: Also, do you know anyone who's really wiz with computers?
translation: 此外，你知道谁是个电脑高手吗？

original: Despite the harshness of the Wasteland, I’ve discovered in more than a few here, a compassion that is unheard of in the Commonwealth.
translation: 尽管废土如此艰辛，但我在这里的不少人身上，见识到在联邦从未听过的同情心。

original: Perhaps it’s the daily struggle for life here which gives appreciation for life in general, whether human, or android.
translation: 也许是因为在这里整日为生存而挣扎，人们普遍更加珍视生命，无论对人类，还是对仿真人。

original: In a few days I’ll be a free man... a new man.
translation: 过几天我就将成为一个自由之人……一个崭新之人。

original: Let me say thank you now, for referring me to Pinkerton at Rivet City, because I will not remember any of this soon.
translation: 现在让我对你们说声谢谢，感谢你们把我介绍给铆钉城的平克顿，因为我很快将会不记得这一切。

original: If you're listening to this recording, it is because you're believed to be trustworthy.
translation: 如果你正在听这份录音，那意味着你被认为是可靠的。

original: I hope that is the case, because this recording puts us both in danger.
translation: 我希望确实如此，因为这份录音使我们彼此都很危险。

original: I’m escaping from the Commonwealth. I’m an android, a synthetic man... a slave.
translation: 我正在逃离联邦。我是一个仿真人，一个合成人……一个奴隶。

original: The men hunting me are ruthless and will stop at nothing to retrieve their property.
translation: 追捕我的人冷酷无情，会不择手段地收回他们的财产。

original: I need to find a doctor in the Wasteland to perform facial reconstruction. I also need someone who knows a great deal about computers.
translation: 我需要在废土上找一位医生来做面部重建。我还需要一个对电脑很在行的人。

original: I need... I need to have my memories erased and my face altered to look like someone else.
translation: 我要……要洗去我的记忆，并改变我的面容，使我看起来像另外一个人。

original: That's just a myth. I bet some deranged Ghoul did it though. Well, I gotta run.
translation: 那只是一个神话。我敢打赌有些凶悍僵尸还是做了。好了，我得走了。

original: I used to think Rivet City was such a safe place.
translation: 我曾以为铆钉城是个很安全的地方。

original: I heard about that! He was shot in the head like he was some sort of zombie. They say that's how you kill a Ghoul too.
translation: 我听到过！那些人把他当成了丧尸，子弹击中了他的头。他们说那也是杀死僵尸的方法。

original: Wasn't he killed by some maniac? Shot right in the head, like he was a Ghoul or something.
translation: 他不是被一群疯子杀了吗？把他当作僵尸，用子弹击中了他的头。

original: Thank God! That was such an annoying broadcast.
translation: 谢天谢地！那可真是烦人的广播。

original: I heard a lot of them got away and made it to the Citadel. I hope the Enclave leaves us alone.
translation: 我听说许多人逃到了五角大本营。我希望英克雷以后不再追捕我们了。

original: Good for them. I think slavery is horrible.
translation: 这对他们来说很好。我觉得奴隶制很可怕。

original: Remember that big explosion on the horizon? I bet that's what happened to it.
translation: 记得在地平线上的大爆炸吗？我打赌出了什么大事。

original: Oh my God! Did anyone escape?
translation: 我的上帝啊！有人逃了吗？

original: Oh, yeah! I heard about that. They're trying to help other slaves escape too.
translation: 哦，是的！我听说过。他们还试图帮助其他奴隶逃脱。

original: I never expected it to happen in my lifetime. I can hardly wait to taste clean water.
translation: 我从未指望过能在有生之年见到它。真想尝一口洁净的水啊。

original: I'm sure she'll just scrounge some from the lower deck.
translation: 我肯定她会去下层甲板乞讨。

original: Yeah. That was bad. I'm sure they'll do something about it.
translation: 是啊。那真糟。我肯定他们会做些什么的。

original: I'll try that.
translation: 我会试试的。

original: Really? It's ready? That's great news! I hope there aren't any problems at the Jefferson Memorial.
translation: 真的？准备好了？真是好消息啊！我希望杰斐逊纪念馆不会再有什么问题。

original: Yeah. Belle's going to have to replace some tables and chairs.
translation: 是啊。贝勒将不得不更换一些桌椅。

original: Well, I hope they do something. Remember that child that fell off the deck last year?
translation: 嗯，我希望他们能做些什么。还记得去年从甲板上摔下去的孩子吗？

original: Maybe A Quick Fix has something that will help you sleep. Cindy's got all kinds of good chems.
translation: 可能急救中心有能让你睡着的货。辛迪有着各种好货。

original: MQ11LDPrimeLines
translation: 已修正策略：初始光子共振超载。

original: Revised stratagem: Initiate photonic resonance overcharge.
translation: 修订策略：初始光子共鸣超载。

original: Established stratagem: Inadequate.
translation: 既定策略：条件不充足。

original: Significant obstruction detected. Composition: Titanium alloy supplemented by enhanced photonic resonance barrier.
translation: 检测到障碍物。组成：由光子共振屏障添加的钛合金。

original: Obstruction detected. Composition: Titanium alloy supplemented by photonic resonance barrier. Chinese blockade attempt: futile.
translation: 检测到障碍物。组成：由光子共振屏障添加的钛合金。企图封锁中国军队：无效。

original: Obstruction detected. Composition: Titanium alloy supplemented by photonic resonance barrier. Probability of mission hindrance: 0%
translation: 检测到障碍物。组成：由光子共振屏障添加的钛合金。任务受阻概率：0%

original: Warning: Forcible impact alert. Scanning for Chinese artillery.
translation: 警告：强行攻击警报。扫描到中国火炮。

original: Great job kid! Meet me around front. I have something for you to keep the ferals from gnawing on your ass!
translation: 干得好！孩子！到前面和我会合。我有些东西要给你，这东西能阻止野兽的攻击！

original: I had a feeling you'd be coming, deep in my angry bones, I just knew it. We're all set, just get that door open!
translation: 我有感觉你会来的，我就知道，这种感觉深入我愤怒的骨髓。我们都准备好了，去把大门打开吧！

original: Come on kid, get that door open!
translation: 快，孩子，打开那扇门！

original: I'm counting on you, get that door open!
translation: 我就指望你了，帮我打开那扇门吧！

original: What's the hold up?
translation: 还在等什么？

original: Get this door open already!
translation: 已经打开这扇门了！

original: Let's go home, Ian. The only way to beat your nightmares is to face them.
translation: 我们回家吧，伊恩。战胜你的噩梦的唯一方法就是去面对它们。

original: You know, for a second there you sounded just like Vance. And you're right.
translation: 你知道，你刚才的说话口气跟万斯一个样。还有你说得很对。

original: I don't know what I'm running away from, but given time maybe things can go back to the way they used to be.
translation: 我不知道我在逃避什么，但给点时间，可能一切都能恢复原貌。

original: Please, tell Vance I've made my decision. I'm going home to Arefu. I hope to see you there as well.
translation: 求你了，告诉万斯我下了决心，我要回断桥镇的家。希望在那见到你。

original: I'm just gonna gather my stuff together and say my goodbyes then I'll head on back.
translation: 我这就收拾行李和他们告别，然后就回去。

original: I know what you did. Vance told me everything.
translation: 我知道你做了什么。万斯告诉了我一切。

original: Then you must think I'm some kind of a monster.
translation: 你肯定认为我是个怪物。

original: Get a hold of yourself!
translation: 冷静点！

original: Don't you understand me? I killed them, okay?! My mother and father are dead because of me!
translation: 你不明白我说的？我杀了他们，知道吗？！我母亲和父亲都因我而死！

original: It was the fucking hunger. That thing that's haunted me my entire life!
translation: 都是那该死的饥饿。这种感觉无时无刻不折磨着我！

original: It doesn't matter what happened in the past.
translation: 过去发生了什么都不重要了。

original: Of course it matters! The past is what's keeping me up at night.
translation: 当然重要！过去发生的事情时常把我从梦中惊醒。

original: That night is like a bad dream... I can see parts of it but I don't remember what happened.
translation: 那晚就像个噩梦……我只能回想起一些片段但却记不得发生了什么。

original: It was the fucking hunger. That thing that's haunted me my entire life!
translation: 都是那该死的饥饿。这种感觉无时无刻不折磨着我！

original: You seem awfully troubled, Ian. What did you do...
translation: 你似乎非常不安，伊恩。你做了什么……

original: I killed them! My own parents!
translation: 我杀了他们！我的亲生父母！

original: It was the fucking hunger. That thing that's haunted me my entire life!
translation: 都是那该死的饥饿。这种感觉无时无刻不折磨着我！

original: You must think I'm some sort of monster.
translation: 你肯定认为我是个怪物。

original: I'm here to take you home, Ian.
translation: 我是来带你回家的，伊恩。

original: Home? I don't have a home anymore. I made sure of that, didn't I?
translation: 家？我没有家了。我非常确信这一点，不是吗？

original: Sorry, I think he needs to be with his real family.
translation: 对不起，我想他需要和他真正的家人在一起。

original: You just don't get it, do you? We are his "real" family, okay?
translation: 你还不明白，不是吗？我们是他“真正的”家人，知道吗？

original: Maybe it will, or maybe it's just messing him up more.
translation: 或许会有用，但或许只会让他更糟。

original: You don't think he's already messed up? Come on. Don't kid yourself.
translation: 你不认为他已经够糟了吗？拜托。别骗自己了。

original: We pulled him out of that shithole town just in time.
translation: 我们及时把他从那垃圾镇里带出来了。

original: Hey, I'm just here to help. All I want to do is be someone he can talk to.
translation: 嗨，我只是来这帮忙的。我想做的就是跟他谈谈。

original: Well, I guess so. You seem like a pretty nice guy.
translation: 嗯，我想是的。你看起来是个很不错的家伙。

original: Vance will have my butt in a sling if he finds out, but let me give you the password to his room.
translation: 如果万斯发现了的话，肯定会把我给吊起来。不过还是让我给你进入他房间的密码吧。

original: Come on, all I want to do is talk. What harm could little old me do?
translation: 拜托，我只想谈谈。我能有什么危害呢？

original: Well, I guess so. You seem like a pretty nice guy.
translation: 嗯，我想是的。你看起来是个很不错的家伙。

original: Vance will have my butt in a sling if he finds out, but let me give you the password to his room.
translation: 如果万斯发现了的话，肯定会把我给吊起来。不过还是让我给你进入他房间的密码吧。

original: Hey, hot stuff. Why don't you tell me how I can see Ian?
translation: 嗨，强人。你怎么不告诉我怎么才能见到伊恩呢？

original: Now that's more like it! I finally won't have to pay for it anymore. Ha ha ha!
translation: 这还差不多！我不用为此付钱了。哈哈哈！

original: Ah hell, here's the password to the pipsqueak's room. Come back and see me after you talk to him...
translation: 见鬼，这是那小子的房间的密码。在你跟他说话后回来见我……

original: Tell me how to see Ian and maybe we can talk... in private.
translation: 告诉我怎么能见到伊恩，我们可以……私下谈谈。

original: My oh my, that would tempting. If you were that good, maybe I'd pay you! Ha ha ha.
translation: 我的天，那多诱人啊。如果有那么好，或许我会付你钱！哈哈哈。

original: Tell you what, handsome... let me give you the password to Ian's room. Maybe you could talk to him and make him feel better.
translation: 告诉你。帅哥……让我给你去伊恩房间的密码。或许你能跟他谈谈来让他感觉好些。

original: Let me see Ian, you filthy liar!
translation: 让我见见伊恩，你这卑鄙的骗子！

original: I can sympathize with your anger, human. Many find cannibalism shocking, especially in the young.
translation: 我能理解你的愤怒，人类。很多人都认为这种相残事件是丧尽天良的，尤其是年轻人。

original: But understand that I cannot allow you to see him during his time of reflection.
translation: 但你要明白我不能允许你在他冥想的时候见他。

original: Please, you must let me speak to him!
translation: 拜托，你必须让我跟他说话！

original: No, it would not be right to disturb him in this time of meditation. I am sorry but I cannot allow it.
translation: 不，在冥想的时候打扰他并不明智。很抱歉我无法允许。

original: Are you telling me that Ian is a cannibal?
translation: 你是在告诉我伊恩是个食人者吗？

original: I am telling you he will no longer be labeled as such. He has become one of us... a member of the Family.
translation: 我要说的是他不再是怪物。他成为了我们……家族中的一员。

original: The hunger that drives us must be kept in check. It is one of the most difficult things to teach.
translation: 我们必须控制自己不被欲望所驱使。这是最难被教导的事之一。

original: Ian lost control because no one was around to guide him. His own family was alien to him.
translation: 因为没有人在身边指引他，伊恩无法控制自己。他觉得自己的家人都是异类。

original: Damn it, Vance! What did you do to him?
translation: 该死，万斯！你对他做了什么？

original: Do to him? Nothing. Ian's hunger for flesh overwhelmed him... it drove him to kill his parents.
translation: 对他？没有。伊恩对人肉的饥渴征服了他……驱使他杀死了他的父母。

original: Because of my intervention that night he stopped just short of being lost forever to his cravings for flesh.
translation: 正因为那晚我的出现，他才暂时没有永远迷失在对人肉的渴望之中。

original: Wait a minute... What happened to him?
