translation: 别在那废物身上浪费时间。你想交朋友，就去和碧安娜谈谈。她会帮你的。

original: What are you doing in Underworld?
translation: 你在地下城做什么？

original: My new line of work, actually.
translation: 实际上，我的新业务。

original: I've used the proceeds from our last acquisition to set myself up as an ammunition vendor. Pretty cool, huh?
translation: 利用我们上次得到的战利品，我当起了军火贩子。很酷吧，呃？

original: No more risking my neck to recover bits of junk for money. Now the cash comes right to me.
translation: 我再也不用冒着生命危险去找那些垃圾来赚钱。现在钱会自己进我口袋。

original: Care to take a look at my inventory?
translation: 要看看我的货物吗？

original: Sure, take a look.
translation: 当然，看看。

original: I'd like to buy some ammo from you.
translation: 我想在你这里买些弹药。

original: Let me ask you about something else.
translation: 我来问点其他事情吧。

original: Okay! Shoot!
translation: 好！射击！

original: You seem kind of addicted to the stuff... Is it safe to drink?
translation: 你似乎对这东西上瘾了……喝了安全吗？

original: Addicted? Why would you say that? I can stop drinking it any time I want.
translation: 上瘾？你为什么这么说呢？我想停就能停。

original: That's so silly to think I would get hooked on the most delicious soft drink ever devised by man...
translation: 认为我会对这种人类发明过的最美味的软饮料上瘾，那未免太傻了……

original: Is there anything else you're looking for?
translation: 你还要找什么？

original: Well, yes. Any document of historical significance would be of benefit to the Society.
translation: 嗯，是的。任何有价值的历史文献都将对协会有益处。

original: However, I am also interested in branching out. Perhaps some interesting artifacts related to our great country's history.
translation: 而且，我也有兴趣开拓业务。或许会有些与我们伟大国家历史相关的有趣文物。

original: Be sure and bring me anything you find along those lines. I'd be happy to compensate you once again.
translation: 一定要把你发现的这方面的东西带来。我会很高兴给你报酬的。

original: Sure, sure. I'm working on it. Really.
translation: 当然，当然。我正在努力。真的。

original: You have to find it. It's the only way any of us can truly rest...
translation: 你得找到它。这是让我们能真正安息的唯一方法……

original: Where did you say the Failsafe was?
translation: 你说的故障保险在哪？

original: The abandoned house. Keeps that one to himself, he does. That's where it is. That's why he doesn't want us in there.
translation: 在那废屋里。他把它藏了起来。就在那。那也是为什么他不让我们去那的原因。

original: There's nothing in that house. You're lying, or crazy, or both.
translation: 那屋子里什么都没有。你要么在撒谎，要么就是疯了，要么两者皆是。

original: It's there, I tell you! He hides it, like he hides himself. You've got to find a way to draw it out. He knows how to do it, but he'd never tell you.
translation: 就在那，我告诉你！他把它藏起来了，就像他把自己藏起来一样。你能找出来。他知道怎么样做，但他不会告诉你。

original: Um... I went into the abandoned house, but I didn't see anything.
translation: 嗯…我进入了那间废屋，但我没看到任何东西。

original: Did you look? Did you really look? You can't just look with your eyes, you know.
translation: 你看了吗？你真的看了吗？你得明白，你不能只用眼睛去看。

original: Look at Braun. You think he really looks like that little girl? He hides things. Confuses them. You have to find a way to find it.
translation: 看看布劳恩。你认为他真的像那小女孩？他把东西隐藏起来，迷惑他们。你最好想办法找到它。

original: Just leave me alone. I'm busy.
translation: 离我远点。我很忙。

original: I'm telling you, this can all end if you find it...
translation: 我告诉你，如果你找到它，这一切就能结束了……

original: How come you're the only one who seems to know this?
translation: 你怎么会是唯一知道这事的人？

original: Don't know. Can't sleep sometimes... Hear voices... My own skin doesn't feel right. None of this is right. You've got to believe me!
translation: 不知道。有时不能入睡…听到一些声音…我自己的皮肤感觉很不舒服。这不正常，请相信我！

original: You've got to find that failsafe!
translation: 你得找到故障保险！

original: Well, I guess it's time to find out. I'll go there myself.
translation: 好啦，我想是时候去找出真相了。我要一个人去那。

original: The Brotherhood simply cannot spare the resources necessary to investigate the area. Perhaps you may be more successful.
translation: 兄弟会抽不出必要的人力去调查那片区域。或许你会干得更好。

original: If you do find anything, please return here so that we may decide on how best to proceed.
translation: 如果你找到什么，请回报，以便我们决定怎样继续。

original: No thanks, I think I'll hold onto it.
translation: 不，谢了。我又不想卖了。

original: How very disappointing!
translation: 多令人沮丧啊！

original: Such a shame, I was hoping to add it to my collection.
translation: 真遗憾，我还打算把它加入我的收藏品之中呢。

original: Oh, very well. If you reconsider, you know where to find me.
translation: 哦，非常好。如果你改主意了，你知道在哪能找到我。

original: I assure you no one else in the Wasteland will pay you more, but I respect your decision.
translation: 我保证在废土没人会比我出价高了，但我尊重你的选择。

original: Sounds like a deal. Here you go.
translation: 听起来很合理。给你。

original: You drive a hard bargain, but it's worth every cap.
translation: 别讨价还价了，你花的每一个瓶盖都是值得的。

original: Will you give me 100 caps for it?
translation: 你愿意为它付出100个瓶盖吗？

original: Thank you very much!
translation: 非常感谢！

original: Sounds like a deal. Here you go.
translation: 听起来很合理。给你。

original: You drive a hard bargain, but it's worth every cap.
translation: 别讨价还价了，你花的每一个瓶盖都是值得的。

original: Will you give me 125 caps for it?
translation: 你愿意为它付出125个瓶盖吗？

original: Thank you very much!
translation: 非常感谢！

original: Gob!
translation: 盖博！

original: I know, I know. I'll get a mop. It's just... blood is so hard to get out of the floor.
translation: 我知道，我知道，我去拿拖把。只是……地上的血太难清理了。

original: Well, that's been a long time coming. Good riddance.
translation: 嗯，这一天我等了好久，总算解脱了。

original: What makes you think this tunnel won't be guarded? It could be a trap...
translation: 你怎么确定隧道没有人把守？这很可能是陷阱……

original: We don't have time for this! Trust me, security doesn't know about the tunnel. Just my father -- and me.
translation: 我们没时间讨论这个了！相信我，警卫不知道通道的事情，只有我父亲和我知道。

original: Maybe this pistol I stole from my father will make you feel better. Go ahead, take it, and then let's get out of here.
translation: 可能我从我爸那偷来的这把手枪能让你心里踏实点。走吧，带着它，让我们离开这。

original: That sounds awfully complicated. Why can't I just get out the normal way?
translation: 听起来很复杂啊。为什么我不能用寻常方法呢？

original: My father's not stupid. He's sealed the door to the exit to prevent anyone else from escaping.
translation: 我的父亲不是傻子。他封了通向出口的门，防止其他人逃出去。

original: The tunnel is the only way out! You're just going to have to trust me.
translation: 这条隧道是唯一能出去的路！你只要相信我就行了。

original: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

original: Sounds like a good plan. Let's get out of here!
translation: 听起来是不错的计划；我们走吧！

original: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

original: I know how you feel. I lost my Dad.
translation: 我知道你的感受。我失去了我的父亲。

original: <whimper>
translation: <呜咽>

original: Want to come with me? It's dangerous out here all alone.
translation: 想跟我一起吗？离开这的路会很危险的。

original: <pant> <pant>
translation: <喘气><喘气>

original: Don't worry, boy. You get used to losing people out here.
translation: 别难过，孩子。在这里你总会失去所在乎的人，你会习惯的。

original: <whimper>
translation: <呜咽>

original: <bark!>
translation: <吠叫！>

original: Hold still, boy. This Stimpak should have you feeling better soon.
translation: 别动，小家伙，这治疗针很快就可以让你舒服些。

original: <whimper>
translation: <呜咽>

original: Sorry, Dogmeat. I don't have any Stimpaks for you right now.
translation: 抱歉，狗肉。我现在没治疗针治疗你。

original: <whine> <whine>
translation: <哀鸣声><哀鸣声>

original: Bad, Dogmeat! Very bad!
translation: 坏孩子，狗肉！坏孩子！

original: Mutts that don't shut up get eaten. See if I'm kidding.
translation: 杂种狗，再不住口就吃了你。看我是不是在开玩笑。

original: <growl>
translation: <低吼>

original: Been a while since I tasted dog meat. Now, play dead. Forever.
translation: 我已经很久没有吃狗肉了。现在，去死吧。

original: <growl!>
translation: <咆哮！>

original: Looks like you've got some fight left in you, yet. That's a good sign.
translation: 看来你还有些斗志。这是个好兆头。

original: <bark!>
translation: <吠叫！>

original: What's the matter, boy? Lose your master?
translation: 怎么了，小家伙？主人不在了？

original: <bark> <bark!>
You know, I think you're the first dog I've met that didn't try to eat me.
translation: 知道吗，你可是我遇见的第一只不想吃我的狗。

original: <bark> <bark!>
Shut up, mutt.
translation: 闭嘴吧，杂毛。

original: <bark> <bark!>
You're pretty friendly, aren't you, boy?
translation: 你倒是挺亲人的，小家伙？

original: <bark!> <bark!>
Good teeth, strong claws. You're a fighting dog, aren't you?
translation: 牙口不错，爪子也利。你是条斗犬，对不对？

original: <bark> <bark!>
Dukov has a special key. Get it for me and I'll take you to Rivet City.
translation: 杜克夫有一把特殊的钥匙。把它拿给我，我就可以带你去铆钉城。

original: We're back.  Somebody open up the... Hang on, something' ain't right here.
translation: 我们回来了。谁来开……等等，不对头啊。

original: Stay here, boy. Don't move until I come back!
translation: 待在这，小子。在我回来之前别乱走动！

original: <whine>
translation: <哀鸣声>

original: In that case, just die.
translation: 要是这样，那就只有死了。

original: <growl!>
translation: <咆哮！>

original: Okay, I'll leave. You stay here.
translation: 好的，我会离开。你待在这。

original: <whimper>
translation: <呜咽>

original: Fine, be that way.
translation: 好的，就那样。

original: <bark!> <bark!>
Shoo, dog. Get out of here.
translation: 嘘，狗狗，从这出去。

original: <aroo?>
I've been to the lab. He wasn't there. Just some old holotapes...
translation: 我去过实验室，他不在那。只剩一些旧的全息磁带……

original: Holotapes? Did you listen to them? Your father was obsessive about taking notes. One of them might have something useful.
translation: 全息磁带？你听他们提起过吗？你父亲很喜欢留下记录的，其中一些可能会有用。

original: I've been to Project Purity. He wasn't there.
translation: 我去过净水工程那，他不在那。

original: Well I know he was going there. Perhaps there's some indication of what he was up to. Did you find any notes?
translation: 嗯，我知道他去过那，或许在那能找到他去了哪的线索，你找到什么记录了吗？

original: James was always taking notes. Recordings, holotapes... that sort of thing. Go back and search for something like that if you're so determined.
translation: 詹姆斯经常留些记录，录音，全息磁带之类的东西，如果你坚持的话，再去找找那类东西。

original: CherryThanks
translation: 不用客气。

original: Well, you kept your promise. I really didn't think you would. Thank you.
translation: 好吧，你信守了你的诺言。我真的以为你做不到。谢谢。

original: Follow me.
translation: 跟我来。

original: The sooner we get there, the better.
translation: 我们越早到那越好。

original: Wait here.
translation: 在这等着。

original: Don't be gone too long.
translation: 别离开太久了。

original: We need to get more.
translation: 我们需要更多。

original: I know. But we got two here still.
translation: 我知道。但这里就有两个。

original: The female is locked up. We'll take her back with us.
translation: 那女的被锁起来了。我们要把她带回去。

original: The tiny male is downstairs. He won't be coming with us, will he? Ahahahah!
translation: 那小男孩在楼下。他不想和我们一起走，是吧？啊哈哈哈！

original: Nope. Hahah!
translation: 不。哈哈！

original: We almost got all of those little people from Big Town. What then?
translation: 我们几乎抓到大镇里的所有小孩了。下一步怎么办？

original: Find more. Somewhere else. Graaaah!
translation: 再到其他地方搜捕。哈哈哈！

original: Yeah. Those bleeders are everywhere. We'll get them all and take them home.
translation: 耶。到处都有流血的人。我们要把他们全部带回去。

original: Home. We need more prisoners before we can go home.
translation: 家。在我们回家前，需要更多的俘虏。

original: We'll go back and get more. Soon.
translation: 我们要回去抓更多。尽快。

original: Greaaahhhh!!!!
translation: 哈哈哈！！！！

original: Ahahahaha!
translation: 啊哈哈哈！

original: Never mind.
translation: 别介意。

original: <aroo?>
Find me a weapon, boy!
translation: 给我找把武器，小家伙！

original: <bark!>
translation: <吠叫！>

original: Find chems, boy!
translation: 找些药品，小家伙！

original: <bark!>
translation: <吠叫！>

original: Find some food, boy!
translation: 找些食物，小家伙！

original: <bark!>
translation: <吠叫！>

original: Find some food, boy!
translation: 找些食物，小家伙！

original: Find ammo, boy!
translation: 找些弹药，小家伙！

original: <bark!>
translation: <吠叫！>

original: Dogmeat, I need you to find something for me.
translation: 狗肉，我要你帮我找些东西。

original: <bark>
Stop searching, Dogmeat.
translation: 停止搜索，狗肉。

original: <bark>
I don't have 100 caps.
translation: 我没有100个瓶盖。

original: All right kid. Then I guess there's nothing else we have to say to each other. Come back to me when you have the caps, and we'll talk.
translation: 好吧，孩子，我想我们之间没什么可说的，等你有了瓶盖再来。

original: I don't know. Maybe Moriarty's right and you're just a junkie.
translation: 我不知道，或许莫里亚蒂是对的，你就是一个瘾君子。

original: Look... I feel awful about what I used to have to do for a living, okay? I use the Psycho to make the memories go away.
translation: 听着……我对我曾经为了谋生而不得不去做的事感到厌恶，好吗？我用疯狂药来摆脱回忆。

original: Who the hell are you to judge me? Tell Moriarty he can take his fucking caps and shove them up his ass!
translation: 你有什么资格对我品头论足？告诉莫里亚蒂，把那些该死的瓶盖塞在自己屁眼里吧！

original: Look, just give me some of your caps, and I'll tell him you're gone.
translation: 听着，给我些瓶盖，我就告诉他你已经离开了。

original: You'd do that for me? I never expected anyone to care enough.
translation: 你愿意为我这么做吗？我从没期待有人会关心我。

original: Here you go. Thanks, kid. You're all right.
translation: 给你。谢谢，孩子，你是个好人。

original: Look, just give me the caps and I'll tell him you're gone.
translation: 听着，给我些瓶盖，我就告诉他你已经离开了。

original: I am tired of hiding out here like some kind of Wasteland dog.
translation: 我厌倦了在这躲躲藏藏，就像废土上的狗一样。

original: I... I guess you're right. Here... this is all I have. Please leave me alone now.
translation: 我…我猜你是对的。给你…这是我所有的。现在让我独自待会。

original: I don't care. I'm just here for caps.
translation: 我不关心，我在这就是为了瓶盖。

original: Is there something wrong with your hearing? I just told you the caps are mine! You can't have them!
translation: 你的听力有问题吗？我告诉过你这些瓶盖是我的！不是你的！

original: This is never gonna end until I send him a message. Well, fine. If I have to kill you to send it, I will!
translation: 在我告诉他前，这没完！好。如果我必须杀了你，我会这么做的！

original: You can talk all you want, but I'm not leaving without the caps.
translation: 随你怎么说，不过没有瓶盖我是不会离开的。

original: Slow down. Tell me your side of the story.
translation: 冷静，告诉我你的故事。

original: Look, I used to work for that slob. Doing... you know... favors for guys.
translation: 听着，我曾为那懒鬼工作，做…你知道…让男人开心。

original: Well, I got sick and tired of it. I told Moriarty I'm taking my share of the caps and leaving. I even slept with the pig to seal the deal.
translation: 我生病了，也厌倦了。我告诉莫里亚蒂我要带上我的那份瓶盖离开。为了它们我甚至能和猪一起睡。

original: Next morning he tells me I couldn't leave. So I bolted. I took my money and ran.
translation: 第二天早晨他告诉我不能离开，所以我就逃跑了，我拿上我的钱溜走了。

original: Now he's branded me a thief and a junkie and sent his cronies to find me. I guess I need a new hiding place.
translation: 现在，我觉得我就是一个贼，一个瘾君子，他派了他的亲信来搜寻我，我想我需要一个新的藏身之地。

original: You'd better calm down, before I put you down.
translation: 你最好在我干掉你之前冷静下来。

original: That lying bastard. Roped you into finding me too, huh?
translation: 那说谎的杂种派你来找我，呃？

original: Well, you're not getting a damn thing from me! You hear me?! Not a damn thing!
translation: 你没法从我这得到任何东西！你听到了吗？什么都不会给你！

original: Whoa, calm down... Who the hell is Moriarty?
translation: 哇哦，冷静下来…莫里亚蒂是他妈谁？

original: Colin Moriarty... the owner of Moriarty's Saloon in Megaton.
translation: 科林·莫里亚蒂…兆吨镇里莫里亚蒂酒吧的老板。

original: That sack of shit is convinced that I'm some crazy junkie who stole money from him!
translation: 那傻子认定我是偷他钱的疯癫瘾君子！

original: Who's Moriarty?
translation: 莫里亚蒂是谁？

original: Colin Moriarty... the owner of Moriarty's Saloon in Megaton.
translation: 科林·莫里亚蒂…兆吨镇里莫里亚蒂酒吧的老板。

original: That sack of shit is convinced that I'm some crazy junkie who stole money from him!
translation: 那傻子认定我是偷他钱的疯癫瘾君子！

original: I don't deal with junkies. Hand over all your caps. Now!
translation: 我不和瘾君子交易，把你所有的瓶盖交出来，快！

original: You're not getting a damn thing from me! You hear me?! Not a damn thing!
translation: 你没法从我这得到任何东西！你听到了吗？什么都不会给你！

original: Just hand over the caps, and I'll be out of your way.
translation: 把你所有的瓶盖交出来，我就会放你走。

original: Owe HIM some caps? He's a liar! He just wants you to kill me! Those caps are mine, fair and square.
translation: 欠他一些瓶盖？他是一个骗子！他只想让你杀了我！那些瓶盖是我的，正大光明。

original: Yes, and he says you owe him some caps.
translation: 是的，他说你欠他一些瓶盖。

original: That bastard! He... he's a liar! He just wants me dead! Those caps are all mine. I earned them!
translation: 那杂种！他…他是一个骗子！他就想让我死，那些瓶盖都是我的。是我赚来的！

original: Look, I need a way to get some caps or I'll never have the money to pay you.
translation: 听着，我需要得到一些瓶盖，否则我就永远不会有钱付你。

original: If you're looking for a handout, you can forget it. But if you're looking for work, there's a favor you could do for me.
translation: 如果你在寻求施舍，你就别想了。但如果你是想要找份活做，那正好可以给我办事。

original: If your successful, it'll provide the caps you need to pay me.
translation: 如果你成功了，你就有足够的钱付给我了。

original: Good. I hope she got what she deserved.
translation: 好的，我希望她能得到应有的下场。

original: I took care of Silver for you.
translation: 我帮你处理掉了席尔瓦。

original: No way, Moriarty. No favors.
translation: 没门！莫里亚蒂，不行。

original: Fine. Go find Daddy yourself then. I'll be here when you change your mind.
translation: 很好，那自己去找爸爸吧。等你改变主意以后再回来。

original: So, you want me to do your dirty work?
translation: 你想让我干那种脏活？

original: Who said anything about dirty work? You need some caps, I'm giving you a way to get 'em. It's just business.
translation: 谁说这是脏活？你需要一些银子，我给你一个路子，这只是个交易。

original: This junkie bitch named Silver borrowed quite a few caps from me... claimed she could start funneling Jet and Psycho to me for a good price.
translation: 这叫席尔瓦的婊子从我这借了很多瓶盖……她承诺可以源源不断地给我杰特和疯狂药，价格公道。

original: Problem is she scrammed with the loot and set herself up in Springvale so she can inject herself into a stupor.
translation: 问题在于她带着钱跑了，在春之谷又开始了那种把自己注射到昏迷的生活。

original: Get the caps she owes me and they're yours. Yours to pay me with anyway. He he he he he.
translation: 把她欠我的瓶盖拿回来，然后都算你的。你欠我的随便你怎么付，呵呵呵呵。

original: Sure, anything to get the information.
translation: 当然，只要能换信息。

original: Eager, eh? Good... I like that. It's nice to have a doer in this shithole of a town for a change.
translation: 充满渴望？很好…我喜欢。还好有个踏实干事的家伙，肯为了改变这破镇子做些事情。

original: This junkie bitch named Silver borrowed quite a few caps from me... claimed she could start funneling Jet and Psycho to me for a good price.
translation: 这叫席尔瓦的婊子从我这借了很多钱……她说她可以源源不断地给我杰特和疯狂药，价格公道。

original: Problem is she scrammed with the loot and set herself up in Springvale so she can inject herself into a stupor.
translation: 问题在于她带着钱跑了，在春之谷又开始了那种把自己注射到昏迷的生活。

original: Get the caps she owes me and they're yours. Yours to pay me with anyway. He he he he he.
translation: 把她欠我的瓶盖拿回来，这些都算你的。你欠我的随便你怎么付，呵呵呵呵。

original: You don't still offer your... services, do you?
translation: 你没有继续提供…服务了吧？

original: No, sorry. I've left that part of my life behind.
translation: 不，对不起，我已经舍弃了我昔日的那种生活。

original: What will you do now?
translation: 你现在打算做什么？

original: Who knows. Shoot myself up until I forget who I am?
translation: 谁知道呢。自我沉沦直到忘了我是谁？

original: The Wasteland sucks, kid. Just get used to it.
translation: 废土太糟糕了，孩子，学着习惯吧。

original: I haven't gone and looked them over, no.
translation: 我没有去看过他们，不。

original: Well you should! Go on out, take a gander, and see if there's anything that might meet your needs.
translation: 你应该这么做！去看看，或许会有什么是你需要的。

original: I will point out that there are a few kids out there. Not something you see very often; a very good long-term investment.
translation: 告诉你，那儿可有几个孩子。并不常见；这是个很好的长期投资。

original: We can discuss details once you've had a chance to look things over.
translation: 你看完后我们讨论下细节。

original: Attention everyone! It is time to cut the cake!
translation: 各位注意！开始切蛋糕了！

original: Andy! Wait!
translation: 安迪！等等！

original: Oh no...
translation: 哦，不…

original: Gear up, soldier!
translation: 加油，士兵！

original: Let 'em eat lead!
translation: 让他们吃子弹！

original: Time to kick some ass!
translation: 是时候开战了！

original: Mister Crowley wants that key. Now.
translation: 考利先生要那把钥匙，现在就要！

original: What key? Oh, that key.
translation: 什么钥匙？哦，那把钥匙。

original: You're a moron. I don't have any of his precious keys. Idiot.
translation: 你这蠢货。我没有他那把宝贝钥匙，白痴！

original: Where can I get a stiff drink?
translation: 在哪能喝到烈酒？

original: The Muddy Rudder. Belle waters down the liquor, but it's cheap. It's on the lower deck.
translation: “泥舵”酒吧。虽然贝勒往酒里掺了水，不过价钱很便宜。就在下层甲板。

original: Try the Muddy Rudder. They don't ask too many questions down on the lower deck.
translation: 去“泥舵”酒吧试试。他们不会在下层甲板问太多问题。

original: Is there anywhere I can get a drink on this tub?
translation: 这船上有地方可以让我喝一杯吗？

original: The Weatherly Hotel is a good choice. It's on the upper deck.
translation: 韦瑟利旅馆在上层甲板，那是个不错的选择。

original: Do you know where I can get something to drink?
translation: 你知道在哪里可以喝一杯吗？

original: The Weatherly Hotel is a good choice. It's on the upper deck.
translation: 韦瑟利旅馆在上层甲板，那是个不错的选择。

original: Can I get a drink around here? Preferably somewhere clean.
translation: 这附近有地方可以喝一杯吗？最好是干净点的地方。

original: I'm over here! Help!
translation: 我在这！救命！

original: <sobs>
translation: <啜泣>

original: <sobs>
translation: <啜泣>

original: Please... God... someone...
translation: 哦…天啊…有人吗…

original: Someone help me!
translation: 谁来救我！

original: Please! Someone!
translation: 有人吗！

original: <whimpers>
translation: <啜泣>

original: Help me!
translation: 救命！

original: Help!
translation: 救命啊！

original: No, you'll need it more than I will.
translation: 不，你会比我更需要它。

original: You'd know best, wouldn't you? I have to go. Again... thank you.
translation: 你会知道的，对不。我必须走了，再次…谢谢你。

original: Okay... if you say so. I can't thank you enough, stranger.
translation: 好吧…既然你这么说，我对你感激不尽！陌生人。

original: You're right. It's dangerous out here.
translation: 你是对的，外面很危险。

original: I... I have to go. Before more of them come.
translation: 我…我必须走了。等下他们会来更多人。

original: I'll take that. Now get out of here.
translation: 我要它了。现在快点离开这。

original: They won't catch me again...
translation: 他们不会再抓住我的……

original: You're right. I'll try to make it on my own. If I'm careful, I should be okay.
translation: 放心吧，我会试着自己去做。只要我够小心，就不会有什么问题。

original: Here, thank you again! I'm going to try to make it home... if it's still there.
translation: 拿着，再次感谢你！我要回家去了……如果它还在的话。

original: I can't believe what I've discovered. Just before he died, one of the security team members told me everything.
translation: 我简直不敢相信我发现的。在他死之前，一名警卫告诉了我所有的事情。

original: The Overseer has been implanting these murderous intentions in the entire Vault population without my knowledge!
translation: 监督者给避难所居民灌输了这些谋杀意志！而我毫不知情！

original: Using the loudspeakers in the dorms instead of just the studios, he subjected everyone to the white noise as they slept.
translation: 他在宿舍里用扬声器代替了无线电，迫使每个人睡觉时都处于白噪音污染之下。

original: He then implanted combat suggestions he claims came from Vault-Tec itself! He... he must be completely insane. No observation, no controls...
translation: 他在那时灌输了符合避难所科技要求的战斗意识！他……他肯定完全疯了。没有监督，失去了控制……

original: I'm going to have to confront him now and make him pay for what he's done. Half the Vault is dead, the other half fighting for its life.
translation: 我现在必须去抵制他，让他为自己的所作所为付出代价。避难所一半的人死了，另一半则在为自己的生命而战。

original: Good luck to all of us and may God have mercy on our souls.
translation: 祝我们好运，希望上帝会怜悯我们的灵魂。

original: The situation is getting out of hand. Over half the population of the Vault is exhibiting savage tendencies.
translation: 情况开始变得无法控制，超过一半的避难所居民开始显露出他们粗暴的本性。

original: I can only assume our noise experimentation has awakened some dormant part of their psyche... brought their primitive nature to the surface.
translation: 我只能假设我们的噪音实验唤醒了他们沉睡的本性…使得他们原始的欲望付诸表面。

original: In essence, I feel that they are almost psychologically devolving. I was stupid for rushing these experiments, and now over 35 people are dead.
translation: 从本质上而言，我觉得他们心理上已经严重退化。做这些实验真是太蠢了，现在已经有超过35人死亡。

original: Unbelievable! We've had twelve more incidents in the past month mirroring Subject V920717's actions.
translation: 难以置信！上月有一打以上的事件是V920717引起的。

original: The shocking part is the savagery these aberrants exhibit when they murder. They rip their victims apart limb from limb and eviscerate them by hand.
translation: 试验品在屠杀时所表现出来的野性骇人听闻。它们肢解了他们的受害者，并用手掏出了他们的内脏。

original: These used to be respected members of the musical community. How could this be happening? Where have I gone wrong?
translation: 它们都曾是交响乐团受人尊敬的会员，为什么会这样？我哪里做错了什么？

original: Disaster today. One of our test subjects, V920717, has murdered three other residents in a fit of unbridled rage the likes of which I've never seen.
translation: 灾难日啊今天，我们的实验品，V920717，已经屠杀了3个居民，这样的暴行我从来没有见过。

original: It took almost 23 shots before the security team took him down. This subject has no history of violence or mental instability whatsoever.
translation: 警卫射了23枪才击倒他，这家伙拥有有史以来最强大的暴力与狂躁。

original: My concern is that this subject is one of our most successful implant recipients, able to execute complex instructions during trance-state.
translation: 我所关心的是这玩意是我们最成功的灌输接受者，它可以在催眠状态下完成复杂的指令。

original: I'm a bit encouraged by the latest batch of data. It seems that 33 percent of the subjects are now lapsing into a trance-like state on occasion.
translation: 最新的数据极大的鼓舞了我。看来有33%的试验体时不时会进入被催眠状态。

original: When in this state, we're fairly certain that suggestion and programming of the subject can be applied.
translation: 在这种状态下，对试验体进行的暗示和控制能被有效应用。

original: We've begun testing this by implanting subtle cues in affected subjects, making them scratch their ear or constantly fix their hair.
translation: 我们开始尝试灌输一些细微的指令去影响试验体，比如让他们挠自己的耳朵，或者时常梳理自己的头发。

original: So far I'm happy to report a 100% success rate on this implantation method.
translation: 现在我总算可以高兴的宣布：这样的灌输方式已经100%成功！

original: So far, the experiment is going exactly as planned.
translation: 目前，实验严格按照计划进行。

original: We're subjecting the residents to extremely low frequency white noise in regular intervals through the loudspeaker system.
translation: 我们通过在扬声器音乐中隐藏次声波频率白噪音来奴化居民。

original: Using the soundproof recording studios and the musicians was an inspired idea. Kudos to the Vault-Tec selection committee on their shrewdness.
translation: 使用录音棚和音乐家这个想法充满灵感，感谢避难所科技精明的选举委员会。

original: 100 caps!? Are you nuts? I don't have that kind of money!
translation: 100个瓶盖？你在胡说吗？我没那么多钱！

original: Guilty as charged.
translation: 有钱走遍天下，没钱寸步难行啊。

original: Tell you what kid, I'm gonna help you out... for old time's sake.
translation: 这样吧孩子，我念在往日情分，就给你个机会……

original: If you don't have the caps to pay for the information, then maybe you could do a little favor for me.
translation: 如果你没有足够的钱用来交换信息，那么或许你可以帮我点小忙。

original: You're a liar, Moriarty. I know where I grew up.
translation: 你这骗子！莫里亚蒂，我知道我在哪长大的！

original: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
translation: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。

original: "All hail the Overseer! We're born in the Vault, we die in the Vault!" And all that other assorted lunacy.
translation: “赞美监督者！我们生于避难所，我们死在避难所！”之类的各种疯言疯语。

original: Kid, you've got better programming than our own Deputy Weld. You'd best wise up quick. Wouldn't want anyone... takin' advantage of ya. Hmm?
translation: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？

original: You're wrong. My Dad never would have lied to me.
translation: 你错了，我爸爸从不对我说谎。

original: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
translation: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。

original: 'All hail the Overseer! We're born in the Vault; we die in the Vault!' And all that other assorted lunacy.
translation: “赞美监督者！我们生于避难所，我们死在避难所！”之类的各种疯言疯语。

original: Kid, you've got better programming than our own Deputy Weld. You'd best wise up quick. Wouldn't want anyone... takin' advantage of ya. Hmm?
translation: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？

original: Oh, I wasn't born in the Vault? That's complete bullshit, and you know it.
translation: 哦，我不是出生于避难所的？那纯粹是胡说，你知道的。

original: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
translation: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。

original: 'All hail the Overseer! We're born in the Vault; we die in the Vault!' And all that other assorted lunacy.
translation: “赞美监督者！我们生于避难所，我们死在避难所！”之类的各种疯言疯语。

original: Kid, you've got better programming than our own Deputy Weld. You'd best wise up quick. Wouldn't want anyone... takin' advantage of ya. Hmm?
translation: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？

original: My Dad told me we were born in Vault 101...
translation: 我爸爸告诉我，我们都是在101号避难所出生的……

original: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
translation: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。

original: 'All hail the Overseer! We're born in the Vault; we die in the Vault!' And all that other assorted lunacy.
translation: “赞美监督者！我们生于避难所，我们死在避难所！”之类的各种疯言疯语。

original: Kid, you've got better programming than our own Deputy Weld. You'd best wise up quick. Wouldn't want anyone... takin' advantage of ya. Hmm?
translation: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？

original: Stay here. Maybe I'll come back for you.
translation: 待在这儿。说不定我会回来接你。

original: <whine>
translation: <哀鸣声>

original: Where can I find Joseph?
translation: 哪能找到约瑟夫？

original: I'm the Mayor, not a babysitter, mungo. Beats me.
translation: 我是镇长，不是保姆！毛人，别烦我。

original: Maybe he's back there by the door. Fuck if I know.
translation: 或许他在后门那儿，我他妈的不知道！

original: Geez, don't strain yourself on my account... I just need a G.E.C.K.
translation: 哎呀，别因为我而紧张……我只需要一个伊甸园创造器。

original: I fail to see how such a device would be useful to you. In fact, I doubt such a thing really works.
translation: 我不明白你要这装置有什么用。事实上，我怀疑这东西是否能真的运作。

original: Either way, the Brotherhood is not in possession of such a device.
translation: 不管怎样，兄弟会没有这种装置。

original: If you are determined to waste your time, you may go off in search of one.
translation: 如果你决定浪费你的时间，那你就去找一个吧。

original: You mentioned something about Galaxy News Radio?
translation: 你提到了银河新闻电台？

original: There aren't a lot of safe places in the ruins right now, but the Galaxy News Radio building is sort of our port in the storm.
translation: 废墟里没有太多安全的地方，但银河新闻电台大楼就像是我们的避风港。

original: Unfortunately, the building's been hit pretty hard lately. We're their backup. So if there are no more questions, we really need to move out.
translation: 不幸的是，这建筑最近被破坏得很严重。我们是他们的后援，所以如果没有太多问题，我们需要开始行动了。

original: Well, the Brotherhood needed a secure outpost, and the guy who runs the radio station needed to not get his head ripped off by Super Mutants.
translation: 嗯，兄弟会需要一个安全的前哨站，而电台的那家伙不想被超级变种人撕掉脑袋。

original: It's a mutually beneficial relationship.
translation: 这是一种互助互惠的关系。

original: Three Dog is the man in charge. He keeps that signal broadcasting, pretty much single handedly. He's um... interesting. I'll give him that much.
translation: 三狗管理着这，他维持进行直播，亲力亲为。他很…很有趣。我只能说那么多了。

original: Anything else you can tell me about GNR?
translation: 还有什么关于银河台的事要告诉我？

original: Who did you say you were again?
translation: 你刚才说你是谁来着？

original: The name's Sarah Lyons, Sentinel and squad commander of the Lyons' Pride. We're with the Brotherhood of Steel.
translation: 萨拉·里昂斯，是“里昂斯的骄傲”的哨兵和指挥官。我们隶属钢铁兄弟会。

original: We do our best to hold back the Super Mutants in this area. But when civilians stumble into our sights, that gets a bit difficult. Doesn't it?
translation: 我们在这个区域尽全力阻止超级变种人的入侵，但当平民误入我们的视线，就会带来不少麻烦，不是吗？

original: I'll take that as a compliment.
translation: 我就当作是恭维了。

original: If we don't try to keep the mutants from killing everyone and everything in the Capital Wasteland, who will?
translation: 如果我们不去阻止超级变种人烧杀抢掠，还有谁会去？

original: The Brotherhood does its best, but sometime's it takes a little something... special. That's where the Lyons' Pride comes in.
translation: 兄弟会做得很好，但是有时会有一些特别的……任务，也就是“里昂斯的骄傲”参与的时候。

original: Wow. You guys don't screw around.
translation: 哇哦，你们这些家伙还真行。

original: On second thought... I think I'll keep it to myself.
translation: 经过重新考虑…我想我会自己留着。

original: Ha! It's not like he'd tell you anyway.
translation: 哈！看来他并不会告诉你。

original: It's Irving.
translation: 他叫艾尔文。

original: Hahahaha! Irving! Are you serious?
translation: 哈哈！艾尔文！你说真的吗？

original: Oh man... wait until the other guys hear this... Irving!
translation: 哦，哥们…让其他人来听听吧……艾尔文！

original: Here's the pool. You earned it!
translation: 给你，这是你赚的！

original: You never did tell me what I'd win.
translation: 你从未告诉过我能得到什么。

original: Ha! Good point. The pool is up to about 1,000 caps these days.
translation: 哈！好极了。现在赌台上已经有超过1000个瓶盖了。

original: Now, c'mon! C'mon! What's his name?
translation: 来吧！他叫什么名字？

original: Never mind.
translation: 别介意。

original: Yeah. Never mind.
translation: 是，没关系。

original: Can't we work something out? Maybe share the winnings?
translation: 我们不能做些什么吗？或许可以分享胜利？

original: No. We can't.
translation: 不，我们不能。

original: Come on, it will really throw those guys for a loop if you tell me.
translation: 来吧，如果你告诉我，那些家伙就会陷入困境了。

original: Fine. I'm tired of this game. Irving. My name is Irving. There. Go collect your money.
translation: 好吧，我对这游戏厌倦了，艾尔文。我叫艾尔文，去拿你的钱吧。

original: Maybe now they'll leave me alone about it.
translation: 或许这样子他们就不会继续烦我了。

original: Fine. I'm tired of this game. Irving. My name is Irving. There. Go collect your money.
translation: 好吧，我对这游戏厌倦了，艾尔文。我叫艾尔文，去拿你的钱吧。

original: Maybe now they'll leave me alone about it.
translation: 或许这样子他们就不会继续烦我了。

original: Are you sure you won't tell me?
translation: 你确定你不会告诉我吗？

original: Sorry, pal. Vance is worm food.
translation: 对不起，朋友。万斯已经成了虫子的食物了。

original: You son-of-a-bitch! You KILLED him and you think it's funny?!
translation: 你这杂种，你杀了他，竟然还在拿他开玩笑？

original: He was my only chance to understand what the hell is wrong with me! And you messed it all up!
translation: 他是让我了解到底发生了什么的唯一机会。但你搞乱了一切。

original: Well you can just GO TO HELL!
translation: 你应该下地狱！

original: Well, Vance isn't going to be able to help anymore.
translation: 万斯不可能再帮你了。

original: Wait. What do you mean? He's dead... you killed him?
translation: 等等，你什么意思？他死了？你杀了他？

original: But he was my only chance to understand what the hell is happening to me!
translation: 但他是让我了解到底发生了什么的唯一机会！

original: Vance is dead, Ian. I'm so sorry.
translation: 万斯死了，我十分抱歉。

original: He's dead... you killed him? But he was my only chance to understand what the hell is happening to me!
translation: 他死了…你杀了他？但他是让我了解到底发生了什么的唯一机会！

original: No time to discuss it. We're getting the heck out of here!
translation: 我可没时间跟你讨论，赶紧跟我离开这。

original: I'm not going anywhere. I'm staying right here.
translation: 我哪都不会去，我要留在这。

original: I guess I shouldn't be surprised that you're here. I figured Evan King would get someone to track me down sooner or later.
translation: 对于你的到来，我并不应该感到惊讶。我早就猜到埃万·金迟早会派人来找我。

original: You're tough to find.
translation: 找到你还真不容易。

original: Maybe that's because I don't want to be found.
translation: 或许那是因为我不想被找到。

original: I guess I shouldn't be surprised that you're here. I figured Evan King would get someone to track me down sooner or later.
translation: 对于你的到来，我并不应该感到惊讶。我早就猜到埃万·金迟早会派人来找我。

original: Evan King sent me to look for you.
translation: 埃万·金派我来找你。

original: Yeah, I guess I should have known this would happen.
translation: 嗯，我想我早就应该知道这事会发生。

original: Never mind.
translation: 算了吧。

original: Yeah... that's what I thought.
translation: 嗯……我也这么想。

original: Nothing I can say will change your mind will it?
translation: 无论我说什么都不能改变你的想法了，对吗？

original: Unless you can prove to me there's a good reason to leave, I'm staying right here in Meresti. Even alone if I have to.
translation: 除非你给我个离开的好理由。否则我就待在米尔斯蒂，就算我孤身一人。

original: I changed my mind, Ian. I think you should stay here.
translation: 我改变注意了，伊恩，我想你应该待在这。

original: Thank you, somehow just hearing you say that helps me a lot.
translation: 谢谢你，你这么说，对我很有帮助。

original: Look, all I ever wanted was someone to let me make decisions for myself. For once I've decided that this is where I should be.
translation: 听着，我曾经想要的，就是有人能让我为自己做一个决定。而我决定了，这就是我应该留在这。

original: I've done something terrible and I need to deal with it. Until I'm ready to face it, I'm staying here in Meresti. Even if I have to stay alone.
translation: 我做了一些很糟糕的事，我需要处理好。我会一直待在米尔斯蒂，直到我准备好去面对我的所作所为。即使我孤身一人。

original: Read this letter, Ian. Lucy wrote it. I bet that would change your mind.
translation: 伊恩，看看这封信，露西写的。我保证你看完了会改变主意。

original: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
translation: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！

original: I think I had it all wrong. I shouldn't have come here. I bet Lucy is feeling just as bad as me.
translation: 我想我完全错了。我不该来这鬼地方，我发誓露西现在心里和我一样难受。

original: Go back to Arefu and tell Evan King that I'm coming home. I have a few things to pack and I want to say my goodbyes to this place... alone.
translation: 回到断桥镇，告诉埃万·金我要回家了。我需要一个人……收拾行李，对这地方说再见。

original: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
translation: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！

original: I think I had it all wrong. I shouldn't have come here. I bet Lucy is feeling just as bad as me.
translation: 我想我完全错了。我不该来这鬼地方，我发誓露西现在心里和我一样难受。

original: Please, tell Vance I've made my decision. I'm going home to Arefu. I hope to see you there as well.
translation: 求你了，告诉万斯我下了决心，我要回断桥镇的家。希望在那见到你。

original: Read this letter, Ian. Lucy wrote it. I bet that would change your mind.
translation: 伊恩，看看这封信，露西写的。我保证你看完了会改变主意。

original: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
translation: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！

original: I think I had it all wrong. I shouldn't have come here. I bet Lucy is feeling just as bad as me.
translation: 我想我完全错了。我不该来这鬼地方，我发誓露西现在心里和我一样难受。

original: Go back to Arefu and tell Evan King that I'm coming home. I have a few things to pack and I want to say my goodbyes to this place... alone.
translation: 回到断桥镇，告诉埃万·金我要回家了。我需要一个人……收拾行李，对这地方说再见。

original: Do what you want. This is a waste of time.
translation: 随你吧。这纯粹是浪费时间。

original: Yeah, that's just what I thought you'd end up saying.
translation: 嗯，我就知道你最后会这么说。

original: Get outta here, you murderer. You killed everyone left that I cared about!
translation: 滚开，你这凶手。你杀了所有我在乎的人。

original: If you want to stay, then stay. You have to do what you feel is right.
translation: 你要待在这就待着吧。做你觉得正确的事。

original: I can never go home. This was always meant to be my home and until something tells me otherwise, this is where I wanna be.
translation: 我永远回不了家了。这里本就该是我的家，除非发生什么事情让我改变想法，我会一直待在这。

original: Even if I stay alone. Tell Evan King that I'm sorry.
translation: 即使我孤身一人也认了。告诉埃万·金我对不起他们。

original: Look, this place isn't the answer. You need to go home and face your demons.
translation: 听着，待在这不能解决问题。你必须回家正视你的心魔。

original: Maybe you're right. It was easier to run away with the Family than to face what I did.
translation: 或许你是对的。跟着家族逃避总比正视自己的所作所为来得容易。

original: Go back to Arefu and tell Evan King that I'm coming home. I have a few things to pack and I want to say my goodbyes to this place... alone.
translation: 回到断桥镇，告诉埃万·金我要回家了。我需要一个人……收拾行李，对这地方说再见。

original: I delivered the letter to Ian.
translation: 我把信交给了伊恩。

original: Oh, thank you for remembering! With everything that's going on, I almost forgot about it.
translation: 哦，谢谢你还记得！现在一切回到正轨了，我都快忘了。

original: You have no idea how much this means to me. Thanks so much!
translation: 你不知道这对我有多重要。真心感谢你！

original: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
translation: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！

original: You have no idea how much this means to me. Thanks so much!
translation: 你不知道这对我有多重要。真心感谢你！

original: I have a letter for you from your sister, Lucy.
translation: 你姐姐露西有封信要我带给你。

original: No, I lied. I'm their newest member!
translation: 不，我撒了谎。我是他们的最新成员！

original: What the fuck? You liar!
translation: 他妈的，你这骗子！

original: Look, maybe you better explain what's going on first.
translation: 听着，或许你最好先解释一下出了什么事。

original: I'll tell you what's going on... the Family's been bothering our town for weeks.
translation: 我来告诉你发生了什么……家族已经骚扰我们的镇子好几周了。

original: At first they just showed up and carried on like a bunch of kids down there by the riverbed, scaring the Brahmin and stuff like that.
translation: 一开始，他们只是跑出来，像一群举止失常的孩子一样沿着河床游荡，吓唬附近的双头牛等等。

original: But this last time, they went too far. They charged up the ramp and started banging on our doors trying to get us to open up.
translation: 但上次他们做的太过分了。他们冲上斜坡，猛敲我们的门，想把我们从房子里吓出来。

original: I was hoping to find out what the Family did here.
translation: 我希望搞清楚家族在这做什么。

original: At first they just showed up and carried on like a bunch of kids down there by the riverbed, scaring the Brahmin and stuff like that.
translation: 一开始，他们只是跑出来，像一群举止失常的孩子一样沿着河床游荡，吓唬附近的双头牛等等。

original: But this last time, they went too far. They charged up the ramp and started banging on our doors trying to get us to open up.
translation: 但上次他们做的太过分了。他们冲上斜坡，猛敲我们的门，想把我们从房子里吓出来。

original: Let me guess, you thought I was from the Family.
translation: 我猜你怀疑我跟家族有关系。

original: Wait... you aren't one of them but you know about them? What's going on here?
translation: 等等……你虽然跟他们没关系，但你知道他们的一些内幕是不是？这到底出了什么问题？

original: That's right! Go away!
translation: 说对了！滚开！

original: Never mind.
translation: 算了。

original: Shut up, you stupid! Leave me alone! All you do is complain!
translation: 闭嘴，你这蠢货！离我远点！你就只会抱怨！

original: I don't know! What do I look like, a human? Talk, talk, talk! That's all you ever do!
translation: 我不知道！我看起来像什么？人类？废话连篇！你就只会这个！

original: Huh? What are you, some kind of human? Why you care? Shut up and go away!
translation: 呃？你是什么东西，所谓的人类？你为什么这么关心？闭嘴，滚开！

original: Umm... Well... Ahhh... Sure...
Ha! You talk a lot! Sound funny when you talk, like a stupid human. Ha ha ha ha ha!
translation: 哈！你话好多！你说话的时候真搞笑，就像愚蠢的人类。哈哈哈哈哈！

original: I'm hungry! I need something to eat. Meat would be good... A Brahmin head, roasted just a bit, with some...
translation: 我饿了！我要找东西吃。肉就不错……双头牛的头，烤一烤，蘸点……

original: This is boring.  We should be collecting more humans. We need more of us! The bucketheads have killed too many...
translation: 无聊呢。我们应该多收集些人类。我们需要更多帮手！水桶脑袋杀死了太多……

original: Have you found green stuff? I haven't found any. Ever. Maybe it's a lie. Maybe we're wasting our time. We could be out killing...
translation: 你发现绿玩意没？我什么都没找到。这或许是个骗局，我们在浪费时间。我们本可以出去大开杀戒……

original: I need a new gun. I want something that won't break. Something that will shoot forever. One of us had... a Fat Man! I want one of those...
translation: 我要换把新枪。我要打不坏的那种，可以不停的扫。我们一个兄弟有把……“胖子”微型核弹发射器！我就要那种大家伙……

original: Wish I had a new weapon. Something good to smash with. Wish I could hold one of those Behemoth clubs. So big! So much crush!
translation: 我希望有把新家伙，打击力量更强的。我希望能搞到超级变种巨人的消防栓。那玩意真大！握在手中真有力！

original: I was thinking. And it hurt! Hurt my head! But I remembered things. From before... I think I knew a woman. Or maybe, I WAS a woman... Aggh! It hurts!
translation: 我在想。真痛！脑袋痛！但我记起一些事。在从前……我好像认识一个女人。要么，我就是个女人……啊！真痛！

original: I was just wonderin'... What are you doing? Something good? Something fun? Me, I'm bored. Need somebody to kill. Or something to eat...
translation: 我只是好奇……你在干嘛？好玩吗？有趣吗？我，我很无聊。想杀个人，要么吃点东西……

original: I have joke for you. Ready? Knock knock.
translation: 我给你说个笑话。准备好了没？诺克敲门。

original: You'll live, tough girl.
translation: 你会活下去的，坚强的女孩。

original: You jerk.
translation: 你这废物。

original: Nice. I'm dying and you're making jokes.
translation: 好呀。我快死了，你却在幸灾乐祸。

original: I'll be on my way, then.
translation: 我随后就到。

original: Yes, yes. Best that you go now, before anything happens to you.
translation: 是的，没错。在你出什么事之前，你最好现在就走。

original: I must insist that you take the vial with you. Leaving it here is... inadvisable.
translation: 我必须坚持你带走试剂瓶。把它留在这……不妥。

original: Good, good. Of course I'll know if you manage to succeed in our little mission. I'll be watching you...
translation: 好的，好的。如果你完成了我们的小任务，我当然会知道。我会留意你的动向……

original: I'm afraid that's not possible. Not until you've taken the vial.
translation: 恐怕那不可能。除非你带走试剂瓶。

original: Power armor, energy weapons, and all sorts of advanced technology. Even some junk like sensor units or spare parts can be useful.
translation: 动力装甲、能量武器和各种先进技术。即使一些垃圾，像传感器或其他多余零件，都能变废为宝。

original: Some of it goes into the archives, some of it gets used to repair our own gear. Either way, it's better in our hands than lying around out there.
translation: 一些归入档案，一些用于修理我们自己的装备。无论如何，都比把它们当废品丢在一边强。

original: What are you looking for, again?
translation: 你又在找什么？

original: You've definitely proven your worth. I'll make sure to tell our people on patrol that you're a friend of the Outcasts.
translation: 你确实证明了你的价值。我保证会通知在巡逻中的伙伴，你是我们放逐者的朋友。

original: So, are we good? You trust me enough now?
translation: 我们现在是朋友了？你信任我了？

original: Okay, then.
translation: 那好吧。

original: That's all for now.
translation: 没什么问题了。

original: Useful stuff out there. Hope you don't have to use too much.
translation: 在外面很有用。希望你不会常用。

original: I'll take Rad-Away.
translation: 我要辐特宁。

original: Can't stand this stuff, myself. Goes through me like a rampaging Brahmin.
translation: 我受不了这东西，用了后我的体内就像有只在狂奔的双头牛。

original: I'll take Rad-Away.
translation: 我要辐特宁。

original: Here. Everyone's favorite. What would we do without them?
translation: 给，每个人都喜欢它。要是没有这玩意，我们该怎么活？

original: I'll take Stimpaks.
translation: 我要治疗针。

original: Here, enjoy them in good health. Or, at least, when you'd like to be in good health.
translation: 给，你要是受了伤就来上一针。它至少可以让你活得久一点。

original: I'll take Stimpaks.
translation: 我要治疗针。

original: Be careful. These can pack quite a pop.
translation: 小心，它会爆的。

original: I'll take frag grenades.
translation: 我要破片手榴弹。

original: Always a popular choice, these. Enjoy.
translation: 很多人都选它。好好享受。

original: I'll take frag grenades.
translation: 我要破片手榴弹。

original: Here you go. Try not to use it all in one place, unless you have to.
translation: 给你。如非必要，不要一次用光。

original: I'll take .556 ammo.
translation: 我要5.56毫米子弹。

original: Here's hoping you don't have to use it. But who am I kidding?
translation: 希望它用不上。可是我在骗谁呢？

original: I'll take .556 ammo.
translation: 我要5.56毫米子弹。

original: It's practically junk, but we can get some use out of it.
translation: 它实际上是垃圾，但我们能变废为宝。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: I've got some spare parts for you.
translation: 我帮你搞到了一些备用零件。

original: It's practically junk, but we can get some use out of it.
translation: 它实际上是垃圾，但我们能变废为宝。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: I've got a sensor unit for you.
translation: 我帮你搞到了传感装置。

original: Interesting. Very interesting.
translation: 有趣。非常有趣。

original: This definitely bears some study. Now, how would you like your payment?
translation: 有一定的研究价值。你想要什么回报？

original: Here, I found an Alien Power Cell.
translation: 给，我找到了一个外星能量电池。

original: What in the world?
translation: 这是怎么回事？

original: Yes, I think the boys down in the lab would be very interested in this. You did right to bring this to us!
translation: 是的，我想实验室的男孩们会对这玩意非常感兴趣。把它给我们你算是找对了人！

original: Now, what would you like in return for this amazing find?
translation: 为了这一惊人的发现，你想要什么回报？

original: You'll like this. It's an Alien Blaster. Seriously.
translation: 你会喜欢它的，这是一把外星爆能枪，真的。

original: Pretty rare piece of equipment, this. Good find.
translation: 非常稀有的装备。好手段。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: I've got a Plasma Pistol for you.
translation: 我帮你搞到了等离子手枪。

original: Pretty rare piece of equipment, this. Good find.
translation: 非常稀有的装备。好手段。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: I've got a Plasma Rifle for you.
translation: 我帮你搞到了等离子步枪。

original: We can always use another one of these.
translation: 这些东西对我们来说总是多多益善。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: How about a Laser Pistol?
translation: 这把激光手枪怎么样？

original: We can always use another one of these.
translation: 这些东西对我们来说总是多多益善。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: How about a Laser Rifle?
translation: 这把激光步枪怎么样？

original: This is some pretty heavy-duty stuff. We'll take good care of it.
translation: 相当耐用的东西。我们会好好保管。

original: Now, what can I give you in return?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: Here's a Power Armor Helmet from the Enclave.
translation: 给你英克雷的动力装甲头盔。

original: Well I'll be damned. The Advanced Power Armor Mark II. This is superb. Absolutely superb.
translation: 我的天，先进动力装甲II型。一级棒，绝对一流。

original: Now, what can I give you in return?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: Here's some Power Armor from the Enclave.
translation: 给你一些英克雷的动力装甲。

original: You'd better believe it. I haven't seen a suit like this in a long time.
translation: 信不信，我很久没见过这样的装备了。

original: And what would you like for this little surprise?
translation: 你想要点什么来换这个意外收获？

original: This Tesla Armor might be of interest to you.
translation: 你可能会对这套特斯拉装甲感兴趣。

original: Not much good on its own, but the optics are useful, at least.
translation: 它本身并不太好，但至少目镜很有用。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: Take this Power Armor Helmet.
translation: 拿着这个动力装甲头盔。

original: Always good to have another of these in the vaults.
translation: 这东西在避难所里当然是多多益善。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: Take this suit of Power Armor.
translation: 拿着这套动力装甲。

original: I see you've got some of our Power Armor there. I'll just take that off your hands.
translation: 我看见你带着我们那种动力装甲。我就要它了。

original: I'm sure you just found it in the Wastes and you're returning it to us, right? Because you'd have to be a real moron to try to turn it in for pay.
translation: 我相信你是在废土找到它，拿来还给我们的，对吧？想用它来换钱，你还真是个白痴。

original: Now, let's see what else you've got.
translation: 让我看看你还有什么。

original: I've got some technology to turn in.
translation: 我要上交些科技产品。

original: Let's see what you've got.
translation: 让我们看看你有什么。

original: I've got some technology to turn in.
translation: 我要上交些科技产品。

original: Suit yourself. Why don't you go talk with Lyons? He's always got time for your kind.
translation: 随你便。你为什么不找里昂斯谈谈？他总是有时间来应对你这种人。

original: I'll pass. If I can't be a member, I won't be your errand boy.
translation: 我放弃。我想成为你们的一份子，而不是当跑腿的。

original: Take all the time you need. But don't waste my time until you're ready to take the job.
translation: 别着急。不过除非你决定接下这任务，否则别来打搅我。

original: I need time to consider it.
translation: 我需要时间考虑。

original: Okay, but first you'll have to talk with Protector Casdin. You can work out the details with him.
translation: 好吧，但你要先和守护者卡斯丁谈谈。他能帮你出出主意。

original: Sounds good. I'm in.
translation: 听起来不错。我接受。

original: That's what I like to hear! You can start immediately.
translation: 正是我想听到的！你可以立即开始。

original: You'll report directly to me: I'll take in your gear and dole out your pay. Now get cracking!
translation: 你到时候直接向我汇报：我收你的装备，给你薪水。快去干活！

original: I'll take the job.
translation: 我要接下这份工作。

original: We may be the best-equipped people in the world, but we've still only got so many people out there looking to recover the past's technology.
translation: 我们可能是这世界上装备最好的人，但我们一直有很多人在搜寻战前科技。

original: Locals like you can cover more of the Wastes to uncover technological relics like Power Armor or power cells.
translation: 像你这样的原住民能够更好地搜遍废土来搜寻科技遗物，比如动力装甲或动力电池。

original: We know their value better than any junk-trader, and we've got more ammo stores, so you can expect a better trade for the tech.
translation: 我们比那些垃圾商人更懂得它们的价值，而且我们有更多的军火贮备，所以和我们做买卖价钱更划算。

original: I'm not sure. Tell me more about this work.
translation: 我不确定。详细地跟我说说这个工作。

original: It's simple enough. Bring in technological devices, and we'll pay you for what you find.
translation: 再简单不过。把你找到的科技装置带给我们，我们付你报酬。

original: Big things like power armor or energy weapons are best, but we'll take things like sensor units or spare parts, too. You never know what's important.
translation: 像动力装甲、能量武器这样的大玩意是最好不过，不过传感器或其他零件这些垃圾我们也照单全收。天晓得什么东西会有用。

original: In return, we'll pay you with your choice of .556 ammo, grenades, stimpaks, or Rad-Away. I'll bet they're more useful to you out there, anyway.
translation: 你可以从5.56弹药、手榴弹、治疗针或辐特宁里选一样作为我们对你的回报。我保证它们物超所值。

original: I need to know more about the job before deciding.
translation: 在我做决定之前，我要详尽地了解这份工作。

original: Why do you want the suit?
translation: 你为什么要这套装？

original: Isn't it only fitting to gloat over the corpse of one's fallen foe? To revel in a victory over a larger and stronger opponent overcome?
translation: 还有什么比踩过敌人的尸体更威风吗？还有什么比打败高强的对手更适合用来庆祝胜利的吗？

original: If I couldn't be there to personally strip the facade from the iron interloper, the least I am owed is a chance to gloat over his shell.
translation: 如果我不能亲自剥下钢铁闯入者的铁壳子，那我至少还有机会嘲笑它的壳子。

original: I can hardly leave it lying around for someone else to find, now can I? The threat of the AntAgonizer must be put to an end forever!
translation: 我无法容忍它让其他人找到，不是吗？痛苦蚁后必须永远消失！

original: I must not let her threaten all that humanity holds dear. Even now, twisted souls may seek to continue her legacy!
translation: 我绝对不能让她威胁到所有人性的温存。即使是现在，扭曲的灵魂仍然会继承她的遗愿！

original: But not everyone agrees?
translation: 但不是人人都赞成？

original: No, not everyone. But for a variety of reasons, those who disagree are no longer with us.
translation: 是的，不是每个人都赞成。因为种种原因，那些不赞成的人也离开了我们。

original: Well, I'm asking you. Why are you here?
translation: 我来问你。你为什么在这里？

original: I'm here for two reasons. One, Lyons needs me. He always has, just as much as I need him. We've been through a lot together, he and I.
translation: 我在这里有两个原因。第一，里昂斯需要我。他需要我如同我需要他。我们从一开始就是拴在一根绳上的蚂蚱。

original: Two... Take a look around you. Access to this kind of technology, and the benefits it could provide to the Brotherhood, is immeasurable.
translation: 第二……看看你周围。我们能使用的这种技术，提供给兄弟会的好处是不可估量的。

original: It must be difficult to communicate with the West Coast.
translation: 同西岸通信想必非常困难吧。

original: Indeed it is. Especially when they refuse any attempts at communication.
translation: 确实是这样。尤其是当他们不想尝试和我们建立联系的时候。

original: Why, what happened?
translation: 为什么？发生了什么？

original: Lines of communication were severed years ago. The Western Elders have washed their hands of us.
translation: 通信线路阻断多年了。西岸长老对我们不闻不问。

original: You make saving people sound like a bad thing.
translation: 照你这么说，救人反而是坏事了。

original: It wasn't why we were sent here. Good or bad has nothing to do with it.
translation: 它不是我们来这里的理由啊。这件事无所谓好与坏。

original: Lyons knew that, but ignored it. He decided it was more important to save the people here than to obey orders from his superiors.
translation: 里昂斯知道的，却视而不见。他确信拯救这里的人比执行上级的命令更重要。

original: For years he'd try and persuade them to send reinforcements and supplies, all the while stringing them along, saying he was sticking to the mission.
translation: 他好多年都在骗他们，说他仍然在全力执行任务，以便说服他们提供增援和补给。

original: Finally, things came to a head. Lyons directly refused orders, and so the West Coast cut us off. No communications, no reinforcements.
translation: 最后，事情没有瞒过去。里昂斯直接拒绝服从命令，因此西岸切断了同我们的联系。没有通信，没有增援。

original: He's in charge, so it's his decision, right?
translation: 他是主管，所以这是他的决定，对吧？

original: He's in charge of this detachment, yes. He's not in charge of the Brotherhood.
translation: 没错，他主管这支分遣队。但他不是兄弟会的主管。

original: As loyal as I am to the man, I can't overlook the fact that he disobeyed orders, and it cost us.
translation: 像我这样对他如此忠诚，也不能忽视他违抗命令的事实，这让我们付出了代价。

original: The West Coast cut us off completely, once they saw what was going on. So now we're on our own. No communications, no reinforcements.
translation: 一发现这里的情况，西岸就彻底切断了同我们的联系。因此我们全靠自己。没有通信，没有增援。

original: We can't even beat the Super Mutants, and now we're expected to defend against the Enclave? Alone? The situation is... less than ideal.
translation: 我们甚至连超级变种人都搞不定，还指望我们去防御英克雷？孤立无援？处境……不太妙啊。

original: Those sound like pretty good changes to me.
translation: 我觉得这种变化很好啊。

original: You're an outsider. I don't expect you to understand.
translation: 你是个外来者。我不指望你会理解我们的感受。

original: We live and die by our dedication to the Brotherhood. To go against orders...
translation: 我们将生命献给了兄弟会。违抗命令……

original: It's not something that's done. I appreciate that Lyons believes he is doing what is right, but he should never have disobeyed orders.
translation: 事情不该这样的。我欣赏里昂斯的信念，但他绝不该违抗命令。

original: And now look where it's gotten us. Forces dwindled, Super Mutants on one side, Enclave on the other. We can barely take care of ourselves.
translation: 看看我们现在到了什么地步。队伍在减员，一边是超级变种人，一边是英克雷。我们几乎不能自保了。

original: Sorry to have brought it up.
translation: 抱歉提起你们的伤心事。

original: You are an outsider. You had no way of knowing.
translation: 你是外来者。你又不知道。

original: What do you mean by "repercussions"?
translation: 你说的“后果”是什么意思？

original: Some did not approve of the Elder's decisions. Initially, they followed because we are all taught to follow the Elders.
translation: 一些人不赞成长老的决定。他们最初追随长老是因为我们都被灌输了追随长老的思想。

original: What kind of changes?
translation: 怎样的改变？

original: We were dispatched with a specific mission. We were sent to locate and secure any technology remaining from before the war.
translation: 我们被派执行特殊任务，搜寻和保护任何战前遗留下来的科技。

original: Like our robotic monstrosity. That was our greatest find. Damn thing still doesn't work, but at least it's ours.
translation: 像我们的机器巨人，是我们最伟大的发现。这该死的玩意到现在都还不能运作，但至少它是我们的。

original: But those damned Super Mutants... They changed things. Lyons changed.
translation: 不过那些该死的超级变种人…他们改变了许多事。里昂斯也变了。

original: He decided they were a threat. Not just to us, but to everyone. And so he altered the mission.
translation: 他确信它们是个威胁，不仅对我们，而且对每个人。所以他改变了任务。

original: Finding the source of the mutants and putting a stop to them was his goal. Our original mission became an afterthought. We've failed both.
translation: 他的目标变成了找到并切断突变源。我们原先的使命变成了额外任务。但我们两个任务都失败了。

original: Then where's the rest of the Brotherhood?
translation: 其他的兄弟会在哪里？

original: The West Coast, unless something has changed.
translation: 西岸，除非他们发生了变故。

original: There's been no contact with them for the last several years.
translation: 自从西岸和我们切断通信后，有好几年没再和他们联系了。

original: There's also a small detachment in Chicago, but they're off the radar. Gone rogue. Long story.
translation: 芝加哥也有支小规模的分遣队，但他们从雷达上失踪了，变成了流寇和强盗。说来话长。

original: Why is that a sore subject?
translation: 那为什么是个难堪的问题？

original: Much has happened in the 23 years since we left the west coast. Our mission has changed in that time.
translation: 自从我们离开西岸，23年来发生了太多事。这段时期我们的任务已经改变。

original: The changes have not all been pleasant, and have had significant repercussions.
translation: 这些改变并非各个令人愉快，并且有了明显的后果。

original: I'd like to hear what you have to say anyway.
translation: 不管怎样，我想继续听你说。

original: If you insist. What do you want to know?
translation: 如果你坚持的话。你想知道些什么？

original: Sorry. Never mind.
translation: 对不起，别介意。

original: No need to apologize.
translation: 没必要道歉。

original: Why are you the wrong person to ask?
translation: 为什么说问你这里的问题是找错了对象？

original: Predominantly because the Elder won't like some of what I have to say.
translation: 还不是因为长老不喜欢我会说出来的看法嘛。

original: But fine, I'll discuss it. What do you want to know?
translation: 但是好吧，就和你谈谈。你想知道什么？

original: That's all I wanted to know.
translation: 这就是我想知道的。

original: So be it.
translation: 那就这样。

original: Was there something else, then?
translation: 还有别的事吗？

original: How long have you been here?
translation: 你在这里待了多长时间？

original: It's been over twenty years since we arrived. And we've been struggling to contain and eradicate the Super Mutants for nearly as long.
translation: 我们到这里20多年了。我们几乎从一开始就在尽力牵制和消灭超级变种人。

original: With the arrival of the Enclave, I have a terrible feeling the Super Mutants are the least of our worries.
translation: 随着英克雷的到来，我有不详的预感，超级变种人已经不再是我们的大麻烦了。

original: We arrived here in '55. Established ourselves in the Citadel within the first few months. The Elder has kept us busy since then.
translation: 我们在2255年来的。用了几个月在五角大本营安营扎寨。此后长老一直让我们忙得团团转。

original: If you're just a part of the Brotherhood, where's the rest of it?
translation: 如果你们仅仅是兄弟会的一部分，那其他的人呢？

original: The Brotherhood began on the West Coast, and exists there still. We were dispatched to this location many years ago.
translation: 兄弟会在西岸成立，现在也在那里。许多年前我们被派到这里。

original: In truth, the Brotherhood of Steel has been struggling for years, both here and back home.
translation: 钢铁兄弟会事实上已经奋斗了许多年，不仅仅在这里，也在后方的老家。

original: Honor, truth, courage -- these virtues seem to have little meaning in these troubled times, I'm afraid.
translation: 荣耀、真诚、勇气 — 恐怕这些德行在这乱世里，已经失去了意义。

original: The Brotherhood of Steel is bigger than what you see here. We're only a small... division, you could say.
translation: 钢铁兄弟会比你所看到的要大得多。我们只不过是个小……分队，你可以这么说。

original: But that's a bit of a sore subject around here.
translation: 但在这里，那是个难堪的问题。

original: You seem to have a pretty small organization.
translation: 好像你们的组织相当小啊。

original: Why are you here in the Capital Wasteland?
translation: 你们为什么出现在首都废土？

original: Ah, now that's the real question, isn't it?
translation: 哈，这才是你最想问的，对吧？

original: Our orders were, and are, to acquire any and all advanced technology. And we have, to the best of our abilities.
translation: 我们的命令原来是、现在也是，寻找任何先进科技。而且要尽全力。

original: But when I realized the extent of the Super Mutant threat, I felt it was my responsibility to aid the people in their struggle against them.
translation: 但当我了解到超级变种人泛滥的程度后，我觉得帮助这里的人抵御它们是我的责任。

original: Unfortunately, my superiors back west disagree with my assessment of the situation. They feel I've grown too "attached" to the local populace.
translation: 很不走运，西岸后方我的上级不同意我的态势评估。他们觉得我和原住民“过于融洽”。

original: And they're right.
translation: 他们是对的。

original: In any event, the Enclave's arrival changes everything...
translation: 不管怎样，英克雷出现后，一切都变了……

original: Well, that all depends on who you ask.
translation: 看你问谁。

original: Lyons will tell you it's because we're protecting the poor, innocent people of the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 里昂斯会告诉你我们是为了保护首都废土贫困和无辜的人民。

original: Most others here will tell you the same thing. They'll do anything for that man.
translation: 这里大多数的人都会这么说。他们愿意为这个人赴汤蹈火。

original: I'd like to know more about the Brotherhood of Steel.
translation: 我想进一步了解钢铁兄弟会。

original: The Brotherhood is an old organization, going back to the years just after the war. We are but a part of it. What would you like to know?
translation: 兄弟会是个历史悠久的组织，一直可以追溯到战争爆发之后。我们只是它的一个分队。你想知道什么？

original: What more did you want to know?
translation: 你想进一步知道什么？

original: I'm afraid you're asking the wrong person.
translation: 恐怕你是问错了人。

original: What do you want to know?
translation: 你想知道什么？

original: Hold on Jonas, I need to record this first.
translation: 坚持住，乔纳斯，我要先记录。

original: I don't really know how to tell you this. I hope you'll understand, but I know you might be angry.
translation: 我真不知道该怎么跟你说。我希望你能明白，但我知道你可能会生我的气。

original: I thought about it for a long time, but in the end I decided it was best for you not to know.
translation: 我考虑了很久，不过我最终决定你还是不要知道的好。

original: So many things could have gone wrong, and there's really no telling how the Overseer will react when he finds out.
translation: 许多事都错了，当监督者知道真相后，真不知道他会有什么反应。

original: It's best if he can blame everything on me.
translation: 如果他把一切罪责都算在我头上那最好。

original: Obviously, you already know that I'm gone. It was something I needed to do. You're an adult now. You're ready to be on your own.
translation: 你显然知道我已经走了，有些事我必须做完。你已经是个大人，你准备好走自己的路了。

original: Maybe some day, things will change and we can see each other again. I can't tell you why I left or where I'm going. I don't want you to follow me.
translation: 或许来日事情会有所转机，我们能再次相见。我不能告诉你我为什么离开，或者我要去哪。我不想你跟着我。

original: God knows life in the Vault isn't perfect, but at least you'll be safe. Just knowing that will be enough to keep me going.
translation: 避难所的生活不是十全十美，但至少你很安全。你要是懂得这一点，我就能安心走了。

original: Don't mean to rush you, Doc, but I'd feel better if we got this over with.
translation: 我不想催促你，医生，但如果把这事先做完，我会觉得好受点。

original: Okay. Go ahead.
translation: 好吧。继续。

original: Goodbye. I love you.
translation: 再见。我爱你。

original: Don't mean to rush you, Doc, but I'd feel better if we got this over with.
translation: 我不想催促你，医生，但如果把这处理掉，我会觉得好受点。

original: I'm sorry about Reddin and the others...
translation: 瑞丁的事我很遗憾……

original: She died well.
translation: 她走得很安详。

original: In the end, that's all that really matters.
translation: 到头来，那就是关键。

original: I'm sorry about Reddin...
translation: 瑞丁的事我很遗憾……

original: Like I needed your help. Please.
translation: 看来我需要你的帮助。拜托。

original: Kid, out here cocky will get you killed. I've seen a Super Mutant strike squad like that take down five well armed soldiers.
translation: 小子，在这儿太招摇是会被杀的。我曾看到超级变种人打五个全副武装的士兵就像玩一样。

original: But fine, next time you want to take them on yourself and buy yourself an early retirement, go right ahead.
translation: 不过好吧，随便你，你想和他们动手来让自己报销，那就去吧。

original: Wait... Who the hell are you people?
translation: 等等……你们他妈的都是些什么人？

original: I'm Sentinel Lyons of the Lyons' Pride. With the Brotherhood of Steel.
translation: 我是“里昂斯的骄傲”的莎拉·里昂斯，钢铁兄弟会的成员。

original: Don't worry. We're on your side. At least I hope so.
translation: 别担心，我们是你这边的，至少我希望是。

original: Thanks for the assist. I didn't know this place was so dangerous.
translation: 谢谢援助，我不知道这鬼地方这么危险。

original: You been living under a rock? This is D.C. The entire city is crawling with Super Mutants. Now if you'll excuse me...
translation: 你是从石头缝里蹦出来的吗？这是特区，整个城市遍地都是超级变种人。现在如果你不介意的话……

original: I'm just passing through. Don't bug me with your problems.
translation: 我只是路过，别为你的小事来打扰我。

original: Please, we really do need someone to stop the Mechanist and the AntAgonizer. We can pay!
translation: 拜托，我们真的需要有个人能阻止机械侠和痛苦蚁后。我们付你钱！

original: They've been using this town as their battlefield, and now some of the merchants are avoiding us! If something isn't done, the town will be ruined!
translation: 它们把镇子变成了战场，商人也躲着我们！如果不做点什么，这镇子就完了！

original: You seem to be pretty calm, considering there was just war in your streets.
translation: 刚才那场战斗时，你看来很冷静。

original: That must be the twentieth time I've seen those two go at it. They're our problem citizens: the Mechanist and the AntAgonizer.
translation: 这肯定是我看到的第二十次战斗了。他们是我们的问题市民：机械侠和痛苦蚁后。

original: A while ago, we were attacked by the AntAgonizer -- that woman with the ants, obviously. The Mechanist saved the town with his robots.
translation: 我们刚才被痛苦蚁后攻击了，就是那个带着蚂蚁的女人。机械侠带着他的机器人救了镇子。

original: That was all well and good, but I swear their fights are getting bigger, and it's been driving off the merchants. They simply won't leave!
translation: 那也好，不过我敢发誓他们的战斗不断升级，商人也被赶跑了。他们完全不肯离开！

original: What was all that about? Who were those people?
translation: 那是怎么回事？那都是什么人？

original: The, um... Mechanist and the AntAgonizer. That's just what they call themselves. Ridiculous, I know...
translation: 嗯……机械侠和痛苦蚁后。他们这么称呼自己。我知道这很滑稽……

original: A while ago, we were attacked by the AntAgonizer - that woman with the ants, obviously. The Mechanist saved the town with his robots.
translation: 我们刚才被痛苦蚁后攻击了，就是那个带着蚂蚁的女人。机械侠带着他的机器人救了镇子。

original: That was all well and good, but I swear their fights are getting bigger, and it's been driving off the merchants. They simply won't leave!
translation: 那也好，不过我敢发誓他们的战斗不断升级，商人也被赶跑了。他们完全不肯离开！

original: Mirelurk gives me gas. I'd rather have squirrel.
translation: 泥沼蟹肉吃多了会放屁。我情愿要松鼠肉。

original: Uh...maybe you should sit in the corner. I can check to see if we have any squirrel if you wish.
translation: 嗯……或许你应该到角落找个位置坐下，我去看看还有没有松鼠肉。

original: I'm partial to Mirelurk Cakes myself.
translation: 我特别喜欢泥沼蟹肉蛋糕。

original: Then you are in for a treat!
translation: 那你可就有福了！

original: Any fool can use a gun.
translation: 傻瓜都会用枪。

original: Said like a soon-to-be-dead Wastelander.
translation: 说来像是快要死的废土游民。

original: Man, I love guns. Nothing's better than the kick of a .44!
translation: 老兄，我爱枪，没有什么比.44更合我意！

original: Ain't seen many of those around lately. They're tough to come by.
translation: 最近没有见到过这种货，要想搞到比较困难。

original: You're a junkie? Tell me where you keep your stash. Now!
translation: 你是瘾君子？告诉我你的货箱在哪里，快！

original: Okay, okay! I steal them from Doc Preston. There's an empty room across from the Staley's. I hide them in the file cabinet in there.
translation: 好吧，好吧！我是从普雷斯顿医生那偷的。斯塔利的房子对面有个空房间，东西就藏在房间的文件柜子。

original: Have you heard any interesting gossip?
translation: 你有听到什么传闻吗？

original: Well, I really shouldn't tell you, but have you heard about Paulie Cantelli?
translation: 好吧，我真不该告诉你，但你听说过保利·坎特利没？

original: He's addicted to chems. His poor wife, Cindy, is at her wits end.
translation: 他对药品上瘾了。他可怜的老婆辛迪已经拿他没辙了。

original: You haven't heard? Angela has the hots for Diego.
translation: 你还没听说？安吉拉对迭戈渴求不已。

original: But since he's a priest, he's been putting her off. One of these days she's just going to jump his bones.
translation: 不过因为他是个牧师，一直对她躲躲藏藏。但总有一天她会和他上床的。

original: So, are there any fun rumors flying around Rivet City?
translation: 铆钉城有什么传闻吗？

original: They say Mister Lopez is losing it. He stands on the top of the bridge tower for hours at a time, just staring out over the city.
translation: 他们说洛佩斯先生神智不清了。他每次在桥塔顶上一站就是好几个小时，一动不动地盯着外边。

original: Are there any other rumors you've heard?
translation: 你有听到其他传闻吗？

original: Bannon is trying to blackmail Seagraves Holmes.
translation: 班侬正绞尽脑汁敲诈西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。

original: That's pretty underhanded, even for Bannon.
translation: 这事对班侬来说都显得下作了。

original: Once word gets out, I bet the market vendors won't want him to represent them anymore.
translation: 这事一旦公布出去，我打赌市场的商人们不会再让他当代表了。

original: Thank you for your help, citizen.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助，公民。

original: I found this letter in Seagrave's room. I thought you should see it.
translation: 我在西格雷夫的房间发现了这封信，我想你应该看看。

original: This is bad. Seagrave Holmes was angling for a seat on the council.
translation: 太糟糕了，西格雷夫·福尔摩斯正想在议会博取个席位。

original: He can forget about that now. Once the market vendors get wind of his past, they'll never trust him. Too bad.
translation: 他现在可以忘记这想法了。一旦市场的商人了解到他的过去，他们永远不会再信任他。太糟了。

original: I found a letter in Seagrave's room. It's from some Slavers...
translation: 我在西格雷夫的房间找到这封信，是奴隶贩子寄来的……

original: Really? I...I mean, I'm shocked. Shocked I tell you.
translation: 真的吗？我……我的意思是，我被震惊了。

original: Tell Danvers about that letter right away. That will squash any hope he has of replacing me on the council.
translation: 立刻把这信的事告诉丹佛斯，这将让他想在议会取代我的所有希望化为乌有。

original: Don't tell her I asked you to find it though. That would backfire in a nasty way.
translation: 不过别告诉她是我要你去找的这封信，那只会适得其反。

original: Bannon tells me you're trying to steal his Council seat.
translation: 班侬对我说，你想偷窃他的议会席位。

original: Steal it? Hardly. He runs the council like it's his own personal bank account.
translation: 偷窃？胡扯。他把议会当自己的私人银行帐户。

original: He's supposed to represent all the market businesses, not just himself. It's about time he was replaced.
translation: 他的责任是为所有市场商人谋利，不是只为他自己。他该下台了。

original: If you had read that letter you'd know I'm no slaver and you know I'm not dealing with them.
translation: 你要是读了那封信，你应当知道我不是奴隶贩子，我和他们没有生意往来。

original: But if that letter gets out, they won't trust me. I'll never get a seat on the council and Bannon will make me pay for trying to replace him.
translation: 但如果那封信泄漏了，他们不会再信任我。我将永远得不到议会的席位，班侬会让我为试图取代他而付出代价。

original: If you care about Rivet City half as much as I do, tell Danvers that Bannon is blackmailing me, but don't show her the letter.
translation: 你对铆钉城的关心程度要是能有我的一半多，那就去告诉丹佛斯，班侬在敲诈我，但别向她出示这封信。

original: You've been doing business with Slavers, and I have a letter that proves it.
translation: 你在和奴隶贩子做交易，我有封信可以证明。

original: It's really none of my business.
translation: 这事和我没什么关系。

original: Don't want to get mixed up in politics, eh? Don't blame you.
translation: 不想趟政治这趟浑水，嗯？不怪你。

original: Whoever this Seagrave is, you think he's a threat to your influence?
translation: 不管这西格雷夫是谁，你觉得他对你是一个威胁对吧？

original: A threat? No, of course not! Well, maybe. He wants to replace me on the council.
translation: 威胁？不，当然不是！好吧，也许是。他想取代我在议会的位置。

original: He's a shady character, I just can't prove it. Now if someone were to find something incriminating in his room...
translation: 他是个阴险的人，我只是不能证明这一点。如果谁能去他的房间找到一些控告他的罪状……

original: Well, lets just say I would be very appreciative.
translation: 那我将会感激不尽。

original: Seagrave? Oh yeah. He's clueless.
translation: 西格雷夫？没错，他是个蠢货。

original: So you've met him, eh? Well he wants to replace me on the council. Now, I can't have that. No siree.
translation: 你见过他了？呵，他想要取代我在议会的位置。我不会让他美梦成真的。没门。

original: He's a shady character, I just can't prove it. If someone were to find something incriminating in his room...
translation: 他是个阴险的人，我只是不能证明这一点。如果谁能去他的房间找到一些控告他的罪状……

original: Well, lets just say I would be very appreciative.
translation: 那我将会感激不尽。

original: Ha ha ha! Yes! Strong soldiers to smash the humans for good!
translation: 哈哈哈！没错！士兵越强打起人类越棒！

original: Green stuff don't work only because men we take weak. We wait for strong men... they make good soldiers.
translation: 绿玩意不起作用只是因为我们抓的人太弱了，我们在等更强壮的人类出现……他们更适合当好士兵。

original: More of us if green stuff work. It makes many mistakes. We dump bodies in cave too many times.
translation: 绿玩意要是起作用，我们会更壮大。出了太多错，我们丢掉进洞的尸体太多了。

original: Ha ha ha, yes! More of them mean more of us soon.
translation: 哈哈哈，没错！ 他们更多意味着我们就会更多。

original: Let them come to us! We'll take them apart! Then when they weak, we put them in green stuff!
translation: 让他们冲我们来！我们把他们各个击破！等他们扛不住的时候，我们就把他们扔进绿玩意里。

original: Stupid Fox say men will come to us one day. To take green stuff.
translation: 愚蠢的福克斯说总有一天会有人来找我们。拿走绿玩意。

original: Need to find more humans then... make them like us.
translation: 还要去找更多人类……再把他们变成我们。

original: Others go to find some. We must have more of us to stop the humans!
translation: 其他人去找一些来，我们需要有更多的同类来阻止人类！

original: We almost out of green stuff.
translation: 我们几乎都是从绿玩意里变出来的。

original: Who's this Sister? A nun?
translation: “修女”是谁？是真的修女？

original: No. He's a big, scary Slaver. He's staying at the Weatherly Hotel. I try to avoid him because he might recognize me.
translation: 不，他是个吓人的大奴隶贩子。他就住在韦瑟利旅馆。我要避开他，因为他可能认出我。

original: Hey, it's none of my business. Let the past be the past.
translation: 嗨，与我无关。过去的就过去吧。

original: That's easy to say. You don't have anyone from your past after you.
translation: 说起来容易，难道你过去就没和人打过交道？

original: I just feel so helpless.
translation: 我只是觉得很无助。

original: Lady, you're nuts.
translation: 女士，你疯了。

original: I'm sorry. I'm just so on edge all the time.
translation: 抱歉，我总是很紧张。

original: Sounds like a plan, man.
translation: 这计划还像样，老兄。

original: All right! You and me, just hangin'.
translation: 好吧！你和我，一起干。

original: I know your type. You're a freeloader and a waste of breath.
translation: 我知道你是哪种人。你就是寄生虫，跟你说也白费。

original: Whoa! Dude! You don't have to get all in my face.
translation: 哇哦！哥们，你别都冲着我来啊。

original: I'll just make myself scarce.
translation: 我很快就走。

original: Heard any good stories lately?
translation: 近来有什么趣闻？

original: Go talk to Vera if you want gossip. I don't talk bad about folks.
translation: 你要听趣闻就去找薇拉吧，我不说别人的坏话。

original: This place looks pretty easy to rob. You have any problems with thieves?
translation: 这地方看起来很容易遭劫，有小偷找你的麻烦没？

original: Don't get any cute ideas. Security is just a shout away.
translation: 别想歪主意，警卫就在外面。

original: Now, if you've got any medical issues, let's hear them.
translation: 你要是有什么医疗问题，我洗耳恭听。

original: Got any Chems? I could really use a fix.
translation: 有药品吗？我可能真的要治疗一下。

original: You can get that crap down at A Quick Fix. It's in the market.
translation: 你可以到快速修复把这些垃圾卖掉。

original: I'm a doctor, not a dealer. I'll fix you as best I can if you're hurt.
translation: 我是医生，不是商人。你要是受了伤，我可以尽全力治疗你。

original: I like you. You're funny. I assume you sell Chems?
translation: 我喜欢你，你很有趣。你好像在卖药品？

original: Yeah. Paulie and I. Our shop is in the market.
translation: 是的，保利和我。我们开的店在市场里。

original: Boy, that sounded dumb! Where else would our shop be? Anyway, thanks. For being nice, that is.
translation: 噢，那句话真蠢！我们的店能开到其他地方吗？不管怎样，谢谢。谢谢你的友善。

original: Whoa! Slow down, lady. You're freaking me out.
translation: 哇哦！冷静，女士。你吓到我了。

original: Sorry. I get nervous easily. When I'm nervous, I'm fast. I mean, I talk. Fast that is. See, I'm doing it again.
translation: 对不起，我容易紧张。我一紧张，我就快。我是说，我说话。说话快。看，我又这样了。

original: Thank God! I can barely carry all this stuff.
translation: 感谢上帝！我都快扛不动了。

original: Well, I'm not open just now, but I will be by daybreak. Stop by.
translation: 好吧，我现在没开店，但白天我会开店，到时去看看。

original: Just what the Wasteland needs, another junk vendor...
translation: 正是废土所需，又一个垃圾商人……

original: Suit yourself. Sooner or later everyone has stuff to unload that only I will take.
translation: 随你便。每个人都有东西要扔，而只有我来收。

original: Anything? Chems? Guns? How about parts and junk?
translation: 任何东西？药品？枪械？零件和垃圾怎么样？

original: Yep. I'll take it all. One man's junk is another man's treasure.
translation: 好，我全部收下，某人的垃圾就是他人的财宝。

original: How do I know you won't rip me off?
translation: 我怎么知道你没有坑我？

original: You don't. No guarantees in the Wasteland. No rebates or exchanges either.
translation: 你没法知道。废土没有质保，不退货，也不调换。

original: Oh, and you break it, you buy it.
translation: 哦，你弄坏了它，你就得买。

original: You got a T-51b? No? Then you don't have everything.
translation: 你有T-51b吗？没有？那你也不是什么有啊。

original: A what?
translation: 什么？

original: Look, if you just want to crack wise, go somewhere else. But if you've got stuff you want to sell, then I'm your man.
translation: 听着，你要是想寻开心，去其他地方。但如果你要卖东西，你找对了人。

original: You some sort of tough guy? You want to try me?
translation: 你很强？想和我比试下吗？

original: Ain't worth the ammo. Just walk away before security hauls you away.
translation: 不和你一般见识。在警卫揪你耳朵前，赶紧滚开。

original: Know where I can offload some guns?
translation: 知道我能在哪脱手一些枪吗？

original: You're kidding right? Flak and Shrapnel's, in the market. I'm Shrapnel, you idiot.
translation: 你在开玩笑吧？“高炮和榴弹”就在市场里。而我就是“榴弹”小帅，你这白痴。

original: What's your problem? Loosen up, pal.
translation: 你有病啊？放松点，老兄。

original: I'm short on time and your five minutes are up. See ya.
translation: 我赶时间，你的5分钟到了。回见。

original: This peashooter has saved my ass more than once.
translation: 这把玩具枪救了我可不止一次。

original: I'm sure that was just luck. You should upgrade. Check out our shop in the market.
translation: 我肯定那只是走运，你应当更新装备。去市场上我们的店里瞧瞧。

original: Cute names. Did you make them up, or are you just trying to look tough?
translation: 好名字，是你起的吗，或者你只是想给自己壮壮胆？

original: Like that's your real name?
translation: 你以为那是我的真名？

original: The names are good for business. And if you don't think I'm tough enough, just try me.
translation: 这名字对生意有好处。另外你要是以为我没胆，那就来较量下。

original: Do you have the big stuff? Flamers, Missile Launchers, stuff like that?
translation: 你这有火焰喷射器或导弹发射器之类的大家伙吗？

original: We usually have a few. I'd have to check the inventory.
translation: 我们通常会有一些，不过我要看下库存。

original: Stop by the shop. Either Shrapnel or I will show you what we've got.
translation: 顺道去店里瞧瞧，“榴弹”小帅和我会向你展示我们的货物。

original: Aren't you afraid someone will use your own guns to rob you?
translation: 你难道不怕有人用你卖的枪来打劫你？

original: Here? In Rivet City?
translation: 在这？铆钉城？

original: I'm packing and most of the rest of these guys are packing. Not to mention security.
translation: 这里的人都带着家伙。安全不成问题。

original: This is quite a selection, but they're all in lousy condition.
translation: 这里东西倒挺多，但它们好像不怎么结实。

original: I don't put the good stuff out on the table. If you're interested, I can show you the stuff in the locker.
translation: 我没把好东西摆出来。你要是有兴趣，我可以向你展示一下锁柜里的东西。

original: I hunt for my own food.
translation: 我在废土上猎取食物。

original: Ah, a true Wasteland warrior. Still, you should stop by my Galley in the market and try a Mirelurk cake. I'm sure you'll love it.
translation: 啊，真正的废土战士。不过你还是应当去我的加里厨房坐坐，尝尝泥沼蟹饼。我保你会喜欢。

original: I am getting a bit hungry.
translation: 我有点饿了。
