original: Perfect timing then! My Galley is in the market, at the far end. I'll save you some Mirelurk Cakes.
translation: 那就刚刚好！我的加里厨房在市场里，尽头的那家就是。我会给你留一些泥沼蟹饼。

original: How do I know your slop is even edible?
translation: 我怎么知道你这泔水能不能吃？

original: Why you...
translation: 你怎么……

original: ...I mean, of course it's edible.
translation: ……我是说，当然可以。

original: You should come by and try the Mirelurk Cakes. They're my specialty.
translation: 你下次路过，应该尝尝泥沼蟹饼，那是我们的拿手菜。

original: So what happened to Project Purity?
translation: 净水工程出了什么问题？

original: In the year before you were born, things became difficult.
translation: 在你出生之前，事情就变复杂了。

original: There had always been something of a "mutant problem" in the city, but it became worse. They attacked more frequently, and more aggressively.
translation: 出现了“变种人问题”，而且越来越糟，他们频繁地发动攻击，更具侵略性。

original: Support for the project eroded as time went on, when we couldn't produce any significant results. Progress came to a halt. And then you were born.
translation: 随着时间流逝，当我们做不出有意义的成果时，对这计划的援助也发生了改变。进度终止，然后你出生了。

original: Your mother and I had talked about what to do when that time came, but then I... We lost her, and I had to make a decision. I chose to leave.
translation: 你母亲和我商量过，当那刻到来，我们要做些什么，不过我……我们失去了她，而我不得不做决定。我选择了离开。

original: From what I understand, things happened quickly after that. It became too dangerous for the others to stay, and so the project was abandoned.
translation: 就我所知，那之后的事发展得太快，对于其他人来说，变得太危险，而我不能留下，因此这工程被丢弃了。

original: Doctor Li and her team left for what became Rivet City, and Project Purity has sat waiting ever since.
translation: 李博士和她的团队组建了铆钉城，从那开始，净水工程一直被搁置着。

original: How did mom really die?
translation: 妈妈真正的死因是什么？

original: I understand that you have reason to question a good many things I've told you over the years.
translation: 我明白，你有理由怀疑我过去这些年跟你讲的那些事。

original: But your mother... I've never lied to you about what happened. Not once.
translation: 但关于你妈妈……在她身上发生的事，我从没向你撒过谎，一次也没。

original: She died giving birth to you. It was a difficult time... She was so eager to meet you, to make a place for you in the world.
translation: 她死了，却给了你生命。那是艰难的时期……她是多么渴望亲眼见到你出世，她为此付出了一切。

original: If nothing else, please believe that she loved you very much.
translation: 如果没别的，请相信她非常爱你。

original: What's the big deal about water, anyway?
translation: 关于水的大事指的是什么？

original: The Vault you grew up in had its own water purification system. Clean water was never a worry. Out here, things are different.
translation: 你从小在那长大的避难所有独立的水净化系统，永远不愁没有净水。而这里，情况就大不一样。

original: Water out here is never clean, and almost always irradiated. It's barely able to sustain any kind of normal life.
translation: 这的水从没干净过，差不多都被辐射过。这的水几乎不能维持任何生命。

original: If we can change that, humanity has a real chance at rebuilding. Starting over.
translation: 如果我们能改变这一点，人类才有真正的机会重建，一切从头开始。

original: What exactly is this "Project Purity"?
translation: “净水工程”确切的说是什么？

original: It started as an idea, really. Remember the Bible passage your mother loved so much?
translation: 它开始是一个理想，真的。还记得《圣经》中你妈妈最喜爱的话吗？

original: Free, clean water for everyone. What a difference it could make in the lives of everyone here in the Wastes.
translation: 每个人都能喝上免费、干净的水。多么的不可思议，它能够影响这蛮荒世界中每个人的命运。

original: Over time, that idea took the form of a purifier. Not like the one in the Vault, though.
translation: 随着时间推移，理想终成现实，虽然它和避难所的有所不同。

original: This one was gigantic, capable of purifying millions of gallons of water at once.
translation: 这是一个庞然大物，能够瞬时提纯数百万加仑的水。

original: We used the old Jefferson Memorial for the location, right on DC's Tidal Basin. Someday soon, I hope you'll see it work.
translation: 我们把它建在老杰斐逊纪念馆，正好在特区的潮汐盆地。有朝一日，我希望你会看到它运作。

original: Where can I find the fuse box?
translation: 我能在哪找到保险箱？

original: Head back downstairs. The one you're looking for is underneath the mainframe room, I think.
translation: 回到楼下，我想你要找的就在主机下面。

original: Right, because I'm supposed to know exactly what you're talking about.
translation: 没错，因为我很明白你在说什么。

original: Where are the flood control pumps?
translation: 水泵在哪？

original: Dad's got you doing the dirty work, huh? Well, good for you. Doesn't hurt to get your hands dirty.
translation: 爸爸让你干了脏活，呃？不错，好样的。要是弄脏了你的手别难过。

original: You'll find the pumps down in the sub-basement. It's one level below where we are now.
translation: 在地下室的第二层你会找到这些水泵，就在现在位置的下层。

original: Just look for the big switch on the wall. Throw that, and the pumps'll fire right up.
translation: 只要找到墙上的开关，扳动它，这些水泵就会开始正常运作。

original: You're kidding me, right?
translation: 你和我开玩笑吗，对吗？

original: Ugh. They're downstairs in the sub-basement. You want me to hold your hand while you look for them?
translation: 呃，它们在地下室二层。你要我手把手教你找吗？

original: Aaaaaaahh!
They just burst in, and James locked the door. Why would he lock me out? What does he think he's doing?
translation: 他们正要冲进来，詹姆斯锁上了门。他为什么要把我们锁在外边？他想做什么？

original: I'm meeting him here.
translation: 我在这等他。

original: You are? Then... he's coming back? After our last conversation, I didn't think he would.
translation: 你？那么……他要来这？自从我们上次见面后，我以为他不会再来了。

original: I already found my father, but thanks. He's on his way here.
translation: 我已经找到了我父亲，不过谢谢。他正在来这的路上。

original: He is? I didn't... I didn't think I'd be seeing him again. Not quite so soon, at any rate.
translation: 他？我……我以为我再也见不到他了。至少是很难见到。

original: Another do-gooder? No matter! My plans can wait for now, Mechanist!
translation: 又一个好人？没关系！我的计划可以等等，机械侠！

original: What's this? A new minion? We'll settle this another day, AntAgonizer!
translation: 这是什么？新奴才？我们改天再解决，痛苦蚁后！

original: I've got some stuff that needs repairs.
translation: 我要修理一下东西。

original: Let me take a look.
translation: 让我看看。

original: No problem, as long as you're good for it.
translation: 没问题，只要你付得起。

original: Sure, I can fix most anything. Let me see what you've got.
translation: 当然，大多数东西我都能修。让我看看你要修什么。

original: Just say the word and it's all over. Course then we'd have to skin you alive and eat your liver.
translation: 说出来吧，就可以了结了。因为我们然后会剥你的皮，吃你的肉。

original: Pain! Pain is your only friend!
translation: 痛苦！痛苦是你唯一的朋友！

original: Don't flinch, you coward!
translation: 别跑，你这胆小鬼！

original: Are you gonna cry? Come on, cry for me!
translation: 你要求饶吗？来啊，向我哭泣！

original: You think you're good enough to run with us?
translation: 你觉得你跑得赢我们吗？

original: That's right. Love the pain! Embrace the pain!
translation: 很好。爱上痛苦！享受痛苦！

original: Pain is your friend.
translation: 痛苦是你的朋友。

original: Is that your son running around here?
translation: 那游手好闲的孩子是你儿子？

original: Yeah. That's James. My own little trouble making brat.
translation: 是的，那时詹姆斯，我的小捣蛋鬼。

original: I'd sell him to you if they'd let me.
translation: 他们要是答应，我愿意把他卖给你。

original: Unless you've got any more personal questions, I'm busy.
translation: 你还有什么问题，我很忙。

original: You don't have to be such a bitch...
translation: 你没必要这么自暴自弃.

original: Oh really? My husband ran off and got himself killed, and left me to raise his little brat. So don't you tell me how I should or shouldn't be.
translation: 哦，真的吗？我丈夫跑了，被杀了，留下我喂养他的小屁孩。所以我该怎么做或不该怎么做都不用你教。

original: You're a fool to pass up a chance at love with Angela.
translation: 你这笨蛋，你错过了和安吉拉恋爱的机会。

original: Father Clifford says she is my trial. My temptation.
translation: 克利福德神父说她是我的考验，我的诱惑。

original: I must chose between her and the Church. I have chosen the Church.
translation: 我必须在她和教堂之间做出选择，我选了教堂。

original: Men are such pigs. Forget him.
translation: 男人都是猪，忘了他吧。

original: You're right. I should. But I can't.
translation: 你是对的，我应该这么做，但我做不到。

original: Do the men on this ship give you much trouble?
translation: 这艘船上的男人有没有找过你麻烦？

original: You mean like hitting on me?
translation: 你的意思是说朝我调情？

original: No. Most of them are polite. Even the ones like Diego that I'd want to flirt with seem to ignore me.
translation: 没有，他们大多彬彬有礼。即使像迭戈这样令我心仪的人，对我也是视而不见。

original: There are no bad children. Only bad parents.
translation: 没有坏小孩，只有坏父母。

original: What a load of crap. Obviously you've never had to take care of some squealing little brat.
translation: 废话连篇，明显你从没照看过吵闹的小屁孩。

original: What?! No!
translation: 什么？！不！

original: Now that I have your suit, I'd say you don't have a chance at all. Time to die.
translation: 既然我有了你的套装，我想说你根本没有机会了。受死吧。

original: A likely story! But perhaps you're telling the truth. Go on...
translation: 有趣的故事！但或许你说的是事实，继续……

original: Wait! I'm not a secret agent! I'm here to help!
translation: 等等！我不是间谍！我是来这帮忙的！

original: A likely story! But perhaps you're telling the truth. Go on...
translation: 有趣的故事！但或许你说的是事实，继续……

original: Wait! I'm not a secret agent! I'm here to help!
translation: 等等！我不是间谍！我是来这帮忙的！

original: Thank you. I don't know how I can...
translation: 谢谢你，我不知道我能怎样……

original: Just... thank you.
translation: 真的……谢谢你。

original: Certainly. Good luck in your new life.
translation: 当然，祝你的新生活一帆风顺。

original: Your mind-games won't work with me, ant-spawn!
translation: 你别和我耍花招，蚁卵！

original: Now that I've unmasked you, it's time to put an end to your lies and treachery! Percival, attack!
translation: 既然我揭穿了你的假面具，是时候对你的谎言和背叛做个了结了！珀西瓦尔，攻击！

original: You really have lost your mind, haven't you?
translation: 你真的失去理智了，不是吗？

original: Your mind-games won't work with me, ant-spawn!
translation: 你别和我耍花招，蚁卵！

original: Now that I've unmasked you, it's time to put an end to your lies and treachery! Percival, attack!
translation: 既然我揭穿了你的假面具，是时候对你的谎言和背叛做个了结了！珀西瓦尔，攻击！

original: You really have lost your mind, haven't you?
translation: 你真的失去理智了，不是吗？

original: That's enough about them.
translation: 他们的事到此为止。

original: I most heartily agree!
translation: 我衷心表示同意！

original: Well, okay.
translation: 嗯，好的。

original: Fine by me.
translation: 我没问题。

original: Do you know anything about the AntAgonizer or the Mechanist?
translation: 你知道任何关于痛苦蚁后或机械侠的事吗？

original: If it'll help, I'm glad to.
translation: 如果有帮助，我很乐意。

original: Can I ask you more about the AntAgonizer and the Mechanist?
translation: 我可以问你更多关于蚁后和机械侠的事吗？

original: You mean the super-heroes? Yeah, I try to watch all of their fights!
translation: 你的意思是这些超级英雄？是的，我看了他们所有的战斗。

original: What do you know about the AntAgonizer and the Mechanist?
translation: 关于蚁后和机械侠，你都知道些什么？

original: Roe hired you put a stop to their shit, did he? Guess he finally listened when I told him I haven't got the time to do it myself.
translation: 是洛易雇你来了结他俩的，对吧？我想他最终还是把我的话听进去了，我没时间亲自搞定这些家伙。

original: It's easy enough to hide inside when those two square off, but they're only getting worse about it all.
translation: 当那两方准备互相攻击时，很容易混进去，但他们都越来越糟了。

original: What do you know about the AntAgonizer and the Mechanist?
translation: 关于蚁后和机械侠，你都知道些什么？

original: What do you want to know about them?
translation: 关于他们你想知道些什么？

original: What do you know about the AntAgonizer and the Mechanist?
translation: 关于蚁后和机械侠，你都知道些什么？

original: You mean, apart from having cheesy names? Actually, I think I might know something useful.
translation: 你的意思是，除了有低贱的名字之外？事实上，我想我可能知道一些有用的事。

original: One of the traders told me she sounded like a girl he used to know. Girl's whole family was wiped out by ants, not long before she showed up here.
translation: 一个商人告诉我，她说话的声音像他过去认识的一个女孩。那女孩全家被蚂蚁洗劫了。不久以后她就这出现了。

original: But they never found any trace of her body. Said her name was "Tanya Christoff." That might just be our little AntAgonizer.
translation: 但他们没找到她的尸体。据说她的名字叫“塔尼娅·克里斯托弗”。她很可能就是我们的小痛苦蚁后。

original: I know Dom doesn't want me just killing them. He and the Mechanist used to be friends or something.
translation: 我知道多姆要我别插手，他曾和这机械侠是朋友什么的。

original: All I know is next time they come to town, I bet I could solve the whole problem with one bullet for each of them.
translation: 我所知道的是，下次他们来镇子，我打赌我能够给他们双方一人一颗子弹，问题就解决了。

original: I sure am. Two hundred caps, if you can find where the AntAgonizer and the Mechanist hide, and get them to end their pointless fighting in town.
translation: 我确信。你要是能找到痛苦蚁后和机械侠的藏身处，让他们终止在镇子里无意义的战斗，200瓶盖就是你的了。

original: You only need to stop one of them, really. Nowadays, I think they only stay in Canterbury to fight each other. So, what do you say?
translation: 你只需要阻止他们中的一个，真的。现在，我想他们只会待在坎特伯雷互相残杀。你觉得怎么样？

original: You still offering that job?
translation: 你还提供那份工作吗？

original: Excellent! Without him, the AntAgonizer should be on her way, and Canterbury Commons is safe again! Relatively speaking, of course.
translation: 非常好！没了他，痛苦蚁后该走了，坎特伯雷社区再次安全！当然是相对来说。

original: Now, I do believe this is our agreed upon payment for your fine services rendered. Thank you, once again!
translation: 我真的觉得我们给你的报偿是值得的。再一次谢谢你！

original: I took care of the Mechanist. There won't be any more fighting in the streets.
translation: 我解决了机械侠的问题。街道上不会再有打斗了。

original: Excellent! Without her, the Mechanist should be on his way, and Canterbury Commons is safe again! Relatively speaking, of course.
translation: 非常好！没了她，机械侠该走了，坎特伯雷社区再次安全！当然是相对来说。

original: Now, I do believe this is our agreed upon payment for your fine services rendered. Thank you, once again!
translation: 我真的觉得我们给你的报偿是值得的。再一次谢谢你！

original: I took care of the AntAgonizer. There won't be any more fighting in the streets.
translation: 我解决了痛苦蚁后的问题。街道上不会再有打斗了。

original: That's grand! I do believe it's fair to say you've saved Canterbury. And unlike that Mechanist, you did so with significantly less stress all around!
translation: 好极了！准确的说，我确实认为你拯救了坎特伯雷。与机械侠不同，你让大家都解脱了！

original: Now, I do believe this is our agreed upon payment for your fine services rendered. And a little bonus, as a special thank-you!
translation: 我真的觉得我们给你的报偿是值得的。一点额外奖励，作为对你特别的感谢！

original: I took care of both of them. There won't be any more fighting in the streets.
translation: 我把他们两个都解决了。街道上不会再有打斗了。

original: First you took away my uncle, and now you took away them, too? Fine - here! Take it and go away forever!
translation: 你先是赶走了我叔叔，你现在也赶走了他们？很好 — 给你！带走，永远别回来！

original: He promised me money for a job. Pay up, or else.
translation: 他答应过付我钱的。快给钱，否则别怪我不客气。

original: Yeah, he told me. I wish you didn't have to make the super heroes go away, but I guess Uncle Roe knew what the town needed.
translation: 是的，他跟我说过。我希望你不要把这些超级英雄赶跑了，但我猜罗伊大叔为了镇子不会同意我这么想。

original: He told me to pay you for the work. He always did say, "Money comes and goes, but a contract's forever." At least the town's safe, now.
translation: 他跟我说过支付你报酬。他总是说，“千金散去还复来”，至少眼下镇子是安全了。

original: I just finished a job for your late uncle. I hope he told you to pay me.
translation: 我帮你叔叔完成了工作。但愿他告诉过你要付我钱。

original: Got anything else?
translation: 找到别的东西没？

original: Sorry, we need every piece of equipment we've got. I can spare the gun and the armor, but that's about it.
translation: 抱歉，我们需要我们所有的装备。我能分配枪支和装甲，但仅此而已。

original: The Minigun is more my speed.
translation: 有了这把转轮机枪，我的攻击更快。

original: You got it. Use it well, and take down some more Muties with it for us.
translation: 你说对了。好好用它，用它为我们干掉更多的变种人。

original: Consider this place your home away from home. If you're ever in the neighborhood again, you're more than welcome to take shelter here.
translation: 把这当你自己的家。你以后要是经过附近，我们将非常欢迎你到这来。

original: I guess that does it. See you 'round, kid.
translation: 就这样，回见，孩子。

original: I'll go for the armor.
translation: 我选装甲。

original: The armor it is. Wear it with pride, kid. We do.
translation: 这是你的装甲，自豪地穿上它吧，孩子。我们都是如此。

original: Consider this place your home away from home. If you're ever in the neighborhood again, you're more than welcome to take shelter here.
translation: 把这当你自己的家。你以后要是经过附近，我们将非常欢迎你到这来。

original: I guess that does it. See you 'round, kid.
translation: 就这样，回见，孩子。

original: Where can I get some more ammo around here?
translation: 我能在哪搞到更多弹药？

original: Well, if you've picked the Mutie corpses clean, there isn't much else to scrounge.
translation: 哦，你要是把变种人的尸体都搜遍了，那就没有其他地方可以找了。

original: I dunno if you came across it or not, but one of our guys dropped on the second floor stairwell. He had an ammo crate with him.
translation: 我不知道你有没经过二楼的楼梯间，我们一个兄弟掉到了那里。他身上有一个弹药箱。

original: Gonna have to get the code from Butcher though.
translation: 得去找布彻要密码。

original: On our way to the roof, one of our guys got scragged. Poor son-of-a-bitch get blown apart by a frag.
translation: 我们去楼顶的路上，一个兄弟挂了。可怜的家伙被手榴弹炸开了花。

original: I think he went down on the second floor stairwell of this place. You find him, and you'll find his ammo crate.
translation: 我想他掉到了二楼楼梯间。你找到他，就会找到弹药箱。

original: Ask Butcher for the code though. We lock that stuff so the Muties can't steal what's inside.
translation: 去找布彻要密码。我们给它上了锁以防变种人来偷。

original: We lost a good man on the retreat to this godforsaken roof. Theo. Newest guy in the group too.
translation: 我们撤到这荒凉的楼顶上时，失去了个好同伴。西奥，最近加入队伍的新兵。

original: He got killed on the second floor stairwell of the hotel. He was carrying our ammo supply with him.
translation: 他死在旅馆的二楼楼梯间，他随身带着我们的弹药补给。

original: Here, let me give you the code. The more ammo we have the better!
translation: 给你密码。弹药越多越好！

original: Let me ask you about something else.
translation: 我来问点其他事情吧。

original: Okay, go ahead.
translation: 好的，去吧。

original: Got anything for these injuries?
translation: 有东西治疗这伤吗？

original: Yeah, here you go. It's all I've got.
translation: 是的，给你。我只有这些了。

original: Sorry. I only had one Stimpak to spare. Hang in there.
translation: 抱歉，我只有一个治疗针，坚持住。

original: Injuries? You look fine to me.
translation: 受伤？依我看你很好。

original: I've been thinking about getting into the trade. You need a dog catcher?
translation: 我想过了要进行这项交易。你需要捕狗夹子吗？

original: Hmm... Eulogy's pretty picky about who gets on the Paradise Falls crew, and the interview process is pretty damn painful.
translation: 唔…对于新加入堕落天堂的成员，面试过程相当挑剔，而且也他妈的相当痛苦。

original: But maybe we can work out a mutually beneficial arrangement, just the two of us. You think you got what it takes?
translation: 不过或许我们能达成互惠互利的协议，就我们。你想得到什么？

original: Can you give me a haircut?
translation: 你能给我理理发吗？

original: The damned G.O.A.T. said I'm supposed to be a hairdresser, but that ain't me!
translation: 该死的G.O.A.T.说我该做个理发师，我才不要呢！

original: I'm a barber, you got that? There's a difference!
translation: 我应该是理发师，你明白吗？这有区别！

original: Butch, what do you do in the Vault?
translation: 布奇，你在避难所里干哪一行？

original: Sure, fine, whatever.
translation: 当然可以。随便。

original: I'm gonna barber the hell outta that hair!
translation: 我他妈要当理发师！

original: Okay, hold still.
translation: 好吧，别动。

original: Sure, fine, whatever.
translation: 当然可以。随便。

original: I'm gonna barber the hell outta your hair!
translation: 我他妈要当理发师！

original: Okay, hold still.
translation: 好吧，别动。

original: HAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: FATHER! NO!
translation: 父亲！不！

original: Why did you kill that bartender?
translation: 你为什么要杀酒保？

original: He put water in my vodka to make more caps from me. Make the drink weak and try to charge me more!
translation: 他往我的伏特加里掺水，想骗我花更多瓶盖。在酒里掺水好收我更多钱！

original: Maybe the next bartender, he won't be so stupid, eh? HAHAHAHAHAHA!
translation: 或许下个酒保不会像他这么蠢，呃？哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Well, you're dead meat now. Give me all your stuff.
translation: 你现在是死人了。把你所有的东西给我。

original: You'll have to kill us first. Go ahead. Shoot me. I dare you.
translation: 你会先杀死我们。来吧，向我开火，我谅你也不敢。

original: What is Underworld?
translation: 地下城是什么？

original: It's a city of Ghouls. It's the only place in the Wasteland that belongs to our kind.
translation: 是僵尸之城，废土仅有的属于我们的地方。

original: It's hidden inside the Museum of History.
translation: 它隐藏在历史博物馆里。

original: What are you doing wandering around out here?
translation: 你们在附近绕来绕去干嘛？

original: We were on our way to Underworld, but we couldn't make it past the Super Mutants.
translation: 我们正结伴去地下城，但我们没办法通过超级变种人肆虐的地区。

original: So now we're just going to find our own place in the Wasteland.
translation: 所以我们在废土寻找自己的地方。

original: There's a locked door up ahead. I can open it, but it'll take some time.
translation: 前面有个门上了锁，我能打开，但要花点时间。

original: Vampires can drink any kind of human blood... even from bloodpacks.
translation: 血族能喝任何种类的人血……甚至是血浆袋。

original: Curious. Many years ago, I survived by drinking from fresh bloodpacks I recovered from hospital ruins.
translation: 有意思。许多年前，我喝了从医院废墟里找到的新鲜血浆袋活了下来。

original: The problem was that these bloodpacks were scarce.
translation: 问题是这些血浆袋很稀少。

original: What do you propose?
translation: 你的想法是什么？

original: Let me see your Chems.
translation: 让我看看你的药品。

original: Yeah, I got some stuff around here. But it'll cost you.
translation: 是的，我在这附近找到了一些东西，但得花掉你不少钱。

original: You know where I can buy some chems around here?
translation: 你知道这附近哪能买到药品？

original: Hey, it's your body, do what you want to it.
translation: 嗨，这是你的身体，让它听你的。

original: If you're planning on overdosing, just make sure you pay me first.
translation: 你要是打算多配点药，你首先得确信你付的起。

original: Trade up front. No exceptions. Especially not for junkies.
translation: 先付费，没有例外，尤其不为瘾君子开绿灯。

original: They will run out of time soon. Then they bleed.
translation: 他们很快就会完蛋。流血而亡。

original: Rangers will pay for all those they kill!
translation: 游骑兵将为他们杀死的人付出代价！

original: Don't take prisoners! Kill them all!
translation: 别留活口！全部干掉！

original: None of them will leave here alive.
translation: 他们没人能活着离开。

original: One of them get by us... make it all the way to melted human town.
translation: 他们中的一个溜了……向人类城镇方向跑了。

original: They have guns... but we have guns too. Soon we can take roof.
translation: 他们有枪……但我们也有，很快我就能拿下顶顶。

original: They very powerful. Kill many of us.
translation: 他们非常强。干掉了我们许多人。

original: Right on. Thanks.
translation: 好极了，谢谢。

original: If it keeps you happy and your gun in your holster, then it's well worth it to me.
translation: 它要是让你开心，就别拿枪指着我，那对我来说就是值了。

original: Anytime, man. Any time at all.
translation: 老兄，随时都行。

original: No problem at all.
translation: 完全没问题。

original: Hey, thanks. Keep it coming.
translation: 嗨，谢谢，以后常来。

original: If it keeps you happy and your gun in your holster, then it's well worth it to me.
translation: 它要是让你开心，就别拿枪指着我，那对我来说就是值了。

original: Anytime, man. Any time at all.
translation: 老兄，随时都行。

original: Sure will. Sure will...
translation: 一定，一定……

original: If it means that much to you, I'll take it.
translation: 如果这对你很重要的话，我接受。

original: You're an example to us all.
translation: 你是我们的楷模！

original: It does. Thank you.
translation: 的确是的，谢谢你。

original: Please, keep doing what you do.
translation: 加油，再接再励。

original: Certainly. Thank you.
translation: 当然，谢谢你。

original: Bless you.
translation: 上帝保佑你。

original: No. Thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢你。

original: Certainly. It's the least I could do after all you've done.
translation: 当然，毕竟你做了那么多，这是我能尽的最大心意了。

original: Okay, let's get this over with. Cycle the airlock, will you?
translation: 好吧，让我们做完，打开气密门，好吗？

original: I can't get in there until you cycle the airlock. Go hit the button.
translation: 除非你打开气密门，不然我进不去。去按按钮。

original: You have to cycle the airlock before I can get to the control panel. Hurry up!
translation: 在我能进入控制面板之前，你必须打开气密门，赶快！

original: All right! Now that's what I'm talking about!
translation: 好吧！这才是我接下来要说的！

original: Really? Wow, tell me all about it? Did you get blown up?
translation: 真的？哇哦，告诉我一切？你被炸了吗？

original: No need to bother testing this. I've already been to Minefield.
translation: 不需要为测试烦心了，我已经去过雷区了。

original: I guess you've been around a bit! So, tell me about what you found!
translation: 我想你看过周围了！告诉我你的发现！

original: No need to test that theory. I've already found food and medicine there.
translation: 不需要测试那个理论了，我已经在那儿找到了食物和药品。

original: I guess you've been around a bit! So, tell me about what you found!
translation: 我想你看过周围了！告诉我你的发现！

original: No need to test that theory. I've only found food there.
translation: 不需要测试那个理论了，我在那儿只找到了食物。

original: Tenpenny is dead. I watched his brains splatter. <Lie.>
translation: 特佩尼死了，我看着他脑浆四溅。<撒谎。>

original: Don't lie to me. The whole wasteland would be talking about it if Tenpenny died.
translation: 别骗我，特佩尼要是死了，整个废土都会炸开锅。

original: Come back when you've done it right.
translation: 搞定这事再回来。

original: You're right. Why bother with a trophy of one pitiful human, when I can go forth and make a trophy of the entire world!
translation: 你是对的，我要是能征服世界，何必还要为一个可怜的人类费心！

original: But when the time comes, remember: as a friend of the Ant Queen's court, you will know the mercy of a quick, painless death.
translation: 不过记住，当这一天来临，作为蚁后膝下的朋友，你会明白真正的怜悯和无痛的死亡。

original: Now, leave me. I must prepare to leave the pitiful town of Canterbury and plan for greater conquests.
translation: 你走吧，我必须准备离开这可怜的坎特伯雷镇，谋划更伟大的征服计划。

original: Don't waste your time with this suit. It isn't worthy of your attention.
translation: 别在这套装上浪费时间，它不值得你操心。

original: Were it in any other hands, I would worry. But I know I can trust you, my faithful sidekick.
translation: 不管怎么讲，我都会着急。但我知道我可以相信你，我忠实的朋友。

original: Now, I must return to tending my robots. Canterbury may be safe, but I must now look to the rest of the Wasteland.
translation: 我要回去维护我的机器人了。坎特伯雷可能暂时安全，不过我还要照看废土其他地方。

original: The AntAgonizer may be gone, but if the world is ever threatened again, the Mechanist must be ready!
translation: 痛苦蚁后可能走了，但这世界要是再受到威胁，机械侠随时候命！

original: You don't need to worry about this suit. There are other threats out there.
translation: 你无须担心这套装。这有其他的威胁。

original: You raise an excellent point, good citizen! It would only slow down my reckless assault upon evil!
translation: 你出了个好主意，良民！它只是暂缓了我对邪恶不惜一切代价的攻势！

original: Now, I must return to tending my robots. Canterbury may be safe, but I must now look to the rest of the Wasteland.
translation: 我要回去维护我的机器人了。坎特伯雷可能暂时安全，不过我还要照看废土其他地方。

original: The AntAgonizer may be gone, but if the world is ever threatened again, the Mechanist must be ready!
translation: 痛苦蚁后可能走了，但这世界要是再受到威胁，机械侠随时候命！

original: You don't need to worry about this suit. There are other threats out there.
translation: 你无须担心这套装。这有其他的威胁。

original: Hello? Hello?... Is anyone there? It's Doctor Li. Something's wrong with the purifier... Please, someone answer!
translation: 喂？喂？……有人吗？我是李博士，净化器出了些问题……请回答！

original: Get in the airlock. I'll cycle it for you so you can enter the code.
translation: 进到气密门里去。我会开启它，以便你可以输入密码。

original: You have to get in the airlock before I can cycle it and let you in there.
translation: 在我开启气密门之前，你必须进到气密门里去。

original: We're running out of time! You need to get in that airlock now!
translation: 我们快没时间了！你必须现在就进入气密门！

original: So, you guys looking for new recruits?
translation: 你们是在招募新兵？

original: That's a negative.
translation: 不是。

original: We've got too many local conscripts as it is. Most are undertrained and too damned trigger happy for their own good.
translation: 事实上我们招了太多平民，他们大多没受过训练，而且最该死的是他们自以为是，喜欢乱开枪。

original: Our very own Initiate Reddin is a sterling example.
translation: 我们培训的新兵瑞丁是个真正的标兵。

original: I'm sure.
translation: 我确信。

original: You can handle yourself, I'll give you that.
translation: 你能管好自己，我就给你。

original: But let's not get carried away.
translation: 但别失去自制力。

original: You sure you're not looking for recruits...
translation: 你确定你们不招募新兵……

original: <yawn> I'm going to bed.
translation: <哈欠>我困了。

original: I suppose it's time to eat.
translation: 我想是时候吃饭了。

original: I'd better get to work.
translation: 我最好开始工作。

original: Time to feed the heifer.
translation: 是时候喂牛了。

original: I'm whupped. I need some shut-eye.
translation: 我太累了，要睡一觉。

original: Better get some grub while there's still some left.
translation: 最好来点吃的，应该还有。

original: I'm tired. <yawn> Time for bed.
translation: 我累了，<哈欠>该睡觉了。

original: I'm starved. I hope there's enough today.
translation: 我饿死了，但愿今天能吃得饱。

original: Well, that stone won't carve itself.
translation: 那石头可不会自己裂开。

original: Time to eat. I have to keep my energy up.
translation: 该吃饭了，我要保持体力充沛。

original: I'm turning in. I need to be sharp tomorrow.
translation: 我要睡了，我明天需要保持清醒。

original: Guess I'd better get some chow.
translation: 我要来点吃的。

original: I'm going to hit the sack.
translation: 我要睡了。

original: Here you go you stupid cow. Don't eat it all at once.
translation: 给你，你这头蠢牛，别全吃光了。

original: Looks safe out there.
translation: 外面看起来很安全。

original: Hmmm.
translation: 嗯。

original: Better have some check that out.
translation: 最好检查一下。

original: Nothing. Good.
translation: 没什么，很好。

original: I'd like to report someone.
translation: 我要举报。

original: Oh, really?
translation: 哦，真的吗？

original: If someone took your stuff, go get it back. If they shoot at you, shoot back.
translation: 有人要是抢你的东西，那就去抢回来。要是有人要是向你开火，那就还击。

original: Otherwise, I've got to see it for myself before I'm gonna do anything.
translation: 否则，在采取行动前，我要检查一下。

original: What do you people do here all day?
translation: 你们这些人整天在这干嘛？

original: We're the lucky ones. We don't have to fight just to survive.
translation: 我们很幸运，不必为了生存而战斗。

original: We have normal jobs. I clean the halls. It might not look like it, but you should have seen it before.
translation: 我们有正常的工作。我清理大厅。看上去可能不像大厅，你之前应该见过。

original: Are you related to Henry Young?
translation: 你和亨利·杨是亲戚吗？

original: Henry's my husband.
translation: 亨利是我丈夫。

original: I have a daughter, C.J. too. You'll see her running around here with James Hargrave.
translation: 我还有个女儿，你会看到她和詹姆斯·哈格雷夫玩在一起。

original: She's my daughter. You can usually find her running around with that James Hargrave.
translation: 她是我女儿，你通常能看见她和詹姆斯·哈格雷夫在一起玩耍。

original: Are you related to C.J.?
translation: 你是长江的亲戚？

original: That's all for now, I guess.
translation: 我想暂时就这样吧。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Nice gun. I've never seen one like that.
translation: 好枪，我从没见过这样的。

original: Yeah, it is nice. I don't even sleep without it under my pillow.
translation: 没错呢。它不在我枕头底下我都睡不着。

original: My father made gun ammunition for a living. Taught me everything about how firearms work.
translation: 我父亲靠制造枪支弹药生活，他还教会了我枪械的工作原理。

original: So, I've spent my downtime tinkering with guns like my 10mm Ultra SMG here. It's like a hobby I guess.
translation: 所以我把休息时间都花在了摆弄枪支上，就像我的这把10毫米极致冲锋枪。我想这是我的业余爱好。

original: You recovered all of that stuff in the Preservation Society's museum?
translation: 保护协会博物馆里的东西都是你找回来的？

original: Oh no. There is more than a lifetime's supply of grade A crap in that place. Couldn't possibly do it alone. Like you, he hires anyone off the street.
translation: 哦，不。那么多的A级废物，一辈子也弄不完。一个人不可能办到。他随便在街上雇人，比如你这样的。

original: Honestly, I don't care what he does with that stuff. As long as the caps keep flowing, I'll be there to collect.
translation: 坦白说，我不关心他用那些东西做什么。只要瓶盖源源不断，我会就去收集。

original: How did you get into the relic hunting business?
translation: 你是怎样开始你的古董猎人生涯的？

original: I dunno. I grew up pretty much like every other girl in this crappy world. Spent most of my life just trying to keep away from Slavers.
translation: 我不知道，我像这残酷世界上的其他女孩一样长大，大部分时间都用来躲避奴隶贩子。

original: One day out in the Wastes, I stumbled across some poor bastard's body. On the body I found info leading to some famous document.
translation: 有天我在废土上见到一具可怜的无名尸，在尸体上我找到了一些信息，顺着这信息找到了一些著名的文件。

original: I had heard that Abraham Washington was looking for these scraps of paper, so I went after the thing. Turned out to be the Constitution.
translation: 我听说过亚伯拉罕·华盛顿在寻找这些破纸，我再一打听，发现这些居然就是宪法。

original: After he loaded me up with caps, I got piss drunk, got laid and was happy for the first time in a while. I haven't looked back since.
translation: 他给我瓶盖之后，我就去买醉了，直到喝趴下，我好久都没那么开心了。此后我再也没回过头。

original: Since we're done now, why don't you tell me about yourself?
translation: 我们说完了，你为什么不谈谈自己？

original: Ha, I'm surprised that you care. Usually everyone looks out for themselves nowadays.
translation: 呵，我很惊讶你会关心我。现在通常人们只关心他们自己。

original: What is it you wanna know?
translation: 你想知道什么？

original: My dearest Little Moonbeam. I know you've been waiting to hear what happened to me.
translation: 我最亲爱的“小月光”，我知道你在等着我的消息。

original: I'm sorry I left you like I did. An important deal came up... one that might have let us to get away from that shack we were living in.
translation: 我很抱歉离开了你。我要做一项重要交易……一项可能让我们摆脱苦日子的交易。

original: I came to the Statesman Hotel to meet the buyer and the deal went bad. We shot each other, and now I think I'm dying.
translation: 我跑到政要酒店会见买主，可买卖谈砸了。我们相互射击，现在我想我快要死了。

original: I won't make it out of this place... the ruins are crawling with Super Mutants. All I can do is record this and then hide up in one of the rooms.
translation: 我逃不了……这些废墟遍地都是超级变种人。我所能做就是进行记录，然后找个房间躲起来。

original: You're a strong girl and I know you can use everything I taught you to survive alone.
translation: 你是个坚强的女孩，我知道你可以用我教你的本事活下去。

original: Please forgive me, sweetie. I only wanted to make the best for us. Daddy loves you very much. Goodbye.
translation: 请原谅我，宝贝，我只是想要我们过得好一点。爸爸非常爱你，再见。

original: So, whatever happened to your father?
translation: 你父亲究竟发生了什么？

original: What?!
translation: 什么？！

original: Oh...my god. That's his voice. It's really him!
translation: 哦……天啊，是他的声音，真的是他！

original: I can't believe you brought this to me. I don't know what to say but thank you.
translation: 我不敢相信你给我带来了这，我不知道说什么好，但谢谢你。

original: Wait! Here, take my 10mm Ultra SMG. It's never let me down. Besides, I won't really need it anymore.
translation: 等等！给，拿上我的10毫米极致冲锋枪。它从没让我失望过。而且，我不再需要它了。

original: Sydney, I found a note from your father. He didn't abandon you.
translation: 希妮，我拿到了你父亲的记录，他没有离弃你。

original: I thought he was the best. My mom was long gone, so all we had was each other. He used to call me his "little moonbeam." How sappy is that?
translation: 我认为是他世上最优秀的人。我妈妈很早就走了，所以我们只能相依为命。他以前管我叫他的“小月光”，很温情吧？

original: But when I was 14, he vanished and left me all alone. Never even said goodbye. I cried for a week.
translation: 不过我14岁时，他失踪了，丢下我一个人，连个招呼都没打。我哭了一星期。

original: Do I have to tell you what it's like for a young woman alone in the Wasteland at that age?
translation: 废土上，对一个像我那个年纪的女孩来说，要是碰到这种事，她会成个什么样？

original: I don't know where he went, and I don't care. I just hope he got what he deserved, the son-of-a-bitch!
translation: 我不知道他去了哪，我也不在乎。我只是希望他得到报应，这杂种！

original: What happened to your father?
translation: 你父亲发生了什么？

original: Sorry. There's some things I still want to keep to myself. Maybe when I get to trust you better.
translation: 抱歉，有些事是我的隐私，可能我更信任你时会告诉你。

original: Nice gun. I've never seen one like that.
translation: 好枪，我从没见过这样的好枪。

original: Yeah, it is nice. I don't even sleep without it under my pillow.
translation: 没错呢。它不在我枕头底下我都睡不着。

original: My father made gun ammunition for a living. Taught me everything about how firearms work.
translation: 我父亲靠制造枪支弹药生活，他还教会了我枪械的工作原理。

original: So, I've spent my downtime tinkering with guns like my 10mm Ultra SMG here. It's like a hobby I guess.
translation: 所以我把休息时间都花在了摆弄枪支上，就像我的这把10毫米极致冲锋枪。我想这是我的业余爱好。

original: Lock 'n load... they'll be here any second!
translation: 握紧枪、上好膛……他们随时会来！

original: Hang tight... there's always a second wave!
translation: 坚持住……总有第二波攻势！

original: Nah, I was just kidding.
translation: 不，我在开玩笑。

original: Well that's just plain rude. I would hope you'd be kinder to an old man just trying to serve his nation!
translation: 真粗鲁。我希望你多理解一下一个想为国效力的老人！

original: But, since you brought it up...
translation: 但是，既然你提到了……

original: Yes... but I had a little help from Sydney. She didn't make it, though.
translation: 是的……但西德尼给过我一些帮助。不过她没能活下来。

original: By bringing this to me, do you realize you've both just written yourselves into the history books?
translation: 你意识到了吗，把这给我，意味你们将自己载入了史册？

original: You're both true American heroes and will be remembered for this glorious day!
translation: 你们都是真正的美利坚英雄，这荣耀的一天会永远被后世铭记！

original: Sydney's name will forever be memorialized for her great sacrifice. She was a patriot and will be missed.
translation: 因为她的牺牲，希妮这个名字将永远被铭记。她是爱国者，会被后人缅怀。

original: But enough of that. Allow me to present you with some sort of compensation for your deed.
translation: 不多说了。请允许我为你的行为赠予一些报酬。

original: Yes... but I had a little help from Sydney.
translation: 是的……但西德尼给过我一些帮助。

original: By bringing this to me, do you realize you've both just written yourselves into the history books?
translation: 你意识到了吗，把这给我，意味你们将自己载入了史册？

original: You're both true American heroes and will be remembered for this glorious day!
translation: 你们都是真正的美利坚英雄，这荣耀的一天会永远被后世铭记！

original: But enough of that. Allow me to present you with some sort of compensation for your deed.
translation: 不多说了。请允许我为你的行为赠予一些报酬。

original: I will award Sydney's promised bounty to her personally. No need to worry yourself about that.
translation: 我会按照约定把奖金给希妮的，这你就不必担心了。

original: Yes... I recovered it all by myself.
translation: 是的……我自己找回了它。

original: By bringing this to me, do you realize you've just written yourself into the history books?
translation: 你意识到了吗，把这给我，意味你将自己载入了史册？

original: You're a true American hero and will be remembered for this glorious day!
translation: 你是真正的美利坚英雄，这荣耀的一天会永远被后世铭记！

original: But enough of that. Allow me to present you with some sort of compensation for your deed.
translation: 不多说了。请允许我为你的行为赠予一些报酬。

original: By bringing this to me, do you realize you've just written yourself into the history books?
translation: 你意识到了吗，把这给我，意味你将自己载入了史册？

original: You're a true American hero and will be remembered for this glorious day!
translation: 你是真正的美利坚英雄，这荣耀的一天会永远被后世铭记！

original: But enough of that. Allow me to present you with some sort of compensation for your deed.
translation: 不多说了。请允许我为你的行为赠予一些报酬。

original: Before you continue... I have the Declaration of Independence.
translation: 打断一下……我有《独立宣言》。

original: What? You have the Declaration? Unbelievable!
translation: 什么？你有宣言？难以置信！

original: Are you certain this time? Or is this another joke?
translation: 这次你确定吗？不是又在开玩笑？

original: Really? Oh, how convenient!
translation: 真的吗？哦，太好了！

original: I might just be able to take care of that for you, but first let me do a little examination. How do you feel?
translation: 我马上就帮你治好，但我要先检查一下。你觉得怎么样？

original: I'm already incredibly irradiated. Can't you tell?
translation: 我已经被严重辐射了，你看不出来吗？

original: Really? Oh, how convenient!
translation: 真的吗？哦，太好了！

original: I should be able to take care of that for you, but first let me do a little examination. How do you feel?
translation: 我马上就帮你治好，但我要先检查一下。你觉得怎么样？

original: I'm already a bit irradiated. Check for yourself.
translation: 我已经被轻微辐射了。随便你检查吧。

original: I'm looking for someone named Abraham Washington.
translation: 我在找叫亚伯拉罕·华盛顿的人。

original: He has a "museum" on the Midship Deck called the Capital Preservation Society. Shouldn't be hard to find. Just follow the signs.
translation: 他的“博物馆”在船的中层甲板，名字叫首都保护协会，顺着标牌不难找到。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Certainly.
translation: 行。

original: The Super Mutants are coming from Vault 87. It's their breeding ground.
translation: 超级变种人都来自87号避难所。那是他们的繁殖地。

original: Vault 87? Where you found the G.E.C.K.? We've never been able to penetrate the radiation surrounding that area...
translation: 87号避难所？你在哪里找到的伊甸园创造器？我们一直没办法穿过那块充满辐射的区域……

original: This information is invaluable! Well done!
translation: 这信息是无价的！干得好！

original: Anything you can tell me about the Super Mutants?
translation: 你能告诉我关于超级变种人的事吗？

original: Would you believe... "no"? It's pathetic, really, considering we've been fighting those abominations for nearly twenty years.
translation: 你相信吗……“不”？可悲啊，我们跟那些鬼玩意战斗了近20年。

original: In all that time, all we've managed to do is contain the threat. Hold them back, so they don't overrun every blasted settlement out here.
translation: 花了这么久，我们也就能勉强控制住威胁。顶住他们，阻止他们泛滥到这里的每个角落。

original: But we don't really "know" anything. Where they're from, why they've infested the D.C. ruins.
translation: 但我们真的是一无所“知”。他们从哪来，他们为什么会在特区废墟大批滋生。

original: And now here we are, holed up in our Citadel. Low on resources, low on troops. It's enough to make an old man so very... tired.
translation: 看看现在，我们躲在大本营里，缺资源、少军队，这些足以让一个老人觉得……身心疲惫。

original: Oh? Have you learned something?
translation: 哦？你打听到了什么？

original: Elder Lyons, we should talk about the Super Mutants.
translation: 里昂斯长老，我们该谈谈超级变种人。

original: My child, you seem to have learned more in the past week than I have in twenty years!
translation: 孩子，你过去一周了解到的好像超过我二十年了解到的！

original: Anything more you can tell me about the Super Mutants?
translation: 你能再说些超级变种人的情况吗？

original: What do you know about the Enclave?
translation: 关于英克雷你知道些什么？

original: More than anyone else, I dare say. Certainly enough to know they're the greatest threat the Capital Wasteland has ever faced.
translation: 我敢说没人知道得比我多。当然只要明白他们是首都废土所面对的最大的威胁就够了。

original: The Brotherhood of Steel has encountered the Enclave before, you see. Over thirty years ago, back in California.
translation: 你知道，时间倒退30年，在加利福尼亚，钢铁兄弟会就已经和英克雷打过交道了。

original: Then, they were led by a President Richardson. Now we've got this Eden to contend with.
translation: 他们当时由理查兹总统领导，现在是伊登。

original: It matters not -- now, as before, they seek to control and destroy, all in the guise of restoring order. Your father, I fear, was just the beginning.
translation: 现在也一样，事情没什么变化。他们热衷控制和毁灭，却打着恢复秩序的幌子。恐怕，你父亲只是一个开始。

original: Well don't just stand there gawking, get your ass down here and give me a hand!
translation: 别傻站在那，快他妈下来帮我一把！

original: Up ahead should be the door to the Archives Strongroom. That's where they keep the Declaration.
translation: 前面的门应该通向档案保管室，那是他们保存宣言的地方。

original: According to the plans, the turret generator is somewhere in this room. Disable it, and it should make our lives easier.
translation: 根据设计图，炮塔发电机就在这房间的某个地方。把它毁掉，我们就方便多了。

original: There's all sorts of shortcuts through maintenance doors and utility gates to bypass security if you can get through 'em.
translation: 穿过维护门和维修口，就有捷径避开安保装置，只要你能打开。

original: They kept the Declaration in the Archives Strongroom that's at the end of the East wing here. We'll have to make our way to it.
translation: 他们把宣言放在档案库机要室，也就是东翼的末端，我们要闯过去。

original: This is the long way down to the East Wing. I'd suggest we head back to the Rotunda and take the cargo lift.
translation: 这是去东厅的长路。我建议我们回到圆形大厅，经由货物电梯。

original: I bet you aren't afraid of anything. Would you steal some ammo for me?
translation: 我打赌你天不怕地不怕，愿意帮我偷些弹药来吗？

original: Of course I'm not afraid. I'll take it and he'll never know. I'll have it by tomorrow.
translation: 我当然不怕，我会趁他不注意拿一点的，明天给你。

original: Sure. I pinched this from his table. He never even saw me.
translation: 给，我从他的桌上顺的，他根本没看到我。

original: I can get you some more by tomorrow.
translation: 我明天可以给你更多。

original: Hey, did you ever steal any ammo from Flak and Shrapnel for me?
translation: 嗨，你帮我从“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅那里偷到弹药了吗？

original: Lies! Grognak could never defeat me! He's not even real! Not like the AntAgonizer!
translation: 撒谎！歌南永远不可能打败我！他根本就是虚构的！痛苦蚁后可不一样！

original: I'll have no more of your insolence! Ant royal guards, kill this interloper!
translation: 我不会再忍受你的傲慢！蚂蚁皇家卫兵，干掉这闯入者！

original: From what I read, Grognak totally kicked her ass!
translation: 据我所知歌南完胜了她！

original: You... You really believe that?
translation: 你……你真那么想？

original: When I read that comic, it made explained so much. Where I came from, who I was destined to be, what I had to do...
translation: 当我读到那本漫画，它给了我很多答案，我从哪来，我的命运，我必须做什么……

original: But it never said the AntAgonizer could ever have a chance to go back to being normal. It never said I had a chance...
translation: 但它从没提及，痛苦蚁后可能永远也没有机会回到原来的样子，它没有提到我有机会……

original: Please... I think I've made some terrible mistakes. If you really think I still have a chance, just let me go.
translation: 拜托……我想我犯了些可怕的错。如果你真的觉得我还有机会，让我走吧。

original: I'll give you the suit. No one ever has to see the AntAgonizer again. Just please, let me have another chance.
translation: 我会给你这件套装。没有人会再见到痛苦蚁后。拜托，再给我一个机会。

original: I read that the AntAgonizer was an orphaned girl who could still be redeemed.
translation: 据我所知痛苦蚁后是个孤儿，她仍然值得救赎。

original: What? No! No children's book could possibly capture the true depth of the AntAgonizer!
translation: 什么？不！没有娃娃书能刻画出痛苦蚁后的深邃！

original: You got this "AntAgonizer" idea from a comic, didn't you?
translation: 你从漫画书里得到了装扮成“痛苦蚁后”的灵感，对吗？

original: Tell me about your trade caravan.
translation: 跟我说说你商队的情况。

original: I provide food, drinks, and discreet chemicals to discerning customers around the Wasteland. I help ease the suffering of my fellow man. For a price.
translation: 我为废土识货的顾客提供食物、饮料和有用的化学药品。我帮助人类同胞抚平伤痛，只要他们出得起价。

original: I don't have a home office, exactly, but I organize much of my trade with Ernest Roe, in Canterbury Commons.
translation: 确切说我没有本部，但我在坎特伯雷社区和欧内斯特·罗伊有很多往来。

original: I scour the wasteland for the very best pieces of trash, the height of detritus, and the veritable pick of the litter. It's all valuable to someone.
translation: 我匆匆走遍废土，收集最好的垃圾、最棒的瓦砾、最丰富的废品。总会有人要它们的。

original: And I always make sure to make my rounds through Canterbury Commons. Their mayor, Roe, always has a place for a clever junkman like myself.
translation: 我常去坎特伯雷社区，他们的镇长罗伊总能为像我这样聪明的破烂王提供容身之地。

original: See, the world's a dangerous and unbalanced place. So I realized, the only way to bring peace was to make sure that everyone could be dangerous!
translation: 你知道，这世道既危险，又不公平，所以我发现，唯一能带来和平的方式就是，让每个人都不好惹！

original: So, with a little bit of help from the mayor of Canterbury Commons, I set up this caravan. I can't give the weapons away for free, but I come close!
translation: 所以，在得到了来自坎特伯雷社区镇长的帮助后，我组建了这个商队。我不能免费赠送武器，但我尽量不开高价！

original: My caravan sells clothing and armor, to decorate and protect the body while it endures the ravages of the physical world.
translation: 我的商队贩卖衣服和装甲，用来装饰和保护身体，让你能抵抗物质世界的残酷。

original: My travels take me from Canterbury Commons to where there is true need of this protection. After all, this is what they'll pay the most for.
translation: 我从坎特伯雷社区出发，一直旅行到那些真正需要这些保护的地方。毕竟，人们最愿意为此花大钱。

original: Why did you damage me? You're supposed to be a healing robot!
translation: 你为什么要伤害我？你不是治疗机器人吗！？

original: There has been an error in the medical subsystem. Please run a level two diagnostic.
translation: 医疗系统有些故障。请进行二级诊断。

original: They don't actually... make you fight. Do they?
translation: 他们实际上没……让你参战，是吗？

original: No.
translation: 不。

original: But I could! I know I'm ready! I mean, it would be scary, but... It's not fair that I have to sit inside while the knights go on patrol!
translation: 但我能战斗！我知道我准备好了！我的意思是，肯定很吓人，但……那不公平，战士们去巡逻，我却坐着当看客！

original: I did go out one time, you know! Sarah... Um... Sentinel Lyons took me out. Just to show me. I killed a Super Mutant, too! I swear!
translation: 你看，我确实出去过一次！萨拉……嗯……莎拉·里昂斯带我去的，只是带我转转。我还杀了个超级变种人！我发誓！

original: I, um... I also sort of shot Sarah. But just a little! It was just a flesh wound...
translation: 我，嗯……我也射到了萨拉，但只是擦伤！只是皮肉伤……

original: Aren't you a little young for all this?
translation: 你不觉得自己还是太年轻了吗？

original: Oh, well... You see, I am descended from the great Roger Maxson, founder of our order.
translation: 哦，好吧……你知道，我的祖先是伟大的罗杰·马克松，他是我们组织的奠基人。

original: I am the last of his line. They say my soul was forged from eternal steel, but I don't believe that. I'm really just a normal boy.
translation: 我是他最后的血脉，他们说我的灵魂由永恒的钢铁铸成，但我不信那套，我真的只是个普通男孩。

original: I was sent to the Citadel many years ago, to be fostered by Elder Lyons. But that was before the Western Elders lost, um... faith... in the Elder.
translation: 许多年前我被派到五角大本营，由里昂斯长老抚养。但那是在西部的长老对里昂斯失去……嗯……信心之前。

original: I really don't know if I'll ever get home. But, well... I kind of like it here. Sentinel Lyons has been very kind to me. She's taught me so much.
translation: 我真不知道我还是否还能回家，但……我有点喜欢这里。莎拉·里昂斯对我非常亲切，她教了我许多。

original: What do you make of the Enclave, Squire?
translation: 你了解英克雷吗，侍从？

original: Y... You're asking me what I think of the Enclave?
translation: 你……你问我对英克雷的看法？

original: Well... The Brotherhood of Steel has actually faced the Enclave before. Back West. More than thirty years ago, according to our chronicles.
translation: 嗯……根据我们的编年史，早在30年前，钢铁兄弟会事实上就已经在西部和英克雷打交道了。

original: Judging from those records, I'd say their soldiers are outfitted in Advanced Power Armor Mark II. It's... pretty strong. Better than our Power Armor.
translation: 从那些记录来看，我得说他们的士兵配备了先进的二型动力装甲。它……相当坚固，比我们的动力装甲要好。

original: And some of their technology is amazing! Vertibirds! Plasma weapons that can turn a man to goo!
translation: 他们的一些技术令人称奇！飞鸟！等离子武器能把人变成灰烬！

original: Does... that help?
translation: 那些……有用吗？

original: I don't suppose you know anything about the Super Mutants?
translation: 你知道任何关于超级变种人的事吗？

original: Oh yes! I've studied them quite a bit since I've been here!
translation: 哦，是的！自从我来这后，就一直在研究他们！

original: They're not all the same, you know. Besides the regular ones, there are also Brutes. And after them, the Masters -- they're really tough.
translation: 他们不是千篇一律的，你知道。除了普通的，他们还有一些狂人。他们上面还有霸主……那些真的很强悍。

original: But the worst of all? The Behemoth! He's a giant! I saw one once, outside the Citadel walls. Sooo scary.
translation: 但最恐怖的是谁？超级变种巨人！对，是超级变种巨人！我从前看到过一个，就在大本营的墙外。真可怕。

original: The Super Mutants are all over the city ruins, but Elder Lyons doesn't think they're actually from there, or we would have found their home by now.
translation: 超级变种人布满了这城市的废墟，但里昂斯长老觉得他们实际上来自别处，否则我们早就找到他们的巢穴了。

original: It kind of seems like they're looking for something, but we're not really sure what that is.
translation: 他们好像在找什么，不过我们不知道会是什么。

original: What about the Brotherhood's history in this area?
translation: 兄弟会在这一地区的历史是怎样的？

original: We first arrived in the Capital Wasteland in 2255. In those first couple of years, we discovered the Citadel, Super Mutants, and Project Purity!
translation: 我们2255年来到首都废土。最初的那些年头，我们建立了大本营，遭遇了超级变种人，发现了净水工程！

original: Ah, the purifier. What an undertaking. The work your father and his team did was... amazing. The Brotherhood helped protect them, you know.
translation: 哈，净水工程，多么了不起的事业。你父亲和他的团队做的事情……令人惊叹。兄弟会致力于保护他们，你知道。

original: At least for a little while. But we were stretched thin as it was, even back then. We had to pull our forces out. When we did, the place was overrun.
translation: 至少是保护了一阵子。不过事实上那年头我们的战线就太长了。我们只好撤退。当我们这么做时，这地方就被蹂躏了。

original: I imagine that's when your father left. I... I'm sorry, I wish things had turned out differently.
translation: 我想你父亲就是那时候离开的。我……我很抱歉，我希望事情会有所不同。

original: I need medical supplies.
translation: 我需要医疗物资。

original: Sure thing. Here's what I have.
translation: 当然，我只有这些，拿去。

original: Sure, here's what I can spare.
translation: 当然，我可以给你这个。

original: Hey, can you hook me up with some chems?
translation: 嗨，你能用药品治疗我吗？

original: Sure sure. I got it all. Check it out.
translation: 当然，当然，我有一些，我来看看。

original: Sure thing, man. Sure thing.
translation: 当然，兄弟，当然。

original: Care to share anything about the Super Mutants?
translation: 关于超级变种人，有什么信息可以分享？

original: You've seen them, so you know what we know. What more is there to say?
translation: 你见过他们了，所以我知道的你都知道，还有什么其他的呢？

original: If we can figure out where they're coming from, we might be able to stop them. If not...
translation: 我们要是知道他们从哪里来，说不定能阻止他们。如果不行……

original: Foul, detestable beasts. They're like an infestation. We cut them down, and they return, again and again.
translation: 肮脏而可恶的野兽，他们像一场瘟疫。我们干掉他们一大片，他们却再次返回，没完没了。

original: Always so determined to kill or capture. But why?
translation: 只顾着残杀或掳劫，他们这是为了什么？

original: They're relentless. Like nothing I've ever seen before. I honestly think they see our Brothers in Power Armor as some kind of... canned meal.
translation: 他们冷血无情，不像我见过的任何敌人。说实在的，他们像是把我们穿着动力装甲的兄弟视为……罐装食品。

original: Some of the... pieces... we've had brought back. Men and women ripped in half. Some pulled through their armor. Just horrible.
translation: 一些……碎片……我们已经带回来的，男人和女人被撕成两半。一些甚至是穿着装甲就直接被撕烂了，太恐怖了。

original: The Brotherhood has been battling Super Mutants for decades. First out West, then in Chicago. Now here.
translation: 兄弟会跟超级变种人斗了十多年，先是在西部，接着是在芝加哥，现在是这。

original: But this group of Super Mutants is different, somehow. Physically, yes, but mentally as well. If we knew where they came from, we'd know why.
translation: 但不知什么原因，这群超级变种人不一样。身体结构不同，心智上也有差异。我们要是知道他们从哪来，我们会搞清楚为什么。

original: Not really, no.
translation: 不。

original: You know how many Uglies I've killed? More than all of Lyons' Pride combined, that's how many.
translation: 你知道我杀了多少丑八怪？比“里昂斯的骄傲”杀的总和还多，就那么多。

original: All it takes is a loaded weapon and the will to use it.
translation: 只需要一支装满子弹的枪，并且有战斗欲望。

original: Oh, and a good way to get Ugly blood out of your armor. Little bit of Abraxo and some water -- works like a charm.
translation: 对了，还有清理装甲上丑八怪的血的最好方法：用一点阿伯莱克清洁剂加一些水，有神效。

original: Yeah, the city ruins are crawling with them. They've pretty much overrun all of old D.C.
translation: 是的，他们布满了城市的废墟，他们在特区泛滥成灾。

original: Do yourself, and us, a favor and stay as far away from there as humanly possible. Definitely no place for civilians.
translation: 帮帮我们，也帮帮你自己，离那越远越好。绝对不是平民该在的地方。

original: Anything about the Super Mutants I should know?
translation: 关于超级变种人，有什么是我该知道的？

original: Shoot 'em, they die. Stab 'em, they die. Strangle 'em? They die.
translation: 射他们，他们死；刺他们，他们死；掐他们？他们死。

original: Hell, I've killed more of those yellow Frankensteins than any other member of the Pride. 'Cept maybe Gallows, with those crazy solo night ops of his.
translation: 妈的，我干掉的那些黄色疯子比任何其他“里昂斯的骄傲”的成员都多，大概除了狂人盖洛斯之外，他进行疯狂的夜间单独狩猎。

original: Man, nothing dies like an Ugly. I once saw Colvin snipe the leg off of one at 200 yards. Thing pirouetted like a figure skater!
translation: 老兄，没有谁的死相能比得上那丑八怪。我有次看见科尔文在200码外狙断一条腿，那家伙被打得团团转，像个花样滑冰的！

original: Why you think I ride these Initiates so hard? I make training hell so fighting those Uglies won't be.
translation: 你觉得我为什么要对这些新兵这么狠？我进行地狱式的训练，等他们对付丑八怪时就容易了。

original: I can tell you that those heavily armored ones, the Masters? They favor heavy weapons -- Miniguns and Missile Launchers.
translation: 我可以告诉你那些厚装甲的家伙，所谓的霸主，他们喜爱重武器 — 多管机枪和火箭发射器。

original: My recommendation -- headshot from a distance. Avoid the meat grinder.
translation: 我的建议 — 从远处爆头，避免跟这种绞肉机正面交锋。

original: So... Any thoughts on the Enclave?
translation: 那么……对英克雷有什么看法？

original: As if we didn't have enough to worry about. Their weapons are better; their Power Armor is better. Is their training better? We'll see.
translation: 好像我们的麻烦还不够似的……他们武器更好；他们的动力装甲更好。他们的训练更好吗？我们等着瞧。

original: So they have Plasma weapons! Bah! It's strong technology, I'll give you that, but limited in modability.
translation: 对了，他们有等离子武器！呸！我承认那是强悍的技术，但功能有限。

original: I've already started removing the compensators on our laser weapons to cut through the black devil Power Armor of theirs.
translation: 我已经拔掉了我们激光武器上的调相器，让它能刺穿他们黑色而邪恶的动力装甲。

original: We'll drop them like any other meat, don't you worry.
translation: 我们会把他们像其它的肉一样打倒，你别担心。

original: They're sporting some pretty impressive Power Armor, I'll give them that. The Advanced Mark II.
translation: 他们穿着给人印象相当深的动力装甲。先进的二型动力装甲。

original: But's that all right. With a few modifications, our own armor will more than handle anything they throw at it.
translation: 但这也不过如此。等做些改进后，我们自己的装甲就能轻松应付他们的攻击了。

original: Quite a few, but most are distinctly unladylike, and unworthy of discussion.
translation: 相当多，但大多数人显然不像淑女，这也不值得讨论。

original: I will tell you that the Brotherhood has encountered the Enclave before, and their motives were just as sinister then as they are now.
translation: 我告诉你，兄弟会以前就与英克雷遭遇过，而他们的图谋和现在的一样险恶。

original: I've read the reports, seen the initial scans. But I can hardly believe it.
translation: 我读了这些报告，看过最初的扫描片。但我几乎不能相信。

original: I figured those radio transmissions were just old recordings. Never figured the Enclave would actually show up, in the flesh.
translation: 我认为广播里只是以前的录音，没想到英克雷居然真的出现了。

original: But don't worry. Whatever they try, we'll be ready for it. I'll lead the Pride to knock them out tomorrow. If… my father permits it.
translation: 不过别担心，不管他们怎么做，我们都会严阵以待。明天我将带领“里昂斯的骄傲”打败他们。如果我父亲批准。

original: They're men. They're born, they live, they die. End of story.
translation: 他们是人，他们出生、活着、死去，故事结束。

original: There's meat under that armor, and meat can be ground…
translation: 穿着装甲的肉，也是能被打倒的肉。

original: Man, I don't know. Fighting Uglies is one thing, but we've never gone up against anyone that well trained or organized. Even their tech is better.
translation: 老兄，我不知道。跟丑八怪战斗是一回事，但我们从未和如此训练有素、组织严密的对手对抗过。他们的技术甚至也比我们好。

original: Don't get me wrong. The Pride's in it to win it, and I'll go down shooting if I have to. I just hope I don't have to.
translation: 别理解错了。“里昂斯的骄傲”既然加入战斗，那就必须获得胜利。如果有必要，我会一直战斗。我只是希望不必这么做。

original: Killing unarmed civilians... Makes me sick. Come over here, try fighting someone who shoots back. Fucking cowards.
translation: 杀害手无寸铁的平民……真无耻。到这来，和拿枪的人打啊。他妈的胆小鬼。

original: Honestly? I can't wait to see if one of those helmets can stop a hollow-point round at 100 yards. I'm thinking... not.
translation: 说真的？我等不及看那些头盔是否可以阻止100码外的空心弹射击了。我想……不可能。

original: What can you tell me about the Brotherhood of Steel?
translation: 你能跟我说说钢铁兄弟会吗？

original: I can see you're trying to appeal to my good nature. Pity for you I don't have one.
translation: 看的出来你想努力激发我的善心。同情地说，我没有。

original: I'll give you this one for free -- we use our big guns to kill big Super Mutants, so people like you can sleep at night.
translation: 我会免费地告诉你 — 我们用大型枪械对付大型超级变种人，好让像你这样的人晚上能睡得安稳。

original: Can I come in?
translation: 我能进去吗？

original: Negative. No Super Mutants, civilians or traveling salesmen allowed.
translation: 不行，超级变种人、平民或商队不得入内。

original: Which are you?
translation: 你是哪一种？

original: That's an affirmative. You're clear to enter. But I still don't like it. Or you.
translation: 是的，你可以进来。但我还是不喜欢这个命令，也不喜欢你。

original: I can come in now... right?
translation: 我现在可以进来了……对吗？

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: You're standing in front of the Citadel, headquarters to the Brotherhood of Steel. Capital Wasteland detachment.
translation: 你正站在五角大本营前，钢铁兄弟会首都废土分遣队的总部。

original: Targets confirmed westbound.  Move to intercept.
translation: 目标确认向西移动，前去阻截。

original: Who built Liberty Prime? Or better yet... why?
translation: 谁建造了“自由先锋”？……又为什么？

original: He was developed as a super weapon, back in the days before the war. The first joint operation between RobCo and General Atomics International.
translation: 在战前，他作为超级武器开发，是Robco和国际通用原子首次共同开发的项目。

original: Apparently, he was meant to help liberate Alaska from the Chinese, but was never completed. They were forced to go in without him.
translation: 显然，人们指望他能从中国人手中夺回阿拉斯加，但一直没有完工。他们被迫单独进兵。

original: They won, but suffered heavy losses. If we can get him up and running, well... I think you get the idea.
translation: 他们赢了，但遭受了沉重代价。我们要是能搞定并使他运作，那就……我想你明白我的意思了。

original: What can you tell me about the Lyons' Pride?
translation: 你能跟我说说“里昂斯的骄傲”吗？

original: It's the best of the Brotherhood, bar none. No one gets in without my say-so.
translation: 它是兄弟会的最精锐部队，没有“之一”。没我的同意，没人能加入。

original: Ah, see, the Brotherhood's one thing, but the Pride... Best of the best. Every damn one of us. Hand picked by Sentinel Lyons herself.
translation: 哈，明白了吧，兄弟会是一码事，但“里昂斯的骄傲”是……百里挑一。我们这群家伙中的每一个人，都是由莎拉·里昂斯亲自挑选。

original: You my friend, are talking about the most elite fighting force ever assembled within the Brotherhood of Steel.
translation: 你，我的朋友，正在谈论钢铁兄弟会中最精锐的战斗力量。

original: Each of us was handpicked by Sentinel Lyons herself. You can't even realize what an honor that is. Sarah defines combat excellence.
translation: 我们每个人由莎拉·里昂斯亲手选拔。你不会明白那是一件多么荣耀的事，萨拉将我们定义为精英战队。

original: Sarah appreciates my... methods. I fill a role no one else can.
translation: 萨拉欣赏我的……方法，我的角色没人可替代。

original: We're the most elite tactical unit ever assembled in the Brotherhood of Steel, here or anywhere else. Hell, ain't nothin' Sarah's cubs can't handle.
translation: 无论在哪，我们一直是钢铁兄弟会最精英的作战部队。该死，没有什么事是萨拉的小子们不能控制的。

original: Are you in charge of the um... the robot?
translation: 你负责这个，嗯……机器人的事？

original: I am, and have been since we first found him, well over twenty years ago.
translation: 我是，而且自从我们第一次发现他后一直如此，大约在20年前。

original: "Liberty Prime" is the designation we found on file for him. Magnificent, don't you think? At least he will be, once all systems are operational.
translation: “自由先锋”的设定出自我们发现的相关文件。多么宏伟啊，对吧？会是的，等所有系统都正常运作起来。

original: It's the energy consumption. Something that big, with such advanced weapons systems... we just don't have the means to power him. Not yet.
translation: 它的能量消耗很大，这样大的玩意，如此先进的武器系统……我们只是没有办法提供动力，至少目前还没有。

original: Ah yes. Everyone asks about the robot. Hard not to, I admit.
translation: 啊，是的，每个人都会问这机器人。好像不问会嘴痒。

original: His name is "Liberty Prime." Very patriotic. Built by a very proud nation, during a very desperate time.
translation: 他叫“自由先锋”，非常爱国。在混乱的时期，由一个高傲的国家建造。

original: We've had about as much success getting him working as they did. You should speak with Scribe Rothchild. He can tell you more.
translation: 我们已经做了许多工作以便他能成功运作。你应当和罗斯查德文员谈谈，他能告诉你更多情况。

original: So what's the deal with the robot?
translation: 该怎么处理这个机器人？

original: Yes father.
translation: 是的，父亲。

original: You don't have to like it, Sarah. You just have to follow orders.
translation: 你不必喜欢它，萨拉，你只需执行命令。

original: I don't like it.
translation: 我不喜欢这样。

original: I agree. Without the G.E.C.K., the purifier is useless to the Enclave anyway. They may give up before long.
translation: 我同意。要是没有伊甸园创造器，这净化器对英克雷毫无价值，他们可能很快就会放弃。

original: And if you fail, then what? The risk is not worth the reward.
translation: 你要是失败了怎么办？不值得去冒这么大的风险。

original: So we just wait until they decide we're next on the list? If the Pride goes in now, we might have a chance.
translation: 那我们就等着成为他们的下一个目标？“里昂斯的骄傲”现在要是介入，我们可能还有机会。

original: We barely have the manpower to keep the Citadel fortified. We've been over this before, Sarah...
translation: 我们几乎没有人力加强大本营的防御，我们以前也曾有过这种窘境，萨拉……

original: All I'm saying is, the longer we sit here, the more time they have to shore up their defenses. We should hit them sooner rather than later.
translation: 我要说的是，我们待在这时间越长，他们构筑防御的时间就越多。我们应该立即对他们发起攻击。

original: And how! I AM the only one in all of the Wasteland with the skill and the guts to perform facial reconstruction, you know.
translation: 非常好！你要知道，我是废土中唯一一个有技术和胆量实施整容的人。

original: Look. You're different from all those other jerkoffs, so I'll make you a deal. You want a little nip-tuck here and there, I'll do it for ya.
translation: 听着，你和那些笨蛋不一样，所以我们做个交易吧。你脸上有几处要整一下，我会帮你办到。

original: I'll get to hone my skill, and you'll get the best surgeon around. The likelihood of death by infection at my hands is only... hmm... 35% let's say.
translation: 我要磨练我的技术，而你会享受到这周围最好的医疗服务。手术因感染导致死亡的可能性仅仅是……唔……35%。

original: So, what do you want to look like?
translation: 好吧，你要整成什么样？

original: You think you could perform a Facial Reconstruction on me?
translation: 你看我能不能整个容？

original: What do you want to look like?
translation: 你要整成什么样？

original: I need a Facial Reconstruction.
translation: 我要整容。

original: I know! He's the best son a Slaver could ever want!
translation: 我知道！他是一个奴隶贩子所能拥有最好的儿子！

original: Exactly! Haha!
translation: 完全正确！哈哈！

original: Yeah. Wow. And what boy doesn't want to grow up to be like his dad? Especially your boy.
translation: 是啊，哇哦，哪个儿子不希望长大像爸爸那样呢？尤其是你儿子。

original: I don't know if that's something he should really be... you know... trying for.
translation: 我不确定他是不是真应该……你明白……变成那样。

original: That's my boy! Just like his dad! Hearty and full of life! Haha!
translation: 不愧是我儿子！就像他爸爸！精神饱满生机勃勃！哈哈！

original: Wasn't he, though! I am proud of him! You'd swear he was a professional drunk, just like his dad!
translation: 他不是吗？我为他骄傲！我打赌他会成为职业酒鬼，就像他爸爸！

original: I'll get Frank to pour us a few cold ones! HAHAHA! Hey Frank! Two drinks over here! HAHAHAHA!
translation: 我让弗兰克倒给我们些凉的！哈哈哈！嗨，弗兰克！来两杯！哈哈哈哈！

original: Better yet, how about five?
translation: 再来五杯怎么样？

original: Do I ever say no?
translation: 我说过不吗？

original: Only if you're buying!
translation: 只要你掏钱！

original: ALWAYS!
translation: 一向如此！

original: I know, man. I got bills to pay!
translation: 我知道，老兄，我还有账要付！

original: We gotta get some action around here.
translation: 我们得采取些行动了。

original: Seriously. It's been dry as hell.
translation: 说真的，这太枯燥了。

original: Christ, I know. Ever since those caravans went and hired some decent mercs, we haven't caught a damn thing.
translation: 老天，我知道。自从那些旅行商队雇了些象样的雇佣兵，我们一点收获都没有。

original: I hear that.
translation: 我听说了。

original: Seriously. Eulogy's been bitchin' up a storm.
translation: 说真的，尤勒基震怒了。

original: Yeah, I hear that Carolina Red hasn't even been able to get any good meat.
translation: 是的，我听说卡罗来纳·瑞德还没能吊上好肉。

original: I ended up with a pack of heroes. They tried to escape. We ended up just having to put 'em down.
translation: 我碰上了一帮逞英雄的。他们企图逃跑，我们只好把他们全都干掉了。

original: I thought we were gonna have a pretty good catch, but they ended up getting' sick before we could bring 'em back.
translation: 我本以为我们能漂漂亮亮的干一票，但是在把他们带回来前，他们就病倒了。

original: Little fuckers got away from us.
translation: 那帮小混蛋跑掉了。

original: We didn't catch a damn thing.
translation: 我们什么都没搞到。

original: Worse every year. Are we running out of Wastelanders or something?
translation: 一年不如一年，废土游民是不是被我们都卖完了？

original: Nada.
translation: 没什么。

original: Pretty damn shitty. You know how it's been.
translation: 真他妈的差劲，你知道目前的情况。

original: I ended up selling that one dude to the Raiders from Evergreen Mills!
translation: 我最后把那家伙卖给了常青钢铁厂的歹徒！

original: Not too bad. A couple of deadbeat buyers though.
translation: 不算太糟，但那是一帮欠债不还的家伙。

original: Not too bad, man. Not too bad...
translation: 不算太糟，老兄，不算太糟……

original: It could be worse.
translation: 本可能更糟的。

original: Honestly? Not too bad. Can't say the same for others though...
translation: 说真的？不算太糟，其他人就不好说了……

original: Considering how bad it's been around here, I'm not unhappy.
translation: 考虑到大家的买卖都不景气，我也没什么不满意的了。

original: Fine. I'll practice on someone else. Thanks for nothing.
translation: 好吧。我会找其他人试试。不谢了。

original: Hey, that's what I'm here for. Anyway, we should get back to our duties...
translation: 嗨，这就是我在这里的原因。无论如何，我们该履行职责……

original: Listen, let's talk about this some more later, okay? I have a decent tactical plan I can run by you.
translation: 听着，我们迟点再谈好吗？我有个战术计划让你进行。

original: Look, either way, we should hit the Bailey later and run through some drills. Sound good?
translation: 听着，无论怎样，我们过一些时候再去外墙。先进行一些演练，你觉得怎么样？

original: Tell you what. Let's hook up later and go see Scribe Bowditch. I heard he's been working on some new Power Armor mods. Can't hurt.
translation: 告诉你，我们迟点一起去看看鲍蒂奇文士。我听说他正在研究一些新的动力装甲插件。反正没损失。

original: Elder Lyons does not sound like that. You're an idiot.
translation: 里昂斯长老才不是这种口气呢。你是个白痴。

original: I've been practicing. Come on, we're a knightly order, right? I figure we should speak the part. I want to sound like Elder Lyons.
translation: 我一直在练习。来吧，我们是像骑士一样的修会，对吧？我认为我该谈谈这部分，我想要像里昂斯长老那样说话。

original: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

original: Why... are you talking like that?
translation: 为什么……你说话要那样？

original: Yes, sir!
translation: 是长官！

original: Then it's decided. Sarah, you take the Pride and use the robot as support. Take our friend here and secure that purifier.
translation: 决定了，萨拉，你带队“里昂斯的骄傲”，用机器人掩护，带上我们的朋友去守卫那净化器。

original: Honestly? I don't know. I think we can scrape by, and I suppose if we can't it won't matter in the long run anyway.
translation: 老实说，我不知道。我觉得我们可以依靠他，不管怎么说，我们不能说他以后都没问题。

original: Rothchild, enough. Can you make it work?
translation: 好了，罗斯查德，能让它开始工作了吗？

original: It's not ready for field tests, let alone live fire situations. The weapons haven't been calibrated, the navigation detection system is offline...
translation: 连实验室测试都没有通过，更别提实战了。这些武器还没有校准过，导航侦测系统也没启动……

original: So?
translation: 那么？

original: What? No! I mean, Li and I have solved the power problems, but we've only barely finished diagnostic tests.
translation: 什么？不！我的意思是，李和我解决了动力问题，我们还差一点就完成了诊断测试。

original: All right, Sarah. The Pride goes in. But I want them to have some extra firepower. Rothchild, is it ready?
translation: 好的，萨拉。“里昂斯的骄傲”行动了，但我想给他们一些特殊火力支援。罗斯查德，准备好了吗？

original: Send the Pride in. We can do it. We can win this!
translation: 派遣“里昂斯的骄傲”进入，我们能做到，我们能赢！

original: I'm afraid you're right. We need to act now while we can.
translation: 恐怕你是对的，只要我们有能力，我们就该行动。

original: If the Enclave has the G.E.C.K., there's nothing stopping them from starting the purifier. They'll figure out the code eventually.
translation: 如果英克雷有了伊甸园创造器，就没有什么能阻止他们启动净化器了。他们最终也会算出密码。

original: That's all I needed to know.
translation: 我就打听这些吧。

original: Come back any time! It's... kind of lonely down here.
translation: 随时回来哦！这下面还……真寂寞呢。

original: Isn't it dangerous being this deep into the city?
translation: 在城市的深处难道不危险吗？

original: Not really. The Super Mutants leave us alone. I guess whatever they do that turns people like them doesn't work on us.
translation: 不。超级变种人不管我们。我想他们没办法把我们变成他们那样。

original: The Brotherhood of Steel will fire on us if we're out in the open, but they don't bother us down here.
translation: 我们要是跑到外面去，钢铁兄弟会的人会朝我们开枪，但他们不会下来骚扰我们。

original: We've had some Raiders and Slavers poke their heads in, but we've got Charon and Cerberus and everyone else to take care of them.
translation: 一些歹徒和奴隶贩子倒是想把头探进来，但我们有卡戎和地狱犬，还有其他人来对付他们。

original: I guess when it comes down to it, being this far out of everyone's way is a good deal for us.
translation: 总的来说，我们不挡任何人的道，是一个好策略。

original: How did all of the Ghouls end up here?
translation: 这些尸鬼是怎么来到这的？

original: At first it was just a couple people after the war. This was one of the only places that wasn't falling down or on fire after the bombs fell.
translation: 最初，这里的人不多。这里是核弹落下之后没有起火或者倒塌的少数地方之一。

original: I think that Carol is actually one of the few that were here then.
translation: 我想卡洛尔当时就在。

original: But, over the years, word got around. There had been Ghouls living in little pockets all around. Not really so much anymore.
translation: 不过，多年来，消息传了出去。曾有很多僵尸散居的四处。如今不多了。

original: Most of them either went feral or ended up here. I'm sure there are still a few out there, but anyone with any sense is in Underworld.
translation: 他们要么变得疯狂，要么就搬过来住了。我确信外边还有些人，但有点头脑的都生活在地下城。

original: What was this place before the Ghouls moved in?
translation: 尸鬼住进来前，这是什么地方？

original: It used to be part of the Museum of History. The exhibit that used to be here was focused on what happens after death: hell and whatnot.
translation: 它过去是历史博物馆的一部分。展览的主题是身后之事：地狱之类的。

original: A lot of it was focused on this old book called "Paradise Lost." It's about a guy who goes to Hell. Pretty interesting stuff.
translation: 还有一些展览集中在这本叫《失乐园》的古书上。它说的是一个家伙下了地狱，相当有意思的东西。

original: I found a big box of copies of the book in one of the back rooms. Here, take one. Nobody around here wants 'em.
translation: 我在一间辅助库房找到了一大箱这书。给你一本，这里谁也不要它。

original: It used to be part of the Museum of History. The exhibit that used to be here was focused on what happens after death: Hell and whatnot.
translation: 它过去是历史博物馆的一部分。展览的主题是身后之事：地狱之类的。

original: A lot of it was focused on this old book called "Paradise Lost." It's about a guy who goes to Hell. Pretty interesting stuff.
translation: 还有一些展览集中在这本叫《失乐园》的古书上。它说的是一个家伙下了地狱，相当有意思的东西。

original: You should read the copy I gave you.
translation: 你应该读读我给你的书。

original: Do you know anything about Underworld?
translation: 你知道关于地下城的事吗？

original: Well, yeah. There's a lot of old pamphlets and stuff down here. I've pretty much read it all.
translation: 是的，这有许多老刊物和旧东西，我差不多把它们全部读完了。

original: You don't get a lot of customers, do you?
translation: 你没多少顾客对吧？

original: No, not really. To tell you the truth, everyone around here who wants a gun already has one.
translation: 是的，的确是这样。实事求是地说，这里想要有枪的人都有了枪。

original: I spend most of my time sitting here reading old stuff I find around here. You end up learning a lot of interesting things that way!
translation: 我花了大部分光阴坐在这读我在周围找到的老玩意儿。如果你也这样生活，肯定也能从中懂得许多有趣的事。

original: You run this place with Greta?
translation: 你和葛丽泰管理这地方？

original: We've been together longer than you've been alive.
translation: 我们在一起的时间比你活的时间还要长。

original: It's just... you know, you think that you're going to be with someone forever, and then you wake up one day and they're gone.
translation: 就像……呃，你以为你会永远和某个人在一起，但后来你有一天醒过来，他们全都不在了。

original: Where do you do from there?
translation: 你从哪来的？

original: You're taking Greta's death really hard, aren't you?
translation: 你对葛丽泰的死感到非常悲痛，对吗？

original: That's right. Her and I have been together for... oh... about 60 years now.
translation: 没错，她和我在一起……哦……大约有60年了。

original: But, things haven't really been the same since Gob left. He was like a son to me. I think Greta was always a little jealous of him...
translation: 不过，自从盖博离开后，日子有些不同了。他就像是我儿子。我觉得葛丽泰总有点嫉妒他……

original: What do you know about Underworld?
translation: 对于地下城你知道些什么？

original: To tell you the truth, hon, I don't really know much about it. All I know is that it used to be some sort of exhibit.
translation: 告诉你实情，亲爱的，我对它真不太了解。我只知道它过去是某种展览馆。

original: Something about hell or the afterlife or something. Tulip knows that sort of stuff.
translation: 展览一些和地狱或者人死后的生活有关的事情之类的。“郁金香”知道那种东西。

original: Not like anyone around here ever buys anything from that shop of hers.
translation: 这的人好像永远不会从她的商店买东西。

original: He works for a guy up in Megaton. I think he might be a slave.
translation: 他在兆吨镇给一个家伙打工，我想他可能是个奴隶。

original: You... you what?
translation: 你……你什么？

original: YOU SON OF A BITCH!
translation: 你这个狗娘养的！

original: He was up in Megaton. At least he was until I killed him.
translation: 他住在兆吨镇。至少在被我杀死前是这样。

original: That's... that's terrible. But at least I know he's alive. So that's something.
translation: 那……那太可怕了。不过至少我知道他还活着。这就行了。

original: If you get up that way again, tell him that I said that I miss him and that I love him.
translation: 你要是再经过那，帮我给带个话，就说我想他，我爱他。

original: But, he shouldn't try to escape. It's too dangerous. No, no. He should stay put where he is. I couldn't bear the thought of him getting hurt.
translation: 但是，他不应该尝试逃跑，太危险了。不，不，他应该待在那。我不想让他受到伤害。

original: He's working in a bar in Megaton.
translation: 他在兆吨镇的酒吧里工作。

original: No! Not Gob... I'm... I'm sorry... I need some time alone...
translation: 不！不会真是盖博吧……我……我很抱歉……我要单独待会……

original: He was up in Megaton. I'm afraid that he's dead.
translation: 他曾经住在兆吨镇。但恐怕已经死了。

original: Oh, that's wonderful news! I'm so glad! if you see him, please tell him that his mother misses him and loves him and that I hope he's happy.
translation: 哦，令人愉快的消息！我真高兴！你要是看见他，请告诉他，他的妈妈想念他，爱他，我希望他快快乐乐。

original: But, he shouldn't come visit. It's too dangerous. No, no. He should stay put where he is.
translation: 但是，他不应该来这，那太危险了。不，不，他应该待在那。

original: All right. I'm going to go have a look around.
translation: 好吧，我会四处看看。

original: Enjoy your stay. Just... try and keep from shooting up the place.
translation: 玩得开心。只是……别在这开枪。

original: We've got a nice little deal going down here. We'd like to keep it nice.
translation: 我们在这下面的营生还不错。我们希望保持下去。

original: Hmm... All right, thanks for the information.
translation: 唔……好吧，感谢这条信息。

original: I thought as much.
translation: 我也是这么想的。

original: I see...
translation: 我明白了……

original: Very well. Thank you for the update.
translation: 很好，谢谢你的消息。

original: Enclave strength is at 100%. They're getting reinforcements from somewhere, but we still haven't determined the location of their headquarters.
translation: 英克雷的兵力达到了100%，他们显然从其他地方获得了增援，但我们始终没法确定他们的总部位置。

original: Super Mutant activity in D.C. is high, but nothing out of the ordinary. The area around Galaxy News Radio is... nearly secure.
translation: 超级变种人在特区很活跃，但还没有超过正常范畴。银河新闻电台周围……基本安全。

original: Enclave troops have fortified the purifier complex. With those vertibirds, they're able to transport personnel at a remarkable rate.
translation: 英克雷军队加强了净化器的防守力度。利用那些飞鸟，他们能高效率地运送人员。

original: There's been another Behemoth sighted in the Wasteland, in the Evergreen Mills region. That's heavy Raider country, so things could get interesting.
translation: 在废土的常青钢铁厂那一带，发现了另一个超级变种巨人。那地方是歹徒的巢穴，所以事情可能会很有趣。

original: It appears the Enclave troops have moved beyond the purifier, into the surrounding Wasteland region. No telling how far they might spread.
translation: 似乎英克雷的军队已经由净化器出发，进入了周围的废土地区。不知道他们将渗透到多远。

original: I'm working on it, okay?
translation: 我正在处理，知道了吗？

original: All right, all right. Do what you have to, but be careful.
translation: 好的，好的。做你的事，但小心。

original: Yeah, it's taken care of. Should be safe now.
translation: 很好，危机已经化解了，现在应该安全了。

original: Excellent. Let's get inside and get to work.
translation: 太棒了，让我们进去，开始工作。

original: <static>
translation: <静电噪音>

original: All right, Rothchild. Fire it up. Pride, move out!
translation: 好的，罗斯查德，点火，“里昂斯的骄傲”，开始行动！

original: Wait a second! I handled Silver for you, and you still want me to pay?
translation: 稍等！我为你解决了席尔瓦的麻烦，你还要我付钱吗？

original: It's called economics, kid. You got something I want and I got something you want. Nothing's free.
translation: 孩子，这就叫经济学。你有我要的，我有你要的，没有免费的午餐。

original: I told you the favor would earn you some caps if you really took care of it. Now, fork 'em over!
translation: 我告诉过你这个忙你要是认真的帮了我，就能够让你赚很多。现在，交出来！

original: Forget it. I'll come back.
translation: 门都没有。我会回来的。

original: I'll be here.
translation: 我会在这里。

original: Yeah, yeah. Here, take your 100 caps. I hope you choke on them.
translation: 好，好。给，你的100个瓶盖。你小心别被瓶盖压死了。

original: How can you be so rude when I'm going to provide you with such a useful public service?
translation: 当我要提供给你这么有用的公益服务时，你怎么能这么粗鲁？

original: Your dad came through here, all right. Didn't stay long, though. Said he had some important business to attend to, and headed off to the city.
translation: 你爸爸确实来过这。但待得时间不长。他说有些重要的事情要处理，就一直向城那边走了。

original: Something to do with Galaxy News Radio. Guess that'd be the place for you to start. Good hunting, and thanks for the caps.
translation: 和银河新闻电台有点关系。我想你应该从那里着手。祝你好运，另外谢谢你的瓶盖。

original: Fine, here's your 100 caps.
translation: 很好，这是你的100个瓶盖。

original: Now that wasn't so difficult was it?
translation: 事情就是这么简单。

original: Your dad came through here, all right. Didn't stay long, though. Said he had some important business to attend to, and headed off to the city.
translation: 你爸爸确实来过这。但待得时间不长。他说有些重要的事情要处理，就一直向城那边走了。

original: Something to do with Galaxy News Radio. Guess that'd be the place for you to start. Good hunting, and thanks for the caps.
translation: 和银河新闻电台有点关系。我想你应该从那里着手。祝你好运，另外谢谢你的瓶盖。

original: Loading Personality: RobCo R38 V3.1a "Factory Assistant"...
translation: 加载人格：RobCo R38 V3.1a版“工厂助理”……

original: Running default factory protocol...ERROR.  Loading daily agenda...ERROR.
translation: 运行默认工厂协议……错误。加载日程安排……错误。

original: Production threat identified.  Initializing program: Excalibur.
translation: 生产威胁确认。程序初始化中：石中剑。

original: Please stand clear and go about your normal work routine.  Your friendly RobCo Factory Helper will have this cleaned up in a moment.
translation: 请保持距离，继续您正常的工作。您友好的RobCo工厂助手很快就会清理干净的。

original: This disturbance will be credited towards your daily break allotment.  Thank You.
translation: 此次干扰将计入您的日常休息配额。谢谢。

original: Due to an unforseen incident you have been issued an unpaid holiday.  Enjoy.
translation: 由于一起意外事件，您被安排了一次无薪假期。好好享受。

original: Please stand clear and keep the palaver to a minimum.  Thank you.
translation: 请保持距离，尽量少说话。谢谢。

original: Why don't you come with me?
translation: 你为什么不跟我一起走？

original: It's tempting, but... my place is here. The Vault needs me more than you do. I'm the only one who has a chance to talk some sense into my father.
translation: 这很诱人，但……我的归宿在这。这避难所相对于你更需要我，只有我能说动我父亲。

original: Listen, if you do catch up with your dad, tell him I'm sorry. For... you know, Jonas, and my father, and everything. Goodbye.
translation: 听着，你要真的追上了你爸爸，帮我转告他我很抱歉，为……你知道的，乔纳斯、我父亲和所有的一切。再见。

original: Greetings fellow employee.  Please present your valid work ID.
translation: 您好，同事。请出示您的有效工作证。

original: Proceeding with scan... scan accepted.  Thank you.
translation: 正在进行扫描……扫描通过。谢谢。

original: No valid ID detected.  Please state name clearly for voice identification.
translation: 未检测到有效证件。请清晰地说出姓名以便语音识别。
