original: Unidentified personnel.  Please vacate the premises immediately.
translation: 身份不明人员。请立即离开此地。

original: Go get them yourself, then.
translation: 你自己快去赶上他们。

original: I'd love to. Can't spare the men.
translation: 我很乐意，不能饶恕那些人。

original: You, on the other hand, are expendable. Especially with an attitude like that.
translation: 另一方面，你可以随时被牺牲，尤其是因为你的态度。

original: Let's just leave this as an open offer. If I never see you again, I haven't lost anything.
translation: 我们从这门离开吧。如果我再也见不到你，也没有任何损失。

original: Goodbye, Amata.
translation: 再见，阿玛塔。

original: You'd better leave before I change my mind about letting you go.
translation: 你赶快离开，在我改变让你走的主意前。

original: Why not come with me? There's nothing here for you anymore.
translation: 为什么不跟我一起走？这再没有值得你关心的事了。

original: No, I can't. Not with you, not now. You'd better leave before I change my mind about letting you go.
translation: 不，我不能。不能和你走，至少不能是现在。你赶快离开，在我改变让你走的主意前。

original: The door's open. You could come with me.
translation: 门开了，你可以跟我一起走。

original: I would, if I only cared about myself.
translation: 如果我只关心自己，我会的。

original: I guess it's time for you to go deal with your father issues, while I deal with mine. Good luck. I will miss you, you know.
translation: 我想是时候让你去搞清楚你父亲的问题了，我也该回去处理我的事情了，祝你好运，我会想念你的。

original: Time for me to go, Amata. My Dad's out there somewhere.
translation: 我要走了，阿玛塔。我爸爸就在外面某个地方。

original: I guess it's time for you to go deal with your father issues, while I deal with mine. Good luck. I will miss you, you know.
translation: 我想是时候让你去弄明白你父亲的事情了，我也该回去处理我的事情了，祝你好运，我会想念你的。

original: Goodbye, Amata. It's time for me to go.
translation: 再见，阿玛塔，我要走了。

original: You're right. Go on. Before anyone comes. Find your dad. I'll... I'll miss you. You've been a good friend. Good luck out there.
translation: 你是对的，走吧，在别人来之前。找到你爸爸，我会……我会想你的。你是一个好朋友。一路顺风。

original: You could come with me, you know. Leave this place behind forever.
translation: 你知道，你可以和我一起走。永远离开这。

original: It's tempting, but... no. My place is here. I may be the only one who can stop my father before something even worse happens.
translation: 这很诱人，但……我的归宿在这。在事情变的更坏之前，只有我能阻止我父亲。

original: Go on. Before anyone comes. Find your dad. I'll... I'll miss you. You've been a good friend. Good luck out there.
translation: 你是对的，走吧，在别人来之前。找到你爸爸，我会……我会想你的。你是一个好朋友。一路顺风，好运常在。

original: Goodbye, Amata.
translation: 再见，阿玛塔。

original: Goodbye. Find your dad. I'll... I'll miss you. You've been a good friend.
translation: 再见。找到你爸爸，我会……我会想念你。你是一个好朋友。

original: You should come with me. It's not safe for you to stay.
translation: 你该跟我一起走，你留下来不安全。

original: Don't worry about me. Whatever happens, I'm sure I'll be in less danger than you. I can't imagine what you're going to find out there.
translation: 别担心我，无论发生什么，我确信我的危险比你小，我无法想象你在外边会遭遇到什么。

original: Go on. Before anyone comes. Find your dad. I'll... I'll miss you. You've been a good friend.
translation: 走吧，在别人来之前。找到你爸爸，我会……我会想念你。你是一个好朋友。

original: Goodbye, Amata.
translation: 再见，阿玛塔。

original: Goodbye. Listen, if you do catch up with your dad, tell him I'm sorry. For... you know, Jonas, and my father, and everything.
translation: 再见。听着，如果你真追上你爸爸，告诉他我很抱歉，为……你知道的，乔纳斯、我父亲和所有一切。

original: Can I see what you have to trade?
translation: 我能看看你有什么可交易的吗？

original: Yeah, I suppose.
translation: 当然可以。

original: Sure. Just be quick about it.
translation: 当然，只是快点。

original: Hey, I've been there! Those Super Mutants are all dead. It's safe now.
translation: 嗨，我去过那了！那些超级变种人全死了，那边现在很安全。

original: That is great news indeed!
translation: 那确实是个非常好的消息！

original: As soon as Caleb gets what he needs, we can start our trip.
translation: 只要卡勒布得到了他所要的，我们就能上路。

original: It would be a great favor to me if you would help him.
translation: 你要是愿意帮助他，那对我是一个天大的恩惠。

original: Enough with the inane banter! Just tell me already.
translation: 废话说够了！说正经的。

original: Fine. Some people just don't appreciate the spoken word.
translation: 好吧，有些人就是不健谈。

original: This holotape contains the location of the military weapons cache. I hope you put them to good use and keep up the fight.
translation: 这盘全息磁带包含了军事武器贮藏地的位置。希望你别拿它干坏事，继续战斗。

original: Remember to keep us tuned in while you're out there, and watch yourself.
translation: 记住与我们保持联络。自己多加小心。

original: I did my part. Now it's your turn to contribute to the Good Fight.
translation: 我做了我该做的。现在轮到你为圣战做贡献了。

original: This holotape contains the location of the military weapons cache.
translation: 这盘全息磁带包含了隐藏军火库的位置。

original: I hope you put them to good use and keep up the fight.
translation: 希望你用于正途，继续战斗。

original: Remember to keep us tuned in while you're out there, and watch yourself.
translation: 记得与我们保持联系。自己多加小心。

original: Yes, please.
translation: 是的。

original: This holotape contains the location of the weapons cache.
translation: 这盘全息磁带包含了隐藏军火库的位置。

original: I hope you put them to good use and keep up the fight.
translation: 希望你用于正途，继续战斗。

original: Remember to keep us tuned in while you're out there, and watch yourself.
translation: 记得与我们保持联系。自己多加小心。

original: Oh boy! Let's go now! Can we please?
translation: 哦，乖乖！我们走吧！好吗？

original: You bet we are! Are you ready to go on the adventure express?
translation: 当然！你准备好继续这次冒险了没？

original: I cannot -- I will not -- allow the Enclave to control the one thing that could bring even the slightest spark of hope to these people.
translation: 即使这东西只能给人民带来些许希望之火，我也不能 — 也不会 — 允许英克雷把它们扑灭。

original: Project Purity would mean millions of gallons of pure, clean water for the people of the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 净水工程对首都废土的人民意味着数百万加仑纯净、清洁的水。

original: James never got the damned thing to run. Neither did we, for that matter. But the Enclave...
translation: 因为这问题，詹姆斯从没能让这该死的东西运作，我们也不行。但是英克雷……

original: If they controlled that much clean water... they would control the entire Capital Wasteland.
translation: 他们要是控制了这么多纯净的水……他们将控制整个首都废土。

original: I simply cannot allow that to happen.
translation: 我绝不允许这事发生。

original: Here I sit, in the safety of the Citadel, while the people of the Wasteland thirst, and suffer, and die. Here I sit, a failed, feeble old man.
translation: 我坐在这儿，在安全的大本营里，而废土居民却在忍受饥渴，遭受痛苦，悲惨死亡。我坐在这儿，我是一个失败而虚弱的老人。

original: What have I really accomplished? How many have I truly helped? The Super Mutants still roam rampant. The people still die of thirst and radiation.
translation: 我真正做到了什么？我真正帮到了多少？超级变种人始终在繁衍，人民始终在饥渴和辐射中死亡。

original: The Western Elders cease to acknowledge my existence. Some of my own people have even gone Outcast.
translation: 西岸的长老不再承认我的地位，我自己的一些人甚至也走了，成为了放逐者。

original: And now... the Enclave. Technologically superior. Infinitely resourceful. The time has come to pass the mantle to more able hands. But is she ready?
translation: 而现在又来了英克雷。拥有更先进的科技，拥有无穷的资源。我们是该让贤了，但他们真的愿意接受这个使命吗？

original: According to our latest reconnaissance report, Enclave soldiers have taken complete control of the Project Purity facility.
translation: 根据我们最新的侦测报告，英克雷士兵已完全控制了净水工程的设施。

original: They've brutally murdered innocent scientists, including James. He went there to revive the project, and died for his efforts.
translation: 他们残忍地谋杀了无辜的科学家，包括詹姆斯。詹姆斯去那重新启动这计划，力竭而死。

original: They will answer for their crimes. I haven't worked so hard just to sit idly by and watch the Enclave undo what little we've accomplished here.
translation: 他们将为他们的罪行付出代价。我不会袖手旁观，容忍英克雷破坏我们进行的工作。

original: I'm sorry, Madison. I am. But what choice do I have?
translation: 抱歉，麦迪逊。我是这么做了，可当初我有什么选择？

original: I thought I knew you... I trusted you! We all did! How can you be so selfish?
translation: 我以为我了解你……我曾经相信你！我们所有人都是！你怎么能这么自私？

original: Selfish? This is my child we're talking about, Madison! My child!
translation: 自私？我们在谈的是我的孩子，麦迪逊！我的孩子！

original: It's you and me, now, okay? You and me. But that's okay. So long as we've got each other, that's all that matters.
translation: 现在是你和我，好吗？你和我。但那就好，只要我们彼此信任，什么问题都迎刃而解。

original: No, no, put that away. This one's on the house. And now a toast. To James and his cheery cherub. May your future be safe, bright, and boring as hell.
translation: 不，不，放在那，这是免费的，烤面包，给詹姆斯和他的快乐小天使。你的未来是平安的，光明的，也会多风多雨。

original: Shh... You're safe now. No more monsters. No more nightmares. Shh... That's it. Daddy's got you…
translation: 嘘……你现在很安全，没有怪兽，没有噩梦。嘘……就这样，爸爸在你身边。

original: Yes, yes. Cardiology, Pediatrics, Psychiatry. Whatever your needs. You'll find I can handle, well… I can handle just about anything.
translation: 是的，是的，心脏病学，小儿科，精神病学，无论你需要哪一种，你会发现我都能应付自如。我能处理这一切。

original: All right. Just remember one thing. We need a doctor, not a deadbeat. Fail to meet my expectations, and there will be repercussions.
translation: 好吧，只是记住一件事，我们需要医生，不是游手好闲的人。没能达到我的期望，你就没好结果。

original: Not so bad, huh? A bit chilly maybe, but we'll get used to that. A few decorations, some donated toys, and this place will feel just like home. Home…
translation: 没那么糟吧？可能有点冷，但我们会习惯。一些装饰，一些玩具，这地方感觉像个家。家。

original: Hmmmm... Good? Huh, is that good? Here you go... No... Not too fast. That's it. That's it. Everything on the spoon. Come on, you can do it.
translation: 唔……好吗？呃，怎么样？给……不……别太快。很奇妙吧，就这样，来，你能行。

original: It's a pleasure. I'm Jonas. Um... I guess... I'm your new assistant.
translation: 很高兴，我是乔纳斯。嗯……我想……我是你的新助手。

original: It's okay! It's okay, see? Just a little cut. Good thing your daddy's a doctor, huh? I know just the right kind of kiss to make it better…
translation: 好吧！好吧，看到了没？小小的皮肉伤。真幸运你爸爸是医生，哈？我知道怎么让你好受些。

original: Ahh, it's my stupid ankle, doc. Sprained, broken, I don't know. Slipped on some grease in one of the maintenance tunnels.
translation: 啊，是我的笨脚，医生。扭了还是断了，我不知道。我滑倒在维护通道的油地上了。

original: Your mommy? Oh, sweetie... I... Of course I miss her. I miss her... so much. Each day more than the last.
translation: 你妈妈？哦，亲爱的……我……当然想她。我非常……想她，日复一日。

original: You are to mend broken bones, prescribe medications, and see to the health of my residents. These "experiments" are a waste of time!
translation: 你应该去治疗那些骨折，开药，保持我的居民的健康。这些“实验”是浪费时间！

original: Don't be a damned fool! We know nothing of the viruses or bacteria that survive down here! We experiment to prepare. We prepare to survive.
translation: 别像个蠢货！我们对这里的病毒或者细菌一无所知！我们准备实验，就是为了更好地活下去。

original: What's the matter, teacher's pet? Gonna cry? Awww... Waaahh! Go run home to daddy.
translation: 什么问题，老师的宠物？要哭了？呜哇哈！回家找爸爸去吧。

original: No, but close. Not 45, 55. You've got to carry the 1, right? So you put the 5 there… and the one goes over there. See? Easy.
translation: 不，但是很接近。不是45，55。你已经进位到1，对吧？所以你把这5和1对换一下。明白没？很简单。

original: Yes, and Amata can come over after you clean your room! Now move! This place is disgusting.
translation: 是的，在你把房间清理干净后，阿玛塔才能过来！现在干活！这地方真恶心。

original: What is their problem, anyway? So I'm the Overseer's daughter? So what? Like I get any kind of special treatment! At least… at least I've got you.
translation: 他们有毛病吗？因为我是监督者的女儿？那又怎么了？好像我有特殊待遇！至少我还有你。

original: Ah. Well... Umm. You'd think being a doctor would make this easy...
translation: 啊，好……唔。你想如果是医生这事就好办了……

original: Boys and girls have different parts. Right? And when a boy and a girl love each other…
translation: 男孩和女孩身上有地方不同，对吧？当男孩和女孩彼此相爱……

original: That was amazing, sport! Four strike outs in a row! I'll tell ya doc, I think we're looking at the new Vault 101 MVP!
translation: 太神奇了，运动家！4次全打！我想我们正见证一个新的101号避难所MVP诞生！

original: Revelation, 21:6. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
translation: 启示录21：6。我是阿尔法，我是欧米伽，我是初，我是终。我要将生命泉的水，白白赐给那口渴的人喝。

original: Come on, doc. Just one more month, that's all I'm asking for. Without those pills, I… I just don't know what I'll do. Please, I'm begging you.
translation: 拜托，医生，只要一个多月，那是我所有的请求。没有那些药品，我不知道该怎么办。我求你了。

original: It's time for you to go home. Tell your father I want to see him in my office first thing in the morning. Amata, I want to talk to you. Now.
translation: 你是时候回家了。告诉你父亲我要一大早在办公室见他。阿玛塔，我要和你谈谈，就现在。

original: No, Mister DeLoria, that is not correct. The Battle of Hastings was 1066. 2077 was the end of the world. Tell me. Are you really that stupid?
translation: 不，德罗瑞先生，那不正确。黑斯汀斯战役是1066年，2077年是世界末日。你真那么蠢吗？

original: Stop fussing! You look great! Now go! You want to be late for you own prom?
translation: 别紧张！你看上去很不错！快去吧！你想在自己的舞会上迟到？

original: Don't give me that! You were drunk! All of you! What if I hadn't walked in? Hmm? Did you think about that? What if the Overseer found you first?
translation: 别给我！你们喝醉了！你们都是！如果我不进去会有什么结果？唔？你想过没，要是监督者先发现了你会有什么结果？

original: There's nothing out there. Just... Horror. Pain. Grief.  You have a good life in this vault. You shouldn't think about such awful things.
translation: 外面什么都没有，只有……恐怖，痛苦和悲伤。在这避难所你能好好的活着，你不必想那些可怕的事。

original: Well that's my job, isn't it? To turn you into a grown-up? Make sure you're ready to handle adult life here in the vault? You're not a kid anymore.
translation: 那是我的工作，不是吗？把你们变成大人？确保你们在避难所准备好了过成人的生活？你们不是小孩了。

original: Here are those results you wanted, doc. From the, um... secondary experiment?
translation: 给你你要的结果，医生。结论来自，嗯……二级实验？

original: Oh my God. Please, doctor. Please! I know you have stuff here. Drugs! You have to fix this! My God, I can't be pregnant…
translation: 天啊，医生，拜托！我知道你有办法。药品！你必须帮我！天啊，我不能怀孕？

original: Ha ha! Look at that! What'd I tell you, huh? Work hard enough, and anything is possible. Even an "A" from Mister Brotch! Ha ha ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈！看看！我跟你们说过什么，呃？努力过后，一切皆有可能。即使是布洛彻先生也能给你打“A”！哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Yeah? Well daddy doctor ain't here to save you now, is he? So what you gonna do now, huh? What you gonna do?
translation: 是吗？医生爸爸不在这救你了，是吗？那你现在要干嘛，哈？你要干嘛？

original: What are you looking at? Stop gawking and get back to work. Selfish and insubordinate, just like your father…
translation: 你在看什么？别发呆，回去工作。自私又不听话，就像你的父亲。

original: Look, it's just... You need to know these things. I'm not going to be around to hold your hand forever...
translation: 听着……你应该知道这些事。我不能永远都帮你……

original: FEV vial must be secured before door locks are released, security protocol Gamma-3.
translation: 在门被打开之前，必须保护好FEV试剂瓶 — 安全协议C-3。

original: As I've said, you'll have to take the vial before I can allow you to leave.
translation: 正如我所说，在我能允许你离开之前，你必须带走这试剂瓶。

original: Ah, ah... Over here, by the console!
translation: 啊！啊！……这里！控制台旁！

original: Okay, I'm just going to slowly walk away now...
translation: 好吧，我这就慢慢走开……

original: You're not going anywhere! GUARDS!
translation: 你哪都去不了！警卫！

original: FollowersFiredNo
translation: 我考虑了一下，你还是留下来吧。

original: Very amusing.
translation: 非常有趣。

original: Nah. I'm just kidding.
translation: 不，我只是说笑。

original: Yeah, very funny. Ha ha. Hilarious.
translation: 是的，非常有趣。哈哈，太妙了。

original: Nah. I'm just kidding.
translation: 不，我只是说笑。

original: Very well. I shall stay with you.
translation: 非常好，我应该和你一起。

original: On second thought, stay with me.
translation: 经过考虑，留在我身边吧。

original: Yeah. That's what I thought.
translation: 是的，正是我所想的。

original: On second thought, stay with me.
translation: 经过考虑，留在我身边吧。

original: Very well.
translation: 那好吧。

original: No, I'm not. Stay here.
translation: 不，我不是。待在这。

original: I was worried for a second.
translation: 我刚才还真有点担心。

original: On second thought, stay with me.
translation: 经过考虑，留在我身边吧。

original: <pant> <pant>
translation: <喘气><喘气>

original: On second thought, stay with me.
translation: 经过考虑，留在我身边吧。

original: FollowersFiredYes
translation: 是的，我很肯定。

original: You can't fire me! I'm the boss of this gang! And I say you're fired! And that I'm going back to Rivet City for a drink! Suck on that!
translation: 你不能炒我的鱿鱼哇！我是这帮派的老大！我说，你才被炒了呢！……我要回铆钉城喝一杯！真他妈晦气！

original: I'm serious.
translation: 我是认真的。

original: Very well. Although you remain my employer until my contract changes hands. I will wait for you in Underworld, should you need me again.
translation: 好吧，虽然我被解雇了，但只要我的契约没有被转手你就是还我老板。你要是再需要我，我会在地下城等你。

original: Do I look like I'm kidding?
translation: 我看起来像在说笑吗？

original: If that's the way you're going to play, lover. I'll be waiting at Eulogy's place when you come crawling back.
translation: 你要想这么玩，那就如你所愿，爱人。当你想再次让我爬在你身边时，我会在尤勒基的地方等你。

original: Because I say so. Go.
translation: 因为我这样说了。走吧。

original: <whimper>
translation: <呜咽>

original: You heard me. Get out of here.
translation: 听到我说的了吗，离开这。

original: I see how it is: the old man can't keep up. Whatever. I'm gonna go see if there's anything left of Megaton.
translation: 我明白的：老人总是跟不上步子。不管怎样，我会去兆吨镇看看还有什么留下来了。

original: Don't make me repeat myself.
translation: 别让我再三重复。

original: I see how it is: the old man can't keep up. Whatever. I'll be at Moriarty's if you change your mind.
translation: 我明白的：老人总是跟不上步子。不管怎样，你要是改变了主意，我会在莫里亚蒂那等你。

original: Don't make me repeat myself.
translation: 别让我再三重复。

original: I'm disappointed, but I cannot say I'm surprised. If you change your mind, I shall be studying in the American History Museum, downtown.
translation: 我很失望，但不觉得奇怪。你要是改变主意，我应该在市区的美利坚历史博物馆里学习。

original: Yes, I'm certain.
translation: 是的，我确定。

original: Leaving a soldier behind? Very bad form. Making base in Canterbury Commons for when you come to your senses, sir!
translation: 扔下一个勇猛的战士？真无奈啊。我会暂时在坎特伯雷社区驻扎，你要是醒悟过来，就去那里找我，先生！

original: You didn't mishear me. Leave.
translation: 你没听错。离开吧。

original: Very well. I shall return to my duties at the Citadel should you require my aid once again.
translation: 好吧，我应当回到大本营的岗位上去，有一天你会再次需要我的援助。

original: We must part ways, Paladin Cross.
translation: 我们必须分道扬镳，星骑士 克罗丝。

original: I found Argyle. I'm afraid he's dead.
translation: 我找到阿盖尔了。恐怕他已经死了。

original: Dead? Argyle? You... you’re sure? My God. I always thought he’d outlive me, by at least 100 years. Poor bastard.
translation: 死了？阿盖尔？你……你确定？我的天。我一直认为他会活得比我久，至少多活100年，可怜的家伙。

original: But thank you! Thank you for telling me. At least now I know. At least now the poor guy can catch a breather.
translation: 不过还是谢谢你！谢谢你告诉我。至少现在我知道了。至少这可怜人能安息了。

original: I’d like to return your kindness. Here, take this key. It unlocks my safe. Lots of stuff in there I'll never use again. My adventuring days are over.
translation: 我想回报你的善意。给你这把钥匙，用它打开我的保险柜，里面很多东西我再也用不上了。我的冒险生涯结束了。

original: Tell me about Argyle.
translation: 跟我说说阿盖尔吧。

original: Argyle was my manservant! Ah, but that’s really just a fancy word for "the guy who saves my sorry skin on a regular occasion."
translation: 阿盖尔曾是我的男仆！哈，不过那也就是个委婉说法，其实就是“那个常救我狗命的家伙”。

original: He was a Ghoul, you see. Been around since before the war. We met when I stole his girlfriend, back in ’41. We’d been best friends ever since.
translation: 他是个尸鬼，你懂的，战前就存在了。我遇到他是在41年，那时我抢了他的女朋友。自那之后我们就成了最铁的哥们。

original: We got separated, a long time ago, and never reunited. If you find Argyle out there, somewhere, you be sure and tell me! Okay?
translation: 我们很久前失散了，再也没能重逢。要是你在外边某处见到阿盖尔，一定要告诉我！好吗？

original: You mentioned something about GNR?
translation: 你提到了银新台？

original: Haven’t you ever heard the radio play? The Adventures of Herbert "Daring" Dashwood? That guy at the radio station put it together a few years ago.
translation: 你没听过那部广播剧吗？《赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德历险记》？几年前电台的家伙把它整理出来了。

original: He did it in the style of those shows they had before the war. Came out pretty well. And it’s all true! Rockopolis, Miss Chase... All of it.
translation: 他用战前那种广播剧风格制作的，效果还挺不错。而且全是真事！岩石城、蔡斯小姐……都是存在的。

original: Of course, they do portray me as a bit of a chump. Argyle may have saved my hide more than once, but I had my moments. Ah, those were the days...
translation: 当然了，他们把我刻画得有点像笨蛋。阿盖尔确实不止一次救过我，但我也有高光时刻啊。啊，那些日子……

original: I saw the Family's mark on the wall. What's up with that?
translation: 我在墙上看到家族的标志，发生了什么事？

original: Vance told me later that he was basically covering for me and allowing the Family to... to feed at the same time.
translation: 万斯后来告诉我，他主要是想替我掩盖，并同时让家族去……去吃一顿。

original: Since my parents were already dead, they drank their blood and left the mark on the wall. He didn't want Evan to suspect I had done it.
translation: 因为我父母已经死了，所以他们吸了他们的血，在墙上留下这标记。他不想埃万怀疑是我干的。

original: The irony is they were stalking our town to feed anyway. It's almost like Vance knew this would happen...
translation: 讽刺的是，他们本就是潜进我们的镇子来吃饭的。就好像万斯知道事情会是这个样子……

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Yeah, okay.
translation: 好的。

original: Do you really believe in vampires?
translation: 你真的相信血族？

original: I dunno. I really don't. I mean, I'm not totally dumb. I know they were in stories and all that.
translation: 不知道。我真不知道。我的意思是，我不是个大笨蛋，我知道他们出现在小说中。

original: But who knows, maybe Vance is right and vampires were just people like us who learned to control their hunger and drink only blood.
translation: 不过谁知道呢，万斯可能是对的，血族正是像我们这样的人，能够控制他们的饥饿，靠喝血活着。

original: I mean, vampires are regarded as feared monsters instead of hunted animals like cannibals. It kinda makes sense.
translation: 我的意思是，血族被人们当成了可怖的妖怪，而不是同类相食的野兽。这有点道理。

original: Did you ever talk to your parents about it?
translation: 你父母知道这事吗？

original: Lucy said Mom and Dad would never have understood. She told me to keep what I did a secret and that she'd try and help me.
translation: 露西说妈妈和爸爸永远不会懂。她对我说会为我保守秘密，她总是尽量帮助我。

original: Thanks to Lucy, she was able to stop that from ever happening again for years.
translation: 多亏露西，这些年，她阻止了这种情况再次发生。

original: Every time I'd feel the hunger, she'd hold onto me and not let go. After a while, the hunger almost seemed to go away.... until... well.
translation: 每次我觉得饥饿，她会按住我不放。过了些日子，饥饿感好像是消失了……直到那天……

original: What did Lucy say she saw you do to that Wastelander?
translation: 当你杀了那废土客，露西说了什么？

original: She said I like... changed into another person... that I even glared at her and raised my arms like I was going to kill her.
translation: 她说我像是……变成了另一个人……我甚至怒视她，举起我的胳膊像是我要杀了她。

original: The Wastelander took a swing at me with some kind of club... I turned around and jumped on him... I tore his throat open with my teeth.
translation: 那废土游民拿着一根木棒向我挥舞……我转过身扑向他……用牙齿撕开他的喉咙。

original: If he wouldn't have done that, Lucy may have been killed too. I just dunno...
translation: 他要是不那么做，露西可能也被杀了。我只是不知道……

original: When did you first discover you had the hunger?
translation: 你头一次发现你有这种饥饿感是什么时候？

original: I was about 10 years old and I was playing with Lucy down under the overpass. We loved throwing rocks in the water.
translation: 我10岁大的时候。我和露西在高架桥下玩，我们喜欢往水里扔石头子。

original: We saw some Wastelander trying to break open the Brahmin pens and steal one of them, so I ran over and told him to stop.
translation: 我们看见一个废土游民试图砸开双头牛的栅栏，想从里面偷一只，所以我跑过去叫他住手。

original: He just laughed and pushed me away. When I fell, suddenly my head started to hurt and my eyes got all blurry. It was almost like I blacked out.
translation: 他大笑着一把把我推开。等我倒下去，我的头突然开始刺痛，眼睛一片模糊。我像是快要昏厥了。

original: Next thing I know Lucy was pulling me off of the guy... I had ripped his throat open with my teeth.
translation: 接下来我所知道的事，是露西用力把我从那家伙身上拖下来……我已经用牙齿撕破了他的喉咙。

original: Would you mind if I asked about your unusual hunger?
translation: 问下你那不寻常的饥饿感，你介意吗？

original: I suppose not.
translation: 似乎不太合适。

original: No, thanks.
translation: 不了，谢谢。

original: Here's your 100 caps. Do it.
translation: 这是100个瓶盖，来吧。

original: Can you heal my radiation?
translation: 你能治疗我的辐射吗？

original: Sure can. Quick and easy, only 100 caps.
translation: 当然能。很快也很容易，只要100个瓶盖。

original: Who the hell are you supposed to be?
translation: 你他妈的是谁？

original: My name's Ian West. And who the hell are YOU supposed to be?
translation: 我叫伊恩·维斯特。那你他妈的又是谁？

original: Wait a second. I heard fighting. You're here to kill me aren't you?
translation: 等等，我听到打斗声，你是来杀我的对吧？

original: Are you a prisoner here or something?
translation: 你是囚犯还是什么？

original: No... not at all. My name's Ian West.
translation: 不……我叫伊恩·维斯特。

original: Wait a second. I heard fighting. You're here to kill me aren't you?
translation: 等等，我听到打斗声，你是来杀我的对吧？

original: Looks like I'm breaking you out of your cell...
translation: 看起来好像是我把你从囚室里救了出来……

original: ..Ian. My name's Ian West. Who are you?
translation: ……伊恩，我叫伊恩·维斯特，你是谁？

original: Wait a second. I heard fighting. You're here to kill me aren't you?
translation: 等等，我听到打斗声，你是来杀我的对吧？

original: What the hell is your problem?
translation: 你到底有什么问题？

original: I can't believe this is happening again! All the people I care about always leave me!
translation: 我不敢相信事情再次发生了！所有我关心人的总是离我而去！

original: Evan King probably sent you to look for me, didn't he!? Well you can tell him I'll never set foot in Arefu again. NEVER!
translation: 大概是埃万·金派你来找我的，对吧！？你可以告诉他，我绝不会再踏足断桥镇。绝不！

original: After what I did, he's the one that probably wants me dead.
translation: 在我干了那事之后，他大概正是想要我死的人。

original: I have no clue what you're talking about.
translation: 你说完全不知道你在说什么。

original: Evan King probably sent you to look for me, didn't he!? Well you can tell him I'll never set foot in Arefu again. NEVER!
translation: 大概是埃万·金派你来找我的，对吧！？你可以告诉他，我绝不会再踏足断桥镇。绝不！

original: After what I did, he's the one that probably wants me dead.
translation: 在我干了那事之后，他大概正是想要我死的人。

original: Calm down, Ian. Tell me everything from the beginning.
translation: 冷静，伊恩，从头告诉我整件事。

original: How the hell do you expect me to calm down? I can't believe this is happening again! All the people I care about always leave!
translation: 你他妈的怎么指望我冷静？我不敢相信事情再次发生了！所有我关心人的总是离我而去！

original: Evan King probably sent you to look for me, didn't he? Well you can tell him I'll never set foot in Arefu again. NEVER!
translation: 大概是埃万·金派你来找我的，对吧！？你可以告诉他，我绝不会再踏足断桥镇。绝不！

original: After what I did, he's the one that probably wants me dead.
translation: 在我干了那事之后，他大概正是想要我死的人。

original: Is there someplace I can sleep?
translation: 有我能睡觉的地方吗？

original: The common room is free, but the beds are lousy. It's on the midship deck. A big open room with lots of beds. You can't miss it.
translation: 公共休息室是免费的，但床铺被褥一塌糊涂，休息室在船的中层甲板。那是个开放性的大房间，里面有许多床。你肯定能找到的。

original: If you want to sleep well rested, rent a room from Vera Weatherly. She's on the upper deck.
translation: 你要想睡得舒服，找薇拉·韦瑟利租个房间，她在船的上甲板。

original: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易。

original: Okay. Here's what I have. What do you have?
translation: 好吧，这是我的货物，你那有什么？

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: This is all I have. I hope it's okay.
translation: 这是我全部的货物，希望你喜欢。

original: Well, this stuff is mostly crap. But whatever. Oh, and I found some weapons and armor, so I'll be trading in that. It's more useful anyway.
translation: 这些东西大部分都是垃圾，但管它呢。哦，我还找到了一些武器和装甲，让我们来交易那些吧，不管怎么说那更有用。

original: Alright. Let's see if we can't find something mutually agreeable.
translation: 好吧，我们看看能不能做一笔大家都满意的买卖。

original: Excellent!
translation: 好棒！

original: I'm sure you'll find something agreeable.
translation: 我保证你会找到喜欢的东西。

original: What's with all the names? Bob, Herbert and Harold? I don't get it.
translation: 鲍勃、赫伯特和哈罗德？这些名字都在指谁？我搞不懂。

original: Okay, okay. Let me talk real careful for the slow folks.
translation: 好啦，好啦。让我给脑子转得慢的人仔细讲讲。

original: I was once a man a long time ago named Harold. Something in me changed and a weird little tree started growing right out of my head.
translation: 很久以前，我曾是一个叫哈罗德的人。我身体里有什么东西发生了变化，一棵怪异的小树竟然从我头上长了出来。

original: It kept getting bigger until I ended up stuck inside. When people would ask about it, I decided to name it Bob. You know, like a friend or something.
translation: 它越长越大，最后我被困在了里面。当人们问起这棵树时，我决定给它取名叫鲍勃。你懂的，就好像它是我的朋友之类的。

original: Sometimes I call him Herbert instead of Bob, because I get bored and I think it's funny. So long story short, call me Harold!
translation: 因为觉得无聊，有时候我会叫它赫伯特，而不叫它鲍勃，我觉得那很有趣。长话短说吧，你可以叫我哈罗德！

original: I'm not a charity. You want to die, cough up some caps.
translation: 我可不是慈善机构。你想死，就拿出点瓶盖来。

original: Well, I used to carry those pesky caps a long time ago, but I think my pockets are in those shrubs over yonder.
translation: 呃，很久以前我确实带着那些烦人的瓶盖，但我觉得我的口袋在那边的灌木丛里。

original: I'm pretty sure the caves below me are full of all kinds of nifty gizmos you could take on your way to my heart. Help yourself!
translation: 我很确定，在我下面的洞穴里满是各种精巧的小玩意儿，在你去毁掉我心脏的路上可以随便拿。随便用！

original: You're mostly a tree, right? Can't I just burn you down?
translation: 你大体上是一棵树，对吧？我能不能直接把你烧掉？

original: Oh, no no no no! Fire would be too painful for me and poor old Bob. Keep that stuff away from us!
translation: 哦，不不不不！火会让我和可怜的老鲍勃太痛苦了。让那玩意离我们远点！

original: The heart would be just fine... I won't feel a thing.
translation: 毁掉心脏就行……我不会有任何感觉的。

original: We've been in here for 3 months now, and it's way better than it used to be. Who says kids can't take care of themselves?
translation: 我们在这已经三个月了，情况已经有所好转，谁说孩子不能照顾自己的？

original: Jason has done a really good job keeping everyone busy. He says if we want to survive, we need to work together, and work hard.
translation: 杰森干得不错，他让每个人都有事可做。他说如果我们要活下去，就必须一起工作，努力工作。

original: A few of the kids have started saying we're like a whole new city. A city of kids. They call it "Little Lamplight." It's so cool.
translation: 不少孩子表示说喜欢这个新城市，一个孩子城，他们管它叫“小灯镇”，太酷了。

original: All of us voted, in secret, and tomorrow we're going to tell Jason that he's the city's first mayor! He's going to be so happy with us.
translation: 我们所有人进行了不记名投票，明天我们要告诉杰森，他是这的第一任镇长！他和我们一起会非常快乐。

original: It's been almost two months, and we're all doing pretty good, even if we are all alone.
translation: 几乎快两个月了，我们做得相当好，即使都只靠我们自己。

original: There's a door that leads to a Vault, right here in the caverns. Every day we bang and bang, but they won't let us in. We can hear them in there!
translation: 洞穴里有扇门通向避难所，我们每天跑过去敲门，可他们不让我们进去。我们能听得出他们在里面！

original: One time, a guy on the other side told us we were dead already. Fuck those grown ups. Fuck them all. We don't need them ever again.
translation: 一次，对面一个家伙告诉我们，已经当我们死了。那些他妈的大人，真他妈的。我们再也不需要他们了。

original: Um... I guess this thing is working. I'm Jason Grant. I'm 10 years old. I'm in Mrs. Delaney's class at Early Dawn Elementary.
translation: 嗯……我猜这东西开始录音了。我叫杰森·格兰特，今年10岁。我在拂晓小学德莱尼老师的班里上学。

original: A month ago, the big war came and everything was destroyed. Except us. We're still okay in these caves. Kind of.
translation: 一个月前，大战来临，除了我们之外的一切都被毁了。我们躲在这洞穴里。

original: Mrs. Delaney went out this morning to get help, and she never came back. The other adults never came back either. So now it's just us kids.
translation: 今天早上德莱尼夫人离开去寻求帮助，她再也没有回来。其他大人也是再也没有回来。现在只剩下我们这些孩子了。

original: A lot of the others still cry every day. They're really scared. I'm not. There's nothing to be scared of, as long as we don't go outside.
translation: 其他人整天在哭，他们真的怕得要命。我不怕，这没什么好害怕的，只要我们不出去。

original: Nobody else wants to be in charge, so I'm going to try. Most of the kids listen to me already, so it should be easy.
translation: 没别人能照顾我们了，所以我想试一试。大多数孩子已经开始听我的话了，所以这事应该很容易。

original: We're all okay. If you can call being stuck in a cave with 82 terrified kids okay. Alive, anyway. But I don't know what the hell we're going to do.
translation: 如果你觉得和八十二个吓坏了的孩子困在一个洞里也叫好的话。我们都很好。不管怎样，我们都活着。但我不知道接下来该怎么办。

original: It's been 4 days. Claudia went out this morning to look around, and never came back. Then Mr. Cob went out to look for her, and HE never came back.
translation: 第4天了。今天早上克劳迪娅跑出去看看，就再也没有回来。之后凯博先生出去找她，他也再没回来。

original: So now there's only me, two other teachers, two of the parents who were chaperoning, and a few of the cavern staff. And all these poor kids.
translation: 所以，现在这只剩我，两位老师，还有两位陪同过来的母亲，洞穴的几个工作人员。另外就是这些可怜的孩子。

original: We've got enough food and water to last for awhile, I guess. But after that? I just don't know. We can't stay in here forever. Can we?
translation: 我想我们有足够的食物和水支撑一阵。但用完之后呢？我不知道。我们不能永远待在这，我们能吗？

original: My name is Carrie Delaney. I teach fourth grade at the Early Dawn Elementary School, in Washington, D.C.
translation: 我叫凯丽·德莱尼，执教于华盛顿特区拂晓小学教四年级。

original: Yesterday, October 23, 2077, half the school went on a field trip to Lamplight Caverns. We were packing up to leave when… when everything went crazy.
translation: 昨天，2077年10月23日，半个学校的学生实地参观小灯镇洞穴。当我们正要离开时，一切都变得疯狂了。

original: The caves started shaking, the lights went out, the kids started screaming. My God... Mister Pollack went outside to see what was going on.
translation: 洞穴开始剧烈摇晃，灯都灭了，孩子们在尖叫。我的天……波拉克先生跑出去看发生了什么。

original: When he came back in, he told us what he saw. Clouds. Mushroom clouds. It's finally happened. The end of the world.
translation: 他回来告诉我们，他看到了云，蘑菇云。世界末日最终还是到来了。

original: Tell me about the Rebels.
translation: 跟我说说这些反叛者。

original: I wouldn't call us "rebels." I mean, we don't agree with the Overseer, but we still love the Vault. We just want to try going outside, too.
translation: 我不会称我们为“反叛者”。我的意思是，我们不同意监督者，但我们始终热爱这避难所。只是我们也想出去。

original: The Overseer thinks he's in charge of us, just because it's his job? Well, nuts to that! We do what we want, and we want to open the Vault!
translation: 监督者认为他说了算，就因为那是他的工作？胡说！我们做我们想做的事，我们要开放避难所！

original: I hate that this whole thing has turned us against our families, but we just can't keep living down here forever. I mean, look at this place!
translation: 这整件事使我们和自己的家庭反目，我讨厌这样，但我们不能永远活在这。我的意思是，看看这地方！

original: Most of them are just kids who're caught up in the idea of seeing the world. But I know we've got to actually open the Vault if we want to survive.
translation: 大部分抱着见识外面世界想法的都是孩子。而我知道，如果我们要活下去，我们就要开放避难所。

original: Otherwise, we're just going to dwindle away down here, until it's all too late.
translation: 否则，我们只是在这儿苟延残喘，一切终将无法挽回。

original: Oh, dear, we aren't asking for anything special. The Vault's been open before, but for some reason, everyone tries to pretend it wasn't.
translation: 哦，亲爱的，我们的要求不过份。这避难所以前开放过，但因为一些原因，人人都装作它没有开放过。

original: I guess they try to forget the poor souls who never came back from out there.
translation: 我想他们想要忘掉那些出去之后再也没有回来的可怜家伙。

original: Tell me about the rebels.
translation: 跟我说说这些反叛者。

original: They're a bunch of hellions, that's what they are. I'm at my wits' end about them, I really am.
translation: 他们是群恶人，千真万确。我对他们已经束手无策了，真的。

original: Those kids are risking our entire Vault, just because they're bored. It's horrible!
translation: 那些孩子拿我们整个避难所去冒险，只是因为他们觉得无聊。太可恶了！

original: It's just a phase they're going through. Every kid thinks they want to leave the Vault at some point, but we all grew out of it.
translation: 他们处在一个必经的阶段，每个孩子到一定年龄都想要离开避难所，但我们长大后都放弃了这想法。

original: What do you expect from idiots like them? I'm just glad I was done with Butch's stupid gang before they got involved in all this.
translation: 对于他们那样的白痴你能抱什么期望？我只是很高兴在布奇的愚蠢帮派卷进这件事之前，我就和他们断绝了关系。

original: More kids looking to get us all killed. Now it's up to security to keep them in line.
translation: 又有更多孩子想害死我们所有人。现在得靠警卫来管教他们了。

original: They don't know what they're doing, and it's up to us adults to keep them from getting everyone killed.
translation: 他们纯粹是胡闹，现在要靠我们成年人来阻止他们害死所有人了。

original: I expect as much from some of those idiot kids and batty old Palmer, but I expected more sense from Brotch.
translation: 我对那些蠢孩子不报任何希望，就像对古怪的老帕尔默一样。但我曾更希望布洛彻能有所作为。

original: I tell you, I'm scared of them. I never know when they're going to try something dangerous!
translation: 告诉你，我怕他们。我不知道他们什么时候会铤而走险！

original: What happened down here?
translation: 这儿发生了什么？

original: It's all kind of blurry for me, but I hear I owe you for saving me. But don't expect much. The whole thing was your Dad's fault in the first place!
translation: 一切都让我有些摸不着头脑，但我听说我欠你的情，你救了我的命，不过别指望我给你太多回报。整件事是你爸爸有错在先！

original: The bugs were horrible, but my family was pretty lucky. But then my Freddie went and got caught up with those idiot rebels!
translation: 这些虫子很可怕，但我的家人非常幸运。不过后来我的弗雷迪被那些白痴反叛者抓走了！

original: With all of the bugs and the fires, there was an awful lot of strain on the systems down on the reactor level.
translation: 因为这些虫子和大火，反应堆系统发生了严重的损坏。

original: Our water chip's pretty delicate right now, but I'm working on setting her right again.
translation: 我们的水芯片现在相当脆弱，不过我正想法恢复正常。

original: You shoulda seen my pop, he personally saved old Stanley! But  guess you wouldn't know what it's like to have a hero for a dad, would you?
translation: 你应该见见我爸爸，他一个人救了老斯坦利！但我想你不会知道有一个英雄爸爸是什么感觉，对吧？ ?

original: After what happened to Vikki and my boy that night, your corpse should be strung up as a warning to anyone else thinks about heading outside.
translation: 经过那晚威基和我儿子发生的事后，应该把你的尸体吊起来作为对任何想要跑出去的人的警告。

original: Bugs. Fires. Confusion. Panic. What do you care? You and your dad started the whole mess.
translation: 虫子、大火、混乱、恐慌，你操心什么？这些都是你和你爸爸引起的。

original: We were so busy fighting those bugs, there wasn't anyone to help put out the fires that started after you left. It was horrible.
translation: 你离开之后，我们忙于和那些虫子搏命，没有任何人去灭火。太可怕了。

original: I lost my poor wife Agnes, is what happened. In all the chaos and fighting, her old ticker just couldn't take it anymore.
translation: 我失去了我可怜的妻子阿尼亚斯。在混乱和战斗中，她那老迈的心脏再也承受不起了。

original: Mom and little Monica got caught in the fires. I tried to get them out, I really did, but it was just too hot.
translation: 妈妈和小莫尼卡陷入火海，我试图把他们救出来，真的，但火势太旺了。

original: I know it wasn't your fault, but my dad doesn't think as highly of you. You wouldn't want to hear what he said he'd do to your dad, either.
translation: 我知道不是你的错，但我爸爸不这么认为。我想你不会愿意听到他说他想怎么处置你爸爸的。

original: Paul got bit real bad by some of those Radroaches, but he thought he could tough it out. If we'd had a doctor to treat him, he might still be here.
translation: 保罗被那些辐射蟑螂咬伤很严重，他以为他能挺过去。我们要是有医生治疗他，他可能现在还活着。

original: A lot of security got wounded and worse. In all the confusion, we still don't know who's responsible for some of them.
translation: 不少警卫受了伤，而且伤势恶化。在这一片混乱中，我们都不知道该有谁来负责他们。

original: It was pretty rough, I'll tell you. I know a lot of folks blame your dad, but I know he didn't mean to cause all that. Don't blame him, or yourself.
translation: 我告诉你，这简直糟透了。我明白不少人责怪你爸爸，但我知道他并不是有意要造成那种结果。别怪他，也别责怪自己。

original: My poor grandson Jonas died, is what happened. They say it was just an accident in all the confusion, but I know it was the Overseer.
translation: 我可怜的孙子乔纳斯死了。他们说那只是混乱中的意外事故，但我知道是监督者干的。

original: Where can I rent a bed?
translation: 我能在哪租到床？

original: Up at Moriarty's at the south end of town. Talk to Nova, she'll help you out.
translation: 在莫里亚蒂那的上层，镇子的最南端。找诺瓦谈，她会帮助你。

original: I'm the one who saved the kids from Paradise Falls.
translation: 是我从堕落天堂救了这些孩子。

original: Oh yeah? Well why didn't you say so, you stupid mungo?
translation: 哦，是吗？你为什么不说，你这愚蠢的毛人？

original: The ship's water isn't much better. If we don't get fresh water soon, we'll all end up like her.
translation: 船上的水也好不到哪儿去。要是我们不尽快弄到淡水，我们最终都会落得和她一样的下场。

original: Yeah. I heard she was drinking river water.
translation: 是啊。我听说她一直在喝河水。

original: What can you tell me about Mabel Henderson?
translation: 你能跟我说说梅布尔·亨德森吗？

original: Janet... Well, Janet and I don't see Mabel very often. Janet doesn't seem to like her very much.
translation: 珍妮特……珍妮特和我并不常常见到梅布尔。珍妮特好像不太喜欢她。

original: I'm not really complaining. Last time we were over there, I bumped my head on that gigantic chandelier she has. Not anxious to do that again.
translation: 我真的不想抱怨。我们上次去她那，我的头不小心在她那盏巨大的装饰灯上撞了个包。以后我们再也不想去了。

original: Roger and I don't spend much time with Mabel, frankly. She's a little nosey for my tastes. And I don't like visiting her house, either.
translation: 坦白说，罗杰和我没有太多时间和梅布尔交往，她有点唠叨，不太合我的性格。我也不喜欢她的房子。

original: That robot she's got makes me nervous. She says it's perfectly safe, but something about it... it just makes me uncomfortable.
translation: 她的那台机器人令我神经紧张。她说它绝对安全，但它的行为举止……只是让我觉得很不安。

original: Mabel's been a good friend to me. She's always interested in what's going on with my life, which is more than I can say for some people.
translation: 梅布尔是我的好朋友。她对我生活上的事总是兴致勃勃，没别的人像她那样和我交心。

original: I'll sometimes go over to her house and chat while she's baking. She really loves to bake... Uses that oven all the time.
translation: 我不时去她房子里坐坐，陪着她聊天，看她烧烤。她真的喜欢烧烤……一直都用那烤箱。

original: She sure loves baking her pies. Always bringing them around, bragging about her fancy oven.
translation: 她真的热衷烤派，给大家吃，并夸耀她神奇的烤箱。

original: I'm not one to turn down a good pie, but it gets a bit tiresome hearing her go on and on.
translation: 我不是个能拒绝好吃的派的人，但听她不停的唠唠叨叨也会觉得有点无聊。

original: Mabel? She's nice enough, I suppose. A bit of a gossip, maybe. And she never seemed too fond of my boy Timmy.
translation: 梅布尔？我觉得她是个好人，可能就是有点絮絮叨叨。她好像一直都不喜欢我的儿子提米。

original: She was just complaining about his rollerskates the other day. Said Timmy left them in her house, and that they were dangerous.
translation: 她前些天还在抱怨说，提米把他的轮滑靴扔在了她的房子里，那很危险。

original: If they're so dangerous, why didn't she just bring them here when she came to complain about it?
translation: 要是真的危险，那她抱怨时，她为什么不把它们送回来？

original: Fond of her gadgets, she is. Heck, I can't count the number of times I've had to fix that new-fangled robot of hers.
translation: 她喜欢她的小玩意。糟糕的是，我不记得我帮她修了多少次她那新奇的机器人。

original: I keep telling her to order some new parts. The motivator goes bad on that one, and she's going to have a real problem on her hands.
translation: 我叮嘱她去买点新零件。抑制器坏了，如果继续使用她会有麻烦。

original: Sorry, sounds like suicide. Be my guest.
translation: 抱歉，这听起来像是自杀。请便。

original: I dunno why you bothered to come here and wake me then. I would have been better off sleeping through it.
translation: 我不知道你为什么要来叫醒我，让我继续睡着更好。

original: Start from the beginning.
translation: 从头开始。

original: We were mapping the Vernon Square part of the downtown ruins and got jumped by a Super Mutant ambush party.
translation: 我们当时正在前往市区废墟的弗农广场部分，结果遭遇了一群埋伏在那的超级变种人。

original: Usually it isn't a problem, but this group was bigger than usual. We fought our way into Our Lady of Hope Hospital, hoping to find cover.
translation: 通常来说，这不算什么，但这次的队伍比通常庞大。我们杀出了一条通往玛利亚医院的路来，希望能够找到掩护。

original: Tell me what's going on and I'll see if I can help.
translation: 告诉我出了什么事，看我能否帮忙。

original: We were mapping the Vernon Square part of the downtown ruins and got jumped by a Super Mutant ambush party.
translation: 我们当时正在前往市区废墟的弗农广场部分，结果遭遇了一群埋伏在那的超级变种人。

original: Usually it isn't a problem, but this group was bigger than usual. We fought our way into Our Lady of Hope Hospital, hoping to find cover.
translation: 通常来说，这不算什么，但这次的队伍比通常庞大。我们杀出了一条通往玛利亚医院的路来，希望能够找到掩护。

original: Your team's still alive... I heard their distress signal!
translation: 你的队伍还活着……我收到了他们的求救信号！

original: They are?! Holy shit!
translation: 真的吗？真他妈的走运！

original: Look, either I need to get out there and lend them a hand or they aren't going to last much longer.
translation: 听着，要是我不去帮他们一把，他们是撑不了多久的。

original: I saved the Vault, and now you're kicking me out?
translation: 我救了避难所，而你却要把我赶出去？

original: No, it's not like that. But if you stay, it'll just keep causing more problems. The Vault can't take any more in-fighting. It's just what has to be.
translation: 不，不是那样。但如果你留下来，只会造成更多麻烦。这避难所已经承受不起动荡，没别的选择了。

original: It'll be a while before we're ready to really go outside. But once the Vault is stable again, maybe we'll see you out there.
translation: 我们需要时间才能真正准备好走出这。等避难所的局势稳定了，我们说不定会在外面相见。

original: So I guess this is goodbye for now. It's not much, but take this with you, to remember us by. With luck, we'll meet again.
translation: 我看该说再见了。虽然比较寒酸，但请你带上，它会让你想起我们。一路顺风，我们会再见的。

original: I understand. Goodbye, Amata.
translation: 我懂了。再见，阿玛塔。

original: We can never really thank you enough for everything you've done. It's not much, but take this with you, to remember us by.
translation: 你所做的一切，我们再怎么感谢你也不为过。虽然比较寒酸，但请你带上，它会让你想起我们。

original: It'll be a while before we're actually ready to go outside. But once the Vault is stable again, maybe we'll see you out there.
translation: 我们需要时间才能真正准备好走出这。等避难所的局势稳定了，我们说不定会在外面相见。

original: So I guess this is goodbye for now. But with luck, we'll meet again.
translation: 我看该说再见了。一路顺风，我们会再见的。

original: Why don't you just forget about it and clear on out of here?
translation: 你为什么不忘掉它，然后离开这？

original: Look, my dad used to always say "You can do whatever you want in life but the family comes first."
translation: 听着，我爸爸以前常说“你一生中可以做任何想做的事，但家庭必须摆在第一位。”

original: If I left now, I'd just be running away. I can't do that. I owe him.
translation: 如果我离开，那只是在逃避。我不能那么做，我欠他的。

original: Look, anything else you can do to help might save lives.
translation: 听着，你可以再做点别的，或许还能救几条命。

original: You know, maybe this will help and maybe it won't, but pappa hid a bunch of stuff behind the old diner in a dumpster.
translation: 不知道这消息对你有用没，爸爸在旧餐馆后的一个垃圾桶里面藏了些东西。

original: He trusted me with the key and said it was for emergencies, but I bet he wouldn't mind you having it.
translation: 他把钥匙信任地交给了我，已备不时之需，我想他不会介意我把钥匙给你的。

original: Will's dad was scary? How so?
translation: 威尔的爸爸很恐怖？你怎么会这么觉得？

original: He was like always watching me and my dad real careful, like he didn't trust us or something.
translation: 他总神经兮兮地拿眼睛瞪我和我爸爸，好像他信不过我们还是怎么。

original: He always kept staring at us from the windows of his house and typing stuff into his TV box.
translation: 他总是透过他的窗户盯着我们，手里不停的往他的电视盒里打字。

original: Will said his dad was like an old soldier or something, but he didn't like doing that stuff so he quit.
translation: 威尔说他爸爸是个老兵还是什么的，不过他不喜欢当兵，所以他后来不干了。

original: How about Will's parents?
translation: 威尔的父母怎么样？

original: Well, his mom was nice too. She was kind of quiet, but she always took care of me and my pappa when we came over.
translation: 他妈妈人也很好。她有点安静，不过我们要是去做客，她总会款待我和我爸爸。

original: I think she was sad that my mom was gone.
translation: 我觉得我妈妈死了后，他心里很难过。

original: Will's dad was... well, I don't wanna be mean... but he was kinda scary.
translation: 威尔的爸爸……好吧，我不想说三道四……但他有点神经兮兮。

original: So, you and Will were good friends?
translation: 这么说你和威尔是好朋友？

original: Yeah, Will was super nice to me. He was like a year older than me I think. He even shared his comic books with me.
translation: 是的，威尔对我超好。他好像比我大一岁。他甚至和我分享他的漫画书。

original: We explored pretty much every bit of Grayditch we could find. I think that's why the ants don't bother me... I have good hiding spots.
translation: 我们把格雷蒂奇能探究的地方搜了个遍。我想那些蚂蚁之所以不来打搅我……是因为我们有好的藏身点。

original: Where did the Brandices live?
translation: 布兰迪斯一家住在哪？

original: Right across the street actually. It was pretty swell having someone to hang out with so close by.
translation: 街的对面就是。有个人住得离我们那么近真让人高兴。

original: About the other people from Grayditch...
translation: 说说格雷蒂奇其他的人……

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: Tell me about the Brandice Family.
translation: 跟我说说布兰迪斯一家的情况。

original: Well, there was Will... he was sorta my friend. And then there was his dad and his mom.
translation: 这有威尔……他可以说是我的朋友，还有他的爸爸和妈妈。

original: Tell me about this "Doc Lesko."
translation: 跟我说说这“莱斯科博士”。

original: He was a strange man. He paid pappa some caps to help him build a shack and carry a bunch of junk into it.
translation: 他很奇怪。他给爸爸一些钱，请他帮忙修了个小屋，然后往里面塞了一捆垃圾。

original: Pappa called him an egghead, but his head was shaped regular, so I didn't get it.
translation: 爸爸管他叫书呆子，但他的神情并不呆滞，所以我不明白他说的是什么意思。

original: Mind if I ask about some of the people who lived here?
translation: 介不介意我问一下住在这的人？

original: Naw, go ahead. It's just nice to talk to anyone about stuff at all.
translation: 不介意，问吧。很高兴和你聊这的人和事。

original: <whistling>
translation: <口哨>

original: I heard you bake really tasty pies. Can you make one for me?
translation: 我听说你烤的派超美味，能满足下我的胃吗？

original: Well sure I can, sweetie!
translation: 当然可以啦，宝贝！

original: Let me just go light the oven to get it warming up.
translation: 我这就去点上烤箱预热一下。

original: The People's Republic of China claims this land as its own! Your evil, materialistic ways are at an end, American dogs! Men, open fire!
translation: 中华人民共和国解放了这片土地！你们这些邪恶的美国狗，资本主义的末日到了！同志们，开火！

original: Dad? Is that really you?
translation: 爸爸？真的是你吗？

original: <bark! bark!>
translation: <吠叫！吠叫！>

original: You want help? Fork over some caps, Einstein.
translation: 你要帮忙？那就给点瓶盖吧，爱因斯坦。

original: Why can't man follow the ant's example? They work together as a team... every waking moment dedicated to the colony.
translation: 为什么人类不能效仿蚂蚁呢？他们团队般的协作……醒着的每一刻都奉献给蚁群。

original: They require no wealth or material items... everything they need is provided for them by their fellow insects.
translation: 它们对金钱与物质没有追求……他们所需要的都提供给了他们的同伴。

original: But I digress. If it's payment you need, all I can offer is one of my Mutagenic Bioenhancers.
translation: 但我跑题了。如果你需要报酬，我所能提供的只有我的诱变生物增强剂。

original: Books aren't going to buy me new ammunition.
translation: 书本可不会给我买新弹药。

original: Why can't man follow the ant's example? They work together as a team... every waking moment dedicated to the colony.
translation: 为什么人类不能效仿蚂蚁呢？他们团队般的协作……醒着的每一刻都奉献给蚁群。

original: They require no wealth or material items... everything they need is provided for them by their fellow insects.
translation: 它们对金钱与物质没有追求……他们所需要的都提供给了他们的同伴。

original: But I digress. If it's payment you need, all I can offer is one of my Mutagenic Bioenhancers.
translation: 但我跑题了。如果你需要报酬，我所能提供的只有我的诱变生物增强剂。

original: Is there anyone on this ship named Pinkerton?
translation: 这船上有个叫平克顿的人吗？

original: Now there's a name I haven't heard in a while.
translation: 我有段时间没听人提起这名字了。

original: Never met the man myself, but rumor has it he helped found Rivet City.
translation: 我从没见过这个人，但据说他协助建立了铆钉城。

original: Some rumors say he died trying to loot the broken bow of the ship. Others say he joined up with the Enclave.
translation: 有些人说他到断裂的船头找什么东西，结果死了。这艘船的船头和船体是断开的。还有流言他说加入了英克雷。

original: Is there anyone on this ship named Pinkerton?
translation: 这船上有个叫平克顿的人吗？

original: You mean genius boy?
translation: 你是说天才小子？

original: Yeah, I've heard of him. Supposedly built Rivet City. They probably think he invented bread too. Idiots.
translation: 嗯，我听说过他。据说他建造了铆钉城。他们大概也以为他发明了面包。一群白痴。

original: Lately he's even been blamed for the noises in the broken ship bow. Anyone with half a brain would know that's just the Mirelurks.
translation: 最近，他甚至被指责为断开船头噪音的罪魁祸首。哪怕只有半个脑袋的人都该明白，那是泥沼蟹在作怪。

original: You ever hear of a guy named Pinkerton?
translation: 你有没听说过叫平克顿的家伙？

original: Pinkerton, eh? That name takes me way back. Claimed to have cured radiation poisoning. Or was it food poisoning? I don't recall.
translation: 平克顿，嗯？这名字让我想起了好久以前。他声称治愈了辐射中毒，还是食物中毒来着？我记不清了。

original: He was always telling folks that he founded Rivet City. All he did was break off the front of it. Or did he die there? I don't recall.
translation: 他总不停地跟人说，是他创建了铆钉城。他所做的就是断开了前端部分。还是他就死在那里了？我记不清了。

original: You know of someone named Pinkerton?
translation: 你认识叫平克顿的人吗？

original: That idiot? He left so long ago, most folk don't even remember him.
translation: 那白痴？他离开很久了，大多数人甚至都不记得他了。

original: He claimed to have found a secret stash of technology somewhere in the ship. Then he just disappeared.
translation: 他声称在这船的某处发现了一批秘密的技术宝藏。后来他就消失了。

original: You ever hear of someone named Pinkerton?
translation: 你听说过一个叫平克顿的人吗？

original: What a moron. Always going on about how he started Rivet City. Who gives a crap?
translation: 就是个蠢货，总喋喋不休地讲述他是怎样开始建造铆钉城的。谁会去理会这些废话？

original: Right before he disappeared, he was going on about some new fangled contraption he was sure was in the broken bow of the ship.
translation: 他失踪前，总唠唠叨叨一些新的技术装置，他确信那些玩意就在断裂的船头里。

original: I'm looking for someone named Pinkerton. Ring any bells?
translation: 我在找一个叫平克顿的人。有印象吗？

original: Don't you believe the rumors. His ghost is certainly NOT haunting the bow of the ship. Now, if you'll excuse me. I have work to do.
translation: 你别信这些谣言。当然不会有他的幽灵在船头游荡。抱歉，我还有工作要做。

original: I'm tracking down a guy named Pinkerton. Do you know where I can find him?
translation: 我在寻找叫平克顿的家伙。你知道我在哪能找到他？

original: Are those rumors still floating around? Look, I don't have time for swapping ghost stories with you.
translation: 那些流言还没停止？听着，我没时间和你讨论幽灵故事。

original: Pinkerton's a legend. Dead or long gone. Don't care much as I've got real people to take care of. Go bother someone else.
translation: 平克顿是个传说，要么死了要么早跑了。我还得操心身边的人呢。你去烦别人吧。

original: You know what, keep your caps and I'll tell Moriarty you're gone.
translation: 这样吧，留着你的瓶盖，我会告诉莫里亚蒂你已经走了。

original: You'd do that for me? I can't believe it... you hardly even know me!
translation: 你真的愿意帮我吗？我不敢相信……你几乎都不认识我！

original: Thanks, kid. You watch yourself out there.
translation: 谢谢你，孩子。自己多加小心。

original: This is a hefty task, Doc. I'm going to need serious incentive.
translation: 这是艰巨的任务，博士，我需要点强力的激励。

original: Yes, I suppose you're right. Science must learn to acquiesce to your standards in order to advance itself.
translation: 是的，我想你是对的。科学为了自身的进步，必须学会接纳你的标准。

original: I was merely going to offer one of my Mutagenic Bioenhancers, but I suppose I could up the ante.
translation: 我本打算只提供一种我的诱变生物增强剂，不过我想我可以提高报酬。

original: I will also award you with my old lab coat. It's served me well over the years... and you may find it useful for your own experiments.
translation: 我再送你一件旧的实验室外套，它跟了我好多年……你可能会发现它对你的实验很有用。

original: So you want me to pop the Queen, huh?
translation: 你是要我用枪干掉蚁后，呃？

original: Oh! No, no, no! The Queen mustn't be harmed at all! Months of work would be lost!
translation: 哦！不，不，不！你不要碰蚁后！要不然我几个月的工作就全毁了！

original: Your objective would be to eliminate what I call her quintet of Nest Guardians. Filthy little abominations!
translation: 你的任务是干掉她的守卫，我管它们叫守卫蚁五重奏。恶心的东西！

original: Why not just kill the Queen and be done with it?
translation: 为什么不直接干掉蚁后，那不就全搞定了？

original: If I were to do that months of data would be lost. No, no... the Queen must remain completely unharmed.
translation: 我要是那么做，几个月的数据就全报废了。不，不……蚁后要毫发无伤地留着。

original: Your objective would be to eliminate what I call her quintet of Nest Guardians. Filthy little abominations!
translation: 你的任务是干掉她的守卫，我管它们叫守卫蚁五重奏。恶心的东西！

original: If the Queen's your concern, why not deal with it directly?
translation: 如果问题出在蚁后身上，为什么不直接把她处理掉？

original: If she were harmed in any way, months of data would be lost.
translation: 我要是那么做，几个月的数据就全报废了。

original: Your objective would be to eliminate what I call her quintet of Nest Guardians. Filthy little abominations!
translation: 你的任务是干掉她的守卫，我管它们叫守卫蚁五重奏。恶心的东西！

original: So? It's your mistake Doc, you fix it.
translation: 那是你犯下的错误，博士，你自己处理吧。

original: Please, don't insult my intelligence. Had I been able to correct this error easily I would have done so long before you arrived.
translation: 请别侮辱我的智商。我要是有能力纠正这错误，你没来之前我就处理了。

original: My portable terminal is set up in the Hatchery Chamber near the Ant Queen. If I can reach it, I can continue to work on improving the mutagen.
translation: 我的便携式终端安装在孵化场内的蚁后附近，你要是能拿到它，我就能继续改进诱变剂。

original: What exactly do you need?
translation: 直说吧，你要我怎么帮忙？

original: My portable terminal is set up in the Hatchery Chamber near the Ant Queen. If I can reach it, I can continue to work on improving the mutagen.
translation: 我的便携式终端安装在孵化场内的蚁后附近，你要是能拿到它，我就能继续改进诱变剂。

original: What can I do to help?
translation: 我能帮忙做什么？

original: Since you've offered, allow me to elaborate.
translation: 既然你有兴趣了，那就允许我详细地描述一下。

original: My portable terminal is set up in the Hatchery Chamber near the Ant Queen. If I can reach it, I can continue to work on improving the mutagen.
translation: 我的便携式终端安装在孵化场内的蚁后附近，你要是能拿到它，我就能继续改进诱变剂。

original: Sir, I encountered three Ferals on my patrol.  This was somewhere around 0300 hours, I think, and it was dark, so they saw me first.
translation: 长官，我在巡逻中碰到了三个凶悍僵尸。我想当时时间大约是0300，光线很暗，所以是他们先看见了我。

original: I discharged my firearm four times, fatally striking two of the three.  My weapon jammed before I could fire on the third target.
translation: 我换了四次弹夹，击倒了其中两个。就在我要向第三个目标开火时，我的枪卡住了。

original: Just then I realized it wasn't engaging.  I knew our orders were to report on anything unusual, and well -- I thought that was pretty strange.
translation: 就在那时，我意识到它没有进攻。我明白我们的命令是报告任何不寻常的事，反正 — 我认为那相当奇怪。

original: He actually followed me back on his own.  We put him in the trailer with the other and he's been quiet as you like.  Strangest thing I've ever seen.
translation: 他事实上只是跟着我。我们后来把它击倒了，他的样子很安静。那是我曾见过的最奇怪的事。

original: Mutagenic Bio-what?
translation: “突变体基因活性增强剂”是什么？

original: I've managed to isolate some of the Fire Ant genes and distill them into human-safe genetic enhancers!
translation: 我设法离析了一些火蚁基因，蒸馏出对人体无害的基因强化剂！

original: I can inject you with one of these formulas and you'll find yourself with either enhanced strength or enhanced perception!
translation: 我可以把这些强化过的基因分子注入你的体内，提升你的力量或者感知！随你选。

original: Not only that, but you'll be somewhat more resistant to fire! How marvelous!
translation: 不仅这样，你还能提升一定的抗火能力！真不可思议！

original: This will stop the Fire Ants?
translation: 这能阻止火蚁吗？

original: No, it should all wrap up rather nicely.  I've rigged my equipment at my portable terminal to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
translation: 岂止如此，应该很有效。我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了我的设备，从而发射一种抑制脉冲。

original: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
translation: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失它们与蚁后之间的情感联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

original: So, that's all there is to it. What do you say?
translation: 就是这么回事。你说怎样？

original: No, it should all wrap up rather nicely.  I've rigged my equipment to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
translation: 岂止如此，应该很有效。我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了我的设备，从而发射一种抑制脉冲。

original: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
translation: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失它们与蚁后之间的情感联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

original: However, there is one final detail I need your help with. Could you do something about Bryan Wilks for me?
translation: 可是，还有最后的一个细节需要你帮忙。你能帮我处理一下布赖恩·威尔克斯的事吗？

original: I hope that's everything, I've had enough of ants.
translation: 我希望一切都结束了，我受够蚂蚁了。

original: Yes, it should all wrap up rather nicely. I've rigged my equipment at my portable terminal to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
translation: 是的，应该很有效。我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了我的设备，从而发射一种抑制脉冲。

original: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
translation: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失它们与蚁后之间的情感联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

original: So, that's all there is to it. What do you say?
translation: 就是这么回事。你说怎样？

original: That's everything to do with the ants, yes indeed. I've rigged my equipment to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
translation: 就是这些了，嗯，没错。我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了我的设备，从而发射一种抑制脉冲。

original: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
translation: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失它们与蚁后之间的情感联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

original: However, there is one final detail I need your help with. Could you do something about Bryan Wilks for me?
translation: 可是，还有最后的一个细节需要你帮忙。你能帮我处理一下布赖恩·威尔克斯的事吗？

original: Just how will all this undo the mayhem you've caused?
translation: 要怎样做才能终止你造成的混乱？

original: I've rigged the equipment at my portable terminal to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
translation: 我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了我的设备，用来发射一种我称之为抑制脉冲的脉冲。

original: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
translation: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失它们与蚁后之间的情感联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

original: So, that's all there is to it. What do you say?
translation: 就是这么回事。你说怎样？

original: I've rigged the equipment at my portable terminal to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
translation: 我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了我的设备，用来发射一种我称之为抑制脉冲的脉冲。

original: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
translation: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失它们与蚁后之间的情感联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

original: However, there is one final detail I need your help with. Could you do something about Bryan Wilks for me?
translation: 可是，还有最后的一个细节需要你帮忙。你能帮我处理一下布赖恩·威尔克斯的事吗？

original: I found him, actually... inside Marigold Metro.
translation: 我找到他了，事实上……是在玛丽戈德地铁里。

original: Really?! Oh my gosh!
translation: 真的吗？！哦，我的天！

original: Well if anyone can stop the Fire Ants, it's you two together. You're both really smart!
translation: 如果说有什么人能阻止这些火蚁，那就是你们了。你们都很聪明！

original: If you can, make sure he comes back... maybe he'll stay here and I'll have someone to talk to when you're gone!
translation: 如果可能，请带他回来……这样等你走了后，我还有个人可以聊聊天！

original: Do you trust Lesko?
translation: 你信任莱斯科吗？

original: I dunno. I mean, he always talked real funny and didn't let me touch anything in his house.
translation: 我不知道。我的意思是，他说起话来总是很好笑，他不让我碰他房子里的任何东西。

original: But I guess he was okay. I mean, he never did anything bad.
translation: 但我想他是个好人。我的意思是，他从来不做坏事。

original: Before Lesko showed up, were there ever ants in Grayditch?
translation: 莱斯科来这之前，格雷蒂奇就有蚂蚁了吗？

original: Well, there used to be like big regular ants once in a while... but pappa could usually hunt 'em down with Mr. Brandice across the street.
translation: 这过去偶尔会出现大个的普通蚂蚁……不过爸爸和布兰迪斯先生常常能在大街上把它们干掉。

original: It only started getting bad here with these Fire Ants after the Doc got here, yeah.
translation: 没错，博士来这之后，情况开始变坏，火蚁像是闻风而至。

original: Did your pappa ever tell you what he thought of Lesko?
translation: 你爸爸怎么看待莱斯科？

original: Well, I remember once they were all yelling at each other and stuff. Kinda weird cause Doc Lesko is so nice and all.
translation: 我记得有一次他们因为什么事吵了起来，有点奇怪，因为莱斯科医生一直都很好人。

original: Later pappa said something like "The Doc has got a brain on his shoulders when it comes to ants, but he's got a lot to learn about people."
translation: 后来爸爸说，“一提到蚂蚁，博士就像多长了一个脑袋似的，但他该学学怎么与人相处。”

original: It was weird, cause I never seen a brain sitting on Doc's shoulder... that would be gross!
translation: 真怪，因为我从没见过博士多长了一个脑袋……那会很恶心！

original: Mind if I ask you some important stuff about Doctor Lesko?
translation: 介不介意我问一下莱斯科博士的一些事？

original: Naw, go ahead. I like talking to you.
translation: 不介意，问吧，我很乐意告诉你。

original: Haven't found a thing. (Lie)
translation: 还没找到。(撒谎)

original: Awww shucks. Well, keep trying, mister. I promise I'll be good and stay right here for you.
translation: 可恶。继续找吧，先生。我保证我会乖乖的，在这等你的消息。

original: Awww shucks. Well, keep trying, lady. I promise I'll be good and stay right here for you.
translation: 可恶。继续找吧，女士。我保证我会乖乖的，在这等你的消息。

original: I know where the Ant Queen lives.
translation: 我知道蚁后在哪。

original: You do?!
translation: 你知道？！

original: Well, what are you waiting here for? Go back and kill that thing! Because of it, my pappa's dead! Hurry!
translation: 那你还在这等什么？回去杀了它！因为它，我爸爸死了！赶快！

original: Don't worry, Bryan... I think I know how to take care of these ants.
translation: 别着急，布赖恩……我想我知道怎么处理这些蚂蚁。

original: Just be careful, mister... I don't wanna lose you too.
translation: 千万小心，先生……我不想连你也失去了。

original: Just be careful, lady... I don't wanna lose you too.
translation: 千万小心，女士……我不想连你也失去了。

original: All the ants are dead so I'm done here. Go home.
translation: 所有蚂蚁都死了，我的事也做完了。回家吧。

original: I wish I had something to give you for all the work you did, but I never really had much to start with.
translation: 我真想给你些东西来感谢你，但我从没什么东西可给的。

original: I guess now you'll be on your way and I'll have to try living here by myself. I hope you'll come back and visit someday.
translation: 我想你现在要继续征程，而我只能试着独自生活。希望有天你路过这时能再来看看我。

original: It's a slave collar, I sold your dumb ass for caps.
translation: 这是奴隶项圈，我把你这蠢货卖了换瓶盖。

original: You son-of-a-bitch!!!!
translation: 你个杂种！！！！

original: How could you do this to me? I lost everything and you sell me to slavers? Well fuck you!
translation: 你怎么能这么对我？我失去了一切，你却要把我卖给奴隶贩子？你他妈的！

original: Something to remember me by. It'll lead you home.
translation: 这给你留作纪念。它会指引你回家的路。

original: I can't believe everything you've done for me. Most people would have kept on walking when I ran up to them screaming like I did.
translation: 真不敢相信你为我所做的一切。当我像那样尖叫地奔向他们，大多数人早就走开了。

original: I'll get my stuff together and move on out there right away. Come visit me sometime!
translation: 我会收拾好我的东西，马上出发。有空来看我啊！

original: It's a Paradise Welcome Necklace. It'll help you find your way, you lucky devil!
translation: 这是一条天堂欢迎项圈。它会帮你找到方向，你这幸运的家伙！

original: I can't believe everything you've done for me. Most people would have kept on walking when I ran up to them screaming like I did.
translation: 真不敢相信你为我所做的一切。当我像那样尖叫地奔向他们，大多数人早就走开了。

original: I'll get my stuff together and move on out there right away. Come visit me sometime!
translation: 我会收拾好我的东西，马上出发。有空来看我啊！

original: Sure did. It's a beautiful place called Paradise Falls. Here, put this on.
translation: 当然。那是个名叫堕落天堂的漂亮地方，给，戴上这个。

original: W-what is this weird thing?
translation: 这奇怪的东西是什 - 什么？

original: I found a place with lots of kids your age. I'll tell you how to get there.
translation: 我找到了一个有很多和你同龄孩子的地方。我会告诉你怎么去那里。

original: Well, it would have been nicer to live with Vera, but this will probably be pretty fun too!
translation: 嗯，能和薇拉一起住会更好，不过这样也挺好玩的！

original: I can't believe everything you've done for me. Most people would have kept on walking when I ran up to them screaming like I did.
translation: 真不敢相信你为我所做的一切。当我像那样尖叫地奔向他们，大多数人早就走开了。

original: I'll get my stuff together and move on out there right away. Come visit me sometime!
translation: 我会收拾好我的东西，马上出发。有空来看我啊！

original: I sure did, Bryan. Vera said she'd take you in!
translation: 当然，布赖恩。薇拉说她愿意收留你！

original: You really found her!? Oh, thank you so much!
translation: 你真找到她了！？哦，太感谢了！

original: I can't believe everything you've done for me. Most people would have kept on walking when I ran up to them screaming like I did.
translation: 真不敢相信你为我所做的一切。当我像那样尖叫地奔向他们，大多数人早就走开了。

original: I'll get my stuff together and move on out there right away. Come visit me sometime!
translation: 我会收拾好我的东西，马上出发。有空来看我啊！

original: Actually, I give up. I can't find anywhere that will take you in.
translation: 事实上，我放弃了。我找不到任何肯收留你的地方。

original: Oh, okay. I understand. Thanks for trying though.
translation: 哦，好吧，我明白了，可还是要谢谢你。

original: Don't worry about me... I'll be okay here. Now that the Fire Ants are long gone, maybe people will begin showing up here again.
translation: 别担心我……我在这会很好。既然火蚁已经离开了，可能人们会再次回到这。

original: Stop by again someday and say hi, okay?
translation: 有时间就来找我聊天，好吗？

original: Actually, I'm not ready yet.
translation: 事实上，我还没准备好。

original: Very well. Return to me when you're ready.
translation: 好吧，当你准备好了再回到我这。

original: I'd like the Ant Sight to increase my perception.
translation: 我想用“蚁之感”提升我的感知力。

original: How marvelous! Ant Sight it is! Hold still please.
translation: 太棒了！就选“蚁之感”！请别动。

original: I'd like the Ant Might to increase my physical strength.
translation: 我想用“蚁之力”提升我的身体力量。

original: How marvelous! Ant Might it is! Hold still please.
translation: 太棒了！就选“蚁之力”！请别动。

original: I'm ready for my Mutagenic Bioenhancer injection and Lab Coat, Doctor.
translation: 我准备好接受我的诱变生物增强剂注射和实验外套了，博士。

original: How marvelous! Here is the promised Lab Coat. I'm certain you'll find it quite useful.
translation: 太棒了！这是答应过的实验室外套。我肯定你会发现它很有用的。

original: Which injection did you want? Will it be the Ant Sight or Ant Might?
translation: 你要哪种注射剂？“蚁之感”还是“蚁之力”？

original: How marvelous! Which injection did you want? Will it be the Ant Sight or Ant Might?
translation: 太棒了！你要哪种注射剂？“蚁之感”还是“蚁之力”？

original: I'm ready for my Mutagenic Bioenhancer injection, Doctor.
translation: 我准备好接受我的诱变生物增强剂注射了，博士。

original: You didn't honor the agreement, so our bargain is null and void. Good day.
translation: 你没有完成我们之间的这协议，所以我们的约定是无效的。祝你愉快。

original: What about my payment?
translation: 我的报酬呢？

original: Your theories were in error, and beyond correction. I had no choice.
translation: 你的理论是错的，完全是南辕北辙，我别无选择。

original: Spoken like a true disciple of science! I will restart my calculations from the beginning and learn to crawl before I try to run.
translation: 说起话来像个真正的科学信徒！我是不是要重新开始学习怎样爬，然后才能开始科学地赛跑。

original: I suppose I shouldn't be angered by your actions, forgive my impertinance.
translation: 我想我不该对你的行为生气，原谅我的无礼。

original: Because you're out of your mind!
translation: 因为你精神不正常！

original: You utter buffoon! You've set my work back months... perhaps even years!
translation: 你是个十足的小丑！你把我的工作进展推迟了几个月……甚至可能是几年！

original: I'm afraid I have no further use of your services and any bargain we may have had is null and void!
translation: 我恐怕再也用不着你的帮助了，我们的约定已经失效！

original: Now, if you'll excuse me...
translation: 现在，如果你不介意的话……

original: I can't let you risk people's lives for an experiment.
translation: 我不可以让你用人们的生命危险做实验。

original: You utter buffoon! You've set my work back months... perhaps even years!
translation: 你是个十足的小丑！你把我的工作进展推迟了几个月……甚至可能是几年！

original: I'm afraid I have no further use of your services and any bargain we may have had is null and void!
translation: 我恐怕再也用不着你的帮助了，我们的约定已经失效！

original: Now, if you'll excuse me...
translation: 现在，如果你不介意的话……

original: It was for the greater good Lesko. Man is not ready to play God.
translation: 这对你有好处，人类不能扮演上帝。

original: Perhaps man isn't ready, my friend. Not today, but maybe someday.
translation: 人类或许没有准备，我的朋友。虽然不是现在，但总有这一天。

original: I suppose I shouldn't be angered by your actions, forgive my impertinance.
translation: 我想我不该对你的行为生气，原谅我的无礼。

original: I've killed the Ant Queen and I destroyed your mutagen supply.
translation: 我杀了蚁后，毁了你的诱变剂。

original: You utter buffoon! You've set my work back months... perhaps even years!
translation: 你是个十足的小丑！你把我的工作进展推迟了几个月……甚至可能是几年！

original: Destroying the mutagen was NOT part of what we discussed!
translation: 我没让你毁了诱变剂！

original: Now, if you'll excuse me...
translation: 现在，如果你不介意的话……

original: I've killed all of the Nest Guardians, but I destroyed your mutagen supply.
translation: 我杀了所有的守卫蚁，但我毁了你的诱变剂。

original: What?!! How could you do such a foolish thing?
translation: 什么？！！你怎么能做这样的蠢事？

original: Actually, my mistake... I'm not done yet.
translation: 事实上，是我的错……我还没搞定。

original: Oh now this is really too much!
translation: 哦，这真的太过分了！

original: I don't have time for these kinds of shenanigans. Allow me to return to my work and you return to the job at hand!
translation: 我没时间陪你恶作剧。我要回去工作，你去搞定你的工作！

original: I've killed all the Nest Guardians [Lie]
translation: 我杀光了所有的巢穴守卫者 [撒谎]

original: Then I will proceed to my portable terminal at once and make the necessary changes to the formula.
translation: 那么我要立刻去我的便携式终端那里，对配方做必要的修改。

original: Let's proceed to my terminal and we'll see if I can undo all the damage I've caused.
translation: 让我们去我的终端那里，看看是否能挽回我造成的所有损失。

original: My work is done, Doctor.
translation: 我的工作完成了，博士。

original: Oh, how marvelous! Please, tell me what happened.
translation: 哦，真不可思议！拜托，告诉我发生了什么。

original: Come now, the faster you tell me... the faster I can provide promised payment for your services!
translation: 快点，你越快告诉我……你就能越快拿到我为你的服务要支付的报酬！

original: Oh, how marvelous! Please, tell me what happened.
translation: 哦，真不可思议！拜托，告诉我发生了什么。

original: Please, don't insult my intelligence. You didn't even enter the Hatchery!
translation: 请别侮辱我的智商。你甚至都没跨进孵化场的门槛！

original: Now, I believe you have a job to do?
translation: 我记得你有工作要做的。

original: I've killed all the Nest Guardians.
translation: 我杀光了所有的巢穴守卫者。

original: Then I will proceed to my portable terminal at once and make the necessary changes to the formula.
translation: 那么我要立刻去我的便携式终端那里，对配方做必要的修改。

original: Thanks very much for everything... you've been quite a useful lab assistant!
translation: 非常感谢你所做的一切……你是一个相当有用的实验室助手！

original: What kind of work do you do in here?
translation: 你在这做什么工作？

original: The secret kind...
translation: 秘密……

original: Well, if you must know... I'm an electrician and computer expert. AND I'm a bit of surgeon. Really, the most gifted scientist you'll find...
translation: 好吧，你要真想知道……我是一个电器技师和电脑专家，并且，我差不多是个外科医生。真的，你所见过的最天才的科学家……

original: Hmph. I'm the guy that got Rivet City up and running in the first place!
translation: 哼。我是建造铆钉城并让它运作的人！

original: And after all that Li and her gang of flunkies pushed me out. Ha! Project Purity indeed. What a bunch of morons -- they can't even clean some water.
translation: 之后，李和她的那帮小人把我排挤了出去。哈！净水工程对吧，一群白痴 — 他们净化不了一滴水。

original: What are you doing here in this wrecked part of the ship?
translation: 你在断裂的船头做什么？

original: I live here. It's where I do my work. And it's FAR away from Dr. Li and all those other monkeys dressed up like scientists.
translation: 我住这。我在这工作，远离李博士和那些装成科学家的猴子。

original: You made it past my defenses, which proves you aren't a dummy. AND you haven't killed me, so I suppose you aren't here to do that.
translation: 你跑到这，还越过了我的防线，这说明你不是个蠢货。并且你还没杀掉我，所以我想你不是为这而来的。

original: I suppose you can hang around if you want. Just don't touch anything.
translation: 我想你要是愿意，你可以留在这，但别碰任何东西。

original: I’m sorry about this, I really am. But it’s true. You’re not human.
translation: 对此我很抱歉，真的很抱歉。但这是事实，你不是人类。

original: I'm not sure what to say... I'm not sure what to even think about all this...
translation: 我不知道该说什么……我甚至不知道该怎么看待这一切……

original: I'll admit, this is pretty convincing evidence, but it doesn't make any sense. How can this be possible?
translation: 我得承认，这是相当有说服力的证据，但这说不通啊。这怎么可能呢？

original: You were made to look and act human. But you’re not. The evidence proves that.
translation: 你被做成外貌、举止都像人，但你不是。证据就摆在那。

original: I'm not sure what to say... I'm not sure what to even think about all this...
translation: 我不知道该说什么……我甚至不知道该怎么看待这一切……

original: I'll admit, this is pretty convincing evidence, but it doesn't make any sense. How can this be possible?
translation: 我得承认，这是相当有说服力的证据，但这说不通啊。这怎么可能呢？

original: It’s not real blood, Harkness. It’s synthetic, just like everything else.
translation: 那不是真血，哈克尼斯。是合成的，和其他东西一样。

original: I'm not sure what to say... I'm not sure what to even think about all this...
translation: 我不知道该说什么……我甚至不知道该怎么看待这一切……

original: I'll admit, this is pretty convincing evidence, but it doesn't make any sense. How can this be possible?
translation: 我得承认，这是相当有说服力的证据，但这说不通啊。这怎么可能呢？

original: I need to know more about what I'm dealing with. What is an android exactly?
translation: 我需要知道更多关于我在处理的是什么。仿真人到底是什么？

original: Forget everything you know about robots. Those buckets are mere children's toys compared to the real thing.
translation: 把你对机器人的认知统统抛到脑后。跟这真货比起来，那些水桶不过是小孩玩具罢了。

original: Androids have fake skin, and blood, and are programmed to simulate human behavior, like breathing. They can even eat and digest food realistically.
translation: 仿真人有仿真的皮肤和血液，通过程序模拟人类行为，比如呼吸。它们甚至能真实地进食和消化食物。

original: So tell me about the Commonwealth.
translation: 跟我说说联邦。

original: The Commonwealth itself is nothing but a war-ravaged quagmire of violence and despair. Inside the sealed environment of the Institute, however...
translation: 除了暴力和绝望，遍布着被战争蹂躏过的沼泽，联邦自身什么都不是。它处于研究院的密封环境中，然而……

original: But... the Institute's affairs are none of your concern. Your undeveloped mind couldn’t even begin to comprehend what we’ve accomplished.
translation: 但是……研究院事件不是你该关心的，你还没有开发过的大脑丝毫不能领会我们已经完成的是什么东西。

original: Uh oh. Wait here. This doesn't look good.
translation: 哦，等等，看上去情况不妙。

original: Holy crap, you're crazy!
translation: 胡说，你疯了！

original: That's it, old man! We're opening that door, and to hell with the Overseer's rules!
translation: 就是这样，老头！我们要打开那扇门，让监督者的规矩见鬼去吧！

original: You know I can't do that, Freddie. Now get back down below, before I have to do something we'll both regret.
translation: 你明白我不能那么干，弗雷迪。快回到下面去，否则我要做的事会让我们都后悔。

original: What, you're gonna lock me up like you did to Brotch? You can't cage a Tunnel Snake, man! Because we rule!
translation: 什么，你要像对待布洛彻那样把我关起来？你是关不住洞中蛇的，老兄！因为穴蛇帮主宰一切！

original: Stay back!
translation: 退后！

original: Defender Morgan and I executed a reconnaissance mission last night to gauge Raider entrenchment in the structural underground of Fairfax.
translation: 昨天晚上，守卫者摩根和我执行了侦察任务，测量了歹徒在费尔福克斯地下挖掘的壕沟。

original: We located three entrances into underground utility tunnels, and confirmed the enemy has occupied and fortified these positions. Some are undefended.
translation: 我们查找到有三个入口可以进入地下的维修隧道，并证实敌人已经占据和加强了这些位置。但有一些位置没有防备。

original: We also identified a small weapons cache in the southeast section of the tunnels. We were compromised by a patrol while placing explosives here.
translation: 我们还在这些隧道的东南区域查找到了小型武器的隐藏点。在埋设炸药时，我们被巡逻队撞见。

original: In accordance to mission parameters, we did not engage, instead retreating to Base.  Raiders will be likely to attach more patrols to that area now.
translation: 根据任务指示，我们没有和他们交火，选择了撤回基地。歹徒目前可能会在那区域增派更多的巡逻队。

original: We've secured the building and are currently implementing our orders for the occupation of Fairfax.
translation: 我们占领了这栋建筑，现在正执行占领费尔福克斯的命令。

original: Raider activity in town has increased since we first took up positions in and around the fort.  We've killed a lot of them and scared off others.
translation: 自从我们拿下堡垒和附近的区域，歹徒在镇子里的活动有所增加。我们干掉他们不少人，其他人也是闻风丧胆。

original: But they just keep coming back. Their numbers seem limitless, while requests for our own reinforcements are repeatedly denied.
translation: 但他们不停地反扑，他们的数量像是源源不断，而我们自己的增援请求却再三遭到拒绝。

original: That the Raiders take such continued risks to invade our facility appears to confirm suspicions that we've had an intelligence leak.
translation: 那些歹徒不惜余力地冒险侵入我们的设施，这确凿地说明我们的情报已经泄露了。

original: They've tried tenaciously to infiltrate the base, but so far haven't stood a chance.  Our objective remains the same: protect the research personnel.
translation: 他们顽强地设法渗透进基地，但到目前为止还没成功过。我们的任务照旧：保护研究人员。

original: I got my own problems right now, kid.
translation: 我自己都有一堆麻烦事，孩子。

original: Why are you so mean!?
translation: 你为什么这么冷漠无情！？

original: I knew grown-ups were stupid! All you care about is yourself! Well, fine!
translation: 我知道大人都是蠢货！你们只关心自己！好吧！

original: Sorry, kid. Help costs caps, and you look pretty broke to me.
translation: 对不起，孩子。帮助不是免费的，而你看起来没什么钱。

original: Look, I know if you find my pappa he's gotta have some caps with him. He'd pay you! Please, mister!
translation: 听着，我明白你的意思，你要是找到我爸爸，他有瓶盖。他会付你钱！求你了，先生！

original: Look, I know if you find my pappa he's gotta have some caps with him. He'd pay you! Please, mister!
translation: 听着，我明白你的意思，你要是找到我爸爸，他有瓶盖。他会付你钱！求你了，先生！

original: If you're talking about the Fire Ants, I'm already working on it.
translation: 如果你说的是那些火蚁，我已经把它们搞定了。

original: You-you are?! I can't believe it!
translation: 你 - 你是说真的吗？我不敢相信！

original: But what about pappa?! I need you to find my pappa!
translation: 但爸爸怎么样了？！我要你找到我爸爸！

original: You-you are?! I can't believe it!
translation: 你 - 你是说真的吗？我不敢相信！

original: But what about pappa?! I need you to find my pappa!
translation: 但爸爸怎么样了？！我要你找到我爸爸！

original: That's wonderful, kid. Now scram.
translation: 好极了，孩子。赶快滚开。

original: Awww, come on. You're pretty tough taking out all those ants by yourself!
translation: 哦，来吧，你非常强壮，可以独自干掉所有蚂蚁！

original: The name's Bryan Wilks, by the way, I live in Grayditch. Well, that is, I did until those Fire Ants turned this place into a cemetery.
translation: 我叫布赖恩·威尔克斯，顺便说一下，我住在格雷蒂奇。就是说，我以前住在这，现在那些火蚁把这地方变成了坟场。

original: They killed everyone in town... including my pappa. Now I'm all alone.
translation: 它们杀掉了镇子的每个人……包括我爸爸。我现在孤身一人了。

original: Calm down, calm down. Just who the heck are you?
translation: 冷静，冷静，你是哪个小鬼？

original: My name's Bryan Wilks. I live in Grayditch. Well, that is, I did until those Fire Ants turned this place into a cemetery.
translation: 我叫布赖恩·威尔克斯，顺便说一下，我住在格雷蒂奇。就是说，我以前住在这，现在那些火蚁把这地方变成了坟场。

original: They killed everyone in town... including my pappa. Now I'm all alone.
translation: 它们杀掉了镇子的每个人……包括我爸爸。我现在孤身一人了。

original: I'm glad those stupid things are all dead though! You're pretty tough!
translation: 我很高兴那些蠢东西都死了！你太强了！

original: Hey, are you okay? You shouldn't be alone in a place like this.
translation: 嗨，你没事吧？你不该独自跑到这鬼地方来。

original: My name's Bryan Wilks. I live in Grayditch. Well, that is, I did until those Fire Ants turned this place into a cemetery.
translation: 我叫布赖恩·威尔克斯，顺便说一下，我住在格雷蒂奇。就是说，我以前住在这，现在那些火蚁把这地方变成了坟场。

original: They killed everyone in town... including my pappa. Now I'm all alone.
translation: 它们杀掉了镇子的每个人……包括我爸爸。我现在孤身一人了。

original: I'm glad those stupid things are all dead though! You're pretty tough!
translation: 我很高兴那些蠢东西都死了！你太强了！
