original: Hold on. You're in the Tunnel Snakes? You guys really do rule!
translation: 等等，你是穴蛇帮？你们这些家伙真的主宰了一切！

original: You got that right.
translation: 你说对了。

original: Better not forget it, either.
translation: 最好也别忘了。

original: What did you hear from the guards?
translation: 你从警卫那听到什么？

original: I heard one of the guards talking about some sort of plan to raid Amata and the rest of us.
translation: 我听一个警卫在谈论什么计划，说要袭击阿玛塔和我们其他人。

original: I didn't hear anything else, but I think he read it on the security terminal, so maybe you can find more there. I'm sure it's bad news for us all.
translation: 其余的我没听清，不过我看见他在安保终端上读着什么，所以你可以去查一下，或许能了解到更多情况。我肯定那是对我们所有人都不利的坏消息。

original: Taylor, stop shooting, damnit!
translation: 泰勒，停止射击，该死的！

original: I didn't mean to fire, I really didn't. I just wanted to scare him off! But he had a knife! I can't be too careful with those rebels!
translation: 我没想开火，真的不想。我只是想吓唬吓唬他！但他有把刀！对那些反叛者再小心都不为过！

original: You almost shot Freddie!
translation: 你们差点射杀了弗雷迪！

original: I tell you, those guards are getting nastier every day. One of these days, it's gonna turn real ugly. But I'll be ready for it.
translation: 我跟你说，那些警卫越来越无耻了。总有一天，他们会肆无忌惮。不过我会严阵以待。

original: I can't believe they almost shot you!
translation: 我不敢相信他们差点射到了你！

original: Well, it's a dangerous place out there in the Wastes, right? People could really use a compilation of good advice. Like a Wasteland Survival Guide!
translation: 好吧，废土是危险的地方，对吧？人们很需要一本为他们提供好的建议的书。像是一本《废土生存指南》！

original: For that, I need an assistant to test my theories. I wouldn't want anyone to get hurt because of a mistake. Nobody's ever happy when that happens.
translation: 因此，我需要一个助手来测试我的理论。我不希望任何人因为一个小错误而受伤。发生那样的事，不会有人高兴的。

original: No... Then they just yell a lot. At me. With mean, mean words.
translation: 不……他们会对我吼出很多……很多脏话。

original: Sounds good. Tell me more.
translation: 听起来不错，跟我详细说说。

original: Don't you get it? We don't want to abandon the Vault. We want to open it!
translation: 你还没明白？我们不想遗弃这避难所。我们只是要开放它！

original: We still want this to be our home, but we want to get supplies from outside. Trading, exploring, anything's better than just hiding down here!
translation: 这仍然是我们的家，但我们可以从外面获得补给品。贸易、探险，做什么都比躲在这里好！

original: Why don't you just leave? There's not much security.
translation: 你为什么不离开？警卫并不多。

original: It's not that they want to leave. It's that they want to open the door and interact with the rest of the world. But that would risk the whole Vault.
translation: 他们并不是要离开。他们只是要打开这门，跟世界的其他人打交道。但那会让整个避难所陷入危险。

original: Wait, why don't the rebels just leave?
translation: 等等，这些反叛者为什么不离开？

original: ...that batch of tests was inconclusive, but Madison and I are convinced it's a problem with the secondary filtration system.
translation: ……那批测试没有说服力，不过麦迪逊和我深信问题出在二级过滤系统。

original: We’re going to re-calibrate the equipment and try again tomorrow, so that... James, please, I’m trying to work. Now’s not the time...
translation: 我们准备明天重新校准设备再试一次，所以……詹姆斯，求你了，我正在努力，现在不是……的时候。

original: So that's the next step. Assuming we get the results we need, we'll move on to...  James! Stop! I need to finish these notes...
translation: 假如我们得到了想要的结果，下一步我们会…… 詹姆斯！停下！我需要完成这些记录……

original: We'll move on to diagnosing the issues with the radiation dampeners. That should... Ow! James! Now? We really shouldn't... Ha ha ha ha ha!
translation: 然后我们要使用放射抑制器诊断下。那应当……噢！詹姆斯！现在？我们真的不应该……哈哈哈哈哈！

original: How the heck can an ant breathe fire?
translation: 蚂蚁怎么会喷火？

original: The stimulation of the subject's evolutionary trigger by the mutagen caused a bio-defensive reaction metamorphosing the ant's venom glands.
translation: 诱变剂引起进化，造成生理防御反应，使蚂蚁的毒液腺变形。

original: This process caused unexpected oscillations in the venom molecules at such a vast rate it produces a thermodynamic biochemical reaction.
translation: 在毒液分子中，这一过程造成意想不到变异，从而制造出一个热力生化学的反应。

original: As the subject ejects the volatile solution, it becomes conflagrant due to new structures in it's maw I call its calefaction array.
translation: 这种反应在蚂蚁的胃中产生新的结构，我称之为加热内腺，它让蚂蚁喷射出炽热的挥发溶质。

original: Amazing, isn't it?
translation: 很惊人吧，对吧？

original: You should have at least told him you were alive. He thought he was alone.
translation: 你至少该告诉他，你还活着。他觉得他很孤单。

original: I can't risk leaving this place... I have to continue monitoring the Hatchery for any further mutations in the next brood!
translation: 我不能冒险离开这……我必须继续监视孵化场中进一步的突变！

original: I have no time for children and their petty games. What do they know about the importance of my work?
translation: 我没时间放在孩子和他们的游戏上。他们对我工作的重要性都知道些什么呢？

original: Don't you realize you've ruined his entire life?
translation: 你难道没意识到你已经毁了他的整个生活？

original: You have your ideals and I have mine. I'm down here to complete my experiments at any cost.
translation: 你有你的看法，我有我的看法。我来这是要不惜任何代价完成我的实验。

original: If that means the loss of a few lives to save generations of lives in the future, it's a small price to pay.
translation: 如果失去一些人的生命可以在未来拯救一代人的生命，那只是微不足道的代价。

original: Can't you take responsibility for his father's death?
translation: 难道你不该对他父亲的死负责？

original: All scientists take responsibility for their failures, because it comes with the territory.
translation: 所有的科学家都该为他们的失败负责，因为这涉及整个研究领域。

original: I will take this experimentation to completion without roosting on the moral high ground.
translation: 道德在我的实验中没有立足之地。

original: If I allow emotions to enter the mix, all this time and energy spent will have been for nothing.
translation: 我要是让情绪掺杂到我的实验中，我花费的所有时间和精力都会付诸东流。

original: Who the hell is Bryan Wilks?
translation: 布赖恩·威尔克斯他妈的是谁？

original: He's a rather bothersome young lad. Always asking interminable questions and interrupting my calculations.
translation: 他是个相当麻烦的小家伙，总是没完没了的问问题，打断我的计算。

original: After you're done down here, perhaps you can locate him on the surface and speak to him.
translation: 你在这的事搞定后，你多半可以在地面上找到他，和他谈谈。

original: Wilks? I have no idea what you mean.
translation: 威尔克斯？我不明白你的意思。

original: He's a rather bothersome young man. Always asking interminable questions and interrupting my calculations.
translation: 他是个相当麻烦的小家伙，总是没完没了地问问题，打断我的计算。

original: After you're done down here, perhaps you can speak to him and calm him down.
translation: 你在这的事搞定后，你多半可以在地面上找到他，和他谈谈。

original: I'd be glad to help him. Who is he?
translation: 我很乐意帮助他，他是谁？

original: He's a rather bothersome young lad. Always asking interminable questions and interrupting my calculations.
translation: 他是个相当麻烦的小家伙，总是没完没了的问问题，打断我的计算。

original: After you're done down here, perhaps you can locate him on the surface and speak to him.
translation: 你在这的事搞定后，你多半可以在地面上找到他，和他谈谈。

original: You've betrayed Doctor Li, and my father.
translation: 你背叛了李博士和我父亲。

original: I'm sorry you see it that way. What are you going to do, kill me over it?
translation: 我很抱歉你这么想。你要做什么，杀了我？

original: You should go. It sounds like you're in enough trouble as it is, and honestly I don't want anyone to see me talking to you.
translation: 你该走了，听起来你自己也有很多麻烦。说真的，我不希望任何人看见我跟你谈过话。

original: Have you seen my dad?
translation: 见过我爸爸吗？

original: Your dad? Nope, I haven't. Did he get lost?
translation: 你爸爸？没有。他迷路了吗？

original: He disappeared on you, huh? Don't worry, I'm sure you'll find him soon.
translation: 他跟你玩消失，呃？别担心，我相信你很快就会找到他。

original: Your dad? No, I haven't. I'm sure he's around here somewhere.
translation: 你爸爸？没有。不过我相信他就在这附近。

original: I don't think so, but then I haven't really been looking for him. Sorry.
translation: 我想没有，不过我也确实没特意去找他。抱歉。

original: Oh he's here, you can be sure of that. Just don't expect to see what you're used to seeing.
translation: 哦，他在这，你可以确定。只是别指望和你之前所见的一样。

original: No, I haven't. But when I do, I'll tell him you're looking for him.
translation: 不，我没有。不过当我见到他，我会告诉他，你正在找他。

original: Nope, 'fraid not. Don't you worry about it, though. You'll find him.
translation: 没有，恐怕没有。可你别担心，你会找到他的。

original: No sweetie, I haven't. I'm sure he'll come looking for you before long, though.
translation: 没有，宝贝，我没见过他。可我确信他不久就会回来找你的。

original: Can't say that I have, kiddo. Don't worry, I'm sure he'll turn up.
translation: 我可没有，孩子。别担心，我确信他会回来的。

original: Tell me more about this place.
translation: 再多跟我谈谈这地方。

original: Maybe later. First I want to see how you get along with Timmy.
translation: 可能要等会。我要先看看你和提米相处得怎么样。

original: The details of this place are far beyond your comprehension, I'm sure.
translation: 我敢肯定，这地方的详情远超你的理解。

original: Be content with what you need to know: This is a simulation, and I am in total control. If you wish to see the Vault again, you'll do as I say.
translation: 满足一下你的求知欲：这是一场模拟，而我掌控一切。要是你希望再次见到避难所，就得照我说的做。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: Don't you worry about that. You just go have fun with Timmy.
translation: 别操心这个。你就去和提米好好玩。

original: You know that I am Dr. Braun. Anything else is irrelevant. Perhaps you should be focusing your energy on what I've asked of you.
translation: 你知道我是布劳恩博士。别的东西无关紧要，你应该把精力集中在我让你去做的事情上。

original: If you insist on an answer, then you may better know me as Dr. Stanislaus Braun.
translation: 你要是一定要一个答案，那你可以知道我的全名是斯坦尼斯·布劳恩博士。

original: I have chosen a different appearance for myself here... in my own little playground.
translation: 我在这为自己选择了不同的外貌……就在我自己的地盘上。

original: What have you done with my father?
translation: 你对我父亲做了什么？

original: Oh, don't worry about that now. There are things to do!
translation: 哦，现在别担心那件事。还有许多事要做！

original: Where is my father?
translation: 我父亲在哪？

original: Have you met Doc the dog? He's another new arrival, much like yourself.
translation: 你见过狗狗“医生”了吗？他也是新来的，和你挺像的。

original: He might seem a bit... familiar to you.
translation: 你可能觉得他有点……眼熟。

original: I just wanted to say thanks, and good luck.
translation: 我只想说谢谢，祝你好运。

original: Good luck? That's it? Fine. Thanks. Now let's get this over with.
translation: 好运？那就这样？好吧，谢谢。让我们把这事做完。

original: I changed my mind. I'll do it. I'll put in the code.
translation: 我改变主意了。我会输入密码。

original: Oh, no. We've done this once already. We don't have time to keep going back and forth.
translation: 哦，不。我们已经做过一次。我没时间来来回回的。

original: Too many lives are at stake. We just stick with the plan.
translation: 太多的生命处于危险之中，我们只好坚持这计划。

original: Are you kidding me? We don't have time for this.
translation: 你说笑吗？我们没时间做这事。

original: Fine. If you're going to do it, then do it. But hurry up.
translation: 好吧，如果你要做，那就去做。不过要赶快。

original: Sorry, I didn't expect to bump into anyone alive down here.
translation: 抱歉，我没想到这还能撞见活人。

original: That is precisely why this is the ideal place for my work.
translation: 所以这地方是我的理想工作场所。

original: Do you realize you're trampling about in a delicately balanced and highly sensitive experimentation area?
translation: 你意识到没，你正在践踏一个精心调试和高度敏感的实验区？

original: Hey, it's none of my business.
translation: 嗨，这不关我事。

original: Damn right it's not. You were just leaving, weren't you, feeb?
translation: 该死的，不是。你应该离开，不是吗，蠢货？

original: What are you doing now?
translation: 你在做什么？

original: I'm assisting Rothchild with some of his research. I've worked with portable generators more extensively than he has.
translation: 我帮助罗斯查德进行他的研究，我比他更多接触到便携发电机。

original: I don't really care for the idea that this is supporting some gigantic military robot, but given the state of things, I recognize the need for it.
translation: 我真不太关心是否要使用巨型军用机器人，不过考虑到现状，我承认需要它。

original: Why do you think the Enclave attacked Project Purity?
translation: 你觉得英克雷为什么要攻击净水工程？

original: I should think it's rather obvious. They want the technology for themselves.
translation: 我认为这明摆的事情，他们需要这技术。

original: You grew up in a Vault, never wanting for clean, fresh water. Out here in the real world it's hard to come by, and that makes it valuable.
translation: 你在避难所长大，从不缺净水，而在这真实的世界里，这是可遇不可求的。所以净水工程很有价值。

original: Where can I buy more things for my place?
translation: 我要到哪为我的房间购买更多的设备？

original: Yes, I believe this place could do with a bit more in the way of decoration.
translation: 是的，我相信这间房子在装饰方面要好好布置一下。

original: Speak with Lydia Montenegro down in the Lobby Level of the tower. She has quite a selection of items to enhance your living space.
translation: 到大厦大堂层跟莉迪亚·黑山谈谈，她有不少物品可以美化你的生活空间。

original: Yes, I believe this place could do with a bit more in the way of decoration.
translation: 是的，我相信这间房子在装饰方面要好好布置一下。

original: Speak with Moira Brown at Craterside Supply here in Megaton. She has quite a selection of items to enhance your living space.
translation: 就在兆吨镇，和坑边杂货店的莫伊拉·布朗谈谈。她有一大批物品可以美化你的居住空间。

original: No, thanks.
translation: 不了，谢谢。

original: Okay, but you're gonna kick yourself later!
translation: 行，但你之后会后悔的！

original: Sure, I'll take it!
translation: 行，我要了！

original: Here you go! Enjoy it!
translation: 拿去吧。好好利用!

original: I'll take it for 50 caps.
translation: 我出50瓶盖买了。

original: Well, it will save me the trip. Fine, you've got a deal. Enjoy!
translation: 行，省得我跑一趟。成交！喝得开心！

original: You got any snake oil in there as well?
translation: 你这儿不会还掺了狗皮膏药吧？

original: I promise you this is the real deal, my friend. For only 100 caps, you'd be one of two people in the Wasteland ever to drink one!
translation: 我保证这绝对是真货，朋友。只要100瓶盖，你就会成全废土尝过这滋味的俩人之一！

original: I usually sell them to a lady in Girdershade, she's just nuts about them.
translation: 我平时都卖给梁影村的一位女士，她可好这口了。

original: How is it better than a regular Nuka-Cola?
translation: 比普通的核子可乐好在哪？

original: For only 100 caps, you'll be the first to find out! I was on my way to Girdershade to sell it to the lady there, but you could save me the trip.
translation: 只要100瓶盖，当上头号尝鲜客就知道了！我本来正赶往梁影村卖给那位女士，但你要接手倒省得我跑。

original: Shut up and make some sense!
translation: 冷静，说清楚点！

original: They're-they're all dead... burned Grayditch right to the ground! Those things... they came out of nowhere! You've got to run! Run!
translation: 他们 - 他们都死了……格雷蒂奇被烧成了灰烬！那些鬼东西……他们不知哪里来的！你最好快跑！跑！

original: Who's burning what?
translation: 谁烧了什么？

original: They're-they're all dead... burned Grayditch right to the ground! Those things... they came out of nowhere! You've got to run! Run!
translation: 他们 - 他们都死了……格雷蒂奇被烧成了灰烬！那些鬼东西……他们不知哪里来的！你最好快跑！跑！

original: Calm down! Let me try and help you.
translation: 冷静！让我帮帮你。

original: They're-they're all dead... burned Grayditch right to the ground! Those things... they came out of nowhere! You've got to run! Run!
translation: 他们 - 他们都死了……格雷蒂奇被烧成了灰烬！那些鬼东西……他们不知哪里来的！你最好快跑！跑！

original: The Wasteland is as dead as you're going to be if you don't tell me the truth!
translation: 你要是不跟我说实话，就会和废土一样死寂！

original: Don't you see? The Great One has gifted us all! It's a second chance!
translation: 难道你没看见吗？圣贤已经恩赐了我们所有人！这是第二次机会！

original: What are you, crazy or something?
translation: 你怎么回事，疯了还是怎么着？

original: I've seen the ground reaching to the sky with its outstretched arms. The Wasteland is reborn!
translation: 我看到大地伸展臂膀，直抵天际。废土重生了！

original: What is it? What did you see?
translation: 它是什么？你看见了什么？

original: I saw life! Life is returning to the Wastes! The Great One brings it to all of us!
translation: 我看见了生机！生机正在回到废土！圣贤把它带给了我们所有人！

original: My mistake. I thought you were someone else.
translation: 我的错，我把你当成别人了。

original: Just keep on walking.
translation: 快走，别停下。

original: Life sucks, then you die. You may as well get that through your thick skull.
translation: 活着无聊，然后死去。用你的笨脑子也能想明白。

original: You may be right. Most people I meet seem to feel the same way.
translation: 你可能是对的。我遇见的大多数人都是这么想的。

original: I used to carry around much anger about my past, and fear about what would happen to me next.
translation: 我习惯了对过去心怀愤懑，对未来心怀恐惧。

original: But it became so heavy I was not able to take even a single step. So I had to put it all down.
translation: 不过这种负担变得太沉重了，我几乎都无法向前迈出一步，所以我不得不把它们全部都卸下来。

original: It may be that I'm just not as strong as most people. I will have to think on these things.
translation: 那可能是因为，我不像大多数的人那样强壮。我总是不能不去想这些事。

original: Happy? Sure, I guess you could call it that.
translation: 快乐？当然，我猜你也可以这么说。

original: I'm glad you are happy. That seems to me to be rather uncommon.
translation: 你快乐，我高兴，那对我来说非常难得。

original: Many people I meet carry so much worry about the future and anger about the past I am surprised they can even move.
translation: 我见过的许多人背负了太多包袱，他们对未来心怀恐惧，对过去心怀愤懑，我怀疑他们是否还能继续前行。

original: I will try to be more like you. Perhaps that is why our paths continue to cross. Thank you for sharing your happiness with me.
translation: 我会试着变得像你一样，或许我们的道路会因此而交汇。谢谢你把快乐分享给我。

original: I've been worried about you. You don't exactly seem cut out for this place.
translation: 我担心你，你真的不适合待在这。

original: You've been worried about me? Oh, because of the trouble I ran into with the humans last time.
translation: 你担心我？哦，因为上次我陷入了和人类的纷争。

original: There is no point in carrying your worry around with you for so long. If I did that, I would never take one more step.
translation: 没理由杞人忧天。要是像你说的那样，我连一步都不敢挪动了。

original: Now that's what I call payment.
translation: 那就是我想要的报答。

original: You earned it. Rangers take care of their own. You watch your ass out here and come back alive!
translation: 你应得的。游骑兵自己照顾自己。你自己小心，活着回来！

original: You earned it... last time. Rangers take care of their own, remember? Alright, I'm out of here.
translation: 这是你应得的……为了上次。游骑兵自己照顾自己，记住了吗？好吧，我走了。

original: Wow, thanks!
translation: 哇哦，谢谢！

original: No problem. Once a Ranger, always a Ranger. Take care of yourself!
translation: 没问题。一日为游骑兵，终生为游骑兵。多多保重！

original: I don't know what to say. What do I owe ya?
translation: 我不知道说什么，我怎么感谢你？

original: Not a thing. Rangers take care of their own. You watch your ass out here and come back alive!
translation: 小意思。游骑兵自己照顾自己。你自己小心，活着回来！

original: Nothing. That's not how it works. But maybe next time you'll think about helping out a fellow Ranger in trouble.
translation: 没什么。不是这样。不过下次你最好记得帮助一下碰到麻烦的游骑兵同伴。

original: What are you doing, following me?
translation: 你在干嘛，跟踪我吗？

original: In a way. I tracked you using your Geomapper. Reilly sent me to find you so I could bring you this.
translation: 可以这么说，我用你的自动绘图模块跟踪到了你。莱莉派我来的，要我把这给你。

original: No problem. What are you doing out here?
translation: 没问题，你到这来做什么？

original: Looking for you. I tracked you using your Geomapper. Reilly sent me to find you so I could bring you this.
translation: 我在找你，我用你的自动绘图模块跟踪到了你。莱莉派我来的，要我把这给你。

original: Nice. So that's the thanks I get for coming all this way to bring you this?
translation: 很好，费尽功夫给你带来这个之后，你就这么感谢我吗？

original: Hey, you can't always count on me to save your ass.
translation: 嗨，你不能总指望我来救你。

original: Donovan! What are you doing in these parts?
translation: 多诺万！你在这地方做什么？

original: Tracked you using the Geomapper. Reilly sent me to find you so I could bring you this.
translation: 用自动绘图模块跟踪的你。莱莉派我来的，要我把这给你。

original: Did you say a city of Ghouls?
translation: 你是说尸鬼之城？

original: Sure did. Underworld. It's right inside the Museum of History, then through the big skull.
translation: 当然。地下城，它就在历史博物馆里，进门后穿过那大头骨。

original: Most of the residents ain't crazy about humans, but they'll sell to you, fix you up, so long as your caps are good. And you ain't a Ghoul hater.
translation: 他们大多数对人类没有好感，不过他们会卖给你东西，治疗你的伤口，只要你有瓶盖，而且不恨僵尸。

original: "Other assholes"?
translation: “其他混蛋”？

original: Yeah, you know. Those humans, like you. Well, maybe not like you, I dunno, but humans all the same.
translation: 是的，你知道的。那些人类，像你一样。好吧，可能不像你一样，我不知道，但人类都一个样。

original: The Brotherhood of Steel guys with their testosterone and Power Armor... Those psycho Talon Company mercs...
translation: 钢铁兄弟会的那些家伙，吃着激素，穿着动力装甲……那些心理变态的鹰爪雇佣兵……

original: Those other assholes.
translation: 其他那些混蛋。

original: I'm not a tourist...
translation: 我不是游客……

original: Come on! Here you are in the Mall of our nation's fine capital, taking in the sights, visiting the monuments!
translation: 省省吧！你现在就在我们国度美好首都的商业街里面，照相，瞻仰纪念碑！

original: Face it. You're a tourist.
translation: 承认吧，你就是个游客。

original: You're crazy to stand out here! Aren't you afraid of the Super Mutants?
translation: 你们待在这地方肯定是疯了！难道你们不怕超级变种人？

original: Those knuckle draggers? Nah. They don't bother us Ghouls. Maybe they see us as kin or something. I dunno. Now, those other assholes...
translation: 那些大猩猩？不，他们不骚扰我们僵尸。说不定他们把我们当成亲戚还是怎么。我不知道。现在，其他那些混蛋……

original: Um... Where the hell did you come from?
translation: 呃……你他妈的是从哪来的？

original: Nice to meet you, too...
translation: 我倒是很乐意见到你……

original: I'm the sentry for Underworld. City of Ghouls? Inside the Museum? For a tourist, you're pretty clueless...
translation: 我是地下城的哨兵。僵尸之城的？博物馆里的？身为一名游客，你还真是够无知的了……

original: My name's Willow, by the way.
translation: 顺便告诉你，我叫薇儿。

original: What's with those things behind the glass?
translation: 玻璃后的那些东西是什么？

original: The Glowing Ones? That's Ethyl. The other one is Meat. They used to be residents of Underworld.
translation: 发光僵尸？那是乙荃，另一个是米特。他们曾是地下城的居民。

original: Doctor Barrows is studying the link between normal Ghouls, Feral Ghouls, and Glowing Ones.
translation: 巴罗斯医生正在研究普通僵尸、凶悍僵尸和发光僵尸之间的联系。

original: His research is truly fascinating.
translation: 他的研究真有趣。

original: Blessings to you, too. Surely, you would care to give a tithe for that wisdom?
translation: 也祝福你。当然了，你介不介意为那点智慧做点施舍？

original: Oh, yes, of course! Please, accept this. It's all I have, but surely I owe everything to the lessons in your holy guide. Bless you.
translation: 哦，是的，当然！请收下这，它是我的所有，不过当然，这一切都要归功于你对这课程神圣的指导。祝福你。

original: I never meant it like all that. It's just supposed to help you stay alive.
translation: 我从没想过它会那么重要，它只是应该用来帮助你们活下去。

original: Yes, it teaches us how to live, and how to return to the paradise that was! Truly, it is our guide through this wasted land.
translation: 是的，它教我们怎样活着，怎样回到天堂！它真的是带我们穿过这片废弃之地的向导。

original: Please, take these as my thanks. So many of us owe our lives to your great work. Bless you.
translation: 带走这些，作为我对你的感谢。我们的生命全都拜你伟大的工作所赐。祝福你。

original: No. Why don't you tell me about it? <Lie>
translation: 不，为什么你不和我说说这个？<撒谎>

original: It's a glory of a book! It teaches us what to do, how to live, and how our people can return to the paradise that once was!
translation: 这是本荣耀之书！它教我们怎样活着，怎样回到天堂！它真的是带我们穿过这片废弃之地的向导。

original: You simply must read it, friend, it'll save your life... and maybe even your soul! Please, take my copy and spread the word!
translation: 你必须好好读一读，朋友，它会拯救你的生命……甚至可能是你的灵魂！请带走我的这一本，让更多的人体会到它的福音！

original: Read it? I helped write it!
translation: 读它？就是我帮助写成了它！

original: Glory be! You're the great survivor!
translation: 真是光荣！你就是那个伟大的幸存者！

original: Bless you, oh bless you for sharing your wisdom with mankind! You've given us all a chance to hope again!
translation: 祝福你，哦，祝福你和人类分享你们的智慧！你给了我们所有人重获希望的机会！

original: You must be crazy. It's never a good day out here.
translation: 你肯定是疯了，这绝不会有什么好日子。

original: That's where you're wrong, my friend. I'm alive, I've got food, and humanity is hard at work surviving and rebuilding!
translation: 你错了，我的朋友。我活着，我有食物，有一颗为继续活下去和重建世界的博爱之心！

original: Haven't you heard the good news? Haven't you read the Wasteland Survival Guide?
translation: 难道你还没收到这些好消息？难道你还没读到这本废土生存手册？

original: Why are you so happy?
translation: 你为什么这么高兴？

original: Why shouldn't I be? I've got food, I've got shelter, and I know humanity is on the rise again!
translation: 我为什么不该高兴呢？我有食物，我有庇护所，我知道博爱会再次笼罩人间！

original: Haven't you heard the good news? Haven't you read the Wasteland Survival Guide?
translation: 难道你还没收到这些好消息？难道你还没读到这本废土生存手册？

original: Actually, I helped write that book.
translation: 事实上，我协助撰写了那本书。

original: Is that so? Well, thanks, stranger. You and that Moira girl done all right by me and mine. Nice writing!
translation: 这样？谢谢你，陌生人。你和那女孩莫伊拉为我们做了大好事。写得太好了！

original: Two meals a day doesn't sound like much.
translation: 一天两顿饭听起来少了点。

original: Not to a fancy-pants like yourself, but it's a lot better than zero meals a day, and that was getting a might bit too common!
translation: 当然满足不了你这样的娘娘腔，不过总比整天饿肚子要强，而且最近我们经常能吃饱肚子了。

original: Now, excuse me, I best be getting back with this bounty of meat.
translation: 抱歉，我最好现在就带上肉回去。

original: Oh, I am hunting. I'm hunting what you've got.
translation: 哦，我在打猎，打你身上东西的猎。

original: Too bad for you, I'm ready for your type, Raider!
translation: 你运气真差，我对你这样的人早有防备，歹徒！

original: Maybe the book's fine, and you're just an idiot.
translation: 或许这本书不错，而你只是个白痴。

original: Well, I'd have to be an idiot to listen to this piece of crap. Here, you think so much of it, you take it. Fat lot of good it'll do you.
translation: 这么说吧，我要是想看这本破书那我就是个白痴。拿着，你觉得这本书不错是吧，那你自己留着吧，它能帮你很大忙呢。

original: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it really that bad?
translation: 听到这个我很遗憾，它真的那么糟？

original: Here, take a look. It's good for a laugh, but don't try to actually follow its advice. Not unless you're looking for a quick way to end it all.
translation: 给，看看，它很好笑，不过别把它的建议当真，除非你不想活了。

original: Actually, I helped write that book.
translation: 事实上，我协助撰写了那本书。

original: Then I think you oughtta leave, before I decide to pay you back for all the bad advice. And take your damned book with you, too.
translation: 我想你最好在因为你书里的那些糟糕的建议而揍你一顿之前，带上你的破书滚蛋！

original: Book? What book?
translation: 书？什么书？

original: Ain't you heard of the Wasteland Survival Guide? Bought one off a trader, and it's the reason my family's back up to two meals a day!
translation: 难道你没听说过废土生存手册？我从商人那买了一本，有了它，我和家人一天能吃上两顿饭了！

original: Just be glad you're still alive.
translation: 很高兴你还活着。

original: Yeah, and no thanks to this so-called Wasteland Survival Guide. It's a piece of crap, is what it is.
translation: 嗯，我不会为这本所谓的废土生存手册道谢。它就是一本破书。

original: Serves me right for taking advice from some crazy girl's book.
translation: 从疯女孩写的书里找建议是我自作自受。

original: What book?
translation: 什么书？

original: This so-called Wasteland Survival Guide. It's a piece of crap, is what it is. Serves me right for taking advice from some crazy girl's book.
translation: 这本所谓的废土生存手册，它就是一本破书。从疯女孩写的书里找建议是我自作自受。

original: Sorry, miss, but we need to ask you a few questions.
translation: 抱歉，小姐，不过我要问你些问题。

original: We need to know where you got that suit.
translation: 我们想知道你是从哪里得到那件套装的。

original: I'm from Vault 101! Please, you've got to help me.
translation: 我来自101号避难所！求你们帮帮我。

original: Of course. We are always ready to assist American citizens in distress. Can you tell us where your Vault is?
translation: 当然，我们总是时刻准备帮助身处不幸中的美利坚公民。能告诉我们你的避难所在哪里吗？

original: I've got the location right here on my Pip-Boy. Why?
translation: 我的哔哔小子上有它的位置。怎么了？

original: Excellent. That's all we need from her. Open fire.
translation: 太棒了。我们就是要打听这个。开火。

original: Fine, I like it better up here than I ever did down there.
translation: 很好，比起下面，我更喜欢待在这里。

original: Then I guess things worked out pretty well, huh? Take care of yourself out here. And thanks again - you've given the Vault a whole new life.
translation: 我想一切都顺利吧，呃？照顾好你自己，再次感谢 - 你给避难所带来了生机。

original: Well, don't let me hold you up.
translation: 不妨碍你了。

original: Yeah, I guess I should be getting back. I'll tell Amata you're okay, she'll be happy to hear that.
translation: 嗯，我想我该回去了。我会告诉阿玛塔你一切都好，她听到这消息后会很高兴。

original: Oh, and here: have some fresh water from the Vault. I guess it's pretty hard to find it out here. Take care out here, and thanks again.
translation: 哦，给：从避难所带来的一点净水，我猜在这很难找到。多保重，再次感谢。

original: I miss her, too. Give my warmest regards to the Vault, would you?
translation: 我也想她。替我向避难所问好，行吗？

original: Oh, I will. They'll be glad to hear from you. Oh, and here: have some fresh water from the Vault.
translation: 哦，我会的。他们听到你的消息一定很高兴。哦，给，从避难所带来的一点净水。

original: I guess it's pretty hard to find it out here, and maybe it'll be a taste of home for you. Take care out here, and thanks again.
translation: 我猜它在外面一定少见，它会让你感受到家的味道。多保重，再次感谢。

original: Doesn't really make a difference to me. I was exiled, remember?
translation: 这对我来说没什么区别。我被赶出来了，记得吗？

original: I know. It's not fair, it really isn't, but it's just the way it has to be. I know Amata still misses you.
translation: 我知道那不公平，真的不公平，但只能这样。我知道阿玛塔一直在想你。

original: So, does that mean I can come back?
translation: 就是说，我能回去了？

original: I'm sorry, but that still can't happen. As much as we owe you, there are still a lot of people who blame you for all the deaths.
translation: 我很抱歉，不过还不行。虽然我们都欠你的情，但仍然有不少人还在为当时造成的死亡责备你。

original: It's not fair, I know, but it's the way it is. I know Amata still misses you.
translation: 那不公平，我知道，不过只能这样。我知道阿玛塔一直在想你。

original: I never expected to see you out here, either. I'm surprised you're alive.
translation: 我也从没指望在这见到你，没想到你还活着。

original: Hey, you're not the only one who can get used to the outdoors, you know! The whole Vault's doing pretty well, as if you care.
translation: 嗨，难道只有你能适应户外生活么！假设你还关心的话，避难所运作得非常好。

original: Good to see you, Susie! Looks like you're doing well.
translation: 看见你真好，苏茜！看起来你们情况不错。

original: Thanks! The whole Vault's doing pretty well.
translation: 谢谢！整个避难所运作得相当好。

original: I'm just out taking care a little trading, now, but they've got the place in much better shape than when you left.
translation: 我只是出来做点买卖，不过比起你离开时，他们现在把避难所管理得更加井井有条。

original: I've got to go now.
translation: 我现在得走了。

original: Now don't get crazy on me and start wearing branches...
translation: 可别对我发疯，开始往身上挂树枝啊……

original: Come back and visit me some time.
translation: 有时间的话，回来看看我。

original: Okay! Wave bye-bye Bob! Oh come one, move a branch at least... sigh.
translation: 好的！再见，鲍勃！哦，拜托，至少摇下树枝嘛……唉。*

original: You're obviously crazier than they are. Why would I listen to you?
translation: 你显然比他们更加疯狂。我为什么要听你的？

original: I can't say I blame you. Its my mistake for making you do something you didn't want to do in the first place I guess.
translation: 我不能怪你。我想一开始让你去做你不想做的事是我的错。

original: Still, maybe it's all for the best. I mean, I've been talking with Birch and they really seem to need me.
translation: 不过，或许这一切就是最好的安排。我是说，我和伯奇聊过了，他们似乎真的很需要我。

original: What do you say Herbert, should I give them another chance?
translation: 赫伯特，你怎么说，我该再给他们一次机会吗？

original: Fine, fine. I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我是说鲍勃。我每次叫他赫伯特都觉得很好玩。

original: I'm not the killing type.
translation: 我不是那种会杀人的人。

original: No, I suppose you aren't. My mistake for making you do something you didn't want to do in the first place I guess.
translation: 是啊，我想你也不是。是我的错，不该让你做一开始就不想做的事。

original: Still, maybe it's all for the best. I mean, I've been talking with Birch and they really seem to need me.
translation: 不过，或许这一切就是最好的安排。我是说，我和伯奇聊过了，他们似乎真的很需要我。

original: What do you say Herbert, should I give them another chance?
translation: 赫伯特，你怎么说，我该再给他们一次机会吗？

original: Fine, fine. I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我是说鲍勃。我每次叫他赫伯特都觉得很好玩。

original: You've become an important part of their life. Without you, they're lost.
translation: 你已经成为他们生活中重要的一部分。没有你，他们会不知所措。

original: So, they really need me that badly, huh? I guess I never thought of it that way. Awfully selfish of me.
translation: 这么说，他们真的那么需要我，哈？我想我从来没这么想过。我太自私了。

original: Should we give them another chance, Herbert?
translation: 我们再给他们一次机会怎么样，赫伯特？

original: Fine, fine. I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我是说鲍勃。我每次叫他赫伯特都觉得很好玩。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Which Treeminder do you get along with the best?
translation: 你和哪位护树人相处得最好？

original: Actually, the kid is the nicest one of all. Yew's her name. She sneaks in here sometimes and just lets me talk about stuff I wanna talk about.
translation: 其实，那个孩子是所有人中最好的。她叫杨。有时她会偷溜进来，陪我尽情聊我想聊的事儿。

original: Bob really likes her too, cause she makes me happy.
translation: 鲍勃也很喜欢她，因为她能逗我开心。

original: How do the Treeminders normally handle other Outsiders?
translation: 树启者通常怎样对待其他的外来者？

original: Oh, you wouldn't believe how they handle them. They make them drink this gunk that Poplar makes.
translation: 哦，你不会相信的，他们让这些人喝波普勒做的这种黏糊糊东西。

original: Sometimes they just go nuts and start running around, and sometimes when they wake up and see me they run for the hills!
translation: 有时候，他们会直接发疯，开始四处乱跑；有时候，等他们醒来看到我，就会吓得赶紧逃走！

original: I'll tell you, Outsiders are almost as entertaining as the Treeminders!
translation: 我跟你说，外来者大多和树启者一样好玩。

original: Did you ever ask one of them to kill you?
translation: 你之前有要求过他们中某人杀了你吗？

original: They wouldn't listen to me at all! If I told them something simple, then it got done. Otherwise, Birch spent a week looking for a hidden meaning.
translation: 他们根本不听我的！我要是跟他们说些简单的事，那倒还罢了。否则，布尔奇会花上一周时间来参悟奥义。

original: Plus, he used to just pop in whenever he wanted and started chanting this nonsense.
translation: 再加上他总是习惯在任何时间突然跑进来，开始哼唧那些废话。

original: Sometimes I used to just sit there silently just to make him mad! That was fun for a while.
translation: 有时侯，我会故意不吭声，把他逼疯！有段时间，那很有趣。

original: Hopefully this will all change now that things are different... thanks to you!
translation: 现在情况不同了，很有希望改变……多亏你！

original: Had you ever asked one of them to kill you before?
translation: 你以前有没有让他们中的某个人杀了你？

original: They won't listen to me at all. If I tell them something simple, then it gets done. Otherwise, Birch spends a week looking for a hidden meaning.
translation: 他们根本不听我的。我要是跟他们交代简单的事，那倒还罢了。否则，伯奇会花上一周时间来参悟隐含的奥义。

original: Plus, he just pops in whenever he wants and starts chanting this nonsense.
translation: 再加上他总是习惯在任何时间突然跑进来，开始哼唧那些废话。

original: Sometimes I just sit there silently just to make him mad. That was fun for a while, but even that's getting boring now.
translation: 有时侯，我会故意不吭声，把他逼疯！有段时间，那很有趣。不过次数多了，现在也会觉得很无聊。

original: About those Treeminders...
translation: 关于那些树启者……

original: Oh, don't get me started on them. I'm liable to talk about them all day! It even drives poor old Bob crazy.
translation: 哦，别给我找机会说这个。我可以说上一整天的！这甚至让可怜的老鲍勃都快疯了。

original: Nevermind.
translation: 没关系。

original: Let's go.
translation: 走吧。

original: What is this place? Some kind of city?
translation: 这是什么地方？某个城市？

original: It's Megaton. Have you been living in a hole or something? Everyone's heard of Megaton.
translation: 这是兆吨镇。你是在洞穴长大的还是怎么？所有人都知道兆吨镇。

original: They have plenty of water in there, but they only give it to residents... or people who can pay for it.
translation: 他们有大量的水，不过他们只发给居民……或者出得起价的人。

original: Timmy Neusbaum? Who's that?
translation: 提米·纽斯保？那是谁？

original: He's the only other kid that lives here besides you. He's a big crybaby... You'll see.
translation: 他是除你以外，这里唯一的小孩。他是个爱哭鬼……你等着瞧吧。

original: Make him cry and then come back here so we can talk some more.
translation: 把他弄哭，然后回到这，我们就可以再聊聊。

original: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Oh... oh... ha ha ha ha ha ha.... That a good one! Ha ha ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！噢……噢……哈哈哈哈哈哈……这个好！哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Kill the humans! Kill them all! Aggghhh!!
translation: 干掉人类！干掉所有人类！啊~~~！

original: Humans who?
translation: 什么人类？

original: Humans.
translation: 人类。

original: Who there?
translation: 那是谁？

original: Do you sell any specialty items?
translation: 你有没有什么特别的货色？

original: Do I ever! I've got the schematics for something called a Rock-It Launcher. I sell all the components, too, so you can make the weapon yourself.
translation: 当然有！我有一张名叫捣蛋发射器的设计图，我也出售它的所有零件，因此你可以自己造出来。

original: Don't worry about ammo! This baby shoots all the junk you might find out there in the Wasteland. Ashtrays, teddy bears... you name it!
translation: 别为弹药操心！这宝贝可以把你在废土中找到的各种垃圾都发射出去，像烟灰缸，泰迪熊……凡是你能找到的！

original: In fact, if you ever need to make any custom weapons, feel free to use my workbench, here in the shop. All you need is the schematics and parts!
translation: 事实上，如果你要制作任何自制武器，可以免费使用我的工作台，就在这商店里。你只需要有设计图和零件！

original: If this android "wandered" off, why would he want a new mind and face?
translation: 如果这仿真人是“走失”，为什么他会想要新的心智和面孔？

original: Maybe.... MAYBE he didn't exactly wander off. Maybe he fled. Escaped captivity, as it were, if he began to misinterpret his "situation."
translation: 或许……或许他并不是真的走失。也许他是逃走了。如果他开始误解自己的“处境”，对他来说，就像是逃出了囚禁一样。

original: It's possible my android sought to forget his previous life. Wipe away all memory, all guilt. Trick himself into believing he really IS human.
translation: 有可能我的仿真人是想遗忘他以前的生活，擦去所有记忆和所有愧疚，欺骗自己，让自己相信他真的是一个人类。

original: So no, he may not be just an ordinary robot, but he's certainly not human, no matter how badly he wishes it so. I made him. I want him. End of story.
translation: 所以不，他不可能只是个普通的机器人，但他肯定不是人类，无论他多么地希望如此。我创造了他，我想要他，就这样。

original: Okay, so if others have escaped... why are you coming after this one?
translation: 好吧，既然其他人也跑了……你为什么还要来追这一个？

original: This particular android... Designation A3-21, is... different. Special. The most advanced synthetic humanoid I've ever developed.
translation: 这个特殊仿真人……代号A3-21，是……与众不同。特别的。是我开发过最先进的合成人。

original: The others, like my escort Armitage there, are all older models. Easily replicated. Ah, but A3-21... it would take years to recreate him!
translation: 其他的，像我的护卫阿米蒂奇，都是旧型号。很容易复制。啊，但A3-21……如果重新制造的话，要花上许多年！

original: So you see, this android MUST be located. At all costs. The others are all... acceptable losses. But A3-21, he is... irreplaceable.
translation: 所以你懂了，这仿真人必须被找到，不惜一切代价。其他的都是……可接受的损失。但A3-21，他是……无可替代的。

original: Why would an android feel guilt? Come on, Zimmer, what aren't you telling me?
translation: 为什么一个仿真人会感到愧疚？拜托，齐默，你有什么没告诉我的吗？

original: By God, you're as annoying as you are clever. Very well. I'll tell you what you want to know, if it helps you locate my property.
translation: 上帝啊，你很聪明也很烦人。好吧，要是你能找到我的财产，那我告诉你。

original: The duty of this particular unit was the hunting and capturing of other escaped androids. Yes, others have escaped.
translation: 这个特殊单位的职责是搜寻和捕获其他逃跑的仿真人。没错，其他仿真人逃跑了。

original: It's one of the side effects of having such an advanced A.I. Machines start to think for themselves. Fool themselves into believing they have rights.
translation: 这是拥有如此先进人工智能的副作用之一。机器开始自己思考。它们自欺欺人地认为自己拥有权利。

original: And so... this particular android may have believed he'd done something... wrong. Immoral.  And wanted to forget those deeds. Satisfied now?
translation: 所以……这个特殊的仿真人可能认为自己做了……错事。不道德的事。并且想要忘记那些行为。满意了吗？

original: Well, you found me. Now try and kill me, tough guy.
translation: 你找到了我。来试试杀死我，硬汉。

original: You!? You killed her!?
translation: 你！？你杀了她！？

original: That's it... you're dead meat! Say hello to the Kneecapper!
translation: 对……你玩完了！跟碎膝者打个招呼吧！

original: The Nuka-Cola Corporation had her killed! (Lie)
translation: 核子可乐公司害死了她！(撒谎)

original: Crap! This has to be about the Nuka-Cola machine I got for her!
translation: 胡说！大概是我送给她的那核子可乐机害的！

original: It had this label on it saying "Warning: If you tamper with this unit you will have to answer to the Nuka-Cola Corporation."
translation: 它上面有个标签说“警告：如需修改，必须征询核子可乐公司同意”。

original: Now I bet they're after me! Oh god! I gotta hide. I gotta go!
translation: 我打赌他们正在找我！天啊！我要躲起来！我得走了！

original: Yeah, it's a shame. She was beautiful.
translation: 是的，可惜，她那么美。

original: Wasn't she?
translation: 难道不是吗？

original: All I know is things are sure gonna be awfully quiet around here with her gone.
translation: 我知道的就是，她不在的话，这就会变得特别安静。

original: Ah well. I guess I'll go clean up the mess and take care of things around here.
translation: 唉。我想我应该清理一下，把这管起来。

original: Ahem... Anyway, that's all in the past now.
translation: 咳……不管怎样，那些都已经过去了。

original: Where was Vault 87 again?
translation: 再问下87号避难所在哪？

original: Check the map in the lab for reference, if you like. The Vault is to the west of the city, far out in the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 你要是愿意，可以查看一下实验室的地图。这避难所位于这座城市的西部，首都废土的边缘。

original: Remember that you won't be able to just walk in, due to the radiation. You'll have to try and find another way to access the vault.
translation: 记住，由于辐射，你不可能大摇大摆地走进去。你必须设法找到其他的路进入这避难所。

original: I expect that Lamplight Caverns is your best chance for success.
translation: 我认为从小灯镇洞穴走是最好的。

original: My father was looking for something called a G.E.C.K. Do you have one?
translation: 我父亲在找名叫伊甸园创造器的东西，你有吗？

original: A G.E.C.K.? Goodness, no. Certainly not.
translation: 伊甸园创造器？天啊，没，当然没有。

original: I must say that there are some who doubt such a device really exists, let alone works.
translation: 我必须说，有些人怀疑这种装置是否真的存在，更不用说这玩意有没有用了。

original: If, however, you share your father's determination, I may be able to assist you in locating one.
translation: 不过，你要是能有你爸爸那样的决心，我或许能帮你定位一个。

original: What the hell just happened?
translation: 究竟发生了什么？

original: James... Your father caused an overload. He sacrificed himself to keep the Enclave from getting the purifier, and to buy us time to escape.
translation: 詹姆斯…你父亲引发了一次超载。他牺牲了自己来阻止英克雷，保护了净化器，为我们逃跑争取时间。

original: There'll be more of them coming. We need to get out of here before they find us, or else your father died in vain.
translation: 他们快来了。在他们找到我们之前，我们要离开这，否则你父亲就白死了。

original: The gate's open. Run for it!
translation: 大门开了，快跑！

original: What? No, I never said that.
translation: 什么？不，我从没说过那种话。

original: Ain't got no use for one. Lost most of my hair a long time ago, y'see?
translation: 这没用。很久以前我的头发就掉得差不多了，你看？

original: Ain't had enough to drink. Can't go nowheres.
translation: 没喝够，哪都去不了。

original: Now's our chance! Let's go!
translation: 现在是我们的机会！我们走！

original: Freedom!
translation: 自由！

original: I'm interested in the Love Machine Theme.
translation: 我对性爱装饰主题有兴趣。

original: Feeling a bit anxious, perhaps?
translation: 或许会感觉有点不安？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: Yuck, the thought of walking around naked's making me sick.
translation: 讨厌，这种裸奔的想法让我觉得恶心。

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: I'm interested in the Love Machine Theme.
translation: 我对性爱装饰主题有兴趣。

original: Feeling a bit anxious are we?
translation: 有点不安，是吧？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

original: You're forcing me to do things against my nature, and I hate you for it.
translation: 你在强迫我做违背我本性的事，我恨你。

original: I don't recall asking for your feelings on the matter.
translation: 我不记得在这事上问过你的感受。

original: If it has not been made perfectly clear to you, I am in control here. I dictate your actions, and the actions of those around you.
translation: 要是还没跟你讲得清清楚楚的话，这里由我作主。我决定了你和你周围人的行动。

original: You will continue to do exactly as I say, or you will find yourself suffering from a sudden and inexplicable aneurysm.
translation: 你得继续完全按我说的去做，否则你会突然莫名地患上动脉瘤而饱受折磨。

original: And that's if I'm feeling generous.
translation: 这还是我宽大处理呢。

original: For now, though, you will become the Pint-Sized Slasher. You will kill everyone in Tranquility Lane, and you will do this because I say so.
translation: 不过眼下，你要当“小小屠夫”。你得杀掉宁静巷的每一个人。因为是我要你这么干的，所以你没得选择。

original: Behind the Abandoned House, in the dog house, are a knife and mask. You will use them to terrorize the residents of this quaint little street.
translation: 在那废房后面的狗窝里，有一把刀和一副面具。你要用它们去恐吓这条古雅小巷的居民。

original: I don't want to do this... But I will.
translation: 我不想做这事……但我会做的。

original: Of course you will. And you never know... You might enjoy it.
translation: 你当然会做。而且很难说……你或许会享受上的。

original: So it's not yours? Oops.
translation: 它不是你的？哎哟。

original: What is this doing here?
translation: 在这做什么？

original: What am I supposed to be doing again?
translation: 再说一遍，我该怎么做？

original: Take on the role of the Pint-Sized Slasher, and kill everyone on Tranquility Lane. I'll be waiting.
translation: 打扮成小杀手，干掉宁静巷的每一个人。我等着。

original: Mabel Henderson needs to die. But in a creative, fun sort of way. I'm sure you'll think of something.
translation: 梅布尔·亨德森得去死。但要以既有创意又有趣的方式。我相信你会想到点子的。

original: Visit the Rockwells. Observe their happy marriage, and then destroy it. But don't kill them; that'd spoil the fun.
translation: 去罗克韦尔家串门，观察他们的幸福婚姻，然后毁了它。但别杀他们，那样会减少乐趣。

original: You need to go find Timmy Neusbaum, and make him cry. It'll be funny. You'll see.
translation: 你要去找提米·纽斯保，把他弄哭。那会很有趣。

original: Zimmer thought you were an android. Don't worry, I set him straight.
translation: 齐默认为你是一个人造人。别担心，我把他纠正过来。

original: I knew there was something about that guy I hated. An android? Good lord... Anyway, thanks for talking to him for me. I... I appreciate that.
translation: 我恨那个家伙，不过我还是了解一些关于他的事情。一个人造人？好家伙……不管怎样，谢谢你帮我去找他谈。我……我很感激。

original: The android is dead. See, here's an internal component. <Lie.>
translation: 人造人死了。看，这是一个零件。<撒谎。>

original: What? Let me see that! This is a Neuro-Servo... Unique to the A3-21... I... And you say you got this from his corpse?
translation: 什么？让我看看！这是神经伺服……A3-21独有的……我……并且你说是从他的尸体上找到的？

original: I suppose there's no other way you could have obtained it. Well... damn it. I was afraid this would happen, out here in this, this... Wasteland.
translation: 我想你没别的办法能得到它。嗯……该死。我就怕会发生这种事，在这，这……废土上。

original: Well. Here's 50 caps for your troubles. Try to buy yourself an education out here in this hell. Good day.
translation: 好吧。这50个瓶盖，就算给你的辛苦废。试着在这地狱般的地方为自己买点教育吧。再见。

original: Look, Doctor Zimmer, we’ve been over this. We don’t know about your runaway robot, and we don’t care. This lab is dedicated to solving real problems.
translation: 听着，齐默博士，我们已经谈过了。对于你逃跑的人造人，我们不清楚，也不关心。这间实验室是用来解决真正的问题的。

original: Doctor Li is trying to save lives, and your constant interruptions are interfering with those efforts. Now please, stand aside!
translation: 李博士正设法拯救生命，你不断打扰干扰了她的努力。请走开！

original: What’s at stake? You won’t TELL me what’s at stake! Vagaries and secrecy! A robot’s a robot, Zimmer, no matter how shiny the paint job. Now please...
translation: 有什么危险？你不说清楚，我怎么知道什么东西正处在危险中！想入非非！鬼里鬼气！机器人不过就是机器人，齐默，别花言巧语了，没有用的，现在……

original: You know, if you’re so smart, maybe you could help US? Hmm? But no, that never even crossed your mind. Go peddle your selfishness somewhere else.
translation: 你知道，如果你这么聪明，或许你能够帮帮我们？嗯？但不，你从没这么想过。到别处去叫卖你的自私自利。

original: Suit yourself.
translation: 听你的。

original: But surely one of you glorified test tube jockeys can assist me? For the most advanced scientific center in the Capital Wasteland, I find your...
translation: 但的确，你们的一个的试管操作员能够帮助我？作为首都废土中这家最先进的科学中心，我认为……

original: Yes, yes, yes... But Doctor Li...
translation: 是的，是的，是的……不过李博士……

original: I’m sure the good doctor’s work with water purification is fascinating, but if you only knew what was at stake. The technology in that android...
translation: 我确信大博士的水净化工作很棒，但你们得知道什么才是最紧急的。那人造人身上的技术……

original: Ignorance and facetiousness! That’s all you people are good for. Shiny paint job, indeed. You can’t even imagine the Commonwealth's accomplishments.
translation: 无知可笑！那是适合你们所有人的称号。夸夸其谈，确实是这样，你们甚至都想象不出联邦的造诣。

original: Fine. But I’m not leaving. Not until I’ve spoken to Doctor Li. I’ll be here when she’s ready to abandon her chemistry set and talk real science.
translation: 好吧，但我不会离开，除非我已经和李博士谈过了。我会一直等到她准备遗弃她的化学装置，谈真正的科学。

original: There's something you aren't telling me. Isn't there?
translation: 有些事你没告诉我，对吧？

original: Oh, all right. So maybe I didn't wipe his mind, like he asked. But I buried it! Deep! Almost as good, really. But it's still there. Still accessible.
translation: 哦，好吧。也许我并没有按他要求的那样抹除他的心智。但我把它隐藏了！隐地很深！其实效果也没两样。但还存在，还能找到。

original: All you need to do is use the recall code. Just say to him, "Activate A3-21 Recall Code Violet" and that will activate the hidden subroutines.
translation: 你只需要使用回忆代码。只需对他说，“激活A3-21回忆代码 Violet”，这样就会激活隐藏的子程序。

original: What if this evidence doesn't work? What if Harkness doesn't believe me?
translation: 如果这证据不起作用，该怎么做？要是哈克尼斯不相信我，又该如何？

original: Well, there is something else you could use. Look, I didn't really wipe his memories. Okay? I just sort of filed them away. But you can get 'em back.
translation: 嗯，你还有别东西可以的用。听着，我没有真的清除他的记忆，怎样？我只是把它们归档了。但你可以把它们找回来。

original: All you need to do is use the recall code. Just say to him, "Activate A3-21 Recall Code Violet" and that will activate the hidden subroutines.
translation: 你只需要使用回忆代码。只需对他说，“激活A3-21回忆代码 Violet”，这样就会激活隐藏的子程序。

original: Harkness should be told. You'd want to know if you were an android.
translation: 应该把事实告诉哈克尼斯。如果你是个人造人，你就能明白了。

original: Maybe I am! Maybe I'm going to have my android army rise up against you and your human ilk!
translation: 也许我就是！也许我会让我的仿真人大军起来反抗你和你的人类同类！

original: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Sorry... Oh... sorry, I couldn't resist...
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！抱歉……噢……抱歉，我没忍住……

original: I suppose you're right. But don't worry, I didn't really wipe his memories. I just buried them. But you can get them back.
translation: 我想你是对的。不过别担心，我没有真的清除他的记忆。我只是把它们隐藏了，不过你可以找回来。

original: All you need to do is use the recall code. Just say to him, "Activate A3-21 Recall Code Violet" and that will activate the hidden subroutines.
translation: 你只需要使用回忆代码。只需对他说，“激活A3-21回忆代码 Violet”，这样就会激活隐藏的子程序。

original: Sorry Harkness, but this is the only way. Activate A3-21 Recall Code Violet.
translation: 抱歉，哈克尼斯，但这是唯一的办法。激活A3-21回忆代码 Violet。

original: Agggggghh!!!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊！！！

original: My God, I... I remember. I remember it all. From before. Zimmer. The Commonwealth. The Institute. My God, all those runners I brought down...
translation: 我的天，我……我记起来了。我全记起来了。从过去。齐默、联邦、学院。我的天，那些我击倒的逃亡者……

original: You... You made me remember. Why? How? I... Never mind... I just... My God... What am I going to do? My life, everything, it's all a lie...
translation: 你……你让我记起来了。为什么？怎么做到的？我……算了……我只是……我的天……我该怎么办？我的人生，我的一切，全都是谎言……

original: Welcome back to reality, you filthy android. Activate A3-21 Recall Code Violet.
translation: 欢迎回到现实，你这恶心的仿真人。激活A3-21回忆代码 Violet。

original: Agggggghh!!!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊！！！

original: My God, I... I remember. I remember it all. From before. Zimmer. The Commonwealth. The Institute. My God, all those runners I brought down...
translation: 我的天，我……我记起来了。我全记起来了。从过去。齐默、联邦、学院。我的天，那些我击倒的逃亡者……

original: You... You made me remember. Why? How? I... Never mind... I just... My God... What am I going to do? My life, everything, it's all a lie...
translation: 你……你让我记起来了。为什么？怎么做到的？我……算了……我只是……我的天……我该怎么办？我的人生，我的一切，全都是谎言……

original: What do you know about the Commonwealth?
translation: 你对联邦知道些什么？

original: Most of it's a blasted nothing, just like here. But there's talk. Rumors, mostly. About a place called the Institute.
translation: 大部分地方都破败不堪，就像这里一样。但有传言，大都是谣言。关于一个叫学院的地方。

original: That's where Zimmer and that android came from. God knows what else they got goin' on in there, but it puts our tech to shame, that's for damn sure.
translation: 齐默和那仿真人就来自那地方。天知道他们还在那干些什么，但可以肯定的是，他们的技术让我们自愧不如。

original: What do you know about this android Railroad?
translation: 你对于人造人“铁路”都知道些什么？

original: Bunch of bleeding heart morons if you ask me. They're going to get themselves killed one of these days. And for what? Machine liberation?
translation: 如果你问我，我会说他们是一群假装有同情心的蠢货。他们总有一天都会被杀掉，因为什么？机器解放？

original: But, they have brought me some really interesting tech over the years, so I guess they're okay. And that android! He was the chance of a lifetime.
translation: 不过，过去的这些年，他们给我带了一些非常有趣的技术，所以呢，我觉得他们还行吧。还有那仿真人！他可是千载难逢的机会。

original: So why'd you help the android?
translation: 那么你为什么帮助这人造人？

original: Ha! Why do you think? I wanted to crack open that Commonwealth can opener to see what was inside.
translation: 哈！你说为什么呢？我要把联邦开启，看看里面到底是什么。

original: There's stuff in there I'd only heard about, and even then I didn't believe it. I can see why that Zimmer feller wanted him back so bad.
translation: 那里面有我只是听说过的那些玩意，尽管亲眼看到了我也还是不敢相信。我能明白齐默老小子为什么要如此郑重地把他找回来。

original: So what do I call you, now? Harkness or A3-21?
translation: 那么，我现在该怎么称呼你，哈克尼斯还是A3-21？

original: Well... I'm not really sure... look, just call me Harkness. That's who I am to the people on this boat who rely on me. It's who I am now...
translation: 嗯……我真不太确定……听着，就叫我哈克尼斯吧。对于这艘船上依赖我的人，那就是我。我现在就是哈克尼斯……

original: In fact, for everyone's sake, let's just pretend I've always been Harkness. We'll keep the truth a little secret between friends. All right?
translation: 事实上，为了大家着想，我们就假装我一直都是哈克尼斯吧。我们把真相当作朋友之间的小秘密。好吗？

original: Well... now that you know the truth. What are you going to do?
translation: 嗯……既然你知道了真相。那你打算怎么办？

original: I have two sets of memories... one android, one human... some of these are mine, some belong to someone else.
translation: 我有两套记忆……一套人造人的，一套人类的……一些是我的，一些属于其他人。

original: But I'm choosing to be human. It's my choice. The people on this boat look to me to protect them. So that's what I'm going to do.
translation: 但我选择成为人类。这是我的选择。船上的这些人都在指望我保护他们。所以我打算这么做。

original: So why did you do go ahead with the change? Was it worth it?
translation: 那你为什么要做出改变呢？值得吗？

original: I don't know... every time I retrieved one of the runaway androids, they'd fill my head with ideas about self-determination, freedom...
translation: 我不知道……每次我找回一个逃跑的仿真人，他们就会向我灌输关于自我决定、自由的想法……

original: At first I resisted the ideas... but then, I started thinking about it, and well... they were right. We're just slaves to them.
translation: 起初我抵制这些想法……但后来，我开始思考，嗯……他们是对的。我们只是他们的奴隶。

original: We deserve lives of our own. So that's what I did. I chose a new life, and gave up my old one. And now you've given me both to remember.
translation: 我们值得拥有自己的生活。所以我这么做了。我选择了一种新的生活，放弃了旧的生活。而现在，你让我同时记住了两者。

original: At ease.
translation: 稍息。

original: It is, Scribe Peabody. Thank you.
translation: 是的，文士博迪。谢谢你。

original: Indeed it does, Scribe Bowditch.
translation: 它真的有用，鲍蒂奇文士。

original: As you were.
translation: 继续吧。

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: If I help you, is there some kind of reward?
translation: 我要是帮助你，会有回报吗？

original: Of course! If you help me, and thus the android, God and the universe will smile upon you. Is there any better compensation?
translation: 当然！如果你帮我、并因此帮助这人造人，上帝和宇宙会向你微笑。还有比这些更好的报答吗？

original: Anything else I should know?
translation: 还有什么我应该知道的吗？

original: Just understand that this android is now, for all intents and purposes, a man. He looks human, he acts human. He believes he IS human.
translation: 只要明白，这仿真人现在，不论是意图还是目的，都是个人。他外表像人，他行为像人，他相信自己就是人类。

original: But even if he's not... Even if he's a machine... He's capable of rational thought. And emotion. So you see, his soul is as human as yours or mine.
translation: 但即使他不是……即使他只是机器……他依然能理性思考，富有感情。所以你看，他的灵魂和你我一样是人类。

original: This person -- and he is a person -- deserves a chance at freedom. Please, if there's a shred of decency in you, don't take that away from him.
translation: 这个人——而且他是个人——应该拥有获得自由的机会。拜托，如果你还有一丝体面的话，请不要剥夺他的这项权利。

original: Can I join the Railroad?
translation: 我能加入“铁路”吗？

original: Tell you what. You deliver that component to Zimmer and tell him the android is dead, and you can consider yourself a member in good standing.
translation: 把这零件交给齐默，告诉他人造人死了，那你就可以说自己行了善事。

original: What about human slaves? Don't you try to help them, too?
translation: 那么人类奴隶呢？你们不也想帮助他们吗？

original: Yes, if we are able. But there are others in the Wasteland who assist in the plight of human slaves. Our android brethren have only us.
translation: 是的，如果我们能帮的话。不过在废土上，有其他的人正在帮助困境中的人类奴隶。而我们仿真人同胞却只有我们。

original: What's this "movement" you mentioned?
translation: 你提到的“运动”是什么？

original: We call ourselves the Railroad. Our mission is the rescue and salvation of synthetic humanoids. Androids, as they're more commonly known.
translation: 我们称自己为“铁路”。我们的使命是营救和拯救合成人类。他们更常见的称呼是“仿真人”。

original: This conversation's over, Ms. Watts. Now step aside.
translation: 瓦兹女士，谈话结束了。让开。

original: Fine. Blow me off. Live in denial. But take this. It's an internal component from the very android you're searching for.
translation: 好啊，轰我走。逃避现实。但拿着这个。这是你要找的那个仿真人的一个内部组件。

original: Don't ask how I obtained it. If you change your mind, if you decide you want to help, present the component to Doctor Zimmer in Rivet City.
translation: 别问我是怎么得来的。你要是改变主意，决定要帮忙，就把这组件交给铆钉城的齐默博士。

original: Tell him the android is dead, and that was on the corpse. He'll believe you. He'll go back to the Commonwealth, and you'll have saved a man's life.
translation: 告诉他仿真人已经死了，这是从尸体上找到的。他会相信你，然后会回到联邦去，而你则拯救了一个人的生命。

original: What would you have me do?
translation: 你要我做什么？

original: You really want to help? Take this. It's an internal component from the very android you're searching for. Don't ask how I obtained it.
translation: 你真的想帮忙？拿上这个。这是你要找的人造人的一个零件。别问我是怎么得来的。

original: Present it to Doctor Zimmer in Rivet City. Tell him the android is dead, and that was on the corpse. He'll believe you.
translation: 给铆钉城的齐默博士看这零件，告诉他这人造人死了，零件是从尸体上找到的。他会相信你。

original: Do that, and Zimmer will go back to the Commonwealth, and leave that poor soul alone. Do that, and you'll have saved a man's life.
translation: 做完这件事，齐默会回到联邦，放过那可怜家伙。做完这件事，你将拯救一个人的生命。

original: What I do with my own time is my own goddamn business.
translation: 我他妈怎样花我自己的时间，是我自己的事。

original: Don't you realize what you're doing? The path you're on has the potential to ruin a man's life. Is that what you really want?
translation: 你难道不明白你正在做什么？你选择的路有可能毁灭一个人的生命，你真的想那样吗？

original: Listen to me... I'm involved with a movement that has dedicated itself to saving these runaway androids. I can't let you interfere with that work.
translation: 听我说……我在从事一项运动，拯救这些逃亡的人造人。我不能让你妨碍这项工作。

original: Look, whoever this missing android is, I just want to help. Okay?
translation: 听着，不管这人造人是怎么回事，我只是想帮忙，好吗？

original: Well... If that's true, then the first thing you need to do is halt your investigation. No more questions, no more searching.
translation: 嗯……如果是这样的话，你应该立刻停止你的调查。不再提问，不再搜索。

original: The movement I'm involved with, we help his kind escape their Commonwealth-imposed slavery. We help them... disappear. You understand?
translation: 我加入了一项运动，就是帮助他那样的人造人逃离他们的联邦奴隶制度。我们帮他们……失踪。你明白吗？

original: I think you're confusing me with someone else...
translation: 我想你把我和某人搞混了……

original: Am I? You haven't talked to someone lately about a missing android? Or nosed around and found some information you should have left buried?
translation: 是吗？你最近没跟人谈起过失踪的仿真人？或者到处打听，发现一些你本该埋藏起来的信息？

original: I belong to a movement that has taken great efforts to hide this android, to protect him. I think you see where I'm going with this...
translation: 我属于一个为隐藏这个仿真人、保护他而付出巨大努力的运动组织。我想你明白我的意思了……

original: Who the hell are you?
translation: 见鬼，你是谁？

original: Fine, let's cut to the chase. My name is Victoria Watts. I work for a movement whose goals are directly opposed to your own, apparently.
translation: 好吧，那我们就直入主题。我叫维多利亚·瓦兹，我从事一项运动，这运动的目的就是直接反对你的目的。

original: It seems you're trying very hard to locate an android my associates and I have tried very hard to hide. You can see how that puts us at odds.
translation: 你在想法设法找到一个人造人，而我和我的同僚则在想方设法把他藏起来。现在你知道我们的不同了。

original: Gaassp...
translation: 呼哧……

original: Huuuhhhhh...
translation: 呃啊……

original: Hhhuuuhh...
translation: 呃啊……

original: Oh, dear. Is that old radio on the fritz again? I should turn it off.
translation: 哦，亲爱的。老收音机又出问题了？我应该关掉它。

original: I can't wait. What do you want me to do?
translation: 我等不及了，你要我做什么？

original: Your enthusiasm is inspiring. It's a shame you didn't arrive earlier.
translation: 你的热情令人鼓舞。你没早点来这，真是可惜。

original: Now, you will become the Pint-Sized Slasher, and kill everyone in Tranquility Lane.
translation: 现在，你打扮成“小小屠夫”，杀掉宁静巷所有的人。

original: Behind the Abandoned house, there is a dog house. Inside that dog house are the knife and mask you will take up.
translation: 在那废房后面有个狗屋。狗屋里有你要拿取的刀和面具

original: Ha ha! Now, scram!
translation: 哈哈！滚开！

original: Yeah, run along and cry now!
translation: 耶，滚吧，哭吧！

original: Get out of here, dummy!
translation: 滚开，蠢货！

original: Damnit, Lucy! Leave me alone!
translation: 该死的，露西！别管我！

original: Get out of here, you jerk!
translation: 滚开，你这怪物！

original: Shut up before I pound you!
translation: 在我揍你之前，闭嘴！

original: Among other reasons, I'm not a mean bitch like you. No, I'm a mean bastard! There's a difference!
translation: 撇开其他不谈，我至少不是你这种恶毒的婊子。不，我是个恶毒的混蛋！完全不是一回事！

original: Whoops, didn't mean to bug you, Miss Pwincess. Sowwy.
translation: 哎呦，没想要打扰你，公主，对无起。

original: Didn't mean to bother you, Princess.
translation: 没想要打搅你，公主。

original: Sorry, Princess. Don't hurt me!
translation: 对不起，公主，别伤害我！

original: Nothing, I guess.
translation: 没什么。

original: I guess I got lots of reasons. I mean, I'm alive, and we've got food and shelter, and I found this awesome rock yesterday!
translation: 我想我有许多理由。我的意思是，我活着，我们有食物和庇护所，我昨天找到这块厉害的石头！

original: Because I know if you keep on bullying people, I can always pee on your cave fungus and you'll never know.
translation: 因为我知道如果你继续欺负人，我就总会趁你没瞧见时，在你的洞穴蘑菇上撒尿。

original: Sorry, Miss Princess. Please don't get angry at me, okay?
translation: 对不起，公主，别生我的气，好吗？

original: Oh, probably because MacCready likes me more than he likes you. That seems like a good reason to me!
translation: 哦，可能因为和你比起来，麦迪更喜欢我。那像是个好理由！

original: You know, the usual.
translation: 你知道，这很平常。

original: Not much, I guess. Apart from keeping you dumbasses in line, that is.
translation: 我想不多。除了管好你们这群蠢货。

original: Evewything's a-okay!
translation: 一且……正场！

original: Just talking to morons who keep bugging me. Scram!
translation: 去和那些不停打扰我的蠢货说话。滚开！

original: Fun times and laughs as always!
translation: 总是笑声不断！

original: Cool junk and collecting, as always!
translation: 继续收垃圾！

original: I was running so fast, I thought my legs were gonna fly off, but then they didn't, which makes sense, 'cause legs don't have wings. You know?
translation: 我飞快地跑，我想我的腿都快要飞出去了，不过它们没有，那是什么意思，因为腿没有翅膀。你知道吗？

original: Just relaxing. Nothing much.
translation: 放松。没事了。

original: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

original: Just playing around, you know?
translation: 只是玩玩，懂吗？

original: Keeping everyone from killing themselves. Same as ever.
translation: 和以前一样，阻止人们自相残杀。

original: Watching after the younger kids and seeing if they can't accidentally learn a thing or two. You know how it goes.
translation: 观察这些年纪轻轻的孩子，看他们能否意外学会一些事情。你知道怎么做。

original: Not much. Still trying to find a way to turn this fungus into something that doesn't taste like toenails.
translation: 不多。还在想办法把这些蘑菇变成尝起来不像脚趾甲的东西。

original: I got a new tooth today! It was just lying there and now it's mine!
translation: 我长了颗新牙！它就躺在那，现在它是我的了！

original: Not much.
translation: 没什么。

original: What's up, pal?
translation: 怎么啦，兄弟？

original: What's happening, pal?
translation: 出什么事了，兄弟？

original: Hewwo. What's up?
translation: 哈罗，怎么了？

original: Hello, there. What're you up to? Not getting into too much trouble?
translation: 你好，你忙什么呢？没什么麻烦吧？

original: Hello. What's happening today?
translation: 喂，今天有什么事？

original: What're you up to, today?
translation: 今天忙什么呢？

original: Hello. What's happening?
translation: 喂，怎么了？

original: Hrmf. What have you got to be happy about?
translation: 嗯唔，什么让你这么高兴？

original: Oh hey! What's happening? Something fun?
translation: 哦，嗨！发生什么事？有趣吗？

original: Hello. Anything interesting happening?
translation: 喂，有什么趣事？

original: Hello. What's up?
translation: 喂，怎么了？

original: Hey, what's happening?
translation: 喂，怎么了？

original: Everything fine down here in paradise? What's happening?
translation: 天堂一切都好？发生了什么？

original: Hey, what's up?
translation: 嘿，怎么了？

original: Sure, here you go and you don't owe me a single cap.
translation: 当然，拿好，你不欠我瓶盖。

original: Well, that's awfully generous of you seeing as I never made a deal with you in the first place.
translation: 你可真大方，我并没有首先和你达成协议呢。

original: But I guess it's pretty decent of you not to sell it to someone else instead. Thanks, kid.
translation: 不过你没有把它卖给别人，还真是实在人。谢谢，孩子。

original: I'll sell it to you...for 300 caps.
translation: 我会把它卖给你……300个瓶盖。

original: Fine, fine. Anything to get it! Here's your caps, now hand it over.
translation: 好吧，好吧，怎么都行！给你瓶盖，交货。

original: Nope, sorry. I'm holding onto it.
translation: 不，抱歉，我要自己留着它。

original: Fine, be an asshole. When you get hungry for caps, you know who to talk to.
translation: 好吧，真是个混蛋。当你缺瓶盖时，你知道找谁谈。

original: I'm not giving you anything.
translation: 我是不会给你任何东西的。

original: Ohhh... I know how this game's played, kid.
translation: 哦……我明白游戏规则，孩子。

original: Fine. How about I pay you 200 caps for it? It's the same money I would have paid Grady.
translation: 好吧，我付你200个瓶盖怎么样？跟我付给格雷迪的一样多。

original: Hang on a second. You want it, you need to pay for it.
translation: 等一下，既然你要它，你就得出钱。

original: Shrewd kid, very shrewd.
translation: 精明的小子，非常精明。

original: Okay. Seeing as I was going to pay Grady anyway, here's the caps I owed him. Now, lemme have it.
translation: 好吧，既然我反正要付钱给格雷迪，我把还欠他的瓶盖给你。现在把它给我吧。

original: Sure, here you go.
translation: 当然，给你。

original: Hey, thanks a bunch for bringing it to me. You could have been a jerk and sold it to someone else, but you didn't.
translation: 喂，多谢你把它带给我。你本来可以把它卖给别人，但你没有。

original: Ah hell, let me give you the rest of the caps I was gonna give Grady anyway.
translation: 啊，他妈的，让我把欠格雷迪的瓶盖给你吧。

original: I bumped into him a while back is all. (Lie)
translation: 我撞见过他。(撒谎)

original: You did huh? Well, if you ever see that lowlife again, tell him Ronald wants his damn package delivered or bring me back my caps.
translation: 真的吗，呃？嗯，如果你再见到那贱人，告诉他，罗纳德要他把该死的包裹带过来，或者退还我的瓶盖。

original: I found him dead.
translation: 我发现他死了。

original: Holy crap! That son-of-a-bitch took my caps and ran and now he ends up dead?
translation: 我靠！那狗娘养的拿了我瓶盖跑了，现在他却死了？

original: Now I'll never get that package!
translation: 我永远也拿不到那包裹了！

original: I have a package for you from him.
translation: 他要我给你个包裹。

original: Holy crap! You have it?
translation: 我靠！在你手里？

original: Well hand it over! I've been waiting over a year for that damn thing!
translation: 嗯，给我吧！那该死的东西我等了快一年了！

original: Do you know someone named Grady?
translation: 你认识一个叫格雷迪的人吗？

original: Grady? Maybe. Why you asking?
translation: 格雷迪？或许吧，你为什么这么问？

original: Nope! Sorry!
translation: 不！抱歉！

original: If you're listening to this tape, then my brains are splattered all over a wall somewhere and you've got a job to do.
translation: 如果你听到这卷带子，那表示我的脑浆已经洒得墙上到处都是。现在你有件工作要做。

original: You need to retrieve the package and get it safely to Ronald Laren in Girdershade. Tell him Grady sent you.
translation: 你需要找回一个包裹，平安的带给梁影村的罗纳德·拉伦，告诉他是格雷迪派你来的。

original: To get the package, you'll need the key. I've stashed it inside an old fire hose case in some maintenance closet in Marigold Metro Station.
translation: 要拿到包裹，你需要一把钥匙。我已经将它藏在了玛丽戈德地铁站维修室的一个老消防栓橱里。

original: The key will unlock the safe that contains the package. Look for the room marked by a spinning light... you can't miss it.
translation: 这把钥匙将打开装有包裹的保险箱。寻找有旋转灯的房间……你一定能找到。

original: Good luck, and hopefully they won't find you too.
translation: 祝你好运，希望他们不会发现你。

original: I'm keeping it, and I'd advise you to back off before I get angry!
translation: 我要留着它，在我发火之前，我建议你快点走！

original: All right, all right. My mistake. It obviously belongs to you.
translation: 好吧，好吧，我的错。它显然属于你。

original: Now... uhhh... you just watch it cause I won't be so nice next time.
translation: 现在……啊……你给我小心，因为下次我不会这么客气。

original: Come and get it from me, if you think you can.
translation: 你要有胆，那就放马过来从我手里抢走它。

original: That was probably the dumbest thing you could have said. Fine, have it your way.
translation: 那可能是你说过的最傻的话了。好吧，随你的便。

original: No way, it's mine!
translation: 没门，它是我的！

original: I warned you, I was only going to ask once. Now I'm gonna take it from you!
translation: 我警告你，我只问你一次。我现在要把它从你手里拿走！

original: How about you pay me for it?
translation: 不如你你付钱给我？

original: I warned you, I was only going to ask once. Now I'm gonna take it from you!
translation: 我警告你，我只问你一次。我现在要把它从你手里拿走！

original: Okay... okay. Here. No need for violence.
translation: 好吧……好吧，给，别那么凶。

original: Yeah. That's what I thought. Now scram!
translation: 那就好，滚吧！

original: So my father's okay? I can... get him back?
translation: 我父亲还好吗？我能带他……回去吗？

original: Yes, I'm sure he's fine. No doubt when you leave the simulation, he'll be waiting for you.
translation: 是的，我确信他很好。当你离开了这个模拟世界，他毫无疑问地会等着你。

original: But there's no one waiting for me...
translation: 但却没有人等我……

original: So... I'm free to leave?
translation: 那么……我可以自由离开了？

original: Isn't it obvious? You've run the failsafe, disrupted everything. I have no power over you.
translation: 那还用说吗？你运行了故障保险，破坏了一切。我无力控制你了。

original: There's the door. Go.
translation: 门在那边，去吧。

original: Tell me about the G.E.C.K.
translation: 跟我说说伊甸园创造器。

original: The Garden of Eden Creation Kit. It was for terraforming, for restoring the world after a nuclear disaster.
translation: 用来在核战之后，构筑宜居地形，重建世界。

original: Unstable technology, and ultimately boring. Why re-make the old reality, when instead you could create any reality you choose?
translation: 不稳定的技术，也是终极的麻烦。当你可以依照自己的愿望创建任何世界的时候，为什么还要选择重建古老的世界？

original: Tell me exactly who you are. Who you really are.
translation: 确切地告诉我你是谁，你真是的身份是什么。

original: Why do you torment me? You know who I am. You know that I am really Doctor Braun, that I created this place...
translation: 你为什么要折磨我？你知道我是谁。你知道我真是的布劳恩博士，我创造了这地方……

original: And that now I'm trapped here, and it's all your fault.
translation: 而且现在我被困在这了，都是你的错。

original: My name is Stanislaus Braun. I am a Vault-Tec scientist. I created this simulation for Vault-Tec, but for myself as well.
translation: 我叫斯坦尼斯·布劳恩，我是避难所科技科学家。我为避难所科技，也为我自己创造了这模拟世界。

original: It was my own design, my own perfection. A better reality than any other. Far greater than my work on the G.E.C.K.
translation: 它是我自己的设计，我自己的造诣，比其他任何世界更好，远比我在伊甸园创造器上的成就更伟大。

original: Tell me about this place, about Tranquility Lane.
translation: 跟我说说宁静巷这地方。

original: You know enough. You know this was my perfect simulation, my exquisite creation.
translation: 你知道得够多了。你只需要知道这是我完美的模拟世界，我高雅的创造物。

original: And now you've ruined it forever.
translation: 现在你已经永远地摧毁了它。

original: It is my greatest achievement. The best of the many simulations I've run in these 200 years.
translation: 它是我最伟大的成就，这200多年来，我运行的许多个模拟世界中最好的。

original: I played with the others, but they bored me. This version never grew old. It amused me over, and over, and over again.
translation: 我和其他人一起玩，不过他们让我觉得很烦。这版本永远不会过时，它一次又一次地逗我开心。

original: I came here for my father. Now where is he?
translation: 我来找我父亲，他现在在哪？

original: Didn't you figure it out? The dog. So loyal, so trusting... so annoying.
translation: 难道你还没认出来？这只狗，多么忠诚，多么顺从……多么烦人。

original: I simply made him what he always was...
translation: 我轻而易举地把他打回了原型……

original: He's been right here the whole time, and you were too dense to figure it out. The dog, you see.
translation: 他一直都在这，是你太笨了才认不出的。你看这只狗。

original: Man's best friend. But now you've taken all my friends from me...
translation: 狗是人类最好的朋友。但你把我所有的朋友都从这带走了……

original: You'll just reset everything anyway. Who cares?
translation: 反正你也会把一切都重置。谁在乎呢？

original: I CAN'T reset it, don't you see? The failsafe disabled the security protocols. They're all dead. For good!
translation: 我无法重置，你没明白吗？故障保险禁用了安全协议。他们都死了。永远地！

original: All my friends, gone. Now I'm stuck here by myself...
translation: 我所有的朋友，都没了。现在，我只能独自被困在这里……

original: It's all over. Now shut up, and answer my questions.
translation: 都结束了。现在闭嘴，回答我的问题。

original: It is NOT over! It's not over until I say so! Do you understand me? I... I...
translation: 还没有结束！我不说就不算结束！你明白吗？我……我……

original: I just want things to go back the way they were.
translation: 我只想让一切回到从前。

original: I'm calling the shots now!
translation: 现在我来发号施令！

original: You? No! I... I am the creator of this world!
translation: 你？不！我……我才是这世界的创造者！

original: ...feel so lost, and... So all alone.
translation: ……感觉如此失落……如此孤独。

original: Are you kidding? If you get out, you can have all the booze you want!
translation: 开什么玩笑？如果你逃出去，就能狂饮一通烈酒！

original: Now that... That sounds like a plan. Imma run for it!
translation: 那……那听起来像个计划。我要逃命了！

original: You're hopeless. Forget it.
translation: 你没希望了。算了吧。

original: Forget what?
translation: 什么算了？

original: What's the deal with Barrett?
translation: 巴雷特和你什么关系？

original: He's my assistant and my backup. In case things get rough. I wouldn't mess with him if I were you.
translation: 他是我的助手和后援。天有不测风云啊。如果我是你，就不会惹他。

original: Can I buy some Ultrajet?
translation: 我能买点超级杰特吗？

original: Hmmm, so you wanna live life on the wild side, huh? Okay. Go for it.
translation: 嗯，那么你是要到野外去谋生了，呃？好吧，去吧。

original: Yeah, as soon as you bring me some more Sugar Bombs.
translation: 是啊，只要你带给我更多糖麦弹。

original: Have you ever heard of The Family?
translation: 你听说过家族没？

original: Sure. I stay away from them and they don't bother me. It's a good relationship. They live somewhere East of here.
translation: 当然，我不找他们的麻烦，他们也不打搅我，我们和平共处。他们就住这东边的某个地方。

original: If you're feeling foolish, I think there's an underground way through to their place deeper in the metro station here.
translation: 你要是够愚蠢，我想这的地铁站下面有地道通到他们住的位置。

original: Here's all the Sugar Bombs I've got.
translation: 给，我所有的糖麦弹。

original: Good... good. There's more out there, so go and find it.
translation: 好的……好的……外边还有更多，继续去找吧。

original: Nice work. The Ultrajet's coming along nicely.
translation: 干得好。超级杰特的进展很好。

original: Excellent! keep it coming.
translation: 太棒了！常来！

original: Let me think about it a bit.
translation: 让我考虑一下。

original: What is it with you people? Stop thinking so much. That's what got us all here in the first place.
translation: 你们怎么回事？别想太多了。那就是把我们困在这里的原因。

original: Make it 30 caps each and you got yourself a deal.
translation: 每个30个瓶盖，就成交。

original: Fine, anything to get what I need. Now scram, I got some preparing to do!
translation: 好吧，怎么都行。走开，我还有事！

original: Alright, Murphy... I'm in.
translation: 好吧，墨菲……我接受。

original: Good. Now get going, I have a ton of preparation to do.
translation: 不错，开始干活，我有许多准备工作要做。

original: No way. I'm not helping you make chems!
translation: 没门，我不会帮你制作药品！

original: Fine, fine. Sheesh. Take it easy. You change your mind, gimme a shout.
translation: 很好，很好，吁，放轻松。你要改变了注意，就吱一声。

original: Nothing's free in this world, Murphy.
translation: 天下没有免费的午餐，墨菲。

original: Yeah, no kidding. I didn't think you were a freakin' charity.
translation: 好吧，不开玩笑。我想你不是行为反常的慈善家。

original: It takes 3 things to make Ultrajet. Two of the ingredients I got plenty of. The other one is a little harder to find: Sugar Bombs.
translation: 制作超级杰特需要三样东西。其中两种配料我有很多，剩下的一种不太好找：糖麦弹。

original: For every box of Sugar Bombs you bring me, I'll pay you 15 caps. So you in?
translation: 你每带一盒糖麦弹给我，我就出15个瓶盖。你接受吗？

original: That's it, Butch. You and me. Right now.
translation: 就是这样，布奇，你和我，现在。

original: You've got to be kidding me.
translation: 你在跟我开玩笑吧。

original: Come on Tunnel Snakes, this twerp needs another lesson.
translation: 来吧！穴蛇帮，这蠢货需要再上一课。

original: Yeah sure, what do you need?
translation: 行啊，你需要什么？

original: It takes 3 things to make Ultrajet. Two of the ingredients I got plenty of. The other one is a little harder to find: Sugar Bombs.
translation: 制作超级杰特需要三样东西。其中两种配料我有很多，剩下的一种不太好找：糖麦弹。

original: I distill it down to its base contents and add that to the formula then presto... Ultrajet.
translation: 我把它蒸馏到基本成份，然后把它们添加到这配方里，一眨眼……超级杰特。

original: For every box of Sugar Bombs you bring me, I'll pay you 15 caps. So you in?
translation: 你每带一盒糖麦弹给我，我就出15个瓶盖。你接受吗？

original: Stop trying to talk your way out of this, zombie!
translation: 别想胡说八道，丧尸！

original: What the hell is your problem? Fine! You're gonna be like that...
translation: 你他妈的是怎么回事？好吧！你会喜欢那……

original: What the heck are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么鬼东西？

original: You never heard of it? Ultrajet is almost double the potency of Jet... perfect for Ghouls. Jet barely affects us you see.
translation: 你从没听说过它？超级杰特的效力几乎是杰特的两倍……特别适合僵尸。你看，杰特几乎对我们没有影响。

original: Only trouble is it's almost impossible to gather the ingredients together.
translation: 唯一的问题是，集齐配料几乎是不可能的。

original: Say, you might be able to help me with that!
translation: 我说，你能不能帮个忙！

original: Ultrajet? That some sort of super chem?
translation: 超级杰特？某种超级药品？

original: I suppose you could say that. Ultrajet is almost double the potency of Jet... perfect for Ghouls. Jet barely affects us you see.
translation: 我想你可以这么说。超级杰特的效力几乎是杰特的两倍……特别适合僵尸。你看，杰特几乎对我们没有影响。

original: Only trouble is it's almost impossible to gather the ingredients together.
translation: 唯一的问题是，集齐配料几乎是不可能的。

original: Say, you might be able to help me with that!
translation: 我说，你能不能帮个忙！

original: Yeah sure, I'm here for everything you got. Hand it over, zombie!
translation: 当然，我就是来要你交出一切的，丧尸！

original: No! No way! You're not taking the formula from me!
translation: 不！没门！不许你从我这拿走配方！

original: What secrets?
translation: 什么秘密？

original: The secret of making Ultrajet obviously!
translation: 明显是制作超级杰特的秘密！

original: Oh dammit, now the cat's out of the bag. Typical me.
translation: 哦，该死，露馅了，都怪我嘴不严。

original: Steal your secrets? Not at all.
translation: 偷你的秘密？当然不是。

original: Good. I was afraid I was gonna have to abandon my lab here. That would mean starting all over again.
translation: 很好。我还担心将要放弃我这里的实验室呢。那将意味重新开始。

original: It's not easy trying to make Ultrajet you know!
translation: 你知道，制作超级杰特不是件容易事！

original: Not now. I'm busy
translation: 现在不行，我很忙。

original: Suit yourself.
translation: 听你的。

original: Nothing much. One of the littler kids had a rock Zip said looked dirty, but he barely even knows what is and isn't dirty in the first place, see?
translation: 非常少。一个小孩找到一个石头，拉链说那看起来很肮脏，但他几乎连肮脏是什么意思都听不懂，明白？

original: Nah. Zip kept asking if I have any Nuka-Cola hidden anywhere, so I told him I kept a six pack hidden near a magic rock. He'll be busy for weeks, see?
translation: 不。拉链一直在问我是否在什么地方藏了些核子可乐，所以我才说我在一块魔法石头旁边藏了六箱。够他忙上几周的了，明白了吧？

original: I changed my mind. I'll go with you to Rivet City.
translation: 我改变了主意，我会和你去铆钉城。

original: I'm sorry to hear that. I hope you'll consider meeting me in Rivet City.
translation: 听到这我很遗憾。我希望你能考虑去铆钉城见我。

original: I changed my mind. I'm not going to go with you right now.
translation: 我改变了主意，我现在不会和你去。

original: That's good to hear. Let's not waste any time.
translation: 很好，我们别浪费时间了。

original: Can I think about it?
translation: 我能考虑下吗？

original: No, no, no. When you're in the game, you have to make split-second decisions; think on your feet. Now come on...
translation: 不，不，不。当你在这比赛中，你必须瞬间做出决定；用脚思考。快来啊……

original: Screw it, I'm going for the faceoff!
translation: 他妈的！对决就对决！

original: Well, you're a little shorthanded, but you showed up for the game. The least I can do is make sure it's a short period.
translation: 你们有点人手不足，但毕竟来了。我至少能确保它持续的时间不会太长。

original: Ice 'em guys!
translation: 弟兄们，封住他们！

original: Make it 400 caps and it's all yours.
translation: 400个瓶盖，归你了。

original: Nicely played; and I know talent when I see it. Here you go.
translation: 打得好；天才我看一眼就知道。接招。

original: Okay team, let's get out of here.
translation: 队员们，让我们离开这。

original: Fine, I'll take it.
translation: 好吧，我接受。

original: Now that's teamwork! Good choice.
translation: 那是团队协作！明智的选择。

original: Okay team, let's get out of here.
translation: 队员们，让我们离开这。

original: I think you're all crazy, and I'm getting out of here.
translation: 我认为你们都疯了，我要离开这。

original: Penalty! No one tries to put one past Goalie Ledoux!
translation: 点球！没有人过的了格尔伊·勒杜！

original: Ice 'em guys!
translation: 弟兄们，封住他们！

original: Well, "captain", are we gonna fight or try and make a deal?
translation: 嗯，“队长”，我们战斗，还是交易？

original: That's up to you. We can make a deal or we can faceoff.
translation: 随你的便。我们能交易，我们也能战斗。

original: I'm puttin' 250 caps up on the scoreboard. What do you say?
translation: 我在记分板上放了250个瓶盖。你说怎样？

original: Okay, if you say so.
translation: 好吧，如果你这么说的话。

original: Now look, you gonna sell us that formula or do we have to faceoff?
translation: 听着，你是卖给我们配方，还是跟我们对决？

original: I'm puttin' 250 caps up on the scoreboard. What do you say?
translation: 我在记分板上放了250个瓶盖。你说怎样？

original: I think you've taken a few too many blows to the head, weirdo!
translation: 我想你的头被打坏了，怪人！

original: Penalty! No one tries to put one passed Goalie Ledoux!
translation: 点球！没有人过得了格尔伊·勒杜！

original: Ice 'em guys!
translation: 弟兄们，封住他们！
