original: What's with the masks, anyway?
translation: 顺便问问，这些面具怎么了？

original: This is the mask of my icegang, Sudden-Death Overtime. I'm the team captain, Goalie Ledoux.
translation: 我叫格尔伊·勒杜，我是超时猝死的队长，最后一支冰球队。

original: There was a time where every city had their own icegangs and thousands would show up to watch them all duke it out in giant arenas.
translation: 曾经，每个城市都有他们自己的冰球队，成千上万的人坐在巨大的竞技场中观看他们的球队冲锋陷阵。

original: We aim to bring those days back!
translation: 我们打算把那时代重新找回来！

original: Who are you and why are you talking like that?
translation: 你是谁，为什么你那样说？

original: The name's Goalie Ledoux and I'm captain of Sudden-Death Overtime, the last of the icegangs.
translation: 我叫格尔伊·勒杜，我是超时猝死的队长，最后一支冰球队。

original: There was a time where every city had their own icegangs and thousands would show up to watch them all duke it out in giant arenas.
translation: 曾经，每个城市都有他们自己的冰球队，成千上万的人坐在巨大的竞技场中观看他们的球队冲锋陷阵。

original: We aim to bring those days back!
translation: 我们打算把那时代重新找回来！

original: Hey, take it easy, I was just passing through.
translation: 嗨，冷静，我正好路过。

original: Don't take slapshots at me like that! We saw you come out of the Nuka-Cola Plant and we know you've got the formula.
translation: 别那样向我抽射！我们看见你从核子可乐工厂出来，我们知道你已经得到了配方。

original: Now you gotta make a decision. Go for the powerplay or sit in the penalty box?
translation: 现在你要做决定，是强攻还是坐在受罚席？

original: None of your damn business!
translation: 不关你他妈的事！

original: Penalty! That's gonna be 2 minutes in the box for you.
translation: 处罚！你小罚2分钟。

original: Ice 'em guys!
translation: 弟兄们，封住他们！

original: I'm here to tell you Mercier is dead.
translation: 我来这告诉你梅西埃死了。

original: Mercier didn't make it? Damn! How do they expect us to play when we don't even have enough people on our team?
translation: 梅西埃没撑住？该死的！我们的队伍连人手都不够，他们还怎么指望我们参与？

original: Well, as long as you brought the formula, I guess we're still in the game.
translation: 嗯，只要你带来这配方，我们就还有机会。

original: I've got the formula for Nuka-Cola Clear.
translation: 我得到了核子可乐清爽型配方。

original: Mercier didn't make it? Damn! How do they expect us to play when we don't even have enough people on our team?
translation: 梅西埃没撑住？该死的！我们的队伍连人手都不够，他们还怎么指望我们参与？

original: Well, as long as you brought the formula, I guess we're still in the game.
translation: 嗯，只要你带来这配方，我们就还有机会。

original: May I have the key to the Research Safe?
translation: 我可以拿一下研究室保险箱的钥匙吗？

original: Certainly, allow me to whip up a copy for you.
translation: 当然，我这就给您复制一把。

original: There you are. Have a wonderful and productive day!
translation: 给，祝您今天过得高效且充实！

original: A is for Ammo, B is for Blade, and C is for Cauterize...
translation: A是Ammo（子弹），B是Blade（刀），C是Cauterize（烙铁）……

original: Clean water is rare, and most water carries germs and radiation. As a result, it's usually healthier to stay dirty.
translation: 净水很少见，大多数的水携带细菌和辐射。所以，通常保持肮脏更健康。

original: Remember, never trust anybody over the age of 16.
translation: 记住，绝不要相信16岁以上的人。

original: Little Lamplight only has one law: you have to leave when you grow up. No delays, no exceptions.
translation: 小灯镇仅仅有一条法令：当你长大了，你必须离开。没有二话，没有例外。

original: When scavenging in the wild, remember to trust no one and to keep your pistol handy!
translation: 在野外拾荒时，记住枪不离手，别相信任何人！

original: Remember this simple rhyme: "When in danger or in doubt, shoot to kill and then run out."
translation: 记住这简单的句子：“当身处危险或疑惑，开火射击，然后逃跑。”

original: Oh, and Vault kid? I know you were seen in the vicinity. I hope to God you had nothing to do with this carnage.
translation: 哦，避难所小孩？我知道你在附近已经被人瞧见了，我衷心希望你和这场大屠杀没有什么关系。

original: Reports are sketchy... but it appears there have been some human casualties. Sorry for your losses, Reilly... assuming you ain't one of 'em.
translation: 报告很粗略……但它显示，有一些人类伤亡。对你的损失很抱歉，莱莉……希望你不是他们中的一个。

original: Do I suspect some Vault Dweller intervention on this one? I certainly do. Good work, 101.
translation: 我是不是在怀疑一些避难所小鬼介入了这事？我当然怀疑。干得好，101。

original: It would seem that a brave soldier named Theo was lost in the line of duty... but some of the others have been rescued.
translation: 看起来像是一名叫西奥的勇敢士兵因公殉职了……但其他一些人已经被营救。

original: I've gotten word that a band of mercs called Reilly's Rangers were trapped on a DC rooftop, pinned down by Super Mutants.
translation: 我获得消息，一队名叫“莱莉的游骑兵”的雇佣兵被困在了特区的一处楼顶上，他们被超级变种人缠了。

original: I killed Junders Plunkett.
translation: 我杀了伦德斯·普朗基特。

original: Well, it's about time someone put that bastard out of his misery.
translation: 嗯，这杂种到了脱离苦海的时候。

original: And here's the reward for it. Spend it well, Lawbringer.
translation: 这是你的奖赏，好好用，执法悍将。

original: Where did you come from?
translation: 你是从哪来的？

original: A place called Underworld. It's a Ghoul city down in D.C. I set off up here to find adventure and fortune. And... well... I found this place.
translation: 一个叫冥界的地方。那是位于特区的尸鬼之城。我跑到这儿来闯荡，寻找刺激和钱财。结果……唉，就找到这破地方。

original: I'm sort of stuck here. Colin says that I can't leave until I pay off my debt to him. Of course, he charges me room and board too.
translation: 我算是被困在这儿了。科林说我没还清欠他的债前不准走。当然，他连食宿费都要收我的。

original: If you ever get to Underworld, tell Carol that I said hi.
translation: 要是你哪天去了冥界城，替我向卡洛尔问声好。

original: On second thought, I think I'll pass.
translation: 经过重新考虑，我放弃。

original: Oh! Okay.
translation: 哦！好吧。

original: Guess I'll see you around then.
translation: 那再见了。

original: Nah. I was just messing with ya.
translation: 不，我在逗你玩。

original: You are such an asshole.
translation: 你真是个混蛋。

original: Well, I hope it all works out.
translation: 嗯，我希望会成功。

original: Yeah. On my own as usual. Sigh.
translation: 是啊，就我一个人。

original: Look, why don't you come back later. I don't need pity right now.
translation: 听着，你怎么不迟点再来，我现在不需要任何人同情。

original: There's tremendous risk in what you do and I bet Theo knew that.
translation: 你所做的事情有极大的风险，我保证西奥明白这一点。

original: Thanks. It's nice of you to try and make me feel better about everything.
translation: 谢谢。你的话让我对这一切感觉好过了一点。

original: I just hope that I can get back to mapping the ruins soon. I have a lot of contacts that are demanding I finish.
translation: 我只希望我能够重返废墟完成标注任务，我接到的不少合约都还没完成。

original: It is what it is.
translation: 事实真相大概就是这样子。

original: Yeah, but I led the guys right into a corner. Theo died because I decided to take shelter in the hospital.
translation: 嗯，但是我把那小伙子放进角落的，也是因为我的决定我们才会撤退到医院，西奥才会牺牲。

original: I'm not so sure I'd be trusted leading anyone at this point.
translation: 我现在已经不确信自己的领导才能会被任何人信任了。

original: Stupid machine... how you work this thing... this thing is stupid! Smash it!
translation: 愚蠢的机器……你怎么这么做……真愚蠢！砸碎它！

original: I'm in hiding now. I'm recording this in the reactor level. They found one of older recordings and now they want me in the labs.
translation: 我现在躲起来了。我在反应堆的位置做这记录。他们发现了我的录音，现在他们要把我也丢进实验室。

original: Luckily I had a friend in the security team and they told me to run. So here I am.
translation: 很幸运，警卫中有我的朋友，他们告诉我赶快跑，所以我躲到了这。

original: What the hell am I supposed to do now? Merrick and his team are obviously experimenting on people. Someone's got to put a stop to it.
translation: 我他妈的现在该怎么做？梅里克和他的团队显然是把人拿来做实验，必须有人出来阻止。

original: But how? There's nowhere to go and no one to tell. Shit, what am I gonna...
translation: 但怎么做呢？这无处可去，没人可以投诉。他妈的，我该怎么做……

original: Oh my god. They're coming... I... Tell my wife in Dorm E that I love her... I...
translation: 哦，我的天，他们来了……我……告诉我在E号宿舍的妻子，我爱她……我……

original: I... I don't know where to begin. I... have to report what I've seen. There has to be a record of this somewhere.
translation: 我……我不知道该从哪说起。我……必须要报告我看到的事。这毫无疑问要做个记录。

original: Sykes and Cossler dragged some unconscious guy from the dorms into the labs. I tried to ask what was going on, but they just glared at me.
translation: 赛科斯和考斯勒从宿舍拖着一些不省人事的家伙进了实验室。我想问问出了什么事，但他们瞪着我。

original: After they came back out of the containment area, they told me not to tell anyone what I saw or I'd regret it.
translation: 他们后来回到封锁区对我讲，不要把看到的事情告诉任何人，要不然我会后悔的。

original: Sykes was even patting his 10 millimeter when he said that. I think they were threatening to kill me!
translation: 赛科斯说这话时，甚至当着我的面拍了拍他的10MM。他们在威胁要杀了我！

original: After they left I snuck into the containment room, and... and I almost threw up. I don't even know how to describe it.
translation: 等他们走了，我偷偷溜进封锁房间，我……我差点吐了。我甚至不知道该怎样描述。

original: It looked sort of human, but it was deformed... I could see some of its organs on the surface of its body like they were trying to push through.
translation: 它看起来想有点像人类，但它被毁了容……我能够看见它的脏器都翻到了身体表面，挤成一团。

original: Its skin was... disgusting. Green and brown and bruised like it was bleeding on the inside. And the smell... it was horrible.
translation: 它的皮肤……很恶心，绿一块，黄一块，还有瘀伤，像是它的内部正在出血，气味……很恐怖。

original: I staggered out of there and came here to get this all down. What the hell are they doing in this place?
translation: 我摇摇晃晃地离开那鬼地方，跑到这来冷静下来。他妈的，他们在这地方做什么？

original: Oh my god. It's all making sense. The missing people... and those things. They... they... oh my fucking god.
translation: 哦，我的天，我明白了，这些失踪的人……和那些事。他们……他们……哦，该死的。

original: Things are getting a bit weird up here on the laboratory level. I swear I keep hearing these crazy noises coming from the experimentation chambers.
translation: 这层实验室里的事变得有点古怪。我发誓我一直听到了来自实验室的疯狂喊叫。

original: When I asked about it they told me it's the animals they're testing on. What the heck are they doing to them?
translation: 当我问起这事，他们跟我说，他们在拿动物做实验。他妈的，他们对这些动物做了些什么？

original: I think I may look into it some more. It gets boring standing in the hallways and pacing back and forth.
translation: 我想我可以窥探到更多详情。站在走廊里来来回回转悠还挺无聊的。

original: Is this thing on? Oh, yeah it is... I see the little needle moving. Ahem.
translation: 这东西动起来了吗？哦，是的……我看见小针在动。咳咳。

original: I'm making these recordings as a diary of my life in one of Vault-Tec's newer vaults. They recommended we keep one, so I figured why not.
translation: 我正在把我的声音作为生平记录下来。我身处一个避难所科技公司最新开放的避难所中。他们建议我们保留一个记录，所以我觉得为什么不呢？

original: But let me start at the beginning. My name is Shelton Delacroix, and I'm a security officer here in Vault 87.
translation: 不过让我从头开始。我叫谢尔顿·德拉克罗瓦，是87号避难所的警卫。

original: I'm assigned to the laboratory level, which sure beats babysitting the reactor room!
translation: 我被指派到这层实验室，巡视照顾这个反应堆房间！

original: Hopefully, in a few more months, I'll be allowed to learn a little more. It's all so hush hush. But that's the way things are around here.
translation: 在几个月后，我将有机会学到更多。这真安静，静得夸张，不过整个地方都是这样。

original: Anyway, I'm due on shift soon, so I'll record more later.
translation: 不管怎么样，我快要换班了。我会晚些时候再作记录。

original: Yep, you're right. He really cares about you!
translation: 对，你是对的。他真的很在乎你！

original: Awww, both of you are so sweet! How did a gal like me get so lucky in this messed up world to find you two?
translation: 噢，你们太贴心了！像我这样的女孩，是如何在这混乱不堪的世界中，幸运地遇到了你俩呢？

original: Now you've gone and made me cry. (Cries a bit)
translation: 现在你走了，我要哭了。(小声啜泣)

original: If this place has living plants, does that mean the water is safe to drink?
translation: 如果这地方有活的植物，那是否意味这的水可以安全饮用？

original: I'm afraid the water still bears the mark of man's greed. It's His reminder of what we once were.
translation: 我恐怕这些水还残留着人类贪婪的印记。这是他的警示，警示我们曾经是什么样的。

original: Perhaps one day He will see fit to lift this punishment, but I fear we have yet to command His full respect.
translation: 或许有一天，他会理解是时候撤消这惩罚，不过我担心我们还没有资格要求他这么做。

original: Harold makes unusual requests.
translation: 哈罗德提出了不寻常的请求。

original: The Great One does tend to speak in riddles, but if that is His way, then so be it.
translation: 圣贤确实倾向于用隐晦的方式表达，不过那是祂的行事风格，那就这样吧。

original: My talks with Him have become quite puzzling of late. I think He's beginning to fear His future.
translation: 最近我和祂的谈话变得十分令人费解。我觉得祂开始对自己的未来感到担忧。

original: The Great One's influence is growing and soon it will break free of the confines of this secluded vale.
translation: 圣贤的影响在不断扩大，很快就会突破这片隐秘山谷的限制。

original: We can't allow Oasis to call attention to itself like that. It would be the end of Him.
translation: 我们不允许绿洲这样引起外界的注意。那将是祂的末日。

original: We are the Family and together we will stand united!
translation: 我们是家族，我们携手共济！

original: We will organize, we will prepare, we will teach you to cope with your differences and we will keep you alive.
translation: 我们团结一致，我们时刻准备，我们教你看待自己的不同，并让你继续活着。

original: Well rest easy now, my brothers and sisters. It's time to stop all of the running, all of the hiding and all of the denying.
translation: 嗯，别担心了，我的兄弟姐妹们。是时候终止所有的逃亡，所有的躲藏和所有的排斥了。

original: We can not allow the humans to hunt us down and kill us like dogs! We must show them we are a force to be reckoned with!
translation: 我们不能再让人类把我们当狗一样的追捕合屠杀！我们要用行动告诉他们，我们是一股必须认真对付的力量！

original: The adaptation we were given wasn't meant to be ignored or persecuted. It's our way of survival.
translation: 我们被赋予的适应性，不应是我们被误解和迫害的理由。它应是我们的生存之路。

original: I submit to you that we are the victims of evolution; the next step in mankind's acclimation to this hellish existence.
translation: 我告诉你，我们是进化的牺牲品，是人类在这地狱世界里适应生存的一步。

original: Are we THAT different from those who hunt for meat to survive or from those who kill for territory? Of course not.
translation: 我们与那些人，那些为了生存而狩猎，那些为了争夺地盘而杀戮的人有什么不同吗？没有。

original: Every one of us has been branded with these insults at some point in our lives. But why?
translation: 我们每个人都在我们生命的某些方面，被这些侮辱打上了烙印。但为什么？

original: Monsters! Villains! Criminals! Animals!
translation: 怪物！恶棍！罪犯！畜牲！

original: Aww, I'm blushing!
translation: 啊，我脸都红了！

original: That's so nice of you to say! Thank you!
translation: 你太会说话了！谢谢！

original: Oh, you're embarrassing me!
translation: 哦，你真让我难为情！

original: Why thank you!
translation: 太感谢你了！

original: Growing Up Fast
translation: 茁壮成长

original: Enjoy the party and speak with the guests.
translation: 享受派对并与客人交谈。

original: Dad finished talking to player
translation: 爸爸结束了和玩家的谈话

original: Follow Dad to my surprise present.
translation: 跟着爸爸去看我的惊喜礼物。

original: Shoot all 3 targets with the BB gun.
translation: 用BB枪射击所有3个目标。

original: Use the BB gun to kill the radroach.
translation: 用BB枪杀死蟑螂。

original: Stand next to Dad so Jonas can take the picture.
translation: 站在爸爸旁边，这样乔纳斯就可以拍照了。

original: Enjoy the party and speak with the guests.
translation: 享受这个聚会并和客人们聊聊。

original: Meet Jonas on the Reactor Level.
translation: 去反应器层找乔纳斯。

original: Use the BB Gun to kill the Radroach.
translation: 用BB枪杀死辐射蟑螂。

original: Stand next to Dad so Jonas can take the picture.
translation: 站到父亲身边，乔纳斯给你们俩照张相。

original: Shoot all three targets with the BB Gun.
translation: 用BB枪射击三个靶子各一次。

original: Quest to Handle Followers
translation: 应付追随者

original: Idle chatter
translation: 闲聊

original: Megaton
translation: 兆吨镇

original: Baby Steps
translation: 婴儿的脚步

original: Walk to Dad.
translation: 走向父亲。

original: Follow Dad.
translation: 跟着父亲。

original: Walk to Dad.
translation: 走向父亲。

original: Open the playpen's gate.
translation: 打开幼儿围栏的门。

original: Exit the playpen.
translation: 打开围栏。

original: Jump onto the chair to reach inside the toy box.
translation: 跳到椅子上，进到玩具盒里。

original: Grab a toy and drag it into the playpen.
translation: 抓起一个玩具, 把它扔到婴儿床上。

original: Play with your toys.
translation: 和玩具玩。

original: Follow Dad.
translation: 跟着父亲。

original: Look at the "You're SPECIAL!" book.
translation: 捡起那本"你非常的特别噢！"看看。

original: Future Imperfect
translation: 不完美的未来

original: Sit down and take the G.O.A.T.
translation: 找个座位坐下，开始G.O.A.T.测试。

original: Get to class and talk to Mr. Brotch about the G.O.A.T.
translation: 到教室找布洛彻先生了解G.O.A.T.的事情。

original: Exit the classroom.
translation: 离开教室。

original: Turn in the G.O.A.T. to Mr. Brotch.
translation: 把G.O.A.T.答卷交给布洛彻先生。

original: Escape!
translation: 逃亡!

original: Enter the Overseer's office.
translation: 进入监督者的办公室。

original: Use the Overseer's computer to access the secret tunnel.
translation: 使用监督者的电脑打开秘密通道。

original: Turn the power back on.
translation: 打开后备电源。

original: Open the vault door.
translation: 打开避难所的大门。

original: Escape from Vault 101.
translation: 逃离101号避难所。

original: Talk to Amata about her plan to escape the Vault.
translation: 和阿玛塔谈谈逃出避难所的计划。

original: Enter the Overseer's office.
translation: 进入监督者的办公室。

original: Enter the reactor control room.
translation: 进入配电控制室。

original: Turn the power back on.
translation: 打开后备电源。

original: Open the Vault door.
translation: 打开避难所的大门。

original: Use the Overseer's computer to access the secret tunnel.
translation: 使用监督者的电脑打开秘密通道。

original: Escape the Vault.
translation: 逃离避难所。

original: Following in His Footsteps
translation: 跟随父亲的足迹

original: Investigate the nearby town of Megaton for information about Dad.
translation: 到附近的兆吨镇打听父亲的下落。

original: Speak to Colin Moriarty about Dad.
translation: 向科林·莫里亚蒂询问有关父亲的消息。

original: Find Galaxy News Radio.
translation: 找到银河新闻电台。

original: Help defeat the Super Mutant Behemoth.
translation: 帮助钢铁兄弟会打败超级变种巨人。

original: Ask Three Dog about Dad.
translation: 找三狗了解父亲的消息。

original: Continue your search for Dad.
translation: 继续寻找父亲。

original: (Optional) Deal with Silver in Springvale.
translation: [可选]处理藏身春之谷的席尔瓦。

original: Retrieve the Fat Man from the dead Brotherhood soldier.
translation: 从死去的兄弟会士兵身上取回名牌。

original: Galaxy News Radio
translation: 银河新闻电台

original: Find the Museum of Technology
translation: 找到科技博物馆。

original: Find the Washington Monument
translation: 找到华盛顿纪念碑。

original: Repair the damaged radio relay
translation: 修复损坏的中继电台。

original: Find the Museum of Technology.
translation: 找到科技博物馆。

original: Retrieve the Communications Relay Dish.
translation: 拿到通讯碟形天线。

original: Find the Washington Monument.
translation: 找到华盛顿纪念碑。

original: Repair the damaged radio relay.
translation: 修复损坏的中继电台。

original: Speak to Three Dog about Dad.
translation: 找三狗打听父亲的行踪。

original: Speak to Three Dog about the Weapons Cache.
translation: 找三狗询问有关武器贮藏处的事情。

original: Scientific Pursuits
translation: 科学的追求

original: Gain entrance to Rivet City.
translation: 进入铆钉城。

original: Talk to Doctor Li about Dad and Project Purity.
translation: 和李医生谈谈关于父亲和净水工厂的事情。

original: Look for Dad in Project Purity's Control Room.
translation: 去净水工厂控制室里寻找父亲。

original: Search Dad’s holotapes for clues to his location.
translation: 寻找父亲的全系磁带,了解关于他去向的线索。

original: Listen to Dad's personal journal entry 10.
translation: 收听父亲的第10段个人语音日记。

original: Gain access to Vault 112.
translation: 进入112号避难所。

original: Sit in the unoccupied "Tranquility Lounger."
translation: 坐进一台空的"宁静巷催眠舱"。

original: Put on a Vault 112 suit.
translation: 穿上112号避难所的外衣。

original: Tranquility Lane
translation: 宁静巷

original: Find and speak to Betty.
translation: 找到贝蒂并和她交谈。

original: Make Timmy Neusbaum cry.
translation: 把提米·纽斯保惹哭。

original: Report back to Betty.
translation: 回去向贝蒂报告。

original: Break up the Rockwells’ marriage, without killing either of them.
translation: 破坏罗克韦尔的婚姻,但不要杀了他们。

original: Arrange a creative death for Mabel Henderson.
translation: 给梅布尔·亨德森安排个有创意的死法。

original: Retrieve the mask and knife from behind the Abandoned House.
translation: 到废弃的屋子后面拿面具和小刀。

original: Kill all the residents of Tranquility Lane.
translation: 杀死所有宁静巷居民。

original: Exit Tranquility Lane.
translation: 离开宁静巷。

original: (Optional) Find and activate Tranquility Lane's Failsafe computer.
translation: [可选]找到并激活宁静巷的故障保护电脑。

original: Find Dad.
translation: 找到父亲。

original: Talk to Dad.
translation: 和父亲说话。

original: The Waters of Life
translation: 生命之水。

original: Escort Doctor Li inside the Citadel.
translation: 护送李博士进入五角大本营。

original: Join the scientists at Project Purity.
translation: 加入净水工程科学小组，前往杰佛逊外边与小组成员汇合。

original: Go to the Rivet City Science Lab.
translation: 前往铆钉城的科学实验室。

original: Turn on the Flood Control Pump Power.
translation: 打开泄洪泵。

original: Get the fuses from Dad.
translation: 在父亲那里拿到保险丝。

original: Replace the damaged fuses.
translation: 替换损坏的保险丝。

original: Boot up the mainframe.
translation: 启动主机。

original: Return to the control room.
translation: 返回控制室。

original: Escort Doctor Li to the evacuation point.
translation: 护送李博士撤退到疏散点。

original: Escort Doctor Li through Taft Tunnel to the Citadel.
translation: 护送李博士穿越通往五角大本营的塔夫特隧道。

original: Deal with the Garza "situation."
translation: 解决加尔萨的"问题"。

original: Drain the intake pipes.
translation: 疏通进气管。

original: Clear Project Purity of any remaining Mutant threat.
translation: 扫清净水工厂内残余变种人的威胁。

original: Escort the scientists inside Project Purity.

original: In general, the higher your Barter skill, the lower your prices on purchased items.
translation: 一般来说，你的交易技能越高，购买物品的价格就越低。

original: The Big Guns skill determines your combat effectiveness with the Fat Man, Rock-It Launcher, Missile Launcher, Flamer, Gatling Laser and Minigun.
translation: 大型枪械技巧决定了你使用“胖子”、捣蛋发射器、火箭弹发射器、火焰喷射器、多管激光机枪及多管机枪时的实战效能。

original: The Energy Weapons skill determines your effectiveness with the Alien Blaster, Laser Pistol, Laser Rifle, Mesmetron, Plasma Rifle and Plasma Pistol.
translation: 能量武器技能决定了你使用外星枪、激光手枪、激光步枪、迷魂枪、等离子步枪、等离子手枪等武器时的实战效能。

original: The Explosives skill determines the power of any set mines, the ease of disarming any hostile mines, and the effectiveness of any thrown grenades.
translation: 爆破技能影响了你安装的地雷的威力，你扫除地雷的能力，同时还决定了你使用手掷弹时的效能。

original: The higher your Sneak skill, the easier it is to remain undetected, steal an item or pick someone's pocket.
translation: 潜行技能越高，你越不易被人觉察，扒窃与偷盗的成功率也越高。

original: High Charisma gives bonuses to both the Barter and Speech skills.
translation: 高魅力会给交易和口才技能带来加成。

original: A high Endurance gives bonuses to Health, environmental resistances, and the Big Guns and Unarmed skills.
translation: 高耐力属性为你的生命点数，抵抗力，大型枪械技能以及徒手技能提供额外加成。

original: The higher your Intelligence, the more Skill Points you'll be able to distribute when you level up.
translation: 智力越高，每次升级可供分配的技能点数就越多。

original: The Lockpick skill is used to open locked doors and containers.
translation: 开锁技能可以让你撬开锁住的门和容器。

original: Raising your Luck raises all of your skill values, and improves your Critical Chance with all weapons.
translation: 运气的提升除了让你能使出更多的特殊攻击，还将小幅提升你的所有技巧。

original: The Unarmed skill is used for fighting without a weapon, or with hand-to-hand weapons like Brass Knuckles or the Power Fist.
translation: 学习徒手技能，你在空手或是使用铜指虎，动力拳套等武器（肉搏）时，攻击会造成更多伤害。

original: The Medicine skill determines the effectiveness of a Stimpak used to heal Health or damaged limbs.
translation: 医疗技能决定了你使用治疗注射治疗重伤或是伤残的肢体时的效果。

original: The Melee Weapons skill determines your effectiveness with any melee weapon, from a simple lead pipe to the high-tech Super Sledge.
translation: 近战武器技能决定了你使用近战武器（从简陋的撬棍到高科技的超级动力锤）时的实战效果。

original: A high Perception grants a bonus to the Explosives, Lockpick and Energy Weapons skills.
translation: 感知属性能够为爆破、开锁和能量武器等技能提供加成。

original: The Repair skill allows you to maintain any weapons and apparel.
translation: 修理技能使你可以维修任何武器和服装。

original: The Science skill represents your combined scientific knowledge, and is primarily used to hack restricted computer terminals.
translation: 科学技能代表了你对科技知识的理解，它的主要用处是破解电脑终端。

original: Small Guns determines your effectiveness with conventional projectile weapons, including the 10mm Pistol, BB Gun, Assault Rifle, and Combat Shotgun.
translation: 小型枪械决定了你使用常规射弹武器，如10mm手枪，BB枪，突击步枪和战斗霰弹枪时的实战效果。

original: The Lockpick skill is used to open locked doors and containers.
translation: 开锁技能可以让你撬开锁住的门和容器。

original: The Speech skill governs how much you can influence someone through dialogue, and gain access to information they might otherwise not want to share.
translation: 口才技能代表了你与人沟通的技巧，它决定你可以在多大程度上说服对方，或从他人口中套取信息。

original: Strength affects how much you can carry, and determines the effectiveness of all melee attacks.
translation: 力量属性影响你的负重与近战武器技能。

original: Things a bit too tough, or too easy? You can pause the game and modify the difficulty at any time.
translation: 是太缺乏挑战，还是难度太高？任何时候，你都可以暂停游戏来调整难度。

original: If you’re successfully hidden, your first attack against an opponent will always result in a critical hit.
translation: 如果你成功隐匿，你对敌人的首次打击一定会是致命一击。

original: A Glowing One uses its special ability to deliver radiation to its enemies, and heal any nearby Feral Ghouls.
translation: ＂发光僵尸＂运用它的特殊能力向敌人传递放射线，同时治愈附近的野性僵尸。

original: Mister Gutsy is a combat variant of the popular Mister Handy, and is equipped with a Plasma weapon and flamethrower.
translation: 狂风先生是风靡一时的巧手先生的战斗改进型，它配备了一台等离子武器及火焰喷射器。

original: The Capital Wasteland lacks an institutional system of crime and punishment. If you wrong someone, prepare to pay with your life.
translation: 华盛顿废土欠缺罪行及刑罚体制，如果你得罪了谁，就作好偿命的准备吧。

original: Sleeping in a rented or owned bed will give you a "Well Rested" bonus that boosts your earned XP for several hours.
translation: 如果你在租来的或自己的床上休息，将得到“精力充沛”奖励，这能让你在接下来数小时内获得更多的经验值。

original: Intelligence determines your effectiveness with the Science, Repair and Medicine skills.
translation: 智力影响着你的科学、修理和医疗技能。

original: The Medicine skill determines the effectiveness of drugs that help manage radiation, like Rad-X and RadAway.
translation: 医疗技能决定了你使用辐射抑制剂，例如放射线-X和辐特宁时的效果。

original: The Church of the Children of Atom believe the war of 2077 was actually a great holy event perpetuated by their god, Atom.
translation: “原子”信徒教堂坚信2077年的大战实际上是他们的神，“原子”，显示的一次神迹。

original: Perception determines when red tick marks (which indicate threats) appear on your compass.
translation: 感知属性决定了罗盘上红色的刻度线（代表敌人方位）出现的距离。

original: With the second rank of the Animal Friend perk, animals will come to your aid in combat (but not against other animals).
translation: 当你的“动物之友”特长达到等级2时，动物将在战斗中援助你（但对手不能是其他动物）。

original: The higher your Repair skill, the better the starting condition of any custom-made weapons.
translation: 你的修理技能越高，你自制武器的初始状态也越好。

original: Security Chief Harkness and his officers are authorized to use deadly force when dealing with any and all transgressors.
translation: 哈克尼斯警长和他手下的警员都被准许可以对犯法者使用致命性的武力。

original: If you want to stay hidden, stick to the shadows, move slowly, try to stay behind your opponent... and turn off your Pip-Boy light!
translation: 如果你想长久地保持潜行，有几条规则务必遵守：藏在阴影里，放缓脚步，从敌人背后绕行，并且一定要关闭哔哔小子的灯光。

original: If you have the Robotics Expert perk and sneak up on a hostile robot undetected, you can put that robot into a permanent shutdown state.
translation: 如果你拥有“机器人专家”特长，当你悄无声息地靠近一台敌对的机器人时，可以将它永久关闭。

original: If you start a fight you can't finish, try putting away your weapon. Your opponent just might forgive you...
translation: 如果你无意挑起一场争斗，那就收起你的武器，对方或许能因此原谅你。

original: You can run faster with your weapon holstered.
translation: 把枪收起来可以使你跑得更快。

original: Repair your weapons regularly -- the lower the condition, the lower a weapon's effectiveness.
translation: 时常修理你的武器--它的状态越差，实战效能就越低下。

original: The lower the condition of your armor or clothing, the less damage it resists in combat.
translation: 你的装甲或者衣服的状态越差，战斗中它能抵挡的伤害就越少。

original: Limb damage can be repaired directly by applying Stimpaks to affected areas, using the Pip-Boy.
translation: 在哔哔小子中，直接对伤残部位使用治疗针能够回复伤残的肢体。

original: Heavier weapons and apparel will slow you down when they're equipped.
translation: 沉重的武器和衣服会减缓你的移动。

original: Zooming in with a ranged weapon slows you down, but improves your accuracy.
translation: 当你使用长程武器的瞄准镜，你的移动会变缓，但相应的，你的射击精度会提高。

original: You can restore Health by using a Stimpak, eating food, drinking from a water source, or sleeping in a bed.
translation: 有多种方法可以帮你恢复健康：注射治疗针、吃饭、喝水或是在床上休憩。

original: Crouching will both improve your accuracy, and activate sneak mode.
translation: 蹲伏不仅提高你的精度，同时也激活了潜行模式。

original: Sleeping in any bed will fully restore your Health and heal any crippled body parts.
translation: 在床上休憩，你不仅能完全恢复健康，还能回复伤残的肢体。

original: Drinking from a water source is always a tactical choice -- you will usually restore lost Health, but raise your radiation level.
translation: 饮用露天水源总是一种冒险：你虽然能恢复健康，但却会受到放射伤害。

original: Running is noisier than walking and makes you easier to detect, even if you are sneaking.
translation: 即便在潜行时，跑步也比行走更为嘈杂，更容易引起他人注意。

original: Changing the difficulty affects how hard combat is. But you'll also get more or less XP for killing enemies.
translation: 改变难度，战斗难度会被调整，但对应的当你消灭敌人时，你将获得更多或更少的经验值。

original: Want to prevent an enemy from fleeing? Cripple the legs.
translation: 想让敌人无法脱逃？那就打残它们的腿。

original: Tenpenny Tower is the brainchild of Allistair Tenpenny, a British refugee who came to the Capital Wasteland seeking his fortune.
translation: 特佩尼大厦的建立者是奥利斯特·特佩尼，一个从英国来华盛顿废土淘金的流民。

original: Allistair Tenpenny now rarely leaves the comfort and safety of his penthouse suite. His is a madness reserved for the obscenely rich.
translation: 奥利斯特·特佩尼在他的楼顶公寓套房过着安全、舒适的生活，平时深居简出，那些套房为卑鄙敛财的富人而预备着。

original: Although it has some crude fortifications, Big Town is the subject of constant attack from Slavers and Super Mutants, who view it as an easy target.
translation: 虽然有些简单的防御工事，但大镇一直被看作是必争之地，持续受到来自奴隶贩子和超级变种人的骚扰。

original: The population of Big Town has dwindled significantly in recent years. Most of the residents have been killed or dragged off by Slavers or Super Mutants.
translation: 大镇近年来人口骤减，在奴隶贩子及超级变种人的耽耽虎视下，大部分住民不是被杀就是被捉。

original: The residents of Big Town are all refugees of another settlement, from which they were forcibly expelled...
translation: 大镇的居民都是从另一个定居点驱逐流放的难民。

original: Canterbury Commons is the end of the Capital Wasteland's established merchant caravan route.
translation: 坎特伯雷社区是首都废土商队要道的终点站。

original: The remains of a large robot repair center loom over the settlement of Canterbury Commons.
translation: 一座大型机器人修理中心的遗迹把坎特伯雷社区笼罩于阴影下。

original: Canterbury Commons has become a constant battleground for two costumed "super humans" -- the sinister AntAgonizer and misguided Mechanist.
translation: 坎特伯雷社区俨然已成两位有乔装癖的“超人”--痛苦蚁后与机械侠之间的持久战战场。

original: At the center of Megaton's crater sits an undetonated atomic bomb, a remnant of the great conflict that destroyed the world.
translation: 在兆吨镇的弹坑中矗立着一枚未爆的核弹，是曾清洗这个世界的大战的残留物。

original: Some of Megaton's first settlers were lured by the misguided hope of entering the nearby Vault 101.
translation: 最早的兆吨镇移民是怀着想进入附近101号避难所的空想纷纷而至的。

original: Some Megaton residents wonder who's really in charge -- Sheriff Simms, or saloon owner Colin Moriarty...
translation: 让一些兆吨镇居民不解的是究竟谁在执管此地？-- 警长西姆斯，还是酒吧主科林·莫里亚蒂......

original: The members of the Church of the Children of Atom worship Megaton's atomic bomb.
translation: “原子”信徒教堂的教徒们崇拜兆吨镇的核弹。

original: Word is that Moira Brown, the eccentric owner of Craterside Supply, is looking for assistance on a new project.
translation: 据说“坑边杂货店”的古怪店主莫伊拉·布朗，最近正为一个新研究而招募助手。

original: The residents of Megaton feel safe behind their metal walls. Ironic, considering their proximity to a live atomic bomb.
translation: 铁墙后，兆吨镇居民们感到安全。但联想到他们身旁，核弹依然活跃，这一切就像个讽刺。

original: The fore section of Rivet City is split from the rest of the carrier, and occupied by hostile Mirelurks.
translation: 铆钉城的前片区与航母其它部分相驳离，那里歇居着充满敌意的蟹人。

original: What was once a small scientific community gradually grew into Rivet City, the largest settlement in the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 曾经的小型科学联盟，渐渐成长成今日的铆钉城，华盛顿废土上最大的居住区。

original: Doctor Madison Li, member of Rivet City's ruling council, is one of the greatest scientific minds of her generation.
translation: 李博士，铆钉城统治议会成员，她那时代最伟大的科学家之一。

original: Rivet City has no holding facilities for criminals, and zero tolerance for crime.
translation: 铆钉城没有罪犯的容身所，对于罪行毫无姑息之心。

original: Underworld has become a haven for disenfranchised Ghouls throughout the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 地下城俨然已成华盛顿废土上民权绝丧的僵尸们的避风港。

original: Underworld was formed in the remains of the Museum of History's special exhibit, which showcased different civilizations' views on the the afterlife.
translation: 地下城是历史博物馆中一件特殊展品，展现了对末世的不同看法。

original: The Ghouls of Underworld generally aren't bothered by D.C.'s Super Mutants, but resent the Brotherhood of Steel for turning their back yard into a warzone.
translation: 地下城的僵尸与首都的超级变种人相处融洽，但对把他们的后院变为战场的钢铁兄弟会却恨得牙痒痒。

original: Picking someone's pocket and placing a mine or grenade in their inventory will activate the explosive... and cause one heck of a mess.
translation: 在偷窃别人时，将手雷或地雷塞进别人的口袋会引发爆炸……遭到巨大的骚乱。

original: The Capital Wasteland lacks a unified government, and any institutional system of crime and punishment. If you wrong someone, prepare to pay with your life.
translation: 华盛顿废土没有联合政府，也没有罪行与刑罚机制，如果你得罪了他人，就作好偿命的准备吧。

original: Stealth is affected by many factors, including light level, sound generated, weight and bulk of worn apparel, and line-of-sight.
translation: 潜行会受许多因素影响，包括环境亮度、声音、负重、着装大小，以及对方的视野。

original: With the Animal Friend perk, you will never be the victim of an unprovoked attack from any animal.
translation: 拥有“动物之友”这项特长，你将不再成为动物无端攻击的牺牲品。

original: With the Action Boy perk, you gain an additional 20 Action Points to use in V.A.T.S.
translation: 拥有活力小子这项能力，你在避难所科技辅助瞄准系统下将多获得20个行动值。

original: With the Better Criticals perk, you gain a 50% damage bonus every time a critical hit is scored on an opponent.
translation: 有了“强力暴击”这个特长, 你击中目标时产生的暴击伤害将会增加50％。

original: The Child at Heart perk improves your interactions with children with unique dialogue choices.
translation: 拥有童心未泯，你同小孩对话时可能会出现特殊选项。

original: The only way to reach the Super Mutant-occupied D.C. ruins is by traveling underground, usually through the abandoned Metro tunnels.
translation: 要抵达超级变种人盘踞的特区废墟，途径只有一条：走地下，通常是穿越废弃的地铁隧道。

original: With the Comprehension perk, you gain one additional skill point whenever a skill book is read.
translation: 有了理解力这个额外能力，你在读书时会多增加1点技能点数。

original: With Concentrated Fire, your accuracy to hit any body part in V.A.T.S. increases slightly with each subsequent hit on that body part.
translation: 有了“集中火力”这个特长, 你在V.A.T.S模式下连续射击目标同一部位时，命中率会逐渐提高。

original: Once you have the Contract Killer perk, any Good human or Ghoul character you kill will have an ear on their corpse, which can be sold or traded to a certain Evil character...
translation: 当你拥有职业杀手这项能力，你每杀掉一个善良的人类或僵尸，你都能从他们尸体上取得一只耳朵，然后用它们和某个特定的邪恶角色进行交易。

original: The Cyborg perk adds 10 points to your Damage, Poison and Radiation Resistances, and 10 points to your Energy Weapons skill.
translation: 生化人这项能力将为你提升10点的伤害、毒药及辐射抵抗力，同时你的能量型武器技能提高10点。

original: With each rank of the Demolition Expert perk, all of your explosive weapons do an additional 20% damage.
translation: “爆破专家”特长每升一级，都能使你的爆破武器杀伤力上升20%。

original: With the Educated perk, you gain three more skill points every time you advance in level.
translation: 拥有知识分子这项能力，你每次升级都将多得到3个技能点数。

original: With the Entomologist perk, you do an additional +50% damage every time you attack a mutated insect.
translation: 拥有“昆虫学家”这项特长后，你对变异昆虫的杀伤力将增加50%。

original: When you choose the Explorer perk, every location in the world is revealed on your map. So get out there and explore!
translation: 有了“探险家”这个额力后，游戏世界的所有地点都会在地图上为你标识出来，快去探索吧！

original: With each rank of the Gun Nut perk, you gain an additional 5 points to the Small Guns and Repair skills.
translation: 每个等级的枪迷能力都将使你的小型枪械技能和修理技能上升5点。

original: With the Fortune Finder perk, you'll find considerably more Nuka-Cola caps in containers than you normally would.
translation: 有了“寻宝高手”这个特长，你在翻箱倒柜时都会比平时找到更多的瓶盖。

original: The Here and Now perk immediately grants an additional experience level, complete with all the advantages that brings.
translation: “马上升级”这个特长可以让你立刻升一级，并享受升级之后带来的所有好处。

original: With the Impartial Mediation perk, you gain an extra 30 points to Speech... so long as you maintain a Neutral Karma level.
translation: 有了不偏不倚这个额外能力，当你的业力值为中立时，会得到额外30点口才技能。

original: With the Infiltrator perk, you gain one more chance to pick any lock broken by an unsuccessful "Force Lock" attempt.
translation: 拥有“渗透者”这项特长，你可以再一次试着撬开因“强制开锁”失败而损坏的锁芯。

original: With the Intense Training perk, you can put a single point into any of your S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes.
translation: “训练狂”这个特长可以让你再增加任意1点属性值。

original: With the Iron Fist perk, you do an additional 5 points of Unarmed damage per rank.
translation: 每级铁拳这个额外能力让你的空手伤害增加5点。

original: Fail a hack attempt and get locked out of a computer? Not if you're a Computer Whiz! With this perk, you can attempt to re-hack any computer you were previously locked out of.
translation: 入侵电脑失败，电脑锁死了？合格的黑客是不会出现这种情况的！有了这个特长，先前被锁死的电脑又能再重新入侵一次了!

original: Once you have the Lawbringer perk, any Evil human or Ghoul character you kill will have a finger on their corpse, which can be sold or traded to a certain Good character...
translation: 当你拥有执法者这项能力，你每杀掉一个邪恶的人类或僵尸，你都能从他们尸体上取得一只耳朵，然后用它们和某个特定的善良角色进行交易。

original: With the Lead Belly perk, you take 50% less radiation every time you drink from an irradiated water source.
translation: 有了“铅肚皮”特长，每次在受辐射的水源饮水, 你受到的辐射量都会减少50％。

original: With each rank in the Life Giver perk, you gain an additional 30 Hit Points.
translation: 每个等级的强韧生命这项能力，都将使你的生命力上升30点。

original: With the Light Step perk, you'll never set off an enemy's mines or floor-based mechanical traps.
translation: 拥有“身轻如燕”这项特长后，你就再不会触发地雷或安装在地面上的陷阱机关了。

original: With the Daddy's Boy perk, a male character gains an additional 5 points to both the Science and Medicine skills.
translation: 拥有子承父业这项能力，男性角色将在科学和医疗方面各获得5点技能点。

original: With the Daddy's Girl perk, a female character gains an additional 5 points to both the Science and Medicine skills.
translation: 拥有女承父业这项能力，女性角色将在科学和医疗方面各获得5点技能点。

original: The Little Leaguer perk improves your melee weapons and explosives skills, making you that much more efficient with a melee weapon or grenades.
translation: 棒球小子这项能力提升你的近战与爆破技能，让你更熟练的使用近战武器和手榴弹。

original: When you take the Master Trader perk, the price of every item you buy from a vendor is reduced by 25%.
translation: 拥有大奸商这项能力，购物时，每样物品的价格都会下调25％。

original: With the Mister Sandman perk, you can perform a special move that instantly kills any sleeping character, and will gain bonus XP for doing so.
translation: 有了“睡魔先生”这个特长，你可以杀死任意正在熟睡中的角色，你也会因此会得到额外的经验值。

original: With the Finesse perk, you gain an additional +5% chance to score a critical hit on an opponent in combat.
translation: 有了“战略大师”这个特长，你在战斗中对敌人的暴击率可以提高5%。

original: With the Mysterious Stranger perk, your own personal guardian angel will appear occasionally in V.A.T.S. mode to lend a hand... with deadly efficiency.
translation: 拥有“神秘客”这项特长，你的守护天使有时会在V.A.T.S.模式下突然现身，助你一臂之力……而他从不失手。

original: You've been pushed around long enough! With the Nerd Rage perk, your Strength is raised to 10 and you gain 50% to Damage Resistance whenever your Health drops to 20% or below.
translation: 已经够了，你再也不想受人摆布了！拥有书虫也疯狂这项能力，每当你体力低于20%，你的力量属性将提升至10点，同时你的伤害免疫力将增加50%。

original: The Ninja perk grants you the power of the fabled shadow warriors, and increases your chance to do critical hits, and the damage of each.
translation: “忍者”这项特长将赐予你传说中暗影武士的力量，提高你使出暴击的几率和伤害。

original: With the Paralyzing Palm perk, you will sometimes perform a special V.A.T.S. palm strike that paralyzes your opponent for 30 seconds.
translation: 拥有“迷魂掌”这个特长，你在V.A.T.S.模式下将有几率使出一记震天掌，让你的敌人瘫倒在地30秒。

original: With the Pyromaniac perk, you do +50% damage with fire-based weapons, like the Flamer and Shishkebab.
translation: 有了“纵火狂”这个特长，你使用火焰武器（比如火焰喷射器和火焰刀）时的伤害将提高50％。

original: Rad Resistance allows you to -- what else? -- resist radiation. This Perk grants an additional 25% to Radiation Resistance.
translation: 辐射抗性能让你……还用说吗？——当然是抵抗辐射了。这个特长可以让你的辐射抗性增加25%。

original: With the Robotics Expert perk, you do an additional 25% damage to any robot in combat.
translation: 拥有“机器人专家”这项特长，你对机器人造成的伤害提高25%。

original: Each rank of the Scoundrel perk raises your Speech and Barter skills by 5 points.
translation: “厚颜无耻”特长的每一级都会使你的口才和交易技能提升5点。

original: With the Scrounger perk, you'll find considerably more ammunition in containers than you normally would.
translation: 有了“翻箱倒柜”这个特长, 你在搜刮时可以比原先找到更多的弹药。

original: With the Silent Running perk, you gain 10 points to your Sneak skill, and running no longer factors into a successful sneak attempt.
translation: 拥有衔枚疾走这项能力，你的潜行技能将+10，而且就算跑步，你也不会跳出潜行模式了。

original: With the Sniper Perk, your chance to hit an opponent's head in V.A.T.S. is significantly increased.
translation: 有了“狙击手”这个特长, 你在V.A.T.S.模式下对目标头部的命中率将显著提升。

original: With the Solar Powered perk, you gain an additional 2 points to Strength when in direct sunlight, and slowly regenerate lost Health.
translation: 有了“太阳能”这个特长，在阳光照射下，你将会得到额外的2点力量属性，并且能缓慢恢复生命值。

original: With the Strong Back perk, you can carry 50 more pounds of equipment.
translation: 有了“善背”特长，你就能多携带50磅的装备。

original: With each rank in the Swift Learner perk, you gain an additional 10% to total Experience Points whenever Experience Points are earned.
translation: “天赋异禀”特长每升一级，你每次获取经验值的时候都能得到10％的额外奖励。

original: The Tag! perk allows you to select a fourth Skill to be a Tag Skill, meaning it immediately raises by 15 points.
translation: “标牌! ”特长允许你再选择一个技能作为“标牌技能”，一旦选择，该技能立刻增加15点。

original: With each rank of the Thief perk, you gain an immediate bonus of 5 points to both the Sneak and Lockpick skills.
translation: 每升一级小偷这个额外能力，你的潜行和开锁技能都会立即增加5点。

original: With the Toughness perk, you gain +10% to overall Damage Resistance.
translation: 拥有健壮过人这项能力，你将多获得10%的总伤害免疫。

original: Yao Guai are fast, powerful predators, and are descended from the area's black bears.
translation: 妖怪是迅猛的捕食者，它们由这个地区的黑熊演变而来。

original: Disabling the antennae of insects, like the Giant Ants, will make them frenzy and attack anything nearby.
translation: 打断昆虫的触角，比如巨型蚂蚁，就会让它们陷入癫狂，袭击任何临近的生物。

original: Super Mutants are often accompanied by Centaurs, which serve as "watchdogs" and alert their masters to danger.
translation: 超级变种人常有多脚兽伴随左右，它们就如＂看门狗＂，提醒自己的主人警惕危险。

original: Throughout the years since the bombs first fell, dogs have remained largely unaltered by radiation.
translation: 奇怪的是，自首颗核弹被投下以来，狗群大都未受到放射线的影响发生变异。

original: Deathclaws are some of the most frightening creatures ever encountered by settlers in the Capital Wasteland. Their speed and ferocity are matched only by the size of their claws...
translation: 死亡爪是废土移民所能遭遇的最可怕的生物。它们的灵敏与凶残，只有自身的利爪能比肩。

original: Eyebots spread President Eden's pre-recorded Enclave message throughout the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 机器眼将伊甸总统事先录制的英克雷的信息传遍华盛顿废土。

original: Feral Ghouls have lost the ability to reason, and will attack any human on sight.
translation: 狂尸鬼已经丧失理性，它们会攻击视野范围内的所有人类。

original: Ghouls, both "normal" and Feral, are not only immune to radiation... they're healed by it.
translation: 尸鬼们，无论是“正常”还是“狂暴”，不仅对辐射免疫，还能利用其治疗自己。

original: A Glowing One is a unique Feral Ghoul that has become a living conduit of radiation.
translation: 发光尸鬼是一种特殊的狂尸鬼，它们的身体早已变成了一座移动的核辐射炉。

original: Mirelurk Kings use a devastating sonic attack to debilitate their foes from afar.
translation: 泥沼蟹王从远处用破坏性的音波来削弱敌人。

original: The Mister Gutsy model of robot was commissioned by the U.S. Army just before the atomic apocalypse of 2077.
translation: 狂风先生是由美国军方在2077年核战争前委托生产的一种机器人。

original: The sturdy Protectron model of robot was created before the great war, and served as a security automaton in both the private and business sectors.
translation: 坚固的保卫者机器人是在伟大战争前制造的，曾作为安保自动机器人被广泛应用于商界和私人住宅领域。

original: The Robobrain, constructed by General Atomics International before the great nuclear war, is unique in that it uses an actual organic brain as its central processor.
translation: 机器脑是由通用原子能国际组织在战前设计生产的。它最独特的地方，便是利用真人的大脑器官作为它的中央处理器。

original: The Overseer is the incontestable leader of Vault 101, and his word is law.
translation: 监督者是101号避难所不容质疑的领袖，他的话就是法律。

original: At age 10, every Vault 101 resident receives a Pip-Boy 3000 personal information processor.
translation: 10岁时，每名101号避难所的居民都将得到一台哔哔小子3000型个人信息处理机。

original: At age 16, every Vault 101 resident takes the Generalized Occupational Aptitude Test, or G.O.A.T., which helps determine job placement.
translation: 16岁时，每名101号避难所的居民都得参加被称为G.O.A.T的“通用职业倾向测试”，为他们未来的择业提供参照。

original: Vault 101 security officers are hand-picked by the Overseer himself for their discretion and loyalty.
translation: 101号避难所的警员均由监督者亲自挑选，他们言行谨慎，忠贞不二。

original: Vault 101's residents remain protected from the outside world, with the exception of the occasional Radroach attack.
translation: 101号避难所的居民受到保护免受外部世界的侵害，唯有偶发的辐射蟑螂入侵除外。

original: A weapon's DAM indicates its approximate damage, and is modified by factors like the weapon's condition, and your associated skill.
translation: 武器的DAM标志了它的近似伤害，这个数值受到武器状态及相关技能的修正。

original: Press and hold your Pip-Boy button to turn the Pip-Boy light off and on.
translation: 按住哔哔小子按键不放，就可以打开或关闭哔哔小子上的照明灯。

original: The light generated from your Pip-Boy light actually makes you less stealthy. If you want to effectively sneak, turn it off.
translation: 哔哔小子的照明灯差点让你显了形！如果你希望潜行时更不容易被发现，请务必关闭照明。

original: Mirelurks are naturally armored throughout their body... with the exception of the face. Try using V.A.T.S. to target this area, and kill them before they get close enough to attack.
translation: 泥沼蟹周身被坚硬的铠甲覆盖，唯有面部是个例外。在它近到能够伤到你之前，尝试用避难所科技辅助瞄准系统瞄准这个部位将它击杀。

original: No job is too nasty for the mercenaries of Talon Company. If you encounter these heartless opportunists, be prepared for a fight to the death.
translation: 对鹰爪公司的雇佣兵来说，工作没有“正直”和“龌龊”之分。如果你遇到这些冷酷的投机分子，就做好死战的准备吧。

original: Raiders take whatever they want, whenever they want, and their favorite pastimes are torture and murder.
translation: 无论何时，歹徒都毫无顾忌，他们想拿什么就拿什么。他们最喜欢的娱乐是拷问和谋杀。

original: Disable a robot's Combat Inhibitor, and the confused machine will go into a killing frenzy, attacking friend and foe alike.
translation: 如果能关闭机器人的战斗抑制器，它将分不清敌我，从而变成彻头彻脑的杀戮机器。

original: Historical algorithms engaged. Processing Capital Post articles. Extrapolating American cultural references.
translation: 历史演算已执行。首都邮报文章处理中，美国文化指涉推算中。

original: Loading Tranquility Lane simulation. Please stand by.
translation: 正在读取宁静巷拟真程序，请静候片刻。

original: Vault-Tec prototype simulation engaged. Active program: Tranquility Lane.
translation: 避难所科技原型拟真程序已执行。激活：宁静巷。

original: Accept your perceived reality.
translation: 接受你感知的真实。

original: Child at Heart
translation: 童心未泯

original: The Child at Heart perk greatly improves your interactions with children, usually in the form of unique dialogue choices.
translation: 童心未泯这个特长可以填补你和小孩之间的代沟, 让你在和儿童对话时能够显示特别选项。

original: Little Leaguer
translation: 棒球小子

original: Years as the Vault little league MVP have honed your hitting and throwing. With every rank, you gain 5 points of Melee Weapons skill and 5 points of Explosives skill.
translation: 身为避难所棒球联盟MVP的日子磨练了你的打击和投掷技能，该能力每升一级，你将获得5点近战武器技能和5点爆破技能。

original: Master Trader
translation: 大奸商

original: When you take the Master Trader perk, the price of every item you buy from a vendor is reduced by 25%.
translation: 你学会了死缠烂打的砍价神功，购物时，每样物品的价格都会下降25%。

original: Thief
translation: 小偷

original: With each rank of the Thief perk, you gain an immediate bonus of 5 points to both the Sneak and Lockpick skills.
translation: 每升一级小偷这个额外能力，你的潜行和开锁技能都会立即增加5点。

original: Iron Fist
translation: 铁拳

original: With the Iron Fist perk, you do an additional 5 points of Unarmed damage per rank.
translation: 每级铁拳这个额外能力让你的空手伤害增加5点。

original: Daddy's Boy
translation: 子承父业

original: Just like dear old Dad, you've devoted your time to intellectual pursuits. You gain an additional 5 points to both the Science and Medicine skills.
translation: 和爸爸一样，你专心于脑力工作，你的科技能力和医疗技能增加5点。

original: Gun Nut
translation: 枪迷

original: You're obsessed with using and maintaining a wide variety of conventional firearms. With each rank of the Gun Nut perk, you gain an additional 5 points to the Small Guns and Repair skills.
translation: 你痴迷于使用和保养各种各样的常规枪械， 每升一级枪迷这个特殊能力，你的小型枪械技能和修理技能增加5点。

original: Scoundrel
translation: 厚颜无耻

original: Take the Scoundrel perk, and you can use your wily charms to influence people -- each rank raises your Speech and Barter skills by 5 points.
translation: 你的脸皮可能有城墙拐弯那么厚，有了厚颜无耻这个额外能力，你可以用你厚黑学的艺术来影响他人。 每一级提高你的口才技能和交易技能各5点。

original: Contract Killer
translation: 职业杀手

original: Once you have the Contract Killer perk, any good character you kill will have an ear on their corpse. This ear can then be sold to a certain person (whose identity is disclosed when you take the perk) for caps and negative Karma.
translation: 拥有了职业杀手这个额外能力, 你杀死任何善良人士之后,在尸体上能得到一个耳朵,这个耳朵可以出售给指定的人( 在你得到该额外能力后, 该人的身份会给出 )换取瓶盖和善恶值。

original: Cyborg
translation: 改造人

original: You've made permanent enhancements to your body! The Cyborg perk instantly adds +10% to your Poison, and Radiation Resistances, and 10 points to the Energy Weapons skill.
translation: 你的躯体得到了永久性的增强！生化人这个额外能力使你针对普通伤害，毒素和辐射的抵抗力+10％，能量武器技能增加10点。

original: Lawbringer
translation: 赏金猎人

original: Once you have the Lawbringer perk, any evil character you kill will have a finger on their corpse. This finger can then be sold to a certain person (whose identity is disclosed when you take the perk) for caps and positive Karma.
translation: 拥有了赏金猎人这个额外能力，你杀死任何邪恶人士之后，在尸体上能得到一根手指，这个手指可以出售给指定的人（在你得到该额外能力后，该人的身份会给出）换取瓶盖和正义善恶值。

original: Impartial Mediation
translation: 八面玲珑

original: With the Impartial Mediation perk, you gain an extra 30 points to Speech... so long as you maintain a Neutral Karma level.
translation: 有了不偏不倚这个额外能力，当你的业力值为中立时，会得到额外30点口才技能。

original: Daddy's Girl
translation: 女承父业

original: Just like dear old Dad, you've devoted your time to intellectual pursuits. You gain an additional 5 points to both the Science and Medicine skills.
translation: 和爸爸一样，你专心于脑力工作，你的科技能力和医疗技能增加5点。

original: Size Matters
translation: 彪形大汉

original: You're obsessed with really big weapons. With each rank of this perk, you gain an additional 15 points to the Big Guns skill.
translation: 你痴迷于正宗的大型武器，这个额外能力每升一级，你会得到额外15点的大型枪械技能。

original: Heads
translation: 头部

original: Right Legs
translation: 右腿

original: Left Legs
translation: 左腿

original: Torso
